name: Amber India - Los Altos
description: At Amber India in Los Altos, we proudly offer an authentic North Indian dining experience that celebrates tradition. Our menu features beloved Mughlai dishes like butter chicken, biryanis, and flavorful tandoori platters, each prepared with care using classic techniques and spices. Whether you're vegetarian or enjoy meat, there's something for everyone to savor.We aim to create a warm, welcoming space where guests feel at home. With spacious indoor seating and a tranquil outdoor patio, Amber India is perfect for casual meals or special occasions. We also offer private event hosting, with a banquet room that accommodates up to 175 guests, making us a great choice for weddings, parties, or business events.For over 20 years, we've been a proud part of the Los Altos community, serving up rich flavors and heartfelt hospitality. Whether you're joining us for lunch, dinner, or our weekend brunch, we invite you to experience the food and warmth that have made Amber India a local favorite.
address: 4926 El Camino Real,  Los Altos, CA 94022
hours: Lunch: Sunday - Saturday: 11:30am - 2:30pm; Dinner: Sunday - Saturday: 5:00pm - 10:00pm

reviews.text: Good not as good as I remember from many past visits.
Highly recommended great food amazing service we will come again

My wife and I had a great experience.  We had a fantastic lunch.  My wife enjoyed her chicken tikka masala and my lamb varattu was fantastic.  Next time we’ll probably get a vegetarian dish, either aloo gobi or vegetable jalfrezi.

We’ll be back.

I specifically asked for my dish to be spicy multiple times. Not sure if the communication break down was but my dish was at best mild. Very disappointing…. Again. And on top of that they are very expensive.
Great food Each dish very distinctive flavors. Love this place and come for many special occasions

I've been eating at Amber since the early 2000s when it was further down El Camino in Mountain View. Back then, it was the considered the best Indian restaurant in the area. Sadly, once they moved to the current location in Los Altos, it has gone considerably downhill. I suspect the Pandemic also had something to do with it as well. We ordered takeout from Amber once during the pandemic and it was not good at all. It still wins "Best Indian Food" awards by local media, but I find Passage to India, further down on El Camino on the same side of the street a far superior restaurant. Both a la carte dishes and lunch buffet is just better there. 

We had a party of 6 this past Sunday to celebrate my sister's birthday. We had a 12:30 reservation and were really surprised how few patrons there were. It did fill up by the time we left but the old location used to be packed for lunch buffet. The buffet selection was decent but every since dish was abnormally spicy. Service was unfortunately below standard. There was a baby shower going on in the other room which could have diverted resources but it was still an mediocre experience. The weekend buffet price of $27.99 is also just not worth it. 6 people with the automatically added gratuity and sales tax was $218.  It used to be the pinnacle of "fine" Indian food dining. It's now just overpriced and average.
everything was excellent.  Waiters were attentive and listened to requests.  Food was outstanding and ambiance and noise level were great.  Will go here again.
Always so pleasant and the hosts and servers are so kind and polite and friendly.
Very authentic north Indian food.   Reminded me of my mother's cooking.   The service was great and fast.   We could have a relaxed and hearty meal in a comfortable setting.

For Lunch, on a weekend, we had a buffet.  One item was wrongly labeled. The person who waited our table wouldn’t even offer a smile or a kind word. Some of the items were greasier than normal.   All in all it was nothing amazing.  Fortunately for us because we went earlier than the crowd arrived it was quiet.
Time was when Amber used to set the bar. Now it’s just about mediocre for the price.

Uber India is always delicious, the venue is lovely throughout, inside the main dining room, on the courtyard patio, and in their event rooms. The service is friendly and professional. All in all, it has been and remains one of our favorite restaurants for many years.
Amber India remains one of our very favorite restaurants, as it has been for many years. The food is delicious, the ambiance is charming, and the service is impeccable.
The food is excellent and consistent. The only issue is that the service fee is 20% on top of 4% living expenses, for a total of 25% on top of published prices.

Although we've been to dozens of other Indian buffets in the past, a recent Friday lunch visit to Amber was our first try of their "brunch buffet." The pluses for me were the broccoli pakora and the saag edamame. Both were very unusual and tasty variations of buffet regulars! However, the rest of the buffet didn't measure up. There weren't that many vegetarian items, the desserts were only okay (except for the stale burfi, which was not even okay), and their watery chai was definitely not worth the $5/cup extra. The restaurant was only half full but quite noisy, the tables were placed incredibly close together, and the $27.50 was way more than this buffet was worth.
Great food as always. Monday night so I would expect quiet, but almost no one there. I hope that is not indicative.

Great ambiance, tasty foods and nice overall experience. Outdoor seating was cool. 

The tables could have been a bit larger; it was a bit congested to keep all the foods and plates. They also did not reserve a 7 member table even if we booked for 7 person, instead fit 7 people in a already small 6 persons table.

Excellent service
Delicious good
Easy parking
Quiet
Nice ambience
Not the food quality I expected for an expensive meal. The items were average at best. It has lost its touch.
Had a great time at the Speak Easy style Amber at Dusk. Great service, excellent food and refreshing cocktails… Mathew and the other staff were very friendly

Always terrific.  We visit often because we will have a reliably great food.
They have an outdoor area for dining that looks pleasant.

Went there for their Sunday “brunch”. The restaurant was busy hosting a large party in the main dining area and seemed a bit chaotic. They kept running out of food in their buffet trays and we eventually gave up on their dessert. Overall was not a great experience or value. There are better lunch/brunch buffets in the area.

The only saving grace was their hostess who was very courteous and energetic. She apologized for the food shortage, but that does not make up for the disappointment.
Everything was delicious and the service was excellent.

Our second visit at Amber India with two little ones. It was wonderful! We were seated outside. Very nice ambiance. Service was over and above. The kids got a complimentary mango laso which really delighted them. Food was excellent. We will be back.

This was our first time and we enjoyed it.
Food was very excellent!

What can I say - the place is an institution in the Bay Area - they have been around for 30 years I think and their success shows.  My daughter commented "I think everyone we know has had their major celebrations here" and it illustrates how well they do things.  Business colleagues from out of town still remind me about the place, too.  This time, my wife asked "can we just go there for dinner, not any big occasion?" so we did, and it was amazing.  We ordered differently from what we normally do - we tried Raan, and it was incredible.  If you haven't tried Frontier Kabab, definitely try it too (it is what I normally get).
We had a lovely family birthday celebration.  It was a quiet night on the patio and the food and service were fantastic.  We tried so many different dishes and all agreed we would return.
We waited an hour for our food. We’re not going back.
Great food. Informal setting. Would go again! Try the Baigan Barta.

Best Indian food on the peninsula! Great for vegetarians and carnivores alike. Love the chaat, baingan bharta, palak paneer, aloo gobi, and butter chicken. Restaurant is elegant, service is good, and critically, it's quiet enough to permit an actual conversation over dinner without having to yell! One of our regular favorites...
Always the best...highly recommend. Superb service to accompany delicious food.
Excellent food and service. Still the best Indian food on the Peninsula.
Not worthy enough for the price! Food was average and the pricey!
Food was generally cold. Served very late. Don’t think they were well prepared for Valentine’s Day crowds.

Zero courtesy shown by overworked staff. It is understaffed for its size. Staff is not very trained either. We were charged for an item they didn’t serve us and when pointed out the mistake, it was treated as an everyday matter. Only saving grace was the taste of the food. Portion sizes were tiny for price. Ambiance is decent but the live music was way too loud. They added 20% gratuity for a party of 3. Ruined a special occasion for us.

excellent food as always, however the service was really slow.  and when we got the bill, we were quite surprised to find 20% tip already tacked on - i thought that was a little cheeky to automatically include a large tip for a party of 3.  we didn't make any noise about it and just paid.  the service wasn't anything special - besides refilling of water glasses, we weren't tended to (not that we needed) at all.
One of our very favorite restaurants on the region. It is a five on all counts!
Fabulous authentic I dian food. We have loved going to Amber Restaurants over the years. Same good food service and attentive service.

I LOVE going to Amber India!  We go here for all our SPECIAL occasions!  Its a great place to take family and friends and anyone who wants fabulous food and a 5* dining experience!  The staff is wonderful and welcoming and the food is beyond amazing!  We already tell our friends to go here - its very special!
Very good Indian food - nice service, prompt, and noise level dropped later in the evening.
A wonderful restaurant that will treat you like a Rajah and ensure that you enjoy the finest Indian meal around. Highly recommended...

We visited with our manager and we were very disappointed with the food and the items served. The number of items is very very less compared to other buffets. No welcome drinks provided which is a basic thing in the buffet.
Delicious food and attentive service. My family and I love their lunch buffet.
Great. We love this restaurant. The food, the service, the atmosphere are all wonderful

The food wasn't as good as we used to think it was. We've had much better tandoor chicken at other Indian restaurants. The nan and onion kulcha were very good as was the salmon. The chicken tikka masala was ordinary and the lamb was over-cooked.
One of the best North Indian places in the Bay Area which is a fertile ground for Indian restaurants.

Slightly hard to find as it is not directly on El Camino Real, but rather in the back of the parking lot of an office complex.  The food was excellent, and the service was very good.  Would happily go back.
First time there. Surpassingly good food. A bit noisy but definitely would go again
Great ambiance. I definitely enjoyed the butter chicken the most.

Nice large venue. Good service, food was good but not great.  For the price charged, I expected better taste, The Dal was a bit bland and the Garlic Naan was a bit on the crispy side. My past experience being the base line, this visit was less than great.
Excellent !

Always reliably good.  Love the chicken tikka masala and raita with nana.
They may a good G&T.  One of our favorite places for ethnic food.
Comfortable, great food, good service, an overall positive experience

As always the food is excellent 
We had dîner outside in the patio. It was quiet in open air
Wonderful lunch buffet.
Great food, great experience, great staff and felt at home.
Food was delicious, but could have been kept a little Warner in the burners.
I always get the butter chicken and refuse to try anything else, it's that good!

What a gem! We were looking for a fun and delicious dinner while visiting from out of town. Amber India was not only delicious but what an incredible treat to sit outside in the courtyard enjoying the perfect summer evening. The service, food, and ambiance were all simply perfect.  It's a flight away, but we'll be back!

Delicious food (the Tandoori chicken excellent) and attentive service. 
Would definitely go there again.

Although I am not from an Indian heritage I have eaten a lot of Indian food and on the whole can recognize the real deal. If that is what you are looking for Amber is the place to experience it. Another telltale was that we were the only non Indian customers in the restaurant.
Love this place. Service is warm and friendly, food is delicious, ambiance welcoming - checks all the boxes and has become a favorite of ours.

Appetizer plate of vege(samosa, cutlates, pakoras) was not worth it. First of all it was cold, pakoras were soft and cutlets were like eating dry green grass!!  
Other food was okay.   
Will never order appetizer , specially this dish.

Excellent meal and service
First time there recommended by a friend 
Everything was outstanding and attention to details was diligent 
Keep it up 👍
The food quality has deteriorated since my last visit a year ago
Best Indian restaurant in Bay Area. Both in terms of service as well as quality of food.
The outdoor patio was the perfect setting for our date night out.
Really Great , variety of seating options including a courtyard . Food is outstanding
Always terrific. Amber India gets better and better.
The quality of the food is not as high as the prices. Exorbitant prices for food that doesn't taste great and very normal.

Service was appallingly slow. 30 mins to get a table having made a reservation in advance. Food came out ONE HOUR after ordering, then came out cold. Sent it back, but 1 of 4 dishes still came back cold. Sent it back again, though they were reluctant to take it back claiming it was hot inside (it wasn’t).  Manager discounted one entree but should have comp’d all 4 entrees or offered additional discount for a return visit. 

Have been here before and enjoyed it, but this experience has me skeptical about going back.

We were seated outside. A mistake on a breezy, chilly evening especially. We had to insist on keeping the heater near our table until we finished paying the bill.  We really liked the chaat items more than the main entree.

I had a reservation for us at 7:00 PM and were on-time.  However, the manager at the front said that the tables are busy and it will take another 15 minutes to seat us.  When I asked him "then what is the meaning for the reservation?", he ignored me and went into busy activities.  He offered us to seat us outside, but the pungent smell of some seafood being served outside, drove us against the decision.

We were finally seated at 7:35 PM, and there wasn't even an mention of apology for the delay.  He behaved as if he was doing us a favor.  Once seated we waited another 15 minutes patiently, and finally, we had to wave and call for someone to take the order.  We ordered everything from Appetizer to main course in one stretch, along with a drink (beer).  The appetizer came in 10 minutes, but there were no sign of the beer that I ordered, even after 20 minutes. After tracking down the waiting staff, he brought it, with the mention that they were busy (the restaurant was full -- Father's day and couple of graduation dinners going on). but no mention of sorry or any other apology.
Food was decent, and by the time we started eating it was around 8:30 PM; we finished our food by 9:00 and then called for the dessert menu. We were told, that all they have is Gulab Jamun and Rice Pudding (usually the ones served during lunch buffet at Amber).  So they weren't even prepared for that evening. 
Finally, I was appalled to see a mandatory 20% Gratuity (for the three of us), and when I asked the staff as to whether it was standard, we were told that they were doing that on that day. Knowing fully well, they will not provide any service to anyone, they decided to rake up 20% Tips, whether someone was happy or not with the service.
Essentially, I am done with this place.  (Am sure  they don't care), although I have been going to this place for the past 25 years.
Occasional service blips are normal, but the attitude was simply terrible. That is humble opinion.
Great service. Really good service. Our favorite Indian restaurant!!

Quality and variety of the food was good.  I also found the service good.  Noise was a bit off the charts because there were a few large parties celebrating graduations.  Could go for maybe one more meat option on the buffet (there was a lamb curry, a fish curry and tandoori chicken).  The tandoori chicken was a little dry.  My friend had the fish curry and loved it.  Overall it was a good dining experience and I would come back.
Wonderful staff and excellent food

Too expensive for the food. The service was very bad for being a premium restaurant. I was here for a business dinner and the person serving us kept pressuring us to order and dropped our check without us even asking for it while we were still eating! Not worth it. There are much better options in this area that will beat this restaurant in all aspects.

Would not recommend for the Mother's Day brunch.  Although there was an abundance of choices, I felt the quality was not as good as ordering off the menu.  We had gone to the Mother's Day brunch a few years ago as well as the daily buffet several times there and it was wonderful.  This year, some of the dishes were barely warm.  The pretty stainless food servers did not keep the food warm and the large top was difficult to manage.  The server gave us a beverage menu with no prices on it and no one mentioned that chai was included in the buffet price.  The servers were very attentive - running everywhere to serve drinks and naan and clear tables. I hope they got the 18% tip that was automatically added on  The poori station was great with a gal rolling them out and frying them right there.  But next to that was another station which we had no idea what it was and the fellow said nothing to us and didn't even ask if we would like to try it. I didn't realize it was a different dish until I saw others with bowls of it.   The many desserts and the many different choices of biryani and quantity of dishes were an improvement over the 
MD brunch a few years ago but the quality was not as good.

Service is a little spotty - they took a long time to take a drink order, then brought the appetizers before the drinks arrived. The tables are kind of small too, a table for four feels cramped. The food is good, as always. The old location was better.
Upscale restaurant with Indian food and quiet seating area.
Always excellent. So many flavors and totally delicious.
Easter with family. It was good.

It was over priced. Dinner for two of us was $120. That was crazy. Had 1 drink each, chicken and lamb dish, portions were small, $3 rice, $3 naan, samosas (small). I do not think I will be going back soon.
The team is so good with our kids and our friends' kids too when we gather for a fun outdoors at the fabulous patio.
The lunch buffet was well balanced and delicious; a little something for everyone.
Great birthday dinner!

This was our first trip to Amber India, at my daughter's suggestion for her birthday.  She is vegetarian and there were a number of good vegetarian options.   The service was fast and attentive and the food tasty.  We had samosas for appetizers and shared several entrees family style.  We ordered the naan bread with goat cheese (very good) and roti also.  The one disappointment was finding a couple of pieces of bone in the butter chicken (the one non-vegetarian dish we ordered) which put a damper on the rest of the dinner and made me cautious when taking additional bites. We will likely come back to try some of the other dishes that we did not get a chance to try this time.

Great tasting food. Wonderful range and fairly priced. Not a very service oriented place. Quality responsiveness from staff lacking at times. Had to call people every time for things.
Overall a decent place. Would go there again for the food.

We asked to be seated outside. So we got lovely seating by the fireplace. We got our menus. After that - We did not get any attention for ~40 minutes. There was no other guest seated outside. Out of sight out of mind I guess? The food and drinks were delicious and ambiance is great. I'll definitely come back but I'll walk over inside to place order next time.

Yes, the only annoying thing that I had to deal with was the fact that I had to remind for a 3rd time that I was attending a birthday celebration (once in the filing of the OpenTable reservation and another when I called to confirm my reservation) and that to explain that my cousin whose birthday we were celebrating did not receive any birthday dessert until I informed management. Why go through the ordeal 3 times when it could have been avoided? I will acknowledge that we received good service and that a mistake in understanding the menu was resolved and we did receive complimentary naan.
Taste- great,  however prices are way up with much smaller portions .  4% surcharge for wages, reflected in smaller tip.
Chicken ka tikka, was very bad, something that was rushed when the initial order was missed.
Flavorful food, no ambiance, acoustics made it very difficult to hear across the table, service was average, very expensive for this average experience.
We are new to Indian cuisine in general and the waitstaff helped us out immensely. Every dish picked for us was delicious. Would come back again in a heartbeat.

There are plenty of Indian restaurants that have good food but Amber is one of the few that offers a fine dining experience. Everything we had was delicious but we particularly enjoyed the assorted vegetable platter and mirchi ka gosht. Service was attentive and quick.

My husband is super picky about seating - like super picky - and this place worked for us! The tables are appropriately spaced so your not right up on top of your neighbor like so many restaurants today.  The service was great, the menu has tons of delicious options and the food was really good. Oh - and the drinks were stiff and tasty! I will def. go back!!
Very few options in buffet compared to amount charged. Only pakode in starter n in desserts only 2items. Was expecting more as already charging high compare to other restaurants offering buffet.
Valentines Day.  Good food.  Great ambience.
Impeccable service, delicious food.  We had the Valentine Day’s special and it did not disappoint! We love Amber!
Amazing tasty food and great ambience . Good amount of choices of drinks. Plenty of options for vegetarians.

On the whole, most of the food in the buffet was very tasty, the waiter was good, the ambiance was nice - pleasant atmosphere. 

Unfortunately, I think they forgot that I said it was my friend's birthday and so they did not bring a dessert with candle, as promised.

Some of the curries in the buffet were too spicy but were not labeled as such. It would be good to know which ones are very spicy and which ones are not.
Food was delicious and servers were pleasant. Service was a bit slow.
The Butter Chicken is a house specialty and was delicious.

Fantastic Indian food in a beautiful setting.  The Tandoori Chicken was tender and packed with flavor.  The Bengan Bartha (eggplant) was delicious.  The menu is on the expensive side as Indian restaurants go, but well worth it!
Loved amber for great northern indian food. Had the goan fish curry and it had large pieces of fish in it. We had the platter for starters and it was a good selection. Really enjoyed our meal
We had provided special requests for a birthday which was ignored. The waiters needed to be summoned for drink orders did not come over.
$185 for two people, no wine and one cocktail and one beer. Totally overpriced for Indian fusion with small plates and no real food.  Will not be back.
Always fresh and a variety of dishes in the buffet. Very excellent service. Staff attentive.

Food and service was great, but the atmosphere is too noisy.
I expected the noise to be a problem during the first 90 minutes of their weekday lunch buffet, but also uncomfortably noisy in the evening.
Average, but perhaps our expectations of Indian food are high following 6 years living in the uk which undoutably has the best Indian food outside India itself.

My only issue with this location is when there are people with kids and parents are not monitoring them it very annoying.  kids are touching the buffet food/utensils. etc.  There should be a sign that says parents need to watch their kids or they would be asked to leave.  I don't pay $20 per head to come and see kids throwing fruit back in the fruit salad bowl or jumping up and down screaming.  thank you!

They messed up on packing the left overs. I ordered vegetarian food and asked them to pack the left overs. Upon reaching home, I discovered they handed me someone else’s non-vegetarian left over food that we ended up throwing away. We had substantial food left over.
Our first time at this location - excellent service and food was great. Note that menus are not identical at all locations. Easy parking. We’ll be back!
Always delicious, authentic food in a beautiful setting. I have a lovely time every time I come here, and they have the best Mango Lassi I have ever had!
As always the food was outstanding!  They are consistently the best Indian food restaurant in the bay area!
Best Indian in Bay area.  A tad more expensive, but worth it.  Never a bad meal at Amber India

The service was pretty bad, we were a table of 7, and they needed to be flagged multiple times to take our order, and didn't take the entire table's order. The food's description and what was brought out was very different. Not very authentic food. At best the food is mediocre.

Although still a very good restaurant with tasty dishes, both service and quality have declined a bit since my last visit.  First, ALL our dishes arrived in a sort of luke-warm state and so had to be sent back to be warmed up a bit.  Second, in order to get something extra, such as another drink or some raita, the request had to be made several times in order to be conveyed upstream to someone who could either understand the request or effect it.  Still a nice place and the food is tasty, but attention to quality is warranted.

Although food was very good, towards the end of our meal but before we had ordered our dessert and while still drinking our bottle of wine, the manager made us feel harassed as he kept coming back first with a premature bill and then every 3-5 mins for payment.  Very poor taste on his part.
The charming outdoor lights on a Mediterranean-style patio get need every time. This place is joy.

Food was excellent. We went as a group of 6.  Everyone likes the ambience and food. The downside was though we reserved for a particular time we were kept waiting for 20 minutes. So reservations are not useful at this restaurant. They often tend to put you outside in the patio and hence I had reserved it. But the wait was the same.

I ❤️ Amber India and have eaten there for many years at the current and former locations.  The food is always delicious and the service outstanding!  I enjoy the buffets as well and the selection of items exceeds those of your competitors in tha local area.  My two guests visiting from New York City enjoyed their meals (and cocktails/wine) and we are still eating our delicious leftovers.  THANK YOU VERY MUCH!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our dinner at Amber - we tried the butter chicken, which was delicious, and a wonderful starter of fried califlower in a spicy sauce that was amazing.  We also enjoyed the goat cheese naan and our eggplant entree.  Very good meal!
Very loud group in dining room.

One of my two go to places for excellent North Indian food with ambiance. Dinner is good. Lunch buffet is a tad less good than Sakoon because of the choice. The vegetarian stuff is pretty good, especially their kadhi.

Good food and service and always consistent. This is a great place for dinner if you like Indian food. The ambiance is nice and the prices are very reasonable for the quality of the food.  We are fans and recommend them to anyone who asks.

I have never been disappointed with the food at this restaurant.  Consistently good and traditionally prepared.  Nice atmosphere and courteous and efficient wait staff.  The weekend buffet has a lot of choices and the price for the quality is reasonable.
Great food and great service...Baljit Purba our server was exceptionally courteous , efficient, attentive and overall outstanding. One of our favorite restaurants

One of the worst dinner meals in the Bay Area!
Hara kabob was super crappy - was so dry and over cooked. Chole reminded me off Delhi roadside stall. Paneer  Handi came with 6 peices of paneer.
The roti was the worst.. it was dry and cold!! Onion kulcha was half cooked and I we could the flour.

We complained and the restaurant replaced the paneer and all the rotis. This was the only good part of the evening, as we did not want a huge argument.

The bill came with 20% gratuity already added!!! We were just two people at dinner and it’s super unfair for the restaurant to add such amount!! We just wanted to leave.

Never going back again and won’t recommend this place ever to anyone..
Great food and high quality lunch buffet allows my husband and I to try more dishes than during a normal dinner order.

Too pricey. Food was just 'hot' but no flavor.
Too noisy.
The service was good.
One of our favorite local restaurants, in a charming venue.  The food is outstanding!

The food at Amber India - Los Altos was excellent.  Authentic Indian cuisine, not the more common "North American" version of Indian food.  The service was outstanding - the wait staff was very attentive.  The only downside was that we ate outside and one of the space heaters wasn't working, so some of our party were cold.  Otherwise the evening was excellent.
Great food and service combined with reasonable prices. We will definitely go back!
Outdoor seating was very nice.  Food and service was top notch.  Great venue for a group meal.
I think you can go there for any occasion. Great food, great service, and great ambience 👍🏼👍🏼

We're big fans of Amber and have been eating there since the early '90s (?).  This review is specifically about a recent visit.

We were disappointed that the kachori appetizer is no longer on the menu.
We had the hara bhara kabab instead - it was not as good.

We usually come here for the dum aloo and either the tandoori platter or one of the lamb dishes - they are consistently delicious.  These dishes are not on the menu at the Santana Row location, and it's worth going to the Los Altos location for the different dishes available there.

Although we preferred the ambience of the older Mountain View location, the new Los Altos location has some benefits, including outdoor dining and space for private events upstairs.
Lovely variety,  excellent spices,  great service,  convenient location.
Very loud, busy, only 3 dishes lactose free, slow slow service

Had samosas for starters and then butter chicken and lamb tandoori for main course.  The garlic naan was well balanced without the strong punch so many are known for.  Overall, the preparation and service were top notch!
Food was great.  Service was prompt as well.  Noise level was too high inside, it's hard to engage in a conversation without raising your voice.

Visiting on business trip and nervous b/c colleague "foodie" wanted Indian food.   Researched the area and reviews, decided on Amber.  BOY, DID I CHOOSE WELL!!!   The food was delish, the atmosphere was perfect, was seated right away and delicious rum drinks!   Best of all, my FOODIE SNOB WAS THRILLED WITH THE FOOD AND THE AMBIANCE!!!!   CHEERS!!!!
This is the best Indian restaurant in the Bay Area. It has an extensive menu with a large variety of choices and the dishes are expertly prepared.
Love the new location and ambiance. The sea bass and butter chicken were both to die for.

See my Yelp review - food was way below the reputation it has. Not going there again. Friends agree this Amber chain food has deteriorated this last year. Menu items are ordinary. Flavors are no longer rich. No creativity that it once had. Cheap items, e.g. for desert. Noisy family next to us was not asked to be quiet. Goodbye Amber until I hear otherwise from friends.

I have been going to this restaurant for at least 20 years and it is always exceptional.  They have a wonderful atmosphere and exceptional service.  They also have a great take-out option at a 10% discount.
Nice ambience. Probably the best Indian food in town.

Best Indian meal I have had in the Bay Area. It us a littl pricey but so worth it. Totally enjoyed the outdoor courtyard space. Noise level was lively but not overwhelming. Highly recommend the kashmiri naan breads. Best I have ever had.

Wonderful experience. Great cocktails, authentic Indian food, and impeccable service. I will be back whenever I can.

The cucumber martini, tandoori sea bass, and garlic naans are a must.
Outstanding!
Delicious and well prepared Indian food.  Great Service.  Enjoyed the patio seating with heat lamps to take the chill off the cool evening air.
Pleasant evening dining on the patio.  Flavorful food, excellent service.  Couldn’t have been better.
Excellent N Indian food. Both lunch & dinner a la carte are good. Ambiance is good. Service is friendly. One of the few Indian places, besides Sakoon & Ugadi, that i recommend to others & visit often

Even though there were many people dining, the noise level was quite acceptable for conversations... This "new" location's construction may have had something to do with it... the sounds of many people wasn't being amplified by bouncing off walls and ceiling like some restaurants...
Awesome, delicious food. If vegetarian, the veg platter combo is great. If pescatarian, try the amazing tandoori salmon (this one is great for kids too).

A far cry from the Amber of several years ago.  Nothin g special - probably explains why were were only one of three tables filled.  There are many innovative Indian restaurants out there now, and after fifteen years we will stop going to the over-priced, underwhelming Amber in Los Altos.
Not the same as it used to be; flavors not as rich. Used to love the food here. Still love the ambiance.

I knew this restaurant is costly as I had been there once before. Still I thought to give it another try for the ambience and booked a dinner appointment for two at this place and yet they didn't give us seat on patio. Also, the staff was too busy in handling bigger parties that they were not even coming to take order for like 15 minutes. I tried to ask the attenders on the nearby tables but they were completely ignoring us. The food is super expensive and is not that great. I found it a total waste to go there. Only patio ambience is good but that is limited. And main thing is they don't care about the customers. I have never been this ignored in any restaurant.
The food is consistently good, really the best Indian food in the Palo Alto/Los Altos area.

I explicitly requested the palak to be not spicy/no chilies, and tandoori fish to be cooked rare, not burnt/blackened/charred on outside. My server assured us that can be done. Unfortunately, the palak arrived with couple red chilies on/in it (I set them aside to show him) and tasted 4 spicy (1-5 hot scale). The server said he’ll have it redone, plain “like for a baby”. It returned diluted with cream and any remaining chili taken out (2.5 spicy level). The 2 entrees, tandoori salmon and seafood combo were moderately charred and fish were cook medium-rare. I showed my server and he told me “that’s all we can do”. I ordered yogurt to neutralize the palak spiciness and mask any charring. We had half of our dinner to-go.
Food was fantastic. The ambiance was very nice. And when you finished dining, you would not smell like food. A great place to get together with friends or coworkers to have a nice meal.
Food was not as good as I remembered. The buffer opens at 11:30am, but not all of the food was ready at 11:30am. The naan was very dry.
It was super noisy. We barely could talk.
Excellent as always for traditional Indian cuisine. A bit on the rich side but it depends what you order.
Tasty food and good service. Cocktails are just ok. If you can sit on the patio, it is very pleasant. The service we received was good, except that one of our drinks never showed up.
Excellent food!!  Service in the patio outside could improve.  I enjoyed it and will repeat.
We had a nice dinner and get together. The main dining area is still reminiscent of the old mountain view experience. The cocktails lounge is a true achievement.
Good service and friendly atmosphere.  Will be back
We keep visiting this place. Love the food and the ambience.
We had several vegetarian items. Most of them were excellent and mild; okra curry was a bit spicy.  The service was very good as well.

The food and service were excellent as usual. It was so noisy, however, we could not hear one another—which really ruined the whole evening.  I would only recommend going there at off hours or with people you don’t want to talk to.

Excellent cuisine with graceful service.   Amazing menu that leaves you ready for a return visit because there are so many wonderful options.  Our only regret was sitting indoors as the noise level made conversation among four a challenge.  Restaurant could not find my reservation but accommodated us.
Amber India gave our family a great birthday experience with food we love.
Excellent food and service.
The most delicious, elegant and complex Indian food to be found anywhere on the Peninsula - hands down, and consistently served over many years.
Quality of the food wasn't there for the price we paid.
Delicious Indian food done well with ton of flavors.
Many curries were salty
Birthday lunch
Amber India in Los Altos is always reliably good.   Delicious food and good service.
Mixed vegetarian was varied some dishes spicy others less so.  Tandoori lamb was enjoyed by my companion
It's a good place to eat. Good food .My family and friends had a good time at this place. We will recommend  and will be back again.
The food was great. Ambience was just fine.
Food is always good, but if you can't handle too much spice, you need to tell them "mild". Even with that, I find the food is sometimes too spicy!
It was a great valentines dinner in the downstairs private area with great good and perfect service!

I will never go to Amber India again for a special occasion. They looked to be staffed well but service was slow. Also, the room was cold, crowded, noisy, and definitely not the experience we were looking for for Valentine’s Day. The food was mediocre too. When our food came, we hardly ate since we were full after waiting so long and picking at our appetizers. And our food got cold quickly. Very disappointed.

Amber is a cut above the average north Indian restaurant. The service, the menu, the creative/traditional flavors. I don't know what they're doing in the kitchen, but everything just tastes better at Amber. The spinach paneer is luscious and rich and delicious and -- spinach. The malai kofta is spicy and warm and tomatoey and wonderful. I ate the leftovers for breakfast.
Food is exceptional; staff pleasant and attentive. Great Indian food on the peninsula
My Tandoori chicken was cooked just right, succulent, yet fabulous taste! We loved each dish so this will be our new favorite restaurant!!

Lovely space. Attentive staff. Nice location off the main road. Wanted to love the food. The raita just wasn’t spiced right. The lamb in my meal didn’t taste fresh. It tasted old. I had high hopes but what I ordered was just not that good.

Wonderful neighborhood restaurant. Good for everyday dining as well as for special occasions. Service is great. Full bar and wines by the glass. Peshawari Chicken Tikka and Paneer Elaichi Pasanda were delicious!

My husband & I enjoy Indian food occasionally and we find this new Amber India delightfully attractive. Ordering takes some skill & it would be nice if the staff was more helpful in explaining portion size etc. . It is often quite empty in recent visits & we hope it’s ok.
Not bad but not awesome.  Some dishes like the lentil dishes didn’t do it for me.
Vegetarian dishes were good but the meat was bland; service was disappointing and price was high.  This used to be out favorite place but the quality and service has been inconsistent
Delicious  food.  Service was very friendly, thoughtful and quick.
Good as always and enjoyed all the dishes we ordered.
Tandoor and Dal was great. The Rasgulla was not spongy at all. Paneer was mediocre

I️ was disappointed. Amber was a favorite. It was my “Go to” for delicious Indian food. This was my first time in their new location. I️ feel the menu was not what it used to be. The food —paneer, cherry bread and samosa was ok. Sadly,
I️ will not be returning. It was quite expensive—I️ want it to be a treat for that price. I️ prefer other Indian Restaurants.

Great food, good service, nice ambiance.
Our daughter wants to go there every birthday!
Food was excellent, service awesome! Thanks
We love Amber and, even though we live over 60 miles away from this restaurant, go there several times a year. But we thought the food was well below its usual standard of excellent.
Amber is simply the best! If you like Indian food, you will love Amber. Great people and excellent  cuisine. Friendly, cordial, hospitable, all the adjectives. I recommend it highly.

Very nice place to have quality Indian food in a good environment. The service is friendly and fast. Very good vegetarian options. Went to celebrate a birthday with two young kids. It was well worth it.
Really good food, great ambiance (especially the patio) and great service. The only thing I thought could be better was the prices...they're a bit on the pricier side.
Great location for sophisticated Indian food. Pricey but they can tweak the spice level to your tastebuds. Top notch service.
Great food, fast service,  comfortable table placement, and attractive decoration with lots of natural light.
The service and food was great!

The food was OK but the service was way too fast! We barely had time to swallow our last bite of appetizer that the meal was on the table. We were there for a birthday party and wanted to enjoy the evening. We ended up ordering, eating and paying within 55 minutes for 4 people. Food was OK, way too much cilantro in some dishes (for my taste) but the low rating is really due to the speed of the service NOT the quality of it. Quality of service was great.
Buffet food was excellent (as always).  Great selection and considering the high quality, not overpriced.
Amber is always reliably good for the quality of tasty food, generous portions and attentive service.   We look forward to  an evening meal with friends at Amber.
Lovely dinner n the patio before the theater. Excellent service and delicious food.
My favorite Indian restaurant. Chicken tikka Marsala & lamb vindaloo with naan is always perfect. Service is always excellent and friendly.
There's only one issue, the head waiter was wearing too much cologne which can affect your palette.
The best Indian food in the Bay Area, great Tandoiry selection (esp the Salmon)...

Good place for Indian food. We have dined here several times.  Each time, service needs improvement.  Servers are not the most personable.  Our glasses of water were served lukewarm (it was a warm day).  I asked for ice only to request it a second time from a second server after waiting 15 minutes.
Pricey at dinner. Lunch buffet is great!
Great as always, love this place. Delicious lamb vindaloo and chicken tikka Marsala  and perfect naan.
Always great tasting and good quality Indian food. We love this place for a nice Saturday night meal.

This is our go to Indian restaurant on the Peninsula! Always great service and great food...very fresh and spices perfectly balanced!
Never disappointed :)

We are gluten and dairy free.  They have a good selection and the staff is very knowledgeable.  The service if very attentive.  They serve the dishes to your plates which makes the experience a bit more special.  I'm never disappointed here.

I have always loved Amber Indian but the new location feels so open and bright.  We ate dinner out on the patio on a warm evening.  Was very relaxing. 
As usual the food was great and the service is always fantastic.
Amazing Indian food...you must try the sea bass!

We have been here 3 times and think the setting and food very enjoyable.  We were very surprised this time at how few people were dining when we arrived as before it has been quite crowded.   We also noticed the the staff at check in was much friendlier which had been a criticism.  In fact two or three came around to ask how things were and urged us to come again!
We studied the menus before we came so knew exactly what we wanted to order.  One can order too much easily.  It was a nice sojourn and we do hope they stay open.
We always enjoy eating at Amber India. The service is great and the food excellent. The new restaurant (across the road from where it used to be) now also has a nice outdoor eating area.

Disappointed.  Service was poor perhaps because they had a full house.  But they still added 18% tip to the check for our party of five.  Much of the buffet food was cold, no heating element was placed under the trays of chicken, creamed spinach, etc.
The food and service here is really one of the best in Bay Area for Indian cuisine.
It lived up to the name.. I had tried amber in SF location but los altos was first time.. Food was authentic as reminded me of South Delhi...(delhities :: I know we are proud about our food).

It continues to be our family's go to Indian restaurant.  They have so many fresh and varied choices on their lunch buffet and even more on the weekends.  They refill the buffet table constantly with freshly prepared items and also bring you as many fresh hot naan to your table through out your meal.  The service is efficient and non-intrusive also.
Amber India is truly one of my favorites and their new location is great!
Usual high quality. Serving portions are large. Chicken kadhai is fantastic
Good food.  Great service. Comfortable setting. Easy parking.
By far the best Indian food you will find anywhere and the friendliest, most efficient staff.
I'm wondering if they have a new chef. The food used to be great, but on our last visit, it really wasn't all that good.

The food is very flavorsome and authentic Indian. A few of the dishes were very hot to a point that you cannot taste the flavors of the dish. It would have been nice if our server had guided us on the portion size as well as the hot /spiciness when ordering. The portions on the Tandoori mix grill platter were quite small and inadequate for sharing /tasting for 4 persons.  For 1-2 persons, it would be great to have a sampling / tasting menu so that one could experience the variety and savory tastes that the kitchen offers.

Love the weekend lunch there with pani poori and all sorts of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options on the extensive and fresh buffet.  They always refill all their buffet dishes constantly even toward the end of lunch.  Great place!
Great Indian food, delicious and good service.  Some people might say it's on the pricey side, but you get what you pay for, it's worth it.
The food is always good and the service efficient and friendly.   The chicken tikka masala is delicious.

The new location is much too noisy and feels like a basketball gym.  Too open.  Our group of friends much preferred the previous Mountain View location where there were three separated dining sections that allowed a feel of privacy.  This new location dining room has NO acoustics so is just a lot of noise that destroys the atmosphere.

Great Ambience.  Both outdoor and indoor seating is excellent. I will suggest all foodies to try the Sunday buffet . They have  variety of authentic Indian food which is all delicious and it is not even very expensive. No doubt lots of food seems quite rich. Keep some time aside to go for a walk after eating it. Ask for tea which is exactly the same as we drink at home in India. I love paani puri/ golgapppe there(Little spicy and delicious). Also, you don't feel pressured to leave as soon as you are done eating like most Indian restaurants in this area.

We were in town for Stanford University Parent's Weekend, and the staff blurted out "Amber" when we  said we were looking for Indian food.  The menu was pretty straightforward Indian, or at least northern Indian.  A bit on the spicy side, as the hotel staff advised, but that's the way we like it.  The food was fresh and hearty.  The waiters were very attentive.
Had to ask two different waitstaff before I could get mint tea on a rainy and cold evening. Options other than 'chai' should exist. Someone could have offered rasam or something!
Delicious and authentic food!

We were seated by a very noisey table of 6 men.  Amber is usually a very pleasant place, but this was too loud and interfered with our conversation.  The food was excellent as always.  I think they need to think about some noise abatement.  The new space is too noisy.

The service we receive here is above and beyond!! I simply ADORE the Malai Kofta.. The staff here go completely out of their way (no matter how busy they are) to make sure everything you need is taken care of. They make sure you enjoy your dining experience (that's why we can't wait to go back). Food and hospitality is the BEST!!

We have been several times and this was the least satisfactory of the occasions.  Dishes weren't great and service was slower than before.  But last times were better so we'll try it again and continue to recommend it.

The food was not as tasty as we were hoping. I had a chicken biryani that didn't live up to my expectation, and my wife thought that her lentil dish also didn't live up. The chicken biryani was served pretty cold. We were there with friends and when the food was brought out the server just assumed that we were sharing every dish and started scooping the first onto the closest plate before asking - but that wasn't the plan.
Great food

Tandoori seafood - lobster and shrimp over cooked, fish perfect
Butter chicken and alu gobi were wonderful 
Tandoori seafood was a big disappointment especially given the price! ($30)

The lunch buffet has always been outstanding consistent in quality, variety, and innovative dishes.  It's the best Indian buffet in the Bay Area esp. the even more extensive weekend buffet.  The service can't be matched either.  This is my family's go to place for authentic Indian food for both buffet and a la carte.

Food is so delicious, but the atmosphere of this location is just lacking any character at all. Feels like an airport or work cafeteria. The old one was cozy. This is stark and looks likes it's a temporary site they put in a meeting room. The other Amber restaurants are lively but not this one. Cocktails were great, but just can't dine in that depressing room again-shame because it's so close!

The food has always been over and above. Lived in INDIA for a bit. And have not found the equivalent in the US. Ambiance is love and not too loud. The have a lounge down stairs with music and dancing. We have yet to try that. The bar upstairs makes great drinks and the wait staff are kind and very professional. Amber India... The best!
Really like the new location - it has a great outdoor patio with fire and heaters! The food as always is great comfort food - classic Indian cuisine, so it's one of our family favorites
We wanted a curry dinner.  This was great.  We'll be back.

Our reservation on Christmas eve was handled promptly.  The menu is excellent and varied.  The wine list had many good to excellent choices with varied pricing.  The food itself was excellent, promptly served, clearly explained, and all around delicious.  My companion's green salad made up of relatively large pieces of vegetables was somewhat difficult to cut and eat--unlike most salads.  Overall, we enjoyed the dinner very much.
Wonderful staff and food

We like to come here when our (adult) kids are in town. It is our go to Indian restaurant, with amazing food and excellent service. The look and feel is comfortable and relaxed, but sophisticated and upscale.  It is too pricy for every day dining, but perfect for special occasions.
Great dinner, as usual.
Excellent lunch buffet with lots of vegetarian options (plus tandoori chicken, butter chicken and a curry).  The butter chicken and some of the veggies were delightfully complex and spicy.
First time at amber. Really tasty and very good service. Will be back
Excellent lunch buffet. Great selection of dishes and good service.

Amber is one of the better known Indian restaurants in the Bay Area. I went there for lunch with a few of my friends. We had their daily lunch buffet. I would say the food was good but there was nothing exceptional or noteworthy. I was disappointed that there weren't any creative choices. You could get equal or better food for less at one of the many other Indian buffets.
Amber food is very authentic and as good as food you find in India. The staff and manager is pleasant and will go out of their way to ensure that your experience at Amber is great.
Too loud, ambiance needs improvement.
Great ambience with quality buffet for lunch.  Bit expensive but worth it as service is great.  Fresh naans get dry /hard quickly (suggest order one piece ata time).

Excellent food. The Tandoori Sea Bass is to die for. The new location in Mt. View is big and roomy. Good for bigger parties. The only drawback is the noise level. Great service.  Could not be happier.

We have been to Amber India several times since they moved.  The first times we were very positive, much more so than at the old location.  This time, however, the food was rather bland or, in the case of tandoori lamb, quite dried out, so we were not as impressed.  Perhaps there was a different chef that evening or, more concerning, Amber India is returning to the style of the old location which was not that great.
Far from good, we took one veggi meal and one for the carnivores, the tastes were pretty mellow and just not exciting enough for an Indian restaurant
Food is getting spicier. 😳
This is terrible food, and to call it Indian is a joke
Fantastic service. Love the new location.
We love Ambers with our Family or Friends.  There food is  yummy. Staff is professional.

Upscale Indian food flexible on level of spiciness.

The food is always wonderful, and the experience is more upscale than most Indian restaurants I've been to. This means high quality food, attentive service, and a beautiful atmosphere.   The price matches these aspects of the meal.

Amber used to be the best Indian restaurant in the area but now the food has gone so far downhill it's unbelievable. Dry, over cooked tandoori chicken and butter chicken were both completely bland. Nothing had flavor. On top of all that the price is now $19.99/person for the lunch buffet. The new place looks nice but the noise level is too loud. Bad food, high prices, noisy environment, there is no reason to come here anymore. I miss the old Amber.
Horrible food and awfully disappointing experience!
Always fabulous. We have yet to find an Indian restaurant in other cities that matches our own hometown favorite.

Enjoyed our visit to Amber in Mountain View. I had been to the one in SF so wanted to try the one in Mountain View, and was not disappointed. 

The service and food were fantastic.
The service is always good here.  Food obviously has so much great spices and so delicious.

Food quality was good, which is always the case, as I have been going here for years.
But choice was limited , no lamb/goat in lunch buffet and price is v high for an Indian buffet, which means I will be looking at alternatives for sure.
Great biryani but dal Bukhara had a bitter taste . Service was good
This is our favorite restaurant in the Bay Area!

Totally love Amber India!! It's our favorite place for Indian dining and we go there not only for special occasions, but simply because we crave it! There Mattar Paneer and Malai Kofta is out of this world. The service here is always friendly and considerate - even when they're super busy. I love the ambience here too.

This is definitely my family's Indian "go to" place.  It's been consistently outstanding in every way and for all occasions.  Our Indian friends love coming here too and think it's very authentic and healthy with delicious food plus great service.
I love Amber--great food and service.  And, I feel special when dining there.
good flavorful food, nice ambiance and warm fireplace in outside patio, very helpful waiter with our menu questions

this was the first time I've been to Amber India since it moved to its new location last year. I enjoyed it even more. The food as usual was terrific but the new dining room really enhanced the experience even more - its spacious and quiet enough for conversation!
Almost pointless to write the review.   Gold standard for Indian food in the Bay Area, everyone knows it.  Still always pleasantly surprised by Amber's tasty creations.

This was our first dinner at the new Amber in Los Altos, across El Camino from their old location in Mountain View. We sat outside in the enclosed patio, transformed from the bustle of the busy streets to a quiet place.  It was delightful place to dine on a clear and cool evening, but we were warmed just enough by nearby standing space heaters. We chose to have our Palak Paneer served with garlic Nan as an appetizer so we could relish the flavors and textures. Our main courses, of Chicken Tikka Masala , Madras Seafood Curry, and Tandoori Chicken, were brought to the table and served family style with more Nan and Basmati rice. The portions are not huge, but amble, and the flavors were all memorable as was the evening we spent at Amber. We'll be back.

Wonderful new location.  Good food.  Good service.
The only issue was they are a bit overzealous in keeping water glasses full to the top.

I've always liked the food here but haven't been for a while.  This new location is very nice but the most important thing is the service.  Super attentive and friendly.   My call prior to the dinner to ask about gluten and dairy free options was handled in a friendly, professional manner.

We have loved Amber Cafe for a long time. The new location is so much nicer. The room is larger and feels spacious with its high ceiling. The outdoor seating is romantic and magical with string lights and the fire place. Our waiter was very friendly and responsive to our children. We loved sitting at their round table to share in great conversation. The food as always was excellent! Thank you for a beautiful night!
Best Indian food in the bay area. And may be even the US!. We have been going to Amber for over 15 years. We still go there at least two to three times a month!  Nothing else to say.

Amber India in MV is one of our favorite dining places for Indian food.  The owner and people there are excellent and friendly.  Food is delicious and we try not to order the same thing every time we go there.  You have to try it!  :)
Food was excellent.  Great service also.
Delicious! Great service and wonderful meal. The lamb dish and chicken tikka Marsala was better than ever.

We've been here several times and the food has been very consistent, service great. Last night, one of our dishes was extremely oily and salty. I had a pool of oil that filled a quarter of my plate. When we informed our waiter, he told us the head chef improvised on the recipe whereas the other chefs typically follow the recipe exactly. Everything else was great but that dish was inedible and unfortunately ruined the meal.
This is one of the best Indian restaurants in the area. The food and service are always exceptional. Even better the new location they took over is beautiful. It looks like an old Mexican restaurant.

Amber India has been around for a long time and although very positively reviewed, we have never thought it was that good.  We had heard, however, that there was a new chef and the restaurant moved to a new location just across the street, so we gave it a try.  Indeed, the food is substantially better, including quite a few unusual dishes, notably from southern India, as well as the more traditional northern India dishes that dominated the menu in the past.  So this is definitely worth a try.  They can handle large groups at long tables.  The service was a problem, we waited a long time for our food.  But the food was very good.
Phenomenal experience and cuisine!

Food is beyond compare - and I eat at a lot of Indian restaurants.  Lowered the star rating for service because the waiters served each dish without asking.  We had a mix of veg and non-vegetarians and we had to be vigilant and interrupt our conversation to make sure no one was served something she didn't want to eat.   This appeared to be the policy of the restaurant.  Service was otherwise friendly and professional.  Despite this I would recommend Amber to anyone.

Great service from the time you walk in, Aldo greeted us and made sure the table they had would be good! The staff from then on were are very attentive and helpful with the menu, drinks really fantastic service
Possibly my best Indian restaurant ever! And I have been to some good ones. Don't order the "everyday standbys."  Try something new, you'll love it!
Lunch buffet is tops---all the items offered were absolutely delicious.

We enjoyed several dishes family style.  We appreciated that when we asked what cardamom was, our waiter actually brought us some seeds to try.  We got lucky in that we went during the Warriors game 7 and the restaurant was very uncrowded and quiet.

Delicious Indian food.  We especially liked the outdoor seating.  The food was good, however, I would have liked to receive the naan before the rest of the meal.  There was a long wait, and then they brought all of the food at once.  It would have been nice to have something to hold us over until the meal arrived.

As always, Amber India was exquisite. Beautiful location, high quality and tender meats, fresh vegetables and luscious sauces. They are always on the top 100  restaurants list of the SF Chron and it is easy to see why

The restaurant is too noisy, the food too expensive and too many over rich items. Perhaps this restaurant would work if there were some greens to offset the heavily creamed entrees, and if the sauces weren't drowninf everything.

I frequent most of the Amber restaurants in the area and have always had relatively great service.. This was a Wednesday evening with a 7.30pm reservation and I was celebrating a friend's birthday and there were only 4 other tables with customers outside and inside. The food was good. The service was poor - we were being rushed to make decisions on our choices immediately upon being seated. This went on for 20 mins with the waiter constantly checking in on us every 5 minutes. At 10pm, we were told that they would have to move us as the side that our table was on was the same side that the next day's buffet was gong to be set up. We decided to leave at that point.
As always the food is delicious.
We have dined at Amber India several times. The food is consistently excellent and the service fabulous. Glad you were able to find a new location close to your former location in Mountain View.
The food and service were great! We will definitely be back.

Great food as expected. The new location can get quite loud and not as warm as the previous one. There was a crowd of people around our table for a little while as two large groups around us left. I could barely hear my wife talking.

Having dined here recently in the new venue we were impressed with the lovely ambience of the dining room and enjoyed the food.  I therefore chose to return for Mother's Day.
We had requested a table along the wall, and were graciously accomodated when we asked for a larger a corner table.   The waiter was knowledgeable  and helpful with ordering.   Here however is where we felt a bit frustrated.  We were surrounded on both sides by ethnic Indian diners and they kept receiving dishes our questions revealed that were "not on the menu." The offerings at their tables were far superior to ours and detracted from our enjoyment.  One of our dishes was bland and un interesting and the grilled platter was dried out.  I do hope this will be communicated to the restaurant.
This was our first visit to Amber's new location.  The food was delicious, as always and we really enjoyed the ambience of patio dining by the fireplace.
This food is so delicious here! It doesn't matter what you choose; it is all so flavorful. The patio on a warm evening is perfect too. This is one of our go-to favorites.
Food is very good but I still think the price they charge is high for the quality.
Veggie and Amber dinner allowed assortment where Paneer, Ceylon chicken, lentils, kheer, and puffy bread were highlights of excellent meal.

the moment we walked in, we were hit by smell of sea food. it was very strong. when i told a waiter, he was rude.
food was also not great. Amber Santana Row does a better job than this place.

Love the new digs. So much better than the strip mall location with all of the tiny rooms. My only critique would be that now it's a single large dining room with all hard surfaces and nothing to dissipate sound. The result is it's pretty loud, which of course, effects the ambiance. It's nicely decorated and the booths are super comfortable. 
The food is still wonderful, doesn't disappoint and the service is impeccable. 
There's a new lounge called the Cellar down the stairs before the entrance to Amber India we saw on our way out. It looks cozy and romantic, so we can't wait to try that before dinner next time.!

We have never been disappointed over the last 15 years going to Amber India. They just moved across the street to a new location with more parking and a nice dining room layout. Food was outstanding and everyone enjoyed the evening. It was almost full on a Tuesday evening. We ordered our favorites from the menu and also got an excellent lame vindaloo that was not on the menu, but they said they could do it for us.

I had not been to Amber since they moved across the street and was happy to find the new space is larger than the original; however, I do think it now lacks some ambiance and authenticity. But the food is still delicious ( the eggplant is my favorite!) and I will go back. This was my niece's first time eating Indian food and she was quite impressed. The portions are reasonable and the service was appropriately attentive.
Excellent food. Great service. Friendly staff. Recommend this restaurant for good, variety Indian food.

The new Amber is on the WEST side of El Camino just south of Whole Foods, which caused us some confusion as I was sure I knew where I was going! 
Once there, we found the new location somewhat odd. There's a smaller main dining area than in the old restaurant, and it's furnished in hard surfaces, amplifying the noise. There are additional function rooms and an outside dining area with an enormous gas fire. As the temperatures were in the low 50's, this area was empty of customers, and the fire wasted. Not great for sustainability.
Anyhow, the food hasn't changed very much, which means Amber still serves some of the best Indian dishes in the area. Truly delicious food, served with great professionalism by an army of waiters. Thankfully, no changes there.
However, I wonder if the clientele is paying for the move and the renovations (and the fire)? The prices seem much higher than I remember at the old location. We had to work hard to keep our bill for two adults and two young children to less than $100. 
I LOVE Indian food, but am not usually prepared to pay $20-$25 per entrée. Next time, I may stop at the much less expensive Amber Café (which hasn't had a renovation in quite some time :), and bring the food home to eat.

I was disappointed in the food. The Prawn balchao was very spicy, but tasty. The Teekha prawns were chewy, dry and tasteless, as were the burra Kabab. The chicken kebabs and seekh kebabs a were good. All in all a disappointing experience. Amber's food used to be much better. This was uninspired and ordinary. 

Even the chai had no taste. No cardamom or any other spice. 

Did not expect this from an upscale Indian restaurant like Amber.

A currie full of flavour and soul. We tried the chicken and lamb curries with garlic and basil naan and rice with a bottle of Italian prosecco spumanti.
Nice room and decoration. The service was nice also.  A place to bookmark and return.

The food is ALWAYS delicious here. We can never NOT get the tandoori chicken & sea bass..it's that good. The new space in Los Altos is beautiful but the noise level is intense. If possible, sit on the beautiful patio lit with overhead lights.
Very, very loud in the dining room, could not carry on a conversation easily.
Nice ambience, flavorful meal and great service. A great find! Will be back!

Amber India recently moved to a new, larger location across the street. Some reviews suggested that the ambiance was not as good, and that the food also had declined, which made us a little concerned.  Not so!  The main dining room is larger, and noise is moderate, but all well within local standards.  The new bar is handy if you must wait for your table, and there are now private banquet facilities for up to 20 people, with a limited menu.  But the food is still the reason to come here -- absolutely top-notch Indian cuisine.  Our favorites are the sea-bass tikka, the butter chicken, the frontier kebabs, and the eggplant side.  Service and attention were very professional.  The only criticism is that the relocation seems to have triggered a price increase:  $30+ per entree is a bit rich, and makes this for us more of a special-occasion event rather than regular dining out.

The new location is nicely appointed, but the hard walls and ceiling make the place noisy even when the dining room is 70% full.

I was happy to see very much the same menu as before, and the quality of the food remains excellent.

Service is just fine.

My problem is that prices went up something like $4 per entrée relative to prices at the previous location. That now puts it out of my league for anything but special occasions. That both saddens and annoys me greatly.

As a long-time customer of Amber India, I was very excited to dine in their new location.  The new restaurant is set just off the El Camino and has plenty of parking.  The main entry passes by a lovely open air patio, where a private event was taking place.  It looked very nice and there were outdoor heating lamps to fend off the chill.  The bar is a great and friendly place to enjoy their signature cocktails.  The main dining room is warm and welcoming with subtle lighting and their beautiful photographs of India on the walls.  As always, the food is the best Indian food I have had in the Bay Area.  It is considered by many people I know as 'The Gold Standard' of fine Indian cuisine.   Come and enjoy!!

Attended the new site for the first time for dinner .

Was sadden to notice that it was VERY difficult to hold a conversation at the new site (we had 4 in our party) and we all had a difficult time hearing each other as there's no sound proofing in the room whatsoever. So you're fighting to talk over others around you so that your guests can hear you.

The previous site was perfect (food, atmosphere, ambience)...wished they didn't move.

If you don't care to talk to each other and just go there to eat and run, then this place is for you.

Food is still good but wasn't impressed with the garlic naan - couldn't taste the garlic at all.  

Service was a little better than the last time I was here (they filled our water glasses without having to ask).
Always loved Amber. First time in its new location in Mountain View  on El Camino. The food was outstanding as usual.

We have enjoyed Amber in Mountain View for many years.  However, we weren't thrilled with the new location.  It is quite noisy !!  We think on a warm, summer evening it would be nice outside, but inside is just too loud, what you call energetic, for us.  The food is still very good.

New location, same high standards! From exquisite service with great attention to details, through beautifully presented dishes, to the highlight of Amber MV - delicious, aromatic Indian food awaking all your senses!

The new Amber in Mountain View, now located across from its previous spot, is now in Los Altos, with an ample patio for outside lunch/dining, plus a pleasant inside dining room
But go for the food, which is simply the best Indian food in the Bay Area. And the service is excellent.

The new location is very ordinary looking . It has lost the cozy feeling from the previous location and has become just another Indian restaurant dishing out mediocre fare. The ambiance and the food was very ordinary. I would not recommend this restaurant for those wanting to celebrate special occasions.
The food was delicious, better than it was in the space.  There is lots of parking. It looks like a wonderful place to eat outside when the weather is warm. It even has an outside fireplace.

Read very great reviews about this restaurant and took my family for holiday dinner and bitter experience first time in Bay area at Indian restaurant. 

Food is not great. Chef seems to like vegetable curries sweet . Navaratn Korma is one of the Indian vegetarian dish that is expected to be spicy (atleast not sweet). I couldn't make difference if it's Navaratan Korma or Malai Kofta...

The food was not as good as I remembered. Dishes were bland and naan bread was not hot and seemed old...like it had been sitting there for awhile. The new place is nice and has potential but part of the buffet was just across from the door which was open and it was cold...so was the food. I was hoping for better. I may try again when it is not lunch to see how the food from the menu is...
Restaurant was cold.  Downstairs bar was a freezer.

We loved our meal at Amber.  What sets them apart is that (a) they have dishes other than the standard ones found at many Indian places, and (b) their take on the standard dishes is different.   We loved the unique flavors, which they achieved without over-spicing.  The ingredients appeared to be of high quality, and of particular note was that the spinach in the Palak Paneer was bright green, not the usual olive drab color, implying that they used fresh spinach instead of frozen or canned.  Service was very courteous, although a little slow at times due to how busy they were.  On that busy Saturday evening the noise level was higher than we'd have preferred, but it didn't affect our experience very much.  Overall, it was a nice surprise!

This place is awesome I will come time and time again as opposed to Santana Row where the manager has the crappiest (I hope you have fired him!) attitude. 
All was nothing but excellent.
The former location of this restaurant had much better ambience.  You could describe the former as romantic, but this one not so much,

We noticed definite changes in the food preparation, none for the better. The Tandoori
chicken was not sufficiently marinated. The rice was very dry. The eggplant was not seasoned 
the same as before. We have recommended Amber India to all our friends for years, so 
please correct these issues
We had a lovely meal on the patio.  Service and food were both excelent.
New location, much nicer than previous location.  Service can be a bit slow when busy but overall a very good dining experience

Lots of interesting looking things on the menu. Appetizer selected was fine. But main course was 'colourless'. Strange thing to say about Indian food - but is was sort of monotone: just one flavour, no sense of the colour or vibrance you'd expect. Odd - maybe it was an 'off' night.

went with an extended family which included people from 3 yrs old to 67.
there was something on the menu for everyone, from soup to rice dishes to chicken dishes to vegetarian choices. everything was very good and the service was wonderful.

Everything about this place is positive except the noise level.  Even in a social group setting, the lunch volume was so high my ears hurt and we could not communicate well.  I do not recommend this place for a business lunch conversation -- just too loud.

During the years Amber India has never disappointed us and a great place to dine with just the family or a group of friends, colleagues and visitors. Every time we  appreciate the quality of the ingredients, the incredible flavor of each dish and the extreme accuracy of each recipe. The service is professional and discreet, a pleasure.

The waiters are pros and actually care that you enjoy your meal. I ordered an exotic sounding drink (jaljeera) and he brought me a sample first to make sure I'd enjoy it before committing a full glass to my bill. It was not to my taste so I went for a mango lassi instead (it tastes like they use real, perhaps even homemade, yogurt btw).

Butter chicken was superb. Vegetarian dish and assorted breads were quite good as well.

Ambiance isn't great, but with this type of food and service it was great for a 3rd date meal.
Great food, excellent service and good ambient
Amber continues to serve the best Indian food on the SF Peninsula.  We are never disappointed and the service is terrific.
Best butter chicken in the area! Lunch buffet is a great deal.
Our three absolute favorites: Frontier Kebab, Butter Chicken, and Sukhi Bindi. Wonderful experience as always!
Great Chicken tikka masala and Chandani Gosht. Goat cheese Naan is delicious. Best Indian in the valley.

Some of the food was spicy, but there were dishes that were mild. The combination of both made it enjoyable. It was a great brunch with lots of selections.  The service was well executed and timely. My friend and I will definitely go back to try other dishes.

Always the best Indian food and they make things off the menu for me. The service is friendly and timely. Lots of families and the outside dining is a little more intimate. We've been to Indian restaurants all over the world and Ambrr is our place to go here at home.

The food is excellent. The service is wonderful. The prices are relatively high for Indian food, but not high if compared to all types of food. The ambiance is ok. 

Every time I eat here, I feel happy afterwards. 

Butter chicken, Barrah (lamb) kebab, palak paneer...all delicious! The naan is very good, but my preference is the aloo (potato) paratha. 

The flavors are exquisite! 

FYI- they do not serve any beef dishes. Chicken, lamb, and seafood only.

Service is a bit slow but Indian food is good and not too heavy. The tandoori dishes are very tasty and not dry. The naan was not the best I have had. But overall the best Indian I have been near Palo Alto.
