Will definitely not go there again also won't recommend anyone either. If you tip them below their expectations they will stop you when you are leaving and ask you for more. Highly disappointing and bad food with equally bad behavior. Many other good restaurants are serving much better food at half the price.

This is the best Indian food in northern California! I lived in Los Altos for 18 years and we visited many Indian food places - no comparison Amber was always the winner. Now that I moved to So California, each time I go to No California I must have my first and last dinner at Amber.  Their food is exceptional and offers a great variety for all tastes  but the best of all is their butter chicken that might sound boring, but the spices and sauce flavor makes this dish a treat to your palate.  The place is nice, the service and staff very attentive, and although it is in a small strip mall, once inside you get the nice restaurant atmosphere you would find in the city.  Great place, great food - not to miss for those who visit or live in northern California!
Another delicious dinner; excellent service.  Can't wait to see the new location across the street.
Butter Chicken- 'nuff said.
Great sea bass tikka and chicken tikka masala along with great service.

All of the dishes I've tried here are good fairly typical Indian fare - make sure you like Spicy!
Have found the wait staff have not been very helpful when asking about choices on the menu.
Used to be my go to place for Indian food but not so much any more mostly due to the not so helpful servers and the atmosphere is OK but so-so.

We had the Tandoori platter for appetizer. It was just ok and small amounts for 2 kinds of chicken
Shared the BUtter Chicken and Dum Aloo. Butter Chicken was great. Dum Aloo was just OK.
The Naan with Goat Cheese tasted more like Pizza

The food was incredible and the best Indian I've had in a long time.  I've been to the San Francisco location several times and the food is good but this location is definitely better food-wise.  The service was also very good and accommodating.  

The only thing lacking was ambiance but it is good casual atmosphere, good for kids and groups.  The SF location has a better ambiance/scene but I will be back to this location soon!

I have eaten at many Indian restaurants over the years and I always come back to Amber as my favorite. The Baingan Bartha (sp)? Eggplant dish is the best! The chicken Tikka Masala has tender pieces of chicken in a well balanced sauce. You have to try the cauliflower appetizer- who knew cauliflower could taste this good?!
The service is attentive yet unobtrusive. The only negative would be that the dining room is a bit small so it can feel a little crowded.

I reserved a party for 11 people for dinner and we all had a wonderful experience at the Mountain View site.

We arrived knowing to order a couple of dishes but also asked the waiter for suggestions looking for chef specialities if they had them.

We ended up ordering (2 orders each) of the following:

Goa Fish - tender chunks
Butter Chicken
Chicken Tikka Masala
Kerala Lamb Curry
Aloo Gobhi  (potatoes & cauliflower in spices)
Sukhi Bhindi (spice okra with onions - this one was especially good!)
Baingan Bharta (eggplant cooked w/onions, tomatoes & spices)
Palak Paneer (Spinach with farmer's cheese & spices)
Assorted breads (onion kulcha, naan, mint paratha)
Saffron Rice
Dessert: Kesari Kheer

and of course, mango lassi for half the group.

The food was superb, everyone in my party couldn't stop complimenting the dishes and there was still plenty to take home for leftovers.

Service was outstanding.  I never had to ask to refill the glasses, service was prompt and the waiters and bus boy were always there if we needed them.

I can't say enough good things about this restaurant at the Mountain View site.  We'll definitely return for another outing with this large group.    

Thank you for making our visit a memorable one (there were a few folks who had never been to this restaurant).

Our table of 4 enjoyed an appetizer, a soup, and 3 different entrees.  All were well seasoned, attractive and had different sauces.  Great service.   We would all return and try other dishes since the menu was so varied.  Each couple had a little left for lunch the next day.  We did order 4 entrees, just 3 different ones.
If you love Tandori, go no further. Best Indian food in the Bay Area year over year.
So glad to find this place. Put it on your list of places to go to enjoy authentic Indian food.

It is always delicious. We only go to Amber India one a year due to distance, but always are pleased. They are moving to a new location soon, which should improve the ambiance.
Can't wait to come back!
Bland food, I think they completely forgot to put the spices in the food.  We even threw away the leftovers.  Sad day, because had been here many times before.

We eat there when we want Indian food. The quality is consistent, and service is good. Since we are only 3, so we tried the set menu of  the Vegeterian for $29, and that was enough for 2 people and gave a lot more varieties.
Chicken Masala is the best there. THe good sign is that there are lot of Indian people eating there.
Please cook the tandoori chicken, it's been undercooked.  The past 2 visits to the buffet, it has been undercooked near bone.  I would like to come back soon, but please fix this.

This is the worst restaurant I have ever been in the bay area. For a $15 we get only one starter, and two not so good basic dessert. The main course curry has shredded chicken in it. The taste is pathetic. I was wondering how could this restaurant get such a rating. Should have sticked with my usual restaurant Sakoon.

Service is TERRIFIC (very attentive & super friendly) EVERYTIME I've been here (& I'm here like EVERY Tues). The food is *AMAZINGLY* DELICIOUS. I really love LOVE love their palak paneer and their fried veggies (pakora???). YUM! And their naan is PHE'naan'MENAL! :) Their taro and eggplant dishes are pretty spicy but still super awesomely perfect. The dishes change from time to time and their fresh salad is SO GOOD! This place is pretty popular so the buffett line gets LOOOONG. So I advise taking 2-3 big fat plates (or however many you can balance with your hands) to reduce waiting time.;) I will definitely be back here MANY times and be leaving with a fatter belly.
For years, Amber India has produced consistently high quality and tasty Indian food. We have never been disappointed.

The Holiday season may not be a good time to visit one of our favorite restaurants! Very Very noisy groups of 8-24 were in the rooms the night we were there 12/15 and we literally could not hear each other from two sides of a small table.

As usual the good was great.  The butter chicken is always wonderful.  This time we also ordered lamb cubes on a skewer in garlic and other spices.  Also recommend.  We also always love the dum aloo potatoes (I believe that is the name--it is the one with mint).
We had a delicious buffet lunch.  Very good Indian food.  The restaurant was comfortable, not too noisy, and the owner and waiters were all friendly and helpful.

This has always been one of our favorite restaurants and it continues to be good but this last meal was somewhat disappointing. MOst dishes were very good but not all. The shrimp appetizer was "off" - maybe frozen shrimp? The poori was greasy. Other things though - garlic nan, frontier tandori lamb chops were excellent. So not as consistent as I would like but still good.

I enjoyed the weekend buffet at Amber India, as there was plenty of tasty food and the offerings were varied from a salad bar, to an extensive entree buffet, and sweet table.  The service was most attentive, and the staff made sure I had plenty of beverages and nan.

     While the buffet is a bit expensive and the restaurant is a very simple establishment at a strip mall, I was pleased with my lunch experience and would return again when seeking Indian food in Mountain View.
I love their Tikka Masala.  It was a great blend of spices and that creamy taste in the sauce.   This is my go to India Restaurant.
I had ordered the Kerala Lamb Curry with white rice. Amazing!! I really enjoyed this plate.
Best Indian we've had in the area.  About $100 for 3 without appetizers or dessert.
Very attentive service. Good quiet ambience. Lot more to be desired about the food.

Outstanding service, very good standard Indian cuisine, noise level moderate (unusual for most of the restaurants in the Bay Area, in our experience), extensive and varied menu with several dishes not often found, modest but well-chosen wine list by the glass.  Seems to get better each time we dine here.

Since moving to the area from London where good Indian food is common, we had not found anything comparable until trying Amber.  We were not disappointed. All the flavours we expected, well prepared and presented.  Nice atmosphere and attentive service.  On our list!

Authentic indian food: mostly north indian, tasteful, not too greasy and you can definitely ask them to modify the ingredients to suit your level of spiciness etc. One of the only indian restaurants i would go to in the SF Bay Area (I'm an Indian) , even though there are many around here.

Quite friendly wait staff, good to make reservations since weekends and afternoons can be crowded.

This is the first restaurant I have ever felt compelled to write a review for.  Amber was recommended to me by a co-worker earlier this week and had the chance to slip down for dinner Friday night.  While the outside of the restaurant is understated, the interior is nicely decorated, the service is supuberb and the food is simply the best Indian food I have ever tasted.  There is tremendous pride in everything this restaurant does, and it is apparent from the moment you arrive to when you leave.  There is no pretense, just quality.

Fairly quiet at 5-7pm on a Tues...............Good food tho could use more non-dairy mild meat dishes to choose from. Tandoori appetiser great tho I think it had only 2 of the 3 types of meat offered.  Xlnt service.  Very good okra dish.
The appetizers and entrees were fantastic: rich creamy sauces, superb seasoning and piping hot food. Skip the desserts, however.

We (a group of 4) have eaten at Amber for several years and at least a dozen dinners, probably more.  This meal was not up to par.  We were rushed in finishing our courses.  Dishes even removed from the table while some of our group were still eating their appetizer & soup though others were finished, thus leading to that 'rush' feeling.  As for the food, Papadam were overcooked (dark & almost scorched), the Mulligatwany needed fenugreek, Butter Chicken was bland, Rogan Josh was all jalapeno and no curry, Palak Paneer was OK, rice was dry and assorted bread has some doughy selections.  The Raita was the best dish we ordered.  A disappointment from what had been a favorite restaurant.  Have then changed the chef during the past year?

Amber India is always great: the service is impeccable, and the food is always excellent.  This time, we had three people, and shared two appetizers, two mains, rice, and naan.  I can't imagine how it could have been better.

Service is TERRIFIC (very attentive & super friendly) EVERYTIME I've been here (& I'm here like EVERY Tues). The food is *AMAZINGLY* DELICIOUS. I really love LOVE love their palak paneer and their fried veggies (pakora???). YUM! And their naan is PHE'naan'MENAL! :) Their taro and eggplant dishes are pretty spicy but still super awesomely perfect. The dishes change from time to time and their fresh salad is SO GOOD! This place is pretty popular so the buffett line gets LOOOONG. So I advise taking 2-3 big fat plates (or however many you can balance with your hands) to reduce waiting time.;) I will definitely be back here MANY times and be leaving with a fatter belly.
Quality of food is excellent -very fresh and very well prepared.  We enjoy every visit.  Service is also outstanding - very courteous.
Food was delicious.  Service was fast. Will definitely go again.
Amber India is always excellent, from the service to the food.  The vegetarian options are always outstanding.  The menu changes, highlighting new flavors and dishes.

We arrived for a business meeting here last Friday at 11:30.  We went in and the place was empty, the buffet was really the only choice. Buffet food was excellent but the good stuff is at the end on another table on the other side of the long buffet. The butter chicken was luscious. The Tandoori chicken was great, potatoes and saag, most everything was very good or better.  Dessert was great too. Great food like Amber India San Jose. By 12:30 the line to get in was out the front door with waves of people coming up thru 1:00.  You can probably get in during the rush and the line moves as all buffet's do. Service was good too.  As lunch prices go its not cheap nor highbrow.  I'm a foodie and this place is highly recommended for lunch.

Hadn't been here in years though we have gone to the glitzy downtown SF Amber several times. They bear no relation to each other. 
Amber MV has a tired very, very typical North Indian menu. We went down (from the East Bay) to meet someone here otherwise we would not have gone. Folks are extremely nice; service is constant and terrific. However the food is very ordinary. Unless you live in the neighborhood, there's little reason to go here. Sorry to say that. It wouldn't hurt if ideas from the Yerba Buena site were taken up in the MV location

We had 
Kerala Lamb Curry$ 19.95, and Chicken Ka Tikka. Both delicious and cooked to perfection. We split them so we could both enjoy them, and loved both dishes. We recommend Amber India to anyone that loves Indian food.
Food and service excellent.  Best Indian food we've had in America!
Very good service and the food was decent. The butter chicken was delicious but the kebabobs were dry. Prices were reasonable and over all I thought was an excellent place

Food was excellent,Service was quick and efficient.One crying child was a distraction.Restaurant was not very crowded for a Saturday night but we did go there early.Will plan to return to this restaurant.

We like the food here for most part.  It is a bit pricey, not sure why, but that is what it is (No, I am not hesitant to pay price for good food, what I meant here is that price to food quality (taste) ratio [price/(food quality) is high).  I have been here several times, and the food quality is at least consistent, over several years.  May be a good place for some special occasions, not necessarily for regular weekend dining!

We hadn't been here for a few years. The last time we came we were in the front room with a number of family groups with rowdy, poorly supervised children. We barely knew what we were eating and couldn't wait to get out.
This time we noticed the family groups were in one room and the adult groups and couples like us in the back. This was so much better and it was a whole different experience. The butter chicken, tandoori chicken, and naan bread were all excellent.
A reliable restaurant.  The menu is extensive and authentic.  We order lots of entries. take home the leftovers and enjoy the whole experience again the next day.

We were sat next to a family of four who's parents did not believe in discipline.  The 2 year old jumped up and down on the booth, then started shrieking at the top of his lungs while the Mom encouraged this behavior by tinkling him.  When the food arrived he decided to throw it around and the parents just sat there.  I would have liked someone from the restaurant to have ask them to control their kids as we were not the only ones annoyed.
Love the Indian food here.  It is usually very cold in the restaurant so bring a sweater.
The most memorable Indian meal we've had in a while.
Superb place for good food, great service, cordial staff and excellent ambience and decor

The Tandoori mixed grill caused my wife to say 'you need to be in India for real tandoori'.  We didn't finish all of the plate.  I ordered Sangria, which is probably not the best choice at an Indian restaurant, and it tasted more like rum than red wine.  Finally, my wife asked for rasgulla for dessert and they were out of it.  I ordered the kulfi and it was rock hard and virtually impossible to cut through with a knife, let alone a spoon.  It was a great evening since my Dad was watching our two young kids and we could relax and talk uninterrupted, but the dining experience left us a little unsatisfied.

We have been here twice this month. This place is great. They have the traditional Indian menu that
we are familiar with, but also do some more creative itens. Try the Gohbi Manchurian, for example.
Also had the vegetable biriyani and the matter paneer is excellent as well. They seem to bring everything
at the same time, so if you want a set of courses, it is best to stagger your ordering. Ambience is good,
not great. Chairs are quite comfortable and the place is nicely decoriated and seems very clean.
Great food and great service. The butter chicken was wonderful.

Not my first time at Amber, but the first time for my partner, who had lived in India for six months. He was very impressed and even though it's a bit of a trip for us, we'll be back. Excellent food and perfect service. The okra, chicken and lamb were delicious.
This place is amazing. I have been coming here every couple of months. It is by far the best Indian food in the area!

The food was not quite as good as usual this time.  The naan & kulcha was burned on one side, too scorched to be good.  The Mulligatawny soup was not tasty either.  The curries sauces (lamb & chicken) were thin & runny, not thick as I prefer.  The rice portion was not adequate for 3 people so we ran out before the end of the meal.  This time it was a disappointment & I've been to this restaurant at least 15 times over the years.

This is our absolute favorite place for Indian food on the Peninsula and beyond.  We try to go as often as we can.  Whether you are there for a lunch buffet or ordering off the menu, the food is delicious, comes in a breathtaking variety and always hits the spot.

Despite reservations, sat us down near the service bar. Complained. Initially told we could not be moved.  We objected and they moved us.
Very loud .. . conversations booming.
Food good but heavy on the salt.

Tried this place out for the first time for lunch and had the buffet with my wife and toddler. Exceptional service and good variety to choose from. Very pricey though, at least $15 for an adult and no military discount even while I was in uniform. The atmosphere is nice, the inside looks much better than the outside. Place is hard to find and easy to drive past. I would still recommend if you are in the area craving Indian food.

We went to Amber India to celebrate a special birthday.  We ordered Sea Bass Tikka, Chicken Tikka, Rogan Josh (lamb curry), Baingan Bharta (baked eggplant), and Cucumber Raita.  Every dish was delicious, and we enjoyed the sea bass so much, that we placed a second order.  The baked eggplant was quite spicy (in a good way), so the cucumber raita provided a lovely cooling effect on the palate.  Of course, we also had naan and basmati rice to round it out. They brought a special dessert with a candle in it for our birthday person, which was a nice touch as well. We will definitely be visiting Amber India again!

Amber India - MV is an absolute favorite in the whole Bay!  Goal tonight was to try new dishes, rather than regular "go to's," and everything was outstanding and provided a great variety in flavors.  If you're new to Indian, servers are also excellent at making recommendations based on your guidance.

We had taken our non Indian friends to Amber for their 40th wedding anniversary. They had wanted to experience authentic Indian food and I selected items from all regions of India for our meal. We all enjoyed the food thoroughly - it was delicious. The service was great too and we appreciated the attention we received to our needs. Thank you!
simply put, have never had an entrée here that wasn't flavorful, balanced, and perfectly cooked! very wide selection.
We always order the butter chicken and are never disappointed. We also enjoy the vegetarian appetizer platter, tandoori chicken, garlic naan, and the spinach. All delicious.
We love Amber India. Go there often and are never disappointed. The service is very attentive and friendly.

Had a memorable dining experience at this restaurant last Saturday. Promptly seated and the wait staff were quite attentive and responsive to our requests. Highly recommend the Butter Chicken, Palak Paneer, Kerala Lamb Curry (this dish had none of the lamb gaminess!), Malwani Shrimp (loved the fact that they removed the tails from the prawns) and the Garlic Naan. Well worth the money we spent and will definitely return!
Arrived at 1130 for lunch, and by noon the place was full with people waiting. Better make a reservation for sure! Food tastes fresh and good.
Not representative of the Amber in SF or the one in the Mission. This one is more run of the mill. It tastes and seems like any old Indian restaurant in a strip mall.
Fantastic food and service. Will come again

Made reservation here for valentine's dinner to avoid the crowds and overpriced prix-fix menus at other places...Turned out to be great! We were promptly seated upon arrival, food was delicious, place was full, but not crazy crowded, and we had attentive service.. So, had an overall enjoyable night! Highly recommend !

The food is always very consistent and very good. I like this location better than the Santana Row location because there is easy parking and I think that the food is just a bit better here, although the other location has good food too. The only reason it doesn't get five stars is because I reserve that for really creative food. I wouldn't call this creative. It's pretty standard with the typical curries and tandoori dishes but high quality.

I wanted my wife to experience really good Indian food, and Amber India was the perfect place to take her. I had previously been to Amber India for lunch, which is a buffet. Everything that I have had there is wonderful - truly exceptional. And the service has been attentive and friendly. My wife loved the dinner, and I would recommend Amber India to anyone.

Has Amber change ownership? We've not been there for a year or two, I remember it used to have delicious food at a fair price. This time our experience of the dishes are just okay, but the price for each dish is arrange too high from $19-$30. Very disappointing!

Best Indian food I have found in an area with many such restaurants. A little pricey.
They have a full bar, hooray, but do not know how to make some of the fancier drinks.
Service is good and the ambiance is nice enough.
I like that it is fairly small and does not get really noisy, even when full.

the food was very good-butter chicken, various nan bread, some sort of mushroom vegetable dish. the service was great-not too intrusive but attentive to and aware of needs. relaxed atmosphere yet a snazzy night out.

Amber India is hands down the best Indian restaurant in the Mountain View/Palo Alto area. Food is just too delicious, and the service is great. I took my wife there for dinner on her birthday and they portioned our food for us right on our plates.(never seen that in an Indian restaurant) Wonderful lunch buffet. And the butter chicken curry is the best I have had.(must get) Amber India is just too good.

I met a colleague for lunch there and we both of us had the lunch buffet. The food was remarkably good and the variety was amazing! There was an incredible range of vegetarian dishes, such as saag paneer, dal tadka, rice biryani, aloo gobi, mushroom curry and at least a dozen more. There was also Tandoori chicken, butter chicken and for dessert, gulab jamun, and vermicelli payasam. Everything I had was fresh, expertly prepared and absolutely delicious; I would highly recommend this place to anyone interested in having authentic high quality Indian food.

This is our go-to Indian restaurant, often with out-of-town guests. Our menu favorites are: vegetable samosas, barrah kebab, rogan josh, chicken masala, chicken tikka masala, and....drum roll....the PALAK PANEER, which is the best I've had anywhere. My hubby also really likes the Baingan Bartha, which is the only way he'll happily eat eggplant. The service has always been cordial and well-paced. The only down-side of take-out is that the bread suffers even if you warm it in the oven at home. Over the years, the only dish we tried and didn't care for was Malwani shrimp.

Amber India did not rise to our expectations.
The service was impeccable, and all staff was friendly. However, we waited about half hour to be served. My wife's vegetarian entree, a potato dumpling dish with a wonderful sauce was great. My tandoori lamb dish was not cooked to top standards since only half of the lamb pieces were tender. The lamb should just fall apart in your mouth. Tough tandoori lamb is really not acceptable. We also ordered nan with paneer cheese filling. I found that the amount of cheese should have been doubled at least. It could barely be detected. Next time we will go to one of the other excellent Indian Restaurants in our area.

Amber India in its original location continues to be our favorite local Indian restaurant. The food just never disappoints. Bravo for maintaining high quality cooking while expanding its regional presence.
Best Indian food ever! Wonderful lunch buffet!

They do make very good Indian food, love the butter chicken, but the prices have gotten too high. They always charged a bit more than the other Indian restaurants and it was worth it because the food was better. But they have raised their prices so much that I'm not sure it's worth it anymore.
We ordered palak paneer, chicken tikka masala, and seabass. Food was great but it took a while to get to our table- around 20 minutes I think.
I've been to great Indian restaurants in both London and Mumbai and can tell you that Amber is right up there with the very best Indian food you will ever taste! Be sure to make advance reservations!
make a reservation,place gets busy!

This is one of the best indian places in the bay area in my opinion.
The ambience is classy.
The food is delicious too.

For vegetarians : Do try their hara bhara kabab, malai kofta
For non-vegetarians : Reshmi Kabab (Chicken) is a must try.

We enjoy Amber and its offshoot Amber Dahra in Palo Alto for high-quality Indian food, more traditional at Amber and with surprising and delicious dishes at Amber Dahra. Our last visit was with friends to celebrate our wedding anniversaries--Amber has been our favourite place to go over several years.

We appreciated being put in a nice quiet corner where conversation was actually easy--a rare plus when most restaurants think high decibels are a sign of success.

Not the run-of-the-mill north Indian restaurant. Everything was delicious. Rogan Josh was outstanding, the lamb was very tender. Butter chicken was delicious. Some nice dishes not on the standard menu at other places. The prawn biryani was a little too spicy, although we didn't ask for extra hot food.
Great food, quick service, low prices. Interesting takes on Indian classics. You know a place is good when there's lots of local 'to-go' traffic.

The food is consistent and very good. The buffet is simple and doesn't provide much in the way of selection. I appreciated the waiter asking if we'd prefer to have warm naan after we get our food, but they gave our mango lassie's to another table. Overall, nice place for lunch, consistent and good. I'd go back, but not for any special occassions.
Great food, great service. Place is a bit cramped and can be quite noisy if a large group is near. Prices are high, but the food is outstanding.

Service is TERRIFIC (very attentive & super friendly) EVERYTIME I've been here (& I'm here like EVERY Tues). The food is *AMAZINGLY* DELICIOUS. I really love LOVE love their palak paneer and their fried veggies (pakora???). YUM! And their naan is PHE'naan'MENAL! :) Their taro and eggplant dishes are pretty spicy but still super awesomely perfect. The dishes change from time to time and their fresh salad is SO GOOD! This place is pretty popular so the buffett line gets LOOOONG. So I advise taking 2-3 big fat plates (or however many you can balance with your hands) to reduce waiting time.;) I will definitely be back here MANY times and be leaving with a fatter belly.
Year after year, they provide great food at the Mountain View location. I believe it's the best of the group of locations that are in the area.
food is always good here. my favorite Indian restaurant
Certainly, a must visit place at least once... Food is excellent but a bit expensive as the quantity served is very less and does not justify the price... But yes, great ambience and taste...!
We enjoyed our dinner...The food was tasty and the service was great.

I brought a client here for lunch on an out of town business trip. I wasn't clear going in that it was a buffet only lunch situation, and i would have preferred it to order, but it was tasty and the client enjoyed themselves. I would recommend for lunch. Lots of options! Very quick to be seated and servers were nice and left us alone.
Go and try the lamb saag - excellent. Butter chicken is always great.
Very pleased with our dining experience .

This restaurant is always too cold. They need to fix the air conditioning.
Food is great. Service is so so.
The staff is organized and prompt even when the restaurant is full. Our food was served within 20 minutes. I liked the mushrooms & peas.
Went for my sister's birthday--the food was amazing and every single employee was great.
YUMMY FOOD! The food is always delicious. Kudos to the chef.

This place is an ideal lunch spot because of the buffet. You could be in and out of there (provided you get there early) in less than an hour. The food was excellent quality, which for me, says a lot because I typically do not like buffets. My only complaint is that once the restaurant filled up, it got pretty loud inside.

I took a friend here for a birthday dinner and we had a really good experience. The food was really good. We ordered a Paneer Dish, a side of okra, naan and a shrimp dish. I would order all of them again besides the shrimp (it was a curry one). I've been dreaming of eating the okra again. The wine list was small but good enough. I will definitely go back and order some takeout from here.
The Chicken Tikka Masala was too sweet to eat. Samosas ok. The naan was excellent. Staff very nice.

Awesome! The decor and host welcome immediately indicate that the restaurant is like no other in the area. The location deceives one's sense of the style and atmosphere of this restaurant. The restaurant is much more expansive than the front room and bar that one first views upon entry. The ease one experiences due to the attention and quickly assist with entree choices makes one feel comfortable. Lamb curry and butter chicken melted in your mouth!
the quality of the ingredients shows in the taste, texture of the dishes. They are not overwhelming with spice, and the dishes are not greasy. one of the best Indian restaurants in the Bay Area.
My family has been dining at Amber India for years. We consider it the very best Indian food in the Bay Area.
Amber has excellent Indian food with unique flavors. The service was perfect and the dinner was relatively inexpensive for the quality of food.

Rude host. Walked away. No apology. Not a good way to stay in busniss!
Went to the Falafel Drive in instead. Great Service, Great food.

The food was excellent, the service was excellent. The strange thing is that they allowed someone to come in to do a "magic show for the kids" that turned out to be a demonstration of a mobile phone's ability to keep a signal underwater. I don't like sales pitches when I go out for dinner, especially when the prices are on the high side. This put my husband and I off so much that we decided not to return. By the end of the meal though, the food was so good that we changed our minds.
High quality ingredients, disappointing flavors. I've had much better Indian food elsewhere.
Really tasty food. Great menu. Good service. Definitely recommend and will return.
Most food was good but Palak Paneer was lackluster. Not spicy and not memorable.
Great local Indian food. We've been there many times and love it!
Everyone one knows Amber's the best in the area.

The food was disappointing, cooking careless, sauces tasted tired and much the same and pre-cooked, instead of being properly married to the meat or fish, the quality has plummeted since my last visit a year ago. The first course of siskh kebabs was excellent, as it was clearly individually and freshly cooked. The restaurant was full and the service distracted.
a very busy restaurant but every single staff person was gracious and helpful in every way.
As always the food is very good - alas this time - seemed a bit more salty than usual.
As always, Amber India delivers.

I come regularly for lunch buffet and butter chicken. Most recently, I ordered the butter chicken for dinner and it tasted even better then the lunch offering of the same dish! Amazing, considering how delicious the lunch buffet tastes!
Always a favorite for our family!
Went for saturday brunch buffet, it's probably better to order from the menu if you're vegetarian like us...

so many Indian restaurants to choose from in the area, we made a great choice
chose mixed tandoori appetizer, butter chicken, shrimp and dum aloo bukhara, garlic basil naan
great sauces on each
we're from so. cal. and we were already planning to return on our next trip north

I love Amber India. They're the best Indian restaurant in the area, the service is impeccable, and the food is always fantastic. They also change the menu seasonally, adding in some new items. This time, we ordered aloo tikki, butter chicken, mushroom muttar, rice, and naan. Everything was hot, fresh, and tasted wonderful. We also had cocktails, which were delivered quickly and were well-prepared.
Great food, reasonable pices, nice ambience, pleasant staff, one of the best Indian restaurants around. Drove 35 miles to go to lunch there!

It was quiet when we arrived at 11:30, but crowded and noisy by the time we left. We should have planned more carefully--Thursdays and Fridays are popular for office parties. Even so, we were well served and the food was delicious. We'll return.
We had the curried scallops appetizer, the lamb curry, and the sea bass. All were very enjoyable. We will definitely go back.

I believe their lunch buffet is great, ... but we went there for dinner.

Loved their Sea Bass tikka, that was amazing and obviously will never be on their lunch buffet. Rest of the items we ordered ... pretty standard Indian fare, can get for cheaper elsewhere, so not worth the $$$$ here.

They messed up our opentable reservation: our friends came in early, said the reservation was in our name, so they seated them. Then we came in right after, but they made us wait in the crowded foyer for 10 minutes, saying there was NO table!!! Then we were seated us at "another" table. Finally they figured it out, and we were seated together.

Then they "cancelled" our opentable reservation.

This was a last minute New Year choice so didn't know what to expect. They had an excellent buffet for the occasion. The best Indian restaurant in Mountain View. Excellent food. Ranks up there with places we've dined in England, Scotland and Singapore.
2nd visit, disappointed. Flavors didn't 'pop', service felt perfunctory: the experience does not match the price point. Feels like this restaurant is riding a reputation it may no longer merit.

Host: very good (8 out of 10)
Waiting service: fair (5 out of 10)
Food quality: fair (5 out of 10)
Not going back unless I have to
I set the naan on fire, and they put it out for me. Very friendly staff; gave us complimentary sauce!
Always good, sometimes great. Vegetable samosa terrific. Butter chicken always a winner.
Lots of veg items on menu. One of the best Indian restaurants in the valley.

I have eaten at Amber before, and the food is always good. We ordered the set meals - the Amber and Vegetarian Dinners. The waiter or waiters seemed to have forgotten what was included in the meal as we had to remind them about the tea and they forgot dessert completely. After we left, I had to think about whether they might have forgotten something else as well.
very good Indian food, however, it is overpriced for the portions you receive and everything is ala carte
We enjoyed the tandoori chicken and chicken vindaloo, prepared as we like it. This place has improved over time.
I have loved the food at Amber India for at least 15 years. It is the restaurant we take friends who love Indian food.

Really great food, enjoyed everything we ordered. Great service, very attentive staff, highly recommend this place. If you love Indian food, or want to try it out for the first time this is a great place to try. Its a bit expensive for dinner, lunch is more reasonable.
Love Amber Mountain View. The Indian food here is some of the best. I should know I am from India and have tasted some great Indian food.
probably the best indian food in the bay area . . . altho not inexpensive.

all is a la carte so the $$ designation is a bit misleading. Tandoori Lamb was a bit dry and over cooked but tasty nonetheless. The eggplant ratatouille was very good but a bit spicy before an evening of theater (my poor planning). Much like a Chinese restaurant, you order one of these and one of those and share it.
Decent and reliable place for a business lunch. Food is good!

Great lunch buffet and nice place for a low key dinner. The food is consistently first rate and I love the veggie pakoras and samosas- much better than at other restaurants (I could make a meal just of these and I'm not vegetarian). It's hard for me to get beyond the Tandoori chicken to the rest of the menu; they do it so well.
Great ambiance and authentic dishes

I went for lunch and it was too noisy to hear my companions. We had the buffet and I enjoyed the food. It would have been good if every dish were labeled, since I am not familiar with them or the ingredients. I think I will have to try this place for dinner to give a more complete view.

Food was great, as it was when we were there before. It was a birthday dinner for me, my 74th, a Saturday night at 8pm. Ambience and enjoyment of meal was spoiled by a number of families with extremely noisy and screaming children, creating a din that went on for hours and that made it hard to hear each other speak. This was a weekend and the waiter explained many families enjoy the restaurant then, but still as it is an otherwise romantic and elegant restaurant with great food it would behoove the management to try to keep small groups of older diners away from the bedlam. As it is, we were given no hint the management planned to remedy the situation, and so we hesitate to return again, especially on a weekend.

No matter how good the food, the ambiance, or the service, the deal breaker for me is the noise level. Here it is so loud that it's difficult to carry on a conversation with the person seated next to you. Have come here often for the food, but won't be returning anytime soon because of the constant roar.
Food was very good but the service was really slow. Long wait time between order and when the food arrived which was disappointing.
food was FANTASTIC!! Everything we ate was delicious. Really made my birthday special! The service was a little spotty, but I would definitely recommend this restaurant to others!
Gourmet level quality

Our foursome likes Indian food, but we don't know the names of dishes--we select according to appearance at a buffet. My friend had a notepad to write the names of dishes she might avoid in future, but she soon abandoned it, stating 'there's not a single dish I wouldn't like to have again!'
The excessive noise was a problem, but could be solved in two ways: sit in a side room, which appeared quieter, or (thanks to Open Table) make a reservation for, say, 1:45, when the lunch crowd is thinning out.

This is our favorite Indian restaurant on the Peninsula. The food is delicious and the lunch buffet is the way to go. The ambience is not spectacular and the location is a little dreary but the food is memorable. The service is also friendly. Highly recommend Amber India!
Not enough variety in the lunch buffet and overpriced.
As always, delicious! As close as it gets to real Indian treat!
Food was well prepared, however portions were very small considering the high prices charged.
Excellent service. We never felt rushed at all. They even asked us when we would like dishes brought out.
This meal was not Amber's finest. Mixed vegetable dish was too salty; eggplant overcooked. My experience is that ordering from the menu gets better (but more expensive) results
Never been disappointed. The food is excellent.
Hade the table we requested and food was great as always
Amber always delivers high quality food and service.

Amber India's lunch buffet was excellent. We will be back! With our reservations, we were seated immediately, even though it was very busy - great service! The food choices were creative, interesting and delicious. Not your typical Indian lunch buffet.
Overall the food looks very fresh. The paneer is very tasty. The spicy chicken is really spicy. We tried different kinds of bread, all were awesome. Service was relatively quick and efficient.
This is our favorite Indian restaurant in the area, by far. The food is magnificent. So much flavor, many choices. We highly recommend Amber India in Mountain View or in the city.
Chaat was good, but everything else was not so good. Not worth the price at all.
Great service!!! The waiters were very attentive.
Butter Chicken gets the most notoriety here, but don't miss the Frontier Lamb Kebab!

Fabulous food my girlfriend and I were so happy throughout our entire dinning experience. From when we walked through the door as the smell hit our noise. Till we left full happy and smiling. Curry chicken was our favorite. Cannot wait to go back.
On menu items great, off menu request so so

We were seated immediately, great service from beginning to end. we ordered family style and loved that they served each person from each of the dishes ordered. The waiter made excellent food recommendations as this was our first time there. I would recommend it and would go again, even though it's quite a drive for us, well worth it.
Amber India is consistently great food, service, and an excellent value.

Excellent as usual....our 3rd time and just as good as ever! I was dying for Indian food and all I could think of was how soon my reservation was coming up. I highly recommend this restaurant - everything is excellent!

Extremely satisfied to find a place for my quarterly Indian food fix. This place fills up fast even during the week so make a reservation or get there early. A little noisy with some of the families there. Had friends from Portland, Louisville, Tokyo and Montana. All went away with a great meal experience at a reasonable price.
This place is all about the Butter Chicken.  I've never had anything else - but it is the best Butter Chicken I've had anywhere.  For better ambiance, go to the location in Santana Row.

Although the location is good (tucked into a strip mall), the restaurant is just average. The food is standard Indian fare, with no unusual dishes or preparation. The samosa and papad appeared to have been made in the morning and reheated for dinner. The thali plate had some bowls which were filled to the rim, others which were only half-filled, giving a slip-shod and unprofessional look to the meal. Service was slow, from the being seated to food service. Waiters were not in sync - we had three people ask about tea, but no one actually brought it until we reminded the busboy after 15 minutes. Find another Indian restaurant where one will enjoy the food and not be frustrated with the serivce.
The food is just really good. We go here whenever we want good Indian food that is a bit more upscale. We like this one better than the Santana Row location.

The Mulligatawny soup - which can vary tremendously - had too many lentils and not enough apple. It was fine to eat, but very much an American soup. The mixed vegetarian appetizer was good, but I wish the samosas weren't so fatty - sometimes they have a pastry case, which I like better. The Tandoori lamb was delicious. The pappadoms were excellent - crisp, fresh, tasty and not fatty. I really enjoyed the kulfi with vermicelli and rose water. The rice pudding was very good too with pistachios on top. The waiter was excellent.

I have not often found such well crafted food at the price point of Amber India. There is definitely something special in their approach.

It is a neighborhood place, not fancy, but still nice. The service was good. They have a lot on the menu and the staff was able to explain things to us.

They have some interesting cocktails. Loved the Indian version of mojitos with ginger and basil. It was a very refreshing low alcohol drink. They do wonderful things with sauces and vegetables. We ordered some meat and seafood on this visit, which was very good, but it would be a terrific place for vegetarians (I was one for many years).

Amber India is always on the Chronicle's list of top restaurants in the Bay Area, and it deserves it. The service is impeccable and the food is well-executed. The menu is updated seasonally, with some stalwarts that are always available. While I do love the butter chicken, my favorite dish is the baigan bartha: a nicely-spiced eggplant curry.

I used to love this restaurant, and I have gone here with my husband three years in a row for valentine's day. This year when we went, we noticed that not only was the menu different, but the service and quality of food has suffered, as well. The waiters were unattentive and had poor timing with when to approach the table, and when to bring out the food. For example, my husband's app was brought out without mine. Then my meal was brought out without my husband's... and they forgot his rice altogether. The pakoras were mealy, the mint chutney had the consistency of water, & the paneer was rubbery and not nearly as good as it has been in years passed. When we asked if the menu had changed, the waiter said, "Everything has changed." Well said.
Food was good, a little on the pricey side. Service was good except the food came very slowly.
Really excellent Indian food - tandoori fish, butter chicken, malai kofta, and vegetable korma were standouts!

I have been to Amber many times with friends (usually table for 4). This was the least pleasant experience. It was a Sunday night at 6 PM. The waiter rushed us to order, then brought the soup well before the appetizer. (We prefer the appetizer served first.) In addition, our Pimms drink did not arrive at the table until after the soup and during the appetizer, which was barely begun when the main course arrived. In addition, the lamb and chicken were not as tender. The butter chicken tasted more of jalapeno pepper rather than curry. The lamb was not as curry flavorful as usual either. Overall, it was a disappointing dinner. Have they changed chefs?
Though the food is quite good, the service was very slow, and our order was inaccurate when it did finally come.

This was a fabulous place to eat. Brought my girlfriends here as we were craving Indian food. Two of the 4 girls had never been to this restaurant and they couldn't say enough good things about this place.

The food was just out of this world, service was exquisite, our waiter helped served our food to all of us instead of just setting it on the table and leave. Most of all the ambiance was very nice.

Reservations was very easy to make via OpenTable and when we checked in, we got seated right away.

We will definitely come back! Can't wait!
I have been dining at Amber India for years and always enjoy the food and the service. My favorites are the Sea Bass Tikka and the Palak Paneer.
Definitely my go to Indian food place. Dont miss the butter chicken
Everything was delicious and the wait staff was very accommodating to our requests.
Excellent, and spicy indian food!

The food was excellent and the variety was good. The dessert table could be improved in variety even though the quality was also very good. The buffet style works very well for lunch and the line was not a problem at all. Service was fast and efficient. Overall a very good experience,
Excellent food. Amazing textures and flavours and great service. Lives up to it's longheld reputation as one of the best restaurants in the Bay Area.
Food tasted good but all of us had stomach cramps that night. I hope this was an isolated issue.
The lunch Buffett is fantastic! I especially loved the butter chicken, but everything was delicious.

We ordered two vegetarian entrees (Paneer matar and Malai kofta) but they both had almost the same gravy. The kofta was mostly potato where they could have done better with 'lauki' (squash).

My son has food allergies (tree nuts, sesame) and does not eat spicy food but there are no kid friendly menu items.

The atmosphere was noisy and tables are close to each other. Overall the price performance is poor.

We really loved this place. Such a warm welcome at the door, and lovely service (except for the server who seemed to look down on us and laughed at us for not wanting to share all of our dishes—but we had a vegetarian who was not going to eat the meat others ordered!) The food was quite good--very satisfying and flavorful. Some of the best paneer I've had. We were impressed that the place was packed on a Monday night in the suburbs! Will definitely be back.
Great Indian restaurant in Mountain View. It's a little pricey with drinks, but definitely an authentic Indian dining experience.
Best Indian food in the Bay Area, period!
The food at Amber India is outstanding. Every time we have dined there it has been good. Our waiter was just perfect, friendly, helpful, had good advice but wasn't hovering.
This is a place to go for Indian food. Try it once and you will come back as many times as we have. It is a special occasion desitination for our family
Amber India in Mountain View is a personal favorite, and is, for me, the best place to go for lunch in the area. With their excellent buffet, I tend to eat too much, since you want to try everything.
Everything was great, we had a fantastic time.

The food was excellent, very well seasoned authentic Indian food with a good selection of vegetarian dishes. Service was good. Tables were a bit close together for a fine restaurant - if they spaced them out a bit the ambience would be better, but it wasn't bad. I will definitely be going back - the food was delicious and very high quality.

Outstanding Indian food, well seasoned and interesting dishes -- not outrageously spicy.
Good service and an elegant ambience. As an amateur cook of Indian food, I was humbled and impressed.
Best Indian food in Mountain View area. Outstanding Butter Chicken!
Thanks for the food and the service. I always enjoy going to your restaurant.
Simple the best Indian cuisine in the SF Bay area.

Food was good but drowning in sauce. Not spicy enough for my taste, but that could just be what we ordered (butter chicken and lamb ghosht). Didn't like that everything was a la carte. Had to order rice and bread and raita seprately. A dinner for 2 with a drink each ended up costing $72. Too much for this food in my opnion

We have been to Amber India many times and the restaurant never disappoints. The food was masterfully prepared and served table side - the butter chicken, sea bass tikka and scallops were prepared to perfection. It was our friends' first time to the restaurant and they thoroughly enjoyed the meal. Thank you for great service and for consistently preparing good food.
The lunch buffet is varied, tasty, and fresh. Best Indian food in town.
Consistently good food and service.
Great Indian food.. some of the best you'll find anywhere in the US. Prices are on the high-side, but good quality and good service.

The food was wonderful--a whole level above the ordinary fare in most Bay Area Indian restaurants. The wine list was excellent with lots of great choices. The service was friendly and helpful as the waiter helped us learn about the house specialties.

We enjoyed the food very much - the dishes are quite substantial. However, the lamb in the dish we ordered was tough and hard to chew. The manager/owner? came to our table asking how we liked everything and we told him about the lamb. No doubt they will correct this. The ambience was lovely, the food not too spicy and no doubt we will go again. The restaurant was filled by the time we left. They seem to have an abundance of waiters.
Food was excellent. Decent selection of wines. Waiter was helpful in selections and quantities - we were a large group. Will definitely be back.

As always the food and service were wonderful. We had 9 dishes for our group and it's so great to be able to try such a variety of their menu. The dishes all somehow work well together, flavors never seem to compete but each are very unique. The staff is always friendly and great with suggestions. Try the seasonal special of ocra!

Food is just plain excellent. It was a pleasure to enjoy such sophisticated Indian food. The service, while enthusiastic and friendly, was a wee bit disorganized — but nothing to get exercised about, it all worked out fine. A lovely experience, 3000 miles from home, thanks to Open Table, without whom we'd never have found the place.
We have not been back to Amber for a while, for no other reason than being busy. We remembered it as one of the best Indian's for tasty food, yetp again it did not disappoint.
Having tried so many Indian places, I think this is at the top of my list. Food is as authentic as any place else.
The lunch buffet is comprehensive with far more than the usual staples. Easily one of the best in the SF bay area.

No comparison to the Amber India in San Francisco, in terms of atmosphere or food. This one's in a plaza on a long non-descript stretch of El Camino, with tablecloths and a few flowers the only really civilized elements. Food was so-so at best; I had the vegetable biryani and my companion had the lamb kebab. Mulligatawny soup was OK. Crowded for lunch most likely because there is so little else that's decent in that area -- but don't come here to meet a client or prospect you want to impress.
inconsistent food execution & taste. on other occasions including takeout, we had better.
The food is great! And the menu is extensive. The service is on again/off again.

made a res for an early mid week dinner. several staff members were standing a few feet away from the reception desk chatting and continued chatting even though they all saw us standing there. eventually someone came up and showed us to our table.

the service was ok and responsive to our need for a fairly quick meal. we ordered 4 entrees. two came hot and two did not. food was ok, good, nothing special. when they wrapped up to go, they gave us each other's take-home bag of food and we didn't find out till the next morning- not good especially since i could not eat almost all mine and had to take it home (most of $13.75 wasted) since it was not hot and we had no time to ask them to reheat. how difficult is it to come by right after m
high quality food. great ambiance. it's a little tucked away off the street so i would add specific details regarding where the restaurant is at.
Excellent indian food, but interestingly more non-indian people dining there!
A stand-out among the many high quality Indian restaurants in this area.
Excellent food - so pleased to have found this restaurant on the Peninsula!
I can't tell you how much I love Amber India. The food is gorgeous, the service is outstanding. Their house cocktails are wonderful. I've never had a bad experience there.
Amber is a terrific restaurant with excellent food, great ambience and outstanding services. I've been coming to Amber for the last 10 years and never been disappointed.
Outstanding Indian food in a quiet, pleasant setting. The complete dinners are a very good value; ordering a la carte can be expensive.
Food is excellent.............very tasty and with top-quality ingredients. Service friendy but professional.

My wife and I enjoyed a fine dining evening at Amber. The staff was prompt and courteous. They were also helpful in helping us arrange our menu. The food was delievered to the table speedily and hot. We found the menu to be both varied and interesting and can easily return and choose a completely different group of items for our varied interest. The general decor was quite agreeable.
Toward the end of our meal, we regretted a tendency of three of the organizational staff to come to our area to check to see how we were progressing (or ending). They tended to stan next to our table and simply staRE. Unfortunate for a very fine meal rreasonably proced.
The Food is the real reason to visit this spot!.... Never disappoints!

While Amber India may lack a lot of street appeal it certainly makes up for it with fine food and great ambiance. The staff were friendly and informative and helped us choose dishes complimentary in taste and flavor. We tried two meat dishes and one vegetarian and all were delicious. My only fault would be that the Mirch Gosht which was described in the menu as being hot and spicy was relatively mild.
Would certainly visit Amber India again though.

We had lunch, so we were able to have a varied selection of the excellent food at the buffet. Delicious!!
Service is also good, attentive to needs.
Terrific lunch spot. Excellent Indian food buffet. In and out very easily. Definitely warrants many a return.
Staff was very attentive and polite, and food was excellent. Food came out very quickly, and water was always filled before we ran out.
Outstanding food, exceptional service. no pretension or excess energies spent on presentation. Setting was simple but neat.

The BEST Indian food money can buy in Silicon Valley..... I live in Manhattan and come to the Valley every month and never miss the food here! MUST TRY! and the staff is the best and friendliest too..... well which Indian is not?!
I've been here for lunch a couple times and been happy with the overall value with the lunch buffet, but I think it's a bit overrated.  I might change my mind if I go for dinner.
Classic largely Northern Indian food, well prepared and well served.

Amber India is one of the best Indian restaurants on the peninsula. The butter chicken is highly recommended. I rate the restaurant Very Good Plus (if five stars were excellent rather than outstanding, I might even rate it that highly - I think there is a need for a new rating scheme). Amber India lacks the innovative creativity to make it "Outstanding" - a rare rating for me, but it is a favored place. It is somewhat more elegant than most Indian restaurants.
The best Indian food in the bay area!
Superb Indian cuisine with great service to boot. Lovely Indian beers available, many that are difficult to find retail. Veggie dishes are superb.
The staff was very attentive to our needs. The food and service was fantastic. We are glad we went there.
Food looked unappealing - resembled slop.
Excellent traditional Indian restaurant. One of the best in the valley.
My husband and sons love the tandoori mixed grill. My favorite dish has always been the butter chicken.
Best Indian food anywhere. Service a little slow, but usually better.

our recent visit was most enjoyable...they have improved greatly and food now tastes authentic and well prepared.....we shall return....tandoori chicken and chicken vindaloo were perfect for our taste.
Good food, nice atmosphere. The eggplant dish was hotter than expected, but delicious. Overall can't go wrong!

Really delicious meal. I went with a friend and our kids (4 kids, 5 and under). The kids had a harder time, as the food was spicier than we'd anticipated. (We like spicy, but we requested the most mild dishes.) They did fine with lassis, plain Basmati rice, and Naan. The ambience was lovely, so fortunately they put us in the back with other families -- didn't have to worry about disturbing more romantic diners! Loved the chickpea dish, biryani, aloo gobi... Not my favorite palak paneer, but still good. Would definitely return, perhaps next time without the little ones...!

Without doubt this is the BEST Indian restaurant in the Bay Area. If you have not had their Butter Chicken you are missing a clasic dish. Service is very professional and they seem to honor reservations on time even though there is always a line to get in.
There was a large party but the restaurant was very apologetic about it. The service was outstanding and the food great. I will not eat Indian food from anywhere else.
Lovely, friendly staff. Excellent food.
No vintage dates on the wine list. This should not happen.
Wonderful Indian cuisine served promptly without fanfare. It's a foodie place.
Excellent food, excellent service.

Was referred here for the Butter Chicken but I have to say, it wasnt overly savory as expected. The fried eggplant or okra app was very good. But wasn't wowed by the curries. They were not bad but they were not decadent and intense as I had been told. I'd go back to try a lunch buffet. Nicer room than appears from parking lot.

I liked the food here. It was well seasoned and just a bit of a step up from the places I usually go in San Francisco. Comfortable dining room. The outside is a bit misleading because it is in a rather shabby small strip mall. The inside ambience is quite nice as is the service. While I enjoyed the food, I probably will not go back due to the pricing. Without wine, my meal for appetizer and two entrees was just about $50.00 before tip; rice is $2.50 for two small helpings. Indian food is prevalent in Mtn View/Sunnyvale, and there are much better bargains with comparable quality to be had.
Great Indian food, and you don't come away feeling like you have to go on a diet. They don't over do it with the oil, that is.
Excellent food. The Kerala lamb curry is unusual, coconut milk and black pepper, and delicious. Palak paneer is one of the best in the bay area. Waiters are excellent. Goes well with Indian beers.
One of our favorite restaurants! The food and service are always fantastic.

Went for the lunch buffet, and everything was delicious! Really tasty.  Service was excellent.  A large group of teenagers came in at one point, and they were a little noisy--but other than that, it was perfect!

Amber is not the nearest fine Indian restaurant to our home. But it is consistently the best--well worth a few extra minutes of travel. We tried some new dishes Friday--they were as luscious as our usual fare. The staff were attentive to our needs and never rushed us. We had a great evening.

This review is for lunch buffet only, which was quite disapointing. The only thing I liked on it was butter chicken. The rest was dull and too salty. There are better lunch buffets offered by other Indian restaurants at much lower cost.

Very authentic indian cuisine, the meat was very tender and sauces very tasty and spicy without being overly hot. Good selection of meat, fish and veggie dishes. As a Brit raised on indian cuisine, can highly recommend!

I took my boyfriend here for his birthday and we had a really great time. The food was spectacular. I had the Chicken Ka Tikka and would definitely recommend it. The service was outstanding; I haven't had great service like that in a long time. Overall the experience was quite pleasant and I would definitely go back.

We were just visiting Palo Alto, and I wish there were an Indian restaurant as good as Amber India in my area! I would go back again and again. We had the tandoori chicken (very good flavor and perfectly cooked) and something similar to sag paneer though they had a slightly different name for it (so good I could hardly stop eating it even though I was full). We also got the veggie platter as an appetizer, which was pretty good though I wished I had saved all my appetite for the main courses. Lots and lots of menu choices. Our only complaint was that it was awfully loud - a couple of large groups didn't help matters of course.
I was most impressed that the wait staff served our first helping. I liked that touch.
Consistently delicious and welcoming

We ate here in June and returned for another good meal in August. However, we left the restaurant after being seated at a miniature table that we thought inadequate for two people to be comfortable and to be able to place two serving dishes, raita, bread and beverages. Why do restaurants do this? We would have had to balance our food or constantly juggle plates around. The place was also freezing cold.  We could not tolerate eating there.

If we return to Amber we will again refuse this type of table. Not only Amber but other places should get rid of these tables to maximize their dining room but inconvenience patrons.
very pleasant dinner. Not muy first time at Amber. As always service was professional and food was delicious.

I think Amber India has excellent food and great service. It's our favorite Indian restaurant in the area. We took 2 friends who had never beeen and they kept saying how good the food was. I would recommend it to anyone, even people who think it might be too spicy, because they can tone down the spice for them, if necessary.
Excellent Indian food . All of the dishes were In the top tier of similar restaurants.
Amber India is my favorite place for Indian food in the entire Bay Area. Their butter chicken is to die for.
Amber India makes the best butter chicken!
Great Indian buffet lunch. We're never disappointed. Thank you.
Food and service is always outstanding. This is one of our family's favorite restaurants.
Service was not up to past levels - food delivered was almost cold which significantly lowered experience.

Well run Indian restaurant, quality and taste of everything we ordered was unformly excellent (we were three, and ordered lamb and vegetable biriyani, samosas, a spicy lamb dish, a chicken dish, some appetizers, etc. Prompt service, helpful waiter. I would defintely go back.
Everything was delicious. We tried something new and had the chaat. It was fantastic. The waiters are very attentive and efficient.

My visit to Amber India Mountain View was fine, but after having visited their San Francisco location, I would probably not go back to Mountain View. The San Francisco location is much better for special occasions. The Mountain View location is in a strip mall with a dry cleaners, a salon, and other miscellaneous businesses, and the interior of the restaurant was not as nice as I would have liked. The buffet that I assume they use for lunch is always out, taking up a large spot in the dining area, and our table was just inside the dining area, which meant the host was constantly standing at our shoulder as he checked to see what tables were free. Not great for a special occasion. Food was good, not amazing. Service was just okay.
Best Indian food in Silicon Valley!
Great food as always and the front room location was good for conversation.

What a change! I had very fond memories of this restaurant and liked the dishes very much. During my most recent visit the food was bland, the Dal overspiced, the noise too much for a quiet conversation and the whole restaurant stank like bad fish. The smell stuck to my clothing, it was just horrible.
I will have to find another Indian restaurant, this is no longer among my favorites.

I didn't realize I was getting a buffet-style brunch when I made the reservation. The buffet was better than most Indian buffets in terms of selection and quality but I thought the service was barely passable for the price. The buffet was poorly introduced to us and I never did find out if ordering off the menu was an option. No one seemed to take responsiblity for our table nor did anyone really check in with us as the meal progressed. Neither coffee nor tea were ever offered. Overall, I felt like it was more a cafeteria than a fine dining buffet.
Amber's food showed me that India food can be non-greasy AND delicious at the same time. It's a great place to go with friends if you want to try several dishes at once.
Food is good and service is wonderful, but it gets very loud in the restaurant. We had to shout across the table with kids and groups right next to us.
Outstanding Indian food in a pleasant and quiet atmosphere---also very good service.

We have not been to Amber India for several months. Our experience was not very good. The food was not flavored and spiced as we remember it....tandoori chicken was bland and the chicken masala was undistinguished. That, coupled by the small and pricey rice and naan led us to feel that we will not return in a hurry.
As always the food was good. Service was very professional and quick.

The hosts were very accommodating considering we were very late for our booking, but being a Sunday evening it wasn't very busy.

The menu selection was fantastic! It's not often that I find a restaurant where would happily choose almost anything off the menu - being a gluten free, non-land animal eating gal. The cocktail and wine list will probably satisfy too, they were certainly satisfactory for an Indian restaurant (where the taste of wine is so easily overpowered by the stunning array of spices).

If you love a good curry I would definitely recommend this place!

As always, the food was delicious. The service was reliable until the end when they brought us our bill before we were ready to leave! We were thinking of ordering desert and another drink when the waiter plopped the bill down and left. He was apologetic when we explained that we weren't through, but I did expect better service from Amber.
If you want great Indian food, this is the place. However, they don't serve lamb at lunch buffet. You will find fish instead.

We go here often and the food is always exceptional.  Each dish is notably different.  It isn't just the same curries and flavors with different main ingredients.  We always order different things and we have never ordered something that we were sorry we ordered.  The quality of the food is better here than at the Santana Row location, in my opinion.  Noise level can vary, so sometimes it is really nice and quiet and sometimes there are loud groups.
We live in Sunnyvale and whenever we are craving a go-to place for dinner it's always Amber. Food is always delicious, good strong cocktails. Quick service (almost too quick).
Good food but a little pricey. Nice ambiance. Attentive service. Definitely a go-back-again place.

Excellent Indian food. This is a somewhat less elegant Amber India restaurant in comparison to their other two locations, one in Santana Row and the other in San Francisco. Tucked away in a small shopping center, it is still a pleasant restaurant setting inside and the food is the same outstanding Indian cuisine served in the other two establishments. Each of the many dishes we tried was wonderful--tasty and expertly prepared. The wine list is relatively small, but thoughtful and moderately priced. Amber India does not disappoint!
Quite pricey for Indian food. The okra was superb, although at $12.95, is a little high. I was hoping it would be under $10.

This is rated one of the best Indian restaurants in the Bay Area over and over for a reason...excellent flavors and excellent quality of food used. This isn't your cheap everyday curry place, but you definitely get what you pay for.
The best tikka masala, palak paneer, and eggplant around.
Amber has long been my favorite Indian restasurant in the area, however I was greatly dissapointed with my experience on Wednesday night. Service was poor and the food was dissapointing.
I liked the ambiance - cozy and clean. The butter chicken was great. The lentil dessert was amazing. Their cocktails are also very good - can't go wrong with any of them.
We were very disappointed in the dishes we ordered. The chicken and lamb were dry and the Shrimp was overcooked. We very much enjoyed the sauces and naan bread.
The food is reliably good at Amber but the service is slow. On all visits we have had to wait up to 10 minutes for a waiter to take a drink order. This is much too slow.
We ate vegetarian - the food was excellent. My foreign guests wanted juice but the restaurant only had canned - that was the only negative. Service attentive but not over-bearing.
Amber India is the best Indian restaurant I've been too. The lamb is wonderful. It is definitely an upscale place, with white tablecloths and very attentive waiters.

I do love Amber India. The food is always great, the service is impeccable, and it's just a great experience all around. While there are plenty of other good Indian restaurants in the area, Amber stands head and shoulders above the rest.

The food was good, as always. The Frontier Kebab is a favorite. The service--which has never been good-- was terrible, probably the worst I've ever experienced. No waiter ever came to our table on his own; we had to wave or call out every time we wanted something. And it was not because the restaurant was full, far from it.

I ate here with my boyfriend on Diwali, and I'm so glad I made the reservation. My boyfriend is Indian and always has a bit of a hard time not being home with family on Diwali, but Amber was a thriving, festive holiday spot. There was an amazing buffet set up with more delicious, perfectly-prepared, unique dishes than any one person can sample in one evening. Seriously, roasted quail in a buffet? Truly wonderful. Thank you, Amber. You've made my boyfriend miss home a little less on more than one special occasion this year. It's worth the drive from San Francisco.

Well-prepared traditional Indian (mostly North Indian) food served by attentive if not polished professional waiters. Attractive, not too noisy ambience.
As is almost universal in Indian restaurants in the US, "hot and spicy" on the menu translates to pretty bland. Indian cooks and waiters simply won't believe that there are Americans who like lots of chillies, even if told so directly. Nevertheless, the balance of seasoning in my lamb curry was good if too bland for my taste.
Outstanding food- fine ingredients.

They were laying a new floor in the main dining room, so the remaining tables were a bit crowded. Food was, as always tasty, but the butter chicken (our favorite) was not as hot as normal. Service wwas great.

We have been going to Amber India for over 10-years and have never been disappointed once. If anything this establishment continues to improve. The services is always attentive without being intrusive and the food is always fresh and delicious. The Sea Bass Tikki is outstanding!
The food is spectacular. We love the restaurant.

the food was good, but portions are small and a bit expensive for what it is. but all of the Amber restaurants have a good reputation Indian and non-Indian alike. i mean $10 for basket of naan, which is maybe two regular pieces of naan is a bit much. most entrees are $12-16, even the vegetables.Otherwise, enjoyable.

The only Indian restaurant I really like in the South Bay. Almost all others' Indian food tastes more or less the same, like industrial animal feed, compared to Amber's. There are some purely veggie Indian restaurants that come close, but Amber also excels in dishes with meat.

The place was good but maybe we had too high expectations based on some of the reviews here. It's certainly not the best indian food in the area, probably not even the best in Mountain View. But it was quite good, the chicken tikki marsala was very tender and tasty, the vegetarian delight had some highlights as well, but some fairly average dishes as well. Surprisingly large drink selections. Atmosphere is fair, not exactly romantic. Friendly and attentive staff.

Amber India is always one of my favorites. It's simply the best Indian food on the Peninsula and both the Mountain View and Santa Row locations have excellent ambiance, service, and food. Try the vegetable samosas as an appetizer.

The food here is tasty and never greasy. The wait staff was helpful when I asked a question about the degree of spiciness of a dish. On this particular visit, we had a hard time getting someone's attention when we wanted to order more nan. I tried the salmon and it had a slightly barbecued flavor. The dipping sauces, one mint and the other a sweet and sour, were nice accompaniments. Often we are seated in a side room where it is easy to have a conversation. This time we were in the larger room and the noise level only allowed for side-by-side conversation, but not for people sitting across the table from one another to be heard.

Always absolutely delicious! We especially like the Sea Bass Tikka and the Palak Panir. The service is good - they don't always check back with you, but overall they are great. We appreciate the quietness both in the restaurant and the staff - all very gracious.

When we arrived, we were disappointed to find that the restaurant was only offering the buffet. Our disappointment quickly dissipated with the first fork full. Every dish offered was full of favor with Indian spices and cooked well. I don't eat meat and had more than enough to choose from and the naan was fluffy, but substantial without being heavy. If you like Indian food, Amber is a must!

There's a reason that Amber India is always on the SF Chronicle's list of top restaurants in the Bay Area: they do it all right. The service is top-notch. The wine list is quite good, and their cocktails are lovely. The real star is the food. There's the much-lauded butter chicken, which no other Indian restaurant in the Bay Area can touch. The rogan josh is another star. Dive into the vegetable dishes for plenty of goodness there.

The meal was enjoyable although I've had equally good Indian food in the Bay Area for more reasonable prices. Also a little disappointing not to receive dining points for a meal on a Thursday night at a restaurant that was only half full.
Tasty Indian food in a "cafeteria/fast food" setting.
I enjoyed the butter chicken, and some of the other buffet table options. I would have liked to of had the option to order dishes at lunch though instead of having to do the buffet.
Good food but terrible service. All but ignored the entire meal.

Amber India is definately one of the best restaurants in the area. The food is delicious! The staff is super attentive. One of the waiters came over and said he was replacing our Naan because it was a bit burned. We hadn't even noticed, but it was so nice of him to take that attention to detail. I have never been disappointed going to Amber. I highly recommend it.
All dishes but the lamb curry were superlative. Service was excellent.

The lunch buffet was very good. The food was definitely top quality and much better than other Indian buffets I have been to. There wasn't quite enough variety though. There were 3 chicken dishes, but I would have liked to see some other meat other than just chicken.
