At $16 a person it was not the cheapest Indian buffet, so I would have liked to have had more choice. That being said, we will definitely go back because the food was really good.
Great food and excellent service.

I went with my vegan and vegetarian friend and of course we had a lot of questions about the ingredients in some of the dishes. The server was extremely patient and diligent in helping us find the best dishes to suit our diets. He chose well! I guess if I had thrown in a couple of meat dishes, I would have marked the food as 5-star Outstanding, but rating the meal I had there that night, it was 4-star Very Good b/c we only had vegan dishes. 4-star for vegan dishes is still pretty great!

I love this restaurant, but I have to say, the Amber India in Santana Row isn't too shabby either. I heard this one was and always will be better, but I might have to beg to differ if we're talking about vegan/vegetarians patrons...
Expensive BUT great food - can't miss the butter chicken!

When we want really good Indian food with great service and ambiance, we go to Amber India. My husband and I ordered the mixed grill, the danish potato dumpling, and the Basil and Garlic Naan -- all were excellent! There was just enough heat/spice to the dishes to be totally Indian but too not overpowering.

I had a question about one of the dishes, as it came out very quickly, but not as hot as one would expect if it were done-to-order. When one of the Managers asked about the food, I mentioned this. He expressed his pleasure at hearing of my concern and inquired of the kitchen. He came back and stated that, indeed, that dish had been made a very short time earlier for a larger order, explaining the small discrepancy I noted.
I greatly appreciated his honesty. The food, as always, was uniformly excellent.

Nice food. Ambiance was not all that great. Feels like a regular restaurant. Not suitable for a romantic outing, but if you sacrifice ambiance for the quality of food, you must visit this place. One of the oldest Indian restaurants in the bay area. The best Malai kofta I have eaten in the US.

Amber India provides authentic Indian tastes. Well seasoned and interesting buffet....good value for the quality and variety, however nothing exceptional here. If you hanker for an Indian meal occasionally it fits the bill.

The food continues to be great at Amber. The restaurant in Mountain View has several rooms with very different light, and the mood varies considerably in the different rooms. With the downturn, many tables are unoccupied. Table decor has dropped off and some maintenance issues leave quite a bit to be desired. Friendly, knowledgeable and efficient service make up for the drop off in decor.
Authentic and delicious food at reasonable prices. A real find!
Great food, and good service. Will be back for many more dinners. Remind me of my friend Manjuma's cooking.

Amber is my favorite Indian restaurant in the Bay Area and deserves its perennial place in the SF Chronicle's top 100 list. While there are other Amber satellites, nothing beats the original Mountain View location. Service is fantastic and so is the food. While I am not a native Indian, I did spend about a month in India on business and had the good fortune of being taken to some of the local favorites. By my best estimation, Amber is just as good as the top native restaurants overseas.

Best Indidan food in the Bay Area. Service can be a tad slow and climate control can be a problem (depending on where one is sitting, the air conditioning can blow cold and hard on you) but the food makes it totally worth it.
Food and service were very good.
Excellent food, very attentive staff.

This is an excellent restaurant that I knew many years ago when it was started. They now are in san jose and san francisco. This is amazingly cheap buffet with fabulous food mostly not meat and a good balance of food that is cooked and salad and fruit. Its a really nice place

Judy

This was the second time we had went to a Indian Restaurant. The first time was in London, and my boyfriend said he would never go again. He hated the food. Since we live in Mountain View and there are so many Indian Restaurants to choose from, I talked him into giving indian food another try. We went to Amber India in Mountain View, and it was outstanding. The food was awesome. We had two of their signatures dishes, the chicken tika masala, and a lamb dish. The flavors were great. The service I think was one of the best we had ever seen. If you are looking for something with great food, great ambiance, that serves indian food then this is the place. We will definitely go back, and I can't wait.
We had an excellent dinner for 4. Wish it wasn't in a strip mall but I would definitely go back. Servers were very nice. Prices were reasonable.
Amber India rightfully has the reputation of being one of the best Indian restaurants in the Bay Area!

We eat Indian often, but had never ventured to Amber. The appetizers were okay, but the entrees were outstanding. We had the butter chicken, a spicy scallop dish, and baked eggplant as well as some garlic basil naan. Each dish was amazing! Definitely the best naan I have ever tasted. The servers were attentive, and we will definitely be back.

The food was delicious. We were particularly impressed by the service. The waiter served the various dishes directly onto our plates for us, which is unusual in an Indian restaurant, where they often just put the dishes to share in the middle of the table. The interior of the restaurant isn't very special, but it's very clean and certainly fine for a family dinner out. If they redecorated and updated the furnishings, it would become a five-star experience.

Food was better than the Amber Santana Row, and like the Santana Row Amber the service was not great. When we got seated we had to get someone to take our drink over after 15 minutes. Plus I saw certain waiters make the customer's plates when the food first arrived, but did not receive the same service, I guess since we were Indian it was understood we could do it. But it would have been great and consistent if they offered us the same service.
Amber is the best Indian restaurant on the Peninsula. The food is always outstanding.

Mountain View has something like twenty Indian restaurants. Amber is clearly a cut above all of them. The menu is varied and has creative Indian dishes rarely found, like the piquant Goa fish. The ambience is one of fine dining with an attractive room and attentive service.

We've eaten here several times over the years. The management and wait staff seem to have deteriorated this year as has the quality of the food. In the past I would have rated the two higher. The maître d'/waiter was abrupt and unfriendly.

We read Michael's Bauer reviews and had high expectation for our first visit. We were disappointed by the service. The food was OK but nothing exceptional. The wine was not very good and the pistachio ice cream tasted like detergent.
Best Indian Food on the Peninsula. Fantastic Fish Tikka, Rogan Josh and Chicken Tikka Masala.
Food was good. Service was slow and disappointing!

This is a popular place in Silicon Valley serving Indian cuisine. Noise level is quite high, service ok, food also ok. We ordered several orders of the Tandoori Salmon and Tandoori Seabass, the chunks of fish were all burnt black on one side, and had been marinated in something overly sour, and were otherwise quite dry. The Saffron rice hardly tasted of Saffron, the desserts were super sweet and gooey, and rather bland. The Chicken Tikka Marsala was ok, but then again this is not really an authentic Indian entree anyway. Overall decent in terms of food, ambiance and service, but not really outstanding.
We were seated 30 minutes after our reservation time and the food was pretty pathetic (in terms of Indian food).
Amber India's butter chicken is the best!

Very disappointing, especially for what is reputed to be one of the best Indian restaurant in the Bay Area. Both the service and food were lacking. We had to wait 45 minutes past our reservation time to even get a table. Then, once seated, the waiter took our order and we never saw him again. The food was bland and uninspired, with no hint of spice. I feel like this is a restaurant that is merely resting on its outdated laurels.
Very good Indian food. Service was attentive but awkard (they serve from platters to your plate). A little expensive and smallish portion.

Great place for Northern Indian food mid-Peninsula. The interior has been re-decorated and looks nice; the lighting is somewhat sub-optimal and takes away from an intimate atmosphere from the windowless room well filled with tables. Don't get scared by the location in a non-descript strip mall. This is where some of the best restaurants are located around El Camino

We had to wait a little while for food to be prepared and served, but it was well worth it. Every dish we ordered was excellent, and the entire eating experience was enjoyable. We will definetley return.

name: Stamp Bar & Grill
description: You will find it hard to recall a time before small plates, and harder still to find a Bay Area restaurant where the focus was on satisfying one appetite at a time as we do at Stamp Bar & Grill. If you were venturing about Laurel street–in the happening pocket of San Carlos, and just looking for something different yet good to eat, step into Stamp Bar & Grill. We will most likely have plenty to keep you satisfied with our fresh, seasonal, and unique selections that will surely keep you coming back. From our meat to fish to vegetables, our food is as fresh, organic, and delicious as it gets.Experience modern American classics alongside globally inspired flavors.Come and seekStamp Bar & Grill
hours:
Mon–Thu, Sun 11:00 am–8:45 pm
Fri, Sat 11:00 am–9:30 pm

reviews.text: Love this place with exception of very loud music.

We had a great dinner once again at Stamp.  Food was outstanding, the cocktails and wine delciious.  We had wondeerful table service from Osmar and the owner/manager stopped by our table of four to see how we enjoyed the food and our overall experience---not something that happens at every restaurant.  We brought another couple who had never been to Stamp.  They will definitely be returning as we will!!!
The food at Stamps is always incredible!  Highly recommend!!

We had a wonderful Christmas Eve dinner at Stamp.  The service was outstanding and the cocktails were outstanding.  The food, as always, was delicious.  Highly recommend the Fettucine with darkened salmon and the Pappardelle Stroganoff---both exquisite.  Start off with Calamari and a Caesar Salad, and you can't miss!!!
The service was slow and inattentive, and the food was mushy and flavorless. Do not recommend.
Tuna tartar was super salty then the vegetarian paella was terrible.  Seemed like steamed rice smeared around the pan and frozen veggies.  Had zero flavor.
As always Stamp was wonderful. The staff went beyond our expectations. Our meals were cooked to perfection. It was an enjoyable experience to share with friends and family

My 13 year old and I frequent Stamp, what a hidden jewel. We’ve always had a great dining experience here; from food and drink to service and ambiance. I love their menu, and their dirty martinis are delicious. We visit Stamp at least monthly.

I love stamp! The owners, bartenders, and staff are all friendly and welcoming, and the food and cocktails are always delicious! I highly recommend the filet mignon stroganoff and the watermelon mule, but you can’t go wrong with anything!

The lamb shank was excellent.
The linguine and clams was ok. Needed more wine and clams
Outdoor seating available, sidewalk tables.  Very friendly staff, good service.  Varied menu.  We enjoyed the paella (sp?), lamb shank, salads, & rigatoni.  We shall return.
A bit expensive, but we enjoyed the dinner and service.
The food and drinks were very excellent and our server was very  excellent and took very good care of us

I ordered the Paella and it was mushy and wasn't pleasant to eat. My wife ordered the game hen and that was a much better dish. The Calamari wasn't bad but included slices of lemon which was very sour.  The service wasn't bad.
Great kitchen, great staff and great place to hang out.
This was my third time there and each time the food was delicious and service excellent.

Was good food enjoyed it
My girlfriend  had a good time
I would highly recommend the oxtail stew; the very best I’ve ever had.
Outstanding all around.  Delicious food!￼ ￼Customizd order for us.  Will be recommending this establishment to all of our friends. ￼
Great place to celebrate! Our family dined there recently for a birthday dinner and, of course, the food and service didn't disappoint. It always feels like we are part of an extended family.
Food and service was awesome!  Outdoor seating was comfortable and we didn't feel like we were forgotten.  Everyone was very attentive.
Ate lunch there with family.   Food was delicious.  Service was attentive.  They offer $22.00 3-course meals for Monday through Friday.  Great value meals.  Highly recommended.

We were celebrating a birthday and they went out of their way to make it a special evening. The service was excellent and the food was very well prepared and delicious. They accommodated my request to have the tacos served in lettuce wraps without blinking an eye. We were very pleasantly surprised by how nice everything was.
Food and service were great! We enjoyed our dinner, especially after they turned off the fan at the door that was creating an occasional loud overtone. Very attentive staff.

This was our first visit to Stamp Bar and Grill.  We had dinner reservations for Saturday night, arrived on time and were happily greeted by the owner.  We had a great table for 4 and our server, Edwin, was a very nice, friendly young man who took really good car of us.  The Bulleit Manhattans were excellent!!  Food was delicious.  Fettuccini with blackened salmon was excellent, French Dip sandwich was done to perfection and the Baby Back Rib appetizer was large enough for it to be an entrée for my wife.  I could go on.  We had a wonderful time and will return again soon.

name: Rangoon Ruby Burmese Cuisine - Palo Alto
description: Rangoon Ruby was birthed from a desire to bring authentic Burmese food to the great people in Silicon Valley & the San Francisco Bay Area.With accomplished chefs proficient in all of the specialties that make Burmese cuisine sought after by food aficionados, Rangoon Ruby is fast striking a chord with diners looking for a fresh, modern approach to one of Asia’s up and coming popular cuisines.Influenced by Indian, Thai, and Chinese cooking, our Burmese menu is complemented by an exquisite wine selection and hand-selected draft beer to quench your thirst.At Rangoon Ruby, we pride ourselves in going the extra mile to bring you the ultimate dining experience. From our warm service staff to an extensive menu of outstanding dishes and artfully designed interior with upscale ambiance, it is our mission to elevate your experience with the delights of Burmese cuisine.
hours:
Lunch
Daily 11:30 am–2:30 pm
Dinner
Mon–Thu, Sun 5:00 pm–9:30 pm
Fri, Sat 5:00 pm–10:00 pm

reviews.text: I accidentally discovered this restaurant and WOW!   Love it!  Have eaten there 3 times this month.  Wish we had one in Los Altos. Judy

We were seated promptly. Service was friendly and unobtrusive. We had tea leaf salad, shrimp and eggplant, lemongrass chicken, and garlic noodles (medium spice level). A great meal and half came home for dinner tomorrow.

Ruby Rangoon is a gem for flavorful Southeast Asian cuisine! The tea leaf salad was fresh and packed with umami, and the crispy samosas were perfectly spiced. The fiery tofu had a great balance of heat and texture, though I wouldn’t have minded an extra kick. The pad Thai was delicious, though slightly on the sweeter side, and the lemongrass chicken was fragrant, tender, and well-seasoned. Service was warm and welcoming. Overall, an excellent dining experience—I’ll definitely be back!

I really wanted to like it but unfortunately we had a bad experience from the start. The lettuce cups appetizer had hard bits in it that we had to spit out.  We ate very little of it and told our server who didn’t seem to understand. The main course was fine but we were careful eating. We couldn’t wait to leave.
Food was great. The place was super packed and even with a reservation there was a 15-20 min wait.

We decided to try new things and ordered the lotus chips Very tasty with tea leaf aioli which we loved, along with the Tea Leaf Salad which is the most interesting and delicious salad on the planet!  The staff took great care of us, advised on a few choices on the menu which turned out to be beyond great, Delicious and a pleasure to try!  We had the broccoli with garlic, the Chicken and Shrimp, the Ruby Shrimp too and the food was fantastic in presentation and flavors. We will definitely dine at Rangoon Ruby again!

The server Mel was great we love him. I asked for no spice and the chicken and they added hot peppers. The broccoli was cold and my friends rice was not hot. But the food was delicious once we got it right
Our group had an absolutely lovely time here. Everyone that took care of us was very attentive and made great recommendations. Food was finger licking good! We look forward to coming back :)
Superb evening at Rangoon Ruby. Food was excellent and the staff went out of their way to do an incredible job. Excellent service, very helpful staff and delicious food. Highly recommended!
Excellent service from Ally (sp?) and Melvin. Food is delicious.
The food was excellent. The tea leaf salad was exceptional.
Very good food, brought quickly. Service slow at entry and at end of meal (getting seated then getting boxes and check). Definitely good enough to go back
The food, especially the tea leaf salad and the Mango White fish was excellent.  We ate at the bar and the service was wonderful.  Can’t wait to return.

We ended up having to get our food to go. Our apps came out fast and then we waited over 40 min for our entrees which we finally had to ask for to go. Also now refills on the drinks or even a check in while we waited.
Excellent coconut crazy cocktail, good food and good service

I’ve been going here since they opened and it was so bad. I’m sure the meat was cat or something other than beef or lamb.

Everything was just so inedible

The food was delicious and the service was excellent. They did a beautiful job of helping my guest celebrate her birthday with a festive scoop of mango ice cream and a wonderful flare. The seasoning on the tea salad is particularly wonderful.
Great food, easy dining experience. I highly recommend it
Good quality has good way down since the last time we visited. Everything was very salty.
Food has felt a bit below their best on my last two visits. Hope it’s a temporary fluke and not a sign of decline because this has been on my faves for a long time.
Must have their tea leaf salad -- unique and tasty treat. We also loved their mango chicken, vegetarian stir fry, and more. We've eaten here numerous times and greatly enjoy it.

This is our first experience with Burmese  cuisine. We like what we ordered, but think they tend to be a little on the sweet side.
We do recommend the Lotus Chip and the Mango Salad.
Food was mediocre and the service was delayed, we were just waiting to order

I would give them a -5 star rating if I could. The food was terrible. It looked awful and tasted awful. No flavors whatsoever.
Burmese food is supposed to be an explosion of flavors when you eat it. I guess they forgot the spices on all of our seven orders. Total waste of $500. Never going there again. ￼￼

I had a wonderful business lunch at Rangoon Ruby Burmese Cuisine. One of our party was familiar with the restaurant and did the ordering and everything was perfect.  Especially the Samosas and the Mango Chicken.  The ambiance was perfect--we sat inside and it was peaceful and sound level was good for conversation.  Hope to return soon.
This restaurant is one of our top 5 that we always use for when we have our executives in town.  Very accommodating and the food is exquisite!
We were seated just outside the main entrance adjacent to busy pedestrian sidewalk. The food and service were quite good. There were many distractions from the passersby.
Excellent service. Sometimes the meat is less than perfect but chicken mango delicious
Delicious food! Highly recommend! Really enjoyed the ginger salad.

Always great food. The chef is creative and flexible, always delivering superior flavor. The wait staff are great. Good place for casual business meals or gathering with friends. Great plates to share and experiment.

The waitress offerred us couple of options for Rum, I chose one which she recommended without saying anything about the price. When the check came, she told us the spirit we chose was the most expensive and a rare bottle, one shot ended up costing more than a meal. She apologized for not knowing and mentioning that when she recommended it. I din't want it to impact her wage so I took the hit and paid the check but I wish a manager would have come and adjusted it to cost and not their retail price because I wasn't told what I was buying.

I went to this restaurant after 7 years, it used to be good, now it seems like a tourist trap.

We had a challenging experience during our visit.  Service was really poor.  We ordered two appetizers and one never came. Then they told us that they’re out of it after we got the main course. Their service was slow and very minimal respect.

Too noisy, cramped and the food was not worth the price. Average nothing special about the place or the food.
Maybe my expectations are high.

Pad Thai veg was ok
Tea salad was good
Coconut was great , served cold

I ordered my dish spicy and my husband ordered mild.  The opposite happened and when I asked for extra spice on the side for my dish, which wasn't spicy,  I was told it would cost extra.  What?! 
Husband had chicken kebat he said he wouldn't get again and I had lemongrass chicken;  I thought the chicken was dry and.....not spicy enough even though I ordered it spicy!

While the service was attentive & friendly, we found the food mediocre for the Bay Area.
Not much in the way of exciting spicing or flavors.
Welcoming Host, Friendly Servers, Delicious Meal, Comfortable Ambiance. We’ll be back!
one dish was really bland - rainbow salad. my veggie curry was way too spicy and not even flavorful. just blended red chillies as a paste. this place used to be so much better
Satisfactory food, but very overpriced cocktails.
The food was so flavorful and delicious and came quickly.
Very tasty food, great choices, comfortable seating.

Worst service ever, Ordered 4 items from the menu after 15 min of waiting got only 1 dish. They forget about the rest 3 dishes , we had to remind them & when it came to the table it was cold. When complain about it they just re- heated and gave it back. No apologies from the restaurant or the server. Would not go agin.

Food was delicious and everyone was incredibly friendly.  Restaurant is very clean and we arrived by 5 and was very quiet.  As others started to arrive around 6 the noise picked up a bit but my friend and I could still enjoy our meal and hear eachother easily when talking.  The prices are a bit high but the quality is impecable.

Food was really good. Ambience was fair. It was really cold inside! Be aware there are no physical menus - QR code to your phone and you order from your table. There are waiters around to help if you need anything. Just a bit of a different experiences. They times, they are a-changin'.

We arrived at 6 pm for dinner and the restaurant was barely occupied. The service at that time was mediocre and then got worse. We had to ask 2 people about placing an order. The traditional tea leaf salad was tasty. However, the coconut rice did not have a strong coconut flavor. And, pumpkin curry with chicken was overcooked and bland. I had been there once before and enjoyed it. However with the poor experience from last night, I won’t be back. One last thing, when the restaurant is full, everyone walking by bumps into you and servers can drop things—not pleasant.

We used to eat at RR in Palo Alto regularly, then when they opened their branch in San Carlos we went there.  But their food quality slowly dropped.  Last week, when walking in Palo Alto we noticed that RR was very crowded, which was unusual.  We had dinner there last night and it was truly exceptional.  They have really upped their game.  We had the cocoanut chicken soup, crispy tofu and curried prawns.  All were excellent.

Amazing food and if you are gluten free, they have an entire gluten free menu which is such a treat.  Our whole group ordered off the gluten free menu and shared everything and no one suffered because their gluten free food is wonderful.  Highly recommend!!!

The pad Thai was so salty. It was just soggy noodles with salt. Only a few shrimps, no eggs, no vegetables or crushed peanuts as Pad Thai should have. We asked the waiter to exchange a dish, she said they could not do it. She just took it back probably rinsed with water and packed it for us to go. It noodles was so soggy was in small bits of pieces. Very disappointed:(
Service and ambience were excellent. Food was amazing - but a little complaint with the chicken curry, the chicken tasted a little 'gamy'. Other than that, I will gladly return.

I've dined here and in the San Carlos location many times. Our whole experience was off- the food, service, basic things like silverware and water. I love Burmese food and this was my last visit to RR.
Food was good. Nothing special. Palatas are greasy. Lamb basil fry was good. Coconut chicken curry is the best of all we tried.

We really enjoy the food here - tasty and reliable. Only complaint is that the food comes out TOO quickly, and the appetizers come out at the same time as the entree.  The last two visits, we received our drinks after the entrees were brought out.

It makes you feel they are rushing you out the door when the food comes out that fast. Drinks should always come our first, then appetizers, then entrees.
Just bad food, not tasty and not as it used to be

Cheap paper napkins and making me order on my phone were my first clues. Service was clunky at best.  Then the food was somehow not what it used to be.

A sign of the end.

Missing Left at Albuquerque.
This is actually one of my favorite places. Everything is delicious! The wait staff is great. We had a wonderful meal and a great time. Also love the decor!
Cozy place. Was a bit crowded in the evening. Tried the tea leaf salad, chicken fried rice and sesame chicken. Food was tasty and portions were good. Would recommend
Excellent food and service but be careful --  they trick you into buying an $8 water bottle by placing it on your table and not telling you it's filtered water...

I didn’t like that they trick customers to serving expensive Voss water that is already on the table. You should provide the water if requested and not have it on the table as if it is free when it is far from free

Food saved the day here to be honest - waiter service and attentiveness was sub-par for a Palo Alto establishment, and there’s nothing I hate more than scanning a QR code for a menu when out for an evening meal. Needs to get proper napkins for place setting as well - wouldn’t take much to elevate this place to a great all-round restaurant.

But don’t dismiss this place because of that - the food was exceptional.

Food quality was disappointing. The fish dish had a lot of onions and not a lot of fish. The garlic noodles had a weird after taste. 

The coco pudding for desert was nice. Ice cream had not a single natural ingredient.
We are always very pleased with our meals at Rangoon Ruby.

Rangoon Ruby was a disappointment. The shrimp in the pad thai still had the “vein” in some of them. This really should be removed for many reasons. Both this dish and the Sesame Chicken were over sweet, in the case of the chicken it was chicken candy.  Won’t be going back.
Feel like it’s gone downhill, maybe due to COVID. Food just doesn’t taste as fresh and delicious as before 🙁
The food was very pricey and oily. Perhaps not for the health conscious
A great place to go for a birthday celebration! Comped us with ice cream topped with a sparkler! Great food, friendly service, nice feeling all around.
Service was good; however, since we had to order digitally through a scanner, could not ask any questions.  Overall experience of dining out was not at all inspirational.
Food tasted bad. Fried rice and noodle are both soggy. Beef is very chewy. It is definitely over priced.
Excellent service and wonderful food!! Great Burmese food
Outstanding!! My new favorite go-to spot for lunch or dinner with friends!!  Love, love, love this place and tasty food! Nice to have GF and vegan for my wife and other guests who may need it.

Service is really broken.  This used to be an upscale restaurant. Now you don't get your ordered items on time or in the right sequence (appetizers come toward the end of the meal).  You have to order on your phone -- so it feels like fast casual.  Prices are up, service is down, time spent waiting is up.
Samosa Chaat was not too flavorful. But the lettuce wrap, Veg Kebat and coconut rice were excellent
Excellent food choices.   Our family of 9 enjoyed the Rangoon Lemongrass Chicken and the Basil Chili Beef the best.     They were the most flavorful.

Everything was excellent. Tea leaf salad was spicer than before, which is fine with us.
The ruby shrimp with onions was great, and the fried eggplant was divine. Add coconut rice and everyone was happy.

Voss sparkling water on every table. Purchase baiting. 9 dollars a bottle. You gotta ask for tap water or they won’t pour you any water.

$4.5 for a scoop of rice.

Shrimp was raw.

Rice noodles were over cooked to mush.

That about sums it up

The order is taken with QR a code on each table. In order to use the code you need an app installed on your phone. While this has its merits, we choose to use the traditional menu. 

We ordered the Chicken Kebat with the spice level as hot and it was very good and very hot.  We always order Tea Teaf salad and as usual, it was great.

First time tried Rangoon Ruby PA location, and it’s quite a let-down experience compared to the Redwood City one.  The quality of the food was below average.  We ordered their signature chicken curry and the chicken came out cold, although the curry sauce was tasty.  We told the server that the chicken is cold, and he responded maybe it’s because the curry was made in large batch and they didn’t reheat it well enough before serving.  The mango shrimp dish didn’t taste mango at all, it’s more like onion shrimp stir-fry and the onion was completely raw.  There was one slice of mango found in the dish, but it’s more like a garnish.  The restaurant was stuffed with extra seatings, crowded and noisy.  Disappointed.

Food is very good but the ordering process a bit weird. You need to us a QR code to order and my order never made it to the kitchen for some reason and then they wouldn’t let me order it afterward. Disappointing.

The staff was so friendly and attentive and the food was excellent. The curry tofu was incredible. It was a consistency that I've never had in tofu and was one of the best tofu dishes (of many!) I've ever had. The drinks were great too! A fun place!
Wonderful service. We were seated at the same time as a party for 25. The waitstaff and kitchen did not miss a beat.

We have been coming to this place for years now and love the food. The tea leaf salad is our favorite.
However, today was the first time we did not enjoy the salad. The first time the salad came, it had barely any dressing or any of the other addons (peanuts, chillies, roasted garlic etc). We shared this with the server who took the salad but then came back and said that nothing can be done and this is how it’s always been (and that he has been working there for years). We had no option but to ask that the salad be taken back.
At this point the owner came and asked what he could do to fix it. We shared the same feedback with him and he came back with the salad that had more dressing and tasted reasonable.
Overall, the food missed the mark and while I really appreciate the owner’s effort to fix the issue, the experience was sub-par. Hopefully, this was just an off day and next time around it would be better.
Great food with an unexpectedly energetic atmosphere
Parents weekend w our daughter at Stanford University

This restaurant is our favorite since so many years now but it deserves a review now. The staff and the owner are so accommodating always. Even last minute reservations they will serve you the same way others are served. They respect families with little kids and accommodate them. Food is delicious and our kids love the food too.
We have eaten there many times and we drive there from San Jose just for diy. I think that says it all.

We had vegetarian food, palata with curry, spicy eggplant and garlic noodles with tofu. All the food was well prepared . The wines we ordered ( Californian, Argentina and Chile) were fine. Service was attentive initially but became spotty as the restaurant became crowded. Loved the feature of being able to pay with Apple Pay at the table.

Overall the food was excellent. The pumpkin dish was disappointing.

What really left a bad taste was at the end of the meal when we had already paid and were visiting with friends. A server came over to tell us that they hadnt realized that we drank the bottle of water that had been on our table (with no indication that it wasnt complimentary)
She then proceeded to hit us with a $10 check.
Bad form all around. We will think twice before returning

Always a great meal at RR, and this night was no exception. We really enjoyed the mango salad, mango chicken, garlic noodles with pork, sesame beef, string beans, and coconut rice. The sesame chicken and garlic noodles were new to use this time, and they were both amazing!
Lunch meeting

The chicken crisp and catfish soup were pretty good, but I didn’t like that we received basically no service (you order from the QR code on the table, and if you want to speak to waiter with any questions, you have to go chase one down).
Used to be one of my favorite restaurants but no more. Food not as flavorful and signature tea salad especially disappointing.

We have always loved the food here, but something is amiss. Wait staff was disorganized. We sat outside (fairly empty on a cold night) and things didn't come, came wrong, etc. When we went inside to see what was happening, there were a couple of groups, but also a lot of staff standing around talking to each other. Also dishes ordered mild or medium came out far spicier than in the past. A real pity, this has been our go to for some time, now we are not so sure we will be back.
The food was so good! I think more people need to try Burmese food.
Nor worth to go! I couldn’t find any value on this place.

Surprisingly snooty, cutting corners, and unwelcoming.
I don't usually leave reviews, but my experience at this restaurant ruined a nice evening. We had a disappointing experience with the managing waiter commenting on and rushing to clear our table and menus, and being generally disrespectful to my female companion. While the server was perfectly friendly, the managing waiter's condescending attitude left a sour taste.

The restaurant clearly has an aggressive policy of pushing alcoholic drinks; we were asked three times about ordering beverages once seated, and felt judged when we went with only water. While the food had potential, it came with just a couple meager pieces of protein that were clearly dressed up with extra lettuce or noodles in order to inflate the overpriced dishes. I am usually stuffed after eating pad thai, but left feeling hungry.

Further, the small space quickly became crowded and it felt like we were sitting at the same table as the two-seater next to us. We could hear their entire conversation.

I wouldn't return or recommend with the current management and crowds.

Just average food and in my opinion very overpriced for the quality.
Dishes were not that flavoursome.
Burmese “pad Thai” was almost totally tofu and hardly any noodles no discernible shrimp and peanuts. The tofu was a little dry and rubbery and seemed flavoured like a different dish.
Mango fish was a nice flavour but  had far too many onions - a whole onion- piled on top.
The other dish was OK but just OK. Even the fried bananas was not amazing. Coco pudding was the one highlight. The bill came to A whopping 150 dollars with only one glass of wine.

Took my daughter for her birthday and had a wonderful experience. We got the tea leaf salad, garlic shrimp and eggplant, shrimp red curry, and garlic noodles, and all were fantastic. Service was prompt and friendly. Definitely going back.
Delicious food, friendly and helpful staff, great place to try something new!
Sesame chicken is incredible! Give it a try, you won’t regret it.
I enjoyed the food and interacting with the serving staff.  This is one of my favorite Palo Alto restaurants.
8 of us celebrated a birthday there.  Food is tasty as always and Service great.
Was a bit disappointed with the quality of the food
Really nice place to eat for a change of pace with exotic flavors and an unusual choice of food. We always sit outdoors and they keep it warm. Highly recommend the experience.

I took a friend for a birthday celebration dinner.  The food was on point .  It was a Thursday night and I was surprised at the number of people eating there.  It was quite noisy and hard to carry a conversation at times but the food and drink were great.

The server was efficient but didn't smile and cold, and in general, looked like she didn't want to be there, would have wanted a more cheerful server. Service ok. The main thing was the ambiance and the flavors and choice of the menu are terrific, love the food but the lamb kebat this time was very chewy, and the coconut rice wasn't fluffy as usual and completely soggy and moist like it was mango sticky rice.
For the price we pay, the food should be flawless.

We sat outside, which was lovely.  All the food we tried was absolutely delicious!  The mango salad was bright & crisp, and one of our favorite dishes.  The veggie kebat was another favorite, delicious seasoning, great textures!  Awesome selection of veggie choices, and also a plethora of gluten free options.  Highly recommend, we're looking forward to returning many times!
Everything was VERY salty

Service was good.  We were seated quickly.  QR code menus only.  It wasn’t clear if we order by phone or via our server, so we put our order in via phone, only for it to be rejected as we hit submit.

But our server was kind and patient, so we were happy to oblige.

Honestly, I had been here many times, pre-Covid and food was tasty.  But this time, it was horrible…..almost tasteless.  Maybe it was veggie options for pad Thai and garlic noodles? But they were the worst I’ve ever had - as I love noodles!

Mango chicken was better.  But saving  grace was the broccoli and coconut rice.
Service was good, but that about it.

The food was excellent; we especially enjoyed the tea salad and the eggplant with garlic.  One needs to use a QR code to order, so if you are a first/timer and need assistance with what Burmese specialties to order, you must summon a waitperson to advise you. Once we got someone to help us, it was excellent service.  The salad came before the cocktails, which was annoying, and then the rest of the food came out very rapidly, so do not come here for a leisurely meal-  more of a fast food ambiance.   It was very cold in the restaurant- they keep the door open so that the waitstaff can quickly serve those sitting on the patio.

Would we return?  Not on a chilly night, and not for a relaxing leisurely meal.  Maybe it’s best to order takeout.

Maybe because of the menu selection process via smart phone, but I didn't really see all the options available.  What we chose was modestly good to mediocre, so I guess we were disappointed with the food in large measure.  The service was fine but all in all the place rates a 3 star at best.

Fantastic food! Really great service. Would have preferred that the server came to us quicker and explain the choice of ordering through them or via the QR code. As it was we just ordered through the online menu, not realizing that our entire meal would come at once. Our server was able to get the appetizers for us first.

Overall a wonderful experience with fantastic food!
Poor service, very disorganized, decent food.

Food was excellent! However, outside seating was too close together that people seating next us often looked us which made us uncomfortable when we were talking.
Waitress was not so friendly to explain the menu. We were waited quite sometime for her to come back for ordering. ..around 5 o’clock, so not many customers were in that time. Also, we were drinking bottled carbonated water which was not explained by waitress earlier. By the time finishing the bottle, another waiter serving regular water next table reached our glasses which were low, so pored the pitcher’s tap water in our glasses. Afterwords, he realized his mistake and apologized, but never changed the glasses. So the water tasted strange with cucumber taste with slight bobbles. I’m not picky, but the service wasn’t good enough that whole experience wasn’t what I expected.
For birthday they brought out candle on ice cream scoop. Very short handed but if not in a hurry then service is fine.
Excellent charming service. Food great as always.
I understand they were very shorthanded only had 2 cups last night.. So we weren't in a hurry but it was much slower getting our main course.  But I'll come back but try to avoid the busy times.

Rangoon Ruby is a hip, unique restaurant in the bustling downtown area of Palo Alto, near the Stanford campus.  The staff is amazingly friendly and helpful.  The food provides an exquisite example of Burmese cuisine and flavors.

Delicious food, excellent service. People use their phones to read the menu & order.  It took us a while to discover this.  After 5 minutes someone took pity on us & brought menus, but it is much easier to order with your phone once we figured it out.
Ok worked well for family

Food and service was good. BUT BEWARE !!!   As you are busy sitting down, on the table are very large bottles of water and you be immediately asked if you want water. If you simply say "yes", you will find that they silently pour the water in your glasses and walk away. When the bill comes it will have $8.00 for a large Voss water. They will then ask if you want to keep the bottle. Even more annoying is that you've just contributed to ridiculous CO2 emissions as this brand is shipped to Palo Alto from NORWAY.

My only compliant is that the outside table for two was very small. 
Other than that, I plan to go back in the near future.

The food, especially the tea leaf salad is always superb.  The wait staff is extremely nice and helpful.  Very, very nice people.  We ate outside, so that's the 3 stars . . . it is a very nice parklet.  There just isn't much you can do about trucks going up and down Emerson.  It is very nice inside the restaurant -- where we dined  before Covid.  Like all places these days, the prices have gone up.  I think the food is worth it even though we can't afford to go as often as we would like.  I love going there.
Food was oily.
The food was wonderful and the service was outstanding. I hadn’t been here in a long time. I think it’s better now than ever.

Unfortunately our experience was not up to Rangoon Ruby’s usual standard.  We had to ask several times for menus ( the scan process was not functioning)  and two wines listed on the menu were unavailable.  Very few of the servers were wearing masks & some of the tables were so close together that we felt uncomfortable.   
A disappointing experience.

I was taking an acquaintance to lunch and chose this restaurant because I’ve loved the food there on previous occasions. Service was spotty this time- no one made it clear to us that we could only order through scanning the QR code. We had questions about the menu and had to wait for more than 15 minutes before we were able to get the attention of one of the staff. After the food was served, the usual checking-in yo see if everything was ok didn’t happen till the very end. So if we had an issue, we couldn’t have had it addressed in a timely manner. 
The food itself was great, so I’d go back there.
Delicious food & service.
Great tasty meal…we’ll definitely be back!
Quick service, Great food!!

Fun, lively spot on a Saturday night for a table of 4. We ate outside and even though we did most of the ordering with the table's QR code, still felt very well attended by the staff. It's great to be able to order more drinks or food whenever we need it. So many more dishes to try, we will be back!
Good food with great ambience.
it was a good place and food authentic and outside was good
The food we ordered was served cold. The garlic noodles had no flavor. We felt very rushed and didn’t really enjoy our dining experience

Excellent tea leaf salad and mango chicken. Excellent and friendly service. I asked to be seated outside which is better for me. Unfortunately, I did not get a table in the park key area, but one in the sidewalk. Sidewalk dining ins not that pleasant / lots off passers by, and dirty Palo Alto sidewalks. Definitely worth it to eat their delicious food

Our server was more interested in chatting with 2 guys on the table next to us. Service was non-existent and had to look around just to ask for water or any additional attention at the table for 5 of us. Food quality has changed, felt like the recipe & preparation of food has dropped. Does not have the previous charm as before. Used to be a good place but times have changed

We love this place and were looking forward to dining on Father's Day but were severely disappointed for the following reasons:

1) They have moved to ordering by phone, which removes any human connection with the server - feels low-brow, something appropriate for a fast casual place, not a finer dining place. Two servers came by anyway to explain how to use the system and went away immediately!

2) We asked the server to get us regular water but he disappeared on us. Even after reminding once, it took a long time just to get water.

3) Our main dishes came before the appetizer. When we asked why, they said if we order everything together on the phone, then anything can come first. This makes no sense - they know what is an appetizer and what is a main, so can stage the service accordingly. In any case, they never told us to order appetizers and drinks first, and only then order the mains. What if we had ordered desserts and they came first?!

4) The Burmese rice they served us was cold, as if it came direct from the refrigerator!! We had taken a few servings out of the bowl already so asked the server for a replacement. He basically microwaved the bowl and brought it back, leaving the cold rice on our plates as-is. We ordered a second rice bowl to make up for this!

5) We ordered a Scorpion Bowl for 2 (drink) and it was super-inconvenient to share. They had these really long straws but it took a while for the drink to start flowing, and when you stop drinking, quite a bit would dribble out. We neither enjoyed the drink nor got enough of it. Total waste for $28!

6) At the end of the meal, we wanted to pack the leftovers but again, no one came for a while. Finally, someone came and insisted on bringing a paper bill, when we could well have paid on the phone app. This was so senseless - why have a phone app in the first place?

It was not as if they were busy - more than half the place (inside) was empty on a Sat evening, so no excuses. Won't be coming back anytime!
The order w/ your phone is wonky.  stop it.  go back to ordering w/ the servers who are incredibly knowledgeable!
There were a lot of good menu choices.  The variety of flavors was particularly enjoyable.
We went out for dinner and the seating outside was super cute, food was amazing and service was a little different since you order via the app but good in general.

Absolutely Aweful from start to finish.  We have been going there since they opened.  We went for Mothers Day, were seated outside with a dirty table and dirty plates.  No one told us we had to order ourselves (never had to do this before) on line so we sat and sat waiting for a waiter or waitress and no one came.  We finally saw someone and asked for clean plates as well as silverware and napkins and received three new dirty plates and none of the other things we asked for so we asked again and this time just got forks; so we asked for new clean plates again and napkins.  Appetizers finally came and we ordered online for our dinner.  Three different wait staff came to us asking what we ordered (though it is online and not taken by waitstaff) and answered each person that we already ordered.  The food finally came and was totally bland, nothing like the tasty food we normally have which is what brings us back time and time again.  I tried to get a beer and was told of different options by three different staff only to find out that they just had one bottled beer after waiting and waiting for my drink to come - so said forget it.  

The only staff member at all helpful was the busboy who filled our water three times and cleared our table.  The hostess was flat out rude and the three waitstaff previously mentioned were unkind, demeaning, and I knowledgeable.  Finally a “manager” came up and we complained about everything only offering a brief apology with no other comments.  We told her we were regular customers and were bewildered by the experience - no reply.

We came for the food/ dining experience, neither of which were anything other than upsetting, and mediocre at best.  If we want to order food on an app, we can do that from home.  In fact, the staff seemed to spend most of their time servicing the DoorDash folks coming in to pick up on line orders, not in any way focusing on the customers dining there.  Other tables with same experience. Will never come back!

We went for Mother’s Day dinner. Very disappointed with the service, seating arrangements and overall quality of experience. 
Food is reasonably good but it came in no particular order. 
They are clearly understaff. They didn’t have a bartender and their wine selection very poor so didn’t have a choice but order a suboptimal bottle of wine as none of the cocktails we asked the lady (temp bartender) knew how to make: 
Won’t go there again.

Food was good, staff was friendly enough, it wasn’t terribly packed for Mother’s Day, maybe 15-20 people dining in and 3 servers. Very slow receiving food. We spent 2 hours and 15 minutes here, about 25-30 of those minutes were spent eating
Mother’s Day

We had a reservation but we still had to wait for a table to be ready. 

Ordering here was all touchless.

After visiting for years, I think, food quality has deteriorated for sure
The food was great!! But it was a little dark inside

Been going for years but now really different. Why???

Generous, tasty food portions.  Friendly and welcoming staff.
Nice place, good food.
Reagan Ruby is always a joy   The staff is knowledgeable and friendly and the food is consistently great. If you try it you to will be hooked.

The food was tasty but served cold. They system of online ordering falls way short of talking to a server. We asked for hot tea but we’re served Luke warm water with it, and when we asked for additional hot water, it took 25 minutes and still came only warm. We sat outside so noise was ok .  They should work much harder because they have a great menu, plenty of reason to go back but we like our food to arrive at the table piping hot.

Dishes were somewhat hit or miss.  The eggplant and garlic was great.  The shrimp and garlic noodles were "OK"  -- they definitely needed a sauce but the sauce they were served with was too sweet.  When ordering, we indicated "medium spicy" but the dishes seemed to have little or no spice.
We have visited this restaurant 5 or 6 times. We drive from San Jose. The menu has many great selections including my favorites, walnut shrimp and sesame beef.

Great service, love the food, only issue was the wait to check in. We arrived a few mins before our 7:30 reservation, but then waited in line for at least 15 minutes just to check in and let them know we had arrived.  Immediately seated after that.  And not a huge fan of ordering on our phones, but other than that, service was fantastic (waiter was the best) and especially love the tea leaf salad.

Had a terrible waitress. Dropped some of our Tea Leaf salad on the table while serving and didn’t wipe it off or apologize. When we pointed it out she said she would bring us a napkin so we could clean it up. Plates were not changed after the Tea Leaf salad. Paper napkins. QR code ordering. Must pay and tip in advance. Portions were small and food was lukewarm. Will not return.
As always, great food! Service was a bit off...but great experience:)
Food took forever and wasnt even that good

I believe this is mainly an issue of staffing shortages, but we were somewhat dismayed by what felt like unequal attention being given to tables. Otherwise the food was delicious and the servers were friendly (just not the most attentive).

Associates were courteous, friendly, very helpful, and polite. Food came out fast. This is our second time and again was very pleased with everything. They even surprised us by bringing a scoop of ice cream for my son who's celebrating his birthday. The only negative side was there is only one restroom and we were there, it was out of order. Food is absolutely amazing!
kinda lame service (plus one very rudy girl).  food ok, no spice at all.  very loud and very cold (even inside).
Had to wait an hour with the reservation in the cold and rain. Horrible
The food was delish!
Very courteous staff. Great Food. Ambiance quite pleasant
Amazing food and service. We ordered the green beans and eggplant. Burmese rice and samosa salad were delicious! Dessert was Suji with ice cream! Will definitely visit this place again.

Tea leaf salad needed more lemon or salt. It was pretty bland. Rangoon chicken was good and the garlic noodles were fine. Drinks were ordered at the same time as the food but didn’t come out until we reminded them half way through our meal. They brought the monk hinga and asked if we wanted bowls to share but then didn’t bring them. I understand everyone is struggling to find help so can forgive the service errors but the food was really lacking flavor.
Had a reservation but still refused to take us in for dinner due to numerous doordash orders!

Restaurant was busy.  Seated as soon as we arrived.  Viewing menu using QR code was fine, but ordering using the same app was a bit clunky.
CO2 was either broken or they ran out, so no tonic water for drinks.  Otherwise, service was very good.  Food was great.  Lot's of great flavors - apps, tea salad and entrees all good.
The food is good. Try the tea leaves salad, it’s excellent. Samosas is also good.
Cold night on the outside eating area and they didn’t have propane for heaters and it was a cold night in palo alto.
Food quality highly variable, great one time and mediocre the next time!  Service slow and mostly automated.

Our waiter added the tip for himself pressing on one of the bottoms on the machine he has in hands without asking for permission. He chose to add 20% tip although he does not deserve it. 
He forgot to add the dried shrimp to our salad. He also forgot to add some vegetables we requested to our salad.

Rangoon ruby not only serves incredible Burmese cuisine but also offers an immersive experience that transports diners to the heart of Myanmar. With its warm ambiance, attentive service, and an exquisite range of dishes, it is a culinary gem that I would highly recommend to anyone seeking an authentic taste of Burma. Prepare to be captivated by the flavors and traditions that define this beautiful Southeast Asian cuisine.

Inattentive service-  we were outdoor and the restaurant was almost empty.  Yet, we had to go in person inside to get attention / service.  

The food quality seems to have gone down as well. Too bad.  We had many good experiences there in the past.

Horrible experience from the starting. The hostess was very unfriendly. We waited long time for our table after reservation was done. Tables were available, the hostess was just not attending to us. Lovely food that was not very spicy at all. Post COVID-19, I see that many restaurants are not as busy and this is one of them. The food is still the same, the great taste, but much less crowded. The samosa soup and the tea leaf salad are highly recommended! Will visit here often! Thanks!
Excellent food and great service. I will certainly recommend this place.

They brought out main course (fish, shrimp, garlic noodles, pork garlic noodles before drinks, soups, salads and starters. The food got cold. We asked them to take it And bring it back later. We ate all of them cold because by the time we finished our soup and salad they were cold. Very bad expensive experience.

Food was a bummer here. 
Everything high on salt. 
Service was good and everyone there was polite
The food was good and the wait staff seemed to be short there were many but only one who took the order. Food is good and will return.

really disappointed as it used to be a great place

The service is good and it isn't too loud.  I would go back there again.
The staff are outstanding and we enjoyed the outside seating.  Great place for good food.

Poor customer service.  When we got there we literally stood in the doorway and workers would walk around us. I had to ask to her seated. They would tell us what they were out of, how to order via QR code, and when the kitchen was closed. They checked on us for water once and started turning off the lights to tell us they were closing foe the break in between  lunch and dinner while we were still eating.
Great food and experience! Restaurants are very limited on staff these days, but this one is doing its best to keep guests happy! Please be patient..it’s worth it!
Confused. Brought wrong dish then replaced it with another wrong dish.

This may be true for a lot of restaurants hurting for staff but we waited for half an hour and had to ask the water server to find someone to take our order.  It was another 20 minutes before we got our wine.  One of the three dishes we ordered was missing half its ingredients: pork curry with potatoes and mango pickle had only meat.

Worst dining experience that I have ever had. Waited over 1.5 hours to get our food without any update from the wait staff. We had to take our food to go due to the timing. The table next to us, who sat down well after us, got their food before us (within 20-30 minutes). Horrible, spoiled our fathers Day never served food after order was placed an hour ago. Terrible service
Outdoor setting smells,  food was ordinary,  service super late. Be ready to wait for 1.5 hours for your meal.

First time back in quite some time. Food was hit and miss. Some dishes were great and others left a bit to be desired. We ordered medium level of spice and felt it had very little, if any heat.
Also, we never really had a waiter/waitress assigned to our table so were left hanging for quite some time.
That being said, we would probably go back again, ask for the food to be even spicier.
waited for food after ordering for almost hour and a half

We had to ask 3 times to get water, twice to get chopsticks, which arrived after almost 40 min.; the food was wonderful as in the past, but it took more than an hour. Service was slow but because of reopening from COVID they’re forgiven.  Good food and service as always.
Great place - despite Covid challenges, they are doing an outstanding job

We decided to try something different from our standby favorite, Thai food, and really enjoyed all the new flavors. Lamb kebab and garlic noodles and tea leaf salad. Enjoyed them all thoroughly. Would be five stars for the food if it was only slightly less oily. Overall, highly recommend as a unique Asian cuisine.

Food was not very distinctive. At most similar restaurants, the server asks how spicy we would like our food prepared. Not asked at Rangoon Ruby, and the food was relatively bland.  Chicken curry at least needed more curry flavor.  Server could have been more attentive.
Rude waitress and staff.
excellent food and service with outdoor dining available.

The food was very good. Our servers was having a bad morning. I think she was tired of having to tell everyone all the COVID protocols. Once we got a new waitress, our experience improved.
Shortage of staff and turnover has impacted this restaurant. Server and manager were polite, courteous and friendly. Often apologetic. Overall the express fine. Food is still good.
For vegetarians, Rangoon Ruby is a haven.  Food is just amazing.

Rangoon Ruby's never disappoints.  We had a very nice dinner on their COVID patio.  The lettuce wraps were fresh and well-flavored.  The Garlic Noodles were very tasty and the sauce to noodle ratio was perfect.  My husband's Lamb Kebet was perfectly spiced and very tender.
Great ambience and good service. Enjoyed the vibe!
Great meal, great service! Met friends for a nice dinner. Food was wonderful.

I love everything about Rangoon Ruby Burmese Restaurant and will definitely go again! But be warned, parking in downtown Palo Alto is horrible--its free, but 2 hour limit per zone!
Incredibly delicious food.  Noisy.  Very good service

We had Palatas, Tea Leaf Salad, Rangoon Lemongrass chicken, Burmese Pork Curry, Walnut Chicken, Coconut rice, Burmese-Indian Rice and drinks. This was our first time and we were so happy that we took a chance—and on my birthday (which we didn’t mention) so expectations were high and hopeful! We will absolutely be back.

I don’t know why it’s taken me so long to write a review. My family and friend have been earthing here since they first opened in Emerson. We learned about them as I grew up in SF and live burma superstar. Again, the food is consistently amazing and we always have fun bringing the kids.

The staff is friendly and attentive.

Their drinks are also pretty fun and yummy. (Their wine list is ok)
Absolutely fabulous food - every single dish was excellent. Great service too. Can't wait to go there again.
Love the green tea salad and the variety of very tasty cuisine. Flavors are diverse and delicious.

Food delicious. Service dreadful. Noise level extremely high. It took an hour to get our entrees. Waiter showed up with just three of the four we ordered. And he brought a beer bottle but no glass. We asked for a glass and the fourth drink for our group. The waiter disappeared for 10 min. No drink, no glass. Had to go find him — he was changing a keg. Don’t they have a bartender for that?  The staff were uncaring. This place used to be great. No longer!!

Really good food.  I was just frustrated that both my friend and I checked in and seated separately and didn't realize the other was waiting at a different table. Happened to be an odd angle where we couldn't see each other.  I wish the hostess would have figured that out.  Food was really good.  I would go back, but note seating is tight - tables quite close and it is noisy.  Not the spot for a private conversation for sure.
The service was excellent. The food was too oily. The taste was good. A little loud for a business meeting however great for a really good bite.
The Mango Sawi was delicious.  The waiter was very kind and gave a surprise ice cream with a candle sparkler for my friend's birthday.  We were very happy with the nice gesture!  Thank you!

Overrated restaurants.
Service is slow, food mediocre.
The mgmt was so kind, I had made the reservation for 2 instead of 3. Appreciate them accommodating our party of 3 and had a lovely meal.
Consistenly good. A go to choice. Can recommend.

According to open table the only reservations available prior to 7p was at 4:30p. However the restaurant was almost empty past 6p. We would have preferred to begin at 5:30p. Do open tables policies need to be adjusted? Food and service were great as usual.

The service was attentive, friendly, and very pleasant. Unfortunately the food not up to same standard. Really heavy breading on the salted pepper calamari, the garlic shrimp and eggplant arrived barely lukewarm, and the lemongrass pork had been forgotten completely but was produced when prompted. Although hot it was very greasy and not very flavorful.  I would not recommend this restaurant.
Superb service. Amazing tea leaf salad and sambusa soup :)
Enjoy the food every time I go. Quiet enough to have a nice conversation. I will keep going back and encouraging friends to try it if they haven't

We had this restaurant recommended by a Palo Alto resident and are so happy we tried it. The food was absolutely amazing. Beautifully prepared and delicious. We had the tea salad, the salmon and Rangoon noodles and each was better than the last. 

The restaurant was also very kind to seat us late, because our reservation was actually during the time they normally close between the lunch and dinner service. We had a visitor from Italy who was very impressed with that kindness as well as the food quality

Seated 20+minutes after our reservation time.  Water was delivered 20+minutes after sitting down.  Entrees showed up late and one didn't show up until the entire meal was finished.  The service was terrible but the food was good, those entries we received.   Will not be returning to this location.
Excellent food. Great service. Just wish the music was a little lower volume .
Awesome food! A bit noisy ambiance - but friendly service made up for it! But it’s the food! I would go back for the taste!!
Good food, bad service and too noisy. Would recommend for takeout/delivery only
Slow getting served but the food was up to its usual good standard
Food good but not great. On expensive side. Nice ambiance. Great service. Could have used more help from wait staff in entree selection.

Why would every dish be spicy, even those that aren't supposed to be? Does this restaurant think that young and hip customers demand it? The menu should say when a dish is spicy, and it wouldn't hurt to ask customers what spice level they want. Then we will all get what we came for.

Food was wonderful but the service was minimal at best. We were celebrating a birthday and felt as if we were an after thought. 
Food served out of order with items brought we did not order so waited for what we actually did order. When the waitperson did not write anything down should have been a clue. Cocktails ordered and not received until midway through and we were already eating. Assumed we weren’t getting them as we had begun eating.  No one stopped by for us to even ask about the cocktails. 
I could go on as this happened at each phase of the evening. Very disappointed. Only saving grace was the food.
Mediocre food and service.  Other than tea leaf salad, entree and sides were bland and uninspired.  Service was slow and generally inattentive
Love it! The tea leaf salad is excellent and my kids love the green beans and garlic noodles!
We very much enjoyed the food and the variety of flavors. We have eaten here many times. Service was good and price was very reasonable.

The flavors were so varied and rich.  Both the tea-leave salad and the mango salad awakened the taste buds.   The salmon pumpkin stew and the shrimp kebat kicked the meal up to a new level.  Leftovers the next night were even better!!!!!
Food was great. Service was okay

This was a first time visit for two couples in our group. The tea left salad, fried tofu & excellent cocktails did not disappoint - every one loved it.  Thank you for marking this a memorable experience!  The service was first rate as well.
Food was good, wait staff great and attentive.   Not the most creative Burmese menu I have experienced.   But it is solid, traditional US interpretation of traditional burmese food.
Service was on point! Glad we beat the lunch crowd.
Overpriced and dishes are too sweet for my taste. Service was mediocre at best. Waitress never came to serve water and seemed to rush us out.

We never got our lunch meal. Waited 2 hours. No apology from server or management, before we had to depart. 
I have never experienced anything like this in my life. Will never come back.

We've been at this restaurant several times and usually sit at the bar, however this time we sat at a table for two.
There were two big issues for us this time: very poor service and the table arrangements which are poor (too many tables in too small a space). The tables at this restaurants are cramped together, and the table we were at was in the middle of a walk space that waiters and patrons needed to pass right behind us giving us no personal space.

We have been going to Rangoon Ruby ever since they opened. The experience in the last couple of years has continued to deteriorate. Last two times (within one month) we encountered an extremely rude hostess, elbow to elbow seating so close that the waiter has to reach over to serve. Overall it is a pathetic experience and there are better options right around the corner.
Food is great but they can space the tables apart a bit more. Cannot have a conversation.
The seating is pretty tight, but the food makes up for the "coziness".
Our new favorite.  Unusual flavors that are truly delicious.  Glenda, the manager is terrific.

We hope for the usual better service next time.
First Date
Food was excellent!  Service was fast but not necessarily courteous.  Our waiter was distracted and was abrupt to the point of being rude.

Can't recommend Rangoon Ruby. We came for the food but it's exactly why we wouldn't go back. Our waiter was superb in friendliness and attentiveness but the food? Every dish looked the same but with a different name. Supposed 'lettuce cups' were strips of romaine lettuce. Clean, simple dishes they were not.  We were greatly disappointed and we could neither go back to or recommend this restaurant.
Love the menu and can't wait to return to try more!

For some time we were very enthusiastic about the quality of food and ambiance in this restaurant and were  very willing converts to Burmese cuisine. However our last couple of visits there were disappointing. WE thought the quality of the food has diminished and the "burmese" aspect has become common. In addition the tables were closer and more crowded interfering with the privacy of enjoying a conversation. In short this restraint has gone downhill which is very disappointing.
Great all the way around.
Great food and very excellent service. Restaurant was crowded but conversation was no problem.
Celebrated our Anniversary and were treated to a strawberry dessert with dazzling candle !!   Very nice !!

Fresh, delicious, creative, original delicious.
Ambience lovely.

Convenient location for dinner before seeing a show at the Aquarius theater.  Their tae leaf salad was good along with the Burmese Pad Thai and the coconut rice.  Nice settings and good service,  I would go back.
Excellent food and fast service. However the "OpenTable" reservation did not hold, yet we got the room because that was not so busy day. All great & Just too noisy!

My friends and I loved Rangoon Ruby. They did a great job of seating us right away, as we had a reservation. The restaurant was packed but service was fast. Only downside was that the waiter was trying to take our order as fast as possible and his responses were so short that they came off as a little rude. Other than that we appreciated the vegetarian options especially the pumpkin tofu. How unique!
Food was expensive for the amount. The taste has deteriorated over the years. I used to love the tea leaf salad but it's become unfortunate now.
Too noisy to enjoy conversation. Food good but not really any better than PF Changs.

I am generally pretty easy on restaurants and servers, but when:

1. My server gives us a pre-opened bottled water (pretending to open it at the table) that had been filled up at a sink and charging us full price
2. Being ignored for 10-20 minutes at a time
3. Finding dirt and aphids on the lettuce for our lettuce wraps
4. Repeatedly asking for an item and never getting it
5. Having my order be incorrect and never getting a chance to get what I wanted (because I had been ignored for so long)

I don't go back, sorry.
Delicious healthy authentic Burmese food in lovely restaurant.

I have never been more disappointed by this style cuisine. Each dish was without any distinctive flavors. We all kept searching for something that had at least traditional Thai spicing.  How can you miss, even with Pad Thai?  I also asked for a new napkin twice and after 10 minutes grabbed one from an empty table.  Very surprising experience.  I brought our friends there, and thought this had to be a great restaurant given its location and what looked like a full house.  I only wish Evvia across the street had an opening so we could have had a better experience.  Hate to write a review like this. In fact, I have never done it before.  Maybe the chief chef was sick and the substitute was lacking skills.  A puzzle.

This was our first time at Rangoon Ruby and it will not be our last. The food was amazing and Konstantin was a fantastic server. My only complaint would be that the tables are too close together...they are trying to squeeze too many people in, esp. near the front window

But, we loved the food and can't wait to go back and try more of the options on the menu.
Fabulous food, you must try the Tea Leaf Salad!!!
Excellent food. Very tasty. Every dish eas delicious. Good service.
Coconut rice and mango swai were amazing!
The food is good but the noise is impossible, tables too close together.
Outstanding food and service. Tables are crowded together, and the noise level made conversation difficult.  All in all, I look forward to my next meal there.
Excellent innovative cuisine unlike any other Asian restaurant I've eaten at in the Bay area. The waiters recommendations were excellent, both had chicken of some form
Didn’t know you had to wait for everyone during reservations
Always great food. We have been to Rangoon Ruby many times and we always have a great experience.
Good food; very noisy. I would like to try again.
The food was pretty good but the cocktails were weak.
Nice ambiance and great food. Tea leaf salad is an absolute must have!

The food is delicious and there are many vegetarian options.  The level of spiciness is adjustable, so no crazy hot dishes that we didn't expect!  The room is spacious and quiet-we could actually enjoy a conversation with our friends and not have to shout!  With plenty of parking close by, we would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Food was amazing!!  

Wine was a bit overpriced and no privacy as tables were too close together.  Would still visit again for the cuisine
Great food and outstanding service. Highly recommend.
Good food and good service.  Not very crowded and they didn't rush us.

Need to improve seat assignment process. 
I reserved the seat 4 days in prior to the reservation date with special request for seat by window and quiet place since it is for my business dinner meeting. 
When I arrived, the lady from cashier insisted me to sit on the table right by the entrance. Even if I found one table by the window is available, she refused for me have such table as mentioning that there will be a group of people for most of seats around there. A few min later, the restaurant manager allowed me to sit in the table which I found available. As having a dinner with my client, I have not seen any group of people to occupy the majority of the seats. And even few tables were not filled.

Please don't visit Rangoon Ruby, it is too crowded and I want to be able to get a table there without a reservation. (Just kidding) As always, food was amazing, service was very good, and I'll be going back again frequently.
The food arrived cold. The chicken looked like it was made the day before

Great food, wonderful service ! A wonderful night out in a very easy to find location in Palo Alto. Wait staff was very friendly and accommodating. Menu was varied with great vegetarian options . Wine selection was perfect for the cuisine and environment. Reservations highly recommended as they seem to be busy most nights .
Decent food, good service, a little pricey but still good. I'd go back.

We arrived at the restaurant very early as we had a meeting to attend after. We had to wait a long time for our appetizer and finally had to ask the server about the timing. We had to ask for more water twice and then had to inquire our lunch. 
We both ordered the Tea Leaf Salad and one of our salads came already tossed and the other salad was tossed at the table??  It's super noisy in the restaurant so it's really hard to hear.
Good food as always. Not much ambience but not really expected at any Asian food joint
Food OK, but not outstanding, service pleasant and attentive.
Consistently excellent food. A bit hectic but overall always a satisfying dining experience. I have been to this restaurant many times at various locations.

Had heard a lot about this place but was a very average food experience. Service was also okay - we were served water after being seated for 10 mins. More importantly, our server was not able to help with recommendations. And what we ordered (Pork curry and the first noodle dish on the menu), was very average. The tea leaf salad was good. Samosas were drenched in oil, Not a place I will go to again

Even with reservation had to wait while hostess went and delivered food telling us she had to go set our table up. Service not very good and tables very close to each other. Food however made up for it.
Amazing food! Amy was our bartender/waiter and was fun and knowledgable regarding suggestion and pairings. One of my favorite restaurants in the Bay Area

Amazing food choices and big menu atRangoon Ruby.
The green tea salad is a must, we also had the beef kebat and the mango chicken. Pair it all with coconut rice, so nice!
The portions are large, enough to share with more people or to take home.
Highly recommend you check it out, when in Silicon Valley.
Always fantastic! Everything we ate was amazing with the exception of the pumpkin curry. No flavor. Tea leaf salad OMG I could have had that as my meal. Delicious!
Though we had the reservation, we still had to wait for 15 mins.  Not expected.
It's a very good place!  Tea leaf salad is an amazing dish.
Excellent food and service with genuine hospitality. Thank you.

It’s our second time - loved it! Service and food were excellent. One minus - noise and cold from the opened door to the street. Hostess was busy and didn’t have a chance to direct people standing by the opened door. Next time will be try to make when it’s a bit warmer.
