I took a sip then sent it back. It’s pretty disappointing. You will not expect this happening in a restaurant this level.

I gave three stars primarily because of the inadequate service.  Food was excellent and it was very enjoyable sitting outside.  When the female server first approached me and instead of extending some greetings, she abruptly said "what do you want to drink?"  After she brought me the drink, she said "ready to order?" instead of, say, introducing the menu or asking if we have any questions.  Throughout the whole meal, asking me what to drink and what to order was about it.  We both thought that this service level was inadequate.  Otherwise, we would have rated a five. Again, food was outstanding and the drinks were great too.
Service was not great!!  Food was overcooked and unappealing  looking on the plate. It was also cold. Restaurant decor is nice, but don’t go there for good food at good service.
Love the food! Our waitress was also great and attentive. Been happy every time I’ve been there!

I asked for one of the private booths upfront in the open table reservation. We arrived at 5:20pm
reservation ND THE HOSTESS SAID THEY HAD NO BOOTHS.  I told her I requested one in writing.
She said they let 2 people from the bar have one of the booths. They offered us a table in the back across from a party of 12 people. She said the only available table was at the front door at a high top table which we took. It was very noisy with non- stop people coming through. VERY UNACCEPTABLE SERVICE AND PROBLEM SOLVING! Please teach your staff the meaning of customer service and reservations! This was a VERY UNSATISFACTORY EXPERIENCE!

The food quality was mediocre. We got Risotto and the rice was jasmine or basmati rice not arborio. It tasted like just butter and rice with no other flavors at all. The Salmon was pretty dry and a bit overcooked. Coming to wine, all wines on the list were extremely overpriced. A glass costs $28? How is that acceptable? There are plenty of good wine bars and restaurants around that sell it for almost half for very good wine from Bordeaux, Left bank and excellent Italian appellations. When asked for a bag for wine bottle, we were denied one. Terrible service. We left unhappy and hungry and went to nearby restaurant to complete our dinner. Terrible experience, please avoid this restaurant if possible.
My favorite place in Los Gatos. Great food, service and ambiance. Highly recommended it.
Excellent food. Fried chicken is the best as is all seafood specials.

This was my first experience at Los Gatos Parkside and it was fabulous! Therese, who served us, was exceptional and made every part of our dining experience wonderful. There were many involved in serving and they were all so helpful, kind and added to our dining experience! It was a huge celebration for me and she enhanced it. The food was delicious, well prepared with a beautiful presentation. We shared the crab cakes, light and very fresh– the best I've ever had – the avocado bruschetta, a very innovative combination on excellent bread, and the salmon – the horseradish made the dish exceptional! We ended with the perfect dessert – the best beignets ever!
Thank you to all!!!!
Great time with family. Thanks for a wonderful brunch. Enjoyed the food and time together. Very welcoming and friendly staff.

We went in for Sunday Brunch and had a wonderful meal.  The country breakfast of eggs, bacon, toast, and hashbrowns was wonderful. The sourdough toast was terrific.  We also ordered a fruit bowl and the banana bread, both portions were very generous￼ and tasted great!  Our table was a partial booth in the corner and it felt a bit cramped, however our server was very attentive and took care of us. ￼￼￼￼ We definitely will go back again. ￼
Great place and very tasty comfy food. Will be back soon

We were there for a Birthday brunch and had a wonderful experience. The service was fantastic and everyone was so nice and  accomodating. They even brought out a special mimosa for the birthday girls. Both the food and drinks were delicious. We had the breakfast tostada, short rib hash, grain bowl and chicken salad sandwich and apple waffles. Highly recommend!
Such kind staff, a beautiful ambience, and delicious food!! The waiter was really helpful when we needed to substitute a full item on one dish due to an allergy.

Had a great lunch sitting outside on the patio. Server was attentive, but not overly. We had the wonderful hot hush puppies-always a great starter and then had the Ahi tuna poke, which was fresh and delicious and we also had the Steak Frites which was seasoned nicely and the veggies were cooked perfectly, but the steak was a chewy and not tender.
All in all a good meal and will definitely come back again to try other items on the menu.
Brunch was delicious. Service was wonderful. It is my mom and my second time there. We will be back. Thank you for being dog friendly!

This is our second time, just in case the first time was a so busy that it was the reason why it wasn’t good. But both times now the food was just mediocre…. Brunch today literally had soggy waffles, and cold chicken, apple sausage,. Ambience and service was great. Won’t be coming back though…
Parkside is always a lovely place for Sunday brunch. Afterward, you can step out the door and you’re at the Farmers Market!
Excellent food and presentation, service good, Not good for conversation, too noisy

As always a great consistent meal - well prepared and delicious.
The Halibut was expertly prepared and a beautiful white color . I loved the sauce that had sliced fennel .
My friend had the steak which he said was excellent. The Tuna poke appetizer was great but the sauce a little spicy as it smothered the taste of the Tuna.

Love this place .
We had a lovely dinner and evening. The atmosphere, staff and our waitress were great. I will definitely be back.
Great food and ambiance. The bar has a nice vibe and the staff was top-notch! Loved it!

They only had one server working for the outdoor seating. We barely got any attention. No eye contact therefore it was hard to flag him down. We needed sauce and refilled on our water but didn’t get it until an hour later… please have more people working so we can have a better experience and service.
Our server was fantastic. The food was fantastic and the ambience was fantastic.
Great service ambience and food. Love their cashew chicken salad!

Our server was excellent providing us with above par attention and allowing us to split up our bill 3 ways. Our food was delicious with just the right size portions. My 4th visit to Los Gatos Parkside but first time visits for my 3 friends. All of them were impressed and will return.
Food and service was awesome!! I will definitely be back.
Food was very good as usual. It was starting to get crowded. We had a reservation which was nice.

We went there for small gathering, and it was very nice. The food was good, the service was good. Only critique is that when it gets busy, they don't look at the water glasses very often, I was thirsty. Better if they had bottles or pitchers on the table to help with that. But, overall, I'd come back because the food visually was pretty and it tasted very good.

We have been to Parkside twice in the past 2 weeks. Everything has been exceptional! The food is delicious and the entire staff is friendly and helpful. I have recommended it to several people since we first dined there.

Very disappointed. Usually happy here but steak I ordered was cold and rather than get another piece of meat, they heated up what I had which resulted in meat being overcooked. Service person pleasant but not much attention
This was our first visit to this restaurant.  The service was excellent and the food was delicious. I was particularly impressed with the freshness of the salads.  Will definitely visit again.

This was our first time dining here. We made reservations and it was good we did. It was very busy with others waiting but we were seated quickly with our reservation. Services was attentive and staff asked if we needed anything multiple times. The food very good. We had salads and sandwiches. We will definitely back!
Great venue and the food was fantastic.  Highly recommend to visit
Great food and wonderful service. We were celebrating a birthday and we got free desserts. But most of all, the food was superb and the service even better
Excellent food, excellent service and excellent time!! Thank you!  Will be back!!
Excellent.  Very attentive to my service dog by giving us a corner table.
Absolutely delicious food!  Wonderfully attentive service and a great vibe!  They made my husband’s birthday dinner super special 🙏

My wife and I had a terrific Valentine’s Day dinner and drinks.  The prix-fixe menu  options were excellent.  The oysters, tuna tar-tar, strip steak were done perfectly.  The bread pudding was possibly the best I’ve ever eaten.  My wife’s halibut may have been a touch overdone—but just a touch and that’s only relative to everything else being absolutely perfect.  The service was prompt, courteous and pro-active. The atmosphere and large table in a cozy nook was perfect, too.  Highly recommend!
This was our third dinner at Parkside. Valentine’s Day menu offered enough options for us, and everything was delicious. Staff members were enthusiastic and friendly.

The fried chicken sandwich was delish.  Crispy chicken with a little jalapeno the waffle fries were good but a little more cooking and they would be perfect.  The benignets were a perfect ending for a b-day lunch.  Amanda was awesome from the moment we were seated.

Parkside has great food, and comfortable spaces, but the tables are so close together, that it’s hard to have a private conversation. The couple at the table next to us, was very argumentative, so it was awkward and loud

I enjoyed my bacon kale salad with polenta croutons and shrimp, and the chicken salad sandwich and fries my sister had looked fantastic -- nice home sliced toasted bread with healthy portion of chicken and not overly mayo'ed.  The lavendar lemon soda was a novel flavor, very much enjoyed that.
We had a great dinner at Parkside. We all loved our meals and the service was excellent. Parkside never disappoints!!

Early February, the night before the Super Bowl, management squeezed us inside for a table for four which I appreciated. But then we had a 5th member of our party unexpectedly. We were relocated to an outside table which turned out to be perfectly fine (effective heaters!). The service was knowledgeable and highly competent, and the cocktails and food were terrific. ￼We look forward to returning. ￼

Everything was great cheese board appetizer, rib appetizer.

We all had steak frites and beignets with our wine 🍷
Food was great and our waitress superb

Great vibe! We will be back soon 🍽️
It was so much fun. It was the perfect place for a first date. Great food, ambience, music, and atmosphere.

Our server tonight, I believe her name was Meagan (?), was absolutely fantastic. Extremely nice and thoughtful; really great at her job! Food was very good. Ambiance was warm and cozy. Definitely recommend.
The servers actually acted like they enjoyed their jobs. Rare to experience that these days. I tipped  generously to thank them.

The bar service was great. The food was very good but at the end of our meal the service was not very good. As soon as we finish d our entrees they picked up our dishes and brought us our bill without asking if we wanted dessert. I called the waiter back but he was in such a hurry we didn’t try to order dessert

We've been to Parkside many times and almost always enjoy the experience.  Today the wait staff seemed off.  Drink orders were not delivered till asked for, some menu options were not available due to shortages of components.  Out first waiter disappeared  without any communication and seemed to be replaced by a couple of others...  Not what we typically expect.
Great spot for lunches and dinners always enjoy Parkside

Seated for lunch on the outdoor patio right away. Service was excellent. We both ordered the Parkside burger that was done to perfection. They grilled the onions on the burger as requested. The Oaxaca margarita was outstanding. Highly recommend this restaurant.
Wonderful food, service and the Parkside experience
First time very nice ambiance, Drinks delish, Ahi App 👍 Deviled Eggs 👍 Filet Mignon Special Excellent, Octopus Delicious, Beignets Fantastic
The service was exceptional - live your restaurant

My friend and I ordered two salads at lunchtime. Mine was the beet salad where I needed to really search for evidence of beets. Plenty of pomegranate, though. Very average. 
My friend ordered the Asian chicken and felt that the dressing was fair. Both salads were plated on typical salad plates and it was easy to push the food off of the plate. 
Atmosphere of Parkside is really inviting and nice.
We could not be happier with Parkside.  We have dinned here many times.  Great bar, great food, and great service every time.
Very delicious and our first time here we celebrated a birthday they gave us free dessert of choice! That was super sweet and made my Fiancé night. Thank you <3

Parkside is a new, needed addition to downtown Los Gatos.  The ambiance is spacious and comfortable.  I look forward to trying new dishes.  I liked the menu but the salad and sandwich we had was just okay.  And I found the dishes to be way too small to properly present a nice meal.
Great local hangout with excellent food and good drinks.

Every detail of our lunch was a 10!
Service, friendly, professional & efficient.
Food as fresh, tasty and well prepared.
We’ll be back!
Thank you
Loved our server! She was very attentive but not overbearing! Provided great suggestions. Had a fantastic night!
Our server was excellent.  The food was good.  We enjoyed our dinner.  It was a little noisy though.

Excellent cocktails, food and service. Great experience all around. Our party had the wild mushroom ravioli (served slightly al dente and delicious), scallop risotto, halibut special and short ribs. Everything was excellent.

Service was really slow last night. The server was nice and professional but every dish took way too long. When Parkside first opened, the service was too fast and we were done with dinner in less than 45 min. They need to figure out timing. The food was great! Filet mignon with spinach and mashed potatoes were delicious. Also had Brussels sprouts, salad and bread pudding.

Great meal.  We had chopped salads with prawns and it was delicious.  The pear crostada for dessert was amazing too.  We stayed for 2 1/2 hours and never felt rushed or uncomfortable about staying so long.
Scott is awesome & food is really really good.  Great place to lunch
Great spot - lively even on a weekday. But for some reason, very loud at the corner table we were at.

Excellent food and service.
Devil eggs - do tasty with a bit of heat.
Steak, skewers and shrimp, and a small salad. Steak was very tender, shrimp was cooked  just right, salad was just enough. All was very delicious.
Prices was moderate.
Only con is noise level is quiet loud!
Definite we Will be back.

Great new find. Delicious meal and great drinks. Can't believe we haven't been here before,...definitely coming back. You have to try the Short Rib appetizer. The Ravioli and Chicken Salad were flavorful and satisfying. The Pear Crostada was okay, (too much dough, and gritty caramel.) Highly recommend it.

Alicia, the hostess, is excellent! My friend and I came in for dinner, and she was a radiant and welcoming face upon arrival. She gave us seating options to ensure we were comfortable and periodically checked in to ensure we had everything we needed. I even asked her what her favorite items were, and she kindly recommended a few we should try. We’ll be back for the brunch and dinner menus and customer-focused attention. Thank you, Parkside!
Another perfect meal with a group of friends. Best restaurant in LG
Server was great. Gave us great food and drink recommendations. Great catch up with old co workers too server didn’t rush us.
The food is tasty and the service is friendly and helpful. One of my favorite places to eat
Their Grain Bowl is so satisfying and yummy.  But I love everything there.  Food is fabulous!
Our server was so great! She was knowledgeable, helpful and kind. We will definitely be back!
Loved our brunch again. Great service and such a good menu!
Too loud for us we had to raise our voices to hear each other. Food was decent but salmon was dry. My date like his salad, Brussels sprouts and meat balls but were too “bready” not so much “meat”
Great overall experience.  Excellent food, service and ambience.

We sat outside celebrating my friend’s birthday. There was one server for about 8 tables and he was slammed so I really can’t blame him too much, but he completely forgot about us and it took us about 30 minutes just to get our tea.

Food was good not anything to make a big deal over sadly🙁 outside was cold even with their small floor heaters. Overall, the brunch wasn’t anything special probably would’ve preferred to go to something more classic like Sarah Southern kitchen for the same cost.
Tom our server was great   Great food! We enjoyed it

3 burgers, an entree salad and avocado toast plus 5 iced teas was $135 + tip.  2 of 3 burgers were overcooked; burgers were average, overall.  Salad was on the smaller side.  Good service and vibe but for $160 I expect so much more.  They did comp us $25 gift card, which was nice but overall lunch was disappointing for that price.
We had a party of five, everyone enjoyed their meals. Service was excellent.
Great customer service, awesome management team. We always love the experience. Excellent dinner last night.

Several items of note. Our cocktail order did not arrive until well after the first course of mushroom soup.  Other food delivery was satisfactory.
Second comment is about our bill payment. Our server “ We” who was in general a good spirited young man seemed to disappear sound payment time. Someone else showed up and accepted our payment as a gift card plus a $50 bill to complete payment and tip. This was accepted but we did not receive a receipt. However it is now almost  one week later and our credit card which was required for the reservation has not been charged. So good!

Food and drinks are always excellent, and the ambience is very good. It is usually quite loud and ‘lively’ - if you want a quieter experience would need to get a table in the back in the corner. It is a very popular place so sometimes they get quite busy and service can be a little bit slow, but overall Service is usually good.
Delicious food.  Great ambiance.  Will be back soon.

Great food and service! Hush puppies are so yummy! Avo toast, burrata toast, cheeseboard, gulf shrimp, ahi poke - all stellar! Drinks were good too - I had the special that day with hibiscus - have forgotten the name. Our server was knowledgeable and steered me away from sweet drinks which I didn’t want..
Lovely ambiance for brunch/lunch celebration. Very accommodating to our group of 9.
Excellent food and service. Only negative was that we were there for about 40 minutes before we received our food. We weren’t in any hurry, but if we had been, it would have been a bit frustrating.

I want to provide actionable feedback vs. complaining. It shouldn't take 15-20 min to get a soda refill and a side of avocado. Seems like you many have been training a new waitstaff member, which is understandable, but perhaps not the best idea on 12/26. We live in Downtown LG, so want to support local businesses, hence this feedback

Sat outside so noise level was low. Heaters were available for customers. Food was good and my table shared a few bites/starters. Ordered two rounds of espresso martini’s at $25/glass. A little pricy considering the plates were $18-$20. However, service was great. Friendly and engaging staff made the evening enjoyable. I live close to the restaurant, so will come back (sans the martini) but if I lived in San Jose, Parkside would not be top of list or recurrence. I gave Parkside a high score because I enjoyed my dining experience.

This was my second time visiting Parkside, both times were great but we had a blast this second time. We sat at the bar and Moses was fantastic. I’m new to the LG area, and think I’m weirdly picky when it comes to service / food / cocktail expectations.. this place ticks all the boxes. Love it.
Place is nice but very loud!!!! Hope because of the Holiday season.

From the time I walked in until we left the experience was great.  The hostess and waitress Lexi were friendly and efficient.  I was with 3 friends and we shared small appetizers.  The potatoes, crab cakes & hush puppies were delicious.  We sat in a booth and it was really comfortable.  Will definitely be back!
Brussel sprouts are amazing, as is the Dulce de Leche Creme Brulee. I'd recommend a new chocolate chip cookie recipe (thinner).
All great but too loud for great conversations. The table was also wide and difficult for a meaningful discussion.

I met friends for a holiday lunch and it didn’t disappoint. We all had shrimp in one form or another and it was well prepared and fresh. We share the beignets and they were fabulous. The waiter seemed a bit overloaded but was friendly and attentive.

This was my second visit to Parkside, after having lunch there a wwk prior. 
I feel the lunch was much better. 
My friends had the short ribs and compained there wasn't a lot of food for the price. I agreed. No starch, no sides, just a modest portion of meat.
My husband had the salmon, which had broccolini and basil mased potatoes that were not very hot, but he enjoyed the salmon.
I had a special for that night, a seafood combination in tomato sauce, which was decent. Again, no pasta or anything else. 
Overall, the food was decent but could have been better.
But the major rub were the wine prices... Expect to pay around $100+ for any bottle from a wine list that is not very impressive.  Whoa!
The noise level was way too high and we could barely hear each other talk.
Our server, Moses, was great. Unfortunately it took a long time for our desserts came out and when they did arrive the runner didn't even bring utensils! After another long wait watching the gelato melt, and we finely flagged someone down to get forks and spoons.  Grrr. 
I would return for lunch but probably not dinner. 
It is a poplular new place in Los Gatos. I hope they can maintain that after the newness wears off.
Very good brunch with friendly staff. Great location and not too noisy!
Great food and love the cozy vibe!  Would come back to try more share plates.

Excellent meal overall - hard to find "farm to table" style restaurants in the peninsula. This place checked all the boxes: great assortment of styles and options, food for vegetarians and meat lovers alike, unique takes on the dishes prepared. Plus excellent cocktails!
Great cocktails, food, and service! Would recommend Parkside for a nice dinner out & would happily return
Great food! Not too loud. Our waitress was busy so hard to get drinks in a timely manner

The menu selection is varied and interesting. Our meals have always been delicious. Wine selection and cocktails are a plus.
Every time we visit Parkside we've been seated at a different table, and there is not a bad table in the house!  We love the bar seating and outdoor seating as well.
First time here and we really liked it! Great find! We will be back. There are great sounding items on their menu.

Usually enjoy our meals at Parkside but must have been an off night. One of the daily specials was not available, the one we were both going to order. Why not just say that when we were seated instead of when we ordered it? Salad was tasty but very overdressed. Main corses were good but nothing special. Didn’t order a glass of wine because the prices were ridiculous. I understand a glass of wine is sometimes almost as much as the bottle would be if you bought it at the store, but when the glass is a few dollars more than the bottle is at the store I draw the line. Disappointing meal but we will be back.

We had great service the entire time. Seated promptly. Food was appreciated by all 7 of us. The parklet was very comfortable. Recent improvements to the outdoor seating made it even more pleasant. The farmers market was going on right next to us but did not disturb us at all. We were never rushed, and enjoyed the food and conversation. Lovely Sunday brunch!

This restaurant is fabulous, my only complaint is the table we were seated at. Some say it's a coveted spot, it's the 4 top table tucked on the corner in the very back of the space. Great.....except it's right next to the door that leads to the restrooms. So very distracting. the door opened and closed at least 30 times while we dined. The hall light in the restroom hallway also goes on and off. I don't know what the solution is other than move the door or request another table. :)

Food was good, ambiance great but service was S L O W. Took forever to get our first round of drinks (probably 20 minutes) and the second drink ordered as dinner arrived never even came. But was on the bill. Not cool. Service was polite but just barely existent. For the price I expect much better than that.
You can’t go wrong with this place.  Food is excellent, service is good, the only issue at times is getting a reservation because it’s popular.  I highly recommend it.

We went here for a birthday brunch. The menu was fun and offered an interesting variety, everything from avocado toast to donuts. Food quality was decent and the value was pretty good. The service was ok. Our waters ran low a few times and completed dishes weren’t picked up until we were about to leave. They may have been short staffed? The ambiance inside was cozy. We felt like we were dining in someone’s quaint living room…a welcomed improvement from the Denny’s vibe of Boulanger. A few guests (very particular about food) weren’t impressed enough to revisit. I likely will, since I’m interested to try their dinner menu.
A farm to table experience always makes the food taste better.  If you’re into cocktails, I recommend their signature ‘smoke on the water’
I loved the shrimp lettuce wraps.  The restaurant service was excellent and the food was delicious.

The cashew chicken salad was delicious!  The lavender & lemon “Refresher” mocktail was a perfect accompaniment. We arrived at 11:30 and it was nice and quiet. It became more loud and lively as the place filled up. Tip:  It is one of the few local restaurants open on Monday, so a reservation is a must! Parkside remains one of my favorite lunch spots. 👍🏻

We had a nice dinner overall. No complaints. My date had the salmon which she liked. I had the fried chicken which was good but not amazing. I wouldn’t get it again. It was too much skin and not enough chicken for my liking and just lacked kick.
Food is always good, service was excellent and the staff is professional.

The food was absolutely amazing!  I highly recommend this place.  I spent 2.5 hours catching up with my girlfriend over dinner.  Our waiter was friendly and didn’t rush us to turn the table.  In fact he insisted we stay as long as we like.
Best service - top notch! I would not only come again but also recommend to friends.

Attended a birthday lunch...the staff was friendly and the ambiance was very nice sitting outside.
Only issue was the quiche my friend was served wasn't cooked all the way through. The server apologized and offered to get her something else, but she declined.
The food and atmosphere was very good as it usually is.

A pretty new place in Los Gatos and the first time we have dined there. They have a nice, large bar. We had reservations and the four of us sat in a booth. We could definitely hold a conversation, so hat was nice. The food prices are decent, but the wine choices are a bit expensive, especially by the glass. Everyone’s entrees were really good. We didn’t have any appetizers. Our server was efficient and very friendly. The beignets were not my favorite, but still tasty. I would definitely go back again.
Went back to one of our favorite brunch places especially for the delicious avocado toast and for the nice, relaxing outdoor dining. Service was great too.

Great food and service on the lovely patio for lunch. We ordered the chopped salad with salmon and the chicken cashew salad. There was a little street noise but we were sitting outside, so to be expected.
I really appreciate the seasonal menus and the use of fresh ingredients. It’s always a great experience to dine here, and the food is consistently delicious!

Very busy when we arrived so had to wait a bit for our reserved booth. Once seated we were greeted right away and placed an order for drinks which it took awhile for us to receive. Once received one drink was placed incorrectly so had to wait for them to replace. We went onto order appetizers which were delicious although very small in portion size. Dinner was okay but had to send back two entrees as the meat on the steak frites was overcooked. This was my second visit to Parkside and I again felt underwhelmed. Not sure I’ll be make a third visit.

Been here a few times before and loved the gnocchi bolognese. We were so bummed though that they removed it from menu - they said it was a seasonal dish! What’s seasonal about bolognese? That’s a total fall winter dish! Their food is great overall but we really loved the gnocchi - it was fantastic. Please bring it back!
Great food. Excellent service. Will return. Only downside was the noise level which was really bad between the piped in music and the diners.

Service was excellent from Dillan , our waiter to the traveling hostesses. It was Halloween and their costumes added to the experience..
Tğ

First time with my girlfriends and it was amazing. We loved all the dishes: Burrata on Manresa Levin toast, Avocado Toast, Crusted Salmon, Short Rib, Kale Harvest salad w/grilled shrimp. Because there was a mix up and our booth was given to another group the manager came by, apologized and comped our 1st round of drinks. How gracious of him! Well the make your own Manhattan, Gin Gimlet and the Frozen in Thyme were outstanding...so we had another round. Ambiance was chill in the back dining room compared to the vibe in the front by the bar. So we will be back for that experience. Great restaurant all around.

Our sandwiches, one chicken salad with apple, grapes, bacon and avocado was scrumptious. Our friends turkey, melted cheese, avocado and bacon was, according to them simply divine. We always consume a large plate of French fries as there's are THE best!!! It was a delectable lunch!
Excellent food enjoyed by all four members of our group. Excellent and enjoyable service from Scott our waiter.
Great service, great food, would definitely recommend and go back again.
Music was too loud. Asked to turn down which was better. Great service!!! Food was excellent!
We had the BEST waitress! She was so nice and we had a great time. Food was awesome😁😁😁
Beautiful place with excellent service and very good food.  We enjoyed are brunch very much.  It's a very friendly atmosphere with gracious service.

First time and it has potential to be a new favorite! The food was fantastic. We had poke appetizer, steak frites and pumpkin risotto. Service was accommodating and the dining room was cozy. Need to return soon to taste a few more things!
Great choices in small plates to share and unique twists on craft cocktails.  Service was wonderful as well.  A great choice for a romantic meal or gathering of a group of friends!
Booked last minute. It was Monday night and this place was very busy! Great outside and inside ambiance!
Great food. Inside and outside seating are both nice.
Never disappointing!  Love going there .  Food is always good and reasonably priced.  Service is excellent.  We are a regular here🙂

First time here…. We had an old fashion to start and our dinners were fried chicken and pumpkin risotto. Both were delicious. Lexi as our server and she was awesome. Will come back and definitely ask for her.
If you visit Los Gatos this is must go to plan ahead but always a treat for us

The service was excellent.  We were seated as soon as we checked in. Our server was very pleasant and helped to make this dining experience very enjoyable.  Once again, the menu was creative and varied.  The food was excellent, making us want to come back  for more.
Great food as always and great service. A fun atmosphere

Lovely lunch outside today.  Very comfortable seating and shade structure.  My only complaint is the loud cars and trucks nearby but we were seated nearest the street.  Would ask for a table closer to the post office next time if that’s possible.  We had a dog with us so outside was the most important part.
The food was very good and even the small plates are generous enough for a lite lunch.  Our server was wonderful, very attentive and friendly.

Lovely ambience next to Los Gatos Town Square (park). Nice patio setting but we preferred indoor interior (quieter). Excellent service, nice selection of wine-by-the-glass. My go-to restaurant when I’m visiting with special friends. Love the appetizer selections—I like smaller portions for lunch! Looking forward to return visit.
Breakfast was delicious, and service was excellent. It was my first time to Los Gatos Parkside, and I will definitely be back.
Very good food and service. Our server was very attentive and constantly asking if we need anything. We will be back again. Always nice to find good food and good service. Highly recommended.
Great food,: the tapas were the best, full or flavor and great presentation, loved the decor and environment. Recommend.
Staff was amaze - food was lovely 😎 inside seemed more formal than the outdoor scene - def recommend

Our host was so accommodating, and Lexi was very attentive without being intrusive. The food and cocktails and wine at this restaurant are stellar examples of a restauranteur and management who all really care about every detail and their customer experience.
Excellent t service! Food & drinks are delicious and good size portions.

Drinks are good, food is good and the all around vibe is conducive to lively conversation and cozy companionship.   The menu is broad and changes often enough to be fresh no matter how frequently you dine there.   It’s one of our favorite date night spots for  my wife and I.
The food was amazing! Our server was friendly, helpful in deciding our order and very attentive. I can’t wait to return.

The food used to be better. The scallops were great but I've had the salmon and it was dry and meh (def not worth the $30 price tag) and my buddy got the gnocchi which used to come with an amazing Bolognese but they decided to put cream in their sauce and now it's among the many things that people who are lactose intollerant can't order, they offered up a marinara sauce that honestly I could have made (better) at home. Overall the ambiance is great as is the vibe and energy in the place but the food is meh for the price.

First time experiencing Los Gatos Parkside!  It was a great evening all around.  We arrived just before happy hour which offered a nice variety of food and drinks. Dinner was equally delicious and Megan our server was terrific. She was knowledgeable, friendly, efficient. I will go again.
LGP is the quintessential neighborhood gem. Great location and ambience. Wonderful service. The dishes are well conceived and executed very well, and delicious. Well done!
A little loud but very attractive space Good service and very good food Will go back

Taylor wanted to go back to her fave brunch place in Los Gatos so we could take K and to celebrate her 21st birthday! We’ve been dreaming of the avocado toast and K had the skillet which he loved. Our waitress was great and personable. Service for water was good and we enjoyed sitting in the outdoor seating next to the farmers market. Our waitress surprised Taylor with the yummy delectable Grandma’s bread pudding with homemade caramel sauce which was amazing!
Our first time and great!  Would like to try the patio on our next visit. Pole appetizer was star!
Absolutely everything was great. Food, ambiance, service. As a vegetarian I appreciated having options for what I could order.

We had a wonderful lunch out on the patio with our pooch! Our server, Long (sp) was great and didn’t rush us at all. The Chinese chicken salad was nice and fresh with a great peanut dressing. The chicken salad sandwich was large and generous with the bacon and was very tasty as was the smoked turkey sandwich. Only complaint was the bacon needed to be cooked more on the turkey sando.  All in all, fresh and tasty! 😋

One of our favorite places and normally excellent   Service- last night service - attention to detail was lacking !
Champagne served originally in a white wine glass and white wine served in a red wine glass.
Server was pushy for us to place the order - we ordered appetizers and then pushed to pal e entrees .
Food was as always great - the octopus special was tender and very tasty - the Halibut special delicious and the potatoes served amazing !

Amazing food! Totally worth the price and hype. Our server Cathy/Kathy was absolutely fantastic. Recommendations were fabulous and paired very well. Food was so fresh! We will definitely be back. Thank you guys for amazing great family dinner

The hostess was so accommodating of us and our handicapped sister, she got us the perfect table. Then, Scott, our server was just amazing. He was knowledgeable, patient, efficient, and attentive without being intrusive. The food was so so great, as usual. We'll be back soon!
We ate outside so the noise level was minor.  Service and food great.
Sunday dinner to celebrate birthday for ‘grandma’. Great table inside for the 5 of us. All the food was delish, plus nice cocktails. Serving staff friendly but professional.

We sat outside. Beautiful location. Food was so good. Our waiter Long was great. My friend had the breakfast skillet w/scrambled eggs & lots of fresh vegetables & just the right amount of cheese on top. I had the avocado toast w/2 eggs. Avocado toast a little too salty for me but otherwise delicious & so pretty.

Our bartender Ian was also our server.  He was on top of everything.  Nice man.

The crab cakes and the tuna poke were outstanding.
Shrimp lettuce wraps were a hit in our group. We loved the server and the patio was a great place for lunch.
Can’t imagine going anywhere else for dinner to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday!!!
Good solid menu. Food was well made and care was taken with the vegetables that came the the halibut special. Service was attentive and pleasant. Overall what I expected.

First time here. Location is nice, literally by the side of a park in Los Gatos downtown. Ambience was a bit casual inside, but the bar looks nice. Sat in a booth facing the bar. Service was prompt and friendly, though it, too, felt a bit unpolished. 

Ordered a couple of cocktails - Frozen in Thyme (expecting a gimlet variant) and a gin / campari one (expecting a negroni variant). Both tasted a bit off-color - they had too much ice and watery juice mixes, so lacked body and flavor, more like diluted lemonades.

Appetizers were crab cakes, gazpacho and superfood salad. Crab cakes were ok, but felt a bit dry without any sauce to accompany them. Gazpacho was decent, though a bit too grainy and spicy. Salad was unappealing in presentation and tasted average.

Mains were gnocchi and salmon. Gnocchi was substantive and satisfying. But salmon felt a tad on the small side and the crust made it feel a bit "junky". Potato puree had an odd taste and some asparagus were wilted.

Dessert was bread pudding, a bit too doughy with too-much caramel.

All in all, the meal felt average, drinks were disappointing, flavors were odd, and while service & ambience were good (though casual), overall the experience was not as fine as we were hoping.
Was seated and then completely forgotten. Left after 20 mins...

We have dined at Parkside many times.  This time there appeared to not be enough wait staff. We had huge gaps in our table service . Had to ask for water refills several times. Appeared to be one server working the entire back room which was full and had a large party as well. Was not our best experience at Parkside.
The food for the most part was good. The service was horrible. The people next to us walked out after sitting there for 20 minutes without even water.

We had a great dinner.  The gazpacho was outstanding were the hush puppies.  The bricked chicken and steak frites were perfect.  The service was wonderful with Shandra checking in regularly, offering tastes of the beer selections, and prompt food service.  We’ll be going back again. Outside wasn’t noisy. Thanks for a great dinner.

This is one of the best restaurants I have been to Los Gatos so far! Our server was so sweet and gave us great recommendations of their menu! Food was excellent and their cocktail drinks were so good as well! We will be coming back here for sure!
I went there with 4 culinary discriminating friends and we all found the food and service to be very good.

It was our first time at Oarkside, and I asked 2 friends who had been if they recommended it - both said YES. We liked everything we ordered: the Heirloom tomatoe&watermelon salad with Burrata cream was my favorite. So fresh and tasty with pea pod puree. My Fieldstone Hazy was perfect: creamy, citrus notes and very cold. We shared a glass of wine - the sommelier helped us in that he heard what we liked and made a great recommendation. I loved how many veggies came with the scallops and my husband loved the mussels. The bread service was also delish: hot, crispy and fresh with whipped butter. We asked for a sauce on the side and it showed up pronto. 
We ate outside because I need to have a firm seat - lovely out at the parklette. 
We’ll go back for sure!!!

Dillon, our server was excellent & on top of things! He definitely added to our experience & is an asset to LG Parkside.

I love the mocktails! Que the Mint rocks!
Great restaurant!  Loved the food . The outdoor patio is really nice

Amanda was a great server !
Food was very good - and is consistently good - our 3rd time here and always enjoy it .

The place has a vibrant and energetic feel.
We love the cozy atmosphere. The food was delicious and it was also reasonably priced. Service was also fantastic. Definitely a great place to hangout and eat!
Parkside is the perfect combination of healthy and yummy indulgence. Great menu, great service and an overall neighborhood, friendly vibe.
We had a delicious brunch on the outdoor patio.  We tried the Acai bowl, breakfast sandwich, waffles and bacon and eggs.  All were delicious!
Great vibe and excellent food.  Our service was excellent.  Friendly and efficient.  The watermelon salad with Burrata was fantastic as was the Halibut special.
Amazing waiter! Food was plated nicely, but didn’t taste as beautiful as it looked.
This is must if you visit Los Gatos,  lunch or dinner always great-pleas get a reservation, its not easy to get in, but walkings are welcome.
Sitting outside made all the difference. Being right on the main square is lovely.

In the past two weeks, I have visited the Parkside Café twice. Both times the service atmosphere and food quality were excellent. I had lunch with my family visiting from North Carolina. Our server was a young lady who was just starting the job, she couldn’t have been more gracious or helpful! She came to our assistance after several tables who had arrived after us had been served before us. Not sure why that happened. She certainly turned a potentially frustrating experience into a delightful afternoon. This week I visited with three friends for the happy hour, again service and food were excellent. Although I realize costs of running a restaurant are high, the prices for some appetizers were expensive for what we were served. $11 for 2 SMALL meatballs seemed absurd. And this was the happy hour price! Nonetheless I will be returning.

First time.  Had a great lunch.  I had flank steak with heirloom tomatoes and fries.  Such good flavor and cooked perfectly.   My sister had the chicken salad and said it was really good.  We started out with the roasted cauliflower with garlic and pine nuts.

Our server was so nice, helpful and the service was impeccable

Really nice parklette, especially as there was not much traffic. The risotto was really nice but a bit pricey when you add the scallops ($44). Best thing I had was the espresso margarita!  Watch your step! Several tripping hazards.

I had the vegetarian sandwich which was mediocre at best and for $18.00 a rip
Off. Service was slow. It was nothing more than an overpriced mediocre lunch spot that I do not recommend.

Ive dined here before but this time the service was crappy as they had too many outside tables for the amount of staff they had.  Basically, no one check in us during the meal and the portions were tiny.  Small tomato salad with Burrata  with a 3 oz salmon...$31.  Only issue there was no burrata and know one to tell as the waiter was overwhelmed with tables.  Never once saw a manager outside during the 2 hour lunch with over 1 hour and 15 min waiting for my salad.

I wouldn’t recommend this place if you’d like a quiet, intimate dinner. Food is delicious and came out timely however there were times we couldn’t have a conversation due to the noise level.  I’m not sure this was a regular occurrence as the manager did apologize for the noise level. We might request to be seated outside next time.
Such a great meal and delicious drinks as well!!!
A nice spot close to the town square, deviled eggs for the win!

This is a very loud, open concept layout restaurant. Not ideal for people who want to have a conversation and definitely not if you have any trouble with your hearing. Came here for a "business" meeting and regretted it as soon as we walked in. Additionally, service was SLOOOOWWW. Arrived 6PM on a Friday eve (party of 3) and didn't leave until 8:40PM.  Server was swamped with other tables and never came to take our order. Manager finally did. Then, upon finishing dinner, we waited a very long time to get the check and then again waited for the server to come pick up the credit card. Each step of this dinner was painstakingly slow.
Everything was amazing…from the service, to the atmosphere, to the food, & drinks!

Outdoor area is very nice!!
Server was great and never felt rushed.
Parkside is such a great find in downtown Los Gatos. It's beautifully decorated, a great location and the menu has such nice variety. Everything we ordered was delicious!
We love the food at Parkside.  Always fresh and tasty.

Always amazing food and service is excellent!
So kind to accommodate my friends’ nut and shellfish allergies!

Jasmine, our server, was excellent.  We had a large party with several picky eaters and she handled them beautifully.  The food was fresh and well prepared.  The atmosphere was very pleasant, all the wait staff were excellent.  Would definitely recommend if you are in the area.

All of the staff from the hostess to our servers was very pleasant and accommodating. I had the scallops with roasted carrots, peas and potatoes and they were excellent. My husband had the crab salad special which was also very good with a generous serving of crab. His only complaint was that he would have liked a little more dressing so I would recommend getting dressing on the side so that you can control the amount. We sat outdoors in the area  facing the plaza which was perfect on a warm summer evening. We had the beignets for desert and they were delicious. Overall a very pleasant experience for a bit of a splurge.
Had a great meal with my family.  Very inviting and food was exceptional

What a great location to catchup with family, friends, or colleagues - we even refer to the Los Gatos Parkside as company office #2

Great vibes, food and drinks.
We had a good table for our group of six, good food & service, highly recommend.
Nice outside ambience.  Across the street from the park.

We were looking forward to lunch at our” Go To” restaurant in Los Gatos.  Arrived a few minutes early and the receptionist was dealing with a couple who did not have reservations and wanted a specific table. They where offered a table by the bar but continued “on” until they where given a booth.  We had made reservations two weeks ago and had requested a booth.  We were offered a table in the back room and the hostess considered the table  with a chair and a padded side a booth.  It was right on top of another couple and we declined the offer reminding her we had requested a booth.  She replied it was a booth and said she could offer us a table in the center of the restaurant which we excepted. Of course I was thinking why make reservations in advance on Open Table if your table is given away to an annoying guest?
The drinks we ordered were outstanding.  The bartender knows how to make a great martini.  Thank you.
Our main courses were also excellent.
We ordered beignets and coffee for dessert. When  the coffee arrived the waiter informed us they were out of beignets.  We ordered crème bur-lee and observed that the table adjacent to us had just received beignets.  We laughed and said “oh well”!    Our coffee was ice cold when the bur-lee finally arrived.
Unfortunately it was a warm custard that must have been sitting out.
We have been to Parkside numerous times and were never disappointed.  Will we return, the jury is out?
I ordered the steak frites and asked for medium cook. It came well done and dry

Enjoyed the poke, salad, fries, cocktails, wonderful bread pudding for dessert. Our server was considerate and informative.  We sat outside in the parklet which allowed us to converse. Inside is pretty noisy.
Overall good service and food. They had to make the burger and then forgot about it. They did comp it which was polite
We were there for a Sunday lunch, but the menu is basically all brunch items (vs their usual weekday lunch).  The burger was very good, as was the side-salad.
Bartenders are fabulous they make the best drinks
We had the BEST server!! She made the evening outstanding. Great suggestions, lovely to talk to, knew just when to swing by and check on us, and when to give us time. Could not have been better.

Los Gatos Parkside was a wonderful experience. We were seated on time and the entire waitstaff is always so accommodating and friendly.
As always the food was incredible too.  Took a friend for lunch and it was her first experience at Parkside.  She was so pleased with her lunch too.  I ordered the burger with waffle fries and it didn’t disappoint.  The waffle fries are great and not greasy.  Ate only one half of the burger because of the portion size.  Will enjoy the other half for a great dinner tonight.  Thanks for providing such great compostable togo boxes too.
I will be returning again to Parkside.  Always a great culinary experience. 👋
We ate wonderful entrees cocktails and main menu. Cheerful attentive waiter and our food was brought out on time. I would highly suggest it for bar or restaurant.

I met a friend at Parkside for lunch and the food and service was outstanding!  I had a super food bowl which was delicious and had a delightful citrus dressing and my friend had a salad with grains, beets, avocado and numerous other delicious vegetable's which she thoroughly enjoyed.  We are both looking forward to returning.
Delicious food, great menu. The service was wonderful and the restaurant is so pretty!  Great location too. Lovely dining inside or outside.

This was my 5th time coming here and my first time being disappointed.  I ordered the chicken salad which I've had before and it wasn't as fresh tasting as before.  Generous portion of chicken, but too much dressing, could have used a few more cashews, and I think there were other ingredients missing.  My friend ordered a salad as well (forgot the name but it had fruit in it) and it could have used more fruit and less of the romaine to be more interesting tasting.

Service was fast, but no refill on the water and no offer of dessert menu or after meal drinks.

We sat outside, and it was quiet and very pleasant.  The service was good, albeit a little slow.  We started with the brussel sprouts, which we liked.  Then I ordered the crab cakes appetizer because I enjoyed it so much that last time I was there.  This time they were a little overcooked, but the seasoning was still good.  It's also nice that they include a small salad with the dish.  My husband had the fried chicken.  I liked the flavor, but he would have preferred a breast instead of the leg and thigh.
Great place and great food. We love downtown Los Gatos.
I find that inside can be a bit noisy so if the weather is right, their outside seating is a wonderful experience. Great food, great service, and will definitely be back!

We requested a booth hoping it would help with the noise. It did help a bit. Outside of the noise, the place is great! Our table wasn’t ready when our reservation time came and went, so the host/manager comped  us an appetizer. That was a very thoughtful thing to do. Service was very good, food was very good and overall, we really enjoyed ourselves.
They have a great bar, excellent food and nice energy. Highly recommend the hush puppies as a starter.
Amazing food. Their grain bowl is absolutely delicious. Try it with salmon. Service is friendly as usual. This is my go to for business lunches and family dinners.
Service was great! We brought my 89 year old mom with us and they help out with everything we needed!
The food is always outstanding. And the service was excellent. I will continue to come here over and over again
This is a much place to visit for great food, great service and great surroundings
A little noisy at lunch but good and service were great!  Always have a nice meal.

We absolutely loved our visit! The service and ambiance was great (we sat outside), and the food and drinks were great! We were slightly disappointed with a couple of our entrees, but aside from that we had no complaints!
Service was friendly and attentive, food was great!!!

I try and go there at least once a week. It’s one of my favorite restaurants in Los Gatos. I go with my family and I also go with clients. The service and food is always outstanding and the management always acknowledges the people that come in more often and we appreciate that I will always support Parkside. It’s a great place to eat

Most important: Dining indoors is unbearably noisy. Add to that several large, very loud parties, and the experience is uncomfortable. An outdoor table would probably have alleviated the problem.
A creative menu. The horseradish encrusted salmon had an oddly-flavored miso sauce that didn't add to the dish.
Parkside was amazing as usual. Will be back soon.
Happy hour menu is awesome.   Bar is always full of chatty people.  Service is top notch.  Thanks Teresa!
Both the service and food are exceptional, as is the presentation on the plate.  This is one of the best restaurant experiences I have had in a long time.  Fabulous!

Greeted by server, Chandra. She was personable and helpful.

We sat outside and enjoyed our cocktails (Vodka, thyme, elderberry, yum!) before ordering some appetizers. 

Enjoyed Jazz on the Plazz while dining--perfect summer evening! 

Highly recommend.
Hostess seated me exactly where I wanted to be and I'm sorry I don't remember our server's name but she was awesome; cheerful, effcient, accommodating.

This is my third visit to your restaurant and each time we have excellent service!
The hostess, to the people who fill your water glass to the waiter/waitress have all been friendly and give great service

The food is always consistent

Food was very good and nice ambience.  We had burrata toast app (excellent), deviled eggs app (just ok).  For mains we had scallops (good, but slightly over-cooked) and bolognese (excellent).  Both mains were very vegetable-forward.  Service was timely in general, but the waiter could not describe dishes or wines with any kind of detail.

So, very good food, pretty good service, but the noise was so loud that we had trouble trying to have a conversation, and came out of the restaurant with our ears ringing. The decor is nice to look at, but it is all smooth, hard surfaces with nothing to help mute the sound. If you're like us, you may want to find a quieter place to dine. Much as we enjoyed the food, we probably won't be going back.
I had the most delicious chicken salad sandwich at Parkside. More than filling.
Our food server was very knowledgeable about the menu and very entertaining.
Great food and good service. Love the cashew chicken salad.
Lovely lunch. Pleasant service & tasty food. Thank you!

My wife and I celebrated our anniversary with dinner at Parkside, our first time there. We were greeted and seated promptly and courteously. We were attended to immediately, and our needs were anticipated. The servers were well informed and able to explain the menu and offer suggestions when asked. And everything was delicious.

One service quibble, and it by no means put a damper on our evening but is worth noting: Parkside seems overall of a high enough standard that those bringing out our orders should know who ordered what. "Who gets the halibut?" felt inconsistent with the service overall.

Still, very highly recommended, and we can't wait to return.

I typically get the Asian chicken salad, which is my absolute favorite and so delicious. But this time I tried their new breakfast skillet. And it was amazing and now they are my new favorite breakfast place as well. So glad they opened in my town! Also, the service is always really really good! ￼￼
Loved it. Very happy with experience! Would go again!
Had a birthday party with eight”older” women and the food and service were all great. Very attentive server and gave us space to enjoy our celebration.
Dined on the patio.  Great service and a delicious salad.
Had a great meal at Parkside.  Excellent food, hospitality and great Sunday brunch options.  Our family really enjoyed the experience.  One of our top “ Go Too” restaurants to enjoy! 😊

Great place for brunch. Excellent food and very family friendly. There’s also a farmers market a park next door for the kids after brunch.

We have been here before and the service was exceptional. This time our server forgot to put in one of the orders and drinks and didn’t check back for additional drink/ food requests. We had to ask other servers to give us our drinks that were ready at the bar for about 15 minutes.

Second time here and again the food was excellent!  Appetizers were the avocado and the burrata which were shared between 4 of us. For the entree 2 of us had the salmon which was incredible- cooked just right with an excellent crisp coat !
The ladies had salads which were fresh and well thought out !
One dessert the bread pudding ! Really enjoyable !
We had the Sancerre which was delicious.
This is a great new find - we hope it stays as good as it is now !

This was our 3rd time here and our second time sitting outside.  Although it was a very warm day,it was pleasant. The noise level was due to music in the plaza. It added to the experience, but my husband and brother in law have a hard time hearing so that was a bit challenging, that being said it was much easier to hear than if we had sat inside. Food very good, service was good.
Perfect spot for a first date - Romantic setting, nice ambience. Reasonably priced but delicious food. Request to sit in a booth.

First time visit with friends and the food was all delicious and flavorful, service was pleasant and enjoyable but the noise level was a bit much for conversations.  The drinks were light on alcohol but the hush puppies, lettuce wraps, watermelon salad, salmon and fried chicken were all very very good.  Dessert was a must.
Great ambience, very fun atmosphere. My burger was a bit dry, which which was surprising because the time prior it was perfect. Otherwise, the meal was great. Loved the bread pudding. ￼

The food was  very good (better than I exoected) and lots of healthy options.  Much thought went into presentation  too. Good wine list . We sat outside which was lovely and really helped with the noise level as we find inside way too  loud.  Ambiance and service wonderful.   Worth the visit.

But overpriced, for sure. Which a a real bummer.
The hostess this day was extraordinary saving our table while we negotiated the Santa Cruz traffic, late by like 20 minutes. She was awesome & our table was perfect.
My 13 year old grandson as well as all the adults loved everything about the restaurant. The server and bus persons were amazing.

I wrote a private review months ago and never heard back. We loved your place so much but the service and portion size went way down. My husband went there on business last night and he said that the food and ambiance was good but that the service was horrible and it took 25 mins to get one dessert to share on top of that. Additionally, it took a long time to be seated even though there were reservations and at 5:30 pm.

Food was very good.  Outdoor seating was pleasant on a warm evening.  Waiter was a bit lackadaisical, but pleasant.  Guests at table behind us were very loud and somewhat obnoxious, which interfered with my enjoyment of the dining experience.
The buffet was not don't very well and service was so so. Regular restaurant is better.

I regret our dining experience on Fathers Day- the buffet brunch was not up to standard.  Service was terrible and had to navigate through awkward crowded space to serve ourselves food from buffet.  They should not have charged $50 pp,
The food was cold, the salad hardly had any dressing, and the eggs were bland. The desserts were good!

Had a lovely Father’s Day Brunch at Parkside! Thank you for helping us celebrate with good food and great atmosphere! Feedback: The sliders were a little dry and the bread was hard (we were there early in the AM too), but bacon, tri-tip, pork chop, french toast and croissants were delicious!!
Second time dining at Parkside. Delicious food and excellent service.

A nice surprise, Good and friendly staff that were well trained in the menu. a nice selection of menu with pretty much something for everyone. 
service at the bar was good with a good mixologist that made good drinks.

Appetizers were good, I had the crab cakes and were tasty although not quite hot enough. For entrees one of our guests and  had the special "Halibut" well prepared and very tasty, desert I had the bread pudding that I loved!My wife had the vegetables on rice which she said the vegetables were really good, but the rice was a little bland.

Our server was awesome, forgot her name but very knowledgeable  and funny.

My only negative was that we booked for 7:45 and had to wait 30 mins for the table.

looking forward to going back
The menu has something for everyone. Amanda was friendly and sincere. We sat outside which was lovely.

I have seen this before. When a new restaurant becomes popular, food and service go south. I frequented Parkside since it opened in my neighborhood but had not been there for a few months. Unfortunately, I will not be going back. Service: more servers seem to be needed; we did not get a refill of water the entire time and hard to get anyone’s attention; the waiter, although nice, almost threw the glass of ice I asked for rather than take a few steps to get closer; my dish was incorrect and so was the lady’s next to us. Food: nothing new since last time, fish portion super small, but taste was good. Just want to say that everyone was nice and polite and the atmosphere was still terrific.
Great patio atmosphere and food was excellent. One of my favorite places in LG.
It is a great spot, with amazing food and service. Plan on returning.

The food was very disappointing and not worth the price that we paid. We ordered fried chicken which came out in 5 minutes. It was not hot or crispy and the chicken was dry. The chicken was obviously pre-cooked and not fresh and crispy.  We also had the short ribs, which also was not hot and fairly tasteless. Our server was excellent and he comped our glass of wine. 
I emailed the restaurant with our comments, but did not receive a response.
The food was tasty and our service was great!! I would highly recommend.

Food is amazing! Service and cost is poor. They added a service charge without saying anything before we tipped. It’s a pet peeve how more restaurants are doing this and you are basically doubling their tip. We did not get our cocktails until the food arrived. We most likely will not come back.

I took my son and his 2 children to dinner at Parkside . We sat outside on the patio. The ambience is very  nice and is situated adjacent  to the park . We had very good service with a pleasant waiter and hostess. The food let the restaurant down . It was adequate - nothing special . However - in spite of this we would return.
There’s nothing nicer than having lunch on the patio . . . food was amazing and our server, Ryan, did a great job.
Food was beyond amazing. Servers were so nice. We loved it!

Food was amazing, everything was cooked to perfection. My group had the short ribs, the horseradish salmon and the risotto with scallops. The food is great every time I come. Yummy & beautiful cocktails, a nice little zero-proof menu as well for those alcohol-free peeps. Great energy, nice vibe, busy and a little loud but not to the level that we had to yell.
Great lunch experience….. Service & Food was exceptional.
Food was great. Service was good. It was a bit noisy. Difficult to hear the folks at my own table

Server was outstanding….. friendly, efficient, helpful.  Scallops, salmon, crab cakes and short ribs…. All excellent.

Noise level high.
My second time here, but not my last. The food is fabulous with service to match.
The place was too noisy. Food OK. We will not return

Wait staff was attentive but did not rush us.
Clean
Food was tasty and decent portions
Super cute place with a good vibe. Tends to be super noisy for lunch or dinner. California "bar style" food that suite just about anyone!
Wonderful hospitality! Thank you so much for going above and beyond!
An excellent brunch, for a belated Mother’s Day celebration. Food, drinks, everything was awesome

We went to Parkside on Memorial Day weekend just before a wedding the next day in Los Gatos. The service and food were great. We had four guests flying in from the midwest (of the six of us) so were a little late but Parkside accommodated us  and moved our reservation time back a half an hour. They staff was great!

This was an exceptional experience. We had the rib eye and the tuna  appetizer. The bread pudding is good enough to write home.

The restaurant is beautiful and so are the people in it.

The only slight ding is the noise level but the restaurant can't control for loud patrons. They do have noise dampening panels one be ceiling. We just couldn't hear each other over the loud shouters next to us.
We had a wonderful lunch at Parkside.  This was our second visit.  Outstanding drinks, food and service.  We will return!  A real gem 💎
The Chef uses fresh quality ingredients and every entree I have had has been delicious!   I cannot wait to go back!  The staff are friendly and accommodating!

Spare of the moment reservation ended up to be a very pleasant surprise!  From checking in to the service to receiving our check, the Los Gatos Parkside Restaurant was great.  We were seated outside which had a nice view of the park. The Grain Bowl with Salmon was delicious and the Ribeye that my husband had was cooked the way he liked it.  It was a lovely experience.

The service was excellent, the food delicious, & drinks yummy! We were celebrating a friends birthday for lunch and sat chatting for quit a while and never felt rushed. We were attended to the entire time. A complementary dessert was given to the birthday girl that everyone could share. We all agreed we would definitely return!
Great to have this place here in Los Gatos. Been a few times and it’s been great each time. Creative cocktails and so many options for apps and mains. We’ll be back.

Our service was slow and spotty. We must have sat down at a change of shifts. One server greeted us and then the other didn’t come for a very long time. It took a long time to get our appetizer and salad and I had to ask them what happened to our food. The main course came out timely.

I had the special halibut and it was fantastic. My friend had the salmon and we could smell it before it arrived. My friend didn’t eat her meal and I thought she wasn’t hungry and afterwards she said it was too fishy. I wish she would have told me or the server right away. What a shame. The appetizer and salad was wonderful.

It was my friends birthday and they sat us at a really weird table that was in a corner and behind a huge party of 10. We asked if they had a better table and they said they were fully booked.

I liked the décor and I’d definitely come back but I hope the spotty service was just a fluke and I’d ask ahead of time not to put us in that weird table.
Delicious food, quick service and very attentive staff.  A bit noisy but only because this restaurant is always full (which is a testimony of its high quality)
Great ambience. As far as food and service just ok.

Parkside Mother’s Day brunch provided a good variety of items from Mexican and plain scrambled eggs, bacon, spicy chicken sausage, carved roast beef and ham, several salads, Mac ‘ n’ cheese, brisket hash, fried chicken, French waffles, various desserts, etc.  The service was excellent and atmosphere festive, especially since there was a farmer’s market just outside.
Great food and experience overall. We will be back!
We had another wonderful experience. The food was excellent and their service outstanding!!
Amazing food! We sat outside and they kept us warm and it was easier to talk with all guests
Had a great dinner of the shrimp salad and the hush puppies.  Service was good and the place was lit!
Our server was excellent. He knew the menu and was very efficient.
Delicious food and drinks. Our server was very good and lovely personality! The nosie was level was extreme. Glad we grabbed a corner booth in the back. This place is very popular!

I’ve enjoyed dinner here several times and love it! Last night they offered a halibut special and it was fabulous. Recommend the avocado bruschetta as a starter. Cocktails are great too. We had an excellent waiter.
A great casual restaurant with wonderful food , ambiance and staff.  My new go-to place for a nice meal with friends or family.

After having been moved 2 times after sitting down at a table, everything went smoothly and our server was helpful and friendly!

The Chinese chicken salad was good, fresh and plentiful.  The special crab salad was excellent and full of crab ( according to my companions)  and looked delicious!

The Hush puppy appetizer (6) was hot and fresh and very tasty!  Definitely order those!  

All in all a good meal once we were firmly seated! :)
Great food and service. Love the location and how they created the outdoor space. Will definitely be back.
Excellent food and attentive service!  Hopping Happy Hour!
Best in Los Gatos!  Noisy inside. Lovely and quieter outside

Overall I liked Parkside.  We were first seated right by the door going out to the patio and we asked to be moved.  Finally they moved us to a table in the very back of the restaurant which was comfortable and not as noisy.  The food was very good.  The waiter was earnest but still needs work on service.  I would go again

We heard about Parkside and without checking reviews decided to give it a try, and are we glad we did! We went in for lunch on Thursday with a reservation and made a request for a certain type of table. The staff was very flexible and gave us just what we wanted. Our waiter was AMAZING! He was extremely familiar with the menu and bar items and skillfully directed us to items we thoroughly enjoyed. My wife and I split the crab cakes (some of the best we've had) which were crispy on the outside and loaded with crab on the inside. Delicious! Then we split the veggie sandwich with truffle fries. Again, the preparation was delicious. The dessert menu was very enticing, but we were quite full, and committed to going back to enjoy the desserts another day. GO GIVE THEM A TRY!

Took my wife for a birthday lunch. Read the negative reviews, but gave it a try anyway. Good thing I did! Service (Hector) was excellent, food was amazing, atmosphere was relaxing. I have nothing negative to say. It was a perfect lunch. Pro tip: If you want a great drink and like tequila, try the “Love Spell”. Enjoy!
Amazing food! Amazing service! Beautiful ambiance!
Love the food and atmosphere of this spot. We are regulars. Excellent chef.
It was chilly so we ended up inside, and what a beautifully decorated restaurant.  The food and service was on-point, and the four of us stayed the entire happy hour and beyond.  We'll be back.

We have once again come to one of our latest local favorites.  Adam (the manager) and his staff continue to be fantastic and present us with delicious choices.  Last night we brought a friend who had never been and was curious.  We each had three different entree's and shared those along with a couple appetizers and drinks.  We continue to be impressed with the food, drinks and service.  See you again soon!

Mike
Great place in general. Have been there twice: for dinner and brunch. Both visits were super good: great food choices, food is delicious, cocktails are super delicious :-), service is wonderful

Our server, Dylan, was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, attentive, and his food recommendations were excellent! In fact, I ordered everything Dylan recommended, and it was delicious! The food felt healthy, easy to digest, and excellent on the palate.

We need more farm to table restaurants!

Order for 2:
Hush puppies
Short Rib Hash w/scrambled eggs and veggies
Banana Bread with chocolate chips
Country Breakfast Plate
Mocktails
We had a reservation but didn't get seated until 25 minutes later and our server didn't get to us until 15 minutes after we were seated. The drinks were also not as good as previous visits.

First time at this restaurant as it is fairly new. The wait staff was pleasant but overwhelmed and shorthanded. They had just opened up patio seating but I don't think their staffing was prepared for the additional tables. However they did comp us two desserts given we waited a long time for our food. The steak my husband got was too bloody even though he asked for medium rare. They did take it back and fix it without complaint which was appreciated. The noise level was really high and it is not a big place so that was challenging. Overall though, it was an okay experience. We were celebrating my kid's 13th birthday and they did bring a candle and help us celebrate him which made it worthwhile.
The perfect spot in DT Los Gatos for a late lunch on the patio. Great food and service from Hector
Excellent crab cakes, hush puppies and fried chicken.  Love all the innovative cocktails.  Nice friendly service

A bday lunch for my sister-in-law. Our server, Jasmine, was excellent. We both ordered one of the specials, a Dungeness crab roll (think lobster roll), which came with their Brussel sprouts slaw and fries. A relatively small portion of crab, but everything was delicious. Outstanding slaw. Brioche bun was especially good. We also had a specialty mocktail with lime, mint, etc. which tasted exactly like a mojito. We shared a dessert, which was sweetly comped for her bday- a lemon meringue concoction. Yum. My only negative was the $36 for the crab roll (didn't  ask the server beforehand- my bad), which l felt was really overpriced.
I really like this new LG restaurant, and will probably return for happy hour. We sat inside, but the outdoor area is really nice, too.

We were excited to try a new restaurant, but overall, was disappointed. Ordered no aioli on appetizer, it came with it. Added chicken to my salad, it came without it. Ordered a drink; waited so long that when the manager dropped by at our table (he was floating around checking in with diners) we let him know and he promptly got the drink. Water was flowing until we ordered dessert. Never came by again and left us with empty cups. 
Atmosphere is cool, but too many strikes to eat there again. Staff were super friendly, but that doesn’t make up all the mistakes. 😞 I would stick to grabbing a drink at the bar…

This was our second underwhelming visit to Park side.  Of the dishes we had, none where very good.  The Salmon was rather tasteless and the mashed potatoes were cold.  The short rib sauce was so salty, it was barely edible.  And while the Cioppino had a nice variety of fish, the sauce was awful. Cioppino broth should be fresh and natural. This sauce was over seasoned, too spicey, and was thickened with cornstarch or some other thickener. Yuck!   I don't understand how a restaurant comes to Los Gatos and spends a ton of money renovating a restaurant and then serves mediocre, expensive food.  That doesn't work here. This restaurant will be out of business in less than a year if they don't improve their food dramatically.
Excellent dinner once again! New manager Lexi is an absolute doll. Love this place!
The food took too long to get to the table and we had to send back the hamburger as it was not cooked.

The food here is generally good, but the spring vegetable risotto is not good.  It more closely resembled a glob of fondue than risotto.  I should have sent it back.  It was just a glob of cheese.  Vegetables were far and few between and there was literally not a grain of rice to be found in the dish.  We also added scallops that never made it to the plate.
Absolutely awesome. We love it there the cioppino to die for.

My friend said his burger was good. As the restaurant got busier so did our server who did not come back and check on us. I ordered a fresh dungenous crab louie. A traditional crab louie comes with the dressing on the side. What a mistake I made and the server for not asking would I like the dressing on the side. Crab has a very delicate flavor. The thousand island dressing blob right on top of the crab had red and green peppers which over powered everything else especially the crab. A bit of color in the dressing is not needed or preferred for something as special as a crab louie. Such a disappointment. At least serve the dressing automatically on the side.
We enjoyed the drinks and the food was awesome. It was a bit loud in the dining area though. We will come back. : )

Great new spot, service was good and drinks were amazing, though took some time and arrived after our appetizer. Food was a little hit or miss—spring risotto with peas and asparagus was lovely, the scallops were unfortunately overcooked. The crab cakes were delicious and cooked to perfection. The Miaki Mushroom was an impressive presentation but was  very dense and lacked seasoning/salt and was just so-so. Will go back for sure as the ambiance is lovely and I’m guessing they’ll work out the kinks.
Atmosphere and vibe was nice. Food was pretty good. Fun date night spot
