I was able to make easy online reservations to celebrate a birthday!  Our server Giancarlo, was kind, courteous, and knowledgeable.  He gave many wonderful recommendations, all of which were incredibly tasteful.  We were invited to relax and take our time—no rushing through the meal which was appreciated for a celebration.  The dessert selection is amazing!  Forget the scale for a day; these are worth every bite!  We selected two to share and Giancarlo brought a third with a birthday candle.  Very considerate!  I will continue to return again and again.  This place is tops!
The gnocchi were good.  So was the bruschetta. I would not recommend the mushroom it was weird and doughy.  The beignet were the highlight.

The food and service were fantastic. Especially loved the avocado toast and hushpuppies appetizers, short ribs entree, and brussels sprouts side. The cocktails (a solstice and a hi-tide) were yummy, too. Pricey, but worth it!
Parkside is awesome! My husband loves their Fried Chicken and I love their hamburger and their grilled halibut. Nice appetizers too. The decor is soothing and tasteful. - Carol D. 😎👍👍
Great service. Friendly helpful waitress. Food pretty good. Price just about right for Los Gatos.

The restaurant was beautifully redone in what use to be La Boulanger location.  Food was descent, we had Mary’s Fried Chix which was very moist and flavorful.  It was plated with purple mashed potatoes and spinach, nice combo.  My husband had the short ribs with polenta and spinach.  It was ok.  The ahi tuna appetizer was nicely presented but need some kick.   We ended our dinner with the Meyer Lemon dessert, a bit sweet but good.  Service was excellent.  Overall we would try it again but ask for the inside room seating as the restaurant is on the loud side.
We took friends for dinner and it was a nice atmosphere with excellent food from an interesting menu and cordial wait staff.  A needed gem in Los Gatos!
Our Easter brunch experience was excellent! We were seated outside, but there were heaters and a lovely ambience. The buffet brunch was excellent, and I was so pleased!

We dined at Parkside for Easter Brunch. Exceptional food- they provided all the right options and everything was delicious. Outstanding service - from the receptionist to the wait staff and the manager .. they couldn’t have been more pleasant. Our new favorite spot!
Food and service was excellent.  Never disappoints.
2nd visit to Los Gatos Parkside and it was fantastic.  The food was top notch, and friendly wait staff.  Can't wait to go back.
Food and service are outstanding. This was the second time my friend and I had lunch and we will return again!

Very good food and a nice selection of offerings.
From soup, salad, sandwiches to bigger plates,
surely something appealing to anybody.
Service was nice and efficient, just felt a little
rushed.
Definitely would go back.
Felt on exapensive side. Like 7-$10.  Dinner was good. My ice cream sundae - not sure it was worth $8

Great ambience and service.  Our food and cocktails were excellent.  The fried chicken and the short ribs were both delicious.  The avocado toast was also a star.   Can’t wait to try everything on the menu.

Loved having a dinner with friends.  Crab Fest -- YUM!  Crab Cake appetizer excellent, although pricey.  Crab Soup -- only comes in a bowl -- also delicious.

Loved the Short Rib entree.  Everyone's meals were wonderful.

Yummy pear crostada dessert, and beingets.
Food and drinks were great. Jose, our busser was amazing!
Staff are so welcoming and kind! Very child friendly love the honey bee wax and crayons as well as the kiddo menu. Food and drinks are delicious!
Truly exceptional dining experience! I got the crab and was blown away by how delicious it was! Service was incredible… park side is such a vibe

Finally a California fusion restaurant not in San Francisco!

Fresh ingredients, great menu and creative drinks.

Staff is very collaborative and knowledgeable of food and wine pairings.
Fried chicken was great.  Beer selection is limited, but wine selection is superb.  Nice atmosphere.
Both of us got sick from the carb cake appetizer. Not good.
Wonderful place for lunch.  Have to try it for dinner now!

We shared the starters at the top of the menu for brunch. Hush puppies were extraordinary. Deviled eggs and banana bread were great. Fruit was fresh and generous. Doughnuts were disappointing - small rubbery rings covered with granulated sugar. Caramel dipping sauce was nice but chocolate tasted like Hershey’s syrup. Excellent friendly service. We would go back.
Hector was a great waiter.. very attentive and friendly as was the bartender!

Lovely setting, but food was just ok. Salmon was room temp and a bit flavorless, pork chop was also just ok, frankly the best part of the meal was an appetizer and the kids pasta. Service was quick and super nice, but food came out in odd order - entrees first, appetizers right after, kids food last. All in all, just alright, and if it was cheaper I’d give it another try, but it wasn’t cheap.

Great bartender and wonderful innovative cocktails.  The food was excellent. Great Hamburger and fries and the Fried Chicken was outstanding!  A bit of confusion about who was suppose to wait on our table so some long waits, but the restaurant was extremely busy.   Overall loved Parkside and have already made my next reservation.
Parkside is our new favorite restaurant in Los Gatos! Nice decor, great service & menu, and prices are reasonable. 👍😎
Always a delicious spread of food and beverages. The staff is 5-star!
Excellent experience!  Food was terrific!  Service was wonderful. Can’t wait to go back!
Disappointed they ran out of cashews for my salad.
Great place in Los Gatos and one of the only restaurants open on a Monday. Very nice atmosphere and solid food and service. Will definitely go back.

Had Hector as our waiter, fabulous.
Really enjoyed the Sunday Brunch menu.
Ordered eggs benedict. English muffin was dry/stale/inedible. Has browns were also inedible (greasy/metallic/freezer burn?). Sad that the food was so poor, as the ambiance and service were good.
All the wait staff were fantastic! Thank you for a memorable evening!

Wonderful Fried Chicken!
Amazing service
Great ambiance

This was our first time there. I brought my wife there for her birthday along with her daughter, but unfortunately, we were pretty disappointed with the food. I got the tuna tartare, which was very standard, the same exact thing that everybody else does. Nothing interesting. My wife and daughter got a salad which were both just OK. They do have location and atmosphere going for them, but they need to step up their food game in a big way if they’re going to survive. ￼
Great food & service. Depending on time of day, noise is extreme. If you go on off times noise is less. Worth it.
Be prepared for "pricey" but excellent, super-yummy food.  Affordable wines and beers.  Scrumptious desserts.  Huhspuppies and fried chicken are a must-have.

Lunch was delicious. The three of us ordered different menu items and shared everything. Chicken Salad Sandwich, Quiche and kale salad, and the turkey sandwich. Big side of fries for the table. Espresso martinis and a good spicy Bloody Mary. Couldn’t finish it all!
Only a slight disappointment that although we had a reservation, it took 10-15 minutes to be seated.

Service at the bar was great.  Nicely appointed place.  Loved the deviled eggs and lettuce cups.  Pork chop was probably a 6.5 out of 10.  Not as moist as Id like.   Maybe they could brine it.  The sweet potatoes needed a little more oomph.
It was perfect! The drinks, the food and the ambience!
Parkside is our new 'Go To' in downtown.  Great vibe, the staff is consistently really good and so is the food.  We look forward to our lunches and dinners here.
Excellent food, knowledgeable service, very noisy
Beautiful space remodel. Salmon was delightful. Great appetizers and drinks! Nice to have such a great new place in LG!
Parkside is my new favorite place!  Moody atmosphere, unique cocktails, fabulous food and good service! I've been twice in the last 2 weeks - and will definitely go back soon!
Really great staff, good food without being overly formal. I will definitely be back.

Reservation was at 8 PM. We did not get seed until 8:35 PM. The food was cold and it was so loud. I couldn’t even talk with my mom who is sitting right next to me. We used to love this place now I’m never coming back.

Seated straight away, pleasant servers, food was delicious! Highly recommend the crab cakes, short rib, mushroom ravioli and the beignets for dessert! Yum! 
Not sure why they serve cava/prosecco in a wine glass though, goes flat very quickly!
Nice ambiance/atmosphere, good for all (families, couples, groups) nice sitting area at the bar too. Just what Los Gatos needed!
Food and service was excellent. First time visiting and will be back.  Noise level by bar very high while the back room was quiet such a difference if you're trying to have a conversation.

Super noisy and WARM. Should have asked for a table outside.

Having tables around the bar makes for UNPLEASANT dining experience. Having to speak super loud across the table so one could hear and be heard above the bar noise level, isn’t what I would call fun.

Food was meh. Who serves a Manhattan in a coupe? NO ONE.

This was my second time having dinner here and unfortunately they missed the mark. I ordered the special fish for dinner, and it came out cold, like it had been sitting for a while after cooking. The flavors were bland. My friend ordered the pasta, and that looked better. We also split a salad and that was bland too. ￼

We came for lunch. The restaurant is clean and modern. The service was friendly. I ordered a chopped salad with salmon and it was extremely small. Side salad small, with a small fillet of salmon, for about $30.  It was delicious though. My family got sandwiches and wraps and they cost less and had a lot more food. An entree salad should be 3 to 4 times that size - especially for that price. The deviled eggs were very good too.
I might come back for dinner and try again, but maybe not.

The food at this restaurant was undeniably delicious, and I thoroughly enjoyed every bite. However, the service left much to be desired. Our server seemed completely oblivious to our presence; it was as if we were invisible. Throughout the entire meal, they were inattentive and failed to check on us. Despite the tasty dishes, the lack of service significantly detracted from the overall dining experience.

The sandwiches were big portions made with fabulous ingredients.  Both of our sandwiches were a bit gooey.... could have had less honey mustard.  But overall, the ambiance was darling, the server was great... it was a really nice lunch out:)

Food not bad but not great. Small menu. Hostess full of attitude and waiter was young & nice but inexperienced. Tastefully decorated, this is the place to see and be seen in LG which isn’t enjoyable for us as old married people. Crowded, noisy and unromantic. Doubt we’ll go back.
Great Restaurant! Nicely decorated in an upscale fashion, with good entrees. I especially like their herb-encrusted Halibut.

Another great night out. Dinner was delicious, the drinks awesome! I love the solstice drink for something refreshing! This restaurant is running great. The new manager, Andrew, is so wonderful. Q at the hostess stand is as sweet as can be. Giancarlo a great server! Went twice just this week!
Our waiter John Carlo was so good. Rarely do we get good service like that anymore. And our food and drinks were excellent!

My husband and I went here for Valentine's Day. We weren't happy with our initial table and our server quickly got us a better table. The four course menu and wine pairing was great. They ran out of the dessert we wanted, but replaced it with a wonderful Pear Crostata.  When we received the bill, we pleasantly surprised that the price of the desserts and dessert wine were deleted from our bill.  I can't wait to come back. The brunch looks especially inviting.

We booked the valentine experience and I gotta say, the food was delicious. Actually much more pleasant than a lot of the high end valentine experience we’ve trjed before. Highly recommend the rib eye and crab cake. Friendly waitress but not very attentive and we both got a weird sense that they’re just exhausted from the busy holiday, which is completely understandable.

I would usually skip going out to dine during a Hallmark Holiday but we had a group interested in going out for Valentine's Day Dinner and so we went along with it and made reservations at Parkside.  They had a price fix menu, which made sense for a holiday and a lovely wine pairing to go with it.  There were some really great choices and we had samples of everything.  It was all very good and we had a wonderful time.  Adam, the Manager and his staff are amazing!  Our server, Lexi was charming, professional and efficient.  We've been to this restaurant a half dozen times now and it's been very good.  You won't be disappointed.

Presentation, service was excellent
I’ve shared our experience with friends and family
Highly recommend Parkside
Great meeting general manager
Our server Rebecca and staff were spot on!

Parkside was an excellent choice for a special Valentine’s treat! The food was creative and delicious, the wine pairing wonderful, and there was excellent service even on a major “dining holiday”. Parkside is a new favorite of ours.

Delicious food!
Friendly service and cozy ambiance.
Our new favorite spot!
Had a great lunch grazing from the appetizer menu!
The service was exceptional and the cocktails are creative. The food of course takes the cake. Great place for a cozy date and jing bang too..

Lovely restaurant
Enjoyed our first time visit
Will return
Our lunch was very good and service and hospitality was excellent.

The food was hit and miss. The crab cake and avocado toast appetizers were excellent but the short ribs and the burger were sub par. Service was adequate. The environment and low price points seem to be appealing to most people.
Pretty and convenient venue. Just ordered drinks and the fish tacos. Too much mayo on those tacos! First Paloma was watered down, second was a bit better.

Very noisy. Hard to talk.

Wine pour was light for price.
Such a great lunch!! I want for a Buisness meeting and could not have been happier with the experience

Menu is eclectic. The food was just ok. We were seated at the back table next to the bathroom. It's a constant flow of people in and out of the door to use the restrooms. Rather unpleasant. The energy in the restaurant was hopping and the service staff very attentive. But overall just ok.
Fabulous choice for high quality meal. Highly recommend it.
Amazing everything love this place   Would highly recommend
Food experience. Power went out from a storm 5 min after we walked in so no food. Wine was good and staff got nice battery powered lights at the bar.  Want to go back and try the food and cocktails.

I was seated at a table where my chair was in the way of the server trying to reach the table next to me so I had to keep moving around. Not relaxing at all. There was a party of 6 near us that was so loud we couldn't even hear ourselves talk. I think the space is probably loud at baseline, but this made it worse. I was meeting a friend that I only have an opportunity to see a couple times a year and it was exhausting trying to converse and connect. I might return for a drink at the bar or an app, but unlikely for dinner.

We had a reservation for 2, but we were seated in the noisy bar even though tables were available in the main dining area.  Took forever to get our dinner.  Burger bun was not toasted and the risotto was mediocre at best.  Meatball app was tasteless and the toast (which was not really toasted) it was served with was left in the sauce so complete mush.  Mocktails were good.  Came for brunch a week earlier and it was very good.  Seems the restaurant can’t handle it when it’s very busy.

Delicious waffles and bacon and de-caf coffee. Also delicious chorizo tostada and hibiscus mimosa. Thank you to the hostess to was able to seat us at a booth and Dylan was very professional and efficient! We’ll be back again
The food and serv;ice were excellent. However, the noise level was so loud that my wife and I could not hold a conversation.  She wears hearing aids, and the noise  was blasting them.
Great meal and excellent service! Very accommodating with our requests! Absolutely will keep coming back and will recommend to others!

Great menu.
We had the Scallops and the Short rib and both were outstanding.
Pumpkin bread pudding was delish!
Highly recommend...

Too noisy. We were there for lunch and could barely hear each other talk the noise was so great. Other diners were not making the noise. It’s evidently just bad acoustics. Do something about it maybe on the ceiling.
Also parking was awful - on a Thursday afternoon !

Great new place in town! The staff is excellent and the food and cocktails are delicious. Inventive preparations keep the menu fresh. I haven't tried their brunch or lunch but if it's anything like their dinners, those would be great as well.

Poke was served with 4 chips, we laughed.  8 would be nice, at least 6.  $24 glass of wine was a very small pour.  The halibut & salmon dishes were very good.  Avocado bruschetta was very good.  Bread pudding was very good.  It was extremely loud!!!  Could barely heard my guest right next to me.
Really good food and great service. Background music was a little loud, but otherwise we all enjoyed our lunches.
I was a bit disappointed with this restaurant. We were all surprised that the portions were very small. The food was good but not excellent.

We had reservations for 2. They originally wanted to sit us in a corner with a very small table. Smaller than the hightop size.

So I asked to be reseated and rhey didn't have any regular finkng area available.

So we were moved to the high top or bar area.

The high top was set and supposedly clean. I sat down and the table even though it was set was DIRTY.  So the hostess moved us to another high table. Which ended up fine.

Our server passes us up after he gave water to a table that sat down after us. We didn't get any water for maybe another 10 min. He came to take our order but we still didn't get water.

When we finally got water, it was accidentally spilled because it was sparkling and it 'exploded' no big deal.  He took a towel and wiped down the table top and the floor.... I watched him go back to dispose of the towel and he walked right back out without washing his hands... 

Food - grilled broccolini - no flavor. Literally just grilled, no oilive oil or any seasoning

Pork Chops - we both had ordered Pork Chops... Dry dry dry and no flavor.  I wanted to send the food back or talk to manager but at thia point I was just tired.  I took more than half of the porkchop home and fed to my dogs...$40 pork Chop and I couldn't even finish it.  Needless to say I won't be comong back or recommending this place for dinner or their porkchops. ASA is way better by leaps and bounds with service and quality and flavors of food

3rd time at this restaurant and definitely a positive experience with regards to service, food, decor.  The only reason for taking a star off overall is that the noise level makes it difficult to hold a conversation. Wish there were some kind of noise absorption panels in the ceiling or something.
The food was delicious. Our waitress was attentive and friendly. Overall an enjoyable experience.

Nice light lunch. Got here early but it got noisy fast.
I had the steak bowl and my friend had a salad. Bread is extra. Ice tea refills extra.

Brought my wife for a date night and we had a fantastic experience.  Great ambiance, lots of tasty menu options, and food was delicious.  The only negative was the cost for glass of wine was high relative to the size of the pour.
Definitely will make this one of our regular destinations.
I had the halibut special and it was fabulous.  Restaurant was very busy but the service was excellent.  Definitely will be going back.
Great intimate spot in the old Boulanger location … good great, small spot so reserve ahead or plan to wait

The food was excellent. We were a party of four and everyone was pleased. The service was spotty, sometimes very attentive and then sometimes long pauses. We ate in the dining room and still the noise is quite loud. The worst part for us, however, is that we had a six o'clock reservation and weren't seated until 6:20. The restaurant opens at five so you wouldn't expect the table to be occupied. We came a few minutes early (better than late as restaurants don't appreciate that) so ended up standing around in a very loud bar area for nearly half an hour. We could talk to the person next to us but as a foursome. It seems that it isn't a good idea to come for dinner unless you are there at the opening or much much later. Too bad as the food was wonderful. I would make a limited recommendation to friends. I hear lunch is a good option.

Busy spot for lunch on a Friday. Decent menu choices, our group ordered sandwiches and salads with nonalcoholic beverages. $100+ for our total, but considering the location it’s probably about right. Server Dylan was friendly and efficient.
Outstanding service from the wait staff and the front desk. There is a friendly, lively and warm vibe to the whole place. It has quickly become one of my go-to dining spots in downtown Los Gatos.

Excellent staff, bartenders and servers!!  Thank you for wonderful meals on the plate. The squash soup was outstanding! 
    We are sooo happy to have you in the neighborhood 🥰
The service was excellent. Atmosphere is extremely cozy!

Delicious food in a warm and friendly environment.
We would definitely go back and try some other dishes on
The menu.

I have dined here twice. Once for brunch and once for lunch.
Both were very good. Service both times have been great! Will definitely try dinner.

Some really great food (highly recommend the Superfood salad), but other times it misses (lukewarm scallops with risotto, very small serving of ahi tuna poke). 
Extremely noisy, especially in the back section of the restaurant, and tables are set quite close together, so not recommended if you want an intimate and quieter dining scene.

Party of 4. The majority of the tapas were really good. We had the crab cakes, Brussels sprouts, poke, and lettuce wraps. We were there during a 49ers game so it was loud but that was fine with us. Only downside was we felt a little rushed to order and when food arrived. Weren’t the last people there so it seems weird.
My husband and I had a great dinner here. The food and services were great.  It was a little loud given that there is a bar area but it wasn’t too loud.

We had a friend’s birthday/gals’ night. 
Everything was excellent! The ambiance, decor, perfect lighting. The food was phenomenal! Best part was the amazing staff - friendly, accommodating. I’m sure we were a handful, but everyone was genuinely warm and we were never want for anything. New favorite place!

This was our first visit to Parkside, but it won't be our last.  All 4 of us enjoyed our meals (deviled eggs, hush puppies, turkey sandwich, chicken salad sandwich) and beverages (sparkling wine, Pliny, and a Manhattan) served pleasantly by Rebecca.  It was a busy Sunday, and I guess that's why service was rather slow (our sparkling wine took a long time to arrive) but we were not in a rush, so it worked out fine.  Of particular note was the charming lady who made sure we stayed well-hydrated with water, kept the plates cleared, and added a warm, friendly touch to our dining experience.
Girls luncheon was wonderful. The food and service were great.
We love this place. Great food. Would love to see espresso and option after dinner.
Prompt service, great food. Nice, lively atmosphere!
I’ve been to the restaurant 5 times now.  The menu has not changed much.  Hoping the menu will change once in a while to keep things fresh.
This is a nice restaurant. The food was good, the menu is limited.The service was efficient, it is a noisy place
The menu has something for everyone and it's just the right amount of food.  Give it a try!

Though it was a busy place, all employees were helpful, attentive, and friendly! Two of us totally enjoyed the halibut special. The fish was perfectly cooked and seasoned. The risotto had a delightful favor that paired wonderfully with the chard and fish. Another said the short ribs were delectable, and my husband raved about the mushroom ravioli. We will return to sample more delights.

good to very good food, with some misteps. nothing special that would make me go back.

crab cakes very good
poke very good
short ribs meh
burger bad: dry buns, lacking sauce, grainy & overcooked patty
fried chicken good

A friend and I had lunch at Parkside for the first time.  The transformation from Le Boulanger to Parkside is amazing.  What a lovely atmosphere!  Like the booth seating and the variety of 2 & 4 tops.  We sat at a corner table for 2. Noted a large table that can seat 7-8.  We both chose the Chicken Cashew Salad and found it very fresh, crisp and flavorful.  Chicken was very moist & dressing was very nice.  Our server, Ilana, was quite pleasant and attentive without hovering.
I am ready to try Parkside for dinner!!

My 2nd time there.  I ordered the short ribs again as I couldn't resist and was not disappointed.  My friend ordered salmon and really liked it.  Non-alcoholic ginger beer drink we both enjoyed.  Glad they offer decaf coffee although wish it was better tasting and that the coffee was hotter. 

Great, prompt service!  Warm decor, beautiful dishes/glassware.  Wish the noise level was lower as can be a little hard to have a conversation.

Definitely will be a go-to place for me.
Nice ambience with excellent food. Also cocktails are prepared very well!
Great place for brunch! Very comfortable! Great service!
Although there were other tables open, and we had reservations, they seated my date, and I had a table right next to the bar. It was almost impossible to have a conversation.

Met a friend for lunch—I raved about the cheeseburger so much she wanted to try.  Delicious and fantastic!  Our waiter Hector was awesome.  It was a bit cramped where we sat—tables for two wedged into the back super close to each other. But otherwise a super fun and yummy Friday lunch!
Great new place! So happy to have this in town. Excellent menus. New favorite!
The food is delicious, and the service is excellent.  I have eaten here many times since it opened and will keep coming back.  The decor is relaxing, simple and beautiful.
Great Lunch Spot in Downtown Los Gatos. The lunch menu is diverse and approachable.

The menu is varied and well thought out.  I like it when there are several items I want to try because they all sound good! We shared the crab cakes to start - they were filled with lots of lumps of crab - and were delicious.  Then I had the salmon and my husband had the mushroom ravioli,  both were excellent.  I can't wait to return and try more items on the menu.
First time dining here.  So happy with the ambiance, menu choices and overall experience.  Great looking bar area that we will be back to check out for a date night.

Four of us all agreed that our chicken salad, pecan, avocado, and bacon sandwiches were really delectable. Our side of French fries was perfectly crispy and delicious. The kitchen kindly split each of our sandwiches and French fries so each person had their own lovely plate. Every employee we encountered was most friendly, cheerful, and helpful. We four look forward to our next visit.

The place is attractive. We were seated right away but we waited a long time for a server to come. The food was very good. We all enjoyed our dishes. The noise level is really loud. We had to somewhat yell to talk with each other. We were seated in a booth near the bar area so it may be quieter in the back but it's not that large of a place. The cocktails were good, but the wine served with dinner was a ridiculously small pour. I doubt it was 4 ounces, the smallest pour we've ever seen. Not a good value at $22 for a glass. Overall, very good food, slow service (although all the servers were very nice), and too noisy. Outside would be a better bet for less noise. I wish there was a "maybe" button on recommendations. I would not go back but I might recommend it pending what a friend is looking for.

Lovely restaurant.  Mainly good service although we missed the waitress for a while. 
 Good brunch.  A bit too noisy.
You should not change $30 for corkage fee even Hero Ranch kitchen a 5 star restaurant had no corkage

Parkside is has a warm ambiance, great food, and bartender Tony gave us excellent service. Great Wine selection
They are often busy so make reservations.

Visited Parkside restaurant yesterday to try something new. Impressed with excellent service, but the food fell short. Ordered a salad with salmon—bitter citrus acids in the salad and an overcooked, small, flavorless salmon left me underwhelmed. Overall, a 3/5 due to the pleasant ambiance.
The setting was great, the food was excellent as was the service.

We really enjoyed our lunch.  The only complaint I have is that both times I have visited the restaurant, is that it has been cold inside.  We sat in a booth, but could feel a breeze when the door opened.  It wasn’t just me, we were all cold.  We LOVED our waitperson (can’t remember her name, sorry) and Jacinda our bus woman.
So excited to have this restaurant in town! Great menu! Great ambiance! Great food!

This was a disappointing experience.  We were told by hostess that we did not have a reservation.  When we proved it, she acknowledged that she gave our table to someone else that had my name.  Then she would not seat us at a standard table as reserved. She stuck us a a hightop.  Another woman acknowledged that they do not have good communication with OpenTable on what table people request.  Make sure you make a special request.   Then to top it off they were having a buffet with over priced food.  We left.  I was really hoping to share a good experience with my friend.  I have done lunch before and it was good.  The hostess could simply have apologized and that would have made a difference.
We had a great experience at Parkside thanks to Bryce! Will definitely be back for the delicious salmon, scallops, brussel sprouts and halibut special!

The food was great, would have liked a bigger Menü but the special was delicious. It’s a very casual place so no need to dress up. It felt very cozy like a place in Tahoe. Will be going back but hoping menu changes often

This was my second time at Los Gatos Parkside, the first time was the week of their opening. The food and service was excellent on both occasions. The noise level was definitely more energetic on the second visit, possibly due to the holiday cheer. Even with a full house, service was attentive & quick. Recommended!
The best! I had the poke and spring rolls (with grilled shrimp instead to start) SO good! Then the ravioli which was incredible. The vibe is the best! It’s always packed and so fun!￼

Food, décor and ambience were only outshined by the excellent service. The crabcake appetizer was perfect as was the scallop / risotto and gnocchi dishes.  A little noisy but vibrant is better than dull.

Food is not great. Our waitress was terrible it was our first time at restaurant and we kept asking her questions and recommendations and she was not helpful at all. It was like it was her first night. All she said to us like 3x was well i dont know because I dont eat pork. Much rather spend my money elsewhere, was very disappointed in the quality and flavor of food.
the place was mobbed, overbooked in fact; a good sign!  the menu was terrific, the prices very good for the location, the ambience was homey and encouraged lingering. I'll definitely return!!
Enjoyed experiencing the latest local dining location. Decor is tastefully done. Service was attentive, our food was delicious, and cocktails were creative and tasty.

We were not fond of our waiter. He did not know his audience and did not fit well with the ambience of the restaurant. He was very loud when the clientele were trying to quietly enjoy their lunch. We also saw him go behind the bar to take a shot of Jack Daniels during his shift.
Too loud and the food wasn’t that interesting gnocchi was subpar. Drink menu was great and server was very warm and friendly.
Very cozy and cute.  Nice menu and the service was good.
The service was excellent.  Especially appreciated the serving sizes as well as the moderate price for lunch entrees.

I’m a big fan of farm-to-table sustainable restaurants. So I had high hopes for trying this one. Nothing wrong with service or the place itself. It was all according to my expectation. But then, the food itself was very inconsistent. Some dishes were incredibly good and others were mediocre, to put it simply. This restaurant has fewer dishes to choose from than usual, and no specials - so I expect everything to be cooked really well.

The best one I had was the crab cake. It was moist, soft and very well seasoned, while having a perfect crunch on the outside and paired with a great slightly spicy sauce and salad. I was impressed.

The salmon I ordered though was on the dry/overcooked side, over a tasteless and even dryer mashed potato, over an almost inexistent and tasteless sauce, paired with extremely crunchy broccolini. So everything was dry and brittle. Also, very under seasoned. I don’t understand that plate at all. And it has horseradish in its name - it felt like they forgot it was a required ingredient.

The Poke was okay. I wanted to keep eating it, but they only provided a couple of chips and a bunch of Tuna. One would say: better than if it was the opposite, huh? To which I agree. But it’d have been a lot more enjoyable if there was balance in the amount of components for that plate.

The ravioli, the soup of the day, fried chicken and deviled eggs were okay. Slightly under seasoned for my taste, but they were okay.

I would say our dining experience was a big MEH. 

The cocktail was good (Smoke on the Water) but I've never had one cocktail that cost $18.  Yes $18. 

The avocado bruschetta was, well, a nice avocado toast.

We paid extra for a little bread & butter. 

But my fried chicken was WAY average and my husband's salmon was over cooked.  That's a big no-no for salmon!  He says he's usually asked how he likes the salmon cooked but I've never noticed this.  Indeed, he wasn't asked this at Parkside. 

The buzz & atmosphere at the restaurant was great, especially for a Tuesday night.  

I tell you, the worst thing was, after we were served our main meal, the server never checked back with us as to see how everything was.  This is a big no-no for me at a high-end restaurant.  When I finally called her over I asked, 'did you forget about us'.  Then she checked on how every thing was, however we were already finished with our meal.  

Our experience at this restaurant did not compare with other expensive, high-end restaurants we've been to.
Great ambiance and food would definitely recommend coming
Loved this restaurant!  Food was amazing and the atmosphere was really nice.  Cannot wait to go back to try out the dinner menu.

Our lunch was perfect. We had a little table near the window..
￼ There was a celebratory energy.
￼

Been there twice now.  The location and decor are great. The food is awful.   It’s very loud.  The people are nice but it’s obvious that working in a restaurant is new to them.  We won’t be back.  Life is too short for terrible food.

Lovely!!! I loved everything about Parkside. It is worthy of being a go-to restaurant. I just hope they stick around long term!! I Plan to go back often. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, every staff member I interacted with was nice, food was tasty, beverage choices were great, and prices were reasonable.

Parkside is new, busy now.  Food is good. Not great.  Service is fair. It feels very frenetic, not relaxing. Lots of staff, yet service is rather poor.  I’ve been several times, only because others want to try, but it would not be my first choice in LG.

Our most obvious problem was the wait staff not knowing their menu, what the dishes contained, what was in the sauces, how many pieces on a shared plate, wines, beers, little knowledge, etc. Each question was answered by “I’ll have to go find out” and the person left for another 5 minutes during ordering.
All staff was very pleasant and apologetic, but it was clear the kitchen did not educate the staff on the days menu.
We were all wait staff in our lives, and found this a major flaw in a new restaurant. But we enjoyed all our courses and definitely will come back.
Also, we were unable to find a reservation before 8:30 pm on open table nor on your website at any day of the week for 2-3 weeks. We found a cancellation at 5:00, and jumped on it.

Waited 30 minutes for food and the oysters were bad. Waited for them get our drink order too and waited all the drinks to me prepared. Didn’t seem like it was that busy so unsure about when we waited so long
I had the grain bowel with salmon! Absolutely delicious! I am SO excited to finally have a healthy restaurant in town with such an amazing vibe! This placing is buzzing and I love it!

What a fun evening!  Small bar area but the dining room was great.  We had delicious meatballs and crab cakes for apps, the short ribs and burger for entree.  Omg—the most delicious burger!  Great wine selection also.  Priced very reasonably.
We will go back—loved it!
Had a great meal with friends there. All of the cocktails, apps, food, and wine were excellent.

So wanted to enjoy our lunch at Parkside as I live around the corner & had heard many great things.  Service was just ok, we had to finagle our table,  waiter didn't check back or ask why 2 plates were half eaten (Chicken Salad Sandwiches?).   Overall not so impressed, will try again as they are just getting going?

Food was very good and the service was generally excellent. The female who went around filling water glasses missed several refills. The water glasses, while beautiful and unique, were hard to see when empty. A nice pitcher of water on the table would solve that issue.

The place looks fantastic, and they must have put a lot of work into it.  Now they just need to put some work into the Servers.  They need to be a little more polished and professional for a place like that!  Also, just as the other comments state they need to add some more acoustical panels as the sound was deafening.  Will try the bar for lunch next time and see how that is.  Going to try for dinner again in about 4-6 months to see if anything has changed.

My husband had the gnocchi and I had the spare ribs.  Excellent!  Our server was wonderful.  

The decor is warm and inviting.  The only drawback that I noticed is that it is quite noisy and some kind of sound absorption panels are needed.

We will be back!

We had a table by the side door and it was very cold. We asked to be moved but were told no even thought there were several open tables (we had reservations but were treated like walk-ins being squeezed in.) Service was rushed and our plates were cleared before everyone was finished eating. The food was the best part of the evening  but the overall experience was disappointing.

This restaurant is a nice addition to downtown Los Gatos.  Be aware that they decide where to seat you based upon your appearance, apparently.  The restaurant was almost empty and they tried to seat us in the bar.  When we asked to be moved, the hostess said, “Let me see if another table is available.”  It was 11:30am, and the restaurant was almost empty.
It was our first visit to Los Gatos Parkside. The bar service was very slow. Our server had way too many tables. The food was decent, but small portions and pricey.
Excellent service and food! Love this new addition to Los Gatos!

Festive atmosphere with great service
Parking can be a challenge

The ambience was very nice, but we were disappointed in the service. There were four of us and the server forgot one person's drink, gave someone else overcooked brunch eggs and forgot the sauce, and on the other item the server also forgot both sauces.  He never came back to check on us and when we finally flagged him down to he seemed to feel that we were making special requests. The manager ended up stopping by to see everything was and was very nice and helped us out but it was a special occasion and it was frustrating to have that all happen.

Bryce was great! The restaurant was packed and super busy but he managed to still be super attentive and take great care of us. Food was delicious and the drinks were perfectly crafted. Great job all around!!!
Lovely atmosphere and decor to enhance the wonderfully delicious food.  🍷
Everything we had was delicious!  Loved the Pear crostata !!!
Server was able and willing to help us in a way that we that whatever we needed great place will return. Bye

Love the food but they put way too much dressing on both the chopped and chinese chicken salad.  I asked for dressing on the side for my grain bowl so that worked out fine.  Love the restaurant and want it to be successful!  Thanks so much

Great Food, Service and Ambiance except for the noise level. Really needs some soundproofing, especially noise coming from kitchen (though we sat close to kitchen).  So loud that you have to shout to the person across the table and I have perfect hearing!
absolutely fabulous atmosphere ! great addition to Los Gatos. beautiful location and design , loved the halibut special . great flavors !

Our first time at Parkside was a nice experience. Service was cordial and quick. Drinks were very good. Food was good not great. The short ribs were a bit dry. Salmon lacked taste. Pork chop was ok. Noise level was very high. The overall experience was good enough to try it again.
Willing to try again, but it took 15 minutes for our waitress to take our drink order. Clam shadow was good as well as the poke. Wine selection was very good.
Loved the dining experience. Will come back soon. Thank you!
Excited to have a new place in town with great atmosphere and food!

Two top tables felt very cramped, chairs aren’t the most comfortable and anyone with a jacket or something that would normally be JJ g off the back of the chair wouldn’t stay and just fall to the floor. Very loud and difficult to speak across the table to another person without shouting and therefore disturbing/inviting the table next to you into your conversation. Staff was extremely friendly but at one point the busser came by to clear plates and asked if he could take one of our appetizers plates away and more or less posted his finger right in the center of the plate so my answer was chosen for me, yes please take the plate I won’t be eating anything else off of that. Speaking of the appetizers though the crab cakes were tasty though small, and the crispy brussel sprouts were crispy and brussel sprouts but nothing exceptional or bette than what can be made at home in a few minutes with an air fryer. My girlfriend seemed to enjoy her gnocchi as there was nothing left at the end, the fried chicken dish wasn’t mediocre, not great but not the worst. Didn’t finish it, not enough flavor making me want to keep eating it. The Hi-Tide cocktail was by far the best thing we had. This was my first time here, not sure I’ll be interested in coming back for dinner but could enjoy a drink. Nothing I’m saying is meant to discourage anyone from going here, nor to knock the restaurant just an honest recount of my experience. Anyone reading this could have the exact opposite and that’s great I hope that’s the case. Overall I give my experience at Parkside 2.5-3 out of 5.
Los Gatos Parkside made our very special occasion even more special...  the free dessert for our birthday girl was especially appreciated!
Delicious meal! We had the hush puppies, lobster roll special with waffle fries and slaw, and the short rib hash. Delicious food, great service and beautiful setting.
Nice new addition to the downtown restaurant scene. Nice variety, fresh ingredients, classy decor, good bar and friendly service. Checks all the boxes.

Server brought wrong wine
my husbands drink took 30 min
server was very scattered

The menu was limited. Too many ingredients in the dishes. Not enough healthy offers. Much too noisy. Very young and loud bar scene.
Much too pricey for mediocre food.
Will not return.
The staff were so refreshingly kind and service oriented.  The butternut squash and burrata flatbread special was inspired!

Beautiful restaurant but still working out the kinks. I had a reservation at 7 and we didn’t get seated until 7:20. They gave us a free appetizer for our wait which was nice. Service was spectacular but the food was subpar. Fish dishes were brought out cold and overcooked. Flavor was okay but it was hard to enjoy the food since it wasn’t a decent temperature.

Overall, i hope the restaurant succeeds, especially because it’s one of the few open on Mondays, but the kitchen definitely needs to step it up. We’ll come back and sit at the bar and try again… fingers crossed
The food, ambience, and service were outstanding! A reservation is a must as this place is very popular.  Enjoy!

Table server was really good ver attentive. Bar service was lacking timelines. My simple bar drink did not come out until midway through main course when order placed as soon as we sat down.
Food was very tasty great atmosphere and beautiful use of space.
We will definitely try it again.

Had a wonderful evening at LG’s newest restaurant, Parkside!! We loved the crab cakes and hushpuppies for starters and shared the salmon for our main entree. We had two cocktails that were underwhelming, but still very drinkable. Needless to say, we’re looking forward to our next visit!
There is nothing on the menu that I would not order. My wife got the grain bowl, I got the fried chicken sandwich both great. Get a reservation and go.
Good food on a limited menu. Inside the noise level was extremely high.
Great lunch spot. Nice size salads (not too big). I always like a restaurant that lets you try the wine even if you’re just having a glass

First time.  Nice ambience.  Food good…had the ravioli…a little too much sauce and a little goopy but nice flavor. Two of our group had salad and it was fine.
No brewed ice tea.
Service nice but irregular…very busy could use another wait person.  Our appetizer dishes were not cleared away before main dish and sat on the table until we asked someone to take them.
Overall good potential, and easy parking.  A few kinks to be ironed out. Will go back in a few months and try again.
Lively atmosphere, decent but generic food, cozy space. A fun place and good value for what it offers. Next time I will get a burger and a beer and enjoy the vibes.

Beautiful interior - great work in recreating from the old Boulanger
Nick was a fabulous waiter
Loved the room with fireplace

I enjoyed it, and I would go back, but I was hoping the food would be better.￼ I realize it’s a brand new restaurant so they’re probably working out a few things… the food was good, but I would not say it’s amazing. ￼
So great! Food, ambiance and service! I would highly recommend for both brunch and dinner!

Amazing food, outstanding service. My friends and I had the best dinner here. Even my friend’s 4 year old daughter had a great time. Recommend to everyone. Adam the manager is so kind and gracious, and so was his staff. It’s a beautiful restaurant. Try the short ribs and the beignets! Those two were my favorite, but everything was so delicious. Thank you for a wonderful night!
Food was very average and a little disappointing.
Excellent service and incredible food! Price was just right for the experience.

The drinks and Gnocchi were the best!
Avocado toast was too hard and toasty; bread was good

Service was fine but the food was not good. Mushroom pasta was smothered in a overly salty cheese sauce that obliterated any mushroom flavor. Also the salmon had an ugly grey purple sauce that had no flavor.
All good!  Waitress very friendly and gave great service
The wait staff was wonderful (Amanda, et al), but the room got very cold.

The non-alcoholic drink selection offered a few nice drinks for those avoiding alcohol. The food was nice enough, but they decided to serve my main course before my appetizer. This plus the noise was a turn off. I’m sure I’ll be back at some point to see if they’ve improved.

Great new restaurant in LG!  Food and service awesome!!  The spare rib husband loved and the gluten free risotto was delicious too (safe for celiac)! Be you sure to get a reservation we saw a lot of people get turned away!

Good food, good value. EXCEPTIONALLY noisy. We had the furthest table in the back and still couldn't hear the person sitting next to you. The owner should consider noise mitigation techniques for the walls or ceiling.
Food was great and the service is amazing! Super quick and friendly.
Birthday was excellent!
The food, service, comfort.... it was all so good! So good I tried to go back less than week later - it was booked. But I WILL be back!
Great food and service for lunch on Oct 30th.   They've done a great job with the construction that created a classy but casual environment.
Our server Lexi was great she had really good recommendations we literally tried everything she recommended.

Tried brunch for the first time on Sunday - very busy! Definitely make reservations here! Extremely hearty and moist fried chicken and fluffy waffles, and a very tasty and unfussy Avocado Bruschetta on Manresa bread, that delivered amazing flavor in every bite. Service was great despite the crowd. Amanda is amazing!

Brunch with a friend. Avocado bruschetta was quite tasty, and the Hourglass Sauvignon Blanc was excellent. My friend’s salad was outstanding (although a couple of rocks snuck in with the lettuce). Service was prompt and friendly. It’s a very nice space. Great new addition to the LG dining scene.

Versatile menu, with great starters, and many shareables. Do the lettuce wraps with shrimp. The lunch special was the salmon chowder. Fresh salads are the rule here - try the simple but hearty harvest salad - or do the decadent chicken salad sandwich with bacon and fries. Great atmosphere that makes you feel like you're right at home.

Food was generally very good - especially the superfood salad. Tuna tartare was good, but tuna did not seem to be the freshest/high quality cut. Fried chicken, mashed potatoes, green beans good, though portion sizes seemed to vary greatly between servings. Grain bowl also good w/ a nice mix of items, though some of the grains were overly hard. Pleasant atmosphere, though the two tops are a little close w/ little privacy. Nice & friendly service with just the right amount of interaction. Overall great start and worth trying.
Amazing food, amazing service, we felt we could eat here all week. Great new restaurant in Los Gatos!

Parkside was just ok last night. I know they just opened so maybe they will improve with time because I enjoy supporting Los Gatos restaurants. I ordered the quinoa bowl and it was all fairly cold and flavorless. The squash and snap peas were only blanched and undercooked. Quinoa had no flavor. My friend ordered the horseradish salmon and she said it was good but didn’t taste like horseradish at all and had little flavor. Will try again in hopes it improves.

Service was good.  I ordered the lobster roll special.  Food was good but I was surprised that the lobster roll costs $46.  I feel server should be telling customer price of specials especially if it is way out of ordinary lunch price range.

I didn't realize they were a new restaurant until after our meal.  That is a testimony to how well run their establishment already is.  The ambiance is warm and inviting (we sat near a lovely fireplace), the service was spot on and the food was delicious.  

Such a lovely location right across from the park (hence their name :). 

Will definitely return soon.
Had a dinner reservation, was a bit late, but they were quick to get us a table.  Overall food was good, we had one special-filet was sent back 2 times for being under cooked.
The staff was friendly, helpful and had great recommendations.  The food was fresh and so flavorful.  We can’t wait to go back
Loved our first dinner at Parkside! Will definitely be coming back often. Los Gatos badly needed a place like this 👌
Very friendly staff.   Checked on us a couple of times.   We all enjoyed our lunch

Perhaps due to soft opening, but pretty basic mistakes during this visit. Long wait at table, never asked for drink order...went straight to menu. Both meals were warm, not hot. Were brought the check and not asked if we wanted dessert. Even though we informed it was a special occasion...this too was not acknowledged. Unfortunately expectations were higher and we really looked forward to this to be a bit dissatisfied. It's a tough business, but foresee my money be spent elsewhere in the future.
Will be back. Food very tasty but cooled down very quickly  after it was served. Beignets were awesome.

Cool new spot with good food, great bar menu, cool ambiance and awesome service.  Shout out to Lexi who took care of us with a smile; she was an absolute delight and very attentive.

I’m psyched about this new establishment that i already have two pending reservations.  Can’t wait to go back.

Note: no dedicated standalone parking lot but there’s lots of side street parking.  Corkage is $35 which is kinda steep but expected given the location.
We had a wonderful time at Parkside.  The food was all very good.  Great decor, good service and nice choices.  Will definitely be going back.
Great new restaurant. Beautifully done! Food was delicious and the service was outstanding. So happy to have a new spot to visit in town!

Parkside just opened and is a wonderful new addition to Los Gatos dining, offering farm to table menu. Attentive manager, Adam, and server, Dori offered great service in spite of a few minor hiccups the night we dined with them. They were gracious and interested in diners having a wonderful experience. I had the short rib which was tasty, and my husband had the crispy chicken. I will go back for sure, and this time sit at the bar. Back room has space for large group and has a nice fireplace.
Great ambiance and service.  The food and cocktails were fantastic  A great addition to the town of Los Gatos.
Great new restaurant in Los Gatos, just what the town neeed.

name: Spasso
description: Spasso features Italian, Mediterranean cuisine and Tapas. Spasso has been a new favorite neighborhood destination located in San Carlos on Laurel Street. Spasso features an extensive Napa Valley and Italian wine selection, and a full bar with specialized cocktails are available. Our waitstaff are consistently friendly, knowledgeable and attentive. And, the atmosphere is lively and exciting.
hours:
Lunch
Mon–Fri 11:00 am–3:00 pm
Sat, Sun 11:00 am–3:30 pm
Dinner
Mon–Fri, Sun 3:30 pm–9:00 pm
Sat 3:30 pm–10:00 pm

reviews.text: Wonderful dinner! Excellent service! Everything was delicious with large portions. Definitely will be going back soon! ￼
Excellent food and service. Thank you Kurt and staff.

We love Spasso’s. We dine there often. The food is always good, but last Saturday night they were very busy. They were definitely wanting us to move along as they were rushing to clear our table, not in a good way, To Go boxes were practically thrown at us, I think they were shocked when we ordered dessert. We were with long time friends. We wanted to visit, but they clearly wanted us to give up our table. Yet when we walked outside, most of the patio tables were empty.

Spasso is a lovely restaurant with great service. Went for lunch and had many choices of salads, sandwiches, or hot entrees. Service is friendly. Great place to meet friends, have an excellent meal, and enjoy an afternoon.
One of our go to restaurants. Always tasty and good menu from small plates to ample entrees.
Food was outstanding. Service attentive. Didn’t rush us. Would eat here again.

Our experience was fantastic since we are still celebrating my mother’s 96th Birthday which was today and she wanted our family of 10 to go to Spassos. Our server Elon was great along with Kirk who help celebrate my mothers Birthday by singing to her… thank you staff so much
Service  was great . Our waitress was sweet and even if it was on Valentine's Day and very busy. she was patient and had a great smile.
Outstanding every time. They treat us like we are family. Always look forward to dining at Spasso!
Great food. Service was excellent and attentive. Great value too

This was our first time at Spasso. We had a dinner party of seven.  The pear salad was excellent,  most of the other entrees our group enjoyed.  The Creme Brule was very good.  Our server was attentive and we got our food pretty quickly.  The biggest detractions were the television playing a sports game and being seated very close to another table resulting in a number of unexpected bumps on the back of chair and head as the servers used that route to the kitchen.

Met friends here to catch up. While I appreciate good service, the waitress wouldn’t leave us alone. She came up to us numerous times, “are you ready to order?” “No, haven’t looked at the menu”. A minute later, “are you ready to order?” Very annoying! Food was good, not great. Way too noisy. Won’t be back.
Restaurant should update menu on website. Our dining experience was different from last year’s.
we love spasso, italian food without the focus on pizza.
Good atmosphere but the fried dishes was just so so.
The service was absolutely 💯 fantastic. The food was unbelievable. Sea Bass was so flavorful and moist. We will keep coming back 🍾♥️
Excellent and warm service. Food was delicious and great portions

This place is amazing! The hostess, Delaney, is what made our night. I’m currently disabled and she went out of her way to accommodate my needs from the very beginning all the way until the end of our dinner. I had to use the restroom and she personally walked me all the way back to the restroom and held the door for me! The food was incredible, our server was extremely attentive, and the food came out fast. I’ll definitely come back. Thanks Delaney! We will definitely come back :)

The food was very good, as always, as was the service. Unfortunately, my special request, to be seated in a certain location, and more importantly, NOT at the back on the left side of the restaurant, was not honored. When we arrived, that was precisely where we were seated.
However, they were very apologetic, and did rectify it by moving us to a table outside, which was fine because the heaters were effective. Also, they comped us an appetizer, which was an appropriate gesture.
They need to remove a table from the back of the restaurant because there isn't enough room there. We were unable to move our chairs enough to sit comfortably.
Absolutely fantastic service  and food. We celebrated my birthday with a party of ten!

Every year before we go to Fioli for Christmas we come here. It is now a tradition! EXCELLENT food, service and ambiance. We are headed to Italy in a few weeks and cant wait to return knowing our favorite Italian place is BETTER than its motherland :)
Always a great experience and fantastic food!!! Love the calamari app. Snd bread pudding dessert. All entrees are great!
service ..food was very good,always enjoy going back
Have always loved Spasso’s but the Menu change is expensive!
Great food and nice restaurant inside and service was perfect!!
Excellent as always. There were large noisy parties inside and they were able to accommodate us outside.

Open table failed to let the restaurant know of our reservation so there was confusion upon arrival.
The food was great!

Not first time  in Spasso >food is delicious.  For today's range  prices are Ok. Will go  again to celebrate birthday




NOTE to Opentable -  why should I receive a special code to write review? The  necessity  to  receive codes with each  effortIt kills the wish to use application

Spasso is one of my favorite restaurants. The food and service are excellent. We had veal and lamb and both were delicious. But, it was so noisy it was impossible to have a conversation with my companion. There is no sound baffling in the space design. We were there on a Wednesday evening which is not generally a special night out. There were three large parties all talking loud enough to be heard from one end of their group to the other. In addition, tables were so close together it was difficult to navigate when we were leaving.
We always enjoy dining here.  Excellent food, hospitality and fresh ingredients.
Spasso’s is always good. They were busy last night, yet they didn’t rush us

Another excellent meal with wonderful service!
We’ll return AGAIN!
service and food are always good here, we had a great time as always.
Enjoyed a birthday dinner with a friend.  Great service.  Food & drinks were just what we wanted & needed.

The food portions were VERY generous.  I ordered the calamari appetizer which was large enough for the entire meal!  My date ordered the crab cakes appetizer, which for her was all she could eat for the rest of the dinner.  The eggplant parmigiana, my entre, was  also very generous and very tasty.  Needless to say, we had two take-home boxes after a delightful dining experience.  Recommendation:  arrive early before 6 PM before the crowds and noise rises.

It’s always a treat to go to Spasso for dinner. I brought a friend who had never been there before and he was impressed with every part of his dinner from the mushroom bruschetta, the halibut, the salad with poached pears and then the cream brûlée. Thank you another memorable dining experience!
Great place  to dine.. we dined outside and was nice and warm
Average service and average food quality. Nothing exceptional.  Would not go back with other better restaurants nearby such as TOWN.
We had a great meal with 8 of us and wonderful, cheerful service!
Absolutely fantastic service,  food , and staff. Would definitely recommend
Always a great dinner. Our favorite restaurant in San Carlos.

Our dinner was outstanding with great service from the entire staff especially Kurt, Elon our server plus everybody at the restaurant couldn't do enough to make sure we were well taken care of.
Thank You
Mary
Loved the food, service and ambiance. The seafood linguine was delicious. Will definitely go back!
We had a delicious dinner and excellent service.

Super fun and energetic atmosphere.  Enjoyed by many regulars and that says a lot.  Food & service were both excellent.  Great quality & presentation. Well paced meal with exceptional & efficient service.

Great food, we had a group of 5 and every one enjoyed this dishes and starters.
We shared three desserts and they were all so on point.
We will be back and definitely recommend this for a good tasty meal.
Staff we also very attentive and professional

Always a great experience at Spasso. The pork chop is over the top and my date loved the seafood special . Laurel is always full of new places and they are gone in 3 years . This place has been there forever and the quality and people are why . Great local place for us
Absolutely love it here. The service and food were truly exceptional
Drove all the way from San Jose to experience Italian cuisine. And it didn’t disappoint us.

I think they overbooked and didn’t have a table ready for us. Had to wait 10+ minutes. Had a drink at the bar.

It’s okay. Things happen.

But, overall great food. A bit loud as folks were celebrating on a a Saturday night ….. once large parties left, it was not as noisy.
Will go back definitely :)

Thanks for amazing food each time we go to Spasso.
Waiter was very good nice and attentive. Food was excellent. Ambience is great we eat outside which could be a little bit noisy but not bad.

It’s so nice to come back to San Carlos after 5 years and find the great food at reasonable prices and to see some familiar staff! It really felt great on my last night in California to be back at my (still) favorite restaurant!!

My wife and I enjoyed our lunch at Spasso. It was our first visit and I found the service to be warm and friendly. There were many good lunch entrees on the menu. We had the spaghetti bolognese (with a hearty meat sauce) and the wild mushroom ravioli. Both dishes were delicious as was the tiramisu dessert.
A great place to meet friends for lunch and dinner. I’m never disappointed with the food or service. The staff always makes it a special experience!
We went for a birthday dinner.  Lovely ambiance, great service and good food.
The food was great.  Had great service and we were not rushed.
The food is great! I definitely recommend the bread pudding for dessert!

Met a long time friend for lunch at Spasso. Valerie was our server. Very nice & professional. Gave us all the time we needed to catch up & order & eat.
Felt bad that there were hardly any customers for lunch.
We must support our local businesses any time we can.
I shall return to enjoy their food & good service. Love their warm cabbage salad with chicken added.
We took our daughter here for her 16th birthday dinner and the entire restaurant sang happy birthday to her. Great food! Great people!
As always, Spasso's was excellent.  The food was delicious and our server was attentive and personable.  We will definitely be going back.
Always a good time at Spasso. Food was great. However, my pomegranate martini needs work. Very bland just taste like vodka with a dash of juice.  But overall good. We will be back.
Spasso’s was fantastic we loved the calamari, bread with seasoned oil, salmon, teriyaki steak, bread pudding, cheesecake, chocolate lava cake. All great service from everyone.. thank you Barak & Kurt
Excellent food & service.  As we were finishing dinner they turned on the music to a level where it was hard to have a conversation.

A very good restaurant for people who are still pandemic-shy. You can sit outdoors and heaters at a good distance from other tables. The service, food and ambiance are all excellent. I trust this restaurant completely.
Excellent service. The food was excellent! We went to celebrate a birthday and it was just prefect.
I imagine it can get loud, but we went on a rainy day and it was nice and quiet.  Staff was extremely attentive.  Food was delicious.
A very busy place on a Friday night which makes the prompt and commendable service even more impressive. Great cocktails and good food.

I had lunch at this Italian restaurant on a Thursday afternoon with a former business colleague and it was a wonderful experience. We ordered the Grilled Prawns Wrapped with Pancetta appetizer, with the Veal Piccata and the Salmon Nicoise salad as entrees. All of the dishes served were very generous portions. The Grilled Prawns had three very large fresh prawns and was served with a lot of delicious sauteed beans with arugula on top. The dish tasted fantastic. The Veal Piccata was also to die for- served in a rich lemon butter sauce with capers over mashed potatoes and a lot of fresh spinach. Enough to take home for the next day! The Salmon Nicoise salad had an abundance of fresh ingredients and was very tasty. Bread and an olive oil bread dip are served at no charge when seated. We finished off our meal with two traditionally made Cappuccinos that were perfect. Service was also impeccable with exactly the right timing between courses. This restaurant is now on my "return again and again" list! Thank you so much for a great and satisfying meal.

Ilhan is a consummate professional. Great server! The capallini was perfection, my hubby loved the sea bass special, Gamze loved the salmon, and we simply enjoyed our time together. Great place to gather with friends for a meal.
Extremely noisy. Unable to hear people sitting across the table.
There was a large group at an outside table who were so loud that we could not hear each other talk nor enjoy our meal.
What a wonderful selection of food! Did not disappoint. Lovely staff too!

I could not have been more disappointed in the service during our visit.  We booked a table for two at 7:00 p.m. on Valentine's Day.  We arrived a few minutes before 7:00 p.m. and were promptly seated.

We were encouraged to order very quickly as we were told "the kitchen is very busy."  It was apparent from the moment that we arrived that the staff wanted to turn over the tables as quickly as possible.

At 8:05 p.m. (just over an hour after the time of our reservation), our waiter approached our table and advised us that they had customers waiting to be seated.  At 8:15 p.m., he approached the table and again "encouraged" us to leave.  When I told him that we were only 1 hour in 15 minutes into our reservation, he asked me for my name apparently wanting to check the time that were seated.

As a result, we promptly got up and left, needless to say, never to return.

We have been dining in San Carlos at nearly every restaurant for over 20 years, and have never once been treated like our visit to Spasso.

This is the first negative restaurant review I have ever written as I am simply inclined to go elsewhere when the service or food is poor.  However, I think our experience at Spasso on Valentine's Day is worth noting.
Our dinner at Spasso was delicious and the service, by Julian made the dinner even nicer. It was a very nice evening.
Owner and waiters are amazing. Everything is delicious! Wine selection is great. We go regularly and sometimes even take our grandchildren.
Had dinner with out of town friends. They loved it.

Everything is deep fried even if it says baked.
Was disappointed with the food quality

Had lunch at Spasso on a Friday.  Reservations at 11:30.  Not crowded.  Service was prompt and courteous.  We split the bruschetta and the arugula & pear salad.  The salad was nicely divided onto two plates, each with toppings.  Server brought a basket of bread and an olive oil/herb dip.  Servers were attentive without being overbearing.  If you're looking for a light lunch, ours fit the bill.  Always nice to be in a restaurant where you can easily converse without talking over music or noise.  Will definitely return.
It was packed but I was lucky to get a table.. food, drink and bread pudding for dessert was great!! As always owners were fantastic along with my server Elon.. thanks for another great experience
Excellent experience.  Service, drinks, and the food was superb 👌 We have been dining here since 2007. Never disappointed
It was crazy busy due to it being NYE but that didn’t stop the great service of our waiters. The food was amazing as usual.
Always a great place to go. Service and food always meets expectations.
Very good Italian food. The prime rib special was a little tough and not enough fat but overall the food was pretty good.
Food was mediocre.  Nothing special. However, location and space were great.  Felt cosy and intimate.

Most everything was very good except our waiter. We felt rushed when all we wanted was a nice Christmas dinner. He just wanted to turn tables and kept insisting that we order now. We talked to the manager who understood and apologized. He said he would make it up to us the next time.
We have eaten here often and have never had a bad experience.  We went Xmas Eve and it felt a bit rushed. The food was good and so was the service, but not the usual relaxed atmosphere.
Always a wonderful experience.  Friendly, helpful staff and always incrdible food and drink

This was my mom's favorite restaurant, so for her very special 90th birthday, we decided to celebrate there.  We sat down and waited a long time until the waiter came by to ask us if we wanted to drink something. We ordered a couple of proseccos to celebrate. We wanted more drinks, but no one came around to serve us.  Finally the waiter came and in a rushed voice, asked us what we wanted.  It was so stressful! The way he spoke to us made me feel very anxious!!! We got our food, and before we could even ask for another drink, he leaves!!! So annoying. We were going to order a bottle of wine for dinner, but never got the chance!! When we got the bill, I asked if he could maybe do something special for my mom's 90th birthday. (Maybe a scoop of ice cream with a candle?) He said-no we do not do that, we do not do anything for birthdays. We paid the bill and left.  Very disapointed and will never go back.

We sat outside. We got a very nice corner table. It was extremely comfortable outside. The food was delicious and the service  was outstanding. Really enjoyed our dinner there. Spasso's a superb Italian restaurant.
great service, delicious food, kids menu and excellent drinks.
The food was great. The only downer was I made a reservation for inside and was out outside.

Very good local restaurant. We’ve eaten there many times most recently yesterday our way to the airport. The food was very good and we were in and out in exactly the time we had available. My comment on Ambience should be taken in the context that we ate at 4pm on a Sunday afternoon.
Great place for celebration and or get togethers.
We booked because it said dress was casual. It’s more business casual but I guess that’s San Carlos. Food was great and space is great. Service was excellent.
We had very good service and the food are delicious and reasonable.  I've been going to this restaurant for several times now and will be coming back again.
Great food and good service. Unfortunately we sat next to the door and it was very drafty. However there were many other tables that looked much more comfortable
Great food, nice wine selection, and courteous service.
Had a delicious chicken wrapped in pancetta.  It was amazing.  Highly recommend!
Overall great experience and food. Would definitely return.

Very disappointed. We’ve been long time patrons at Spasso , however had a terrible experience last night. Despite making reservations on Open  Table for 7pm , when we arrived we were told we did not have reservations. When shown our confirmed reservation via Open Table app, they were not apologetic and told us it would be a 15 minute wait. 25 minutes later , we’re told they could give us an inside table however we had specified outside dining in our reservation. While waiting,  2 of our party had a glass of wine at the bar and these were not even comped. After 30 Minutes without any prospect of an open outside table , we left , went next door to Pranzi for dinner and had a great meal and experience. After being good , recognized patrons of Spasso  for so many years , at the very least we would expect an apology and a comped glass of wine rather then disinterested shrug of shoulders, their lack of interest and courtesy is very disappointing,
Good food, good service, good decor, good ambience. I cannot think of anything to criticize!
Excellent food and very good service, friendly staff. Just be aware of the prices, but if you're willing to pay, it's worth it.
We had a great dinner and our server Elon was fantastic not to mention Barak and entire staff.. loved our salmon dinner, along with cheesecake for dessert..
Great dinner plus our server Elon was fantastic I loved my crab cake appetizer not to mention Barak the owner is always happy to see us..
Food is always very good and the service outstanding. I do believe they have scaled back portions post-pandemic but no one leaves hungry. Always on the list of recommended stops for visiting friends.
Loved the food. But it was too loud and crowded. People were pushing chairs to get around.
Staff was lovely and food delicious- cocktails also very good!

Had lunch here on a Monday and sat outside - great weather though a little warm but we got to sit close to the fan which was even better.  Food was delicious -  we each ordered something different. Service was really great - very attentive. When I commented on how amazing their bread was, the waiter boxed up the last few pieces left in our bread bowl and brought them back to me without me even have to ask.  This is a great place to keep returning to!
Halibut and chicken parmigiana were phenomenal, and they brought our pup a bowl of water which he lapped up too!  Will definitely be returning.
Great time for a birthday dinner. Quiet little restaurant with good options.

I needed a good place for a business dinner for a party of five.  Chose Spasso, although I hadn't eaten there since long before COVID.  The occasion exceeded by expectations.  The Spasso staff was very friendly, accommodating, and attentive - but not too attentive.  The food was served in a timely manner, nice presentation, and delicious.  Made a note to return in the near future for a night out with just my wife.

Food and service were excellent, but it was very noisy inside, making it difficult to carry on conversations across our round table (6 people in our party).
When we left the restaurant, we noticed it was just as noisy in the outdoor seating area.
Great food, attentive service. Let our large group linger for quite awhile after finishing our delicious food.
2nd time visiting and it was just as delicious as the first! The ambience is fabulous! The service is fantastic!! Love the location downtown too….
Great service, good menu choices for starters, pastas, and main dishes. Everything we've ordered was very tasty. Great wine selection.

Salmon on sautéed spinach was perfect.
I will order it again.
Always great service drinks and food. Enjoyed a lovely evening outside

It was an enjoyable evening had by all.  The food was excellent in every way - delicious and presented beautifully. The menu offers many options and is reasonably priced.
In addition to the food, the service is always impeccable. From the initial greeting upon arrival, everyone on staff is friendly and extremely attentive. I always enjoy dining at Spasso and I always highly recommend Spasso to my friends and family.
The staff was very accommodating and made sure we had the perfect table! Our waiter was amazing and attentive. We dine here fairly often and always have a good experience, so we go back.
Everything was great ! Had a table for 6 and everyone loved their food and our table location .. service was great !

Wonderful dinner with family.  Spasso’s is one of our favorite Italian restaurants.  The food is delicious, the presentation is amazing and the service is impeccable.  We highly recommend Spasso Italian Restaurante!
The food is very good and we have a fantastic service.
Little too noisy inside, but it was a cold evening, so better than shivering outside.

Always loved to meet friends for a nice lunch at Spasso until today.  It seems that Levent and I didn't get along from the beginning.  I asked him about a previous menu item of a cup of soup with a smaller salad.  He said they didn't have that and asked me in a rude way..."how long ago was that?"  I told him maybe about 6 months or more.... he said..."We change the menu all the time!"  So, I said, I'm glad they are still open and I like doing business with local restaurants, even though I did not appreciate his manner.  First time I was ever disappointed in the way I was treated at Spasso.

My friend & I had salads (pear & cabbage) and we liked them as usual.
