Upon paying I left Levent a fair tip even though I didn't like the service.  I thought he may have been having a bad day.

To get me back, It would be nice to issue me a gift card of some sort.  This open table reservation is under my partner's name not mine.

Thanks for listening.

Patricia, 2946 Sherwood Dr., San Carlos, CA 94070

Quality of food poor.  Pasta undercooked.  Management and service staff dismissed finally gave us dessert.  Manager commented dish was most popular and didn’t hear the issue.  Venue was very noisy.  Not a good experience especially this was a gift to friends.
Love everything about this experience. Food, service, wine, ambiance just everything.  Definitely coming back with our family and friends.  ❤️❤️❤️

We were able to get a last minute reservation on Mother's Day for an early dinner. We ended up bringing 1 extra person and they were very accommodating which was so wonderful! We were seated promptly. Our server came immediately to take our drink orders. Cocktails were tasty. We all ordered and the kid's food came 1st. They enjoyed their meals. We had a couple of glasses of wine- great value for the glass. Food was delicious. I got the black pepper linguine with shrimp and scallops (so good) and the husband got a steak (also great). We did not get dessert because we wanted to go home to eat the cake that my kids made for me for Mother's Day. Overall, everything was good. Our server was a little abrupt and he came off a bit rude. We were seated by the kitchen and the servers kept bumping into my chair and didn't apologize so I can only imagine they didn't feel it (?). I would come back again and ask for a table away from the kitchen.

Good Food
Good service Didn't have to wait 
Waiters were right at our table taking our order
and bringing our food at a reasonable time but not
being rushed.

Had a reservation for 13, but at the last minute had to change it to 9.  When I mentioned it to the waiter, he was OK with it and separated the table out.  This gave an extra table that they can offer to another party.

Food was good.  All came out at the right time.  No issues.

Price....it's Mother's Day.  Many restaurants make money on this day.  Can't be mad at that.

I was happy that we got a table to celebrate Mother's Day.  Food was good.  Waiter was nice.  In all a good experience.

Mother's Day brunch so it was a busy morning but they sat us, waited on us and fed us quickly yet we didn't feel rushed.  Service was friendly and prompt, food was good to great and prices... well it was more than I wanted but about what i expected.  Which isn't unusual given the current economics.

Definitely recommend this establishment.
Lovely halibut and salmon dinner entrees with my good friend. Food was delicious.
Wonderful meal the halibut special was outstanding.
We held a birthday celebration.  Food and service were great. Everyone had a great time.
Enjoyed dining again at Spasso’s last night.  Excellent food and even better service by Angelo.  Always a consistently positive experience at Spasso’s.

Highly recommend. We just had the best experience. Very cute space in the restaurant strip. Originally a table for 16, I was expecting to be be put out of the way, and to my surprise we were right up front. Then we had a few people cancel on us, they rearranged with no fuss at all.

Service was so good. Very engaging,warm and quick. The host promptly made suggestions to get the table started with appetizers. Entrees came out perfectly timed. Everything was reasonably priced

My food was fresh and yummy. It was a big group so I’m not sure what everyone had, but everyone seemed quite happy.

Overall I couldn’t have asked for a better experience for us.

We’re sorry to say that the quality of service and food has declined over the past year.  I used to love the salmon. It was prepared perfectly, not too rare and not too dry. Now it’s routinely overcooked and dry.  They stopped having sweet potatoes which was a big draw for me.  While they seem to be interested in respecting dietary restrictions it feels more like lip service and I’ve had digestive issues soon after finishing my meal.  It was one of our favorites and we’ve continued to see if we might have run into a bad night, but sadly it consistently disappoints now.

Perfect restaurant to take my cousin to lunch.  She likes Italian, we ate outside on a balmy day and she was excited to have some of her favorite choices on the menu.
Service was good and it was a great place to celebrate her birthday.
Great food and service. Did not feel rushed as they allowed us plenty of time to order and enjoy our food.

Birthday
Service was wonderful
Food was good
We enjoyed our evening!
Great service..delicious food.. have been eating there many years…service and food are always good… highly recommended
Food was delicious. Fast n courteous service. Enjoyed!
My aunt 85 birthday celebration. We spent a really nice time with the family 🥰

This was our 4th time here and the food has been consistently great.
Our waiter, Elan, was outstanding: friendly and extremely competent.
He (they) even comped a delicious cheesecake dessert for my birthday.
I highly recommend this restaurant for casual dining or any occasion.
Outstanding food & service was excellent.

I have been to Spasso many times with my family. Even though I live in San Francisco, it is always worth it for me to drive to Spasso in San Carlos. The food is great and the food server - Julian (whom we always request for) is just fantastic!!
We were celebrating my daughters birthday! The appetizer was delicious, our entrees were divine and the service was top notch.

It was a fun experience.  My daughter was celebrating her 12th birthday with 4 friends.  They got their own table and my wife and I got a separate table.  The waiters were very nice to the girls.  There were 2 larger parties and that is when the noise got louder.  It was not bad but it was nicer when we could talk and hear each other.  My daughter really likes Spasso so we will be going back again.

Nice "old fashioned" style eatery, that captures all the plus's of this style. Food was solid, particularly with the fried calamari appetizer. Very vibrant and energetic atmosphere, which speaks to its clear popularity with locals. Planning to come back and try other dishes.

Excellent food but service was borderline abrasive/surly, totally unlike our first time there last month where our server was A+!!!

Only been there 2x and will definitely go again for food, drinks and ambiance, but hope to get a different server than last pm!
Overall was alright. There is nothing special about this restaurant that would make us go back there again.
Very good, everything; ambiance, cocktails, food, service, friendly, accommodating staff. Never disappoints.
Mussels and lobster ravioli outstanding. Service also very good
We have been going to Spasso's for many years and it is consistently a great place with wonderful food and service. We highly recommend to anyone.

My friends are I thoroughly enjoyed our meals and of course I tried a taste of theirs.  We shared an arugula salad and there was plenty for all three of us.  I had the capellini, one friend had the salmon and my other friend had the mushroom risotto. All three of our dishes were great.  The salmon was buttery.  The risotto was very flavorful and my capellini was delicious .  I ate half and had a huge portion to take home.  Our waiter was very attentive.  The prices were better than most these days.  My capellini was only $18, which is reasonable.  We were celebrating a birthday so they brought us a slice of cheesecake with a candle for the birthday girl.  It was absolutely divine!  Very smooth and creamy.  All in all I would highly recommend it.
Always consistent. Good cocktails, tasty appetizers, delicious entrees, never disappoints.
Great food and service!
so far every item we've tried on the menu is fabulous and we will keep trying new menu items
Overbooked -- multiple people with reservations at the same time with not enough tables. Had to leave and go eat elsewhere.

We went on Valentine's Night.  Lots of people.  Staff did a great job dealing with rude
and impatient guests.  People showing 45 to 60 late and waiting to get seated...

Food and service great!!

mike f.
We’ve been going to Spasso for many, many years and it’s always been one of our favorite restaurants.  It hasn’t changed and the food is always good.

Excellent service with quick filling of cocktails & wine orders . Salads were excellent, entrees very good.  But mostly we felt very welcomed and taken care of—- professional yet friendly almost like family.

Will definitely be back!
Choices for everyone!  Great dinner, great food and fabulous service.
Absolutely delicious meal. Great service will definitely go back.
Great restaurant very nice inside with excellent service food was delicious.

Felt a bit rushed by the waiter for our table a bit.
Food was really fast though.
Other than that the other staffers are great.

Everything from the cocktails and appetizers to the salads and main courses was outstanding---fresh, tasty and hot.  Service was on time, attentive to our needs and requests, and everyone of the staff was friendly, polite and really seemed like they were enjoying their job.
Great staff great food and bar tenders are terrific

I had the chicken Parm and my girl had chicken wrapped in pancetta. My meal was delicious but hers was better. For desert we shared bread pudding which was just as good. Our waiter was fantastic. Very attentive and polite. I’ll definitely go back.
One of our favorite local restaurants - we are here often.
The food was excellent and served quickly. The ambiance was very welcoming. It was a bit noisy but it seems the place was full of regulars which makes sense. Definitely would recommend it!
Great service and amazing food! Love the Italian paintings on the walls. Staff was super friendly with my 1 year old.

Christmas dinner average at best. Service was quick but outside table with propane heaters were marginal at best. Menu was limited and website didn’t indicate that menu options would be limited. Disappointing dinner.

I wanted to take my “Adult Kids” out to a fine restaurant in Christmas Day. Very few restaurants are open on Christmas Day; however, to my surprise Spazzo was open!
Excellent service and great atmosphere. The owner was very friendly
Discovered this place by accident — among few restaurants open on Christmas Day. What a surprise! Amazing food. Friendly service. Will definitely visit again.
Enjoyed the venue and the wait staff. Food and service was good.

I had the pleasure of dining at Spasso in San Carlos recently and it was a truly wonderful experience. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the staff was very friendly and helpful. The food was delicious, with the highlight being their Pasta dishes—cooked to perfection and had a great combination of flavors, while the pasta was cooked al dente and had a wonderful sauce. The flavors were so well balanced and the presentation was beautiful. I would highly recommend Spasso for a wonderful dining experience.
Excellent service and food. Even on a busy night, the staff was able to cater to the needs of our group efficiently and promptly

Had a Sunday evening meal. Lovely spot on downtown San Carlos a block into the newly closed Laurel corridor. Place was crowded but warm and welcoming. Menu is old school Italian with some not typically seen items like white beans and prawns. Delicious food with reasonable portions. Service was good but not amazing. Dessert - we had the ‘crisp’ was just ok. I’d skip that if we go back. Overall nice meal and priced as peninsula places are - high but typical.

Enjoyed celebrating friend's birthday!  Excellent calamari with really delicious artichokes and green beans!  Prosecco, lemon drop, and chardonnay drinks were quickly delivered.  All enjoyed their entrees- spaghetti bolognaise,  sausage with penne, veal picatta, and lamb tenderloin with polenta instead of garlic mashed potatoes.  Food delivered steamy and hot to our table.  Of course, we had dessert- Orange Creme Brule and Tiramisu.  Matt's service and extra touch with bday candle made our celebration!  Definitely coming back!

It was my 40th birthday and my family’s annual Christmas celebration dinner. Spasso is my favorite restaurant and I have been enjoying it for the last 7 years on my birthday. The wine list is amazing and the food , service and atmosphere is impeccable.
Outstanding service... food...ambiance.....Thank you Kurt

The food was excellent. My portion was a little on the small side though. Service was great, very attentive. We were seated at a table that was directly in front of the counter from the kitchen where there was a lot of traffic from the servers.
Fantastic Christmas lunch with our family

Birthday dinner with friends. Greeted rather gruffly, host didn’t seem to care we had reservations, just asked how many people. Seated at table by the kitchen, very noisy and busy area. Chairs bumped by severs several times.
Food was good, they are consistent with their preparations. Server was attentive but seemed to want to hurry us out.
Outstanding food, fixed to perfection with excellent cocktails and very reasonable prices!!  Definitely a place to which we will be returning.
VERY loud. Not conducive to conversation. Ate and left.
Spasso's never disappoints. Great place for celebration, dinner and kids are always welcome.

The food was ok, but nothing special...
It's definitely an "Americanized" restaurant - not Italian as I'd expect.
We were sitting outside also I reserved a table a few days in advance and the heating lamps above the head were not the best experience. 
The service was slow but friendly enough.

Very mediocre food.
We were 5 people celebrating birthday of my granddaughter.
After 90 minutes at the table we were asked to leave!
Because they sold the table to the other party.
Rude.

Very nice place for a good lunch and being able to catch up with an old friend.
We both had a cup of soup and a salad.  Both were very good and the waiter was very pleasant.  I was happy to see that they were busier than when I was there the last few times.  They deserve to do well.

The menu is great with many options but not overwhelming.  The service is excellent.  The wine selection is very good. The ambiance is really great with both inside and outdoor seating with sufficient space between tables. The gnocchi is amazing as is the Caesar Salad with Salmon.

Had a wonderful lunch with good friends. The service exceptional and the meals were just as good. Wine , bread and that sauce is so delicious. 
Spasso’s never disappoints run not walk for a good meal.
We had a great dinner and Kirt made our experience even better by checking on us to made sure all was great.

Excellent, consistently prepared dishes. Have never been disappointed. After food quality and consistency my metric is waitstaff. The folks at Spasso rank right up there with the best. Quiet competence….water glass never empty, but you didn’t notice it being filled, your waiter just seems to appear when needed, but doesn’t intrude. 
Quiet competence. Love the place.

I am a regular customer of Spasso. I always have the grilled salmon but the last time I was there the salmon was a thin tail cut and was over cooked and very dry. The server did not seem to indicate on our order that I was dairy free and gluten-free, and I’m pretty sure the spinach or the potatoes were cooked in butter because of a digestive issue I had later. Nobody came to check to see how we were enjoying our meal, either. We were very disappointed.
wonderful place to meet with friends in a cozy and inviting atmosphere. The food & wine is perfect. You will be pleased!
Love the food and friendly service.  Will definitely return.
I received a message from Open table that I didn’t receive points for this reservation. Why?
Delicious food and great atmosphere. The waitstaff was very attentive. We will go back!

Loved the Chilean sea bass special. 
Waiters should always tell you the price when they announce the specials.
The $41 charge was high. There should have been more potatoes & spinach on the plate. 
I would’ve asked the price but I was being treated by my friend. 
Glad the restaurant was busy with a large party. 
Will return but will ask the price.
Excellent food and service
Great food, excellent service. Was a little noisy inside but we were outside so not an issue.

Our waiter was great! Attentive, very personal & just overall wonderful.  The warm cabbage salad was delicious as was the salmon & my husband had the veal picatta. The outdoor seating was so nice.  It was gorgeous outside so we couldn't have had a better setting to enjoy & catch up with old friends. This was our first time at Spasso but definitely not our last!!
Food was ok - not exceptional.  Bread & dip - delicious.
Spasso's was fantastic as usual especially our Seafood Pasta Dish. Zoe and Kurk were so helpful and made us feel like VIP's.. Thank You
Food was good not great. Good value. Good service. Good menu selection.
Great customer service and delicious meals
Julian was an awesome server. Food was terrific.  Such a great place
Mostly great service and it was a Friday at 5:30pm and then place was packed both inside and out.
Great as always
As always - fabulous.
The busboy abs the waiter was awesome
Good food but great service. Zoe is the best!
We were celebrating a birthday. The food was delicious and the service excellent!  Loved the warm cabbage salad and pasta was so good.
This is one of my favorites. Service is excellent. Both lunch and dinner menus are varied and well-prepared. This is an upscale experience, lunch for two was $50 including tax and tip.
Zoey was our server and was very personable.
Great lunch spot with a variety of nice choices.

Soup & salad combo lunch was great. 
Waiter was so nice (Ya????). 
Will return soon.
We were celebrating a birthday. We brought a cake and the waiter was very accommodating with a candle and the cutting of the cake. Our waiter was very nice. Food is always good at Spasso’s.
Service poor, food quality not as good as last visit.....probably will wait a while before returning.....very disappointed this time out....
Went for my daughters Birthday and had a great evening

Well-prepared traditional fare. The calamari appetizer had a nice twist, including battered green beans and artichoke. The skirt steak satay was excellent. I realize that prices have increased for everything, but there was a little sticker shock with pasta dishes reaching toward $30. We went on a relatively busy July 3, but did feel abandoned at times by our waiter. Again, perhaps a function of the labor shortage. We ate outside but tables were close and the outdoor area was enclosed on a couple of sides. Caveat: because I don't go out often, when I do, I hope for a truly exceptional experience, and this was perfectly fine but not a standout.
It was just ok. Boxed pasta noodles. Calamari was good.

We ate in the parklet, which turned out to be a better choice this evening than the inside where there was a large party.  Our server was very nice and gave us good suggestions on what was particularly good that evening.  I followed his suggestion and ordered the mushroom ravioli.  It was redolent of forest floor scents, the creamy sauce brought out all the flavors of the crimini and other forest mushrooms - delightful!  My husband tried the seafood pasta and was equally pleased with the variety and freshness of the clams, mussels and fish.  Our salads complemented the hearty pasta dishes well, light and flavorful.  The well curated wine selections made it difficult to choose, but our server described them aptly and we were pleased.  We will return!
Good food great service
Service was fantastic, lots of tasty food, reasonably priced, outdoor seating. I left my jacket there and they shipped it back!

This is one of our favorite spots in San Carlos.  We went there for a family dinner, and the service was just ok last night.  We were busy having a conversation and didn’t even notice the waitress offering specials for the night until later in the evening. The pork chops and veal were excellent tonight, but the crab cakes were small and greasy.  Unfortunately, my stomach couldn’t tolerate.  After the pandemic, prices increased as usual, but the portions remained the same.  Spasso’s didn’t skimp.   We enjoy coming to this restaurant for their consistency and quality food.  Service could be warmer no matter if you are a regular, local, or from out of town.
food was average waitress was nice but not very attentive
Celebrating my twin daughters Birthday plus Zoe our server was fantastic…

First time I went to your restaurant.  The ambiance and food selections were very good and value for the price.  Parking was also premium.  The bread served when we arrived was one of the best I ever had.

An upgrade I offer is should be able to handle more credit cards for payment as was also let the server know how much it charge on each card.  Makes it much easier for guests in this economy.

It was so refreshing to have a nice night out at a restaurant and not feel like we were getting price gouged (which appears to be most places, now).
Yes, I understand that there are shortages and service failures everywhere, but there is a limit to increasing prices reasonably.
Food and service were excellent! Love the outdoor seating, too!
Thank you, Spasso, for continuing to be a great restaurant!

Waitstaff is very accommodating and friendly. Our waitress (who we have had many times) is especially good. She lets us take our time to talk and catch up. Food is always good and the atmosphere is relaxing.

I have been to Spasso twice. The first time I ordered the fried calamari and a pasta dish. I also have the cabbage salad. Everything was absolutely delicious five star for sure! The second time I went I ordered the cabbage salad and the pork chop. My friend ordered the flank steak. Overall, my best suggestions for this restaurant is to go there if you want pasta for dinner. All the pastas at our table were absolutely delicious. The meat dishes were very poor. The bread pudding is something to order! Off the charts! All in all, I would go back and order the items I know they make well.
Quick service (headed to a play). Excellent food, well prepared. Bread is outstanding. Favorite Italian restaurant on the Pennisula.
14 of us for son’s graduation from Stanford Law School. Great food, great service, great time!
Exceptional food, great wine and friendly service. We enjoyed every minute of our dinner.

It was a solid NYE choice. Only issue was 1. The noise level is a bit high and 2. Took them a while to sit us and we had a reservation. Still one of my go to San Carlos Restaurants.

First visit was New Years Eve. The hostess and waitress we had  were unfriendly.  Once seated they rushed us in ordering. We ordered appetizers, drinks, and Salad. New Year’s Eve should be a time to relax, unwind, and enjoy a meal with your loved ones. Everyone left with an upset feeling, felt like we had been to a cafeteria style restaurant but paid close to $400.00 for it. Staff was unfriendly and didn’t seem to listen when we asked them to slow down the order. great food, ad fabulous service...such a nice environment and welcoming.
Excellent prime rib and service. Will definitely return.

First time at Spasso and we were impressed.

The bread pudding with maple brandy sauce (made in house) is the best bread pudding I've ever had. Highly recommended, especially if you like maple.

Great service. Considering it was Christmas day and the place was packed, our server was very attentive and helpful throughout. We could see how busy she was, but she made us felt like we were her only table.

Service and food were great.

Outstanding service and fantastic food.

Excellent, as usual

Delightful meal with outside dining in San Carlos.
18th birthday. We had a great time

Mothers Day

Great service .. some appetizers and entrees were a bit pricey

Great restaurant and service. Love the ambience.

we live this restaurant food always outstanding.   only issue I have is because they don't have double doors at the entrance the tables at the front are drafty and cold so sit to the rear

the pasta dishes were the best, comfort food, reasonable prices,  excellent service, full bar
New Year’s Eve dinner. Perfect

We were excited to try this place for dinner on New Years Eve. It was our first trip and we were excited for the menu that we saw online. No where (open table, their website or at the restaurant) did it mention there was a “special” menu for the night. Special entailed a small subset of the same items from the regular menu marked up 50-125%. At normal prices I would have really enjoyed this, but the disingenuous switching of menus left us extremely dissatisfied and will result in taking our business elsewhere.
My wife and I both had the Flounder which was overcooked and dry.  The food here is normally very good.  Maybe it was because of being New Year's Eve.

Well, admittedly it was New Years Eve, so the place was a bit crowded....certainly not unexpected to have to wait for 15 minutes past our reservation time.

We were disappointed that the menu presented was a small subset of the selections on the Open Table menu. There was very little to choose from if one did not want cream sauce.  When my wife asked if she could get a simple pasta with tomatoes, basil and olive oil, the waiter refused the request citing the owner's instructions that nothing was to be ordered that was not on the reduced menu.  I can understand the need to focus offerings on a holiday to turn tables more quickly but then the menu should have a variety that accommodates wider tastes. My wife settled on a salad and an appetizer as her meal since the choice of entrees was quite limited for her palate.

 Not only that, the prices were significantly higher than their typical menu. For example, Mista Salad normally $7.00 was $14.00; crab cakes normally $16.00 was $22.00; and Salmon normally $21.00 was $34.00.  The crab cakes were good; salmon was good but certainly not worth $34. However, the Lava cake was excellent! (at least one bright spot)

So overall, quite a disappointing experience. I doubt we would ever return and will not recommend.  The owner's decision to price gouge on a holiday is certainly his prerogative but he will need to wear the consequences of his decision.   He made $50 more off us one time but lost potentially years of business.

Lastly, Open Table, if it does not already, needs to prompt restaurants to provide updated special event or holiday menus.  We were grossly misled based on the menu available on Open Table.  While the fault is that of the owner, Open Table's reputation as a "go to" resource for dining has been compromised.

We have always enjoyed Spasso. The food and service is always good. When we made the reservation, there was no mention of a special limited menu. That would not have been an issue, except the prices were about double what they would normally be. Of course, people will say that is was New Years Eve, and we should expect that. That would not be true. There are many restaurants that post that type of information. It is disheartening to arrive with certain expectations, based upon their posted menu, only to find something very different and over priced. We certainly could not have just walked out and found another table somewhere else that evening, so we stayed. There are many restaurants who do not do that, and just serve their normal menu. This will probably result in me not returning to Spasso. While the food and service was good, we felt as though we were hosed. I believe in transparency, not deceit.

We made a reservation for 10 and end up with 12 of us going there for family dinner.  They add a table fast and we were seated in 5 min.  Food was delicious and service great.  Our server was very nice and friendly.  We all had a great time.   This place is great for groups or family gathering.

I love these guys.  We made a reservation for Christmas eve. Our table was right there, waiting, at the appointed reservation time.  Beautiful.  It was packed.  Understandably so, because the staff is so friendly and the food is so good. Yet the ample staff attended to our every need and never appeared stressed even in light of a very full customer load and very busy pace. The food?  Wonderful. It was the perfect choice for a special Christmas.  And we'll continue to go there for everyday dining because these guys are just so good.
Went out our first time to dinner on Christmas Eve . Although the restaurant was busy , service and food were perfect .  Have eaten here before and that is why we will continue.

Food and service were amazing!  Great location.  We will NEVER go there again in a holiday!  The noise was deafening!!  I left with a horrible headache.  

Lunch is great - dinner is great.  Just go early!!
Christmas Eve dinner. Restaurant is very loud due to the acoustics unfortunately.
So delightful on Christmas Ev!!
Aside from the noise and poor parking (which Spasso has no control) we would be back in a heart beat. Our server was exceptional, the food good, and our overall time was worth a repeat.

Excellent food. The best salmon I've tasted at a restaurant.  Normally, I do not order salmon because it is never as good as at home.  I'm glad I ordered it at Spasso; the salmon was cooked to perfection.
Cocktails great. Food great. Service great. Everyone is friendly and attentive.
great as always! Our #1 go-to restaurant in San Carlos

I did love this place - but, we had a really bad experience on Saturday night.  I made a reservation on Open Table, said I wanted to be away from the cold blasts from the front door, and when I got there, they just kept asking us to sit outside on the sidewalk.  We said "no" three times.  The outdoor area is so small, and people walk by  on the sidewalk and bump into the tables.  Then, they said they had a large party coming in the back, but could "squeeze" us in for an hour back there, so we agreed.  The waiter was stressed and very short with us.  Our salad was served quickly and then  he brought  the entree and plopped it down on the table,and we weren't even half finished with our salad - as if to say, "hurry up and get out of here".  Then, the large party started trickling in after we were only at the table about 20 minutes, the employees were rushing around shouting at each other and moving chairs, and the large party was a group of very rude young people who appeared inebriated - they were so loud - and shouting at each other.  After we were at the table about 40 minutes, they asked if they could move us to the bar, and gave us a tiny glass of port, but it was at the end of the bar where the wait staff kept bumping into our chairs to pick up their orders - the evening was truly a disaster, and I don't know if I will ever go there again.  I would have felt better if they would have just said the reservation got mixed up and they didn't have room for us.  I offered to go elsewhere if they couldn't accommodate us, but they wanted to "squeeze in" a few extra bucks, I guess.  So sad to see a good place let their greed ruin their good reputation.  What a disappointment - we felt like we were just annoying the staff the entire time we were there - not welcome at all.
always constantly good and the staff is very friendly
Always good. Love the warm cabbage salad. Excellent cocktails

They had given away our 6:30 reservation due to the restaurant overbooking. Never got a table because the wait for a table wasn’t happening.as it was so crowded. So we sat at the bar for dinner. It was my birthday dinner so even though they were nice it didn’t overcome my expectations for my birthday dinner. When we finally got to eat my food it was served warm instead of hot. But I was to hungry by then to send it back
I️ always enjoy eating at Spasso’s and I️ am sure you will also!

After some good meals this one was a disappointment.  Food was under cooked  and underwhelming.  Not much flavor, and pasta noodles were hard.  Service was efficient but lacked any type of interaction or general friendliness.  Seemed like everyone was being overworked so they were just running from table to table trying to get things done rather than making it a positive dining experience.   Want to give them another chance, but probably will try some other San Carlos spots first .
Delicious food, good value on wine and all around terrific service.
They accommodated 14 of us very nicely.  The food was delicious but the noise level was over the top.  Service was also excellent.

Friendly and courteous personal offering great Italian cuisine!

Great Job Spasso!!!
Great food in an environment where you can have a business meeting and hear the other person.  Outstanding service from our waiter too.
A very good neighborhood Italian restaurant  with good food, good friendly service, full bar and good wine.  Easy street parking.

As usual, all is fantastic.  The service is great, attentive and very personal.  The food is good although more variety would be great for those of us who dice there frequently.  One of my favorite spots for a good meal and after work get together!
Outstanding. One of the best restaurants I’ve visited in a long time.
So noisy we barely heard each other's conversation. Waitress had to tell us  3 times about the specials.So noisy.

I used to eat dinner at Spasso with some regularity when I lived down the street, but haven't been back for a few years. That was an oversight.

My girlfriend was supposed to cook, but our schedules didn't work out on a busy afternoon so I started up my OpenTable app and narrowed my choices to the western suburbs. Spasso was about halfway between where we were coming from, so that became our destination.

I had forgotten that they co-own the wine store next door, so the wine prices are quite reasonable for some above-average selections. I had a nice broiled walleye, while my girlfriend went with a well-prepared chicken dish.

The only downside of the evening is that we were seated next to a few boisterous kids who just got out of a soccer game, but we engaged them and ended up having a nice dinner despite the "extra movement and sound".  

We will return in a month or two!
I have come here for years. Never had a bad meal, service or experience.

Two women friends enjoyed a quiet lunch where we could talk & catch up.
Good cabbage salad with skirt steak and eggplant parmigiana with pasta.
generous portions.
Everything was excellent.
It's pointless to make a reservation at this restaurant - they just don't keep reservations.  I guess you're making a reservation to get in line for a table at Spasso.
Our go to for good food & service for a special occasion or just a night out.
Great food , awesome service . We would definitely go back!

We were warmly greeted  The service was nice The  waitress also our greeter was attentive to us. The food was excellent  the three diners had mains of wild mushroom ravioli, paella,&  veal piccata. All were savory the Veal picatta was delicious. Compliments to the chef as his sauce was near perfect. We will be back.
Really good food!! Great staff.  Always enjoy eating there!
Great service, accommodating, great food. We love Spasso!

I LOVE Spasso!! We go there at least once weekly.  The staff is amazingly friendly, attentive and always remember names and likes.  The food is very good and ranges from healthy to comfort food.  The bar is well equipped with nice cocktails and very good wines. Without hesitation, I highly recommend this place.
This is our GO-TO spot. This night was my wife's and I anniversary. brought seven family members with us. Great food, great service, we were treated like royalty.

My girlfriend moved to Arizona and everytime she comes to visit she loves to have dinner here. The service is always friendly, polite and very professional which is great.  The waiters always go beyond and it's great.  The food is delicious and it's nice to know that the cooks will accomodate and the dessert menu has a great selection.

Met some old friends who were visiting the area.  The Caesar salad was very good and the crab cakes were also delicious.  My husband and our friends enjoyed the cannelloni.  I would definitely return for the warm cabbage salad.
Two ladies who lunch both enjoyed warm cabbage salads.  Very tasty.
We took an "out-of-towner" to our favorite place. She eats special foods & found things on the menu that were perfect.   Enjoyable evening.
Love this restaurant. Great food and service!

Trying too hard to be something it's not
That is an authentic Italian eatery 
Staff very friendly and attentive 
Menu a bit scattered unfocused 
Food not very satisfying in that it's just a step off throughout 
Too acid red sauces 
Balsamic added to everything for no reason whatsoever 
Mushroom brucetta v good
Mains felt almost a bit Sysco like although I'd hope they are not
No deep comforting flavors 
Creme brûlée just ok grand mariner?? Didn't taste it
On a scale of 1-10, our server was about a 5.  She didn't check in with us after the food was delivered, and she did not offer us dessert we had to ask for coffee.
Wonderful food and service. Traditional Italian. Calamari appetizer is excellent.

We made a reservation for Spasso at 9:00 pm through the Open Table App. It would have let us make a reservation as late as 9:30. We got there right at 9, and were told that they closed at 8:45. Not really expecting much, I did show them that we had a reservation, and that I could have made an even later reservation. The response I got was "well I don't know anything about that."

Keep your hours on Open Table up to date, and try to give an at least halfheartedly gracious response. I know you're not going to reopen the kitchen for two people. But don't respond in a dismissive and rude manner when it was your own failure to keep your hours up to date that caused 2 customers to waste the time it took to drive to your restaurant. I won't be back.

I love this restaurant and go here for special occasions. i have never had a bad thing on the menu and the waiters and bartenders are nice and friendly. i particularly like the portabella sandwich on the lunch menu. and the sea food pasta on the dinner menu. it's a great place for a date  or girl night out. it is a little pricey but everything is delicious!

This is one of my favorite restaurants in downtown San Carlos.  The menu has a lot to choose from, and, of the several times I've eaten here, the food has been delicious.  So far, I have not been disappointed in the quality of the food.  The dip served with bread when you first sit down is especially delicious.

We celebrated my husbands 50th Birthday with 5 other couples.  I can not say enough about the exceptional service we received.  From the moment we walked in we were greeted and seated. The waitress was amazing and the food was delicious.  There was something for everyone, including our vegan diners.  Great wine & cocktail menu.  We will be back, whether it be two of us or a large group.  Thank you Spasso for making my husbands Birthday memorable...
Their was three of us two order halibut it was over cooked they did not adjust the bill. No other service was provided. They did ask to place another order but we did not reorder.
Father's Day
The lamb pita  is no longer on the lunch menu. That was one of my favorites.

We visited on a Sunday evening to celebrate and were impressed.  We all ordered pasta entrees and they were delicious!  The fact that there is no corkage fee on Sundays allowed us to bring our own fabulous bottle that we were saving for an occassion.
Penne chicken was delicious. The bruschetta was great.  The olive and vinegar dipping sauce is fantastic.  Will return.

Have gone to Spasso's a bunch of times. Sad to hear that my lamb sandwich was taken off the menu. Along w/ my cobbler for dessert that I've been waiting to come back. Their bread and oils are great to start off the meal but we had to keep asking for bread, as there were 8 of us and we only got 2 baskets w/ only few in them. One of the meals was supposed to have grilled potatoes per the menu but they got boiled so that was a bummer. The rest of the food was pretty good.

Celebrate Mothers Day.We always enjoy Spasso and try to dine at least 1 amonth. 
Very crowded but open table assured my seat of 4 and will use this service again.
Reservation at 0630 pm was fine. Fix menu and every one seem pleased with their choice. Maybe try the skirt steak next time. Looked very good in presentation
Enjoy
Requested sport for my 15 year olds birthday celebration. The food and service are always great.

Service was pretty good.  Was given a choice of tables.  Ordered the paella but the mussels weren't very fresh.  Probably will go back and try other dishes but will pass on reordering the paella again.

We had a small team of 5 people for dinner. Dined outside. Food was excellent- Italian menu. Great wine list. Excellent value for the dollar. Have eaten there before and had fantastic service. Service during this visit was a bit slow.

The absolute best service, food, and ambiance. Thank you for your hospitality!
A MUST if your in San Carlos
Group of 12. No complaints. Everyone enjoyed their meals and service was very good. Will definitely return.

In my opinion, this is one of the better restaurants in San Carlos.  The food is very good and I like the variety of food on the menu.  It's a place I want to keep going to back to try different things.  Love the decor as well.
Food was good. Could have been better if it was warmer. Service was good. Bar and wine good.
Celebrated my husband's  birthday and was extremely pleased with the  service, food and ambiance.
Spasso consistently good! The food is delicious, wait staff is excellent, and it's affordable. What else could one ask from a San Carlos restaurant??

This is one of my favorite San Carlos restaurant.  I'm always treated well. Service is superb. Wines and cocktails are great. Food is done to perfection 

I took my daughter and my newborn granddaughter there.  We sat outside and ordered calamari, two salads and shared a steak sandwich. 

Delicious!
Always the best most consistent menu and service

Great meal as always at Spasso! The calamari is a big hit with our family. A big upside to this place is that we always feel welcome. They are always pleased to see us and the wait staff are great with kids and adults alike. Highly recommended...
Average 1950's style Italian - big portions - attentive service - Very Loud

My wife and I had dinner at Spasso on Saturday.  Food was extraordinarily superb.  My wife had the veal cannellini.  Superb flavor!  I had the curry shrimp pasta dish.  It was also very good.  They make their own bread pudding.  The maple bread pudding was excellent.  

The only issue was that we had to wait about fifteen minutes before we had a table.  Our reservation was at 7:00 pm and this other couple was at 7:15 pm.  We both had to wait until a table was free.  I use OpenTable every weekend to make out dinner reservations.  I do not understand these restaurants who make us wait for a table.  Something must be wrong with the way the managers run the restaurant.  OpenTable customers should never have to wait for their table.

I found this place on google and it was the second on the list, I find it should be first! I reserved a table at 8:45PM for my mothers dinner, it was simply amazing. Whatever plate you order, every bite is flavorful and the staff was the friendly/ helpful. The lighting has a warm feel and you just feel at home. The price of your food is most definitely worth it.
Do not get a table near the door.  With outside diners, the constant opening of the door we were subjected to constant blasts of cold air.
Love this restaurant! Have been here many times. Food & service always great.

We were not impressed with the quality of the food compared to the price. The homemade raviolis were undercooked, and a bit bland. I do not remember what my partner ordered, but she was not impressed with her meal either.

Food was overpriced, service was poor although the waiter was somewhat accommodating to our food preference.  Special Valentines menu was overpriced for what they serve. I've had Italian food in a lot of other places and I can tell that the food here is just average. Nothing authentic about it . Although the wine selection is very good ! Definitely not the place for vegetarians !
Great as always. Owner let us try a new local winery at his cost for bottle. It was delicious as was the food.
We love Spasso!  It is a pretty restaurant with a great menu and wonderful food.  The service is excellent.
We were catching up and spent quite along time at the table but it was not crowded and we did not feel rushed by staff.  Very nice but expensive.

We wanted so much to like this restaurant as we have walked by many times.  The service was among the worst we have ever received.  Our first clue should have been when the gentleman who brought us to our table, threw the menus on the table and walked away before we even got there.  He was so rushed we could hardly get out our order before he took off and we had to call him back to order a bottle of wine.  This was the first time in probably over 20 years that we did not leave a 20% plus tip.  Extremely disappointed in the service and really do not understand how they can be busy if this is how they treat their customers.

The waiter was very accommodating with my birthday celebration (held the cake in their fridge) and did a very good job at surprising me with the cake! Very friendly and attentive to us. Asked us how we were doing and the staff was good at making sure our water glasses were full (I'm picky about that). Overall, definitely recommend this place for a good time and for good food. Thank you Spasso!
Had been several months since my last visit. It was bustling and a bit noisy. Food excellent. Love the warm cabbage salad! Looking forwar to my next visit sooner rather than later.
It's one of my favorite restaurants.  The food is always good.

We came in to celebrate a birthday dinner and we were a big party of 13 well everyone was very accommodating and the service was great!  We had a wonderful experience from the minute we were greeted, to being seated, the attention was very pleasant and food was delicious.
Another enjoyable evening with Luis as our waiter. Great food, warm and inviting atmosphere.
Food and service were excellent and they were very accomodating in Making adjustments to our side dishes. Second time here and will definitely be back more often.

Awesome food. Unbelievable service
Great staff

Went for New Years Eve dinner---great ambiance, great food, great service.  Only issue is we felt a bit rushed--no time to linger over cocktails, appetizers, etc.  Meal came out quickly and we were finished in just over a hour.  Understandable since they proabably had lots of reservtions for NYE, but we still could have used a bit more time to enjoy our food and company.  But overall the restaurant was festive, warm, inviting and fun.

The meal was delicious, and service was great as usual, although we felt a little rushed at the end of our dinner.  Unfortunately, they had raised their prices on all of their menu items served on the Seasonal Menu, which was disappointing, since we had chosen the restaurant because they don't usually have outrageous prices, for their delicious food.

I treated myself to a New Years lunch today. A break from eldercare. What better place than my favorite Spasso

I had a Pinot noir with the fish of the day.  Petrale sole sautéed with capers white wine and lemon with mashed potatoes and veggies. Delicious!
This is an neighborhood Italian restaurant in San Carlos downtown. we have come here a number of times and each time we enjoyed the dishes. Their pasta dishes are always good.
Food is delicious and service is great too.  Terrific risotto and my husband loves the walnut crusted pork chops.  Great wine list and drinks.

This is a great neighborhood place we have been to many times. Last visit was for a holiday lunch, and it was just as good as always. There is a nice menu with lots of choices. The food is fresh and we have never had a bad meal here. Service was friendly and attentive. Highly recommended!
Food was very good, nice dining room decor. Wine list was ok. Sitting next to the door was a bit chilly in the winter time.

The food was very well prepared.  The service was excellent and the ambience was wonderful.  Even though the restaurant had a good crowd, the feeling was intimate and conversations could be had at a comfortable level.  Overall, a great experience.

The family ate there for Christmas Eve. The food was as good, as it typically is, but our table location made an enjoyable dinner difficult. We were seated at the front of the restaurant so every time someone came in or out a cold wind blew through the open door.  Not much that could have been done about it so my suggestion would be to ask for a table away from the door!

We've made Spasso our go to restaurant on Christmas Eve after Mass. The food is delicious. The service is great the drinks are great, desserts were delish. We ordered an assortment  & shared.   The value is there.   We will continue to go to Spasso for our family dinners.
We love Spasso. We seem to get seated by the door a little too often... had to keep my coat on during dinner but it was worth it.

Really disappointing dinner Christmas Eve. We used to dine here for special occasions. However our recent Christmas Eve dinner was only edible. Not enjoyable. In addition they charged us a $30 corkage fee. We brought a special bottle from home and expected a corkage fee but the amount was not disclosed to us until we got the bill and the seemed outrageous. I'm afraid we won't go back. :-(

Absolute gem. the service was excellent for a busy Christmas eve. The ambience was very nice and the restaurant was not to noisy. They had a limited menu for Christmas Eve but the choices where excellent. the walnut crusted pork chop was perfect as was the lamb medallion and the other entrée's. The wait staff is a gem in this restaurant can't say enough about the how great they where..
Everything was excellent.
Food was fabulous, and the specials were great.  The waitress we had was the very best, very attentive but not intrusive.  She filled our wine glasses timely.  And helped greatly with our selections.

It was my husbands birthday and the staff couldn't have been more accommodating .We had a reservation but weren't seated for about 20-30 minutes. It was very crowded and noisy and people were packed in at the bar so it was hard not to bump into people or hear their conversations. In spite of that, our experience was wonderful, as it has always been in the past.. This is one of  our favorite places in San Carlos for family celebrations and will continue to be.
Great service, wonderful food  and generous portions even when you share a salad or entree.
Everyone was so accommodating...the best waiter and the best staff experience!
A very pleasant find.... good meal and everything just right!
It's always a lovely time at Spasso. With one friend,  several, my family or a date.
Was a great place to eat, very friendly staff.

I have been to Spasso several times and the food quality is very consistent. Went there for an anniversary dinner on a Tuesday and all tables were occupied which is an indication of the restaurant's ongoing  popularity in San Carlos.  I have found the staff to be polite and attentive and the prices reasonable for quantity and quality of the food. I did notice the wine prices have gone up since my last visit.
Everything was great! Staff, food, ambiance. It's great for small group.
The staff was very courteous and took care of our needs.   The food was tasty and well plated.
Drank sparkling wine and ate beef carpaccio, both were very good and reasonably priced. Will be back to try their pasta!

We have been going to Spasso for a number of years now.   The service and food has always been excellent and I'm happy to say that tradition continues.   They have a nice children's menu, our son really enjoys the gnocchi.  If you want to have an exceptional experience ask to be seated in Luis' section, he is an outstanding waiter!  Enjoy!
Great food! The service was fast and great even though the restaurant was packed.
Amazing service, food and great wine selection.
We were disappointed. The food was not very tastefully and was not hot. One large group (around 18) and felt service was limited because they were attending to the large group.
Awesome food. Awesome service. No long waiting between servings. Excellent paella .

The staff was friendly, attentive and professional. My friend and I both had salads (Caprichosa & Caesar w/ chicken) for lunch. Our salads were great, we both highly recommend them for lunch. I asked the waiter to choose a red blend for a single glass of wine for me and the meritage was so good I almost had a second! Pricing was very fair, less than some similar restaurants on Laurel Street in San Carlos. I'm definitely going back for dinner soon! 👍🏼
Amazing food. Wonderful wait staff. Too noisy :(

Midway though the meal my nostrils were assaulted by the smell of bleach, feeling a wave of nausea come on I could not eat another bite. The smell came in from the restaurant .The service was not up to par, the waiter never told us about the specials and never once did he come back to check on us after we were served, instead he watched the baseball game on the tv bar.  I had the Gnocchi with pesto, which did not have enough garlic or pesto taste, My friend had the pepper linguine which was bland. The table next to us was loud and the sound bounced off the wall making ti hard for anybody else to hear themselves. 

2 Stars for location: no need to pay for parking or to move the car, being able to be sat early despite the later reservation and a good wine.

Had not been to Spasso for quite some time. It has the same limited menu. So not much choice. 

Felt rushed by the staff. They kept trying to take away our appetizer and entree plates before we were done. Felt like a fast food joint instead of a restaurant . I finally had to ask our waiter to back off. There are plenty of other restaurants in San Carlos where they don't do that. We'll go there instead.

There were 9 people celebrating my birthday 
Service was great and the food was plenty and delicious 
Enjoyed the cheesecake and chocolate cake
Great neighborhood spot.  Staff and overall service was superb.  Cozy and friendly atmosphere.  Great place for groups and any celebratory occasion.
Excellent Service.  Delicious Food.  Have highly recommended to all our friends, etc.

I try and eat here at least twice a month. It was a Friday night we invited another couple go out for diner, and they wanted Italian food. Say no more I have a great place to take you. They loved it. Thank you Spasso, I'll be back.
Waiter was clearly rushing us...Parpadelle was excellent, Skirt steak no too good.
Usually very friendly and attentive service. Not so this visit. But we will return since the food is good and we are locals.
Highly recommend!  Very good food, great location and atmosphere.
We always enjoy dinner at Spasso. The food is excellent and the wait staff are always accomadating and nice.
Just a great place to eat. Service and food is outstanding!!!!

Another fabulous dinner at Spasso.  The service was outstanding and attentive.  Our waiter recommended the prosciutto wrapped shrimp for appetizer.  It was so yummy.  We also ordered the grilled polenta appetizer and devoured it.  For dinner try the scallops and shrimp fettuccine.  The portions are large and beautifully plated. We will be back!
Food was good as always. The bad thing about this evening, was that there was a group of about 12 people and they were extremely loud, which ruined the dinning experience for the evening.
Food was very good.  Was a little hard to carry on a conversation as it was loud.
Great service, best waiter in San Carlos

Predictably great!  Despite an unruly and unreasonable customer near our table, the waiter showed poise and constraint in dealing with the situation.   This is a neighborhood gem.  Outdoor patio seating is also great for lunch or dinner.  I highly recommend Spasso's.
Solid offering but nothing very high-quality or special in an area where choice affords no reason to sacrifice!

Terrible Service from Waiter. Bus Boy had more of a personality and drive to help than the actual waiter. I wish my whole tip went to the bus boy and not the waiter. A tip for the waiter would be to smile, look the customer in the eye and pay attention to the people who you are serving.  Food was ordered before 3 other tables and our food came after those 3 tables. That was my go to spot for years to take friends and family on special occasions but it will be a long time until I ever step into Spasso again.
Great italian restaurant with something to eat for everyone!  Very nice wait staff.

It is nice and quite if you sit outside.  They also have plenty of heat lamps if it is cold.
Food is always good.

The staff was very busy and there didn't seem to be a host/ess so the wait staff was trying to greet and seat people. We had to wait 25 minutes even though we had made a reservation.  Once we were seated though, the service was great!
Very reliable food and service, reminiscent of traditional Italian family style restaurants in NYC.
Excellent experience. Easily able to get a seat outside and all the food was delicious. We had the Sol special and eggplant parm. Arugula salad. Wine recommendations were on point.

Spasso consistently serves up some great food. I've tried various dishes over the years and have never been disappointed. The dish I order most frequently is the fish. Whether it's the salmon or the halibut, it's fresh and cooked perfectly every time.  
And I love that the owners appreciate their  customers. This is a great spot to have a delicious meal and great service.
We went here for Father's Day lunch.  Our waiter was awesome, food was great.
At lunch it was quite quiet which I appreciated. We all had the same salad for lunch so can't say how the other food is but friends go there quite frequently and like it.
Another fabulous family birthday dinner!  Spasso you never disappoint!  Our favorite place year after year! Thank you!!
We had great service, our food was delicious and the ambiance as always very happy
Outstanding rib eye special and seared scallops. Everyone enjoyed their entrees and we shared salads and desserts. Most excellent experience with really tasty bites. Recommended!
Decent place but too many better alternatives nearby. Over-sauced entrees, overdressed salads, distracted service, bothersome sports TV in bar creating confused ambiance.  Not my kind of spot.
The chef has never let us down!  The food is delicious and makes us always anxious for our next visit
Great service on Memorial Day. Food was as good as I remembered. Good cocktails.

Waitress spent more time laughing it up with the other help and tapping on her phone than waiting on tables.   Had to summon her for service; just embarrassing to the business.  Hopefully the jokes were better than the service.  Food was okay.  There's lots of competition in San Carlos for Italian restaurants, and it will be a long time until we try this one again.  Hopefully by the time we try it again it will be under new ownership
Very mediocre food, waiter was of no help with wines & we ordered a couple of average wines. Not worth the time or money.
We ordered 3 appetizers, calamari, paquilo peppers, and carpaccio. All were good but not the best I've ever had. I think that pretty much sums up the whole experience, decent but not great!
Great food and service. We had outside seating that was fantastic
Wonderful dining experience always treated like family!

This was our third visit to Spasso, and on each visit we have had very good food and excellent service. Despite the fact that this time we were in a crowded restaurant on a Friday evening, our server, though busy, could not have more prompt nor more professional. He also gave us extremely good advice on what to order, particularly with respect to our choice of wine. Another of his recommendations, the seafood pasta was a favorite as was the delicious bread pudding he suggested for desert. The restaurant is friendly and family oriented. We very much enjoyed our evening there and will certainly return.

We are from the West Linn, Oregon and do frequent several family owned/operated Italian Restaurants in the Metro Portland area (Tualatin, Lake Oswego, West Linn, Wilsonville et al) and while all these range from good to very good in one or several different ways, Spasso, met or exceeded these in virtually every category ... on a side note twenty -plus years ago when we lived on the peninsula in the Bay Area, we did frequent several North Beach restaurants in The City (as you may know in the 70's-80's & some of the 90's North Beach was "little Italy" ... Spasso compares well ... what more can I say ... I look forward to coming back ...

amazing little gem of a restaurant. I have dined here several times and have never ordered something I didn't like. they have an expensive wine list and amazing food. cute little restaurant with beautiful decor. the staff was very knowledgeable . great little place for a girls lunch, romantic dinner and more.......

Fully enjoyed our dining experience.  The service was excellent and the food was delicious.  We were seated on the outside patio with nice heaters and lively activity from the city streets.  Will definitely return.
The restaurant took great care of us and our 4 year old.  The food was great.  Kids menu had a bit of variety.

No need to travel to Italy, the delicious food, beautiful decor, great service and  wonderful ambience at Spasso's makes you think you're there!  Celebrating mom's 85th birthday lunch with 12 very Italian ladies was delightful!

Been here for lunch 2 times during the week and once weekend. Consistent quality. From quiet to lively but not deafening. Good for relaxing and business talks. Good and unobtrusive service. Recommend.

This is our "date night" restaurant.  The food is exceptional, the service remarkable and personal.  The bar is fun, outdoor seating is great.  Love Love Spasso.  Just had a wonderful family birthday gathering for our 75 year old father.
A serendipity was no corkage fee on Sunday. We had gone wine-tasting with friends from New York during the day, so being able to bring our own wine at no extra charge was a pleasant surprise.

I ordered the "Clams and Mussels with  garlic, white wine and tomato sauce". The sauce was delicious, not the typical white wine "broth". My lunch date ordered the "Arugula Salad with poached pears, jicama, toasted pecans, blue cheese, balsamic vinaigrette, she added grilled chicken and really enjoyed it.
Staff very accommodating to children.
Great food, excellent service.
Been there many times, excellent food, great service, just a great place to meet up with friends for dinner!
Alway an enjoyable evening
We have dined at Spasso a few times now and have never been disappointed. We will be back!

I went here for lunch with my colleagues from work.  I had the best lasagna I have ever tasted.  Shared a plate of crab cakes that were really good as well.  The price for lunch is a bit higher than most Italian restaurants I have gone to but I felt the price was a fair reflection of the quality of the food served and portion size (ample) that I received.  Normally I am drawn to more modern surroundings, but really enjoyed the atmosphere of this small restaurant.  It felt like I had stepped into a local favorite in a small provincial town in Italy.   If you want to feel a million miles away from the hustle and bustle of SV to enjoy an incredible meal, you might want to give this restaurant a try.

This was our first time here and we'll be back. Service was very prompt and attentive. We shared the mushroom truffle bruschetta which was rich and full of flavor. The portion was very generous with four large pieces. A real treat and a nice change from the usual. Our pasta dishes were cooked fresh with large portions.

Once a restaurant makes a name for itself with good food and service, it tends to get
overwhelmed by people trying to get in.  That is Spasso's current predicament.  We
booked our reservation for 6:30 PM for 4 people on a Saturday night.  We were finally
seated at 7:10 PM.  Apparently once people get a table, they enjoy the ambiance so much
that they stay and talk well after dessert and coffee are over.  The sound of energetic
conversations was a little disconcerting, but at least everyone seemed to be having
a good time.
Loved the chicken bolognese pasta dish. Always have it when I go to Spasso's
We decided it's fun having a fave spot to go to. The service was excellent and the polenta is amazing.

I asked for a quite table on open table, however, when we arrived, we were seated by the kitchen, we asked to be moved, however, the waiter argued about moving us. This was my friends Birthday. I asked for a special dessert to be brought out ahead of time, but it was forgotten. When I asked the waiter, he just keep talking to another table for about 10-15 minutes. In the meantime the other waiter came out, and tried to take a dessert order, while we
were waiting for our other waiter to bring the surprise dessert. Not sure why we had 2 waiters.

I love Spasso's! 
Great menu selections, service is exceptional, decor is comfortable and unique and the experience is consistently good.  When it's really busy say for weekend dinners, it can be a bit noisy but it's not disruptive and if you go for lunch it's not an issue.
Heaters outside make seating at the outside patio work any time of year and the inside window seats are also a great option.
I love the Polenta appetizer!
Great restaurant in downtown San Carlos -

My family went to dinner on Christmas Eve.  We had perused the menu online before going.  That night they used specially printed menus that were almost the same, except that the prices were jacked way up.  I suppose since it was kind of a holiday....  But it is already a fairly expensive restaurant, so I was a little surprised at how much they went up.  The food was quite tasty, even if the portions were a little small.  I would like to try this restaurant again on an ordinary night.
Our dinner was Great and our service was fantastic and evening well spent in San Carlos...

We love spasso's always so good, service is awesome, however, this time we went on a Sunday, There were 10 of us celebrating a family birthday, the food was a little off, service was slow, we sent back one dish, and had to ask waiter to move from our bill.  I think the "main" chefs must be off on Sunday's it just wasn't what we are use to there.

It was VERY cold and we had to wait outside for 20 mins even though we had reservations.  And when we were seated, we were given a tiny table right next to bar and front door which people kept holding open while trying to checkin at a protium by the front door by the bar. It was a VERY cold night and we needed to wear our coats inside. 
Good was good but  not sure I would go again if they didn't have better tables.

It was a busy night on Laurel street with the street lighting, music, and kids rides.  Spasso staff handled the extra crowds with grace .  We had reservations but had to wait  a few mins due to the crowds, they were accommodating and gave the kids bread to keep them occupied while we waited.  We had a large party and the server attended to kids food and drink needs immediately.  Food was delicious as usual.  A fun and lively evening was had by all.
We enjoyed a very relaxing Sunday lunch at Spasso.  Love the pasta dishes and they are flexible with sauces to accommodate dietary requirements. The arugula salad was fresh and tasty.
Food was very good.. pasta .. and veal .. the only thing was that we still have to wait for a table even though we reserved the table ..
Had a great business dinner at Spasso which I have always enjoyed and would recommend.   They seemed pretty busy for a Monday night and so the service was not up to there usual standard.

Luis was terrific.
 The special filet of sole & the cabbage salad (with steak) were very tasty.
2 ladies who lunch...We shall return.

I'd heard good things about Spasso and its being the best Italian in San Carlos.   I have to now disagree after our experience.  We went with another couple, could hardly talk as it was so loud.  The appetizer came out with our main course, after we finished our salad course.  the main course selections we the mahi mahi special (very dry!), the lamb tenderloin (sauce was good meat  was very chewy), saffron pappardale (shrimp with soggy noodles in tasteless shrimp bisque sauce was missing the arugula as well.)  I did not taste the gnocchi so no review there.  Dessert of tiramisu was soggy and disappointing.     Service was very good .  Our wine a $54 dollar of Stags Leap was the best part of the meal.  The wine list could be expanded some, as there are few choices for chardonnays for example only 5 or 6 .   
All in all a great disappointment.
Good food, good ambiance.
It was perfectly OK food for old fashioned Italian food. Not likely to go back - looking for more interesting tastes

We had dinner on a Friday Night about 6 PM. The food and service was great but the noise from the bar scene was intolerable. The restaurant in shaped like a shoe box with a long bar down one side. Much better place for happy hour on a Friday night than for dinner.
Went here for a work dinner, everyone enjoyed their dishes and the wine was excellent

We had a very lovely dinner and enjoyed every aspect of it. They were very gracious as we hemmed and hawed about where to sit. We were seated at an intimate table outside and were assured the heaters would be turned on immediately upon request. The servers were attentive, but did not hover. Our salad and entrees were all flavorful and beautiful in presentation. We enjoy the meal from start to finish and will return soon.
Great food, moderate prices, wonderful service.  Fantastic bar, good wine list.
Wonderful!! We sat outside on this gorgeous night and enjoyed delicious food!! Excellent food.. Excellent service!

The food was excellent.  We were there for my birthday and it was a very warm evening.  They left the front door open and it was pretty warm in there.  I would think they have air conditioning  but maybe it was on the fritz.  I don't think it would be good for groups more than 6.

Had a birthday lunch for our team and it was nice that the restaurant read my 'special occasion' birthday on the OpenTable comments and brought out a free dessert with candle. appreciate that. The food was great and everyone was happy. I wish they would bring back the fruit cobbler dessert tho ;) miss it!
The best Italian in San Carlos to my taste. The food is always fresh and tasty, service outstanding and the outdoor seating is a plus.

Restaurant had great reviews on Yelp. Food was good. Wine list was good. The downfall to eating there was the noise level. If you're looking to have a nice, relaxing dining experience and enjoy a glass of wine or drink at the bar, this is not the place to do so.

All the food was excellent except for the Lamb Pita Sandwich-much too dry. The meat was not tender and cook too long, needed some type of sauce. Calamari and clams & mussels appetizers were outstanding and delicious. The pork chops were succulent, tender and wonderful, all the pasta dishes were great. This luncheon was a Birthday celebration for 3 VIRGOS. The waiter knew that this was a birthday luncheon but yet no desserts were comp at the end even though we ordered a few desserts to share at the table. All the restaurants we go to celebrate usually gives the birthday person (s) a free dessert so we'll have to consider this next time we plan another Birthday Celebration.
Spasso never disappoints.  We've been going there for years and it just keeps getting better and better.

Took a group of 13 to dinner on a Sunday evening.  Reservations person was very welcoming on phone and in person. Ambience was good. Table was ready when we arrived. Many appropriate menu choices for ages 10 to 86. Service was really good, but restaurant was very noisy. Food was good to very good, except that halibut special was seriously overcooked (3 people ordered this dish), even when I asked for medium rare preparation. No corkage fee on Sundays or Mondays - an excellent value for a group of this size. I would go back but avoid ordering fish.

Went theRe for birthday dinner....never been there before...food was tasty...m pasta dine perfectly....had the sole special...had calamari and it came with green beans and artichokes....perfect for the family...noisy...but still very good

A visit to Spasso is always a delight, the menu varies which for us who go out a lot is much appreciated. Fresh ingredients, deliciously prepared, just fabulous. We started with the mushroom bruschetta, my friend had the salmon and I had the mushroom ravioli, all amazing! We finished off with a chocolate lava cake with ice cream - wow! Absolutely sumptuous and we can't wait to go back again. Great wine list too, we enjoyed a great Moscato and by the way the service couldn't be better.  Kudo's to Spasso, a neighborhood gem and favorite destination of ours for wonderful dining, service and lovely atmosphere!

Really was surprised the sole entree was incredible! My friend had the shrimp pasta and she loved it. I had a taste and really loved the saffron. Everything was great quality and cooked to perfection. Loved the bread and olive oil tapenade too! Definitely will return. Service was good and we ate outdoors which was great.

Had dinner with two other friends.  We each had something different.   One had salmon, one had a fish special and I had simple old spaghetti Bolognese.    We all loved our food.  The service was fantastic.  We will definitely go back.

The restaurant was quiet because we were there for an early 6:00 dinner at the window table.   We had an excellent waiter and prompt service.  We had the delicious calamari and bruschetta for appetizers and we had the fish special, crab cakes, and pasta dishes.   We all enjoyed the dinner, the atmosphere and service.   My friend lives in San Carlos and she referred me here saying it is always consistently good.   I'd definitely go again.

I will continue to return to Spasso for lunch or dinner. I prefer the lunch menu because of the range of menu options I am offered. I will return to have dinner soon to reassess the evening menu and to clarify my review here. In any case, all dishes I have eaten thus far have been fresh and flavorful, beautifully presented and thoughtfully prepared in the Italian tradition. Desserts are the same.  Nice wine list. I'll be back!
Menu has something for everyone in our family.  Enjoyed the fried calamari starter as well as the pastas.
Love the lamb pita sandwich and the piquillo peppers appetizer.  Nice variety of small plates.

This has been one of my "go to" restaurants but the quality of the food has declined considerably. It's not that it's bad but it's no where near as good as it used to be. Last night I spent $350 for a party of five and not a single dish was memorable. It's tough to see one of the "neighborhood" restaurants decline to this extent.

We wanted to celebrate Brandon's 8th grade promotion and Taylor making it to chamber choir! The calamari was good and pork spring rolls were ok. The grilled salmon, capellini and skirt steak were delicious!  Bread and dip were yummy!

If in the area and desiring Italian food, this is a solid choice. Fresh pasta would be almost enough for me to go back, but the service and clean, new interior add to making Spasso worthy of repeating. Very welcoming, full bar, decent wine list, and dessert menu, all add to my desire to return. Check it out when in the area. You'll like it.
Not the over sauced dishes Americans think of as Italian food. Been there many times and its always great.

Nice place for ladies who meet for lunch.  We both had cabbage salads, one with steak and one with chicken. We enjoyed them.  Service was nice & allowed us to have a leisurely lunch, as we had a lot of catching up to do!

We went here for Mother's Day with a reservation, waited outside 45 minutes and still no table.  We left.  Since then I went with friends, their choice, the food was good but I noticed people waiting outside.  Just after we had dessert the manager slammed the table next to us up to our table.  I said kidding, are we having guests? He said yes I have a table of 15 that has been waiting 45 minutes outside. I need you to move over there, I'll buy dessert.  It was so rude.  He could have asked us nicely a lot earlier.  They need to improve their table management.  Not going back, would never recommend.

Spasso is normally a good restaurant for food. I was disappointed in the paella which was floating in a red grease and in which both the chicken and the chorizo were tough. I'll give them another try based in my prior good experience with them
Lovely place, good service, full service bar, menu is varied and the food was wonderful.
don't pass up the salmon over spinach  !!  the  food is always hot & nicely served.  If I want to substitute extra vegatables for the potatos they are always willing

We had a great time, the food was very delicious, our server was fabulous, we sat outside and it was a beautiful night and our server was great at recommending food and dessert. An over all wonderful experience

With the San Carlos dining scene improving each day, Spasso, an older mainstay has remained an excellent place for a meal out. The food, especially the pasta, is well prepared and you wont be disappointed. Highly recommended if you are dining in San Carlos

We've not eaten here for some time, only because Spasso isn't close by.  Our wait was a little longer than we expected with reservations, but our dinner and service were as good as we remembered.  We will not wait as long to return to Spasso.
Good food as ever - have to be careful that they do not compromise presentation when the restaurant is busy......

I use to really like Spasso  however I think lately the menu has changed for the worse and the food was not very good at all.  My son had spaghetti bolognese which was basically a bowl of sauce with very little pasta in it.  My wild mushroom ravioli was swimming in sauce as well.  Despite being relatively quiet, our waitress was in a hurry to service us and never came back to see if everything was ok.  We will not be going back anytime soon.

I enjoyed an excellent lunch with a friend at this neighborhood restaurant.  The caprichosa salad is one of my favorites, filled with artichoke hearts, tomatoes, capers, onions, mozzarella and grilled chicken tossed with slivered romaine in a tasty vinaigrette.  My friend had the crab cakes, which looked delicious and she seemed to enjoy.  Service is excellent - attentive without being intrusive;  our glasses of iced tea were replenished often.
