I have been here for dinner before and also enjoyed it, especially the small plates which make it convenient to bring children who aren't up to a full meal.  This restaurant is located on a busy stretch of Laurel in downtown San Carlos, so parking can be a challenge, but the experience is worth it!

We dined here on Valentines Day and were expecting some delays or sub par service because of the day. To our surprise it started with our lovely hostess who kept everybody informed on waiting  times to eat. We were actually sat 5 minutes early to our reservation time. We then had drinks minutes after seating. Our waiter was very pleasant and did not seem rushed or overwhelmed do to the all night full house. He also had a great since of humor. The food was EXELLENT and was served with perfect timing even the bus person was on top of his game. We were truly amazed by the Spasso staff who worked like a well oiled machine. We personally rank Spasso as a top restaurant on the peninsula and we will definitely be dining here again

Food was strictly OK.Service was poor. My 8 months pregnant wife and I had to wait for 35 minutes to get a table despite having a reservation.
I would not go again as there are many Italian restaurants that serve better food and have warmer service.

On this Thursday night we were waiting on our server who was also the bartender and both our  dinners seemed like they had sat for awhile. I was a little disappointed.  I've had the same pasta plate for lunch and it's always so fresh and yummy.  I left with the impression that Spasso's is great for lunch but maybe not as "on it" for dinner.

With excellent service, a varied menu, and well prepared, tasty food, Spasso has much to recommend it. Particularly enjoyed the warm cabbage salad and the lamb this time but look forward to trying other dishes, although it would be hard not to order that salad again. The only negative that I can see is the street parking which was tough even on a Tuesday night. Nonetheless, will certainly return but not on a weekend.

In a city known for great restaurants, Spasso is one of our favorites. From our 8-year old to grandparents, we all love it. The food is consistently great and so is the service. The warm nappa cabbage salad is a standout, as is the skirt steak and the salmon. Our daughter loved the risotto.
Prices are moderate to high, but worth it.
I have been going here for years for both lunch and dinner. Always consistent and great food. Also sidewalk dining option and people watching is fun.

My wife and I started with a shared bowl of Lentil Soup, my favorite soup. It was excellent. I ordered the soup and did not say that we would share it. The waiter delivered it with two spoons---a thumbs up (literally) from me. We also split (as we usually do) Black Pepper Fettuccini and Gnocchi Duck Ragout. Both were excellent. Two Iced Teas were also very good. We looked over the Dessert Menu, although we told the waiter that we would not be getting a dessert at that time (waistline decision). The dessert list looked so good that we will at least split one on our next visit. Yes, there will be a next visit!
Spasso is a great restaurant for a excellent outdoor lunch on a sunny day.  Great food, wine & service.
Spasso consistently provides a great meal in downtown San Carlos on the ever-popular Laurel Street.
Spasso is a fantastic neighborhood gem!  The food is authentic, fresh and imaginitive.  It's ideal for any occasion from a lunch to a special evening out.  We'll be back!

Took a risk. First time there. Chose based on restaurant reputation. Excellent late NYE dinner! Somehow seated at best table in the place! Cocktails perfect! Food exceptional...better than expected!!! Service superb!!! Looking forward to returning!!

my husband and I had dinner there on New Years Eve. the restaurant was crowded but the service was still attentive. noise level is extremely high but that's to be expected on such as festive evening. my salmon was cooked perfectly and my husband had the steak teriyaki and really enjoyed his dinner as well. they offer a full bar and a wine list with wines by the glass at a very reasonable price.

Enjoyed dining here Christmas eve.  Service extremely attentive! We tried 2 different types of salads and unfortunately both dressing were tart, but tolerable.. Portions huge tho! Loved my Gnocchi! The atmosphere overall was stellar.  Enjoyed dining experience and will return! Happy Holidays!
Our server was very polite but a bit busy. Normally, service is fantastic

The cannelloni pasta is tender and cooked to perfection with a flavorful sauce. The Sea Bass also is tender and cooked just right. 

Noise level was very high due to two holiday parties. Plus the acoustics add to this.

 We will be back!

We really enjoyed this place.  The restaurant was very elegant and confortable and the menu selection was diverse enough to get what you are in the mood for.  The selections we ordered were very good and the only bad thing was that we were not able to try other items on the menu.  We will have to go back for that and we certainly will.  The service was also outstanding.

Food was good as usual.  A couple of large parties who were standing throughout the restaurant instead of sitting at their tables made it a little extra loud so difficult to hold a conversation and for the waiters to get through the narrow pathways.  Otherwise, enjoyed our night and seeing lots of locals enjoying Spasso.
consistently very good to excellent.....and the wine prices are very fair.

I don't know when i've had better service, every staff member is attentive and friendly, i just love Spasso!  the food is excellent and the atmosphere lovely, you feel like you've stepped into Tuscany, it's warm ambiance and excellent cuisine - overall an excellent experience you can count on.
Excellent experience as always.  Our family favorite!

We recently visited Spasso for a birthday lunch, and we're extremely pleased with the ambiance, the food and the service. My friend and I went in different directions, food wise. I enjoyed saffron pappardelle with shrimp; my friend went the healthy seared tuna route. Both of us were extremely pleased with our lunches. Delicious, in fact!

The bread served with the olive oil/balsamic dipping sauce (and the sauce) were to due for.

Don't miss this little Laurel a Street gem!

I always stop here when I'm in the Bay Area.  My niece loves the calamari and my sister says the veal.  I have something different every time.  The ravioli was very good - I didn't have the cream sauce by the way.  Great drinks that actually have liquor in them.

Our second visit to this little trattoria was delightful. The new tapas/appetizers are a great addition. Be sure to try the tuna cubes, steak satay and goat cheese bruschetta. All three of us loved the sea bass special which was pan-seared, with a sun-dried tomato piccata sauce, over lemon risotto. Even the roasted asparagus was exceptional. Our creme brulee was an outstanding end to a delicious meal. The food has really developed since our first visit. Definitely worth a visit!

What a wonderful meal we had at Spasso - they could not have been more accomodating or provided better service, they were so busy and every single staff member was most attentive, made sure we we were comfortably seated - truly excellent service and the food was sumptuous and atmosphere lively and warm. You can't help but feel welcome, what a great marriage of dining and atmosphere, a true neighborhood gem. We started with the mushroom bruschetta, absoloutely delicious, enjoyed a Reisling from their great wine list. My friend chose the cod and I had the pancetta wrapped chicken,  both delectable - we can't wait to come back again!

My husband and I were especially pleased with the appetizer selections on the menu.  We wanted to try every one.  For this visit we decided on the carpacio and the panceta wrapped prawns.  Very good.  For an entry, we both had the portabellow mushroom ravioli, and it was TERRIFIC!  We will definitely be going back again.
1st date, excellent waiter suggested surprise appetizers, great bottle of wine, outdoor dining, well done!

This restaurant was a major disappointment.  They seem to have 2 waiters for the entire restaurant and they need at least 4.  I can understand why they have 2 because on the night when we had a 7:30 reservation, it seemed like everybody else did as well.  As a matter of fact they had no reservations after 7:30.  We arrived a bit early and the only way we could be seated anywhere near on time was if we were willing to sit outside which we weren't so we weren't seated, until 7:50 and we were the first 7:30 reservations to be seated.  They took our drink service quickly, we ordered a bottle of wine.  Then we waited half an hour to have our dinner orders taken.  The appetizers were excellent, the rest of the meal was mediocre at best.
I've had lunches and dinners many times over the years. The food always surprises me with its goodness, and the service is superb. Love this place, and so happy its nearby.

Fresh salads
Delicious"grilled" calamari ( much better than fried)
The Friday night special with scallops and pasta is divine. The pasta was tasty and done to  perfection

I've eaten here multiple times and in the past the food has been excellent.  I took a work group here and for the first time I had the impression that the chef was trying way too hard to make fancy food taste good.  it was not bad, but also nothing to write home about if you can understand that comment.  Service was great.  Our waiter, as well as the rest of the service team, was very attentive and spot on

Excellent food and waiter. Manager honored a 6 year old gift certificate, which was very nice. 
Noise level was too high because we were seated near a loud party. 
However would really recommend restaurant!

I have eaten here several times and have never been disappointed. They have a great selection of tapas and starters, which I love. I've tried their bruschettas, the mushroom polenta (yum), the polenta cubes, and their grill eggplant caprese. All were delicious! My friend wanted the warm cabbage salad which didn't sound appealing to me but I think I ate 2/3 of it - it was amazing! Will definitely go back.
The food and the service was excellent. Our waitress was very nice attentive and professional
Good was good. Hostess lacked enthusiasm. Service was excellent. Will be back.
an enjoyable experience.  First time there.  Would be happy to recommend.

Loved our dinner at Spasso.  I have a seafood allergy and our waiter very graciously created an appetizer sampler plate without seafood that I could enjoy with the rest of my group.  We each had a different dinner, veal, fish, lamb and each dinner was excellent.  The wait staff was friendly and always available to us.  This was our first visit but it won't be our last.

The staff were extremely friendly. They were great with my 2 kids and served their meals first and dessert while my husband and I enjoyed our dinner. The only reason I did not give them 5 stars is because it took a little too long for our main dish to arrive.
Good selection of entrees. The lamb was superb. Service was excellent.
Every time we go it's always great food and great service

I used the Yep reviews and selected this restaurant for dining with out of town visitors on a Thursday night.  The place was bustling but the staff was attentive and the service was excellent. The food was outstanding, we loved the appetizers  (crab cakes, eggplant and portobello), our dinner (salmon, clams, special of the day fish) and desserts (new york cheese cake and bread pudding).  I will recommend this restaurant to others.

Service was good and our server was very polite.  However, the food is below expectation.  We ordered seafood linguini and Spasso chicken bolognese.  The pastas were over cooked and were very soft.  The bolognese sause was very watery without any flavors.  More spices should have added to the dishes to enhance the taste.
I love this restaurant. Whether I am alone or with friends the food and service is excellent.

We've eaten here before and the experience was very positive.  The ambiance, service, cocktails and food were good.  We thought we'd found our "go to" place only to be disappointed with our next visit.  The food was fair, the waiter was entertaining and attentive in the beginning but I ended up bussing our table and had to ask the hostess who was busy chatting with the bartender for our check.  The hostess that sat us was not the same as the one at the end of our meal.  The gal that greeted us and sat us was the best thing about the restaurant sadly.

Spasso continues to be one of our favorite neighborhood restaurants. Kurt and his staff are wonderful and the food is always amazing. Thy cartered our sons First Communion and everyone raved about the food. We bring out of town guests and we go just because.
Wonderful Lamb. Very delicious crab cakes. I usually go to Spasso when I visit my family in San Carlos.  They are consistent.

This was my first time at Spasso. We were greeted as we walked in and promptly escorted to our table. The staff were attentive, the food is delicious. We had the calamari appetizer and ordered three different pasta dishes as entrees. Each dish was delicious, and everyone was happy! I ordered the tiramisu for dessert, and it was a perfect ending to my nice meal. Spasso is a great neighborhood restaurant and I will definitely be back when I'm in the mood for Italian food and prefer to dine locally!

we purposely asked for a table outside because it can get really loud inside. However, the staff made the outside distractingly loud. There was a constant banging of dishes as they hastily cleared tables and dragging tables and chairs all over the pavement to reconfigure for the next seating. This happened 8 or 10 times in the 90 minutes we were dining and was distracting and repeatedly interrupting of our conversation. It is completely preventable and disrespectful to all those dining outside. Have to say the food was a disappointment this time which it usually is not. Lamb pita had lovely bread but contained only a few bits of overcooked and dry lamb that looked left from a previous cooking. Desserts lovely!

We come here fairly often as it is convenient and they have free corkage on Sundays and Mondays.  The food is good as is the service.  Seating could be better and it is usually quite loud.  Don't expect a quiet romantic spot and you won't be disappointed.
the food was excellent and the service was wonderful. our waiter was very nice and accommodating.
You can always count on SPASSO to provide a delightful dining experience.  The food is consistently excellent and nicely presented. The service is attentive and friendly.

I had a lovely experience at Spasso's! The service was excellent and for maost part, the food was delicious. I ordered the halibut with mashed potatoes and there seemed to be a funny taste with the sauce and with the mashed potatoes. Otherwise, everything was fabulous.  Thank-you!

My husband and I met another couple here for dinner one evening.  We had never been here before, but they had been and recommended it. The food was amazing!  We shared a polenta appetizer that was delicious! I had the fish special of the evening; it was seabass and it was moist, flavorful, and seasoned just right. My husband ordered scallops and they were cooked perfectly. 
We had some really good food, friendly and attentive service, and GREAT company with whom to enjoy it!

We WILL be back... And, eventually, we will try everything on their menu!!

Went with a friend for lunch.  The decor was very nice and being that it wasn't too crowded, the noise level was low. We both had the warm cabbage salad with chicken.  It was very good except the chicken was a bit dry. The service was excellent.  I would go again to try the other things on the menu.

The service is always friendly and first-rate. The food is always delicious. The drinks are always refreshing. Dining here feels like a celebration. We often go with small plates (crab spring rolls, piquollo peppers, polenta cubes, the beef carpaccio) and drink wine or champagne and end with a split piece of cheesecake and coffee. This is a delightful place to sit at an outside table and watch the passing people and their dogs.
Service is still the best. Great ambiance. For some reason the food doesn't taste as good as it once did.

Great experience overall - enjoyed the food, great menu choices, ambiance was comfortable, server was helpful and funny, and the wine we had was delicious. The only note I would recommend for improvement is to not be so quick to rush our plates away after dinner. We had one person at our table who really likes to take her time eating. There were 5 attempts to take her plate away before she was done - all different people trying to be helpful, but after the 2nd request, it felt less helpful and more like they're pushing to get us out the door.
It was our 57th wedding anniversary and we had an enjoyable time. Had dinner with family. Food was good. It was early enough that it wasn`t too noisy. Later on it tends to be extremely loud.

My husband made this res for us to celebrate my birthday! The food was great, we brought our own bottle of wine and because it was a Sunday the corkage was free. We did order cocktails and they we're relish. The service was great ( I do t like to feel rushed). The only complaint was that there was a large party next to us, of 10 people that were a little noises but not a big deal to me. I would definitely go back. I had the lamb (delish) my husband the pork chop which was tastey though slightly sweet with raisins in the sauce. The gran marnier creme brûlée was a great ending to the meal.
Been coming to Spasso for some time now. Friendly staff and good food

We had a 8pm dinner on a Thursday night and the place was packed. The service was great. Our waiter was very nice, make sure all of us are taken care of, accommodating of our requests.

Food is good, not like wow wow. We ordered calamari and mozzarella eggplant. Both are good, but need little bit more salt for the calamari. Seafood pasta has MORE seafood than pasta which worth the $ you paid. Although, we all love pasta, but absolutely no complain about the portion of the food. Descent size.

Dessert, we ordered the chocolate lava cake, tiramisu, bread pudding. Out of all, surprisingly, bread pudding score the dessert.

All of us were very happy with the overall experience. We will definitely good back for sure.
We love this restaurant! The food was phenominal! Great service and not too hard on the pocketbook:-)

I made an early afternoon reservation for a business dinner and was more than pleasantly surprised. From the flatbread tapas to the entrees, the food was superb. Menu offers a great balance of old favorites and new trends as well as healthy choices. Our server was charming, and made some great suggestions. Meal was well-paced. It was the perfect end to a long day. I will definitely be returning!

My most recent visit was a disappointment. It was extremely noisy. Good was OK, service was OK, but it is a change from several previous visits where everything was very good. A change in the wrong direction.

As we were the last diners on a recent Tuesday night, and were enjoying the quiet at our table nearest the kitchen, we were disconcerted to have a couple seated right behind our table. Chairs are very close (back to back) and was awkward to move away from our table. As the restaurant was empty except for our table, we asked at the bar on our way out, what the reasoning might have been for that deliberate seating choice. We were told that the couple had asked for that table??? Could not they have been seated at at least one more table away from our threesome? Just curious as to the seating policy for those situations.

This is the first time we ate at Spassos. I went there with two girlfriends for lunch. The menu was quite extensive. And the food was excellent. And I love the decor. . I am really looking forward to going there for dinner.

We took my daughter and new boyfriend here for dinner. Everyone loved their meal. Food is always great. The only negative is that the restaurant is often very noisy at dinnertime during the weekend. Fortunately we had a quieter table in the corner. We were seated right away. Enjoyed cocktails before ordering and did not feel rushed.
Good food and service; was quite loud (but we're older)
The service staff rushed us a bit and the menu was limited because of Valentine day.

Overall the ambiance of the place is good. But i have had much better Italian food at other places. Nothing outstanding of the food. Any Italian place can be judged by the bread they serve in the beginning. This place served thick bread which wasnt even warm.

Pros:
Small plates
Many options for appetizers
Good ambience

Cons:
Small red wine list
aweful bread

Went on a weekday evening. Although we had pleasant service, We had to wait too long for the waiter to take our order. Appetizer was just okay. Long wait between app and entrees, but I liked that our entrees arrived steaming hot. Unfortunately, the salmon entree was bland; thumbs up on the black pepper pasta.I would have enjoyed the evening much better if the pacing improved. The food is reasonably good, but for the price, I think I'll be looking for an alternate to Spasso.

Good well prepared Italian food. Typical continental offerings as well. Uneven wine selections.
Good service. Nothing outstanding, but nothing bad either.
Dinner after a great theater experience was very good. Wait staff helpful and attentive. Food exceptional. Cost in line.

Restuarnt was very crowded and loud. Our 8pm reservation was not going to honored, so we went across the street to the Cask where we had the same meal in a less hectic atmosphere.

The problem with Spasso, if you have to wait there is no room to do that and you are just standing in the way.

the girls and i were out for our girl friend's birthday and we had a great time. Our waiter was on top of his game and service was great and the food as always was very delicious even our picky eater of the group was very happy!

I was hoping this place would be really good but I wasn't impressed. The food was average. When I go out I want to taste food like if its something that I can't make myself no matter what the dish. My date and I shared apps and entrees, both of us were not impressed. I felt like we could have made something better at home.

My husband and I had dinner at Spasso New Years Eve. We did expect it to be noisy and crowded, but this was over the top. I had heard so many good recommendations for this restaurant, due to the fact that all the pasta is supposed to be made from scratch. However, this evening my husband and I didn't select any pasta dishes, but decided to have entree's of prime rib for him and lamb chops for me. The chops were very fat, grissly and hardly warm. It was a very basic dish with no imagination!! Chops, potatoes and gravy and seared asparagus. The only good thing on our table was the wine.

The service was very haphazard with the wait staff looking after too many tables,
My 12 year old daughter specifically requests eating at Spasso's. Food is always good, the food servers are very friendly and accommodating.
They changed the menu and the prices almost doubled for Christmas Eve. I wish we had been told this when we made our reservation.

We were pleased that our table was ready when we arrived. Our service started immediately and we indicated we were not in a hurry, our waiter was responsive to this. The sampler appetizer was ample for 4 and delicious. We did not feel rushed, our entrees were delivered in a reasonable amount of time. However, one entree was cold - the melted cheese had hardened on the canneloni - so we sent it back to kitchen.
Unfortunately for most people sitting in our section - a very loud group of 5 men were seated right next to us. I finally signaled to one of them to please keep it down. We might have lingered a while over coffee and dessert, but it was so loud we had to leave.
Three of the four of us enjoyed our food and would return.

This is one of our favorite restaurants in restaurant "row" on Laurel in San Carlos. We mostly go for lunch, and like to sit outside with tapas and wine flights. The food is varied and generally very good, plus the noise level is not too high, unlike some of the other restaurants in the area. On a cold evening, you should stay away from the front door, where it can be cold.
We took friends of ours thier for the first time and everything was superb.

We had a group of 8 for a workplace celebration, food was fantastic, staff took care of the group's every need. Favorite dishes were the Spasso sampler (ordered 2 for the table), Filet Mignon and Paella.
Nothing outstanding. Pasta sauces too sweet. Hardly memorable. Better choices on Laurel to be had.

I've been to Spasso twice and both times the food has been good, ambience is nice and the service is really slow. The kitchen is really fast with getting food out, however the server seems overwhelmed with tables and prioritizes the larger tables for the smaller ones in the corner. I would recommend this place to a friend if they were not in a hurry.

San carols has a lot to offer and this is one of them,
Great food. Great service and a fun vibrant scene.

To families with children, when you bring you children to dinner, please have them keep their shoes on and use a chair. People are paying a lot of money to enjoy their dinner and aren't your babysitters. It's rude to have your children run around a restaurant. Restaurant was good, good food, good service.

I was searching to dine with my girl friend in Redwood City/San Carlos area. I googled and Spasso came up. Got a table for two by the window looking onto outdoor dining, bar on the right side of us. It was a secluded table in a corner. The waiter told us the special menu of the day before we looked at the extensive menu, so much to choose from. We decided to order the combination appetizer, with fried calamari, beans, beef skewers, artichoke hearts. The beef was so tender and tasty. Did not care much about fried food. We also ordered a salad and the special pea soup. Both good and could not resist the chocolate lava cake.

We came for my Mother's birthday lunch and sat outside ( I have a dog), our waiter Louis ( who is our favorite) was there to greet us and had our table ready. He is so accommodating and always pleasant. The food never disappoints and we had a great time! Louis surprised her with a birthday dessert of bread pudding which we all enjoyed. Everyone that I bring to Spasso's always comments on how much they enjoy the restaurant which is centrally located in the hot spot of San Carlos on Laurel Street.
Great food, great location, wonderful service. I love Spasso!
Been many times and food is always wonderful along with service too

We love the convenience of restaurant being so close to home and having delicious food. The kids love the Cappellini and the bread with the olive oil dip. Kelvin says the Teriyaki skirt steak is the best ever...so tender and tasty. The grilled salmon is excellent too with delicious potatoes and spinach.

We met friends for a delicious lunch at Spasso. They have varied entres from which to choose. You can have small plates, salads, sandwiches, pasta, or a complete dinner. The service was outstanding, and we were allowed to sit and chat after we finished our lunch. Have also been there for dinner. It is an excellent choice whenever you want to dine.

My husband and I went there for our "date night." We made a meal out of the appetizers and side dishes. Even though he's not usually a beans guy, my husband LOVED the cannellini beans that came with his shrimp dish. When we asked about what makes the dish so yummy, the waiter shared with us how they make it and told us many people really enjoy the special basil oil that tops the dish. We had a great night overall!
Been dining at Spasso regularily since it opened. Terrific

My family and I frequent Spasso's regularly, so I admit I'm biased. It seems if there is one thing San Carlos isn't short of its Italian Restaurants. However, Spasso's has one thing that none of the others have - Luis. The food is very good, but what makes going to Spasso such an exceptional expirance is the service you get from a waiter named Luis. Sure, you can find more authentic Italian food served on the Peninsula, but you will not find a better waiter bar none! I should know, I'm a former professional waiter myself. Some restaurants will have great food, but provide a poor dining expirance, others will provide mediocre food, but an exceptional dining expirance. Fortunately, at Spasso one needn't compromise either of these qualities.

Several of us ordered the Petrale Sole, a sizeable portion of fish, served with gnocchi (sp?) The appetizer plate preceding was mostly fried, with the exception of the bruschetta, but good, although the lobster egg roll looked slightly out of place aesthetically. Noise level inside was fairly high because of Spasso's high ceiling. Very enjoyable evening with friends and wine and good food and attentive service.

Sat outside for a late dinner, very charming but could have been more intimate.
Food was above average and exceeded my expectations. Had the mussels, gnocchi and veal piccata. All sauces were outstanding and the gnocchi was melt in your mouth fantastic. Veal fell a little short as it was overcooked and very dry.
Service was fair. Went above to make sure we had what we liked but could have been a little quicker.
All in all a good experience, I look forward to going back.
Nice resturant with great service and great good. The weather has been great and there is plenty of outdoor seating. There even dog friendly outside.
We were a party of 9 with 2 kids and the staff were great! They were so helpful. We'll certainly be back.

Been a regular lunch patron at Spasso's & have always loved it. Unfortunately, dinner was disappointing. First, they did not read the comments section even tho the guy I talked to at Spasso's told me to enter our request for table of 10 in 'comments' since the highest # showing is 6 on Open Table. Had to wait almost 10 mins. for table-which is hard w/ kids & 2 elderly ladies. When sat down, one bowl of bread was brought for the 8 of us. Bread was cold. Asked for more, it was warm. Our drinks came AFTER appetizers-not good. The food was pretty good-salmon tho tasted like it had been boiled first. Spinach was too salty. Service was slow & not good so wasn't happy w/ the 20% gratuity add on - cuz it definitely was not worth 20%.

When we arrived they did not have our reservation, and were quite busy, but they did seat us. We were grateful for that! The place was quite popular and lively. The food was just OK - not bad, but nothing special.
often. It has really gone down hill. No consistency no flavors. Hope you can get back on track. Wonderful people who run the restaurant, but the food lacks.
Enjoyed their special scallops and the chicken in pancetta for lunch topped off with the best bread pudding in San Carlos!

A friend and i celebrated my birthday here. The waiter was funny when he brought a piece of cheesecake with a lit candle and wished me happy birthday but told me I definitely did not want to hear him sing. Spasso is excellent for small plates and wine but also for entrees such as filet mignon and chicken parmesan. The wait staff is always friendly and attentive but not overbearing. The food is always served at the perfect temperature and cooked to perfection. We love going here.

we were a party of 4. my mother uses a walker. i had requested a table with easy access for her. we were seated earlier than our reservation time. the wait staff was attentive without being overbearing. the mother's day menu was smaller than normal but offered a great variety of dishes. none were over priced for the holiday. our orders included: spinach salad with chicken, canelloni, spasso salad and penne with chicken in a creamy tomato sauce. our meal was prepared and served very fast. no long wait due to the holiday. each dish was prepared very well. we finished our meal with creme brulee.. it was excellent.. another plus was that there wasn't a price-fixe menu. i would recommend trying spasso's anytime.

We arrived with 4 kids and 2 moms, expecting the lunch menu "with some extra items for Mother's Day". I had told our party to expect brunch. My bad. It was a dinner menu, with no satay, no burgers, fewer tapas, and mostly entrees that kids aren't too crazy about. (Not the menu on the Spazzo website). The food was quite good, so it wasn't a total bust, but I was very disappointed that it wasn't what we expected nor was it advertised as such. I checked the menu online and called the restaurant to check before we went, so I really tried to do my homework. I even stopped by during the week. In the end, I felt bad that I dragged another family out for a meal they didn't plan for so I picked up the whole tab. At least that made me feel better.

Met friends there recently for drinks & tapas/appetizers. Spasso has a great selection of those items, and we had a good sampling of the menu. We chose an outdoor table, which was perfect for talking and enjoying a warm pleasant evening. Both the food and the service were very good.

We love this place...the food is always really, really good. Their menu has a lot of choices, with appetizers, salads, tapas, entrees, etc. I usually like to get a small bite and a salad and their tapas are perfect! Their cocktails leave a little to be desired though....

The atmosphere is friendly, as is all of the staff. Our party of six had a delightful dinner. My husband loves thewarm cabbage salad. We enjoyed the pastas and fish special. For dessert we shared the bread pudding and creme brule. The service is attentive and helpful. It is a bit noisy, but we really enjoy eating here.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in San Carlos. Their food and service never disappoint. It can get quite noisy, so it's not really a tranquil spot, but it's great food in an energetic atmosphere.
Had a great evening out with the ladies and we very well taken care of! The food was delicious, ambiance was fun and we will return.
We come here to celebrate birthdays. Love this place!
We had lunch and the food was delicious. Service was impeccable.The menu is interesting and varied and it was hard to chose among the many choices.

This trip to Spasso was with business colleagues who were in town from New Zealand. We ordered a bunch of small plates and had drinks before they had to return to SFO for a night flight. Polenta cubes, crab cakes, piquillo peppers--these are some of the tastiest things on the menu of small plates. But we eat at Spasso often and have never had even a mediocre meal--it's all been stellar. Great food, delicious drinks, and the nicest, prompt service.

Spasso is a neighborhood favorite... full of flavor, style, great blend of friendly atmosphere where you feel at home combined with deliciousness. The starters from seafood spring rolls to truffle mushroom bruschetta culminating with great fish specials of the day - you can't miss.

Spasso was such a nice place for my wife and I to celebrate our 24th wedding anniversary. We each had a nice martini, shared a warm cabbage salad, enjoyed perfectly prepared Halibut and Skirt Steak, and finished off the meal with a wonderful cobbler for dessert. We were at a nice table by the window and were able to quietly enjoy a one-on-one conversation. The service was very good and we thoroughly enjoyed our experience.
This was our second trip to Spasso and it was much better than our previous visit. There seemed to be more wait staff. The food was incredible and we really enjoyed our evening there!
Pretty bad front and wait staff

Really good service - we got there at 6:45p for a 7p reservation - didn't get seated until 7:15p (busy Fri night) They gave us a 2 free glasses of wine for the delay. The food was yummy (try the walnut crusted pork) It was a little loud (one table of 6 was the main noise maker) but very rustic Italian, would def go there again.

We love this restaurant. The service is always friendly. Sitting outside in the CA sunshine is always great. The black pepper pasta, the chicken parm, and many of the small plates (the polenta cubes and the piquillo peppers in particular) are delicious. The wine list changes often enough to keep it interesting. We've never had a bad meal here and most often the meals are outstanding.

The food was really good however the service was very slow and we were slammed right next to another table. I think next time we will ask to sit outside. They have some beatiful heaters outside that create a wonderful ambiance.

Excellent! Would highly recommend it ! With All the entrees going by our table and it was difficult to decide what to get because they all looked so great! Our salmon and warm cabbage salad was wonderful

food very good, but a little pricey. 5 little scollops for $28 special of the day. Very crowded tables lined up along the wall all 2 tops. The tables for 4 were much better. Was a very cold and windy night and we could feel the cold air everytime someone can in the front door. Overall a very good place for good food, well prepared by a chef, not just a kid cooking meat. I will go back but it will be a while. I would try this place anytime. Give it a try and judge it for yourself, I would give it 4 stars overall.
We had the greatest dinner. We loved Spasso, and will go again real soon.

The waitress came up twice to take our order and when we hadn't looked at the menu yet, she failed to come back again and I had to flag down the bus boy to get her to take our order - maybe 30 minutes after we arrived.

The service was attentive at first but since we were slow to order, the service became slow. (Perhaps we brought that on ourselves.)

The food was OK but not great. I've heard good things about this restaurant and feel perhaps my friend and I ordered something (crab cake sandwich) which is not one of their better dishes. The dressing on the salad was tasteless and heavy. I will return, based on the good opinions of the restaurant from others, but this dining experience was not the best.

Have been there 3x and each time the food and service was delicious.
And it is quiet so you can actually hear the people at your table!
We loved it. Some of the best risotto I have ever had. Wine selection was great too!!
The food and service here were top notch. The ambience was okay. No view because it's downtown. Parking was not too hard to find. Overall we enjoyed our experience very much.
Ate dinner in celebration of friend's birthday and they secretly followed my request on Open Table to put a candle in her dessert for a quiet acknowledgement. It was perfect. Dinner was tasty.

Service was outstanding, we were a group of four and two of the dinners were good, two of us ordered scallops and were not prepared well. We will be back, just ordering something else. Very friendly and owners always greet with a warm welcome, return guests.

Overall, our party of four liked Spasso. The food was good, but not outstanding. We had a reservation for 7PM, but were not seated until about 7:30. This is the second time in a row that we've booked a reservation through OpenTable and ended up getting seated much later than our reservation time. Is this happening to other people?
Food was good, but nothing special. Classic Italian.

We had reservations at 730pm and didn't get seated until 800pm. It was really crowded with no room at the bar because people were eating their meals at the bar so needless to say I wasn't happy! When we were finally seated at our table the owner brought us to appetizer dishes, a fried calamari and bruschetta. That was a very nice gesture and we appreciated it. The food was very good and service too. The restaurant is very small and so that is probably the problem with seating but if it wasn't for the wait I would have rated it higher. All in all it is a very good restaurant and I would recommend it to my friends and I would go back. Just be prepared to wait!
I am a huge foodie. Every time into this restaurant the food is excellent!
The lamb special was perfect and delicious. They sure know how to make everything flavorful!

I made a reservations through Open Table for 7:30pm on Friday. When we got there it was packed and several parties were waiting. I asked how long it would be for our table and they said 20 minutes. This has happened before and we have waited 45 minutes, even though we made a reservations through Open Table. They make you wait for your table and sit you based on who arrived first, regardless of a reservations. Although I like the food, I am not willing to wait 45 minutes despite the fact that we made a reservations.
Love it! One of our favorite places.
We had another great family dinner celebration. With picky eaters and a couple with food allergies we still had a hearty devious meal. Thank you Spasso you made our time together wonderful.
We've eaten here before, and it was better. Xmas Eve menu was more or less the usual stuff, at higher prices.

Spasso is one of my favorite places to dine because the food is fresh and simply made. On Saturday I enjoyed the rack of lamb with a pepper sauce and my dad ordered sea bass (fresh). The malbec wine (Uraguay) I ordered was excellent and only cost $32 a bottle.

The food was excellent, it's nice and quiet so you can actually
hear the people sitting across from you at the table, nice
place for a group work lunch.
Surpassed my expectation. The dishes were wonderful. The only gripe I have if any is the bread. It was a bit cold.

Food was good and reasonably priced, but it is so noisey we could not communicate effectively with the couple across the table from us. Also, don't sit near the door unless you like people waiting for a table hanging around (very) nearby while you eat!

We had a wonderful time celebrating my son's birthday. The calamari appetizer is delicious and a nice touch that it's mixed with beans and artichoke. We had our favorites again...the grilled salmon and cappellini and may parents really liked the grilled teriyaki steak and chicken penne. It was a nice touch with a birthday ice cream for my son. The service is excellent and a definite favorite of ours now.

Spasso's food is always great. Their outdoor seating is available year round as they have heaters outside as well. I've never had a bad meal here, and the service is consistently wonderful. The only reason I'm not giving an overall 5 stars is it's pretty noisy and they really pack you in tightly. But if you are looking for good food and good service, they are 5 stars overall. We go back frequently.
We took a friend there for their birthday and it was a great hit.
Great food and excellent service.

When trying to decide where to eat, remember Spasso's.
They offer friendly service, nice atmosphere, and excellent food.
You can't go wrong.
Delicious food, awesome service. I loved the decor and ambience!I went with colleagues from work and I plan to go back soon with my family.

Spasso was crazy-busy the night we had a reservation. Because we had to wait for the table, the restaurant gave us free wine to enjoy while we waited. That was a lovely touch. The food is always fresh and delicious. That night I had a filet mignon with blue cheese, garlic potatoes, and asparagus. My husband had the black pepper fettuccine, which is one of his favorite things at Spasso. The food was delicious and prepared just perfect. We love Spasso. They are great for small plates too.

Everyone there was friendly yet efficient and they even brought us a complimentary treat as we decided what to order.

The wine list was excellent and our server artfully paired a crisp and refreshing sauvingon blanc with our halibut special. The best halibut ever - cripy crust and moist inside, served with lightly steamed spinach and polenta - a very generous size serving.

A definate repeat.

This was our first visit to Spasso's. We went with a group of 4 for my wife's Birthday. The severs were very nice and attentive. The food was good. Nothing jumped out as amazing but good for the price. The wine list was large but a little too pricey for the wines offered. Overall a good experience but I think next time I will bring my own wine and pay the corkage fee.
Enjoyed lunch with friends. Service very good and salad, canneloni and spaghetti entrees were very good. We ate every bite!

We got seated right away despite the fact that 1 person was running late. The service staff was very accommodating and had great timing when order taking, water pouring, food serving , etc. Food was excellent! I would definitely go back.

Great place on Laurel Street.
- Friendly staff.
- Great food.
- Nice ambience.
- Walkable neighborhood.

Go back again.

We were celebrating our anniversary dinner with our kids and so we ordered a few items to share. The calamari with beans and artichoke were tasty. The bread with the olive oil dip was delicious. The Caesar salad was a little small but still good. The Cappellini was so delicious and perfectly al dente that we ordered another one! The grilled salmon with potatoes and spinach was excellent and had a nice grill taste. The lava warm chocolate cake was a nice dessert ending to the meal. The service was good too...waiters kept water filled, cleared tables and gave us more bread.

Spasso - beautiful decor, wonderful wine list, excellent food!
Chicken Parmigiana was perfection.
Delicious food and great service, Try the Warm Cabbage Salad YUM

Always great food!
Thanks for your excellent accomidation when we changed out meal time.
Outside table was perfect. Inside much too noisey. Otherwise wonderful

Spasso is my favorite restaurant in San Carlos, which says a lot given the many great restaurants in S.C. The food, service and ambiance are wonderful, and of course I can always have a glass of my favorite wine, Rombauer.

I had the Salmon which I should have ordered medium rare instead of medium but it was good. We had dinner on a Saturday night and it was noisy. The restaurant staff was moving tables around next to us which added to the noise level. We will go back to Spasso's during the week rather than on a Saturday. The service was good.
The food is always good and never disappoints
My parents were in town so we had to bring them to Spasso's. The food is always Consistant and Delicious. It's another hidden gem to share.
Spot-on perfection as always!

A neighborhood gem with a high quality menu and a casual comfortable atmosphere. Outside in the sun or inside under the skylights, Spasso is a great, dependable delicious time. Best bread pudding in the Bay area!
Excellent wine selections, really good food and the owner/staff always make you feel welcome.

We had a very nice lunch for my friend's 50th Birthday however, the prawns special did not taste very fresh for those who ordered it. it was also over-cooked - so that was a bit disappointing. we normally also receive a complimentary birthday dessert but we were charged for all 3.

Always great food and service. Only thing negative I would say is I wasn't happy with their crab cakes. They looked like small little hockey pucks. Put everything else is great and the crab cakes are not going to stop me from going back.

Warm Cabbage is the best along with any pasta. You can order flat bread with smoked salmon from across the street Wine Cask their Sister restaurant Wonderful! No corkage on Sunday or Monday nights add to the wonderful experience.
food was wonderful and service exceptional. Many great choices to pick from including interesting appetizers. Wine choices by the glass were really nice, too.

We LOVE Spasso, particularly for lunch on a weekend, but any day the food is tasty, the service is friendly and efficient, the atmosphere is relaxing. And sitting outside watching the dogs go past with their people, while we drink great wine and indulge in tapas, is a great way to spend a Sunday early afternoon. The piquillo peppers stuffed with goat cheese, the polenta cubes, the beef carpaccio, all are delicious. Their NY Style cheesecake melts in your mouth.
Wonderful Warm Cabbage Salad and great Pastas. Sit outside and watch the people walk by while you have a wonderful meal.
Our fourth visit and one of the best experiences yet. Food and service was very enjoyable.

Spasso is our go-to place for dinner. My wife's favorite is the unfailingly good capellini, while I browse the salmon, pork chop or paella. The paella in particular, if the right cook is on duty (ask Luis), while not a traditional crunchy-rice, wood-fired Spanish number, is simply delicious. The wine list is mid-range and well-chosen, drawing on the stock of the wine bar across the street owned by the same people. Great family place. If you're into admiring babies and precocious kiddies, you'll not be disappointed. If you want to ignore the kids, they somehow, magically don't intrude. I can't explain it, except that apparently Spasso attracts very good parents.

The food was outstanding. My husband had the pork chop with the sweet potatoes, it was delicious, perfectly cooked and a very generous size pork chop, He took left overs home, which i so enjoyed the next day for lunch! I had the seafood with pasta, another delish dish. our kids had the kids mac and cheese, my only complain that my daughter who is bordering 12; wanted a bid of a bigger portion.
Our server, Eddy; was on top of things and very attentive!
Great Father's day spent at Spasso's!

Spasso has a respectable wine list and is great for tapas. Go and sit outside and watch the people walk down Laurel Street with their dogs and eat the polenta cubes, the piquillo peppers, any of the skewers, and/or the eggplant and drink some stellar wine and you'll be very happy. Great service and wonderful, friendly atmosphere.

Really enjoyed Eddie at the bar. The pork chop & veal picatta were very good and generous.
It was packed and very noisy. Do not know what they can do about that?????
Had a great time again - took my out of town family guests and they loved it too!

Again always a great meal everytime. The service is top notch. Thank you again Spasso's for making dinner and I don't have to do the dishe! afterwards! For Mothers Day we went to a Resturant in Burlingame....afterwards we both said to ourselves," we should have gone to SPASSO'S instead. The food had changed. At SPASSO'S it's consistent and delicious.

Spasso continues to shine as a neighborhood favorite. We've been there from the start and the subtle adds and changes to the menu keep it fresh and exciting. The new truffle bruschetta is amazing. Bravo!

Came here for lunch recently. Made a reservation for an outside talble but was given one inside. They don't take reservations for outside apparently, even though you may request it. It wasn't busy but the service was very slow. It took a while for the waitor to take our order and to tell us that they had a 2nd menu as well. The food was pretty good however, fresh and pretty tasty. Everyone seemed to enjoy the meal. Prices are reasonable as well.

I think that out of the Italian style restaurants in the area, this is the best option. Will be back.

Great outdoor seating (under an overhand), interior design is like being in a an Italian bistro. Wonderful food - had the sword fish special a top gnocci with olives and artichoke hearts. Good wine list, great neighborhood find even though it is not my neighborhood, it is worth the 15 minute drive to get there.

The appetizer sampler plate was very good and demonstrated a small variety of flavor offerings. However the crab cake was mostly filler with little to no crab flavor.
My wife and I order 2 separate veal dishes - she had the spinach cannelloni with veal and I opted for the veal parmigiana. Her canneloni veal filler was bland and dry and the spinach was over-powering throughout the entire dish.
My veal was sliced extremely thin and again dry.
My wife ate maybe 3-4 bites and I took half of mine to go.
While our server was very attentive, they're performance did not affset the lack in food quality. When asked how everything was, we explained the dissatisfaction with the overall meal; taking the time to discuss in detail. We will not be back

My wife and I were quite hungry, so enjoyed that the first two courses being delivered quickly. There was a lot of time before the entrees arrived. My wife was eating slowly, and was asked at least three times whether she was done. This will be enough to reconsider going back- there are plenty of other options. That being said, we enjoyed the food quality, and the service of filling water glasses and such was efficient. My wife and I both enjoyed our respective wine flights (three wines along a theme).

My husband uncle from New York was in town. We knew Spasso's was the PERFECT place for dinner. He was impressed not only with the amazing food but the superb and friendly service/atmosphere. My young daughter was kept busy with crayons and drawing for us. Spasso's menu is impressive and you can't go wrong! Highly recommend them to friends and family. They treat you as if you're one of the family.

Don't go there especially if you prefer punctual.
They overbooked reservations, everybody had to wait at least 45-80 minutes from the reservation time.
Bars and inside, even outside streets are packed up since they booked too many people plus amazingly OpenTable reservations are still available online at that time.
There were not seats, not even standing areas to wait my reserved tables for 60 minutes, which is ridiculous for reservation people.
Even seated, it is not relaxed at all due to too many people standing around tables, too.
I don't think they ever manage reservations or don't care reservations at all.
Top marks on the starters; great carb friendly options and excellent service, as always. Can't wait to be back outside in the near future.
Great food. I had the polenta cubes and a warm cabbage salad. Our group of four shared the wonderful Grand Marnier orange creme brulee for dessert....the best!

The Food was delicious. We were there for a party of 14 but the service was still impeccable. We decided to eat familiy style and everything was spot on. The gnochhi was fresh, the mushroom bruchetta was delicious and the beef carpaccio was the best I have ever had. The beef satay was surprisingly flavorful all the pasta dishes were served al dente and piping hot. The owner Marco is extremely accomodating and willing to make sure that the dining experience is perfect. He even got behind the bar to make a special birthday shot for the party. Try it out. You can thank me later.

Went for the small plates and appetizers. Food was really good, there isn't a lot to choose from though. There isn't a lot of places to choose from for tapas on the peninsula. Enjoyed my night there, will go back, but it wasn't anything spectacular.

The ravioli wasn't very good. The filling inside the ravioli was dry and undercooked. Also, the peas were not a fitting addition to the sauce. The only thing I enjoyed about the dish was the sundried tomatoes.
The decor was outdated and the booth seats needed to be redone. The salad was overdressed and pasta greasy. Halibut ravioli, the fish tasted past it's prime. Won't be going back.
We loved Spasso, can't say enough good things about it.

We had a reservation for 7 pm and were not seated till 7:40pm. There were at least 2 other parties that waited as long as we did. While they did comp us a couple appetizers and after dinner drinks, they way way underestimated their turnover rate. I would not go again unless I knew for sure that my reservation time could be honored. It is a shame since their food and service are very good other than scheduling.

Have been to Spasso several times, but it has been a while since our last visit. Service was rushed and food was OK. My wife's food was cold. Noise level was energetic. Maybe some time before our return, if at all.
Went for my wife's birthday and had an exception time. A great local restaurant.

Maybe my expectations were set high after hearing all the great buzz on Spasso. Needless to say, I left disappointed. We arrived a few minutes late, only to wait for our table to be set. The place was packed and extremely noisy. I could barely hear my husband from across the table. The food was good, but not as fantastic as I had heard. Finally, the service was mediocre at best. I can go to three other Italian restuarants on Laurel Street and feel like I am the most important customer. At Spasso, I felt like I was just another diner with a credit card.

Usually Spasso is a very relaxed, calm and romantic atmosphere and Valentines Day was definitely not that way. It was loud with groups of people and you couldn't hear each other talking. Food was good but portions were very small. Not the norm for Spasso. I have been there for dinner several times and have been very pleased. This time I was a little disappointed especial considering it was Valentines Day.
Went on Valentine's Day and even though it was very crowded, the staff were awesome and the food was great.

We went to Spasso's for lunch and sat outside. The food was fabulous. The four of us each had a different entree and thoroughly enjoyed our lunches. The service was courteous but not rushed. I have suggested Spasso's to my husband for a great lunch spot. Would love to try it for dinner.
Food was great service excellent but it is overly noisy

Everything was great. A big improvement over the new years dinner. I had the filet mignon and it was cooked perfectly and had great flavor. Everyone enjoyed their meals. The desserts are also excellent. The feedback I got from my wife and my mom was that the Cappellini could have used more sauce and flavor.

Great for outdoor dining and tapas and wine. We love Spasso. We love the delicious food, the patio seating, and that people bring their dogs to this restaurant. Excellent polenta cubes, salads, piquillo peppers stuffed with goat cheese, and eggplant caprese.
Large, varied wine list with nice range of lower and higher priced bottles!

I have never been here for lunch, but have eaten here many times for dinner..I was not disappointed; the service was excellent and the lunch very good. We friend and I shared three starters and one dessert. It was perfect, and I will come again.

Fabulous food. We loved this place. It was dinner for 7 and 1 was a 9 year old. They were great with him and we saw several other children in the restaurant. It was very busy, so obviously not a secret, but worth the wait. Friendly staff that didn't seem ruffled by the crowd. They knew the menu and went out of their way to take care of us. Highly recommend Spasso.
Don't take the table by the front door on a cold night.
We were not impressed with the food or service. Despite having made a reservation, we had to wait for a table.
always a great experience & we so look forward to a reason to go. Sometimes we need no reason :)
Nice assortment of appetizers and small plates. Great service, got us out in 45 mins without feeling rushed. Nice assortment for vegetarians.
Great time. Good food. Cozy. But they didn't have my Open Table reservation so had to wait 20 min. However, they brought us complimentary drinks while we waited.

My friend and I went here to celebrate his birthday with tapas, wine, dessert, and coffee. We sat outside under the heaters and next to the heat lamps on a chilly evening but we were warm and enjoyed living in California, with delicious local wines and CA-grown food at Spasso. The wait staff is always just the right amount of attentive, the food arrives relatively promptly, and everything tastes great.
went to celebrate friend's birthday- great restaurant.
We enjoyed our meal very much. The lamb was cooked to perfection and the waiter was very happy to make a substitution for an ingredient when asked. We will be back.
Best chocolate martini in town....
Food was not great and service only slightly better.

We always enjoy Spasso. However, the reservation we made with Opentable was lost or not recognized upon arrival. They accommodated us after a short wait. There are several Italian restaurants within the same block and Spasso was covered up on a Sunday night, while others were near empty. That tells you a lot! A good casual choice in San Carlos.
Good food, good service, what more could we ask for. Killer creme brulee!

Spasso was full when we arrived for our 7PM reservation, so we had to wait 30 minutes at the bar for our table, which was positioned directly in front of the kitchen in a high traffic area. Not the best location for quiet conversation! Othewise, the food and service were good. I'd ask for a different table next time, and hope to be seated more promptly.
Great food, relaxed atmosphere. We were there 3hrs on a Saturday night and no pressure. Very loud/energetic inside
Food consistently good...great waiter
Was there on a Tuesday night, not as crowded, so not as noisy as a weekend night. Food still great, my favorite, warm cabbage salad was wonderful.
This restaurant has become a consistent performer for quality food. Excellent, personalized service!

We alway enjoy eating here.. We are always greeted and feel welcome. The atmosphere is very friendly and warm. The food here is always good, whether it is pasta, steak, chicken, or fish; our party of six had a sample of them all. Our desserts tonight were outstanding. We shared a peach/apple dessert and the ice cream sundae.
The calamari and portabello polenta was delicious. The cappellini pasta was tasty but slightly too al dente. The mista salad was good too.

Everything we had was very good, Laurel St., is a happening! Try the truffle mushroom bruschetta. warm cabbage salad, special of the night; pecan crusted sea bass & lamb shank were all very good. For dessert bread pudding and warm peach cobbler yummy!
Food and service are always good!

A disappoining experience based on poor management of Opentable reservations. I had an 8 pm reservation. When I checked in with the maitre d', she asked where I made my reservation. When I said Opentable, she then asked when and had to look for it. By 8:20 pm, we had to leave because it was clear we were not going to be seated in the next few minutes.
food is consistantly great - always an enjoyablt dinner :)
Only drawback is the noise level.
It was a bit difficult to carry on a conversation in the dining room. It was very loud. Our waitress was excellent.

Spasso is great for small plates and wine and for full entrees. Sitting outside and watching people while eating is one of the additional benefits of going to Spasso. Often dogs relax on the patio with their people which is great too. The polenta squares are fabulous.

THE ATMOSPHERE IS GREAT. OUR SERVER DID AN OUTSTANDING JOB. THE COCKTAILS WERE VERY GOOD FOR THE PRICE. WE ENJOYED

THE DINER.
It was very good. They are very consistent and really nice people. They are willing to please and take input at any time.

This restaurant was a great find! My husband and I loved the food and the service.
We celebrated our anniversary there and we would definitely go back. Great pasta dishes!
In laws were visiting from Sacramento Area and took them here for another GREAT MEAL. Going again this weekend with some friends to show it off. Thank you Spasso for excellent food and service.
Got the best chocolate martini.......
ALWAYS GOOD FOOD & A GREAT PLACE TO MEET OUT OF TOWN FRIENDS

This was my fourth time eating at Spasso. I've dined there twice for lunch and twice for dinner.
We were early so we were given our choice of seating. It was my friend's birthday and they put a candle in her dessert.
We sat outside and it was a little cramped and somewhat noisy since they seated a party of three right next to us.
The food was good but the birthday dessert was pricey for the portion. The waiter didn't seem happy with his 20% tip.

The perfect place to celebrate our anniversary. The table presentation with a bottle of champagne waiting was the perfect way to begin. The food was wonderful and our dessert was fantastic. Everyone was very attentive to our celebration. Thank you Spasso!

The food and customer service here is exceptional. From the first bite of bread/dip, appitizers, salads/soups, entrees, and desserts. Everything was delicious! A new favorite and will continue to bring family and friends. Our first visit the owner gave us a "Muscat" on the house. We came back with friends and were given a free brushetta appitizer. The food is cooked to perfection and with love. Great place to bring kids as well.
We had group of 8, very accommodating of size. Staff did need reminder about drink order
My wife and I have eaten here many times and we just love it!
Don't miss the pomegranate martini!
Had a lovely 21st Birthday Lunch for our grandaughter, all was wonderful

If you sit out-side and people watch it's fun. But the food is okay on a good day. I don't understand why Italian restaurants can't grasp the concept of how to cook a steak. The last one I had there came out like shoe leather. If they can't cook it, it shouldn't be on the menu. The server we had was a joke, I'm sorry but the restaurant business is people oriented business. The server we had was in the wrong job. He had this attitude of we should be glad he's waiting on us. It's over-priced and considering it's located in place where the competition is high and I'm surprised it's still in business
My wife and I both tried pasta and were disappointed. Would not order pasta again. The salad was good. Perhaps the entrees would be better. Service was good.
A little noisey, but the food was excellent.
The food was very flavorful, presented nicely, and was served in a timely manner. Our party of three never felt rushed. Wines were fairly priced. This was my second visit and I plan to return.
Have dined here three times and always enjoyed a delicious meal with great service.

Brittany our server was great! The food was very good, had appetizers, polenta cubes, wild mushroom w/truffle oil bruschetta*, calamari, pear/walnut salad, saffron pasta*, veal picatta*. *Must try excellent choices. Dessert great bread pudding & peach/apple cobbler/tart.
I've never had a bad meal here. The food is fantastic, and the atmosphere's always hoppin'!
Superb. Marvelous Italian food.

Went to Spasso on a Sunday nice Sunday evening with a 7:30 reservation. We were seated immediately at the table that I had requested when making the reservation. There is also some outside seating. The food was delicious...all of it for both of us. The wine list was ample and the prices were reasonable. It's just become our local favorite.
very noisy on Friday... Musch less so during the week!
One of our family's favorite restaurants. It is a small restaurant so you usually need a reservation. The food is excellent and the staff very friendly and accommodating.
This is our favorite place on the Peninsula
Spasso is my favorite neighborhood restaurant. Great food, excellent service, perfect ambiance.

Our reservation was for 2 people at 8pm. At 8:20, 20 minutes past our reservation time, we hadn't been seated. Previously the food was ok but definitely not worth that kind of wait. We chose to leave.

First time visit...Very nice people and the food was very good also...We'll go back! Busy Friday night, has a full-bar area upon entering and common to the tables area, the customer noise level up in the active range...has nice, street front, outdoor tables for a warm night dining...
Excellent dining experience as in past visits. Exemplary performance by our server and the other wait staff. Veal piccata beautifully executed as was the pasta Bolognese. Recommended.

The service was a little off, not quite as attentive as I would like for the prices. The food was good and the portions were generous, I had the Ahi tuna dinner and my friend has the seafood pasta, both were good. The menu seems fairly standard for Italian fare, nothing that stood out or seemed creative.
Nothing special, like the ambiance
Spasso's consistently delivers great food,, top service, and a great place to relax. Delicious appetizers welcome the pallete to rich entrees and fabulous wine. Bravo
Spasso never fails to impress. Great local find!

I enjoyed the food, the company and the service. I waitress was fabulous and very helpful. The restaurant is small and we had a table right by the kitchen, not my cup of tea but because of the food, the service and the company I didn't let the fact that we were right by the kitchen. I would not want to sit there if I were to dine there again.

We love Spasso! It is probably our favorite restaurant in San Carlos. Our experience this time wasn't as great as normal but I think they were just busy. We arrived for our reservation and they sat us at stable that had just been cleared and not reset with glasses or linens. They set the table while we sat there and then nobody greeted us for approximate 10 minutes. Finally I asked a man dressed in all black who had been milling behind the bar if we could get some drinks and he looked at me strangely and said he didn't do drinks...maybe he was the owner? Finally we got drinks and our server helped us order. My appetizer was extremely salty but I so LOVE the dumplings with mushroom sauce that I didn't care.

We chose Spasso from Yelp as we were looking for a new place in San Carlos to meet for dinner and wanted to try something new. The online menu looked inviting and so we booked a table for Sunday night. (Free corkage!)
We all had the arugula salad (yum!) and the stuffed chicken (double yum), the polenta with mushroom (very yum), skirt steak in teriyaki (also yum) and the vegetable risotto.
We also tried the fried calamari with artichoke and asparagus. I wish there would have been more of the calamari and less of the veges in this selection, but it was great and the two sauces serviced with it were very good.
All the food was delicious and the service was prompt and enjoyable.
We will definately return here! I can highly recommend it!
They were 40 minutes late seating us for our reservation. However, they apologized profusely and comped us and other guests a glass of wine. The food was worth the wait!

I made our reservation through Open Table around noon on Saturday for 6:30pm. We arrived right on time only to find out that they had not checked their computer and did not have us listed. The restaurant was full, and most patrons had just started their meal. We would have had to wait 30-45 minutes for a table but were able to find two seats at the bar where we ate. The good new was that the bartender comped us for our wine.
Eddie, our server, was fantastic -- knowledgeable, friendly, attentive. Food is superb -- fresh, flavors, presentation. Great experience -- really busy between 6:00 and 7:00 Pm on Friday.

Overall we thought that the food was good, but the portions were very small to the price; especially that the ingredients did not stand out. The service bread was chewy and cold, seems like a fast food kind of bread.
The highlight was the Service and corkage fee is $10. We thought that was a very fair price.

I love the family feel of Spasso! The decor and ambiance are perfect for a date, a business dinner, or a delicious meal with friends. I have been here many times and everything is always cooked to perfection, served by the best waiters in the peninsula and typically accompanied by a stop at your table from the owner. Take your pick of the wide variety of great food on the menu, but if you go with the skirt steak or the mushroom rissoto you will be on cloud nine. Give it a shot, you won't be disappointed.

Consistently high quality food and excellent customer service. Great location for friends to get together or a romantic dinner out. I forgot half of a coupon at home and they still accomodated us. Very friendly staff who went out of their way to acknowledge my dietary issues and make suggestons for my meal.
Outstanding service and the food wasn't bad either.
We love Spasso. We probably eat there once a month. The staff and owners are great.

They have something going on great in the kitchen. The food was spot-on tastey with fresh ingredients. Go there for that. They really missed it on service. The hostess and wait staff show inexperience. Arriving with reservations, we waited about 40 minutes beyond our reservation to be seated. Clearly, they had not made allowances for reservations. Once seated, the service was hit-and-miss, with our waitresses (which one?) showing up here and there, forgetting drinks. The noise level is off the charts. There is nowhere to stand while waiting for your table because the"wait area" has a table for two pushed in there. Great food, bad service.

Spasso is great for good food (small and large plates), great wine, friendly service, and their wonderful sidewalk seating that lets to your breathe fresh air and watching the passing dogs and pedestrian. We love the goat cheese stuffed peppers and the polenta cubes.

We had to wait for our reservation so ordered drinks at the bar, the bar tender was very friendly, as was our waitress. The restaurant is very noisy but has a fun atmosphere, lots of groups celebrating etc. The sampler appetizer and arugula salad were very tasty, and my friends enjoyed the sole and chicken. Unfortunately the pasta primavera (100% vegetarian) was very boring--I've had much better veggie pasta elsewhere and you'd think it'd be hard to do it wrong! Not sure if I'd dine here again since the only other vegetarian pasta is cappelini (again...easy to make at home so why would I order at a restaurant.) Having said that, my friends really enjoyed the fish and chicken so you'll be safe if you're a meat eater!
Centrally located on Laurel Street, good menu plenty for everyone to enjoy. Friendly service.
Loved the food, very tasty and the service was wonderful!! Would definately eat here again.

Spasso's has always been a favorite of mine but the last two times I've been there the food hasn't tasted the same. Veal canelloni was...bland. Marinara sauce tasted as if it came straight from a jar. Pesto ravioli had way too much garlic - couldn't taste anything else. Sort of dissapointed. What happened?

Spassos was recommended to us by a local. It had a nice trendy feel and the service was very good. The presentation of the food was nice too. All around, a great restaurant find that I would return to and recommend.

Although there was only one other table occupied at lunch, we were not asked if we wanted a drink when we sat down, nor did our server ever revisit the table after she served our meal. The veal picatta and fries were very good, as was the arugula salad. The clams and mussels, however, weren't fresh and full of grit.
Love this restaurant every time I go back. So lucky to have it in my neighborhood. Have never had anything but great food there.

It is a warm and comfortable restaurant. You walk in and you feel like you are in a small family owned restaurant in the Italy. The Arugula salad was delicious and the Lamb sirloin was so tender. The portions are just the right size. Our server was very polite, friendly and attentive.

Great place! Our family loves going for dinner to Spasso. Great manu and kid friendly!
Highly recommend!

We've enjoyed Spasso's on many occasions. They seem to be crowding in more tables lately, causing food to be delivered more slowly (and colder). The noise level seems to be increasing as well. Otherwise it was a treat as always.
Food and service is always outstanding. Love this place!

We had a great meal here on Friday night. It was the Tree lighting in San Carlos so the streets and restaurants were packed with people. We had made a reservation and were seated right away.. Great wine recommendations also
I love the people in here and they couldn't be more upbeat. The menu needs to change and the food is ok.

My date (blind) liked it and the ambiance, thought it was like being in Italy. I wasn't so excited about it, but it was OK. We didn't have anything other than appetizers/salad and wine so can't really comment on food. I clearly asked the wait person to serve the appetizer and salad together but he forgot, and he didn't come by to ask how things were so I could remind him...and of course, I couldn't remember what he looked like--my bad. The place was fine.

I like Spasso. But this time I made a reservation for my husband's 40th birthday and talked to someone on the phone to make a a little surprise.
When we got there, the receptionist welcomed us with "happy birthday" but waiters didn't know about that and after the main dish she brought us a dessert menu and I was so dissapointed.
They are very nice and food is very good.
Excellent food, excellent servcie, great ambiance, and above all: consistent. What more do you want?

Would have appreciated better service. The food was fine. The drink I ordered tasted bad, so I asked for a replacement. When I didn't drink that one, it should have been obvious something was wrong. The servers (seemed to be several) didn't care enough to ask. Minor thing - but it impacts how we felt about our experience there. I didn't want to be a complainer, so relied upon the server to take note. When something is not touched, something is wrong. Ask the customer. Or - lose the customer.

Great service, but disappointing food. Came here with a reservation for 3 on a busy Saturday evening. Not sure if the restaurant is this packed every weekend, because it was the weekend of the Art & Wine Festival in downtown San Carlos (and the weather was SUPER nice, so the patio was full also). Despite the busy crowds, we were seated promptly, and received attentive and friendly service. We split the arugula salad with poached pears (the best item of everything we ordered), and the calamari appetizer. The calamari had good texture, but was bland. Also, there wasn't enough calamari proportional to the other fried items (artichoke hearts, green beans) with which it is served. The two sauces that came with the calamari was unfortunately just

Notwithstanding that I had Open Table reservations, no table was held for my party.  As my reservation date coincided with the 2010 San Carlos wine/street fair, walk in customers were allowed to completely fill the restaraunt. We were told we could wait on the street for 'about 30 minutes'. What is the value of a reservation if it is not honored by the restaraunt?  As my party never got to taste the food, I have rated it poor.

I had a great time there, it was my first and I would definately go back, all our meals were fabulous, and the service was first rate, they really wanted to please you. Cant wait to go again. We went early 5:30 but by 7:30 it was full of happy diners.
The food was very good as usual.
We've always liked Spasso. The food is consistently great, the wine list is good and fairly priced. Service? It depends on how busy they are but even on the busiest nights they are attentive.
In this era of chain restaurants, Spasso is a blessing. Delicious, carefully prepared foods; warm, authentic atmosphere; terrific service. A pleasure every time I go.
We are sooooo lucky to have this restaurant in San Carlos. It is always awesome. I have never had a bad meal there, and the service is fantastic.
