Service and ambiance were fine. The food while not flawed was also not inspiring. A solid place but not spectacular.
Loved the food just as much as last year! If not more.
One of my favorite restaurants in the bay area. Last night's dinner another piece of perfection. Thank you!!!!!!!!
We had a great dining experience!
Spasso continues to be a San Carlos favorite. It is a more intimate than some of its neighbors on Laurel and the service is a little more personal. The warm cabbage salad is especially interesting.

We love to go here for lunch and to sit outside and drink wine and order tapas (the polenta cubes, the skewers three ways, the goat cheese stuffed peppers--these are our favorites) and follow that up with an entree salad per person. The wait staff is always top notch (there when you need them but they never hover or annoy) and the food is always scrumptious. The wines by the glass change often enough to keep it interesting so diners can always try something new.
Wonderful food. Great service! Fun outdoor table. Loved it and go back often

The food was not as good as usual. I think it was due to the cooling down outside and so the crabcakes were served cold both times. The prawns in bisque sauce was great and pork chop was a bit tough. Love that Spasso is in SC though. They are wonderful people.

Spasso is great for tapas and drinks or for meals, and it is a wonderful place to sit outside on a sunny California day and to share your meal with your canine companion. The polenta cubes are especially delicious. I've been eating here every couple of months almost since Spasso opened and we've never had a bad meal here or a wine we didn't like.

I've always had a good experience at Spasso, which is why I chose it to meet some friends for dinner. We all loved what we ordered. Good food & drinks, good service and they gave us a table where it was easy to talk & catch up. So many restaurants now are too noisy to talk.
Another great meal and excellent service. It's one of our all time favorite places.
wonderful neighborhood place to dine. Excellent service and food.

A great mix of fine food, eclectic wine selection and family friendly atmosphere make Spasso a great place to have a nice family dinner during the week or a nigh out with a friend. The owner is always working the bar and interacting with customers. Spasso and their wine bar across the street, The Wine Cask, are both great places to eat and socialize in San Carlos.
Been here many times.  Never dissapointed.
Great neighborhood spot with a great and friendly staff. They definitely try to please the customer.

A very pleasant experience for brunch. Food was good but portions can be improved for those with a good appetite. Service was very good...staff very pleasant. Will return in the evening for dinner to see if food and service is consistent!
We continue to go back for good reasons!
Everything from the cocktails to the dessert was wonderful. An enjoyable experience.
Simply the best restaurant on the Peninsula!
Delicious cuisine with creative touches. Very comfortable ambience and attentive professional service.

We love Spasso. It is a great place to sit outside on the sidewalk with your dog and have wine and tappas or a full meal. My husband and I love to eat their polenta cubes and peppers stuffed with goat cheese drizzled with balsamic and served with tart apple slices, the meat skewers and Spasso's fabulous salads. The service is friendly and efficient. The wine is always delightful.

Food was terrible...I ordered the spring rolls which were dripping in grease. I could not eat them...greasy with no flavor. I also ordered the warm cabbage salad which was inedible...I sent it back. We had virtually no service and I had to ask for the check. Restaurant was not that busy but we were ignored! I will not be returning!
We have tried many restaurants in San Carlos -we will return to Spasso.

This is a restaurant I really like, but the food is slipping a bit.
Wondeful vibes and energy
Great place! My friend I went there to celebrate our birthdays. Everything was excellent, service, food, etc. I love going to this place.
The service was excellent and the food outstanding.

Inviting, comfortable setting; painted window scenes are charming. Tables are arranged far enough apart to avoid "overlapping conversations." Interesting and varied menu, and accommodating service.

The portobello sandwich was a delicious lunch entree; the roll it came on was outstanding. The warm Napa cabbage salad was a very generous size; two of us split it, and it was still a large portion for each. Also split an order of the gnocchi with light tomato cream sauce. The gnocchi were tender, just like they should be.

The servers were friendly and attentive, without overdoing it. All in all, a very nice experience.
Awesome as usual! Great food, delicious starters, and perfect service. Always a great place for a team lunch to a biz dinner. Keep it up!

Dinner was great; service, excellent! It was a perfect evening. In our party of three, two of us had the halibut special - it was wonderful; the third person had the salmon, and it, too, was great! We shared the cheese fondue for an appetizer, and it was delicious.

It's always wonderful to dine at Spasso's..the food comes to the table hot, not lukewarm,
which is what I like....service is always good, menu is varied; a great assortment!
Very enjoyable. Good food. Nice service. very child friendly.

I met my three women friends for dinner. The waitress was attentive, but not intrusive. They let us talk and visit until closing (very important for our group). They have a full service bar - beer on tap, mixed drinks and good wine selection.

We all enjoyed the salads. They were fresh and lightly dressed - yummy along with the bread. I really enjoyed my penne with chicken & sundried tomatoes in a cream sauce. The dessert was okay. I ordered the molten chocolate cake on the waiter's recommendation. Unfortunately, it was over cooked and there was nothing molten about it.

I would return because I enjoyed the rest of the meal, and there are some interesting tapas options. It was an enjoyable experience.
The noise level was over the top. Much prefer to dine outside the next time.
I always enjoy myself when I dine at Spasso. I was dining with two girlfriends celebrating a birthday and we had a great time. Thank you for the wonderful food and service.
Everything was fantastic - food, service, ambience, even our fellow diners. Totally great experience in all ways. We will definitely be back soon.
A colleague and I had lunch as Spasso last week. The food was fantastic, and the servers were very attentive. I definitely enjoyed it, and I will be back!

Met with a group of dads and our daughters before an elementary school dance. Spasso took great care of us. The girls all loved their macaroni and cheese (one of several items on the kids menu). I had a great salad and mushroom risotto. Given the nice ambiance, it was a perfect spot for a fancy dinner before our event.

We arrived on time, however, the restaurant was running late. After waiting almost 1/2 hour at the bar, we were given an appetizer and an apology for the wait. It was totally unexpected and we appreciated their acknowlegement of the time. Our server was delightful, as well as our dinner. I had the special halibut, and my husband had the black pepper fettucine. The warm cabbage salad was as good as always, and the creme brulee dessert was delicious.

The service is always very friendly and professional. You really can't go wrong with any of the appetizers. Our favorites are the polenta cubes and dumplings. The salmon always tops our list of favorite entrees. The wine list is extensive. We love this place!
Fun cocktails, tasty appetizers,the entree specials were outstanding, very good wine list and the service is friendy and attentive. Thank you! See you soon.
WE had a nice dinner with a very attentive waitress.

I cannot wait to return to this restaurant! It was our first time, and we both found other menu items we can't wait to try! It's small, cozy, and the staff is extremely attentive. The food and the staff made it a memorable Valentine's Day dinner.
Spasso is one of my favorite restaurants. Great food and the best Lemon Drops if you have a chance stop by.
service was excellent, food was good
Spasso's is always such a delightful place to dine; food's always consistently good and flavorful, service is always impeccable and staff always cordial and friendly.
Great food...wonderful service. Definitely worth going back again!

I've been to Spasso before usually in the evening and I've always enjoyed the entire experience. This week I went for a "girl's lunch". The food was great (great salads and choices for vegetarians in the group as well) and the staff helped to make the birthday occasion even more festive. My friends came from as far away as Los Altos and thought the drive was totally worth it! Thanks!!

We ate here for our 14th wedding anniversary. Usually when we dine at Spasso we get tapas and small plates and wine. This time we actually started with salad (mista for me and caesar for my husband) and ordered entrees (i had the daily special of sea scallops with spinach and tomato risotto; my husband had the gnocchis in the tomato cream sauce.) Spasso's tomato cream sauce is so delicious; it is one of the best sauces we have ever had. Our food was wonderful. The service was superb. The wine we drank we complementary. For once, we had to eat inside as it was raining buckets outside so we couldn't sit on their small front area. Though it is a little chilly in the front of the restaurant every time the door opens, it was a pleasurable place.
My favorite neighborhood restaurant. Food is great, staff is wonderful, fun place to be.
Warm atmosphere, very good food. Comfortable bar for about 10. Nice place to run into your local friends.

I've eaten at Spasso's several times and have always had a good experience. I like dining outdoors in good weather, but also enjoy the atmosphere indoors. The food is always good, and so is the service.
Our favorite local San Carlos restaruant!

The food was good but not exceptional. Maybe we had false high expectations based on the reviews we read. We had a better meal at La Tosca which is only a few doors down. Spasso is not as cramped as La Tosca but the noise level at Spasso was quite high which makes it difficult to carry on a conversation.
We ate everything - no leftovers. I got the paellea, but I didn't taste the saffron in it. It was missing something. The terriaki skirt steak was excellent. Great service and friendly atmosphere.

This was the first time we have eaten inside the restaurant at Spasso (we usually sit on the patio) and it was very quiet and peaceful, even with other diners nearby. The wine and the food are perfectly paired at this restaurant, where we usually dine on small plates and appetizers. The polenta cubes are scrumptious (my husband who doesn't like polenta inhales these like he can't get enough of them; it's the sauce that makes this dish). We also enjoy the peppers stuffed with goat cheese; the skewers of chicken, prawns, and beef;any of the salads; and the eggplant basil dish. All of these are good with the Poppy Cab or the J Lohr Merlot.
Great restaurant! top service, and lot's of variety on the menu. Have to go back and try some more!

Food continues to be consistently very good, and service is, as usual, excellent. Our waiter, Maximo, did an outstanding job. All the staff works as a team in assuring this high level of service. The minestrone soup was loaded with vegetables and hearty; one of the best around. The veal piccata was a generous portion and well prepared as on prior occasions. The noise gets high on the weekends, yet remains one of our favorite places for great food at a reasonable price.

Service was delightful--they attention to all the details but it seemed like there was nothing on the menu that said "I'm something you can only get at Spasso and I'm delicious." So it was a comfortable meal in a nicely decorated restaurant but I'm more likely to try the neighbors than I am to return.
In addition to a good wine list, their red wines are the right temperature. Food was good and the wait staff was very attentive.
The food and service were excellent.
Not as good as in the past. Recognized no wait staff, hostess or owners? Wondered if there are problems?
Love the menu selections. I have never had anything but an awesome experience at Spasso's.
Spasso delivers consistent quality andd value. We love it. Been going since they opened. We especially like their Filet Mignon. As good as you will find anywhere.

We made a reservation and came in at the correct time. The hostess told us she had no tables available. I said if you don't have any tables why did you take my reservation. I mentioned that I could see at least 4 tables for 4 available. She said a big party of 8 was coming in. They when I questioned her further she said there will be a 10 minute wait. After a few minutes someone came up to us and showed us to a table. It was a though they were doing us a favor by seating us. We were told that they ran out of menu's and we were given 1 for the four of us. After 10 minutes the additional menus showed up. Food was ok, however, the noise level for deafening and we could not have a normal conversation between the four of us.

Enjoyed an excellent salad of chicken, artichokes, tomatos, olives, and greens with an unusual name - caprichosa (?) salad. Dressing is light but flavorful and portion size is very good - filling for a lunch entree. Good bread, too. This restaurant is always reliable in quality of food and service. We went late for a business lunch appointment so were able to talk easily and were not rushed. Highly recommend this restaurant.
Very nice restaurant. Good food and service. Great tapas. Willing to make subsititutions.
Weve never eaten at Spasso during the week. We were not disappointed; the restaurant was busy, and everyone in our party of six enjoyed dinner and dessert.
My only complaint was I really wanted a Bellini, and they didn't have any fruit purees. Had to settle for plain Prosecco.

Food was good. Service was good. I would suggest more additions to their menu, especially on the appetizer section. To reduce the noise I would suggest more Italian Fabrics or Flags be hang to the walls, ceiling. Wine list may be better too.
Have been here several times and always love it each time...great place, with fabulous affordable food!
I always have a great experience at Spasso's. Service is excellent. Wine recommendations are great. Very accommodating to special requests.
Spasso was excellent as always. This is a favorite local spot for my husband and me.
Great menu, food, service and interior! Get the sampler, you won't be disappointed!

Was there with a group and the restaurant added a large table outside so we could enjoy the nice weather. Sometimes the noise level inside can make it difficult to hear when you have more than a few people at the table, and we did not have that problem outside : )
One of our favorite restaurants in San Carlos.  Great food and service.  Everyone is always so friendly....
Enjoyable, as always. One of our favorite local places (we live within walking distance).

We love this restaurant. The food is superb, the outdoor seating lots of fun (to watch the dogs and people), the service is spectacular. We have been here twice and can't wait to go back. Highly recommend the goat cheese stuffed peppers and the polenta squares. The steak sandwich is also very tasty. It all pairs nicely with the J. Lohr Merlot.
Great place in San Carlos. The peppers and goat cheese are my favorite.
I've always had a great meal there. Service is impeccable.

We had a wonderful lunch at Spasso's. We came with a baby in tow--waitress was very helpful setting her up, and smiled and waved each time the baby waved to her. The food was very good and the service was invisible (meaning everything happened as it should without any drama).

My husband and I dined here for a late lunch on a Sunday and we had some of the best food we have ever eaten (along with a J. Lohr Merlot). I highly recommend the polenta squares. My husband hates polenta and he ate half the plate of these, even though I was the one who ordered them. The tomato basil sauce on them is heavenly. We also had the eggplant caprese and the stuffed with goat cheese peppers, a salad, and a chicken sandwich. Everything was so fresh and delicious. We cannot wait to go back to Spasso. We'd definitely order to same foods again, and we look forward to trying other things on the menu.

Our waitress was attentive and very friendly. We strongly recommend this restaurant; it's a great place to relax outside.
Service and food were excellent.

The meal was good, but not outstanding or memorable. I thought my parpadelle pasta sauce was under-seasoned and my mother's rack of lamb also under-seasoned. Loud and energetic atmosphere, so if you want some social energy surrounding you while you eat, try Spasso.

Spasso's captured attention from the moment they opened - and the continued level of quality, success, and consistency are unmatched. The atmosphere is designed to let you focus on the food and service; which are both exceptional. Nothing is too small a request to specialize for your needs. The wine list does a great job of meeting all palates and dishes. The perioidic rotation of new appetizers or entrees is always a welcome new exploration. Truly a great place to visit frequently...
We found the food to be rather ho-hum. Our waitress was quite good however. The place was packed and noisy. They could use a few acoustical treatments to cut down on their echo problem.
Nice restaurant. Surprised by the small lunch crowd as it's packed for dinner.

We visit Spasso's at least once a week... and if we don't, we get cranky. :) The food, the service, the great atmosphere make it one of the best places on Laurel street and the Peninsula to entertain out of towners or to just do a quiet lunch with your special someone. Chef Michael's exceptional execution combined with Marco's amazing service up front always puts a satisfying smile on our faces and happiness in our tummies. Stop reading and go now! :)

This is one of my new favorites. So far it is very consistent, but I think they will need to change the menu every couple of months or the menu will be stale. Alot of the menu is the same as the lunch menu....

The food was very good although nothing particularly unique or creative. The service was very attentive and the restaurant is decorated nicely but it is noisy. We were a party of 5 at a large table and had a hard time talking across the table. The portobello with polenta appetizer was notable as was the teriyaki skirt steak, tender and not over marinated.
Excellent food, excellent staff, great place for any occasion.
Always a wonderful dining experience.

The menu offers a number of interesting choices. We love the warm cabbage salad - that could almost be a meal eaten at the bar. Porcini mushroom pasta has a rich, savory taste. Pork chop wrapped in bacon on Yukon Gold potatoes is also excellent.
So delicious and the waitstaff were so friendly. We were there for almost 2 hours and my 4 year old never got bored or fidgety.
Excellent food as always with great service and innovative specials. Continue to be one of favorite restaurants. Weekend nights can be hectic and noisy. Recommended to all

I love Spasso. Great food, nice ambiance and ALWAYS friendly, wonderful service! Their mashed potatoes with blue cheese are excellent...nice combination of flavors. My husband had that with his filet mignon recently, and was quite pleased. One of my favorite items is the eggplant and mozarella stack, topped with basil and drizzled with balsamic vinegar.

This is a great place to sit outside on a nice day, and they have a nice wine selection to meander through if you like to stick around for awhile. They are the same owners as The Cask, the wine bar across the street.

A very disappointing experience. This used to be one of our favorite restaurants. We loved the food. But we stopped going there sometime ago because, despite always having a reservation, we always had to wait at least 20 minutes to be seated. However, last Saturday we decided to give it another try. Bad idea! We arrived right on time for our 6:30 PM reservation. Then we waited 25 minutes at the very crowded bar before we were seated. In the interim we watched two different couples arrive and then get tables before we did. We received excellent table service by a young man whose name I believe was Byron. But the food has declined substantially since our last visit. It was mediocre at best. We won't be back!

Way too crowded! We were seated at a small table where the wait staff couldn't get through to other tables. I was continuously bumped by the wait staff thoughout the evening. Very unpleasant dining experience. Food was average. Prime rib was chewy.

Another fabulous evening at Spasso. Service is consistenly excellent and very thoughtful - from the hostess to bartender to servers, it is clear that my overall experience is important to them. This has quickly become my favorite restaurant in San Carlos.
Perfect. My Ahi went back for a warm up but it was really done right. i just wanted it a bit hotter.

Spasso's has built an excellent reputation with locals and imports alike. They consistenly deliver exceptional food with some of the best service on the Peninsula. Their portobella muhsroom and polenta appetizer, combined with their filet tips, and their crab spring rolls are glorious; let alone their fabulous Ahi tuna and variety of pasta dishes! To finish... a great selection of scotches, after-dinner wines, and sumptious desserts such as the richest chocolate gelato anywhere. Huge props, Spasso, keep it up!
We are regular Spasso customers, and enjoy many of their entrees. We also enjoy the free corkage on Sundays.
I love this place....I think only place in area that does tapas and GOOD tapas. Outside is great but inside it gets too loud for me. I LOVE that they ACCEPT dogs outside.

Obviously very popular, but based on our experience, it is unclear why. The service was adequate but indifferent; the noise was intolerable and the food was a great disappointment. My pork chop was overcooked and tough and the accompanying vegetables were luke warm to cold. My companion's ahi tuna was tasteless. The salad was the only course that was above average.
Love this restaurant! Great addition to San Carlos. Food always great, atmosphere warm and fun. Good for singles or families.
I always enjoy going to Spasso. Very friendly and great food.
Outstanding menu -- best in downtown San Carlos!

My salmon was great (as always), and my friend's chicken breast was OK. Our waiter just did the basics for us, and seemed a bit impatient at one special request. Overall, dinner was good, but I've had better wait people there in the past.
Our dinner was SO good! It's great to find a place on the Peninsula that is this good. We usually have to go the City to find food like this. What a gem!! Service was very good as well.

we were seated promptly. they were very cordial. food was very good, served hot. we all enjoyed it very much. you get a lot of food. prices were friendly. prompt service. we certainly would go back. it did get rather noisy as the restaurant filled up.
Outstanding food and service. Highly recommended.
The food was delicious, service excellent.

Sent my crabcakes (appetizer) back because the crab tasted very very "off". No offer by staff to get another appetizer for me so I sat and watched everyone else at the table eat. Entree was only lukewarm and 5 tiny scallops. No offer to comp my dessert or anything. Second time I've had a bad experience at Spasso and won't return. Go 2 doors down to La Tosca.
Very good, sometimes there's a wait if there's just 2 of you. Can be very very loud at times!
Menu is diversified, even found several items our picky friend would eat! All of our meals were excellant and it was a very nice atmosphere. The only negative was the long wait for our meals.

Not very good. There was a set menu which we were not informed of, and the food came out to us with rubbery pasta and very dry chicken. Plus we spent $110 on a bottle of wine, and they couldn't even comp us two regular cups of coffee. They did themselves more harm than good trying to get the most money out of valentine's night. The waiters were visibly stressed, and the food was not even close to the quality we've had before.

Since it was Valentines Day, the restaurant had a limited menu. The food was very good, but they should have stayed with thier everyday menu.
We were prompty seated and the servers were very attentive. We did not feel rushed but didnt have to wait for a server to show up. The appetizers and salad were extremely tasty....The main course was just as tasty, but I had my eyes set on a few dishes on the normal menu. I will definitely go back again.
We enjoyed a family Valentine's Day dinner together at Spasso including tasty food, friendly service, and attractive decor. The restaurant has great positive energy and we left with a smile.
Expensive and the food was awful. Ravioli was like rubber. Salad had very little in it. Will not go back.

Open Table res honored on time; quiet at 5:30 on a Wednesday eve. exc. service & the food was plated in an eye catching manner & wonderful flavors; we were too full for desert but will try again the next time. We enjoyed Spasso's & will return again. The carpaccio was to die for!
Overall a solid, perhaps a bit expensive, find. Went for lunch and was not disappointed, but not very many table were occupied...
Very attentive host and wait staff : )
delicious, from the soup, salad, service... to the grilled lamb... we will be back.
Although we had reservations we waited for quite some time and then decided to leave. It seems every time we make reservations here we always have a 20 - 30 minute wait.

Quality of food is not good. Tastes like an inexpensive Italian restaurant and it's not. Also, they didn't honor the Open Table reservation in a timely fashion. Walk ins who are ahead of you get priority. We won't be going back.
Our meals at Spasso have always been outstanding. However, two entrees out of four missed the mark. We will return, again, hoping that this was an off night.

Not sure if it is family owned but feels family owned. Have been 6 times in the past year and will continue. Chef is top notch and caters menu to special needs but the menu is awesome and well rounded Italian. Top notch Italian!!

Another wonderful dining experience at Spasso! The veal piccata continues to be better than we have had at other restaurants: three brown-edged tender veal scallops with great mashed potatoes and spinach. The freshly fried calamari appetizer was a plentiful portion and beautifully done with string beans. Even the chicken chowder surprised. The usual superb service by our waiter, Maximo, is always appreciated. Highly recommended for excellent food at reasonable prices.

Spasso's continues its successful offerings as a great local restaurant for casual meals with friends to power lunches with out of town business guests. The food, the style, the amazing service, and did I mention the great food all keep us coming back as regulars on a weekly basis. Hats off to you all! Keep up the great work.
It was nothing special. Atmosphere, food, service blah. Too many like restaurants in the area.
Food and service were both very good for an early dinner.
The food and service continues to be excellent as in all past visits. The wine list has some excellent values and many unusual selections. We continue to come back!

Spasso is indeed a gem, where the service, food, overall environment and wine is consistently excellent. The owners and staff there clearly take pride in their place, and one feels it throughout one's time there. I give an A+ to Spasso and we look forward to many more lovely evenings there!
Was good italian..nothing spectacular but good. Prices were ok.

I was really disappointed. I had heard great things, but the seafood pasta I had was tasteless and nowhere near the "spicy" promised in the description. My boyfriend's black pepper fettucine was equally tasteless and bland. I will not be going back.

We've had a few nice dinners here. Great for small groups, but probably not as accomodating for a bigger crowd. Portions are on the smaller side, but everything is flavorful and cooked to perfection.
I liked the wine flights, and the wines change from time to time so you can do some sampling. Service is always stellar and the ambiance is quite lovely. Definitely worth a try if you're in the San Carlos area.
had a 7 pm reservation and table was given away to a walk-in at 6:55. had to wait for a less desirable table.
Great service and excellent brunch!
Spasso has been my favorite San Carlos restaurant since they opened. Food and service has been consistently great.
Great dining and the menu provides something for everyone. We went with our sons visiting from college and they loved it!

Food was good and the service was good as well. It's a pretty noisy restaurant and the tables are too close together. I had trouble hearing my friend who sat across from me. The salmon dish was too salty. We had a nice experience but I might just eat at the bar next time due to noise and table close proximity. But everyone was nice and the service was good.
Food was great. Took my daighters there for an early Italian Thanksgiving dinner. The only minus was being served my cup of soup with my appetizer. Felt rushed.

My dining companion thought the food was a bit bland; I disagree, but my food rating reflects both of our experience. I've been there before when it wasn't too noisy, but it was really loud last night, enough to dampen our enjoyment.

Truly delicious Italian inspired food. Equal in quality to much more expensive and "uppity" restaurants. If you're looking for a more casual and relaxed atmosphere but still want excellent food, this is the place. It's been *very* busy every time I've gone, so do make a reservation.
Also, if it's nice out, the street dining can be quite pleasant.
THE FOOD WAS GREAT AND THE SERVICE WAS OUTSTANDING. WE CANNOT WAIT TO COME AGAIN.

Love the variety on the menu. Several small plate choices in addition to main menu.
The food always tastes fresh and well seasoned.
Bread was stale, scallops were overcooked, dry and fishy, and they were the 'special'! Service was good however.

Spasso's is a consistent favorite for myself and many of our colleagues and friends. Be it for a quick lunch or a relaxing dinner, Spasso's has something for every taste. Delicious crab spring rolls and portobella mushroom starters to fabulous pastas. Some of the best items for entrees include the Sesame Crusted Ahi Tuna as well as the richer, more savory side with the Pancetta Wrapped Stuffed Chicken Breast. Definitely save room for the unbeatable Bread Pudding. Bon appetito!
A little noisy, otherwise excellent food, wine and service.

The food was very good. Salad was nicely dressed. I had the veal piccata (tender juicy slices) with spinach and garlic mashed potatoes. They customized the amount of garlic in the sauce making the dish excellent. Portion size was just right. My friend had the lamb with a delicious sauce. They let us sample an unfamiliar wine. My friend decided to have it and I chose another, improving the whole experience. The restaurant used to be the Uptown Cafe and the new decor is very attractive, warm, and happy. The waitress was cordial and very accommodating. They were understaffed for a busy Friday night so it took a looooong time to be served wine but they were quite apologetic. I'll definitely go there again.
As usual, Spasso was terrific!!! Love everything about it!

Spasso's is one of the best stops on the Laurel Street strip. The food is always top of class, fresh ingredients, great cocktails, and awesome service. Be it lunch or dinner, dining al fresco on their frount porch is always fun for people watching and some sun (or stars) while sipping one of their many great wines. We have almost a regular habit of once-a-week (or more!) coming to visit our friends be it for lunch and/or dinner. Their new venue, The Cask Wine & Cheese bar across the street just opened and we are most impressed with the diversity of flavors, style, and overall uniquness of having twin restaurants within walking distance. Hats off to you!

As a large group for a business lunch it's perfect. For small romantic dinners it's again fantastic! It's hard to find any fault with Spasso's - great food, awesome service, broad wine list, scrumptious desserts ... we highly recommend it for any ocassion or meal!
Great value -- really good food at a very fair price.  We've eaten there twice, and enjoyed it thoroughly both times.

Most of the food was good, but the crab cake seemed more frozen crab cakes and my rock shrimp pasta tasted like bait shrimp.  The appetizers were good and we loved the polenta.  I am not sure if we would go back at this point.  I expected better quality ingredients for the amount paid.
GREAT SAN CARLOS SPOT!!!!

I've probably written 2 or 3 reviews for Spasso's now ... and fortunately, since their menu is so diverse I can always find something new to talk about! The latest addition for me is their amazing Calamari appetizer and their relatively new Dumplings (shrimp and artichoke with a mushroom sauce that's to die for). Wow... could've made a meal out of those alone! Sitting outside at one of their tables is a great way to spend a sunny afternoon. If you can save room for it, you definitely want to try their homemade chocolate gelato or their out-of-this-world bread pudding. Yet again, another top-notch recommendation from me and my team! Oh, and try the Shafer Cabernet 2005 - high marks!
Spasso is just great everytime we go.
As always, absolutely wonderful
They use way to much Salt in every dish. Not good.
decent Italian, great for dining outdoors on a nice day
Love the food! It really is a great value...Service is good but misses the extra touches!! I will continue to eat here any chance I get because the food really is outstanding!

I thought the wine list interesting and liked the reasonable $10 corkage fee as I brought a bottle.

My only negative is tht we ordered an appetizer and the meal followed too quickly as we didn't have time to enjoy the very good calamari.
Enjoy Spasso frequently but service was bit off on a Friday evening...some food wasn't hot.
This is a great neighborhood find. Food and service are excellent.
Great small plates and tapas!  Their menu includes great dishes as well.

Pretty straightforward Italian of reasonable quality. Arugula salad with pears was a little soggy with a nearly flavorless vinaigrette and if that was Arugula and not baby spinach, well, it was the sweetest tasting arugula I ever had ;  The kitchen was very slow, but it has a friendly San Carlos neighborhood feel and they literally put tables right out on the sidewalk so you can dine alfresco - San Carlos has great weather so this is a nice option.  Not too expensive, or cheap.  Spasso works if you want to stay local and have an enjoyable (definitely not gourmet) dinner, maybe run into some friends, have a some decent wine at prices that won't break the bank.
The lamb sirloin steak was not good, it did not taste like lamb it seemed kind of stale. I suspect it was from frozen piece as it took a long time to prepare, compared to other tables

Spasso is a great place to visit during the summer, with wonderful food and a lovely patio area.  During the San Carlos farmers market the restaurant offers a great location for people watching while enjoying a good meal.
We are regulars at this restaurant because the food is consistent and tasty and the service is exceptional.
We were 6 people and thoroughly enjoyed our dinners.
As always, simply fabulous!!!
Nice selection of tapas and other appetitizer plates to please the pallet and satisfy the stomach without indulging in a large entree.
I was impressed!  It was a very warm evening, and they had the back door open for the cooks, so it was a little stuffy.  Great menu, we are going back.
Excellent service and food. We are always treated so well and the food is consistent in quality and preparation. A great neighborhood find.
Excellent

It was a great place for a ladies' day out.  We all had delicious salads and loved the dipping oil with herbs for the bread.  The service was excellent.  I'm looking forward to trying the dinner menu.
Spasso is consistently great.  The food is fabulous and this has quickly become my most favorite restaurant in San Carlos.

As in several prior times we have dined at Spasso, the food and service were commendably excellent. The staff always strives to please and be friendly. We appreciate the no-corkage policy on Sundays and Mondays, though their wine list is excellent, diverse, and fairly priced. One of our top favorite places for special dining. Bravo!

The food and service were excellent as always. Only complaint I have is about seating and noise level. This is the second time I have been to the restaurant as a party of two, and both times we were ushered to tables in the very back by the kitchen under speakers playing music. There were plenty of tables in the front and middle of the dining room, but they were mostly all set for 4 people. Conversation was difficult and we felt a bit slighted. It would be nice to have more tables for two in the front of the restaurant.
The food is really good and the service is impeccable.  Nice hole in the wall find!  Highly recommend it to anyone!
A great neighborhood restaurant and one of our favorites.
Very ggod food and service.  We ordered 2 appetizers/salads and 2 entrees to split and they were so nice to split everything on separate plates for us - we had 4 courses!!!
Terrific.

The food and service are always consistent, this is our 10th visit to the restaraunt ans each time we enjoy the friendly service, since our first visit they have continued to remeber us each time we come and we are promptly seated and throughly enjoy each and every experience.

Highly recommend this for downtown San Carlos dining spot.

Ask for Marko he is great
Although the food was great I made reservations and had to wait over 30min longer. It sends a message of not being prepared for your guess.
Excellent....

We sat in the middle of the room by the bar, and had requested not so.
The food was excellent, service was chaotic, seemed too busy.
I will go again but try harder for a back table.
They have no computer for the reservation we made and we had to wait for a table to open. Open table should have them online or remove them from your listing of restaurants.

In addition to its very good food and great service, I love three things about Spasso--
(1) the small plates
(2) the wine flights and wine list generally
(3) it's the un-Town.
Went to Spasso for lunch. They have a great menu, including tapas, Italian favorites, and some Greek influences. The lamb pitta was outstanding! Sidewalk seating and attentive service.
Enjoyed the food very much.  Service was very good as well!
Marco is fantastic!!!!!
All 3 of our dishes were delicious. The warm napa cabbage salad was much better than at Town.

Great Food...good prices..nice service. Loved the pork chop..Bread Pudding is the best around ( anywhere )...the only thing is it was REALLY HOT in the dining room..almost to the point of not being able to stand it!! Hopefully that is not the case all summer..because I love this place!!
friendly service have been there mny times and from the first visit they remebered my wofe and I and we have always had a good meal and an enjoyable time

Calamari was overcooked and burn't , everything was over salted.  Halibit was cold when served, Kitchen was way out of whack all evening. :-(((  We used to love this spot but our last two meals were terrible.
Solid menu, good service.
All five of us enjoyed our dishes. Service was great--well timed and and friendly. We'd go back in a heartbeat.

Wide variety of hot & cold small plates (tapas and appetitizers)in addition to main menu. Great to share (or not)! Great martinis too!  Limited seating outside that provides a quieter atmosphere. They do not rush you, but the tables are turned frequently.  Service is attentive and the kitchen is very prompt.  It's one of our local favorites.

Normally my food is fantastic, but the risotto was not as creamy as in the past.  Also, the warm cabbage salad seemed different as well, not much blue cheese.  The wine list did not have many good selections of by the glass.  The chocolate gelato for dessert was outstanding.

Everyone thoroughly enjoyed their dinner.  (Stuffed chicken, veal and gnocchi.)  I had been before but for the other three it was their first time to Spasso.  All three said they would definitely return!  

The only negative is the noise level.  It is very high if there is a large party there.  Both times I have been there a party of about 16-18 people was there.  You realize how load it was when they leave and you can lower your own voices.
fabulous!

The dinner was very good.  The only drawback was the wait time, because a party of 15 had paid their bill and continued talking for an hour, which delayed the seatings scheduled for after.  Otherwise a very nice and romantic place, maybe will go again either earlier or later.
I love this place, but this the third time they had me wait for 30 minutes, even though we had a reservation.  They need to do better with table and time management.
The walnut crusted pork chop was very succulent!
The only thing that I didn't like was the bread which was below average.  They should either offer good rolls or something that looks and tastes better than white bread.

Food is great, one of the few Peninsula restaurants that offers wine flights, great selection of wine, including by the glass. Our waiter was patient, knowledgeable, interested in our feedback on food and wine and had a great sense of humor. This was my third visit and all 3 have been similar - great food, excellent, creative wine choices in many price ranges, great service. Highly recommended.

We cancelled our order and left the restaurant because the noise was so loud it was uncomfortable.  We'll never go back.  I selected Poor on all of the above, even though we never got to taste the food, because the form won't let me submit otherwise.
Food was great. We had a really nice time. Fun atmosphere. Liked the bar and wine/drinks list. Will go again.

Spasso moved into the Laurel St scene in the past year or so and it's been a rising hit ever since! Be it a power-lunch from the nearby tech-heads to a fabulous dinner, the food always impresses and the service makes everyone feel like a regular. The bar, while small, has a decent wine list with some hard-to-find surprises hidden in its pages. The cocktails are strong and quenching. The bread pudding is to die for; the appestizers and tapas are truly a social event all to themselves. My team, friends, and colleagues are all regulars on an even weekly basis here.
We are frequent diners here -- love being able to walk over, and glad they are now on OpenTable.
Food is good but over salted.
Overall not bad. They did not seem to have our OpenTable reservation but as the restaurant was not busy, there was no problem.

My dining experience as Spasso was very good overall. It was my third time dining at Spasso and when I had to plan a work dinner, I thought of the restaurant immediately. All of the members of my group enjoyed the dinner and the wine list has a good variety. I had the ravioli with rock shrimp and it was delicious! On other occasions I've tried the skirt steak and that was very good as well. My only complaint would have to be the dessert. It's a little disappointing when you have such a delicious meal and great service and then the dessert tastes like it's been refrigerated and then re-heated. I had the bread pudding and was very disappointed. It was a bit dry and lacked richness and flavor.
I consider this one of the best restaurants in San Carlos!
Had a drink at the bar.  Tonic was flat.  Cosmo made with Rose's Lime instead of fresh lime.  Not off to a good start.  We'll go back and give it one more try.

The food at Spasso was very good and the portion sizes were perfect...even for lunch!  The crab cakes would have been better if they weren't so oily.  They seemed to be deep fried not pan fried.  The service was fantastic!  The team at Spasso really makes you feel welcome and they are there to get you what you need for a fabulous dining experience! They are sooo accomodating without the attitude that most servers/mgmt have in Bay Area restaurants.  I recommend this restaurant to everyone.
We enjoy dining at Spasso.  There is a varied menu, with several appetizers and small plates to share.

Had the appetizer prawns wrapped in pancetta and seared halibut.  Both where outstanding.  The desserts were excellent as well.  The bread pudding and apple peach cobbler were excellent as well.  I'll be back!

The food is excellent! The service is cordial and pleasant.
We will certainly go back there!
The entrance is a bit cramped and could be arranged better for customers that are waiting.

We had to wait 20 minutes for a table and was placed next to an often open front door making it cold at our table.  The food was good but not great, the salmon overcooked but had a tasty wood-cooked flavor.  May return but will go to others first.
Solid good San Carlos neighborhood restaurant that pleases both parents looking for a nice meal and kids with pickier palates.
The food and service were fantastic
Broad menu selection at moderate prices. Wait staff can't do enough to want to please you. A must try!
Everything the 4 of us ordered was delicious.  We can't wait to go back and try something else on the menu!
Great atmosphere and decor - quite crowded (a plus - means it's popluar).  Friendly staff and really good food.  Enjoyed it very much.  Will definitely return..
I have been to  Spasso twice this week, both times were excellent.  The other time I sat at the bar and had great service from the bartender (owner?) Always a great place to eat.

I went with a coworker. I ordered pasta and it was pretty good , but she ordered salmon and it was overcooked.  The service is OK.  I found the decor a bit "cheesy and cheap".
Won't need to go back.

They are doing a nice job in San Carlos and I'll go back... certainly before going to most other restaurants in town because of the consistency, positive and polished staff, and good vibes.  I wouldn't change a thing except to maybe be a bit more forthcoming on the bread and olive oil dip, without having to ask.

name: palm & ember
description: Palm & Ember Restaurant located in The Hayes Mansion, Curio Collection by Hilton™,  offers delicious, California-inspired cuisine and cocktails. Whatever your taste, you’re sure to find the delicious flavors and seasonal fare you’re looking for when you dine with us.Palm & Ember serves fresh California cuisine made from locally sourced ingredients. Guests can enjoy a diverse and delicious menu in our spacious indoor dining area or savor a handcrafted cocktail out on the deck – all overlooking our historic grounds.
hours:
Breakfast
Daily 6:00 am–10:00 am
Lunch
Daily 11:00 am–4:00 pm
Dinner
Daily 4:00 pm–10:00 pm
Bar
Daily 4:00 pm–11:00 pm

reviews.text: Mediocre food and overpriced. Service is good tho.
If you are staying here at the hotel, it’s the closest option. For what we paid I should have gone to High Five.

We were disappointed to see that breakfast was a lackluster buffet. The menu suggested something more upscale. The restaurant and grounds are gorgeous though. The service was also excellent. We’ll be coming back for dinner and drinks to try again.

name: Speisekammer
description: Traditional German cuisine- Pickup-take out & delivery through UberEats, Postmates & Grubhub- Limited outdoor dining.
hours:
Mon–Thu 4:30 pm–8:30 pm
Fri, Sat 11:30 am–9:30 pm
Sun 11:30 am–8:30 pm
cuisine: German, Beer Garden, Bar / Lounge / Bottle Service

reviews.text: Alwys a fun experience. Food is somewhat bland and more side option swaps should be available for the price of entrees. Servers and staff friendly and good.
Great food! I really liked the pickled vegetables.

Our server was Uriel; he took care of us wonderfully. The Reibekuchen and Fried Brussels Sprouts were outstanding as was the Leek and Mushroom Soup. The Salmon and Chicken Schnitzel were done perfectly. For dessert we had Strudel and Cheese Cake.
A taste of Germany in Alameda with excellent food and drinks
Excellent music, delicious food and great craft cocktails. Perfect date night spot

Five of us went to dinner and also caught some live music. The food was delicious, albeit on the pricey side - an order of fries for $14?! I’m thankful the portions are sizeable as I’ll be getting almost a 2nd meal out of my order (chicken cordon bleu). Pricing aside, the waitstaff seemed distracted - it took a while for our order to be taken; the wait for the food was fine and it came out nice and hot. But no one asked how the food was, if we needed anything, etc. for the rest of the night. I suspect more drinks might have been ordered, perhaps a slice or two of pie, etc.

Overall a nice time with good food. Just be prepared to flag someone down every time you need something.
Very nice dinner. Sauerbraten is good . They have many German sausages.
I would like to thank Sergio for his assistance, which made our experience very enjoyable.
Always worth the drive.  Great German food, lots of German beers on tap, and very friendly staff.  Really a great place to go when you feel like German food!

Used to come here regularly, but hadn't since the pandemic. Happy to say this is still a great choice for authentic German food. Service is friendly and efficient. Actually better than in old days. Great selection of German beers. Good cocktails. Prices reasonable considering the generous portion size.

We had my husband’s birthday celebrated here. Their food is oh so good and the drinks are amazing. Try the juicy sand tender roasted pork and tri tip. The cheese beer sauce was delicious. Service is excellent!
It used to be better, dishes don’t taste as authentic as before
Generous serving sizes, good selection of beers & great tasting German cuisine. Will definitely come back.
Came because of a gift card. The food was amazing. Service was excellent. Cant wait to go again!
Consistently pleasant & enjoyable from start to finish.   Thank you!!
Excellent food and great service. Definitely not our last time at the Speisekammer.
Previously great restaurant struggling to maintain quality of food and service.
Took my friend from out of town here. She absolutely loved it! We are definitely coming back here and bringing more friends and family!
Great dinner. Seems like new staff. Excellent food and service

Sat inside, in one of the two back rooms, since there was a full patio and front bar area - very cozy and quiet.

Very large portion, even though I only ordered a small bratwurst with mashed potatoes & cabbage. The full dinners also come with a small plate of the 4 traditional pickled cold salads. These were very fresh and tangy. Great cocktails but coffee was not good. Enjoyed the cranberry juice and potato pancakes very much!

Speissekammer is consistently delicious. We’ve dined here many times and it has always been pleasant and the food is wonderful.  It is on the pricier side but the quality of the food is worth it, especially for a special occasion.
This is a German restaurant with very good German food and German beer. The food was delicious. The service was very good. I am glad i had an opportunity to try this restaurant.
Food was tasty and service excellent! I will return soon.
Lovely food and server was fantastic! I highly recommend the Apple struddle. Thank you!
Totally crowded for Father’s Day but they were fully staffed and ready. Food was great.
Outstanding food & beer choices.  They were out of Bit Burger beer however & didn’t bring us our sausage appetizer.
Delicious food! Everyone in our party of 8 found something they loved. The staff was very friendly and attentive. Excellent service from our server!  We can’t wait to return.

This might be my favorite Friday night to have in the East Bay: eating delicious comfort food, drinking exceptional beer, and watching Mitch Polzak rock and twang like nobody's business. Just a great night. Thank you, Speisekammer.

Sorry to say the rouladen was a huge disappointment for the price of $36.00.
Barely edible, but the beer was good and cold.
Parking was an issue. I will not be eating there again.
Excellent.  Server only served small portion when LARGE portion was ordered.

The atmosphere was pure Germanic and the food was delicious.  The Reuben sandwich was crispy on top but the bottom bread was soggy, like it was sitting for a very very long time.  Besides that, the flavor was good.  TOTALLY skip the pretzel dumplings.  They were like day old matza balls.  

The service was excellent.
It was super to sit outside and have a nice dinner and discussion with my colleagues.  Very comfortable and casual.  Great food.  Great beer.  Great service!
A gem for Alameda neighbors— rain or shine it’s the place to enjoy good food and  companionship.
We liked the option for smaller serving sizes! Generally a good experience.
Large fresh & pickled salads, extensive cocktails & beers selection, full snd (large) half portions offered; we go once per month!
We have been to Speisekamer dozens of times since they opened in Alameda 15+ years ago.  Food, drink and service is always excellent.
Loved the Hemingway Daiquiri and Blackberry Manhattan, hearty portions of the salmon cakes, pork meatballs and sausages, we all took to go boxes. Service was a bit slow on this visit.
Service was slow. Our food server was mediocre. He didn’t seem to want to make an effort to ensure we had what we needed.

Have been here many times. Appetizers were caprice salad and Potato pancakes. Had half chicken, mash potatoes and red cabbage. Sour braten broccolini mash potatoes. All was great except red cabbage. Was Smokey and burnt. Not supposed to be like that.

Speisekammer is the place to go for the genuine gemutlich atmosphere: good food, good beer, excellent service! This is not 'cleaned-up, CA-style' German food, sorry; this is the kind of hearty, rib-sticking food I grew up with among the large German and Polish immigrants back in the Midwest. The applesauce for the potato pancakes is housemade; the sauerkraut is braised (a pox forever on restaurants that serve you raw sauerkraut, ugh); the spatzle is wonderful. The pork entrees are killer good, but I admit to often ordering just the Nurnberger sausages with extra kraut for an entree! Be careful on Fri afternoons; street sweeping on that side makes finding parking more difficult.

Due to unforeseen circs, I had to cut my visit short and take my food to go. The twice baked potato skins (a St. Patrick’s Day special with corned beef added; wish it could be more regular) were delicious, as was the bread and butter I ordered and the mint ginger Paloma cocktail my friend ordered.

My only callout is that you get nowhere near enough of the lovely herbed butter to cover most of the slices of the warm and delicious loaf of bread ($2.00 charge, btw). I was obliged to ask for more, and the second little container of butter was plain (not herbed).

I cannot say enough good things about the staff at Speisekammer—they are what makes this place so special. From Hannah behind the scenes to Johnna, Kara, Liz, Krissy, Alex and too many other amazing staff members to name. We have come here for years and years and the low turnover tells us that the staff is taken care of and helps keep things consistent, familiar and inviting. Peter and Cindy may be passing the torch, but we are hopeful that with new ownership, we will be able to continue to enjoy this Alameda institution for many more years to come. Delicious food and drinks served by kind and engaging staff in a cozy, warm and charming German environment… what more can I ask for? Prost!!
All was good, except prices.  $14 for a pretzel?  $8 for cucumber salad?  Not for me.
Always enjoy coming here. Food is good and the staff are always attentive.
I never thought something would replace my love for Sushi but here we are.
This restaurant serves authentic German fare - we enjoyed the pretzel, spaetzle and cheese, and bratwurst. It's a great place for groups or couples.
Good food, good service, a nice beer menu, and a relaxed, comfortable atmosphere.

The entire staff was great, especially our server (Alex) and Christine? (by the bar - server?)

The food value (quality for cost) was terrific.
We are frequent diners because the food and service is so good. This time we went with a friend who drove all the way from Woodland in part to come to this restaurant.

Cozy ambiance and excellent service. I requested to be seated near the fireplace when I made the reservation and I was extremely pleased when we arrived and the hostess showed us to our table right in front of the fireplace. It made for a perfect dining experience on a cold, rainy evening. Our server was super friendly and attentive. Food was delicious and beer/cocktails right on point. Can’t wait to return.
We have dined here many times over the years. The overall experience was not up to the usual excellence.

The food was fantastic, and always is.  The bartender/waiter made a French Kiss martini for me although it’s not on the menu.  I showed him the post I found of it on FB & it was fantastic.  David went the extra mile for us and made our lunch and drinks fabulous.  Cheers to the chef for the great cabbage roll and amazing Reuben sandwich.  Will definitely return.
Incredible food, great service, and live music. Loved the fireplace and decorations. We will definitely be back!
The specials are always interesting and delicious!
The food was amazing, as always. Our server was attentive and friendly. The rest of the staff was friendly and helpful. One of our favorite restaurants!
Great local spot for very good German food. The server was excellent and her suggestions were spot on for an enjoyable meal.

We found this place using a gluten free app. They offer a good range of gluten free foods and let you know what is and what isn’t safe.
We’ve eaten here twice without issues and have loved it both times.
Reservations are a must, since it does get pretty busy here. They often have live music.
We go here often and the food and service is good, Parking is a problem.

Hard recommendation -

Get the marzen, the pretzel with the bier cheese and the 2 person meat plate.  We cannot stop eating this as it has been the epitome of comfort food for me and my friend now going on three visits.

While we are both still slightly tempted to branch out to the other offerings,

but when you know something is simply THAT #%^* GOOD

…why would you switch to something else to eat and drink.

Thank you, Speiskammer… ;)
Great food and service, many German beers on offer, room gets loud after 7 PM.
Excellent food and nice atmosphere too.  We will be back!
Always great food and service. It was very loud though, but everyone was excited for the Krampus visit.

We always make time for Speisekammer at the holidays. Some years it was for Christmas Eve. This year was just a moment before. And we've never been let down. Great soul-restoring German food. Excellent selection of beers and cider. We had great service, always ready to clear dishes, bring another drink, offer dessert. We may have been loud enough to cause one group to move tables, but that's just a measure of how much fun we were having. A true Alameda gem.
Me and my daughters love this place. The fries are so good and the ambiance is great.
Authentic German cuisine and especially the BEER. My family has made Speisekammer our favorite place to gather.
Always delicious and warm service. The duck special was fantastic. Be sure to order an apple streudel for dessert
Delicious German food, vegetarian friendly, great service!
Food was amazing. Service was extremely slow for both drinks and food. Restaurant was busy and apparently the kitchen was back-logged, but our food took far too long.
lovely evening out with my daughter celebrating the holidays and the end of freshman first semester final exams. Father Christmas and Krampus visited us to boot!  Such a delicious and fun evening!
please put a farmers plate  ( schlacht platte ) on the menu
If you want to enjoy some good German food and beer, stop in here.
I celebrate my birthday here often and the restaurant has always been accommodating, had great service, and, most importantly, delicious food and drinks. I always would recommend!
It’s an amazing restaurant, great service, and kid friendly.
Great German food and beer!  Had three generations for a family dinner.
Even though we had a reservation, we were seated in the bar, which is extremely noisy. The food was overcooked to the point of being dry. The service was good despite it being busy.

Lots of beer choices. Good food. Limited menu. Would have liked to see potato pancakes come as a side with a few of the entrees. The bathrooms were clean.  We made a reservation through Open Table for an indoor table, but somehow when we arrived for lunch, the restaurant had it as an outdoor table.  So, when confirming your reservation, make certain the table is where you’d like it. Fortunately, Speisekammer was able to accommodate our request for an indoor table ( it was chilly outside).
The food was outstanding and the mushroom brown gravy with spetzle was out of this world!
Wonderful, warm ambiance.  Great food and attentive service.  Always fun there.

Speisekammer is great local restaurant. I always feel like it's a little pricey for hearty straight forward German food but the food is very good. The cocktails could be a little more generous for the style of the restaurant but the star is the beer. It can get quite loud at times inside during regular dining,  but the outdoor seating is very nice. Keep in mind, outside seating is bench style, so no backs. The music nights are excellent but get there early to get the best viewing of the stage. This has been a local place for a long time, but note a dispensary has opened next door and Speisekammer has been discovered.
Had not been here since before the Pandemic. So happy it is still great service, yummy food, and warm atmosphere. ❤️
Great place, food and service. Be sure to try some of the special cocktails and seasonal desserts!
Large portions of tasty German food. Terrific beer selections plus good value wines by glass
Attentive staff, authentic, good German food, great music.
Great sampler entree for 2-3. We were full & still had leftovers. Great selection of beers. A go-to spot.
As always, the food was excellent and good times were had by all....
Wonderful food with big portions.  Price is very good for the amount of food. We went on a Saturday and the place was full and a little loud.  We will go during the week next time
Great atmosphere and delicious food! Look forward to eating here again!
Love Kara! Always love speisekammer! You all are the best. -Luke & Liz Dollar
Our family enjoyed the food and ambience very much.  Staff was friendly and efficient.  We'll definitely go again.

Alex was our waiter for a party of 8.  He was EXCELLENT!  Very nice, water on the table all the time,  very helpful with deciding what to order.  Honestly best waiter at restaurant that I have had in a long time.  Thank you Alex for making sure we had a great time the great time we had last night at your restaurant

First of all, there is no parking available; you must find street parking in a very busy area.  The small lot adjacent is for the cannabis store next door only.  There’s big servings for the entrees, but some items offer half portions ala carte.  Great beer selection; very affable waitstaff.  The food itself could be presented more visually appealing on the plates.  Two pork cutlets thrown on top of a mound or roast potatoes—ugh.  The restaurant was attentive to my special request on Open Table.

After recently coming back from Germany and trying out the food from restaurant I can honestly say it is definitely close to how they make their food in Germany. The flavors were spectacular and the display also the beers were amazing. I highly recommend this place to others.

A really fine German restaurant that realizes tha German cooking is a lot more than sausages.  Menu is varied and the entrees I have tried have all been excellent.  The cabbage rolls are great, but I really miss true rouladen on the menu, be it made with pickle, sausage(like my family recipe) or bacon.  I guess asking for north German Grunkohl would be asking for too much.  As to noise comment, I was there on Thursday night football.  I could do without TV's altogether but so far the best German restaurant since Speckmann's closed.

Food was good but a bit pricey for my blood. Overall atmosphere was nice but then you get those individuals who are drinking a bit much and are loud and boisterous, it's a little bit distracting and annoying.
Nice selection of authentic dishes.  Bring an appetite. Dishes are huge!
Good food and great beer. Staff are very friendly and always will to help.
Loved the food, but wished we had sat in the back room. The bar area was super load with guys cheering for their favorite rugby team.

We always enjoy dinner, drinks and great beer at Speisekammer. The food is consistently delicious, great drink options, beers and wine selection. Fun music in the weekends. We love the seasonal specials and my husband gets especially excited when the pork shank is on the specials menu.
Excellent service! Delicious food and great beer selection.

Best sauerkraut ever. Really, it was amazing. The sausage and schnitzel were both delicious. Generous portions. Interesting menu with lots of choice. Great beer selection. Friendly and efficient service. Make a reservation. We’ll definitely go back.
This place is amazing!! The ambiance is fantastic and the food is even better!

We have been going here for years. It has changed annoy for the better.  It seems like they have a different chef or different recipes.  The Sauerkraut was sweet.  The Bratwurst was flavorless and seemed undercooked.  The spaetzle tasted dried out and chewy like it had been sitting out all day.  The table was very sticky, we asked for it to be wiped down, but that never happened. They sat a family with 2 screaming kids next us instead of seating them in the main dining area where they have kids toys.  The music was loud.  Overall bad experience.
The best German food in the bay area. Authentic homestyle delicious. That combined with great music without a cover charge, makes it a sure fire winner.

The best German food in Northern California at value prices, great service and ambiance, wonderful blues & rockabilly music that suits all musical tastes, in a true destination restaurant populated by "colorful" locals!

Everything in the menu is top-notch.  Varied and delicious. The beer selection is amazing!  Educated and friendly staff offer great service. Stands head and shoulders above other local German restaurants. A pleasure every time.

Wonderful dinner with party of 8.
Great drinks and pretzels with beer-cheese sauce to start!
Dinners included salmon, meat balls, pork, special sausage meal ... everyone enjoyed their meals
Excellent food and drink in a wonderfully friendly setting.  Can’t wait to go back!

Went at 1:30 on Sun. Our sever was very friendly. The amount of food was more than adequate. And very tasty.   Great selection of beer! :) 
We’ll be back
My friend and I celebrate Oktoberfest and the memory of her late German mother every year at Speisekammer. The food and drink were delicious, and we finished our meal with apple strudel.

We had dinner outside, basic picnic-style seating with umbrellas and heaters, which was very pleasant. The music and other guests were quiet enough to allow for conversation without being loud. :)  The food was fabulous and felt like home. The staff was helpful and responsive, providing recommendations and making sure we had everything we needed.  Note: Most of the menu is not low-calorie food, so keep that in mind and just enjoy the fabulous flavors.
Great ambience, great food. Several vegetarian options and even a lot of vegetable sides with an option to have them all on one plate for a great vegan meal. Highly recommend!
What a lively restaurant with in and outdoor seating. Large German beer selection and full bar. Delicious and large servings of Schnitzel dishes!

Speisekammer is such a nice place to dine. The waiter who waited on us was also so kind and knowledgeable about the food and drinks (German beer). Everything was wonderful. We will come again and again. Thank you so much.
Nice evening/dinner on the patio last Saturday.  Beer was outstanding, food very good.  Service was top-notch.
Good German food.  Thanks!  We have been coming here for years.
The grilled porkchop was excellent, and the environment is authentic.  Outdoor seating is also available but parking is not easy though there are side streets to park on. Would recommend.
Again an outstanding experience.  Good food and plenty of it at a very reasonable price.  Highly recommend if you are looking for genuine German cuisine.  Nice European wine selection.

Spieskammer is always a good place to go for the best imported German beer. If you you want to feel like you’re in a real quaint German restaurant then this is the place. Food is always great as well and the prices aren’t bad.
The food is pricey and good but the service was excellent.
Don't ask me to type anything.  I already did the page with the stars.  Please!!  If you want people to respond to surveys (& usually I ignore them) then make it simple.
Always solid German fare and beer. Attentive service and was very quick for orders to come out of the kitchen this time.

I love this place not only for the food but also the atmosphere. I always feel like I’m on holiday sitting at the terrace. Their pretzel and bratwurst are my favorite. Of course their beer selection is vast, but they also have a wide range of cocktail and wine offerings. Lastly, service is always very friendly and welcoming.

My father's (he's 90)  favorite German restaurant in the Bay Area. The drive to Alameda is also a joy, and the island itself, a delight to visit.  He has much to say about the picked cucumber salad, the sauerkraut and bratwurst.  We never leave without a helping of their strudel.
Went here for our Anniversary on June 1st. Excellent service and food. Excellent beers on tap. One of the best German restaurants in the Bay Area.
The most authentic German restaurant in the Bay Area.  Portions are large so go for the small option or enjoy the leftovers.  Excellent selection of beers on tap.
Live music @ Speisekammer is the best deal in town. Delicious food and beer that come with a fantastic show. Great night.

If you are looking for authentic German cuisine and a great beer selection - this is the place. They’ve been serving up savory food and improving the beer selection for years and their efforts have paid off. They even have a nice selection of Cider if you aren’t into beer. I would recommend Speisekammer the next time you are in Alameda.

We sat outside and our table was uneven and we made a wedge to keep it from rocking. The food came out slow and then we got the wrong order but our waitress was so nice it made it all the better since it was Father’s Day and she was so apologetic even though it was the kitchen who messed up the ordered.  The food was great we loved everything!
There's nothing bad on the menu and the service is really great.  Throw in a great beer selection and you know that you picked the right place to eat :)
Beautiful restaurant and great food.  Good waiter, until we tried to get the bill!
It was assume loved the food and drinks.  Everyone was kind and helpful.  Great place ❤️
Food was as good as it always is and our server (Alex) was perfect!
Overpriced   The food is good but overpriced for what you get.
German food at is best with a great beer selection spanning the range of German offerings plus good local beers in a setting reminiscent of being there
Great vibe/atmosphere.  Down to earth, excellent food, fun
Food was very basic.  Nothing stood out as being well prepared
This was out third time here and my daughter and I were very pleased overall. Great food!
Delicious (and even vegetarian friendly) German food in a relaxing atmosphere.
Excellent food.  The appetizer portions seemed small compared to the main dishes.  And we were seated near a noisy busser station, even though there were other tables available.

The food, beer and cocktail selection are fabulous. You seriously can't go wrong. Perhaps the best feature is that you can order small portions of most of the entrees (so if you fill up on the wonderful potato pancakes you won't overdue it). Don't miss the apple strudel for dessert!
Great authentic German food . I have lived in Germany and  should know.
As an Austrian living in Oakland this felt very close to home. The food was phenomenal and the beer and wine list matches the food offering.
Great food. Great beer. Great Service. Always a good time.
Exceptional German food and service, great value, entertaining crowd and music.
A great place to get authentic German food and plenty of great beer on tap
Love this place. Local food, with an amazing list of beer. They have the best beer garden and patio heaters! We often come visit here and the food is always on point.
Food price did not match quantity and quality of food preparation. Too pricey. Would not recommend this place.

$16 for a single pretzel? I don’t know what to say. We are definitely aware of high Bay Area prices for having lived here for over a decade and having actually observed the place change - so we are not whining. But really, $16 for a single pretzel?
Beers are fantastic, at least the ones we had. Potatoes were good too. We loved the ambience and the staff were very friendly and helpful. Overall, very expensive, probably worth one visit. More if you have money to burn.

Oh my goodness, I loved this place. Great beer menu, but what I wasn't expecting was 5-star food! Everything we had was delicious from the brussel sprouts, shrimp, and pretzel with cheese as our apps to the schnitzel and curry sausage. I can't wait to go back!
Great place with great food. Our server was very attentive and helpful. If you like good beer with a wide selection and tasty eats I highly recommend. Das boot!

As usual, this place never disappoints.  I'm just sorry they are not open for lunch everyday like they used to be, but finding good help is tough.  And they only hire the best for their help.  
Waitress was on top of everything.  Even with 5 or 6 other tables she was waiting on.  She had them all covered.
Highly recommend to everyone.  You will not be disappointed at all.

Seriously a little taste of Bavaria in Alameda.  Always takes us back to the Augustiner Beer Garden in Munich.  Authentic food and excellent service.  Parking can be a challenge so get there a bit early.
Food is amazing. Parking is hard but worth the trouble. Some of the menu options sell out early on busy weekends.
V. large portions. If you enjoy half then take the remainder home for later, then you've got value. It seems to be authentically German, but without adaptations to lighter "California" fare.
Our waitperson was great—Chrisy. The food is fantastic.

We had not been in maybe 5 years and I think it is even better than before! The food, beer and service were impeccable and as always sitting outside in the sun (finally sun!) made the lunch even more enjoyable. Relaxed atmosphere, delicious fresh food, good beer shared with friends ... who could ask for more?

Food was excellent, however was disappointed with the french fries. They used to be skinny fries and they changed them to thicker fries, and they are just not as good.  The Ruben sandwich was outstanding with a hearty portion of corned beef on delicious rye bread with all the trimmings. The lamb shank was also delicious and falling off the bone meat. My daughter had the pork meatballs on spaetzle, and they were seasoned well and again a hearty portion with plenty of leftovers. Fun place for a group.

The food is amazing and authentic. The vibe is very European and cozy. Great beer selection.  Huge portions . Potato pancakes are the best. A terrific meeting place.
I highly recommend
Amazing Authentic German Food! Our favorite place to splurge on payday.
Music was great and added to ambience so since weather was good we opted to sit outside.  Food has gotten rather pricey … $16 for a pretzel!!  Inflation?
Not as just as last time.... may not go again.  Sausage and sauerkraut good, but wienerschnitzel was bad, overcooked, dry... even gobs of lemon couldn't help it.
Lovely eating outside with our dog. Great beer and food!
Yes, Cindy and Her crew put on a great feed.. The hospitality is great also!
Warm welcome and promptly seated. Christi, our waitress, was most knowledgeable of the menu.  The food was delicious including the sauerbraten, cabbage rolls meatloaf, mashed potatoes, and spaten.
Always good food!  And very pleasant service.  But if you want to chat with your tablemate or group, request the dining room since the front area gets really noisy.

It was my Niece Birthday and I decided to invite my Relatives here. This is their first time eating at a German Restaurant.
Good Food and Outstanding Service.
Best German food around. Though my husband tries to order in German and the staff does not know German ;) They do know the food and beer so that makes up for it.
The food and service are always outstanding!  Thank you :)
Service was great. Drinks and food were really good. It was lively but not so loud you couldn't carry on a conversation.

Had a birthday dinner here and it was totally not the best day they were having. Servers were all over the place. Beer was fine but too mistakes with food and duplicate orders. At one point the power went out in the room. Great maybe to socialize and drink the night away but way too loud to have a simple dinner.
Love this comfort food place. And amazing selection of beer!

We love Speisekammer but today was not the best. Our appetizer did not come out as specified and also ended up coming with our meal. It was not warm and had been probably sitting out for a while. The server offered to keep the entree food in back until we had finished our appetizer. So we could have more lukewarm food? No, thank you. Food was mostly good. Our server did not come by for at least 20 minutes after we finished and our empty plates sat in front of us the entire time. Not a horrible experience. But we usually receive much better service.

Wonderful atmosphere, all kinds of people, families with kids, friendly servers, celebratory feeling. Food good and plentiful. Onion soup delicious but not hot enough. Apple strudel phylo crust tough. Sauerkraut and mashed potatoes with pork shank outstanding comfort food. Will return.
