Authentic German food is really good. Large selection of German beers on draft. Music on Friday nites is really good. It does get loud!
Always my favorite place to have dinner with my beautiful wife. I tease her, because I worry that when we visit Germany, she won’t like the food as much as she does at Speisekammer.
They had an amazing blues band playing called Howell Devine.  Three person group who rocked the joint!!!
Always extraordinary German cuisine at great value, but service from Liz and customer service from Holly were both over the top. This food and music venue is a treasure.

It’s a warm and happy place with attentive service and great food.  Loved the Jager schnitzel w mushroom sauce and spaetzle as well as the chicken with excellent mashed potatoes and broccolini.  Opted for the assortment of four German salads instead of a mixed green and loved the freshness and flavor of the beets, cucumbers, etc.  also appreciative that they serve decaf coffee at night as the flavor after the evening meal is great but not caffeine 😄
I mentioned in our reservation that it was for a birthday, and they sat us next to the fireplace! So thoughtful! Food and service were excellent as ALWAYS.
Speiskammer is the real deal!  Going there is like a trip across Germany all in one restaurant from the Beer to the Sausages
Delicious authentic German food...indoor and heated outdoor dining.  Get yourself down there, a great restaurant with huge beer selections and cocktails.
This is my second review of this restaurant. It is consistently excellent in every way.  We had 40th Anniversary celebration at Speisekammer. 8 months ago. The staff was wonderful!

Excellent as always. Service top notch.     

Holiday menu a must.

Always a good experience! Foods and beer on point along with käsebrett and pretzel. 

Heaters outside so no real issue with sitting outside but highly recommend to bundle-up.

It was great.  Our friends were from out of town and love German food.  We chose Speisekammer over Brotzeit Lokal because we knew we would be able to eat inside on a cold night- also because we love the food at Speisekammer!
Excellent service. Wish I could remember his name.  We were seated near the fireplace room.
Great atmosphere and reliably good food.  Very festive at this time of year especially.
The food here never disappoints!  Everything was fabulous!
Fantastic food and excellent service. The quality of the food exceeds expectations every time.
Great food and friendly service!  Lots of space inside.  Inside is a great option when weather/season makes outside biergarten less practical.
Good selection of German food and Beers. Service was great and accomodating.

Take an Uber/Lyft so you can enjoy the amazing selection of beers!
Food was delicious.  Definitely come hungry because not only is the food rich & heavy, but the portions are large!
Will definitely return soon!

We had dinner here before a concert. This was our first visit and certainly won’t be our last. My husband had the goulash and he loved it. The beef was incredibly tender and a perfect dish to eat on a cold evening. The serving was enough for two. I had sliced pork roast in a delicious sauce, mashed potatoes and broccolini…another delicious dish that gave me enough for leftovers. The staff was extremely friendly.

What a great experience! Our first time visiting. We were a group of 5 for a Saturday night dinner. We ordered several beer flights to sample the many beers that they have on tap. My carnivore friends had meat feast that was for 2-3 peeps. I loved the pretzel, potato pancakes, and the cheese plate. For dessert I recommend the mini pecan pie. Will definitely revisit when we are back in the area.

This is the best German food restaurant in the Bay Area hands down.  Never a bad meal.  Service was a bit slow last night but this is not the norm for this place.  Thought it was a bit odd that the soda drinks came in a can, and not a glass as all of my other visits.  I am guessing their soda guns were down/out of order for some reason as I haven't had this type of experience before.

All in all, if you are looking for authentic German food this is your place.  Don't miss out on this amazing place.  You won't be sorry.  

There are only down sides to this place that I have found.  First is that they are not open for lunch yet.  A small group of us used to go here once or twice a month for lunch, but since the pandemic, they have not been open for lunch.  
Secondly, since the pandemic and the eating outdoors was the only option, they turned their very small and hard to maneuver parking lot into outdoor dining.  Parking is at a premium here and taking the 6 spots they had had really put a strain on the area and parking.  Hopefully, they will soon open the parking lot back up as there is plenty of outside dining out front, especially with the cold weather approaching, I am not sure all of the outdoor dining spaces are needed.

Speisekammer is one of our favorite restaurants.  The food is always very good, but on this visit, they seemed to be extremely busy.  Our salmon was overcooked and mine was almost burned.  Still, the mashed potatoes and spinach were very good.
Since we always had very good food there, we are going to assume this was a rare time that the food was not up to par.  We'll definitely go back!
The best restaurant in Alameda.  Food is wonderful. Tastes just like the food in Germany.  The best.
The food was great, but we had to wait almost an hour for it to come out.

First time there.
I'm 1/2 German.  
My wife is not. 
We both loved it.

We had just returned from a trip to Munich Germany and really enjoyed the food.  When we found out there was a German restaurant, we knew we had to try it.  The ambience was excellent.  We took my parents for dinner to celebrate my mother's birthday.  The food was absolutely delicious.  Our waiter was very kind and patient .  We were all very impressed with the food and will be returning again to try the other items on the menu.  We love that there weren't a lot of items on the menu and that they had specials which changed every week according to our waiter.  What a wonderful surprise to be able to enjoy authentic and delicious German food so close to home!
Loved it. Food was great. Cocktails were great and overall good experience.

Food was disappointing and service was slow.  Weiner schnitzel was dry and flavorless.  Needed sauce.  Tri tip was overcooked and bland.  Pretzel appetizer was fine but overpriced -- $12 for one pretzel.  Restaurant was busy on a Saturday night and under-staffed.  No one cleared the plates until they brought the bill.  Waiter dropped off the dessert and but didn't take the empty plates, so we had to stack up the plates to make space.  Apple strudel was good, but waitress said it was made at a bakery elsewhere.  It's a popular neighborhood restaurant so I was hoping for better.

Great food and atmosphere for casual dining. Dog-friendly and even has a dog food menu item that always satisfies our pup.

I often get the rouladen as they are always great. The schweinbraten and sauerbraten are always phenomenal options as well. The beer selection is always amazing.

The service is casual, but attentive. Servers often have a deep knowledge of the beer selection, which is great. The bar can make some beautiful and delicious drinks from the drinks menu.

Expect to sit with another group at the long tables outside. Great for meeting new people.
Great place. We go about once a month.
Great place , fantastic food and service beer selection,

We enjoyed lunch. Great beer selections  the service was great Our waitress was friendly and helpful 
Good Octoberfest lunch
Great food and service as always
Waitress extremely nice and kept checking to make sure everything was alright

Food a bit dry unless you had the mushroom gravy.  Overpriced on wine choices.  Would prefer a chunky apple sauce with pancakes.  
Fun to try.  Beers and appetizer.
Great beer selection. I always order the bratwurst. Very satisfying.
Really enjoyed the experience. Excellent overall!
Food was good, lots of draft beer choices. A bit understaffed right now.  Very casual.
The food never fails to delight our palates!! Service is efficient and friendly.
The food here is amazing!! The salmon was superb!!!
Enjoyed the ambiance. A fun evening.

Very, very, very disappointed. Highly unlikely I/We will return.

Server was good but he was in the weeds, with too many tables/guests. Order was wrong, twice, items put on check that weren't ours, food was a disappointment and bland.
We had a blast listening to Mitch Polzak's live set and enjoying delicious food and beer. When you consider that great music came with the dinner, it was an awesome deal. A great night out.
Fun, energetic place and good food.  My Partner loved it!
Amazing German food with great atmosphere. Live music and great bar. If you are craving German fare this is the place

There were several large birthday celebrations going on in the room where we were seated. I saw 1 waiter taking care of all these tables. We got water but we never got bread. He took our Drink order, seemed like a long time b4 we got our drinks. When we got our drinks, he started to walk away and my wife let him know we’re ready to order. My wife ordered the schnitzels, I ordered the bratwurst that I thought was over cooked. The waiter was serving cake to the large group of Birthday tables and caused our wait even longer to get our check. I had to flag him down and ask for a food box and our check. Party of two people never get the same attention that a party of 4 or more get.
Sad, I’m a paying customer too, and have been eating here for several years. Maybe, we’ll start going to Berkeley for our German food, they are very attentive there.
Excellent German food and beer.  Been here several times.  Always consistent and delicious.
Perfect, as always
Fabulous and authentic German cuisine and a great selection of beers.
We waited over an hour for our food. One of the meals was Luke warm.
Great food, great service great ambience!  Will return soon
bratwurst with mashed potatoes and sauerkraut - terrific with a dark marzen beer.
Love the beer garden-such a nice place to hang out with friends and our pups!
Generally very good. I would have preferred the Wienerschnitzel pan fried, rather than deep-fat fried - which left it overly dry. Appetizers were excellent, as were the beer and wine.
Great variety of German food options. All of our dishes were very tasty and well presented. Would highly recommend, especially for German food fans!
The food was delicious and service was good. We always enjoy coming here!
Excellent all around
Usually Speisekammer is top notch, but our meals came lukewarm. Still tasty but not quite as good as usual. Service is great and we were compensated for the glitch.
Great food very nice service

Wonderful 1st time experience! Went for my birthday and was VERY pleased overall.  2 reasons why I gave 4 instead of 5 stars:

1) While server AND service was GREAT, I felt a little "rushed" by server, as if he really wanted to turn the table. But I'm NOT going to be RUSHED when eating! He brought a special birthday treat - which I welcomed; but I wasn't ready for it yet and wish I'd been ASKED WHEN I wanted it instead of server assuming his timing was the correct timing for ME! I do hope the next time he's serving a group celebrating that he'll ASK 1st before bringing the special item! Minor deduction!
2) Parking is HARD around here! Not their fault, of course, but since they make a BIG deal out of how long the reservation will be "held", seems a bit more flexibility is needed to find adequate parking! Plan ahead!

Still, we had a GREAT time and, now that we know about this place,  look forward to returning soon! In fact, we've already planned another family birthday celebration coming up!
We shared an excellent dinner that got better with each course! Traditional German food in an outdoor setting offering great variety. Everything was terrific and we look forward to another visit.
We love this place! Have been coming for years. I do miss German background music though.

The seasonal gazpacho and the prawn with tomato caper sauce and baguette appetizer were AMAZING.  I can't believe at at these and then finished my stuffed cabbage roulade.  So good.  Our drink were equally inspired and delicious.  I always love the Kuhl Cucumber and my daughter tried a vodka, pear, cranberry, hazelnut cocktail - a lovely summer spirit.

Very tasty food- cabbage rolls with mashed potatoes and red cabbage side dish were both delicious, and one order fed two of us easily.
Definitely meat-heavy menu, but well prepared food.
Extremely pleasant outdoor/patio dining.  Lots of shade and well spaced tables.  Super attentive staff, large selection of import beer and great German fare.

Speisekammer has consistently excellent German food all year round including seasonal dishes. The front of house, wait staff and busing staff are all friendly, helpful and focused on providing good customer service. The large, spacious outdoor dining is wonderful for dining parties of all sizes from small to quite large. The beer selection is extensive and ever-changing. The beer on tap is always very good.
We love going to Speisekammer.  The food is always delicious!
Food was amazing waitress had a great personality. Service was a little on the slow side
Best german food I have had in years.  Maybe ever.

I liked the Rouladen.  The Jagerschnitzel was a bit disappointing.  No flavor.  Jagerschnitzel means hunter's chop, so it is supposed to have kind of a wild 
or gamey? flavor. 

It was nice to eat outdoors.  The tables were kept clean and my husband liked the beer.  I would like more choices that were not pork.  Next time I might try
the trout.

Also, it would be nice to have authentic German bread served with meals.  It is so
good and it is a shame the restaurant serves only white bread baguettes.

Truly excellent beer and awesome German comfort food. You absolutely have to order the potato pancakes. The reuben is amazing. The schnitzel is the best I've ever had, with an otherworldly mushroom sauce. It's slightly pricey, not something to do everyday, but the quality and flavor are completely worth it

A classic that doesn’t disappoint in terms of ambience and service. The potatoes weren’t as hot as they should’ve been but it’s a minor thing because it’s such a fun environment. Our server was amazing and gave great beer recommendations
We will be back! The German food was very authentic and the service was friendly and professional. Thank you!

The perfect choice for Father's Day!  Even though it was a busy evening, the staff was friendly and efficient.  We chose this restaurant because we wanted to bring our two dogs, and we were given a long table outside near the entrance of the restaurant.  There was plenty of space between our table and the others, so we felt very comfortable.  The staff was very kind to our pups and even brought them water.  We really like the generous portions as well as the quality of the food and the friendliness of the staff.  We will definitely be back!
Fine German fare, large portions, joyous ambiance.
Excellent traditional German entrees plus a large selection of beers.  Bavarian or Austrian atmosphere and pleasant service. Although a bit pricy, the food is well worth it.
Always appreciate a good dinner here!  Beer was amazing too!
big portions, good value, very relaxed, friendly, comfortable atmosphere
Always delicious! If you want to feel like you are in Germany, come here! It authentic and wonderful!
It's been a while, but the food was very good as usual. Always a favorite.
Incredibly easy to get a reservation, even on fairly short notice.  Great food, drinks and service.  A family favorite.

This is a regular destination for us.

Our family came here for my husband's birthday and it was great. I had the non-alcoholic elderflower cocktail (I love this drink) and my daughter had a version with alcohol.  My husband had a beer. 

My husband had the mussels and potato and bacon soup. My daughter also had the mussels and I had the kleine Nürnberger würstchen. We all shared a medium German salad and potato pancakes. The food was delicious and no one went home hungry. I ordered a slice of black forest cake for dessert and it was as good as any I've had in Germany. We had a great time eating on their patio in front of the restaurant. Very gemütlich!

After more than 2 years away due to the pandemic, we made a return to one of my favorite places in the east bay, and as always, it didn’t disappoint. A tasty cocktail at the bar before dinner, followed up by a tasty meal in the beer garden. The ice cold Pilsner was the crowning touch to a fun night out. Well done, Speisekammer!
Food is always great and they always have some interesting specials too!   Great place, our family loves it as there is something for everyone!
Speisekammer is always a good option. The ambiance, food and service are great.
Great service,food delicious,beer make me little headache
Always the best authentic German food around. Great selection of “on tap” German beer. A delicious dining experience.
The food was fantastic, will be coming back for sure!

We’ve been to this establishment multiple times since the first reservation and have been pleased every time. The food is authentic and there is ample seating inside and outside. The outdoor beer garden is so spacious and welcoming.

The staff are all very nice and David and Cindy behind the bar are fantastic. I consider them a dynamic duo of Alameda.
One of the best places for German food in the Bay Area! Big portions and selection was top notch. Will be telling everyone about this place.

Go-to authentic German "Gasthaus Essen" that my family loves. The four of us had the Schweinebraten, Kaesespaetzle, Reibekuchen and the every popular Jaegerschnitzel.  Everyone was delighted with their order and was thoroughly full. 
For lovers of German beers, I highly recommend the Traunstein Dunkel (Hofbrau). I've never seen it on the tap menu and it was splendid!! Wish I could find over here near Walnut Creek. 
We were seated immediately and service was attentive. Love this place.
Wonderful food staff is amazing!
Wonderful birthday celebration. Food was awesome and so was beer selection!
Great server. Was kind to the dogs and gave them water.  Food reminded us of a beer garden in Munich,  Outdoor tables, authentic German food and great drinks

We love this place. Food is always excellent, staff always really attentive, not to quiet. Not crazy noisy (unless live music) although we haven’t heard music since Covid. (Not sure if they no longer have or we just haven’t eaten on the right day. 

Highly recommended place to eat.
Our first time there.  We felt like we were in Germany
The food & service was exceptional.  No parking lot, but you can park in the residential area.
Delish food.

I'm sad we had not been to Speisekammer earlier. This is German food done just-right. We came for a milestone birthday and had a very easy, delicious, meal. Drinks were good and our son, who prefers burgers, had one and said it was really good.  Service was really friendly and thoughtful.
Amazing food and attentive staff!!  And how did I forget to mention the fantastic beer selection! The cabbage rolls are amazing.  It has an authentic feel and nothing I would change!
I have never had a bad meal at Speisekammer.
Great food and service!!  Great selection of drinks and German food.

Took my wife, our children's mother, to Speisekammer for an early Mother's Day dinner, and came away knowing it was exactly the right choice.  The waitress was friendly, perky, and perfectly tuned in to our sense of fun and humor; the service was so fast, the speed of light felt endangered.  The food (sauerbraten; jaeger...something) was 1) Easily enough for two; 2) perfectly delicious.  The expense was such that we are validated in having come to Speisekammer many times before and will continue to do so.
The stuffed cabbage was delicious.
We always enjoy our meal and the service here. Thank you.
Waiter was especially helpful with birthday cake and split checks.
Wonderful food and wonderful service

What made me decide on Speiskammer for lunch were the stellar reviews found on Google and Yelp. I am sad to say that I found the food to be nothing like what I had read in the reviews. I ordered the typical German dishes, schnitzel with spätzle, I also had a pretzel as an appetizer, all were very underwhelming and the flavors were very bland. Additionally the spätzle came out a bit cold.. I’d like to preface with the fact that I am a bit of a foodie and have eaten at many restaurants throughout the Bay Area, Los Angeles, San Diego, Sacramento areas. Internationally, I have travelled to Germany on several occasions and had authentic German food, this didn’t come close.

Having said that, the drinks and Apple strudel were very good! Additionally the service was good, our waitress was friendly and the ambiance was fantastic. If this is what you enjoy I’d highly recommend but if it’s delicious authentic German food, I would pass on this restaurant.
We had a lovely evening, sitting outside with a heater beside us on a chilly night. Delicious food and great service! Love this place!
The food and service was very good. It was quiet as we are still cautious around the pandemic. My mom thought the beef and cabbage rolls were some of the best she’s eaten, apart from her own recipe!
As always, good food and service!  We lived in Germany, this restaurant is a terrific reminder of our time there.

Everything was delicious! We had the potato pancakes, the potato soup (definitely get this), stuffed cabbage, some kind of sausage with a side of fries, combination of pickled vegetables, and apple strudel. Not a weak dish out of the lot.

Excellent service and great beer selection.
Excellent overall, especially the cutlets! Bartenders were very helpful with beer and spirits selection. We'll be back!
Awesome food
Authentic German comfort food, just like mom made! Schnitzel, sausages,spaetzle, salads, and more. Beers and sodas from Germany.
Wonderful evening to celebrate a special birthday! The food, staff and ambiance were fabulous! They went above and beyond to accommodate us!

We were  very disappointed in the food, being greasy and artificial tasting. It was marginal at best. And was served warm. I have been there many times before but this was a disappointment and will probably not return
Good no great!
We had a fantastic time out as a family.

It was restaurant week in Alameda, so I went with a friend to support our local restaurants. The 3-course menu was delicious and a good value. Speisekammer offers many German beers on tap as the perfect accompaniment.
One of the best places in Alameda.  Dog friendly patio as well

We had a fabulous family dinner to celebrate a special birthday. This is a go to spot for us, great cocktail menu and beer selection, fun atmosphere and many delicious menu options. Don't miss the Apple Strudel!
Nice ambiance with a nod to German fare. Good beer selection.
The food was delicious. The service was friendly. And it made for a great birthday dinner for my husband.
Overall it was an excellent meal & we will go again!!
It was our first time dining and everything was great. The food was hot and tasty along with great service. We will definitely be back.

We sat outside with our dog for dinner around 8 pm so the crowd was thinning out. We ordered the meat platter sized for two or three to try an assortment from their menu and beef with cabbage roll and schnitzel for everyone to try. Everything was really tasty. We tried several German beers and we all had our favorites. They have a menu for dogs also and our dog loved it. Worth at least one stop to try and we shall be back.
Amazing food and beer

When you're in the mood for hearty, comfort food, with great beer in a relaxed space, Speisekammer fits the bill. Loved the room with the fireplace and service was friendly, attentive and quick. Definitely recommend for a casual dinner for two or a group celebration.
Absolutely love Speiskammer!  Ya been the same since it first opened which is why it’s still open.

Always fantastic - our favorite restaurant on Alameda. We were lucky to be seated in the back room, directly in front of the small, roaring fireplace on a chilly evening. Fun Bavarian-themed decor with a large Schwarzwald hunting-themed cuckoo clock and fully-antlered taxidermy on the walls. The menu has slimmed down, but still has a huge cocktails list and many cold and pickled-veg salads.
If your looking for a local place to have good German food & beer plus a little extra this is the place to try out. Great atmosphere. Great service. Neighborhood gem.

Lovely place to hang out in the afternoon. Nice diverse selection of German beers. Conversion of the parking lot into beer garden nice, could use a touch more ambiance (music would be lovely). Still, great place to hang out on a nice afternoon. We did not eat inside so cannot speak to the ambiance inside.
Food was very very tasty. Portions were good and by looks of other's plates very generous. For some items pricing seemed spot on, others a little high. For example $12.50 for a pretzel and cheese and the pretzel was rather small (one person really), sausages also maybe a bit high for sausages. Sandwiches looked great and large, mains (dinner entrees) also looked very large and generous. 
Would absolutely come back and enjoy the beers and food.
Oh, and service was outstanding. The gal we had was WONDERFUL. Very attentive without being intrusive. Lovely sense of humor and helpful with questions about the food and beers.
Delicious food and great great service.

I can’t believe I waited so long to try it out. Both vegetarian entrees were great. I felt spoiled by the cheese plate and the interesting nonalcoholic drink options. Made me want to go back to Germany
Excellent food, beer and drink options!  Expansive beer garden as well.  Friendly service as well.
A family favorite. Food was delicious. Great to see the place was busy again. Suggest reservations.

What a great find! We were looking for a restaurant that offered outdoor dining but never expected to find a fun, welcoming, and wonderful German restaurant. The food was great, the service beyond great, and they even provided heaters to make sure you stay warm. Would recommend to anyone!
Great service and food. Will be back for sure
Food was great - service was outstanding and drinks were awesome!!
Good beer selection, but the food has gone downhill
Favorite restaurant in the area. Everything is delicious.
Best German food around!  Fabulous bee selection.  Great service. Good outdoor dining space.  Established restaurant that knows their business
One of my favorite restaurants in Alameda. Actually, it is my favorite. Speisekammer has become an Alameda institution. If you haven't been, you are missing out.
We love coming here. Our kids are treated great. The food is great. Beer is great. Outside seating with heat lamps.
Loved the food, the service was good, general ambience was nice and casual.  The only thing we wished for was a little background music.  Would have made it that much better.
Wonderful authentic German food in a lovely atmosphere. Great bar, extensive beer selection and do not miss the crispy potato pancakes or the apple strudel
The food was delicious! Ambiance was romantic outdoors and sufficiently spaced from other tables. We loved everything. It was the perfect Valentines dinner date.
So far best family friendly restaurant in Alameda! The food is great, outdoor and indoor area are great, service very fast and professional!
Food was good-- comforting, good variety, generous portions.  Outdoor seating was plentiful and well spaced out.

Delicious food and drinks in a lively atmosphere. Great for groups so you can try all the different food and beverage offerings. Our server was very attentive and thoughtful with his suggestions. We will definitely be back.
We had a great time. It was comfortable food and great drinks in a comfortable setting
Love food, love opportunity to eat outdoors Speisekammer’s!
Tasty and wonderful service! Always a delight!
Great Food and Great Service...two things Speisekammer always delivers on.
Wonderful outdoor dining with heaters!
Authentic German food said my native German husband ! Fabulous meal.
We had a nice time, we were celebrating my friends birthday !
Authentic good German dining experience. Vegetarian options are a welcome surprise.
A fun place to go for delicious food, German of course, and a great selection of beer and wine. The venue is attractively decorated and comfortable.
We had amazing service on New Year’s Eve with our kids and pup. Drinks and food came quickly. Food was great as usual. We ate outside under a tent with festive lights. Happy kids, happy parents.

Not what I expected
The cheese plate was more of a fruit plate with 4 little pieces of cheese
Pretzel with cheese sauce taste like from a can
Cozy, celebratory and delicious! Great menu, drinks and consistently friendly service.

Menu has been pared down (fewer choices of sausages) , but excellent baked potato soup, schnitzel, and all the many kinds of sides and pickled vegetables as before. Fast service and festive holiday atmosphere.
Good food, but extremely noisy next to the bar.  But we’ll go back for the food.
Had outdoor reservation but it was quite cold and we had a 3 month old. They worked things out to get us indoors.  V. appreciated.
Appetizers, drinks, dinner was very good as always, service was on point.
Inedible potato pancakes. Off tasting gravlax. Very nice waitress

Speisekammer combines excellent German with excellent German beers. (There's a full bar but we stick with the beer.) My wife had Wienerschnitzel and hash browns and I had pork roast, which came with mashed potatoes and sour kraut. We also split one of their wonderful pickle salads. That included beets, cucumber, carrots, and cabbage. We also had a couple of dark German beers. They offered desserts but we had to stop. Highly recommended!
Good, hearty food, no-nonsense service. Nice place for our family get-together.

I eat at Speisekammer at least once a week and their food, especially their entrees, are very well prepared and a good value for the money. Lots of great beer, cocktails, wine tool. Always room to sit somewhere. Friendly, welcoming ambiance. They have several nice salads as well. My favorites: the stuffed cabbage and the braised pork.
It’s a nice restaurant for meat lovers. Lots of choices. Good beer. Love it

We are never disappointed when we go to Speisekammer. Our server was fabulous. Attentive when we needed her and unobtrusive when we were busy talking. The food is always good. We actually ate inside for the first time in a very long time and it added to a growing sense of normalcy. Thank you, Speisekammer
Great meal, great beer in a boot and awesome B-day desert
Ample portions, authentic German food, fresh and bright.
Wonderful dinner after a long drive back from Sacramento.  Thank you!
Good food and cocktails. I liked the German Vacation cocktail especially. Could place outdoor heaters by more tables.
I like this place, food is great with big selection of beers.
A rare sort of restaurant these days. The attraction is a beer garden, but the food is quite good too. A treat.
We enjoyed our Oktoberfest meal very much.
Always authentic German food and beers
Be sure to arrive on time if you have a reservation because they won’t hold a table for you if you are a little late!
Not a fancy restaurant but a nice place with good German food.  We loved our jagerschitzel
This restaurant is one of our favorites. The food is always fabulous. The staff is great and we always have a great evening.
Everything! Love it!
Food menu options have been limited since last time we went but it was as still delicious!
Always great food and outdoor dining is great!

My favorite German restaurant. This restaurant not only has ambience and terrific beer selection. It feel authentic. The food is amazing . Large portions and fair pricing.
The strudel and hot chocolate are not to miss.
I love dining here and will return soon.
Our service was extremely attentive, friendly and helpful -- as always -- and the food was excellent, as always. Going to Speisekammer is always an event, never just going out to eat.
My friend and I celebrate the approach of Oktoberfest at Speisekammer every fall. We sat outside on a lovely day and enjoyed German beer and food.
Awesome,  little bit pricey but worth it! A must for any European in the Bay

Delicious comfort food served by warm and friendly staff!
We had eaten here before, but quite a while ago. Whatever we had before must have been just ok, because we couldn't remember it.
On this night, however, the food was absolutely delicious! I had the Gegrilltes Lachsfilet (grilled salmon with mashed potatoes and spinach with onions), my sister had the Weisskohl Rouladen (cabbage leaf stuffed with seasoned ground beef) and said it was at least as good as her German mother-in-laws'! My husband had the Curry Wurscht (pork and beef sausage with curry ketchup and fries). He also enjoyed his dark beer, chosen from an extensive menu of German or German style beers.
Service was great from the friendly hostess to our server and the rest of the staff!
Excellent quality authentic German food.  Get the salad plate.   Grilled salmon perfectly cooked.  Good cocktails too.  Lovely outdoor sitting area - perfect for these Covid times.
We love to come and eat at Speisekammer. The food is excellent and the service is great as well.
It’s a neighborhood gem and best real beer selection, not just 5 kinds of ipa like everywhere else.

This place was highly recommended but we went kind of late and the food was cold and the Potato pancakes were hard as a brick. The server was great and the manager took the meal off of our bill which was very kind.
Excellent genuine German food
It was delicious. Was such a good place fir a good change of foods. Not pizza or burger.
Dined outside after more than a year away. Great service and the food is still good, but the bread isn’t what it used to be.
Always great food and delicious German beer.

We had lunch inside where it was cool and quiet.  They were short staffed and you could see the servers running around. However,  every time they interacted with us, they were sweet and kind.  The food was fantastic!!

They have a great selection of different styles of beers on tap - more than just IPAs. It was enjoyable on a summer afternoon where I could comfortably chat with my wife in a family-friendly environment.
The food was amazing, safety protocols fantastic and our server was the best.
We have been regular patrons for the last 15 years and we continue to be happy to indulge in our favorite German dishes….sometimes you just have to have a schnitzel dinner.
Courteous waitpersons. Abundant and flavorful food servings.
Went here with some friends to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary. It was a chill spot. Not too busy. Service was great. Food was tasty.

Returning after a 2 year hiatus was rewarding.  The food was as spectacular as I remember.  The service was excellent.  I was happy I made reservations because the walk in line was long. The potato pancakes were fabulous as I remember.  Super crispy with thin strands of potato.  I don't know how they do it.  Their beer list was extensive and diverse.

The Jäger schnitzel and bratwurst wer fabulous.  I had the spaetzel with black forest ham.  Super rich and creamy. 

Call for the specials.  I was looking for the roasted pork belly that they had as a special the week before.  Darn.
Consistently good!

We've been to Speiskammer many, many, many times and have always been happy with the food and service (5 stars across the board in the past). This recent visit was perhaps just an off night for the restaurant.
A wonderful place to eat outdoors with fabulous food!
Great Father’s Day experience:) Danke!

I love this German restaurant.  Food is perfect as well as portions.  You can have quiet indoor dining or fun outdoor group dining.  Has a bar and live music often.  Always get a table thou I always do reservations now.
It was great. The food is off the charts. Do yourself a favor and go.

We went for my husband’s birthday with our 7 month old daughter. They have a nice seating area outside where it was easy to bring her in a stroller. We saw a lot of other families with young kids; granted, we were there before 5pm. Food was great and service was fast. I would definitely recommend it, and looking forward to going back!

Not sure if this is due to the pandemic but quality has gone seriously down at this restaurant. The service is still great and staff is super friendly but the food was not as good. My pretzel was stale and also the portions were not as generous

It was our first time visiting Speisekammer on March 14, 2020—and it may have been our last meal out for a bit... if so it was the way to go out strong! I loved everything—from the pretzels and beer cheese to schnitzel, Spatzl, and struedel. I can’t wait for the chance to go back!

I reserved Speisekammer for our group of eight on Saturday, March 7th. We had to signal our server to get drinks, appetizers, and lunch. He ought to have been a bit more attentive for a large group. The beer and wine came promptly, as did the appetizers and lunch once ordered. The food was just OK. A few years ago when we all were last there, we thought our dishes were tasty and nicely presented. I sincerely hope this restaurant isn’t cutting corners to maintain or increase profits. I’d rather pay a bit more if it meant keeping quality high. We hope this isn’t the beginning of a slide into obscurity for Speisekammer. I’ll check it out from time to time, but I won’t bring our group there if things don’t change for the better.

I liked the space; the fireplace was lovely. I was disappointed in the food; it was not particularly flavorful. I wanted more seasoning in all of the food. My two friends felt the same way. One ordered the salmon salad, one ordered the wiener schnitzel and i had the stuffed cabbage rolls. we each found our food to be bland. i did like the salad dressing.
We never had a bad meal here....it is one of our favorites !
There was a large group in our room making more noise than typical

Looking forward to a big night with our newleywed kids.  They sat us by the bathroom.  The furthest corner from anything.  We didn't know it was the bathroom because there was a curtain and no sign.  But as the night went on the traffic by our table was busy.  I thought going through OpenTable, we would have had a better table.

Even though it showed up written correctly on the final bill, one of our plates came out with the wrong meat on it(one covered in gravy). When returned, then it was at least a crispy schnitzel, but pork rather than veal. Now, though, the spaetzle had become fried  potatoes. They graciously brought a side of spaetzle, but hmmm-get it right the first time? The cabbage rolls were ok-so well-cooked that the cabbage was thin mush. Mashed potatoes had no texture at all-whipped to death.The dessert list was small and nothing excited. How about a dark chocolate cake rather than German chocolate (which is NOT a German thing)? We reserved, but our table was right in front of the bar, so before the music began, people were standing close by.
Great food.... beer...drinks...

Great food n beer selection
 The service was excellent.  The waiter explained all about the beers n got as extra bread etc since we were all hungry. It was my birthday celebration n they made it special.
Great food and great service! I would highly recommend this restaurant.
noisy with absolutely no parking. food was just ok. expensive for what you got

This was our second lunch reservation and found to be with the food quality and service to be consistent. Have nothing negative say. Love everything on their menu. Excellent waitress. Would go back in a heartbeat

Met friends for lunch on a Saturday afternoon.  Arrived at opening 11:30 and felt silly for making reservations but the place soon filled up (not even a game day!).  Great bar and of course German and other beers on tap from both local and from around the world.  We shared a large meat plate (all their greatest sausage and pork hits) and a large mixed German salad plate (four different salads, all reasonably healthy).    Finished off sharing the best strudel i've ever had (including places in Germany). Good value for the prices too.  So fortunate to have Speisekammer local in Alameda!

Service was excellent and the drinks and apps arrived quickly.  Hostesses warm and inviting.

Very flavorful and savory dishes, comfort food but with a pop.  Fresh ingredients, deelish sauerkraut and sausage.  Told my workplace in San Leandro, and they've gone 4 times now since November.
Love this place! Went for restaurant week lunch
We keep coming back here 5-7 times a year. It’s always good. Not many places have a dozen plus German beers on tap, cocktails, and tasty German food. Three generations in our family love it.

Convenient location for meeting with family and friends from Bay Area. TV’s convenient tu not intrusive. Food and service was very good, we’d return for that and the beer.  Would like to go for dinner and live music.  Potato pancakes, lunch special (restaurant week), pretzels and pastrami sandwich is highly recommended.  The salmon salad was also a hit.

I am tempted to say "fast food" due to the service.  We were seated promptly and ordered a bottle of wine.  Took a bit of time to show up but that was fine as they had a good band playing.  We ordered and specifically told the waiter to take a long time as we were not im a hurry and wanted to listen to the music.  

Our salad and soup arrived quickly - my wife took one bite of her salad and I was on my first spoon of soup when our main course arrived.  So we squeezed those onto our small table for two and let them cool while we finished our soup and salad.  I probably should have sent them back.  

We finished our meal before the band finished its first set.  So much for a leisurely evening.

I will probably try again BUT will not order our main course until we are finished with the appetizer.  Lesson learned.

Authentic German food (mostly for meat lovers but they do have at least one seafood and some vegetarian options), generous beer selection, great ambiance and friendly staff. In addition they have live music Friday and Sat nightS. We visit frequently and are rarely disappointed. They can accommodate  large groups And weather permitting they have patio dining reminiscent of a Biergarten. Weekends are busy so to get a good table especially for larger group make a reservation.

A must visit each trip to Alameda. Last time a vegetarian friend grabbed my Jager schnitzel and was wolfing it down before I could warn her. Great selection of German bier. The flour-less chocolate cake is superb.
The veal was VERY TOUGH.  Very disappointing and I have been here many times.
Food is always good.  Place always seems busy.  We went on the early side so no problem getting a table.
Nice restaurant. Good food. Large portions
Great food and service!! Fun, Fun, Fun!! Thanks!! Saturday night music was very good also! The vom fass beers rocked!
Love Speisekammer, the food and beer are always great.
Fantastic place with great authentic german food!   Love it!

Stopped on our way home from the airport for a wonderful dinner after a long flight.  We've been meaning to try Speisekammer for some time, but just have never done it.  We will be back!  I had the spaetzle with ham and it was delicious and enough for two large meals.  My husband had the goose and thought it was really good.  He also took a good size portion home to have for lunch the next day.  Our server was very attentive as was the busser, who asked multiple times if there was anything else we needed.
Phenomenal as usual. Speisekammer transports you to a comfortable, old world setting with delicious food and a great selection of imported beers, local brews and yummy cocktails.
The food is always great. The atmosphere is very inviting. Lots of families with kids, all well-behaved. Great staff. Love it!

This is my favorite restaurant in Alameda and one of my favorites in the Bay Area.  If you are looking for comfort food and drinks that are always changing, then this is the place.  I have come here 14 or 15 times and they never disappoint.  It is a great place to bring a group or your kids.

Fun, festive place for dinner with a group.  Great starters, bread and pickles.  Entrees were a bit bland, but that’s the nature of some German dishes so I can’t say if it’s the chef’s fault.  Service was outstanding!  Would go again and stay for the live music.
Great beer selection, delicious authentic Bavarian dishes.
I have been here a few times and every time it is delicious, I have never had any problems. The staff is very good at meeting anyones needs and wants.
Very nice find!!  Always looking for food German food & this was a great find!  We’ll be back.

We enjoy dining at Speisekammer.  Good food and German beer.  We had a ringside seat to watch the entertainment setting up; unfortunately we couldn't stay to hear them play.  Maybe next time.










g
I have yet to find a better German restaurant in the Bay Area.  Decent vegetarian choices as well.
Eating here is always a treat, but I love the winter specials and this year’s goose was excellent.
Happy Birthday!
Native German here. Fruit plate, Wienerschnitzel (from veal), potato salad, drinks, it was all great. Service was wonderful.

Wonderful restaurant, just like being in Germany.  It was great to have a true German dinner here in the states.  The restaurant is bigger than it looks but still fills up on the weekends.  Hard to hear others speak on a Saturday night, but still a great overall experience.
Speisekammer is a great place to meet up with friends for great food and atmosphere, just remember to bring your appetite, the portion sizes are quite large!

We had a very nice time but it was spoiled by the fact that we had a reservation at 7:30 and waited until 8:30 to get a table - one that was next to the entrance on a cold night.  While we were comped the appetizers (very nice), staff wasn't very apologetic, aware, or attentive while we waited TOO LONG for a table on my mother's birthday. A buzz killer.

If you are very casual and don't care, then enjoy.  The food is good.

We really enjoyed Speisekammer! It’s a cozy place with lots of authentic German touches without being dark or gloomy. There was an excellent selection of German and local beers and wines. We have a lot of experience with German food, one of us having grown up in a German family. So trust us when we say the food is very authentic, freshly prepared, and plentiful...come hungry! For appetizers we had the Reibekuchen (potato pancakes), which were delicious but we felt the apple sauce was oddly gloopy (cornstarch?), and the Fischplatte, which was very fresh and provided a little salad. For entrees we had the Sauerbraten (very tender marinated and slow cooked beef), which was very good and had a nice sour tang to the sauce as it should, and the Wienerschnitzel which was also hearty and very tasty and came with some of the best roast potatoes I’ve had at a restaurant (courtesy of onions and bacon). Our only disappointment was the red cabbage that came with the Sauerbraten was also gloopy with cornstarch: not needed and a little out of place. We rinsed the leftovers before reheating the next day and they were wonderful. Service was courteous and attentive without being intrusive. Parking is a little limited/tricky so allow time to find street parking. We will definitely be back when in the area.

Upon arrival the hostess was very welcoming, and we were seated right away, even though not all of our party had arrived.  Our waiter was super friendly and knowledgeable about the foods.  The meal and drinks were outstanding.  This was our second time there will continue to come for special occasions.

Drove across the Bay with a friend who loves German food as much as I do. We made a reservation for lunch and were seated right next to the cozy fireplace.  While everyone else was on a buying binge for the holidays, we had the most wonderful Wienerschnitzel I've had outside of Vienna.  TO DIE FOR!  The side potatoes were heavenly, and my friend subbed hers out for spaetzle that she enjoyed as well.  I had the draft Bitburger Pilsener and my friend had an Amber Hefeweizen that our server brought her to taste first against a sample of the usual one.  Apple strudel for her and Mohnstrudel for me - yummy!

I will be back and soon for this fine food! I cannot wait to try the sauerbraten and other awesome things on the menu.  If you like German food, or even just good food, check this place out.  Would love to come back in the evening when there's live music, or on a warm day to sit outside in the biergarten.

The only minimal downside was that we parked in the slim alley of parking area immediately to the right of the restaurant thinking that it must lead out to a street on the other side.  It does not!  We had to back out onto the street in a very narrow alley and could not see the traffic coming.  Thank goodness new cars have cameras everywhere.  It was pouring and difficult to see.  Perhaps they could add parking suggestions to their website?  This was a tiny headache in the end, but I would have appreciated knowing about it in advance.  Danke!
Service is lacking. Tables need cleaning. Very little parking availability.

Our company had our first Christmas Party at this place because of our love for German food and beer,  along with the good reviews they had. We drove from Sacramento to Alameda and we are glad we did. We had a great time and really enjoyed the service along with the quality food and beer. We plan on coming back for October. Thank you to all of the staff for dealing with us if we were a little too loud.
Excellent dinner of roast goose and other delicious dishes. Service was top notch as always
Awesome drinks and outstanding service. Entertaining music making the experience perfect for a weekend evening.
Always good beer, food and service. That’s why we keep coming back!!
Best German food out there.
For some reason our group of 3 was put in the room for large parties and one group was quite noisy.  I do not know why we were not put in another room which only had tables for up to four.

Third and likely last visit. Food was really sub-par.  Potato pancakes were absolutely tasteless.  It was just a deep fried nothing.  Brussel sprouts were overcooked and way too salty. Entrees also way too salty and spaetzle was bland and barely warm. The din in the room was deafening.  Overall it was a bummer.
Outstanding restaurant. One of my favorites. Very fog friendly. And of course excellent beer.

Everyone raved about the potato bacon soup, the beed goulash, and the sauerbraten.  But unfortunately, they were out of the pork belly special even though we were there at 6:00 PM on a Saturday.  They were very busy, so service was hit or miss.

Loved the food.
Loved the beer.
Loved the dessert!
Our server was great, attentive and efficient.
The only issue was they said I called to change our reservation to Sunday! On Friday, I received a text to confirm Saturday, which I did. I even received an email confirming Saturday! They did find us a table.
I will return for the curry wurst!

The best German restaurant in the SFBA! I grew up with German food and when we discovered Speisekammer, I was ecstatic - the schnitzel, spaetzle, braised sauerkraut, potato pancakes, stuffed cabbage rolls! If the goulash is on the specials menu, don't miss it - it's made with true Hungarian sweet paprika, the way it should be. They even have currywurst, LOL. The service is always excellent, something those trendy hot bistros opening up everywhere, should try harder to copy. The beer list is amazing, too!
Food was terrific, service very prompt and friendly, parking is problematic. Beer cheese & pretzel was the bomb! Definitely will be back.
It was a great place to celebrate Veteran's day with my Army men!

Speisekammer offers a wonderful selection of German foods, all that seem true to the land.

Service is very good. Staff is very friendly, welcoming, and helpful.

I love this place and the food never disappoints. Everything on the menu is extremely good. It can get a little loud, and it’s more of a family style restaurant than a dressy place, but it perfect for a date at anytime of the day.
Love this place. the food is outstanding and the service is great. It's loud, so, be warned. :)
Amazing food (hello, comfort food at its best!l), wonderful service, great wine list, neighborhood vibe, so warm and friendly! Extremely happy to have this restaurant in our neighborhood!

Once we were seated in a quieter space, we had a wonderful dinner.  The rolled beef was out of this world, with enough for a dinner or lunch at home too!  The spaetzel, red cabbage, potato pancakes with sweet mustard and apple sauce were all yummy.  My sibs’ Sauerbrauten lived up to her very high expectations!  Great restaurant for German fare, good service and European flair.

Unfortunately, this place lacks the quality that modern German cuisine has to offer.  The Reibekuchen were either overcooked or previously frozen and therefore were a disappointment.

The German-style salad had no quality and no imagination to it and is not up to the standard in a good German restaurant.

The Jaegerschnitzel's sauce was ultra bland and I have no idea who this was made, but no! This is not a Jaegerschnitzel.

The Wienerschnitzel's veal was hard to eat and unevenly pounded (a hallmark feature of a good German or Austrian Wiener Schnitzel).  

So an attempt to get a taste from home failed badly.  I should have stuck with Naschmarkt in Campbell.  I am so terribly sorry that this wants to portrait German food, at best a less than good restaurant in a small German village.  I have the feeling that this was the understanding of a non-German Chef, who was never trained in a German kitchen.  I would hire a consultant chef trainer to get this kitchen up to modern standards.

It is neither worth the money, nor the time it took to get there.
Lil spendy but good times for sure. Relaxed place with hearty food
All innovative and delicious!! Schnitzels ti due for = yum!
One of my favorite to go to get some very yummy German food.
If you want to try awesome German eats, you just gotta go!  The beer, food , ambiance and service was awesome!
Our go to restaurant.....always satisfied with the authentic German cuisine.

Speisekammer is an amazing restaurant.
The food is delicious and tastes homemade 
All the dishes are hearty and good
Bring your appetite.
The service is efficient and great.
The hot chocolate is a treat. Tastes homemade.
The atmosphere is cordial and fun.
I haven’t been to Germany but I feel like I’m there.
Great outdoor seating
It’s a cozy restaurant so I like going when it cold.
Good German food and the band was excellent as well. I recommend Speisekammer for all how to love German food and good music.

Our favorite German restaurant...so reminiscent of many of the restaurants in 
Bavaria, loud, fun, active, delicious and entertaining.
An East Bay gem if you appreciate German fare and a large selection of draught German beers.
We had an excellent meal at a very reasonable price
The food was good. The noise level was very very high

We had a very enjoyable experience once again at Speisekammer...
We had a great get together for a 70th birthday party!
Enjoyed the German authentic food and drinks!
Great traditional German vibe for Octoberfest.  Good Saturday music.  Never disappoints.
It is a good place to hang out with friends!
A perfect Octoberfest meal,  Dining outside with steins of beer and a great roast pork!
Love going to Octoberfest. Great beer. Great food overall! .

Great restaurant with good food, large portions and helpful service. It was a bit loud this Saturday due to the large crowd of people that were dining here. Maybe Oktoberfest puts everyone in the mood for German food. Great neighborhood restaurant.
Delicious and great staff!
We just love this place. The food is always good no matter what we get and the staff can always recommend the perfect beer to pair with your food or taste.

Always delicious traditional German food.  Great, fast service and amazing spaetzle, sauerkraut, mashed potatoes and beer braised pork.  The atmosphere is lively and inviting.  They had live music on the Friday night we went.  A great experience.
Brought my parents that lived in Germany for many years they enjoyed there meal and my dad was Happy to get a good Pilsner! Service was excellent!  Parking is a bit tuff but was a 👍 up over all !

We lived in Germany for a year and a half while my husband was serving in the Army. The food at Speisekammer was like being back in Berlin. We had the Jagerschnitzel and Schweinebraten. They were both great! I’d definitely recommend this place for some authentic German food.
Excellent food and the waitress was spectacular.  She answered questions and made recommendations at our request.  Wonderful service!
SCHWEINEBRATEN is terrific but XYL prefers SAUERBRATEN. Guests had WIENER SCHNITZEL and WEISSKOHL ROULADEN.  Great potato pancakes. The beer list cannot be beaten. We visit each trip to Alameda.
Always great food and service here! Lots of fun when there's live music :)

We picked Speisekammer because we hadn’t been there and German food sounded great.  We weren’t disappointed.  Speisekammer is a charming place with very good food.  We all enjoyed the dining and the great selection of beer.  The highlight of the evening was the Server Liz.  She was friendly,, informative and very helpful.  She turned the evening into a real event.
Loved our visit with our friends. Our waitress Erin was amazing, knowledgeable and friendly. Answered all our questions with ease. She is a GREAT waitress.

The ambience is wonderful. The decor reminded me of my childhood piano teacher’s European style home in San Francisco, lots of warm old country touches. The food is fantastic. The charcuterie appetizer was a great starter, the small platter of tasty meats, pickles, and a green salad was more than enough for 2, the sauerbraten tri tip was fork cutting tender, and the peach cobbler brought tears to my eyes. The staff is so friendly and completely at your service. All you need do is show up and enjoy!

The service is top notch and the food  is very authentic German.  I live in Fremont and the commute to Speisekammer is well worth the drive for the food experience.  Great beverage selection  and there's nothing like live entertainment while enjoying good times with friends and family. Probably the best German dining experience in the Bay area.

What a great neighborhood gem. The food on my last visit was outstanding. Have been here before and the food, only occasionally, had a few misses. What establishment doesn't? The thing is, they keep coming back and doing it well. German food can be a hard sell in the vegan, I won't-eat-it-unless-it's-kale Bay Area. Live a little and go for the carbs. Beer selection good also. Speisekammer is pretty unpretentious but young with a few families thrown in there. Only downside is, wait time can be long as the food takes awhile to get to the table, but worth it. Aside from the standards, which are good, I would heartily recommend the butterfish if available and the oxtails. Street parking can be a problem so be prepared to walk a few blocks.

The food and service is always exceptional. The interior is comfortable and clean, and the patio is wonderful. It can get a little loud inside but that’s just because everyone is enjoying the food and company. In the form of the cafe and patio we enjoyed great music on a Friday as well.

My husband and I took his sister and brother in law here for lunch. They were stationed in Germany so knew what the food should taste like. They had been to other German restaurants and were not impresses. When each one of them took their first bite their comment was "Now this is German food". Each one of us enjoyedoir lynches and would highly recommend this restaurant.
Good food, nice waiter outside dining, difficult to make a reservation on OpenTable

We arrived at 5:45 for reservations at 5:45. When walking in the inside was again very musty or heavy air as in no air circulation. They need to turn on a fan. We chose the other option and ate outside. It was a little cool outside but better than the blanket of humidity inside.

Food was delicious! I've only had German food a couple of times. We had the wiener schnitzel, jagerschnitzel, and schweinebraten. All were super good and we really enjoyed the food and atmosphere. I really appreciated the full flavor of the German food. (Not just meat and potatoes.) They also had food for the kids.The atmosphere was friendly and open. We would definitely go here again.
Hard to choose among many delicious sounding meaty comfort food dishes.  We both enjoyed what we had there, and took home enough for several meals as leftovers.

Our family arrived from Atlanta, and we all agreed on "German food" on our way home from the airport. We arrived early, anticipated the worst-they are always busy, and were met with the best of surprises.  Despite being early, they seated us, and provided the best service throughout the meal.   As always, the food was delicious-just difficult to decide upon because there are always so many choices.

If you love German food, I strongly recommend Speisekammer.  It's almost a 2 hour trip through heavy traffic for me but well worth it.  Because of the distance, I can't go there as often as I would like. If it was within an hour from my home, I'd be there every week for sure.  The sauerbraten in particular, is outstanding.

Food was very good, but location is difficult. Terrible parking. Getting there by Lyft was ok, but getting Lyft pickup was difficult (some drivers seems lost, going wrong way on tracking map). Lyft driver we go came from a long way. Would come here a lot more if they had more parking.
Great food love the music.  Service is great

I've been going to Speisekammer for many years now and I've never had a bad meal. If you like a lot of options when it comes to eating pork, this is the place to go. Their list of German beers is outstanding. And the desserts are excellent. My wife and I had the apple struddle with vanilla ice cream, which was outstanding. My brother had the Turkish coffee flavored crem brulee, which may have been a special (so they might not always have it). In the end it cost us about 40 USD each, which was reasonable since we had plenty of leftovers. We also had a bottle of wine that my brother brought (20 USD for corkage).

We arrived right as the dinner service was starting so it was really slow to get our drink order taken and to get those drinks.  But once our waiter got into the swing of things the rest of the dinner and service was fantastic!
Good eats! Service was great. Enjoyed the live music but it was very loud so difficult to carry on a conversation.
We love Howell Devine (the band) and the food was great.  Thanks.
Great food in a region where there is almost no competition for this cuisine and superb music in a fun setting.
Excellent Authentic German cuisine, great bar with wide range of German beers, wines and imaginative cocktails. Love the live music, happy crowd and very good waitstaff

Very enjoyable!  The food was quite good and I appreciated the option for a “small” version of several entrees I.e. one cutlet instead of two.  Several options for side dishes that really allows you to customize your meal to your liking.  The wine  I greatly appreciated the thoughtful notice!  We were seated immediately but waited 10 minutes or more before a server approached the table.  It also seemed that we waited 20 min or so for food to arrive - perhaps a nod to the slower pace of meals in many European countries??  The food was excellent - each meal came out exactly as we ordered.  Would love to go back - lunch on one of the many patio tables would be a real treat on a nice day.  
After leaving the restaurant, I received an email from OpenTable that my reservation had been marked “No Show” but that was quickly remedied by OpenTable with the restaurant so I consider that a success.
We had a lovely evening with great food and awesome music.
I hadn’t been in a while and was happy as always with the meal.
Beautiful day on the patio
The food and service are great.  The parking is challenging.
I love this place!  Good people, good food, always a great time

The 6pc potato pancakes appetizer @ $10.50 is a bit high for an oversized potato chip.  A soft potato filling on the inside with a crunch on the outside would have sufficed.  It did leave a big mess trying to cut into it.


The Stuffed Cabbage is the main reason we came.  It is the 2nd time we came and Speisekammer was completely out.  If an item such as this is so popular, more of it needs to be prepped for the evening service.  The waitress also did not advise us of the unavailable item until taking our order.  It would also be helpful to be advised of this so that those who are committed to one item can make another choice.  But again, the best solution is to have enough of an item on the menu to serve everyone.


We had our reservations @ 7:15PM and left about an hour later.  At 8PM, the music began.  It was nice for the atmosphere.  We would have been nice if they started earlier.  Also, if a group can play live German Folk music from the Alps with an accordian that would make it even more authentic.


The Peach Cobbler was one of the best desserts we've ever had.


Hope this critique help makes it better.

We visited Speisekammer on July 5. We had a number of dishes, all of them excellent. Servings were good-sized, which meant good value for the price. Service was exceptional. The restaurant has live music on Fridays and Saturdays, so the noise level was moderate. We were still able to carry on conversations while the band played, all the same. Highly recommended.

This was my second time at Speisekammer, and just like the first time, we waited forever for drinks and food. I like the ambience, and I like the food, but the restaurant is way understaffed and simply isn't able to serve people in a reasonable time.
It was my first time at Speisekammer and I was very happy with the food, service and location. I will return again! The other guest in my group also enjoyed the lunch.
Everything was great, though the waiter was a little distracted.  He kept forgetting things, though he was always pleasant.  The band was VERY LOUD, but also very fun.
Delicious entree, best dessert chef around,  terrific service.
Celebrating birthday with family.
surprise, great wine list, too! six happy diners with different tastes and we were all happy-- start to finish
Excellent authentic German food and drink. The only problem is th absolute lack of parking. My wife and I are both handicapped and it is a major problem when we muscular two blocks away.
Fathers Day.

This restaurant never ceases to delight.  The food was superb.  Service was a little slow that day, but it was Father's Day so it was understandable.  And the meal was worth the brief wait.   My friend's JÄGERSCHNITZEL VOM SCHWEIN  was in an incredible sauce.  My SCHWEINEBRATEN was moist, fork tender and full of flavor.  Best Sauerkraut ever!

GREAT AUTHENTIC GERMAN FOOD,  Big selection of beers and the coffee was good too. We had a very attentive server with good suggestions for pairing. Parking is a little difficult so go early! A fun experience.
Consistently good. Amazing beer selection. Great staff. Feels like you are in Germany.
Ya Guud!  Been too long since last time, will endeavor to NOT make same mistake otra vez!

Was our first time having German food. What a place to be initiated at. The food tasted amazing. The Reibekuchen (potato pancakes) were cooked to perfection and they come with a tart applesauce. Tasty! The Kleine Nürnberger Bratwürstchen (petite sausages) were tasty and come on a bed of sauerkraut. Made for sharing. The Sauerbraten entree was tender and the sauce/gravy was tasty as could be. We also had the Jägerschnitzel Vom Schwein entree. The pork cutlets were moist and the beer mushroom gravy is absolutely amazing, I kid you not. We had the apple strudel for dessert. YUM! I guarantee it won't disappoint.
We enjoyed a rare warm night in Alameda so sat outside. We waited a bit for our waiter but once we connected he was very attentive and friendly. You can't beat those potato pancakes and spaetzle.
We were seated inside, but it grew very much too hot by the middle of the meal. The food was well prepared, but took over 45 minutes to arrive. The drinks were excellent and the portions were large.
Love this place.
I always recommend Speisekammer. Great food, great beer, great atmosphere.

A great German pub. Excellent food and huge beer selection plus a full bar. Portions are huge.  We always end up with leftovers for a second meal at home.  Fish platter appetizer is not to be missed. Ask to sit in the back for a quieter experience when they have live music in the bar area. Highly recommended.
Great German food.

Good German restaurant- very authentic 'Bier Garten' vibe. Nice traditional bench seating garden patio out front. On a side street so not too busy. Street parking and small free parking lot.
Food was excellent and very good quality. I'm the daughter of a German Mom and have been to Germany many, many times. German pretzel shipped in from German bakery in Vacaville every morning (!) delicious. Best one I've had in the US. Spinach salad with smoked trout- delicious. Weinerschnitzle, excellent. Beer- of course excellent. Nice server. Nice, relaxing, positive atmosphere. If you are looking for an authentic German restaurant,  I recommend.  I'll bring my Mom here :-)

We had a great time as we were celebrating my daughter-in-law‘s new job which starts tomorrow. Marco is an excellent server and our food came quickly and we had all the help we needed in a very timely manner. We had a great time. 
This is the place of the three of us have enjoyed twice in the last month. We previously came on April 29  and we enjoyed it so much then that it was an easy pick for us to come again tonight.
Food and service fabulous.  We were seated next to a very loud 3top that was so very loud.  I will definitely go back hopefully at a quiet table.

Wonderful authentic german restaurant.  We have very few traditional german restaurants here in the bay area...fortunately for us, Speisekammer is close enough that e can make it a regular part of our dining experience, while being good enough to make it a rewarding experience.  We started our meal with the appetizer Kleine Nurnberger Bratwurstchen, six small wursts served with sauerkraut.  For my entree I ordered the Schweinhocke, (special item not on the standard menu.)  My wife ordered the small Wiener Schnitzel with roasted potatoes.  Both meals were prepared well.  There are many beers available on tap, I selected a Kolsch ale, my wife went for a french Sauvignon blanc. All in all, you can't go wrong if you like good german food.
Does what it does uniquely and well. A must meal each time I’m in Oakland.

I enjoy the food as does my wife. The bread basket could use a pretzel bread and should come with a bit more butter. But it is good and they will bring more.

I love the flavor of the Jägerschnitzel, but even the full size is not quite enough food (hence, the need for more bread).

That said, I probably need to order an appetizer first. I don't do that at most restaurants though, and seldom come away still hungry.

The parking is terrible and I have to be ground guided to get out of the lot. 

But with all of the minor issues, we keep coming back because the taste of the food is just that good.
Excellent food. All kinds of schnitzel, sausages and cabbage . And yes potato pancakes a delish! Very friendly people too!

Have eaten here before and enjoyed the food.  Took my parents for some good German food, they had lived in Austria for a number of years and really loved the restaurant and food. Will take them back again.
Gotta love this little slice of Bavaria in Alameda. Food is good and the service is always very good. Recommend for a fun place to take out of town guest.

This is a great jem in Alameda. If you love German food, you need to visit this establishment. Great food, terrific beer and wine selection, terrific service. You should not miss the pretzels and beer cheese sauce.
Great food and great beer. If the weather is nice I highly recommend sitting at the outside tables.

Service was excruciatingly slow. I had a weiss wurst and pretzel lunch. Both of the items were good by themselves but the wurst came in a bowl of lukewarm liquid with all the charm and flavor of dishwater, making it hard to eat without soaking the pretzel in the dishwater, or splash it around trying to cut the sausage. You would NOT want to drink the stuff.

Great selection of beers on tap, unfortunately none of drink during the day and since we were here for lunch we'll have to come back for a dinner sometime to try them.   The food was very good, we each had something different (6 of us) and all enjoyed them.  Portions were good sized, those that got the full size could have easily had only the smaller size since we took doggie bags home with us.

Wonderful restaurant with authentic German food and beer.  Our daughter suggested this restaurant for Easter Sunday lunch.  We were not disappointed. Food was great.  We will be back.  I will have to get an extra order of the potato pancakes next time!
This was so much fun! The food was delicious and great service.  I will go back soon!
Great food / great service. Tough parking.

Loved that we found a beautiful hoffbrau. We went early, it was quiet. Beautiful German-style interior and patio. Wanted so much to like it.  Food and service were OK/good. Compared to othe German restaurants such as Supenkuche (sp?) in SF, the food was just OK: Neither main dish nor salad were "wow, this is so delicious." They were prepared well and nicely (tender, hot, nicely breaded pork cutlet), but the recipes were missing something (spices such as paprika?), they were relatively flavorless. TI will say the mushrooms in the sauce were delicious, it's just the sauce itself, which is the defining element of the dish did not perform. he spaetzel, however, was excellent. I had the jaegerschnitzel, and like I mentioned, the sauce just didn't have much flavor, although it looked wonderful. Also, the do dont bake their pretzels to order, so they were tough How hard is it to bake one fresh like other hoffbraus? 

Beer was very good (Beittberger Pilsner).

Service was very pleasant and appealing (man, woman waiters plus a busboy) but wassuper fast, such that meal was rushed and we ended up not even being there an entire hour on our Friday night special meal out, as all food placed down in front of us immediately. The hostess who took us to our table seemed so bored and unhappy when she seated us, and she didn't talk, just sorted went through the motions.  And the music was off--it was not German or classical or something that fitted the restaurant -- it clashed, oldies pop music, gospel -- it distracted.

I think we saw owner at the bar as we left, whomever it was seemed very friendly and happy and enough personality to carry the place. Unfortunately, that spirit and passion was not carried through the dining room. Sadly, we won't return or recommend based on food missing flavor. I hope/trust other have excellent experience enough to keep this beautiful place going.

6 of us ate dinner together and had a perfectly delightful meal.  The food was home style in the best of terms.  There was nothing among the 6 entrees that we wouldn't order again.  Our waiter was fantastic.  Besides being able to answer all of our questions about the ingredients in all of the food items, his knowledge of the beer menu was fantastic.  It is a German restaurant so the best alcoholic drink from the bar is beer.  One of our party asked for a high end Napa Valley wine and it was the only time our waiter seemed a bit stymied.  The beer menu is so extensive that it is hard to go wrong there.  A great place for families and adults a like.  It is one of the most comfortable and yummy places in Alameda.

Speisekammer is a decent comfort food restaurant.  Our server was excellent.  My partner liked his beer but my Hemingway daiquiri was too sweet although it was certainly strong enough.  I really liked my JÄGERSCHNITZEL and its accompaniments but my partner's side of roasted potatoes was really dry so overall his WIENER SCHNITZEL dish was hard to eat.  The potatoes had obviously been sitting around too long.  A better side would have been mashed potatoes or Spätzle.   I'd eat at Speisekammer again but not real soon.
Always love the food. Best pork chops we’ve ever had!
We love Speisekammer and make the trip to Alameda just to eat there. We love the food and selection of beer, and always find the staff friendly and helpful.
We were celebrating with my high school senior and this was his request. Great food, service and overall experience as usual.

Good wholesome food at affordable prices. You can get a fresh salad, roast meat, fresh sausage with a variety of German beers, cocktails, or wine. Big place, too. Nice outdoor seating area in good weather. I eat there at least once a week.
A fantastic home style restaurant. We come here for every special occasion! Always a fabulous experience.

We have always really enjoy going to Speisekammer. The food is good German fare, quality choices you would find at a small local beer house in Germany. 

The 2 top tables have legs very close together, so it makes it a little tight for larger (I am 6'6") people.

The service was polite and cheerful, but a little slow. Also, the server who was bringing food out from the kitchen, tried to set the main course down as we were starting our appetizers. This is always a huge fail with me.
Overall it was nice. The waitress never did come back to check if more drinks were wanted. Atmosphere was not as authentic German as hoping.
Get together with friends to meet my brother visiting from out of state. Mixed ages all enjoyed the beer, the service , and the authentic German food with nice salads
Excellent food and surroundings.  Loved the decor and music. Food was excellent. We had the potato pancakes and brats and sauerkraut. Everything was great.
Prefer entertainment to start before 8 pm - may be 7 pm
We visited to listen to Mark Hummel and the Deep Basement Shakers play on a Friday night- what fantastic music! The food was yummy, the German beer was top notch. Would definitely return.
Way too noisy. Great music impossible to hear or enjoy
Our friend said the sauerbraten was better than he had in Germany! Everything was delish!
Excellent German food, as usual.  Speisekammer is tops.
Food was great, but a little pricey for some sausage and fries.
Always a great meal, fantastic service and extremely comfortable environment! Thanks!!!!
Delicious as usual! We love this place! The food is top-notch!
