Excellent food and beers, a good place to get together with friends.

Everything was great with the exception of the hostess, who sat someone else under my reservation and then argued with me about making one. She proceeded to act like she was doing me a favor by assembling a table at the last minute. Our waitress was exceptional she always is and the food was amazing. The hostess needs better training
Good ambiance and live music, but food is only mediocre
Quintessential German cuisine and fantastic beer selection.
Great in everything and especially good server..

I lived in Germany for 12 years.  This place just doesn’t get it.  I ordered Curry Wurst and it was decent sausage covered with an inadequate sauce-read only  catsup with no curry taste at all.  I’ve had much better at a kiosk in Berlin.
Great authentic German food, terrific beer selection and ambience.  Excellent choice for families and small groups.
Happy with yummy Gluten Free dishes and with the good selection of beer and wine.
It was a the perfect place for 9 friends on a Sunday afternoon. Great German food, German beers on draft, and friendly vibe.
Always a wonderful experience at Speisekammer! Food was delicious, but be prepared for a loud experience. Fun for a group and they have a kids menu. Highly recommend.
Great time overall. Wonderful food. Beer was excellent across the board. Can’t wait to go back!!!

We went there after watching Check Please!  They did not disappoint.   I had the Jagerschnitzel with mushroom gravy - wow!  Amazing quality and generous portions.  Terrific beer selection.  We brought a visiting German and she was very impressed.    We’re going back this summer to sit in the beer-garden.

The food at Speisekammer is always wonderful and the service too. One could wish for the installation of some sound-deadening material on the ceilings--but that's really a minor quibble. We  were especially happy with the turkey schnitzel and the broiled brussels sprouts.
Great experience as always. Very accommodating for gluten free diners.
Fun great service.
Our mouths were watering for traditional German food and you didn't disappoint. We have put it on our list to come back. I especially liked the beet salad.

We have tried all the German restaurants in the SF Bay Area and this is hands-down our favorite. A wonderful neighborhood restaurant beloved of locals, with that generous gemuchleit feeling I remember from my fav childhood places. Don't miss the potato pancakes - best in town, get the optional sour cream to go with that tart housemade applesauce! Beer selection is much better than most of the hipster places, with really outstanding service (and we don't say that lightly, we are picky about good waitstaff training). No need to reservations at lunch but a necessity for dinner. Parking is manageable; lot is tiny but the neighborhood has a fair amount of parking available within two short blocks of restaurant.

Sunday lunchtime and the restaurant was out of dishes and certain beers.It was my birthday and it was known to the restaurant thru open table and the fact was ignored. I celebrated my birthday at this restaurant for several years and they would always bring out a Strudel with candle. I was disappointed, especially since I spent about $360.00 for lunch.
Our long time favorite.  Great German food  with great service and wonderful eclectic music on the weekends.  And no cover.  So, the best of everything
Great German food and beer!
Great service and consistent good food.  Has the old world charm with very affordable menu.  Especially good when there is music.
Casual homey vibe, incredible food, fantastic German beer selection. Love this place!

Great ambiance and decor, lovely dinner and drink options, and we had a very fancy and romantic Valentine Day dinner. It was thoughtfully curated and not overtly themed as German, so you don’t feel as if you’ve stepped into a Bavarian pub. Fantastic food and service was attentive even on the holiday.
Service got slow at end of night, maybe they just didnt see empty glasses but they sure picked up empty plates fast... Food was AWESOME and everything else was from great to acceptable

Hidden secret in Alameda
Great to watch sport and enjoy good beer.  And good food

Hearty comforting German food in a cozy relaxed atmosphere.  The employees are very friendly and recommended we tast some beers before committing to ordering a specific type.  I have taken my whole family here and will come back for sure.

Good comfort type food but very slow service (35 minute wait for entrees) and quite noisy. Waitress and staff were both friendly but no one came to say why the food was so late - so maybe this is the norm?
It's hard to plan a date night with two toddlers, but this place was perfect to have a family dinner out. Kids loved it as usual.

On Sunday Jan 27 the food was superb as usual. Service was slow, slow, slow however. And the background music had the bass turned up so loud it was mind-numbing. Parking here is terrible. I almost needed an Uber to get me from where I parked to the restaurant.

The food was solid, tasty German fare. I would have regarded the service as slow had there not been entertainment, but with the band it was fine. Parking is problematic. Plan extra time for it or Uber if you are pretty close.

Love this place! The food is GREAT! Our server really took care of us. I introduced this place to my boyfriend and he loves the food and beer. You gotta try the pretzel with their mustard. It is delish!!! This is our go to place on the weekends.

My wife was watching a food show and this restaurant was on the show. It had good reviews so off we went. It was over a hour drive once we arrived we found out there is no restaurant parking, went inside and asked where do you park was told parking is a problem finally parked in the residential area. The food was good for the price and the portions were big so you won’t go away hungry. Service was ok maybe that was due to how busy they were. Yes I would recommend but make sure you make reservations and give yourself extra time to find parking not sure we will drive the distance again due to no parking. But if you like German food you can’t go wrong
Always a great experience!

We had a great time at Speisekammer! The food was excellent and they had a large selection of German beers. We tried 3 beers and they were all great! The staff was friendly and attentive and also knowledgeable when we asked questions regarding the food and beer. Will go back for sure.

The food and service were exceptional as always. Diners near us were a little louder than usual which made it difficult to have a conversation with others at our table, but that’s not the restaurants fault just rude young people.

This place NEVER disappoints. Amazing food, and excellent bar with a huge selection of German beers, and a cheerful, knowledgeable staff guarantees a good time. Been coming here since the beginning and will continue that trend. Well done, Peter, Cindy, and crew!!!
Good food. Try to get their specials. I always go back to their schnitzels and the German potato salad. Good drinks too

Great meal for restaurant week here in Alameda.  Brussels Sprouts appetizer, wild boar hunter’s pie and beef goulash (stew), and their famous apple strudel, ice cream, and schnapps for desert.  We go hear a lot, but the restaurant week meal is always a hit (and a good deal)!  We washed it down with Bitburger beers!
A favorite neighborhood restaurant...great food....never disappointed.

Slower service due to only one oven being operable. Would have been nice to know immediately so we could have ordered appetizer, rather than finding out 40 minutes into 45 minute wait from ordering until  dinner arrived.
Speisekammer has excellent German food and provides an  authentic atmosphere.  We highly recommend this restaurant!
Rick is a fantastic bartender! I love their creative Specials menu too.
Nice,friendly place to meet up wth family,friend. Good German fare.

Great brussell sprouts & red cabbage. I liked everything else we tried, but wasn’t blown away. Service was beyond excellent. We were made to feel very welcome. Brought me a piece of apple strudel with ice cream for my birthday, it was actually on 1/5.

Will definitely come back although it’s a bit of a drive from San Jose.

Pretty noisy but still a fun time & fine meal.
Good food & service. Sitting by the fireplace was lovely.
We enjoyed the ambiance and liked our meals.  We don't eat German cuisine all the time, but when we do, we will be going here.  Definitely recommend you give it a try.
Great community atmosphere. Food and waitstaff  wonderful. Seating by the fireplace a plus!

We learned about this restaurant from KQED's Check Please program. The TV review was spot on in lauding this place. Healthy options are available and delicious, but if I went here often I'm afraid I would weight two tons!
We were celebrating my birthday. The service and food was wonderful ! We were able to take our time and really enjoy lunch. I appreciated the apple strudel and vanilla ice cream free of charge.
Surprisingly good, hearty food. warm, welcoming atmosphere. Unpretentious, neighborhood restaurant that's very inviting. Great beer and Riesling selections.

The busboy kept trying to take my soup if I would set my spoon down and took the basket of bread though we weren’t done.  I got the roast chicken and it was so dry I couldn’t even cut through th skin with a knife.  I said something as the busboy asked if he could box up my food.  I said I couldn’t eat it as it was so dry I couldn’t bite into it.  He didn’t say sorry, just said you want me to just take it then?  They did have the Krampus and St. Nicholas which was fun.

It was a busy night but the 1 hour wait for our food was a bit much.  Kindly we were given two drinks free.  But the goose special and the sauerbraten, what is that meat?  Overcooked, dry.  The red cabbage with catsup of all things was peculiar.  Check Please patrons raved but I think they were all drunk.

parking is challenging 
excellent beer and appetizers 
main course did not meet expectations as it was hyped up by reviews. next time will just have have sausages.
My family has eaten here on a number of occasions and have yet to have a bad experience. The staff is friendly and professional. The food is ever changing and evolving.

We just love this place and tho we are from the peninsula we think it is worth the drive.  The food is great and it is a fabulous neighborhood Gem...Just wish it was closer to where we live in Burlingame, as we would probably be there at least once a week!
Professional waiter, excellent service, gourmet German food
The potato pancakes are to die for though I think they have shrunk in size over the years. attentive service and food comes out at a nice pace. Gravlax and sausage appetizers  very good as well.

The selection of beer is very different from local bars and it is very good.  The German food was also very good, indeed!  The seafood platter was particularly good.  The 4 of us all ordered different things and everybody was happy.  The dessert was worthwhile, especially the one that was served with locally made cinnamon ice cream. yummy!

Come here every year for my birthday. It's warm and inviting...and delicious! I end the night with a rudesheim and a shot of apple scnapps! Highly recommended! And good for groups. So much love to this place! Top 3 in the East Bay!

Nice place, with plates of German cuisine but on American style, I'm from North Italy and Tavern a lot to Germany, missing their party and family spirit! Good quality, missing some important German plates! I'll be back for sure

It took 40 minutes to get our food.  The waiter had 3 big groups he was attending to and never came by to check with us.  The groups were so loud I couldn't hear the person next to me talking.  
I liked the food, even though they were out of chicken, tri-tip and goose.  I don't think I'll go back there, though.

Most tasteless Weisswurst ever ( I am from Munich and travel there frequently). The Pretzel looked like the real thing but the texture - OMG, rubber. You can buy better ones in many grocery stores.  BTW, the mustard was of an absolutely poor quality and there is no excuse for that. My German lunch partner had the Schweinebraten (pork roast) and she liked it, so maybe if I ever were to go back I would try that.,

Delicious German fare as usual—never disappoints!
A friendly, welcoming atmosphere, and on this night a fabulous trio of country and surf music with an strong, local following! Really fun evening !
Wonderful service and authentic German food. I will be back. Its worth a 30 min drive.
Excellent in every way.
Always good food and excellent service.  Lively, energetic patrons.  Authentic German restaurant atmosphere

I’ve been there once with my girlfriend and I really enjoyed the food and beer. So I decided to take my boyfriend there and he really loved the food. I ordered the tri tip and he had the stuffed cabbage rolls. Both entrees were delicious. They also have a great selection on German beer. He’s really not into beer, but he had tried the one I ordered and really liked it.  
I would recommend making reservations. They get really packed on the weekends. We are definitely going back to try the other dishes.
Good German food. My family and I have dined here a number of times. Sometimes they are very busy and other times it’s a slow night. We’ve always enjoyed eating here.
Great food but a lot of noise from nearby tables

We love the band that played, The Americano Social Club.
Our seating request always gets granted. The food is authentic, great menu both food and drinks. Service is excellent, timely, attentive.
We were celebrating our 31st anniversary and the waiter surprised us with strudel and ice cream. Although we had told him we were too full for dessert,  we had no problem finishing it. Very tasty!
Awesome 😁, love this place for everything!

We are never disappointed with Speisekammer.  Whether we're there with friends or just family we completely enjoy ourselves. The wait staff always remember us and we are always free to take our time and enjoy the meal.
Always a great stop for comfort food!

we love this place - it’s great for all ages from tattooed hipsters to local fogies like us.

but we’d never been seated in the fireplace room... which was cozier and quieter than the other sections. 

the food was absolutely fabulous and mom had a terrific 80th birthday.

highly recommend it!
Always a great time to be had here with incredible German food and beer. This restaurant is what lured us to Alameda to lead us to then buy property here.
Had a nice time with my friends but my food took an hour to get to me.

This is an all around good place to eat and drink. They have a tremendous variety of great German and American beers and excellent cocktails. The food is classic German, but has gotten lighter since Speisekammer first opened. The servers are also happy to split meals for you. This can be an inexpensive place to eat for that reason. We split a pork shank and each of us had plenty to eat and the check was light.
Had a wonderful meal with my mother and great friends. Shared all plates and all was delicious.
Birthday celebration.
Very good food, great music, great service! Will come again.

Took my wife here for a special date night, what an awesome experience!  This place checks all the boxes for us,  most importantly being extremely celiac friendly (GF)!

Our server was so conscientious,  knowledgeable and friendly about making sure the GF options were explained.  She took great care not to cross contaminate and informed the kitchen staff regarding our restrictions as well. 

The vibe was fun and the food was delicious and interesting!  Who knew German food could be so gluten free friendly? 

Live music Friday and I think Saturday nights.  The bar area seemed full of friendly people enjoying eachother and the music. 

5 Stars for sure!  If you need to eat GF, this is a must try in the bay area!
It was our anniversary.  A nice clean restaurant with a good musical combo.  Love German food.  Server was very nice to us.
This place is the best! Service is always awesome, staff is always so friendly and accommodating. Good place for good food and a good time with family and friends!!
Always a great meal at Speisekammer. The pretzel is always fresh and the schnitzel is a reliable great.

What’s not to like about Speisekammer?  We’ve been dining here since shortly after they opened.  They’ve only gotten better and better.  It has a nice neighborhood vibe, and the food is always outstanding.  Oh, did I mention the beer?

Love love this place!  Been coming regularly now for about 4 months, never a miss only good food and good beer!  Had the smoked pork shoulder last 2 visits wow!  Love that they mix up the menu.  Great food, go now! 😜
Good food, potatoes with weinerschmitzel were the best

Restaurant management/employees should ensure the restaurant atmosphere is enjoyed by all with zero tolerance from other customers drunk and yelling in the restaurant. Oct 9, 2018, was a big group seated in the back of the restaurant and most of the were literally yelling in the restaurant even when they were seated right next to each other.  Most of them were drunk and obnoxious and disrespectful to others in the restaurant. Management can refuse customers that are drunk in any public establishments and or ask them to keep in it down or be removed from the restaurant. We won’t be coming back to this place nor will we even recommend it. Our server provided great service and kept apologizing for the loud abnoxious group.
Authentic, delicious, large portions,great service, really great.

After living in Southern Bavaria for three years, this is the best German food we have found since returning to California. They serve traditional gasthaus fare with an unbelievable selection of beer, both on tap and in bottle. Further, the restaurant is furnished with authentic furniture, from the wood tables to the shranks that litter the little alcoves nooks in the restaurant. If you like central European cuisine and miss echte Deutsche Bier, this is the place for you.

I go to this Place once or twice every two months and generally have excellent experience. Unfortunately this time the service is not what I am accustomed to at this amazing place. Sometimes it appeared that the waitress forgot all about us being at the table. We got the one bottle of water is that was the only drinks that we were going to have it got empty and wasn't replaced with a full lunch service. The food was excellent as usual but this deserves a lower than five star because of the lack of attention in less than Stellar service on this visit this is the first time I have been disappointed in my dining g experience.
This is our go to restaurant,,,our family loves it.
Speisekammer is our standard for genuine German food outside of Germany. We say "it's good, but it's not Speisekammer!"

Love this place and have been here multiple times.  Only drawback is the noise level.  Been here a few times with other friends and family and each occasion the noise level was too loud.  It's the biggest complaint I get from them.  The food is the best in terms of authentic german cuisine in a cute setting but the noise level is unfortunately enough to discourage me from taking others here.  May just have to settle for just me and my husband.

Was looking for a great place to have a business dinner in Alameda that could accommodate the size of my party.  Service was great, food was great, atmosphere was spot on for Oktoberfest,   my guests had a great time and enjoyed the selection of beers and food!  A Hidden Gem!  Thank you!
This is a fabulous place for great German food & beer.  The noise level is what keeps me away but I suppose  that's a sign people are having a good time!!

We enjoy Speisekammer.  It's not "5-star" like Chez Panisse -- but it is outstanding for what it is -- a wonderful neighborhood eatery.  Great (and distinctive) food, wonderful beer, relaxed setting.  I always look forward to our next visit.
Our waitress Hannah treated us old guys special and made us bowl that way too!
Very good food. Great service. Great selection of German beer. Will be going again.

We've been fans of Mitch Polzak and the Royal Deuces for awhile, we went mainly to see them. Very entertaining, they play there every first Friday, authentic rockabilly, truck drivin' songs and old-school country! Stuff you don't hear on the radio anymore and probably won't ever again. The food was delicious and authentic, my only issue was after we ate, there's no area for folks to sit or even stand and hear the band, without getting another table, after we had already eaten...the bar was packed all night. It seemed like we were in the way wherever we stood, I finally went and sat outside, and could still hear and see the band OK. We will definitely go back, but now that we know the scene, we'll try to get a table in the front room where the band is. Oh, and the parking situation is pretty bad, but the neighborhood seems quite safe which is a good thing, because you'll be parking several blocks away and walking.

I have been here a few times and it just keeps getting better, Love the Food, Love the BEER, and Johnna is the Perky Best!
See you again SOON!
It was a perfect spot after a long day for relaxing.  It is low key with good Germanic style food.  Good beer also.
Fantastic food and ambiance.  Creative variations to traditional German cuisine.
Always a treat. Brought our German friend and she gives two thumbs up!
Absolutely amazing food and an authentic German experience. I would highly recommend eating here if you want to enjoy great food and beer, and an experience to match.
as always reliable declicious German food.  only wish the vegies could be "californized" by adding some spice and sauces to them not just boiled!  but beside lovely meal as always!

We went for dinner and the live music they have on Saturday nights.  The service was attentive; the  food was very tasty, cabbage rolls , schnitzel, and brussel sprouts.  Each dish was well prepared.  The drinks, beers and cocktails, were good.  Everyone was thoroughly satisfied with the whole evening.

I had been wanting to dine here for a long time and finally made it. I cannot drink alcohol because of medical conditions. I ordered ice tea. One sip and I knew it was old. Probably left over from the day before. Waitress promptly removed and credited my check. I ordered the Schnitzel sandwich. Charred breading heavy with oil. Not how I remember it in Germany. Had the Spaetzel. Very good.  Next time I’ll try the sausages.
As usual, the food at Spieskammer was excellent, service was fabulous and the leftovers the next day were fabulous!

Our server was very attentive and friendly.  The food was absolutely delicious and the outdoor seating area accommodated my small dog.  I have already recommended this restaurant to friends and family.

We love this place so much that we had to come back and bring our friends with us! They fell in love with this place too...The food is awesome, the beer and wine is fantastic and everyone there is so friendly..We live on the Peninsula and its a drive, but well worth it!

Great food, wonderful service, comfortable environment that I would recommend to all.  Tasty German food reminiscent of my 1st generation mother's, but with a new twist (pulled pork sandwich with sauerkraut and cranberry sauce?  Mom didn't serve, but  would have if she tasted this! Order with the roasted potatoes!)

Very disappointed with Speisekammer.  Food consistently poor and inauthentic.  Reuben sandwich dry throughout -- from bread, to meat, to meager serving of sauerkraut and sauce.  Slap-dash assembly of a classic sandwich also unpleasant.  Sauce and mushrooms on schnitzel both tasted canned -- and mashed potatoes -- as though they'd recently resided in a box.  Restaurant quite dirty -- smelled sour as though carpets were wet -- very Uncharacteristic for anything German.  Speisekammer may be coasting on previous, positive reputation as this was a 'bucket-list' spot for friend's birthday lunch.  She, being German, was even more disappointed than myself, as second generation Deustcher.  Oh well, one can only say, "Schade, schade...!!!"
Our favorite restaurant in Alameda...never disappointed..
Always a treat to have my German beer and favorite dishes. Consistent and wonderful experience. Love bringing new people to this island gem!

Food is great. Also, excellent, polite, friendly service. Atmosphere is very warm and cozy. Nice pictures on the wall add to the the ambience of the restaurant. Also, the fire place, during the winter months, generates a very cozy atmosphere.

Had a great time here! Delicious food and beer. Jagerschnizel with mushroom sauce and apple strudel for dessert - highly recommend. Attentive service as well. A nice homey vibe. Seemed authentic and reminded me of our trip to Munich.

Great German food in Alameda. Delicious signs of mustard are brought up with the first course and stayed the entire meal. Sausages were delicious and the mustard only made it better. Expansive beer list. Will definitely return
Reliably excellent German food and an authentic atmosphere. Excellent beer selection, and the variety of live music is appreciated.
Good food as always. Service was great as we had 3 children and they brought their servings out quickly.

The food was delicious.  The staff extremely kind. We needed to be seated early for dinner and they were kind enough to let us sit at our table and took our orders and put them in as soon as dinner started.
Service was kind of slow and it’s a tad pricy but very good food and lovely patio atmosphere.

Birthday Dinner with family including a 14 month old.  Staff was wonderful with our toddler, discreetly picking up his toys, etc. fabulous friendly staff. Out waitress was caring and efficient!

My husband enjoyed his veal cardon blue, my son his fish and chips and I enjoyed the salmon.  The free shot of schnapps for the birthday husband was a nice touch. 

Only complaint, and it is minor, the table next to us ordered the boot-for each guy-and as the evening of progressed processed to get very drunk, loud and profane.  Our boy was one of many children present.  

We went early to avoid that crowd but apparently 5;30 still isn’t early enough.
Love this place great food and great service.  Only draw back is parking.

Second visit, same waiter...food is excellent, comes out hot...
Cooked to perfection.
They leave you alone wh e n y ou are eating, but come at appropriate moment...
We love this place,very warm friendly...and excellent food...

Really enjoyed the experience.
Nice Vibe, great place to  socialize and relax after work. Friendly  and professional service. Had a tasty wiener  schnitzel dinner.  Looking forward to going again.

It's always a treat to hang out at Speisekammer's on a Friday or Saturday night and hoot and holler with the live music.  Saturday July 14th was terrific because of the fabulous Saddle Cats, Western Swing with a classical air. Visiting nephew from Toronto was really impressed with food, beer, and music (not to mention his elderly aunt's choice of venue).  Cheers!
We asked for a “quiet” and were seated in the back room reserved for large parties. Go figure. The food was good, but we chose not to linger to give our ears a break.
Had a great anniversary dinner.  Went with my brother and father the first time this past Fathers Day, and had to share it with my wife.  Friendly atmosphere and great service!
We haven’t been here for a long time for some reason, and really enjoyed our dinner.
The fried Brussel sprouts are wonderful and the side dishes were great!  The service was attentive and they have something for everyone at the party.
Every time we come here we
Good German food. Just like my grandmother used to make. Hefty portions for a fair price

We were there to hear our friend perform music and decided to go early to have dinner. The outside picnic table was nice on the summer evening. The food was good though I admit I'm not a big fan of German food. The duck liver pate was good. I had veal schnitzel on spaetzle with mushroom sauce. My boyfriend had the pork wiener schnitzel with potatoes. It was all good, comfort food. Of course there was an extensive German beer list. 

Then we moved inside to the bar for the performance. It got pretty warm in there and they could have used a couple of ceiling fans to move the air around. Other than that small complaint, the Speisekammer was a pretty cool place with friendly people, good food and good service.
We enjoyed our visit and food. The service was good. Didn't like the parking as no way out of parking lot. Had a hard time getting out.
Saw this place on a local TV show called check please we had to drive down from the Northbay to check it out had a great meal great beer wonderful folks wonderful setting all-around great experience
Outstanding dessert chef, half and full plate options, huge drinks menu, lively atmosphere.
Excellent beers as always, tasty food and a nice outdoor seating vibe with shared tables and friendly people.

I've been here many times, often in order to catch the great bands that play here (like Howell Devine, Jinx Jones, or Americano Social Club).   Food is good, beer and mixed drinks of a wide variety and always excellent service.
We've been there before and would go again. We took a few people who had not been there and they enjoyed it very much.  Very nice staff! Try the cheese and fruit plate!
The experience here is always good. Solid food and drinks. Some really good beers. Cant say anything bad.
Fun food and great neighborhood vibe.

The food was good, but we waited a long time for it to be served, and we had to ask for a bread basket instead of being offered. The server was nice and was able to get our dinner order correct, but seemed really busy and had too many tables to wait on by himself.

We’ve lived in Alameda for over 20 years. Always past by this restaurant. Recently saw it on Check, please & decided to check it out. We went there yesterday, had a great experience & great service. Went there tonight, had the worst service ever! We were seated for a good 15 minutes, no waiter or acknowledgement. Had to ask a bus boy to see who our waiter was. He finally came over, wasn’t pleasant or polite, asked us if we knew what we wanted. We ordered, food came slow. He never checked in or refilled our drinks. It took so long, we missed our movie. My kids wanted to have the apple strudel dessert again, had to ask the bus boy to place the order for us. Waiter then came by to confirm dessert & ask if we wanted to refill our drinks at the end of the meal. I watched him chatting for at least 10 minutes with another table. My son ask the hostess (who was wonderful yesterday & today) for the check. She brought us the check, not the waiter. Told her service was terrible & missed our movie. She said they were short of staff, but that’s not a good excuse if he has time to chat up other tables. Hostess comp us for the rose & dessert, which was very nice. Food was good, but I really HATE bad service!!! I would go back, only cuz the hostess was so pleasant from my booking of 1st reservation & making concession after our second reservation. Btw, the waiter with long beard & sagging pants which he kept pulling up, was not appetizing...topped off bad service! Smh
Always wanted to try  Speisekammer because I've never had German food. Nice beer selection and great food! Enjoyed my experience and will definitely come back. Highly recommend to everyone!
We sat outside.  It was very nice.  Plenty of food.  It all tasted good.  Good beer selection.
This is one of my go to restaurants in Alameda. The food was wonderful, the beer was spectacular, the environment was great. I definitely recommend it
Great food and BEER! Service was amazing too. Must have the SChnitzel!

Incredibly tasty meal with the best sauerkraut I have ever eaten; an extra side of it a good idea.  Pretty meat-centric, and the quality was outstanding.  We had the family style meat platter, and each item was tender and cooked just right.  Yum yum
Yummy Dinner before Tower of Power’s 50th Anniversary Concert!!! Rib eye steak special so tender and delicious!

Many thanks to the wonderful people who made our first visit a time to remember! This place is legit German and the food and beer prove it. As a former chef in Germany and the spouse of a German I can say I wish we lived in Alameda so I could go there everyday. If you want to real deal, go, please go you won't regret it. Prost!

I had a reservation and table was ready when I arrived. Tried the potato appetizer which I found very greasy and tasteless. If it had not been for Apple compote it would’ve only been greasy and tasteless . I had steak special which was just OK . Meat was good a little more than medium and was a fairly tough cut of meat. Fries were good. Not a beer drinker but I saw a lot of people enjoying a variety of types and they all seemed to enjoy them. Went as recommendation from check please. I will probably not go back
Lunched here with a friend. We split the big platter and were not disappointed. We were well taken care of. A lovely day overall.

I hate to be critical, but our group of three had a poor experience.  The hostess and waitress made us feel like nuisances instead of guests.  They were unsmiling and unfriendly.  We had to request a third place setting and bread, and felt rushed to finish.  My husband ordered the veal, and later was told it had sold out.  His lamb was disappointing.  My spaetzl was tough and tasteless.  The sweet and sour red cabbage tasted only of vinegar.  My friend's bratwurst was dry and blackened.
We had made reservations and were looking forward to this meal, as we came in from out  of town to experience it.  So it was doubly disappointing.  I hope the kitchen and staff were just experiencing an off-night, as the restaurant is nicely decorated and pleasant enough.  It was not a successful evening for us.

Speisekammer has become one of our favorite spots to enjoy a great beer or cocktail, and pair it with some incredible German comfort food.  I can order a Spaten on tap and jager schnitzel with veal, and I’ll feel like I’m dining in a family restaurant in Bavaria!

The service is always attentive, professional and knowledgeable, which really keeps us returning over and over.
Ecsellent. We had been looking forward to being in town, ani it met all expectations. Nice quiet spot in back.

Speisekammer is the best place for authentic German food in the East Bay.  The menu is reasonably extensive and the beer choices are phenomenal.  I consider the prices moderate.  Music on weekends keeps the place quite lively.
Best Traditional German food around and great German beers served properly.  This place is awesome just wish we could have stayed longer for the blues music!
Authentic German dishes.  Very friendly staff, great service, great food, great selection of beer.  A great German experience.

We had been to Speisekammer once before for a friends 50th birthday.  It is a great place for a group.  The food has a German orientation but basic American items are available.  The beer was excellent.  We arrived 15 minutes early and got a beer at the bar.  Our table was ready on time even on a busy evening.  There were great specials and substitutions were not an issue.  I would recommend this restaurant.
Great Food, Drink and Service.  German food at it's finest
Food was good, service and waiter attentiveness was poor

It was mothers day so they where very crowded, They tried to seat us in the bar, had to fight to get a table in the dinning room. We had an early reservation and the place was empty at the time 
Food was good but not great, I was there two years ago and the food was much better.
The best thing about the restaurant is the beer, its great.

Having spent time in Germany , learned German cooking from  my in-laws, and received a BA in German, I can with some experience say, "Das Essen hat mir wonderbar geschmeckt." The meal was great. ( I had salmon, cooked just right) The beer was also fantastic and even though it has been more than 30 years since I have been in Germany, that night I dreamt of Bier Stubes, (pubs) Aufschnitt (cold cuts), white rolls, dark bread, Konigberger Klopse,(meat balls) potatoes, and horseradish sauce. Speisekammer is the real thing. I can't wait to go back.

3 stars for Ambiance because dogs are  allowed on the patio eating area (wasn't aware until other patrons arrived with their dog just as our food was served). I like dogs,  just don't want them near me when having dinner. The dog's owner had a hard time keeping it at their table.
All is good!!! Full bar with good selection beers.. love it
Excellent German cuisine, the best that we have found in the Bay Area.  My only problem with the ambiance is that the music was too loud, leading to more noise from guests.
Nice menu options and great beer list.  Friendly service.  Parking is an issue, so ride share is a good idea.  Outside seating is available.

Me and my partner went on a Saturday night. I had the bacon wrapped meatloaf and my partner had the salmon. The food was very good. The venue is like an oasis. Very satisfied with the service and the staff was very friendly. Also had a drink called pearadise. It was very good. Would definitely come back! Looking forward to bringing some friends here who have never been. Great experience and affordable. Would highly recommend! !

First time there.  Waiter was friendly and helpful.  Food was great and definitely satisfying.  Almost avoided the pork shank because another reviewer had been disappointed.  Ordered it anyway and was glad we did, it was excellent. Great experience, will come back.

Saw this restaurant featured on Bay Area Check Please and had to check it out.  It was definitely worth the drive to Alameda. We will go again to try other selections.  Service is a little slow but we didn't have to be anywhere in a hurry.
Wonderful service and satisfying food.

If you like fish, the appetizer plate is outstanding. I had the pork shank for my entree, it was disappointing. I would try a different entree next time. The German beer was very good and the selection is large.

This is a fun and good place for people who like German food.  My German brother-in-law loves it.  They also have steak, salmon and chicken if you want.  It has nice atmosphere authentic to German restaurant.  Friendly waitstaff.  Good beer, cocktails and desserts.  We sat at a quiet table in the back room, very nice.
Stuffed cabbage!!!!!
Terrific family dinner with both sides in-town for new baby!

I love this restaurant! I have been coming here for years and I always find amazing food! I am a vegetarian with celiac disease so it's usually hard to find good food at restaurants but Speisekammer has multiple options. The servers are really friendly and helpful and understand about celiac. They even have gluten free deserts like creme brulee.

Speisekammer has been a consistent restaurant for drinks and food. The outside beer garden is a great place for meeting after work with friends and coworkers. The addition of live music is really nice. Good food with good friends.
45 min wait.  Food came out cold.  Absolutely no apologies.  Offered a  dessert.....like I want a dessert when I haven't eaten a thing all day and everything else was horrible?

Friendly, lively people
Love the live music.  Mitch Polzak is great and the clientele is wonderful
Always have a great time there.
The food is authentic German and delicious. My favorites are the fresh salads
Long wait for service.   Incorrect meal delivered to table.  We went to hear music but could hear little over room noise.

One of our long-time favs, Speisekammer is THE German restaurant to dine at if you love traditional German food. It is far better than Brotzeit Lokal and the portions more generous than Gaumenkitzel (a place that is very good, but not the 'gemutlich' bargain Speisekammer is). Their schnitzel is marvelous, the potato pancakes divine (housemade applesauce; get the optional sour cream). Very happy to see the pickled veggie salad and the sauerkraut are back to being properly done: savory and tangy without the excessive harsh vinegar that was happening for a while. Sausages are excellent here, as is the roast pork dish. Service is top-notch here; this place should give lessons to newer flashy bistros who can't time a meal or even clear a table properly. Highly recommended; lunch is quieter but definitely make reservations for dinner when locals arrive after work. But don't even try to squeeze yourself in during World Cup finals, LOL!

If you know anything about German food and the culture that surrounds a meal this place has it. Authentic flavors of braten, speiszle and schnitzel. All need to be eaten with a German kolsch, lager, pilsner, hefeweisen or a dark ale; my favorite. Delicious dark rye slices came to the table as well. There was a birthday party with us in the back room which had sound bouncing off all walls at once. Although we had to pause our conversation a couple times, it wasnt a bother. Thats how i experienced pub life in small towns in Bavaria. I'll be returning sooner than later. BTW, later on there was live music in the front room which wasn't German. But i do know that Europeans appreciated R&B/Jazz much sooner than popular music did in the US.
Great place with good food and s friendly staff. Always a good stop for a get together with friends
Very good food, drinks and desserts. Excellent prompt service. Thanks.
EXCELLENT FOOD AND EXCEPTIONAL SERVICE..RICK AT THE BAR MAKES FANTASTIC COCKTAILS !

We enjoy Speisekammer once or twice a month (sometimes more) and the experience never disappoints. From the welcoming greeters and reservation management, friendly servers, attentive waitstaff, skilled kitchen and bar artists — everything is excellent and we always leave happy. Thank you for always showing us a good time!! Prost!!

Good German food. Mixed salad wasn’t fresh this time. Sauerbraten wasn’t marinated enough to give flavor to the meat. Potato pancakes needed some chopped onion in the batch and weren’t crispy enough.  I’ve been here a few times and it’s not as good as it used to be.
Great place to have dinner!
Wiener Schnitzel (veal), apple strudel, ohh...

The German cuisine is wonderful. We went for the live music and heard a terrific band called the Luxomatics.  Service was slow, but the restaurant was VERY crowded to capacity inside and out. The food was so good that we didn’t mind waiting. A very enjoyable dinner.  While we were there a videographer from CHECK PLEASE BAY AREA was shooting video for an up coming show.
Have enjoyed many REAL GERMAN dinners over the years.   And will do so again.   I always have a reservation, can get busy.
I've been to Speisekammer quite a few times.  The food was not as good as usual, BUT the live music absolutely made up for it!

We enjoy coming here because we miss Germany. We have been here several times. The schnitzel was not as good as in times past. (Underdone breading), and I suspect the potatoes are instant. But we'll be back I'm sure.
Great food and draft beers.  I like this restaurant and we will be back.

Authentic, great ambiance (sat next to fireplace), great food and excellent beer with great beer serving practices, e.g. proper serving temperature and glasses/mugs! I’ve been here several times and highly recommend it!
Great authentic German food and beers.  Fun time !
Great German Food.  Too loud to have a conversation.
Best potato pancakes ever!! Authentic German food. One of our favorite spots.
Went with just me and my 3 kids. We all had a great time. Food & service were fantastic!
Great food, drink and atmosphere

This was our third visit, the food was excellent as usual.  Good variety of german beers on tap.  Service was a little slower than we would have liked, but we enjoyed the company at atmosphere.   Despite looking small on the outside, there are three separate dining rooms to break up  the crowd of people.  Excellent German cuisine.  We'll be back, for certain.
One of the few places in the bay area to get German food. Outdoor seating, just like in Germany.
Authentic, terrific food, and generous portions. Mixed salad is an excellent accompaniment to various dishes. Been there many times, never disappointed!

Very good service. Thank you😃😃

Why 50 characters.
Good German food
The food never disappoints here!  The appetizers are amazing, the food is authentic and delicous... and plentiful!
It's our first time listening live music here. We enjoyed it.
Happy environment and good food. Very friendly service. It's a great place for adult gathering with great beer. It was a nice family dinner but the kid wasn't being patient.
Sadly, they were out of pretzels, but the spätzle and schnitzel we had were fabulous!
Our table was ready for us when we arrived.  The food was outstanding, as always.  Our server was very good.  Checked on us often, but not intrusive.  This is one of our favorite family go to places.

My friend invited me the first time I came for the live music, which I really enjoyed.
I invited my two friends, because they are fans and we ordered light meals, which were
served with friendly servers.
We got  a table reservation on line so it was ready when we got there.
We had a great time.

My husband and I enjoy trying any German restaurant we come across. Based on reviews, we were very excited to try Speisekammer!
We started with their Potato Pancakes and Pretzel with Beer Cheese dipping sauce. Both were enjoyable but definitely not the best we’ve eaten in our experiences at other German establishments. The Potato Pancakes were light and crispy but with little seasoning/flavor. The Pretzel was very chewy in a stale sort of way...however the delicious Beer Cheese dipping sauce masked that nicely.
For our entrees, my husband enjoyed the Sauerbraten. It was a decent amount of meat with a luscious gravy and classic sides of Spatzle and Red Cabbage. Both sides were mediocre. I ordered their baked Spatzle (think of a German take on Mac N Cheese.) They used rich and decadent cheeses and came nice and hot. I was given the option to add ham or bacon for an additional charge and I chose ham. Nice and necessary addition! Also for an additional charge, you can have their side salad - I highly recommend AGAINST this...chopped lettuce, pickled veggies all drenched in what tasted like the pickling vinegar. Waste.
Drinks. Although they had many options for many patrons (children, non alcoholic, wine, beer, cocktails...) we were so disappointed in the small amount of German beers on tap. Needless to say, my husband had soda and I tried a nice light Austrian wight wine.
Staff. Very friendly, attentive and informative! They gave us a beautiful cozy table at their romantic fireplace. Beautiful!
Wonderful good again tonight. Both had Bratwurst dinner with sauerkraut and mashers.
We came here for a weeknight dinner and had a great time! Excellent food and drinks, and friendly, attentive service.
We love this restaurant....have never had a bad meal...great neighborhood gem.
It was great!! Food was outstanding, the service perfect!!  I highly  recommend this place!!
Came to listen to the band and enjoy a good meal!
We love Speisekammer! Great service, food and drinks.

Love the ambience like a European pub or bar, with a collection of steins on the wall and other decorations.  Food is good, with good service.  What attracted us was the live music Friday and Saturday nights.  There are two rooms, one with cozy booths, another with tables, and the garden outside.  Loved the roasted butternut   squash.  Beer is delicious!
Great for family
Noise level was okay because we asked for a quiet table but much of the restaurant was quite loud. The food was uniformly delicious and we will be back!

We had a great first experience at Speisekammer. We just heard about it this week and went right away because we had been looking for a good German restaurant. With Speisekammer, we found it. All of our dishes were excellent.
Enjoyed a lovely post-holiday dinner with friends! They were very accommodating with our 3 kiddos and their varied needs/requests.

Late Saturday lunch. Even though the menu was shortened, it was  perfect for trying new dishes and sharing a meal. The fish platter was exceptional. The pretzel with cheese sauce was a hit. Of course the beer selection is what it should be in a German restaurant....love the black beer. Always a great place. Highly recommend .

We have been coming here for quite a while and just love the food, ambience and great staff!  Everyone is very friendly and professional, and it is so great to have them always come by to be sure we are never out of water or ask if there is anything else we need.  (It is nice to come to a restaurant where a customer doesn't have to ask for these small things).  Our favorite dishes are the Potato Soup, the Pork Wienerschnitzel, Sauerbraten and Bratwurst entrees, and their roasted potatoes with bacon bits.  Even their bread and the buttery concoction they serve is delicious.  The desserts are good too, especially when the dessert chef whips up the delicious toffee cream brulee.  We have never been disappointed at this restaurant and the prices are very reasonable too!  It will continue to be one of our favorites.  The only negative thing is that sometimes parking can be a problem, especially during Fridays and Saturday evenings.
Have been here several times and love the food, beer and service. Great place!
Solid, very authentic  German food at reasonable prices.  Casual, friendly service. Definitely going on our rotation.
A little taste of Europe in Alameda. Always busy but the food is great! The place always has a good vibe...a little noisy but a fun spot.
The cozyest spot in town.

Great atmosphere...big selection of tap beer...good menu selections...friendly staff...reasonable
price...

This place is a FAV,
Consistently fantastic.
Thank you!
Good German cuisine, cozy ambience and great service.
Great food.  Instead of ordering individual meals, we ordered the meat platter and several sides and went family style.  It worked well for the four of us.  One of our favorite restaurants!
Disappointed with Apple strudel which was soggy with crystallized ice cream but main course was very good as were cocktails and beer.
One of the finest German eateries in Bay Area and beyond.
Amazing restaurant!!!! My wife lived in Germany most of her life and says the food is near authentic! The staff there are also very welcoming. Would recommend to everybody.

We took visiting family over Thanksgiving, not once, but twice! And in the summer, I took visiting friends twice. The staff is so refreshingly welcoming. Talia was our wait person the first time....wonderful and positive and engaging. Marco was our second trip and he was amazingly tolerant, funny, attentive. Kindness prevails at this local gem that has become our go-to favorite. Thank you so much!
A delicious and authentic German meal in a warm and friendly atmosphere.
Wonderful Boar Stew. One of the Specials for the night. Yumeeeee.
Amazing all around!

Went here for our 11th wedding anniversary and had a great table in the bar/live music area.  The food was YUMMY  and the service friendly.  Loved that we could enjoy dinner for a little bit and then the band setup and started playing, super fun evening!

I have been here a bunch of times and loved it each time! The food, beer, atmosphere and service is great. It is a bit slow as they are always busy but the food is worth the wait. It's noisy so if that's not your thing ask to sit in the back area. The main winners: Potato pancake and pretzel with beer cheese...drool

We ordered a variety of starters (potato pancakes) and mains (schnitzel, turkey schnitzel, meatloaf and onions) for a family and friends get-together. The potato pancakes were just okay with the applesauce being pretty basic (bland). I can skip this next time and make it at home since they weren't to our liking. The other dishes were quite flavorful and filling. The overall restaurant vibe was definitely lively with the band playing. However, the noise level made it difficult to enjoy any conversation...and we were in a separate room. I can only imagine trying to eat and carry conversation in the main dining room and bar area. Overall, not a bad choice for German food in the East Bay.

In Germany, each brewery has their own unique glassware or mug for serving their beers. Spaesekammer has managed to acquire this glassware to serve whatever beer selection you choose in the genuine glassware from that brewery...very cool. The food is quite good and reasonably priced.

Great meal at Spiesekammer!  Food as always was wonderful; friend loved the cocktails.  Only negatives was that we have a visually impaired daughter; and the low
Lighting made it difficult for her - would love if there was a table with Good Light

Beeeeeeer!

What a wonderful beer garden!

Great food and desserts.   The potato pancakes are fabulous.   Apple strudel was superb.   Never order flourless chocolate cake on any menu as it usually is awful.   Not this version.  House made and warm, gooey and delicious.   Worth every calorie.
My husband and I enjoyed everything that we ate. The service was great! It looks like it's a real family restaurant.

I took my 8 year old here on our quest to discover new food. We ordered several appetizers including the potato pancakes, the Fisch-Platt (variety of fish with salad), and the KÄSEBRETT
MIT FRÜCHTEN (fruit and cheese plate). We ordered a small size but they were still really big portions. We didn't care for the potato pancakes (I thought they were mushy inside) but everything else was good. My 8 year old liked the pickled herring - who would have thought. We ordered the JÄGER SCHNITZEL for dinner. Neither one of us cared for the Spätzle but the SCHNITZEL was good. To be fair, I've never really cared for Spätzle so I don't think that it was a reflection on the restaurant. Another person with us ordered the Flat Iron Steak which was the special. They said that it was very good. We of course had Strudel for desert. All in all, it was a fun experience and we will go back.
Amazing food, slow service
The food was wonderful. Like that you have choice between a full meal or a smaller portion. We all enjoyed it!
Birthday celebration for a close friend.

Service is very good.  We asked to be seater closer to the live music and they were very accommodating.  The food is good... wish they had more vegetarian options.  I think there could be more salads and fresh vegetables.  Their vinegar salads are too vinegary.
Authentic  German food according to my friend of Germanic parent.
Makes me feel like I am back in Germany. The atmosphere is really cozy and the food is good. I will go back again.
Fantastic service, good food and the wonderful musical stylings of Lavay Smith and the Red Hot Skillet Lickers...
consistently good quality food with people who care about their job.  They work together.  The food is always good.
Great atmosphere, good food - if you want a lively group dinner, this is a good spot. Not great for a quiet night or low key meal.

Fabulous waitress Johnna, so sweet and goes out of her way to make a wonderful dining experience.

Potato pancakes are the best I have had with the homemade apple sauce.  Pretzels great, all of the dishes worth the drive.

 Great for accompanying dogs

Thank you
Great selection of beer. Best German food this side of Hamburg. Flourless chocolate cake is superior. Must try the suckling pig when it's on special.

The only German restaurant that I know in the Bay Area - food is authentic and consistent. Lots if good draft beer choices. Almost always have sauerbraten which is always great. My partner had rouladen which was also good

We had a wonderful time celebrating my husband's birthday here. The food was fantastic as were the drinks. We had everything from the cheese and meat plates, to pretzels with the cheese sauce, the tomato salad, the meatloaf, the weinerschnitzel, the jagerschnitzel, the sauerbraten, and the lamb shank. Everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meals. Our server was extremely patient with our large group and I was super happy to be able to book a table for 10 people on relatively short notice (3 days). And A++ to the restaurant for having good air conditioning in the back room!! That was tantamount to our experience, since the food can be heavy, you don't want to eat it while your all hot and sweaty. I will certainly think of this restaurant again for future special occasions. This place is truly a gem!
This place is everything a German restaurant should be!  Fresh ingredients, good beer and the best cheese plate!
Meal was excellent. We thoroughly enjoyed the entertainment provided by Mitch Polzac and the Royal Deuces. The service was impeccable.

Probably not the best choice on the hottest day of the year.... service was really good, food was so-so, beer was great!
Nice Friday afternoon / evening place and weekend drinks. Will definitely be going back.
Good food. Good service. Have been there for lunch and dinner and had good experiences.
Always a great meal and the German speaking waitress was great fun! Added so much authenticness to the meal.
Excellent service along with excellent food.  My second time there, and cannot wait to go back.
Great service.       Super music.      Fun atmosphere.
Great food and German experience.

This place is an absolute gem. The food was amazing, and exactly what I wanted. The beer list was impressive, as was the option of ordering a 2 liter "Das Boot". I don't live anywhere near Alameda, but I will definitely be going back.

Also, as the occasion was my birthday, we all got to share some apple streudel and schnapps. Speisekammer has a lifelong fan.
Always great German cuisine.  Highly recommend.  Parking in the area can be a challenge even on a Sunday evening.

Always a great time at Speisekammer! The food is so good, made with love and presented in a which that makes you feel like your family! The ambiance is great too. The BEER....love it. even the drinks (I HIGHLY recommend the Hope Floats - it is so crisp and refreshing) are awesome!
I wish this gem of a restaurant was closer to us so we could visit more often!  Delicious, fresh, authentic food and an awesome beer and wine list!  Be sure to save a little room for dessert!

Haven't been here in a while, but after this food/this night, will go back again soon! Fries were the best I've ever had (with multiple dipping sauces). Special of the night -- pork shank marinated in apple juice -- was outstanding. Everything our party of five ordered was very much enjoyed. Best of all was the free live music and the super service (our multi-lingual waitress was on top of our every need).
Love this place, service is beyond compare.  Fabulous potato pancakes, the best I've ever had.
It was just good place to eat it was our 3rd time going eating the salmon and it was just the best flavor like the first time we went and I would definitely come again .😌😌
Currently our favorite family friendly restaurant in Alameda. Wonderful service, food, and beer. This is also a choice date location of ours. Amazing french fries too.
Authentic tasting German food, great beer selection, ambiance much like a real German beer hall and friendly service. A solid taste of Germany close to home.

great german food. superb beer choices.
seating inside was a little warm and noisy. could use some air conditioning in the summer.
Pretty good authentic food, nice staff, but very, very slow service. If you have a few hours to spend hanging out then it might be worth your time.
The food is comfort food and very consistently good.  When it's busy though, the service is slow.  Which is understandable, but maybe they can do something about the weekend evening shifts?

My sister wanted to go to here for her 64th birthday and we were all pleasantly surprised! The reservation was flawless. The table location perfect and beer menu enthralling!! We will definitely be back!!!

Good German food!  Very good service.  Parking lot was a bit of challenge and on-street options were rather limited.  Would not have found the place without following my GPS!

Now that we are "veterans" we will stop by again, especially after picking up people at the Oakland Airport.

Fantastic jazz and blues night. Amazing singer. It took a little while to get served but when we were everything came quick. The best was the corn chowder. Everything else was really good but not eye rolling amazing. About $35pp

We are repeat customers. 

We always order Spaetzle here.  The past 2 times were not good.  This time was no exception as well.  We ordered 2 Spaetzle's with Salads.  This was absolutely the worst Spatzle we have ever had anywhere.  The Spaetzle had NO ONIONS and NO Emmentaler that we could taste!  The dish was very bland.  The meatloaf I ordered was covered in wine gravy instead of brown gravy?  What's up with that?  We wanted to come back again to give it another chance.

VERY DISSAPOINTTED!!!!!

VERY NOISY!!!!!

Don't think we will be back anytime soon!
We always have a good time and really enjoy the German/Austrian food!

Excellent, authentic German food.  From the Schnitzel to the Curry Wurst and Spaetzle, everything is fantastic.  Great Bier and wine selections as well.  Dining is great inside and out!  Definitely worth the visit if you want some outstanding German food!
Wonderful service, food is amazing always try something new and it's always great.  Who could ask for more!
Very good option for German food and beer in Alameda.  Nice patio dining option.  Friendly service.

The food is so authentic, as are the beers. We love going there, we just make sure to order quickly because the food always takes awhile to be prepared. Maybe that's because it's very fresh & each individual meal is prepared from scratch on the spot. I would suggest speisekammer find a a way to speed it up a bit. Maybe more chefs, larger kitchen. Because they shouldn't compromise their amazing quality.
Not as good this time but still better than a lot of others and i love it there..!!
Great, homey, friendly place! Always nice folks, good food.
Excellent waitress, service and food.

Fabulous place for best food around.  Potatoe pancakes the best I've ever had.  Pretzels yummy, bratwurst and more great.  Love the atmosphere and service is great, friendly and so accommodating.  Love it here

I have been to Speisekammer many times, but this time I was quite disappointed. It was particularly unfortunate because I had brought friends I wanted to introduce this restaurant to. For whatever reason, right from the beginning, the server seemed displeased with us. It's true that my friends came 20 minutes late, but that didn't seem sufficient reason. We were then turned over to a second server who misheard my answer to a question (it was quite noisy), but seemed convinced that I had just changed my mind. One of my friends did not get the dish he ordered, though he decided to let it go.  All in all, not an inspiring evening.
Authentic German cuisine and great array of German beers.
Always a good meal. Unique and friendly atmosphere.
Service was very poor.  Over one hour for entree to arrive and had to flag sever to get any attention on that 1 hour.

The food tonight was excellent - as usual. The service was disappointing. It took over an hour from ordering to delivery of our food - salmon for my wife, bratwurst for me. The two elderly women at the neighboring table, who arrived about half an hour after we did, but were served their jagerschnitzel 10 -15 minutes before our food finally appeared, were embarrassed to be served before us, and apologized for receiving their food prior to us. Would have ordered apfel strudel for dessert, but didn't want another lengthy wait. Hope this is a one time experience, since Speisekammer is a restaurant we always visit when we come to our 2nd home in Alameda.

We were excited to try this local favorite. Unfortunately, we waited 1.5 hours with kids in tow. Not a good idea. When food came finally, it was just dropped at the table without a word. Not sure if we'd give it another try.

Once again Speisekammer delivers. This time it was a sunny Father's day late lunch & beer with the family. We sat outside, were well taken care of, and had a great time. For us it's a treat to go to such a 'regular' sort of place and still have great gluten-free options available for my kid who has celiac.
Great to have lovely German food in an authentic restaurant

I've been coming to Speisekammer since the beginning. I love the beer and the atmosphere. Mostly, I love the convenience. Though I love the locality and ambiance of the neighborhood restaurant, I think the cost of food relative to value is definitely something that has increased. We went on a hot day and there is no AC for those who plan to go in the summer.
Slow service. Good food but limited menu. Difficult parking. Good beer menu.

Excellent small live bands on some weekend nights. You can sit inside (in a restaurant or bar setting), or we prefer outside, under umbrellas. We could see fireworks over the Oakland coliseum from our table. Super authentic German food, right down to the pickled vegetables and sweet sauerkraut. Most big entrees can be ordered in a smaller size. The BMW sidecar with brandy is my favorite East Bay cocktail - lemony and lush, but not too sweet. Rot kohl (red cabbage) is a great side dish, and the meals are preceded by fresh bread.
Great authentic German restaurant!
Great place! Have never been disappointed and loved how well they serve our nine person party.
Another great dinner.  The specials are intriguing enough to tempt me away from the main menu.  I haven't eaten a bad bite here yet.
Great German food and beer with good service and atmosphere.
We enjoy the authentic German food and very good service. We go regularly to hear the Americano Social Club play lovely music. We recommend this restaurant.
very authentic  German beer garden with an excellent restaurant if you like German food..
Friendly and conscientious service, good drink selections and menu options for our group. Fun place!
This was a great little find.  Had some Mother's Day specials that were quite nice.  Can't wait to go back and try regular menu.  Nice meat and cheese plates too.

I would never recommend a restaurant with a wood oven, or a fireplace, as wood smoke is a dangerous air pollutant, contributing to health issues and climate change. I am so glad that was not an issue here. The food is always comforting and the service absolutely great. I do think my martini was smaller than in past visits, but overall a very nice location for a family gathering. Best spinach ever!

I tend to go to Speisekammer for lunch on sunny summer days, and sit outside on the patio. The food is well-prepared, and if you are German or love German food, it is comfort food. On this occasion, it was clear that some of the other customers very regulars; the waitstaff knew what they would order before they ordered it. There were quite a few dogs under tables who were also enjoying the patio. The beer list has something for everyone. The menu covers a wide range and includes some items I have not seen on menus at other Bay Area German-themed restaurants. Prices are quite modest and portions substantial. It is a solid four stars, and a restaurant I hope to get back to more often.
Slow service, overcooked salty food and less than cold beer...nuff said.

This is our go-to restaurant. It never disappoints. I'm vegetarian and I'm able to eat a good-sized meal by combining side dishes. 
The service here is always friendly and stellar. 5 stars.

This was our second visit to Speisekammer. It was good, just like the first time. 

I ordered the soup of the day, which was mushroom leek. It had long strands of leek, which took away from the soup. It would have been better if the leeks were cut up and then pureed into the soup. 

We all enjoyed our entrees. Three of us had a schnitzel, and my wife had the wild boar from their specials menu. She thought it was very good. 

I do recommend Speisekammer and I would also recommend making a reservation as they do get busy, especially on the weekend.
As always,a wonderful meal
As always this is very good German restaurant that we visit often.   A large beer selection, good hearty German food and interesting specials.  We always get the potato pancakes.
Very enjoyable.  Friendly people.  Food first rate and portions are generous.  Reasonable prices.

The food was quite tasty and the prices were reasonable. My mixed drink wasn't watered down. Quiet enough to have a conversation. Quaint Alameda neighborhood with lots of interesting shops within walking distance.
Excellent food.  Ditto service.
Very happy every time especially the potato pancakes..yummy..
Enjoyed authentic German food. Sports on the Big screen was a plus!
Loved it.  Loved the area.  There's a wonderful natural foods market nearby.
Had a great time here. If you're looking for a German pub with authentic food, and an extensive beer selection, look no further. Will definitely be going back soon.
This is our go-to restaurant for a great German meal.  Always good.
Food is consistently good.   Great place to hang out with friends for a casual delicious German meal and great selection of beer.

Great food.  Love the potatoe pancakes, wienerschnitzel, spatzle, and sourbraten.  Get small portions unless really hungry or want take home.  

We always enjoy dining at this restaurant.
We came here to celebrate my parents' wedding anniversary.  We were taken care of very well.  I want to try all the beer on tap.
The food was amazing, the only challenge is finding parking.
we celebrated our anniversary years ago here and come back every year to remember that great party and of course have their tasty food and great beer selection

We went for St. Patrick's Day to eat dinner and to hear the music.
All was terrific! Amazing music, enthusiastic crowd, absolutely delicious food.
The beer was the best I've had!
Speisekammer has been a neighborhood gem for years.  They offer a great selection of German food and beer.  I would recommend this restaurant to friends and family, and out-of-town guests.
Excellent food and service. I had the corn beef and cabbage on Saint Patrick's Day. The kids menu has a good selection too.
Nice to see some additional menu options!  Great beer, and if you are up for hearty fare, this is a great place.
First time here. It was highly recommended by a couple friends. The service was great! Food was awesome! Everything we ordered tasted excellent. I would definitely come back!
Food was very good. We sat near some fans during the Warriors game. Would have preferred a quieter area for the wife and I to enjoy the meal. Overall: good food, service and ambiance.

What a terrific find!  We just discovered this restaurant, have been there twice and will visit return again.  We've only been there in winter and can't wait to sit outside.  Close to the theater and shop district, makes a lovely day and you only park once.  Great German food and of course terrific beers.  We were there with person celebrating their birthday and our friendly, helpful server brought out a complimentary birthday dessert with lit candle.
Another awesome meal. Every time we've eaten here the service has been goid and the food fantastic.

We are regular patrons and always enjoy the food and cocktails at this local gem but often struggle with the slow pace of service. The last time we tried to get a table on a Thursday night without reservations, we were turned away. Yes, turned away and not even given the option to sit at the bar.  The place was half empty.  I have never in all of my extensive travels and dining experience had this happen.  I found it arrogant and a bit off putting as a frequent diner here.  And, yes,...we we had shoes and shirts on.

A fun place to have dinner, especially if you are in the same room as the live music.  This restaurant would be perfect if it weren't for the questionable service.   I think they must lose a lot of money by not seating parties more quickly.  We heard estimates of well over an hour for next available seating, while many tables sat empty.  They have enough hostesses, but not nearly enough servers.  This place is poppin, but they do not keep up with their demand.  We had reservations, arrived very early, and still didn't get seated until 20 minutes after our reservation.   Our food order wasn't taken until 45 minutes after our official reservation time, but we were having such a good time that it didn't matter terribly.  The food is impeccable German fare.
Great food, good service, fairly priced.  Nothing to compliant about.

Staff is excellent.  Attentive, knowledgeable and friendly.   Food is German style but not necessarily heavy, plenty of fresh and local options...my  grilled salmon served over a bed of sautéed spinach was delicious!
Music by Americano Social Club was fun and entertaining.  Will definitely return.

As always, a tasty meal.  Sunday night dinner was great - a bit quieter, with attentive service and delicious German food.

Prost!

Made a reservation for a large group lunch. Staff that seated us were initially a little unhelpful  but the waitress assigned to us was incredibly accommodating and kind. Great food and beers and nice space. Good for large groups but call or reserve to make sure they have space.
Great German food and good beer, hard to beat that combination! A cool local spot, very busy and bustling. Fun.
Great German food, good beer selection.  Kids loved it, adults loved it.  Will be going back.

LOVE Speisekammer ! Always a great meal...great German food ! We drive over from San Francisco every couple of months for our German food fix !
Only disappointment this trip....we were seated in the bar area...lunch noise was a bit much ! Next time we'll ask for another table, in a less noisy area....no other complaints !
Thanks to the entire staff for another wonderful meal !!
Very great experience, delicious food, and wonderful service. Can't wait to go back!
Our waitress gave our table excellent service.  I don't eat German food often but it was a great experience.
Nice place in Alameda, clearly well-established and well-run. I plan to return.

Being from Albuquerque, which doesn't have good German food, we were excited to see  this restaurant close to the Oakland airport. Once we found parking (which wasn't easy), we were quickly greeted and seated. We each ordered a different German beer on tap after explaining our beer preferences and choosing the waiter's suggestion--all three were spot on and excellent. We ordered the potato and bacon soup to start followed by the meat sampler plate. The food and the service were also excellent.  Unfortunately we were all too full to have dessert, now I have to plan another business trip to Oakland to try more food and beers!

The staff was very friendly & helpful in all regards! Our dinner mate wanted the veal sausage, but we were told it was only available at lunch, our server Tally  (sic) asked the kitchen to prepare it for her , which they did.The food was very good with the exception of the potato salad, which had waaaaaaay to much vinegar & mustard! I ADORE both of those condiments, but one bite was all I could handle and no one else, in our group of 4, liked it either. The portions were reasonable sized but the $200 + tab (including cocktails, wine, beer)will stop us from going too often, but we'll definitely return.
For German food, it doesn't get much better or authentic than Speisekammer.  Good food, good beer, friendly service.
These guys were super accommodating and the food and drinks were great. Service was also great and we got our own private room. Thanks again for everything!

We came to do some tasting before we decided to use them to catering our sons engagement party. Cindy came to our rescue. Even though we had a reservation during the busy time of the evening, Cindy was unbelievably helpful, getting us small portion sized dishes for tasting and enjoying. We tried the Bratwurst, Sauerbraten, red cabbage, all 4 salads ( love the cucumber) spatzle , both plain and with cheese and had room for apple strudel for dessert.
The food served at dinner was very well prepared and delicious. We have been to Germany and finding Speiskammer is a hidden gem in the bay. We will be back for more great food and beer.
Great German food with a live music venue, free of charge!  Don't miss out!

This is one of our favorite restaurants. We love the potato pancakes (get the optional sour cream to go with the free housemade applesauce). Many of the heartier dishes are available in half-sizes at lunchtime, so the half-order of Jagerschnitzel--veal, altho pork is available--was the ideal segue. Spouse found the burger first-rate: just a single patty, but well-crusted and full of beefy flavor. Caramelized onions and a good bun made it perfect. Warm apple strudel ended another excellent meal. We have tried the other EBay German restaurants but none compare to Speisekammer!

Third time here. Every trip I've tried something different and each time its been worth the visit - Bratwurst, Jagrschnitzel, and Sauerbraten are all excellent. Looking forward to future trips to try out the rest of the entrees.
Second time here. First time had Jagrschnitzel this time the Bratwurst. Both were excellent and reminded me of our trip to Germany. Well worth it.

Nice venue for Sunday lunch, meeting up with an old friend. Our experience may have been unique, in that it was a really gloomy/rainy day, so restaurant was not very crowded.  I booked a reso, anticipating more of a crowd, but not needed on this particular day.  

Restaurant staff was very cordial and did a good job of balancing attentive service with leaving us alone to talk, as we were obviously catching up and deep in conversation at several points.

Food was excellent - I had the sauerbraten, the others had the omelette-special and bratwurst.  Portions were generous, loved the sides on the dishes (nicely roasted potatoes, spatzle and red cabbage, mashed potato and sauerkraut).  Would recommend the potato pancakes w/apple as an appetizer: pancakes were nice and crunchy and sauce was not too sweet.  We shared a very generous and delicious vanilla creme brulee w/lemon-poppyseed madelines and the smaller apple strudel for dessert.  Coffee was fresh and delicious .  Total bill w/o tip = $101

We had enough left of our entrees for a doggy box and enjoyed the next day.  I will most definitely go back.  A friend recommended the Fri-Sat entertainment, so will return for dinner and check that out.

While known for its great German food, Speisekammer has always been known for its delicious food.  We were not disappointed.  We went the first week of the new year, so holiday lighting was still up. In the past, we've sat in the front section which has a more casual feel. I never sat in the more formal dining room, which is where we were seated, so the holiday lighting added to the atmosphere of what I would expect in a German room: warm and friendly. This feeling was further enhanced on a cold, rainy day. This room is good for a large party.
