While I'm not a red meat person generally, two of our group of five had the sauerbraten and raved about it. I had the salmon. While not the most exciting entrée on the menu, I couldn't bear to eat anything heavy after the holidays. My daughter had the roasted chicken, which is her favorite item on the menu. I can say that it is delicious and not overcooked, which can happen with chicken. Or salmon, for that matter. 

We were celebrating a birthday, so my only disappointment was that the restaurant did not read my special directions when I made the reservation.  Nothing special was said. I had hoped for a candle on the dessert at the very least.  Regardless, this won't keep me from visiting this place again, especially at Oktoberfest, which is when the weather is warm in the Bay Area and there is plenty of outside seating. And very good beer, to boot!  (Did I mention their extensive beer menu?  Thumbs up, that's for sure!)

Have gone here on several occasions over the past years.  Food is always good and reasonably priced.  Beer is always outstanding.  This visit was marred only by the decibel level in the dining room.  I've never experienced such a loud dining experience where we had to shout across the table to be heard over the noise.  Place needs some sound-deadening!

Authentic German food in a nice, fireside setting. Great selection of favorite German food with a little California flair. Best selection of on-tap German beers anywhere. A must go for the Bay area Germano-phile...

Been to Spieskammer several times, including before Warriors games at Oracle Arena, a short 10 minute drive away.  We LOVE everything about it. The German food is very well prepared, the service is top notch, the 16 German (and domestic micro brew) beers on tap are outstanding and rare to find, and the atmosphere is fun and cool and as if you've taken a trip to Germany itself.  Great for dates, kids, you name it.  We love the KLEINE NÜRNBERGER BRATWÜRSTCHEN ($10.50, small sausages on a bed of awesome sauerkraut) and the authentic german PRETZEL MIT BIER-KÄSESOSSE ($7.00) to start.  The WIENER SCHNITZEL (Pork = $18.50 with a nice German salad accompaniment, Veal $3.00 more) and the SAUERBRATEN ($23.50 with excellent, excellent Red Cabbage & Spätzle (like my mother used to make!), are absolute favorites.  And, to top it off, the Apfel Strudel is an absolute treat. Spieskammer is a GEM, and we recommend it highly...5 stars all around!
Took a client and friend. Beer and meal were excellent. Wild boar and goose dishes were amazing. I have regular cravings now. Secured future business!  Thank you.

I've been to Speisekammer several times, but never on Christmas Eve. It was about the best restaurant I could've picked for a festive evening. It felt like Christmas inside the restaurant.  There were Carolers and music.  The food was exceptional as usual.  It made for one of the best Christmas Eves I can remember in recent times.
Delicious dishes and excellent service. The waitress was familiar with each dish and wine selections. She provided outstanding recommendations.
Great service. Good German food.

As usual, another great meal that just makes my mouth water thinking about it again.  This is one of my 'go-to' places when I want something special.  If you haven't been here, you need to try it out.  You will not be disappointed.

We ordered three appetizers, four entrees, and two desserts. 
The worst appetizer: Nuernberger sausages on sauerkraut. The sausages were shriveled and totally dry, as if they had been sitting on a steam table for hours. 
The worst entrees: the goose - presentation: scraps in a pile. The meat was dry, tough, and flavorless as if it had been sitting on a steam table for hours or scraped off a pan to make one more order. The smoked pig shank: dry, dry, dry - again, steam table quality.

Since we had guests with us, I focused on the wonderful company I was with rather than complain about the food. Including beverages (two of them non-alcoholic) the total came to $200. 

We will not be back.

Probably my 5th time here and the food and beer have never failed me or my guests. My parents were born in Germany and they were successful restaurant owners so I grew up on German cooking. Highly recommend this restaurant for variety and authenticity. The beer choices are excellent. I suggest a more expansive dessert menu with German style cakes in addition to the Strudel. We really enjoy  the herbed butter and dark bread basket, too. By the way, we had a lot of fun watching  Fußbal in the bar area last year and eating lunch.

Probably our 20th visit and it's ALWAYS a great experience at Speisekammer! Great food and flavors that you can only find at a few places in the Bay area. Wonderful German beers, and a very welcoming and friendly atmosphere.
Hadn't been in a while due to service and food quality.  Prices went up, but so did food quality and the service.  We had a great meal and wonderful service.  Happy to see them back on track.
Good beer selection and typical German plates. Geat service and the restaurant atmosphere made us feel in Germany! Well done
Great German food - best so far we've had in the East Bay. Prices are a little steep, but the ambience is nice. Would be even better if there were no TV!
Sooooooo good! And just a fun atmosphere. Great food, great service, everything was great. I'll be a regular here for sure.
Very nice place. Two large parties slowed down service. Staff very attentive. Great selection of beer.
Server tried to rush us.  Food was served cold.  Cold spätzle -uck.
Great German pub atmosphere. Some food was great, some fell flat. Try potato pancakes and apple sauce. Miss the soggy salmon.
Fun place and really nice staff! We will be back with friends and family!
Great place. The only place to go in the Bay Area for authentic German food.
Wonderful dining experience ~ nice to visit local favorites as we moved from the BA a few years ago~ love the atmosphere and terrific service ♥️
Our first visit, and the jagrschnitzel, bratwurst, and roasted chicken that the three of us had were all uniformly excellent. WIll be back!
Our waitress was AMAZING! So accommodating!
Heard great things about this place and finally got to check it out. The meat platter was filling and the pork chop was my favorite.
Terrific experience

Had a lunch date there, great options for breakfast or lunch.  There was a game on so it was pretty lively at first, once the game was over, it was a normal noise level for a thriving restaurant. I like taking friends who aren't from Alameda there because it is a unique experience to have authentic German food. The Friday night music is really fun!
interesting people, excellent food, good service, attentive waiters. plates were served with style and panache. interesting little cocktail menu. we all enjoyed it.

Great  German style food with great beer selection. 
 Service was fast and attentive .  Will be back again.
The food and atmosphere is always casual and delicious.  Great beer and cocktail options.

There were six of us going out to dinner.  Some had Sauerbraten which was awesome.  But the
other items ordered were all wonderful.
This is one of our favorite 'go-to' German restaurants
The food was quite tasty, and the portions were very generous and a good value (except for dessert sundae).  Service was a little slow, but the place was packed early on a Saturday night.
We are never disappointed....wonderful  in every way.
Speisekammer is excellent with authentic German cuisine.
love this place.  Wonderful selection of German Bier.  Food is off the charts.
We had a great meal and afterwards the fantastic Lee Vilensky Trio played 2 sets. Relaxed, no rush, tasty food: what more could you ask for?
Great food, great beer, great gluten-free options for the celiac -- My husband loves this restaurant !
Perfect place to bring a parent. He loved it!
Authentic German food. Great sauerbraten and schnitzel. Can't eat here often enough

Speisekammer has been part of the Alameda restaurant scene for years. We started going back recently when we discovered they had updated the menu.  Along with a delicious lighter fare, there are lots of good German dishes--we miss the stuffed cabbage though; that dish was one of our favorites.
Food is good, variety for all.  4 salad plate is good... but too much vinegar.
Great German food, service, music.Always a consistent winner for an entertaining evening with good value food and no cover charge.

I go to Speisekammer about once a year for dinner and a couple more times a year for beer and some music.  I enjoy it everytime.  I struggled on whether to give it 4 or 5 stars for the food.  I landed on 4.  I had a cup of beet soup and wild boar as a main course.  It came with asparagus and noodles.  All were very good and my dinner companions also loved their pork shank and sea food stew.  They were not busy on a Sunday night.  Conversation was easy, not too loud.  Service was efficient, friendly, and non-obtrusive.  Great night and I highly recommend Speisekammer.

Ich bin nicht Deutsche, aber.... I have been there many times and eating at Speisekammer always takes me back; the food is authentic, the beer list excellent, and they had no problem accommodating my friends' service animal or need for gluten-free options.
My husband and I were feeling a need for German food as fall arrives. We had a wonderful meal with some of my favorites. Great red cabbage and sausages. We sat outside and enjoyed the warm evening

We love Speisekammer -- it's one of a kind, and it doesn't try to be everything to everyone.  It serves good German food in a very nice. multi-room setting.  Our service experience has always been excellent.  The beer list is amazing.  We are especially happy about the outdoor dining options on the front patio, since we can bring our well-mannered Weimaraner with us and be made welcome.  One of our go-to places for Special Events, plus a nice place to drop in for lunch on the patio.
We love Speisekammer! Great german dishes, thumbs up from actual German immigrant! And who can negate the  great beer choices...! Friendly and attentive staff, definitely worth the drive :-)

Took our German mother here and everything was up to her standards and delicious! The desserts and some of the cocktails weren't German style but were welcome additions and also tasted great. We encountered only very friendly staff and the patrons all seemed to be enjoying themselves. We will be back!

Consistently excellent German food that can hardly be found anywhere in our greater metropolitan region. Add this to no-cover live music and great attitude among servers, a funky and effortless setting, great  value -- nothing more than you can ask for fun evenings. Highly recommended.
Wonderful to have dessert brought to the "birthday girl".
Everything was great.  The food is just like being in Germany.  Very large list of beers to choose from.

Making the reservation was very easy.  The wait staff were attentive but not overly so. The music was fantastic, our group had a wonderful time . My husbands entre was very good, my meat was a bit over done.  The fruit and cheese platter was beautiful and delicious. We go out here often and will continue to do so.
We had an amazing time! The food is just delicious, they had live music on Friday night and very good service.

Authentic German fare (wiener schnitzel,  bratwurst) served with great attitude at value-low prices and in generous quantity, paired with lively live music without cover charge or minimum and a fun crowd. Truly a fun night out for folks of any age and taste.
That ambiance was great. I felt like I was in a Bavarian chalet. Well decorated, and the live music really set the mood. The food was delicious. Five out of five stars!
This is my 'go-to' place for German food.  I haven't found a better place yet.  A little on the high side for price, but still reasonable.
Great food as always.  The service was exceptional.  Highly recommend this restaurant.

The food was excellent, authentic, German and came hot to the table. 
The music was great, we love the Americano Social Club and can't wait to hear them again.
The service was very good.
Everything is Fantastic there.  great potatoe pancakes, bar, food and music.  Lots of of beer appetizers and food to try.  Fun meeting new people and their dogs everyone has fun.  Servers are great
Love it there!
Excellent beer, and pretzels. Amazing peach cobbler. Some of the food was too salty for me.

We sat on the patio and the patrons behind us were extremely loud and vulgar, and management did nothing but serve them more and more beer (they were already plastered when we started our meal and they were still ordering more throughout the entire evening). Completely ruined the entire experience. I thought the food was average at best. The schweinebraten was more like a pot roast
Meat platter is so flavorful.  Diamond spot in Alameda.

We love Speisekammer and tell all of our friends about it.  We love the bar, the food, the menu, the servers, the atmosphere and the wonderful beers and cocktails.  This visit was very sub-par food-wise however.  Our pretzel was good, though we realized later we did not get the cheese sauce that always comes with it.  I ordered the roasted pork with mashed potatoes and sauerkraut.  The sides were great but the pork had an odd, gamey taste and very gray.  I don't know whether it was overcooked or just a poor preparation, but I did not eat it.  My bf had the jagerschnitzel  so we shared his piece of meat.  The apple strudel with vanilla ice cream was divine.  We will return, but never order the roasted pork dish again.  (It's the first listing under specialties).
The food is spectacular, surpassing our expectations! Wonderful way to get your fill of German food cravings.
Such an authentic German place! We love it! Delicious and generous portions. You won't go hungry!

We had a wonderful time.  The service was quick to know what the best dishes were and had great suggestions on beer pairings.  There was a lovely patio/garten outside to enjoy the weather.  We plan on going back.  The portions were considerable especially with a beer or two.  So try extra hard to save room for dessert.
Our server was a pro and helped to make our first experience dining here a great one!  Already planning another visit.

We haven't had much exposure to German food, even though my husband's grandparents came from Germany years ago. Our son took us to Speisekammer for Father's Day dinner. My husband loved the food, ambiance, and friendly service.  The food was really authentic, like German home cooking.  We all enjoyed our meal, and will return to try other dishes.

I made a reservation for a table in the bar on the night of game 7 of the 2016 NBA finals.  Speisekammer had a table for us with a great view of the large TV.  The food, service and beer was great as usual, the only thing wrong that evening was the winning team.
Food & service was great - little noisy but definitely worth it
I always have a great meal and great service. The best German restaurant by far!

Great sales with lightly pickled vegetables and other things specific to German cuisine. So good, we went back the next night. Platter of 3 sides was great, with grilled broccoli I, green beans, and spectacular squash. favorites were smoked ham appetizer and be sidecar cocktail. Huge selection of beers and good ginger ale.

Great place to come and eat with friends/family.......

Also, besides that the food is wonderful, the beer list is amazing. 

Outside eating as well as inside in the back has room for bigger groups.
One of our favorite neighborhood restaurants. Great food. Live music. And great place to watch soccer games.

Reasonably priced cocktails start off your experience. I had the BMW Sidecar, made with German brandy (Anspach). It was a very good drink. Next we ordered appetizers, my wife had a bread bacon dumpling, which was a half order (thank goodness). Absolutely delicious, it was about 1 1/2" in diameter. I had the potato pancakes, a half order, which consisted of 2. My wife and I shared the appetizers, and declared them yummy. We ordered our entrees, I had the Venison Oso Bucco special, with sumptious meat falling off the bone. My wife had the BBQ pork rib special. Both were delicious, and generous portions. We ordered an Austrian red wine to go with the meal, priced at $30. We enjoyed the wine very much. For dessert, we shared the house made Apfel Strudel, and my wife had the Kafe Rudesheim, again made with the Anspach brandy.
We liked the restaurant very much and would return happily.

Beer was great and waitress friendly.  They ran out of spätzle and only had enough for one plate.  The food does not look like the pictures on their website.  Sausages were good.  Ordered a tri tip steak that came out like pot roast but tasted OK.  Gravy on the Jaegerschnitzel was a bit greasy.   Would definitely give it another try.

Speisekammer gets no notice from foodie blogs or critics, yet it has consistently excellent food (outside of sometimes forgetting to rinse the sauerkraut before braising it). Schnitzel, braised pork, spaetzle, sausages, and those DIVINE potato pancakes (get the optional sour cream to go with the housemade applesauce). And the smoked pork chop! -- now that Wente's chop has gone south, Speisekammer is the only place you can get this moist, ham-on-a-bone deliciousness. New pastry chef Ms. de la Rosa is doing a very nice job although she sometimes oversweetens a dessert. Full bar, great beer list - why are you wasting time at those other pseudo-German places? Come here for REAL gemutlich!
The food is really good.  Ditto the beer - they have lots of fine German beers on draft.

In a very unlikely location, Speisekammer has a great atmosphere.  Nice outdoor terrace for nice days.  Very large brunch/lunch menu and of course, a wonderful selection of German beers.

Had the curry wurst and stuffed cabbage - what's nice this for more of the entrees you can order whole or half order.  Also tried the bread dumpling.  Very hearty food, good portions and great service.  

I wished I lived in the area - I'm sure their happy hour is a lot of fun!
Not entirely true German fare per my German boyfriend but pleasant atmosphere, decent pricing (for brunch/lunch), and German beer selection that you wouldn't easily find elsewhere
Took my dad here last time he visited and it was fabulous like always.

The food is so, so good! I'm always so impressed with the food and crave the composed salad. So sad that the food is consistently so bad that it is almost comical. Staff is very unpolished and unprofessional. Hostess greeted us wearing an outdoor hooded parka, server wore a very revealing tank top and shorts, and staff were sitting at the bar drinking after their shift.
Delicious, and a homey atmosphere. Didn't have room for dessert!
All our family love this restaurant! Delicious food, good vibes, kind staff and good service.
For the second time they seated us in the extremely dark red corner. It was gloomy and the worst spot in the restaurant.

Hands down, this is the best restaurant I have eaten in through both my visits to Alameda. 

It was our last night in town and I remembered seeing something about this restaurant, so we made a reservation (highly recommended - it was packed on a Saturday evening).

We were sat immediately. Within a few minutes, we were greeted by our server, Sterling. Very nice and very familiar with not only the food menu, but also the drinks.

We started with a cup of their roasted cauliflower soup and a cup of the potato soup. Both were very good. 

For our entrees, I ordered the Jagerschnitzel, which is pork cutlets topped with a mushroom cream sauce. My wife ordered the sauerbraten, which is sliced beef topped with a wine-based gravy. Each of our dinners came with a salad.

Needless to say, we cleaned our plates. The flavor was excellent. You could tell our food was served immediately after being placed on the plates. It was steaming hot. 

Speisekammer has a very large German beer selection, on draft and in bottles. The also have a large German wine selection as well as quite a list of specialty cocktails. 

There is parking on the street and they some parking on the side of the building. Be careful, though as the parking lot only has one entrance and then you have to back out. Maybe not a good idea if you been sampling their bar selections. 

There is also seating outside and on this occasion, it appeared a band was beginning to set up. 

Highly recommend,making a reservation. This is a very popular restaurant. 

I knew there had to be at least one good restaurant in Alameda. I just wish I would I found it earlier.

The food was really good.  The beer selection is also pretty good.  I've been here many times and it's always pretty solid.  Service can sometimes be spotty, but the place is always really busy and packed, so I understand if the service gets slow in spots.  This night, our waitress was pretty on it.  The one that wasn't was the host.  It seemed like there were two of them, and one sort of seemed like she knew what she was doing, but the guy I think was messing everything up. We had to wait 20-minutes or longer to get seated after our reservation time.  Zero communication about why the delay or how long it would be or anything.  I would still go back because the food is pretty darn good and it's a good place for groups and kids.  But I have to knock it down one start because that part of the service was really lacking.

I took my German father here for his birthday. The food is pretty authentic German cuisine and it was very good. We had potatoe pancakes for an appetizer, followed by their combination salad. The salad has alot of vinegar taste to it which both my father & I like. The portions are decent sized depending on the entree. My son had the wiener schnitzel and had large portions. I had the sauerbraten and it was decent size. My father had the salmon and it was not too small nor not too large. The restaurant gave my father a free apple strudel for his birthday.  I had the black forest cake and it was a tad too sweet for me, but I prefer my dessert not too sweet more European style where desserts are a little sweet but not too much. My son had the turkish coffee creme brulee which he said was outstanding. We enjoyed our meals and had a good time. We did not stay for the band. The restaurant filled up quickly so I recommend having reservations.

Our most recent visit to Speisekammer underscored once again why it is one of our favorite places. The appetizers and main dishes, most from the Daily Specials menu, were wonderfully delicious. I have to point out the mushroom and goat cheese strudel with the red pepper sauce - incredible! Also the barbecued ribs with sauerkraut were exemplary - rich, moist, and flavorful. The tart sauerkraut cut through and complemented the rich sweetness of the ribs and the sauce.

Our server, Patrick, was friendly and took perfect care of us, and he did so despite the fact of being responsible for multiple tables both in and outside.

We started going to Speisekammer shortly after it opened, and back then it was really good. Happily enough, it has continually improved and reset the bar since then, and it is hard if not impossible to name another German restaurant that so consistently delights us. Thanks!

We LOVE your restaurant and use it as our special "getaway" when we want a really great "comfort food" type meal, in a very relaxed home like, local place with great beer and wine!! We always take out of town/state visitors here and they are blown away. Our server was terrific and she celebrated our quiet anniversary by bringing us a half split of champagne on her!! As usual our dinner was superb! Thank you for being a part of our community!

We truly enjoyed our Sunday evening meal at Speisekammer. The atmosphere was casual and thematic, though the room did get very loud as it filled up. The waiter was prompt and helpful. Our food was very good and our German-born friend said it was pretty authentic. The portions are large, but I thought the prices were a bit high. The desserts were fabulous!
While the food was  generally well prepared ,  all  of  our dishes were way too salty.   Even though we asked for low salt,   our meals were still  too salty to eat.   Disappointing.

Always a pleasure to dine at Speisekamer. As my German friend says, it's one of the few authentic German restaurants in the Bay Area. It can me loud but they really accommodate children which is nice - special menu for them too. Arrive hungry because the portions are large or be prepared to take home and have leftovers for another meal!
Spiesekammer offers the some of the best Germn food & beer in the Bay Area! (I have German parents so I'm very critical!).

I've been here numerous times.  The food stands on its own for being great!   I love that you get the option of ordering 1/2 portions but honestly... Just get the whole thing and take it home for a nice treat the next day.   

The service here is usually just so so.  Only once have I had a server that went above and beyond while also being super friendly and helpful.   The service isn't bad.... It's just not good... This last time included.   We ate at the bar on a weekday.  It was not busy.  Still, we found ourselves having to stop the bartender to ask for more drinks and even to place food orders.  He was nice... But again, not super attentive which seems to be the general rule of thumb here.  

With all that being said.... I still love this place and I'd recommend you give it a go!
We had a very good first time visit. Enjoyed the hous specials, German beer and desert.  We will be back.

Great wine and beer list. The food was wonderful & plenty of it!
Service was fast and courteous.
I'll be back!
First time there and it was a neighborhood jewel in Alameda, where we had not eaten before...a classic old time German ambiance...loved it!!!

I found this German restaurant on Open Table, and having a long line of German heritage, thought I would introduce my husband and son to the food that I grew up with.  I have been to Germany, so I expected a long list of different kind of wursts, sauerkraut, maybe some rabbit, it was, unfortunately, nothing like that.  I loved the salad, very vinegar-y.  I loved my Bier.  My husband LOVED his wurst/sauerkraut/potatoes ("Best Sauerkraut I ever ate!").  My son got a dish with spatzle, which he did not care for (the spatzle).  The meat was good.  I had a pork cutlet, that was breaded and cooked way too much, it was certainly not what I expected.  With some kind of puffy potatoes that I did not care for.  The menu is very set and in my opinion, limited.  I did expect more as the reviews were wildly enthusiastic.  It reminds me of a German Cheers, where everyone knows your name, very warm and welcoming....but set in their ways (menu) and not inventive or current...kind of "churn it out" atmosphere.  

The service was absolutely impeccable and our server was very helpful.  It was an adventure for us and although a little disappointing (not horribly) it was on the whole a good evening trying a new kind of food.  Will we come back?  I think so, but we will order differently.

The food is always spot on for great German cuisine. Seasonal German beers on tap. The wine list is full of local California wines and excellent European selections. Service is very good. I always take out of area friend here and they all a gushing in their praise.

Title says it all. Came a bit late for reservation on Friday night, but table still there. Noisy country and western band, but good atmosphere and noise level tolerable one room away from band. Food ok. Beer awesome, especially draft selection - but simply overpriced.
Had a lovely dinner here,  full bar, great gravlax!

As a North-German who left his home country (Schleswig-Holstein :) )  one year ago, I really can say that the food at Speisekammer is the best and authentic German food in Bay Area.  I tried the  sausages and the Schnitzel, the fried potatoes and Spaetzle. They are incredible good!
Through serving one of my most favorite German beer "Flensburger Pilsener" the Speisekammer really made my day!

I  celebrated my birthday at the Speisekammer together with family and friends. The Speisekammer provided a perfect and fast service also for a bunch of people. They baked in-house  a black forest cake for my birthday. Also the cake was authentically German and was delicious. 

Many a chefs in Germany can take a leaf out of the Speisekammer chefs book.
It was really nice German Food, and  very big menu. It was pretty loud but the food was worth it.
For German food this is the best I have had in a long time. Not just the usual but different items as well

If you enjoy German food this is the ONLY place you should be eating your pork and sauerkraut! Gaumenkitzel/Berkeley has great quality but you could starve to death there (and I don't need green salads on every single dish, thanks). Speisekammer has marvelous braised pork in beer,  good sauerkraut, the lovely smoked pork chop (Kassler vom Grill), and the best potato pancakes in town with housemade applesauce (get the optional sour cream--yum!). Beer list is superb, and desserts have taken a leap upwards. Forget Brotzeit, come to Speisekammer and see what German food SHOULD taste like.
Delicious  German dishes, friendly service, and a good value (big portions, too!)

Always a pleasure to eat at this restaurant (been there a dozen times or so).
Sausage sampler with pork chop, etc., for the carnivores is really pretty amazing
and comes with a couple of nice mustards. Also loving the dumplings, fries, shrimp 
w/tomato and capers for appetizers. The entrees that I like are the schnitzel, spatzel, 
and even the salmon was tasty, well-charred, but medium. The desserts this last time 
were the best that we've had, so far. A Turkish coffee creme brûlée (wow!), a coconut 
trifle (wow!), a chocolate souffle (very good) plus ice cream, etc.
Nice beer selection (full bar). 
The atmosphere is jovial, mildly loud, sometimes live music, friendly servers, fun, with
a German decor, stone fireplace in the back room, tables and booths.
We love trying new dishes and this place always pleases. The servers are so helpful in describing foods we are unfamiliar with and giving good recommendations. We will come back again!
The taste, tenderness and quality of the food, the service, the ambiance, the wait staff, the hostess.  All were exceptional.

We came to hear music played by the Saddle Cats who play there once a month on a Saturday night.  The music was energetic and wonderful.  To our delight the food was just as wonderful as the music.  Authentic, delicious, German cuisine, wonderful wine and beer and fabulous home made ice cream for dessert on top of strudel.   Very courteous staff.  We are looking forward to our next visit.
Everything we had - appetizers, dinner, dessert and beer were all delicious!  Our waiter was very attentive and answered all our questions even though it was busy

The food was better than expected.  This was husband's first experience with german food and the saurbraten melted in his mouth.  My breaded pork chop special was cooked perfectly also and the apple strudel was light and fluffy.  The waiter was very attentive and we were grateful for his recommendations.  If you are hoping for a quiet meal, stay out of the bar area when the live music starts.  We ate in the back and it was perfect.
Great food....a bit pricy tho....ambiance could use a face lift. ... seating not very comfortable. ..service was fantastic!

Speisekammer is one of the best restaurants around by far. Always a nice mix of seasonal items & their staple delights; friendly & attentive staff; delicious beers; seating for any and all group types, from rowdy & sports-loving to quiet & romantic. Their pretzels are soft and warm, with housemade mustard that makes your heart melt with every bite. The vegetable sides are always done to absolute perfection. And the meats...oh, dear god, the meats. The sausages are obviously fantastic, with various kinds to satisfy the pickiest carnivore, but their other cuts are nothing to sneeze at. I recommend it all!

Great food, good service and within walking distance from our home  - parking can be difficult on busy nights.  We shared a fruit and cheese board for dessert and it was a nice alternative to  something sweet after dinner, especially with a glass of port.  The weekend live music with no cover charge is a bonus.  (Request a table in the front room/bar area if you go for the music.)
What an awesome place! Everything we ordered was unbelievable!! Never really tried their food before but I was totally amazed!!! We are coming back!!!

We eat at Speisekammer at least twice a month and it is always fun, always good hearty German cuisine. This particular visit stood out as our server Johnna was particularly delightful in taking care of my wife and I, along with our two children. It was a Saturday night, the house was packed, the noise level was very loud and every server and staff was busy. Johnna was right on top of it, handling her tables with poise and charm--thank you, Speisekammer!! See you again soon. Prost!

Truly tasty food and nicely presented. Authentic German. Great choice of beers.  Very generous portions. Excellent service and good value. The only drawback for us is noise level a bit high, but that might be a reflection of peoples' enjoyment. Thank you for a great night out.

Speisekammer is our go-to German restaurant. We prefer it to Brotzeit (ick) and Gaumenkitzel (where you could starve). The veal Jaegerschnitzel was superb, and the spaetzle is always good. The housemade pickled vegetables are delightful here, unlike Brotzeit; do NOT miss them. Love the potato pancakes, too. Happy to find the sauerkraut has finally been rinsed before cooking; it is tart but no longer like Vinegar Incarnate. But the Nurnberger sausage is no longer spiced correctly; it tasted like an American pork breakfast sausage - very disappointing! Service is always good at Speisekammer, although when they're slammed at peak times it can lag a bit, like any other place.

We had the best waitress! Knowledgeable, conscientious, helpful. Hostess looked like a guest, and slightly unkempt. She tried twice to put  our party of 3  at a two-top. Since we made a reservation, there should have had an appropriately sized table. We've been before and will go again.

My mom is visiting from Maine and loves German food so where else would we go?  The food is always very good, service friendly and efficient and we really enjoy the live music on a Saturday night.  Our only (minor) complaint is that we had a reservation for a party of three, including my 84 year old mom who uses a cane, and were seated at a small two top table while other parties of two or three who came in after us were seated at larger tables.  Next time we will ask for a different table if there are others open so we can be comfortable while enjoying our dinner and wine.

I normally would give this restaurant a good review but I am ticked off at them at the moment. We made a reservation through OpenTable for July 5th,and showed up with two other friends meeting us there for a special lunch.  To our dismay, the restaurant was closed even though we had an email confirmation of the reservation from OpenTable, so we had no way of knowing that the restaurant would be closed. Apparently they hadn’t bothered to inform OpenTable. We ended up having to go look for another restaurant along with our two friends.
Communication is important. We are frequent customers and in the future we will call the restaurant in addition to relying on OpenTable. For this incident though, thumbs down! 😡

The menu is unchanged and still good quality. Service very efficient  especially given a wildly busy Saturday night. As always, I wish there were a few more options that weren't so hearty  but  this place is in Octoberfest every night. Wonderful selection of beers.

We have eaten here with groups and just as a couple, but the best experience has been this New Year's Eve.  It was very cozy and gemuetlich.  We ordered the Sauerbraten, our favorite, but it comes with their red cabbage which I find has too much of a clove taste, so I asked them to give me more Spaetzle instead, which they did.  I love their pumpernickel bread with the herb infused butter they bring when your first sit down, and our terrific waitress, the wonderful Katherine,  gave me more when she noticed I had already devoured it.  When I asked her where I could get this wonderful bread  she came back with a note that had all the information on how to get it.  Considering how busy the restaurant was, it was really great to have all this personal attention.  Speisekammer, keep Katherine no matter what!
Loud but charming and the food is a surprise for those of us who think German food not so great. My son recommended this place and he was so right!!!

Italian, French. Chinese and Japanese restaurants abound in the Bay Area but when you want good basic German food - Speisekammer has it and considering the paucity of German restaurants, the food actually has an exotic taste to it.  A great change of pace.  Love those potato pancakes and a great selection of beers too.

Service was excellent.  The food was delicious.  There was a large party in the same room. They allowed their kids to run around yelling. The parents were oblivious.  A real bummer for the rest of us trying to enjoy a nice meal in a very nice restaurant.

As usual, the food and service were lovely. However, there was a large party there with children. Unfortunately, the parents failed to supervise their children who were running around screaming, and yelling. It was not ideal. I don't have a problem with the kids. Obviously, that's how they behave at home. Wha I have a problem with is the parents who think it's OK to subject other diners to the obnoxious behavior of their children. 

Please put families with kids in the BACK ROOM! Give the rest of us a break!
Great spot!  Easily handled a party of 13. Good beer and eats. You won't be disappointed.

We attended as a group; we were seated without all of us being present and allowed to start our orders.  The missing parties joined us about 15 minutes late but we already had appetizers on the table for all to enjoy.

Our service was exceptional and the food was delicious and well prepared with very good presentation.  I will be back!
The food and service is always great. I would eat here more often but parking is always a problem.

Would be good to make sure servers are familiar with the menu offerings, especially the main items that are common to a German menu. For example, when one of our party asked if the bratwurst was made from pork or beef, our server wasn't sure. Bratwurst is really basic to any German restaurant, so that was a bit puzzling that she didn't know. Overall, food is quite good. It was an enjoyable place for our group of 5 for lunch.

Speisekammer is a German neighborhood restaurant that exceeds my expectations with delicious German food, a gemütlich cozy atmosphere, great music and tons of delicious German beers. Killer desserts. Casual comfortable ambience and kid friendly- there you have it. Can't ask for more in this style.

Great fun and always a good time .  Food was delicious, service was excellent and all employees were friendly.  Our waiter was very courteous and knowledgeable about the food.   The resturant was very busy but our waiter was very attentive and met our every need🍷🍷🍷
Service and food were excellent as usual for a nice dinner with my in-laws-to-be.

At first I was skeptical when a friend recommended die Speisekammer to me. At first I thought it would yet be another sad excuse to get german cusine to the bay area , but I was pleasantly surprised. 

The food really does taste very authentic and has some nice "twists" (like the "salsa" covering the Schnitzel Salad).  Very good beer selection and the service was very nice and friendly.

A group of 7 of us met for dinner at Speisekammer on Halloween night, we had fabulous German food, some great beers and great service. My favorite dish was the Weiner Schnitzel vom Schwein (breaded and fried pork chops), but everyone at the table was happy with their meal. They have a fantastic black lager too (Kostritzer), I'd recommend this place to anyone. Its not too expensive, the food is great, the ambience is fun, the beer is fantastic.

We've been here before, and decided to return for our son's 25th BDay. My husband opted to sit outside; it was a bit problematic for the ladies wearing dresses to straddle over a bunch, but we managed. Per usual, food was excellent! We had the potato pancakes and sausage appetizers which quickly disappeared. Our entrees included salmon, sauerbraten, stuffed cabbage rolls, and veal. Everyone pretty much cleared their plates! I had the salmon - moist and delicious served over a bed of wilted spinach and a side of mashed potatoes. My son said the sauerbraten could have been eaten with a spoon since the meat was so incredibly tender, it just fell apart! Our drinks were great, as well - Citrone, raspberry mojito, Moscow mule, and even the white  chocolate mocha. For dessert, we tried the streudel, pot de creme, and the chocolate cherry streudel. The streudel was crispy and slightly sweet, paired perfectly with their apple and cherry accompaniments. The pot do creme was the perfect consistency reminiscent of my favorite childhood pudding. Overall, we love Speisekammer - a great place to enjoy warm weather or the eclectic beauty of the wall of beer steins indoors! Great food, fun, festive ambiance - and check their website often - there are many special events that happen here where you can enjoy some great, local music, as well!

Good food.  Great beers.  Place is a bit pricey.  Good staff.

Only negative is the number of families who come here and do not see that their children are respectful of a restaurant space.     Yes, it is family friendly and should be.  However, parents need to wake up.  This is not McDonald's.   A rambling and yelling 4 yr old almost tripped the waiter on Sunday evening!  Parents were chatting and not watching the little boy.

We've dined here several...SEVERAL times ! We come over from San Francisco, JUST to eat here !! And, every time it just gets better !!
Marko, our wait person was the icing on a perfect meal ! He offered wonderful ideas on specials, was extremely attentive and even did a b-day celebration for our friend !!
There is nothing bad on the menu....just depends on how hungry you are !! And, save room for dessert !!
Only downside.....parking wasn't the best....but living in S.F., walking 4 blocks was really no big deal !!!
Thanks again Marko !! We'll be back !
The portions were plentiful and enough for leftovers the next day. All of the food (meats and sides) was great. We had a large group and everyone was happy and full when leaving.
the beer list is great, as is the wine list. the food is traditional, but they make sure to include vegetarian options. everyone thought the meal and ambiance was great!

Went on a Wednesday as we wanted to celebrate Ocktoberfest and have a stein or two.  Had Potato Pancakes and Sausage & Sauerkraut appetizers to start.  Liked both appetizers although my son is not a Sauerkraut fan - the appetizers are substantial thus for entrees, we had half orders of Roasted Pork and Wienerschnitzel.  Nice selection of beers.  Son was in Germany last Ocktoberfest and said food here is authentic.  Service was also polite and professional.
Had the Jager Schnitzel  and spaetzle  reminded me of what I had in Germany.  Will be going back to try other foods.

This was our 1st time, we went for lunch.  Sat outdoors as the weather was nice.  Offered the full menu even though there is a lunch menu.  One nice touch was 2 serving sizes - good for lunch as the portions were large.  Tried the house cured gravlax with potato pancakes and the Schweinebraten  (roast pork in beer sauce).  Both were excellent.  Had Hofbrau Marzen - one of their Octoberfest beers.  We will be back to try the the wursts and other beers.  This looks like a fun place to be - they have music on certain days.

We've been going to Speisekammer for more than a decade, and are always excited to come...
today was our first bad time.
From the  time that we arrived, and the hostess not finding our reservation for awhile, to the close to two hour wait we had with no offer of drink replenishment, bread, or anything at all while they corrected our already late coming order - it was awful. The menu and food have gone a bit downhill, and the horrible service made it all too unpleasant. We were sad, having spent an hour on traffic just to be there from San Francisco...next time we want German food, we'll stay here and wait in line at Suppenkuchen.
Too too bad.
I lived in Alameda a long time before trying this restaurant.  The food is wonderful and the desserts are yummy.  You won't regret coming here.

Speisekammer is a great place for family groups or just solo. They have extensive indoor and outdoor seating, a wide selection of  beers, authentic and cheerful ambiance, not too dark, and their food is very good, not too heavy. You can actually hold a conversation in there! There are a few TVs for sports fans, not too obtrusive but convenient if you want them. Prices are very affordable.
Best German dining in the Bay Area.  Great Beer selections.  Staff very helpful in explaining the dishes and the beers.

First off, parking can be really tricky on a busy weekend night..  Came here on a Saturday with reservations and we were greeted right away, however it took a bit of time to get shown to our table.  First thing I noted when we entered both the front door and our back room seating area was the NOISE, kids running around laughing, diners voices ringing off the walls.  We were seated and the meal progressed along nicely with everyone ordering and enjoying their food. The voice made it hard to have conversations across the table without having to join in the fray of loud conversations.  The main courses came out quickly and were hot, which I appreciate.  Our server was attentive and our water or other drinks were never empty.  Dessert was AMAZING, we shared a couple of choices..
Speisekammer is alway a sure thing. Food is always spot on, and a great selection of beers.
Combine really good German food, amazing beer selection, bar, patio, music and the Alameda community.  This is a great destination for any Bay Area foodie looking for a fun night out!

Speisekammer always delivers.  The menu is constantly changing with excellent selections.  I had the wild boar which was incredible.  My wife had a half order of Schnitzel; also outstanding.  The four star on ambiance is that it is noisy.  With tables of large groups the sound level can get quite high so it's not an intimate place.  If you want a great beer selection and excellent German food and great service, this is definitely the place.

The food was wonderful as always; I don't think I've ever had a bad meal here. We were celebrating some birthdays....free dessert! Who doesn't love that. However, there are people like me who don't like apple strudel. I wish they had another choice for the free item. Other than that, excellent as always. Our waiter had been a server for only a few days. He made sure to get the information he wasn't sure of, always a plus in my book.
Super fun, delicious food, even for this vegetarian.  Friendly waiters, lively regulars at the shared tables.

We had a table for three. I started with a potato soup, that had herbs and pieces of bacon, yes and yes! I had a stuffed cabbage for the entree. The cabbage was super tender, the meat inside was perfectly seasoned, and the tomato sauce was well balanced. And those mashed potatoes! The best in the Bay. The cheesecake was nice at the end, kind of lemony with fresh raspberries. Oh, and a nice beer on tap--there are many options.
Trying out a German cuisine
Fine German beers, authentic German food, great bar, friendly wait staff and live music on weekends, love the wiener schnitzel .

It was my wife's birthday, so I asked her to yelp something that interested her.  I was shocked when she selected two German restaurants.  I did not feel like driving into SF and Speisekammer had live music, so thought would be more festive for a celebration.  I was right.  We actually had a German waitress, we drank great German beer from a glass boot.  The trio played music music from the 40s,  was fantastic, and fit the restaurant perfectly.  Everything we ordered was fantastic with the exception of the meat platter - I guess I'm just not a fan of German sausage.  We had the mussels and all of us used the bread to sop up the broth.  The potato pancakes were light and wonderful.  My wife ordered the jeagerschnitzel and my son had the weinerschnitzel - both were fantastic.  I ordered the 2 liter boot of beer and by the time the apple strudel came around - I couldn't really remember the taste.  I am told it was to die for.  Glad my son can drive....  Not too fancy or expensive.  Great for a group of friends to enjoy the evening.

Have eaten here many times, and it will never win a Michelin star, but it's a solid choice for classic German food in an area where that's hard to come by.  The bar is also very good (great selection of German beers, decent cocktails and wine list), and it's a fun spot for live music on some nights.
We had the jagerschnitzel, the bread dumplings, and several beers.  This was our 10th time here.   happy returning customers.

The Server should know the menu I t's not that extensive. And by "know" I mean that when you ask her what a food is, i.e., Bock, you expect an answer other than "Um, it's a meat thing. I think. Probably."  If as a Server you don't want to learn the menu then at least go ask someone who knows. But your disinterest in your job may explain why you also brought the check without ever asking: 1. How was your meal (it was pretty good)and 2. May I offer you dessert (we ended up ordering).

- The food was fairly priced and pretty good. 
- Odd location by auto shops but we didn't mind that quirkiness.
- Potato Pancakes were like greasy hash browns cakes. Skip them.

With so many other good local spots we won't go back.

This place is hands down one of my favorite Alameda restaurants. There are few places you can go that offer live music, never mind great live music - on Fri and Sat nights. We really enjoyed the Weiskohlrolade (stuffed cabbage roles) and  Gebeitzter Lachs (gravlox and potato pancakes). Both dishes were yummy. The great overall experience fortunately overshadowed their dry and tasteless Jägerschnitzel vom Schwein (pork cutlets in  mushroom sauce with Spätzle). Sorry guys...this dish in our opinion, is not their best. They have an amazing beer list - - and they have a wonderful German sparkling wine (although now only available by the bottle) : (
Very cool space, outside, inside the bar area and the larger dining area - thanks, we'll be back!
Speisekammer always delivers.  It is my go to restaurant, always good, always a good meal, beer and charm.
Come with a big appetite.  Great beer and cider selection. Wienerschnitzel, jaegerschnitzel, potato pancakes, are all winners!
Always a good experience...food great...friendly staff...this,is on our go to list...highly recommend this wonderful restaurant..
Food was amazing, beer selection is awesome, all around a wonderful place to eat.

The food was hearty and delicious! The hubby ordered the tri tip and it was very tender. The kid had the pork cutlet and I had the house made sausage. We were very pleased with all the dishes! The best part was Ricarda... So knowledgeable ( she knew that the huge  wooden structure on the wall was for shredding cabbage) and so attentive even though the house was packed and they were understaffed. Will go again... And again!
The beer list is wonderful, as are the many different kinds of German specialties available throughout the day. It was a treat!
Went for lunch on a Sunday great beer selection great Wienerschnitzel going to have to try it for dinner
The food is superb and so is the beer menu. Get a reservation or sit outside.  Come on Friday and Saturday nights for some live music.

We had been looking for a place that had REAL German food and this was it!!  The beer selection was fantastic and the food is as close to what we had on our trips to Germany as we have found around the Bay Area!!  I suggest you try it!!

Everything we had was really yummy!! The potato pancakes were super crispy! We also had the jegarsnitzel and stuffed cabbage rolls and they were both so good, we finished our whole plates!! (But they were all half orders). The best thing I had was the herb butter that comes with the bread tho!! Omg!! I put it in my potatoes and it was soooo good!!! 
The server was really nice but couldn't be found at times and the food took a long time to come out. We actually put an hour and a half in our meter and it was empty when we got back to the car :(

This was my second visit here - the first was with a group of seven, this time, we had a group of eight.  Both times we sat at picnic type tables outside - which was great for our group.  Everyone really enjoyed both the drinks and the food - and everyone agreed that the potato pancakes are the best, if not the world, but at least in the United States.  (Though this was at brunch both times, and based on friends who have been here in the evening, the potato pancakes aren't as good in the evening.   Everything is presented extremely well - and the food will have us coming back time-and-time again.  Service was excellent, though both times, the servers did not speak a word of German, and as the menu is in both German and English, it was a bit odd to have to repeat in English, what we ordered in German.  But again, everyone in my party still longs for the food at the Speisekammer and we'll all come back with spouses, friends, relatives, and savour the food!
No downside to eating at this establishment.  Everyone should eat here at least one time in their life.

A group of us went to Speisekammer Friday night for a birthday dinner and for the music. The food was awesome and the Irish music was  authentic and wonderful. If you love beer, great food, great service and incredible music - go to Speisekammers!
We have had excellent meals at Speisekammer every time we have dined there.  They change the menu regularly which makes it even more fun.  Excellent food, great service (except for one visit).

I took my daughter here for lunch as a treat as we have spent quite a bit of time in Austria and while you can't find Austrian food here, German food is often a close second.  We were extremely disappointed, didn't really like anything but the German chocolate cake which was EXCELLENT.   We had a mushroom dumpling for starters and it just tasted off then we moved on to a schnitzel salad for me and the meal for her and the schnitzel just didn't cut it.  In their defense we are use to Austrian schnitzel cooking so maybe that was why.  The breadcrumb coating was too grainy instead of fine the meat was really thin, and it was pretty greasy..  The meal came with potatoes which were way soggy and had too much speck cooked with them.

Ah well, we'll stick to eating our schnitzel when we go to Austria.

Service was great and the outdoor patio was nice.  I could see where it would be a fun place to go with a group or famlly gathering.  Just not sure the food is on par with other german restaurants and it was pricey!  Lunch for two ran me $50.
If you are in the mood for some authentic German food, This is the place to go.  We had the meat plate and an assortment of salads.  There was plenty of food for 3.
Another Authentic German meal at Speisekammer! Delicious food and great German beer selection.

Such a great German food experience. From the outdoor beirgarten experience to the welcoming interior this place is great for groups and beer.  The food is authentic and if you don't know how to pronounce it that is ok there is a full description of each food item below the German name.  They also have a beer list that has on tap and  bottled choices.
Great German food, which is hard to find in the Bay Area. Wonderful family-style platter of sausages with nice selection of craft beers. Some of the best spaetlz I've ever had.
Generous portions for lunch, great beer served in exquisite crystalware, wonderful service!
Great German wine list and fresh quality German selections you can count on.
good german food, fair prices, accomodating for kids.  Vegetarian options beyond the ordinary.

I would definitely recommend this German restaurant to people with gluten allergies and those who love to eat out with a large group or have a great drink and atmosphere. The gold, especially the cold cut plates, was delightful and delicious and the service was excellent, the drinks large.
We love it..always a top choice...potatoe pancakes always a favorite..

Had a wonderful family dinner to celebrate our daughters dance recital.  Great place and food was super.  Staff was attentive and was very considerate of our daughters food allergies.   Best place to get really good German food on this side of the bay.

Ive been going to restaurants in the area for years and fell upon this place after reading some great reviews.   What a great place - cant say enough good things.  Great portions, authentic setting.   Go when they have live music  A+++
Hubby loves German food & he was in a food coma after dining here! The Sauerbraten is awesome & what a choice of beers & wine! Gotta go back & try the Salmon next time.

Our friends wanted to experience some quality, authentic German style food so we arranged a Sunday night dinner with them. Everything was a truly great experience except for the two unruly children and the totally oblivious parents that sat at the table directly next to us. Not a single reprimand or any attempt whatsoever from the parents to get their children to sit still and be quiet. Of course watching this happen and listening to the noise brought up our personal  experiences of when we were growing up and how our parents made us behave when out in public or when visiting other friends homes. Some truly different parenting - or lack thereof - out there today.

My wife and I went to Speisekammer for dinner and the live music on Friday night . We were seated right away, but shortly after the place filled up (lots of indoor seating and a small outside areas as well). The service was  very attentive but not in an annoying way. We had the shrimp appetizer, which I'd have again - then split the salmon dinner and a beet salad - to leave room for dessert (apple strudel that was killer) 
I'm not a beer drinker, but if I was, I'd be in heaven there - because their selection is vast. The German sparkling wine was dry, crisp - and perfect with dinner. We'll definitely be back!

We there for Mother's Day lunch.  They had a special menu, my kids ordered the French toast with fresh fruit and they liked it.  We got the bread dumpling as appetizer, it was sitting in a mushroom gravy that reminded them of daddy's cooking.  I got the benedict which came with an excellent potato pancake and creamy hollandaise that wasn't sour at all.  Very mild and did not dominate the benedict.

And some other stuff, but the plate is RICH RICH and filling. Do not go here for arugula. go for fermented cabbage. Go for beets. Go for potatos. Go for sausages of all sizes and makeups. Go for schnitzels. And (best of all) Go for Beer. Yes, German Beer not waterbeer as from the US big guys. And you can get your oil changed across the street or buy gold coins around the corner or do the Park Street Shuffle and get some ice cream and waffles after you finish the wurstfest

We wanted to take my dad here for his 85th birthday, since he loves German food and wine.  Even though they had set us up a nice table inside, we decided to dine on the outdoor patio because we had brought our dog and it was a nice evening out.  They were very accommodating.  If, like me, you find it disappointing that a lot of restaurants don't carry any white wine but chardonnay, you will enjoy this place.  Lots of rieslings and Spatlese on the sweeter side from Germany on the wine list, either by the glass or a bottle.  They don't disappoint.  This isn't just a "bratwurst and saurkraut" place, though you will find that on the menu.  They serve pork and braised beef tips.  Delicious.  The marinated cucumber salad is tasty also.  Try them out!  And bring your pooch.

The most delicious sausages, amazing German food, and wonderful beer and wine selection. 
I am an avid fan of this restaurant. However, the past 2-3 times we've been there, the service has been mediocre at best. Maybe they're going through some management changes? 
I hope they get their s**t together, because they really are one of Alameda's best spots.

Great beer selection w/ many German faves. Jaegerschnitzel was outstanding as were the sauerbratten and potato pancakes.  The rosenkohl (Brussels sprouts) from the specials menu were a highlight. Live band in the other room provided a little extra entertainment without being overpowering. Great evening out.

I'm always excited when I visit this place and lucky me I've never been disappointed.  This was my third visit overall but my first lunch.  I had the 6 six sausage appetizer and the beer marinated pork sandwich with German potatoes.  All was tasty,  well prepared and fresh. Great swe vice and an impressive beer menu will have me return again. ... hopefully soon!

I went here on a Saturday night with a reservation from Open Table.  Seated right away and no waiting for the food.  The food and the drinks were great.  I had the grilled salmon with mash over a bed of steamed spinach.  The spinach was phenomenal... not overcooked.  I ordered an extra side of mashed potatoes with dinner because I didn't know that the serving that comes with dinner would be so generous.  (They made for good leftovers).  The fish was cooked perfectly and again, a generous portion.  My friend had the Bratwurst which was also really good.   I love their potato pancakes.  They are really crisp on the outside and taste great with the apple sauce.  They would also taste good with the sour cream and dill dressing that came with the fish.   

Our waitress was terrific and got me fixed up with a bottle of Mexican Coke since they just switched their fountain to Pepsi.  The one thing I didn't like is that it was insanely loud.  Not the kind of place you want to go for dinner conversation.  Next time I will stick to my original plan and sit outside.  I definitely plan to go back to this restaurant.

First time going there for lunch.  We usually have gone for their great dinner menu.   The lunch selection was very good, and very delicious !  Amazing beer selection, too.We highly recommend Speisekammer !!
We had the meat platter, which was superb, and couple of beers and stayed until almost closing.  Good music, easy vibe, just chill.

Food was great, drinks were great, BUT...

Made a reservation for 7pm 3 days prior to arrival. Requested to sit at the bar to listen to the Band playing that night.

Received a call the day of the reservation stating that I need to push out my reservation to 7:30 to sit in the bar area.

Arrived at the restaurant and was told that the next available seat would be ours. IT WAS NOT.

They gave away our table to someone else. We were finally sat down 30 minutes after our modified reservation; 1 hour past our Original reservation.

Seems as if the staff here can't figure out how to manage reservation times. They would be better off not taking reservations at all since they don't know how to figure them out.

Always fun to go to.  Food is good, very generous helpings.  Since you can do half orders on most offerings, you can keep the cost reasonable.  Great beers.  It really is an excellent family choice.
Colorful atmosphere.

We eat here a couple times a month and the food is consistently good. The service ranges from good to average and last night was on the low end. Our waitress was not as friendly as some of the servers we have had here and luckily I examined our bill and found a $22 overcharge. It may have been a mistake but you always have to wonder. Will return when we next crave meat and potatoes and tasty beer. Decent bourbon and spirits selection as well and live music occasionally. Noise level is up there typically but what you should expect at a place Like this. Kid friendly and outdoor seating available.  Prost.

Food was very good and very german 
The server was a greay BUT the food came out very slow 45 min for the main they forgot the appetizer.
Might go back if we have a lot of time to kick back and wait

we have been here for the last two weekends now. the bands are great, the service is outstanding (marco b one night, and may (?) the next time), the food is incredible (brussel sprouts were so good we ordered a second round). open table ressies are always met with great seating as requested. i have nothing but good things to say about everything speisekammer! see you again soon.

we love the food here. the Jägerschnitzel vom Schwein with Spätzle, our usual choice, is delicious every time. the beet salad is also very tasty and refreshing. and the velvet hammer (special vodka drink) was wonderful for dessert. our waiter was attentive and very pleasant, even though super busy. we requested a table up front near the band and got the best seat in the house. parking is always a challenge but well worth the effort.

At the last minute our dinner party increased from 6 to 7, and although the restaurant was packed with diners, they accommodated the extra person without any problems.   The service was great, as was the food and the entertainment.  We will definitely return.

Beer hall decor and ambiance builds the anticipation of an authentic German pub meal, and Speisekammer does not disappoint. Tasty, crispy potato pancakes with applesauce are a must have starter before diving into your selection of sausages, sauerkraut, schnitzel, spaetzel, stuffed cabbage, etc.  All are well executed and very authentic to meals I have had in a half dozen trips to Germany and Austria.  They also have a longer list of beers on-tap than their German equivalents since they draw from several regions rather than just the local favorites, plus have additional bottled selections, including a couple of alcohol-free varieties for you designated driver.  

A local favorite that takes me back to Europe for an hour or two on every visit!

The night was ok... It got off to a bad start as soon as we got to there. We arrived thirty minutes before our reservation. We checked in and told them we wanted to get a drink at the bar first before we were seated.. The check in guy informed us that the table was ready if we wanted to sit down, we told them we wanted to get a drink first.. Good for the bar right! He then informed me the table turn around was established and if we were not done in the allotted time we would have to leave.. Not a good way to treat customers... BAD BUSINESS!!!!!

Ten of us decided to try this eatery at the recommendation of a friend.  The area that this is in was great, the food was amazing and the service was top notch.

All of us are looking forward to going back.  Definately recommend this to anyone that loves great food, great service and beer...
Great food to listen to music to.  Authentic cooking.  Not greasy.
Staff extremely helpful love the fireplace suggestions and outside seating for a more casual atmosphere

When searching for that Authentic german meal look no further.  Great for parties, celebrations or just to hang out with friends.  There are even half meal options just in case you weren't too hungry.
Will keep coming back...
We have never had anything less than excellent food, lots of it, and good service at Speisekammer.  Sure hope you will be around for many more years!
Great food and service. Good vibe and excellent menu selection.

A friend and I visited Speisekammer on Sunday for lunch.  This was our second visit and again we were not disappointed.  I had eggs with sausage and yummy roasted potatoes with bacon.  My friend had the Wiener Schnitzel Sandwich.  My eggs were done perfectly (scrambled) and the potatoes were great. My only complaint was that the little sausages were a little dry.  My friend enjoyed the sandwich.  There was a nicely done piece of meat on a German hard roll.  She also got the lunch salad which was comprised of several different pickled vegetables:  cucumber, carrots, beets and cabbage.  Very good and refreshing.  We will definitely go again.  I still hope to go there sometime for dinner so I can order one of the richer traditional German dishes.  I am sure they will be equally fine.

Speisekammer is always a pleasure, delicious food, fantastic service staff (always...always) and without trying to jinx it, we consider it our all-time favorite restaurant! My wife and I have had romantic dinners there, best friends brought there, both families taken there, and even a couple of dinners with our kids....every time we dine there, it is fantastic, every group we go with, all have a great time. Best food, best service, comfortable and never pretentious. We LOVE Speisekammer!!!!

My friend and I went for lunch on a Sunday and were starving, not having had breakfast.  The place was not busy at all, but it took forever to get the appetizer.  Then the main course took an equally long time.  The server was friendly, but lacked attention and urgency.

On the upside all the dishes were delicious and satisfying.  We were also pleased that everything was available for lunch, even dishes from the dinner menu.  We started with the seafood antipasti and then had Wiener Schnitzel with veal and the Bratwurst.  The Wiener Schnitzel was cooked just right and the Sauerkraut had the perfect balance of sweet and sour.  Also the beer selection was great.

I would go back because of the food, and hopefully it will arrive faster next time.
Great food and I love the live music they offer. I've been here about 15 times and I'll definitely be returning.
Speisekammer was great for your new year's Eve celebration dinner, with plenty of great beers and comfort food to go around. The service was great.
Love the food, hearty and well prepared. We did feel like the food came out too fast though. But, the service was friendly and personable.

Not many German restaurants in our area and  what few we have tried, we have found pretentious. Speisekammer  in Alameda was very friendly, great service, and the food was authentic from salad and soups to incredible Viennese Strudel.  They also have music acts on certain nights that are anything but traditional.This was a fun place to dine.

We had the herring, gravlax and trout as an appetizer It was perfect Oh and the potatoes pancakes which was all wonderful. Then we had the sauerbraten, bratwurist and pork cutlet. All was perfectly cooked and was marvelous. We finished with the Apple Struddel which I was forced to share and really didn't want to.

A friend and I enjoyed our holiday lunch at Speisekammer. This was my first visit and I was impressed by the full menu of German specialties.  I could quite happily eat my way through the entire menu. I had the potato pancakes.  They were very light and tasty. There is an extensive list of cocktails and beers.  Next time:  dinner!
casual setting serving classic German food with vegetarian & gluten free options: good veg. streudel and weiner schnitzel.   Good band.

My wife and I had dinner here on 11/18/2014. Our server was also managing the bar. He was so efficient and pleasant in spite of being busy, he must have been the owner (but we are not certain).  The two beers we ordered were served in steins and were superb. The mixed salad plates were quite nice and the small size was quite large. My wife ordered the large mixed grill meat platter which she found excellent. Being from Europe, she knows what these types of things are supposed to be like. My roasted half chicken was good, but the accompanying broccoli was not cooked quite enough. The complimentary birthday apple strudel was the best I have ever had. Decor was not great but the atmosphere was relaxing. Our server had the perfect balance of being attentive and not overly intrusive, and making sure we had everything we needed in a timely manner. We highly recommend this place for those who want to try this type of food and beer, and expect to be back someday.

Always fun to stop in at Speisekammer for a little German delicacy or full fledged meal like gramma used to whip up!  Big bonus to have local music on the weekends, dog friendly beer garden for those sunny days and a full bar with fabulous cocktails and beer.  Make sure to put this one on your list for once a week dining out.

As always, the food was hot and delicious. The server was the best we've ever had. Really outstanding for our group of 13. We asked for a table in the quiet room, in the back by the fireplace. Last minute we were moved because they set up a TV back there for the World Series. Ok, no problem. However, there was also a fund raiser being held to support some local businesses that were recently burned out. No problem! We were more than happy to chip in. And, it was a vibrant Sunday evening dinner crowd. No problem there either. But, all mixed together made for one of the noisiest  restaurants I've ever been in.  Our friends were not impressed with the restaurant despite the great food. Way too much atmosphere for them!
We've been to Speisekammer a number of times and it never fails to please.  This time, we had a native German friend with us and she loved it as much as we did.  Try it - you'll like it!
Good food and good wait staff.  Aloof, slow bartenders.

If you are out in the Bay area and want a taste of homemade german food, go to Speisekammer! The service was exceptional throughout our dining experience. The drinks are powerful and tasty. You won't be disappointed.  The food was by far, the best german cuisine I've ever tasted! That is saying a lot since we live in New York and have access to some terrific german restaurants back home. My sister and I believe this is the best german food we've ever tasted outside of Germany. The potato pancakes are wonderful - crisp and flavorful. We also ordered the ghoulash, lamb chops, pork tenderloins, pork chop and the sauerbraten. All of it was awesome!  Great find in the Bay area.

We absolutely LOVE Speisekammer! Always perfect service, excellent food, and bustling energy everywhere. Exquisite food, each dish was perfection, and delicious! The kids ate everything on their plates, we had to seriously try hard to stop, as everything was so good, we overate to be certain. Delightful wait staff, thoughtful and caring...it is without a doubt, our favorite restaurant. Thanks Speisekammer!!!

This is the second time my husband has chosen to spend his October birthday at Speisekammer, he likes the Oktoberfest vibe, even if we're not there during the overt Oktoberfest observances.  The food is fantastic, the beer list is great, and, best of all, the restaurant can easily accommodate pretty big groups.  We were nine people, and not all arrived at the same time, one in fact came long after we'd given up on him, and the serving staff seemed able to handle us plus several other fairly large and rowdy groups.  I particularly liked the schweinebraten, which I had not had before.

We returned for this year's OctoberFest dining experience. The food was delicious and prepared to our specifications. The wait staff was attentive and responsive to our needs. The OctoberFest beer offerings were the Schofer Grapefruit and the Erdinger Fest with their grapefruit and citrus notes respectively. The wife enjoyed the Tafelspitz (poached Tri-Tip in horseradish sauce) and I enjoyed the medium-rare NY Steak. We shared the Black Forest Ham and Melon appetizer. I also had a bowl of the Soup of the Day of Split Peas which was pleasantly seasoned. We were stuffed by the ample portions, so no dessert. Afterwards, we walked up and down Park St and noticed the advertisements for the upcoming annual Zombie Crawl. A very pleasant evening.
We greatly enjoyed our meal and had plenty to take home.  There was a good selection of German beers to pick from.  The only downside is finding a place to park near the restaurant.
Lovely birthday celebration, great food, and great place to take small child.  Will go again.

This place is absolutely amazing.  It's every bit as delicious as Suppenküche in SF.

The Cheese and Fruit plate is an outstanding appetizer.  The Sauerbraten and Jägerschnitzel are amazing.  I love to split the Gegrillte Fleischplatte, too.  It's all just awesome.

And they have an incredible selection of German Beers.  Just go already.
The food was fantastic, enjoyable wine list, pleasant service, very much 1950s German.  Very loud though!

I've been here twice, once with extended family, once for just dinner with my wife. Both times the service was just "okay." The second time was better than the first, but it felt like it was not attentive enough. (i.e. we had to flag down the server for refills, check on food delivery, etc.)

The food was good, but the service could use a little improvement, a little bit would go a long way.

Wow. Great food, great service, great ambiance.  This is not "classy" or "romantic" but it's fun as hell with so much to explore on the menu. It's was extremely quiet while we were there - too much so. The place begs for vibrant, social sharing over great German people's food and beer!  Loved it!

Was introduced to Speisekammer by a friend who lives in Jack London Square (I'm in Fremont). Was not expecting much but have to say that the food was outstanding and the pricing was great. Traditional German food with a large variety to pick from on their menu. Eating in the front of the building is the best, out back is more for families with kids.
Great potato pancakes and awesome German beers on rap.

Friendly, lively atmosphere. Authentic, delicious German food: Wiener Schnitzel, creamy Spätzle and beet salad are a wonderful combination. Portions are HUGE. Full bar. Excellent service. Staff works together to ensure rapid service to all. Delightful.
If you are looking for authentic German food this is the place.   The menu is very complete with lots of variety - hard time choosing so we ordered half orders so we could taste everything!

The food was excellent. The beer ist great. The Band was great. A bitt noisy from the table next to us.
Good service. Would recommend this restaurant.

The German dishes are spot-on.  I think they may have the best sauerkraut I've ever tasted and my partner and I both think it's the best German food we've had in the Bay Area.  I love the crispiness of the Wienerschnitzel.  Potatoes are done with onions and bacon.  I've never had a dish that wasn't excellently prepared.  Wines are reasonably priced and well chosen.  The service is efficient, friendly, and charming.
