The beer list is impressive.  The menu contains all the traditional German food you would expect, plus a few vegetarian options that are delicious.  I had the veggie strudel and my daughters had the cheese spaetzle.  Both were delicious.  The traditional German entrees were also very good,

food was as expected: spaetzle wtih ham & wienerschnitzlel were good. chicken dish was overcooked and DRY. pretty good beer list but need to include sour beers. ambience was not german (steins on a shelf and posters are not enough), making the experience seem inauthentic & "off." just a few touches & details would make a huge difference. our server (from maui) was likable and helpful. many patrons were dressed waaaay down. almost seemed like they came straight from outdoor chores/activities. unappetizing! parking was difficult. probably won't return.

We have been dining at Speisekammer for years and have always had the BEST experiences.  The food is phenomenal and the service is generally wonderful.  We love bringing out of town guests or going in groups to celebrate birthdays or other special occasions.  We love that it's so kid-friendly too!

We also enjoy the live music on Fridays and Saturdays. They really know how to showcase good local music!
I'll keep this simple....some of the BEST German food this side of Germany !! We drive from San Francisco JUST to eat here !! And, ALWAYS wonderful !!! RUN...don't walk to Speisekammer !!!
We come here regularly and are never disappointed. Best German food in the area.

Excellent selection of German food & beer. Full bar. Music is great on live entertainment nights and its not polka: Rockabilly, jazz, country, blues, Irish drinking songs, sea shanties, etc. - many different groups - check the schedule: http://www.speisekammer.com/music.pdf

Potato pancakes -- great! Sausage -- very good! salad -- very good! Schnitzel -- dry, too much coating, tasteless! Will probably go again to try one more dish that isn't brat-based.  Otherwise, it's a great place for brats, beer and very friendly ambiance. (And I will definitely tell this to anyone who asks for a recommendation.)

We've been to Speisekammer at least 4 times for dinner. Our last visit suffered from an inattentive server, but this visit was back to the high standard we have come to expect. Food is excellent and the German beers are great.
Beirgarten.  Good spot.  Tasty food and imported beer!

Reservation was for 9:15. Arrived at 9:11 and was scolded by the hostess that we were too early and they weren't ready for us. Huh?? We don't mind waiting for a little while, but do you have to make us feel unwanted? The service was so-so. Seems like we were an after thought to the larger table that was sat 15 minutes after us.

A wonderful date night out- delicious food, great beer, and an exciting ambiance. Although we waited for a table- and the hostess's attention- despite a reservation, our waitress quickly made up any shortage in the service department. We settled in with two brews from an expansive draft list and started with the potato pancakes- perfect golden brown and served with a succulent apple compote (much better than the standard applesauce garnish) and a tasty beet soup. Dinner came another beer later: mouth-watering creamy spatzle and bacon (and the taste to match) and a very flavorful (if a bit salty) sauerbraten with exquisitely pickled red cabbage. Pair the attentive waitress and delicious food with live jazz, and you have a perfect night.

We went to Speisekammer primarily to hear one of our favorite musical groups, however, the food and service was beyond our expectations.  We advised our server that we weren't in a big hurry and just wanted a leisurely dinner while listening to the band.  She paced the dinner perfectly, brought our beverages in a timely fashion,  and made several suggestions from the daily and standard menu.  My wife ordered the halibut special, which was done perfectly, and I had the delicious jagerschnitzel, which was better than any I have had in Germany.  We usually don't do desert, but our server suggested that we try the apfelstrudel with homemade ice cream - it was superb.  Finally, the check was surprisingly affordable.

Great German food. I have yet to have a bad meal here in my years of dining with them.  The staff is always super friendly they have an amazing beer selection, a great patio for when its warm enough to sit outside and a beautiful fire place in the back for cold nights. A+ all around

Speisekammer is a great neighborhood spot for any type of meal, whether you want to come with friends or by yourself. Really nice, down-to-earth atmosphere with welcoming and caring service. I thought it was kind of funny because what they call the "beer garden" out front really looks like it used to be the patio of a former taqueria… just a funny combination. ;-) Homestyle food with lots of space to enjoy sports on TV, or a quiet meal in the corner. I also really enjoyed the fact that there were people there of all ages and all ethnicities. For German food! Would definitely come back again.

Went for a memorial dinner for my brother and the place fit the needs perfectly.  However, we found the service to be a bit slow.  One poor girl handling the whole room of tables.  Could have used help.

Out-of-town friends wanted to take us out for dinner "pick your favorite place"....so we did. The food is always good with an interesting menu. They chose different entrees then half way thru the meal switched plates...very cute. They would love to eat here again. My steak was a bit overcooked, which surprised me; usually the orders are perfect. However, I won't let that stop me from coming back often.

Good Food, Good Service, Nice Place, Good Food, Good Service, Nice Place, Good Food, Good Service, Nice Place, Good Food, Good Service, Nice Place, Good Food, Good Service, Nice Place, Good Food, Good Service, Nice Place, Good Food, Good Service, Nice Place

I brought my parents here, and now they want to go back every time they visit.  They have a large German beer selection, the food is good, and  the atmosphere is festive.  The music, when they have it, makes you move in your seat as you are smiling and enjoying your dinner.  The music does make it a little hard to talk if you are by the band, so if you may want to sit in one of the back rooms if you don't want to listen to the music.

We've been wanting to try this restaurant for a while and are glad we did.  It was a fine experience and we would probably come back.  Our experience with the food was mixed.  We both had sauerbrauten. I enjoyed it more than my wife.  We agreed on the desserts.  They were excellent.  Parking is an issue even with their small parking area, so plan a little extra time to find a place and walk to the restaurant.  It is obviously a popular spot.

German restaurants aren't as omnipresent as others, so I'm always happy to find one--and this one was GOOD! The menu has everything you would expect being an American--potato pancakes, sausages, spaetzle, apfel strudel, weinerschnitzel, great beer selection--and others I hadn't heard of that seem authentic. All of the food was excellent. It was pretty dead on a Memorial Day Sunday night ~8pm, which was fine for us. Compare that to a German restaurant we went to in SF, where we waited an hour for a table in a tiny, loud room. Service lost 1 star as at the end the waitress seemed to be totally done--I'm not sure if we did something (used a LivingSocial deal?) or if she got some bad news, but her attitude completely changed once we paid.

Love this place; the hostess was very accommodating when we wanted to sit outside, even though we had reserved a table inside, at 6:30 on a Friday night. When it was getting chilly, we asked if it was possible to be seated inside. The hostess found us a table right away. We were lucky that it wasn't as crowded as it usually is on a Friday night, possibly it being Memorial Weekend and crowds being out of town but the hostess still deserves many accolades for her help. Waitstaff friendly, delicious food, one of the best restaurants this small city has to offer. Crazy crowded during Oktoberfest.
We love this restaurant, it has a unique atmosphere, good food and great music on some days.

It's been a few years since our last visit to local spot, Speisekammer. It's still a good restaurant but we've evolved our tastes a bit and generally enjoy new places or tend to do repeat visits to restaurants with consistent quality but a bit more experimental. The vegetarian offerings here are the same as they were 12+ years ago. I remember back then feeling gratitude for the one entree and sides...but I've been to Germany since then -- and ate at first rate vegetarian restaurants -- and the SF Bay Area has lots of restaurants with interesting vegetarian options. I invite the chef to broaden his horizons...why not put a German twist on another vegetarian option? Why not make pea soup without meat? And you got rid of the German bread? ;-(

The sausage/smoked pork chop platter couldn't be passed up, gravlax good (a bit tough and heavy on the dill sauce), potato pancakes great. Make sure to know their modified menu if going late in the afternoon. Great service and food, as always.

This may be my favorite Alameda restaurant.   Very good modern German food with friendly service in authentic European style.   They have a very comfortable bar with many beer, wine, and cocktail choices.   Eclectic styles of live music with no cover charge on weekend nights.  The customers seem to be a blend of friendly locals and international ex-pats.   I feel a little guilty not giving them five stars but I'm afraid the prices will go up and I won't be able to get in.
We had Mother's Day lunch here and the food was good.  Most of us had the Sauerbraten and it was tender and sauce was quite good.  The service was good.  Really not much to complain about.
Went there on a recommendation of a friend and loved it! Never had German food and we really liked it. Loved that we could talk without telling across the table. Super evening.

My kid took me here.  I have been here many times before.  It is outstanding!!  Marco, our server was wonderful.  Food is always good.   My kid loved the beer. I will continue this place on the top of my list!!!

As a craft beer junkie and lover of German food, I knew I had to try Speisekammer.  While it took me a while to make my way there, it did not disappoint.  With a great selection of beers from Germany (and one Pacific Northwest IPA for those who need hops) that tasted fresh, and not overexposed, that alone was worth the drive.  The food was excellent as well, with the beef and cabbage roulade being my favorite of the 3 dishes we tried.

I've never tried German food and have always wanted to try this restaurant.  My first experience did not disappoint!  I thoroughly enjoyed my food and beer.  The atmosphere was laid back, but attentive.  I enjoyed the recommendations as well.  We will definitely go back!

Service was terrific.
Crowded, but a happy crowd.
Not an intimate venue, but that is not the intent.
Do not know if the food was authentic German, but it was very good. Best sauerkraut I have ever had.
Great beer list, including a non gluten import I can not find any where else.
We have been several times even though it is a half hour drive.
Great place to eat if you are looking for authentic German food!

We found this gem on a phone map, decided to try it, and returned for seconds! Although it is an hour and a half from home, we plan to frequent this restaurant when a dinner is in the cards due to flying in/out of Oakland often. We simply love the craft beer selection, sauerkraut, german "dogs", pork chops, and apple desert, among other items. The butter you spread on your bread is delicious, but the dark bread slices could be softer or exchanged for something else. Overall, we think this restaurant is a keeper!
Third time dining at Speisekammer, the servers are attentive, and the tradition food is very good.

Right off the bat, I'd have to say the food is quite good and very authentic. The wait staff, however, didn't seem to be all that knowledgeable when it came to answering questions about beer and specific menu items. I suspect that the actual cooking is done by a German, but the front of the house could be made more informed about the food. Still, I would definitely go back and I would also recommend others to go.

Very good experience once again. The food was authentic and fairly well prepared taken together. The Nürnberger Bratwürstchen and Jägerschnitzel vom Schwein (veal version) were both excellent, but the Wiener Schnitzel vom Schwein and Reibekuchen could have been better cooked. The first was a bit dry and the second was a bit too cooked on the outside and not quite on the inside. All the deserts were excellent. We'll be back
Good beer. Good food. Don't need much more.
Great food, good atmosphere, comfortable.

We stopped on a random Friday night and the Royal Deuces were playing, which turned out to be a great show. We started with the Reibekuchen (potato pancakes). The apple compote was a very nice twist to the usual applesauce I've had at home. The pancakes themselves were cooked perfectly, but a little bland. It is very rare for me to add salt to anything, but I did with these.
I had Jägerschnitzel vom Schwein, which is very similar to chicken marsala. Good, but not great.
My wife had a spaetzle dish with cheese. It was just like mac and cheese. She liked it a lot. Very creamy and cheesy. The chewiness of the spaetzle gave it a nice twist.
Service was good. The apps were very slow to come out, but the food and drinks were spot on.

I have eaten here three times and every time I leave with a great feeling. The Food is really good, great variety and quality. The service is also great and the energy in the bar area is great. I will go back many more times.
Food was very good but the service was exceptional.
Met a colleague for lunch and enjoyed great German food while we sat outside.

Food was incredibly good!!! Waitress was great.
Live music was very good, just much too loud for such a small venue. Bring ear plugs and don't expect to have a conversation during dinner when the musicians are playing.

The food was delicious, although hard to pronounce. This place is a great and tasty way to be introduced to German cuisine. The hefeweizen they have on tap tasted great and paired well with the food. Although we sat in the backroom, we had no issue with the service. She was there when we needed her and wasn't around when we didn't.
Speisekammer has a European atmosphere and great quality food. The beer selection is equally impressive.

The food at Speisekammer reminds me of the meals my German mother made. The food is authentic and well prepared. Portions are hearty. Nice selection of beers. We went for Mother's Day, and they were quite busy, thus the service suffered a bit. Wish we had a restaurant like this a bit closer to home.

To be honest, I was a little worried about going...especially on a Sunday afternoon. Don't get me wrong, the food is great! My concern was with parking in a highly concentrated area; finding enough "quiet" for our gathering (enough to be able to talk and catch up with one another); as well as the service not being too busy to properly service our visit. I was very pleasantly surprised being seated in a fairly quite location where we were very comfortable (although parking was still a miserable experience). The food was GREAT although the service was...let's just say it could have been better. For authentic German food, or simply a great place to drink beer with friends, I would highly recommend it. But carpool!
Generally good food, and service but last visit there was not either.

My girlfriend and I went to Speisekammer for dinner on a Friday night. The staff was very courteous and attentive. They also have a good selection of German beer on tap. I ordered the pork chop, which was served with a side of mashed potatoes and sauerkraut. My girlfriend tried the Wienerschnitzel, which was served with a beet salad. Our entrees were tasty and prepared well. I was disappointed with the beet salad, as it looked and tasted as though it came from a can. Also, there were two varieties of bread - sliced brown and dinner rolls. Both were definitely bought not baked. It is a fun little spot and will go back, but they just need to improve some of the little things.

Food and service was very good. Noise level increased when large parties were brought into the room.
Ask for the smaller room.
Food is delicious. Comes in different size portions to accommodate all appetites.
There's no other place like this on this side of the Bay that I know of.  The food was great and the ambience great.  It was a nice treat!

This place is amazing! Everything that hit the table was delicious! The Reibekuchen (potato pancake with apple compote) are out of this world! Roasted Chicken and Pork Shank were to die for. We may be heading back for lunch today. SO GOOD!!!

Great beer selection especially Gluten Free.

Food is excellent German food with large portion sizes even with half order option.

Great potato pancakes. I'll definitely be back.

Only shortcoming was entrees took 45 minutes to arrive. They may have been shorthanded so not fatal. I would have otherwise given them 4 stars.
Wonderful and authentic German food.

Best German restaurant in the East Bay period. I don't know why I waited six years to find it. As long as a German restaurant has great German beer, which Speisekammer does, I usually give it a thumbs up, but this place has excellent food too!, an adorable, German fraulein for a server, and is super accommodating to kids. If I had three thumbs they would all be up.
Can't wait to try out the sunny beer garden!
Phil
Had a great dinner. Went with the specials and was pleased. Great German beer, in tap, Tables are close together, when it appears it doesn't need to be.

This was our first time at Speisekammer. I was looking for a restaurant in Alameda and saw the ratings in Yelp. My wife and I thought we would give it a try as we love German food. We love this place other than the parking which is a real pain. The food and service were terrific. We Wiener Schnitzel with Beet salad coupled with some great German beer. We will be back and bring our family.
You can't go wrong with Speisekammer!!!

Food was great, service was great. Many selections of beer, had a few different kinds and it was awesome! I went with a large group and as you know the gratuities are generally include (and in this case they were); however, we did not notice this and left another one based on the entire total. The next day, Anthony, call me and told me what we did and credited the additional gratuities back to our card. Who does this? That was awesome and just a testimonial to the great service. It was only my second time there and we will be back!
Very good food
Great German food. A real treat!
Great for dinner and music on a Saturday night. Great beers. Consistent food and service. Fun place that has become one of our go to places. Prost!

What a wonderful surprise to find a good German restaurant in Alameda. While not my usual first choice in cuisine, the food here is universally good. Something for everyone who eats meat. Not a vegetarian comfort zone, as most dishes are pork based. Enough beer choices for my British husband, with selections for every type of beer one would want with Spacious outdoor dining patio area in the front adds to the restaurant appeal. Give it a chance and you will become a convert like me. German food is really good!
Food was amazing! The prices are also pretty decent. Would come back here again for sure.
A great comfortable place for dinner with friends. Extensive list of German beers on tap, so perfect for someone who wants to try something new. Great staff.
Loved the food. It is almost impossible to get quality German type food in the Bay Area and this does it.

I had a Living Social coupon that was about to expire, so a friend and I went on a Thursday night for dinner. I had made a reservation, but soon realized that it was not necessary on a week night. The wait staff was pleasant quick and eager to answer any questions we had about the menu. I ordered the Schweinebraten and my friend the Bratwurst, and we split both meals. The saukraut that came with both meals was the best I'd ever had, sour, but with a bit of sweetness, as well. The Schweinebraten was melt-in-your mouth delicious. The sausages were outstanding. All together, a really excellent meal. We both decided we'd definitely go back again.

This is a wonderful bistro, speak easy, restaurant and besides excellent German food, the music is wonderful in a smallish room. What could be better?
My only (and very slight) issue was the 'live; nature of sound bouncing all over the room, hard to converse and hear. I will definitely want to go back and try more of their offerings and enjoy the excellent music. Glad they are there!
Friendly restaurant. Music: Le Jazz Hot was outstanding!

We always enjoy our meals at Speisekammer. The potato pancakes are always good, as are the dumplings with mushroom sauce.

The noise level was quiet, as we were most recently there on a Tuesday evening, but it can get quite lively (noisy) on the weekends, especially in the front dining room.

The service at Speissekammer is above and beyond any restaurant I have ever been to in the bay area (I've lived here for nine years). The hosts, servers and bartenders are down to earth, funny, and very attentive. The food is consistently delicious and the bar menu is chock full of yummy German beers and unique cocktails. Speissekammer has all the qualities of an excellent restaurant without the pretentiousness and inflated prices so common in the bay area. Speissekammer also offers live music on the weekends. I would recommend this restaurant for any occasion, from large parties to date night!

I went to Speisekammer with my daughter, a friend and myself to celebrate my daughter's b'day on February 15th. The bartender was very helpful in selecting us a bottle of red wine that was moderately priced and to our liking. He even had us all sample the wine before purchasing it. The waitress was very attentive and spaced out our food so we could stay and listen to the live music. We ordered an appetizer, entrees independently, and dessert. Everything was very well prepared and delicious. We would definetely go back again. One recommendation is that it would be nice if they did something special for Birthdays similar to other restaurants such as free appetizer, dessert etc. Overall an excellent restaurant to go to.

Exploring the menu further, we tried the the Kalte Fischplatte, a cold seafood antipasti of shrimp, gravlax, pickled herring & smoked trout. Comes with a mild sour cream/cucumber salad on the plate; very tasty. The Schweinebraten sandwich is quite large on a fresh French bread roll, with good fries. The Floris, a 3.8% Belgian apple beer, is very refreshing. Always good espresso drinks which is appreciated. Often crowded for lunch on Fridays, so make a reservation just in case!

While the food was great the service was a bit off - however, we went on a very busy night where the restaurant was turning people away who did not have a reservation. There was a band playing so the noise level was a bit higher than what I assume it would normally be. I will say that the service staff knew that their game was off for our table and they bought us 2 drinks which was not asked for nor expected... but it was appreciated. We will be back.

Overall the German-centric food is excellent (Wienerschnitzel is outstanding for a restaurant in California, braised pork & beef dishes are very well done, and vegetables are deliciously prepared in the Bavarian style), but again we had a major miss, in this case the Valentines' Day escargot special, one serving of which was gritty and inedible. When it was pointed out, the chef's response was "that's the way it is." We've had similar experiences about one in three visits. Having dined there a couple dozen times, including bringing out-of-towners as guests, we feel that it serves wonderful standard dishes but avoid anything outside the regular menu and don't expect professional responses from the kitchen.

Don't go for the vegies. Go for the meat; which is fabulous. The vegies are bland bland bland; that's ok. sauerkraut is great though, how can you go wrong with that.

Excellent wiener schnitzel main(can get either pork or veal). , seafood appetizer with gravalax, smoked trout, warm shrimp, etc. was terrific , also had mains of wild boar and suckling pig which were both terrific.

this is NOT a fancy place but a fun place to go with a group and they have music there quite a lot. and huge wine list and even bigger beer list.

bread dumplings good. mushroom soup very good

I'd skip the desserts nothing to write about; I wish they would get a great German chocolate cake . they had sorbets & a warm chocolate cake; just ok
Good negronis, and in a German restaurant whose liquid forte is beer.
Great spot to relax and listen to some live music ...bluegrass music, German beer--good combo!

We've come here twice with the kids and it's generally been great fun. There is of course lots of great German beer, and even some good vegetarian options which was a pleasant surprise. The front room is where the bar is and so is a bit more of a bar scene If you don't want that then ask to sit in the back room.

We're lucky to have good German food in the EBay. The Nurmberger sausages with sauerkraut are great. Ask for some sour cream with the potato pancakes; luscious with their tart housemade applesauce. Skip Saul's and come here for latkes, SO MUCH BETTER! Spouse loves the spaetzle, whether plain or with cheese. The little pickled salad that comes w/full order of spaetzle is terrific, like a coleslaw but better. Smoked pork chop is as good as Wente's famed pork chop but cheaper and nearer. Bread pudding was best dessert of the night. Service is always very good here, a real draw. Loved the Spaten Franziskaner Hefe-Weisse wheat beer with fun banana flavor, light and crisp.

We have eaten here a couple of times, and frankly, think it is over-rated. It's true you can't get German food anywhere else in Alameda, but the food here just isn't that good! I had the venison, which had the texture and flavor of shoe leather. Things are over-priced, and it really is a loud place. Service is nice - but there are better restuarants in Alamda for the money.
Yummm. Great sausage platter with a tasty and alittle sweet sourkraut. Wonderful beers. We will definitely come back again.

Great German place in the East Bay! It is very predictable food and beer. Nice and fun place!

I would not go here during Oktoberfest, way too crowded with staff, bar and food service completely overwhelmed at this event. But, this should not at all stop you from trying this great place every single other day of the year they are open!

Speisekammer continues to provide fabulous food and service in a very comfortable atmosphere. We love to take groups there, sit in the room with the fireplace and have family style service and it is consistenly fantastic!
Very authentic German food. If that is what you are looking for then this place has it.

The food and waitress service were good. We especially enjoyed the band featured the evening of our visit and the ambiance surrounding it. The maitre d was excellent, she accommodated all our wishes in regards to seating.
Great beer selection, authentic German food. Wasn't trilled with the potato pancakes. Looked like they used breakfast shredded potato, and not mashed potato's. Tasted good anyway. Would return.
Awesome! The food and the jazz band were great. We love the place.

Speisekamer provided the best New Year's Eve experience and perfect for me. I wanted dinner and dancing to a live band. I had a great time!

The food is always outstanding - they always do a good job with each dish. The service was a little off because of the great crowd that was there for the band - not sure how the restaurant could have improved since so many people were standing listening to the music. Usually, we get outstanding service. Of course, it was noisy - LIVE MUSIC!!!

We love Speisekammer - kid friendly, but good for adult night out too. They seat families generally separate from the bar scene if there is a band playing for example. Food is excellent. Service can be great, sometimes a little less so, but overall a great experience.
Service was extremely slow. Food was good.
It was incredible! We had a group of 6 New Years Eve. The waitress was fantastic. The only interesting thing was that no one spoke German.
Pretty good German food, and nice beer selection on tap.

If you like German food and great bier I highly recommend this place. The service is excellent. The quality of the food may vary at times, but usually it's always somewhere between very good to excellent.

At Christmas time you'll find a cozy and warm setting including a lit fire place and beautiful Christmas decoration. For our (German-American) family, it's a tradition to come and celebrate at least one Holiday meal at Speisekammer. Authentic German environment!
All of the food is good, but the potato pancakes are worth the visit.

Fun place to have a good German meal. Food, wine and beer is authentic and well done. After living in Germany for 20 years, it's great to have a place where I can reconnect with those comfort foods and drinks. Servers were very attentive in spite of a full house. Christmas party and birthday party going on and every table full but they still kept everything coming and we never felt neglected. Another nice feature is that many entrees can be ordered as a full or half portion, so you can try a number of items without breaking the bank or the belt! Always worth a trip to Alameda. There's also the beer garden when the weather is good, but right now everything is decorated for Christmas.
Very good food, but the noise level was far too loud, as our table was by the bar.
The music starts around 8 and is varied evening to evening. We have seen three different acts and enjoyed all of them. We enjoy that the audience is close to the performers.

We've eaten here many times and really like the food. This time however we really had a mediocre experience. Even though we had a reservation, we were seated right next to the drafty entrance in the bar area instead of the main dining room. The service was unfriendly, didn't understand the items on the menu (you have to speak a little german if you work in a german restaurant). We only received our bread basket after the food came and we had to ask for it. Water was never refilled and the bus boy basically stole my plate from under me while I was still eating my bread.
We like the food, so we'll be back, but the service has to get better again.
First time, enjoyed the authentic German food. Service was outstanding

Speisekammer now has a Gegrillte Fleischplatte, a meat platter meant to be shared. It contains one each of the thürlinger and bockwurst, and two each of the bratwurst and Nürnberger sausages, along with a sizable Kassler vom Grill, a grilled smoked pork chop, all served over sauerkraut. This is ideal for people like us, who believe one can never have too many kinds of sausages or too much sauerkraut in life. We still had to order an extra side of sauerkraut, because we love the stuff. Spaetzle is excellent, as is the true rye bread (not fluffy American rye bread). Red cabbage was a little too tart for us, but potato pancakes were back in form again. Applesauce has been extra tart last few times, though. We love this place!

The staff and food (and of course the beer selection) keep us coming back again and again. Had a special this time, a roast suckling pig and it was so tender and yummy. We live in Alameda and took our friends that just moved to Alameda there for dinner. They loved it as well and I am sure will add it to their favorites list. Keep up the good work!

I've been to Speisekammer several times and while the restaurant was a bit busier than on past visits, the service was not up to par. It was a nice night and we opted to sit outside, which *was* set up for dinner, but it seemed there was no assigned server. It took over 20 minutes for somebody to offer to take our drink order, and another 10 to get them. The food runners didn't seem to know the seating layout, delivering orders to the wrong patrons. Others sitting outside also seemed underwhelmed by the service. The country band playing inside didn't seem to fit the German theme...

Still, good German food and a decent selection of German beers (plus a few American microbrews thrown in).

Great for outdoor dining when the weather is warmer. Especially since we had a new mother with a baby in our group, we chose to sit inside. Food was great, beer was great, service was casual but pleasant. They held a very nice big table for us, with room for 8 adults and the baby and her carriage. All had a great time. Wish the music had been Oktoberfest-themed, though!

Went on a Saturday night and it was packed but the service was still good. Really great ambiance, we sat in the back room but could still hear the live music coming from the bar. The food is exactly what you would expect, tasty and comforting. The prices are very reasonable with most of the entrees under $20.00.

Speiksekammer is a great place to go with a bunch of friends. Friendly staff, interesting decor, and good beer. Definitely come hungry. With all the beer and bratwurst, you will feel like a jolly gluttonous German by the end of the night.

I can't add "fit for foodies" because German food is not thought of that way -but if you like German food, or aren't familiar with it & want to try, Spiesekammer is the BEST. I always get the sauerbraten because it's so tender & flavorful; portions are huge but they offer many items as half plates; I combined the sauerbraten with the pork braten (sides of red cabbage, sourkraut, spaetzle & potatoes) & my date had a great bratwurst plate - we took home a lot! One of the specials that we tried was sort of a deconstructed herring salad - beautifully marinated herring & onions, with carrots, beets, sour cream and cucumbers that you could put together any way you liked; a great shared appetizer. Service was very attentive and accomodating.
Standout service from charming bi-lingual servers.
Food was very good, authentic.  Good service.  Everyone enjoyed the visit.
I love Speisekammer! I've not had one negative experience dining there. It's family-friendly, amazing food, great service and great music on the weekends.

The food was not the traditional quality typical of Speisekammer. The baked spaetzle was soupy. The Nurnberger sausages were very dry. We ended up sharing a chocolate dessert though one not typical of Bavaria. Overall, very disappointing.
Excellent as usual
Wonderful time! Server was a bit.... Off. But this place is too good to worry about little things like servers being a bit off.
The free entertainment on Friday and Saturday nights is an added bonus!

Dining at Speisekammer is like eating at your mom's if your mom is Bavarian, a good cook and likes beer. The jagerschnitzel with spaetzel is a favorite. The place is comfortable, relaxed and accommodating. It gets a bit loud and when it's crowded.
WUNDERBAR - HAD THE WIENERSCHNITZEL, AS I QUITE OFTEN DO. IT WAS DELICIOUS, NOT GREASY.
very friendly atmosphere, the staff is very attentive, very authentic german place that offers great food! will definitely come back again.

I havee tried nearly all the German restaurants in the Bay Area (not that many of course) and Speisekammer is 1) by far the best, 2) the most authentic, and 3) an amazing value for the money. The addition of a full entree list (including half orders of some of the most popular items) to the lunch menu makes this an incredible go-to spot for lunch.

Add pleasant, efficient service, a nice outdoor seating area, and an extensive beer selection and you have a place I will return to often--even though I (or my designated driver) have to drive 35 miles to get there.

There aren't many German restaurants in the Bay Area and even fewer in the east bay. This one can be a little noisy, but is a good stop for German staples. The food is passable as authentic and the Beer selection is good. The outdoor patio is great on a warm day.
I'm never disappointed when I come here.

The gravlax was amazing, the smoked trout was some of the best smoked fish I have every had. Good German beer selection. Mash potatoes were a bit thin for me, wild boar meat loaf special was ok.

They had a great 3 piece jazz band playing in the bar area.

The service was top notch. You could tell they've worked here for a time and care about creating a friendly, inviting atmosphere. They have half portions for many of their dishes, and those were more then enough for one person.

Small parking area on the side w/empty spots on busy Sat night. There are many items on the menu we want to try. Great place, will be going there again very soon.

2 people, 3 beers total, one shared app, $65 before tip. And we took some food home.

Want a friendly neighborhood bar experience? Wonderful beer selection and when I'm missing food from the homeland this place really hits the spot. A little more refined take on Mom and Grandma's homely fair which is awesome. Try it all, you'll never have a bad meal. They often have live music and on Fri they had my favorite band, Le Jazz Hot! There's nothing like great French Gypsy Jazz with a good German beer. Think WW2 Europe and the combination fits beautifully. Speisekammer has perfect ambience and it's always a good time. You would think with live music and an exciting crowd you wouldn't be able to carry on a conversation, but you can. But be respectful or you may get the stink eye from patrons trying to listen to the music! Ja?!
My husband loves german food, and this place passed the test! I really enjoyed it too. We will definitely go back!
The food is excellent and the servers and waitresses are super. They had just served 500 people for the world cup and were exhausted but they gave me and my family the same attention as always.

Service was ok...food was fine for the price...beer selection and pricing excellent, and the 3 piece "band" was exceptional. Will go back for beer and entertainment. Also, really really loud...couldn't hear others at the same table without shouting...good for families and groups, probably not for a romantic outing. Lots of locals...they didn't lack for business.
The service was outstanding and the food was exactly why you chose a German Restaurant. I will go back and I do recommend to anybody who is looking for good German food.

What a gem! Delicious authentic German food. I've tried 4 different dishes there now and each one was excellent. Relaxed atmosphere...not stuffy. Menu points out gluten-free and vegetarian options too. Can't wait to go back for live music on Thurs/Fri/Sat nights. Great for kids, by the way.

Great experience from booking via Opentable to the restaurant itself. Very smooth transition and it came off flawless. We got there a tad early so sat at the bar for a drink before telling the hostess we were present. I got a little nervous when I saw it getting crowded but things worked out seamlessly.

Food was excellent!

The vibe is lively here, and it was perfect for a small reunion of friends. Great selection of beers, delicious pretzels, delicious food at affordable prices, and terrific, friendly service. We enjoyed the salads, pork in beer sauce, potato pancakes and more. I especially appreciated the option of ordering a half meal.
Great German Food and Beer. Perfect spot for a liter out on the deck!

Great german food .We've never been disappointed .Large portions... if you're not a big eater or just not REALLY hungry , consider the half order . It is rather loud and dark . Try the Ginger Martini !

I love Speisekammer. The German cuisine is hearty, well-flavored and abundant. The service is friendly and efficient. German cuisine is unfortunate deprecated in the San Francisco Bay Area, but perhaps due to Alameda's historical German founding community, German cooking has always been at home in Alameda, and we are very grateful for it. Ausgezeichnet!

First visit with a German neighbor who had been referred to this restaurant by another friend. The food was authentic and the wines and beer selections were good. One in our party had the venison which was okay (a bit tough), another had the pork tenderloin which was good and 2 had the weiner schnitzel which was very good. One neighbor had a dark german beer which was very good. Food portions were good and the beer was even better (I like beer). The service was good and prices reasonable. Yes, I would consider going back for the weiner schnitzel and beer.

This is our go to spot on Friday and Saturday nights when we have guests in town because the owners book some amazing jazz, blues and rockabilly type bands to play.  The food is well prepared, hearty German food and, of course, the selection of beers is great.  If you plan to go for the music, be sure to make reservations and call to make sure they seat you in the bar area.
The service was extremely slow.
A great German restaurant without having to go to the City. Great draft beer selection including some unusual Bavarian beers.Live music on Saturday nights.
Good authentic German food! On a Saturday night, we definitely needed reservations

We ordered soup and a salad with our entree and I was served my soup with my entree and my boyfriend was served his salad after his entree. We also waited for what seemed forever to be served 2 beers prior to ordering food. All in all it just wasn't what we expected. Oh and by the way the food was luke warm when it reached our table.

Speisekammer has always provided reliably good food for a good price. This is a great place to sample European beers, as well. The ambiance is authentic without being kitchy. I would recommend it to anyone who wants to try something different from French or Italian cooking.

Love this place! Authentic German fare. I cannot say enough good stuff about this restaurant. I have never had to wait when I had a reservation. Be aware that it can get pretty busy, so book ahead. Alameda island is lucky to have such a gem.
All in all a solid spot with great German food. Service seemed a little overwhelmed by the full dining room, but not too bad.
I love this place and always bring my out of town friends here. Everything tastes authentic and delicious!
Unfortunately, we were not seated until 45 minutes after our reservation, however it was st. Patty say and they had good music there. The food was superb too!
Absolutely love this place! The host, hostesses, servers, etc. are so nice and the food is delicious. They have a great beer selection too. It is our favorite restaurant hands down.
My husband and I love this place. We come here for date nights and leave the kids at home. We miss Germany and the food definitely brings us back memories. We love this place!

Food was outstanding. Service friendly but only fair, Back dining room was noisy. Tables structurally sound, but had trouble maneuvering my feet and legs around corner table legs to inside booth seating.
Throw pillows made seating comfortable once in position.
Friday Nite Music started before we left and was quite pleasant and tasteful. It broke up the dining room noise.
I would definitely go back for the food and consider asking about specific seating needs.
Great! Everything meet our expectations, we will be back!
What a gem! If you like German food you should definitely give it a try.

Came in for dinner with the bf and nieces, arrived on time for the reservation and was seated about 5 mins later.
After looking over the menu, we sat and sat and sat, no sign of a waitress in sight. Finally the bf had enough and went to go one.
Our waitress arrived shortly after and took our order.

Then we sat around some more waiting for the food to arrived. More waiting. The waitress came by twice to tell us the food would be out shortly. It wasn't, and we waited some more

Finally! The food arrived, but sadly didn't come out hot and was horribly over salted. I got the half-rotisserie chicken with mashed potatoes. The chicken was a bit dry and the potatoes tasted like they came from a box :{

Staff definitely needs to be more a

Although it was not bad, there are a few items, which we felt could be done better. First, a round table at a corner bench does not work. They have to rearrange their seating.
Regarding the food: I had the Kassler with Sauerkraut and mashed potatoes. The meat was much too soft, the Sauerkraut (=sour cabbage) was far too sweet and the mashed potatoes were too watery (most likely this were prefabricated Pfanni mashed potatoes). We also had the Nuernberger Bratwuerste. I thought they tasted horrible, more like fried Leberkaese. The Apple Strudel was OK, although this was not a strudel dough, it was too dry. Overall, if you have never been to Germany, you might like the food, but it is for sure not authentic.

We have been to Speisekammer many times, and they continue to be a great and very consistent choice for tasty and authentic German food in a very pleasant setting. They also happen to be one of the few good restaurants in the City of Alameda.

Everything from service to food to that little something special was very good.  The German food, the back room with fireplace and tasteful decor, special beers and drinks, all make it something a little different.  We were not there on a night with music but I can imagine it would be fun and a nice change of pace.

A great find for people looking for something a little different. A nice assortment of authentic German dishes, beers and wines. A tasteful and pleasant atmosphere, with good energy. Good service and friendly staff. Overall, a very pleasant experience.
Fantastic German cusine bordering on gourmet. Great beer selection. Fun place, hard to find nearby parking.

This is a hipster hot-spot up front, with live music and what appears to be a great bar. In the back there's the dining room which is still noisy and vibrant, but charming. There is a great big fireplace! The food is well made German fare; hearty and filling. You must have the Potato Pancakes. The wine list is OK, most German whites are too sweet for the California palate, so they include some drier selections. This is a fun place with good food, and reasonable prices, but a bit noisy if you want a romantic dinner.
Never had german food before and I was blown away the food was amazing the environment was very comfortable the service was great and I can't wait to go back and try more of the food!
LOVE this place! Very welcoming staff too!
We love this restaurant but the night we dined there service was really slow and without great follow up. I'm sure it varies depending on staff so we will visit again.

We had a wonderful time. In fact, we didn't know that the first Friday of every month is Pirate Night. It was a lot of fun watching everyone in their pirate costumes and even the band was dressed as pirates.
Authentic German food, rare in the bay area.

Came here for New Year's Eve and randomly again a few weeks ago. Once at a table, once at the bar. Both meals were excellent. I have been introduced to Goose, I want more. Service is good, food is solid. It's difficult to get passed the Specials and try their standard menu, but it all looks and sounds good. Does one describe beer as "especially fresh"? If so, they've got that covered.

It was good as always. The food was outstanding, tasty again. Took the half portion of the Sauerbraten, what was plenty for me for dinner. The Kohlrouladen were to die for, said my husband. I got my Gluehwein and I was happy.
All in all. Never dissapointed to go there.

I checked the wine list box, but honestly, its the BEER! I often laugh when I hear someone talk about "german food", the names are funny sounding and the food doesn't have a reputation for particular deliciousness. Then I ate here and I have a passion for it! Its severe comfort food...amazing sauerkraut, mashed potatoes to die for, bratwurst they have specially made just for them. You can't go wrong here, and its a fun culinary adventure.

I always enjoy coming to Speisekammer, and seem to be developing a tradition of coming here on my birthday. It's a fun place to bring a group, the food is good, and there's a nice selection of beer, wine, and cocktails.

Cautions: The menu has limited vegetarian options by Bay Area standards. And, on nights when there is entertainment, it can be loud (depending on your taste, Pirate Night could either be a blast or be annoying). So, if you are looking for a quiet chat over dinner, check the schedule first :)
This place is fun. If they are typical German food then I want to go to Germany. They have TONS of beer to choose from. I always leave satisfied and happy.

Good for drinks, bad for food. I've been coming here since it's first opened, and the food has gone downhill over time. I'm half German, half Irish, so I grew up eating German food. Sauerkraut should be SOUR. This sauerkraut is awful. It was never very good, but it's even worse now - it has a hint of sweetness that just doesn't belong. The highlight of the menu are the potato pancakes, which are yummy. The German chocolate cake only had the coconut icing in the middle and the side - the top of the cake was frosted with some sort of icky chocolate over-sweetness. Shame this place isn't at least as good as it was even two years ago. I won't be going back.

Food was wonderful, as always! We had a fitting holiday feast with sauerbraten and roast goose at a table near the fireplace. We finished the meal with Lebkuchen ice cream, a treat we had never had before. Service was a little slow but to be expected on a busy night. We received excellent wine recommendations that went perfectly with the food.

This was our family's 5th Christmas Eve dinner at Speisekammer and was one of the best. The service was markedly faster and friendlier. The food was wonderful as always. But thanks to the improved service, it arrived hotter. We don't eat here as often as we should and every Christmas Eve we ask ourselves why. For 2012, I resolve to be back before Spring.

We come to Speisekammer whenever we are hungry to traditional
German favorites. We are always pleased.

No cover live music in the bar area every weekend.
Excellent German cuisine and a large selection of Bears.

Great food, convivial atmosphere. Very busy on the night we were there, thus the evening stetched out longer than I had anticipated. Still, the wait staff was friendly, the food hearty and warming. A good time.

Great experience overall. I was with a group of 6 where everyone ordered something different from the menu and each thing tasted great. The beer selection was great too. I didn't get the famous boot but I saw others drinking from it. Those could be a meal in themselves. I would definitly return to this restaurant. Unfortunately we did not stay long enough to enjoy the live music but this place has live music every Friday and Saturday.

Our group of Würzburg American High School Alumni have been coming here for many years. This was our 5th Annual Holiday Lunch and we wouldn't even consider having it anywhere else. The staff is fantastic......friendly and so accomodating. Of course, the food is the best German food in the Bay Area. We'll definitely be back next year.

Vibrant Bar Scene ... Kid-friendly .... not terms that usually go together. At Speisekammer you enter through the bar/reception area (which was rocking due to the first Friday of the Month Pirate event) through heavy curtains and into Bavaria. Kids will enjoy a quick glimpse of rum swilling pirates before setting down to their potato pancakes and baked spatzel with cheese. The adults enjoyed their food as well. Very authentic German cuisine with surprise specials like wild Boar.

A really fun little neighborhood gem. German food, as you might guess from the name. Specials list was great and took the cuisine to a much higher level than the menu. FANTASTIC wine list....great older German whites at amazingly low prices! We were there on a night that had a wonderful musical performance. All in all a very pleasurable evening.

Food was excellent and in generous portions. Service was patchy. The guy bussing the tables and refilling water was right on his game, but the wait staff less so. Long waits between menu drop off and order taking, little attention to whether drinks were empty.

This was our third time at this restaurant, so we like it. The food is traditional German, and that's why we come several times a year. The bier garten is nice, and they have music almost nightly. This time, our service was not as expected. We ordered two appetizers for our group, and one large appetizer, was served with our entrees, even though we ordered an entree for every diner. I wish they'd brought it earlier, when we were waiting. For $15. it seemed like a waste, since everyone's dinner was getting cold while we just had a taste of the appetizer.

I wanted to like it because there aren't that many German restaurants around, but the underdone, chewy pork shank was something you can't ignore. The service was terrible. We were one of 5 couples seated in a room with a huge party and the service suffered for it. I allotted 1 1/2 hours for dining and we still missed our dance class. Won't be coming back here.

We had made a reservation for 7:30 via OT and then had to push it back to 8:00pm but our initial reservation and push back were BOTH confirmed--never a problem before. We know it's always crowded for Kit and the Branded Men, well-worthwhile--that's why we went!!!and it was my birtday dinner too. The service was horrible--waited so long for bread and drinks and our food and our order; so that the restaurant was not able to handle a large Sat night rush, it seems. You will love the food and music, etc. so just be prepared folks!!

This is German food presented in a old world style, authentic to what I remember from years past. Not a modern twist on German cuisine at all. The staples are all there, and make sure to try the Saurbraten, the Spaetzle, and the Potato Pancakes. The Sauerkraut is awesome as well.

We have been to this restaurant numerous times and it never disappoints us. Add to this the entertainment and you have a full night out.

Food was delicious. The adults and kids in our group all had a great time. The Wiener Schnitzel was a big hit with our kids. They also liked checking out the toy drawer. We liked the variety of beer on tap. Our server was knowledgeable, friendly and prompt. This is one of the better family-friendly restaurant options in the area.

We've been searching for good German food for some time, as that cuisine seems to be lacking here. Speisekammer delivered on ambiance, quality of food, and - particularly - value. While not quite fully German Bavarian, it was close enough that we will return - often - even though it involves a 90-minute drive.

Free live music is always enjoyable.Nice middle-aged happy crowd, Always a birthday or other celebration.This is ethnic German food.Outstanding beer list, Wine is good too.Plenty of outdoor space at all hours for smokers.
It was a wonderful place to celebrate my birthday, both inside (for lunch) and outside in the biergarten. Our server was great and the food was delicious.

Enjoyed our appetizers & meal. We have been going to Speisekammer for the last few years (when we are in the area). Food is consistent. Great beer & wine selection. Atmosphere is relax and better before 7pm. We will continue to enjoy going to Speisekammer.
Food is truly authentic German cuisine. Excellent taste and wonderful service!

It was a busy Friday night and the service was substandard. Good grub, but an hour and ten minutes passed from the time we were seated until dinner arrived. Water wasn't refilled and we had to prod the waiter for just about everything except more beer, which we didn't want. I like the food, but not well enough to overlook poor service.
Great service, begining with the host who seats you. Wonderful German food that is not available in very many restaurants in the area.

They had the exact sauerkraut, crispy potato pancakes and incredible dark beer which we had hoped for and the entrees were also excellent (smoked port chop and beef-stuffed cabbage roll). All as good (maybe even better ... sorry grandma) than my German grandmother's.
Terrific, delicious and authentic German food. Yum
Generous portions with great service

We celebrated my father's 70th birthday here last weekend. It amazes me that a restaurant can win in so many ways: ambiance (our long table was set up in the middle of the back room next to the candle-lit fireplace), kid friendly (we are guilty of bringing wild toddlers to dinner) AND romantic and worthy of the most adult of evenings, wonderful food (served promptly for the whole group), beer of course, dessert (the Black Forest cake prepared for us and served on a cake pedestal with candles, etc, by the staff was TO DIE FOR)... the list goes on.

Bring your group here and you will have a ball.
Very enjoyable. Terrific range of beers on tap and hardy German food. The polar opposite of spa food.

I judge all German restaurants by their Jägerschnitzel and their Spätzle. These folks make it from pork or veal - take your pick. I had it "vom Schwein". "Mit Kalbfleisch" costs just $1.50 more. I will try that next time.

I was thrilled with my dinner. I spent time in Germany back in the 1980's. The tastes and textures of this mean took me back to Heilbronn. I drank the Weltenburger Dunkel, which came at a proper temperature, not nearly as cold as American beer is served. The Spätzle was perfect.

My wife wasn't paticularly hungry, so she tried a half order of the Gratinierte Kasespätzle and she was delighted.

The Apple Strudel topped with Ice Cream was just the right finish to a wonderful meal.

We will certainly return soon.
Excellent Southern German cuisine, attentive wait staff, great beer selection. Pirate night on the first Friday of the month means motlcy customers and a very high noise level!
authentic German Food in a nice setting. The Potato Pancakes were great as well as the entrees!
The fruit and cheese plate rocks and we love it when the Frisky Frolics play!!! Roasted chicken was dry, though.

Great selection of German food and German beers. Food is tasty and filling! Service is friendly. Very noisy. Had to ask that the music be turned down near our table so we could try to talk to each other. Staff was happy to do so.

The is most traditional German Restaurant, in the Bay Area, we love it. Not a hoffbrau, a great family style venue. With good music and great staff.

Thank you!
Nice change of pace place. I have not had German food in a while. Service was good and the music was a nice touch.
Good beers and food. Very accomodating to large group dinner. Live music. Nice outdoor patio.

Celebrated a family birthday dinner here on a Friday afternoon. All the food was delicious including the potato pancake appetizer and the bread pudding! We enjoyed the ambiance on the outdoor patio with the fairly large and lively crowd. The waitstaff was helpful and friendly without interrupting our conversation. Parking was somewhat challenging, but there is a small lot on the side.
We loved it! Large portions, well prepared and authentic German cuisine. Main entrees were terrific -- side dishes a little lackluster. Desserts were excellent!!
2nd time here and the food was really good. Nice beer selection. Service wasn't the best I have had nor was it the worst.
Great scene. The bier garden out front was cool. The live music inside was great. Oh, and the food. oh, the black forest ham was to die for.

I live in Alameda and I want to love this restaurant.  However, everytime I go, I am severely disappointed in the food.  There are some really incredible restaurants in the city with simialar menus and what a huge difference.  Speisekammer has a great location, nice bar, beautiful fireplace.  They often have live music and the place looks great.  They should keep their chef and send him to eat at some of the other places for training.  Would love to go back and it be the best around.

I took a group of 9 there for my husband's birthday. The good was great. The beer was great. The service was great. Most of the people in my group had never been to Spiesekammer and all said that they would go back! Thanks for everything.

My experience at Speisenkammer Rerstaurant was great. I had jagerschnitzel, spaezle, and red cabbage, with Black Forest cake afterward. My partner had wienerschnitzel, potatoes fried w/onions and bacon, and a beet salad, and also, Black Forest cake. Everything was delicious, the service was great, and we really enjoyed ourselves. I definitely will go back again!
I've never had a bad meal here!

Fantastic food, amazing beer selection, and a great staff, but don't count on having a relaxing chat with friends if there's live music. The din of the band had us shouting and we cut out to have dessert and after dinner drinks elsewhere.

The food was very good. I especially liked that many entrees had the option to order a half portion. The service was very good as well. When we arrived, our reserved table was in the bar area, right next to the live entertainment. Much too loud for dining. Even with a full house, the staff was very accommodating and found us a table in the dining room...very much appreciated! We will definitely be returning.
We always try to bring a guest!

First time back in a couple of years. A mix up at the front desk left us at a table that was not assigned to any wait staff. After waiting for 30 minutes we flagged a waiter who was most apologetic and leaped into action. The food was better than we remembered - the seafood stew was especially impressive. The complementary desert - we choose the black forest cake - was their idea of making amends. It worked. We'll be back. Perhaps not on Pirate Night. Arrg! But we'll be back.
Great Beer
Excellent German food & great beer. We enjoyed our meal very much.

The food was excellent - maybe a little too much pepper on the steak - but the asparagus, the tomato soup, the graxlax and the wild boar dish were all very good. I'm a little biased, because I got to sing a couple of numbers with the Hot Club of San Francisco trio, which I haven't done for years. All in all, a wonderful evening!
We have been there many times and the place never disappoints us.

The food was very good as usual; however, the service was not. One meal was forgotten so the one diner had to wait while the others dined; one side dish was forgotten; and one salad order was never received and had to be removed from the bill. The restaurant also made no effort to reconcile these problems, such as comping the forgotten meal.

It was a delightful experience for our group of eight. There are vegetarian entrees, and good German wines. The atmosphere is congenial, the food tasty and the service efficient. Half portions are available.

I have been to Speisekammer a few times, but this was the first time during the day and in a large group. It was my son's high school graduation and we decided to eat at Speisekammer. When we arrived we had a somewhat private room which allowed us to decorate. The service was excellent and the food was wonderful. We had the option of ordering either from the lunch menu or the dinner which was nice because it allowed more options. I would highly recommend Speisekammer for group events.

A special place in Alameda. Good food with a wine & beer list, emphasizing German beer and German and French wines, that doesn't break the budget. If you like German food, this is a very good place to go.

Our server was friendly, but it took a long time to get our food. We had 6 people, and everyone got served but one person. That's when our server told her that they were out of the dish she ordered. So the whole table of people had their plates in front of them, except one person who had to order something else and wait while they prepared it. We weren't comped or anything! So it was disappointing, especially since we'd really talked the place up to our out-of-town guests.

the standard for german-style food is the former speckman's and the former reisehoff, both in san francisco. to date, i have not found a restaurant approaching either of those fine german restaurants. if one resides on the east side of the bay and does not want to travel to san francisco, speisekammer offers a wide variety of authentic german beers, good service, and acceptable german-style food. i would have preferred the traditional 'schmaltz' bread spread, but the garlic infused butter was quite good. the mushroom stuffed with escargo appetizer was prepared to perfection, perhaps as good as any michelin 3 star restaurant.
lousy service. They ordered the wrong meal for us. Too expensive for what we got.
Excellent food and service, nice selctions of Brews what more do you need from a german restaurant. not only will I go back I will be taking people with me each time.
Excellent German Food, and only German Food. Service can be spotty, but excellent when around. The arrangement of the restaurant makes it very noisy. Sometimes I can't hear the people at my table.

If you have a hankering for authentic German fare - look no further. Excellent food, a solid variety of German beer and attentive service made our meal one to remember. The only downside is parking, but that is to be expected in Alameda.

Excellent German food.  Not fancy at all. Very friendy staff.  We went a group of 8 & we waited to get in 1/2 hour(we had reservations), then waited 20 minutes to order, then waited another 1/2 hr to be served.  Order had so many mistakes we were the last people left in this back dining room because order took forever; not because we lingered.  but the waitress was lovely.  We came to hear a music group play & they put us in a room far away from them so that was not good.

Fabulous selection of beer.  

Wiener schnitzel (pork or veal - we had both) was very good.  The vegie sides were very plain like home cooked; good but simple.  Boar was excellent.  Bratwurst was excellent too.  

Desserts were good.  German chocolate cake was great
Very good place. I didn't think I like German food. I was wrong. This place completely changed my mind, a 180 degree flip. Great food, good selection of beer, reasonable price.
lussty, filling, authentic, and dometimes inspired.

I was impressed. I'm gluten, wheat, dairy and soy sensitive. They have a menue which indicates Gluten free, Vegan, dairy free. Juchu for me. I had Kohlroladen mit Kartoffeln und Gurkensalat. My best meal for the last 16 months. I love you for this. AND they have Gluten free Beer. We are going to your restaurant for very long time. But now it is one more reason to go there. Thank you.
I find this restaurant very consistent in both food and service. It's a fun place to go in Alameda and everyone is very friendly.

I like that they have half orders, so that if you're not too hungry you can get plenty of food for a very reasonable price. Considering that this place has a pleasant ambience, nice service, actual tablecloths, and pretty good food, it's a real value.
Very good German food, with wine and beer to match.
Food was tasty, prices are great, service was outstanding

Although this is a fun German food and culture hub, there were some downers: the online advertised prices for the 'Recession Menu" were not in effect, and the service was problematic. We had to beg for bread, but our beer glasses were whisked away prior to finishing. I heard a nearby table request to keep their folks for the dessert they ordered when the waiter tried to bring their check too fast. Although I asked for vegi, I received a meat-based soup special with ham. :(

First, I say energetic in the noise catagory, but it is part of the awesome ambiance this restaurant provides. The food is great as always, serving staff took my family's jokes about not being able to pronounce German words well(I'm sure its old, sorry guys).
The artwork, tables, chairs, cabinets; they transport you somewhere that doesn't feel like Alameda anymore. Has a well stocked bar, some good beer choices, and a nice list of cocktails. This is easily my favorite on Alameda.
Dishes are hit or miss. Stick with the sausage and the pork dishes and you'll be fine.

Sauerbraten and Red Cabbage like Oma used to make! Great German beer list, German Chocolate Cake from heaven :) A nice if not fairly predictable German menu. Dishes were well prepared with one exception: The Wiener Schnitzel cutlets were generous and flavorful, but on the dry side ~ easy remedy by ordering Jägerschnitzel ~ same, but with addition of a lovely mushroom sauce. Personable and welcoming front desk, service is good considering the hectic pace of wait staff during peak dining hours - the place is packed! Would have liked traditional German music to go with fare, but not everyone grew up with Hugo Schneider's German-American Music hour. Speisekammer moves to my Top 10 Favorite Restaurants In The Bay Area List :)
Some nights they have live band/group performance.

A solid German restaurant! The standards were very good and we had one of the daily specials,duck, that was also quite delicious. Good selection of German beers and wines and the server was helpful on these. Casual, good for families, and very good German food.

Although we had a reservation, there was a back-up trying to check-in (no one seemed to be attending to the front desk), but once that was resolved we had a wonderful evening. The service was even, the food delicious, and the live jazz was a wonderful addition making the evening all the more fun. Would certainly go back!

We go to Speisekammer fairly regularly to see friends' bands play, and we enjoy some German food and beer when we go. While there are a couple of servers that go above and beyond, we have found the service to be mostly a "miss."

Most disappointing was this past Thursday when we went for St. Patrick's Day for an 8p dinner. We made a reservation on Open Table, and wrote in the notes that we are coming for the music and would like to be seated in the main room. 40 minutes later, they offered us a seat at the bar - with one of us sitting, and one standing. The host I could tell felt badly, and was apologetic. We ended up joining our friend's table, and the bartender who felt badly for us brought the food. So, the reservation was a waste.
The food was fbulous!!! Rwal good German food. thewaitress was wonderful. we had home made apple strudel...delicous...I recommendhighly!!!!!!!
the food was good;however, the service was slow to non-existent. We waited an hour between appitizer and the entre.
Great German food! They had all of the dishes that I crave, but can never find: spaetzle, potato pancakes, etc.

We had a reservation for four, then five of us showed up. After seating us two more joined us, an finally two more. The friendly staff put at us a table that magically accommodated all of us and we and we had a great night. Vegetarians loved the strudel, the pescevore loved the gravlax, the carnivores loved the pork Jägerschnitzel, and everyone loved the spätzle gratin (though we all agreed it would be better with a higher proportion of gratin top to gooey insides). And we loved the live music, a retro surf-a-billy soul trio.

The Speisekammer restaurant was very comfortable and offered a pleasant dining experience. The staff was helpful and efficient while allowing us to visit without constant interruption. The food choices were varied enough to satisfy our different tastes and to make us want to return to try others. The atmosphere was lively while not overwhelming. The diners were a varied group and all seemed to be enjoying themselves.

There was a new matre'd who took a long time to seat us for our reservation. Everything turned out okay, since we did eventually get a table. Lucky for us, we knew the other wait staff and bartender along with knowing the musicians. We had a great time and the "recession" menu was still in effect. Sehr gut!!
Great hearty German food, the service was wonderful with a good wait staff and overall recommendable.

We went here to hear a particular band and were surprised and delighted by the great service and food. I highly recommend getting the combination salad which includes many German specialities; and they also had the best apple streudel I have ever had.

Great german food, very authenic!  Gets crowded on the weekends, especially if there is entertainment in the bar.  Reservations advised.  Overall, the staff is friendly and helpful and the food has been consistently good each time we've visited.  Worth a visit if you are in the neighbor and have a hankering for German food and wine!

Speisekammer continues to be a reliable spot for genuine, high quality German cuisine -- it's really the only place you can find this in the East Bay and one of very few places in the entire Bay Area.
Great German food and wine! Room with fireplace added to special ambiance.

We had grown somewhat disillusioned with the food and service, but Speisekammer has rehabilitated itself with our last meal. It was terrific. Everything from the beer which was our appetizer, to the dessert was excellent. Our server was extremely busy and hustling from table to table, but we eventually got everything and his attitude could not have been friendlier. We'll definitely be back
We have been here several times. The food is great....most of the time. From the host to our waiter the employees lack professionalism.

Great local German food place and great draft beer list. Despite 50 minute wait for our food after it was ordered, it was worth the wait. A very casual place and good food. We've been there before and the wait was not as great. We will visit again.

Honestly?? We Loved it! We had a great time - the staff was friendly, the food great, the beer even better! This was our first time in and it was a great dining experience.
Vielen Dank Speisekammer!

We like sausages. We like sauerkraut. DH loves spaetzle. I love potato pancakes. How can you go wrong at Speisekammer? Wonderful housemade bratwurst with sauerkraut. Excellent cabbage rolls. All the pork dishes are fabulous. Vegetarians and vegans need to go elsewhere; there's plenty of restaurants for them...but for sauerkraut lovers, this place satisfies when we need our "fix."

Loved it! Food, beer and service were really great. My 2-1/2 year old loved the German version of mac-n-cheese. Bought this deal through yelp! to try someplace new and we were very happy with our pick and savings results!

Speisekammer is the best place for German food, even when you don't know you want German food. The potato pancakes with apple compote? Delicious. Every entree brought to our table got oohs and ahhs.
Huge perks? The extensive beer list that had everybody passing around drinks for reviews. The "Recession" menu so us broke fools can still partake in deliciousness. The gluten free option, I get to eat like a real person with my friends!
Great place, we love going here, and bringing new people to experience it.
Food was very good, nice choices and the specials were tasty. The room is a bit cold but only because it was a slow night. Lots of people at the bar

My husband and I eat here often. The food is consistently good and of high quality, including well-prepared vegetables and delicious soups. The portions can be generous, but order from the "recession menu" for smaller portions. Three different veggies are available a la carte. There is also a great drinks menu, offering inventive cocktails, an interesting and varied wine list, and extensive beer options. On the weekend, there is entertainment available in the bar area, mostly jazz, with no cover charge.
the food was great but very LOUD.. parking is bad...and we went early...their were kids-but that made it even more noisey...try to seat in front of restaurant.

Authentic German Haus set up with rooms for dining with fantastic beer and menu! Music on the weekends.
Oxtail stew was flavorful but would be better if falling off the bone.
Great food, ate at the bar, Victoria our server was awesome! Fun atmosphere. My husband is from the midwest and the food reminded him of comfort food from his hometown. We'll def. come back.

My partner and I have passed by Speisekammer many times as we enter Alameda. We were very happy to finally make a stop into the restaurant. The people were great, the serive very nice, and the food wonderful. A nice surprise to have a local German place...no need to travel into SF! Thanks..
Great food, fantastic beer, and a great back room with a fireplace.
Speisekammer is our favorite East Bay German restaurant! We especially appreciate their 1/2 servings (aka "recession menu") and their designation of Gluten-free dishes.

We've been to Speisekammmer several times - the food and service are always good, and it's tops for German fare. (We also like Walzwerk/SF, Tyrolean Inn/Ben Lomond.) Not so German, but the calamari are to die for - super tasty, not too bready or oily - terrific! Lots of good veggie choices for my sister. And the beer selection is fabulous. Pleases all palates.
Friendly and welcoming staff. Great beers on tap. Warm homey setting and really good food!
The food has always been good and the service has always been bad. Last night, both were disappointing. Did they change chefs?
The food is hearty and comforting.

It is one of our few Christmas traditions to spend Christmas Eve at Speisekammer. There's just something warm and cozy about the place and the food that makes it perfect for the occasion. The service is always good. The beer selection, delectable. And the food, tasty and filling enough to set you down for a long winter's nap.

I really enjoyed the food. They have some holiday specials that were great (I had the goose, and definitely would recommend). It was very busy that night, so the service was a bit slower than in past visits. Good traditional German food, nice atmosphere, and a busy bar.

Abysmal service -- very disappointing. They got my order incorrect, forgot to change it on the bill, never offered the young kids in our group crayons or coloring paper. Such a shame since we love the ambiance and enjoy the food.
Our waiter was terrible. He missed on so many levels.
We went for the band (The Saddlecats - great!) and to enjoy great food and drink. We got it all including a perfectly placed table up front. Thanks!
Great hearty food, excellent for groups. Live music, if you're into that. Seems much quieter than Zuppenkuche! Love the recession menu and the vegetarian options.
It was fun to watch the Giants win while we ate! It was a little loud and crowded but fun.
Service was quick, friendly and informative. I was there with two senior citizens and the wait staff was patient and suggested meals that seniors would enjoy. Love the various choices of brewski.
A large group made for a noisy atmosphere this time. However, food was still good!
Second visit was disappointing, meat was on the tough side. Service attentive but almost rushed.
