Even though we had early (6PM) reservations the host seated us in the noisy bar at a small table, not comfortable. Diners arriving after us were seated in one of the two dinning rooms. Waitress did not know why we were seated near the entrance, which is normaly used for late arriving guests.

The service was awful. We sat down and waited for about 10 minutes; finally I asked someone at the bar if there was a wait person. she came. Didn't apologize for the wait, etc. I would never go here again.
Authentic German. Great beer, nice staff!

The Borscht dinner was not liked by my guests. Neither person wanted to finish their meal. There was some sort of spice in the meat which crept up on taste buds in the back of the palette and stuck with you. I don't know what it was but per my guests it detracted from the enjoyment of the meal.

The wiener-schnitzel dish was OK but very bland. I appreciate that its intended to be a basic dish, but if they included some dips (variety of mustard or apple sauce) it give a very bland dish some needed flavor.

Enjoyed the selection of German beers. Deserts (German Chocolate Cake and Lemon Sorbet) were both liked.

Service was OK but not great. Staff was always friendly.
The next best thing to eating in Germany!

Disappointing.  After all the rave reviews about the authentic German food, found the food to be of both doubtful authenticity and quality.  Their take on kassler ripchen is simply way off the mark, and the sauerbraten is a poor take on a classic.  If you enjoy real German food, go to Teske's Germania in San Jose.  Trust me.  http://www.teskes-germania.com/

We stayed away for several years because the service had been very rude. But our service this weekend was pleasant and courteous, just the way we like it. The food has stayed consistently good. We'll be back again.
Very good draft and bottled German beer selection, don't miss their annual Oktoberfest celebration.
This is an excellent landmark in Alameda. I was able to make a last minute reservation for 10people and were excellent with the service. And the food is exceptional!

At first when you walk in, you might find yourself thinking that this place is pretty small. But then you find yourself being escorted into another room with more tables and very nice high-back chairs. Excellent interior decor.

Definitely, recommend the sausages and sauerkraut. Their weiner schnitzel was a bit dried, but the other dishes with sause which my coworkers ordered were tasty.

Great food and beer! Friendly service.

Thank you!
The recession menu offerings were excellent and the prices were good.
With an accordian player in the background you almost feel as if you are in Germany! Great fun and good food. Definitely worth a try if you are in the neighborhood.
Super fun place. Friendly staff.
This place has great german food and beer. Great selection of german beer! I would definately repeat! Oh and our service was fantastic!!
The beer they offer on tap is what I go there for! Also live music!

If you love German food (e.g., pork in all its wonderful forms), you will know we are sooooo lucky to have Speisekammer in the East Bay. The sauerkraut is fabulous, the potato pancakes have housemade applesauce (they are what the latkes at Saul's in Berkeley SHOULD be, but aren't), and the pork....yum! Whether in bratwurst or roast suckling pig, nobody does pork better than Speisekammer, not even the Chinese! This place is an old-time treasure, and we hope it stays around forever. Honest, simple food at moderate cost: what more can one ask for from a neighborhood restaurant?

The food was great, service relaxed but responsive, the crowd was energetic and mix all ages. Lot of beers to choose from (German ones too of course). Seemed to have all ages showing up from the University, and also older folk from the neighborhood.

We picked this kinda at random, but enjoyed it more than we thought.

We will definitely be back.

While Speisekammer won't get 3 Michelin stars, it does offer basic German comfort food which is very tasty. That, combined with a selection of German beers (many on tap) not available at most other places, makes it a gem. On a nice day, their outdoor deck makes for an especially pleasant meal.

I have been to Spiesekammer a number of times and have never had an off meal there. Our most recent visit was no exception. We were seated quickly. The waiter was funny and well-informed. The beer selection, as you might expect in a German restaurant, was wonderful and interesting. As you might also expect, the food is somewhat heavy. That may be the key reason we don't dine there more often. The appetizers came out quickly. We had a tasty, if plain, beet salad; some lightly battered and perfectly crunchy calamari; and the always wonderful potato pancakes. My wife and I had intended to go half and half with the stewed pork and the roasted lamb, but neither of us wanted to switch.
Excellent food!!! Yummy! And super tasty beer on tap! Highly recommend the bratwurst sandwich!!
Food here was quite good. I would recommend it, especially with their recession buster menu and prices
Good food, location, service, beer, and ambiance. These are just 5 reasons that we've returned and will continue to do so. (BTW, I use a 3 tier review: good, fair, and bad.)
We love Speisekammer -- the food, the beer, the ambience, the servers. Great neighborhood place.
Good hearty food, freindly service. Super kid freindly. I will definitely recommend to anyone craving a delicious german meal.

I was reading German/Austrian restaurant reviews and one said this is the standard they judge all other food establishments by. We went to the "S" that afternoon and lunch was very tasty, prices reasonable, nice bar, etc. I recommend it.
Not your normal neighborhood restaurant. This is like a little corner of Germany tucked into Alameda. It's the real deal.

Everything was great! Speisekammer proves that German cuisine is delicious, innovative, healthful, while still having its vaunted meat-and-potatoes heartiness. The only and minor issue is that the portions are too big for us to finish, even with our big appetites. Otherwise, Speisekammer is a restaurant that started out strong and continues to improve with each visit over the years. It will always be one of our favorites.

The food was great. The service was slow and we did not get much attention. I probably would have drank more beer had the server shown up at the right time. He didn't show up once after the food was served to check in on us, and only showed up once after the appetizer was served. We were a party of three and were seated at a very small table, while there were plenty of normal sized tables open, so I had to get that changed as well. I put a special note on our on line reservation that it was my Fathers 84th birthday and it would be great if we could get a birthday desert. No desert, no birthday greeting, and a poor table as well. Obviously they did not take the time to read the note I wrote, or they simply did not care.

The food at Speisekammer is always enjoyable, the owner was attentive in recognizing a minor problem and correcting it immediately upon his notice of the issue. We have dined here often as it is convenient to Oakland Airport for thoseof us not in the area. We look forward to returning.

We've eaten here before and were always happy. This time was an occasion (obviously had reservations, and flowers were delivered there and brought to table), dining room was fairly empty, yet we were tucked into a back corner in second dining room. Two out of 4 meals had issues with how well it was cooked, one with quality of meat and one was very satisfied. Waitress not very attentive once meal was served, they use buss staff to keep attention going at the table. Too bad...but these issues won't keep us away since most of our visits the food was excellent!
Good food, the cabbage roll was excellent and the Ginger beer and beer beer were great.
Amazingly kid friendly location - balloons, crayons, toys. They bent over backwards to accommodate our two small children.

This is an authentic German restaurant with very good food and a more than acceptable beer selection. Patrons that night were from all walks of life and the facility was quaint & the service excellent.
Speisekammer was impressive all around - Great beer selection, variety of regular menu items and specials, and good service. Definitely on my list of favorites!

Waited for about 20 min. before a waitress came to take my drink order. Another 10 min. passed by before the beer came. Needless to say, I was not too happy with the service, especially with two kids yearning for some schnitzel.

The authentic German food was OK.
Have been before as we live in Alameda. We also go for the music. Great German food and all the different beers.

We go to Speiskammer to hear Jinx Jones and have dinner. Previous times the food has been very good. This time, however, it was not. Specifically the weiner schnitzel was way overdone and the meat in the cabbage roll was dry and over spiced. Not at all a good experince for the entree. The apple strudel dessert was quite good, however, as was the beet salad.
Great German beers on tap. And truly delicious German food.
better than the usual wonderful ...fantastic! Love this place ... great food, wonderful atmosphere ... fabulous beer ... what more could you ask for?

My boss arranged a dinner for(10) of us at Speisekammer, which was a bit of a trek from our office in Pleasanton. There was some grumbling regarding the distance of the selected restaurant, but turned out to be a real treat. I love German food, and this place serves the best in the area. Some of the dinner guests didn't think they liked German food, but were pleasantly surprised as they discovered they even liked sauerkraut. We shared Nuremberger/sauerkraut appetizers (imported from Nuremberg) and the potato pancakes were a big hit. Great evening.
Fantastic service, the food was as always amazing. Love this place!!!

This was our 3rd visit to Seisekammer and we enjoyed it thoroughly. We particularly appreciated the "Recession Menu". On the Recession Menu everything is 1/2 order and 1/2 price. This is unsual. With 1/2 orders elsewhere you don't get fully 1/2 off on the price. Before we really thought there was too much food. This way we both ordered the 1/2 orders and an additional side dish/appetizer. We had the Smoked Trout Salad. It was excellent. For an entree I had the Weiner Schnitzel and my wife had the Beef Sourbraten. The quantity seemed just right and the quality was excellent. My wife wants to try the pork saurbraten next time.

We went on a Sunday, and it was not crowded or noisy . The German beer choice is extensive & good.
Great restaurant, if you're in the mood for German food like your Oma (grand mother) used to make. They have it all and there's even an item for the vegetarians. Don't skimp on the beer or desert.
Phenomenal! Everything was superb!

If you are looking for authentic German eats and drinks - this is it. And if you come on a weekend night you can check out a fun and lively music and bar scene that borders on Rockabilly/Swing. I can't wait to check it out in the summer when the Biergarten is open. I would definitely go back.
We had a great experience at Speisekammer! The Venison with Plum sauce was excellent and something unusual and different that you can't get everywhere. We'll be back!

Usually we eat like four times a year at Speisekammer. It's a long way to drive for us. We like the food and the beer. I'm german and feel like home when I'm going there. Around Christmas we go with a group for a holiday dinner. Otherwise we go with friends in a small group. Always good Service and always wonderful food. The menue changed and we are missing a few dishes what we liked a lot. (Zigeuner Schnitzel, Pfannkuchen and Rouladen)Around Christmas / New Year they have Gluehwein, which is really good. Hope this restaurant stays in business for a very long time.
It is really good if you haven't been to Germany recently and are missing good German cuisine. But if you just returned from Germany, not so good.  :)

We eat at Speisekammer for specific things: spaetzle, sausages, sauerkraut, and the homemade applesauce (delectably tart-sweet) served with the potato pancakes. We like having a choice of plate sizes, too. Food comes out fast and service is always cheerful. It's a homey, comfortable kind of place that is a world away (thankfully) from the crowded-elbow, trendy bistros everywhere. Long live German comfort food!

We had sauerbrauten and spaetzle which were delish. This is ethnic German cuisine and very good. From the breads on the table served warm with a garlic butter to the excellent german beers it was a hearty meal. I love spaetzle which they did with a black forest ham and it was really good. Excellent mustards for my husbands appetizer of sausage. I would be a brun hilde if I ate there always but I really enjoyed our meal.
Hearty, flavorful food at very reasonable prices. If I lived in the neighborhood, I'd be a regular here.
Staff was great, food delicious, a definite must! Thanks for the gluten free choices.

This is the last time I'll be going to this local place. We were the only ones there, we eat early. I specifically, in my reservation, asked for a table near their fireplace in the back. What happens? She doesn't bother to look up the reservation and then seats us at a table near large cold windows and the front door so we'll feel every breeze that comes through. So I ask my waiter if they can turn on the heater and he says they did and that was the warmest room in the place. Really? The room with the fireplace isn't just a bit warmer than the room with the front door & large windows? The service has ALWAYS been bad here. Then the very next two groups asked to be seated whereever it was warmest and they were seated near the fireplace!

We were a group of 7 there for a birthday lunch.  The surroundings were pleasant and casual.  We were pleased with the weiner schnitzels, all the potato dishes -- mashed potato, french fries, home fries with bacon were good.  Eaters were also happy with their bratwurst sandwich with sauerkraut, yeager schnitzel, schweinerbraten, and stuffed cabbaged.  The only unhappy eater was the person who ordered the crabsandwich.  Better to stick with the classic dishes.
Good food, service on Christmas Eve was poor.
We had a lovely evening with our group of six. Food was delicious as always,you have to have the potato pancakes. Our weighter was extremely busy and still attentive.

After a bad experience, being seated next to an inconsiderate table who let their kids bang on the benches and scream at the top of their lungs, we had a great dinner with good service at a friendly quietish table where nearby tables talked in normal voices. The gluvine is great this time of year and the goose special was lovely. Recommended.

We loved the food, but the only factor that stops us from giving this restaurant a full 5 stars overall was the noise level. Energetic with a vengeance. No point in even attempting conversation. The server had a hard time understanding our order (don't know why) but she did return several times for clarification--a good sign. Thank you. I should add tho that I found the menu items a bit expensive. So, will we go back? Have to balance to quality of the food against the expense and the noise. Probably not.
Off night for this restaurant - portions were small, some sand in the greens, service was fair but not great.

Beer selections: outstanding. Appetizers: Nürnberger Bratwurstchen, Gebeitzter Lachs, Reibekuchen - excellent. Entrées: server delivery mixups AND: Sauerbraten - ordinary; venison osso bucco special, expected to be very tender with the meat falling away from the bone, juicy, filled with flavor, but it was rubbery, stuck to the bone, and not flavorful at all; Wiener Schnitzel mit Kalbfleisch arrived with cottage fried potatoes rather than roasted potatoes, and rather than the expected large thin crisp hot golden piece of tender veal there were two oily 3/4" thick, brown, breaded pieces of very dry, ordinary meat, and no berry jam. Excellent Apfel Strudel. Very mixed and disappointing evening. Not sure I'll be back.

This was our first time there. The potato pancakes were clearly the stars of the meal, and the daily special leg of lamb beat out the roasted pork from the regular menu. I also thoroughly enjoyed the sauerkraut; *huge* improvement over the canned stuff. Duh! My date was unfamiliar with the beer offerings and asked for small samples of two to taste, but decided she didn't care for either and ordered two different cocktails over the course of the meal, both of which seemed uninspired. She really would have liked to continue sampling beers until she found one she liked, but felt uncomfortable asking the server to provide that for her. It would be nice if tasting samples of multiple beers were available as a menu item.

Excellent German food and beer, great service and an outdoor patio where you can dine with your dog. Also kid friendly. They let us try tasters of 3 different German beers so that we could be sure we liked what we ordered. I had the bratwurst, sauerkraut and mashed potatoes; my husband had the sauerbraten--both were authentic, traditional Southern German-style dishes. They were well-prepared with interesting flavors that paired well with the German beer. My husband offered his highest compliment, "This is just like Grandma's". We ordered off of the "recession menu" half portions at half the price but all the taste. This place is a great neighborhood find, but is worth the drive even if you don't live in the area.

The food was just okay. Definately nothing to write home about. The crowd has changed. It was once a classy place to have dinner with a date. But there are a few questionable patrons that have found this establishment whick makes this place look like a dive.

Place has the best beer on tap that you can only get at a few other places in the bay area. The food is usually great though last time I went in October it wasn't very good. They have great live music. The parking for this place is a bit difficult. Overall this is a great place to eat and drink in my opinion the best beer you can find in the bay area.

The service was excellent and it came pretty close in ambiance to an actual German Guesthouse. While the food was good, it was not as truely authentic German as we would have liked (certain things seemed "Americanized"). Because we had to drive a pretty good distance to get here we probably wont be coming back regularly, but may return occasionally.
Nice neighborhood feel, good service and interesting menu.
Love it! Great food and fabulous atmosphere! The usual wonderful and friendly service! Can't wait to go back!!!

This was my first visit to Speisekammer and it happened to be for Oktoberfest. I went with 2 friends and we ordered up a great set of sides and entree's and had some excellent bier! I thoroughly enjoyed my experience there and will definitely be going back. I am curios how the the place is on a friday or saturday evening.

My only complaint is the cost of some of the food, which they do offer a half menu for a lower price. But to be honest, most people probably do not order from it, lest they leave hungry.
The food was very authentic. We were expecting some german music as it was oktoberfest, but the band was sitting having lunch. Service was only moderate and it was not busy.
Good food and nice to have great beer on tap..
The Oktoberfest festivities were very fun here, I highly recommend it!

Beer is great, particularly the German brew on tap.

Food is authentic German, but the taste is just OK. Wiener Schnitzel was a little too dry. The sauces on the Currywurst and Schweinbraten are a bit too thick.

So it would be a good place to go for a beer at its beer garden; and perhaps one should not have too high an expectation for its food.
Beer was great. Food was great. Dessert was delicious. Service was only ok.

This is not your usual heavy, fatty German food. Ingredients are fresh and preparation is excellent-- Gourmet German if you will. Right now they have a recession menu too which has many of the favorite dishes in smaller portions for a reduced rate. It makes this a great time to go and try a number of different things to decide what you like best. Our favorites are the beet salad, the sauerbraten, potato pancakes, and believe it or not there is an amazing vegetable streudel. For you beer lovers they also have an extensive beer list, and knowledgeable waitstaff when it comes to the beer. We've taken a number of people here and everyone has loved it.

Love the new recession menu .... smaller portion at smaller prices. Was perfect! Went there for a friend's birthday and it was perfect. Great service and food and even a complimentary glass of schnapps for the birthday person.

Speisekammer's German cuisine is delicious, authentic, and continues to get better and better. The wine list is rich in unusual selections not only from German and Austria but also from lesser known California and New Zealand producers. Each time we dine there, we go with high expectations, and Speisekammer delivers beyond those expectations every time. If you like German cuisine or are curious to get to know this frequently and unfairly dismissed take on the products of Northern and Middle Europe, don't miss Speisekammer. This isn't meat-and-potatoes heaviness; it's flavorful, hearty, and surprising.

The food was excellent, as always. Pork is a real specialty here. Service was generally very good, but with a glitch - our entrees arrived just a minute or so after our appetizer. Overall, though, an excellent experience. Speisekammer is one of our favorite places in Alameda.

Although our server seemed annoyed to be serving us, we ended up having a great time here. The food isn't as good as the German restaurants in the City but still pretty good. We enjoyed ourselves and enjoyed the food. The beer is excellent as was the entertainment for that night. If you're a vegetarian, make sure to ask if the side dishes are vegetarian as well. I ended up eating bits of bacon in my sauerkraut that night.

We have been to this restaurant many times, and will probably go many more. We like to bring out of town guests here as they have great food and it's an unusual dining experience. The past couple of times, as well as this time, the service was very slow and not very friendly. When we arrived, with reservations, there were not a lot of people there. We were seated at least 10 minutes before our drink orders were even taken. Many people that worked there looked at us, like, is that my table? that's not my table, and then stood by the bar waiting. I asked our waiter about a wine and he just kind of shrugged his shoulders. As we were there a while the place did became very busy, and our service remained the same.

Went to Speisekammer again with our German friends who were pining for good Schnitzel. Our favorites are the Jaegerschnitzel (with mushrooms). We were not disappointed with our experience. The food is always good, selection of beers great, and music was excellent. We sat out in the garden after dinner to enjoy the evening and hear the music.
Wonderful food, beer and wine options. Very professional service. Dreadful euro music playing while bar TV covered soccer.
Will be back for the sausage and beer again.

We went early, so there was no action, but food was wonderful...loved the cheese plate which was easily shared by our group of 5. Our outdoor table was a little narrow, but absolutely no other complaints. Everyone in our party liked their entrees. We will certainly go again.
Chris
The service was very slow, but that's the first time out of 6+, so we'll let it slide.
Authentic German food. A real delight to find.
Consistenly excellent food! Love this place!

We booked an evening at Speisekammer to listen to a local favorite Le Jazz Hot. Being from German heritage, we looked forward to a European flair and found the atmosphere warming and a fun crowd. We're certain to return and also want to explore the business district down Lincoln St.
Food is great as always. Beer is outstanding. Ambiance is fun & loud. Service is friendly but often slow when they're busy so don't go if you're in a rush.
I usually love this place but the food and service weren't quite as good that night. I will come back but it was slightly disappointing.

Wonderful German restaurant with truly authentic and fantastically home-made food. My German-born mother said she's never had better German food in 30 years of living in the US. The 'recession' menu is a great idea!

Good choice if you want hearty German food and lots of good beer. The restaurant is roughly divided into two rooms. The front room has the bar and live music, and it's lively and loud. The back room is expansive with large tables on the sides so it's good for groups and families with kids. But don't expect the back room to be any quieter than the front.

Naturally, the food is the same in both rooms, and it's good! My pork chop was delicious. I topped it off with a couple of half-liter beers (they have several German ones on tap) and left a happy and full customer.

There's also outdoor seating facing the street, a good option in the warm summer nights.

Loved the food. The beers were excellent. A little difficult to hear if you are next to the bar, but it is a wonderful bar scene, with good music.
Wish the serving of potatoes with the weinerschnizle were larger! It was so yummy. The beets are to die for.

OMG! The food was awesome!!!
Sat outside so g.friends could smoke.Smoked trout appetizer w/spinach was perfect! The beet salad the three of us fought over,beware you are purple the next day in the restroom! ha ha (true!)G.friends salmon dish was a generous portion,cooked to perfection. My other g.friend had the pork sandwich,breaded cutlet on french bread,also a generous portion & THE MOST TENDER any of us has ever had! It was perfectly lightly breaded,just so moist & flaky.
I had the signature spatzel dish that was SOOOO YUMMY I felt too guilty eating it all & brought some home to my hubby who is a mac & cheese fanantic. I ordered it with the ham. Our favorite was the apple beer! The servers are attentive & informative!

We love German food and there are not many German restaurants in the East Bay so we enjoy coming here. Overall, our experience for this occasion was very positive with a few minor glitches - the first one being that the wine we ordered off the wine list could not be found in their wine cellar and the second being that the dinner (in this case, Bratwurst) for one of our party of 3 arrived much,later than the other two dinners so this guest had to watch us eat (else our food would have cooled) while she nibbled on the rest of her salad - and then, of course, we others were done before she was half-way through. On the plus side, the waitress - very pleasant and willing to please - brought us complimentary apple-schnapps at dinner's end.
Not the most authentic German food I've had, but it was still delicious. The beer and wine lists were awesome and the restaurant had a really nice atmosphere. Will definitely go back.
This was our second Mother's Day lunch here. Excellent German food and beer. Service was a bit slow, but considering the date, great weather and number of patrons it was expected.

Speisekammer is an old-fashioned place with prices to match: a true bargain these days. Great sauerkraut and homemade bratwurst, wonderful pork in beer. New half-portion menu is very price-conscious; a nice way to introduce German food to newbies. Roast chicken is enormous and perfectly cooked. Potato pancakes with housemade applesauce shouldn't be missed. We travel from the Oakland Hills area for their spaetzle!
This -is- a neighborhood gem and quite authentic. The food is great, wish the servers spoke German but that would be icing on the cake. Really enjoy the biergarten ambience and the "Recession Menu".
The pirate party on the first friday of the month is a must! Food was fantastic, and so many great beers!

The food was good as leftovers. I had ordered off their recession menu as well as the regular menu. The appetizer came first which took about 20 minutes which was fine; however, the other 2 entrees took 1 hour! Although the place was busy for the "Dining Out for Life" fundraiser, the waiter did not apologize for the delay, only until after we were starving and asked for a second basket of bread. Second of all, a party of 4 that sat down after us received their food before us, unbelieveable. We only had a party of 2. I was ready to leave the restaurant and not wait for our entrees. If it was not for the fact of the fundraiser, I would not have stayed or even left a decent amount of tip. I will probably not recommend this place.
German cuisine based menu. Excellently prepared, but the food came to the table only just warm; should have not waited so long in the kitchen after plating.
We always like coming here for special occasions. Not just great German food, but great food, period.
Fun German food and beer.  Traditional favorites. Reasonable prices.   Absolutely leave room for the bock.

After living in Alameda for over four years, I never even bothered to check this place out, because I assumed I didn't like German food too much. Then, after a trip to Berlin during which I had some truly fantastic food, I couldn't wait to get home and see if I had similar options in my backward. The food was wonderful, though slightly less perfect than what I had in Berlin. The portion size differences, however, were dramatic. In Germany you really get massive potions, but here I got what seemed like appetizer portions by comparison. Still, it was enjoyable and definitely someplace I will return to to make up for four lost years of ignoring it.

We love authentic German food and the chefs at Speisekammer have kicked it up a notch with flavor, particularly in the sauces which accompany most dishes. The Jaegerschnitzel is tender and hearty with a rich mushroom sauce and the Schwein-Hoxen will melt in your mouth. Located in the Alameda suburbs, parking can be a challenge so go early and give yourself time to park and walk. It will be worth the extra effort.
Great place!! Good food and beer.Staff was great!!!

I love going to Speisekammer! I get the same thing every time, the weinerschnitzel, roasted potatoes, and red cabbage. Always super yummy with enough left over for me to have lunch the next day. The potato pancakes are delicious as well. I've never gotten dessert because I'm always too full but others in my party have and always rave about how good it is.
Good authentic German cuisine. Right now they have a budget friendly recession menu..1/2 the price for entrees.

We went with friends. They were skeptical about the "german" food -- however, we all were pleasantly surprised with the quality and all enjoyed our meals. My husband is a "french" fry guy and he really liked the german fries! I especially liked the recession menu as it gave me a chance to try 2 things. Drinks were good too! I would go back if I was in the area.

I went to see Le Jazz Hot and was pleasantly surprised with the restaurant. I had seen Hot Club of San Francisco at Yoshi's and appreciated the restaurants small setting. I ate off the recession menu which served half portions which I found to be a perfect portion.

Nice service. Great Beer, good food. Liked the "recession" portions on the menu-it allowed us to sample more stuff.
Liked the music too- the Porch Flies.

We made this reservation for a Friday evening birthday dinner - a group of 6. After other visits to the restaurant with long waits, it was great to walk in, present my reservation, and go right to the table. They even remembered the high chair for our toddler.

The food was wonderful. I had the sauerbraten, a perennial favorite. My husband had the schweinbraten - tender enough to cut with a fork.

The service was fairly attentive - lots of water refills - but the food is never fast at Spesekammer.

The noise was a bit much - the live music in the next room was ok, but the carousing group across the aisle from us was very loud. Couldn't they have been closer to the bar?
The food and service are great. I love the atmosphere, it reminds me of the gasthaus's in Germany.

Since the German food is prepared in a fairly authentic manner, we almost always enjoy our meal at Speisekammer, and it's always been a hit with out-of-towners we take there. Our experience on Valentine's Day was fine with the unexpected bonus of prompt service even though it was a pretty busy night. The lengthy waits between ordering and getting served that we've experienced in the past had always been the main drawback to our enjoyment of dining there. The bar is also a plus - good cocktails and good choice of wines & beers.
Table turned in 25 minutes...did I smell funny?
if you want German food - this is the place to go.
This place is fantastic. We are so glad to have found it.

The best German food I've had since Munich! The semmel, baked spaetzle with emmentaler, and wienerschnitzel were perfectly authentic. And the desserts were to die for!!! We had three and shared--apricot crisp, pear torte, and apfelstrudel...oh, the apfelstrudel...I can't even describe how delicious it was!

Geat place! My husband and I have been looking for a good german restaurant for ages and only now we found it! Food is delicious, service is nice, friendly and efficient. We were there on the first Friday of the month and had a lot of fun with all those "pirates" and the live music. We definitely felt at home and we are planning to go back soon for lunch and take the kids with us, since we are sure they will love the food.

I love this restaurant. We go there for special occasions. The wait staff is SO terrific! Very attentive and friendly. The food is always top notch. The night we were there recently was "pirate night" -- lots of music, people (dressed as pirates, of course), and singing. Though we weren't appropriately attired, we had a lot of fun!

HI there,

Overall my experience was really good as reflected in my ratings. What's happening, though, with the chocolate mousse-type dessert? It is decidedly not as good as it used to be. My palate says you have reduced the amount of cocoa in the recipe and have added coffee and sugar to stretch. The serving is also larger than before. Go back to the original recipe, make the serving smaller, and even charge more if you need to. It was one of the most outstanding desserts I have ever had. As it stands now, though, I would not order it again.

The schnitzel was especially good -- great veal -- tender and tasty.

Best to you, Rosalie Torres
Great German food and hospitality. Good size portions - no one was hungry after! We all knew we'd be going back. A Great find. The Orange Ginger soda was excellent. The cheesy spatzle was awesome.

Authenic German cooking!

Warmer environment than their SF location on Hayes Street.
Food was very reminiscent of the food in Bavaria. The Nurnburg sausages are authentic and the German beers on tap was exceptionally good.
This place continues to be a favorite.

Not much variety in the menu - mostly pork and potatoes. Food was over-salted and the mashed potatoes were grainy, not creamy. Apple strudel was too small and evidently microwaved. My chair was uncomfortable. However, the service was good.

We've been going to Speisekammer for years and it really says a lot about the restaurant because we live about 30 minutes away and we're willing to drive all the way out to Alameda. This restaurant is a true rarity and I haven't found many other German restaurants around the area that I live in, let alone authentic German cuisine. I absolutely love the ambiance but it's the food that keeps me coming back. I get the wiener schnitzl every time! I would wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for some good food.

We celebrated a birtday party here. The staff was unfailingly friendly and very competent; the food was delicious and very authentic. My only regrets were that the place is acoustically bright and very loud; and that, though the cuisine is delightfully authentic German, the atmosphere is less so.
the additional 8:30 music was lot's of fun and entertainement for our group of 7 and kept us there much longer than just for the usual dinner time ... consuming more beer while tapping to the beat!

This was a fun, friendly and cheerful Alameda spot. Great beer selection and lots of classic German dishes. The atmosphere was lively and everyone seemed to be having a great time. It is a nice place for a casual celebration -- not fancy, but a good convivial atmosphere!!
Go for lunch. Get the Weisswurst and a half litre of Trumer Pils!
Love the beers!!!

There was a wedding party in the room next to us. They spilled out into our room and we could not hear the person across or next to us speak. We understood that they could not control the wedding guests but it was still very loud.

It took a long time for us to get our food and drinks. Overall the service was ok but you expect more when you are spending the money we did.

The food was very good once we got it. This is an improvement over last year so we were happy. We come at least once a year for a family dinner. We also say that we are going to come on date night inbetween but never quiet make it.

Food was really good as usual. I Liked the Recession menu, because this was enough food for an evening menu. Really good idea.
Will come again, and again.

What happened to the food here? I have not eaten in Speisekammer in 2 years and the recipes and food have changed significantly. Has this place lost their chef or changed ownership? I was disappointed in the sauerbraten compared to how they use to serve it. This place use to have the best potato pancakes. The apple strudel for dessert was awful. Everything is so different. The food use to be the best German I've ever had and now, sigh, it is just good.
What a tremendous disappointment.
We had the snitzel sandwich and in our opinion there was way too much bread for the sandwich; also we found the meals to be pricey.

Great beer selection and very good specials - plus the wienerschnitzel is always perfect. If you want a huge tankard of great german beer this is the place - sometimes a little slow but the food is fresh and hot (And HUGE portions!)

Good ol' German food and excellent selection of beers, ales, etc.  The decor is kinda ugly, as is the view from the patio, but you don't really notice.  I wish I had the stomach capacity to order one of everything on the menu.
Really disappointing beer menu--very underwhelming. Service extremely slow, although friendly. Food bland, not particularly interesting. Disappointment all around.

If you're looking for authentic German, this is it. I felt like I was back in Frankfurt! Food is better than expected and though a little pricey, worth going if you're hankering for a real taste of Germany!

Really hearty foods done with care. The specials never disappoint and the regular menu has no bad choices.

The owners do a great job of hiring wait staff. They are always very attentive and immediately make you feel comfortable.

German cuisine is uncommon in the Bay Area, where residents dismiss it as "meat and potatoes" fare. Speisekammer gives the lie to that characterization. Speisekammer provides highly flavorful, well balanced dishes: to wit, the beef-stuffed cabbage rolls with a piquant light sauce with creamy mashed (yes) potatoes, or the Sauerbraten with red cabbage, or pork or veal schnitzel, or the heirloom tomato salad with goat cheese and herbed dressing. (Germans enjoy light, flavorful seasonal food, too.) The food has been on a constant upward trajectory for the past five years, and I have yet to sense one even mild mis-step in the kitchen. The wine list is surprising, sharing many unknown German and Austrian wines along side the Cal-French regulars.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in Alameda, CA. It's very unique and they have German music playing in the background.  It's a great place to hang out afterwork and for birthdays or celebrations.  The noise level is from people talking, so it's a great place if you're a loud talker, or even a place for if you're shy and want to listen to others.  It can be casual, or it can be formal. I love the outdoor seating option, and I love that you can choose to be at or near the bar, or go further in the restaurant where there are more options.  We LOVE this place.

When we arrived, the hostess had no record of our reservation.
Food is very good but service is HORRIBLE!  Waitresses are crabby, rushed, unfriendly & 
lack people skills.  Waited forever for water refill and second beer round. 
Waited 15 minutes for waitress to return for the dessert order.  When the ice cream was received,it tasted like it had sand in it and the waitress commented something like, "Well, I didn't
make it--so I dont know what to tell you!"  (I'm serious, that's what her 
response was!) No offer to substitute. I sent an email to the manager--no response.
Will never return. And neither will any of our friends.  Their loss.

Good selection of beers.  Biergarten sitting area in front on a quiet street.  Generous size servings of delicious food.  Potato pancakes reminded me of Hong Kong style fried noodles with a good potato flavor and good homemade applesauce.  All the usual type German dishes and several vegetarian selections.  Also had an interesting jazz group that evening.  Staff is very friendly and helpful.
This is a lovely restaurant!  Parking can be a challenge but the food is well worth any effort that might take.  It was a great place to celebrate my birthday with out of town guests.  Thanks!

Service was some of the best we've had recently.

We dined early, during the first hour the restaurant was open, and it was a truly
pleasant and personal experience since there were not too many other patrons.

We will definitely go again, my father was happy to see a soccer match being
aired on the TV!  It will be fun to dine during a different time, to see the
restaurant in a different time period.  Food was nicely presented, however,
we were hoping for a traditional warm German potato salad, which is a favorite
of my father's.  The beer selection is great, and my five year old daughter felt
very comfortable and included in the dining experience.

Very fine German food paired with an excellent choice of German, Austrian, and American wines. Many great German beers on tap as well. Don't miss the Shinken plate with two special air dried hams, or the shnitzel. Beautiful wursts as well.

Had the worst service we've had in a Bay area restaurant.  It took 25 minutes to be greeted.  Food was slow coming out and then we waited 30 minutes to be cleared and offered dessert.  When the waitress finally offered to take out dessert order and I declined because of the long wait, she stormed away got my check and plopped it on the table.  Since we had a party of "6 or more" tip was included.  I then understood why we had received such bad service.  Food is average and has seems to be inching downhill.
It's great to have a good German Restaurant in the East Bay.  They have a nice little patio area for eating or toasting with a good German beer.  Charming decor with good specialties.
Speisekammer comes very close to the food I was used to while living in Germany - especially the salad [although, they have downsized them which is a dissapointment] and schnitzel.
Authentic german food in a fun and casual atmosphere with an extensive beer and wine list.
authentic German food and great selection of German beers on draft.
Their weekend musical groups are great!  The music is not typically German as one would expect but revolves around the Ukulele or other acoustic instruments.

As there are little venues for German cuisine, I found Speisekammer alright, but not particularly outstanding. The Weiner Schnitzel was lackluster as were all the dishes we had. I fin the most memorable part of our dinner was the ample beer selection. Dinner entertainment was reminiscent of New Orleans rather than your stereotypical "German" band which was expected given overall ambiance. I don't know if I would come back for dinner, though it seems like a good place for a nice stein of beer on a warm summer day.
We love Speisekammer!

The service wasn't as good as normal, but it was dining out for life that night and extra busy.  That won't keep me from coming back again.  There were 7 of us and we chose Speisekammer because they were donating more than the average to Dining out for life.  Bravo!  We will be back even when it is not a special occasion.  The food was fantastic.

Great ambiance and great spot for that special occasion that can only be celebrated with a German meal!  People are friendly and welcoming to the younder guests of the group.  When the weather is nice and hot, the outdoor area becomes ideal for outdoor dining.

Would totally go back!

We are from Livermore and visit Speisekammer 3 or 4 times a year. We like the food a lot and THE BEER. I'm german and feel home with this good beer and excellent food. Last time the menu was a little bit bigger. Missed the Gulasch and Kassler on it. Will be going again soon. They do a wonderful job.
Best German food around!
It was a nice, very tidy restaurant with friednly and attentive service and good food.  If you crave some hearty German food with a good beer it's a neat place to go in the East Bay!

The food is always good... solid and consistent.
They also have live music, which we really enjoyed.
Service is stellar...
Overall Speisekammer really is a 'gem.'

Entrees are the $15.50 - $23.50 range; fresh ingredients, and well-balanced tastes.  Meats are fork-tender, but portions are meager.  Good brews on tap.  Service is friendly, but s-l-o-w.  Lunch for four: $120+tip
A lot of fun. Large portions, very nice servers and good music.
When the weather is nice, it's so lovely to sit outside, drink a cold beer and eat some saurkraut. A great spot.

The food was good.  We had outstanding service.  With four little ones, the server was patient and accommodating and made us feel very comfortable.  The table reserved was thoughtful and considerate of the request I made on the reservation request page.  We'll certainly be back!
Absolutely fantastic experience. Between the food, great beer selection and the spectacular music from the live band, you can't go wrong!! We will most certainly go back soon and often!
Truly a rare find - a restaurant that serves GOOD German food!

The food is consistently good at Speisekammer and the service is always excellent. Warm, relaxed atmosphere and definitely kid friendly. We had a family dinner here with a large party including two active toddlers. The staff was friendly and food served in a timely manner. We didn't feel rushed or like we were waiting around for our meals. A well run restaurant with delicious German food.
We thoroughly enjoyed our dinner at Speisekammer. There were great beer choices and excellent food. We'll be sure to go back!

I've been there twice now, both times with groups of about a dozen.  I love this place!  They have wonderful food, a fabulous selection of beers and cocktails, and great service.  Vegetarians have two amazingly delicious entrees to choose from, as well as an appetizer large enough to be a meal for one person.  I definitely plan to go back there, and I recommend it to friends often.
Very good dinner. Great beer. good food
good fun, but has been better. They have unique bands on the weekends and lots of great beers.
One of my favorite Alameda restaurants.  They have excellent vegetarian options, especially the spazele with emethaler cheese, the perfect comfort food.  Excellent beer and wine list.

Service is outstanding!  Food is hearty, delicious and well-prepared. We had a very large, diverse group (adults, kids, older adults) and they were very accommodating with our menu and everyone had a great time.  My dog was waiting for us outside, and I went to check on her when it began to rain I found the staff had already put an umbrella over her so that she wouldn't get wet. SO GREAT!! On Fridays(?) they have GOOD, live entertainment. I had to leave just before they came on, but I am pretty sure they had a Japanese polka band one night.  Speisekammer is versatile.  I've been here for dates, for a large parties and for power lunches.  Worked well for all occasions.  Highly recommend the spaeztle.

We loved this restaurant. The red cabbage,the beer,the trout,the potato pancakes -all excellent. The service was warm and personal.  The restaurant is an an old house. Very charming. Our only complaint is the lack of parking in this residential neighborhood.
Best German food in the East Bay!

name: La Fontaine Restaurant
description: Spiced with the flavors of France and Italy, La Fontaine serves an array of pasta dishes, entrees (chicken, veal, or fish) and seafood specialties. Whether you're craving something creamy, tomato-based or succulent, there's a dish for everyone to enjoy.
hours:
Lunch
Daily 11:30 am–2:00 pm
Dinner
Mon, Sun 5:00 pm–9:00 pm
Tue–Sat 5:00 pm–9:30 pm

reviews.text: Great service and the food was excellent.  The ambiance is great for a quiet dinner or a lively group.

Love La Fontaine. It’s my neighborhood goto restaurant when I want an upscale experience and food without a high price. This visit was with my extended family.
We were seated in the window where ch they know I prefer. We had a variety of cocktails to start with. Mine was Black Shadow which is refreshing for a whiskey drink. Next was bruschetta, two orders because you get 4 in each order. The bruschetta is a nice, light appetizer. Yummy but doesn’t fill me up. La Fontaine salad is my go to but sometimes I get the strawberry spinach salad. After that was  my favorite, cavatelli pasta with meatballs. The rest of us got branzino, ravioli, orecchiette pasta, steak frites. My husband went vegetarian and had capellini pomodoro and a side of vegetables. We went for dessert and coffee and had a mago cake and lava cake. Such a lovely evening with perfectly paced food, great service from Dee Dee and fab food.
The beef Wellington was beautiful and delicious.

Quick service and good food ! Quiet restaurant
Good for small gathering

La Fontaine is one of the most consistent restaurants in Mt. View downtown; great service and fantastic food.  We have gone to other restaurants and order similar dishes in the past; but La Fontaine's food always ride above them over and over again!  Highly recommended!

We were greeted by a very cheerful hostess who wished my son Happy Birthday as we came in the door. It was such a great way to start the night. The food was excellent and service very good. At the end of the meal my son was presented with a nice dessert with a candle, which was a very thoughtful touch. Very enjoyable and delicious dinner.
A perfect dinner from start to finish. We  had the duck and branzino. Flawless preparation and presentation. Lava cake and coffee to top it off. Friendly professional service as well.

Went for Valentine’s Day event. The beef Wellington was excellent, the staff were extremely friendly and really added some flare to the holiday with complimentary champagne, a balloon release and allowing people to take home the rose at the table. LGBT friendly. The octopus tasted a little off and felt like it was either frozen previously or not fresh. Portion sizes felt a bit small. Overall very good and recommend for special occasion or wanting to impress while having a sense like you are like part of their family.

These guys at La Fontaine are great. They always deliver on service and quality, especially service. If I ever eat at other “fancy type” places, a thought always crosses my mind that I could be getting more and better flavor for less money and treated better at La Fontaine. Cocktails are great too.
Food was excellent and the service was great would recommend the lobster pasta .
The service is impeccable! The food is well priced and well up to our standard!
All three of us enjoyed our before-the-theater dinners. An outstanding waiter sealed the deal!
Wonderful experience, with spectacular food and service.

RE: lunch. Portions were generous. Service staff was polite and attentive. Food was nicely seasoned but not "over-dressed" or dull (which can be the case, for example, in salads that are included.) Fries were to die for! very thinly cut, so the crispiness, not mushy inside, prevailed. And they were obviously fresh from the pan. I will definitely be introducing friends to this restaurant and hope they have success on Castro Street, where many establishments don't seem to be making it.
We enjoy the good food and spot on cocktails.  Our wait person went above and beyond to see if we can change the sauce on an entree.   La Fontaine is consistent.  We will continue to revisit.

We visited the restaurant on New Year's Eve. Very nice, cozy, home style environment.The food is very good with excellent portions and freshness!  The seating could be a little bit better. It's really hard to hear someone sitting across from you as the tables are within arms length. Overall, I would recommend this restaurant if you are in the area looking for a very authentic dinner option.
Pleasant dinner with my husbands. Supperb service and wonderful food, never disappointed.
3 of the group got their $42 steak. It was 1/2 inch thick and it only came with French Fries. For that kind of money I would have expected a much better piece of meat
The food was ok. Nothing great. Service and ambience was good.

Really enjoyed our first time at La Fontaine. Split a spinach, strawberry salad and had branzino and duck breast for entrees. Great presentation on both dishes. The fish was perfectly prepared and accompanied by a nice selection of veggies and potatoes. The duck was tender and tasty in a cranberry sauce with black rice and asparagus. The chocolate lava cake for dessert was attractive and delicious. Add friendly and professional service in a well appointed space and you have a perfect dinner out
Our waitress was fantastic. We wanted for nothing. Great wine list. The food was delicious and plated beautifully. We had a great Christmas party. Thank you.
Overall quite a decent place. The food was delicious. The service was friendly. Parking is hard to find.

We dined at La Fontaine on Saturday night. I had the duck, and my wife had a pasta dish with seafood (pappardelle?). It was easily the best duck I've ever had, and my wife was very happy with her seafood. The restaurant is classy, clean, and quiet enough for a lovely conversation, and the service is excellent.

Good food and excellent service.  We were there for a birthday celebration and the waiter gave us the perfect amount of attention.  He was right there when we needed him, and left us alone to have fun otherwise!  Will go back for sure!

Came here for lunch with a friend.  The pizza that was recommended by the server was limo and soggy and laden with undercooked mushrooms, but not much of the other ingredients that were supposed to be on it.  I didn’t send it back because we didn’t have time, but probably will not go back again.

Loud to the point of unable to hear the conversation of  those at my table; there were just two of us at the table;  I had to send my order back because they didn't bring the right order (TWICE!).  I won't be back
Excellent Service!  We were a group of 13 and our service didn’t miss a beat.  Food was outstanding!  We will definitely go back!

La Fontaine is a nice restaurant and has been around for years. I met my friends for dinner to celebrate a birthday.  The bartender was great.  We all enjoyed our cocktails and food.  We will definitely return.
Exceptional service and great food.  The crab cakes did not disappoint. The boneless burgundy ribs were very tender and  flavorful. We will definitely come back for another date night.
It was a great lunch experience, Thank you for your service.
Beef Wellington is excellent! All the foods we ordered were very delicious. Best food in Mountain View!
Excellent Fresh Homemade Pastas.  Outside seating for our party was lovely and server was very attentive!

First time at this restaurant and will be back.  Very good and attentive service from Didem C.  Dinner (Branzino) was good in terms of food quantity, quality, and presentation.  Prices are Bay Area ridiculous, but not abnormal.  Menu has lots of appealing choices.  The entrees are more interesting than the appetizers and desserts which are more Italian/ Mediterranean focused (though the place does describe itself as cuisine provencale).  Outdoor seating a plus, though perhaps some music/flowers/plants to separate the place from the noodle soup next door would be nice.

The food and the service were exceptional (except when the old guy (manager or owner) swiped the chili right off our table without asking if we were done with it) but it was SUPER noisy in there. It was so loud we had trouble having a conversation.
The food was very good and very reasonable priced.
La Fontaine handled a large group dinner for me, and did not disappoint. Great service for a large group, and delicious food.

nice place
good service
great good
would go back there again
Love La Fontaine, we’ll be back! The outdoor tables were great and the service is excellent.

La Fontaine has been one of our favorite places for a group dinner for years. My wife always likes to start with the warm goat cheese and honey appetizer for the table. Service is always prompt yet friendly. As is often the case there were 6 of us with others joining at dessert. Outside on Castro avenue: Street noise is pretty good even with occasional passing trains a block or two away. Our table was probably more a source of noise, than bothered by it. Specials are always great. Wine choice excellent.

Nice Italian spot with cozy seating and fairly attentive service.  Waiter was engaging after the meal with a little napkin folding entertainment.  My homemade pasta with chicken and creamy sauce was good, and dinner mates enjoyed theirs as well.  I do give them a little mark down on their cocktail (Old Fashioned) though.  It was a Saturday night at 6.30 and we were seated immediately as the restaurant was not very full.  Their marketing/internet description says French and Italian, but I did not find many overtly French dishes.  I would consider going again.
Excellent meals, great service, very quiet.  Highly recommend.

This was our 2nd time here and it was even better than our 1st time. First thing we noticed is that the prices were lower than comparable restaurants. All the dishes we ordered were delicious. We each had leftovers to bring home. The best part of our evening was we had an awesome server. Normally we don't usually care about servers as long as we get our food served and nothing gets screwed up. He was a gem and made our dinner even more special. It's rare you get that server who loves what they're doing and is very knowledgeable, competent and personable. We love the evening vibe ambiance and the cocktails were perfect. Looking forward to going back again!
The service was great! Always smiling and very very quick with the food. My table finished the bread and they quickly brought more!

Before our reservations, we emailed the restaurant to ask if they could accommodate a guest with multiple food allergens. They responded right away and said yes! Upon our arrival, our waitstaff (Duman) was very patient waiting for our order because we were so busy acquainting ourselves. We never felt rushed and the person who poured our water was also very attentive. It was a great evening all around. It was our first time here and will definitely return and add it to our list of reliable restaurants!
The salmon entree was excellent.  And my son liked the chicken sandwich a lot.
Everything was ok. The food was average not perfect. The service was slow. in overal it was ok.

"Starter for two" was good, nicely presented,  good flavors.  Wines by the glass were reasonably priced.  However, I've made beef wellington myself that was far better - this was just filet mignon with a mediocre dough crust and mushroom gravy on top, bedded on top of mashed potatoes and some sautéed vegetables- disappointing and overpriced at $49.  The special pistachio crusted fish & shrimp was ok, but bland.  80s pop background music was occasionally annoying.  Probably will not return.
All the staff were very friendly and the service was on point.  The salad, soup and main courses were delicious!  We would definitely go back again.

We ordered a lunch appetizer (Antipasti) that was for two people, but the server gladly increased it to serve 3 of us. It was so substantial that we decided to split the ROASTED GARLIC MUSHROOM RAVIOLI among the 3 of us as our main course. There were 6 large ravioli and splitting it was perfect. 

We topped off the lunch by splitting one lava cake for dessert. Couldn't have been better!
Bad food don’t waste your time, but the service is good

Good appetizers and good entrees, and quite affordable
Well, definitely. Come again, enjoyed our dinner.

We were eating outside, so the ambience was exactly what we wanted, and it was relatively quiet. The breeze might have been too much for some people, but it was fine for us. The food was as delicious as ever; I thoroughly enjoyed the crab cakes, which I think are the best in the Mountain View area.  The server was perfect . . . attentive, even though we were possibly the only outdoor diners, and pleasant.

The chicken cordon bleu is fantastic. The beef Wellington was just ok. I should have ordered the steak frites. It’s a little $$$ at this restaurant. The staff is really really nice. It was too hot in the restaurant. They should have opened the back door.
Both food and service were great. The beet salad and cordon blue were delicious.

My favorite place to go when we visit Mountain view. I have been sending my mother pictures of the food for the last couple of years. I am glad she finally got to go and enjoyed herself. The food and the service always amazing.
Excellent, attentive, friendly service really good food good wine list, easily walkable and not very noisy. Great combination.￼
I love this restaurant!! We will definitely be going back!

Superb experience!  Wish I remembered the name of the server - he was spectacular and deserves props by name. Took one star off the food only because one of us four felt the food was nothing to write home about - but still, he had no complaints. We other three were thrilled with all of it. Plate presentation was top-notch; I had the branzino and was delighted with the picture-perfect plate. Likewise the duck breast and all the desserts. Beautiful and tasty. Don't hesitate, go check this place out!
Both hospitality and food are amazing! So happy we went with this restaurant for a birthday dinner!
Excellent Beef Wellington and salads. Nice restaurant.
Excellent service … and more important exquisite food. Highly recommended!
Great local, food and price
Every thing we had was delicious….Great service, our waiter and bus girl were awesome: definitely will be coming back.

The food is really good.  The bouillabaisse and pizza were fantastic.  There were lots of other items we want to go back and try.  The wait staff were friendly and very attentive.  I highly recommend going.
Our 55th Anniversary dinner was made special by the quality of the food and service.  La Fountaine has a wide variety of menu options sure to delight any palate.  Highly recommended.

We went for a family lunch here with a group ranging in age from 4 mos to 96. The staff was so accommodating, especially Paola our server. The appetizers were smallish and fine if nothing special, but the entrees were very good. Thank you for hosting us!
Excellent main course and dessert! The server was moderately attentive and the noise level wasn’t too loud or quiet. Would recommend!
Great food and very nice people! The Valentines Day ambiance is wonderful

The food was good and  the service was excellent.
Attention to details was appreciated
Lovely food with beautiful presentation. Service as friendly and professional. Will return!
Delicious food and wonderful service. This was my first time eating at La Fontaine. Will definitely return.
Radical, very kind staff, they helped my girlfriend clean up a bunch of water. Food was great!

We had dinner recently at La Fontaine. Reservations were easy to make and were in the relative timeframe I wanted. We got there early and were seated promptly, which was a good thing because unfortunately we were placed next to what turned out to be a party of about 14, so being seated early meant we were out of there by the time they all arrived and started ordering. Party of 14 notwithstanding, it was pretty noisy in the restaurant. Service was good, although I did have the forethought to ask for to-go boxes, dessert and the check at the same time since that was about when our neighbors started ordering in earnest.

We had calamari, beet salad, orecchiette, cavatelli meatballs and, for dessert, lava cake with a scoop of sea salted caramel gelato. (Allegedly. To me it tasted faintly of caramel but I did not find a hint of salt whatsoever.)

The calamari and my beet salad were delicious and the best parts of the meal. My husband enjoyed his pasta and meatballs. The orecchiette was EXTREMELY bacon-forward, even for a bacon-lover like me. It could have used less (much less) bacon and more peas. And oddly enough, even with all the bacon, it was pretty dry. Though the list price for the dessert is $10, I'm pretty sure I was charged $12, even though the menu online says there's a $1.50 split fee. I guess it's another way to make money, but what really was split? The miniscule dessert was served on one plate, so basically I was charged $2 for an extra spoon. Ridiculous.
Food was very good.  Had the beet salad, chicken risotto special, and casarecce calabrese.
Amazing restaurant with great service and great food !!!

Service and food was outstanding. We were pleasantly surprised how excellent the food was. Simple and well balanced flavors and the best beef wellington we've ever had. The beef was melt in your mouth tender with impeccable seasoning. Ravioli was so delicious and the pasta tasted fresh made and was cooked perfectly with sauce that tasted made from scratch. Our server was efficient & sweet and knew what she was doing. We had a lovely evening and will come back with more people.

We came for lunch to celebrate my mother's birthday. Our food and wine were excellent. Music was really nice, and they played it softly, so it was very easy to talk. Wonderful service. They provided a vase for the flowers, gave us a beautiful birthday cake, sang happy birthday with us,  and made some great pictures of our party! Thank you everyone for helping us celebrate!
Great soup, fresh bread, quick service. Excellent lunch choice on Castro Street in Mountain View.
Great service, barely mediocre food. Not worth the price at all.

So it can’t be overstated what a terrible snob I am for service. I’d rather have mediocre food with great service than the other way around.

This wasn’t my first time at La Fontaine - we come here most Christmas Eves the past several years.

First thing I need to say is that our service was fantastic. I wish that I knew the name of our server - fantastic lady though. Absolutely no complaints and I’m the one to complain typically. Perfect.

Food? Absolutely wonderful. I love their beef Wellington and this year was no different. Just perfect as was everyone’s order from drinks to food to desserts.

We will be back.
Incredibly flavorful food with excellent service. Would highly recommend for any occasion.
Great food and lovely service. Loved the drink menu too! We will definitely return.
Excellent dining experience. From service to food to ambience, it was a great experience.
Outstanding meal (beef wellington).  Service was excellent.  Looking forward to a return visit.
We had 4 different plates and they were all great. It was my birthday and the also presented me with a sweet treat. 👍👍🤓

This was our first time in nine years ever together having a date night and La Fontaine made it very memorable and easy for us.  The food was amazing!  The only thing I had a little reservation were the mashed potatoes.  Although they were delicious, there were a bit salty for me and I have developed Post Partum High Blood Pressure so the foods I eat must not have high levels of sodium.
Other than that, staff were very friendly and always checked on us and always filled our water/drinks.
We will come again on another special occasion!  This was for our anniversary:)
Food was served pipping hot and delicious! Service was excellent.
Good food and wine selection. Perfectly located downtown Mountain View.

Wonderful ambience and delicious food. Everything tasted delicious and very well prepared. Host and wait staff were very attentive to our needs, and even send us a birthday dessert on the house. Will definitely come back!

We had the wonderful pleasure of coming in for a late lunch, during the Christmas market. The service was wonderful and they were very accommodating for our toddler. The food was excellent, my wife and I ever much enjoyed our meals. Will return next time we are in the area.
I have been coming here for a few years. Food is always delicious and the service is friendly. I like that it’s more than your standard Italian fare.

Best restaurant in the area, in my opinion.   A varied menu, of really high quality.    (e.g. absolutely delicious grilled octopus and chicken cordon bleu).  And the service is ALWAYS outstanding, super-friendly, professional and inviting, without being intruding.
The tiramisu was amazing!!!!! We had a great time and exceptional service

The food and service were excellent! The short ribs were a big hit as well as the calamari appetizer.  We will definitely be back and will recommend it to others. Our server made our meal especially memorable!

La Fontaine is a great restaurant. I took my daughter for dinner to celebrate her birthday.  We had a nice table for two next to the window. The staff was excellent, attending to whatever we needed. The food was outstanding. I took my daughter here because it's the only place I've found locally that has Beef Wellington. I introduced her to it on a cruise a few years ago and she loved it.  I've been to the restaurant many times but this was her first. She was more than impressed by everything. It's a great place to enjoy a lunch or dinner.
Good location in Mountain View main street. Nice atmosphere. Excellent service. Very good dishes (bouillabaisse, and duck confit)

Wonderful food delivered by friendly staff.
I had veal meatballs and spinach salad that were delicious.
Top notch service. Our glasses were never empty which says a lot about their attention paid to customers.

I absolutely love good crab cakes, and the crab cakes at La Fontaine are the best I have ever eaten. I also really enjoyed the pistachio-encrusted goat cheese with honey. And the beet salad is always wonderful.

My gf and I were celebrating our joint birthday and both ordered the Beef Wellington. 
It was excellent as always! 
It is so unheard of to get Beef Wellington on the West Coast and we are delighted LF continues to serve this for dinner.

Our first time dining here after TheatreWorks play and we arrived at 5:30 for dinner, with hardly anyone inside except us. We were seated near the front window with a view of Castro Street foot traffic. We ordered calamari as the appetizer followed by shellfish Bouluvaisse, lamb chops, and Beef Wellington as entrees. Everything was delicious, although the crust on the beef was somewhat soggy instead of flaky. We will return to try other entrees on the menu in the near future.
Excellent outdoor dining for a large work group.  Good service, tasty food and nice outdoor setting.
food was good, service was super, except for a late delivery of the appetizer.

The place was elegant and had a decent amount of vegetarian options.

Mushroom ravioli was really outstanding and the desserts were good too.

We had a lovely time at the restaurant before heading to the Performing Arts Center for some ballet.  Table by the window with delicious cocktails and no rush.  The beet salad with arugula was terrific and the food was great.  A very nice spot in Mountain View.

Been coming to this restaurant for special occasions for many years. It is reliably good. This visit was for a birthday celebration and apart from the inconsiderate people on the next table discussing business at full volume it did not disappoint. Staff very attentive. Full bar with cocktails. Will continue to visit.

Pleasant restaurant, nice ambiance, quiet, comfortable, very good service, very attentive, but not too much so, food very good.  I had beet salad, lamb chops fig balsamic, and crème brulee.  All very good, though I requested lamb chops medium rare and they came closer to medium-well; still good, but too dry and some flavor lost.

Excellent Italian food.  I had a delicious pasta dish with fresh bacon, tomatoes, and peas.  We were waiting for the rest of our party, and the host kindly supplied us with beverages and great bread with olive oil for dipping.  Parking no problem with parking garage in rear of restaurant.
Had lunch with friends, outdoors, which was very nice. Service was attendant without being cloying, food well worth coming back for.
A French restaurant this is not, only a pale imitation. The cooks clearly aren’t trying very hard. The bouillabaisse was a mess and the duck overcooked. It is way overpriced for what it is.

La Fontaine was excellent, start to finish. We were a group of 12, seated outside. When it got a bit chilly, they kindly brought out heaters. 

Our meals and service were wonderful.  Thank you!

La Fontaine continues to be one of our favorite restaurants, consistently providing exceptional food and service! We thoroughly enjoyed perfectly prepared calimari fritti, delicious roasted garlic mushroom ravioli & a decadent lava cake with sea salted caramel gelato. It was perfect for our anniversary celebration! We’ll definitely keep returning!
Our waitress Nehari  was sweet and she made sure we were well taken care of. Food was delicious and dessert mango sorbet was amazing you should try it.
My chicken was dry nadja do too much pepper in it.
It's as advertised. Good for business dinners. We liked it.

Was craving Beef Wellington, so came here on my birthday.  It was cooked exactly to doneness requested, and come artfully served atop of layer of vegetables and mashed potatoes.  The mashed potatoes were just a tad salty for my taste.  My spouse ordered a burger with fries, which were quite satifying.  Service was excellent and price was quite reasonable.
We three women shared a delightful assortment of appetizers and salads and delicious white wines. We will return!
The waitress was friendly and welcoming.  Food was delicious!
We enjoyed the food, and the service was excellent.  All that was somewhat spoiled by a very loud background noise to the point we nearly needed to shout to hold a comversation.

Recipes and execution excellent. Outdoor dining (mandatory for us until COVID-19 is truly vanquished) would have been enhanced by simple wind baffles. Since our daughter's birthday, last November, La Fontaine has and will continue to be one of our "go back to" restaurants. When we are comfortable with indoor dining again, La Fontaine will no doubt earn our 5.0.
Great food and service although we mentioned our anniversary in the Open Table reservation and they did not note it.
Lot of vegetarian options and parents from India love it too.

Waiter was awesome!

Delicious food and wine. Appetizer for 2 was very yummy
Fine restaurant for adults. Food quite good, and reasonable value for price

We return to La Fontaine several times a year for special occasions--this one my birthday. We almost always order beef wellington and/or lamb chops, and they are always cooked perfectly. This time was no exception. However, the three of us all felt the chef was too heavy on the salt across dishes this time. We told our server, but wanted to say it again. Otherwise a perfect dinner, including a complimentary birthday tiramisu!

Hidden Jewel on Castro Street!
The food is excellent and there is a great variety on the menu with many vegetarian options. 
Service was great, we were pampered 
Price/Performance is excellent

We were a party of three.
Service was excellent and fast.
We had three tasty and generous pasta dishes.
I loved the crab cakes.
Will be back.
Food was excellent. Service was excellent. Bathroom even had diaper changing station. All excellent and highly recommend.
Excellent dinner and superior service with a smile. Lots of menu choices to fit many people’s needs.
Wonderful place for a date night. I ran late and called telling them I would be and they were incredibly understanding. Best Gnocchi I’ve had ever and wonderful made in house pasta.
We took my elderly dad out to dinner and everything was great.  Very attentive service without being intrusive.
This Castro St favorite never disappoints.  And the menu pricing fits every budget.  Out theater group of 8 has enjoyed LaFountaine many times.
Excellent Capellini Pomodoro and great recommendations from the server. Food, wine and cocktails all good. Will visit again.
It was a very nice quiet dinner. With great food, quick service. Will definitely go again.
As per usual, great meal and service! Thank you!

We reserved table and when we showed up there were several tables open but the manager/bar tender wanted us to be seated right next to the door.  When we nicely requested if he can seat  us inside with several tables open, he frowned and thought for at least a minute or two.  Made us really unwelcoming and then moved to next table.  Quite unprofessional.  Food was ok and waitress who served was professional.

Never going to this place back again.
Dinner here on Saturday night was great.  The service was very friendly.  The food was excellent.  This was our second time there and we will be back.

Excellent service! They keep your water glass full which I very much appreciate. We received our drinks and food in a very reasonable time after ordering. It was easy to make a reservation online and we were seated right away. Very clean inside and a classy atmosphere. Great for a date night!

We’re greeted when we arrived. We were shown to our table. The server asked us if we would like a beverage and we ordered our drinks. We had a Calamari for appetizers. The salad with prawns was a delight. I had the sole which was cooked to perfection. We’re all pleased with the restaurant.

I was disappointed by the food, especially for the price. I had the beef Wellington. The beef was quite good and the sauce decent. The presentation was very basic. At $49 per plate it was not a good value. The butternut squash soup was okay but bland. The dressing on the Cesar salad tasted a bit off. My husband’s seafood risotto was mediocre. It definitively was not a true risotto. No creaminess. It was essentially rice mixed with seafood. Also pricey. Our cocktails were decent, but pricey. The service was outstanding. Very friendly and attentive.
