Food was great and service was great too! It was just a little loud with everyone else in the room.

The calamari appetizer was tasty and included both tartar and cocktail sauces. Our server was pleasant and made a custom requested Manhattan cocktail using Canadian whiskey. The crispy flatbread pizza was enough to share. The strawberry salad was also enough to share and the 6 piece ravioli was delicious! Butternut squash soup was good as a first course. We all shared a tiramisu for dessert. The restaurant was not busy at 5:30 pm on a Saturday night. We were seated near the front window with good lighting and view of the street with foot traffic.
The service was vey good.  We enjoyed the food and will definitely go back. The Salmon was cooked to perfection
Attentive service.     Beet risotto, duck breast, and tiramisu are all delicious!

The food is always delicious here and they have so many choices. The price for the quality of food is also very reasonable. Most places we go that offer comparable quality are quite a bit more expensive. The service was great too.
Loved everything about our lunch! Excellent food and service.

A little pricey for the quality of the food we got. We ordered the steak frites and the "rib eye" was extremely thin and lean. Truffle fries were good, but overall the dish was NOT worth $50. The pasta was pretty good.

This was a mediocre experience. Perhaps because I was a single diner, perhaps because amenities are not important, I felt neglected. I waited  more than 20 minutes for them to take my order. I was offered no bread. Is that not standard? The waitress came to my table half as often as the waiter at the next table. The food was mediocre. The scallops in the papardelle were tasteless and the shrimp nearly so.  The sauce was ok but it would have been nice to have some bread to sop it up. And no veggies. I say meh.

Overall wonderful dining experience- great service, delicious food. We shared beet salad and then I had octopus as my entree and my friend had duck. Everything we ordered was perfectly cooked and delicious.  And the prices were relatively moderate compared to other restaurants.

The crab cakes were honestly the best I’ve ever had. I loved the Pasta Pomodoro with the superb chicken added. Our waitress was fantastic. While the prices mean I cannot go too frequently, I’ll be beck.

Fairly small interior with seating really close together. Not much privacy for conversation. They were however not sweating at all tables and turning people away who did not have a reservation. The food and service was excellent. I think some small partitions and sound dampening would go a long way for this place.

I use to go to this restaurant all the time and send my boss etc.  I moved and finally came back to the area and so wanted to eat here!and I always found it to be nice.  Since Covid… The service was good and nothing else!  I decided to order a Napoli pizza that they bragged about and it was about half cooked and the yellow tomato sauce was just a few yellow sliced mini tomatoes… soooo disappointed and my friend ordered Chicken CorDon blue which was a bit undercooked and we will not come back ever or recommend it to anyone!
It was an exceptional experience!  Food, service, everything.
First time at this restaurant and it was amazing! The service was fabulous and the food was delicious. Highly recommend the short ribs!
My chicken was a bit dry, but my companions thought their filet mignon and boulliabase were excellent.

This was our first time at La Fontaine and we will definitely go back. I should say that it was early and there were only a few other customers, so it was quiet. Service was really excellent; the food came quickly and the waitress and other staff were very attentive. The food--beet salad, duck and branzino entrees--came quickly and the presentation was quite nice. The food itself was delicious; they have a terrific chef.
Very delicious menu and specials! Beef Wellington, extra gravy is Very good!
Quaint and delicious food. Relaxing atmosphere for my daughter and I.

This was our second time in this restaurant after a gap of many years and it will be the last. We were a group of 6 people. For appetizers, we ordered the PISTACHIO CRUSTED GOAT CHEESE (V) and BRUSCHETTA (V). The bread slices were cold, looked white and unbaked. The goat cheese was okay. For entrees, we ordered the VEGETARIAN (V) pizza, CAPELLINI POMODORO(V) and MUSHROOM TRUFFLE RAVIOLI (V). The pizza was okay, the capellini was extremely overcooked and looked like a fat blob of tomato soaked pasta. The Ravioli was the only saving grace. For dessert, we ordered the TRIAMISU, CREME BRULEE (GF) and LAVA CAKE (GF). The chocolate cake did not look moist at all; creme brulee came with cut strawberries on the top; triamisu was ok. Overall, below average experience with food. However, the service was excellent. And maybe, their non-vegetarian options taste better than the vegetarian options.
Good spot.  This last lunch experience was better than the one from a year or so ago.  I'm glad I gave it another chance.
One of my favorite restaurants. The menu is not big but still offers variety of choices.  Great service.

The food was a disappointment especially for the price. I’d skip this and look for either a cheaper place or an actually classy location for Italian. This restaurant tried to be classy but the food and atmosphere didn’t live up.

My gf and I went to La Fontaine to celebrate our “big” birthdays. 

We both had the Beef Wellington- and it was AMAZING. The combination with truffle potatoes was very tasty. 

We had an extremely nice Pinot Noir with our food. And we got a birthday tiramisu to share. 

Service was very good. Checking in regularly while not being bothersome. 

As we had an early dinner, the noise level was very quiet when we arrived but picked up later in the evening. Even so, it was not intrusive. 

I have been to this restaurant before and had good experiences. But particularly after this meal I would definitely recommend La Fontaine again.
Good food great service
Sat outside for an early afternoon Thanksgiving meal.  Beef Wellington was delicious.
Service was incredible! Food was very well plated and quality to say the least.
Food is excellent, very modern.  The Duck and the Beef Wellington are my favorites
Pasta wasn’t al dente but rather soggy..

Food is very good, but pricey. Very good wine list. The noise level however is unbearable. It looks like the owners put in place reflective surface everywhere to maximize the decibel level. This makes the place unfit for a date or a business dinner.

Service was absolutely lovely but food was sub par - meatballs were dry and tough, pasta was overcooked. Fruit flies constantly around the table, and some dinnerware/glassware that has seen better days.
The food and service was great, and the noise level was low enough to talk comfortably.
Menu has many choices.  Salmon was delicious including the bread.

We enjoyed the ability to choose both French and Italian cuisine.  The presentation  and taste of the dishes were very good, as was the service.  It was fairly quiet at the beginning of the evening, but got quite loud when an all male business dinner sat down next to us.  There was also a table with  a couple of very loud screaming small children  which lowered the ambience.  We would definitely go back if it quieter.  Maybe it was just a loud night.

What a lovely evening at La Fontaine!  The service was excellent....very attentive and  professional.  The restaurant was quite busy serving a very large party along with several tables of 2's + 4's with a number of patrons in the outside seating area.  The staff handled it all effortlessly, friendly and always attentive. Delightful and tasty food and a nice selections of wine.
Great place with a unique provencal menu! Ambience is great (outdoors) - has a lovely vibe!
We are outside so there was no noise issues and the food was very good along with prompt service. We are here as a pre-concert event for Sir Elton John, so it was an early dinner.
The service was phenomenal. Everything was clearly made fresh from the Mushroom Truffle Oil Ravioli to the Tiramisu. Highly recommend! :)
Very nice food selection, presentation, and flavor. Not overly crowded.
The chicken Cordon Bleu was fantastic and the pasta with peas and pancetta and tomato was very good. It was on the expensive side. We had the sample appetizer for two people. It was good.

A beautiful day, we sat indoors but close to a window.  We were all pleased with our lunches and felt the portions were a good value.  Two of us had salads, one had the salmon sandwich and I had a pizza.
We were happy and satisfied.
Birthday meal
Tasty food. But very expensive and serving size for appetizer is very less
the duck breast was overcooked and the first bread was cold, but other than that, everything was delicious and nicely plated.  A bit over priced but the quality is pretty good
The food was good, the desserts are very good

We had a terrific time here.   Food was excellent, service impeccable.   I ordered the sea bass and split a Ceasar salad with my dinner companion.   She had the shrimp and almond crusted sole special.  Highly recommended for delicious food and wonderful service!
excellent service. most of the dishes were good except didn’t care much for tge Calabrese
Nice selection of choices for wine, cocktails and main menu.  Food was brought out with perfect timing and was all very good.  Our server was very pleasant and attentive.
Food was outstanding! Would recommend to others for sure.
Beef Wellington was very well done.   BOUILLABAISSE was very tasty and the Golden Margarita pizza was very tasty

Our waitress was very nice and treated us like part of the family. 
We really enjoyed sitting outside and was a perfect night all the way around. They truly went that extra mile to give us a night I will always remember.
Friendly service and delicious food! What more can one ask for?
Nice outdoor dinning section with good coverage by waitstaff
Very nice spot on restaurant row in Mountain View with simple menu. Outside dining the highlight with excellent service.
Food was good ambiance perfect a bit pricey but very good restaurant overall
I always have a wonderful evening at La Fontaine.  The food is delicious, the service attentive.  They do such a good job!
Really enjoyed our lunch at La Fontaine Restaurant!
We had the sea bass and beef wellington and it was absolutely delicious!
The outside dining area was not in any way aesthetic and slightly unkempt and few people dining.
Great food & service.Was a bit disappointed that the beef wellington was missing the duxelles--so in my opinion not a true wellington, but delicious nonetheless.
Nice food and service was fast and friendly

We love this restaurant and are frequent visitors. The outdoor environment is very upbeat and there is happy energy around. Our server was hospitable, attentive, and patient. She definitely made us feel welcome. We are vegetarian and this place has good vegetarian choices. The food was delicious. We loved their bruschettas, risotto, and spinach mushroom ravioli was satisfying to the palate. Good quality food, not heavy. They have good wine selection too. We like to take our friends to this restaurant as well.
A great location, good service and a good menu. The items we got failed to impress though. A little bland - but Italian can be that way I suppose

Excellent food. The service was also good. Would definitely recommend it. Ordered the macadamia nut crusted lamb chop, but turns out to be rack of lambs, which was a great surprise. My wife ordered the fish, and it was very good as well.
The service was excellent - very friendly, welcoming, and helpful with menu choices. The food was Amazing!  I’ll Definitely dine there again
Reliably delicious choices, unpretentious and friendly service, good choices for wine. I keep returning, and that is really saying it all.

Great dinner outside for our wedding anniversary. 
Great rab cakes.
Unique cuisine Entree: Squid Ink Tagliolini
Salmon, Whitefish, Squid, Clams and Mussels over Squid ink Taggliolini noodles.
Excellent.
Very good service and delicious food. I was happy to have wild-caught fish option on the menu. I’ll be back!

We had the pan fried sea bass. Thought it would be a whole fish but turned out to be fillet. Presentation was tastefully done. And the taste was equally good. 
We also had the braised boneless beef ribs. Melts in your mouth. Well seasoned and one of the best braised ribs I have ever eaten.
Very accommodating staff, food was good as well. Especially enjoyed the Ravioli.

I found this restaurant to be expensive (not much choice for under 30 dollars).  Everything is higher these days so it's hard to complain.  I had the Sea Bass and the plate was so beautiful, I had to take a photo.  It was good and I ate every bite.
A few sips of Sauvignon Blanc was $12 and it, too, was cool and delicious.  Service was very gracious and attentive.  We ate outdoors;; not as elegant as inside the r restaurant but the cool breeze and people watching substituted nicely.
It’s more an Italian restaurant than a french one, with pasta and pasta making most of the menu except bouillabaisse and steak frites.
Appetizers & entrees were plentiful and super tasty!  Wait staff was helpful & attentive.  Outdoor seating on Castro St. is nice.

Been here many, many times and have always enjoyed the foos and wine selection.
If you go at dinner time, know that the train noise a block away is noticeable.
If you are up for French food at a decent price- look no more. Very nice, yammi place.
The food is delicious and the waiters are nice and kind. The price is reasonable.

We were delighted to see lunch choices, including a chicken breast sandwich on focaccia. The chicken was perfectly and simply grilled. The one shortcoming was that the sandwich was served with avocado on the sandwich, and the avocado was nowhere near ripe. In situations such as this, it would be much better for the server to let the customer know that there will be no avocado on the sandwich because the restaurant had none that were ripe. 

The sandwich was served with very lightly salted string fries--real potatoes, fried perfectly. There was also a mixed spring greens salad with a very light dressing--just enough to accent the salad.

We will return, but we will be sure to ask about whether the avocados, tomatoes, and such are fully ripe.
Great food, great service, will definitly go back!

Enjoyed the Food very much..we both had the chicken cordon bleu
Waiter very nice....
Problem parking....street blocked off...
also hoping to see salmon Wellington on the menu...
not there any more...
Would get the same meal again....very enjoyable
Service was excellent, friendly and thoughtful. I had the wild salmon special that was one of the best I've ever had. And a delicious lava cake dessert!
The food is good and we could sit outside
Enjoyed our lunch at La Fontaine.  Looking forward to returning.  Thanks for a good time.

We had a reunion lunch for 3 and sat outside. The tenting made it comfortable even though there was a breeze. We had two aps, the calamari that was on the small side and buffalo milk mozzarella, and pastas, orchiette with smoked bacon and peas, penne in a cream based sauce, and linguine in a red sauce, and desserts, pannacotta, tiramisu and a pastry. All were nicely prepared and served. The waiter was helpful and filled water glasses regularly. We enjoyed a very pleasant meal and recommend La Fontaine for lunch in a pleasant venue with good food.
Very nice restaurant!!  The ambiance is perfect and the food is delicious.  It's a bit pricey, but appropriate for this restaurant.  A great place for a special occasion or celebration.
The wait staff was very friendly and efficient.  Service was great and the food outstanding!

I probably would have given LF five stars except my friends burger came cooked medium (maybe almost medium-well) vs medium-rare. 

We didn’t want to send it back and have it arrive at a different time from everyone else’s food. 

But our server was very nice and gave us a free dessert to share.

Decent spot, except the outdoor seating was just a metal table. We expected table cloth type seating fir this experience. I guess being from Paso Robles we’re just used to good food and fancier restaurants

A hiccup on the seating as it was an exceptionally warm day so the outdoor seating was fully occupied but that was resolved soon enough. The food was nicely prepared with the calamari lightly fried and tender, the beet risotto fresh and crisp, and the mussels/clams in the seafood papardelle super fresh.  The prices were excellent especially given the quality of the overall experience!
We are inside were it was cool.  Since Castro is closed off need better directions for access

3 people shared 3 dishes plus an appetizer for 2.  We in general liked everything.  The spinach was too salty when it was served with sole & risotto, the waiter graciously reordered for me.  We enjoyed, the ravioli, sole and the seafood papparedelle. My friends came from out of town, food mecca, they enjoyed it. Glad that we went there.
Great experience, would highly recommend. Good food, friendly service and cute downtown location
Absolutely delicious meals! Great service. A little expensive, but we knew that would be the case.
La Fontaine salad, calamari, bouillabaisse, and complimentary bread were good
We sat at an outside table. It was heated and the staff were attentive. The food was, as always, delicious.

I come here primarily because their crab cakes are out of this world. I also love their beet salad. And I can't say anything else about the rest of the menu because I never get past the crab cakes and beet salad, which have always been terrific!
La Fontaine is our team's go-to restaurant for excellent service, food and atmosphere. They never disappoint!

Dinner with a friend. For tradition's sake, we both had the beef Wellington. Meat was cooked very nicely, pastry—though cooked well, and flaky, and flavorful—lacked substance (I prefer more of a brioche-like pastry to a puff-like pastry). Chocolate cheesecake for dessert was yummy, flavorful, great texture. Nice selection of wines by the glass. Very enjoyable al fresco dining. We were at our table a long time, yet the staff never rushed us nor indicated in any way that they wanted us to relinquish the table during our after-dinner conversation.

Love this place. 

Prosciutto melon and orecchiette and fish were all delicious. 
Staff is super friendly and service is good.

Very nice bistro feel, the food was very good - halibut was nicely prepared, crusty and flaky, the seafood risotto was not too heavy with nice seafood. The steak in the steak frites was tasty, but it had too much fat. The service was excellent. Overall a very nice experience.
Great stuff!

First time for us at La Fontaine, and we will definitely come back.

Very attentive and friendly service, sound advise, knowledge of the menu and wine list, prompt but without rushing.

Nice choice of cocktails, decent wine list at reasonable prices.

The menu is varied, hearty family-type dishes inspired from Italy and  Italy, generously sized without being overwhelming. Not your usual offering, rather beyond the norm with a variety of dishes that are true to European tastes (we are French). 

Attention to details, both in the plate and on the table - I personally give more points to restaurants that have table cloth - this is not school canteen! I know, this is a bit snobbish but hé, les traditions sont importantes!

We did not try the deserts, nice offering though, and settled on the cheese plate: there, could use a little more creativity but I suspect there are not enough “amateurs” to justify stocking a decent assortment. Oh well… 

The main dining room was quiet, which is a nice alternative in Mountain view for more lively places - getting away from the high pitched voices is nice after a long day at work. 

We will come back to taste the rest of the menu, and enjoy the cozy albeit unpretentious atmosphere.

Forgot to say: a great balance between cost & quality for an otherwise usually overpriced, often ostentatious Peninsula food scene.

“De tous les arts, l’art culinaire est celui qui nourrit le mieux son homme.” Pierre Dac
Organized a team dinner here. There were 20 people and the service was really good. The servers were courteous and nice. The food was really good too.

Delicious vegetarian choices, great house wine, nice cream brûlée, cheerful outdoor experience: we have started frequenting this place with guests both for lunch and dinner. Seating took a while this time though we had done reservation and had received confirmation by email.

A work lunch turned into a lovely visit during our time at La Fontaine. Our wait staff, especially Paula, were  wonderful and attentive, the food was delicious. Being outside on a beautiful warm April day gave us the space to really visit with each other. I especially recommend the antipasto platter for two and creamy mushroom soup
Had a wonderful lunch yesterday at La Fontaine.  Service was prompt.  My friend and I both ordered the Hamburger with Garlic Fries.  It was cooked just as specified and was delicious.

Excellent presentation of taste food and great service 
Had planned to ear inside the restaurant, but there was a large very noise party inside so we moved outside.

Love Castro Street where it's blocked off.  Plenty of room at the tables and very fast, efficient service.  Our server, Didem and her staff were at our table every 5 minutes checking and refilling.

Beet salad was awesome with yellow and red beet slices and very lightly dressed arugula sprinkled with goat cheese.  Yummy.

Crab cakes were said to be awesome as well.  Drizzled with dill aioli.

Duck breast was served with cranberries and wine sauce.  Very tasty and the wild rice very good pairing, offsetting the richness of the duck.  Perfect with our Pinot Noir from Testsarossa.

Many Italian dishes on the menu for a French restaurant.  ???? 
That said, the pasta was extremely fresh and house-made.

Special Buffalo Mozzarella Ravioli had a tomato cream sauce and was light and delicious.

Pollo D'Angelo elevated chicken to new heights.  The combination with the mushrooms, peas and tomato all in the light sherry sauce was divine.

Seafood Pappardelle arrived in a huge bowl with the many clams, mussels, shrimp etc sticking out.  The pasta was generous, too--wide noodles with the tasty tomato broth.

Super fun dinner.  Can't wait to go back.

We had two little kids with us and the server was so friendly and made sure that our kids were taken care of. He even made little animals and hats out of napkins for my son to keep him (and the table) entertained. I would definitely recommend going here especially if you have kids. The food was excellent too.
Love celebrating at La Fontaine!
I had the duck breast which was excellent.  The sauce with cranberries was exquisite.  The duck breast was served over a bed of wild rice and asparagus.  Excellent!
We enjoyed a wonderful lunch outside.  Food and service was great!

Two of us had the sole, which was perfectly done. The other two had different chicken dishes and both were very impressed. We sat outside and unfortunately it was cold the day we dined. It took a little from the full enjoyment. The service was great and all were very attentive. We’ll go again without a doubt.
Cold and windy night, but the meal was delicious and the service quite good.

This restaurant is much to noisy for a special occasion such as a romantic evening or anniversary or other intimate event. It was populated by the after work crowd drinking and laughing, and felt like being at a happy hour at some local watering hole.

I took my fiancé there to celebrate her birthday and we were unable to have even a simple conversation. We were also way over-dressed for the place. All the patrons and staff, though friendly and attentive, were dressed as if they had just left a fitness club. I had on a dinner jacket and my fiancé wore a nice dress. We felt very out of place.

Food wasn't bad and the prices were very reasonable by silicon valley standards. It was easy to get a reservation.

Unfortunately, I can see why...
Food quality has gone down the hill. Service was sub standard as well. Won’t go back again. So sad to see an once good place gone down the hill.
The food was disappointing.  In particular the Fontaine pizza was mostly just crust.
Excellent meal! Highly recommend.

I had set up a surprise birthday dinner for my partner with certain French courses at La Fointaine. It was great to work with the La Fontaine team. I had created very specific process for the dinner.  We even had a mix of dishes I was paying for,assigned seating and individual orders.  The team did fantastic even when I changed the assigned seating at the last moment. They didn't miss a beat.  The service was phenomenal throughout the night and never once did I feel stressed or anxious. I knew I was in capable hands!

The very high noise level caused by two large groups of men caused what could have been a nice dinner to be less than ideal. I realize that the restaurant staff has no control over these groups, but it would have been helpful for the rest of us dining at that time if they had been reminded to keep the level to a reasonable level so the rest of us could enjoy our evenings. 

Due to the waitress' heavy accent which was made worse by both of us wearing masks, there was a misunderstanding regarding my order and she brought two additional side dishes I did not order (one was supposed to be a substitution for the vegetables included with the menu item). I decided to just pay the additional $14 rather than try to explain the mistake as I assumed the explanation would have confused her even more and caused even more disappointment. 

Other than that, the food was good.
Amazing service and great environment.  THE  FOOD WAS GREAT AND MET OUR EXPECTATION.
Birthday dinner.

Food was delicious. Our group of 4 had the chicken, cordon blue, the bouillabaisse, the beef Wellington for the entrees. We also had crab cakes, which were good, spinach salad, which was tasty and Caesar salad which was good too. Nice selection of wines and the place was quiet enough to hear one another talk. The restaurant asks that phones be put on "silent" which made the experience great. Also I need to say the service was excellent. Water glasses filled, plates removed, etc. on a timely basis.
It was great, the food was delicious and the atmosphere was nice.
Excellent meal.

We came here for our wedding anniversary on a quiet and cold Tuesday evening. The staff were warm and welcoming and responsive. We ordered the appetiser plate for 2 and every element was fresh and delicious. Our entrees were the duck breast and the Beef Wellington.  The duck was delicious and flavourful. The beef was incredibly tender. The portion sizes were satisfying, We shared a crème brûlée for dessert. It was the perfect size to share.  We will definitely be back. A fabulous date night restaurant.
It was a chilly evening but we elected to eat outside. They  were accommodating with the heater placement. The food was delicious! We will return soon.
My girlfriends and I were a bit early, they gladly accommodated us in. Food, service and ambiance were excellent. Our server was very attentive, highly recommend this place.
Food is ok, but my entree was served cold, obviously pre-made and not heated properly. For that price this not acceptable.
It was an excellent choice for our anniversary. Delicious food, good ambiance, pleasant service, fair prices. This was our first visit and it won't be our last.
Food and service were amazing! I had the seafood risotto which was delicious - perhaps best risotto I have ever had. Highly recommend.

The food just did not taste good - plain and simple. Taste did not justify the price at all. Also, some of the meals were either very hot or barely warm, making me think they either warm them up or leave some of them out for a while (just didn't feel fresh). Everything else was great, like the service from the waiters and rest of the staff.

they raised their price by almost 80-90% on Valentine's Day - they created a "special menu" with the same dishes they usually offer on their regular menu and took away their regular menu. Basically a fraud and the food is not good especially considering the increased price
Great Valentine's day dinner! Menu had many options. Service was fantastic. Food was really tasty. Can't wait to go back and try the full menu.
Excellent service.  Feel very special.  Will come back.

The food was very good, and the drinks too. The waiter was polite and attentive. However, we got seated outside and as the weather was turning cold, they couldn’t turn on the heaters from “low” because “that was a new system”and they didn’t know how to work. They had a lot of other heaters around, but they could move them. So we were freezing off and kills the ambiance and the mood. Also, a little detail, but it was Valentine’s Day and they gave everyone a long stem rose as they got seated - nice! For us they forgot it, then they brought it and it broke, so he just shrugged and gave us the broken rose. That felt almost insulting. Will I come back? Idk; not with a group of people for sure.
Service was excellent food was outstanding always a great place to go especially for Valentine’s Day
Great service and amazing staff
We had a lovely outdoor Valentine's lunch at La Fontaine.  It was our first time there and we were very happy with the service and the food.  The mushroom raviolis were excellent!
The food and service were top notch.  It was our first time coming, but it won’t be our last!
Our party of six had a marvelous time at La Fontaine.   3 generations. (youngest, our grand-daughter age  11) every course delicious, the wait staff charming and accommodating.
Delicious food, excellent service.
Good service, so so food and a 100 bucks for lunch for two without wine seems excessive.
Very pleased and would recommend. At the end the bill was lower than expected. Ain’t that a nice surprise? :)

Our waiter (likely the owner) provided excellent service. He did several magic tricks with my kids. Because he was fun, this now has become the kids’ favorite restaurant. 

The food was delicious! My Beef Wellington was very tasty. The beef was a tad over cooked but the flavor was amazing!

We patronize this establishment many times in the past and it never disappoints.
Wonderful as always ! Service, food :)
Unpretentious and delightful, as always.
It was a great birthday dinner. Our server was very helpful with food allergies.
We got there when they opened so it was quiet inside with a few outdoor diners.  Service was great and the food the awesome.  I love their specials.
Amazing service!!! Great food. So happy we went there!!!

First time at La Fontaine was a pleasant experience. Service was friendly, professional and prompt. Food was very good including meatballs, steak frites and mediteranean sea bass. We plan to return in the future.
Really good place for a work dinner or small social gathering. I enjoyed it overall

Best ever New Year's Eve dinner: Beef Wellington and Pistachio Crusted Lamb chops  -very tender and tasty, Beet Salad with arugula , goat cheese & citrus -truffle vinaigrette was superb, as were the vegetables. Dessert was Creme Brule-soft & creamy with crunchy melted sugar top. Service was friendly and attentive. Bread and dip plus crabcake hors d' oeuvres kept our attention while waiting for entre, which was not long. Vegan and Gluten Free dinners were also available.
New Year eve dinner
Great food, good service - you can't go wrong coming here for dinner.
Christmas Eve family dinner. Great service. Nice selection of choices on the menu. Food was tasty and a good temperature.
Wonderful birthday dinner, excellent food, relaxing and enjoyable.
Food is good in reasonable price. The service is excellent.
Great service and very friendly staff.

Very easy to make a reservation, it was very quiet when we arrrived after 5 but by the time we were leaving it was a full Saturday night. Service was friendly, fast and dinner was delicious, roast chicken and vegetables and golden marguerita pizza - fresh and generous portions. We also enjoyed blackberry mojito, fresh bread was good. Calamari appetizer was the only sort of average part of dinner.
Appreciated the tiramisu for Bday celebration very much. This is the 2nd time I have brought a friend here on a Bday and surely will return.
Excellent service and very friendly staff!  The food was delicious!

It was our first tome there. The place was a little smaller than I expected. When everyone talking it becomes loud inside. The food was great! Service was fantastic! Definitely my new favorite restaurant.

The waiter was very difficult to deal with and very condescending.  I had arranged a team lunch for 7 people to welcome a new director and bid farewell to the previous director and had called the day before to confirm they have covered outdoor seating with heating as there was 100% chance of rain.  Some of the team members had unvaccinated infants and toddlers and eating indoors was not an option.  When we got to the restaurant, the waiter said we could only sit indoors and that the chairs outside were wet because of the wind.  When I mentioned that I had called the previous day and had been reassured we could sit outdoors, he said it was up to god to decide if there would be wind. We were about to walk out when he begrudgingly agreed to let us sit outside and, of course, the chairs were not wet.  He just didn’t want to provide service outside.  Towards the end of the meal, my boss wanted a coffee to go and the waiter advised they didn’t have to go cups so we had to drive to Starbucks to get coffee.  The food was good but the overall experience was poor and I do not plan on going back let alone organizing a company meal or anything important there.

We had our office holiday party here on the spur of the moment.  It was PERFECT!  The food and service stand out!!!!!!!  Everything was very delicious.  Portions are pretty decent.  Flavors incredible.  There was a lot of variety for everyone to be happy.  We'll definitely go back!  Staff was beyond great.  Really elegant but relaxed and friendly at the same time!  Thanks everyone!

This was our first time visiting this restaurant. We went for both mine and my husband's birthday. The service was outstanding and they even brought out a complimentary dessert for each of us. The only reason I am not giving 5 stars across the board is b/c the food could use a bit more seasoning.
The bruschetta was amazing! As was the smoked salmon appetizer. Excellent food overall.

Never said happy birthday to mom even though I made notes. Asked waitress for recommendations and she did that weird thing new waitresses do when they don’t know the menu, so they tell you what they haven’t eaten and what they can’t eat because of their own diet, which… doesn’t help. The best we could get is the seafood pappardelle “seemed to be popular”. Food was actually decent. No ambience- community college classroom lighting.

Overall a very pleasant experience and a great place for our birthday celebration. The service was outstanding! Our waiter was very attentive to detail and went out of his way to make sure every one was happy which is so nice to see. The Chef was also VERY accommodating of special requests and due to some of our party having food allergies.
Great restaurant for a date where you can have an intimate conversation over lunch.
As always … great service…. Friendly  and Professional staff…. And most of all steak and duck we ordered was delectable .
Very good food, excellent wait staff, good for date night or special occassion.
Waiteress is friendly and prompt, replaced the propane tank which was out. We had a nice dinner.
Service was great. Attentive staff, even though there was only one waitress for outside dining. Food was also tasty, with seafood in the risotto and bouillabaisse fresh and not overcooked.

Excellent service and dishes from start to finish. Black diners, this review is for you. Our reservation was for outside, but we respectfully asked for an indoor table, and our wish was granted. Great table at the door/window. It did not feel crowded. All wait staff were attentive and seemed to read us well as customers. The mixed drinks were ahhhh-mazing! The bread in the basket was the first signal that this would a good night. Freshly baked bread with olive oil. Then the crab cakes were just right. My sea bass was very good - it could have been a bit more flaky or “buttery” in texture, but zero complaints. The mashed potatoes and vegetables were cooked perfectly. My wife had the bouillabaisse, which she devoured - and she is a true foodie. Fantastic presentation, too. My adult niece requested no cheese to her dish to honor her vegan needs. This was done so seamlessly that I had to ask her if it was discussed. My wife and niece were perfect dinner company. Our fav dessert was the crème brûlée. We were not rushed. Now, back to the Black dining experience (although Black people will read in between the lines above). First, all of our party was Black and we were the only Black people in the restaurant for 2 hours - period.  In spaces like this, we often get outrageous, safari-like stares (“look, there’s an anomaly”). We did not get those looks in Mountain View. We were barely noticed. That added to the experience. But there was pedestrian who took out extra time to turn their camera toward me without my permission. That was odd. Otherwise, if you’re Black (from East Bay) and you’re looking for a very comfortable dining experience, without the fake service, and without feeling out of place (even if you’re the only Black people and you’re sitting in the window), then you’ll like this restaurant.

I will start by saying the food and cocktails are delicious. The portions were just right and plated very beautifully. The pictures however made it seem like a fancy place when it is not. The service was slower than I am used to.  It took a while to get our menus and longer to place the order.  The servers were great though.  I would go back eventually.

We very very pleased with our dining experience at La Fontaine Restaurant in Mountain View.  We had read a review in the Sunday Mercury News and decided we should go to celebrate my wife's birthday.  We drove a few days prior to see where the restaurant was located as we had not been to Mountain View for several years since before the pandemic.  Luckily it was very easy to find a there was a big parking garage behind the restaurant, so we made a reservation for lunch at 11:30 a.m. to avoid heavy lunch time crowds.  The host greeted us very warmly and we immediately felt at home.  We ordered some wine and my wife had the sole while I had steak frites.  Both were excellent!  They gave my wife a tiramisu cake for dessert for her birthday.  We had a n excellent time and will go again but for dinner next time.
Pleasant restaurant with good food, service and ambience.  Prices on the high side.

Entrees were good, Mushroom ravioli and the special Lobster ravioli.  Caeser salad just so so.  Appetizer of Arancini was less than average; the marinara sauce tasted like it came out of a can (we have had this at other Italian restaurants and really enjoyed it.)  The bus staff was great, but the server was weak.  Never heard of a negroni cocktail and I had to explain how to make it.  The first thing we did was order the app, but when she later came to take our dinner order, she had forgotten to put it in. When we did finish our salad and app, it took a LONG time to get our entrees, they weren't that busy so I assume she just didn't put the order in at the appropriate time.
And, a pet peeve of ours, her response to every verbal interaction was "no worries". What does that even mean?!
We celebrated a birthday. We sat outdoors and the noise level was not noticeable. The food was excellent the service was excellent

Outside evening dining was a little cool without a heater. I and guests enjoyed the dinners and mostly excellent service, 
Although removing plates before all have finished their meals is a no-no. The choice of beers was limited.
It's a quite place to have business lunch/dinners, as the place isn't that popular :)

We ate outside at a lovely table next to a heater so we were quite comfortable. They had a high chair for our 2 year old grandson and made him feel quite welcome. The food was a delicious blend of French and Italian. The wide variety of dishes gave everyone an opportunity to find something they truly wanted. Their Zinfandel was delightful and my husband and I are already planning a return visit with friends.

The food was decent enough, but unfortunately the service was poor. The server was friendly, but either she was new to the industry or just unaware of how service should be provided in a quality restaurant (seemed like her last job may have been in a fast food establishment). One of several examples is when the desert was served, she removed the main dish plate but did not preparing the table for the desert dish, leaving some of the used utensils on the table as well as, a few fries that fell of the main dish plate and some other elements of food, which did not make the desert dish very inviting.
Respectful servers , great food and excellent drinks selection

La Fontaine is an outstanding restaurant.  I went there for my girlfriend’s birthday. We ordered the crab cakes and the Ceasar salad to start with. The order or crab cakes comes with two cakes big in size and are well made. The Ceasar salad was spectacular. I had forgotten how the Ceasar dressing should taste like: this was the real taste; very few restaurants know how to prepare this dressing and the lettuce was fresh and crisp in the long stalk (not chopped in chunks) with just one anchovy that was not salty at all.  
We had a bottle of the house Cabernet (from Santa Rosa) and for the main course my girlfriend had the beef Wellington and I had the branzino.  Service was impeccable: we had three waiters to ourselves (it was Tuesday at 5:30 P.M.).
Top notch excellent outstanding the best ever food and service.

My husband and I went on a Friday night. We ate indoors starting about 6 pm. Before our entrees arrived, a basket of tasty warm bread and herbed olive oil for dipping was brought to the table. For the main course, I had the chicken cordon bleu, a generous and delicious portion of two pieces, perfectly breaded and filled with a creamy sauce and ham and cheese. The entree also came with mashed potatoes and vegetables. My husband ordered a blackened fish off the specials menu, with a carrot-ginger soup appetizer. We shared a delectable pumpkin cheesecake with berries, also off the specials menu, for dessert. 

The special entree was a bit pricey.  Also, I found the ambiance a little dark. But, the food and service were top-notch.

Going to La Fontaine was a great experience. The server (I didn't get his name) and the staff were very friendly and accommodating. The food was delicious. I love the octopus appetizer and the sea bass. Ambience was classy. We were glad to experience a classy environment without paying too much of a price. I will definitely recommend this restaurant to a friend. (The cookie in the photo was a friend bringing for me, not part of restaurant).
Good food, good service, good location, good atmosphere
love the food from appetizers, entree to dessert & the selection of wine
We always enjoy the food at La Fontaine.  The nice thing is we can always count on their standard of good food and service.

La Fontaine is serving both inside with tables spaced and outside in an attractive tent.  We enjoyed the food very much and our server was pleasant and appropriately attentive.  This is our new favorite French/Italian nearby restaurant.
Food was delicious and so glad they were able to accommodate a birthday
Very good food although a bit on the expensive side.  Great selection of wines and cocktails. Very pleasant and helpful staff.

La Fontaine is among my top favorite restaurants in the Bay Area. The ambiance is pleasant, the staff friendly and kind and the food never fails to be delicious! I love a combination of the LaFontaine Salad and their Beet Salad (only because I don't care for big portions of arugula).  They have a very good wine selection and are very accommodating to special requests. Overall this restaurant is a very nice gem in downtown Mountain View.

Fabulous service! Reservations were easy, it was not at all crowded, my water glass was never empty and neither was our bread basket! 

The food was phenomenal (I got the gnocchi and my only suggestion would be to make the sauce a little thicker so it stuck better to the gnocchi. It was a little thin, but still delicious and perfect for dipping the bread!). With the nice table cloths and romantic atmosphere, it made for a lovely date night.
Great food and service. Good place for people watching and good Castro vibes.

We left because no one came to serve us..  
I think they were short staffed.
It’s too bad no one wants to work anymore

We enjoyed everything about La Fontaine.  Vanessa along with everyone there took such good care of us (party of 5). Everything we ordered was delicious: the Beet salad, Prosciutto Cotto pizza, Chicken sandwich, Salmon sandwich, Roasted Garlic Mushroom ravioli, Sole w/ risotto milanese (my personal fave).  They treated the Birthday Girl to Tiramisu and it was delicious! The Panna Cotta is also yummy!  We are definitely going back soon!

We ate outside at 6:30 pm on a Saturday night. Sat away from sidewalk next to plants, with heater nearby to use as needed. We enjoyed wine, an eggplant appetizer, and entrees were game hen for my husband and a pasta dish with chicken, peas, mushrooms, sundried tomatoes, cream sauce, and wine. Both of us greatly enjoyed our entrees. We made room for a special hazelnut chocolate dessert with berries which was also good. The complimentary bread came with a balsamic vinaigrette with herbs, which we also enjoyed. Portions were generous and service friendly. Service was a little slow, but likely due to this being a popular time.
Went for lunch on a Friday.  Outdoor dining was pleasant and the food was delicious!

I had high hopes based on prior reviews on Google, but the food quality was spotty at best. The cavatelli & meatballs was ok as far as the meatballs were concerned, but the pasta was described to me as "mushy" and the sauce was watery. The pistachio crusted lamb chops were cooked medium-rare as requested, yet the pistachio crust was mostly charred. Also, the fig/balsamic sauce was *really* sweet. The steamed veggies were fine, and the potatoes were crisply done on the outside with fluffy interiors. The Appetizer for Two was enjoyable except for the bread foundation of the crostini -- the bread's texture felt like it was cut from a baguette of WonderBread instead of having the expected firm, airy crumb and crisp crust.
It was a great experience great food great service. The flavors in the food combined well the drinks were great. Overall good

Everything was  very nice  except they didn’t offer happy hour specials as indicated on the website. So we spent significantly more for appetizers and drinks than planned for. But food was delicious and service was outstanding. I think because they don’t offer happy hour specials, they are not getting the traffic that the other restaurants in the area get.
Staff really took care of my wife on her birthday.  Best party?  Happy wife!  We both had the risotto and it was excellent (even for a carnivore like myself).

Seated quickly, cordially. Outdoor seating was idyllic. Our server was excellent and attentive. The burrata caprese salad was excellent. Also had the goat cheese. Very tasty! The almond encrusted sole was wonderful too. The lava cake and gelato desert was very good as was the cheese plate. Definitely would return!!! Thank you!
Great service and ambience outdoors. However food was underwhelming indeed.
Could Be more attentive to guest menu very limited.

Was excited to visit La Fontaine based on curb appeal, menu and other reviews. My steak was still significantly over cooked. My companion’s dish was also not great. Service was a bit lacking as well. I might try again…probably not soon though.

Great food and service! We've been here many times before Covid and the  expanded outdoor eating area is perfect. Hope Mt. View keeps the street closed. We always have the Fromage de Chèvre aux Pistaches (Goat Cheese with Pistachios.) Great as always! I had the Cavatelli Meatballs. Very good but spicy! Had to take 1/2 home. Wife had the Veal Meatballs (just a little bland for her tastes.) The Testarossa Pinot was very good and they also serve Italian Sodas; I had a vanilla one.
All in all, still a great restaurant. We made our reservations through Open Table.
The food was mediocre but the service was nice. I wish the steak had a bit more flavor or seasoning.

The food was absolutely wonderful.  We dined outside, and it really added to our experience.   The feel was very European and it was soo much more than we expected. The service was a little slower as the tables filled up- but still very good.

It is extraordinary that La Fontaine is able to provide a fine dining experience during the pandemic. They have a lovely outdoor parklet with heaters, and the servers try to make the experience as comfortable as possible. Their crab cakes are the best I've ever had, and they are my primary reason for going here as often as I can! I love to balance it with their beet salad.
Tables were a bit too close for the COVID era, else everything was great.

The staff provided excellent service.  They went out of their way to keep us happy.  The halibut was excellent. The cavatelli and meatballs and the shortribs were both very good.  I loved the combo of French and Italian.  I would definitely recommend and return.

One of our most favorite places for fine dining in the Bay Area.  Have known the owner who is the chef for 18 years.  The menu is exhaustive and complete with numerous delicious options.  Strongly recommend the duck breat with wild rice - fabulous!  Great appitite starters and delicous deserts.  You'll love this fine dining place as a break from the fast food glut.
great selection, well prepared quality ingredients. great wine list
Great food and excellent service!!
Great family place. The service it was amazing. Totally recommend it
70th Birthday

La Fontaine is one of our absolute favorite restaurants--the food and service are always exceptional. Pre-pandemic, we always enjoyed the classy yet comfortable ambience of the restaurant.  When sheltering in place, we were impressed with how the take-out food was still delicious, even with a 30-minute drive from the restaurant.  We just enjoyed a perfect anniversary dinner outside--it was difficult to choose what to eat as the menu had so many delicious options, but we were so pleased with the calamari fritti, cream of asparagus soup, lobster ravioli, duck breast, lava cake with sea salted caramel gelato and profiterols. We brought home a golden margherita pizza and calzone for our children and they absolutely loved the food, too. We've loved every experience we've had at this restaurant, from dining in to take-out to retirement parties!
We went on Father's Day.  Were seated on time.  Excellent service.  Food was very good.  Highly recommended.
Took 1 hour for the foods to come. Other than that everything is good
Great selection of vegan, vegetarian, and GF options along with all the fancy French meat dishes my husband likes. Perfect place to celebrate our anniversary!
Delicious food in a great atmosphere! Even the bread and oil/vinegar was amazing
Wonderful food and excellent waitress, we very much enjoyed our first post-COVID outing for our anniversary!

Great diverse menu, excellent and friendly service, tables appropriately spaced outside, all made for an enjoyable dinner experience. My only minor quibble was that the beet salad was 95% arugula with only 3 thin slices of red beets and no golden beets.  I love beets but arugula is not my favorite.   Beets were only a very minor component of the salad.  On the other hand, the duck was very enjoyable
Food were excellent.  It was for a birthday and the Chef made a cake for the occasion.
First time dining out since Covid restrictions. Service was polite, tables were nicely spaced out. I had the Sole special…. EXCELLENT!!!!
We had a wonderful family dinner at La Fontaine, the seafood (we had pasta and risotto) is excellent and fresh, the lamb delicious, and the desserts waou! It was perfect, I strongly recommend !

We ate in their outdoor dining area, special for the pandemic. The service was a little slow, which is not surprising because of pandemic issues. They have the absolute best crab cakes I've ever had; that's the primary reason I go there. I also love their beet salad. My friend had the pistachio-coated sole and said it was exceptionally tasty.

La Fontaine is back to their small a new quant inside dining.  This place knows how to service their customers and provide a nice pace for serving your meal.  Feels a little like Europe in every visit!  Highly recommend for anytime and special occasions.
Excellent food and cocktails. The chef really knows how to do French food right. Very good service even though we had a large group of people.
Everyone loved their dinner! We will be back soon.

Everything was awesome here. From food to ambience to spending time with family to create memories. Even though with Covid , resources were low, the team did an exceptional job to ensure everything stays on top !
Had a great experience, food was delicious! Staff was attentive and the food was served in a timely manner.
Julllliiiaaaaa! Best server ever! Omg the burrata pizza was to die for! We loved it so much going back for brunch tomorrow! A must try
Food and service were outstanding for Mother’s Day dinner. Restaurant now has European atmosphere with no street parking and traffic. Highly recommended.

We enjoyed a most wonderful Mother’s Day Brunch on Sunday. We sat outside surrounded by trees which really made the setting lovely. We ordered an appetizer of goat cheese rolled in pistachio nuts and placed on a bed of caramelized onions which we spread on crustini. It truly was amazing!! The three of us all ordered the Crab Benedict which came with potatoes and fruit. This entree was very delicious and cooked perfectly!! We each had a Mimosa to celebrate Mother’s Day........... it truly was a delightful and memorable experience.

Very solid all-around restaurant.  Everything was good.  The service was good.  The food was good at a fair price.   The arancini appetizer was really good!   What stands out at this restaurant for me is the amount of choices that you have on the menu as well as the generous portion size.  They definitely give you your money's worth.  I had a special for the day squid ink seafood pasta dish and my fiancee had halibut. Both were really solid dishes and they filled us up.  There are many other dishes that I'd like to try here.  The wine was delicious.  As far as downtown Mountain View goes, one of the better, more interesting restaurants for sure.  Would I travel a great distance for this place???  Probably not.  That's why only 4 stars out of 5.  Would it be my choice of restaurant in downtown Mountain View.  Yes, yes it would be.  And living within walking distance of the restaurant means that I will be going back.   It's a good date place for those of you who want to treat someone to a nice meal.
Great food and service.  Enjoyed our dinner outside under the awning.
Great food. I would go back. However, menu online needs to be updated with list and price.
As always the food was delicious!! I love Beef Wellington and it’s always on the menu and always made to perfection.

We sat outside under a tree next to a heater and couldn’t have enjoyed our dinner more. The appetizer plate for two gave us a lovely taste of different items, just the right amount. My husband enjoyed the lamb; I enjoyed the short ribs (with enough left for my lunch the next day.) The tirimisu was divine. We will definitely return.
I enjoyed my experience here and would come back. Good, tasty food. Good service. 👍
Nice food nice dining experience!
Very tasty food. Best of Mountain View

My wife and I decided to give this restaurant a try. The food, service, wine and atmosphere were very nice. The cavatelli was stand-out tasty and well presented. We will be back. We enjoyed the casual evening

We have been driving from San Francisco to eat at this restaurant. That's how good the food is.  It quite lovely to sit on Castro street and dine while live classical music is being played on a Weekend.   I hear the pizza is great but we go for the Boulibasse and the Cordon Bleu.
Attentive service, great ambiance, wonderful food. It was something to remember. Parking may be hard at times
Superb food and service. Having lunch  with friend who lives out of state.
Excellent menu with a variety of choices. The entrees were delicious and well presented. This is my new favorite restaurant.
Poor service
The food at La Fontaine is always wonderful. Duck, lamb, steak, pasta is all great. Something for everyone.
Valentine’s Day

Manager was rude at the face telling the servers to not take any more customers even though we had reservations. The food was good and great service by the servers. I would say everything was great except for the manager. And the manager is the reason for me not giving them more than 3 stars for service.

We had a wonderful anniversary dinner at La Fontaine. The food was delicious and service was attentive and anticipated our needs. Covid dining in a tent while it rained was a bit adventurous, but they provided a heater and we had a great time.
Love this place, great service, good food, love ambience
Hazan continues to concieve and deliver fantastic food with wonderful friends and family support.  Keep up the exceptional cuisine in Mountain View Castro Street

I said pink in the middle but the filet was served red in the middle. The server took it back and the chef finished cooking it. 

Also, wine service was slow. 

But we will go back.
From appetizer to dessert, everything was extremely tasty.  The Beef Wellington is my favorite, and was extra good friday! Highly recommended!!!
Prices over 50% higher than shown on Open Table.
Very nice place, delicious French food, professional employees.
They position themselves as French restaurant, but they are Italian in fact, with pizza and pasta in the menu. Very disappointing.
Amazing food and nice service, the seating by the street was a nice vibe
The pasta was perfect al dente on both the lobster ravioli and the seafood pappardelle

Food was passable for an Italian restaurant, but I'm really not sure where the "French" part came into play, save for one or two dishes plus creme brulee. Outdoor seating was nice, service was good, but the price for the food doesn't match the quality so I probably won't be returning.

Their dinner-special menu change from time to time. I was lucky to be able to try their carrot creamy soup, so delicious! I wasn’t able to try the bread pudding for dessert cuz I got so full from eating the duck breast. Maybe next time :)
Nice ambience, great staff and exceptional service overall. The vibes outdoor on Castro were just what I was looking for having a fun and romantic evening with my significant other.
There were only a few servers who seem to pay attention to only certain tables. After our apetizer our entre took too long to arrive. Overall poor experience.

First time here, white pandemic, the outdoor sitting was actually enjoyable on a nice summer evening. Mountain View city made it nice by closing the street so we can make sure to have the social distance. The food is good and service were good, definitely visit again when we needed an Italian fix.
We had a very enjoyable birthday dinner...........
We dined outside on a Monday evening.  The food was excellent and the service was very good.
We ate outside per the Covid guidelines. Castro Street was completely closed so the restaurants all had lots of outdoor seating. Very nice tree lined ambiance. Overall a very nice dinner.
First time eating out, literally. It was a pleasant experience since SIP had started. Felt safe. Food was delicious and staff were very attentive.
Great service. The whole street was close down to make room for out side dining had a nice ambiance for all the restaurant on the street
In the time of COVID they are doing a really nice job of taking care of their customers. The food was very good and the service was spot on. Overall value was high. Really enjoyed the experience.

Al Fresco dining (eating outdoors) on Castro Street! We've eaten outdoors at 4 different restaurants the last few weeks, and La Fontaine did it the best. Delicious food, reasonable prices, great service.  Note - specify when reserving (or call them) if you'll be ordering wine, because they can serve it to sidewalk patio tables, but not to the new tables in the blocked-off street. They will seat you accordingly. (Glad we did!)
     Speaking of wine - many to choose from, with by-the-glass varieties from $9.50-$16.  The Zin was awesome, fruity and smooth. The Ciu Ciu Montepulciano was pretty dry, like a Chiante.
     Food: excellent bread on the table, with oil & balsamic. We loved it. Caprese Salad delicious, but only 3 slices each of tomato and mozzarella. Prosciutto w/melon was fair. 
       Tre Colores (rigatoni?)  ($24) was AWESOME. The creme sauce is to die for.  The entree with the unpronouncable name (starting with the letter O) was delicious, also, with a hint of bacon.  The Angel Hair with marinara was good, but did get boring halfway through. Would be a good one to share, maybe with the Gnocci.
    Seating was immediate, service prompt, water glasses kept filled. The only slow part was waiting for the check - or offer of desert! But this has happened at all 4 of the restaurants I mentioned; not quite sure why. Highly recommended!
Food quality was not so good.  I think the quality has gone down.
We celebrated my wife’s birthday here. We had great meals, wonderful service and a lovely time.
Food was amazing! Service was great! Thank you 🤩
We had a great time.  Great service, delicious pasta and seafood and great drinks.  We were delighted to have live music during our meal.  Quite a treat and we will return!
We came to listen to our friends...the Lily Alunan Trio, hence they medium noose level.  excellent food and ambiance

Lovely little restaurant. Very nice menu, reasonably priced. We both had the Poulet aux Champignons and it was delicious!

And happily it was quiet enough for my girlfriend and I to chat. 

Definitely recommend.
Nice ambience and Food !!

This small bistro provides a consistent menu choice that includes unique specials and good variety of food choices.  All dinners have been enjoyable and provide filling portions.  It is always a treat for a quite dinner out!
Service below average at best and food tasted less than average. Not close to any authentic French nor Italian food. Definitively will not visit or be taken again.
I love their food. Good price nice and cozy place.

I visited for Valentine’s Day with my girlfriend and the restaurant was packed, but the Owner Hasan, and our waiter still took amazing care of us.

Must visit if you live in Mountain View or one of the surrounding areas!!

Everyone on the staff was very nice even on a busy night. We just didn't feel the food was worth the price. I'm usually willing to pay $90+ for a price fixe meal (3 courses with a drink included doesn't seem bad!) but the food in this case disappointed us. Maybe because they were so busy? The crab ravioli was very rich but enjoyable. The tomato sauce on the eggplant appetizer was tasty! But the scallops were kind of fishy, and my dining mate received a large 16oz steak that ended up being really gristly--it was seemingly cooked fine, but seems like they didn't have a great source for the beef and perhaps tried to make up for it in volume? And unfortunately the tiramisu was pretty dry. Ultimately an only OK experience that left us wishing we'd gone for something more satisfying for the price that night.
Restaurant was great and we enjoyed evening with good meal and service! Very recommend!

First time there and found it to be very nice!  The servers and service were very good!  Smiles and attentive!  The food was good but not great!  It is nice place to be able to have a conversation too.
Love this place.  Great menu, excellent food, and really lovely services, always. My favorite restaurant in Mountain View.

La Fontaine is a little gem that my wife and I recently discovered. The menu includes French and Italian entrées that are reasonably priced. We tried the Salmon Wellington and Lamb Risotto. Both were delicious. The restaurant is quiet with a nice ambience.

Our party of 5 has adopted La Fontaine as our pre-theatre spot, after trying a number of different restaurants on Castro Street with mixed results.  La Fontaine has an extensive "continental" menu, with a wide array of beef, chicken, fish, pasta, etc.  For fine dining on a Thursday evening on Castro Street, this is most definitely the place to go.  Wouldn't call it "quiet", but the noise level is very tolerable.  The cocktails are excellent -- they don't seem to use pre-mixes.  And the service is exceptional.  I wish I knew the name of our server on the most recent visit --- she was one of the best EVER.

The servers were very helpful and attentive. The food was very delicious and priced reasonably. The goat cheese appetizer was divine and the grilled salmon had a nice crusted skin. Our party also enjoyed the risotto and angel hair capellini (especially the sauce). It was a nice restaurant for business lunch and we had a quiet corner with a street view all to ourselves. Added bonus: Tiramisu was really really delicious! Thanks for a great hospitality. Highly recommending this place
This is the best service I've received in a restaurant in the Bay Area in many, many years.  Highly professional!!!

The restaurant was kind enough to take us early so ce we arrived sooner than anned.  The service was great as was the food.  We had the Branzino, lamb chops and the linguini with prawns. It was nice to see a french/italian menu with variety.  The room became a little noisy towards the end of the meal as the restaurant filled up but not enough to ruin the experience.
Service is very friendly, attentive and accommodating. Food and wine are excellent. I usually get the Cordon bleu.
Good food and good service. We had the beef Wellington, orechiette, crab cakes, and frisee salad and all were tasty. Do be aware that the beef Wellington is a bit bloody.
I love the food and the service is outstanding!  This is a great restaurant for a night out on the town!
The best thing I took from our experience at LaFontaine was the exceptional service.
Food is always good. What I love most is how they engage children to have a good experience at the restaurant.
As always, food, wines, and service were excellent.
The food and service were great.
My wife and I were in town on business and sought a place for dinner.  We were delighted by the quality of our experience.  Outstanding on all counts!

Meeting with 5 friends to dine together before attending Smuin Ballet Christmas Performance at Mt. View CPA.  The service was fast and polite.  It was quiet enough for us to talk together and enjoy each other’s company.  The food choices were good and tasty though not quite gourmet quality.  This is a great venue for dining before CPA performances.
Excellent menu choices.
Veal Saltimbocca, Sole and Prawns, Bruschetta and Lava Cake were delicious. Service is excellent.

First - the prices were considerably higher than the menu shown on Open Table. I had numerous choices for Italian food that evening; I chose La Fontaine because its prices were lower than other similarly-rated restaurants.  Not that it is a bad restaurant, it's actually pretty good. But it felt like false advertising. 

We had the Beef Wellington. It was delicious, but... the whole idea here is that the meat was supposed to be wrapped in a puff pastry, and it wasn't.  $38 for a ribeye on mashed potatoes is a bit pricey. For that price, we expected a treat -Puff pastry!

Our salad was good - our server generously split it for us. Our companions ordered separate salads, but only one was delivered. (Fortunately, we were not charged for it.)  

Other than the salad issue, our service was excellent.  My only complaint, here, is that prices are high for what you actually get.
Excellent food and setting
The food at La Fontaine was good but not excellent.  We had a very pleasant evening there, though, and the service was very nice.
Restaurant is fine, just kind of “meh”. Food was OK, it kind of felt like they are rushing us through the courses and pushing us to finish and leave, which was kind of disappointing.
This was our second time visit to LaFontaine. We ha such good vibes from our first visit we thought we would visit a second time. Met all our expectations once again.
The food and restaurant were excellent, but the waiter, Dumond really made the evening! He should run a school to teach people how to be good waiters!
They lamb was superb
The service was great but the food was mediocre at best..
Wonderful food but no one else in the restaurant for lunch.  Surprising!!!
Italia in Mountain View. Nice menu and a lovely red wine.

I reserved a table for 10, and it was waiting for us when we arrived. We ended up being only 7, arriving gradually over time, and the staff handled it elegantly.
The food - appetizers, main dish, dessert, wine were very good.  (nit: my duck breast arrived well done rather than medium). The menu, including the wine list, had attractive options, and the food was well prepared.
Service throughout was excellent,  attentive but not intrusive. When an additional person joined the group mid way through dinner it was handled smoothly and elegantly.
The check arrived including a 20% service charge, and tax on top of the total.  The manager said "it's legal", which I don't doubt, but it felt unordinary and unnecessary, leaving a sour note.

Lovely service and excellent food. Nice selection of wine and cocktails, too. Very much enjoyed the quieter atmosphere; actually able to carry on a conversation without raising our voices. Will definitely return.
Risotta special was very good that night, but the chicken dish I ordered wasn't a good choice.  Chicken texture was rubbery and tough and I couldn't even eat it.

I guess it's unrealistic to successfully find a good restaurant in the Los Altos, Mountain View, Menlo Park or Palo Alto areas on ANY night of the week that isn't pretty noisy.  Our criterion is whether we have to shout across the table for two in order to hear each other.  Perhaps if there hadn't been a party of 8 celebrating AND a particularly loud party of 4 senior gentlemen having an excellent time, the noise level would have been moderate at La Fontaine.  But their were those parties and once again, quiet evaded us.  That said, the food at La Fontaine, as well as the service, was very good, and we would recommend to any friend who wasn't particularly sensitive to that noise.  We had Caesar Salad, Salmon Wellington, baked Eggplant parmesan and Orichiette with bacon, fresh tomato & basil instead of peas (substitutions welcomed).  Generous portions, so our frequent take-homes are a welcome extra.  I believe the Wellington was also available with beef.  There's also a large selection of daily specials.  Parking for Castro Street Restaurants has become very challenging, and it took us about 15 minutes PAST our reservation time to find a spot.  Mountain View needs another parking garage badly, perhaps 4-stories high.
Great food and ambiance!
Went on a Monday night - very quiet as there weren't many patrons. Very exquisite service, would recommend. They serve a mean beef Wellington.

The dinner and service was good.  It was ruined by a group of 8 people  that were very noisy.  The restaurant did not warn us and seat us to the front of the restaurant.  Also, this was an anniversary and it was never acknowledged.

NOT a French restaurant.  Almost everything on the menu was Italian.  Food was poor, overcooked and portions too big.  Service was excellent, probably because there were only 2 other tables occupied during our 1 & 1/2 hour lunch.  Lovely space, but we won't return until we hear that the food has improved.
Good food but pricey. Good choice of wine. Very noisy, so not for a date.
Meh, they serve Italian food. Not good, not bad, not memorable. Really good and friendly staff though.

Food was delicious, unusual choices and a good value.  I had Beef Wellington which I have not seen on a menu for a long time.  Hint of mustard with vegetables in a puffed pastry.  My friend had the duck which he enjoyed.  We first split the appetizer/salad sampler which was a great value for only $19.  We had several glasses of Merlot wine which was a bit expensive for $12.  Tables were close together, and the restaurant seemed understaffed for the number of people in the place.  We were there on a Monday night, and did not anticipate that it would be so busy.  There was one large group with about 15 people.  We enjoyed it and intend to return.
This was our first time there and the experience was very good.  The service was spot on, food was good and the drinks were great.    We will be back!
A charming, unassuming place with very good food. Not a lot of places nowadays offer beef Wellington! My only reservation is that we felt a bit rushed through the meal.

Great food. The short ribs with polenta were just right. Service was great on the patio, with the heat lamp on. Will visit this place again. Enjoyed the coffee with the lava cake. The lava cake was pretty small for the price, but was tasty and was complimented the coffee perfectly.

Our food was great. We sat outside. Had great service most of the evening until we were finished and ready for the check it seemed our server had disappeared for awhile but it was quickly remedied when we caught the attention of another employee. It was a Sunday evening of a holiday so it was quiet in the restaurant and I'd say fairly slow. We will definitely be back for more.
I really enjoyed my dinner. The menu had many options. We were not rushed and service was great.

If you go for ambience it is a nice place, unfortunately food is average at best and pricey for very small portions. The beet salad has 3 thin slices of beet buried under arugula, the pasta is mediocre and the entrees were average
Best neighborhood gem around Downtown Mountain View to me, bar none.

My husband and I enjoyed an awesome meal to celebrate his birthday. We started with the mixed appetizer platter since we were unfamiliar with La Fontaine's offerings. This was a large platter of four pairs of items with a central salad. I loved the bruschetta which had just the right amount of garlic; his favorite was either the melone e proscuitto or the caprese.  He raved about his branzino entree, and I was very happy with a delicious bowl of orecchiette tossed with peas and bacon. We accompanied our meal with a glass of moscato and a tasty Montepulciano.  We share a dazzling chocolate mousse for dessert that surprised us with the crunchy sweetness of feuilletine - wow! We look forward to our next meal at La Fontaine.
Excellent service and food.  Loved the fish I had. My business partner had the steak flat bread excellent!

La Fontaine is a good restaurant for lunch. I have yet to go for dinner. The service was superb and the staff were very attentive and accommodating. I had the sea food pasta which was good but the pasta was a little over cooked and sticking together. My friend had the steak frites and enjoyed it, especially the fries.
Good for groups
Great for a lunch meeting. Casual setting, great food.
Truly fantastic service.  Excellent food.  Quiet and attractive ambience so we were able to converse easily at our table of 7 diners, most in their 60's.   Highly recommend.
The Best food on Castro Street, Mountain View!!!
Very affordable for downtown Mountain View. But excellent food and generous portions!
Best spot in downtown Mountain View.  Food is delicious, great service.  Highly recommended!

The reason for a 4 and not a 5 is because we asked if a dish could be sautéed instead of fried. The server hesitated. I asked if he could check with the chef. The server said no, they were very busy and couldn’t ask. The restaurant wasn’t even half full.
Great food and service. I haven’t been to this place since it changed management a while ago but I will definitely go back.
Very nice service for a  party of 7 which was appreciated
This quaint little restaurant reminded me of Italy, especially at the end of dinner when they offered complimentary limoncello.  The portions of our dishes were able and the food was delicious!
Best spot in Mtn View, great food, great  service, great experience
This is my favorite go-to place for excellent food, lovely atmosphere, great service.

A great dinner before preforming arts! Great service ! Always attentive but not "overseeing" No rush to finish:-)
We're definitely coming back:-)
Service was a bit on the slow side but everyone was very nice and accommodating and the food was very good
father’s day
The place had a nice ambience but few people and the bread that they give as a compliment had a hair stand in it!

Entrees were very good.  Wine selection was very good to great.  Pricing seemed a little high, but I don't feel like I overpaid.  My only complaint, the minestrone soup was average to below average.  It was almost like eating Campbell's Vegetable Soup.  I liked it, but it lacked being something special.  I do plan on returning.

There were 7 in our group.  We got the table we had requested, and our server was BEYOND wonderful! She managed to get us all fed and out the door in plenty of time for our theatre reservations.  3 of us ordered the Branzino, which was fabulous.  We will keep coming back!

La Fontaine is one of the more pleasant places to have lunch in downtown Mountain View. The 3 star rating is on a very demanding scale, where Michelin starred restaurants might get 4 unless they were truly phenomenal; so "Good" means Good - no verbal inflation here. The food is traditional French/Italian - tasty, satisfying and predictable without any fashionable affectations.  Service is efficient, thoughtful and unobtrusive.
Our server was amazing and treated my children wonderfully.

The food was good, but overpriced.  But it is a typical trendy restaurant in downtown Yuppieville, better know as Mountain View.  Will probably go there again, because of it's convenience & because it the only non-Asian place on Castro Street.  Contrary to most Yuppie's not everyone loves Thai food!
Food was good , nice ambience .  Service was slow in the beginning ,even though we were the only table in the restaurant . Entrees arrived quickly .
