I don’t know, but I feel that the system that they have in terms of how they space out and distribute the items in those six or five course meals just doesn’t work. You get your rice first and by the time they give you the vegetables and your meat or seafood, the rice is super cold… so you have to make a choice about whether to eat your rice without veggies or protein… or eat your meat and vegetables without any rice. Makes zero sense to me. For the price, it’s totally not worth it. It’s also a very noisy place.

We were seated by the window but the sun was shining directly into our eyes for the first forty-five minutes.  The manager told us that the window coverings were on order and had not yet arrived.

We got covered by the smoke during the cooking process.   The exhaust ventilation needs to be enhanced to avoid being smoked.

Overall the staff (Dixon and server) was very attentive and made corrections immediately when we pointed out that we were missing scallops and filet mignon for one of the party. 

A photo of the birthday celebration party provide by Benihana was not expected but was very nice to receive.

Thank You for providing a pleasant evening out!

Our waiter Vlad was awesome, he went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. His positivity was infectious.

We had reservations for 6:15p and we didn’t not get sat down until 7p. What’s the point in making reservations when you still have to wait 45 mins to be sat down. The front of the staff was horrible in addressing our issues and they simply did not seem to care about our wait time.
Had great meal.  Meat was cooked perfectly as well as all the other food.   Always loved Benihana.
Wait wasn’t too bad compared to other locations but Chef seemed fairly new messed up on our order and rarely interacted with the table

We had an inexperienced chef who did not do any tricks, talk with the customers etc. unfortunately we had 4 kids at the table with it being one of theirs birthday and he was brought specifically for the entertainment. The chef did not even do the onion volcano. The food was very good but the experience that was anticipated was a huge let down.
Not the same. Corporate has taken over. Didn’t even get a table picture at the end
Azad was swift, attentive and friendly. Our Chef Dixon did an outstanding job in entertaining us.

It is so loud in there. The music could definitely be turned down. The service is slow bc there are limited chefs I think and compared to the Japantown location the food did not taste as good. Still a fun time but will probably work out some kinks with time.

Total Amateur  hour !  I thought Benihana’s Teppanyaki chefs train for 6 months in Hawaii .
Our table’s “chef” was a complete amateur.
Tried to Put on a Show, kept looking at his Notes while the Lobster Tail got overcooked, Dried and Rubbery, the Medium Rare Filet Mignon showed just a little pink, was Dry and tough to chew. I waited for his “ assistant “ and to remind him to Bring me a Pint Glass 10 Minutes after he had brought me my Sapporo Beer , a Large Size , but apparently is the Only Size served without offering me a Choice.
I brought my own  container, but will probably throw away the “Leftovers” because it is Dry and Inedible.
Did Not even try to take away my whole bowl of “Fried Rice” because How could such Soggy Looking “Fried Rice” be Actually Dry with the chopped Chicken overcooked, hard, Unpalatable.
I care less for “ The Show “ and would Rather have the Basics such as Lobster Tail and “Filet Mignon showed” Cooked Properly !
A Total Disappointment ,  and A Waste of Time and $91 + Tips.

It’s my first time at this establishment. I went there with my friends. Let’s start with the noise level. The noise level was over the roof. It was too loud and we could not hear what our chef and server was saying. Lots of confusion with the orders. My friend order a a filet mignon and she wanted it cooked rare but it was over cooked. Other guests had their order messed up too. We waited too long for our food to be cooked and by the time it was done, it was cold. Overall ambient was good and service was good. Ryan our server did he’s best to accommodate us. The chef couldn’t speak English so it was difficult in terms of  communication. I was impressed at all and for the amount of money spend was not worth it. The only good thing that was good was the drinks. We had an old fashioned and dragon fruit margarita. I hope they will step up and improve as time goes by.

We came here for a triple birthday celebration and it was very disappointing.  The chef was very young and inexperienced.  I don’t think he’s quite ready yet.  He was so nervous that he was dropping food all over the place.  It was the most boring Teppanyaki experience we’ve ever had.

Disappointing to say the least. We had an 8pm reservation, arrived about 5 minutes early and checked in. Didn’t get seated until 8:45. Front desk and managers were unconcerned with communicating or trying to alleviate the problem. Our chef was clearly new and couldn’t really put on the show you come, and  pay extra, for. Nothing was comped and no apologies for the excessive wait. They pack them in so I guess they really don’t care if people are happy with the experience.
Congratulations on opening a great new venue. My wife and I enjoyed the bar and the tables. The food was great and the chef was witty and entertaining.

We are so excited to see one opens close by. We experienced similar teppanyaki at an all inclusive resort before and wanted to live the magic again.

We secured a 715 reservation and showed up 5 minutes before. And on man, the place is packed. We had to wait 40 minutes until we are seated. This does not meet expectation.

Our table seated nine people across three parties. As a result it was crowded with no elbow room. For the adults we opted for the specialty options (surf and turf) which included 6 course-meal. However you still had to pay extra for fried rice.

We finished just before 10pm. The cooing show was good. We enjoyed it. It could be a little better. If it were quieter, we could have hear the jokes better.

All in all, I do not recommend going back. We spent nearly three hours for over 200 for decent food. I would prefer something else instead.

Restaurant was pretty good but gave a fair rating due to we had a reservation for 7:00 and we were seated at 7:40. I get they were busy so tried to stay positive but then they put us at a table with 7 other people so we were extremely squished. I would understand if we were late or didnt have a reservation but that was not the case. The people at the table checked in after us as we saw them walk in. I had to eat at a corner of the table so it was very disappointing for being that we had reservations.

Long wait even with a reservation. The food prep itself took way too long but food was still Benihana. Still working out the kinks of a newly opened restaurant. Give it some time and hope they work it out
New location always gives fresh impression . Fairly manageable when we arrived at 6 pm but when leaving at 7:45 pretty crowded. Food & service both outstanding.

Our server Yamin was wonderful, took time to explain the menu since it was our first time there. She also checked on us often throughout the meal, making sure our drinks were filled. Music level was a bit high in the restaurant.

Our Chef Brian is always the best!  He is funny and VERY experienced. We have known him for over 20 years at the. Benihanas!

Our waiters Mahir (main waiter for our table) and his cousin Azar (spelling might not be correct) were awesome!  They were very attentive to us and provided a great customer service experience. Thank you.

Not at all happy with our visit to the new Benihana in San Mateo. We have been loyal customers at the Burlingame location for over 20 years. San Mateo location gets a big thumbs down. We spent over three hours at the table, getting our food cooked extremely slow. Noticed a lot less food given compared to Burlingame. And prices are higher? Somehow paid way more for our usual family of five here versus Burlingame. There’s a lot more work needed at this location. Understand they are still building up but it is unfair to customers who pay high fees for less than good quality food/quantity and experience. Will not return and do not recommend.

They are clearly still figuring things out, I’m not sure this location had any soft opening and it shows. Sitting at 430, we didn’t leave until 745. Everything was painfully slow, the waitress and chef didn’t seem like they could handle doing more than one thing at time. I’ve had plenty of trainee waitresses over the years but never a chef as slow as the one tonight, cooking each item individually. My kids were over it after an hour and we had to bust out our phones for them to watch shows, and by the time the dinner was cooked everything on their plates was cold. I will say this location is nice and the tables facing the windows at the bar area are also quite nice, but the marble around the teppanyaki table itself is huge and it’s impossible even for an adult to eat off the plate while the meal is being prepared so it’s kind of an issue. Also I’d urge whoever is running the restaurant to rethink how they print tickets- the chef had to constantly check the ticket on his cart to figure out who got what, just making everything take way too long. When we were leaving the lobby was absolutely slammed shoulder to shoulder with people- not surprising if they are taking that long to turn tables that they just can’t keep up with the reservations they book.

We had a large party of 9 and the table held us comfortably. The food was great, the service was choppy. Forgetting things but running to go get the item, and no offer to refill drinks had to flag them down. It wasn’t super busy as there were open tables. The birthday singing was way too much for my liking but hey if you like 6 people with tambourines screaming happy birthday at the top of their lungs then this is your jam. I was charged for two extra fried rice ($15) but that was my bad for not double checking the bill, however in my defense I wanted to get out of there after three hours of being overstimulated and shouting to the people at my table anytime we wanted to converse. The cost of a basic (not top shelf) margarita was $18.50! I will say the food was really good. Our chef Javier was splendid. 
All in all, this is a special occasion meal, not a Friday night date night. There are many other downtown options (San Mateo, Redwood City, Palo Alto) to experience sushi, steak and cocktails that aren’t going to cost a fortune and your voice the next day.

Clumsy chef. Really hurt the vibe. Chef spilled food all over the place and dropped everyone’s food at least once while serving. Also dropped food was taken from the counter top and then placed on patrons plates. Dropped food in our sauces too. Chef had a bad night. Food was not prepared timely. Lots of cold bites.

Better luck next time Chef. We’re rooting for you!

Not a great experience, we will not return. Go to a different location. We had a reservation at 7:45, we were not seated until 8:30, 45 mins after our reservation. Servers were overwhelmed with the amount of tables they had, ours was super nice but very busy. The chef wasn’t great. Unfortunately, it’s the worst Benihana food I’ve had.
Service was very nice, food was fantastic and the overall experience was amazing.

Decided to try the Bridgepoint shopping center location in San Mateo/Foster City area. I made a reservation and we still had to wait 20 min before we got seated. It took us 1 hour from when we arrived, got seated, and had our first drink. Then another hour to finish all of our meals. We were sat in the back and the chef was having problems with the grill and assuming temperature where other co-workers had to help him fix it. Overall our chef was very kind, but I was expecting more of a show and interaction with customers. We brought our kids thinking they will love the energetic show and it was a bit disappointing. I also had a birthday coupon that I wanted to redeem and apparently you can only redeem it Mon-Thurs. Overall, I could have saved $100 off my total bill and went to Suishi and had better food, better price, and home sooner. A family of 4 will run you close to $300 including tip.

Everything was delicious unfortunately it seems like things are more overpriced especially with their delicious chicken fried rice.  ￼Plus, I was not happy with the promotions they had they did and  not specify it could be only in the bar area ( there course meal for $39 5 course) But we had a great server. Food was fantastic and our chef was amazing. I am very excited to have a Benihana closer to our home :)
￼￼

Great experience love the new Benihana and San Mateo. The food is exactly the same as all the other Benihana’s great service delicious food nice atmosphere would definitely go back again. I recommend it to everybody a little bit on the expensive side, but worth every penny.❤️

Your chef is new is very slow cook. The helper didn’t clean our dishes and didn’t refill our drinks.They did give the birthday cakes to my daughter and her husband.They didn’t take the picture of us. They didn’t thank us
The food was delicious and the service at the table was great. The only downside was, we had reservations for 5:45 pm and we were not seated till 6:25.

It was my birthday, the hostess were great, but when we got sat the chef did not give the fldinning experience we usually get, the chef did not speak English so he only talked with the other family that spoke his language, he only did 2 fun things, our food took so long because he only cooked 1 thing at a time so when our food was done most of it was cold.... it was my 7 year olds first time and he almost fell asleep and the cook also forgot his order so he didn't eat. The manager needed up taking my son's meal off the bill. It was sad because it was my 40th birthday and I was super disappointed since we paid a $245.00 bill and tilled a undeserved $50, the chef did say sorry for missing my kids food.

Disappointed  in our experience last night in San Mateo. We were seated at a table that was a booth where we were crammed in and barely any room for our plates. 

2 cocktails in the bar before dinner cost us almost $50 with tip

Our chef did not speak a work of English and cooked our food without any fun experience and not in the right order.  He did the fried rice which was great, but then cooked the shrimp and scallops first, followed by the steak and then chicken and then finally the onions and mushrooms at the very end after we had already eaten most of our food.  The cooking process was SUPER slow and not the fun experience that we've had over the years in Burlingame. 

We will not be going back

We wanted to give the new location a try, but our Hibachi Chef was too new and inexperienced. The chicken fried rice (which is a $7.50 up charge) was burnt and bland. The timing of the meal was off, and steaks were overcooked because the chef was doing too much at once. There were only a few of the Hibachi “tricks” he could do but it still took him a few tries to get it right. Overall the meal was still fine because the soup, salad, sauces can make up for it. Given the cost of the meal, I would wait a while before coming back to this location.
Fantastic family dinner to celebrate a birthday. Wonderful service and meal entertainment

We had a horrible experience dining at the new Benihana San Mateo location. Given it was their 2nd week or so being open our waiter didn't know the menu and our cook was definitely brand new. 

Immediately when we were seated, we were placed at one of the two tables by the bar. The music was so loud we couldn't hear the waiter or each other. Thankfully they turned the music down. 

For my order I ordered Hibachi Chicken with Shrimp. The waiter/cook didn't have my shrimp on the cart and I had to remind them despite it being on the receipt. I also asked for zucchini only and felt cheated when I got 7-8 small strips of zucchini. The menu says the Hibachi chicken came with mushrooms, neither my husband or myself received ours. When I asked the waiter brought out mushrooms, but only served one of us. No discount offered, the waiter said "I'm not supposed to say this, but we did just open". I get mistakes, but we paid $130 for horrible service and barely any food. We felt hungry and scammed.
Nice place to eat. Fun atmosphere. Our chef was better than others. Lots of shrimp being tossed around. Chopping food and grilling it in front of you was interesting.
For a new location,  the staff did a great job, food was well prepared and cooked well.

A Longtime Benihana Family Shares Honest Feedback on New San Mateo Location
Our family has been loyal patrons of Benihana for over 30 years, so naturally, we were excited to try the new San Mateo location. Unfortunately, this experience was not what we’ve come to know and love about Benihana.

We were a party of six and shared our table with another couple. From the moment we sat down, the service felt rushed. Soup and salad were brought out simultaneously, we barely had time to enjoy our appetizers before the plates were cleared away. It seemed as though our meal was being paced to match the smaller party rather than tailored to our group of six.

The fried rice, usually a highlight we happily pay extra for, was underwhelming with very little flavor. The milkshakes—at $11 each—were surprisingly small. Most disappointingly, we were asked if we needed to-go boxes before we even had a chance to finish our entrees. We hadn’t even been seated for a full hour!

The atmosphere was loud music and poor acoustics making it difficult to hear the chef. The overhead fans were cited as the issue, but we suspect it's part of the “new vibe” the manager mentioned. Unfortunately, it took away from the signature Benihana experience of engaging conversation and lively chef interaction.

We did bring our concerns to the manager that night, but the conversation felt brushed over.  I followed up with a call the next day, I appreciated that the manager asked how they could make things right—but honestly, I just wanted to express how different the experience was compared to all our other.

We remain loyal to the Benihana brand and its legacy, but this location has some growing pains to work through. For now, we’ll give it time to find its footing before returning. Dining out, especially for families, is a financial investment—and this visit didn’t meet our standards.

Overall just not great.   Staff seemed to still be trying to fugure it out, restaurant has only been open teo weeks.  Lunch was costly, $118.00 after top, that was for two people, no alcohol.  Food delivered from kitchen wasnt really hot, they forgot to bring our appetizer ( we had it for desert)   My meal was delivered from kitchen begire they even began preparing my dates food.  It should be brought out st about the same time.  Just not a great experiance

Only 2ish weeks into San Mateo's opening, our toddler boys wanted to take dad out for his 40th birthday. Food was off to a slow start, our waitress was darling but the chef was clearly undertrained and just seemed forgetful (didn't give us sauce, kept going back to ask questions, couldn't remember who ordered what).  Once the show started, things felt better but after food and drinks, we waited for over 15 min until anyone came to ask for dessert, and then another 15min to get the check. It seemed like there was a mistake with other tables' checks and everyone was chaotic. We finally had to get our own to-go boxes and just ran out since we were there already over 2 hrs!! 

The kids were so bummed they didn't take the usual benihana photo. For the price, it just didn't feel great but I do wish them the best of luck as they ramp up.
Good food and service, still have a few minor kinks to work out just because of being new. Some of our order didn’t go through, but they fixed it right away. Great sever, chef and manager.

Understanding it’s new but our chef was confused about what to cook and how to cook them correctly. We were there for the “show” or experience but all the chef did was cook with minimal excitement and wow moment. He also made our food in the wrong order. We were served over-salted grilled onion at the very end by themselves, after the meal is completed. Why? Because he forgot about it!! That is not good and we still have to pay the premium price for subpar food.

For our almost 500$ tab, our food was not cooked and seasoned the way it typically is at any benihana. It was hard to chew and my chicken tasted like cardboard. The portions were even smaller than usual and bland.

I think our station was an afterthought during after construction. Our station was in the bar area. There  wasn't a prominent light over the grill. Our chef could barely see what he was doing. We couldn't see the grill so the fan fare was limited. At one point a couple turned on the light on their phone to help with the visibility. The station next to us had the same problem.
Because of the poor lightening we didn't get to enjoy the cooking show that Benihana is famous for.

We ordered appetizers. The calamari was drenched in oil and cold. The shrimp tempura never showed up.  The chef used a great deal of garlic butter. More than what I'm use to them using.

The music was way TOO loud.

Our wait person was GREAT! With everything that was going wrong she was professional and attentive. I think her name was Shea.

I would have appreciated if the staff didn't continuously come by and sweep the floor around our chairs. 

The restaurant just opened so it might take a while before they get a groove going.

Joseph

The restaurant just opened so we were not expecting perfection but our table had a chef that was not up to the task. He confused the meat and never cooked the onions and forgot the mushrooms for my husband’s steak. We were 2 and the other group had6. They had the same unfortunate experience we did. The waiter was extremely attentive and understood what was going on. A member of the other party spoke to the manager who apologized and gave us 10% off which was a bit insulting. 25% would have been more appropriate.
The service was great. The food was great and the manager came to our table to see if everything was OK. It was OK twice I recommended to anybody that wants to have a good service.
Overall amazing experience. Only flaw was it was my birthday and had a coupon from them and they told me I couldn't redeem it on a weekend
Food had great flavor, yummy prickly pear margaritas!

The service, ambiance and food were great. Our first visit at this location and it did not disappoint. Both my husband and I ordered the Benihana Trio. It was delicious. Looking forward to coming back.
Staff was absolutely wonderful.  Food was delicious but a bit expensive. Great new location in San Mateo.

Visited the new San Mateo Benihana restaurant.  The place was jumping and service was extensive (where did they get so many servers from?).  It was actually too much for us, who prefer quiet and peaceful environments.

The meal was interestingly, and good quality and taste, but was slow in preparation and by the time the cooking was done (roughly 2 hours after our arrival) , the food prepared earlier in the cooking process was cold.
Excellent experience! Chef Adan is the best 🙌good food

Waiter was mew and goofed a couple of times on my order, bit he was very apologetic. Meat was cols and he brought me a fresh hot steak. $7.95 for adding chicken fried rice was a bit too much. Overall food was fresh
We sat at the tables in the bar area and the lighting was terrible. Our cook had to use his own phone to light up the cooking area.

I made a reservation at 8 and got seated after 9. It was a soft opening so probably why.   I probably will not go back to Benihana.   The food tasted good.   It was wayyyy tooooo slow.  2 of us ordered chicken and shrimp. The chef did not have my shrimp and cooked it later. 6 people ordered steak.  The steak finished cooking then started on the chicken.  Overall no change in the Benihana show very boring.
My only complaint was 1 of the hosts ignored me which I was clearly there waiting to be acknowledged but he then proceeded to check in with others who came a few minutes after which annoyed me.
Reservation time was 7pm. Seated at 9pm. Chef arrived at table at 9:30. Aside from introducing himself did not speak with anyone at our table.

We had a 7:30pm reservation. They did not seat us & commited to my reservation. We left after waiting for 45 mins. Why even take reservations if you are not going to honor it. Such a disappointment. Went to BJ’s right beside & got seated right away. They need to do better!
Crowded, loud, and bland food.  Not sure why people were excited about this.

name: Willard Hicks - Campbell
description: At Willard Hicks - Campbell we offer our guests an elevated experience in a warm, comfortable, inviting atmosphere. Our vision is to provide a balanced experience where quality and comfort are truly affordable. We strive to create a relationship with each of our patrons and truly appreciate our neighborhood community.We are excited to offer Certified Angus Beef steaks, deliciously prepared on our almond wood burning grill and feature dishes prepared with only the finest, freshest ingredients.At the bar you will find handcrafted cocktails created with premium craft spirits and an exciting selection of beers and wine.We welcome you to Willard Hicks; it is our hope that you feel right at home.
hours:
Brunch
Sat, Sun 10:00 am–2:00 pm
Lunch
Daily 11:00 am–4:00 pm
Dinner
Mon–Thu, Sun 4:00 pm–10:00 pm
Fri, Sat 4:00 pm–11:00 pm

reviews.text: Food was fantastic. Service could have been better. We felt all night we were always waiting.. waiting to take our drink order, waiting for the check, waiting forever for someone to pick up the check.

This was my first time at Willard Hicks. We enjoyed a private dining room for lunch.  The staff abd service was attentive and good.  The food was presented lovely and tasted excellent.  I recommend the petite Filet Mignon and the Ceviche appetizer.    I will come again and would send my executive and team members there as well.
Great food, tasty drinks and the service was stellar. It was a perfect day to sit out on the patio and all of the food was delicious.

I asked for a special request and they kept it as a surprise as expected, that was outstanding and appreciated! Food was really tasty! The environment is really intimate for special occasions! Looking forward to come back again !
Understaffed both at bar and servers. The coconut shrimp was dry.

We went for 2 birthdays and requested and got the private room in the back. A plus, but it was a Sunday night and wasn't busy at all. Flavor of the food was good, however, here's why the lower rating. Bar brought a wrong whiskey..not the flavor ordered,  but they did bring a 2nd one free of charge. We brought a bottle of wine which was spilled sligjtly when being poured. Pourer offer something from the bar to compensate, but said.that wasnt necessary. Worst thing was a NY steak had to be returned 2 times to get it cooked as requested (med rare). 1st was well, 2nd was very rare. Requested horseradish and brought some sort of aoili instead. Had to ask for butter for the baked potato which wasnhard as a rock wwhen they briught some. For the price, these things shouldn't happen. Was there a month ago on a week night and had a very good experience. Not so nice on a Sunday night. Was disappointed this time.

Food was outstanding. The only issue is they gave my teens mocktails with alcohol in them!! They should not allow cocktails to be made with alcohol to prevent this from happening. They thought it was great joke and did not tell me until they had almost finished the drinks.
Great food and drink - menu selection terrific.  Everything looks, smells and tastes great!  Well presented.  One of our favorites.  Looking forward to our next visit.

Not what I expected.
This seems like a restaurant trading on past glories.
The furniture and menu (and prices) say (near) high-end dining.  The stained paper menus, wait staff and music choices say fast-food/casual dining.
Service was great overall and very attentive. Food took longer than expected to arrive, but all in all it was a great experience.

We had a reservation and were seated promptly, but no server came to assist us for about 20 minutes. We had to ask someone if a server would be helping us, and a kind gentleman stepped in. The restaurant wasn’t too busy at the time, so we weren’t sure what the issue was. Once we ordered, the drinks and food arrived, but one dish didn’t taste good and had to be sent back. It took a long time to come back out, and after it did, multiple people kept trying to bring us the same dish again. It seemed like there was a major lack of communication. That being said, our server was very nice, and the food (aside from the one dish) was good. I just wish the overall experience had been better.

Booked reservations for my moms 80th birthday and they put us in one of the back rooms!  It was such a great space for the family to talk and laugh and open presents.  Mom had the 18oz special ribeye and she ate the whole thing! Food was good and ambiance was the best.
María was our server and she was great!
Looking forward to returning again soon!

Valentine special was amazing! Our waiter was very nice checked up on us frequently. We gave him and the cooking staff an impossible request, my hubby likes his steak well done and I like mine medium rare and we were hesitant about ordering the VDay special steak and we all came to an agreement of ordering it Medium and when they brought out the steak some of the sliced pieces were medium rare and some well done. We were more than happy the team went above and beyond for us.
Celebrated birthdays. Food and service were great. Loved the pork chop, ribs and cornbread. No corkage fee was nice. We will be back.

Food was not great over cooked shrimp appetizer
Flavors did not match . Salmon on salad so dry and over cooked .

Will not return
It was such a great night. Great food, drinks and service. Love this place.
Food. Was good as always but the service was painfully slow.  One meal showed up 10 minutes after the others.  Staff was friendly but something was off.

This used to be one of my favorite places, but I don’t feel like it anymore. The restaurant was more than half empty, and yet we had to wait a long time for our food, asking to check on  dishes over and over again. One of my previous preferred dishes - the French onion soup- was REALLY bad, watery and extremely sour, and was returned after one sip. I wish I didn’t have to write this review.

I did not have a good experience dining here last night. Both my steak and my wife’s steak were overcooked. The mash potatoes were some of the worst I’ve ever had. There was no butter or salt in them. For the price the restaurant charges for 2 steaks and mashed potatoes, I could’ve made this meal better at my house. I will not be returning to Willard Hicks.
No waiter for 15 minutes. Was great once he came however.  Steak was tough. Meh.
Sorry to say that this place has gone down hill fast. Service was terrible and food equally the same. Tasteless and uncreative. What a bummer.
Slow service, wrong drinks came out twice.  Food is ok, for the price you expect better.  Very nice people, very nice atmosphere.  Just not worth it for a $300 dinner in my opinion
Came for the filet steak i had ordered it medium rare and it got over cooked twice just a little disappointing when everyone was saying how good the place was, didn’t even end up getting a steak

Horrible service/ had to call a manager over after asking no less than 6 times for the same thing.  Manager was zero help and kept referring to the “people above him” (meaning he wasn’t well positioned to even address our issues.  Couldn’t get drinks and when waitress did take drink order it was one/two at a time versus asking the entire table of 8 what they needed.  Thought we had found a good alternative to all of our Los Gatos favorites but was highly disappointed last night!  The lady who helped with the reservation was the bright spot/ she suggested table 30- commented that she and her family love said table over the holidays, etc.  SHE was delightful- other than that, horrible experience and we easily spent 2k for dinner and all of the drinks/ should have walked away feeling happy as opposed to frustrated!

The appetizers took almost 1 hour to come out. It was not very busy when we first ordered.  One came out and we thought they forgot about the second appetizer and it came out as we finished the 1st appetizer. Usually, we order appetizers to eat from both while we wait for our meal. The drinks took a very long time to get.
My only complaint is the full corn in the cob and peppers in my wedge salad. I mean why?! Our table assistant was incredible, he was on top of it with water and clearing plates.

The food and drinks are consistently good. The bartenders are knowledgeable and make great cocktails. The risotto is a favorite of mine. The coconut shrimp is delicious, and the one pound burger is a winner!

Today was my first time at Willard Hicks.  The service and staff were great.
The menu has a variety of things on it, so this is a good restaurant for people with all kinds of tastes.  The salad was great, the tacos were great.  I'm not a big bell pepper fan, so I took those out of my salad and tacos, but other than that, the flavors were great!   The atmosphere was really mellow and everyone seemed relaxed.
The music was a mix of 1970's easy rock and light jazz. 
All in all it was a great lunch and I will definitely come back to try other things on the menu.

Food was delicious, They were busy but we sat inside. Brought our own bottle of wine, generous corkage fee. French onion soup, Cesar salad, scallops and risotto, grilled swordfish.  Perfect date night,… especially when you’ve been married for 35 years ❤️
Usually a fine experience tonight seems to have been the exception. It was particularly disappointing as I brought a friend after promising them a perfect dining experience.
Service is terrible.  Takes 30 minutes to get a drink.  This is always an issue.  They seem to change management and staff constantly.

Hit or miss - Ahi was amazing as well as the chicken wings. 
Caesar salad was strange and tasteless with giant chunks of garlic. Added salmon that we requested medium rare and it was way over done and dry.
Crab cakes super fried and strange texture
It was good. Food is still really good but I felt like it went down a notch.
Service was slow, wine arrived after dinner. Food was mediocre at best,
Came in on Tuesday night. It wasn’t fair. Stuff was really friendly. All of the appetizers were really good, but the chicken over rice dish was a little salty because they used too much. Soysauce.
Nice portions, beautiful presentation and excellent food and service.  We'll definitely return.

This place has been hit or miss. I’ve had a couple good experiences here in the past. Ribs are generally good and I’ve enjoyed their filet mignon in the past. However, the signature bone-in ribeye with ginger glaze was disappointing. The glaze was overdone and masked the flavor of the meat plus the steak was delivered undercooked,  cool to the touch and fatty. I had to send it back to be refired and cooked to medium. Even then, it was just so-so.

Outstanding service and very delicious food! It was not my first visit, and definitely not my last. And please build out your mocktail selection as the 2 we had was delicious, so more options would be a delight.
Our long time favorite restaurant. Food is amazingly delicious

This dinner was for my husband’s birthday. We greeted warmly by the hostess and our server, David, was so attentive and fun! The food was amazing! Everything from the appetizer to dessert was fantastic.

No sé si sería simplemente un mal día, pero todo salió mal en este restaurante. Órdenes equivocadas. Comida con mal sabor. Carnes que no fueron traídas al término deseado. Fuimos por nuestro aniversario y estaba incluido en la reservación y ni siquiera fue mencionado.
The DJ on Friday kills it every time! Keep that ambiance! We go for the food, stay for the DJ!

This is a restaurant trying to be what it isn’t. The positive reviews are so inaccurate I felt completely misled by them. The first thing I noticed as I entered the restaurant was that the photos were so touched up that they misrepresented how the place really looked. It was loud with a DJ playing music as the ambient music. Service was no better than at Denny’s. Wait staff are not trained properly. Wine opened and poured without tasting.  Timing of appetizers and salad was bad.  No fresh ground pepper for the salad. Entree was cold. My pork chop was served in a bowl so it was hard to cut. The pork chop was piled on top of sides so that everything was a mishmash - no individual distinct flavors.  We had to keep asking for silverware after they removed the used ones.
For a $300 meal, this was a complete waste of money for both the food and experience.  There was no value for this meal.  I would not recommend this place. I will not return.
Everything was great it was just very hot in our room. (L private room)…

The food was yummy, as usual! The service there is normally good but last night was not at all. Our server barely checked on us, only two meals came out and the 5-6 minutes later the other two came but still didn’t see our server… we had to pour our own wine. The service was bad. The loud street performer was terrible. It really impacted being able to hear a conversation. He has to go. The bus boy was incredibly helpful and hard working.
This continues to be one our favorite restaurants.  The staff are friendly and helpful and the food is always exceptional.

It took the server 30 minutes to even acknowledge us or give us water although everyone around us had been served.  Then after we ordered they got my order wrong and i had to reorder which they then forgot about. I had to ask about my order and then they finally brought it out.  Service was not good, food was decent.
Our charcuterie was sever but no plates were provided until I went to the host stand. There was a street musician on the corner blasting weird music that was audible on the patio.

Food was excellent as always.  Service this evening was horrible.
I've reached out to management and hope our next visit has better service
Great NY Steak. The Pancetta Mac and Cheese was also excellent. Free corkage for the first bottle of wine is a great benefit to eating there.

Something was off this time around. It was Thursday 8/29/24 dinner was at 630pm - wasn't that busy at all. Overall a great place. I think it was a night of distractions that might's caused some issues. 

- Ordered a Filet Mignon w/ Fire roasted grapes & raspberry demi-glaze from the signature menu (Medium Rare). Came out well-done. Scorched
- Business partner ordered the NY Strip w/ Peppercorn Sauce (Medium). Came out - Well done and also scorched. 

- Appetizers & drinks were perfect. Not sure what happened w/ the steaks. I've been here many many times and never had a problem before. Mayne it was an off night or distractions? 
- Overall 

- I wish Mama's Meatloaf was still on the menu. I miss that dish.
First time visitors to Willard Hicks and we enjoyed it!
Our filet was over cooked and when they brought back a new one it was under but also didn’t look like a filet.
Lack of staffing made the service brow the normal we are used to here. Definitely no fault of the service, but just a lack of staffing!
Food was just so meh 🫤 it’s such a pretty restaurant but has lost it luster in the food all together

First time ever that my husband didn't finish an old fashion cocktail.  It was weak and poorly mixed.  Ribs were too spicy.  Loaded Baked potato looked like it had been sitting out for awhile.  Butter cake was excellent though.

We came here for a Sunday dinner at 5:30 with friends. There were only maybe 4-5 other tables sat while we were there, so noise was not an issue. The drinks were tasty and the food delicious. It’s a nice establishment so a tad on the pricier side but we had a great time eating, drinking and  fellowshipping; Would always recommend this place!
Everything was very good as usual but.... It happened to be humid outside and they kept the door open. It so hot and uncomfortable inside. They should have cranked the air conditioning.

Very poor service, our server was very young and inexperienced. We had to ask for appetizer plates, had to ask to place our dinner order, had to ask to order wine after he walked away, asked for a steak knife, dessert menus, etc etc etc. The music was too loud for what I perceived to be a  steakhouse and there was a DJ in the front of the restaurant. Why? Food was just ok. When I made the reservation online I was asked if it was a special occasion; I replied anniversary. Why ask if it’s not going to be acknowledged by anyone at the restaurant? Also, apparently you have to request a booth when making your reservation if you want one, although that’s not listed online as an option, only outside and standard seating are options. Ridiculous. We spent $500 as a party of 4 and we will not be back.
Everything was good, steak was overcooked but was still good. We really loved the tuna appetizer, will be back.

Simple and casual with a very good bar.  Steaks were very above average with great service.  It's in the middle of downtown Campbell which is a real destination these days with lots going on.  Parking in the First Street Parking Garage is highly recommended.
Fantastic, accommodating service. Really a great meal and love coming here.
Nice experience with my husband. Food was delightful. Our server was super nice.

The service is always great. The food this time was less yummy than usual, but still good. My only complaint is the volume of the music. At 6:30 on a Friday, the music was already so loud that it was difficult to have a conversation. The music was good and if it was a cocktail bar, I would have expected that.
As always, had a fantastic meal.  Love their Pesto Cheesy Loaf and the rib-eye and filet were tender and tasteful.
Scallops were amazing! Cooked perfectly ! Swordfish and the burger were awesome too. Great service and a great evening.

Had an early dinner in a Friday night because we had heard of service issues. Not sure how things are when things are busy there, but we had great service. Food was great. Everything was cooked perfect and tasted great. We did not order drinks, so cannot comment on those.

Unfortunately, this was a very disappointing visit. I was celebrating my birthday and we ordered the ribs, filet mignon, kids teriyaki steak and pancetta Mac n cheese, pictures looked good but everything except from the Mac and cheese was almost uneatable.

Teriyaki steak was burnt, fries soggy
Filet mignon we had to send back, flavor was off, overcooked (initially requested medium rare)
Ribs had so much sauce and it was so sweet and over powering. The fries soggy as well.

For dessert they offered a homemade chocolate chip cookie with a scoop of ice cream, it was so hard and crumbly, tasted old.

So sad, felt bad and took food home except for the filet mignon that we asked to take back to the kitchen.

Bella was our server, super sweet girl, it was just a super slow service, took forever to get water and the food took over 35 min wait.
L

I made a reservation on Open Table, I got a confirmation text from the restaurant. I even called and confirmed and when arriving to the restaurant they said there was no reservation. When I reserved I asked for outside and we were seated inside since they said there was no reservations. I should them my confirmation and text . The service was slow, the waiter never checked on us once food was served. I would not go back again .

Our server barely came by. They were very awkward during the ordering process. They seemed combative when we asked questions. Made us uncomfortable. The food was ok. The atmosphere is very very loud there. Not ideal overall for how expensive it is.
Great steaks. The Brussel sprouts side was delicious as well.
Food was very, very salty. Service was OK, value for the amount spent wasn't on par.

Poor service. Nice guys but their English was poor. Our order got mixed up with someone else and we never did receive our fries. Looked like we were only ones in restaurant and it took for ever to get our drinks. Don’t think I’ll be going back
4 of us enjoyed our lunches!  Can't go wrong!  Service was good and wasn't too busy inside during lunch.

This was a perfect place to meet for a business lunch.  It was unexpectedly empty so we had no problems conducting our business meeting.  However, the food took quite a while to be served and the portions were very small considering the price you were paying for the entrees.  The poke bowl had plenty of tuna and one scoop of rice but the rest of the dish was taken over by a lovely garnish that was huge and not really edible from a nutritional value standpoint.  Very disappointing.  Two of our party ordered "beef tips" with their salads.  We were very surprised that they were teriyaki beef tips which wasn't mentioned on the menu.  Very disappointing again especially since this is a steak place and we were expecting nice, juicy, well seasoned meat.  

The place next door, Mo's (which is run by the same owners), was packed and hopping for lunch which was a huge contrast to Willard Hicks which was empty.  

I might have a business lunch here again but it would be for the atmosphere and not so much the food.  I hope they change things up since it's a lovely place.

Preface, we come here for every birthday in our family, and with four teenage boys, that's pretty frequently, at least 6 times a year.  Unfortunately this year the birthday fell on Mother's Day, but we hoped that most people went out for brunch and dinner would be better.  The hostess was nice and helpful but it took forever to get somebody to even bring us water and take our order-in the end, the bartender had to come outside and take it because our server was too overwhelmed being Mother's Day, I guess.  Our meals all came out a few minutes apart from each other, so we waited until everyone had their food, and the food quality of the "signature" steak and the special sirloin with the lobster tail was horrible.  The "horseradish mash" that was advertised with the special was a small portion of over-baked mashed potatoes, dried out and no flavor.  I will say the lobster tail was good though.  Steak was fatty and very tough.  My son that ordered the NY strip from the "signature" steaks said his steak was very under cooked (a Medium was ordered and it was very red in the center) and then after we paid, we realized they charged us $4 extra for the peppercorn sauce that we thought came with that entree.  My husband and two of our teens had the filet mignons from "The Grill" with sides and their steaks were much higher quality, so I guess we've learned our lesson to stick with "the grill" steaks and not the specials or "signature" steaks.  Definitely disappointed this time around with the quality, especially for what you pay.

After a great experience at the Morgan Hill Willard Hicks recently my wife was eager to have Mother's Day dinner at the Campbell Willard Hicks, but it was not the same. The service was relatively slow, and the drink order was wrong. We asked for the wedge salad to be chopped and tossed so we could share it easily. They did make a few cuts into the wedge but left the rest to us (with the server telling us "it is chopped" when we said something about it).

To be fair, our server took the drink off the check, but we only figured out the reason she didn’t like it was because they brought the wrong drink (and we found that when he brought the check). Back to the salad, it was served with the stems still attached to the peppers and the grapes. The corn (in the salad) was on the cob. If it was supposed to be a garnish, I understand, but the salad was described as including corn.

Her steak was just as good as she remembered, but the grapes (part of what really makes this dish) were served with stems attached (just a bunch of grapes versus individual, roasted grapes as the plate was served in Morgan Hill). I made the mistake of trying something different (the scallops and risotto; not worth it). The staff was friendly enough, just not as attentive as we experienced in Morgan Hill (or as you should be able to expect for the price).
Great menu selection, good ambiance and lighting, well run even on a particularly busy day.

Disappointing Mother’s Day experience. The restaurant opened 10 minutes late and appeared to be completely unprepared for a service. It took an hour and 10 minutes before the coffee cake and yogurt parfait came out. The remaining order took another 30 minutes and the dishes were cold and of subpar quality. The manager at least acknowledged their issues and compensated us for the entire meal. The poor server had to constantly apologize for other peoples shortcomings. Fortunately, it was Sunday and the Farmer’s Market was still open so that we could pick up something to eat there.
Great service, awesome food , we gonna come back again

Food was great as usual but going in the later afternoon (4pm) is a challenge for service as the only staff present is the Bartender. He is working the bar, setting guests and waiting, serving and clearing tables. Hard for 1 guy to be everywhere. So I’d rate him a 5 but the restaurant a 3 for expecting him to do it all.
Amazing food and service. Love this place. Thanks for everything. Cheers
Love this restaurant! Great food! I will definitely be back.

Had dinner at 6:30 and the music was so loud that you could barely hear yourself talk. I get having loud music in the bar area might make sense but most people dining are there to listen to people they came with

We had three different appetizers. They were all good size and could serve the four of us. We all had a different type of entrée and over very good. The dessert choices are very limited, but we were very full by then anyway.

Our waitress Jamie was fantastic. Food was great but really pricey. The desserts, even though the menu has expanded are all premade and shipped in and they taste like it. They cookies were stale and the red velvet cake tasted like freezer. For the price they should hire a pastry chef. They will have a run for their money when Doppio Zero opens down the street in May 2024. Also would be really great if they actually varied their menu. Tells me they don’t actually have a chef, just cooks who have mastered the menu that hasn’t really changed in years.
Wonderful service and food was perfect.  We ate outside.
Overall, the food was delicious especially the swordfish entree' and the jalapeno corn bread.   Drink service was a bit spotty but our server-in-training made for that with effort and enthusiam.

Our server was a rookie. Very slow and I had to get out of my seat a number of times to track her down about the wine we ordered. It came after we finished our dinners. Other than the slow/incompetent service, the food and ambiance were great.
Consistently very good with great value. Nice clean restaurant and very friendly staff
Horrible service, got charged for items they never delivered, sent in a complaint, never heard back after spending over $350 on dinner.
Great place to hang out with a friend over dinner and a glass of wine during a week night.

This place is a go to location you can enjoy food and cocktails and enjoy the variety of the menu and consistency in the flavorful dishes.  We frequent this location for lunch, cocktails and occasional dinners.  Wait staff is friendly and attentive.  Ambiance is Warm, inviting, vibrant and energetic.  The background music and Live DJ's for dinner create a great ambiance.  Morgan Hill is our go to... Campbell location... eh.. it was ok, not the same vibe as Morgan Hill.
Delicious steaks, perfectly prepared.  excellent and generously portioned side, we had mac and cheese, brussel sprouts and mushrooms.  excellent oreo crust cheesecake.  We'll be back!

The service was seriously lacking and it wasn’t very busy. From the beginning, three of us were sat in a booth and nobody approached us for 20 minutes until I flagged someone down.  Other tables were served that sat after us.  To get a glass of wine took about 15 minutes.  Food was good but won’t be back.
Food was tasty. Service was okay. Piped music was too loud -
Finally, my steak was cooked exactly as I wanted it.
Everything was great except for the tables being too close together. People could barely go between them.
Food was fabulous. Service was great. Drinks were amazing
Great cornbread and baby back ribs! Would definitely go back.
We really enjoy the food here. I also come here often for work lunches. The food is consistent, and the stall is friendly. Great for groups and family.
Amazing staff, vibe was great, food was delicious overall great experience.
Good foods, nice and warm atmosphere and excellent service. I'll introduce to my friends and will come back for sure!

Server came to pick up our order then disappeared for 1.30 min, we had to flag another server to get his attention again. Food was delivered shortly (and hot, so thankful for that) server started finally paying attention but a little too late. Then we received the ticket and noticed they had comp several items so that put us in a good mood but then when we finally received the ticket, the server canceled all of our comped items and we ended up paying full price (which honestly felt like a bait and switch). We still left a good tip because we're decent people, even though he didn't deserve it.
The food was extraordinary and offered flavor profiles that were different and well executed. This isn't just another steakhouse, we'll be visiting again.

We have been many times and enjoyed it but this time it was poor. Food was great but service was just too slow. It was friendly, genuinely nice staff but just too slow and disorganized. I doubt we will be back which is a shame because the food really is good, it just needs some proper organization.

Great service! 
Went for a 25th Birthday for our son. 
Enjoyed the small room and food was all delicious.
Service was slow  food was alright, but lacked anything special.
The restaurant is nice but it’s very noisy and we were underwhelmed with the food. The salad was the best thing we had. We think we’d enjoy it more for lunch than for dinner.

Food was very good.
They always seem to take to long to take your drink order.
Food arrived quickly, but the side dishes arrived AFTER the entrees were half consumed.
Made my fiancée birthday amazing!! Shout out to the DJ 🎶
Really slow service. Drinks took 40 min to arrive.
Great food, good drinks, it was a Friday evening and a DJ was spinning 90’s RNB and old school. A definite recommendation.
The steaks were cooked well but had no flavor. The menu is poor. The salads are small. The sides are small. The loaded baked potato was burnt. The cheese bread was great.
Tab was expensive for mediocre food. Dishes and appetizers weren’t all that. Service and drinks were great.
Food and service were excellent, as usual.   Love the cornbread, burger, salads, sticky chicken, and mac & cheese.  We will be back.!
Always amazing food and drink! Great time with the family!

I have had several enjoyable meals (lunches and dinners) at Willard Hicks but Saturday night dinner with half the restaurant full was not stellar.
When we first arrived, they wanted to place us at a table near the front door. It was quite chilly outside, and every time someone entered it would blow through that area. I asked if we could be moved to a different table as there were 6 tables open for parties of four further back. One would think if you make a reservation, you would get a better seat away from door. I like that first bottle of wine you bring has no corkage. So I brought a very nice Chardonnay and had to ask the waitress twice for a chiller or simpler ice bucket.
The gents had a couple cocktails and beer which they said were fine. Then we had to wait over 20 mins to order our mains as the waitress didn’t stop by to check on us. The expeditor brought the shrimp appetizer and it was tasty and plenty to share for our party. We asked if he would find our server again.
The waitress forgot our salads and when our mains finally arrived we said just “skip it”. She questioned why we still didn’t want it.
The two steaks ordered were just ok quality, not their usual juicy flavor Both were over cooked from our ask of med-rare. I enjoyed the sticky chicken and my friend had the scallop risotto, which she enjoyed.
I don’t think we will be back any time soon, which is disappointing as it’s in great location to meet friends.
WH needs to button up the service and check with food distributor if they are getting same quality.
excellent food and dinner, the service was excellent and really appreciated the staff’s attention to detail.

We had the blackberry filet mignon.  Cooked perfect, sides of beans and mushrooms to top it off.    One person had the loaded potato and didn’t care for the candied items on it.   She didn’t eat much of that but otherwise we cleaned our plates.   Haven’t been in a while and glad it’s still as good as ever.   Very good cocktails.

This is a really nice place for a very good steak or an amazing burger! On this last visit I tried their Sticky Chicken which was delicious! However, I would prefer dark meat to the breast. Butter Cake - delicious dessert!
Great food and service! Sat outside early evening, heat lamps were sufficient.
The food was underwhelming especially considering the price point. Multiple people in the party had GI issues after the meal. Service was good, but will not return.
Service and food was great. We had the pork chop with apricot chutney and the pappardelle pasta dish delicious.    Waitress and staff were very attentive. Thank you for a great experience

Wonderful dinner and service. Filets were cooked perfectly and were delicious. The calamari steak appetizer was very flavorful and tender.
Great dining experience!
The food and service were both very good. We had to wait a little bit for a table because it's 2 days before Christmas and people were lingering, I guess.
Great food and nice quiet ambiance for a business meal!
We had a great company holiday luncheon.  Food was great.
Excellent food and service. Great team dinner experience. Thank you!
Outstanding from Coctails through Dessert. Will be sure to stop here again when in San Jose.

The food was fantastic. Very tasty. Service was slow - needed to flag down waiter for water, to open up wine and to take our order.  Then the food gets brought out all at one time - salad and soup and our meals. It made no sense.
The food was great and the drinks were good! The service was horrible and everyone seemed like they were in a bad mood. Poor service.
Great for a birthday celebration. Food was excellent. Wine list was good.

Met a friend for lunch here. We both ordered the WH Chopped Salad. Sounded so yummy with the candied bacon and shaved Parmesan…
The salad had chopped iceberg lettuce, the crappy inside of the head of lettuce. If you are out of lettuce, buy some mixed greens. For $18. Expected more, tab with tip was $50. Won’t be back

So sad how far this place has fallen. Used to be hard to get a reservation. And now the food quality is barely a step above a fast casual chain.
A shame because the bar is solid and the atmosphere still nice.
Food took over 30 minutes after we ordered. Several tables waited an extended period of time to get their meals.
Excellent menu with wonderful cocktails! Comfortable and warm atmosphere with pleasant staff.

The food is outstanding but the service has gone downhill. It’s really too bad. The ambiance is fantastic. We go there once a month and the busboys seem to pay better attention to you thank the waiters. I had to ask for our waiter 4 times last night. Kind of a bummer.

Tuesday night dinner, hostess greeted us and we got a drink at bar first. Then when we got to table, she was on phone then went directly to incoming couple, instead of us who had reservation. Odd but was ok.

Kitchen was very slow getting 3 meals out, as the restaurant had a total of 10 tables at 6pm. 

Pork Chop, steaks and burgers were delicious, however please add a side salad on the menu as an option. Not sure why you have to buy a full salad when only veggie sides you have are mushrooms (allergic) and green beans. Need more variety choices.

I don’t know if they were short-staffed, but we were not waited upon for 20 minutes after being sat, including getting water/drinks.  Food was lukewarm.  I’m not sure my salad had the proper dressing, but I was too hungry to care.  And their chicken on the kids menu is a peppered breading… Not a wise choice for kids.  Very sad, given I used to live dining here.

It was not crowed and that was nice.
Server forgot to bring our appetizer but then he corrected that. I felt it delayed plating our dinner but not cooking it because of that; our pork chop was very well done when he said it would be medium, over all it was pleasant and still delicious just a over cooked. Makes me want to try it again cooked properly! 🤤

Extremely disappointing. Quite possibly the worst service I have ever had in a restaurant. Our server didn't appear at our table for 25 minutes after we were seated (we'd arrived on time for our reservation). At that point he merely rushed by and said he'd, "be right with us." 10 minutes later we were able to place a drink order, Another 15 minutes went by before we finally asked the manager to come by who then explained that he was "sorry" but the server was also responsible for a large party nearby. Seriously, that was the best he could offer. We received our appetizers an hour after being seated and the server was clearly not thrilled with our having found it necessary to speak with the manager so we were treated like petulant children for the rest of the meal.

The restaurant was busy (7:00 p.m. on a Saturday night), so we can live with moderating our expectations, but the staff clearly could not give a crap about whether or not the people in the restaurant were satisfied with the experience.

Not only would I never recommend the restaurant to anyone, if any body every tells me they are considering dining there...I'll relate this experience to them and let them decide if that is how they want to spend their dining dollars.

Poor. Poor. Poor.
Pork chop was the best I’ve ever eaten and I’m an 82 yr old foodie.
We love this place! The food is always good, the service is quick and professional and the restaurant is clean. WH is a great place for a solid steak!
WH has once again delivered across the board.  It helped make my mother-in-laws 88th birthday very special
Willard Hick’s never disappoints. Always satisfying my craving for a good steak or pork-chop. Did miss my Main man Dj Don doing his thing in the booth.

The food was excellent. The pork chop was the best pork chop that I have ever tasted at a restaurant. Flavorful and super tender.  The corn bread appetizer was to die for.  Definitely looking forward to returning to try different appetizers and main dishes.

A great place to bring visitors. Twice this month we’ve had visitors from out of the country and WH did not disappoint. Very tasty food. Nice atmosphere. Great service usually but they can sometimes get busy. A bit on the pricey side but well worth it if you can afford a bit of a splurge. Highly recommend the cornbread and coconut shrimp appetizers. All our meats (steak and pork) were cooked to perfection. Juicy and tender, not dry. Highly recommend.
One of the best places for every  event or celebration.
It was amazingly good food was bomb great service
Such a wonderful experience. Food was amazing and the portions were HUGE! staff was so friendly!
Asked for water it never arrived, once food arrived they brought steaks and no knives, waiters seemed annoyed when we asked for a knife, not sure how they expected to cut it without.

Had a great time at Willard Hick's. The ambiance and vibe are great and the quality of food is upscale. Still can't get over they allow free corkage on your first bottle, that is such a nice incentive. Will definitely be back!
Enjoyed a nice dinner there with my husband :) The sautéed green beans with peanuts was very tasty.
Excellent food and competent wait staff ... just to damned noisy

In all fairness I feel like the issue with the service was not our server but possibly staffing. To be honest I’m not sure. The issues were our server was not attentive to us while we were dining, my steak came without a steak knife and by the time I could get her attention for her to grab me a steak knife my steak was a no longer hot ( this I semi blame on the kitchen). We ordered a drink that we watched sit at the bar by the time it was brought to our table it was watered down by the ice, we were already asking for the check by this point as well.

Again, her personality seemed like she was trying and I don’t think it was out of neglect we constantly watched as she bounced from table to table pouring wine and doing her job. The issue seemed like lack of staffing as half the restaurant was empty and she had tables both inside and outside. This was around 7pm we didn’t start to notice other servers until closer to 8pm all in all you would expect better service for a bill that’s over $200. Of course I still tipped as I felt like the issue wasn’t my servers fault per se.

I also noted that this dinner was for a birthday but I guess they don’t acknowledge that at all anymore.
food was ok. these days thats not good enough for a $150 meal for two.

The worst service I’ve have ever had at this restaurant. Our drinks took 20 over minutes. The server was rude and the restaurant was practically empty. We used to like this restaurant but I’m not sure we’ll ever go back after this experience.

Wonderful restaurant in downtown Campbell.  My office is down the street, so I decided to try it with a client.  Very impressed with the service, food and the entire dining experience.  In fact, it was so good, I  returned a few days later with the family.  Again, we had a great experience. Highly recommend Willard Hicks.

We were greeted promptly, and appreciated that our server brought the kids beverages and food ori first. However when the adult enters started coming out, we waited 10-15 minutes for three more tending adult enters.    Streaks were cooked to the requested temperatures.  The only other miss was that I noted we are celebrating a 50th wedding anniversary on the open table reservation and the dessert plate said happy birthday.
One of the best restaurant experiences we’ve have in ten years in terms of overall experience!
The experience was special for us. It was our 1 year anniversary.
Always a great experience, with good food and service.  Will definitely be coming back again.

We have not been there in over three years, we were missing out. Food was great and our waiter was wonderful (Calen).  We sat in an outside table which was nice, there was a little breeze that was much needed.  It was a little stuffy inside the restaurant.  Overall great night and we will be back.

The steaks we ordered took forever to get to the table and once they did arrive were tough, a little cold and just not very good.

For what it costs, this place is not a good value.  They need to improve the quality of their meat, and the time it takes to get food to the table.

We sat down at 6:30 and did not get our food until almost 7:45.

Very disapointing.
Always a great time with great food and excellent service! Will be back soon!

We had a Wonderful time!  The hostess was very friendly.  The server was amazing as was the food!  He even suggested espresso martinis which were fantastic.  Will definitely be back!  So nice to go to a restaurant and have such wonderful staff as well as great food!

We ordered two apps, which came quickly and were good. We ordered a steak medium which was delivered rare. The server agreed it was underdone and too it to be refired—nearly 40 minutes later the refired steak returned to our table. All of our sides were gone. No one had checked on us to see if we needed anything (additional drinks etc) or offered us anything for the wait. We refused the steak as our meal was basically over. They forgot to remove the steak from our bill and when we pointed that out they removed the steak but still charged us for the sides that went along with it—the manager claimed he didn’t have authorization and couldn’t do anything. Terrible experience.

We sat outside and had a great time. 
The food was good - we had mushrooms and fries with our drinks. 
Then had the tempura chicken and the wedge salad. 

Drinks and beers. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves
Excellent food and service. Was an overall, successful experience

Food and service were excellent. However, made a reservation for “bar seating” only to be told the bar is open seating. The hostesses were able to get me quickly seated at a different table. Very helpful, will be back
The food has gotten very expensive. It also wasn’t very good. It was just average. Our server was very nice, but not very attentive.
Good food, good service, cozy environment, nice restaurant
Like the food for the price.  I think potato should be part of meal.

The food and service were excellent.  It's a little expensive, but you're paying for the excellent service and food.  I would highly recommend this location for business lunches and/or dinners.  We were even given a private room so we could speak freely without being overheard.
Enjoyed a glass of wine with a friend. Nice music and service.

We really lol WH. The only issue I will point out from last night is that they served our main dishes while we were clearly in middle of drinks and starters. Kinda disappointing from a steakhouse. Otherwise, good quality of food and drinks!
Excellent meal & very friendly service. Thoroughly enjoyed our family meal & evening.

This was our second time visiting and likely our last. The pork chop was overdone - my husband sent it back and they did redo it for him. The coconut shrimps and crab cakes were heavily breaded and also overcooked.  The location and environment is great.
We always enjoy going to Willard Hicks. Everything was excellent but there was one tiny thing...The bread that was served with the brie was way too hard. Someone could break a tooth on it lol

Server brought out the food in this order:
Sides
Soup, salad
Starters and entrees (exactly 5 minutes after the soup & salad)
I had to get up repeatedly to get silverware as there were 3 of us and the table was set for 2.
Bizarre, poor service.
The service was excellent the steaks were great, but my son said the sticky chicken was tough; but we will be back.
A nice booth, good food and good company on Father's Day, what more could you ask for?  The staff is fantastic and very accommodating.  You have to try it!

The food was good, but the service was some of the worst I have had in years.  The restaurant was not overly busy, but it took over 30 mins just get the waiter to take our order.  The waiter just kept forgetting we were one of his tables.  We got better service from one of the other waiters who just felt sorry for us.
Nice to eat I love happy hour great food and prices love sitting outdoors

Food was fantastic except for one dish. The salad with chicken on top was the main entree for one person in our party. The other three main entrees were fantastic but the last one, the salad, was not ready with the others. Had to wait about 10 more minutes while everyone else ate their dinner. When it arrived the chicken was tough and half of it was inedible. Disappointed in this one meal for sure. The other three meals were very good.

The rib eye steak was wonderful, practically melts in your mouth. The baked potato was also very good, large with bacon, cheese, sour cream, butter, enough for two to share. 

The baby back ribs were a disappointment, they were overcooked, tough, and hard to cut. The slab was very generously sized. Saw another tables baby back and they looked like it was supposed to; tender, moist and I assume flavorful.  I guess I just got a bad batch. 

All in all, I would definitely come back for the steaks and would not recommend the ribs.
Food was great, service was superb, ambience was amazing. It’s our go to place.
Nice venue, very good service, interesting menu choices.

Most of the food was over cooked - charred!!  I asked for outdoors seating and she waitress put us in the very last booth!   We asked to change and she compiled with this request.  My friend took home 2 steak dinners - I'm anxious to hear how these were.  I don't think any us would be returning.  The waitress was very nice........ Why would we sit in the last corner of the restaurant when it was a lovely day outdoors!

We had an amazing meal!  From the dirty martinis to the wedge salad and scallops….it was wonderful!  Sat outside and enjoyed the classic cars cruising the street.  One of my husbands best birthday dinners.  Thank you for a great time!

I seldom write reviews of restaurants.  When I do, they are generally favorable.  This will not be.  My wife and I ate at Willard Hicks in Campbell last Saturday night to celebrate her birthday.  It was a terrible experience.  We should have suspected something when it took over ten minutes for our server to first announce her presence, at which point she said she would be right with us.  That took an additional 5 minutes.  Once we each ordered a cocktail, it was an additional 10 minutes to receive them.  Luckily (?) we placed our food order at the same time we ordered our drinks.  We asked to split a Caesar salad.  When it arrived it had not been split for us, so we had to do it.  No big deal, but then later another Caesar salad was delivered to our table with no explanation.  I thought perhaps we were being offered the second part of our initial order, but nope.  They just screwed up and tried to give us another salad.  I ordered their specialty, a New York strip with peppercorn sauce.  My wife got a filet.  We each ordered them medium.  They arrived just as we were finishing our salad, despite the fact that we were told the courses would be spread out.  For the first time in my life I sent a dinner back to the kitchen.  My steak was not pink (as described) but grey and grossly overcooked.  The potato strings on top were ice cold.  My wife's filet was also overdone, but she said she would keep hers rather than wait for a new one.  She should have.  The busboy had taken away our silverware when he cleared the salad dishes.  Our server said she would replace them immediately.  After 10 minutes my normally mild mannered wife became so irate she had to go look for someone to get her a knife and fork so she could eat her meal.  When my replacement steak arrived, it was a tough, fattty gristly mess.  I would have been better served to simply have kept the first one.  To summarize: bad food and atrocious service for a meal that without wine was over $250.

Starting from service to management to food everything that there is to be expected from a fine dining steakhouse was delivered not only poorly, but below poorly I will never step foot in this restaurant ever again ￼

This local gem never disappoints. Always welcoming, warm, airy, comfortable and positive. The menu is spectacular, the drink tinkchures are delish and the service is AAA. This is one well oiled machine.

Best fresh ground 1lb steak Burger in the state!

Keep up the great work! 🍽️🍔🍪
Incredible food and service! We really enjoyed every inch of our dinner with them.

We took a party of 6 there for a birthday dinner. The food was very good but the service was well below what I’d expect from any restaurant let alone a pricey one. Forgot drinks, asking multiple times to get one of them. Having to track someone down to order. Having to ask to clear plates so we could open a few presents. A lot of waiting. They were busy when we first got there but it calmed down quickly and we could see our server and other staff hanging out talking. Maybe it was an off night but we won’t be going back.
Loud, average steaks and poor service but still expensive, open table booking not on system even though I had confirmation
Sticky chicken overcooked, no silverware when food came out? overcooked Ahi appetizer served again no silverware or plates, no water offered, extremely slow service all night.  Disappointing

We reserved an outdoor seat for 6:45 on a Saturday night and were sat right away.  We started with the Tuna Poke appetizer and unique cocktails.  We had entrees of filet mignon with blackberry sauce and a strip steak with peppercorn sauce, sides of sauteed mushrooms and mashed potatoes.  Finished with the butter cake for dessert.   Everything we ate and drank was very good, in fact, maybe some of the tastiest food we've had in a while.

Service was a little slow but that may have been due to a festival on Campbell Avenue which may have produced a lot of unforeseen walk-in activity so the help may have been stretched.  

Outdoor seating with heat was very welcome.  The DJ was certainly feeling his oats so it was a little loud but the place was hopping.  This was our first visit but will not be the last!

This was our first time here and we were celebrating my wife's birthday. We had expected a high-end steak house atmosphere. Therefore, the sports bar with some tables added for dining was a bit of a surprise. The noise level was quite high when we sat down, but it settled down some. I think we got lucky that none of the local teams were playing at the time.
The service was excellent. Everyone was very friendly and attentive. 
The food was also very good, but there was room for some improvement. We ordered the baked brie and the accompanying roasted garlic was underbaked, so that it was not usable as a spread. The green bean side dish was also undercooked for my taste - you could still snap them apart. 
The steaks were the absolute highlight. My wife had the blackberry filet mignon and I had the peppercorn NY - both at medium rare. They were both prepared well and we enjoyed them thoroughly. The fact that these $50+ steaks were being served on a miniature cutting board really took away from the high end steak house effect. But I can't argue with the flavors and textures.
We definitely will return, but now we know we don't need to get dressed up in any way - but we might dress better than casual just because it feels better when spending that much on a meal.
Great service but food was just ok. Also one host was not very helpful. Not sure if i would come back.

The food and service was great. We had drinks in hand quickly after ordering. Our server was super nice and checked on us to make sure everything was going great. I would definitely come back to try other things.
Wonderful food and staff. They really did a great job today.

Had a wonderful dinner with the family. We sat in the patio, which was great for people watching. Our server was friendly for the most part.
