Drinks took a little long to come out, but good when they arrived. Found it odd that the server took our appetizer order and then didn’t take our entree order until after we finished our appetizers. This caused a long gap between courses. A bit disappointed that my bone-in-ribeye was not hot, just warm, but still very good. Won’t hesitate to come back despite this minor issues.

Just a lovely evening great food, great service busy and buzzing in there with a full restaurant but it’s got great acoustics so you didn’t feel like you were yelling at each other to hear each other from across the table. Very very lovely restaurant highly recommended.

The food was good but unfortunately the service was sub-par. Not anything huge, but a lot of small things, which make a meal go from good/great to just okay. We had to ask three times to get water for the table, which didn't arrive until 20-30 minutes into meal service. A couple of us ordered steaks and they didn't bring the steak knives until 5 minutes after the steaks arrived. Similarly, desert arrived fast, but with no spoons, and again we had to ask three times to get spoons brought over. Maybe a five minute wait in total, which is not that big a deal, but feels bad when you're watching your ice cream melt on a warm cake. One of the dishes we ordered never arrived either, so we had to ask to have it removed from the bill.

It's unfortunate because the food was cooked well, came out quickly and was very tasty. The food was good enough that I'll probably try the place again, but it's certainly not on my "must return" list.

It was our first time there.  We both ordered the swordfish.  The waitress surprised us
by asking how we wanted to have it cooked, i.e., well done, medium well, medium, etc. We were only used to being asked those questions for steak.  However, the
waitress suggested medium.  We said we did not want it "dry".. The swordfish came
out perfectly.  Had a delicious sauce and came with a little salad, delicious also.
We ordered a side of mashed potatoes to share.  We were very pleased with our
dinner, I would highly recommend Willard Hicks.

First time eating here and it was a wonderful experience.  Hostess and servers were cheerful and polite.  We were offered suggestions when asked (great suggestions,  BTW) and our anniversary dessert was unexpected and delightful!
Don't miss the cornbread, hamburgers, pork chops, filet, tacos and sides.  Really appreciate that you do NOT close between lunch and dinner, very flexible.

Chose this for a birthday celebration.  Less expensive than Fleming's, less crowded too.  Service was good and the food excellent.  I had the baby back ribs.  The half slab was more than enough for another meal, along with half of the large baked potato.  My companion had the Pappardelle Pasta which was cooked to perfection (her words).

Date night with my hubby! Food was delicious and service was outstanding. The mushroom side dish, coconut crusted shrimp, risotto, and New York cut steak were amazing! Everything was perfectly prepared and cooked to perfection. We will definitely be back!
We always enjoy Willard Hicks.  The food is great, ambience and service top notch. The staff is always friendly and super accommodating.
Food was very good. We ordered a bottle of champagne, steak and brussel sprout and onion soup. Overall are fantastic.
Great food and service as always.  The signature blackberry Demi glaze fillet is fantastic!

We went for a friend’s 50th birthday celebration. We each ordered the filet. It was delicious. Cooked perfectly. We started with the cheesy bread. That is a must have! We added Brussel sprouts to our three steaks and the amount was perfect. We ended the evening with a creme brûlée to share. They brought her a cookie with ice cream. The cocktails are fun too. Great girls’ night out.
Attentive outstanding service, we came for the burger and it was outstanding.
The food, especially the steaks, were subpar.  The cuts of meat were not quality.  This place is better suited if you want drinks and appetizers.
Server forgot about us multiple times. The manager took care of most of our bill.
Always good yummy food. Consistency is the norm!!

We booked on open table and they didn’t have our  reservation when we got there. They did seat us though. Took a bit for the server to come but she was great during service.
We ordered the cheesy pesto bread. Which was fresh and tasted great. The wedge salad was split between us and was plenty. Tasted. Great with bacon peppers and a tasty blue cheese.
My wife ordered the sticky chicken and I got the bone in pork chop. There was too much time between the salad and entree but they were great. The pork chop tasted great and mostly came out medium but there was some a bit under cooked. Came with mashed and Brussels. A little light in the sides. My wife loved hers and this was the second time getting it.

The service was lacking. I had a reservation and when my party arrived we were told we couldn't sit at a booth because we only have 4 people. Keep in mind the place was mostly empty. What was frustrating is that as we sat at a table next to the booths we saw each of the booths fill up for parties of 4. Clearly what we were told was a lie. What was their hosts motivation for telling us no?

We also found it difficult to keep the attention of our server. We had to ask the hostess to call him over. Then when he delivered drinks he was missing some. And when our food finally arrived he kept trying to dash off before we could ask for what we needed to make the meal complete.

Luckily the food was delicious. Next time I have the option to eat at Willard Hicks or somewhere else I'll probably choose somewhere else because the service was poor.
Lovely for Easter Brunch! DJ was spinning great songs too- good for the whole family. Service was great!
Good service for brunch. Brunch was forgettable and unremarkable.

Everything was great, right up until the end of our meal when the sun was literally blinding me through the window and their “shades”. They either need to invest in better blinds or not seat people along the back wall during sunset. There wasn’t a point in moving when it happened because we were finishing up (the waiter did offer), but it made the end of our meal fairly unpleasant.

very good food
steak menu and beer are very good.

I had never been there before, and my friend paid for everything, so that was nice because I wouldn’t have wanted to pay for what was given us. It wasn’t the best and our main dishes were very salty for me. The server was wonderful very nice and friendly and Attentive
Dinner for my bday and celebrating 10yrs in business

My Brother and his wife were visiting from Las Vegas and we wanted to treat them out to an awesome dinner and experience. We decided on Willard Hicks. 🍷🍹
My girlfriend and I go to the Campbell location most often but also go to Morgan Hill locale.
We had an awesome time catching up while enjoying great food and drinks. There was a DJ playing great music at the right loudness and in eyes view we were able to watch the end of Final 4 game with SDSU winning!
The Pesto Cheesy Bread and Coconut Shrimp appetizers were awesome!
Three of us had the Pappardelle Pasta with Braised Short Rib and my Brother had the Swordfish.
Our Server, “Royson”, was great! He checked in on us often.
We recommend WH for a great time and great food!
Service and cleanliness has gone down.

PROS
My first visit here was for my friend’s birthday celebration on a Friday night. We split the pesto bread and both ordered the filet mignon - these plates were delicious! The indoor-outdoor environment is stylish and lively, and there was even a DJ. Our server was very kind and gracious, and the facilities were sleek and clean.

CONS
We had to remind our server that we had ordered the pancetta mac and cheese. Then after a few minutes he returned to inform us that they were out of mac and cheese. Fortunately we were pretty full so we decided to forego a side substitute and get dessert instead - but UNfortunately both desserts (the cookie and the chocolate “mousse” cake ) were dry and crumbly. The only redeeming factor was the delicious strawberry frozen milk (ice cream) that accompanied both.
fantastic and unique menu! the staff was awesome too.
The food was amazing. I had the blackberry filet mignon and it’s the best I’ve ever had. We had butter cake and crème brûlée for dessert and it was also delicious. Service was excellent.
Great place to dine. Delicious food and wonderful service.

Love the food and the ambiance at Willard Hicks, but even better was our great server, Kalen (not sure of the spelling). He was just the right amount of attentive, and his humor and panache made the evening extra enjoyable.

Our meal was fantastic! My wife had the crab cakes & I had the small filet mignon. We stared coconut shrimp, which was wonderful. dirty martini glass of Chardonnay. Glass of red wine with the steak. Ambience was good. Service was good. Food was excellent.!
Great food. Staff was very good and helpful. Food came out perfect.
Food came cold, service was poor, too expensive for what you get

Went there to celebrate my husband’s birthday. The grilled ribeye was cooked perfectly. However, the pesto cheesy bread was not cut into pieces so it needed to be torn apart with our hands. It had a sticky drizzle so it was very messy to eat. The house cut fries were dry and overcooked.  The brussel sprouts and mushroom sides were good. The ginger ponzu bone-in ribeye was served on a wooden cutting board with no side lip and drowning in too much sauce so it spilled on to the table. The plain grilled ribeye with no sauce was much better. The noise level was pretty loud.

We made a reservation for 9:00 and as soon as we were seated the server was there every two minutes trying to get a drink and food order when we hadn’t had the chance to look at the menu yet. After we ordered our server had basically disappeared. She didn’t come when the food came out never checked on us. I was disappointed that I asked what their seasonal risotto was and she told me it wasn’t seasonal and it came with mushrooms and when the dish came out there were grapes and pumpkin seeds in it. Had i known that i would not have ordered that.

Our server made us feel special for our anniversary dinner. It was our first time visiting Willard Hicks.
Our son recommended it as he has dined there on several occasions
We were there for Sunday Brunch so not very crowded. Enjoyed the food and service.

We dine at Willard Hicks often, especially for happy hour.
The food always pleases, the ambience is beautiful, but the service/staff are the real stars!
Last evening, our waiter Roysen, was friendly, accommodating, and provided us and our guests excellent customer service!  We felt valued and were well taken care of!!
I often recommend dinner at Willard Hicks to friends for the above-mentioned reasons!
Great ambiance! Food excellent, especially love the pesto bread appetizer.
The food was under seasoned.  It needed salt badly.  Protect meals have been much better.  Pretty disappointed.
Good food and attentive service by Cailan. Will definitely be back!
Food was good but service was almost non existent.  Yanneth barely checked in, didn’t check on drinks and tended other patrons more frequently than our table.
Great dining experience as usual….thanks!  Had the Scallop Risotto and Ceasar Salad…so good!  Service was great as well!
Our poorest meal at Willard Hicks ever. Seemed like they were serving leftovers.
Terrible atención no lo recomiendo para nada

This place has a good vibe, but it’s loud. Food is mediocre. Our waiter was slow, drinks took forever, then the waiter was MIA for quite a while. Steaks were over cooked. Way overpriced for what you get. Go elsewhere.

Took my daughter out for B Day Dinner. She and Fiancé had never been. The cheese bread was awesome. Daughter had the pasta with beef which she loved. Girlfriend also had the pasta as that’s her favorite meal there. Fiancé and I both had the ribs. The meat just melted off the bone, delicious. He tire thru them as he was living the ribs as well as the loaded potato. The server was awesome. He was very attentive and presented ice cream cookie with candle to wish a Happy Birthday! We will be coming back again soon.
We alternate between Campbell and Morgan Hill.
My first time had a great dinner, service plus food was fast.!

First timers! Location, ambiance, decor, and restaurant all very nice. Loved the added bonus of a DJ onsite playing all your old school songs (low, not 2 loud). The food and drinks were delicious. If I had one bad thing to say it would be the tables are too small. Table for two should be a little bigger. Not all of our hot plates fit. We had to scrape some of the side dishes onto our main plates just to make some room. Super crowded table. That wasn’t fun. But I would definitely return for the food/drinks alone. It was yummy!

Waiter was very friendly but Service was extremely slow to get our drinks and food.  Ordered extra Spicy margarita and it was not spicy at all so had to ask for extra muddled jalapeños on the side and wait again.  Had to ask for dessert menu after waiting quite a while after finishing dinner.  Bill took a while to get as well.

The food & ambiance were fantastic. The service left more to be desired. We were seated by our host. About 20 minutes went by without being greeted by out waiter. I had to get up and ask the manager at the bar to advise us of who our waiter was. Once the waiter arrived, her lack of enthusiasm was evident. She gave us minimal service to meet bare minimum requirements. She rarely checked in on us, and by the end of the meal she had her coat on and ready to leave so we felt very rushed and uncomfortable

Came in on valentines day and had reservation for outdoors. It was too cold to eat outside so they made accommodations and gave us really good seating inside! Very nice and patient with us. Their food was amazing! Me and my partner were completely satisfied with both the portions and flavor. They also had a DJ that played perfect music making the ambiance incredible for out valentines.

Have reservation for outdoor seatings and that’s was all that’s available.  When we arrived, there were tables inside available but they said it’s reserved.  Sat next to the street, too noisy, too cold and smell of car fumes.  Waited for 45 minutes, decided to leave when rain started and that’s when they decided to give us the table inside.  Food was ok, but liked the one in Morgan Hill better.
Steaks were delicious, and the cocktails were amazing.

Ladies night out. We had a great time. It was a little loud. Our meals were good with the exception of the sticky chicken. The chicken tasted boiled. The Brussels sprouts were delicious. The pork chop and the crab cakes were yummy. The pesto cheesy bread was the best. The expresso martinis were good. They were perfect with the butter cake.
Had a wonderful birthday celebration for my husband! Our server was the absolute best!!!
great birthday celebration in a nice private room!
Attentive service, food as prepared well. Appreciated that we were able to get indoor seating when outdoor seating was only available for the reservation.

We brought our friends for a birthday celebration. It was their first time here.  The server came over and opened our wine and we ordered the corn bread. The corn bread about ten minutes later, but when our birthday guest put some on his plate and went to take a bite, he noticed aluminum foil in the cornbread.  Luckily he didn’t eat it first. We told our server and he basically blew us off.  His only response was, I’ll let them know’.  No apologies or let me look into it or get us a new one.  We thoroughly ent through the remainder and found no more aluminum and finished the appetizer.
A few minutes later we ordered our meals and continued with the appetizer and a bottle of wine while waiting. Later, FORTY minutes after ordering, our server came up to us and said he had made a mistake when putting in our order. After a small apology, he never offered something while waiting!
We had finished the whole bottle of wine and appetizers and still waiting. Unsure what happened, but it was approximately an hour after ordering before our entrees arrived.
Then to top it off, our birthday guest’s meal was incorrect! He ordered the signature steak and received the regular. He asked where were the crispy onions on top, but they just look dumbfounded as if didn’t order what he said.  The server then nodded as if to go get the correct order. Finally the corrected steak arrived ten minutes later, but I think they just transferred it onto a wooden slab with about a pound of crispy onions.  It was like a sarcastic statement that the wooden tray was entirely covered by the crispy onions and could barely see the steak!
 Extremely poor service, long wait and little empathy or genuine care to all the insufferable service.  I received the bill, which was the only thing that came very quickly!, I expected some compensation for the aluminum in the cornbread, the extended time waiting for entrees, and the wrong steak being delivered.  We received nothing! Even charged xtra for peppercorn!

Willard Hicks quality has gone WAY downhill:

Brussel sprouts with truffle and brown sugar: sounds amazing, right? But no, the Brussel sprouts were basically boiled and then tossed with brown sugar and truffle. It’s like how your mom used to make Brussels when you were young, no flavor and gross texture.

Coconut curry shrimp: it was over cooked that the texture was chewy and the curry sauce was sour, not appetizing at all.

Warm milk and cookies for dessert: the cookies were stone cold and not warm at all. We had to break off pieces.

Honestly for $120, expected way better quality! Pretty disappointed and I rarely ever give negative reviews unless it’s outright robbery.
I like this place a lot.  It is upscale without being too snooty.  Ribs and fries are so delicious.  Restaurant ambiance is quiet and calm.  Service was outstanding!

Great time! Anastasia was terrific with our party 10. We were there to celebrate my daughter’s 18th birthday w family & friends. Luckily it wasn’t very busy (due to 49er game) so we could take our time and not feel rushed. (Plus we had a good view of game!).
Food was delicious, this was our 1st time at this location and food didn’t disappoint. Portions were enough to share.
All servers were kind, patient and attentive.

Very short staffed, Ton of bussers but no servers. Busser stuck his finger in our food and asked if we were fone - we were not… but we were after that. It took over 30 minutes to get drinks. Food was overbooked. This place has so much potential - seems it is mismanaged.

Server was friendly and easy going, We ate at Willard Hick’s to celebrate  my brother’s birthday. Party was seated on time and I ordered a  Ribeye from the grill and my side dish was a pancetta Mac and cheese. My brother also got the same steak that I ordered and esthetically he had gorgeous grill mark. Overall, I’m not impressed with the quality of the food. Don’t think we’ll be retuning anytime soon.

I loved the service and food, but it was outrages that my boyfriend had made a reservation for 8pm we arrived there at 7:50pm and we were not seated until 8:45pm. We expect to wait that long if you show up without a reservation but making us wait 1 hour for a table with a reservation for two is outrages!! 
The manager gave us complementary dessert and it made the horrible situation mildly better, but our date night was kind of ruined, we had plans after that we couldn't fulfill anymore.

Food was excellent, server was not. He argued with us about a wine being by the glass even though it was listed on the menu, seemed irritated when asked if we could taste the wine before committing, and brought the wrong wine, simply because he wasn't careful and didn't bother clarifying. Not particularly attentive, and seemed irritated every time we asked for anything, like a slice of lemon. Also didn't acknowledge that he heard us, then became annoyed when we repeated our request.

Ordered the filet mignon medium rare. Steak was cooked to medium and was dry. If it didn’t have the sauce and grapes on the side it would’ve tasted like cardboard. Very disappointing….

The service was fantastic though. Noise level was quite loud for a steakhouse. Would not go again.

Williard Hicks was okay, but not outstanding. The cornbread gets great reviews, not sure better than mine. The steak I got was good and cooked to my order. The drink I had was good, and the swordfish dish my wife got was also good. The atmosphere was a little off, at the price point expect a little better than this, but not a bad place if you want a steak.

At Willard Hicks, medium rare = medium well.  For a >$50 New York Strip that's prepared like cardboard, I'd rather go to Sizzler for a fraction of the cost.  Also, the server said that they were no longer serving the burgers for the evening.  A table seated later were served burgers.  Skipping WH.
Great experience- we got our own room with a round table for our Xmas dinner. Food was excellent
We like Willard Hicks. It was busy on Christmas Eve, had to wait ten minutes for a server and the servers was adequate but not attentive
Good food nice meal the music was a little loud for my taste but otherwise good food and drinks.

Food was pricey but delicious 
Service was great
No longer what it used to be. Overpriced and underwhelming. Food was meh and service left a lot to be desired.

Another wonderful dining experience. Food and service was excellent. WH was new to all my guest and they lived it. Tina was amazing with her service and suggestions on the menu. Very much looking forward to returning again.

The food was amazing.  Some items we got that were excellent:

The Blackberry Filet
Coconut Shrimp Appetizer
Brie Appetizer
Calamari Appetizer
Wedge Salad
French Onion Soup
Scallops
Butter Cake Dessert

There was nothing we ordered that wasn't very good.
Very nice evening

We were looking forward to dining prior to visiting Willow Glen to look at holiday lights. Unfortunately, we sat there for close to 40 minutes and no one came by to help us, not even bring water. It was disappointing as Willard Hicks is a go to for us .
Delish chilaquiles!
Our server was Michael and he was extremely personable and attentive. The food was fantastic. I highly recommend the risotto and scallops! We would definitely go there again :)
Everything was good but when ordered a med rare steak, it came out close to well done

It was a very slow day and I expected the service to be the best since it was empty. It took a very long time for the waitress to come and she was somewhat friendly but not as friendly and efficient as the bud boys who were constantly checking in on us. We will come back but next time if they don’t get with it, I will defiantly say something.
Very attentive server and host. Thank you!
My steak was a
I’m a vegetarian and there are options for me! The tower fries are my favorite!! Best wedge too!

Was here 3 years ago and liked it. Not anymore.  Outside, the noise from car engines and blasting music kills the ambiance.  The brie platter was so-so, the cheese had little flavor.  Both the tacos and onion soup were over salted.  Waitress was very nice and accommodating/apologetic.
Not near as expensive as I thought it would be and the food and service was outstanding.
We always enjoy the Filet Mignon. It was delicious. Great bar selections. The butter cake a la mode dessert was fabulous.
The table was little close to the other table I could barely talk. I heard people next to us more. Our server was amazing. She was energetic and happy.
Our service was the worst I’ve ever had! Food was good once it came out properly. Have to say very disappointed!
Great! My family and I come once a month a they never disappoint
Overall food was okay, not what it used to be. Will think twice before heading to WH Again.
This is our second visit to this restaurant.  The first time the service was poor.  The second time it was worse.  We will not be returning.
The service was excellent and the food delicious.

We had fabulous time. Megan was our server and she was amazing. Knew exactly when to check on us. Had a great flow of apps, entrees, desserts and even with our takeout items for when we were ready to leave. Looking forward to returning again soon.
Had a large business dinner on the patio.  Seems like we ordered one of everything on the menu and it was all delicious
Beautiful back room , service was amazing and food was amazing

Food was excellent! My party sat in the back in one of the private rooms which was perfect bc we can get loud. The service was a little slow but we didn’t mind. Ambiance was great and even though there was sports playing on the screen it still had a classy feel. I will definitely return, especially for the steak burger!
Services was not very attentive but food and ambiance was great.
Everything was fine but the food. Was not good at all and pricey. Horrible tasting pork chops for $42? No thanks.

If I can be super honest … this was my second time coming here . First time was my birthday, I had to send my steak back 2 times because it was very undercooked. Overall it was a decent experience, hence why I came back a second time . Great vibes, awesome music , cute esthetic, good service . This time similar experience. My boyfriend’s pork chop was very dry and not seasoned well . Id probably never come back for dinner . If anything I would come back for drinks and vibes . THATS IT !!!!

It was 5 of us and my wife's birthday.  They gave us a separate room which was wonderful, except it was too cold.  The ambiance was perfect and so was the food and presentation.  My compliments to the chef.  We all loved it and will be back.

Okay good 
Tasty
Sit down

Servers are nice...  kitchen is slow and bad.  Ordered 2 burgers, both medium.  One came out well done.  Had to wait another 30 min for it to be remade.  Wasn't even that good after all.  Been here before and the kitchen is really hit or miss. Server was apologetic, but that's it.
Amazing food and drinks, and superb service! This place is my #1 in the South Bay
Vibes were good, service took a while and steak came out way overcooked. All the food was very good minus the issue with the steak. The coconut shrimp was 10/10.

We felt like our waitress was over booked so she seemed to forgot about us for blocks of time.  The music was awesome but got uncomfortably loud at times.  The food was good but we could get a similar meal elsewhere for the same price.  Our anniversary was completely forgotten.
First time and loved it! Enjoyed a birthday lunch outdoors with great service. Highly recommend.
Waitress was nice but slow. Communication was difficult
Steak was cooked properly as medium rare, but the quality of the steak sucked. It was hard and tough to eat. I wouldn't come back. It was better pre-pandemic
Fantastic service and food!!!

Food was great as usual. Service was not. It took 30 min for our drinks to come out. We had to go to the bar and order them ourselves. Our appetizers came out and still the waiter had not returned with our drinks. We’ve been here many times and service is usually good so maybe last night was just a hiccup.
Excellent dinner, ambiance and service. We even got a complementary anniversary cake. We will definitely be back.

I had called a week in advance for reservations for a Friday evening, and spoke to the manager, telling him of my plan to propose to my girlfriend, and asked if we could be sat somewhere appropriate for the occasion.  We drove all the way from the East Bay, 1.5 in traffic, for what I thought would be a special evening. When we arrived, we were sat at a table in the middle, nothing special.  The music was very loud, almost like a pub. The real issue was with the service and the quality of the food. I would have thought based on my requests that we would have been sat in an area covered by an "A" list server...but instead, our server appeared to have his head in another place.  We started off by asking for water with no ice, and of course, the water was delivered with ice. We ordered cocktails, and our meal, with a side of string beans. Our meal arrived first, followed later by a baked potato. When we finally were able to track our server down, and told him of the mistake, the string beans arrived just as we were finishing our meal.
He never once came to check on how we were doing, how our meal was, or, asked if we'd like another drink (empty glasses on the table....c'mon!). 
The food itself was nothing special....but the prices were certainly high enough that I would have expected better. The half rack ribs were bland and tough. 
Anyways, I followed up a few days later with the  manager, who was apologetic and offered me a gift certificate to make up for our experience. Unfortuantely, it never came, even after making another inquiry  ("it's being handled by the head office". )
I recognize that COVID took a heavy toll on the restaurant industry, and I sympathize with the difficulties of management to keep things going. But frankly, I would have expected much better than this from Willard Hicks...pre-COVID, they were great. This experience soured me greatly on them, and likely will not return.

I live in downtown Campbell and frequent Willard Hicks often.   Somewhat post pandemic their bar service and wait service was horrible.  Previously we'd wait 30 minutes for a cocktail.  Place or order and wait so long for our starters that they'd come at the same time as the entree.  I visited in late August, met the new manager and service was EXCELLENT!  

Unfortunately, recently the service has gone back to how it was.  Waited over 30 minutes for a drink order and apps took another 20 and dinner (salads) finally arrived.   My friend ordered the same salad (Wedge) as me but hers was half the size of mine.

I hope the new manager was off that night.
Favorite restaurant of ours. Celebrated my bday here with family and was as fabulous as ever! DJ makes dining fun as well!
Excellent steaks. Wonderful wine list. Very nice outside area for dining.
Our server Brian was awesome. Everything was amazing

This dating really reflects more in the value. We started with the the Southern Wedge which was great. The bacon could have been crisper and chopped just to make it easier to eat but overall very good. 
I’m not sure if plates sat but everything came out barely warm. Sticky chicken was good. Portion size was large and we took home some of it. The special strip was not worth the cost. I ordered it medium and it came out correctly cooked. The glaze was okay but it was supposed to be done in peppercorn. I didn’t see a single piece of pepper. Overall bland for a strip. No sides came with it so I ordered the Mac and cheese. Cheese sauce was bland and settled to the bottom of the cast iron skillet. 
Again nothing was bad but given the cost I expected more. Charging a steak house price I expect a top notch meal and it was lacking

The restaurant was empty, with plenty of tables available when we walked in.  Nevertheless, the host was nowhere to be found, and a line had formed waiting to be seated.  Once we sat down, the initial drink order took 20 min to arrive.  The swordfish had a strong fishy smell and didn't taste right.  I would have sent it back, but the server was nowhere to be found.  The busboy stepped in to help us and found the server, who didn't understand what I was telling her and that I was unhappy with the meal, but told me "to enjoy" and left again.  Shortly thereafter, the tables behind me finished their meals and began to look for their server to close out their check.  At this point, all the servers were gone, the hostess was also gone, and only the bartender was present.  The other guests began to complain to the bartender, who just ignored them at first.  The guest continued to get angry and asked for the manager but was told no manager was present.  Once again, the busboys went to the back of the restaurant to get the servers back.  As these angry guests were checking out, the host returned and gave a weak apology.  Startled by this mess, we promptly asked for our check before the crew disappeared again and we might get stuck there.  What is so tantalizing in the back that keeps the whole staff there?  Where is the manager?  For the price charged there is no value and no service!
Introduced some friends to this restaurant. They loved everything. Food, service, drinks, & the ambiance were great 👏

Food great. Service not so.

Service was sketchy. Started out great then deteriorated to the point of me standing on the outdoor patio looking into the inside dining area and not seeing ANY service staff... especially our server. (No management presence that I could discern).

I was treating my colleagues to what I thought would be an above average experience. The setting on the outdoor patio was perfect, as was the weather. I arrived early before my guests and started to warm up my belly with a Negroni. All was well at this time, then again there were even more scant guests at this time.

The server seemed to bungle our orders and had to remind him. I observed other tables either receiving more prompt service, or totally abandoned. Inconsistent.

Our meal server WAS an example of teamwork... I think the kitchen expo staff served us our burgers! I got to practice my espanol, which was a bonus.

Our server did seem buried, although when present, there were plenty of servers, just rarely visible in the dining room. Plus, it was nowhere near as busy as I have seen it in the past.

Next time, we sit at the bar to avoid routine server experience.
Always a wonderful experience. A little pricy but worth it.

This is the second time that the restaurant is messing up my filet mignon and for the same reason. I asked for medium and specifically asked the server to make sure it's only pink and not red. The steak came as almost rare, the server took it and came back after 5 minutes, asking if I want the same steak or a new one (strange question), I agreed to receive the same, when it came back, it was all burned outside and still rare inside, needless to say that I said nothing more but I was very unhappy.
It was wonderful! Loved the room and ambience in the back. Great to be at a round table for a party of 8! Thank you!

Would not recommend WH to anyone who wants to enjoy their dinner.  Their DJ was playing the music way too loud for 5:30.  Totally understand if they want to create a different vibe late in the evening but it was totally unacceptable when you can’t hear anyone at your table.  We asked the server if he could ask the DJ to down the volume…but it only seemed to get louder.  Not going back.
The chopped salad was great. The green bean side dish is a favorite. We had the best servers and the music and ambiance was cool.
Nice place for a business lunch! Great service and great food!
It was a business meeting. I do enjoy the professional atmosphere and the attentive staff.
Terrific service! As we were leaving, the bartender (Ricardo) made a point to chat with us, and warmly invited us to return. And WE WILL.

Great service and wonderful waiter. 
Appetizers we great. 
The steak was cooked as requested, but for the price it was not the cut of meat that I would expect. 
The Pappardelle had a wonderful sauce but it was quickly absorbed by the noodles. The paired short ribs were tender but with little flavor. 
It was a nice evening , great atmosphere, great seating and drinks but please serve meat that I want to come back to, after all WH is supposed to be known for their meat.
Server was very forgetful when it was very slow. Ruined my meal. Food was phenomenal get the baked Brie

We received excellent service when we dined at Willard Hicks.  The food was good, but a bit pricey.  We were a bit disappointed with the fries.  The presentation was nice, but the fries were not crisp and more like potato wedges.  Overall, we had a pleasant dining experience and will return again.
Great service and environment. Waiter was very nice and considerate. Food was awesome.
NY Pepper Steak was not cooked to order (undercooked).  Sent back, and came back overcooked.  Service was very marginal.
We waited 20 mins before ordering, the drink orders where messed up twice, we had 3 different servers, got our food and had to wait 5 mins for silverware, etc.

Service was slow and the server did not really listen to our orders or requests.  Drink order didn't get received until after our entrees arrived.  An order was not received and orders for specific things (ketchup or hold certain things from the order) were not followed.  Food was mediocre - not bad but not great either.
Great food, drinks and atmosphere. Would definitely recommend.

The food was good. I ordered the steak . I liked that they helped us even though it was late. We were probably the last ones there before closing time. I’m doing this review for over all since this isn’t my first time there. It’s a restaurant I go back to if I want a good steak but don’t want to dress upscale.

We showed up and we were told they couldn’t serve us cause there was no wait staff , came back in 10 minutes, table was terrible then we moved to another and it was worse. 
Dogs everywhere , uncomfortable chairs , and they are not cheap !! I’ll never go back

Terrible. Worst experience I have ever had at a restaurant. Manager extremely rude. I’m shocked that an establish can function in such a fashion. I guess Resturant accountability doesn’t happen anymore. Never again

Value was just not there, service was slow, the bar was slow, food was not worth it. There are better places to eat in Campbell. It kind felt the Golden corral with better glassware and a DJ. 

Maybe they had a bad day?
Excellent service
Service was excellent. We dined late on a week night, so it was quiet. The green beans are sooooo good.
I love this place, but the bar service is just so slow.  No one took our drink order for about 15 minutes.  Our appetizers and entrees came out at the same time.

The food was great and the waiter was very friendly and personable.  Unfortunately the restaurant was understaffed, particularly in the bar area, but really all around.  It took a really long time to get out our drinks.  Once we ordered our meals, it didn't take the kitchen that long to prepare the food, but it took a very long time for the order to be taken.

On this visit to WH, we were with a couple of friends for dinner. The atmosphere was electric. I'm so glad we had open table reservations because the place was packed! On this trip we ordered the spare ribs that were incredible. The meat just fell off the bones and were so tasty! We also went back to our favorites, the coconut shrimp and the poblano cornbread. We are already looking forward to our next visit to try other items on the menu that caught our eye!

Had a great time! Service was great. Brought a bottle of wine, had it opened the second we sat down. Great recommendations on the food, even though we have been before. Would highly recommend this for a date or even a group event! Food and drinks were great!
Everything was excellent with the exception of the music. The music was so loud, we had a hard time hearing each other talk.
The ambiance was amazing and so was the food! Our waiter Timothy was knowledgeable and just overall great. We will definitely return to try some of the other items on the menu.

Steaks were overdone! When a restaurant specializes in steaks, I expect that this is their strong suit. Both steaks ordered medium rare and both were solid medium. No pink in the center…cooked all the way through. For $50 per steak, it needs to be done right. Medium rare is the only way to eat a prime cut of beef but I’m sad to say they missed it badly. Service was good and the menu has a lot of good selections. You just can’t miss on the steak prep if that is your claim to fame.
Always fun to sit outside and enjoy the downtown vibe, and the food and service were wonderful!
Horrible service horrible attitude

This was our first visit to Willard Hicks. We had the southern wedge salad, coconut shrimp appetizer and the honey jalapeno poblano cornbread. All were delicious. Our server Daniel was friendly and attentive without being aggressive.

There are many other menu items that we look forward to trying. We will be back soon!
great food, great value, lighting fixtures were fused in almost all chandeliers which made the ambience feel dingy but otherwise it was great. Service needed polish but we didnt care

Williard Hicks is my go to and the food and ambience is great, BUT the service is really lacking.  I take all my friends there and have to apologize every time.  The bar service is super slow as well.
Great food and great service!  Nice ambience and quiet for a business lunch.
There were out of certain beers and tequila.  Waiters were slow. Took over and hour to get our food. Won’t go back there again. But the food was good.
Food service and quality of food was good.  Bar service was terrible.  Our food started coming before our drinks did.  The bar was not that busy either.
Wait staff a bit slow towards the end but all and all a lovely experience!  Food was exceptional!
Bar service was very  slow.  Wine didn’t arrive until 10 minutes after dinner was served.

We had a wonderful dinner at Willard Hicks.  The food was very flavorful and fresh.  The waitress was very nice and always there when we needed her.  The drinks were great.  We were there for my husband's birthday and they brought him a complimentary chocolate chip cookie with ice cream on top.

The appetizers were amazing- the Ahi carpaccio, prawns, brie, and street tacos were so artistically plated and tasted amazing.  I ordered the sticky chicken and there was an outburst of flavor in my mouth.  Fantastic plate.  The filet minion was superb. The Dj was playing a variety of music that was very nice though my kids felt like it was all over the place. I will come back for sure and will bring some friends.
My sweetheart’s birthday!

Food is prepared well and has a wonderful taste.

However, big downside is the prices.  Even with inflation  $60 steak needs to be larger than 3 inches.
Worst service I have ever had. 30 mins at table before settings or water. Another 30 mins for 3 out of 4 cocktails. 2.5 hours for dinner and a brand new waiter with no training.

Getting inside was easy since we had a reservation. Requested for a bigger table since 4 of us were there and we ordered alot of food. Once seated no one came to us for more than 35 mins.

Overall service was ok. Second trip.....probably not.
Father's Day was super busy with lots of new staff. They were all struggling to get food on the table in a timely manner.  The food was decent but it definitely took a lot longer than it should have.

This was the first time dining here and our experience was horrible. The food was cold, the service was very slow and the overall experience was not worth it. After ordering drinks and an appetizer, we had to wait 1 hour for the food to come and our appetizer never made it.

Loved the vibe of this place! We were seating promptly, and even though they were super busy, our server was attentive! Drinks took a while, but sometimes that can't be helped when there's a lot going on.

Really enjoyed French Onion Soup appetizer and one of the mains... Fettucine with Short Rib. We were disappointed with our Grilled Filet Mignon. For a steak restaurant and a $54 price tag, we expected a perfectly cook steak. We asked for Medium Rare, and that's what we got, but the underside of the steak was burned and completely black. My son wouldn't eat it. I tried, but it definitely tasted of charcoal.

Again, our server was really nice and she gave us a dessert on the house, but I'm still a little surprised the steak wasn't as perfect as I expected.

Other than that, loved the ambience and would give it another try if in the area.

Quality of Food and cocktails were not worth the price. 
Steak at our table and the two neighboring guest tables were no cooked to specifications. Cocktails were more fillers than alcohol. Tables need a deep cleaning as well.  Will not be coming back.
Nice venue, the menu is quite reasonably priced, but then you get what you pay for I guess. I would not have a steak again, more a burger kind of place

Worst service ever!  We arrived with reservations and were seated right away. At this point, we were pleasantly surprised by how efficiently the hostess handled us.  However, for the next 20 minutes, nobody came to our table.  The hostess finally noticed and told us that she would get someone over.  We waited for another 10 minutes.  Why couldn't the hostes at least serve a couple of glasses of water?  Finally, the server appeared, albeit frazzled and we gave him both the drink and dinner order.  The food took another 20 minutes, but when it arrived, the flavor and presentation were good.  The drinks didn't show up.  We went to the hottest to ask if she could find the waiter.  Another 10 minutes before he showed up and asked what we requested.   As that server left another server showed up and offered to get the drinks for us but wasn't able to.  As we were finishing our dinner, the first server came back and dropped off the drink order with a weak apology for the delay.  What did arrive promptly was the check.

Food and ambiance was very good. The server was very helpful and courteous. The service overall was slow but not terribly. I also think this had more to do with limited staffing rather than a quality of staff issue. 
This was my first time and I will be back.

The staff was extremely accommodating and communicative. They warmed us about them being behind and things possibly taking a little long which I appreciated. They also didn’t take that long with anything and the food and drinks were amazing. It was my first time dining there, I will definitely be back.

Food is very good but also not cheap.
The music is more noisy than my family with two kids would like.
Wonderfully delicious!

Not sure what was happening when we went on a Thursday for early dinner, but WH was terrible for service. Our waiter forgot our drinks, forgot food, took forever! The restaurant comped me some food, but honestly would not go back here anytime soon unless I didn't care about wasting time and money on their food and service.
The service, the staff, and ambiance was great, but the food was awful.  Steaks were overcooked, no flavor, and definitely not worth the money.

I am pretty sure our waiter was new- he seemed a little unsure about what to do, and we had to ask the hostess to find him to get our check. Food was good - we had the Brussels sprouts (really good) pesto cheese bread (so so) street tacos (excellent but enough won’t the fried onion strings) and the pasta (good). Way too noisy.

Had the in laws visiting us in California and they wanted to grab a steak .. we were looking for a spot as well since we moved from Texas and by and large have been disappointed with so called steak houses here in the Bay .. WH did not disappoint!

Fabulous food, great dj, which was surprising. Music was not too loud, great selections from all eras. Service was good, server read that we didn’t want to be bugged too much and left us alone. Only complaint was that he was a little too good at that, had to get his attention for refill water, order drink, but was super once realized we needed a little more.  Food was fantastic and we felt that it was good value for the quality

We came to Willard Hicks to honor a friend’s retirement.  Although my wife and I had dined here before, the others in our party had not. WH did not disappoint!  The food was outstanding and the environment perfect. We already plan to be back as a group for another dinner together.

Wow
Just
Wow
Took some friend here for dinner. This was their first time here. They really enjoyed everything about WH.
Excellent food!

It was a disaster from the minute we walked in.  Host was rude, and said we could not have a booth although one remained empty the whole night.   Food was served cold, butter did not melt on steaks.  We returned food, had to wait another 40 minutes for slightly warmer food.  Cheese on potato was not melted.  In the hour and 20 minutes we waited for food, we were never offered more drinks, nor did our server EVER come back.  We got drinks from the bar.  While we were given two free deserts, the cookie was inedible because of far too much baking soda.  

The waiter was kind but they were very understaffed.  Sorry, we won't be back.
Marriage Anniversary

The place is still low on servers. The wait times are long from the moment you are seated to the time a server will approach the table and take the drink order. Then, expect that they are out of a lot of items and drinks.  Food takes a while to be served and the server will not show back up until you are ready to leave.

It was a poor experience.  Waited 25 mins for a waiter to take our drink order.  Appetizers arrived after entrees.  Bathrooms were filthy.  Wrong and more expensive bill charged to my card.  We used to live this restaurant but the confusion and poor experience last night means we will not be back
We waited 20 minutes and no server came to our table. Multiple servers just kept walking by us. We had to ask the host stand if we had a server. After that the service was great! Food was amazing.
Consistently great food and fantastic value.   Lee it up guys.   Don’t play the music too loud please.   It’s a restaurant and people want to relax and talk.   The rest was perfect.
Go for the bar scene.  Swordfish was tiny.  Steaks served on a cutting board.
Great atmosphere! Came on a Sunday morning with nice weather. Indoor/outdoor seating is available and the host was pleasant
Great food. Sloooooow service.

Okay but not great. Perhaps the lunch and dinner menus are better but brunch did not overwhelm. I was expecting more given it was Mother's Day. And for whatever reason thought it would be more upscale than its neighbors, Opa and Mos.

Steak was overcooked. And also, sausages were delivered raw. When asked to be sent back, they were but we never got them.

Service was good. We had a table outside but the host was nice enough to seat us inside and ahead of schedule. Our server was good as well -- nice guy.

But unfortunately food was not something that I would recommend for a nice meal out
Really great! Only downside was they wanted us to move tables after a few hours and we were watching the Warriors game.
The food is always so delicious I love coming back to Willard Hicks

Music was way too loud.

Swordfish portion was exceedingly small.

Calkamari "steak" was not a steak, but small, tough fingerlings.
Service was VERY slow.   We ordered 2 Risotto’s with our meal.  One came out with the other 4 plates.  Mine took another 15 minutes to arrive.

Idk, I don’t want to be harsh, but I feel this place has gone down hill since the pandemic. There was no one In the joint when I went and I still got bad service. The joint being empty should have been red flag number 1. Steak took way too long to prepare. The fillet I ordered showed up before the sides.  I ordered it mid rare and it came out mid well. As soon as the sides came I sent it back. 20 minutes later the fillet came back well done!?!? Not sure if it sat in the window or what but it was more well than the one I sent back. I asked to speak with the manager, but no one came by? The server did comp the steak, but I didn’t eat it because the second time they didn’t even bother to season it…a steakhouse that can’t cook steaks???  For the price you are better for going elsewhere. The desert cake was trash too. Who ever owns this establishment may want to hire some managers that know how to run a steakhouse. Won’t be surprised if they go out of business within the next two years.
Amazing food. Great night.

I took my beautiful friend Wendy here for a birthday lunch. The restaurant is so beautiful inside, but it was a warm sunny Cali day so we opted for a table outside. Our server was so nice and attentive, we started with a  glass of wine, Black Stallion cab for me  for me and  Wendy discovered she loves Moscato, she had  the Coppo Moncalvina from Italy. For appetizers We had the corn bread and crab cakes,- both were so delicious.  For lunch we both opted for the swordfish and a side of greenbeans. Both cooked to perfection and sooo good.  I let our nice server know it was her birthday and he brought Wendy a tasty cookie with cream.....a beautiful restaurant with great service and delish food. I look forward to coming back for dinner to try a tasty steak! Thank you for making my friends birthday special.
The food was amazing, drinks were just as good. Definitely will be making this a routine stop.

Everything was exceptional 
IT WAS FANTASTIC 
FABULOUS SERVICE 
DELICIOUS FOOD
GREAT MANAGEMENT 
PERFECTION

My wife and I were seated almost immediately when we had our reservation at 7:30pm. But then it went bad. Took over 30 minutes for someone to even acknowledge us and get our order. From the time of us sitting down to the time that we actually got our food was over an hour and 20 minutes. Then when we got our food, both her steak and my steak sandwich was over cooked. They comped us her meal, but it doesn’t make up for the overall experience. The DJ was great and the noise level was perfect. But we do not plan on coming back or recommending this place to people. For the price, my wife and I could have made a way better dinner and had multiple bottles of wine with almost the same atmosphere at home, and the food would be cooked correctly and no one would have forgotten that we were there.
Food and drinks and ambiance was great, but service was really slow.
Delicious food... fun vibe! Great place to celebrate a special occasion.

The burger was a little bland and way too big. I understand the gimmick, but honestly who needs a 1-pound patty?
The steak was mediocre at best and overpriced. 
But the service was absolutely catastrophic. Slow, inaccurate, unattentive, just terrible. We will definitely not be returning.

I had the pork chop, I ordered it medium, it was tasty, but on the tough side.  My husband had the scallops, he said they were ok.  We tried WH in Morgan Hill and the food seemed better quality, but this was a few years ago.

We waited two hours for our food. No server was upfront with us about the severe delays in the kitchen. And when the food came out, it was undercooked and tasted awful and we were afraid we’d get sick eating it. Almost all their cooks called out sick, which was a big part of the issue. And despite the tremendous wait times (we left after 2 hours), for some crazy reason they kept seating people and honoring reservations despite not being able to feed the people already seated. Numerous tables had the same issue and kept getting up to ask the staff for either water, updates on where the food was, or just the check so they could leave and not be held hostage by the restaurant. Poorly managed situation. Please save yourself the disappointment and don’t come here

Avoid right now - unless you want free meals because they never show up! 

This review was for terrible experience at Easter Brunch. We made a reservation for 6 people at 12:30pm. During the first 15 minutes our party was sat we had great attentive service - the server was checking in to see if we wanted drinks and appetizers. 

After we ordered we had about an hour wait until food showed up. They served 4 of the 6 dishes. We waited, thinking they'd come right back with the other 2 ... 15 minutes and nada. So ask two bus boys to check. Nada. Finally someone tells us they are just really backed up and it will be another 10-15 minutes for the remaining dishes. One finally shows up at 2pm (when the rest of the party finished eating) and the other quite literally didn't show up at all. A restaurant with an average 30-50 plate should know to not bring out food until every order is plates. 

The staff was very young and only took the two plates off our bill when we went to ask for a manager. There was never a good explanation given about the poor service. And quite literally by 2pm they had about 50% tables open so the rush was over in the kitchen. I am just surprised the manager didn't get involved. Didn't start offering drinks, appetizers or discounts for the bad service. They didn't even train the staff to at the bare minimum keep their tables updated about long waits. In fact they were seating new tables despite being unable to keep up in the kitchen. 

We actually witnessed another table leave without paying! Too bad because the food is generally good here from past visits. 

Avoid until they get this sorted.

Worst ever
Took over an hour for the food to be served
They forgot to bring the water
They forgot the second beer
One of our guests had to leave before the food arrived
The crab cakes took for ever so we asked them just to box them,  when we got home it wasn’t crab cakes but a second benedict 
Benedict’s really don’t reheat
So disappointed
Embarrassing as we took guests
Staff were great and apologized for the disastrous service

Arrived 10 minutes before reservation. There were 4 other tables . Was not busy. Waitress only wanted to take our drink order despite us being ready to order. 30 minutes later she took our food order.  We received part of our order 1 hour after sitting down and then 25 minutes later the rest of the tables food order. The steaks were cold almost like they were still frozen. The pancakes were uncooked. Waitress never checked on us. We had to flag down other food servers. Terrible experience with no explanation or apologies to why we had to wait over 1 hour despite it not being busy.
The server had to be asked to take the order and deliver the check.  So disappointed.

Very unbusy day.  Service was excellent but chopped salad, some of the leaves were yellow (old).  It was tasty and had shrimp added which was delicious.  We asked for coffee-it was cold.  We flagged down another waitress and she apologized & said she'd make a fresh pot.  That one was fine.  We were not charged for the coffee.

Everyone's food was amazing, and Claire did a great job taking care of our party throughout the night. Only knock would be that their wine list wasn't up to date. But that was minor compared to the overall great experience.
The food was absolutely delicious! The short rib pasta dish is just amazing!

Great attention, excellent food 
We recommend this restaurant
Nice ambiance. I can't recommend the chicken, but it is a steakhouse. My husband gives his steak three and a half stars. Took forever for our order to be taken but service was good after that.
Side dishes, salad and cocktails were great. We shared a New York steak (requested med rare) and it took 3 attempts to get it right.
The restaurant has great architecture but unfortunately the staff are entry level, and untrained.  The food was ok, but the bar was awesome.

The good was over cooked with poor flavor. The bar was okay but the bartender did not know his stuff. Ordered a wine and received champagne. Two of our orders were messed up the ribeye was ordered and a New York arrived and it took another 30 minutes before the correct one arrived. It was around 740 do don’t ever go later in the evening. Overall it was a poor experience and over priced for what you get. I will not go again.
Dining was excellent! Food was delicious and it was not too loud. Excellent prices for the portions and a wide variety of food and drinks!

Never before have I been intimidated by a hamburger. It was humungous. Good too! Loved the pesto garlic bread and coconut shrimp as well. The steaks were large and delicious as well. Our server Claire was charming and attentive. Great food, great service and large unique dishes. I will be back!
The food was beautiful and tasted amazing! The craft cocktails were well priced and yummy too. Great atmosphere and attentive staff.
Worst service and meal! 40 minutes to even take our drink order. Very disappointing experience overall!

The food was delicious and everyone was very polite and willing to help.  They were understaffed so service was slow and it seemed like our waiter had a large area to cover, but the food arrived warm.  I was charged for a glass of wine that I ordered but they did not have available.  It took longer than expected to resolve the error.  I would go back for the food and hope that the staffing issues are not permanent.
Lunch time. Pretty quiet and with skeleton staff. Food could be better. 8oz Filet mignon at $52 was one grade cooked but the cheese bread was excellent.

I visit Willard Hicks frequently. The experience is generally good except for this last visit. For starters, I always request to sit in a booth and they never honor requests for this. Their excuse is that booths are reserved for groups larger than 2 people. This is false because I walked past the booths several times to find groups of 2 sitting there. 

I ordered the pesto cheesebread that usually comes in a large, round loaf. Out comes a sad looking sliced, deli style sandwich roll disguised as the pesto cheese bread. Super disappointing size and taste; the serve should have warned us that they were out of the normal bread and would be using cheap sub sandwich rolls in place. If I would have not ordered it if I knew that was the case. 

The service was overall lackluster compared to my many previous visits to this location. The server was nice but we had to ask for things repeatedly after we ordered them. We had to ask for status of items multiple times as they took a super long time to arrive. Simple things such as a soda refill took a long time. We kept asking him to bring it and it was always delayed even with the bar less than 20 feet from us. I should have just gotten up to grab my drinks myself at that point. The bussers also insisted on taking every plate as they walked by before we were finished. I felt rushed and pressured to finish and leave. I was dining and enjoying conversation with a friend and they kept coming by trying to take our plates before we even finished. This is super disruptive, annoying and rude to continuously disrupt someone dining and talking to try to clear the table every 5 mins. 

Overall, disappointed by my latest visit to this location. It was quiet embarrassing to hype up this place to a friend I had brought here only to have a poor experience. This made me not want to come again and/or recommend Willard Hicks.
They were not busy at all but took a long time to bring out the appetizers and about an hour or more to bring out the food. The food tasted good.
Great rib eye steak and a very tasty chopped salad.

The food was great and Claire, our waitress, was on point from start to finish.  The outdoor seating tables could use a quick wipe down and the tree foilage could use a quick sweep--noticeable but nothing significant enough to alter an overall positive experience.

The wait staff was limited, so there were long waits between being seated, getting a drink order, and placing a food order.  The food arrived in stages with one person getting their meal as the rest of us waited for our food to arrive.  When the food arrived it was missing the main portions of the dish.  As we looked around, other tables were also experiencing the same issues.  The food quality has been better in the past although we order the same items as before.  This time the food tasted rushed and cold.
Anniversary

We enjoy Willard Hicks for the ambiance, selection of food & beverages. Service is always great. Only thing I would like changed is to lower the salt content of some dishes. Several are over the top salty ruining the food. Multiple friends have felt same so we know it’s not just us.

The service was not as good as it used to be. It felt as we are in a hotel dining room. Servers stacking loads of dirty dishes in their hands from the table, as if it was a competition between them.  The server forgot to show at the table. When we ordered a second bottle of wine, it took a very long time to arrive and we were done eating our main course.  We listened to the server recommendation and ordered the burger medium (he said it was very big and if not enough, it can fall of the bun) well, it was over cooked.

We were celebrating our anniversary and very excited to order as we were hungry. We ordered our drinks and appetizer to start and apparently our appetizer was delivered to the wrong table. Our server came back and was very apologetic and explained what happened. He said he put in another order and it would come out soon. We still had to wait, our appetizer when it arrived was great. Best Calamari we've had. Our server ended up waiving the appetizer and dessert off our bill to make up for the wait. He was great.
Service was slow and it wasn’t crowded. Some dishes were good and hot, other dishes not so much. Two steaks were overcooked and barely warm. One side dish never arrived.

The whole experience was a delight for my entire party. The filet mignon was done perfectly and seasoned just right.
The wine choices were excellent to choose from.

We chose Willard Hicks for my husband's birthday dinner because he hadn't had a good steak in a while - but it turns out everything on their menu is fantastic.  My husband ordered the bone-in ribeye and claims he will be dreaming about it for weeks.  My sister-in-law and I both ordered the blackberry filet mignon and were equally extremely impressed - neither of us typically finish our meals at restaurants but we both finished this one!  Service was professional and prompt, and everyone was very sweet & accommodating to our 9 month old daughter.  They also seated our party of 7 in a room off the main dining area, which made conversation much easier and alleviated my fears about having our daughter out in public.  Overall this was the best dining experience I've had in a very long time & I highly recommend Willard Hicks to anyone who enjoys excellent food and service.

I hadn't been here in years (was living abroad) and was pleasantly surprised!  Food was great (pork chop, New York strip), cooked to request, solid sides, and good flavor.

Service was really great, had a lovely server who was attentive without being intrusive.
Great food and wine!
Delicious food! The crème brûlée was phenomenal
Haven’t been here in years but it’s still a great restaurant. We had the pesto cheesy bread, Sticky Chicken, & blackberry filet mignon. Cocktails are 🔥 as well.

One of my favorite places to have dinner service and food always 
Great!!

The service was okay, took a while to take our order. The food just okay, my sword fish was a small cut, my GF’s steak was dry, the backed potato was dry, the plabano corn bread skillet had too much honey. It just wasn’t a great meal for the cost and special occasion.

We had reservations at 1130am and were the second party to be sat for the day.   It took 30 min for our drink order and 60 for our food.  Our appetizer came out with our lunch . Once the food arrived the steak was cooked incorrectly and no one stop by the table to check in with us in . We finally were able to flag someone down (not our server) and ask for our check. We paid and went and lunch elsewhere.

We went on super bowl Sunday it is so cute and trendy love the vibe! We enjoyed some great cocktails at the bar! And shared some appetizers! The poke was amazing! We also had some good steak tacos and shrimp tacos! Would definitely come back again!
Had a lovely birthday dinner here. Food, cocktails, wine, and service were excellent. The rib eye was pricy but my husband said it was the best steak he's ever had so it was worth it.
Food was amazing!  We got there early for dinner on a Friday night and when we left things were really picking up.   Great value and we’ll be going back.
Great location, food and drink options. WH never disappoints.

We had a wonderful experience at Willard Hicks.  The DJ was great with his selection of tunes but the best part was that the volume was low enough that we could still have a nice conversation at our table of four!  The food was delicious and the wine selection was good.  I wish they had a larger selection of California wines but given we are just now starting to return to normal, I expect it’ll increase in the coming months.  Entire staff was very courteous and our waitress was very attentive.  We can’t wait to come back!
It was very loud

Our food was mediocre at best.  Nothing extraordinary and actually quite expensive.  We did enjoy eating outside which was nice, but I had specifically made the reservation to make note that we were celebrating a birthday.  Evidently, they don't offer any dessert (or even a candle) for birthday celebrations.  So it wasn't very special in my eyes and we still paid quite steeply.  When we finished our meal and were starting to get cold, we asked for the check - well it seemed that their system had gone down and there would be a delay to get our check.  Ultimately they were able to produce a check after about 10 minutes and we left.

The wait staff and service was very good - but they need to up their quality of food or downgrade their prices.  Nothing special about this place.
The food used to be really good and now it’s nominal. Too bad we used to like dining there. No longer. Also our waiter was MIA most of the time and they weren’t busy at all at 1pm on a Sunday.
We thoroughly enjoyed our experience.  We had relatives from out of town and they loved it!
Celebrated my Son’s birthday and everything was great as expected we were all very satisfied
Excellent food. Prices have increased due to Covid and inflation, but it was so nice to be in a restaurant with excellent service and high-quality, tasty food.  Highly recommend the pork chop!
Great food and experience

Service wasn't that good for the establishment. We did not see our waiter too often and had to find a random worker to bring us our check and boxes. The food seemed rushed and wasn't as good as previous visits. Pretty disappointed for the price we paid. Usually, we have a completely different experience there.
A perfect spot for the casual, yet chic ambiance, amazing food/drinks, great service, and the best background music!
Nice ambiance, good service and food was ok
Thank you for another wonderful experience. The food, service and drinks always amazing!

The food was good but not great. The service was not good. I always give the benefit of the doubt on service but they appeared well staffed and it took forever to be served and multiple requests for silverware.

Sorry to say but the service was quite bad.  We waited 20 minutes. We’re never greeted by a server. Eventually ordered from the bartender who was passing by. Lack of attention by the service persons continued throughout the evening

I've always have good experience with Willard Hicks. Took our friends to lunch and they liked Willards Hicks as well.  Our server Tina was an excellent "people person".  She's an asset to your restaurant!!

This was our first time at Willard Hicks. The food was great. The young man who delivered our entrees did not know a filet from a bone in rib eye. It did NOT ruin our experience, but the poor guy needs to be trained better

Drinks Not that good.... a $50.00 steak was over cooked asked for it to be recooked chef said it was med. and would NOT recook it.  steak had NO pink and was well done !!!!   Noone did anything about it !!!!   Bartended was fighting with the waiters in front of customers !!!!!    We won't be back anytime soon  !!!!

Not sure what is going on at WH???  Used to be one of our favorites and still could be but needs improvement to every aspect.  Just went for a business celebration with colleagues and family and were 'greeted' eventually by a host that obviously had better places to be, and mentally was.  Our server eventually came to us but the gaps in service were so long it was annoying and there were three servers and only 4 tables seated on a not busy at all Wednesday evening.  We waited for everything, apps, drinks, food, silverware.  The silverware took so long the food was cold by the time we ate and two of the six meals were wrong (entirely different entree that what was ordered).  Too bad, as we really used to look forward to coming here.  The owners and management really need to pay attention and make some improvements.  Maybe that's why there were only 4 tables?
The food was good. However, the music was a bit loud, and the service was slow.
Very attentive and courteous staff.  Beautiful ambience .  Food presentation and taste was excellent.
Food was delicious and the ambiance was very nice. But service was very slow and subpar for the prices.

My dinner was cold.  I had to get up to find my waiter.  It came back 5 minutes later in a smoking hot dish, but it was still cold!  Waiter was nice, but very inattentive.  $9 for a cold baked potato?!
I'm not sure where to start, overall experience was very disappointing unfortunately
The food was excellent! The server was distracted since her mother and/or friend was dining outside and she was out visiting them a lot.
Lovely experience
Great Food, amazing Food! Great time with the family!

The host asked if we minded sitting at a high top table at the bar that was a large table with other guests. We said no thanks because of COVID we didn’t want to share a table. The host sat us there anyway and just said it wasn’t so bad because there was an empty chair between the two parties. By the end of our meal the bar became crowded and we were surrounded by guests to the point where I had to excuse myself because I couldn’t get out of my seat. Our server was amazing and the food was great. Drinks were great too!

The food was good, the waiter was great. 
The only outstanding bad experience was a hostess(a chubby one, there were two). She placed us on the first table next to the door. We asked her since the almost half of the tables were empty and we had reservation, can she place us to a different table. She didn’t wanted, she told us everything was reserved. We asked her then, also if possible to place us at some of the 7-8 booths (only one was occupied with 2 adults and one little girl), she told us the booths are for parties larger than 4. We were party of four and until the end of our dinner, I didn’t see more than 4 people in ANY of the booths, almost all booths were occupied by 3 people, rarely four.
To the management, please work with the hostess to improve her skills. After more than 300 restaurant visits this is my first negative review because this hostess attitude was really bad throughout all conversation.

Drinks took almost an hour to get to us.  Swordfish was overcooked then brought us another and that was undercooked. Our servicer was a bit snarky and not very welcoming. She did comp us a dessert because she probably knew the service was unacceptable.
Food was excellent. Service was non existent. Like one server for the whole restaurant. Took a long long time.

Very surprised that the service was so poor, in the past it was excellent.  Took more than a half hour to get drinks each time  throughout dinner.  Our waiter disappeared many times and we had to ask numerous times for things and to have empty glasses removed.  Appetizers were good but all of our steaks were incorrectly cooked and had to be sent back.  Some of our sides did not arrive, we had to wait extra time to get them once we reminded our waiter we ordered them. Overall, lousy experience for a birthday dinner that cost over $1000.  Not sure I will be back.

4th time at Willard Hicks in Campbell. My steak good but was not as "tasty" as the first 3 times. Also it seem to be louder than previous visits and the background music mad it worse. Overall I would rate Willard Hicks as "good".

Used to be a great place for cocktails and appetizers, the last three times we’ve been there the drinks are watered down and not real cocktails, mostly juice, even the gin martini was cut with something.. good good but very few option anymore. Sad but I’m looking for a new place to spend my cocktail money..
Very good, would go again. All of the sides and appetizers were excellent and the steaks were perfectly cooked.

We had reservations at 7pm, didn’t get seated until 7:20-7:30. After they seated us they just forgot about us. We didn’t even get water. We had to flag them down to take our orders. Apparently we didn’t have an assigned waiter so no one knew we were there??  Placed our orders around 7:50, our drinks and food didn’t come out until 8:45!!! We made a reservation at 7pm because we had movie plans at 9:30 but with the long wait and no server/slow food we ended up rushing to finish our food. Not enjoyable. The food itself was mediocre. Risotto and scallops was under seasoned and the risotto tasted off. The sticky chicken was salty. A few of the steaks were over seasoned and over cooked.

Went for a girls night. There is a great variety of drinks to choose from! We ordered the tacos for an appetizer and they were great. We ordered salads, loaded potatoes and short ribs. Everyone enjoyed their food. It did take a while for the food to come and for our drinks. We did order dessert which was also delicious. Overall a good time it would have been even better with a more attentive server.

We were seated immediately. The staff was prompt & courteous. The food was great! I really enjoyed the baby back ribs, and I’d definitely order them again. Also, the baked brie was surprisingly good. The calamari steak was a little underwhelming, but it was still good. I loved the atmosphere. Not loud, and perfectly lit.
60th Birthday Celebration.
If you want to dine and chat, this is not the best place. It gets very noisy because of the bar scene.
A special event place for good food and excellent drinks. Excellent steak, fish, and scallops.  The risotto was nothing special.

Food has gotten worse and worse. Filet tasted like propane and the Risotto was inedible. We were one of three tables there and two managers sat as we waited 15 minutes to get our check. Hope things improve.

Food took over 2 hours and was served cold.  Every entree and side.  The butter over the steaks would not melt the steaks were so cold. And the “hot skillet” sides were all cold to the touch.  Horrible experience. Will not be going back.

Had a great 3 course meal.  4 if you count drinks as their own food group!  Table of 4 devoured the baked brie appetizer which was outstanding.  Swordfish, steak, and coconut shrimp all excellent.  French onion soup was to die for!  Highly recommend this restaurant!
Our table was too small and in a bad location. We did ask for a booth but was told no. My food was fatty

Had the Signature Filet steak and the sweet to savory accompaniments were phenomenal. Whoever put these flavours together is an artist! truly enjoyed the addition of the grilled grapes, bleu cheese, and the Blackberry Demi Glace were brilliant!

I am guessing they are having a problem like other restaurants in hiring enough people.  Service was super slow, our waiter seemed super stressed, took forever to get what we ordered. Food was good when we did get it.
