Willard Hicks is a perfectly fine, if not pedestrian, steak restaurant. The menu certainly has a typically formulaic set of items for such a restaurant.  The food itself was good with a New York steak cooked nearly perfectly with some really even seasoning. The other entrées showed the same care. 

The sides, that are billed as “huge”, are most definitely not. I am not a fan of large portions but really, don’t call out “huge” unless they are. The green bean side was really excellent but not overly large. The fries were disappointing & resembled “Jo-Jo” potatoes or overly large steak fries. They were hot but not crisp & they were kind of mealy. I should have chosen another side. 

The big issue was our waiter. He seemed a bit nervous as if he was new to waiting tables. He seemed in a rush & that made us feel rushed as well. We weren’t in a hurry for anything & there was no table time limit but still…he didn’t seem to honor our request to “give us 10-15 minutes”
before we ordered entrées as he was back in 3-4 minutes tops. He also seemed to be new to clearing dishes & nearly dropped used silverware all over the table and us. 

After enjoying a few cocktails, some really delicious cornbread & our entrées, we passed on dessert as there wasn’t anything we wanted.  We asked for the check at that point. The check was delivered & we continued talking for a bit.  He came up to the table in a rush & said “you can stay as long as you want but I really need to run your credit card…”. I took that to mean that his shift was over but what restaurant cuts shifts at 9p on a very busy Saturday night? Hand us off to another waiter then?

When he returned for the card, I just asked him if he was rushing because his shift was over. He abruptly replied “yes” & rudely stalked away. 

I’m not asking for super special treatment at a restaurant but this behavior was pretty subpar & kind of spoiled our evening. Everything but this had been really pretty good.

I don’t think we’ll return.
Really delicious food and the wait staff went above and beyond

The food at this steak house never disappoints.
Everything tastes great.
The service is not the best as the waiters are always serving too many tables and always seem rushed.   They just don’t have the time to spend with guests for a truly memorable experience.    That needs work at this Reataurant.

Also when there busy they rush you a bit and always give away your tables that you request.  So be careful if that.

But great place overall.
Extremely inattentive service. The bar bill would have been much larger if someone was paying attention. Never got a water refill.

Took my mom here for her birthday. Our server was exceptional. He made excellent recommendations and went above and beyond to ensure we had top notch experience. Poke, rum old fashioneds, signature filet and pork chops were just beyond words. This place does it all. Sat down at 5, noise level was very quiet as we were the only ones there til about 6:30 the energetic buzz began. I love this place and will definitely return. I highly recommend.
Great place for a business lunch as it's quiet enough to talk.

Lovely dinner with friends  --  but every dish was overcooked.  The staff did what they could to make up for the lapses.  We are not mad at W. Hicks, we feel bad that literally, everything was wrong with our meal there.  Nonetheless, we would give them another chance.
Great food and drinks!
Good food and fun!

We had crab cakes for an appetizer. They were fresh, perfectly cooked, and pretty tasty. I had the scallops and risotto main course and it was unbelievable! Perfectly cooked and delicious. My partner had the sticky chicken and it too was amazing. For dessert, we shared the cookies and cream and this was the only so-so part of the meal. The cookies were not kinda stale and not warm. A disappointment. The service was really good and the fact they will not charge for corkage on the first bottle was an awesome extra. We took advantage of that. We will be back soon!

Love Willard Hicks! Service, food, ambiance always spot on! Our favorites are the cheesy bread, salad wedge with steak, burger, Stroganoff style pappardelle pasta & sticky chicken. The beverage selection is fabulous! Perfect Crème Brûlée :)
Tge drinks were horrible and the food was tasteless

It was a very busy Friday night. The food and drinks were incredible. We will definitely be going back. 
I have one very big complaint. For a restaurant of this caliber, they do not serve half and half cream for coffee. They only provide milk. This is totally unacceptable to me as a true foodie and coffee drinker.

Tlwe got seated right away and the staff was very courteous and polite. The food came super fast which was not a great sign because we ordered steak and we literally got it within 10 minutes of ordering. My wife felt like the her filet mignon had a very strong and overpowering taste of blue cheese and after tasting myself I totally agree. It was almost like there was no flavor to the meat all blue cheese and grapes. My new York steak was very tasty but had a lot of tough skin and some large chunks of fat around the edges. I did not mind it since it was a large potion of meat and I had plenty to cut around. The bread with pesto cheese was really good I only wished they had the balsamic on the side instead of all over the bread but it was not too overpowering which was fine. 
Staff was knowledgeable and they treated us really nice. We will come back here for sure to celebrate another special occasion.

After reading the reviews about Willard Hicks, I and two others decided to go there for lunch on a Friday. Two of us were all very disappointed in the quality and quantity of the food and the third person was satisfied.  We all ordered something from the appetizer list including the tacos, calamari, caesar salad, and the crab cakes.  Only the crab cakes were considered acceptable.  The tacos were just ok with the ahi cold from refrigeration, the calamari was very limited and not very tasteful, and the caesar salad consisted of 5 outer romaine leaves, many whole cloves of garlic, lots of sun dried tomatoes, and shaves of parmesan cheese.  The menu indicated that the salads were large and could be shared but the caesar was hardly large enough for one person.  Maybe it was an off day but I won't be back to this restaurant again.
Was OK, but not super. The food was cold  and not real dessert choices

Waiter was just okay, didnt seem to have much of a personality, delivered food and left. More like a food delivery person than our waiter making sure we had an excellent experience.  Took too long to deliver drink orders and delivered food too fast inbetween course. Restrooms were very messy and music too loud for eating area to hear people across the table.
Lovely evening. Drinks and food was delicious and service was great!

Everything about our dinner should have been excellent. However we were seated at a very small
Table for 2. We each ordered a starter. Before we had finished, a salad that we were sharing and 2 entrees arrived. Needless to say there was no room for everything plus 2 wine glasses, 2 water glasses and a bottle of wine. The salad should have been served when the starters were finished. The entrees should have been served when the salad was finished. As it was we just decided to take the salad home untouched. Our server was very nice but I feel like the whole dinner was rushed…and we were NOT slow.  The food was excellent but that was overshadowed by the rush. Not sure we would do this again.

The Host was very rude and was not willing to change tables for us. He stated that the 3 open tables in the back were already booked. I noticed that the two of the tables were seated about 30 and 45min after our arrival and the third was never seated. All this While 4 tables remained empty up front the entire time we dined. The Server was not really in the head space of work. I noticed he was more or less just wondering around the entire restaurant, while drinks were needing to be filled not only at our table but the two other tables in his area. He finally came and asked if we would like a refill and then disappeared to return about 10min later. He was just standing behind my partner holding a glass of coke and a kiddy cup for a good 5min just staring at the other table. I guess he then had a light bulb go off and he turned and gave the coke to us and then walked the kiddie cup over to the other table. The steak was decent but was not cooked medium rare, instead it was cooked medium well to well. The sides where not that great, the fries where a dark brown almost to the point of being burned, the mashed potatoes where lumpy- missing seasoning- and still had chunks of under cooked potatoes in them( I’d say that’s why they were lumpy), the Mac n cheese just lacked any really taste and was over all bland. The appetizer of baked bri came out and had to be sent back because the dough was still raw on the inside. Desert ended up being skipped as 2 of the 4 items were out. However the waiter did not know this and so we ordered to be informed they were out, went to option 2 and then after waiting again was informed it was also out. Over all it was just not a good experience for the price. I would say if you are planning on visiting here you will have a better meal at Morton’s or Ruth Chris, I know I have and that’s disappointing as I had rather dine at a local place instead of a chain.

Celebrated my Birthday dinner at this fine establishment! Great food and nice service! Live DJ also played our song request. Love the rib-eye and everything we had for dinner. We will definitely come back to try others on their menu! TY!
Food was excellent. Everything cooked perfectly. Staff felt cold, almost awkward. We will dine there again, but probably not our first choice.

This was the worst experience I've had at WH, probably because they had a few large parties which  consumed the restaurant's attention. Reserved table wasn't ready, service was very slow, orders were mixed up, food wasn't very good. WH did comp us for the poor experience.
I've never been but have heard about the good and bad. The food was amazing and will definitely be back!!
Servers were very helpful and always there when needed.
Great for a date, although more on the animated, upbeat, almost noisy side. If you are looking for calm and silent, not the best. We are definitely going back many times.
This reservation was our first time and we’ve been back since.  Love the food, cocktails and energetic vibe!  The cheesy bread appetizer is a winner, as are the steaks.
The service was terrible and the food was just OK,
Amazing food! great atmosphere and great service!

We loved it! Great service, booking ahead, calling restaurant to update headcount, once we arrived, and all through our meal. The ambiance was amazing. Food was delicious and service was fantastic. All around our experience was a 10 out of 10!!!
Coming from an Asian American palate. The food tasted subpar as it wasnt
Very noisy.  The food was only so so.  The pork belly was way under cooked.
Lunch was great and our server was professional and friendly.
Exceptional service.  Rated noise moderate as we did request outdoor seating, overall very pleased
Excellent service, delicious food and best cocktails ever
Food was amazing, our plates were picture perfect, and we had a great server!
Thank you!  Great service, food and ambiance!

Disappointed in table section and when asked if we could change, Host response was no that table has reservation.  Kind of thought we did too.
Fight broke out next to us in the bar, no-one or a manager came by to apologize or say anything.
Steak was over cooked and food was bland..minus the pork belly which was good. 
Server was nice and doing the best she could.
In the end, was looking for lively place with good food to enjoy our anniversary and clearly picked the wrong place.
Great food and Server!!
Was disappointed that was not notified about bar was not serving till 6:30.
Lawrence was great!
The experience was absolutely wonderful and the ambience was romantic definitely definitely enjoyed all the food and the waiter was very accommodating
One negative was that they did nothing to acknowledge my wife’s birthday.
Food, service was excellent!   This was my first time there and I will go back.   It was really good!!!!!
not enough waitpersons to cover the number of people there that night. Food took up to 20 min to show up.
Great time out on a Sunday night evening and WH!  The food was excellently prepared and service on time.  We'll make another reservation soon'

I have eaten here many times, and the experience keeps getting better. 

The food is well prepared and extremely tasty, the service is superb and the ambiance is awesome. 

I recommend it to everyone. I will be coming back soon.

We are not huge red meat eaters so we didn't order a steak. We ordered the calamari and pork belly bites to start. The calamari steak was good. The pork belly bites were terrible. The sauce was amazing but the pork fat was cooked correctly. They were inedible lumps of tough fat and too crispy on the outside. I couldn't even cut through it. Needs to be cooked slower so the fat is rendered properly before searing. It was pretty gross. We also ordered the sticky chicken and short rib pasta. The chicken was tasty. It would have been better if they had marinated the chicken or even pounded a bit thinner. It was just tough. Loved everything else about it. The pasta dish was just OK. The noodles were a little too al dente. Some noodles stuck together so they were very raw. Needed a little more sauce but the short ribs were delicious. For dessert we ordered the creme Brule. It would have been delicious had the custard not been frozen. It was weird taking a bite and cruching into icy bits. Missing the creamy texture. All in all, we wouldn't eat here again. We only came because someone gave us a gift certificate. I am guessing the big draw is steak.
The service was good. The food is very overpriced for the quality.

Steak was over cooked and had to be sent back. Portions sizes seem much smaller than we remembered. Yet since it was for an anniversary we didn’t mind. Still a beautiful restaurant with great food. Will be back!
Outstanding in all categories.  Food/drinks fabulous.  Outstanding service.  Beautiful place.  Nice to have a dinner/conversation without having to yell.
Willard Hicks was great. The server was very friendly. The food was great! Thank you!
Another great time at Willard Hicks.  Great service from Lawrence.  A little note, the music was a little loud and hard to hear to each other for a Sunday for lunch.

Food was great, always is. Didn’t care for the server. We ordered drinks half way through finishing a cocktail because the bar was taking a long time to make drinks and the server said she couldn’t put in our drink order unless we finished our drinks fully. We explained the bar wait time (which she must have been aware of because she was the one bringing the drinks over) but she wouldn’t budge. The some like it hot is my favorite cocktail but each round was very inconsistent.
Great service

Food was excellent.   Our server had to be new..not very attentive.  We had to ask him for everything we needed...even utensils and napkins 
several minutes  after he served our appetizers...hopefully he gets some training
Great food, great service. A little pricey, but we enjoyed everything we ate and drank.  Will definitely go back.

Went here for a date night and this has been by far the worst service I have ever received. My boyfriend was served a straight up raw piece of pork chop. We informed our waiter and he asked if we wanted a whole new pork chop or for them to reheat the current one… what kind of question is that? We order a new pork chop and while we are waiting my food gets cold (pasta). It took them 30 mins to bring out a new dish. By then we were annoyed with the lack of customer service that we just wanted to leave. We asked to speak with a manager but I guess the manager doesn’t work at 8pm on a Friday night. A manager of the bar comes over and says he can’t take off any meals off the bill but he can get us free drinks or dessert. We had already ordered a bottle and we were already disappointed with the service that we didn’t want to waste our time anymore. It took them an additional 10 mins to figure out the bill and was only discounted $20. My boyfriend ate a raw piece of pork and the most that they could do was discount $20. Do not waste your time going here, there are way better options and extremely better service than this place.

If sitting on the sidewalk or by the curb is what you want, this is a good place to do it.  Inside was noisy, outside was, well, outside.  Light, when the sun went down, as well as portable heat units, would have made the wobbly table and chairs more comfortable.  The food was mostly competent but uninspired.  The pork belly skins were like cement, absolutely inedible.  Risotto was bland and the scallops were only overcooked a little.  Scraping the sauce drizzle off of the risotto bowl rim for some added flavor was an exercise in futility.  I had to ask for a single glass of wine three times.  Maybe if we ordered steaks the meal would have been better, but this evening was a big "meh".

at the end of our diner, the waitress brought the check without even asking if we wanted something else ie; Dessert, coffee, etc She then said that there was a "Last Call" cause the Restaurant will close in 10 or 15 minutes...

While clearly short staffed, our waiter did his best and was quite obliging through out the meal. Everything was delightful until the end when unfortunately our carrot cake acted and tasted more like a carpet- it was SO dry.

Otherwise our steak was cooked to perfection, the risotto was delightful and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. My one piece of advice would be to lower the music just a tad and trade out the basic pop music as it is a nice place that could use a better tone.
Food was great as usual.  Service was phenomenal.  Lawrence took amazing care of us.  Great attitude, fun interaction and on top of the details.  Made the evening great

The kitchen delayed our food for over over 40mins even after we received an apology for the kitchen being behind. Then another server, not our sever comes over and informs us that they have 3 large parties ahead of us and they are short staffed which is why there is delay in the kitchen. I explained I saw the table next to who had 4 people seated after us, received their appetizers and main entree before us. It seems as if all the staff members were all trying to cover up something with their multiple stories. Then food comes out and not the whole order, it’s takes another 10 mins for the remaking food and it’s all subpar. So sad to say all this. I really thought it would be a great experience since the appetizers were really good. Then it all fell apart and went down hill from the appetizers on.
Service was horrible.  Quality of food was average not for the price they charge.
Good food always loved coming here. Last time we did wait longer than other times. But good food fun time

This was our second time visiting Willard and Hicks. Decided to bring my BF here for his birthday and was the BEST decision! Originally booked for an outside table but was offered indoor dining since was a bit windy outside. Everything was fantastic! The staff and the food is AMAZING! Including  the cheesy bread we had as an appetizer! LOL… NY steak was cooked to perfection. Will definitely be back soon!

Another enjoyable meal here. Our service was great which we have found it to be bad at other restaurants due to the pandemic’s effect. Food and specialty cocktails were delicious. We had the filet and New York steaks with the Brussels sprouts as a side. We usually order appetizers too but we weren’t as hungry this visit.
We love this place!
Forget ordering any food that requires to be cooked to order. It will be overdone.

The service was abysmal, the waiter and the manager were both rude and flippant. I sent back my burger because it was raw and both the waiter and the manager tried to imply it was my fault for not ordering it medium. I believe they said that the piece of meat is so large it cannot be made medium rare. If the restaurant cannot cook The meat medium rare they should not have asked me how I want it cooked. It was either raw (in my case) or over cooked (in my daughters case). No one was kind or tried to make it better but just instead told me I didn’t understand how it should be cooked. They “recooked” the burger but all they did was char the part I had cut and the inside was still raw. 
It was one of the worst lunch experiences I have had. I will not be returning to Willard Hicks again.
Great staff, nice ambiance, food is great. More accessible and space for parking areas!
Loved the food here, super tasty, large portions on appetizers.
This is the second time we have eaten here and the service was very slow both times.  The food and service are good, but the staff ignore you.
The food is amazing and plentiful! Short rib Papperadelle, Scallop Risotto, Mambo steak, and the Ribs all too awesome and very top notch!!!
Food was excellent and service was fantastic.

The one in Morgan Hill is better.  The music was a bit loud, so people were talking louder.  The food was just ok (not worth the price)...nothing special about the steak or baked potato (in fact, I had to send back the first one because it was still a bit hard and was pretty cold).  We've had outstanding food/experiences twice at the MH location, but probably won't go back to the Campbell location.

Food was good, but if you’re a cook it’s ok.  Crab cakes were awesome, single sides for two, if you are a light eater.  However very tasty.  Had the Mac n Cheese and Brussels sprouts.  Both very flavorful.  Steak 18 oz ribeye order medium rare came medium well.  

Great service, great atmosphere definitely a nice place for gatherings or a date.

I was very disappointed in the food here.  The hostess was Mary and she was so friendly.  The management is very lucky to have her.  Our server Jesus was also excellent.  My friend had a steak ordered medium rare and it came medium well.  The birthday cookie was not crisp and was disappointing.  Not enough sauce on the crabcakes. Sloppy food presentation.  Not nearly up the quality of two years ago.

The only reason I’m not giving it a one is because our server was absolutely lovely. But for a steakhouse to serve overdone Filet mignon (it was grey inside) is super disappointing. Whoever runs the grill needs to do a closer watch.

I made reservations well over a week prior to the date we would be going.  I confirmed the reservations the day before, and was told the table was assigned on the patio.   We showed up in time  (it was a birthday celebration) and our table had been given away.   There were no more outside tables available.  After almost 15 minutes waiting for them to come up with a fix I asked for the manager.  They brought tables out and uncomfortable metal chairs, the location was not on the patio but was better than the alternative offered.  Meanwhile, the spirit of the evening was gone.  While they comp’d two drinks (first round) it didn't make up for the fact our reservations and effort to assure the evening logistics were perfect were all for not.  

Very Disappointing.
We had my wife’s birthday dinner at Willard Hicks. Food was excellent. The dishes were unique, tasty and fresh. The drinks and beer on tap was great as well.

Food was excellent.  Kids steak meal was an actual good cut of steak cooked correctly, not overdone and chewy as in many restaurants.  Salad was fresh and delicious.  Green beans were average as well as the desserts.  Mixed drinks were good, mixed properly.  Kids lemonade was the artificial type so not great.  Overall a good experience and great steaks.
Great food! Looks like staff was short. Our waiter was great and friendly. The only complaint was   all our food came out the same time.
Very slow service, food so so. Wouldn’t recommend.

It was my best friend and I dining. We hadn’t seen each other in a while as we don’t live close to each other. We sat at a hightop in the bar and had Jeanette as our server. Jeanette was lovely, courteous and thought to our every need! If you do have the chance to go there the jalapeño corn bread is to die for! We had the entrée pork chop with apricot chutney mashed potato

Sitting in a booth for four people when we were 6 was unpleasant. Our wine came before the cocktails. My pork chop was raw, a friend ordered her filet medium rare and was served rare whereas another’s steak was ordered rare and came well done. We could barely hear what the waitress was saying. She forgot to put the mushroom side order in so we had the entree without it. She forgot one of the appetizers. The busboy was the most competent person in there. We will not be back.

I have dined at Willard Hicks many times and my reviews have been stellar. Not even close this visit. Our food order took over 45 minutes to come. 3 out of 4 orders finally arrived but my wife's burger took and extra 10 minutes.  She had ordered it medium well, but it was literally raw. She sent it back, waited another 10 minutes for it to return.  Everyone else's plates were being removed when she finally got her meal. The manager comped the burger which would be expected but when we asked the still $160 bill be split we each recieved a bill for $143 each. That took another 15 min + to clear up. In addition to all this the management has seen fit to hire a DJ who played so loudly as to destroy any conversation we were attempting to have during this thoroughly unenjoyable dinner.
We come every for my husband and daughter’s birthday.  Service is great.  Food is good.  I do notice when ordering off the kids menu they never ask if the kids wanted juice or milk.
Great appetizers, affordable, food was on point as were the drinks
Always enjoy our meals here   Food is always excellent.

The restaurant itself is very nice. Good design with indoor and outdoor tables. Good bar and sitting as well. TVs with three different sports events on.

Service was very pleasant.  We ordered the spicy sweet corn bread which was served hot and was delicious. Next we had the Southern wedge salad, we were told it was large enough to split, it really wasn’t but we did enjoy it very much. Nice thick strips of bacon on it, small piece of corn on the cob, blue cheese crumbles and dressing. However dressing was not consistently tossed throughout the salad so parts of it were dry. Also a nice wedge of avocado was on the salad. We then ordered two entrées, the ribeye steak with bone in and the blackberry glazed 8 ounce filet. Both were very tasty and cooked to order however neither were hot. They were served lukewarm. Sent the file back it was returned same temperature.

We did mention it was our anniversary on our Open table reservation however it wasn’t mentioned nor were we comped anything special.

We enjoyed two glasses of Cabernet with our steak as well.
One was served chilled, the other room temperature.

Overall it was a nice evening with tasty food however lukewarm steaks are not appealing especially when they’re $55 each. Total priced of dinner including tip was $225.

I would consider going back, perhaps not ordering a steak.
Great service and good food.

The service was the worst I have every had and there were only two parties at the tables (we were first).  We waited a really long time to order.  After we finished no one came to see if went wanted to dessert.  I finally went inside to where the server and hostess where chatting and ask for dessert menus--I was given one, I had to ask for a second one.  I did not dare interrupt them for a third menu.  Then I actually had to go up to the hostess (the server was still chatting) and ask the Hostess to take our order (at her stand).  This was my friends 65th birthday celebration and fortunately, he was the one that requested the restaurant.  If your staff is not able to serve at lunch time on a Sunday then perhaps only be open for dinner.  Truly very disappointing.

Despite being short staffed and waiting 15 minutes past our reservation time to be seated, we had a great experience with excellent service and very tasty food. Cocktails were spot on. The pork belly was really delicious as was the goat cheese in phyllo. The 1/2 rack bbq ribs was more than enough and really delicious. The burger was awesome as well!

It’s a challenging time to hire and train staff.  Some restaurants do better than others.  Our waiter was fine, but the rest of the staff was poor.  Didn’t clear first courses before bring second course.  Brought first course to two of us several minutes before the other two were served. Servers had to ask who had what in every case. Didn’t bring serving spoons for the shared side dishes.  One of two steaks was overcooked. Need an on the floor supervisor to spot issues and train.  Warning: starters are very large and should be shared.

The food was great. The wait staff was just ok.  She did not make me feel welcome.  I told her to please put the sauce on the side for my crab cakes. The crab cake came out with the sauce on them  which was very spicy and I eat one and could not eat anymore.  My girlfriend ask the waitress if we could have them re-made and she said something to me about being charged.  So  I gave her may crab cake to eat with her swordfish. We left her a very good trip of $37 dollars for way below service.  I will return but will not sit at her table again.
The swordfish steak was delicious. The salad with bacon and croutons was great - would order again. The coconut shrimp was okay - would order the crab cakes next time. Service was very good.
Possibly the best steaks we have ever had.

The food and service were wonderful. I had a delicious Filet Mignon with Blackberry Glacee served over truffle infused parsnips, garnished with fire roasted grapes. My steak was cooked to perfection and perfectly delicious! My husband had the Risotto and Scallops, which he said was very good. We also ordered the side of green beans which were truly delicious! Overall, the restaurant was very nice. Our only complaint was there choice of music. Maybe we are just “old” (barely 50!), but having to listen to rather loud rap/reggae rap music while you are trying to enjoy a nice meal, is not ideal. I get that they are trying to draw in the younger, lively/party crowd, but maybe tone the music down a bit.

The ambiance and presentation was great, however, I wasn't impressed with food.  Lacked flavor and spices.  Moreover, the two drinks we ordered were horrendous.  SOME LIKE IT HOT-MI CAMPO BLANCO, CUCUMBER, JALAPEÑO, FRESH LIME JUICE and TEA GARDEN COOLER-BULLDOG GIN, FRESH LIME JUICE, BASIL, CUCUMBERS, CLUB SODA

I have been to Willard and Hicks numerous times and was definitely not impressed this time. The quality of the food has gone downhill. I took 3 friends who hosted my baby shower and was expecting to treat them to a nice dinner. The service was slow. We had to ask for things multiple times and waited and waited them would ask again. The food was cold, bland or overcooked. Here’s what we ordered:
Crab cakes - ok but the sauce had definitely been sitting out. Color on top was different than color inside. 
Chopped salad - wilted and warm 
Street tacos - cold and steak was dry
Mac and cheese - cold and bland with dry, hard pancetta
Fries - way over cooked too the point that you could crumble them. 

I’ve been coming here since you opened. It seems to get worse and worse each time I come back to give it another shot, expecting a nice dinner. Based on previous experiences, the food and service could have been way better!

Disappointed in the food last night.  Steaks were overcooked.  The staff was great and provided complimentary dessert, but could not help but feel disappointed that an expensive and special night out turned out to be a pretty average meal.

The food and drinks are great! Service could be better. They seem understaffed but it’s understandable due to the current situation with the pandemic. The staff is nice and the food is great. Just wish they had a bit more time to check in on the tables as sometimes they took a while to come back. Overall a great experience, would definitely recommend!

Food is excellent, well cooked to your demand, and dish creativity is excellent. 
Price is on the high side, but I guess you get what you pay for. It's not a quiet place, without being too loud. 
Cocktail were excellent too, and unlike many places, the Rum Runner was good with a generous amount of alcohol.

The food was amazing and worth every penny. Drinks are on the stronger side which is great. Service was a little off as we felt rushed at times and then after me mentioning when making reservation via the OT app that we were celebrating a birthday they did nothing not even a simple happy birthday from our server. That was disappointing and made for a good night to just be fair.

One of the best restaurants in the entire Bay area---awesome menu, great ambiance, wonderful service--and very safe inside and out during these sad COVID days---they wear masks and so a great job of social distancing---especially if you go during off hours, as we did.  Thank you for a terrific anniversary meal yesterday!!  :)
Service and in particular the waitress was awesome. Friendly to our special needs son and was very efficient.
We come for everything, family, celebrating, business. We love this place

We love Willard Hicks for a great steak dinner on a date night, but last night took the kids since they requested a special steak dinner for my son’s 13th birthday. The service was fantastic and the steaks were cooked to perfection. I wish you’d bring back the wasabi mashed potatoes, but the Brussels sprouts are my new favorite in their place. We had two fantastic red wines too-Troublemaker red blend and a Malbec. Just a perfect meal. Thank you!
Our bartender was very personable and gave amazing service thank you we had an awesome lunch

First off we were a party of 8 and they gave us a private wine room! The service was excellent and the food was great. The cornbread and poke for an appetizer were delicious. Most of us had filet mignon cooked perfectly as requested. The wedge salad was good and the sticky chicken was moist.
Great food and vibe!  Perfect night out for any occasion!

We went there for the first time. It was my husbands birthday dinner. We picked the restaurant based on some meat cuts that were listed on the menu online, however those were not on the menu at all at the restaurant. While the server was very friendly, the service wasn’t great. Our cocktails arrived much after our appetizers. We were 6 people at the table, our main courses arrived in different batches, so our food started getting cold before everyone was served. In fact, one of my kid’s received and incorrect order, and it took so long foe them to replace her dish with the correct one (a kid’s burger!!!) that we were all done by the time it came. We also didn’t get one of our side dishes at all. The food was just ok - the Teriyaki Beef was very charred to the point of tasting burnt, and it was dry. The sticky chicken was salty. Our desserts took long to come out also, and when the server said they’re we’re almost coming, she came to come let us know that we had to pick different flavors foe the ice cream because they were out. All in all, we enjoyed the outdoor ambiance, the food was just ok and the service was lacking. I won’t be going back.

We ordered the Cheesy Pesto Bread as an appetizer. A Jalepeno Cornbread was delivered and we said it wasn’t ours. Waiter swings by and says, “The pesto bread is coming, it takes a while to cook.” The pesto bread comes out about 5 mins after we received our main course. He gave us a knife, which was odd because I’ve ordered it many times before. I saw into the bottom crust and take a bite. The bread was not cooked in the oven. It was clearly microwaved!! The cheese near the corners were fried and hard. The crust became extremely chewy. Ever microwaved leftover pizza before? You know what I’m talking about!

I told the waiter, and he kept cutting me off saying there must be something wrong with the oven. I told him this bread was microwaved. He continues to cut me off and blamed the kitchen. Once I got the receipt, it was clear that he mistook our order and charged the cornbread (first). The pesto bread was charged at the bottom of the receipt. Mistakes happens. I’ve worked food service before. No need to lie about the food and try to pass a microwaved cheesy pesto bread.
No recognition of birthday.  Menu selection for lunch was very limited.  Food was mediocre.
Best steak I have ever had. The one with the blue cheese and grapes. Amazing combo. So so good!
The steaks were great. We liked much of the sides. The cheesy bread was good as were the coconut shrimp appetizers.  The baby back ribs were delicious.
Food was delicious and served timely. Wait staff was very attentive to our needs.

Our food was served in a timely manner but I had to wait for a fork for a very long time. After finally cutting into my filet I was disappointed as it was over cooked…nothing was done by the staff to rectify the situation.
Excellent place to dine. Wonderful menu, service was great, very attentive, the food did not disappoint. Thank you for a wonderful dinning experience!
The blackberry glazed filet is to die for! The drinks the sides the salad the desert!!!  Everything was amazing and the service was exceptional.
Waitress came and brought us dessert menu before we got our dinner. We waited over an hour for dinner after ordering.  We were celebrating a big birthday and received nothing!

the appetizer was very good, after waiting 45 min for our ribeyes, the flavor was good but the steak itself was nothing special. Was hoping for much better but between the service and the steak, i did not recommend this place to my friends.

Willard hicks service has gotten worst 
It was excellent before Covid all your good servers snd bar service where excellent 
Now it’s gone down hill

There were a lot of things that made this a bad dinning experience, some of which I wouldn’t even normally notice but together made for a bad experience. Started by feeling a little rushed, we were asked if we were ready to order multiple times in the span of minutes. Some may say that’s just being attentive but it felt over the top, and Unfortunately that level of “attentiveness” went away once the food arrived. We both ordered steak, cooked to medium, my bone in prime rib was cooked well and tasted good. My wife’s New York strip steak was way over done! I don’t think my wife has every returned something but she wanted to on this instance but our waitress did not return. She eventually just decide to eat it (this was on us, we should have waited and got a new one). We both got sides, one was Mac and cheese and the other mashed potatoes. The potatoes were good but the Mac and cheese was flavorless. I would say in this instance the prices of the restaurant don’t match the food or the experience. I hate to give a negative review after one visit, maybe just an off night but at the price point I would not risk a return visit.
A few mistakes with the orders and long stretches between check ins, but overall, a good dinner.
A nice place to eat. Music could be a little softer. Food was great

We were seated outside for lunch (5 in our party). Our server was good and able to suggest cocktail pairing with our food selection. Serving size was large. The food was tasty with the right amount of seasoning and not salty which is good. The pancetta and manchego Mac and cheese was delightfully yummy and not heavy. The pork belly dish was really good (simple yet delicate) but rather large in size. The sticky chicken, baby back ribs, and paprdelle pasta (stroganoff style) was delectable. The portions were large, so be prepared to come in hungry. All in all, our lunch was pleasant and the service was good and friendly.
The food was just not good, especially for a higher end place.
Delicious food. Great service. Very nice location.

I don't do many of these reviews, but thought I would comment on this visit. The service was very slow, with a couple of times wondering if we were forgotten, and this was on a Wednesday night. Food was good, as it normally is there, but the Brussel sprouts we had as a side were pretty bad. I know places are getting back to the swing during reopening and such, so I try to really give most everyone a pass, but all 5 of us at the table felt the same way. For the prices they charge, it could have been better.

We love Willard Hicks and recommend it to friends. However our last visit this week was disappointing. Typically our dining experience is well paced and attentive, this time it was slow and disappointing. Our wait staff was totally overwhelmed, she said they were short staffed. Our drink order took way too long and we had to wait 30 minutes to order our food, after completing our appetizer.  We had to flag down someone. We watched 2 different tables leave after long waits because no one came to their table
The food is ok and they bring a lot of food.  But so greasy and feel bad afterward.  Just sooooooo greasy.  So much sauce and grease 🤮

We came to downtown Campbell to have a nice afternoon at Willard Hicks. However, well the gentleman who seated us was very friendly, we waited an exorbitant amount of time to receive our drinks and my friends drink came not as ordered. And again, while the server was friendly about replacing it, we waited a full 30 minutes to receive the replacement. At that time we ordered our entrées, and waited an additional hour minimum to receive them. I would say, I wouldn’t come back here unless it was the only restaurant in town, or I was desperate.  Maybe service is better at night???
Brie cheese in filo dough appetizer was delicious! Service was excellent by Claire.
Food was wonderful. Service was a bit rushed and that was off putting. It would be better to enjoy a perfectly grilled steak without feeling rushed.
Great service, wonderful food.
Great food and great service! I love their filet mignon and their wine!

We had dinner here Saturday, July 10th.  I had to change the number on my reservation a couple times. I felt so bad changing it back and forth but they were very kind about it. When we got there I really liked the look of the restaurant. They sat us quickly and the waitress was great. We had really good service and the food was delicious. I will definitely be going back as I saw some dishes on the menu I would like to try. Also we brought a cake for our nephew and his wife's Wedding Anniversary and they were very helpful with that.
It was our first time eating here and everyone in our party of 8 was very happy we tried this restaurant.
Great night, service was awesome I didn’t care for my steak and they changed it right away no problem!

Started with “the Abigail” cocktail. Coconut shrimp was nicely cooked and tailed, add the plum sauce for a tasty start. Followed with a zesty Caesar salad. Falling off the bones ribs, potatoes, and tangy green beans with peanuts. All winners! Delicious meal!
A retirement dinner.
Great food

Both of our steaks were over cooked.  They were sent back to be remade.  Took forever and our sides died while waiting.  The second round of steaks were still overdone. 

Such a disappointment as we typically love WH.

GREAT food! But unfortunately our service was very slow.  I empathize with the restaurant, it looked like maybe one chef called out that day and lead to long delays.  We had an early reservation at 5:15 so we could have an early night- we didn’t even have our dinner an hour and 45 minutes later..
We also ordered appetizers that arrived after a 50 minute wait as well.  We wouldn’t have been as bothered if there had been any communication at all, but our serve never even would have stopped to check on us- we had to ask for him every 35-40 minutes so that we could ask him for an update.
All things aside, our meals were incredible and we are still in a pandemic, everyone’s doing the best we can.  We’ve been here many times and will of course be back- this experience did not deter us, we understand things happen- but I’d recommend being a bit more transparent or communicative with patrons.  Keep the delicious food coming!
Like most places these days, they were short on wait staff, but still did a great job! Risotto and pasta were both pretty rich, and cornbread was great.

My husband and I made this our “go to” spot pre-covid. This was our first visit since then. I usually get a steak. This time it came out room temperature and so did my Mac n cheese. For $50 I expect a top-notch steak. This was not it. 
My husband always gets the burger. It did not disappoint. Our son ordered the farfalle w/ beef. It was the only item that came out hot and it was delish w/ a huge portion of beef that I was not expecting. We also brought a bottle of Rosé, love that there’s no corkage fee on the first bottle. 
At the end my husband mentioned to our server some of the mishaps with our food. He said he’d take of it. When the check came there was a $10off “neighborly discount”. Seriously??!!! I pay $50 for a not so great steak and mostly room temperature food and all you can give me is a “neighborly discount”?! So disappointed with their lack of customer service. 
Definitely NOT our go-to spot anymore.

The service was really slow and unwelcoming. The restaurant looks old and so dark you can barely see.
It felt like the staff just want to go home.
The food was nice but it’s far from what we expected it’s not our first time in that restaurant and it was real good before Idk what happened.
Ribeye and Brussel sprouts over cooked.

Our reservation was for 6 o’clock.  There were only 4 tables with guests when we arrived. Our waiter was attentive enough but as the evening went on and more guests arriving, we didn’t see our waiter at all.  We realized there were only 2 waiters for the entire restaurants.  We finally flagged ours down to pay our bill & he was a bit haggard from all the running around.  Btw, we dined there on Sunday night, July 4th.  I think management should have foreseen how busy it would get & planned the staff accordingly.  It was a long holiday after all.  The food was great but you guys dropped the ball in service.
It was my first time at Willard Hicks and I loved the food.
Food was good, but salad was a little limp and it's usually really great. Cornbread was amazing as always. Service was definitely a little slow!

No umbrellas outside, blazing sun. We went inside, music too loud. Brought french onion soup and it tasted like vinegar, prob old white wine as an ingredient, sent back, got tacos which were mediocre. No spoon for soup, I had to ask and they brought a tea spoon. Kid's chicken strips were full of large pepper flakes which we had to remove for our kid to eat it. The steak was ok. The cocktail glass was half empty. Overall money and time wasted.
Delicious!
We like the food and the fact that there is no corkage fee for your 1st bottle 🍾

We arrived at 5:15 per open table reso. Phone email confirmation in hand. They had NO RECORD of us !!!
Thankfully they were able to seat us
Fabulous dining. 
What’s up Open Table???
This happened to us once before…..will be calling the restaurants from now on
Service was amazing.  Food was good.  Music was a bit too loud - hard to have a conversation.
Friendly & knowledgeable staff, fun music playing in the background at a reasonable volume, delicious food, lots of very interesting craft cocktail recipes to choose from, great wine selection.

The kitchen ruined the two $18 hamburgers we ordered.  Ordered them medium well and they both came out charred/burnt on the outside and rare on the inside.  There was no offer to take them back and replace them.  Our steaks came out cold.  They were very understaffed.  I won't return for a while and hope they get their act back together.

Food was great and the staff was very friendly, but the service was incredibly slow... Almost a three hour lunch - food didn't come out at the same time, drinks took forever, etc... Looked like they were understaffed, so I don't blame my server.
Excellent service and experience. Can't wait to go again.

My boyfriend and I had a wonderful time. The food was amazing! Our server, Marco was awesome. He was friendly and attentive to our needs as well as the other staff.  We plan to return soon with friends and hope we get Marco again. Thank you again for a great experience.
For first time We really like it and we recommend

i use to love willard hicks. USE TO are the words to focus on. lately things have just gone downhill. thinking with slowing business during the pandemic, now that things are opening up things would be great. WRONG! i arrived with my family saturday at 2pm and it was not busy at all. service was nonexistent. nobody seemed to care about dining patrons. all they cared about was mingling with each other. every time my table would need anything, we would have to wave them down. they would never look over at us nor did they care. we would just see them constantly laughing and paying attention to themselves. is that what their job is now? not to care about paying patrons but laugh and joke amongst thenselves.

This place has always produced amazing food & outstanding service. I move here 4 years ago & when I found this place, I couldn't help but not god back. Everything on the menu is excellent. I only wish they still made and served Mama's Meatloaf. That was my favorite item. 

Everyone should check this place out and I promise, you won't be disappointed.
Everything was amazing as usual!

Everything was nice except our waitress kept disappearing?  Every time we needed something  more drinks, wine, desert, check, etc   we had to flag down one of the busboys to track her down?  And even then it took a while?
Food too salty
I really like the fact that Willard Hicks does not charge a corkage fee for the first bottle of wine that you bring with you to enjoy with dinner. Great!
Just coming out of Covid. You can tell they are short-staffed, but they’re doing a pretty good job. Food was great as usual (get the ribs). This is one of our go-to places and will continue to be so.

Willard Hicks is our go to place for special occasions, and we were thrilled to return for our anniversary.  We both had the blackberry glazed filet, and it was amazing!  We also shared a delicious chopped salad and the macaroni and cheese.  The mac and cheese was beyond wonderful, probably the best I’ve ever tasted!  Our only disappointment was that we wanted to share a dessert, but they were out of creme brûlée and the only sorbet they had was lemon mint.  Nothing else on the dessert menu looked even remotely interesting, so we left without.  Service was, on the whole, good but there was an error in our bill, and we waited a long time for it to show up.  But all in all, it was fine.  WH is still our place!  Frankly, I think their steaks are the best in town.

Food quality is nowhere close to the prices for meat dishes.  The $48 steak is closer to Applebee’s quality than to a comparable steakhouse.  Service was okay, considering post-COVID opening, but should be better.  Atmosphere is decent.

Short story: Got reservation, went there on time. Got seated and everything went fine till then.
No server or host showed up for 20mins. Not a single person stopped by at the table. After 20mins we just left and went to another restaurant
I think our server was new. She had no knowledge of the wine menu or wine list. Also limited knowledge on the spirits selection, had to go back to the bar 3 times to ask if they had something.
The short rib is outstanding and the Brie appetizer is a must!
Celebrating my wife’s birthday.  Great day, great food, good wine.  Will definitely go back.

We've eaten here numerous times. Normally I would give 4 points or more, but last night the service was appallingly slow.  There seemed to be enough staff roaming about, but no one seemed to understand the timing of a meal.  We waited a LONG time for our first drink, waited even longer for the second.  The food was good as usual.  The drink menu was fine, but needs to be changed.  It's the SAME as it ever was.

Always delicious. Grateful your restaurant is still in business. We came with intention to relax and not worry about how long the service may or may not take. Especially with how difficult it is to run the restaurant during this transitional time. Enjoyed every minute to be out with friends. Thank you for all the hardworking staff. We appreciate it.

This use to be one of my favorite places.  Loved the ribs, calamari, and atmosphere.  Something has changed, as this trip the ribs went from being a nice tangy to very hot and spicy.  The calamity looked and tasted like it had been microwaved.  The green bend where old and dry.  We told the waiter about the berms, he said he would check on it…we never saw him again, a diff waiter served us afterwards.  The atmosphere is quiet and lifeless now.  This went from one of my top 5 places to a place I won’t go again for a long long time.  Disappointing.

This Place is amazing, the friendliest staff, Great service, Foods is just unbelievable. 
Everyone is so nice that you feel like part of the family, we ended up with a larger party than what we have anticipated and they have upgraded us to the private room, Service was one of a kind. don't get me started with the drinks:):) amazing Bar and selection. it was just such an amazing experience. Thank you you all
Graduation

made reservations through opentable for 4pm. arrived right on time and was seated promptly. no one else was in the restaurant and maybe two tables occupied outside. 

our server took our order of the abigail, privileged sidecar, cheesy pesto bread, pancetta mac and cheese, peppercorn new york steak, and ginger ponzu bone in ribeye. 

the drinks and cheesy bread came out first, giving my friend and i time to catch up. 15 mins later the main course came out. sadly all the toppings that were suppose to be on the ribeye were no where to be found. super disappointed because i raved about willard hicks to my friend since she’d never been and they didn’t present things like they normally do. 

they are on point with the 1.5 hour limit when dining in ... which was weird because again no one was even there. it was pretty dead for dinner to be honest.
food and drinks were good but service was super slow

I need to first start off by saying its been over a year since we have been back.  Over the last two weeks, every time I wanted to book, there was no open slots.  So when we had the opportunity, I knew exactly what I was going to order.  

Now the let down:
*Host was not confident in getting us a table, he looked lost.
*We waited for 10 minutes and still no not greeted.
*Three tables in the same general section was seated and had water service
*My wife went to the host and asked who was are server and se said he would get him
*Waited another 7 minutes and still nothing
*Went to the hostess stand and we asked who was our server and he pointed to the one serving the people in the same section
*A manager was also at the host stand and was apologetic, but by that time, nothing was going to taste good.  She offered to seat us, and give a free appetizer.  This situation was well beyond an appetizer for the recovery.  She did not try to keep us, not by offering comps, but be apologetic?

I am not sure if Covid and the return to work has been difficult, but I can say these types of situations will ruin your repeat customers.  Very unfortunate that this happened.

I am a hospitality advocate and have been giving back to do my part in the recovery of our food industry.  I have been in the food industry for over 35 years, and that was one of my biggest disappointments.  Even on busy days, we were never treated like this.  Hopefully for others the service and integrity of the company will get back to the standards that they had.

Sincere regards,
Eric Barnache
Service was a bit off... took a while to get our drinks and appetizers.  Meal was delicious as always!

Food and ambiance is great but unfortunately, we were there for the filet mignon but they run out of it. A bit disappointed that a steakhouse runs out of steak in the 1st seating in the afternoon. Overall, we replaced it with Ribeyes and still taste good.

Hate to complain because I know restaurants are trying, but didn’t feel like our bill for $198 for 2 people with no starters or dessert- just 2 entrees and 2 glasses of wine total were worth our experience. Sat for 10 min before anyone said hi or brought water. Sat with our dirty plates for 15 min before someone came by.
We were celebrating an occasion, service didn't acknowledge it, he also took orders very late from us and the bill as well.

I'm completely disappointed. We have lived in Campbell for almost a year and have looked to this place as a "fancy, once a year celebration" kind of place. Not so much. The service was awful (I was a server for 3 years, so I'm usually incredibly forgiving), but our server had 4 tables and we saw him maybe 4 times total. Never asked how our food was, never apologized that our drinks came out 20 minutes after ordering. The water guy was 10/10 though, he tried to refill my water when it was still full, but it's probably because they were overflowing from liquids by pulling it out of the chicken. Whatever you do, don't order the sticky chicken. Unless, you like having to gnaw on a carcass for about 30 minutes each chew. I ordered my filet mingon medium with a side of spicy sauce and it came well done without any sauce. Our $9 "enough to feed to table" side of mashed potato's were 100% instant (again I have been a server so I know the difference between instant and hand peeled). If I had to come again, I would sit at the bar (no server needed) and order cocktails and pesto bread- those were the stars of our night. We were looking forward all week to a special once a year date night and walked away disappointed. Went to Vesper and immediately had a better experience, should've gone there from the start.
Delicious food! Went there for a birthday celebration.
Great spot and wonderful food and service.

Went here looking for a steakhouse for a family dinner. Overall it was an okay, but unremarkable experience. 

First the food:
French Onion Soup - Just so-so
Caesar Salad - It was one of those deconstructed caesars that I would normally dislike, but this one was quite good. 
Steaks - Got the Fillet Mignon Medium and the New York Well done. Both were burnt on the outside, more than a nice char from the grill, and surprisingly tough. The rub they used on it was flavorful, but clearly sub par cuts of meat. Also, the presentation is horrid, just meat on a white plate. The sides come separately.
Scallop Risotto - The scallops were surprisingly good. Risotto was well cooked (not mushy), but a bit bland.
French Fries - unique jumbo fries that were crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside. Pretty good.
Carrot Cake - A huge slice for $10. It was enough for the 4 of us to share. Pretty good.

Drinks:
Stella Beer - first beer came with no head/foam in a cracked glass. It was replaced but it is clear that the beer glasses were not properly cleaned, there was no lacing from the beer in the glass
Fancy Pants - decent gin cocktail.

Service:
The service is slow. It seemed like the staff had too many tables to attend to? We were there for an hour before we got our entrees and we didn't do much in the way of appetizers or drinks.

Ambience: 
The decor is a bit somber and the music was too loud for my tastes. More suited to a younger brunch crowd as opposed to the family crowd. Also the booths were strangely tight with little room to the table. Fine for me, but anyone who needs more room would not like the booth setup.

Price:
The price was somewhat standard for the bay area - $200 for 4 - but the steaks definitely felt like a rip off. $44 for each and they were not worth it.

We had a great server who did her best but they didn’t have enough servers! Our server worked so hard and was still very pleasant! 

The restaurant is beautiful and the food was very good! 

We’ll be back!
Requested a birthday dessert but was not done for no reason!
Have been there before. All is okay but nothing outstanding

It was so great to get out with the family.  We had a nice time.  The food was fantastic.  The service was good as well.  This would have been a perfect evening...however, the music was so loud we could not hear our server and we had a difficult time hearing each other at the table.  I am all about the ambiance, but it was like Studio 54.  Way too loud.  If you are looking to go out to dinner and not have to talk to the people you are dining with, this is a perfect place.  It was not what we were looking for.  
Other than that, it was fun!

Had never bee and was looking forward to it. My daughter and I had the baby back ribs. Over done and dry. She ate half of hers. My wife had the tempura chicken breast.  Tasted good but it one huge breast and was tough. So disappointed. Service and ambiance nice. Not sure if this was COVID labor related but too many other restaurants to try to make we want to go back anytime soon.
Excellent service.  Loved the food
Great food! Liked eating outside.

We were very pleased with everything at Willard Hicks. The service was great. We were never interrupted. We had a chance to have a lovely dinner and take our time. We only mentioned our daughter’s birthday once and dessert was presented with a candle. I was very surprised and equally pleased. I will be back very soon! I highly recommend this as a dining destination.
We really like Willard Hicks and very glad that they have managed to servive and be here after COVID.

I really like the food and cocktails here, which is why I always return. However, as usual the hostess was rude. It is interesting because it is not the SAME hostess each time. It just happens to be the personalities they pick. The servers are always great!

Food was amazing
Portions are large.
Very nice and clean

The silverware were dirty and had pieces of food stuck on them. They had a lot of empty tables but there were no servers.  After 20-25 minutes of no service we got up and left. Terrible service. I will not go back there.

I made a reservation hoping to conclude my anniversary celebration with a great meal.   We got seated immediately by a super friendly host. However the best part of my meal was our lone items  a glass of water (in a beautiful glass).   After sitting at our table for over 30 minutes we were never acknowledged by any wait staff., even those who visited tables nearby.  There was no industry standard of “did someone come take your order?” Or. “I’m your server I’ll be back”. There was just nothing.   What an awful experience and a way to make your patrons feel devalued.   We left without anyone noticing as we had been invisible our 35 minutes there anyway.

We were seated outside and essentially forgotten about. Took 20 minutes to get a spoon for soup which was getting cold and propane heaters wouldn't turn on because all of them were out of propane... So that seemed intentional. Good wasn't bad but poor service.

The food took a really long time to come out, when it finally came, the steaks weren’t cooked to its correct temperature, the mushrooms and green beans were super salty, as well as the filet mignon. I had asked for some sauce, but was forgotten.

I got there and they had already given our table away and we arrived on time even slightly early. The event was a birthday and no desert was brought for the birthday person. We spent the first 30 minutes while the workers tried to get us a table and even then there wasnt enough chairs it took us an hour to get a table for a reservation I made weeks in advanced.
Good food and service.  However, they did not acknowledge the birthday, which was noted in reservation.
Amazing food!
Our server was great!  Desserts were not as good as expected.
Our waitress was very nice and everyone enjoyed their meal

The brussels sprouts were raw and did not taste good and the waiter did not take that off the check even when we mentioned it. He was friendly enough but that would be what should be done. The corn bread appetizer and brie cheese appetizer are excellent! The steak was dry, the shrimp tacos were fantastic. The person that clears the dishes from the table has no idea how to clear without crossing over people that are still eating, which really should not be done at all, a little training in that area would help the restaurant. Thank you

Food was amazing! Service was poor. When the bus boy starts serving you because your actual server forgets about you and starts making drinks behind the bar and stays there — that’s a problem. We also waited almost 50 minutes for our steaks. It wasn’t busy. We came before the dinner rush. We’d go again for the food and just hope the service was off that day.

The food at this place has never disappointed.   Great food and good service.   A bit pricey but then again this is the Bay Area.   Everything is outrageously expensive here.  Go make your money and enjoy good food here.

Waitress and staff were all friendly. Environment was nice outdoors. Tried two cocktails one was very sour and the other was not too memorable. The coconut shrimp was great. Had the sticky chicken which was overly salty. Parter had the pork chop which was a bit over done but still tasted good.
We had a medical emergency and the restaurant was very helpful and ended up comping our meals. Couldn't have asked for more.

Not very good. Ordered steak medium rare, and it was more like medium done, practically no pink in the center.
And they serve full leaves of Romaine in the Cesar salad, very difficult to eat.

We were celebrating our anniversary and chose to dine at Willard Hicks. First of all, the crab cakes were perfectly cooked and so delicious. We enjoyed our entrees, his was the blackberry glazed filet which was perfectly cooked and simply melted in your mouth, excellent flavors. The creamed turnips were flavorful as well. I enjoyed the swordfish, wonderfully seasoned and it just came apart easily and was soft and cooked perfectly. We also enjoyed the sautéed green beans with soy garlic and roasted peanuts.
The restaurant was nice and quiet so we could enjoy our time there. Thank you Willard Hicks, will be back!

Pork chop was tuff to cut, medium is actually medium when in most places medium is medium rare.  Corkage was really reasonable.  The food was ok, not sure I would go back.  I wasn’t “I like this place” when we left, not sure I would go back, didn’t “knock my sock off”.

Food was quite good as always, however service wasn't very good, our waitress was often nowhere to be found. It was an early dinner reservation for Mother's Day, so possible that they were short staffed.

Had the worse service, I feel bad saying that but we had to ask for someone to come to our table 18 mins after we sat down, we were looking forward to enjoying a drink and app before our meal.  Two other couples sat after us, got their alcoholic beverage before us, our app came out before we even got water.  One margarita came out 30 mins later when we ordered 2 (one for me and one for my mom), the second was served 15 minutes later after mine was finished.  45 mins for a drink?  When the tables next to us were seated after us but yet greeted, served, and had drinks before us?  I didn't understand.  Overall the food was good and if I return it will just sit at the bar for better service.
Our waiter tended to forget about us after our food came. Had to ask for a to go box 3 times from 2 different people.

Mother’s Day at 2:30 pm- had to beg the hostess to give us a booth from the 4 open ones as we only had 4 in our party.  Asked politely since Mother’s Day would she let our party of 4 sit there.  Then the food took quite awhile to come out.  Filet was a bit tough  and asked for medium rare to rare so not because it was over cooked.  Value for quality wasn’t there.

The Service, wait staff and busboys are terrible there.
It took 45 minutes to get 2 glasses of wine.  They forgot side dished, no dressing, disposed of our take home items.  I would never go there again!!!!!
Had such a lovely time dining here for our anniversary!

Service was efficient and very cordial. The menu selections we picked were outstanding especially the steak, pork chop, salad and yummy brussell sprouts. We also selected a bottle of wine to share and that was good as well. All in all a lovely dinner.
Swordfish was simply extraordinary!  Very relaxing environment that afforded privacy and comfort.

Our waitress Rebecca was the best, she really made the night & made my sisters birthday better by teaching us a new cheers on spanish!!! The food was great also, and the crab cakes were flavorful with a crunch and a soft inside. Definitely will return and a great place for birthday dining, a night out, or just to eat!

Sat outside on the patio.  Service was good, the weather was nice and they were very careful with their Covid-19 precautions.  Food was excellent all around.  The restaurant can be a little pricey but we find the food and experience worth the cost.  We have been to Willard Hicks many times (5+) and we continue to go in the future.
Always a good place for food and drinks. I truly enjoy the Dj that comes in on Fridays or Saturday’s.

The Jenga style fries look great but are horrible. Someone needs to say it.  The seasoning is too dry and too much.   The fries are a bit too big to taste crispy.  It might work better if the fries where coated but right now, they simply look neat but taste horrible.  The sizes are all very gourmand.  A 1 pound burger is difficult to eat and sort of gross.   But if that appeals to you, then very large sizes, this is your place.  Expect to pay about $60 per person for food and drinks.

Service was poor, our waiter was also the bartender and he had to exit the bar from the far side just to get out and walked to other end of the restaurant to serve our table. It made no sense, since the waitress was taking care of the table next to the bar.

Caesar salad was drenched in a dressing that was vaguely Caesar (we asked no anchovies), steaks were “meh”, one wasn’t even cooked correctly. Meat and cheese platter was sliced cold cuts and sliced cheese with no description. Neither the runner nor our waiter knew what was even on there. 

Music loud and hard to talk, over all very disappointed.
42nd Anniversary

Celebrating a birthday and specifically wanted to eat outdoors.  Happily the table was in a protected area and not effected by the wind.  Nearby heaters helped warm the space too, very enjoyable and fun to watch Campbell roll by!  Our food was amazing, we split a Caesar Salad, plenty for two and just delicious!  He had ribs, I had the risotto, so good.  The scallops were perfectly cooked.  Saved room to share a slice of carrot cake - the best!  Can't wait to go back.  For a high quality meal and wonderful service, the price was right!
We’ve been here a few times and the food is consistently good.

Went in for girlfriend's birthday dinner , everything was good, decwbt steaks with decent side dishes, also their cheesy bread was good. Only thing that got me a little confused is that when I made the reservation I said it was my girlfriend's birthday. They brought us a carrot cake, after my girlfriend said no dessert and then I still got charged for it on the bill, really confused as to what happened there. Otherwise, good place to eat
Ate inside. Food was good, but table was wobbly.  We were not given a booth so ambiance was lacking.

We were originally seated outside and there were no additional heat lamps as it was a chilly Saturday night. But management was able to safely move us inside, which was way better than a heat lamp. The French fries were great to share with a bunch of guys. Everyone ordered some type of steak and they all enjoyed it. I ordered the steak burger and was not disappointed. The thing is massive and delicious and only $18. I finished 3/4 of it and gave the rest to a late arrival in our party. Our server was fast and attentive. It was a great way to celebrate all of the April birthdays in our group.

Had a wonderful date night here, returning to a place that never disappoints! 
We had the brie which is a great small size starter if you want a little something but don't want to get full. Loved the sweet and savory combinations. 

We split a wedge salad which was a little heavy on the dressing. 

My husband had a perfectly cooked, juicy pork chop. I had the filet with the blackberry demi-glaze where the flavors nicely complemented each other. We finished with the butter cake which was light and also very rich in flavor. A nice, light dessert to the end the night with. 

We completely enjoyed ourselves and can't wait until we can hang out at the bar after.
Willard Hicks is always a nice place to dine out at on a Friday night. Very lively but nevertheless the service is always impeccable.
Nice evening out with the girls!

Food was beyond delectable! We had the rib eye, pork chop, swordfish and filet with Brussel sprouts to share. Our meal was fantastic, service was so attentive without being impatient or intrusive. Thank you for making a difficult day, the heavenly birthday of my grandmother special for our family.
Awesome place to gather with your coworkers and family💕

We were there to celebrate my birthday. Overall the experience was good, but the hostess was bad, first they seated us by the door  (with door open)on a cold night with 2 young kids while there’s another table was empty, and I had to request it. Then she never lit the candle for us like any other table. With most people would make reservations, they should arrange table seating better, instead of telling their guests they have big party while there are 2 people seating in a 4 people table, and they can’t give us better table. Other than that, the food and service was good.

A 4PM RSVP.  Lil unprepared like a change of shift was happening or something.  The restaurant was open my friend had not arrived as yet.  The host was actually going to make me wait to seat me because she was t there yet.  There was no one in the restaurant... literally.  I said you’re not serious are you.  You are not going to seat me when there is no one here.  He sat me.
I really struggle with that requirement...a lot.
The rest of the experience was great.  Drinks, food delicious.   I made another RSVP for 6 people for next week.  My birthday!!! 🎉🎊🍾🎈
Waiter never offered water after the first fill-up and missed the steak knives on all four plates. Used a butter knife. Food was excellent!!!!!

We had reservations for outdoor seating at 12:30 fir lunch and arrived 5 minutes early. We were told that they had just seated several parties and that reservations were no guarantee of having a table. The gentleman who helped us was rude and didn’t even apologize but said the wait would be an hour.I will not be giving this restaurant my business again.

We asked for outdoor seating when the reservation was made, but we were gonna be sat inside. They were able to accommodate the outdoor seating request after all. The server took about 20 mins to take our drink order and then another 20 mins before taking our food order. After receiving the bill another 20 mins past before I took the bill inside to pay because our server didn’t come back.
Yummy, fun & great service!

The food was bad for the price I paid. My potatoes tasted like they were instant mash and came out cold! Steak had a weird flavor. The appetizers we got were fine. 

Service was not good either. Took 30 minutes before we could order our meal. And they forgot one of our appetizers and then tried to charge us for it. 

I will not be back. Spend your money elsewhere. I've had amazing meals for the same price at many other restaurants in the Bay Area. Extremely disappointed.
Waiter was great, food was mediocre, hostess and manager forgot they work at a restaurant
Great spot for date night and the food is amazing!

My husband and I went for an Anniversary dinner and we loved everything about your restaurant!
We will definitely be coming back to enjoy another meal or just drinks and apps again, keep up the good job!
The waiter was nice, but got 2 out of 6 entrees wrong and missed one side. It was nice to be out in a restaurant, but expect more for the money. ,
Food was mediocre.....wife and I both had steaks, lacking flavor and side dishes were a little cold.
Drinks are fancy and yummy. They had a DJ on Friday night who played some smooth 90’s R&B.
Amazing service for my son’s birthday party was great.

I spent $48 on a tasteless steak. I had been dreaming of this night out all week and it was such a let down. The kids Mac n cheese was yummy, but the burger was over cooked and the swordfish was not the swordsfish steak I would expect to see at a place like this...it was tiny and thin. Very disappointing

We were disappointed tonight. We were there about a year ago, and the food was great. So, we came back tonight hoping for great food on our anniversary. The food was okay overall (steak was great, scallops were underdine, risotto overdone, creme brulee WAY too sweet and heavy) but the service was terrible. The waitress did not come back after taking out order. A different waiter served us (who didn't know who ordered what). Then he was about to bring our check before asking if we wanted dessert (we did). Some of the staff were standing around, chatting, while our waitress was nowhere to be found.  We're not snobs; the service needs SERIOUS help.

Hostess never greeted us nor welcomed us.  Took her a bit to figure out where to seat us which was odd as we had a reservation and the restaurant was almost empty.  Service was on the slow side and food was okay.  Not a customer experience you would expect in a restaurant trying to survive.

Enjoyed the new reopening due to the new COVID tier. There are no paper menus and you must use your phone to scan the QR code on the table to get the menu. Not convenient and the hostess' instructions were not clear, but she was friendly.  The ribeye was delicious as was the pancetta mac-n-cheese. Our server/Otto was wonderful, attentive, and efficient. Looking forward to a full reopening. We will be back.

Food ad service was great.  Only bad item is that they didnt check me in for OpenTable and I received an email that I was a "No-Show".  I had to take the time to fix that mistake by providing them with details from my receipt.
although I got the wrong type of protein on my salad, everything else was great.
Such great service and amazing food! Love this place.

The food was excellent. The order was wrong.  The wait time very long. Service was non-existent. I had to keep waving the people at the register down to get anything. It was my first dining out experience in a year. If restaurants want people back they should do better than that. They didn’t charge us for one of the meals but overall it could keep me from going back.
Great outdoor seating for lunch.  Friendly efficient service.  Nice varied menu and excellent casual food.
