I’ve been to WH many times before and during the Pandemic, but this recent experience was extremely disappointing from beginning to end. It was as if they just opened.

My reservation was at 7:30. I received a call at 7:32 asking where I was. ....I was 30 seconds away, but still off putting.
We were seated quickly and then sat for 15 minutes before anyone came back to the table.

We received wine before water and the only water refill we received was after the meal, despite numerous requests.

Our waiter was new, and he was eager to please, but neither he nor the kitchen knew the menu. The pork chop I ordered did not come as described in the menu.  A plated chop with an apricot chutney, mashed potatoes and brussels arrived  as a chop alone on a plate with a side of tasteless mashed potatoes. I eventually received the brussel sprouts only to have to ask for them to be removed from the bill. I never got what I ordered and nobody knew what an apricot chutney was. The pork chop was cooked perfectly and was delicious, but I never did get the meal I ordered. 

Our appetizer had to be sent back as it was cold in the middle.

I realize expanded capacity requires some time to work out the kinks, but at no time did management check in, apologize for the errors and or offer any compensation or fill in for a staff that was clearly not ready for the change in capacity. 

I don’t like to write poor reviews but hope this one gets the attention I wanted at the table.
We were seated pretty close to other tables despite COVID and we had to go ask for service because our server never came by. When he did, he wasn't friendly at all. The food and atmosphere are good.

It was my anniversary. I specifically requested outside but there wasn’t anything when we got there for our 530 reservations. We waited another 20 for a table to finish but turns out they hadn’t ordered yet. It was a beautiful day and we were stuck inside. was a slight let down truthfully. if it wasn’t for the sword fish and waiter the stars would be less .

Great ambiance and setting, and food is fine. However, hosts need to learn how to provide guests with reservations actual seating. Like that's the point of a reservation, right? Guests with reservations were treated indifferent than walk-ins. 

Would normally have rated higher, but first host was blatantly rude when we arrived 30 minutes early for our reservation expressing an interest in outdoor seating, and more than happy to wait. When our appointed time arrived, there was no call out, handoff or mention. When we re-approached the checkin desk, the hostess had no idea we were waiting. Other guests with reservations were equally confused.

Food was subpar. The phyllo cheese appetizer was very disappointing and came cold and the phyllo wasn’t crunchy.

This place is a gem!
Great food, wonderful service 
Isaac was our super terrific server!
I will be back!
It was great, the food was perfect. Very open relaxing environment. Two thumbs up!
Absolutely terrible. We will never return, so disappointing because this place was our favorite.

It was my birthday and I had two tables of 6 it took some time to get drinks and my other table of 6 it took over 2hrs to get the dinner and it took another 2hrs to get my table of 6 dinner. 
Service was over all horrible and not planning on going back.
Great food. Service was a little slow but the staff was very friendly and helpful.
Everything was fantastic! Only opportunity would be our waters sat empty for awhile, but besides that is was a great experience!
I loved the food and drinks. My toddler also loved the food
You have to try their hamburgers. Incredible!  But share it with your date!  Too big for one person.
Willard hicks has become my boyfriend and my favorite go to steakhouse. Never disappointed!

Excellent experience at Willard Hicks! Great food, great drinks, and great service. Had the rum runner's old fashioned and a classic martini, and my date had rose. We shared pork belly bites, crab cakes, and steak tacos. Everything tasted great. Friendly, attentive service! Highly recommend.
Took my niece & her 2 friends who were visiting me.  We all enjoyed our meals!
The only issue we had was that it took over 15 minutes for someone to come take our initial drink order. Everything after that was excellent.
Loved the whole experience
Fantastic back to indoor dining experience. The food and service was exceptional except for the dessert (they were out of nearly every dessert and the creme brûlée was mediocre at best).

The restaurant had run out of propane tanks the night before as well as celery’s for the Bloody Mary’s and creamers for coffee. 
It was disappointing to freeze outside without working heat lamps and have the restaurant be out of so many items while still paying high prices.

I understand everything is a little compromised these days due to the effects of COVID but the quality at WH has really suffered. We ordered a bunch of appetizers and only 1 was really enjoyable. We left half of our plates untouched as it was almost inedible from quality of product, temp, over salted, etc.  For the price paid I just don’t feel the overall experience was matched. I hope that they can fix these issues and get some better chefs in the kitchen as this used to be a favored spot. These days more than ever restaurants should be trying to raise the bar and going the extra mile to deliver as we all need it.  We’re routing for you!
We ordered chopped salads. Half the ingredients were missing. Paid 8 extra dollars for cold, old chicken on top. Salads were $25 each.

Our reservation was cancelled upon arrival because we were trying to be placed indoors. When booking the reservation online it wasn't stated that we would be seated indoors. We asked to wait for a table outside and were told we couldn't and that they were full for the night. This is our 2nd time attempting Williard Hicks and both times have been greeted with unaccommodating service and attitudes from the staff. Sad turn for this local spot.
Service and food fantastic!

This was the coldest meal we ever had. Waiter said they had heaters but no one ever brought them out to warm the poor people eating outside.  We were celebrating our 45th anniversary and I indicated this on our reservation but we never received any wishes. Our waiter spent more time inside the restaurant than waiting on tables. We wanted a bottle of wine and we made a choice. Waiter dissapeared and returned with a report that they were out. He offered a taste of a replacement but that fell short so we chose another wine. Waiter dissapeared and return to report that they didn't  have our second choice. We finally found a wine they actually had in stock.
Now down to the food. We had the brie appetizer which was ok. I noticed the kitchen likes using sweet drizzles and jams and candied nuts.  For a brie dish, you only need a sweet compliment not a avalanche of sweet stuff.  Our side of brussel sprouts again had way too much brown sugar. The stars of the whole meal were the steaks. Both were simply grilled and perfectly cooked.  Whether we would return, its hard to say.
When we arrived there were no tables available. We were told that everyone who had reserved a table had shown up. All were just sat, so the wait was long. We canceled our reservation and left.

They only had one chef, so it took a while for the food, but it was all very delicious and so were the drinks. Once they get back up to speed after being open for outdoor dining again, I’m sure it will be wonderful again.
Amazing service! Beautiful atmosphere! Flawless food! Can’t wait to go back!

The ahi (presentation impressive) and crab cakes appetizers were excellent. We shared a creamy mushroom polenta w grapes that was above average. Creme brûlée and Sorbet were nice desserts to finish with. Our Waiter and staff  provided excellent paced service and we were never out of water. We also weren’t charged a wine corkage on out 1st bottle. Very cool. Will definitely come back on our next special occasion outing.

The food has really gone downhill during the pandemic 
Cheeseburger was still good but the ribs were completely burnt and barely edible 
Was here to celebrate a birthday so they have you choose a dessert and bring it out with a candle but still charge you for it ..
Probably won’t go back .
Great as always, thanks!

It was the worst customer service.  Will not recommend this restaurant to anyone.  We were celebrating a friend’s birthday.  We were a party of 5, out of which 4 had arrived and we were waiting on the birthday girl. But the wait staff refused to seat us until everyone was there.  But initially they even refused to acknowledge us.  

We ended up walking over to Opa and had a great evening.

I hope the management of this restaurant cares enough to get back to me.
Food was fantastic. There were at least 4 items that u ran out of on valentines night! When u know it’s gonna be busy they shouldn’t happen.

Have eaten here many times. No more:( Service was non existent practically (tables weren’t packed, but busy). 15 mins before asked for drink order. Red wine (by glass came and it was truly not drinkable) I explained I’m not one to return wine but this Pinot Noir is old .. waiter response was that it was opened this morning. No apologies.
Hubby and I both ordered steaks mine filet mignon and his ribeye. Both ordered medium rare. Mine was well done. Now I felt like that picky person sending steak back but anyone could see it was well done. 2nd steak came exactly the same after one bite... now manager comes and asks what’s the problem and I explain thus steak is also well done. She asks how I would like it and for third time I say medium rare... I kid you not only slightly better but not soft meat so I just couldn’t be bothered at this point.
How can a steak house get it wrong 3 times??? My hubby said his was def not medium rare either but he was hungry lol. Too bad the service AND the food was not good. Moving on.. Willard :)
Our food didn't come out together, one of our steaks had hair... We got our meat and sides came like 35 minutes later..
It was cold. Table was wobbly. Food was not as tasty as I remember it to be. Service agreed with our complaints and did not do much to make things better. I won’t be going back.

Service was terrible. Took about 20 minutes for our drinks; another 20 to order . Monday night so it wasn't busy. Waiter forgot to put in an order ( that was repeated twice).  Everything just took super long. End of the night we ordered two henessy shots and he only brought one . Took awhile to get the check too- food was alright

Oh my. I have enjoyed WH at the Morgan Hill location & even the Campbell location at times. The food this time was meh. If I want to just fill my belly, I can do so for FAR less money. It was sorely disappointing. 😔
Friendly and efficient staff. Nic

Went to treat my mom and my stepdad and fiancé to dinner here and every one of our steaks came back well done when we ordered them medium rare and rare . The service was good and the manager was quick to fix the issue and even comped one of the steaks (even though it should have been at least two comped because mine was still a bit over cooked second time around) would come back though the cocktails were made well and over all service was good .

It’s so hard to rate my true experience as business is hard all around but I feel I need to.  I will start with this is NOT my typical service at WH but this time Service was terrible.  First they forgot they sat us down.  Someone finally came to take our order who I believe was the hostess.  Our steak came back cooked wrong temp.  Side dishes were cold.  She delivered our dinner and never came back.  I had to flag someone for our check, which she delivered and apologized for not coming back.   I get times are hard but if you want repeat business service needs to be better.
Service was slow, soup was not hot. My salad had sun dried tomatoes that we hard to chew.

This was our last day to dine out before this next lockdown. We wanted to make sure to enjoy one of our favorites meals and wine while dining out. Our waiter was fairly new and he did an amazing job. The meal was cooked to perfection. We made sure to thank our wait staff which we hope you all do by being generous with your tips!  Thank you for being open as for hanging on there during these trying times. We will be back as soon as your reopen for dining and will be ordering take out in the meantime!
Enjoyed our experience but the waiter barely came to check on us.
Service was perfect. One of our meals came out overcooked, but they quickly re-fired another burger for my husband. Overall, another great experience at Willard Hicks.

Went for dinner requested a table by a heater as it was cold and no indoor dining was allowed at the time, it was still a little cold but can’t blame that on the restaurant.  My sister had the risotto, she subbed parmigiana for the goat cheese said it was amazing my mother had coconut shrimp they were quite tasty as well. I had the sticky chicken, the  flavor was good but the chicken was very over cooked, it was so dry and tuff it ruined the dish.

Food was excellent-crab cakes, filet mignon, NY strip. Server was prompt, attentive, and personable. Sat outside and were warm and cozy with the heaters. Love the lighting and atmosphere. Willard Hicks is one of our family’s favorite places!

Great food and great value.
Service a bit slow but acceptable.

Our family had a Sunday lunch at the restaurant. The menu which popped up after scanning the QR code was not complete and did not contain the desserts as opposed to the one you  can find on the website. The food was good but not outstanding, however, we had to wait for approximately 40 minutes, which - taking into consideration there were only few guests - is rather long, and the fourth plate was served 5 minutes after the rest, which is not acceptable - at least according to European terms. The staff was friendly but not professional. The noise level was moderate, we were sitting outside because of the pandemic.

The restaurant is nice, casual but classy. We went for my sisters birthday and the service was excellent. We originally reserved seating outside but unfortunately WH's heaters weren't working so they provided an indoor space, a private room, for our party. This was so great as we were worried about eating inside and they totally accommodated us by providing the private room. Also, the ambience was so nice, they had this music playing throughout the restaurante that was jazzy, with a little bit of old school, totally appropriate. All the food we ordered was fantastic, especially the cornbread, so sweet and savory, a must have. Another great item was the poke, very fresh and flavorful, I would definitely order again. Overall a great experience!

Willard Hicks used to be my go-to Campbell restaurant. I loved the service and the food. I enjoyed ordering a glass or two of Domaine Chandon Brut. Well, whether it has been the SIP and restrictions placed on the establishment, it wasn't what I remember. Our server seemed to be having a bad day. When I approached her about my glass of Champagne being not fresh and not cold enough (I had asked for a glass of $18 Champagne from a fresh, chilled bottle,) and was very polite about it, she didn't apologize and just said, "So you want to change it for something else." There was no offer of a new bottle, more chilled, etc. So, I changed it to a Merlot...Decoy, which we can buy at High Five Pizza in a strip mall for $8 a glass. 

Our friends were really cold outside with the wind blowing, so we asked for an outdoor heater, upon seeing that there were 6 of them. We were informed that there was no propane. How does a manager not prepare for the first coldest day of the Fall? We are in Campbell, not Buffalo. When this situation was brought up to the server, she acted very apathetic to it and luckily, someone at the host stand intervened and said he would help. We were offered a table inside. Once seated, our server informed us we "only had an hour" since we switched to indoors. 

Our food was okay; I probably should have ordered the burger because while my filet was good and was prepared black and blue, it wasn't really what I would consider to be worth over $45. And we pay to dine out. Part of this is due to the service. 

I know these are trying times for all of us. Having been in the hotel industry for over a decade and a half, and food and beverage service for longer, I understand we all have good days and bad. If you have patrons shelling out this kind of money, the experience should be worth it. 

It makes me sad to write this review and I sincerely want to like WIllard Hicks again.
Great server, food was ok, not a lot for the price.

I used to love going to Willard Hicks but after this visit, I will likely not go again. First, the service was terrible. Our waiter hardly checked in on us and we felt stranded out on the sidewalk. Secondly, our food was extremely bland. For the price you pay at Willard Hicks, you would expect more. Even the steak fries (which used to be my favorite) were not great and overcooked and dry. Everything from the salad to the mac-n-cheese, to the mash potatoes, they all lacked taste considering their simplicity. My boyfriend had the New York steak which was overcooked and also lacked flavor.
The steaks here are so delicious and have great presentation! First class

It was a really fun experience, the service was great, the food and drinks were awesome. We went on Halloween so it was a very fun ambiance sitting outside and people watching. Everything was very clean, overall great experience, we will definitely be coming back.
The heater on our outside seating area was not working. No one even cared to replace it so my son on that side of the table was freezing.

Delicious food, but took a long time to come to the table. Service was friendly, but seemed understaffed this particular night. HOWEVER, the music playlist was amazing & made the wait for the food tolerable.

Food was definitely low grade. Doesn't compare to LB steak and texas roadhouse is better. We arrived at 6:40 reservation at 7 and weren't helped even for drinks until 7:15. Waiter was about the best from this place and our bottle of wine.
Enjoyed eating inside with good social distances and the food and service was great.
as good as it's gonna get until this passes, everyone is soldiering on the best the can.
We ordered the brie which was good, but everything else we ordered was cold.  I had a steak salad and even though I ordered medium, it was well done and dry.
Even with reservation we were not given a table for 30 minutes. Hostess had no clue about ‘Customer Service’.
The server didn’t set up heat lamps for a table of 6

Great place with a great atmosphere. It took a little time for us to get served, and the waitress forgot a couple of things (the beverages), but other than that, excellent food, and the fact you can seat inside, make all the difference.

Kind of disappointed. Outside heaters were somehow out of propane. Not sure how you have a restaurant that is out of green beans and doesn’t have a green vegetable substitute. Salad was very blah and cocktail was so so at best. Servers were only minimally attentive. Have been here before but will really think twice before going back.  It felt like one of the before restaurants on one of those Gordon Ramsey or Robert Irvine shows.
I love going here because they have good quality food and it’s reasonable pricing. Nice atmosphere and good service.

We seem to always find Willard Hicks to be hit and miss. I don't know if we'll ever return.
The waiters tried hard, but the order kept getting screwed up, and then we had to wait too long for things to be fixed, and when one meal finally came back, it inedible.
The kitchen is not very receptive or sensitive to special requests or special needs.
I understand the challenges of covid and eating outside, but other places in Campbell we have gone to seem to be coping much better. The circumstances exacerbated the already poor perception we've had in the past.. Hit and miss became just one big miss.
Outside dining. Safe and relaxing.
We were a party of 4.  Food was great...everyone thought the flavors were fabulous.  Ate outside, they are working the COVID-19 dining plan well.  Will definitely go back again.

They were very busy during our last visit and hence we had to wait a long time for a waiter to take our food orders. In addition, they got our orders mixed up. So, overall the last visit was not such a great experience but we love going to Willard Hicks in Campbell and will certainly be back knowing that this customer service experience is not usual at this place.

A major disappointment. We’ve enjoyed great food and service here before but tonight was a let down. Poor and slow service, we were seated inside when my reservation was made for an outdoor table, disappointed with drinks and food. 

We made a reservation to sit outside. The hostess acknowledged my reservation yet seated a couple outside who didn’t have a reservation but had been waiting for a table. We then were seated inside (note at the time of this review Santa Clara county had just opened restaurants for indoor dining earlier this week). We were seated for over 2 hours due to slow service.

The restaurant has a nice setting and outside dining area .  When we showed up to the host we had to wait for two employees to finished their conversation  before they asked us if we had reservations.  After that they were nice and explained how to view the menu on our mobile and took us to our table.  Table was nice and secluded with good outdoor ambiance, lighting and ambiance.  The night out wa to celebrate our 14th wedding anniversary with my wife.  Our waitress was the reason for a sub par review .  She must have had a long day because she was very short with us both .  We hadn’t looked at the menu more tha 2 minutes and just asked for water while we took a look at the drink and wine menu.  From there it was a 20 minute wait before she came back.  Drinks took another 10 minutes but when. we ordered drinks we ordered our appetizer and entree all at once because we did t want to wait too long again. Ordering was not pleasant , instead of suggestions or confirmation it felt like drive thru at a fast food drive thru., constantly being asked is that it, is that it.  When my entree arrived it looked great but my wife ordered the fillet special with parsnips and blue cheese and brussel sprouts for sharing and what she got was just a grilled plain fillet with Brussel sprouts  on the side. Literally a plain charred steak on a plate alone.  It was incorrect but my wife was going to eat it because our waitress didn’t bring it out and was no where to be found.  I had to call a waitress over from another table and she was nice and went to get a supervisor and then our waitress finally came over .  they took away the plate and brought back the correct entree in a quick 10 mins.  We are and finished our drinks but we’re never asked for a water refill or a new drink order. Dessert was not even mentioned by our waitress . I had to find her to get the check.I was prepared spend a lot of money on drinks, dessert & tip, but the service from our waitress was bad.  Very dissapointed
Love this place.   Miss the bar and the girls, Rachael, Lauren Jill and Rebecca....   Can’t wait for this year to end.
Nice dining experience at Willard Hicks in Campbell over the past weekend. Staff is always very nice and knowledgeable!
The service was fantastic, the perfect balance of attentiveness. The food was great as well. My husband and I enjoyed our dinner at Willard Hicks

Me and my boyfriend love coming here for dinner. We hadn’t been back since this whole covid started. Dining is outside in the patio area of course. Food was delicious but our server was terrible. We sat for 10 mins before she even came to greet us. Then she took our drink and appetizer order finally but then again she was gone for so long, we were ready to order dinner and she was no where. We finally got a busser boy to get her. She took out dinner order and once again we did not see her for like 30 minutes. Our drinks were empty. We had to get another server to refill our drinks. Which then took another 10 mins to be brought to us. Our server still no where. We finished dinner and we had to ask another busser to grab her for our check. 
Terrible costumer service. I think they need to have more servers or at least a manger walking around checking on tables.

Well we use to love going to Willard Hicks, but after tonight the Campbell location is done for us. Tables are too close together for indoor dining and the poor bartender had to serve our table and cocktails for the rest of the restaurant. We were one of the first tables sat at 5 pm and when asked to move service dropped even more and staff seemed to make an effort to walk by table even closer than before. Too bad...really loved this place and it’s too bad to see the service level drop...blam it on COVID!

Great place to dine 
- value of food was fair 
- food tastes amazing

The appetizers and drinks were great.
My wife’s scallops with risotto were really excellent.
The side dish of roasted Brussel sprouts were also very good.
But my New York steak was rather tough!
I was really looking forward to a great birthday steak.
They did bring a nice birthday dessert.
The service was also good as was the table spacing for COVID.
Food was wonderful, entire staff over and beyond helpful, kind, smiling, made the entire experience for my Husbands Birthday dinner best ever.

Service is great but food was somewhat disappointing. The cornbread was cold on the inside despite being in a hot skillet. I think it should’ve been heated longer. It tasted good.

The beignets were really just fried donut holes that were very dense.

The green beans and crabcakes were delicious as well as the short rib with potatoes.
Great food!  I really enjoyed my filet mignon and creamed spinach!

We love Willard Hicks, but lately the food has been a little disappointing.  The ribs were “crispy” and the shrimp appetizer was too “crispy” also -seemed overcooked or reheated.  Also the other night we had the crab cakes and they were so dry we could not eat them. We understand the circumstances may have an impact but Hopefully they will get back on track.

I know they are trying their best but Covid takes away a lot of the atmosphere we enjoy at Willard Hicks.  We enjoyed our food.  Unfortunately they make the charcuterie platter much smaller than it was.  Unfortunately they need to adhere to the Covid rules and police people.  Two women moved their table right next to two other tables due to the sun instead of asking for an umbrella to be moved and no one said anything.  Crazy!

The food was delicious! I had the Peppercorn NY strip and it was the best steak I have eaten in a very long time if not ever! Our waiter was attentive and also gave my husband and I time to enjoy each other's company. The tables set in the street where we were first seated were not swept clean underneath from previous diners and there were leaves there as well.  The hostess was very nice and got us a table that was much nicer to dine at.  I would definitely go back there again.
Consistently very good.  Great huge burger if you are in to that.  Craft Cocktails are the real thing and not overpriced.  Go-to spot in the area.
poor service; decent food; general manager has poor customer service.
As always Willard Hicks was a very good choice for a nice dinner with friends on the weekend! Their staff is always very accommodating and on top of things.
Dinner was delicious. The variety of options on the menu were a plus. My steak was a little overcooked but it was still good. I will definitely go back.

We ordered rare and medium rare steaks. They were both well done.  Second time around my husband’s steak was medium rare (perfect) mine was well done when I ordered a rare steak.  Very disappointing as we normally dine here for special occasions in the past.  We did appreciate the server not charging us for the steak but I went home hungry.

Great overall experience with Willard Hicks. Been going here since they first opened this location. It’s been fun, food is great, service can be hit or miss depending on your server, and I can say the food is a little pricey for what it is. But we’ll wroth eating and enjoying a great time with friends, family, and social gatherings.
Great outdoor set-up, food and service was excellent. Loved my steak and my wife was happy with her salad. The musician busking across the street was a fun bonus.
Dinner with some good friends.

Good meal and drinks. We would go back again. We particularly liked the street tacos appetizer and their specialty Sidecar cocktail.  Overall, we found the food quite flavorful, the portions very generous, and the service good.

There were a few minor drawbacks. The steak burger, although tasty, was almost impossible to eat because it is so large (1 lb), piled high with toppings, and served uncut. It’s hard to see how anyone could bite into it. The sticky chicken entree was also good but the sauce was a bit too tangy for my tastes. 

A note about outdoor seating: to respect proper social distancing, some tables are in the street. This isn’t a problem, although some straddle the gutter, so you’re sitting at a slant for the meal.  I was OK with it, but if you think that would be a problem for you, you might want to note that when making your reservations.
For the price the steak was basic. We spent over 400 and it wasn't that great. Also the tables are wobbly. If you are going to serve outside fix your tables.
So nice to be able to dine out again. The spacing of tables was great and our server was really helpful. The drinks were great but food unfortunately was just good/ok.

We love our server Jesus. We go to Willard every couple of months but always order the same thing. Jesus remembered our drink order as soon as we sat down and remembered to bring extra sauces for our burgers. Great great service!
Treated us so rudely from the moment we walked in and did not honor reservation.

OK, I know this Covid thing is hard but the hostess at Willard Hicks definitely needs to lighten up. She was definitely a downer start to the evening.
The crab cakes were excellent.
The Basil Hayden was not Basil Hayden
The filet mignon was prepared perfectly as ordered with excellent mac and cheese side
The baby back ribs were also excellent falling off the bone tender
The swordfish was also superb.
The carrot cake dessert was HUGE and excellent.
Having to sit in the middle of the street without a heater definitely took away from the experience.

It was great.  Felt very safe and great to be outdoors.  
Great Service

I really like this place and our waiters were great but the host/manager was so unpleasant it took a while to enjoy the food and experience. 
Since she is the first one people see, my thought is she should be most welcoming. 
Food was good as usual.
We loved everything about it, food and service was great.
Service was great, food also delicious as usual. They’ve done a nice job on the pivot to outdoor only dining. Looking forward to returning again very soon.
It was our first since the shout down.  My mom watch the kids and we went to have good dinner
Willard Hicks is an exceptional restaurant. My steak was not the right temperature they promptly took care of it. The food and the service was top notch. Thank you.
Since they closed Campbell Ave. Outdoor dinning is very enjoyable.  The staff was friendly and the kept the drnks and food coming at a good pace.

Great experience each time I've dined at Willard Hicks. Great service, food (the porkchop with apricot chutney is my favorite, but can't go wrong on most items on the menu) , and refreshing cocktails. During COVID-19 time, seating is outdoor (heated lamps in the evening) and WH does a good job with social distancing (all servers had masks and gloves on), putting their menu online that you can access on your mobile devices by scanning a QR code when you check-in (clever way of not distributing physical copies of menues which helps reduce the spread of  virus). Will be back for the dozenth time to try some of their other entrees and will be bringing more friends or date for lunch/dinner!

The host, Susie, was absolutely rude to us and was clearly frazzled as she couldn’t handle the stress of dealing with multiple customers over different modes of communication all at the same time.  Unbelievable that she’s the Asisstant Manager.  At this rate, she’ll likely run the restaurant to the ground.  

On the other hand, our wait staff was incredible.  This review is only specific to the poor service offered by Susie.

The pork chop was excellent.  The Mambo salad was good, but somewhat bland.  Our drinks came just as we ordered them and the service was quite good considering the servers had to run in and out constantly.  Didn’t really enjoy sitting in the street, but the restaurants don’t have other options.
More shade needed for outside, but food and service was great...as always. I’ll be back soon.

One of my favorite dining spots is the outdoor area at Willard Hicks - Campbell. Amazing food!  The Baked Brie is just perfect.  Innovative themed beverages from their bar and great steaks. How can you not love this place.  They don't just try hard, they serve up great food consistently.  It is always a great experience.  I cook at home and I am always looking for a restaurant that can prepare and serve a meal that exceeds what I can do at home. Not many restaurants can deliver. But one that has delivered absolutely enjoyable meals   more than three times this summer is Willard Hicks.  I highly recommend the Filet, the Bone in Rib-Eye, the Green Beans, and the Intruder adult beverage.  However be aware that literally everything on the menu is worth trying, and you should!  The Sword Fish is great!  The Butter Cake A-La-Mode and the Crème Brûlée is perfect as well.  Seriously the consistency in execution is impressive, they are deserving of your business.
We had a 4pm reservation and arrived 5 minutes early.  The maitre d very rudely advised that they did not open until 4 and then shushed us.  We left!
Their porkchops are one of my favorites on the menu, also had the mac and cheese and tried the cornbread for the first time--was sooo yummy! Great way to end a bike ride evening 👍
Willard Hicks in Campbell never disappoints. Great customer service with much attention to detail by Victor! Love dining at this neighborhood gem.
Great Experience!

We love this restaurant and have been coming for years.  However, we had a terrible experience earlier today because the host, Susie, was terribly rude and doesn’t know how to communicate with her customers.  

While I understand that during a pandemic, it’s difficult to pay for  a good staff, this host is absolutely terrible and should not be in the restaurant business as she lacks customer service and communication skills.  Worst of all, she is rude and doesn’t have cleanliness in mind as she sat us at a table that was not yet cleaned and sanitized, after making us wait for 20 minutes at 9:30 pm.  

She’s chasing customers away and this is not a good time to compromise on service given how vulnerable restaurants are during a global pandemic. 

TERRIBLE SERViCE by HOST!  That said, the wait staff  was amazing as before.  Something needs to change now or the restaurant will be driven out of business over time by Susie!!!

Great atmosphere. Great service staff.  Our table was right next to the sidewalk and there were plenty of people walking within 2 ft of us not wearing face masks.  Everyone needs to do our part so restaurants can stay open.
Nice dinner on the patio! Covid safe dining out!
Food was excellent, service was wonderful...  wait time after our reservation time was not.

Willard Hicks is always a good spot for a nice dinner on a weekend night. Their staff is very friendly and attentive and makes looking after customers look easy even in these challenging times where only outdoor dining is allowed and they have to walk a lot further.
Anniversary was very nice

We booked online and then upon arrival we were told that they didn’t know why open table showed we had a reservation.
Apparently they were booked
Great as always even though we sat right by the door.
Always amazing. We were seated outside, the food, drinks and service was fantastic!
My husband and I have been wanting to try this restaurant and finally made it here.  The service was awesome and food delicious.  We will definitely be back!
Everything was excellent. Our waitress may have had an off night.  Just little things like refilling our drinks,bringing all the food out at once or shortly right after.
Excellent service and fantastic food! Great variety in the menu for those who can't eat only steak. The staff were topnotch and we had a wonderful experience. Highly recommend!
Favorite! Received terrific outdoor service.

The food here was incredible - we ordered the coconut shrimp and baked brie as starters, I got the short rib pasta and my boyfriend got a steak with mac and cheese and a baked potato, and we finished with the creme brûlée. Everything was delicious. We also got cocktails which were fantastic. It was pricey - around $300 after tip - but we ate and drank a ton and enjoyed it very much.
It’s not that good. Very expensive for mediocre food.

The hostess podium was not very welcoming, 
I believe most people are not able to understand that when you are wearing a surgical mask, and you greet people the eyes are the welcoming smile.  So, a bit of confusion with that aspect.  I was with a work mate, (both in health care)and we are more comfortable communicating wearing a surgical mask . The waiter was excellent and more than made up for the interrogation from the hostess .
Delightful meal, waiter Armando was gracious and attentive, food was delicious, wine was sensuous and smooth.

Have been wanting try this Resturant for a while now and was very pleasantly surprised at the high quality of food, the presentation and the attitude of the wait staff.  A very satisfying night for my wife and me.

When we arrived 10 min prior to our 7pm reservations, my husband dropped me so I could go in and get us a good table. I’m on oxygen and can’t walk far or stand long. I asked at the reception if I could be seated while my husband parked. The answer was no. The receptionist, standing next to the new manager, said they had Q’s for us (she meant the SCC required Q’s re: Covid) but could not seat me bc they “had to ask us both together.” That’s NOT the law. I quickly answered the posted Q’s , but was forced to stand while I watched them give away the good table I had been eyieing to some walk-ins, & seated us at an undesireable spot having glaring sun in one direction, and also another, reflecting off the large window glass. We asked abt another table, they said no, it belonged to the other restaurant, then came out and switched chairs toWH chairs. (They share patio tables w/ next door restaurant.)
The cool, indifferent and careless reception was in stark contrast to the previously warm, attentive service we always experienced there, and filters down to servers and others.
A week earlier, we reported that the chef had so much black pepper in the crab cakes, it was “hot” and my mouth burned long after. I love black peppercorns, and even ordered the peppercorn sauce on my $44 steak, but it was overkill on the delicate sweet crab and the wine we ordered to accompany it. The steak was of poor quality, very tough, and came doused with Sweet Ponzu sauce, not included unless you order it that way. They put it on top of my peppercorn sauce. Terrible!
We felt bad bc we want to support restaurants during this tough time of reopening. We left a $50 tip on a $120 tab. That was the previous week.
This time, 6/25, we both ordered the bone in short ribs, usually quite good- what we got was tasteless, mushy, overcooked pot roast. The only thing that was good was the wedge blue cheese salad. The server said they never told the chef abt the over use of pepper.
NOT GOING BACK! EVER!

I really like the food at this place. Unfortunately ever since they have become busy due to being open again the staff- the hostesses especially have been extremely rude and snotty the last 2 times I have been there. This is a restaurant in Campbell, not Encore beach club in Vegas- not sure why all the sass.

Ingredients were very fresh, great quality, cooked perfectly and meal was delicious. WH took care to keep everyone as safe as possible.  If you are fortunate enough to have Armando wait on you, you will enjoy the same great service we had.
Very rude manager. Immediately gave my wife and I attitude for not having a mask on

We were happy to be able to celebrate my husband's birthday the weekend outdoor dining opened up! I selected birthday for the occasion we were visiting, however, I'm not sure if this got translated to Willard Hicks since no one mentioned it or offered a birthday dessert. Overall, the food was good and on par with usual Willard Hicks expectations but service was mundane. We waited so long for our waitress to come back and grab our check that we went inside and just paid for it at the counter with the host, who was great and friendly.
We had a wonderful time and a fantastic dinner!
It was great

We love Willard Hicks the swordfish was amazing , the service was outstanding and our waiter was the best. I believe his name was Jorge. We brought our own wine and he was always right there to keep our glasses full. Was really nice to be out after all this shelter in place .
Loved the outdoor ambiance to celebrate our anniversary. Generous portions.

Wonderful experience. Our waiter Jesus provided excellent service. 
Food & wine so enjoyable.
Great way to spend an evening. My sons (18) first experience at fine dining and he loved it.
our server was great....there were only a few tables and it took us 45 mins to have our food served.

Had a party of 8 for a 25th birthday.  Reservation was on 3/15/20, just one day prior to the "shelter-in-place" order due to the coronavirus outbreak. Decided to go anyway and resturant was quiet, but service staff friendly and attentive.  We were put in a private room with a round table which was perfect.  We were away from noise and people so that we would not disturb them and vice versa.  Brought our own wine and birthday cake, which they graciously corked and poured the wine, and cut and served the cake. They even put their own candles on the cake!! Kudos to the staff for risking their health and working and being attentive without being in too close proximity.  Was a wonder meal and I would highly recommend Willard Hicks and I will definitely return.
Food was a little on the expensive side but great. Very good selection of scotch and bourbon.

I had a lovely evening at Willard Hicks.  the CORNBREAD- oh my!  I enjoy the DJ ambient music and the lighting is flattering.  My rosé was great and so was the butter cake,  I will definitely be returning

Not on them for what i'm gonna start with, but I wished there was a way to specify  that we need a high chair when making a reservation through OpenTable. They had reserved a Booth for us, where a high chair cannot fit. 
As for service: pretty poor. We waited way too long for our drink (about 15mn after ordering them), and another hour for the food. It was on a wednesday, the restaurant was almost empty!
As for the food: pretty poor too. We had 2 kids cheeseburger: both came out way too over-cooked, and the fries were too hot for the kids to consume right away. Honestly, if you're a restaurant and you offer kids menu, you should know that and be careful when handing over the plates (we weren't warned about that so maybe that goes into the "service" category).
My wife and I's food was OK however, but definitely not worth the price.

I discovered WH 1 year ago and I first enjoyed it a lot, but the quality dropped significantly since.
This was my 4th time here, and it's gotten to the point that I can no longer forgive them.

Chose a night and time when I expected low number of customers. Wanted to taste their food at its best.  Typically head chef off on Mondays , how good are the secondary staff?  They didn’t disappoint. Both steaks were cooked perfectly. Waitress was attentive. When she realized my daughter was celebrating her birthday she brought a birthday cookie, scoop of ice cream and a candle on the house.
We enjoyed the food and the service was good. The noise was higher than we preferred.
Great service from wait staff just food comes out too quickly...luckily it is all such wonderful food it was ok:)

Had a great experience. Have been here before and never disappoints. Will be coming back again. Staff is friendly and the food is very good. We've been to similar restaurants in the area however they do not compare to the quality. Would recommend this place

We've been eating at WH ever since it opened in Campbell. The food and service are consistently great. Our NY steaks were perfectly done and seasoned and tasted so so delicious. WH Chopped salad it always a winner, and it's big enough for two. But honestly, the best part of the meal is their pesto cheesy bread. Holy cow, it's a whole loaf of sour dough with  pesto and melty cheese. I almost don't need anything else in addition to the perfectly prepared martinis. The cheesy bread fell off the menu a few years ago, and I'm so glad it's back. WH is a bit expensive, but I think it is well worth the price as a special treat.

Note to management: Please please please keep the pesto cheesy bread on the menu!
Great place love coming here

Let me start by saying, we have visited Willard Hicks a few years in the past.  It was good but not great..... Last night We had an amazing dinner.  Started with appetizers, pork belly, poke’,pesto cheese bread.  Bree was our waitress, she made our night.   Dry kind, happy and accommodating.   She kept the pace the way we wanted. We never felt rushed and smiled continuously.. our meal was great, filet, sticky chicken and scallop risotto.    Everything delicious,we finished our meal with Bree’s suggestion of butta cake....oMG amazing

Out  waiter Samantha or Amanda I think is was her name.
She was so outstanding.
Birthday dinner with my family.  My husband and daughters (7 and 9) loved it.  Thank you.
Moms birthday

Service was polite but non-attentive to us ( I think she had a group in the private room ) 
Food was just okay for what we are used to at WH
Check in was awkward had to talk to 3 people to get seated
One of my favorite places to eat. And our waitress was amazing!!
Even though this was our first visit, Michael the host and Nina our server treated us like we had been coming for years! What a wonderful experience. We will definitely come back!
Went here for my birthday, the food was good and the butter cake for dessert was excellent!  Definitely will come here again!
This visit was our 3rd visit. The food was really good and consistent. Because we came during Valentines Day weekend, it was very crowded and noisy. I would be back but during a non-holiday day.
Valentine day dinner. The rib eye steak was amazing! Usually don’t eat too much steak, but this time I ate the whole steak which is like 1 lb :)
Ate at WH on Valentine’s Day, Amanda was super attentive and made our dining experience fantastic
Valentine’s day
Nina was fantastic. Wonderful experience!! You guys made the B-days woman night. Thank you
Food was great. Service was great. Cocktails were great. One of best pork chops Ive had and they have a spicy tequila cocktail that was really good. Favorite spot in Downtown Campbell.

Had dinner there with husband.
We both ordered steak both ask for 
Cooked Medium.
I cut into the middle and it was really red 
And not cooked (raw).
Even the waiter made a comment how red 
It was.
Waiter took it back to get re cooked it.
Brought it back and it didn’t taste good.

We walked in on time for our 7:15 reservation. There was no hostess at the hostess stand. This by itself would not be an issue except that every other employee in the restaurant just stared at us.  Nobody said hello, or somebody will be right with you, or anything else.  When the hostess arrived and seated us, she took us to what I’m sure is intended to be a 4-top which could seat 6 if necessary.  The upholstery was either stained or torn, I couldn’t tell which. As we were carrying presents and a cake I asked If a nearby horseshoe table was available, since it provided more elbow room. It was available. I shouldn’t have had to ask. Our server was friendly and professional. Drinks and appetizers were all good. I asked for my bone-in ribeye to be cooked medium rare. Any steakhouse should know, and their menu defines medium rare as having a warm red center. My steak had a barely pink thin stripe in the middle. My son in law, who asked for his New York steak to be cooked medium, got a warm red center. I’m sure they would have re-cooked the steaks had I asked. That would have meant watching everyone else eat while 2 steaks were re-cooked (properly this time) or having the rest of the party wait to eat until our 2 steaks were re-cooked, and 4 other people’s food got cold. The quality of the food, other than temperature, was fine.
Anyone who professes to be a chef in a steakhouse who can’t cook a steak properly, or can’t handle a 6 entree order (with only 5 proteins) is incompetent, as is the management who hired and continues to employ him. I have no problem paying $48.00 for a quality piece of meat, but I damned well expect it to be cooked properly. 1 of the 1st things most chefs learn about beef is how to test temperature without having to use a meat thermometer. If I received such a poorly cooked steak at Denny’s I would understand. To get something like this at a places that claims to be a fine dining restaurant is completely unacceptable. I will not be back.
Very special way to celebrate my birthday. My family and I all enjoyed it.

Food is delicious, especially the steaks.  I didn't really care for close proximity of the seating for a party of 2.  You feel crammed and close to the people next to you.  Not ideal for date night or trying to get up to sue the restroom.
Daughter birthday
Food was very good, if a bit pricey. Waitstaff was attentive and helpful. A bit loud when the restaurant filled up. A good pick for a nearby steakhouse.
Great food and service as always.
We had a party of eight for a friends birthday.  Everyone thourghly enjoyed their meals.  The service was   excellant.  We would all love to go back and try a different dish.
We had a great time! Great food, great drinks, great service. My entree came out raw, but they totally made it up with excellent service! We will definitely be back more often

We’ve been here several times. We will not be going back. The food has really gone downhill. The steak and chicken dishes were both overcooked and the presentation was not what it has been in the past. Service was mediocre and the restaurant was extremely noisy.
Husbands birthday

It was a Monday night and not very busy but we felt the service was a bit too casual for the cost.  The food, ribs, pork chop, and sticky chicken were all okay, but nothing special. Doubt we’ll bother to come back.
Our server was pleasant and attentive.  The spinach salad I ordered had many long stems throughout.  Disappointing lack of attention to this detail.  Food overall was good.
BAD experience due to very poor customer service. Manager did not visit and attempt to address our unhappy experience after being told of our unhappy situation.  BAD Manager!!! 1 STAR rating!!!

Awesome dinner.  Started with the Pork Belly Bites then moved on to the bone-in rib eye with Sizzling Mushrooms, Creamed Spinich, and Horseradish Mashed Potatoes.  Ended with the Beignets and Popcorn.  The pork belly was wonderful.  Crispy rind with very tender braised pork belly with hoisin sauce.  The rib eye was a perfectly cooked medium rare with a lovely char and herb butter.  Sizzling mushrooms were very tastey as well as the creamed spinich.  Was not impressed with the bland “horseradish” mashed potatoes.  Did not taste and horseradish in the potatoes.  I think that WH does not use prepared horseradish at all.  Even the “horseradish” aioli did not taste like horseradish.  I believe they use creamy “horseradish” which is not real horseradish at all.  In any case, do not waste your time or mo ey on the mashed potatoes.  Lastly, the beignet were lovely but needed a little but of whipped cream on the side along with raspberry sauce, blackberry sauce, strawberry sauce, chocolate sauce, etc., not popcorn!  Why popcorn anyway?  That was just weird!!  I git the beignets and popcorn with the intention of not touching the popcorn because I wanted traditional beignets which never ever anywhere does beignets ever include popcorn.
The loud music was horrible

my pork chop was so yummy! Carrot cake was delicious! 
the food here is great! I liked the music and the service.  Lighting is not flattering however, too bright in places and creates harsh shadows.  I could hardly see my husband's face because there was a bright light in my eyes behind him, and his face was in darkness
Food was fantastic. Service was a little slow to check on us to order, etc. Staff very friendly. Will be back again for sure!
The food, drinks, and service are excellent! Presentation of food is excellent
Arrived early and ate at the bar
Had a fabulous mother daughter how are you. The food was superb as well as the service. Kudos to all.
Great evening at Willard Hicks for steaks.
Our food was delicious! The server, Amanda was the best....and it was New Year's Eve. Loved that we could just order off the regular menu. Great experience!!!

Our server was awkward - quite phased by simple requests (the order of a Coke, a request for no seasoning on a steak).  The music was too loud and intrusive.  The glass divider by our table had a huge smear on it - very unappetizing.  Our Street Taco appetizer (2 steak and 1 shrimp) was delicious though the onion string garnish was not hot.  After our food arrived, my husband had to remind the server that he had ordered sauce for his steak.  The NY and Filet and Risotto & Scallops entrees were well-cooked and delicious.  The side of fries was uninteresting.  The side of mashed potatoes was dry and not warm.  Once we had our entrees our server seemed to be everywhere but at our table.  After we were finished eating, we sat with dirty plates in front of us for at least 20 minutes without any attention from her.  At this point three of us left the restaurant and my husband stayed to settle the check.  10 more minutes went by before the waitress noticed that the table was empty and cleared, and said she'd be right back with the check.  My husband declined to wait further, presenting her with our payment.  Perhaps we were not a priority for her, since we did not order any alcohol.  We will not be going back, and will not recommend Willard Hicks.

Came in to celebrate my boyfriend's birthday. He had the signature ribeye and enjoyed it. I had pappardelle pasta with short rib. It was good but quiet heavy. Pimm's Royal is delicious and would definitely order this cocktail again. No birthday dessert was offered to us even though I indicated when booking reservations that we were coming in for a birthday dinner. If you're there for any type of celebration, just notify your serve because reservation notes don't get read or acknowledged.
Loved it! Host was great. Food was incredible. Service was awesome. Will definitely come back
The Food was great. We were greeted as if we were regular diners. Carla Took great care of us. Thank you
So good! Eric our server was outstanding and honest when asking questions about the menu.

We have been to this restaurant many times and it seems that the service and the preparations of the food has gone down. I also requested for the private room for our party of 9 but I guess now they have put a minimum of $1000 to spend to get the room. Anyways my complaint was that we were seated at a spot close to the entrance and so when people come in and out the cold air comes in and it just messes up our dining experience. They also put the tables for another party pretty close to ours so it felt uncomfortable for our party and theirs. Also when our food came out it was just warm to almost getting cold. I suspect that the food sat for a while. Overall the food taste is still there but my party did not enjoy it due to the degraded service and food temperature. Hope that the business takes care of its customers, cause that what makes this place stay open.

We showed up on time-which was early (5:30). They had lost our OpenTable reservation. Because of that we were seated at a table, instead of a booth (which went unfilled the entire time we were there). 

Food wasn’t as good as previous visits. Moreover, we sat, being cold, because they lost our reservation. Basically, my family was
punished  because they couldn’t locate the rez.
Food was good, but my wife was expecting a tablecloth for our anniversary dinner, so I fell short in her expectation for ambiance.
Food is delicious. We will definitely go again and again.
Wait staff was excellent!

This was a company dinner for 6 of us.   Important clients!
About three weeks prior to our arrival I asked specifically for a window table and that this was an important dinner meeting for our company 

when we arrived they said sorry all the window tables are taken we already gave it to other people 

then we asked for a larger booth in the back of the restaurant and they replied sorry we have a big party for that table 

Then they cramped us into a small four-man booth which frankly ruined the night for us and they would not even complain one single beer for that inconvenience

overall the management here is rude, insensitive, and I would not patronize this place ever again.  Shame guys!

The host was very welcoming.  The wait staff was very attentive and accommodating.  The food came out quickly and had good flavor.  We tried the poke and kurobuta pork chop and both were delicious.  Cocktails were nice. The room was a bit chilly so we sat outside as it was quieter and warmer. It was a good place to go for a girl's night out.

Very nice Steakhouse. Our server, Brie was exceptional. We didn’t have to “wait to be waited on”, but at the same time didn’t feel smothered by her.  The food was very good. I will visit again when I am back in town.
I have been here multiple times but the service and food was just perfect this last time. Couldn’t have asked for a better server.

Birthday celebration and it was great, although the beef rib and mash was a bit under seasoned, the manager came over and welcomed our feedback. It was a lovely and very satisfying evening. Thank you for the hospitality AND the wine was really good choice!!!!

Great waitress and great food, after finishing dinner with business clients we had a couple more drinks after the table was cleared not long after we finished our drinks a hostess came to the table to inform us they needed  our table. The hostess offered to buy us a round of drinks at the bar or in a nice way  implied we need you to leave. We were driving so didn’t need another drink so the business meeting was cut short. Maybe it’s just me but I have never been asked to give up my table, maybe 476.00 is just a drop in the bucket for a party of 4  for your establishment but I know I will not meet for dinner here again.

I’ve been to Willard Hicks twice and I always enjoy my experience! I love the cool, relaxed ambience. A very classy restaurant with amazing service, delicious food, and a great ambience. I believe I had their short ribs the last time I came and it was amazing! Definitely a great place for date night or with friends or family for a special occasion. They have Southern, hearty food but with a refined twist. They truly elevate classic dishes and make the flavors and the presentation so unique! Truly a great experience! Can’t wait to come back to Willard Hicks!! :)

The food and service were excellent. The price was fair for what we were getting. Was seated close to the bar, which is part of the main seating area, and I didn’t really like that. But it was definitely not something that bothered me the whole time. Overall, it was excellent. I will definitely be dining here in the future.
The cornbread appetizer was burnt. The dessert, cookies, were cold. Steak was good.

Upon entry, we were welcomed with mixed attitudes. After having to move around tables because of some rain leaking in through the roof, we ended up by a small table for the 4 of us. It wasn’t a smooth start, but only partially because of the leaking.

We got an excellent server (happy, knowledgeable and polite, not over the top) and were happy with our food. The dining portion of the evening was great. The presentation of the food was excellent and it tasted how we expected it.

Our reservation included a special occasion tag, no one noticed or asked about it. Not even a booth was saved for us. The ambiance was ok but with a surprisingly old school feel - not vintage / western but old school (greeter in pullover, scratched tables, laminated wooden-patterned wallls).There is nothing wrong with these, except that the feel didn’t match the food quality and especially the prices. This would be a fantastic place in a lower price category - or with a higher standard of organization and a bit of updating.

The noise level was too high because the music was too loud. We asked to have it lowered and were told it was not possible because it was programmed and could not be changed. The food was excellent but we will not return soon because we had trouble hearing the friend we were with. We would not recommend it if you want to converse with others.
Wonderful restaurant in downtown Campbell.  The bbq ribs are fingerlicious.  Best giant burgers in town!!

Excellent service and the specialty ribeye and mac n' cheese were delicious. The shortibs were good but probably wouldn't order again, the blue cheese was a bit overwhelming. We had a fantastic server and very attentive to drinks and other requests. We sat outside which next time I'd prefer inside. Being outside on the sidewalk we had a lot of foot traffic coming by (people smoking nearby) as well as people leaving the restaurant lingered near our table which was uncomfortable. Overall, would come back again for the steaks and service. Next time I'll request to sit inside. Prices were very reasonable for a steakhouse.
Birthdays! Everyone enjoyed everything!

Steaks were cooked perfectly, scallops were tender and moist, and baked potato was jumping.  
Whole family enjoyed it.

It's one of my favorite restaurants. Everyone was great.  Only complaint about was that our waitress was busy with a big party so we got a slower service than normal. But she was fine and we didn't hold that against her cuz she was very nice.
Nothing that wowd me

It was ok, but not great! I feel like the service level needs to improve highly. When reservation was made it was noted tha it was a birthday celebration.  We got a private room, which I tought was nice because the noise level was low for us and perfect. But upon arrival, my sister arrived first and had checked in, so as I arrived and approached the host (older gentlemen)  as soon as I started to talk he interrupted me and said "you already got checked in", I then gave him a sarcastic HI because I would think his first words should have been hello and welcome.  Sammy was our server and seems like the down energy was in the air, also gave us a very disappointing service, maybe she assumed because we were Latinos and I had instead of 6 adults, had 2 kids her tab would be less and didn't need to make an effort. Never offered appetizers or suggested cocktails, buy the time she came around we were hungry so went straight to entrees. She was very simple like not engaging at all, never asked if we were celebrating anything, which I was celebrating my birthday! Food was ok, we liked it.  At this point the busser was the nicest guy, when he came to pick up plates he made eye contact, he asked how our night was going, if we needed anything, if we liked our meals...BOY I was expecting all of that from our server. When dessert came around. We ordered and i wish she would of asked as marked on reservation who's birthday it was  so i could tell her mine and at least get a picture in that beautiful room with a candle :( but nothing. "So no upload to facebook for promo there" we still tipped her 18% as I am a great tipper and never like to leave less than that. But I think service could have made my experience for first time much better. Quality of food is good and place looks great but didn't think the price was worth the lever of service.

My date and I went here for our monthly date night. We arrived early for our reservation and waited for our table. After being sat, we ordered our appetizer and a glass of wine. The service was quick and attentive and our food came out in good time. The music and ambiance were funky and fun! We will definitely be back to enjoy the food and dessert again in the near future.

The place was pretty quiet when we first arrived and the host staff was friendly. We were seated at booth towards the front. Waiter asked for our drink order and apps right away and was very attentive.  We ordered and the food came out without too much of a wait. Brother and wife shared the WH Chopped Salad which was very large and delicious. 
My daughter ordered the Steak Burger medium and it came back extra well done, dry and a little burned.  I ordered Street Tacos and (2 steak and 1 shrimp) but I received 2 shrimp and 1 steak, The waiter let me keep the shrimp taco and gave me another steak taco in a reasonable amount of time. We also order chocolate mousse for dessert which was very good and received 2 free birthday Cookies and Frozen Milk since we were celebrating 2 birthday that night.

The ambiance is great.  This is a good spot to have a nice dinner and/or watch the game.  My hope was that there would be more low-carb options at a steakhouse, but they seem to add sugar or flour to most of their options.  Even the brussel sprouts had brown sugar.  If you do not care about gluten-free or low-carb, then this is a nice place.
Delicious food! The ribeye was cooked to perfection, the poblano corn bread was sweet and savory buttery goodness, and the cauliflower was delish! $7 well drinks for happy hour were also a plus.
We enjoyed our meal and excellent service. The in-house DJ is a fun touch, but can be too loud for even cross-table conversation.

I made our reservation for 5 friends. 3 of us arrived together and I checked in and the hostess told me they had no reservation for me. I showed them my open table confirmation and the confirmation text. They had also called me the day before to confirm and I showed them the call log. They suggested we sit outside on a cold night, I said no. Hostess left to speak with a manager and was gone for several minutes. Then she came back and said there is nothing she can do. 
Checked the list again, still couldn’t find me. Then suggested we sit outside again, still no. She said the open tables were all reserved and I reminded her that WE had a reservation.  She left again. Came back again and said nothing she can do. She checked her list again and realized the other 2 people in my party had arrived earlier and were already seated at our table (they were seated by her!) so finally we were taken in to sit. This place needs to get their crap together.
Food came out cold 3 out if 5 dishes even coffe at end if dinner was cold. Waiter needs more experiebc

I used to enjoy this place but not anymore.
We went there with friends who are vegan, and who kindly asked if it was possible to get some veggies in lieu of the chicken that's in the kids menu (for their daughter). The waitress did not bother trying to ask someone at the kitchen if that was doable — she just replied "what's on the kids menu cannot be changed".
Well, turns out that the last time we went to Willard Hicks, our friends had made the same exact request, and they immediately accepted.
Veggies are on the kids menu, but they just come with some meat. Fries are also on the kids menu, with meat. Our friends just wanted veggies and fries. Not too hard right?
Anyway, the waitress ended up accepting their request, we had our food served about 20 minutes later.
Their daughter got her fries and veggies, along with some ketchup… but wait… that was SPICY KETCHUP. And by spicy, i meant REAL spicy, the kind of spicy you just DONT have a 2yo child try it!! They apologized and brought regular ketchup but oh god why in the first place!!!

My wife ordered the burger and ended up with an over-cooked patty (she asked for medium but it was clearly VERY well done… could even taste the charcoal).

Kids menu are supposed to come with a cookie as the dessert… we ain't got any (we had ordered 3 kids menu).

It's sad, cause I used to really like this place, but I feel like this is becoming worse every time I go there. Guess i'll have to find a different place that serves Delirium on tap now!
Great service and quality of food
Food was delicious with generous portions.
What a treat!  The service was great the food cooked to perfection. We enjoyed steaks and sides and everyone was happy with their selection.
All was perfect except for extremely high noise level

Always a #10.
Outstanding food and service.
I found the prices to be to high compared to the value and taste of the food. Perhaps this is a good happy hour spot as the ambiance and service is great. Sorry I can't say the same for the food.

Excellent dinner. Great wine list. We shared the fries as an appetizer. A bit too spicy, but hot and crunchy and creamy middles. Yum. My friend had the rib-eye, which she loved. I had swordfish. Delicious, and just as good cold for lunch the next day. Great professional friendly service. Will return.
Our server Dana was amazing. You can tell she loves her job, and is very good at it. Food was mostly excellent. Appetizers & sides were stellar. The steak was merely average.
They asked me if I was celebrating something when I made the reservation, I said yes my anniversary. But nothing ever happened at the restaurant, nobody even acknowledged my anniversary

Celebrated two birthdays in our party. We were seated quickly; it was a late reservation (830pm) on a Thursday evening. The wait staff was pleasant, quick  and accommodating!  We brought our own wine as corkage fee is $15; very reasonable! We ordered starters the meaty chewy rolls & Jalapeño cornbread. The roles were ok. Unfortunately the cornbread came out burnt twice. This was quite disappointing. The third batch was just ok. Entrees were very good & the sides as well. We’ll probably try other “like” restaurants in the area first.
Everything was great but the service was just average.

The host was not very helpful when we asked for a table that was larger than the ones they have set up for two people. Those tables are so small you can’t have an appetizer dish on the table with the menus at the same time. We needed to have them remove the candle and any dishes we were still working on in order to accommodate our meal plates.  The waitress was great and the food was better than average. The only thing I was disappointed with was the risotto. It was a bit too sweet.

So disappointed! Great food and ambiance. Ordered the ribeye and chicken from the grill with the Mac and cheese green bean and mushroom sides. Incredibly disappointed after the meal. When I asked for the other half of my ribeye steak to-go with the leftover mushrooms the waiter took all the dirty plates including the ones I asked to take home. The bottom of the other plate sat on top of my steak. It’s disgusting and there’s no way I’m eating the leftovers if the staff has such disregard for cleanliness. Won’t be back.

This is now the 2nd time I have had a bad experience here. I went with my husband a few weeks ago on his company’s card. I ordered a filet mignon and it came out completely burned. When I asked to get a new one the waitress said they were having trouble with the grill. For the new filet and it till had a band taste like they were cooking on a dirty bill. Then to make matters worse when my husband goes to submit the receipt to his work we find out they billed us for TWO steaks!! I got charged over $40 for a steak that I took one bite out of and then sent back. Emailed management within two days and no response.

I take my team out last week. Again my steak was completely burned on the outside yet rare on the inside. It was so burnt I could not cut it with a steak knife. Also the fries were burned to a crisp and the cornbread was completely burned on the bottom.

Never again!! Save you money unless you like you food extra well done and crispy

Great server, dishes well explained when we asked, very reasonable wine prices, tasty food esp: coconut shrimp & pork chop with mash and sprouts. Three TVs of sports but at least they’re in a separate bar area. Good.

Willard Hicks did not disappoint! I had been meaning to come here since it opened and I was a little bit nervous it wouldn't meet my expectations, but it totally did! Our server (Anthony) did an amazing job! He really knew the menu and was able to elaborate/ suggest several drink options and food! I had the Pims drink and my boyfriend had the "some like it hot" they were outstanding! We also tried the cornbread which was a total high light! Also, the burger was legit the biggest burger/fry combo I've ever seen in my life! It's no wonder why they have a "split" option for that! So so yummy and truly gourmet! 
We will for sure make our way back more frequently and recommend to anyone in the area! It was also the perfect place to celebrate my birthday as I got a delicious free dessert (cookie and ice cream) and they kept it discreet! 
Can't wait to come back!
Chopped salad was a little bland.  Corn side dish would be nice if kernels were cut from Cobb.  My pasta with short rib was very good.
Great food and great service. Our waitress Brittany was so friendly and helpful with our first experience dining at Willard Hicks. Will definitely be back.

Great food. Excellent service. Cocktails were great. They were very accommodating with our toddler. Giving us a booth and making sure we had kid friendly utensils. Setting hot plates away from our toddler (it’s amazing how most people just don’t think about that).

Meeting up with old friends. 
Tonight we had fantastic service and outstanding food.
Our grilled swordfish was excellent, our server was "genuine" and very good.

Our waiter Anthony was very attentive and provided great dining customer service!

We had the swordfish which was delicious.  My only critique is that for the price, it would have been nice to have two sides included instead of a grilled lemon and a tiny bed of greens.
Poor service. Server was rude and impatient. Good came out cold. Overpriced for quality of food.

Steak was cooked medium, while I ordered medium rare. I notified our server, Vanessa, and she had the kitchen prepare a new steak.  I've been here 5 times and this is the first time my steak had been overcooked.  Vanessa was great. Love that there is no corkage for the first bottle of wine.
Food was great... served hot and delicious. Server very attentive. Good place .. lively but ok to talk and not be overheard.
It was a quiet night at WH but everything was just fantastic. Food and service.

We have dined at Willard Hicks numerous times, including hosting a dinner party. We have been pleased with the wonderful food every time.  The service had also been top level, until this evening. Tonight our waitress must have been distracted. She disappeared for significant periods. Other waitresses even stepped in because they saw we needed or wanted service. We asked to have our table cleaned after the entrees and before dessert.  The table was not cleaned before we left.  We wanted refills of soft drinks but another server, who noticed we wanted something, helped us. At the end, our server had not been around for some time, so I asked another server for our bill. This dinner was our second visit to WH in two weeks. Sadly, now I’ll wait a while before I return.

Overall we love Willard Hicks however last night wasn’t the best for us. My burger was ridiculously ginormous. You were forced to cut it up and eat it with a fork. I ordered it medium it was overcooked and because I could not bite into this burger the flavor profile just was not there for me. 

My husband had the street tacos, wasn’t his best meal but not horrible. We have eaten at Willard Hicks several times which we have been quite impressed. I still give them a five star and we will go back but it was a bit disappointing last night.
Had a late reservation so the restaurant was basically all ours. The food was prepared rather quickly but still so so delicious
Sister in town
Always great food !! Nice evening out , excellent service and staff

We went with a couple of friends for dinner.  The drinks took some time to arrive, but were excellent.  The appetizers (crab cakes, tuna tartar, deviled eggs) were also excellent.  While all the proteins were really good, the side vegetables were actually better.  Beautifully seasoned, interesting and creative.  The restaurant is a bit on the noisy and bright side.  Also, we sat with dirty plates on our table for about 20 min hoping someone would clear them away.  Aside from that, it was a great experience and we will definitely be back.

Good quality steaks. The rib-eye with Ponzu demi-glacé was a tad on the salty side and the fries could have been crispier. Overall it was an ok meal. Certainly have had better steaks elsewhere in the world but it’s a good enough place to go if you’re in Campbell. Wish service was a bit more attentive though. The place wasn’t packed but we could see quite a few tables including ours just anxiously waiting or looking to catch the eye of servers who were nowhere to be found.

Everything about Willard Hicks is outstanding.  We have been there many times before,
and they never disappoint!  All of the food is beautifully presented and delicious!  Highly
recommended!
Server was excellent. Food is consistently great. Perfect spot for dinner, a date or just hanging with friends. Great small party rooms available. Fun bar vibe. Great music played too.
Service was superb, friendly,open ! Special request ( very pregnant daughter) table no problem. Food so delicious
The burger here is big enough to split between two people. I really enjoyed the Bone In Short Rib and would highly recommend the peppercorn steak as well.
First time at this restaurant and well worth it.  The food, service, staff, etc were all outstanding.  We will definitely eat here again!
I requested a quiet table since it was our anniversary dinner. Instead they put us right in the walkway next to the bar area, so that was annoying. Other than that food and service was good.

We greeted at the host stand upon entering. The host (might be a manger) seemed a bit confused or unsure, but quickly composed himself and brought us to our table.
