We quickly greeted by our server who helped us with our drink orders, sharing his personal favorites. Our drinks came out in a time manner, alone with our appetizer. Out next was our entrees, all were delicious and cooked to order.
Took 3 hours to complete dinner.  Waitress was nowhere to be found.  Manager was unresponsive and not helpful.

The food and drinks were good, but there were several significant issues with the service that would make this a do not recommend, with so many other places in the area.  There were several order mistakes made for our party (forgotten soup, wrong side dish).  Then there were the other service issues: appetizers, soups, and salads all coming at one time, even the servers were bumping into one another.  Secondly, there was the waiting for several items: refills on ice tea (needed to ask 2-3 times), a side of salad dressing (waiting over 15+ minutes, needed to ask twice, everyone else was done with their salads/soups), a glass of wine to have with the main course (asked as they were taking away the salad, glass didn't arrive for 20+ minutes after the steak - even eating slowly waiting for the steak I was 1/2 way done before it arrived).  The server seemed like he was trying and he cared, but for the amount paid for the meal I expect better service.  The food itself was good, not excellent.  Paired with the service, I do not know if I would come back again.
Reggae music isn't the best for an early Sunday evening but the staff made up for it with their friendly approach to a special night for my wife and I. The pomperdelli pasta was AMAZING!
Great place to meet after the game for a meal 💯👍🏽
Love this place!! The vibe and atmosphere was indescribable... my friends and I love coming here for birthday occasions. Food and services are amazing.

I’ve enjoyed WH a number of times and tonight was no exception! Great food and cocktails.  Service was also excellent.  I brought my (adult) kids for a farewell dinner for my daughter who visited me this summer.  It was her first time at WH and definitely wants to go back!

I’ve been wanting to try this restaurant for awhile. We were not disappointed. The portions are big, in fact their burger can be shared. The kids really enjoyed the mac’n cheese and chicken quesadillas. I enjoyed the swordfish very much!
Will definitely come back.
Food and service were very good  my 1st time eating at Willard Hicks.

We went for our anniversary dinner and imagined it would be like our previous visit some time back - great food and drink, great service in a relaxing environment. It turned out to be super-busy and very noisy - you can’t fault a restaurant for being popular, however the service (and food) suffered badly for it. 

We waited a long time for any acknowledgment; when the server finally arrived she was great, but we let her get away before finalizing our drink order, and it was awhile before she made it back. Oh well, no big deal. And once we finally ordered, everything came pretty fast. Maybe too fast - the steak arrived before anyone realized we still had only our dirty appetizer plates and butter knives. Oh well, no big deal again...my husband grabbed some clean plates from the nearby waiter station.  I proceeded to cut open the ribeye with the butter knife, and here is where I draw the line on patience - the $42 ribeye ordered medium rare was fully brown and dry all the way through. They make a big deal on the menu about steak doneness, so this was really not okay.

Luckily I was able to flag our server right away and she whisked the steak back to the kitchen to be redone. She also quietly slipped steak knives on the table and took our dirty appetizer plates away. But not the side dish, which of course would be cold before the new steak arrived. And no mention of the empty cocktail glasses or any opportunity to order a glass of wine. Oh well...

At this point, though, a manager had gotten wind of the steak issue and took control of the situation- he handled it ably with some nice glasses of wine graciously comp’ed, and some warm potatoes along with our new steak, which I’m happy to report was perfectly cooked and delicious.

I like Willard Hicks and hope to go again sometime, maybe early in the week when they’re not so busy - or sometime after they get better at handling busy nights.
Keep trying to love this place but has not been the same since they re-opened. No to standard.

Overall a very good experience. The service was excellent. One of our steaks came out far overcooked, but the server noticed and they very quickly comped that meal and offered a replacement. Mistakes happen and they absolutely made up for it in my mind. They have a DJ and you could tell because the music was very well suited. A nice upscale restaurant which still feels modern and fun.

I like Willard Hicks they have a great menu, wine, and cocktail selection.  The crab cake appetizer was delicious but, this time the scallop risotto was just ok.  The scallops were wonderful but the risotto came out cold and was tired.  My wife's steak was perfect.  I also felt really rushed by our server.  I know they fill up but the speed of the service was to fast for me.  The noise level was really high probably because they sat us close to the DJ.  I think I will stick to my traditional favorites there next time and not venture too far off the menu.

PS forgot about the chocolate mousse for dessert it was amazing as well.
Found piece of plastic in my burger. They were willing to replace it (I declined) but they comped the burger and were very responsive and concerned. Otherwise good and service were excellent.
Wedge salad was excellent. Scallops were sweet and perfectly cooked. Good cocktails and friendly service. Pleasantly surprised!
Always satisfied when we leave this restaurant. Good is great and Servers are so very nice. This place one of our favorites.
Great food and libations and the atmosphere is nice. Both indoor and outside seating
Service was great, attention to detail and soft spoken words made for a night of wonderful food and easy conversation
terrible waiter
Great good and service. We will be back. The ribeye steak was great!
Great food and service, great atmosphere!
LOVE Willard Hicks! Every important meeting or special celebration is spent there! Service is wonderful and the food is just spectacular!
Filet was over cooked. Waitress Carly was awesome!
Both the food and the service were excellent.  It was our first time dining at Willard Hicks.  We were pleasantly surprised and impressed.  We will definitely come back again.

We ordered two filet mignon and they served one normal filet and the other was butterflied. We asked and they tried to tell say that they were the same steak. Ultimately, we had to explain that we eat at WH regularly and know what a filet mignon looks like. They finally explained it had been butterflied and they could take it back but we were in a hurry at that point and soured on the experience.

Food was fantastic. We ordered a couple of New York steaks, Willard Hicks chopped salad, and the pesto cheesy bread for a starter. Our martini order got messed up, but our server was quick to fix it. Second time around, the martinis were perfect. The pesto cheesy bread was so good, we had to order some to go home with us. The chopped salad was excellent. It was light and perfectly dressed and was not too filling.  But the stars of the show were the steaks. They were done perfectly medium rare and were so so tender. They were like large filet mignons but with lots more flavor. Our server Kevin was great and hard working, and the front of the house staff were so pleasant. We can't wait to go back.
My husband got the ribs and they were fall off the bone delicious. I got the scallops & risotto. The scallops unfortunately were over cooked

Friend was moving overseas
Food was terrible, server was polite.  Friend was sick from the scallops.

this was our second time at WH both times have been great except our last visit the cornbread that I was looking forward to having again since it is unique to most other places was burnt think the cast Iron skillet they used was to old not sure. But on our first trip we ordered the normal size one it was delicious the last visit our waiter convinced us to go with the smaller cheaper happy hour one which was brought out in a different skillet then the first time we ordered the big one. Outside of that the rest of our meal was delicious and we would definitely go back again.
Overall a pleasant meal in modern surroundings.  Service was quite good, as was the food.

The food was delicious and the waiter was awesome. He informed us what was his favorite on the menu and gave us tips on what to order. My boyfriend had the blackberry glazed filet mignon and I had the bone in pork chop. It was both cooked to perfection. The steak was juicy at medium rare and the pork chop was not dry, but juicy and tender. For the sides, we had Mac and cheese, string beans and house cut fries. All were amazing! Definitely will be back to try other foods on the menu.
Great experience eating dinner her with my wife. Our food was great, staff service was excellent, I don’t really have any complaints. As a matter of fact I will definitely go back!

Nice enough place if not looking for “fine dining”.  I went planning to have steak and got one of their “best” and most expensive cuts.  Cooked well but meat quality disappointing.  My fault for not going to a real steakhouse, of which there are plenty to choose in South Bay
I had the swordfish.  Portion was very small and it came with some salad.  Not enough food!  It would have been better with an appetizer.
Loved NOT having the obnoxiously loud DJ! You could have a normal conversation. Food outstanding, jewels... you are a great server!!!
Food was good, service was terrible! Our waitress Julieann, was the worst waitress I’ve ever experienced. Food came out wrong, requests were refused. We won’t be back.

Not on par with other high end steak houses. Seems to provide the illusion of something special, but the food did not measure up. Vegetable sides were very 'gloppy' and meat was fine, but not outstanding. The highlight was our very helphul and personable server.
We always enjoy the vibe and the food.  Excellent cocktails and the pork chop was excellent.  Fun place to meet friends.

We had ahi and crab cakes first. 
Filet mignon with blackberry glaze and NY strip. 
Then chocolate mousse. 
Everything was scrumptious. 
Vanessa was our perfect server. 
Expensive- kinda.  Worth every cent.
2nd time here. Fantastic again.

The food was cooked to perfection except for the ribs were a bit over cooked.
We will be back.
GOOD food , wine selection , reasonable prices   ............................
Food came out cold after waiting 90 min.   It never came back out!
Well I always have the best experience at this restaurant, this time the host and the waiter specially the waiter Jesus was beyond amazing we had a great service thank you
Food was very good, but the Caesar salad was a joke--5 lettuce leaves sprinkled with dressing and cheese.

Great experience where. I got the Filet from the grill and was absolutely delicious. Healthy portions across the board with a solid alcohol decision. We sat inside, but they still had a huge outdoor seating area. Service was fantastic and everything was decently price for the food we got. Will be back!

I had the blackberry glazed filet, which was cooked to perfection and just melted in my mouth.    The Caesar salad was delicious with the sun dried tomatoes, roasted garlic, and spicy jalapeno Caesar dressing.  I can't wait to go back to try the ribs.  Our service was absolutely on point, which I would expect from this type of restaurant.  I was not disappointed at all!   I would definitely recommend this restaurant for special occasions, dinner with friends, or date night.
Green beans, brussel sprouts, and squash were delicious.  My husband's NY steak was good- but I wished it came with a sauce or something- too plain.  My glass of Rosé was very nice.
Great food and excellent service! And I really appreciate the free corkage on your first wine bottle. I will definitely go back!
The food and service was great! I will absolutely return for another round!

We have been wanting to eat here since they opened and finally celebrated my birthday here for dinner.
Excellent food, comfortable and relaxing.  Really enjoyed our appetizers and steaks!
First time at Willard Hicks.  Celebrating our anniversary  Nice atmosphere.  Good service. Food was very good  The tables:for 2 could be bigger. Not much room.

I have been to Willard Hicks twice, the first time I was wowed with the food, last night unfortunately missed the mark.  We ordered the brie and conserves appetizer, but the bread must have been by the steamer because it tasted chewy and sort of stale, it wasn't very good.  The fried vegetable resting on top tasted like it had been fried hours before and was limp.  The steak was just ok, I ordered it medium rare and it came mostly medium rare, but it wasn't all that tender.  Our server however was attentive and great....but not sure I'll be back soon.
First bottle has no corkage fee and the food is good! Careful of the thick fries when you first get them - they’re piping hot! The ribs are a go-to favorite.

We had made a reservation a few days ahead of time and were disappointed that we couldn’t sit in one of the 5-6 booths that were empty. In asking to move, we were told it would be a 45 minute wait to get one. The booths remained empty until the time we were paying our bill...even then we could have been accommodated. 

Music was playing higher than I’d like, which elevated the noise level overall since our conversation had to compete. 

Service was excellent. Our drinks were brought promptly as well as our food. We never had to call for service as our waiter checked in on us throughout our dinner. 

Food wasn’t as great as I’d expect with the pricing. Our rib eye was a little chewy and the rest of meals were just okay. 

I wouldn’t necessarily recommend this restaurant to a friend...drinks and apps yes, but for a meal out, not so much.
We come there often. Love the food.. The Burger is the best.

As always- a great place to meet up with friends. We still love the honey-coated cornbread! This is to die for- seriously. 👍 And the steaks, of course, were grilled to perfection, so we left very satisfied. No photos this time-sorry!

Have never been disappointed at WH.  the Swordfish is a excellent, as are almost all of the small plates.  Many times we just order a bunch of small plates instead of main courses...they are that good!
It was good!

Arrived Sunday night 8pm, 1/2 full at best, plenty of parking around...other reviewers say different.  Food was decent, but the ODD & COMMON bad thing was the OVER SAUCING & COVERING of many good foods by yummy but unhealthy & WAY too many dried fried micro onion rings.  They say good food does NOT need to be hidden or covered much!  I guess that’s not a concern of the $$$$ & biz-focused owners at Willard Hicks?

My swordfish was good but WAY TOO TINY for $25. & WAY too smothered & almost SWIMMING in a less than healthy white sauce.  I had to “wipe-off” the fish & remove it from the sauce POOL or LAKE or OCEAN to even eat it.  Only that one fish entree offered.  My wife’s burger was good, but again, a bit too covered.  Server told us NO corn side-dish available by 8pm as it “was all sold out”, odd, sad, bad for us.  Who cares about the customer nowadays?  Nice corporate buildout, but it feels too cold & sterile.  Servers & most staff nice but all speak better Espanol than English.  They often “disappeared” for a while, but I guess they had tables FAR away in the back too.  Not good for us & the other table upfront, we had to WAVE to get water & ketchup & sharing plates & ....   

What’s funny is that a bus boy told us that the Owners are the SAME as next door kinda way too corporate & fair at best Opa & newer Mos.  Be careful, as they say, you get cocky & greedy, open up different kinds of places & then too many of them & lose focus...as they say, “Jack of all trades, master of none”!  Dilute & you become weak.  Weak die.  It’s better to focus & master.  Oh well, Morgan Hill & Campbell customers may not know the difference?  We were one of the few customers in last night without tats or kinda buzzed upon walking out the door to their cars...the cops are waiting in their cars just around the corner!  Beware...
Tables are Uncomfortably close together.

I really enjoyed Willard Hicks. The restaurant service was impeccable.  We started off with the wedge salad and caesar salad - yum very satisfying. The bone-in ribeye was out of this world, perfectly grilled steaks to perfection. Great sides - bake potatoes, green beens etc. Followed by wonderful desserts. We loved the vibe, complete with dj music in background.  One of the ordered entrees was entered incorrectly so it came out later than everyone elses, but the order was credited even without us asking. More important, the food was amazing.
Part steakhouse, part frat house. The music was awful and the noise level ridiculous considering the prices. Next time I want to drop $150+ on dinner for two, I’ll definitely go elsewhere.

The service was really good and the ribs were also good. However the steak was not medium the way my husband asked it to be. Also, they had something they called cornbread but it was definitely NOT cornbread.
Husband had wonderful birthday!
Fantastic experience. Great good. Personable waiter. Delicious cocktails. Presentation was outstanding as was the flavor. Great ambience.
Excellent food. Wait staff very helpful.

We used to love Willard Hicks.  Last night we were celebrating a 75th birthday for my mother-in-law.  We waited over an hour for 6 burgers.  Waiter knew we were waiting way too long and just disappeared rather than checking-in with us periodically.  Food was not nearly the quality we had experienced before.  Two items of six were served with errors.  Oddly, food was not even served hot.  This was our favorite local restaurant but we won't be going back again.  We understand kitchens get backed up but they failed on service and quality.

Had a great meal and great service.  Portions were generous.  The tuna appetizer was outstanding.  Loved the Southwest wedge salad. My husband's filet and my pork chop were both prepared well and were delicious.  We will definitely return.
It was a nice time with good food
It was pretty amazing. The food was great, and I especially liked the blackberry filet mignon.
We had a great dinner at Willard Hicks. Our waiter was fabulous! We will be back soon and I hope to have the same waiter.
We were served by Anthony who was very attentive and friendly.

Super disappointed this last time I was here. The first appetizer had stale bread and when I brought it to the server's attention they seemed to already know because they had multiple customers with the same issue. The second appetizer didn't show up and we ended up having to ask. They thought we didn't order it. Lastly, it took almost 90 minutes to get our food out after we asked what was taking so long.  All of this was on a Monday. It might be a while before I try this place again
Nice place. Steaks were really good. Superb service

Nice for a casual restaurant with a large steak menu.  Wine list was of a reasonable selection and value.  Service was very good.   Campbell is a densely packed little town with tough parking so a tad frustrating spending 20 minutes and having to call to let the restaurant know I’d be late for my reservation.

This is tough as I have been her 3 or 4 times and this time was the most disappointing.  Service was slow and delayed... we had to ask for our server three times which was disappointing :(  Steaks were good but not cooked to order.  Drinks were the highlight.  We were in the front of the restaurant which didn't have an amazing vibe... I could tell towards the back would have been better.  I will give them one more chance before I cross them off the list....
The food and service was exceptional! We always enjoy coming here!

Unfortunately this restaurant was a dressed up Applebees. I was going to say Outback Steakhouse, but I've actually had pleasant meals there. It felt a bit like a tv set, in that it is made to look good at a distance on film but really fell flat when you got up close. From the wobbly tables, to the too close floorplan, to the remarkably poor quality of meat and vegetables, to the loud top 40s music blaring, this experience was lacking. Keep in mind that I'm 30 not 75, and this all bothered me a lot. The only redeeming feature was the staff, who were delightful. 

The food was below average for the pricing. I understand that the rent must be very high but maybe don't open a steakhouse if you can't afford to accommodate the type of clientele who would support a higher price point and allow you to afford better quality ingredients and kitchen staff? The steak cut was fatty and charred on the outside (I ordered medium), yet gristlely on the inside. The sword fish was well prepared but the sauce it was served in was oily and unbalanced with the citrus flavor, also there was no mention on the menu that cilantro was in the side salad dressing which was an unpleasant surprise. We ordered two of the same cocktail and the discrepancy is flavour was notable, it was like we ordered two different drinks. By Campbell standards maybe this restaurant is a convenient choice and better than some of its competition, but I don't ever plan to revisit this. I was actually surprised by how inexpensive our check was for what we ordered compared to the same meal at other steakhouses, so my theory is that this restaurant is confused about if they are high end or not. I suggest that they figure it out so they can actually create a menu they can afford to provide at a high level of quality, not a menu they aspire too.
Great place with great service and food.  Steak and sides were excellent quality!  I’d recommend this place to anyone visiting San Jose!
One of my new favorite restaurants. Food and service is EXCELLENT!
Mother’s Day

The food was good, not as good as it has been on previous visits. The portions seem smaller and the prices have gone up a bit. The steak was fantastic, the wedge was ok but it's served in a bowl that's way too small for cutting and mixing the salad (the focus is on the presentation, and not on ease of consumption).
As always the food was delicious & cooked perfect! The service was exceptional as the staff was very attentive & prompt! We always enjoy our dining experience at Willard Hicks.

The food, the ambiance and the service were all good. The noise level was high since there were games going  on. One thing that was disappointing.  We put down Birthday as the occasion when making the reservation.  We arrived the restaurant early and told the Matre D' that it was a birthday celebration and gave her our credit card. She wrote something down and said she would pass it on to the waiter.  The meal was over and the deserts were served. There was nothing to help celebrate our guest's birthday.   It would have bee nice to have our server to wish our birthday guest a happy birthday.

We really enjoyed our dinner at Willard Hicks this past Friday! My wife is a big fan of quality steak cooked to medium rare perfection and WH meet her expectations and then some. (And with maybe the exception of her spousal choice, she has very high standards! :-) ) Our server was friendly and attentive (but not overly so). We both had drinks (a highly recommended Old Fashion for her, glass of Decoy Merlot for me). With an appetizer, shared salad, the two drinks and 3 entrees (our 16 yo son was with us) it ended up being about $210 (with tip), which is the only reason the value star rating was 4/5 instead of 5/5.
All around great ... food, drinks, atmosphere, service. Be back again soon.

We were very happy with the food. We ordered the ribs (a little hot) but meat was so tender! We also got the wedge salad, baked Bri and crab cakes for appetizers. The baked Bri was so good, very pleased with our choices!
The food is always excellent and the service is spot on!
Food was excellent but service was a little slow. To be fair, we were on the patio and not sure if the waitress had more tables inside. The first bottle no corkage fee is fabulous!

The service was impeccable - Anthony did a fantastic job ensuring we had everything we needed without being intrusive. 

The cornbread was delicious. Unfortunately, the rib eyes were gristly although they were cooked exactly as ordered.

This was an unpleasant dining experience.

When I arrived, I was greeted by friendly staff and promptly seated.  However I felt like I was walking into a night club and not a restaurant.  The noise level was so loud it was uncomfortable.

I ordered the chopped salad and a glass of merlot.  The wine was very nice, however the salad was average at best.

For dinner I had the bone-in rib eye with a side of horseradish mash.  The steak was very good, full of flavor.  The mash was cold.  I asked for a side of horseradish and was charged $2.00.  Sad.

The wait staff was friendly, but absent.

I would not go back.
Willard Hicks is always consistent. That's why we continue patronizing them.
Always good food and great customer service.

Excellent ribeye cooked a perfect medium rare and the mac-n-cheese is still fabulous!
My friend Craig enjoyed the full rack of ribs and fries...He was quite pleased too!
Highly recommended!
Food and drinks are always great at WH.  Not a cheap place to eat but worth it when you want something good.
The wait staff was excellent!
Amazing. I don't know what they do, but as a friend said... "This isn't fair to other food."

We dine out a ton with our busy schedules and I really appreciated the last minute booking on this location. However, our experience left much to be desired. Our server was not very engaging (i.e. asked about some of her favorites and she says 'well they are all good.' Our drinks were empty for most of our app course and never offered again! Our app plates were piled up when our shared ribeye arrived and I asked for a wine list. No list appeared (nor did share plates....but we did get fresh silverware!) Then a refill of the wine I was drinking appears, but I asked for the list. Overall, this was a great opportunity to reconnect with a friend and we will leave it at that.

We were celebrating my mom’s last day in the area. What a crummy way to send my mom home. Anthony was our waiter and never introduced the manager. 

We ordered the short rib appetizer. Tiny egg rolls cut in half. Little to no content in them — lots of cheese. They were served cold like the rest of our meal which was disappointing. Dinner was two rib eyes (14oz) with Brussels and cauliflower. All cold. Server forgot the Brussels and my rib eye was over cooked. No one came over to check on our food. Finally someone was making water rounds so we asked them to the send the waiter. Took a good 10 minutes for him to appear. Anthony apologized about the Brussels and steak. A new steak was sent out that was too rare. I gave up and just ate it. Very fatty which is common for rib eye but my gosh it was such a thin piece! Brussels came out shortly after. Cold again and lacking flavor like the cauliflower. Anthony advised his manager authorized removing my meal off the bill. Big gesture! Great. Well, he came by 15 minutes later and the story changed. They were just removing the Brussels sprouts and there was a miscommunication. It’s also worth noting Anthony kept apologizing to us and the table next to us about being slow to come over. The restaurant was barely full. Why was this such an issue? We were nothing but polite and understanding the whole time. Then we asked for coffee and dessert. No surprise it took a while to come over. A quick dinner before a flight became a painful two hour circus. Couldn’t believe the time when we left. Very disappointed in this restaurant experience. Best part was the cheesecake we had. Unfortunately the experience was so sour that it barely mattered. 

Most surprising thing is Anthony kept mentioning the manager but he never introduced us to discuss the poor service and food.

The food was delicious but the service was awful. Once they realized we weren't going to order more cocktails because we brought a bottle of wine, the server was totally uninterested in us. Came back once to get us water. Did not pour our wine. We ordered 3 steaks, which was a lot of money. Sorry we didn't order cocktails, but there is absolutely no reason for us to feel less than because we took advantage of the free corkage fee. 

I want to come back as the food was delicious, but the service was truly terrible.

Been here multiple time and each time the food and service seem to get worse.  Maybe it depends on server.  Even on non busy night the server seems to disappear for long periods of time.  Then they seem to gather up and chat at the waiter stations while customers wait around.  I saw another table that had a person get up and walk to the station to ask for the bill because they were tired of waiting.  I almost did the same but just flagged down the hostess to help me.  The place is a cross between a 4star restaurant with a lively bar in the middle.  Their prices are on the high side compared to value and service.  As for the food.  I always get the bone-in rib eye. (Except the day they ran out!?). It’s very hit or miss.  Each time we come it seems not as good.  Of the two we ordered one came out excellent and the other was just meh.

Willard Hicks is one of our go to places! It's great because you can get dressed up or not and not feel out of place. The food is great, the service is great. It is just an all around good place to go and have a nice dinner, either for a special occasion or just for a night when you don't want to cook!
Always enjoy my time at WH!  The food is fabulous.  The baked brie is a must try!
Amazing food, service, and atmosphere. Definitely one of my favorite places to dine.
The food is good and of consistent quality. Food and drinks come out at a good pace for the occasional night out with the wife.
We are regulars at Willard Hicks and never disappointed. Very concistent and high level service. Our meals are always well prepared and declious
Our waiter was absolutely fabulous, food was cooked perfectly! It's been a long time since I've had such great service ;)
Everything we ordered tasted great. Our server was very friendly! Good value for the quality and comfortable and relaxed atmosphere

My family have eaten here a few times and every visit is nothing but exceptional. We took our kids here to celebrate their birthdays (21 & 30) and as always, the food and service was excellent.  Both my husband and I ordered grilled rib eye but when mine came out not to my liking they fixed it right away, which was no big deal. However, to our surprise they waved my meal.  That was totally unexpected cause they fixed the problem and I enjoyed it. That was just amazing service, something that I never had even from $$$$ places we've been.  We don't always visit Campbell but if we do Willard Hicks always comes to mind cause there you get the best service and good food no doubt.
Food was good, although my steak was under cooked.  The drink service was slow.  It took about 15 minutes to get the first round of drinks.

We flew up to San Jose to celebrate our daughters birthday and after reading several reviews I chose Willard Hicks for dinner. The food entrees and sides were excellent and our waiter was super nice and efficient. We enjoyed the evening. The only negative is it was very loud and at times difficult to hear the conversation at the table.
Delicious food with friendly service. The restaurant is really nice on the inside and they have a great wine selection. Would I definitely recommend this place!
All was Okay

Was a little disappointed this time.  We have been here several times and had a fantastic experience 

This time I’m not sure what happened our service was very slow and it was not crowded 

I
Pretty good. Cornbread was better than I expected. Decent salad. Cookies and “frozen milk” was a good name and good dessert.
This was our 3rd time and we have found the food to be very good each time. The steaks were slightly over cooked this time but not a deal breaker. Try it out and you'll enjoy it!
Absolutely amazing food and great service. I had the best steak of my life. Great for date night.
First time eating there. Food taste awesome, service was excellent and so was the environment.

Since they re-opened, it's gone downhill.  Still a fun place for drinks but loud, understaffed at the bar (the poor gal was there on her own on a Friday!) and for some reason the chef feels that every entree-be it fish, pork, vegetarian, or any number of flavors- needs a balsamic drizzle and microgreens.  It doesn't go with everything and it's baffling why it's on everything whether or not it belongs.  The quality of the food is decent and I enjoy a lot of it, but could do better for the cost.

Food was delicious. Service was pretty good too. The only thing we weren’t big on was the DJs choice of music selection. Very club-y type which my husband and I aren’t very in to. It didn’t ruin the night for us though. We’ll likely be back.
Two bone in rib eyes over cooked and wasted. Couldn’t believe it. They comped our dinner for two but still we’re unable to prepare a steak.

the service was less than high quality.  after our 1st waiter took our order, we never saw him again.  one person's salad didn't come until after the entree; requests for some condiments were slow to be granted; felt like no one person was really paying attention to our table.
This was a return trip to WH and the experience was disappointing.  The food was delivered to the table cold and the service was haphazard and in some respects indifferent.
Steaks had excellent flavor, but one was not cooked as ordered. Scallop dish was very good and the restaurant has a nice vibe with great service.
First time visiting Willard Hicks and was definitely impressed. Great ambiance, the dj was amazing I ordered crab cakes and a Cesar salad the food was good. Will be back to this establishment!
We had a wonderful time at Willard Hicks celebrating a birthday. The food and service was great.
Great service.  Past experience was terrible so it was wonderful to have an excellent experience with service, food and drink.
Food was great! I asked for a wine menu and waitress never brought it to me until 20 minutes into my dinner time. At that point no reason to have a glass of wine after my dinner.
Oh my! Both food and service were so impressive :)
Love their burger. It’s huge, so be sure to split it with a friend.
Great local spot that has the most amazing burger in bay area
This is one of the best restaurants, always consistent. Great service always!
Everything was top shelf. Loved it

Great food. Our server was awesome. Only strange that the appetizers were delayed and the main meal came 2 minutes after the appetizers. We had them bring back the meal so we can get through appetizers first.
They were obviously trying to rush us out the whole time

The ambiance and service was very nice. Unfortunately the food was just okay. For a place that specializes in prime meats, our meats were not cooked to what we had asked them to be. The food tasted good but I wouldn’t say it was anything special or worth going back given how much money we spent there.
Service was outstanding & the food was delicious.  Warm & efficient employees.
We had a great meal with friends. Fun place great food and all around good service. We lil to drop in every couple months for a special night out.

The food was very good; we had a very enjoyable dinner. Would have given it 4 1/2 stars, but as a higher-end restaurant, expectations are also high, so no 5 stars. The steak was cooked to order, which does not happen that often when we dine out. Service was perfect. We were a little put off by the tables for two being so close to other diners - you had to focus to not be distracted by the conversations of strangers next to you. For us, this is a negative. Going out to dinner is a good chance to talk and we were conscious of our conversation being easily overheard by neighboring tables. I think the reason for not giving 5 stars for the food was that, while good and properly cooked, there was not a "Wow!" But  I am sure we will go there again.
Valentines dinner with my wife and two daughters

This is one of my go-to restaurants for a celebration. The ambience is set well and feels both homey and decadent! The food is always cooked well and the portion sizes are generally great value. I love the starters here. They're beautifully plated, plenty to share, and all pair well with their great selection of cocktails.
Great place overall and fabulous steaks.   A bit pricy but worth it for that special occasion.   Well done Opa (I hear it’s owned by them).

Ordered signature bone-in ribeye, the meat was full of tendons and fat, less than half edible part. Our worst steak experience...
Mac n cheese, brussels sprouts were good. Creme brulle and white chocolate mouse were decent too.
Kudos for actually serving Pinot Noir in Pinot Noir glasses and not in generic red wine glasses.

It was great but their sticky chicken needs some fine tuning; either soak the chicken breast in buttermilk overnight or slice it in half then fry them so the chicken is tender.  Needless to say, the chicken was a bit tough.

Parking difficult. Order the appetizers which were good. The main courses, pork chop and sticky chicken were severely over cooked. They must have been having a special on arugula because everything was covered with it. Tables are very close and conversation was difficult.
Because of the difficulty in parking anywhere on Campbell Ave you really are challenged especially if you have limited walking ability.
It was not worth the effort.
Good Ambiance, good îselection is good, metal confecționer interesting.

Great experience as always. Took our daughter here for her birthday. The drinks, appetizers and entres were really good. Crab cakes and the cornbread are great starters. Our server Jesus was fantastic. Despite our large group he was able to keep everyone happy with anything we needed. 

Will definitely come back.

We've enjoyed dining at Willard Hicks several times and love the consistency in service and food quality that we receive.  We brought friends who had never been before and they commented on how delicious the food was.  Our waitress was excellent and when she was backed up, other staff brought out our food so we could enjoy it while it was hot.  The Jalapeno Corn Bread was a group favorite and the Papardelle was fabulous (especially with a bit of crushed red pepper).  We look forward to coming back and sitting outside once summer returns.
Excellent food, service and wine list.  We are never disappointed.
appetizers and drinks were great! Steak was overcooked and chewy. I'd return but not for the steak.

My wife and I went to Willard Hicks on the recommendation of a friend.  Unfortunately, we felt the food was overpriced for its value.  Good ambiance and our waiter was great, but the food felt like it was just overpriced Chili's or Applebee's.  No disrespect to those those restaurants, but if I'm paying 20%-30% more for dinner, I expect the food to be worth the price.  The so-called Street Tacos were underwhelming and the house fries, while they looked like Jenga blocks, were soggy and lacked flavor.  It's unfortunate the food did not live up to our expectations.

First time. My steak was cooked a perfect medium rare. Brie appetizer was delicious. Too noisy for a group to talk at a table. Even for just two people. Would go back maybe not on a Friday night for a quieter time.
We had the blackberry filet mignon and the tempura chicken. Both were excellent.
This is our go to for any special occasion dinner. Best steak in the South Bay with out a doubt!
Service, food and ambiance was fabulous.  It was my first time dinning at W&H and i will be back!

This was our first time to the restaurant. It was absolutely fantastic! The service, food, and cocktails were 5 star.  I highly recommend the blackberry glazed filet minon. If your looking for an inexpensive dinner, this not the place. With that said, the prices are right for 5 star food and experience. We will definitely go again!

The ambiance and vibe is very good.  We were greeted by a friendly hostess and seated at a very nice table.  We then waited 15 minutes for a server to come to the table and acknowledge our presence.   My wife and I wanted to order cocktails but there was nobody to be found.  I do not like it when I go to a restaurant and I have to get up, go to the hostess and beg for service.   I go to relax and be served.  Our server then came to the table and asked for our order.  She was very efficient and professional.  The remainder of our experience was very good.  The food was excellent as was our server.   We  spent nearly 500$ with our group of four.  I would suggest a management breakdown occurred.  Guest want their drink orders taken when they arrive.  They do not want to chase down a server.
Great service and food! The waitress’ were wonderful!
Food and staff were great as always.

First, the food that we had was good though a little salty and the Brussels Sprouts weren’t crispy or even extra crispy as we ordered them. The issue came with the lack of service in my opinion. The waitress was sat immediately with three table. We were the first table and the redheaded stepchild of the tables. She would look at our table however she would go directly to the two booths instead of stopping at our table. This resulted in empty iced tea glasses and requesting or advising her of any wants or issues. I did tell the waitress the first time that she refilled our iced tea that I would “always” want the refilled and she commented that she liked that.  Additionally she was training another waitress which in my opinion means that the new waitress was learning bad habits early on in the training.  In my opinion, if you go, please make sure that you stay on top of your food tastes and waitress because it can be a very costly bad experience.
I loved the steaks and environment. Service was great. Will come back again soon #NewFavoriteSpot
Always a good time at WH!  Server Kameron (Cameron?) is attentive, informative, knowledgeable.

Great meal with excellent service.  The menu sounds so good it was difficult to pick only a couple items.  The cocktails were great, although definitely on the sour side.  Even when I asked for a sweeter suggestion the recommended drink was very sour.  The other negative is the overuse of herbs such as thyme and rosemary.   But I would definitely come back to try more of the menu options.
Overall great experience - excellent service and food!

We met up with dear friends for dinner.  We had suggested Willard & Hicks but our friends were not keen on the idea due to bad experience .  We had explained that we really enjoyed the restaurant and suggested given it another chance so they did 
We all enjoyed great cocktails and baked Brie appetizer with apricot chutney- very good start to the dinner.  The waitress Ruby was awesome -  very attentive and knowledgeable about the menu and wines.
All our meals were cooked to perfection- the swordfish with whole grain mustard sauce was superb along with the scallops and risotto.  We especially enjoyed the Mac and cheese and cauliflower side dishes 
Of course we ended meal with a nightcap - port and muscat paired with creme brûlée 
All in all we had a fabulous dinner.  Our friends were happy they gave Willard & Hicks another chance!

Our food and service was terrific. Our server explained the restaurant has recently been remodeled. This was our first visit. However upon leaving the restaurant, my husband stumbled on the step out front, and I completely fell to the ground, smacking my knee very hard on the concrete. There is no lighting and no rail. With a recent remodel why was this overlooked???? Be very careful

I really enjoyed my first time here.  I liked the look of the bar and restaurant, I’m asking for a booth next time, they looked cozy and great for a special occasion.  I had the ‘Abigail’ cocktail and loved it.  We split the pesto cheesy bread and it was yummy, but the micro greens on top were cilantro (yuck). We all liked our dinners, I had the scallops which were perfect and risotto which could have had a little more flavor.  In fact, my friends both got the short ribs and they also need a little more flavor.  Overall we had a great time and really enjoyed ourselves.  I’m definitely going again.
Classy traditional steak house, service was great, they were originally 100% booked, but managed to change my 8:15 reservation to 7:30, which allowed us to get to our movie.
Delicious!
Way too loud in the restaurant

Willard Hicks is a restaurant with a split personality.  The prices and the way food is presented, makes it look high end.  But half the restaurant is a sports bar (casual and loud).  I did not enjoy my scallops with risotto nor did my husband think his steak was anything special, however my children loved the 1 lb burgers.

The burger was tasty but just too overwhelmingly big. Would prefer a 2/3lb burger.

Chicken was good, but perhaps a tiny bit too salty.

Food was good and creative and ambiance nice but the service was TERRIBLE.  It ruined the whole dinner. Our waiter could not describe the food or the wine. For example he described the charcuterie plate as “deli-meat and some cheeses I can’t remember”.  When I asked about different wines he had no clue. He was slow and inattentive. He forgot our drinks. He forgot one of our side dishes. My $45 steak came out 10 minutes before my wife’s pasta so it got cold while I was waiting for her to get her food. 

For a $175 dinner for two I expect FAR better service and experience. We will not be returning.
Love the ambiance.  Love the food.  In particular, the pastry brie platter is astoundingly good!  Salads are quite good; veges are crispy.  I just keep going back....
We were impressed by the service of your staff.  All staff in addition to our assigned waitress were very attentive but not annoying.  Food was wonderful!!

I had the scallop risotto.  It was fabulous. Only got three scallops. Should have five in the dish.
I love Cabernet, so I'm glad I was able to get a glass of quality wine. 
This was also my first time. I was on a date and we had a very nice time.

Great place with a relaxing vibe.
Nicely decorated.
I really enjoyed their signature filet. Absolutely delicious and it's a must get item.

This was a very disappointing Thursday evening. When we arrived four booths were empty. We asked if the four of us could have one.  We were told that they needed the booth for big parties who had reservations.  Two of those booths remained empty during our entire meal.

It took a long time for our waiter to come to our table and ask what we needed.  Throughout the evening he never checked back in with us to make sure that everything was going ok.  We actually had to get up from the table one time to ask him when our food would arrive.

The food arrived piecemeal.  The soup was barely warm and had to be sent back.  Finally the entrees arrived.  The two fish meals were delivered. Awhile later the sides were delivered. Still more time passed until the third entree arrived.  Then we sat quite awhile waiting for the final entree, a pork chop, to arrived.   It was undercooked and had to be sent back.  Again, our waiter never came by.  By the time the pork chop was redelivered, the three of us were finished with our meals.   The sides with the pork chop were never reheated or replaced.  

Although we were comped for the pork chop, it was a vert unsatisfactory experience.

This place looks amazing and our food was very tasty and well presented. Overall, I will be returning for another dinner. The only areas I saw improvement in were the service. The host sat us at a two person table. When we sat the table had a very noticable wobble which the hosts noted with an “uh oh” and glanced at us. She left which I assumed was to grab a table wedge but she went straight to seating other individuals instead so we had to pin the table down with our feet for the remaining of the night. Our server was very nice! I did get the sense that she was new and might not have known the menu well because her answers to my menu questions were 100% accurate when I got my meal.

Service was fantastic and the food was Impeccable! Cannot wait
 to go back!
This is one of the best restaurants in the South Bay. P.S. they also have free corkage for the first bottle of wine!

We were at WH for NYE dinner which has been our tradition for the past several years.  We ordered FILET MIGNON from the grill paired with cab and merlot. For sides, we ordered the house cut fries with the house-made SPICY KETCHUP  and the yummy famous brussels.  Our server was very attentive and simply pleasant.  It was a wonderful dinner and  we will surely maintain our tradition for 2019.
Net Years Eve dinner with the family
Food and service were amazing! We can’t wait to eat there again.

We hadn’t eaten since breakfast and were looking forward to celebrating my friend ‘s graduation from college.  We each started with the Caesar salad which was pretty spicy but tasty.  He had the ribeye and I the swordfish.  We each had some veggie sides (I had Brussels sprouts and baked potato he had green beans and cauliflower).  The creme brûlée was excellent and the Americano satisfying!
Really great food and the service is impeccable! From FOH, Bar and Table - all great people with great recommendations! :) We'll be back!
Great steaks good for impressive date. !!!!!!!!!!!!!

We had made reservations a week or more ago. Upon arriving and getting seated we immediately ordered the ribs. They came back five min later saying the ribs were all sold out for the evening. How do you run out of ribs by 7:00pm? So we decided to order something else. We ordered the filet at medium well. The steak came out medium rare and had no flavor to it at all. We were so bummed as food here before has been good, especially the ribs. We specifically came here to enjoy the ribs. 

Usually in this situation the waiter would offer something comped or a complimentary dessert since they ran out of food. But it was full price and not really more than a sorry. It wasn’t the worst experience we have had but it definitely wasn’t a good one.

Went there on Christmas Eve. Casual but festive atmosphere. Nice mix of people in the restaurant. Service was outstanding, very friendly and attentive waitress. Food was also very good. The only low light was the french onion soup--but maybe this was a variation that I just didn't care for. Fillet Mignon, Sticky Chicken, and slab of ribs were excellent.
The addition of more cuts of steak on the menu would be nice.
Great service we requested to move tables away from the door and the hostess complied with in 10 minutes
Service was perfect

Another successful dining experience as usual at WH! There ended up being more to our party than originally planned but the staff accommodated us flawlessly. Every person’s meal was exactly as they ordered & our waitress was very attentive & on point with everything.
Never disappointed when we come here to eat. Service and food always the best.
With the holidays and corporate parties it did not take away from the experience. The service and food quality was outstanding! I have yet to be disappointed.

Our waitress was very distracted and messed up our order couple times, almost poured our wine in our water glass.  We’ve been there so many times I let it go because the food is amazing.  Hope for better service next time.
Service has been horrible since they reopened.

The food was great.  The service could have been better.  We had a nice waiter but he would leave our table before we could ask him for anything.  I am not sure if he was new but he seemed to be in a hurry all of the time.

While the wait staff was very accommodating and helping with our food allergies, we were somewhat let down on the quality of the food.  For the price and prestige of the restaurant I was expecting a higher quality meal.  I have been here before for cocktails and apps which are very good and I will be back for, but the entrees let me down.

We were looking for a delicious steak dinner and Willard Hicks truly delivered. I had a filet and my husband had a bone-in ribeye which were both cooked perfectly for us. The flavor was remarkable. We shared the green beans and the fries, highly recommend the fry stack. It was a nice, casual dinner and the service was very attentive. I missed them while they were closed but very happy that they are open again. This is really our go-to steak place now.
I tried it two times now in a 3 week period and each time left with bad stomach pains.  Though it tasted good, something is not right. My husband had the same feeling the second time we went.

Although we enjoyed our time here and the our waitress, Rachel was lovely the food was cold and one member of out of our party of hour meal did not come out for a while after the rest of the meals. This made the other meals were colder because we had to wait for all of us to have our meals before eating. Would probably go back and give them a second chance as the place was fun.
Steals were cold, food tastes like fish. Very disappointed

I thought this would be a nice sit down dinner for my husband and I to celebrate. It was loud and rowdy and there was a huge group just hanging around like it was a sports bar. It was so loud. The food was wonderful and the service was great, but it didn’t go with the atmosphere at all. If I want to eat a hundred and fifty dollar dinner out, I don’t want to be listening to drunks cursing at the next table.

Always good -- ribs are always my go to.. this visit, they were overcooked, a bit dry, and burnt... a bit disappointing.....  the cornbread is a good starter for the table - yummy!

We were celebrating two birthdays, they brought the house dessert as a surprise - that was nice.

Place is high in noise level, that is the only down fall.

but worth the visit, we will be back in time.....

This is a great new date night restaurant! We had a fantastic salad, a wonderful filet mignon and enjoyed trying all of the sides. The horseradish mashed potatoes are fabulous and all of the cocktails were excellent. All of the servers were exceedingly friendly and attentive. We will definitely be back to try the cornbread next time!
We were seated promptly upon arrival ; wait-staff was friendly as well as helpful. Food was prepared exactly as we ordered and each course was served at the right time. Great deserts as well.
Enjoyed the food. Service was slow in the beginning but our server made up for it.
Because there were several other parties, we were treated as an afterthought. The food was good, but our server was not present. The noise level was too loud. It would of been nicer to have a booth.
We had a great time!  Ribeye amazing.

Great food, a bit pricey
EXTREMELY NOISY

Everything was good and the server was very patient with us though we were a little bit difficult. It would be nice if there were some lighter dish options. Everything on the menu is pretty heavy. Most steakhouses have a few more fish options. I had a child behind me with a fairly loud and annoying video game playing the almost whole time we were there which I could’ve totally done without, but that’s not the restaurant’s fault, that’s just inconsiderate parents.
Awesome service!

A bon voyage planned for 10 and lucky enough to be seated in the private dining room so we could all visit. Six out of the ten had never been and they loved it.
We had a terrific server and staff who kept the wine flowing. Everything was superb~food, service, special attention. 
Great time had by all.
Willard Hicks never disappoints and now they have even more guests who will return and spread the word.
Truly one of the best restaurants in the South Bay.

I know this is a steak house and I'm told their steaks are great. However, if you're a vegetarian in a party of meat eaters, get them to go somewhere else.

I couldn't have salad because of the Romaine salad issue right now so I ordered the quinoa stuffed peppers. It was just a mushy mess. A small pool of water from the peppers coalesced into the one part I ate. There was maybe 2 tablespoons of quinoa in the peppers. The yellow mush surrounding the peppers was unidentifiable. Needless to say, I didn't finish half of my food.

One could argue I shouldn't complain because I'm a vegetarian in a steak house, but if that's the case then why put it on the menu at all? Anyway, the dish was over $15.

My wife and I have dinner here a few times a year and every time it’s a pleasant experience. The food and drinks have never disappointed us. The service and ambiance has always been very good as well.
It was so wonderful and my out of town friend loved it too!
Excellent meal and our server was very attentive without being imposing. Would definitely recommend

We had come for my mother's birthday and also had a stroller with my 3 month old. The staff was absolutely incredible. Both the hostess and the wait staff.
My mother had wanted a steak for her birthday meal and she was not disappointed. The food was incredible and the staff was great with our minor changes to the food. My wife ordered the risotto, but didn't want the scallops, the chef was amenable and my wife said it was one of the better risottos she had. My father had the swordfish and was also greatly pleased. My mother and I had the steak and were very happy with the food.
Excellent dining experience. The food was portioned just right leaving just enough room for dessert. I  highly recommend this restaurant and would definitely return in the near future.

This was our first visit to Willard Hicks and it did not disappoint.  We started with a cocktail and I can say my Manhattan was one of the best  that I have had.  The steaks, ribs and chicken were all excellent and don’t forget to order the corn bread!  We were celebrating a birthday and so the waitress also brought out a delicious cookie topped with ice cream to celebrate.  Overall, an excellent experience.

I have eaten there several times before and as they just reopened, I was looking forward to going back. We took another another couple who has never been  Our meal was awful. The swordfish was like rubber - didn’t even taste like fish.   Also the steaks and fish were cold. Our waiter never came to check on us or I would have sent back. I ate two bites and the bus boy took my dish before I could say anything. Truly not the Willard and Hicks from the past. Our meal was very pricey for the quality of the food.  It was embarrassing to bring our friends for a thank you. 

The cornbread was still amazing and the cheese board was yummy but these are basics!
Very cool spot. The Yuzo ribeye was great , as was the service. Will be back
Incredible food, service, and location. Took my boss and peers for dinner. We will definitely be back.
Great decor and ambiance. Steak was cooked to spec but lacked any flavor. Needed salt and tasted no ginger or ponzu in the sauce. Hard to do since those are very strong flavor profiles.

Our first time here with friends.  Had heard a lot about the restaurant so expectations were high.
We were not disappointed in the food- we started with cornbread...omg loved the sweet and savory flavors.  We had ribs, salmon, short ribs and filet.
All our meals were off the hook
We will definitely be back!
Great restaurant. Been there several times and really enjoy dining there. Lots of options for large or small plate dining. The sides are so so so good.
Great food, service and beautiful decor.   Great for a date night, group event or party.
Well it stated salad big enough for two, I don’t eat a lot but the salad was small.  And the appetizers were very small to.  Food was good.
Great birthday time with the family. Can’t wait to do a big family dinner again!

Celebrated my 12 yr wedding Anniversary and Jesus was amazing! Very attentive and was super friendly. Everyone greeted us with happy anniversary! Even though we ordered sparkling water Jesus treated it as fine wine. Great food and the sides were some great comfort food. Try the mac and cheese and the milk and frozen cookie for dessert! 😍

Food was good but not great. Service was definitely slow (particularly from the bar - drinks seemed to take forever - ~15min). Nice place for the South Bay but I'd try and go somewhere else in the future.
It was just a great time . Me and my lady needed a bite out and it was just great service the food every thing would definitely  recommend  to everyone e.

Overall, it was a good meal.  The noise level was way too loud for me.  I had to scream across the table so that I could be heard.  The service was slow in regards to the food.  We were brought the wrong appetizer once and then cold fries after that.  Not sure if I will be back.

Had a great meal with family 
Good wine good food good service 
But very pricey. But would do it again

Ive eaten here twice and would recommend.  That said, my steak was great along with the Appetizers.  BUT, 2 of the 7 people at the table had their steaks messed up and had to send them back...twice.  also another side dish was messed up.
I was bad enough the Manager bought us a pretty expensive bottle of wine.

Nice that they’ve reopened.  Had the steak burger and a half rack of ribs.  My wife and I split both and there was plenty of food. The ribs were Absolutely perfect. Meat falling off the bone.  And the new bun they are using for the burger Holds the burger together!  Karly was out server and she was outstanding!
Music was too loud. Server was too casual. Sticky chicken was the worst chicken dish I have ever had. Chicken was way overcooked, to the point of being inedible.
We really like this place. We haven’t ventured far from the signature fillet BlackBerry main dish.  It’s fun to walk around downtown Campbell before and after.

we had reservations but they were not needed at 4:45. They seated us promptly. Gave us a choice of seats. Waitress was very friendly and attentive to our needs. We enjoyed drinks and then a nice dinner. filet minion and grilled chicken. Excellent preparation. I really like the side of green beans. we will go back soon. th dessert of homemade ice cream and fresh baked cookies is always great.
Great waitress, she was funny and a delight to have her for us.
Food was a little bit lacking in flavor, but overall experience was still pretty good.
Great food and atmosphere.  DJ plays great music on saturday nights but I like that it's not obnoxious and you can still talk with your company.  Love the cornbread and ribs.
Steaks were superb as ALWAYS!  This is our favorite spot anytime I’m in town from Ohio.

I was pretty disappointed with Willard Hicks. I had heard very good things and therefore, I was looking forward to dining there. The other three people in our party said the food was quite good. My bone-in ribeye was bland and cold. So cold in fact, the herb butter on the top didn't even melt. I would have sent it back but we had a show to attend. The timing brings up the second and most important issue. The service was very poor. Our water seemed more like an amateur or what you might expect from a casual dining place like Appleby's. He was slow, even though we were there early and they were not yet busy. He seemed lost about how to handle the wine. We asked him to open it and let it breathe until dinner and yet he kept trying to pour it. Our entres took way too long to come out. When they did, mine was cold making me wonder how long he let it sit. One of our entres was more than 5 mins later than the rest and he never said a word. 

On the plus side, the veggies we had were fantastic. But I expected more from a steakhouse.
John our server was a great addition to our fantastic meal.

We are glad that they are open again,what a loss for the entire Summer!
We waited over 35 minutes for our food and when I asked if they were short  handed, the reply was YES! Not all the desserts were available. I would like to see the Chocolate  Cake  come back ( glad the Pesto Cheesy Bread is back) and the old style Pork Chop The one with the bone has a strange flavor and Pork Chops are my Favorite!
I tried the Short Rib and it was DELICIOUS.
Everything was good, service the food is delicious, Lb steak have nothing with you guys

I was impressed with the setting and the friendliness of the staff.  I am gluten intolerant and the waitstaff wasn't well informed and had to check with the chef at almost ever stage of the dining experience.  I was happy with what I could order, but unhappy that I was so limited and had no condiments.
5th anniversary. Brought the kids and the staff was all outstanding with them.
W-H provides really, really tasty food; service is good and amibience also good.
The bar is understaffed and took a really long time to get drinks! However, the food never disappoints.

This restaurant was not what I expected, based on the menu, prices and reviews. I expected understated elegance. Instead, it was EXTREMELY noisy. The dining room is open to the bar, which had 3 large screen TVs playing various sports, making the ambience like a loud sports bar. We were celebrating a special occasion (birthday) but I would not describe it as appropriate for this. When I made the reservation, I requested a quiet table and mentioned we were celebrating a birthday. The hostess seated us near the middle of the noisy space. I asked about a booth and was told they had none, yet as we were being seated, a booth emptied and was not offered to us. I mentioned on the reservation that we were celebrating a birthday, but no one acknowledged it. I will say the food and cocktails were excellent, but this wasn’t enough to compensate for the noise. It was so loud that my husband and I had to shout across the table. We will not return. Not recommended!!
Service was awesome. Best corn bread ever. Risotto was bland but if you eat along with grapes it makes it more edible. Scallops were cooked perfectly. Steak was good.

We love coming here and will always eat here. Our favorite are the burgers, they are the best.   My only complaint would be how difficult it is to get reservations.  And then when you go to the restaurant and they say they are booked for reservations but yet there are many empty tables and you finish your food and those  same tables are still empty, when someone could have eaten and left by then.  Waiters are great.
Excellent steaks and sides. The waiter was very attentive.
We got a table where there were no lights above us.  The lighting was horrible
What could be better than a couple of cold Manhattan's with some steaks cooked perfectly in a classy but comfortable, open and airy atmosphere?  Willard Hicks always hits a home run.

Very dirty: table was not clean. Had to ask them. No one brought water

Many sons cloth  napkin was dirty

Real bad experience-won’t go there again

The service was great. We ordered the burger with fries. The fries were raw on the inside and not crispy at all. We’ve been there before and knew what we were expecting. We also order the Mac and cheese with pancetta but there was no pancetta at all. It was my husband’s birthday so it was a bit dissapointing.

Love Willard Hicks, yummy food, good portions, lots of options. Our server was meh - not engaging and definitely not checking our needs. The rest of the wait staff were great, always filling water, removing plates, helping pack up leftovers.
Good local restaurant, predicatably quality food, mist a bit on the high price end, suitable for family with kids of all ages

Although we enjoyed our food, the music was excessively loud for a Thursday night at 7pm. My friends and I immediately commented on how we had to practically shout to hear each other. It might be because we were not in the booths away from the DJ, but a good number of tables were situated in this loud location. It's a great restaurant to have drinks and a big gathering; don't go here expecting a quiet night.
food & service were great, also great wine list. It's getting a bit lively there, hip young music playing, etc., so it's fun but a bit harder to carry on a conversation.
21st Wedding Anniversary

Nice Atmosphere, waitress friendly, service not so good.  Our dinners (6) all arrived at different times.  The birthday girl received her dinner approx 10 minutes after everyone else....not acceptable.  The steaks/hamburger (gigantic)/short ribs were all good.  The pork chops were tough and the thick cut fries were dry.  The desserts presented well, but were just okay.
Great server (Heather).  Friendly and fun.

Was a great night with friends except for the hovering waiter. Just didn’t get that we weren’t in a hurry. Empty tables around us so don’t think that was it. 
Re food....salads were big! Apps good. Entrees all good. Just felt very rushed. Take that element out and it would have been 5 star review.
Ambience was definitely lacking.  Stark interior but pleasant.  Food was good but not great.  Somewhat strange menu selections atypical for a steakhouse.

Atmosphere was nice and the bar was well stocked.
Wife Ordered 8oz Fillet (Medium Rare) which was almost raw in the middle so didn’t finish the dish.  18oz Bone in Ribeye had a lot of fat on the cut so probably only got 12oz of actual meat.
Fried Okra was great, Brussels Sprouts were also tastey.

Overall, the place was nice and our server was great but I’ve had better meals for much less money.    They ‘re definitely over priced for what you get.  If you are going to drop over $250 on a meal, go to Forbes Mill or Morton’s.
Nothing wrong, just nothing standout. Patio is nice when weather permits.  Inside can be a bit noisy.
Great food, a little too loud
Food was very good. Servers seemed very rushed which made you feel like a bother.
I feel that they were understaffed. The waiters were running around like crazy. They were as attentive as they could be. Service was good just slow.

We enjoy eating here. Service was good, but I suspect they were a bit short handed that night, at least at our 5:30 reservation time. Good food and a good value, cost-wise. Very fair corkage program: other than in the bar area, 1st bottle no charge. Subsequent bottles at $15/bottle. My wife said her steak was cooked a bit more than the medium-rare she likes to order, but still delicious. My bone-in pork chop was cooked to perfection. Cesar salad had a tangy dressing, but a bit too spicy for me. Sides included a baked potato for her, and mac 'n cheese for me. Both very good.  Didn't leave the table still hungry. One of our favorite places when we dine in Campbell.

Willard Hicks is HIGHLY over rated.  Our evening started out poorly with the hostess seating us at the very last 4-top near the bathroom at the back of the restaurant.  There were SEVERAL open tables, and we asked for another location, possibly a booth--"not unless you want to wait a half an hour."  One person we were with sat back in his chair only to stick to GUM on the back of the seat!  After relaying this to a manager walking by, we were told, "oh, geez, that's too bad..."  Our server was much more sympathetic, but NOTHING was offered other than an apology.  The best value on the menu is probably the charcuterie board, which is well presented, ample & delicious.  Salads were good (caesar & quinoa)  but too big & overpriced.  Now the entrees - shrimp & grits--grits were undercooked, swordfish was tiny, maybe a 4 oz piece of fish, and the bone-in rib eyes seemed smaller than the 18 oz. listed and were mediocre at best.  On a bright note, our server was pleasant and working her bu-- off.  However, drinks did not arrive at the same times even though ordered together, and we actually had to ask if the restaurant has a dry cleaning policy due to the gum situation.  Overall, very disappointing.
The food was great, service was terrible. It was too loud to hear the person next to you.

We have been to Willard Hicks numerous times but this time would be our last.  There were four of us and while three of us received our food on time,  one did not.  When the fourth person's food finally arrived, the three of us were done with our meals.  Therefore the fourth person requested a to go box.  Due to the circumstances, the manager on duty came by and offered apologies and told us they would take care of it. When our bill arrived, the dish was credited and we received a further discount.  However, when the fourth person arrived home and went to eat their food,  the inside was RAW.  (I do have a picture of it) I called back to the restaurant to let the manager know.  

While our wait staff did everything right, I find no issue with them.  However, the manager's attitude and comments were not well received by our group.  

This was a family dinner to celebrate two birthdays and it was ruined.
The food was very delicious but the portions were small.  Waitress should have recommended some side dishes with the entrees.  The dessert menu could have been larger.
One of my fav's for sure! Highly recommend WH. Great atmosphere!

Second visit and did not disappoint. Great cocktails, lots of meat lovers options. I had the Scallops and Risotto the first time but this visit it was all about the 1lb steak hamburger! I brought half home for another meal . We shared a wedge salad, each had an entree and then finished with a shared triple Sorbet dessert.  Definitely will go back!

This place was PHENOMENAL!  I’ve been to many top level steakhouses around the country and Willard Hicks did not disappoint.  We read a couple negative reviews beforehand and have no idea what went wrong on those occasions.  My girlfriend and I ordered filets(I got the specialty one, blackberry glaze) and we were both VERY impressed!  We ordered many appetizers as well(cornbread-excellent, must get, Blue Devils-very good but I want a larger portion, house Fries-excellent, both dipping sauces were great as well).  Then the sides, definitely enough to share although we each got a loaded baked potato, the Mac n Cheese was decent, I like more cheese and less milk/cream tho, mushrooms were ok.  For desert we had the cookies and frozen milk.  Our service was great, steaks were unbelievable and cornbread is worth every penny.  We will definitely be back many times.  I live in Ohio but my girlfriend lives in San Jose, pretty sure every time I visit we’ll be fitting in dinner at Willard Hicks.  Thanks again!

Very good food,  fairly priced  considering its location in downtown Campbell.  Moderate noise level makes it semi casual but pretty fancy looks and nice ambience.  Dessert was great, apple Dutch pie, steak was good just slightly overcooked.  Sides were awesome. Salad was excellent.
Nice evening
First time to Williard Hicks, we will be back . Food was very good and the cocktails we purchased were very tasty.
The service was great but the music was way too loud and inappropriate for a nice Mother's Day meal.
Mother’s Day

First time here, for a quick meal, no cocktails. We shared the chopped salad and it was super. We each got a filet mignon, cooked med rare. Perfectly cooked and seasoned. Our server, Kevin, was polite and helpful. The ambiance is fun. Definitely worth going here!!
Server tried hard but the kitchen was slow and the food quality uneven.
Yummy in my tummy

The patrons on the table behind us were very loud and cussing and shouting expletives at each other. It was just one person, but that wasn't how I wanted my dad's birthday to be. Oh, well. At least the food and service was good as always!

Everything was great. I had been there many times but first time for my friends who thought it was awesome. 
Great food service at the beginning was a little slow—they were down 3 servers— but everything went fine and we enjoyed our meal!!
You can't go wrong the staff is professional and the food is good
Anniversary

Not worth the prices or the aggravation.  Service was friendly and adequate, but hardly exceptional.  Tuna carpaccio was abysmal--tiny amount of poorly prepared tuna hidden under too much greenery--no balance of flavor.  When rib meat falls off the bone, it means the ribs have been cooked far too long--it's a lazy technique, and the ribs can't be rescued by burying them in a mediocre and overly sweet sauce.  Probably the worst aspect of the experience was the noise level.  It's well known that restaurant owners want to move customers along after dining by denying them a comfortable place to dwell and talk, but the noise level in Willard Hicks prevents any attempt at table conversation, and that's obnoxious.  We won't be back, and we would actively recommend against this place.

Very Silicon Valley bar type restaurant.
We had a great waitress.  
Food was good but not memorable.
We go frequently and get the hamburgers- which are fantastic. This time two members in our party ordered the pork chop and chicken- both were served partially raw.

This was an outstanding dining experience from start to finish enhanced by our expert server Kaitlyn.  Noteworthy side dishes were the brussel sprouts and butternut squash.  My scallops were perfectly cooked. It was a birthday to remember!

I love this place and have been going for years.  The food is consistent and good.  My only complaint is the cocktail menu.  They've served the SAME drinks forever.  Considering the fabulous drinks being served all over the area, they need to change it up to keep up.  I'm a huge fan of a great cocktail and I have several other places I would choose over WH.

We were seated by the door in the front of the restaurant. We had to ask to be moved because it was so cold.  We ordered 2 New York steaks. They were perfectly cooked medium rare and medium. They came with nothing on the plate but the steak. Medium rare steak was tender. Medium steak not tender. Sides are big enough for two to share.  We ordered the horseradish mashed potatoes. They had a very strong horseradish flavor. Not subtle.  The summer squash with walnuts was bland. House cut fries - great! One glass of wine. Total for meal -$92 before tip.
Amazing ...we love this place
With a group of 10 for a birthday, we had our own room. It was excellent. I love this place.
Food was good, service was excellent. This was our first visit and there are many more things we want to try on the menu. Can't wait to go back.
WH’s portions are large and most couples can easily share entrees and sides. The open dining room and outdoor seating was wonderful on a warm evening.

Great steaks. Delicious sides. Good service. Depending on what time you go, it can be a bit noisy. Okay, it can be VERY noisy during peak hours on weekends, but the food makes it worth the effort to hear yourselves over the music.

The food is great the prices are not bad the service not so great. They brought the check and everything and I really thought they were going to bring the complementary birthday dessert I had requested so I ended up telling the birthday person how upset I was and when we were already paid she came with it after I had already told him.
