She didn't even introduce herself, all of a sudden she was in front of the table. Food is great portions are big enough. Birthday guy really liked the food

Very good New York steak dinner with family and friends. Everyone loved what they ordered. Waitress was great. Would have giving outstanding experience but the music which was DJ'd was very loud. Granted my parents are in their 70's, but had a very hard time participating in our conversations. Hopefully it was a special event to have a DJ and not like this Everytime. Otherwise definitely will go again.
Great cocktails, great apps, great salad, steaks were disappointing.
The steaks were dry and cold. Not worth the expensive price.

Willard Hicks provides very good American grill fare, well presented and tasty.  We ordered French onion soup, the scallops with mushroom risotto, kurobota pork chop and ended with a delicious creme brûlée.  Atmosphere is casual, but elegant.
This is a great place for dinner and drinks. The service level was excellent.i Recommend this place to all my friends

Food consistently great. Table service was fabulous as usual. The three women working at the hostess stand were very abrupt when they finally addressed us. They were clearly more interested in the men sitting at the bar then helping the customers and doing their job of greeting people.

Bottom line the food is good. Entré, sides, salads, etc. are well-prepared. The cuts of meat I have had here are excellent. 

The ambiance is perfect for that first date and as a go-to place for friends to meet for dinner or just to have a drink or two at the bar. 

The place has a vibe for the younger crowd, but at 62 I did not feel out-of-place.

I cannot imagine anyone coming away dissatisfied if they choose to head to Willard Hicks.

I’ve been here three times and I’ve never had a bad experience.  Drink service was a bit slow today, but other than that it’s always good food, lively atmosphere and great service.  Their 1lb burger was definitely worth it!

Love the music, but can be a bit loud if you want to have a deep conversation 

Great service and good food

Everything fine. Ordered cookies first time for dessert came out stale and cold on a cold plate. Gave us a second one came out out stale and cold on a hot plate? Definitely not made or cooked to order, but they still insisted cooked to order. Come on man?

We have been to Willard Hicks several times. The puff pastry brie cheese appetizer is great - comes w/ roasted garlic, nuts, etc. The blackberry filet mignon with blue cheese sauce is outstanding. And the swordfish is the best I've ever had. A great restaurant with delicious food. You can sit outside if you like. They open at 4 p.m.
Great cocktails and fish options, outdoor seating is nice.
Service was Great. Music Awesome inside dinning. Got to bring 1 bottle of wine free corkage. 2nd $15 dollar charge. Still good deal.

We celebrated our wedding anniversary. Luckily we went to  a nicer place the day before...

Very large portions but quality is just average. My wife had the bone-in ribeye which she thought was cooked past medium-rare but she didn’t complain. I had the 1 pound burger and it was cooked well past medium. They offered to halve it for me because it’s large. But I’m sure that added to its demise. Who knows when it was halved...not me. But the waiter made it sound like the norm which I regret not challenging. The only thing we enjoyed was the chopped/iceberg salad. The wait for food was rather long considering it wasn’t very busy. Probably won’t go back seeing a simple burger and an expensive meat clearly missed their marks; neither tasted very good...bland. My burger had tasty grilled peppers but that was the extent. Even the House Cut fries were lukewarm which made them tougher to chew. Not impressed for our first time there.
Great food, so so customer service. Wasn’t able to accommodate our baby.  Would come back for the food but not sure about the customer service.
The food was fantastic to say the least and who ever made our drinks that night was amazing. However, it is very loud, so not great for quiet conversation.

We reserved an early time on Wednesday and quite empty for awhile.
Once loaded, noises were noticed.

We had an excellent time celebrating with our friends. We were all very impressed with how delicious the food was. Our friends were saying it was probably the best meal they had ever had. I had the garden tea cooler which was refreshing and excellent. We had steaks, green beans, macaroni and cheese, brussell sprouts and the corn which were all extremely tasty and well flavored. Our 2.5 year old son was with us and was able to stay entertained and comfortable in the booths. The service was quick and friendly. All a really great experience.

Caesar was tasty but my wife and I have a pet peve about salads being served whole-leaf... that's not an immediately edible form, don't make me cut my own salad.

Risotto was okay, but didn't mention mushrooms on the menu which my wife hates, and I can make the same if not better Risotto at home.

rest was tasty!
Overall everything was fabulous!
Willard Hicks has consistently good food and service. Make it in early enough and enjoy happy hour too.

Service at the bar was outstanding.  The bartenders were all attentive and friendly although busy!  It was a great first impression!  Drinks were flavorful and different!  Table service was mediocre this evening... our filet minion was tasty but the loaded baked potatoes were barely warm.  I was a little disappointed as we took our boss out for dinner.
Fabulous way to celebrate my best friends birthday! Great food and drink, excellent service and a fancy yet non stuffy atmosphere!!
Service was great and very attentive. Drinks and food were all incredible. Came here for my birthday and they gave us a complimentary dessert with candle!

We caught a nice restaurant on a bad night (at least for us). We have been there two times prior and the food was good and service excellent, but last night, was different. It was a date, and we were seated in an extremely close/small 2 top next to two very loud men. The server we had was not great. He either was rushing us or ignoring us. I wanted to leave from the moment I sat down. The cocktail that was ordered was completely undrinkable since it was so spicy, it left our mouths stingy and numb for at least an hour, making eating anything else unpleasant. The food (certain items) we have found to be a bit under seasoned and over dressed (an arugula salad was extremely oily), in our opinion. The GM did come and speak with us and was apologetic and comped what we had ordered, which I greatly appreciate. I would consider going again, but I will request a booth, like we had the last time we were there. If booking through Opentable, I’ll just say it’s a party of three...
Stellar food and great service great wine list and craft cocktails
Excellent food, excellent service, excellent value, but ambiance and noise weren’t great...
We had a wonderful waiter and will go back

Great please to eat... Mix drinks are the best 
You can have a small party or large group you get great service either way.
Everything was wonderful. From our waitress down to our food.
Our family members all liked this restaurant very much.

We came here for my wife's birthday dinner. My steak was large and delicious! Our side to share (green beans) were really good and we ordered the cornbread which was also very tasty (and normally I'm not a fan of cornbread.) The service was excellent as well. It's not cheap but it's also not Alexander's expensive... Highly recommended for adults for a night out.
The food was very good. It was quite busy so service wasn’t quite as good as I’ve come to expect. Staff was very friendly as always and I would certainly recommend Willard Hicks to my friends!

We have reservations at 5 o'clock when we enter the restaurant the hostess didn't even look up at us and we had to wait several minutes for her to even acknowledge her existence. Then she sat us next to a window at the front of the restaurant. It was freezing cold next to the window and we immediately asked if we could get a booth. She said the booths are only for a party of six. Then we asked if we could get a table far away from the window she said that's only for a party of four. There is already a party of two sitting at one of these tables.  At this point the restaurant is completely empty and freezing cold and they will not seat us anywhere away from the window. We decided to leave the restaurant because we felt like the workers were being very snobby with us and we didn't want to be freezing cold during our dinner.
Great place for any lunch or Dinner special occasions or everyday Dinning, great service and great food selections in their Menu
Our server was not experienced enough for a busy restaurant.
Family dinner celebrating birthdays. Food and service were very good. The burger is amazing. Liked that there is no corkage fee if you bring a bottle of wine in.
The food was just okay. We got the rib eye and the WH new york strip. The new york strip was tasty, but the rib eye a disappointment. Service and ambiance was on point though.
Birthday dinner for a relative. Everything was amazing!

The service was poor and they were not even busy. Our intention was to purchase a bottle of wine and spend more money, but service was lacking.  I would never compare to high end steakhouse. Just horrible service.

Making reservations for the hubby and I on a Thursday night using OpenTable, we got there promptly and were shown to a table right in front of the live DJ. Dimly lit, the restaurant makes for the perfect spot for a date, but be prepared to use your outside voice because the music is popping!

Food-wise, Willard Hicks offers a huge variety of appetizers, salads, entrees, and sides that are advertised as "big enough to share." The hubby and I decided to get a side of roasted cauliflower while for the main course, the hubby choose risotto with scallops and I the "sticky chicken."

The only pitfall of the night was the service that was inattentive. Our waitress didn't check on us throughout the whole dinner and just seemed to disappear entirely, only returning to give us the check.

Thankfully, the food was so good that even the cold service could be forgiven. First, there was the roasted cauliflower, served on an iron plate and dressed with a fresh terragon and garlic sauce that was both sweet and savory. The cauliflower was also a beautiful purple and tasted incredibly tender.

The entrees were presented on large white plates that highlighted the amazing color of both courses. The hubby's risotto had a generous drizzle of what I believe to be balsamic dressing and four large scallops in the center. The scallops were cooked to perfection whole the risotto was creamy and decadent, without all the weight.

My "sticky chicken" was massive in size. The chicken was fried in one of the crispiest tempura batters ever that paired perfectly with the sweet, honey sauce. The chicken itself was moist, tender, and absolutely delicious. There was also a generous serving of a fresh mango and arugula salad that added acidity and brightness.

We loved Willard Hicks the first time we stopped by, but who knew we would love it even more the second time around? If you haven't stopped by, you need to go soon because you are most definitely missing out on a gem on downtown Campbell!
The food was great and the service was very good. I'd recommend this restaurant for any occasion.
Burger was amazing
Great place, great menu and great staff.   We usually sit at the bar and Lauren, Jill, Rebecca and Rachael are super!!!   Great happy hour and location.   Can’t wait for them to reopen......
Birthday celebration.  Food was just ok.
Another nice evening at WH
Enjoyed the original cocktails! Appreciated the patience the server extended while we made our food selections.
I always enjoy having dinner at Willard Hicks.  The great service, wonderful food and beautiful ambiance makes the evening very special.

I go to WH for one reason: Ribs  The ribs are decent and the fries accompanying them are usually good. On this visit, the fries were undercooked. The onion soup was so salty that I couldn't drink enough water for the rest of the evening.  The salad wedge was good. Overall, this visit was a disappointment.
Love this place. You have to order their cornbread. It’s yummy.
Second time there. Great spot.... great food and service

Menu states "Our salads are big enough to share". VERY misleading! They are not big enough for one person to be "entree salad" when ordered with meet or chicken, forget about sharing! Tasty food but inadequate portions. Very poor value.

Great high energy place for a get together with friends.  Good bar with ample seating and a good menu that has a lot to offer.  Not a place to bring your children, or for a quiet business meal (at least not in the evening). This is an adult friendly high energy bar/eatery.  Enjoy!
This place was ok, not the best.  However, the music and the ambience was nice.   Food was ok, service was slow.  I will return, hopefully, we get better service.

Food was average and service was poor.  I was expecting more for the price point and good reviews on Yelp. Server wasn't aware of the special occasion we were celebrating.  Server was never around. . Very difficult to flag.  I doubt I'll be back.

Had a nice dinner and selection of the mac and cheese was a real hit.  I was slightly disappointed by the steak.  Not awful, but a little tough.  I was surprised.  Love the no corkage on first bottle of wine.  Service was very good.  Cocktails are tasty.
A steak is a steak.  Food ok. Went on a Wednesday, so not too busy. A bit too expensive for what we got. Probably will not return.

The chopped salad was horrible.  I’ve never had apples in a chopped salad...
The burger was enormous and awkward for ladies to eat.  We cut it in 1/2 then cut the 1/2 in 1/2 and took the other 1/2 home.  It was good but really messy and hard to eat.
Just pleasant.  Not amazing.

Waitress barely checked on the table. Suggested something that was three times more expensive Then what my friends actually wanted. Couldn’t even find her for a glass of wine.It was my girlfriend’s birthday, and I wrote in the notes on the reservation, And flat out told her when she took our order for dessert. they couldn’t even bother to put a candle in They’re horrible drive pie that I had to have them take off the bill. After I had to look for the waitress that was missing for over 10 minutes.

We came here for a birthday in the family this past weekend.  We came here once before and always wanted to come back for a special occasion because of the great food and great service.

My son has celiac disease and  the waitress we had was intimately familiar with the importance of he having gluten-free entree.  She was super nice, attentive, and sincerely polite so she made our evening a very pleasant one.

Overall everything was good.  I was somewhat disappointed with my dish as it didn't have much flavor from the shortrib due to the overwhelmed flavor from the bluecheese.  The Ahi carpaccio was great. Caesar salad was good.  I would have preferred less sun-dried tomatoes and add anchovies. Peppercorns NY steak was good.   I liked the ribeye better. Side corn was OK -For $8, only 3 pieces=1.5 cob.  Cranbrulee and port were great for dessert.
Good food and great service, but supppper loud music.

Group of 4.  We had the brea, it was quite tasty.  Then burger, ribs, filet mignon, & risotto.  Large serving, we all took some home.  All were good, the risotto needed more spicing.  Enjoyed the meal and plan to return.  No corkage on the first wine bottle was a pleasant surprise.
Good place for some craft cocktails and food.  a bit cool in the winter if you sit near the front windows.
The rib eye was the worst steak I’ve ever had in my life.
Good happy hour, nice salads, great steaks, nice cocktails.
Went here for a birthday dinner and the experience and food was amazing! Would come back again!
We loved the experience and menu. The table we got was separate from the rest of the restaurant which worked perfectly for our event
Had a great idea night out with friends. And need to hit a character length for some reason.

No corkage cost for a bottle of wine is appreciated, however you must be seated at a table, not in the tabletop/bar area. The Poke was added to the appetizer menu recently, it was a favorite for our table. The scallop risotto was too much risotto :-/ Short rib was tasty, as were the steak street tacos. Kids mac n cheese was blazing hot, maybe bring an extra small plate so some can be removed from the cast iron skillet it comes in. Overall an enjoyable evening
It’s nice. I left birthday on the open table app occasion option but was not acknowledged.

Very noisy 
My sticky chicken  was difficult to cut into
So noisy we couldn’t hear one anothe
First time there. Service and food were great! We plan on returning.

Every one of our steaks was overdone. We ordered a rare filet, a medium rare bone-in t-bone and a medium New York. None came out cooked as ordered, and were all overdone. 

Coconut shrimp and crab cake appetizers were good. Mac and cheese, street corn (?) and fries as sides were all tasty also.

This place has gone hill. It is poorly managed and the food subpar. I keep trying it again thinking “it’s just an off night”, but last night was the last time I will throw my money away there. I ordered ribs. They were inedible, you couldn’t get a knife through to cut the ribs. I pulled a piece of meat from the bone, it was dry, like sawdust. I asked when the ribs were actually cooked, no one could verify. Even the server couldn’t get a fork into the meat. They looked and tasted like leftovers.  I decided not to order anything else since my husband was finished with his brown salad (again not fresh) and the server offered dessert, we got the apple pie.  Nicely presented, while the top was warm, the apples were frozen! Don’t waste your many. The food was inedible from main dish to dessert! By the way the manager never stopped by to apologize!
Food was only okay.  Service was fine, but doubt that we'll be returning.

I've been eating at Willard Hicks ever since it opened in Campbell.  It used to be one of my favorite restaurants, but no so much anymore.  On the plus side, the cocktails and steaks are still excellent, and I love their salads.  On the down side, they dropped their pesto-cheesy bread appetizer which was one of the major reasons I went.  It was that good.  The only bread they offer now is a corn bread appetizer.  It was quite dry and way too sweet for an appetizer.  I will not order it again.  They also dropped their fudge chocolate cake, which was also outstanding.  In its place, they offer this chocolate hockey puck shaped thing that is, in my opinion, not all that good.   Won't be ordering that again either.  And finally, they dropped their au gratin potato side.  Another big disappointment, because it was really, really good.  And it's something you don't often find in other restaurants.  Fortunately, their baked potatos are excellent, but I can get a good baked po at lots of other restaurants.  Will I go back?  Yes, probably, because they are convenient, and the steaks are good.  But Willard Hicks is not long my first choice in local restaurants.

This was our first visit to Willard Hicks.  We had reservations for dinner on NYE, and were seated promptly.  I can imagine that the acoustics can be quite loud, as the ceilings are high, but we were there early before the crowds arrived.  A great perk at this restaurant is that there is no corkage fee on your first bottle of wine!  After that, it is only $15.00.  The food was very good, but we did experience a couple of "hiccups".  I ordered the filet cooked medium, and I had to send it back as it was too rare.  My husband ordered the pork chop, which was on the small side for him.  The waiter was thoughtful and comped him a plate of scallops as her description of the entree was a little misleading.  My daughters ordered the grilled chicken, and the filet as well, and were both happy with their choices.  The sides are generous.  The corn on the cob was mushy, but it is not in season right now, and it could have been frozen.

Normally I would give this place a higher rating, but I felt like the portions were much smaller than normal. I ordered shrimp and grits and it looked more like an appetizer portion.  Even with the 2 sides, my friend and I were left hungry.  Same for my husband who ordered the swordfish and got one little piece on his plate.  If you're going to serve small portions, then you need to remind clients to order a lot of sides to make up for it. The drink menu was the same as it's been for forever.  Mix it up, people!  I've had everything you have to offer. Overall, though, we like this place a lot and will keep going.  They need to remember not to let quality slide, however.
What an awesome experience. The staff was so pleasant and attentive and the food was like a work of art, and it tasted just as good!  One of my new favorites!
Excellent place!! Really enjoy my dining at Willard hicks

This was our second visit to Willard Hicks and both times were excellent! Each dish ordered was thoroughly enjoyed by the guests. We had two entrees of their signature Filet with blackberry sauce, one had the delicious Sea Bass special, and one had ribs. We also shared a cornbread appetizer and the side brussel sprouts. Our server was friendly, funny, knowledgeable and efficient. We will definitely be back.

Too loud. Willard Hick’s has a DJ which is pretty unique for a steakhouse. The DJ did a good job of playing music that resonated with the crowd, however the volume was way too loud. I had to shout my way through every conversation. When I head out for dinner with my friends I want to be able to talk with them in a normal tone of voice. 
The service was a little slow. We had to wait far too long for someone to take our initial drink order and then waited even longer for the drinks to be delivered to the table. We found ourselves looking for our waitress multiple times during the meal. 
The food itself was very good. I had the risotto with scallops. It was well made and the flavors were excellent. Everyone at our table enjoyed their entree.

We have been dining at WH for some time and it's been one of our favorites.  Unfortunately our most recent trip was very ....... average at best.  The Asian Mambo Salad has been changed and didn't at all have it's previous flavor or flair and the Spicy Tuna Roll has been removed from the menu.  When we asked about the removal the Ahi Poke was recommended and it wasn't very good at all.  Too bad as we had really liked this place in past visits.  The tables near the entry door are useless on cold nights as well as we were freezing every time one opened and couldn't be re-seated so we left for better options.
Great service and excellent selection.  The overall ambiance was fantastic. Food was delivered quickly and healthy portions.
Sarah, I'd give 10 stars for your attentive service if I could.  Thanks a million.
Fun celebration for our college graduate!

Everyone knows this is a steakhouse/sports bar that serves up king size portions with a lively bar scene in DT Campbell.  For the past 4 years the Caesar salad was practically a meal for 2.  It consisted of an entire head of Romain lettuce with roasted whole garlic, huge pieces of sun dried tomatoes and chunks of croutons and tons of shaved Parmesan with a dressing that has a good spicy kick!  Weirdly tho their normally very large Caesar salad was half the size last night!  The waitress stated that it was their normal portion.  We ordered extra salads and moved on.. it was still delicious but no chunky croutons and minimal everything else that typically goes with it.  This was the only down side to an otherwise awesome dinning experience.
Everything from swordfish to the beef was fantastic, the wine list has some excellent California selections. We passed on dessert since we had stuffed ourselves with the Mac’n cheese, loaded baked potato and roasted Brussels Sprout plus baked Brie for appetizer....All of it delicious!

Had early Sunday night dinner with friends.  Decor and ambience were great, complimenting the festive holiday lights in downtown Campbell.  Started with a great vieux carre cocktail and went on to cornbread and coconut shrimp appetizers.  The Shrimp were really tasty and the cornbread was a nice balance of sweet and spicy. The Wedge salad had some creative additions and was very good. My wife and I shared the Ponzu Ribeye while our friends shared the Blackberry Filet.  While both steaks were cooked as ordered, tender and tasty, the Filet was the big hit, even though the grapes are kinda superfluous.  Also had the Brussel Sprouts and Green Beans.  Definitely go with the Sprouts, very tasty.  Shared a creme brulee for dessert - it was OK.  Overall, great dining experience and we were well taken care of by Ben.  Definitely would recommend to friends and will be back - plenty of menu items looked tempting.
All apetizers were good. Steaks were close to the bottom of any I've ever had. Very thick and tough with no flavor. Friendly wait staff but a little slow. Will probably not go back.

Food was incredible. The filet was cooked perfectly, and the accompanying grapes are different from what you typically see and are delicious. Yet, my girlfriend had the scallops that made me regret getting my steak! The noise level was on the louder end, but tolerable.
Server forgot 2 peoples out of 9 enter, and definitely needed to ask more if we needed drinks etc

We have dined here several times over the last few years. The food is excellent and prepared as you have requested it, especially the many cuts of beef that WH has on their menu. This particular occasion was a birthday celebration and there were six of us dining.  We had several starters including the Mac n Cheese, Brussels Sprouts and French Fries——all were excellent!

We had several different beef main courses as well as a couple of seafood main courses. All were excellent and cooked to perfection. 

Desserts were great too! Sorbet, apple pie and ice cream, and cookies and cream! 


Though the service was a bit uneven tonight, we will return again for the excellent food, and overall great dining experience!
Food is great here. Was super crowded but didn't have to wait w our reservation. Service was good, not great.

name: CAMPER
description:
Nestled in Menlo Park, Camper invites you to a culinary adventure led by Chef Greg Kuzia-Carmel, a Michelin-starred talent. Experience a vibrant atmosphere filled with natural light and rustic charm, perfect for enjoying California's seasonal bounty.

The menu highlights fresh, local ingredients with hand-cut pastas, succulent roast chicken, and vegetable-centric dishes. Each plate is crafted to let natural flavors shine, whether you're indulging in a grilled Wagyu cheeseburger or creamy Dungeness crab spaghetti. Vegan and gluten-free options ensure everyone can find something delightful.

Camper also features an extensive wine list and handcrafted cocktails, enhancing your dining experience. Discover Camper, where California flavors come to life and warm hospitality awaits.
address: 898 Santa Cruz Avenue,  Menlo Park, CA 94025
hours:
Brunch
Sat, Sun 10:00 am–1:15 pm
Dinner
Mon, Tue 5:00 pm–8:45 pm
Wed–Sat 5:00 pm–9:00 pm

reviews.text: The food was fantastic.  Loved the service.  Can’t wait to go back

We had the pleasure of dining at Camper with an out-of-town guest, and every time he took a bite, the conversation would just stop—every dish was that good.
We started with Miyagi Oysters, fresh and bright with a touch of ume vinegar and kumquats. The DiStefano Burrata was creamy and paired beautifully with grilled asparagus and smoked mushrooms that was dressed with a sauce/dressing that could have made us lick our plates but we showed restraint. The Tuna Crudo was clean and fresh.. The surprise of the appetizers was the Grilled Local Squid Salad—tender squid with avocado, mustard greens, and just the right amount of heat. It was absolutely delicious.
We shared everything family-style because we all wanted a taste of everything. The Kimchi Fried Rice with Mushrooms and Yuzu Furikake wasd delightfullly unexpected —the crispy bits of socarrat and layered flavors were unlike anything we have had. The Dungeness Crab Spaghetti was creamy but balanced, and the English Pea Agnolotti tasted like spring. The Herb Gnocchi Parisienne was rich, comforting, and full of flavor in every bite. And while we do not usually order halibut, the Potato-Crusted Halibut was a surprise favorite—perfectly seasoned and cooked with a crisp texture that made it feel almost fried, without being heavy.
For dessert, the Caramelized Milk Jam Pudding was among one of the best bites of the night—rich, silky, and so good our guest’s eyes literally widened at the first taste. “Let me bathe in this please” he said.  And of course, the Pistachio Ice Cream remains a familyfavorite.
Camper is one of those restaurants where even the most classic-sounding dishes arrive with something a little unexpected—in the best way. Fantastic service, fresh ingredients, the creative flavor combinations, and consistently beautiful presentation and execution make it a place we always look forward to coming back to.
Loved our experience at camper. It’s been over 2 years since we went last and I found myself asking why we haven’t been back earlier. Their fish entrees never disappoint
Outstanding and creative menus, drinks, and impeccable service.

My mother and I dined at Camper for the first time Thursday night. We travel to the area a few times a year and I wanted to find a nice place for us to have dinner. We loved Camper. We sat outside on a lovely spring evening, the weather was perfect. The heaters were there but did not need them. We saw them offer blankets to other guests but we did not need those either. The service was spectacular, the staff all were very friendly and knowledgeable. Now to the food, our meal was excellent, great flavors cooked perfectly. All made for a lovely evening.
Food came out room temperature which was pretty underwhelming

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️!

Camper has completely reimagined the classics--and every bite is a reminder of how exciting and fresh brunch should be.

The Smoked Trout Salad was a surprise standout. One bite in, and I felt compelled to take another bite, and another bite... It is a creative play on potato salad with layers of new textures and flavors--bright, savory, and addictive!

The Breakfast Steam Buns were another clever twist--fluffy bao filled with savory sausage and egg, with pickled cucumber and mint cutting through beautifully. Balanced, bold, memorable and delicious!

The Buttermilk Pancake Double-Stack was cloud-like yet chewy at the same time. Paired with chamomile honey butter, it added just enough floral sweetness.

The Shakshuka Verde was fresh and herbaceous, with the tomatillo and green garlic bringing brightness to the warm, comforting base. This is a cold day comfort meal order.

And then--the Roasted Apple-Cinnamon Roll. Imagine apple pie and a cinnamon roll had a perfect child. One bite and I was completely blown away.

Every dish felt thoughtful and new. Chef Marcus has brought real creativity to the brunch table, and I cannot wait to come back next weekend, and bring all my friends!

Took my best friend to Camper for her birthday and had a great brunch! Staff was great and food was awesome. Everyone made a point to acknowledge her birthday.  It was such a great time.

A dinner with family over the holidays was equally a great meal.  Camper is my favorite restaurant in menlo park.

Delicious and diverse offerings
Loved the ambiance and service

Food is creative and delicious. 
Service is knowledgeable and pleasant.
Highly recommend for dinner with friends or colleagues!
Food and beverages were delicious.  We sat outside under the heaters.  Very comfortable and much quieter than inside for conversation.  Highly recommend.

The food and cocktails are inventive and delicious, I will return in warmer weather when we can dine outside. The restaurant has all hard surfaces and is very noisy, making having a conversation unpleasant.

As always, great food, service and ambiance
Thank you camper team
Food was delicious.  Menu was different than what was posted online.
Great experience, fun drinks and wonderful food! Really enjoyed the ambiance too.

the crab Benedict was to die for, the fried chicken with side slaw and dilly dipping sauce were super yummy as was the spanish salad...and... I LOVED my milk punch (yay for bourbon!).  I would definitely try to come again for brunch ASAP!!
Fantastic food and super friendly service. Highly recommend.
Great brunch menu on a bright and sunny weekend in California.
First time there. Fell in love with the food, service and atmosphere. Looking forward to going back!
Dined here in Valentine’s Day with their pre fix menu and everything was delicious. Wine pairing and cocktails were also good. Would def come back to try their other items

To all the real ones who know--Camper's brunch is BACK, and I couldn't be happier! This downtown Menlo Park staple is serving up more chances to enjoy their incredible food, and trust me, it's worth it.

There isn't a lot of brunch photos for camper online so allow me to feed your eyes with the me documenting our satisfying brunch.

Came hungry and majorly craving carbs, so my girl friend and I went all in--Logan's Orange + Currant Scones for her, Challah French toast for me. Her scones? Warm. Flaky--paired with fresh butter that gave such a buttery finish to every bite. She wasn't super hungry, so the "on the side" menu was perfect. Love that they offer that option. Me on the other hand? I was ravenous.

LET ME TELL YOU--the Challah French toast was life-changing. A thick, buttery slab of challah, cooked perfectly, ridiculously satisfying to cut and bite into, and topped with macadamia nut butter that added just the right nuttiness and umami.

I can't even describe in words how good it was, no words would do it justice, you'd have to try it for yourself. Shoutout to our server and the kitchen for the amazing service and accommodating my request to swap the apples for strawberries. I'm 100% sure those apples would've been amazing, but sadly, my gut does not agree.

Thought I'd still be starving, but that French toast was actually the perfect level of satisfying. Took my chicken apple sausages for family to enjoy; I'm already dreaming of my next French toast bite.

Service? A+. Ambiance? Perfect for a girly brunch. Plus, downtown Menlo Park has easy parking (a rare win for downtowns) and is just 8 minutes from Palo Alto Shopping Center if you want to make a day of it.

TL;DR: Brunch at Camper is back! Please make a reservation on OpenTable and enjoy a nice brunch solo or with someone. Get the French toast. Thank me later.

My wife and I have made Camper one of our regular spots. We love the fresh farm to table ingredients, seasonal menu options, and fantastic cocktail menu. We were said they closed their sister restaurant Canteen, but glad we still have Camper.

Wonderful dinner out at Camper! It was a bday for one of us which we think was the reason we were seated over in the area that was less quiet and busy and which we greatly appreciated. Cocktails are delicious with lots of variety, and the food is absolutely wonderful, so creative with generous portions. We ordered the corn break, snap peas, pasta special and the halibut. We ate every last bite and were not able to fit in any dessert. Definitely will be back again for a special evening out.

Visit #2: Another culinary, enological and service staff triumph!  Camper delivers 5 star dining experience over and over again! It would be nice to see the back of the house come out into the dining room once in a while… so that we might bestow upon them well deserved praise and gratitude. Thank you Camper team for being good humans!

From start to finish, an absolutely delightful sensory-oriented dining experience; haven’t had one of those in a long time. Our server, Andres, was amazing and gave us exemplary service. All aspects of our meal, each plate, was creative, delicious and extremely satisfying. The wine list a wine lovers dream!  One can tell that the work culture at Camper is actively and positively engaged. Thank you for taking care  of us!

Corn bread and beets starters were great. 
Halibut and grilled prawn entrees were also very good. 
Apple crisp apples were not soft enough.
Excellent!!! All around!!!! Wonderful wait staff, very attentive but not too much. Food was fantastic and you’ll see me again. Thanks Greg!

We love camper from the incredible food, impeccable (and friendly) service, creative cocktails, and great atmosphere.  Salads were delicious, and Potato-cursed halibut was phenomenal. Dessert is always a treat. I can’t wait to come back.
The outdoor area was much quieter than inside and was comfortably warm even on a cold evening. The food was outstanding - every course and accompanying drinks.
Best spot in Menlo! Whenever I’m in town this is my go to place.
My first time.  Surprisingly, in an excellent way, it was fantastic!  Tried three different dishes - buonissimo - meraviglioso!
We went for my husband’s birthday dinner and he was so pleasantly surprised. He said he thought that the food was better than some we’ve eaten at Michelin Star restaurants.

Wow, what a DELICIOUS meal we enjoyed tonight.  From the PICKLED VEGETABLES, the LITTLE LETTUCE SALAD, to the my DUNGENESS CRAB TAGLIOLINI, the food was on point.   All four of us enjoyed our respective entrees.   There was a small snafu with our second round of drinks, but the EXCELLENT ATTENTIVENESS of the manager, Sarah, quickly and happily resolved everything.   Our wait staff was very attentive too.  We will definitely be back for dinner again and we were thrilled that CAMPER delivered…AGAIN.

Fantastic food! One of our favorite spots in Palo Alto. I have noticed that during periods of peak busyness that the service gets a little slow, would encourage them to think about adding one or two servers to improve their table coverage ratio.

Food and service were excellent. Decor was beautiful. Noise level for 4 seniors even at 6 pm was way too high. We could barely hear each other despite requesting a quiet table when I reserved. We won’t be returning bec of the noise which is too bad bec everything else was great.
This place never disappoints. Food, service, and drinks all fantastic. A true neighborhood gem.

Great food and service, but the waiters were a bit much. Felt like they came to our table every 3 minutes. It started to feel disruptive to our conversation, and like they were trying to get us out as soon as possible.
Loved the location, food and selection was amazing as well as the service, would definitely recommend and go back

usually love this place, but this time my pasta was soo salty and the waitress up-sold us on getting the burrata when the bread comes with ricotta which felt a bit annoying. the chicken also came out about an hour after we ordered and they brought the fries and hour early - everything was a bit off but they did provide a free dish + corn bread for the wait. but did not really acknowledge the lateness..

Service was very good as our server clearly knew the food and drinks and was well-trained and very professional and friendly. Food was okay, but could improve. Had the potato crusted halibut which was over cooked but otherwise flavorful. The prawns were served in the shell and were somewhat soft in texture, a bit unexpected. The pasta ragu was the best of these three. Since we were outside we needed heaters, and we had one which worked well, but could have used a second one. Metal chairs are cold and need cushions for evening. The small table lamp didn’t work. If they plan to keep booking outside they do need to improve the heating and comfort.  Overall we did have a nice time, mainly through the efforts of our server.

always a lovely experience.  food excellent.. once we got going all was good.. they were busy so a tad too long to order cocktails, other than that all was very nice.. it is very energetic though.. in case you are looking for quiet

We have been a Camoer supporter since Logan was there.
A bit disappointed with fried rice which we always order, portion smaller and rice was overly crispy
Otherwise we will always support Camper

We had a fabulous experience at Camper.  Our server, Walter, was perfectly attentive and suggested a red wine that was slightly different than my usual order, which paired wonderfully with all our dishes.  The seasonal pasta dish was one of the best pastas we've had, and everything else from our fish to the beet salad was exceptionally fresh.  The atmosphere was lively but comfortable and cozy at the same time.  We would happily return any time we are in the area.
Amazing clean food, wonderful staff and service, perfect ambiance, can’t ask for more!
What a fantastic dinner. The burrata appetizer with pickled delicata squash was simply delicious. We enjoyed the halibut so much. My husband said it was the best he ever tasted! Can’t wait to return.
I had the halibut which was cooked to perfection.
Delicious meal we did family style.  Service was great!
Average food for the price of rigatoni was not cooked enough. Very Al dente

I’ve dined at this restaurant many times and I’ve never had such bad service as I did last night. We waited for someone to check us in for 10 minutes. We just stood around and nobody helped us. I had to ask three times for a host to seat us. We finally were seated and had to wait 10 minutes for someone to bring water. We ordered a bottle of wine right then and we waited 25 minutes for the bottle to arrive. We finally ordered our food and by the time it arrived at the table we had been seated for an hour and fifteen minutes. We were then rushed to eat because they were closing and the servers kept coming to our table to try to take our plates. Mind you, we arrived on time and because of how abysmal the service was, we were rushed to eat! Our reservation was at 7:30pm so it’s not like we should have been pressed for time. My water glass was empty for 30 minutes before it was filled.

Overall I am shocked with the service. I’m not sure I’ve ever been so frustrated with service before in my life and I’m not the type of guy to complain and find issues over nothing. This was truly the worst dining experience I’ve maybe ever had. I can’t believe it and I can’t help but laugh when I think about it because it was truly the absolute worst.
Great ! Warm , friendly spot to hang out and eat with our son and his new wife .. good food and lovely Chardonnay too
Thoughtful, flavorful, fresh, colorful food. Service was friendly, attentive, and fun. Strong beverage program. Five stars baby!

Always delicious. Do not skip the corn agnolotti, whatever the season!

The entire staff was attentive and knowledgable about the menu. Each dish was an orchestra of flavors, without being over-the-top.

A local gem!
Great food, excellent choice and good quality ingredients.
The shrimp entree had 4 small shrimp in the shell and tons of beans. It was barely any food and the menu does not indicate the shrimp are in the shell. Very disappointed

Poor service
The host hands you menus and lets you seat yourself
Service is lackluster
Servers just hang around talking
Food was less than worth it!

We began our meal with the Warm Cast-Iron Buttermilk Cornbread and the Stracciatella. For the mains, we ordered the American Wagyu Cheeseburger, the Slow-Cooked Liberty Duck Panzotti, and the Gold Die Mezze Rigatoni.

Unfortunately, the overall experience was underwhelming. Both the food and drinks were mediocre, lacking the flavor and depth you’d expect from a restaurant that emphasizes farm-to-table, local, organic, and sustainable ingredients. The cheeseburger stood out as the best dish. The rigatoni was overcooked and bland, while the duck was just okay.

Adding to the disappointment, there was food left under our table and a noticeable trail of ants. The side patio had no ambiance to speak of. Sadly, this isn't a place we’ll be revisiting.

Another incredible meal at Camper! We started with the always delicious cornbread and added the stratchiatella with peaches, apricots and ham. This was so summery and tasty! For entrees, 2 of us had the halibut which was cooked perfectly with an incredible sauce, and I had the corn agnolotti… a summer staple that I adore. We also couldn’t resist trying a new item on the menu; their chicken breast. So juicy and tender; I would definitely order it again! Service was fantastic and friendly and once again, we left smiling after a great evening.

Enjoyed two nice pasta dishes, fusilli with clams, and one with duck confit. Service was excellent, with knowledgeable staff. Tasted wines before ordering by the glass. Generous pours both.
Highly recommended.

22% service charge included was surprising.  But great experience.  Great food & staff.

Update: Impressed with the team taking the time to respond.  IMO, the service charge is totally worth it.  (Hopefully others won’t be surprised with the charge and even if they are we hope they understand and look past it.)

But mainly, we’d return in a heartbeat.  Hope you do too.
This place has some of the best pasta in the Bay Area, always creative and always delicious.
Great food, great service. Nice round table for our party of 6.

Great experience! Creative cocktails and food was very good! It was a Thursday night and the restaurant was pretty quiet. We sat at the bar and had a couple of apps and entrees. The tuna crudo was amazing!! There were not a lot of dessert choices that caught my eye so I skipped it. Overall a great experience. I would definitely go back.
Great food and atmosphere. Always a treat to have dinner at Camper!

Food was great and waiter was also very polite and helpful.  Only hiccup was at the entrance/checkin.  The hostess initially offered us a table outside but I had selected 'standard', not patio table (ie. Outdoors) in open table. Whats odd was hostess claims there was no notification of table choice from open table - sure that may be true but why does that mean we sit outside? Doesnt that mean by default, we should get the inside? And why wasnt a message/text sent to confirm, prior to my arrival?

Fortunately we were offered a free appetizer and the service afterwards was great

A beautiful meal on the outside terrace tonight. We had the bucatini and halibut. So tasty. Started with hamachi crudo and cornbread. Delish.  The food never fails to deliver a true gourmet meal.  Kudos to the whole staff.
Love Camper! Favorite restaurant in the area. Feels more like NYC/Brooklyn and the food is excellent.

We shared a starter, a pasta, and a main - they were all outstanding !
Cocktails were great too.
First time dining at Camper and all 4 of us loved it!  Best Halibut dinner two of us have every had.  Everything else was great too, including the service.  We will be back!
It w great that they are Pet friendly. Nice outdoor space

Although the food was good, I definitely do not think it was worth the price point. The entree sizes were small and most did not come with a source of protein. The service was great, but it was really loud and cramped in there. I wouldn’t repeat this one.

Really enjoyed dining here. The food was wonderful. I particularly enjoyed the Pacific Halibut Fillet and the signature Milk Jam Pudding.

Interior seating was a bit loud.

Service was attentive, friendly, and relaxed, but was somewhat intermittent. Perhaps the server had too many tables to attend.
Excellent food, service, and staff. An excellent way to end our stay in Palo Alto

We went here since my sister was in town and we wanted to do something nice for her. We had been there before but awhile back so it was nice to come back here. We had the salad and sardine toast for a starter which was delicious! I had the corn pasta salad, my sister had the fusili clam and my husband had their burger. Each dish was great! The pasta tasted fresh. Wonderful staff and the portions are good too. We had more than enough where we didn't leave room for dessert. Would def come back!

We were a little disappointed in the service at the restaurant. There was little attn paid to our table by the waiter. The food was on point but the experience here was much different than our last dinner a few months ago.
Server never came back after taking our orders and taste of food for price point is concerning.

A Monday night dinner that was a good expeience only marred by the service.  On leaving we realized there was a very large party in the back room which explained the slow service.  Campers is a place that provides unusual combinations that few others offer and makes for a positive experience.  It is still noisy because of the many hard surfaces and the long narrow venue.  We liked the food.

My recent visit to Camper in Menlo Park left much to be desired. Despite arriving five minutes early for our 8:45 PM reservation, we felt hurried and rushed throughout our meal. We were informed upon seating that the kitchen was closing in five minutes. We had made the reservation online. It would’ve been helpful if no reservations were available online for booking five minutes before the kitchen closes.

Our server seemed impatient when seated, pushing us to order quickly. This rushed service continued as our courses arrived promptly, one after another, not allowing us to enjoy each dish fully.
The food itself was, unfortunately, subpar. While the presentation was pleasant, the flavors did not meet expectations for a restaurant of Camper's reputation. The dishes lacked depth and complexity; some components were undercooked or underseasoned.

To add to our disappointment, the server hovered near our table as we finished our meal, making us uncomfortable and pressured to leave. This feeling persisted even when we attempted to settle the bill, as the server stood close by, seemingly eager for us to go.
Our dining experience lasted 41 minutes from a glass of wine, two appetizers, two entrées and one dessert.

Overall, the experience at Camper fell short of what we had hoped for. The rushed atmosphere and mediocre food detracted from what should have been a relaxing dining experience. I would unfortunately not recommend Camper based on this visit for those seeking a leisurely meal with quality cuisine.

Food was good. Pricy though for small portions. Cauliflower for example not even a quarter of a cauliflower was the appetizer. Tiny flat loaf of corn bread. Small Bucket of fries $14!   Great staff. Food came quickly. Would go again for a special occasion.

Great service and teamwork, seems like a great team. 
Next level camp food; mine was never this good!!

Always fabulous. Victor usually looks after us but tonight we had a new server, Juan. He was so warm and happy to find out anything he wasn’t sure of (like if my cocktail could be served up). Victor even stopped by to say hello. We are so fortunate to have such a wonderful place nearby. The menu is updated seasonally so there’s always something new to try as well as old faves.
Great food! I highly recommend Camper. Good cocktails and the halibut was perfect!

The service that was provided by CAMPER was amazing. Our waitress was attentive and when we asked for recommendations, she was very knowledgeable. The food, however, was very bland and we had to ask for hot sauce and to make up for the lack of flavor. For the price, we felt that it wasn't worth it. Would give CAMPER another try but not in the near future.

We’ve been coming here for years, with small kids too. Camper has delicious high quality food, esp the corn agnolotti, and is one of the few places that both delights foodies and also is casual enough for toddlers and young kids.
Service was exceptional and food was good! They did not rush us which is a huge improvement from the last time I was there.

Eaten at Camper several times and I have always been satisfied with the quality of food, service and price.

This last visit REALLY disappointed on the food. Halibut Filet was anything but a filet - and whatever the accompanying greens / sides were, equally disappointing.

Will have to skip this restaurant for awhile, which means I take my business dinners elsewhere.
Food was great. Service was not. Server recommended levain bread after we told her we were gluten free.
We love eating here. Everything is done so well. The s’mores at the end were perfect.
Food was delicious and service was great!  Enjoyed everything we ordered, we’ll be coming back!
Really excellent food and a great menu. Great cocktails. One of the best hidden gems on the peninsula
wonderful food and cocktails. tart & sour cocktail was fantastic!

Biggest issue was the noise, but the service was a little off and the food was just okay for the price. A few people in my party ordered the burger all at different temperatures. When the food arrived the server literally told them to let her do her job and give the right proper the right burger: so we did and they were all wrong.
Beautiful food and very well composed but it was very expensive. Great ambience.

We were seated upon arrival as per our reservation, which was nice, bu the table we got was directly under an air conditioning vent, which, with the significant noise factor caused us to ask for a different table, perhaps in the back, quieter area. The host was gracious, re-seated us to a comfortable spot.
The three of us had unusual and delicious entrees, the fourth had the lovely-oooking hamburger (which he exclaimed about.)
The golden cauliflower we had as an appetizer was delightful, unusual spices, nice texture & aroma.
My pasta, with lamb sugu was perfect, just right al dente pasta, tasty sauce.
Similar comments from the other two. Service attentive without being intrusive.
All in all, except for the noise/cold air factors, an extremely pleasant dining experience.
We look forward to return visits to sample new menus.
We always enjoy our dining at Camper.  The staff are incredible and the food is amazing.  We love the seasonal changes and great cocktail list.
The squid bucatini and halibut were exceptional.
Very good. The Old Fashioned was the best I’ve ever had!
Nice experience overall . Service was very good ! Food was beautifully presented and I enjoyed their use of fresh vegetables and spices.
Absolutely delightful experience, food is always excellent

I’ve been going to camper’s since it opened and have been impressed by the imaginative menu however the last few times I’ve dined there I have noticed a deterioration in quality and attention to detail. This evening the salad was shocking poorly dressed and the main dish under seasoned as has been mentioned by other reviews. I hope they return to their previous standards.

Camper is fabulous as always. I especially love the seasonal menu changes to their regular pasta dish (I’ve tried many of them. The Afghan-style pasta was my fav). Somehow they always manage to hit “familiar” and “surprising” at the same time. Well stocked bar for excellent drinks and the entire staff is so kind. It can be very loud sometimes and when it’s busy service can be uneven. But overall one of my favorite go-to places.

We dined here for the first time for our anniversary. It's kind of a casual venue for a special occasion. My partner was disappointed in the size of his small (but potent) lemon cocktail. I knew the sangria would be white with pinot grigio, but forgot it included tequila as well - different. The rock cod dish was fancy and delicious. I was hungry later in the evening.  My partner liked his ample pasta bolognese. We also had the cornbread, thinking it would come first, as an appetizer with our drinks. It came all at once with the entrees, in lickety split. We were a bit disappointed the food came so fast! The service was professional enough.

I love Camper but last night’s experience was pretty terrible.  We had a reservation at 7pm and waited until 7:40 to be seated with no offer to give us a drink or anything for our inconvenience.  Up to maybe 15 min I can understand but 40?

We went to Camper on a whim for a friend's birthday.  Well, we were wowed by the bar and the bar tender!!  She was very knowledgeable and made excellent quality cocktails.  Then, for dinner we had the oysters, the burrata, the yellow fin tuna crudo, and the herb and saffron dumplings...and ALL of these dishes were absolutely superb!!!  For desert we had the pot of creme, which was also deeeelicious and very creative.  We are planning to go back once a month now!!  My only small negative feedback is that inside it is a bit noisy.  We sat outside and it was perfect.
Wonderful food, inventive takes on the classics. Will be back!
Always delicious. We elevated the La Vie mocktail with Rocket Vodka.
Very nice personable evening

Delicious meal with our world traveler friends, that came to town! They were very impressed with all the yummy, unusual food selections…and believe me, we tried a lot!
All delicious, even down to the strawberry rhubarb dessert!
It was nice for them to meet Chef Marcus!
Thanks!

Delightful dinner on a Monday night where the room was busy but manageable.  Attentive waiter. Excellent martinis to start. Two orders of the sunchoke agnolotti (excellent), an order of cod (expertly cooked) and the dumplings (just okay). Side salads were fresh and deep green. Killer sourdough and some orange zest tasting butter.  Lovely Sancerre from a wine list that was surprisingly affordable for a Silicon Valley upscale eatery.  Only knock was that the room was a bit chilly.  We’d recommend this joint.

Food was ok for the price .. I couldn’t believe that I paid  $30 for rice and my husbands bourbon was an embarrassing pour .. the waitress rushed us out of there.. didn’t even sit down and she was already asking g for drinks appetizer and dinner all in one breath.. then gave us the bill and we thought we tipped and the owner came out and said was there something we said no and then he asked why didn’t we tip.. I have never had that happened. If there wasn’t so many things o probably would think they had an off night but for $350 I expected more .. not going back

One of our favorite and most frequent go-to restaurants in Menlo Park. Chef Greg’s food is always delicious and creative – their cocktails too! As a Rocket Vodka launchpad, you know the cocktails are going to be elevated.

A lovely meal. The chef is super creative in the use of vegetables and original sauces. Nice selection of wines by the glass, which our server was happy to let me taste before ordering. Highly recommend the cauliflower starter and the chickpea risotto, which were quite exceptional. The baked cod however was a bit too salty. And we needed to order some bread to cleanse our palate afterwards. They did offer to remake the fish which was thoughtful, but it would have interrupted the flow of our dinner at that stage. That said, it was a great experience overall. And don’t skip the s’mores desert!

Everything was SO delicious: the scallop crudo with peas, the tortelloni , the  spaghetti w/Dungeness crab, the waygu hamburger and fries and the apple tart tatin.  I think one cannot go wrong with dining at Camper and I look forward to trying the pizza on my next trip :)
Unimpressive. Weak, slow, and inattentive service.
Amazing service, amazing food! A local favorite that’s a must!
Great food and top notch service.  Requested to sit away from door (cold air enters each time) and they accommodated. Very nice experience.  Will return.

Really underwhelmed by this restaurant. Service was terrible, food was unremarkable, under-seasoned and overpriced. Not a whole lot of accommodation for dietary restrictions, no salads with protein and the only option to add was chicken. Some guests didnt get place settings for the duration of  the meal. Drinks were never refilled. Took a very long time to get food.

The reason it’s not 5 stars is that we waited quite a while after Checkin for our table. Ambience is nice & cozy. Our server greeted us with a big warm smile & the recommendations were good as it was our first time and we had out of town guests. Cornbread was excellent & the two pasta dishes were delicious. Dessert recommended to us was outstanding. Perfect dinner!!!
Food was unique and delicious. Nothing was a dish I'd had before. There was always a delicious twist. Crudo and rock cod were my favorites.
Our first time there we will definitely be coming back. The staff is great. Great atmosphere.
We enjoyed dinner but the noise level wasn’t overwhelming. About 25 guys standing by the bar were really loud, so it was hard to hear
charcoal pasta w crab was a bit salty but the ragu rigatoni was very good. Smores were amazing aswell and the place as a whole was very cozy and clean. would come again
Service was impeccable, and the food was great. However, a very small amount of steak for $50 is just ridiculous. Do better.
We went for a birthday. The service was GREAT! The food was good quality and very flavorful. The dessert was amazing!!

It was a rainy night and we decided to find a place close by to home. Camper did not disappoint. Our server, Abigail, was amazing!!! Everything she recommended we absolutely loved.

We can’t wait to come back again.

Tried Camper for the first time last night and LOVED it. Excellent service, all the food was delicious, relaxing ambiance, perfectly mixed cocktails. I would love to go back in the warmer months & sit outside (although they have heat lamps and nice outdoor set up for year round!) highly recommend!!
Food OK but not great. Wine list is limited. Staff was attentive.

Camper continues to be one of my fave places to dine on the Peninsula! Seasonal vegetables and grass fed local meats perfectly prepared win every time.  Greg's Steak (MR) alongside the 12-hour Rigatoni with Pork Ragu and Sourdough Breadcrumbs is my absolute fave combo here. DELISH. I look forward to trying the Charcoal-Stained Spaghetti with Dungeness Crab next time. Started with the Cast Iron Cornbread, which came with a delicious herb-honey butter...would've like the cornbread a little warmer, so the butter would melt. But yummy, nonetheless. Next time, I'll try the Sourdough Bread with the Homemade Ricotta. The Bourbon-heavy bar made it a MUST to order a Penicillin, with a Lagavulin float. The Japanese Old Fashioned with Akashi Japanese + Ume Whiskey and Yuzu Bitters was TOP NOTCH. Ended our meal with two desserts vs one...An oozy caramel sauce drizzled over a crunchy Canele cake topped with Vanilla ice cream AND the Smoked Smores with Burnet Meringue....Say no more! Lastly, the impeccable service (from the host to the bartender) along with the restaurant's rustic outdoorsy ambiance is 10 out of 10!!

The food was just okay. I would say there wasn't much depth of flavor on the dishes. The dish the bothered me the most was the cornbread with compound butter. The butter was undersalted and we couldn't taste any flavor from it other than just butter. This seems like such an easy dish to get right that this was surprising. Overall, everything else was nice (service, ambience, decor), and it was easy to have a conversation (the restaurant wasn't too loud), but I would not come back given how expensive the food was when I thought it was just mediocre. I don't mind paying the amount I did here for other restaurants where I feel the dishes actually deliver.

Food was good (ordered cornbread, fries, rigatoni and black spaghetti with crab, s'mores and the dessert with dulce la leche). The food was piping hot, tasty and the portions were quite big. The wait staff was attentive. Our water glasses were never below halfway--they kept filling them. We were celebrating my birthday and they gave us a free dessert! We never felt rushed and enjoyed our dinner immensely. We will be back!! Thank you for making my birthday dinner special!

Great changing menu. Potato crusted rock cod was fantastic. 22% auto service fee was deserved but it should not be calculated against the 6% living wage included in the bill. I hate paying tip on tax!
Great food!!! Creative. However a bit on salty side.
Blown away by the food, ambience, drinks and value. Really enjoyed our meal!
The chicken dish I had was excellent.  I am not sure if my other guests were as pleased with their meal as I was.  It was a nice evening.  Good service, food and drinks.

It’s so unfortunate to have to write a negative review. We discovered this restaurant close to a year ago and loved it. But we’ve been back a few times since and our experience just gets worse and worse. This was our last dinner at Camper. As far as the food, the salad was well dressed but not washed properly and the grit and sand made it inedible. My date’s pasta was fine but the sauce tasted like pure salt. As for the service .. what service? The host barely looked at us, the busboy slammed water glasses down on the table as we sat down and  the waiter acted like he’d rather be anywhere else than serving. He wasn’t familiar with the menu, couldn’t be bothered to ask if enjoyed our meal, had zero interest in us all together  At $300 for two, we could have enjoyed a fabulous meal at Bar Zola or Ettan in Palo Alto.  Menlo Park could really use a nice restaurant- unfortunately, Camper isn’t it.
Loved the creative cocktails, and the food was outstanding!
Service and food are consistently excellent.
Boisterous atmosphere.  Creative menu.  Great service.
Good food and service. A bit pricy but big portions.
A great place to go for a birthday celebration.  Staff was attentive and the food was unique and delicious.  Would have liked larger portions for the $$.
Really great pasta dishes! Always a staple in the Bay Area! And to add, the chef is so accommodating!

The experience at Camper was mixed. We were the first to arrive and they sat us at a table by the back door which seemed odd. But we were greeted by the waiter immediately and he took our order for drinks and appetizers. The cocktail menu had some great offerings but I thought the starters were unusual; they would be either complementary or sides at other restaurants (olives, bread, roasted cauliflower). We got the drinks and starters quickly and everything was very good. We ordered our main courses, but those took a very long time to come out. We were going to a concert so, unfortunately, we didn't have time to enjoy the full meal. My husband and I split the half chicken, and our friends ordered the fish. The chicken was excellent but it should be for $42 for a half roasted chicken!!! Our friends felt that the fish was OK. All in all, we will go back and give it another try. I liked the ambiance and there were definitely some good aspects, but they need to hit on all cylinders especially at those prices.
Really good experience with a large group.  We had a big table to ourselves at the front of the restaurant.  Food and service were both great.
A staple in our Downtown Menlo cuisine, and a cocktail menu that saves me a trip into the city.
Best, most creative pastas on the Peninsula. Never disappoints.

Camper is amazing and we have always enjoyed the dinner and beverages there.  The seasonal menu highlights the incredible foods of Northern California and unique cocktails makes for a lovely evening.  We will definitely be back

The food and service are excellent here.  The biggest problem is the noise level.  It’s very hard to have a conversation and hear without speaking very loudly, and even then the noise level is deafening!  My husband and I will not be coming here with friends anymore.   We will only dine by ourselves until the weather is warm enough to sit outside.

We had a great experience. We sat outside under the covered patio which was cozy since it rained on and off but we were completely dry. They had cute bistro lights strung up and space heaters on. The drinks and food were delicious. Especially the autumn sangria and the pastas.

Recommended. Great food and delicious cocktails that were a bit unique. Very friendly service. Sat outside. A bit of street noise, but still easy to converse. Warm heating lamps kept us comfortable. Inside looked fun, but seemed a bit noisier.
Excellent food and cocktails, nice selection of pastas

Camper is dependably good- excellent food, attentive service, but every single time we go, the server greets us by apologizing for how long it will take to get food out.  It’s very slow, so plan accordingly.  It is also really loud.  It would be great to see them do something to soften the acoustics in there- it’s all hard surfaces, and even one boisterous group makes it impossible to hear your own table conversation (and I’m not hard of hearing).

Service was very attentive. The food in principle should have tasted amazing but perhaps there was an issue with the execution. Food arrived cold. 
I’ll probably return again to give it another go.

Portion sizes were small relative to the price. One of us ordered the fried chicken sandwich and the ratio of chicken to bread was abysmal. Way too little chicken and the breading on the chicken did not stick to the chicken. 

Their brunch menu also did not have many options to accommodate vegetarian / pescatarian diets. 

Service was also subpar. We sat outside on the patio and took forever to flag a server down to take our orders and get the tab.
The pork tortelloni was delicious and the cannele cake with apples, caramel and vanilla ice cream was so So SO yummy. I wish to try brunch there next.

Food's good.
Service could be faster (seated for ~10 min before we met the wait staff for our table, after we order, the cocktail and drinks come after the appetizers were served), perhaps it's due to the busy Saturday or the purpose of giving customer more privacy.   :-)  All staff are very friendly and helpful which is a big plus!
We were seated at the low ceiling area, all hard surface that reflect sound, a little hard to hear even the people cross the table.  Perhaps the high ceiling area in front of the bar will be better.

Come for the food and service (and isn't that the most important part?)  Innovative, beautifully prepared dishes and a varied menu.  Glad to be with three eager eaters ready to try anything.  Mushrooms and burrata were a surprise favorite--I wanted to swim in it--with the corn pasta a welcome choice by one of us on his third visit.  Cornbread? YES!  Steak? YES! Lamb meatballs? YES!  Only thing that didn't wow us was the sourdough, which didn't shine.  Checking in is a bit congested and you may get backed out onto the sidewalk to queue for check in.  Nice bar area, but atmosphere otherwise not really remarkable.  Gets noisy when fully occupied.  But Camper is definitely a keeper and should be in your rotation.  We'll definitely be back!
We go to lots of restaurants on the Peninsula and other than Protege, a 1 star Michelin, best meal on the Peninsula
The food was absolutely exceptional. Will run back there the next time I am in town for meetings at Stanford.

The menu looks great. Several of the dishes were very tasty but a few of the pasta dishes were very undercooked and the service wasn't very good. Many of our items were forgotten. It was neat restaurant but not sure it was worth the price.
Wonderful experience! Great outside seating with heaters and wonderful food and service!

Lackluster and unprofessional service starting from the host to servers. It took 10 minutes to be acknowledged by our “server” who welcomed us with “have you guys been helped yet?” with an armful of dirty dishes. Overpriced food for the quality. Why did our butternut squash soup have pomegranate seeds when it doesn’t say so on the menu? We sent a crab and charcoal pasta dish back because the sauce was oily and broken and not spicy for a diavolo sauce with 2 pieces of overcooked crab in it. Our server Curtis came over and sighed awkwardly asking if we want anything else with zero acknowledgement other than “yeah that didn’t come out the right way”. Our waters were never refilled. We had to ask for silverware twice because our food came out before hand. Very unfortunate and frustrating compared to reviews I’ve read about Camper. This also was a birthday reservation, which was never acknowledged that left me feeling very embarrassed about my choice.
Greg is the best!

Our experience at Camper was terrific for excellent food and service!  Our entrees - salmon and agnolotti pasta - were creative and perfectly seasoned.  The S'mores dessert was delicious and unique!  Our only criticism was a noise level that made normal conversation challenging.  We will definitely return because we love the food and attentive service, but wish they would install ceiling baffles or something similar to reduce the noise level.

Ask for an outside table with Andres, his service is always terrific and he takes great care of us.  The cuisine is outstanding and the menu is always changing to reflect in-season and locally sourced meats and vegetables.
We’ve been many times but found lunch over the weekend to be so underwhelming.
We are HAPPY CAMPERS! Awesome new items on the fall menu!
Reliably great food and cocktails! Given the number of mediocre restaurants in Menlo Park and Palo Alto, this is a welcome shift.

Great food and service. We are not from the area but we were meeting a friend who was visiting from Atlanta, Georgia. So glad we tried it, we’ll be back. Fried cauliflower, corn bread and Lamb Balls were our favorite appetizers. Get the milk jam pudding for dessert, you won’t be disappointed.
We were a table of 6 and ate outside; inside, the noise was deafening—great veggi dishes and drinks.
Best meal I have had in ages! Highly recommended!!
Great food. Good service. Nice experience. We’ll be back!

The food is quite good, but very pricey. The wait staff are not particularly friendly, bordering on rude.  Our waitress felt compelled to explain how ordering worked in a most surreal moment. One of our four entrees delivered over 5 minutes after the other three. With all the pleasant dinning opportunities in the area, unlikely we will return.
Good quality and service. Helpful and friendly staff.

Attentive waiter who provided great recommendations and descriptions of what was on the menu.  Food was creative, different, and delicious.  Great table that made us feel like we were able to talk easily to each other.  The salted caramel dessert was out of this world.  Kudos to them for having wild salmon which was perfectly cooked.

an amazing restaurant with incredible food, good location, and attentive service. this was our first time enjoying Camper and we were very impressed. we elected outdoor dining as the indoor option is quite loud.  it got a bit chilly outdoors, but the evening was pleasant. 
we begun with an amazing gazpacho and a burrata based salad with cherry tomatoes and frisee. both were outstanding. bread would have been a good accompaniment with these dishes. it is offered, but you have to ask.
we chose pastas as a entrees...one of use had a mexican based gnocchi, which was totally fantastic.  the other had the bucatini, which was rich and tasty. desert was a smooth sweet creamy concoction, somewhere between panna cota and mousse.  we also tried a cocktail and glass of red wine. 
we also enjoyed a pleasant conversation with our server, who was a local guy very knowledgeable of Menlo Park area.
It is pricey...but, its really a special food and drink treat!!

Lamb dumplings were weirdly chewy.
Clam bucatini had sand in it.
Petrale sole was nicely done, but the sauce strongly flavored for such a mild fish.
Dessert menu slapped down on the table before we were done eating the entree. The reservation included a warning that dinner for two had an hour and fifteen minute limit but we had only been there about 35 minutes when the waiter brought the dessert menu.

As before the flavors and the food were excellent. The wait staff very good. There was a problem with our order not coming out in good time. But the staff and chef talked to us, comped an extra appetizer and we totally enjoyed the even. The Midnight Raider martini was also a winner.

Food was very good. Summer salads and produce are amazing. But I'm always struck how restaurants on the Peninsula are very expensive. Dinner for two:  burger and a pasta. Split some appetizers and a few beers. $200 + tip.  I don't think anyone is profiteering but it's still discouraging.

Great food and servier from this local gem.  We had the Cornbread appetizer with the Stonefruit salad. Both were delicious.  For our mains we had the Petrale Sole and the Flat Iron “Greg’s Steak”    We left no room for deserts but will be back again soon.
We had the corn  agnolotti pasta and it was scrumptious and we ended up ordering a second plate since it was out of this world!
This is my néw favorite Menlo Park restaurant!  Just wish they had more wait staff!  Food is exceptional and their brunch was fabulous!  Had the delicious Crab Omelette 😱😱😱😋😋😋 YUMMMM!

Camper is one of the very best restaurants on the Peninsula.  Excellent, creative, and healthy offerings with every course on the menu. Tasteful informal atmosphere.  Wonderfully friendly, informative, responsive staff.  They deserve every bit of their price point.
Good food though a bit under seasoned. Service was terrible - We waited 15 mins for the waiter to take our order, our bread order was forgotten, dessert was undercooked etc.
Only “issue” was wait staff left a dirty hors d’oeuvre plate on our table even though the main course had been served. I put the dirty plate on the ground, and asked a staff member to remove it.

Very delicious and creative dishes. Our waiter was very nice too and helped us decide what to get!

My only complaint is that our table was a bit wobbly.

Thanks Chef. Nice restaurant. Friendly.
Wine is good.

The wait staff was great.. refilling our waters constantly. Our waiter was pretty busy towards the end, we had to wave waiters down to get Togo boxes and the dessert menu. We also had to go to the front to ask for our credit card. The waiter left it in the machine. It started out great. Towards the end it was ok.
Food and cocktails were outstanding.  Wide variety of flavors!
Our server, Habib, was outstanding. The food was delicious and the ambiance welcoming and relaxed.

Excellent dinner started with fresh delectable oysters followed by shared fresh pastas and delicious main courses. Don't forget the Levain bread, fresh baked daily and even a delicious vegan dish for those so inclined. Overall a great experience and exceptional service.
The steak tartare was the best I have had since Lyon, France.  In fact it was even better.  Greg’s steak also excellent.
Amazing!  Absolutely delicious!!! I can’t wait to go back!

What a gem!  Some friends and I thoroughly enjoy/loved  dinner at Camper.  We dined outside.  The food was wonderful,  and all 5 of us loved our dishes.   Our server was great!  He gave us recommendations that were spot on.   One of the specials that night was steak tartare, and it a dish I love and Campers did not disappoint it was delicious.  I will be back and I know my friends feel the same.
