Food was great, though portions small even for an expensive pasta place.  Skip drinks from the bar - tasty but about three sips.  The service was awesome, we loved our server.  Attentive and humorous, he checked in enough to be ever-present but not intrusive.  We had an outside table which was nice but could kick it up in the ambiance category.
Friendly service, food was excellent. Music from park was a nice (albeit faint) addition! We had a nice birthday dinner!

Delicious food and amazing service.
I love the pasta, the steak and the appetizers. And the dessert was delicious!

I love the farm to table food at camper. It’s always fresh and incredibly well prepared. This is one of my go to restaurants.

There was a period where I could not go because of what you did to one of your employees. I really loved the bartender Robert and it’s unfortunate you let him go for political reasons. Hopefully you missed my business for a little while. I know a few people were staying away from your restaurant because of the action you took against Robert.

Alas, I decided to come back because your food is some of the best on the peninsula.
Very disappointed in this restaurant. We went for brunch recently and had horrible service, the food was only mediocre and pretty pricey.  Will not go back again.

The creative menu was exciting. The flavors even more. The starters were really excellent (sungold tomatoes, blistered snap peas). Service was excellent in a no rush atmosphere. The scallops entrée I had was a 100% winner. We will be back.
We had a great time here! Our meal was delicious and the service was fabulous. Would definitely recommend a meal here!
Great pasta dishes and nice beverage list.  Would go again.
The food and service at Camper is amazing and we always enjoy our experience there. Looking forward to going back
Crazy delicious home made pasta. Absolutely would recommend
Habib was great. The appetizers were delicious, but the fried rice wasn't great. It was really noisy inside, but fortunately we got a table outside.
Ate solo and sat at the bar. The bartender was very friendly and she helped with some great recommendations. Food was amazing, would definitely go back again.

Wonderful dinner at Camper. our waiter Victor was extremely friendly and knowledgeable with the menu.  He had a deep understanding of the menu and drove use to order items perfect for us.  the cherry burrata with lavender and the hamachi crisp was a perfect way to start the meal.  The pastas were very fresh and flavorful.  Will definitely be back.  Thanks Victor for the great service
As always, our meal was.just terrific. The dishes did not disappoint!! And what a treat to see Chef Greg! Thanks for the amazing food, drinks and wine, the amazing service, and the warm welcome!

We dined outside in the parklet which was great with the robust heat lamps. Service was prompt and helpful. Our drinks and appetizers (blistered sugar snap peas, grilled cherries & burrata salad, fries) arrived faster than expected. The pasta selection is diverse and all good. Desserts should be shared - huge and delicious. Good wine list, something for everybody. Everything was so good!
simply delightful atmosphere, great choices of sharable appetizers. definitely go back there.
Really delightful food and drinks. Their patio is quite pleasant. Definitely worth a visit!
Lots of lively young families with small children meandering about. Great place for families and littles. If you want quiet and a calm atmosphere you might want to skip Camper.
Camper was good for the food and service.  The noise level was high.  We had a hard time hearing each other.

One of the best dinners I’ve had in awhile! The menu was varied, very creative, and delicious! Drinks and wine list were great. Service was outstanding! Our waiter, Victor was warm and really cared about providing an excellent experience for my husband and I. This was our first time at Camper but I think it will become a regular date night spot. Fantastic evening. Thank you!
This was our first time at Camper.  Food and service was impeccable! We will definitely be visiting again.
Outstanding! Wonderful experience and great service.
Tasty cocktails (launchpad for Rocket Vodka from 100% Apples), delicious food, and awesome service!
We got a reservation for 30 minutes out, which was amazing! The food is excellent; the staff is knowledgeable and very professional. I love the decor as well!
Truly a gourmet experience.  So many great choices.

Dinner was amazing! We sat on the front patio outdoors; weather was nice and the heaters felt great as the sun went down. Where do I begin? We started with the asparagus and burrata and added the always- delicious sourdough bread. We then had a new menu item (for us): the avocado toasts with sardines. I don’t normally eat sardines, but the flavor was so subtle and blended so well with the avocado. Beautiful presentation as well. We also added the cornbread which was so moist. For dinner we had the cheeseburger and also the morel pappardelle; cheeseburger never misses and the pasta was heavenly. We also had the snap peas plated on top of a very flavorful sauce. As always, we left feeling so happy that a restaurant as incredible and innovative as Camper exists in Menlo Park. Thank you Camper!

Chef Greg and the Camper team never disappoint! The food is delicious, one of the best places to eat in the Bay Area! Don’t miss the ramp butter, the lamb sugo pasta, potato crusted cod, and Greg’s steak!  Also the cocktails are incredible - if you like Mezcal, you have to try Heat of Passion, my new favorite cocktail!!!

Outstanding experience at Mothers Day brunch!  Everything we ordered was fresh and delicious.  Portions are very generous - easily could share the fried chicken between two hungry adults.  Service was outstanding as well.  Will be back for sure!
Always excellent. Love that they adjust the menu to seasons.

Amazing and creative food. It was one of the best meals we have enjoyed in the Bay Area in a long time and we go out A LOT!
Everything was fresh and creative. From appetizers to dessert this was incredible.
Fantastic meal, the sourdough bread side was delicious and our entrees were so good!
Excellent food, mostly-OK service, pricey –– a decent restaurant.
The food was excellent. We had the cod and the bucatini with seafood. We Really love all the food at camper.
The food and cocktails were pretty great. Loved the cornbread and brussels! Service was really kind but sloooow. We were there for 2 hours.

Every item we ordered from appetizers to dessert was delicious.  Their service was outstanding.  The manager came out several times to help us with our wine order and brought out an appetizer, on the house, after we had been discussing a particular dish.  They made my husband's birthday special by bringing out a dessert and, once again, they brought out another dessert, on the house, "just to make it fun".  We definitely recommend Camper and will be back again.
It was wonderful service and environment. The cod is super fresh and tender. Just a bit cold, recommend a jacket

Food was very good.  Service was excellent, very friendly and helpful staff.
The milk jam pudding for dessert was to die for.
Fantastic!!!was the best great food great service
Amazing experience as usual, great new dishes and great service!

The food was delicious. We enjoyed the cornbread and burrata. We had the local cod, 
 smoked chicken and Tri-Tip. They also have a nice wine and cocktail list.

I first dined at Camper when it opened in 2018 and had a bad experience--noise level, poor, out-of-sync service, mediocre food, narrow menu choices and high prices.  The owner apologized on Open Table.   Unfortunately, after nearly 5 years, nothing has changed.  Even on a night when the restaurant was not full, the noise level is way too loud (he promised that the acoustics would be addressed in 2018), the service is terrible--nothing comes out at the same time for the table from drinks to the food.  Had to ask multiple times for nearly everything--pepper, butter, "where is the other person's drink", etc.  And, to charge for the "coke" separately for a mixed "rum and coke" drink is basically outrageous and the menu choices are from a very narrow list of similar items. The waitress was clueless and forgetful--not good.  So, basically an overpriced underwhelming experience NOT to be repeated.

It’s always fun to bring people to Camper for their first time and witness their pleasant surprise with the food. Fresh. Varied. Perfectly seasoned. Staff is efficient and friendly. Always a great pick.

We bumped into the owner on the way in through the back and he was very gracious and welcoming as was the entire staff.  The food was outstanding, we started with a couple of appetizers, oysters and the Brussels sprouts.  We followed with the crab spaghetti and steak - perfectly done. The restaurant had a casual ambiance and the sound level was moderate. There was a mix of diners ranging from families, groups to couples. Definitely will be back again to try more items..

Extremely disappointing experience. We made a reservation for 4 at 7:30PM, specifically for indoor dining. We arrive at our slotted time, the host asks if we mind dining instead outside, I reply by saying we had made our reservation for indoors and request to wait by the bar. As we’re standing at the bar waiting to order the drinks, the manager (I’m assuming) asks for us to instead take a table outside, since none of the indoor tables are close to checking out, we respond by saying no and saying we’ll wait for our indoor table. Not even 5 minutes later, the manager comes over and asks for the THIRD TIME, if we can please just get a table outside, I finally oblige. Once he seats us at an outdoor table, he makes a scene out of saying he’ll comp our appetizers (he should’ve done it and not made such a big deal about it), and doesn’t bring us menus. After an additional fifteen minutes someone brings us menus and immediately asks what we’ll be eating. We ended up getting an order of the cod, two orders of rigatoni, and an order of the charcoal spaghetti. The spaghetti was sitting in at least 6 oz of straight oil, and the rigatoni was terribly under salted/seasoned. I was extremely disappointed in the experience, especially after seeing it was a recommendation on the Michelin guide. Will not be returning.
The food was delicious and the service was exception! We had the best waitress, very sweet and attentive.

We went for a birthday dinner and several people in our party had different dietary restrictions.  The base menu accommodated almost all of our needs and additional changes/substitutions were accommodated graciously.  Everything was fresh, the flavors were bright, and the preparations were spot on.  The fried Brussels sprouts were a hit.  Two of us had the black cod, which was excellent and prepared perfectly, and the rigatoni and roast chicken were equally delicious.  The milk pudding (more of a vanilla mousse) with dulce de leche was divine.  We noticed a lot of diners appeared to be regulars and I understand why, we will definitely be going back.
Vegetables, including brussel sprouts and flowering cauliflower, were outstanding. Sweet pea agnolotti was delicious. Friendly and helpful service.
Our server took very good care of us!  Wish their Sangria was chilled in tall glasses instead warm like the ski lifts.

Wow! We had the oysters to start. They were fresh and briney and outrageously good!   The black spaghetti with crab, surrounded by a scrumcious cioppino sauce was out of this world. Will be going back!!
The rice is back!!!  Whoo Hoo! We're not even vegetarian's but the rice entree is amazing.. We also had the steak Bavette and fries asparagus. Sooo good Service perfect...
My husband and I love going to dinner at CAMPER. The food, service, and wine list is fabulous!
We had a wonderful dinner and experience with my family. Love the ambiance, food was fantastic and service was exactly what you would expect for the best restaurant in Menlo Park.

Headed to Camper for a birthday celebration.  Food was outstanding, as was is the service!  Favorites for the adults were the baby lettuces, agilinotti pasta, roasted chicken and the steak.  For the teenagers, it was the brusselsprouts and the cheesburger.
Everything was stellar! Great cornbread, cocktails were interesting and fab, we loved the burgers! The staff was also so kind and attentive!
We had a great experience.  The food was delicious. We were seated right on time for our reservation and the service was great.

When we decided to go back to CAMPER, we did so knowing that we were making a wise choice.   We had had 3 days of power outages, so we wanted delicious and simple.  Our cheese burger selection (a blend of THREE different kinds of cheeses) and the pasta dish were just what we needed.
Our server, Hebib, took such good care of us.  Over dinner we noted that CAMPER was becoming our favorite place to eat out.  A wonderful neighborhood gem that folks should drop in and have a great meal at.
Phenomenal dishes, an attentive staff, great vibe and ambiance, I will definitely return!

The cocktail menu was very interesting and we enjoyed our cocktails.  We ordered Brussels sprouts as a starter, and they were perfectly prepared.  We then ordered 2 pastas because we wanted to try 2 different ones.  The Charcoal Stained Spaghetti with Dungeness Crab was wonderful.  The Buckwheat Strozzapreti with Braised Lamb Sugo was also delicious, and we ended up taking most of it home for another meal (it is very filling).  We will return and try the rest of the menu.
Fantastic food, drinks & service, including one of the best pasta dishes I've ever had!!!

We were celebrating my partners Kidneyversary…5 years from her transplant.

The pickled veggies were crunchy and wonderful.  Then came the soup which was delicious and HOT (just as it should be on a cold night🤗).  The best part was the charcoal spaghetti with fresh crab.  Yum!   We almost didn’t want to share with each other.
We were HAPPY CAMPERS for sure.

We always have the best experience at Camper! The food was outstanding: we started with the cornbread and the Brussels sprouts, which were so delicious! 2 of us had the charcoal stained spaghetti with crab and loved it. Other person had their cheeseburger, which comes with crispy fries that everyone at the table enjoyed! And the other ordered the steak, which was cooked perfectly. We finished the night sharing the S’mores (gooey deliciousness!) and the butterscotch pudding, which was so good. Our server was very attentive and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves! Thank you Camper!

Did not seat us on time, it was a chaos with everyone waiting for their tables. Service was very very poor, Food took forever to come to the table while we watched other tables served food. Waiter was rude and basically told us why are we asking for food and that they are doing their best and that it’s not microwave cooking . Very rude .
Camper is consistently delicious. Love the environment. Love the food. Look forward to coming back soon.
Very good experience provided by the staff as well as a wonderful variety from the menu
Always great food and excellent service - our local favorite!
Totally unexpected pleasure and having the complimentary really good Chardonnay was a wonderful surprise! Thank you so much, Robert!
Their Valentine’s Day menu was a little pricy and very few vegetarian options. I wish they played light music in the background while enjoying our dinner. Overall the food quality was good and tasty.
Cornbread, roasted Brussels sprouts and wine list were the hits!  All great food.
Really nice experience. Food was good and cocktails were nice as well

Had heard good things about this place and the menu looked good. This place did not disappoint. The service was top notch, the ambiance was warm especially during a rainy night.

The Brussels sprouts were delicious. Great accompaniment to some drinks. The cornbread is soft, crispy, and creamy and the butter just elevates it.

Tried the rock cod for the entree which was delicate, flaky and perfectly cooked. The s’mores dessert was the perfect end!
Great experience
Had one great experience here and one average. The cornbread is excellent. Overall a solid choice although a little pricey.
Amazing restaurant, with delicious food! Sat outside which wasn’t awful with the heaters… definitely need to make reservations earlier in the week to get inside!
Always a lovely place for great food, service and ambience.

We chose to sit outside on the patio since it is quieter and the heaters kept us warm. For our group of 5 we started with the oysters, the cornbread with herb butter, burrata and crispy Brussels sprouts. All of them were so so good! Entrees were the charcoal stained  spaghetti with crab ( delicious!) the crusted cod, the cheeseburger and the fried rice, along with a side order of their homemade bread. It is so rare to eat at a restaurant and have everyone think their food was amazing, but that is what we all felt last night. Our waitress was incredible as well. Thank you Camper for a special evening!
Good food, nice service
Service was incredibly warm and earnest. Food was delicious. Grateful to have this in the neighborhood —and open on a Monday!
Camper is an accessible top-rated dining experience. It feels like the neighborhood place and yet is exceptional food and service. It is our go to spot for special occasions and date night alike.
They were busy and good finally! I do not know what’s changed but they finally have mojo 👍🏼

We enjoyed Camper! Kids liked the burgers, my wife the cod and the Rigatoni Ragu for my part. Save some space for the dessert, they are very good too. Our server Victor was attentive and made the evening very pleasant.
Wonderful food. Much better than when we went about a year ago. Everything was delicious

This was our second time going to Camper and it has become one of our favorite restaurants because the food is so extremely delicious and the ambience is so nice. The staff is very attentive and you can tell they help each other out.  This is a great restaurant for any occasion.
Always creative pastas, the best burger anywhere, and interesting cocktails. The service was perfect.
The staff were attentive and had very appropriate timing of visiting our table. It was a really nice dining experience. Food was flavorful and good quality. Definitely going back again.
We celebrated a birthday and lived everything we ordered!  Service was great, noise level was good- we will definitely return
The squash pasta was outstanding, but the chickpea pansisse was dry and not very interesting.  The Bulli cocktail is great for those who love a "spirit forward" drink. Very good service.
The food and location are good. Not crazy about the atmosphere which is a bit of a basic feel.
Marcus the chef is awesome!  Everyone took great care of us.
Great dining experience. Staff was attentive and very kind

We loved the food, service was wonderful and we enjoyed our dinner.
The only negative, which is not the restaurant’s fault, is that both tables on our sides were too loud.
We had not been to Camper in a long time. We thought the food was very good. Three of us shared the steak, butternut pasta and rock cod. All of it was delicious! We will definitely go again.
The food was surprisingly delicious! We will definitely come back again!
I love this spot. I come here as often as I can for their delicious food and kind staff.

One cannot help but being a Happy Camper here on weekend mornings, especially if you love bacon! The brunch menu guarantees happiness whether you are intent on carb loading, green building or protein packing. Love the eggs Benedict with slightly spicy and lemony Hollandaise on biscuit  toast! Our server told us to order the French toast next time.

We had a wonderful meal here.  All three of us enjoyed our entrees: Vera Cruz fish, smoked chicken, and  the tritip. Our starters were excellent too:  Brussels sprouts and the market pickles.  Desserts were good but not spectacular.   Service was excellent.  We had a wonderful meal and dining experience.

This restaurant is a great find. We went with very little information and had a great meal here. The only thing, if you can call it a thing, is that the hard surfaces mean it was a little noisy but just a bit more than we prefer.

I was looking so forward to this.. our last two times had been excellent and so tasty. This time though  it seemed off. Hardly anyone there at 5:30, had to flag down a waiter to ask for a cocktail, and twice for boxes..The menu had changed. Our favorites gone. The Petaluma chicken just ok. The steak very small. (I know meat prices are through the roof)..and it was freezing! The back door was open for the outside diners. need to fix that . Really not fun eating in a overcoat.. not sure we will be back. Maybe give it a try again in Spring.   would we recommend.. Maybe..I hate that they give us a yes or no!!!
Incredible. Victor was great
Great experience! Amazing food and service
It was freezing cold inside. Having dinner inside with a jacket is not a good experience. I heard at least 3 different customers complaining about the temperature.

Excellent food and cocktails that you won't find anywhere else. Tons of infrared heaters that keep the outside space super comfortable. I've been several times with large and small groups and everyone is always happy they went.
Delicious food, I wanted to try everything on the menu! Definitely will make this a regular spot!
Blackened spaghetti could have used a few more shrimp.  Too much pasta and not enough shrimp.

Wonderful food and service. 

We had  the  cornbread & squash/mushroom agnolotti and it was very good. 

Cocktails were also very good.

Highly recommended!
We love camper!

The food was surpassingly perfect bistro food. Strongly recommend the corn Agnolotti is one of the best pasta dishes I’ve had.  The warm sourdough was amazing. And I highly recommend the dulce de leche dessert!  This was a perfect date night experience!
Yummy dinner. Great food. Highly recommend!
Great food and good service.  Our server (Ruth) was really nice!
Very slow service, one of the outdoor seating areas very ugly, the rock cod wasn't very good.

It’s like Camper is trying too hard. The menu is limited with few options for anyone desiring a simple, safe go-to. Even the cheeseburger has sauces that didn’t appeal to the one person in our party who ordered it. Only one of the four in our party thought their entree was special. The service was friendly, but slow and the noise made it almost impossible to hear across the table. All in all our experience was OK, but with the array of dining choices nearby, Camper will not be high on our list.
Food was delivered in a rush. Was just ok

Victor was our wonderful waiter after we were greeted and taken to our table by the manager. The food was incredible. Unusual mixtures of ingredients and spices that were outstanding. My husband had the “Rick special steak” with a mole sauce that was fantastic. High quality meat, so tender and the sauce is but free!  I had a ravioli dish with grilled corn and mushrooms. The combination with the sauce was fantastic. We each also had a specialty cocktail, a margarita and a gimlet and they were great as well. We will be back!
Food and drink are outstanding.
Birthday. Good food, very helpful service.
Terrible service. Our waitress didn’t put our order in the system. We kept waiting for the food for over 30 minutes and she didn’t even notice it
Being from Montreal, I am very picky with my restaurant selection and to be honest have been mostly disappointed since moving to this area. Camper makes me feel like I am in Montreal and I love it!

Cocktails are amazing!  Service was super slow this visit … we received our appetizer before our cocktails and had to ask where they would be coming.  Entree also took a while as well, but we’re delicious.  Luckily the wait staff kept us hydrated.
Food and service are outstanding and we have always been thrilled with our experience at Camper.
Sat outside so there was some traffic noise  The food is good but a little pricey and the drinks can be expensive also. The cod was very good but on the salty side. Our waiter Andreas was very nice

Excellent food! Every course was good. Service was a little slow but like everyone these days they seemed to be understaffed. The waiter (super friendly) warned us at the beginning it was going to be a busy night and he was right!

As always, amazing food and service. Chef Greg has brought back weekend brunch and does not fail to impress! Best BLT ever! Seriously! And the special soft scrambled eggs with caviar & truffle hot sauce….UNBELIEVABLE! We feel so fortunate to have this gem in our neighborhood. Thank you to all the Camper team. You always make us feel like family!
Food was very nice, service too. But it was extremely loud

They served us raw shrimp in the pasta. The new pasta dish they brought wasn't good and they merely took the shrimp dish off our bill (which, duh, is a given). They could have made us very sick and should have done something to make up for it. Was very disappointed.

Great food, outstanding service. We are vegetarian and we found many delicious options. My wine was delicious. Our special occasion was a friends birthday and the s’more was great. Tad bit pricey, Will definitely go back.
We were early birds tonight and had the best service and yummy food! If you haven’t already tried Camper you must!
I was not impressed and I don’t know how this resturant is qualified as a Michelin star restaurant.
Excellent inventive food! Our meal was terrific! We loved it!
My graduate student clients loved everything about Camper!

We started with the burrata which was excellent, along with the dish of olives which included some unusual and tasty varieties.  My daughter enjoyed the rigatoni with pork ragu,, my husband had the smoked chicken and especially liked the mixed vegetables that came with it, and I enjoyed the tri-tip which was cooked perfectly medium as I'd asked.  The Jerusalem artichokes and roasted onions were also excellent but I wasn't as fond of the tomatillos. For dessert we shared a delicious version of s'mores and some vanilla Gelato.  In general the food here is always excellent but the menu is pretty limited so we sometimes struggle to find something we want. But we've never been disappointed as the meals are always unusually flavorful. Service this time was slower than it has been in the past and we had to wait long stretches to get attention but this seems to be more prevalent in our post-COVID world and isn't unique to Camper, certainly.
Everything was fine, nothing spectacular.
Great place to meet a friend for an interesting meal. The best part of the experience is the excellent service.
The food was delightful as was our waitperson! Loved the Limerick Lane zin!

Our dinner tonight was great.  Ruth was very helpful with recommendations from wine to snacks to start.  We had wine with Cornbread and peppers everything was so good. The staff helping her was very attentive.  The camper burgers were good and the scallop entree was perfect.  
We finished the meal with chocolate and raspberry gelato.
Thanks to the economy, restaurant was understaffed.  But the on-site staff did a really good job.

This was an excellent experience that I definitely will repeat. The food was good with excellent flavor and the cocktail and wine selections were all of uniformly high standard. All in all a pleasant evening with great food.
Birthday dinner

While the menu always changes with what’s fresh in the moment, the meal quality is unwaveringly outstanding. There’s a dish for every palette and mood. The biggest challenge is deciding what (how many) appetizers to order. Shishito Peppers and Cornbread are ‘musts’. One might expect food this great to only being served in a ‘should be dressed up’ setting. Among the great things about Camper is ‘come as you are.’
Really delicious food and very accommodating service

Very good spot for a nice meal.  Outdoor dining area is great and inside tables are cozy with a big bar.  We were very happy with all the food we ordered which included 3 starters and pasta.  This is definitely our favorite spot in Menlo Park.

I can’t believe how delicious the food was! Every bite of everything. I want to back as soon as possible. The standouts were the corn pasta and the tri tip. But the eggplant pasta and the plum salad we had were also amazing. Service was perfect. We sat outside on the street on Santa Cruz Ave.
Delicious! Friendly servers! We'll be back, yet again.

Just underwhelming.  Energy and attentiveness of servers was low.  Mailing it in. Lighting needs work.  Appetizers were good. Entree was meh. Solid cocktails.  Place seems to beg for someone on staff to create some energy and raise the bar.  Doesn’t meet up to the price or potential.
Everything was delicious and fresh! The staff was very friendly and I loved that they didn’t hover, giving us enough time to enjoy the food.
Food is great, a little over-priced but makes for a good casual date night. service staff seem kind of stressed

Celebrated our 21st anniversary here with our kids (teenagers) and had an absolutely fantastic evening of dining excellence and fun.  Looking so forward to coming back as soon as possible and my wife also now looking to book her annual staff outing here.
We’ve been to Camper a number of times. Always excellent, especially outdoors.

Camper is the place we take all of our out-of-town visitors. They truly have something for everyone, without the menu being overwhelming. The food is always very high-quality. You can tell a lot of thought goes into the ingredients and the presentation. The atmosphere is special without being stuffy. We like that they have abundant outdoor seating, since we aren't yet comfortable dining indoors; they are also kid-friendly and dog-friendly. We think it has the best bar selection in Menlo Park right now.
Great service and delicious food. Brunch was fantastic. Recommend the French toast and morning bun, breakfast sandwich was also great!

A lot of promise that didn't quite deliver: nice ambiance with outdoor and indoor seating in lovely Menlo Park, and the food was overall good, not great. The pork ragu needed more differentiation in flavor to make it something more than what one could do at home, yet the flatiron steak mole and burratta appetizer were outstanding. What tempered the experience was the service. Waited 10 minutes to be sat, not because of a line but because there was no one attending the host station. And our server needed constant reminding: for beer, water, and bread. Having to be vigilant about whether your server remembers your order definitely dampens one's enthusiasm.

I've visited CAMPER previously and in general I would recommend it. But on this occasion, I was underwhelmed - maybe because it was a Monday? 

The (mostly) good: We were seated in their outdoor parklet which doesn't match the indoor ambiance but doesn't do a bad job of feeling cozy. Two of us had the gazpacho which was excellent; two of us had the bucatini which was ok: a bit drowned in the sauce which sounded interesting as described but was basically a sort of pesto (redeemed by the dollop of stracciatella cheese on top ). One of us had the salmon, not bad but a bit pedestrian for the price. And our fourth enjoyed the garbanzo bean panisse (a dumpling a bit like fried tofu) which was a unique vegetarian option. Enjoyable cocktails (Miss Pippi and Yogi Bear Gimlet stand out), though the by-the-glass wine list was a bit limited we still found something to enjoy.

Subpar was the service; our server was personable but a bit unresponsive and simply didn't rise to create the dining experience in ways I'd expect of CAMPER.

Still, I'd go again.

Camper is always great for some good food.  Love this place but it is a victim of Menlo Park which falls asleep at 9pm.  Nothing against Camper because I know the restaurant itself is great but our evenings always end sooooo early because of the sleepiness of the area.
Food and drinks were excellent and the service was outstanding.

Everything we tried was fabulous! The cornbread, burrata, pasta entree and salmon entree were each perfectly done with care.  From presentation to flavor, all was bright to our table with outstanding TLC and pride of work.  We were suitably impressed.  We finished with the creamiest and most luscious dessert….we will be back!
The food was amazing, so delicious.  The patio isn't super comfortable, hard seats and wooden benches.
Great ambiance.
Food and the service was excellent!!

This is the second time I have eaten here. The first time was on a whim when we were walking by. That experience was much better than tonight.  We were seated by the window and there were two flies continuously flying around us ( gross).  The server Raj was nice but seemed distracted. It’s 5:30 pm and only about 6 people in the place.  It’s empty to me.  We order the shishito  peppers and drinks to start. Everything is good. We order our main courses , Camper burger and the Salmon.  I asked for the burger to be med rare it comes well done.  Come on. This place has a really nice menu and can’t cook a burger correctly. I think most Chefs have a food thermometer on them and can tell what temperature the food is supposed to be.  The Salmon was underwhelming. A small piece of fish in a big bowl of beans and vegetables.  It tasted ok, the beans were not fully cooked either. Some were still crunchy.  We drank out drinks and eat what we could.  The server came back and asked about dessert and we didn’t want to risk it.   
We won’t recommend this again.   Sorry Camper
Excellent food, including a large selection for vegetarians

Although we have been to Camper quite a few times, the experience makes it difficult to justify the prices charged.  The food is good, the service is fine, but the portions are small for the prices charged.  Menlo Park/Palo Alto has lots of different options where the menu and portions seem much more appropriate our tastes.
Delicious, fresh dishes.  Excellent wine.  Attentive staff. Loved the sea bass crudo.
Just fabulous all around.we did go early 5:45.  It did get really busy. Thursday night ,so if being really busy ..or noisy..is a thing go early.food was amazing..especially the rice.
As always, food and service were simply outstanding!
The food & setting were very good (& creative).  The server (Ruth) was very knowledgeable & friendly. Had a fine evening
Waiter was a ghost .... never saw him and bar tender had to serve us. Strange !

We had another amazing evening at Camper outside on their patio. We started with the pickled veggies, pole beans and the shishito peppers… all had great flavor. We also added Campers homemade sourdough bread, which is paired with a yummy carmelized onion butter. For entrees, 2 of us had the burger which was very nice and served with a pile of their crispy fries; 1 had the rigatoni with ragu (also delicious) and 1 had the duck agnolotti, which she said was so good.
Even though we were pretty full, we decided to share a couple of desserts and had the s’mores and the strawberry basque cheesecake… HEAVENLY!!
We are so fortunate to have Camper in our community! Well done!
Excellent dinner. Genuine, knowledgable and very attentive server coupled with fresh well prepared delicious food.
Salmon dish was excellent. Pole bean appetizer was way too salty, but otherwise would have been really good. They took it off our bill.

We sat outside on a warm night and enjoyed the delicious fresh food. The agnolotti and the radiatore were both excellent. The cornbread and salad starters were also perfect. Service was also excellent. Definitely recommend!

Pre graduation dinner - wonderful sourdough bread and burrata… pistachio was a bit spicy albeit tasty and a heavier dish. Salmon had a great flavor but was more cooked than I like. Chocolate s’more dessert was nothing notable- graham cracker crust was too hard to cut with a fork.

Based on other reviews I had higher expectations. We were not impressed with the food so will not be back. Our group had a couple of pasta dishes which were flavourless (had to ask for Parmesan 3 times to even make it edible) and Tri tip beef. Burrata appetizer was tasty but priced at $20 didn’t come with any bread to eat it with. Weird.
Unique menu and very good service!

We ate outside, and created a multi-course meal. First the Easy Fella was a great take on the Old Fashioned. We had interesting appetizers, followed by a pasta course and two of us split a pork chop special that was truly amazing. The services was attentive and interactive. It was a pleasure to spend a few hours drinking and eating. We were not rushed at all, and as the evening got cooler, the heater came on to keep us warm. Delightful experience
Food was good, but portion sizes were small and service was very slow.

Went to camper for the first time and was somewhat disappointed with the service. They were slow to acknowledge us and one waitress came over very concerned if we had been helped yet she could see that we’d been sitting there waiting for a while. I ordered a second drink and it never arrived and the waitress tried to blame it on the bartender, but I am certain she forgot. The food was good, however it did not wow me and I probably would not go back because there are so many other options
great experience, food was delicious, cocktails superb, service sublime!  went for a special occasion and they made it very special!
Delicious food that was decadent without being overly rich or sickening.  Great use of seasonal ingredients.
Camper is our local go to place. Great food, relaxed vibe and lovely outdoor seating.

We came here for Valentine’s Day when they were doing a pre fixe. It was very good then so we decided to come back. On a regular day, the food was just ok. We packed up some food we didn’t finish in a takeout container. We forgot it on the table and came back 10 minutes later and they had already thrown it out.

Our favorite restaurant in the Peninsula for pasta. Highly recommend. 

We sat at the bar and experienced excellent service. 

Humble suggestion: add Nutella to the s’mores dessert.
Main entree of pasta was great, but dessert was truly incredible. Loved the ambience and style of the restaurant.
Nice atmosphere and friendly staff but disappointed by the food.
Food was very good! Intersting and unique dishes! Loved it
Delicious, fresh, great portion sizes, awesome ambience

Wonderful farm-to-table fare, uniquely prepared and elegantly presented, but in a casual, neighborly setting.  Every order was received with oohs and ahs and was loved by all.  Our only issues were with the rather elevated noise level (they could use some more sound baffling) and a waiter who was rather aggressive with upselling.

Pretty restaurant! The starter (crudo) and bread were a delicious start of our meal. Yet the mains were not that amazing. The Ragu was nice but no salt , and the seafood pasta was stick all together and the sauce was a weird combination of seafood sauce and curry . The worst dish was really the basque cheesecake, they cannot call that basque cheesecake were the flavour is completely different and it’s super over cooked. The price is quite high for what you get. Still I would come back for the starter and the bread and give them another try.
Great cocktail menu and fresh, interesting dishes. Enjoyed our dinner out! Would come again definitely for the drinks.

What a fantastic restaurant. We had a reservation on the early side, so I think that’s why the noise level was rather low. Excellent service. Our waiter recommended a great wine and his favorite items on the menu. Food was innovative and tasty. We will be back for sure!

We celebrated out 30th Anniversary at Camper and it was wonderful.  As soon as we sat down they bought us two glasses of champagne which was totally unexpected.  The service was just right, the food casual, healthy and so delicious.  We will be back!

The food was great.  I only knocked down the review for service because they seemed to lose our order.  It was almost an hour from when we ordered until our pasta was delivered.  Our waiter was nice and comp'd us a dessert but it wasn't that crowded.  it shouldn't have taken that long to get our entree's out.

Otherwise great starters and entree's.  Beautiful evening outside.  We will definitely go again.
The food was amazing and the server was very busy but came around just enough times. We will definitely come back.
Always a treat to eat here. Staff is warm and attentive. Food as always was exceptional!
Good time; would definitely go back.
Service and food were excellent! Our first time here for dinner. Will definitely return!
Outstanding all around!
The cocktails change all the time and are insanely good! Thank you for helping me have a wonderful anniversary!

Wine was very bad and very overpriced compared to other restaurants in Palo Alto/ Menlo Park Area. Food was ok, but nothing special. Service was good. Atmosphere impersonal, did more feel like a chain restaurant, lacked some character

Great food & good service - outdoor seating was a bit loud since it is right on a busy street corner but the drinks & food quickly distract you from that.
Our server immediately changed the propane tank in the heater closest to our table when we noticed it went out and we really appreciated that since it was a chilly evening.
Still the best neighborhood restaurant in Menlo Park!
So tasty - one of the best meals we have ever had - not exaggerating!
Love this place. The chef continues to surprise us with his creative dishes, and the care and effort he puts into his food is obvious.
The smoked ricotta cheese was amazing, great value.

Great meal, except my wife found her dish to be bland, no high notes,  sweet, acid, salt - just kinds plodding middle notes.  The fish was well cooked.  The other dishes, the buttermilk cornbread, slightly cooked asparagus, brussel sprouts, cocktails were delightful.  I ended up with a great pasta dish that did have lots of acid, fat, ocean / sea (clams and mussles), and overall loved it.  The cod dish seemed out of character.  Great, attentive service filled our water (and kept track of bubbly and still).
Great food, good value. Every dish I have tried so far is well-crafted. The cocktail program is exceptional as well.
This is a great restaurant. They may be understaffed.
The food was excellent, everything we had was great.  We ate outside and its a nice space with good heaters.  The inside looks very cozy but with covid we stayed outside.
Great foods and service.  Will go back again.

Such good food and great service! Ate on their covered patio, which was perfect since there was a chance of rain and we wanted to eat outside because my friend’s son is too young for the vaccine. Dishes came quickly, and everything was so good!
Delicious pasta dishes, tasty appetizers, inventive cocktails, attentive service, rich desserts, fair prices.
Good old days service and quality dining:)
Our waiter made excellent wine and entre recommendations. All around, it was a great dinner.
Our waiter was very nice. He made extra effort to make sure we were good, and made excellent recommendations
Dinner at Camper was way beyond my expectations.  Both the service and the food were excellent!  The prices are very reasonable, especially in view of the quality of the dishes.  We will be back!

I love this place. It’s aesthetic is simple and it’s food and drinks are delicious. I had the squash agnolotti which was mind blowing. I can still taste it then next day. Our waiter, whose name I think was Azazi, was very kind, entertaining, and attentive. In the past I’ve had their sangria with dinner and it is also delicious. I highly recommend this place!!
Great food but limited selection; ambience is a bit downscale relative to the menu prices.  Nevertheless a place we'll be returning to often!

Delicious fish dish (only one on the menu), well prepared and a generous portion.  My friend had one of the pasta dishes, which she enjoyed.  We sat outside along Santa Cruz Ave and there was a heater, thank goodness!  I think they could do a bit more to make their outside dining area more appealing, maybe even have some live music (perhaps a guitar player) one or two times a week.  The restaurants up the block, Bistro Vida & Left Bank are certainly more fun to go to .  Our server was very helpful and friendly.  I will go back again and try other dishes.
Small menu. Prices high compared to value. Service great. Food just ok. Wine good but small menu by glass. Table comfortable. Covid precautions good.

The two dishes I tried were outstanding.  

One was the Crispy Chickpea Panisse, pasta made of chickpeas.  This dish is vegetarian.  The 'pasta' was made in a cube, nicely 'toasted' and soft on the inside.  A light touch of saffron reminded me of indian dishes.  The other dish had was the Fresh Durum Caserecce.  The Mole Sugo sauce along with shredded chicken and some cheese on top all mixed very well in the dish.  I was very impressed.
Great service, delicious food!

Camper was delish and the cocktails were unique and tasty. The pastas are something special and will have us coming back regularly. Wine selection is great and the staff were very knowledgeable/friendly. Only suggestion would be to add draft beer option and if not possible have a couple of alternative IPA options for the beer lover.
Just good quality food, and cocktails. Must visit.

The food was not very good.  I have the spaghetti with clams, muscles and shrimp.  They either took the meat out of the clams and muscles or bought canned ones, it was very odd, and the shrimp was bay shrimp.  It had no flavor.  WE ASLO HAD THE COD WITH WAS OVERCOOKED. The menu is lacking and boring..
A terrific server who was able to steer us to some delicious menu choices and a nice ambiance created a great evening at Camper.
We had such a wonderful time celebrating Steve’s birthday! Thanks to the entire Camper team for always taking care of us.
Delicious food, great service, creative and tasty cocktails.
Really, really great food, excellent wait staff, hostess was a nuisance but can be overlooked. Highly recommend.
Chef Greg welcomes guests like no one else, exceptional food and creativity, a diner at Camper is a journey across flavors inspired from very diverse cuisine cultures. Always a real pleasure…
Perfect as always!
Food much improved, will be going more often now after what I get was a rocky start.

Love the use of produce at this restaurant. Also the services was great - albeit a little slow but didn't feel too much and wasn't rushed. The team gave us free bubbly at the beginning to toast to our anniversary - such great technique for a good price in a pricey area.
Fantastic food and superb service!
We cannot get enough of this place.  We have been here three of last four weekends.  Continues to amaze.  Good job chef!

It was so nice! Great cocktails, my friend and I had some wonderful array of appetizers and then had a pasta dish for the main course. Can’t wait to come back as I hear the steak is also excellent. tables were spaced nicely outside so you didn’t feel cramped and the service was wonderful!

Just found my new favorite spot in downtown Menlo!

Fresh, innovative, and delicious dishes. Clean design yet comfortable interior with very efficient and friendly staff.  The lentil encrusted cod with coconut curry sauce, greens and zucchini is perfection. The salads are a must accompaniment, either the starter or the smaller side salad. A favorite: the cornbread served with herbed butter (add honey to make it dessert!)

Sat early and presented with 2 flutes with a toastable amount of champagne which was a nice touch for an anniversary celebration.  Waiter was knowledgeable and personable.  Food though was not anything spectacular.  We have the cornbread (good) and gazpacho (good but heavy) and the grilled burrata which was only fair.  Didn't care for the tiny bit of bitter escarole - was it grilled too? - , the smoky cherry tomatoes, and the pain looked fried.  Actually for harvest season, I thought the menu was too heavy on tomatoes.

Once again, a wonderful meal.  We introduced some friends to Camper that hadn't eaten here before, and they were enamored as we were.  We tried all four pastas, and all were wonderfully inventive - and different.  Highly recommended.
The food and service is so fantastic!
Lovely restaurant, very good food (salad was delicious). On the pricey side though.
Great food and environment 👍🏻

The prices are high even for this area.  $22 for a burger which took an extra long time to arrive. All we’re ordered medium rare  all came salt free.
The salad dressing was very bland. The gazpacho was good ood as were the shishito peppers.

Amazing experience yesterday night at Camper, the menu is great and can please everyone, the dishes are really good and sophisticated. The ingredients treated with harmony and the presentation is very elegant. Thanks to Greg and his team we really had a blast! Thank you guys!

Had dinner outside for two. Truly outstanding food -- I had gazpacho, which was some of the best gazpacho I've had, and then Sweet Corn Agnolotti, which had a wonderful balance of flavors and textures.  One can easily tell the freshness of all ingredients and also the care and skill of the chef.  Biggest disadvantage is that the wine list only includes expensive items.
Creative and delicious. Cannot wait to go back and try more!

The chef puts an enormous amount of care, creativity,  and attention to detail into his preparations, and it shows. Plus, they have managed to maintain a high level of service despite the challenges of COVID. It’s always great eating here, we are never disappointed.
We love CAMPER! Amazing service and delicious fresh food. Definitely recommend the cornbread and Agnolotti pasta - our favorites!

Service was very good. Attentive, but not hovering.
We had the cornbread as an appetizer. It was good, not outstanding. If you’re a person who doesn’t make cornbread at home (I do) then it’s probably a special treat. We both had the rigatoni with ragu for entrees and it was excellent. The pasta was cooked perfectly and the ragu sauce was outstanding. The amount of ragu sauce was also perfect & had been properly mixed with the pasta to evenly coat the rigatoni. The only downside to the experience was the occasional obnoxiously loud car driving on Santa Cruz Ave, but that’s to be expected when dining outdoors on Santa Cruz Ave. Overall a positive experience and we will be back.
It’s our favorite neighborhood restaurant!  We go at least  once a month and my kids love the pasta!  Wonderful food & drinks!  We like our host too!
Great dining experience with friends outside. Food and cocktails inventive and farm to table fresh. Robert looked after us and was amazing.

Food delicious, great variety menu, outstanding wait staff, clean, safe and accommodating. We shared the corn pasta and it was fabulous. The drinks were delivered quickly and were delicious. We had a great time.
Excellent food and ambiance but felt like our table was in the “kiddie corner.”

Food was delicious and original.  The Grilled + Chilled commanche Tomato Burrata starter was accented by a smokey cabernet vinegar that gave the usual run-of-the-mill dish, a unique and amazing flavor!  The pickled vegetables served as a delightful snack and palate cleanser and we also enjoyed the shishito peppers with their yummy vinaigrette and tasty crispy shallots.  Main courses were also very well done, the Camper Cheeseburger (definitely high-end) was cooked to perfection, served with crunchy pickled green tomatoes and a special secret sauce that brought all the flavors together.  The Rock Cod with roasted vegetables was crisp and fresh and the Veracruz Rojo sauce accented the dish with its mild spice and vibrant color.  The staff was welcoming and knowledgeable, and though the meal was pricey, it was delicious and fun!

Hostess was terrible and soured our experience from the get-go. Got a corner seat on the University side and it was so noisy as cars accelerated to turn onto the street from Santa Cruz Ave. Table had ants. Overall not a pleasant experience considering the price tag - you’d expect to have a relaxed meal without these subpar facets. Food was ok - no complaints - but prices not cheap, so overall not a good value in my book. Would prefer to spend my money elsewhere.
Great food and outstanding service!!
Very good food and very attentive and courteous service. Prices are a bit on the higher side for the value you receive but then again you are in Menlo Park.
Great as always

No vibe, sat on the side of the restaurant that is detached. No music, candles or anything remotely nice to look at . 
Food was ok. Nothing amazing but for a date night. No thank you

Delicious food in a great outdoor setting! We enjoyed trying the three starters; all were very good. We all also enjoyed our main courses. The corn agnolotti was delicious and the pasta with lamb and also the cod were very good. Portions varied - the agnolotti was a perfect amount for me but might not have been filling enough for my husband. The other two dishes were a bit larger. Wine list was good, but pours by the glass were a bit smaller than at most places. We didn’t have dessert. Will definitely return!
Food too fancy.

We had a lovely time!  Great cocktails, great appetizers and then took a larger meal home to my family.  

The food and drinks are delicious and beautifully presented. 

Can't wait for a next trip to Camper.
Food is delicious.  Menu is small but everything is good.  Atmosphere is elegantly simple.  Servers a bit eager, but not a bad problem to have.
Food quality  not worth the price. If they just step it up even a little bit or lower the price to march the quality.
Dining at camper was a very nice experience overall! Food was good and the service was great. We would definitely recommend.

We had a fantastic dinner last night. They greeted us with two glasses of Prosecco to celebrate our anniversary! Every dish was delicious. The ingredients were so fresh and the hot dishes came piping hot off out of the kitchen. We were especially impressed by the raw karpachi starter… such a unique combination of flavors. Already recommended it to a friend!
Great food and service

While the food was very good, it was the service that made our evening out.  Warm, helpful, and attentive.  The gazpacho was excellent as was the tri-tip and burger.  Their pastas sounded great too, so I guess we will have to come back soon!

Lovely service; only complaint we've had before is the time it takes camper to get drinks down on the table once they've been ordered--last time we ate here, our $140 bottle of wine didn't arrive until well after our appetizers did! This time drinks came immediately and server was highly responsive, which was great. Excellent seasonal entrees--corn pasta fabulous. Dessert menu is lacking--a few pudding/mousse ish options. Could use some cake/cookie/ice cream options to match the solid espresso drinks.
Cool vibes, fresh generous portions, California cuisine yum, terrific service
A very comfortable experience - excellent food and service combined with a relaxed environment.
Delicious, unique food. Excellent, attentive, and friendly service.
Fantastic food and superb service!
We both got sick the next day. It was the only meal we had together and we had the same symptoms.

consistently an amazing dining experience; one of our favorite go-to place in the area; menu continuously has new, unique and tasty additions, while still having the favorites; service is personable; highly recommend

Everything from the martinis to the entree was perfect.  So
Delicious!

The bar is fantastic, cocktails are the best in town. Menu is interesting and has several gluten free/vegan options which we appreciated. Our waiter was spot on, friendly and attentive.
It was definitely more than I intended to spend for a burger, two drinks and a bowl of chickpeas :(.... but covid pricing seems to be inflated everywhere, hopefully once everybody has been able to run at full capacity for a while we'll see a return to normalcy in that regard.
21 birthday

We started with the ahistorical peppers snack, a very generous portion with an interesting vinaigrette and fried shallots on top.  It was a nice twist to an otherwise plain dish.  For my entree, I had the rock cod, which was very well prepared, breaded in a cornmeal mixture and sitting in a pool of spicy Mediterranean sauce.  It was accompanied by a generous mixture of vegetables, which included pea tendrils.  Service was excellent, and they were very amenable to switching our indoor table with another customer’s outdoor table.

Loved this menu as I am gluten/dairy free with low sugar and boy, did I have a lot to choose from. The appetizers such as olives, pickled veggies, cornbread were all excellent. My avocado soup was fantastic. The main dishes left a bit to be desired. I had Petaluma chicken with grilled little gems which was good but a bit bland. It needs a sauce or something. My husband did not enjoy his Cod unfortunately - too much rub he said. Others had pasta (excellent) and Camper burgers (excellent). The desserts left us unsatisfied and there was nothing with chocolate except a gelato, which several had. The service was slow but they had a large private party so that probably had something to do with it. Also my father fell when stepping down from the park-let (we were seated outside). It was very frightening (he's fine) but I think there needs to be a bright strip along the wood flooring indicating that there's a step! It's quite low and easy to miss.

All in all, we will definitely return.
So great! Delicious food and drinks, great service! A gem!

Dined on a Friday night with two people- shoestring fries are great, the rigatoni with the ragú was very tasty, and the sangria was also very delicious. Hot-smoked chicken was okay. Overall a good experience!

We tried a little bit of everything from the salads to pastas to steak and everything was delicious! I’d say the way to go is to order a bunch of dishes family style so you’re able to share and try everything. The menu changes often and they use a lot of locally sourced ingredients. Everything was SO fresh, well thought out, and cooked perfectly. I couldn’t say anything negative at all about our experience as the service was top notch and staff was extremely friendly and helpful in their recommendations. Outdoor seating area was great as well with heat lamps and nice ambiance. Totally recommend this place and will be definitely back for more!

‘It’s about Thyme’ is the best cocktail I’ve probably had in my life. Perfectly balanced in flavour, smell, and experience, with no single element overpowering any of the others. 

The food was delicious and fresh. The wine recommendation was perfect. Can’t wait to eat here again!

We sat outside on the patio under a nice warm heat lamp for dinner starting at 8:15. We got there a bit early and the hostess was very nice and offered us menus, seats, and to take our drink order while we waited. We were shown to our table and our waiter came over immediately to ask if we had any questions. He was very knowledgable and attentive. Most importantly, the food was delicious! We had a couple of appetizers and then split a salad, pasta dish (chickpea panisse), and main course (rock cod) all of which were fantastic. I took a milk pudding dessert home and it was excellent as well. All around great experience, looking forward to going back!
Great food and service priced at what you might expect to pay for quality.

The food was very good, but the server didn't see us at all and it seems she ignored us completely. We had to wait a long time to see her and repeat our request.
Very slow and ignorant!

The food was Awesome!!  We decided to do this family style since we all thought we had the best dish... so glad we did this!

Sitting outside and socially distance meant that we could see others at the restaurant but honestly we did hear them much.  We had a wonderful dinner and evening!!
Fabulous. Excellent food, service, wine and cocktails. They deserve 2 Michelin stars in my view.
The food was fantastic! We especially loved the shoestring French  fries.

Love their and their outdoor seating area

Our server didn’t seem all in us  - we asked about different wines and he didn’t have much information

The food was amazing. We got what we needed whenever we asked for it but our waitress seemed uninterested. We never were asked how is the food after it was delivered or would you like anything else. My hope is that something bad didn't happen to her earlier in the day.
Staff was amazing food was amazing highly recommend

This was our first meal out after our vaccinations and our first visit to Camper.  We had a table for two along the sidewalk which wasn't too busy and made for easy conversation with the quiet noise level.  Service was great - friendly but not intrusive and paced perfectly.  We enjoyed our food very much - the burrata with puffed quinoa and greens sounds odd but was a tasty and interesting dish.  Drinks were also delicious, though pricey.  We would gladly return here for another meal.
Wonderful, innovative food prepared by chef/owner. So glad it landed in Menlo Park.
Great place with excellent food and cocktails. My wife and I love dining here.

Would give half a star if I could. Unfortunately overall poor experience.  Food was bland. We had two pasta dishes that were very plain and tasteless.   No meat in either pasta dish. My Negroni at $18 was supposed to be straight up.   It was Campari on ice with a twist of lemon.  The bread was a small wedge of cold bread for $7, not sourdough.  The shisato peppers were soggy and oily.  Needed salt.
The waiter was very nice but clearly not trained. They cleared the table and placed two out of four entrees down immediately.   Without resetting the table.  The food cooled as we waited for eating utensils and other entrees 
Would not recommend.   Overpriced and haughty.
Are outside so can
Staff was VERY rude.

A perfect dinner spot. Came here with good friends and stayed for almost 4 hours. Adorable and cozy outdoor seating. Food was perfect- not too heavy, but perfectly indulgent. Everything was amazing! Can’t go wrong with the chicken or pasta.

We had a great experience this time, good food , drinks and service.  Food has improved a lot, I am glad we gave this place a try again since is in our neighborhood and we eat out a lot.  The host in the front not very friendly:(
Great food and great atmosphere.

We were there for 2 hours and 15 minutes on a Saturday night, and we didn't even order dessert.   Food came out too slowly.  The roast chicken came out cold.  Pastas were good.  Service was good.  Difficult to execute in these COVID times.  Worth another visit in a few months after things have settled more into place.

We ate in the dining room for the first time since the start of the pandemic. Everything felt very safe: tables were spotless and distanced. The windows were open and so the room was quite well ventilated. As, usual, the food was delicious. We especially enjoyed the burrata appetizer and our go-to order of fried rice.
Camper is my favorite go to on the peninsula. Thanks for another memorable meal!!
Wait staff great/personable and interaction with the bartender was outstanding.  The food was OK, but not something I'd say anything like "I gotta get back here soon"
Great place with original and tasty dishes. Relatively expensive, especially given the smallish portions.
great place to eat and have enjoyed dining both inside and outside.
It was our anniversary and they welcomed us with a small glass of their house brut. It was a lovely touch. Excellent waiter/service and very tasty food and drinks. Will definitely return.
Consistently good service and food
The food was just okay. They give really small portions and the price isn’t worth it.

Great seating outdoors right next to heater that was needed as the sun went down. A gin and a bourbon cocktail started our night and were delicious and creative. We split Rockcod and a filled pasta with fresh peas. The rock cod is one of our favorites and was hearty over a bed of lentils. The pasta was light and fresh. Ended by sharing pudding and a delicious decaf coffee.  

Great service and friendly staff...all in all a great evening
Love camper! Love the food - and service is wonderful.
Camper has some of the best pasta around!  We were disappointed with the very high $40 corkage fee.  That’s significantly higher than similar restaurants in the area.
Only downside was the hefty corkage fee.  $40 is excessive!

Camper consistently meets and exceeds our expectations.  Yet again my husband and I had a wonderful dining experience. Andres was charming and professional.  The hostess was super friendly and accommodating and the food and cocktails were superb!! LOVE this place!!
We’ve tried Camper several times and find that it’s always a little “off” in terms of food and overall ambiance.

We celebrated a birthday dinner inside. The decor is a bit sparse, the indoor seating obviously restricted due to 6' limits. With the windows required to be open it provided a nice inside/outside experience, though a bill chilly on the night we were there. Service was very friendly and immediately attended to drink orders. Wine list is sufficient, full bar. Menu is small but interesting. We ordered the fresh black cod on greens and it was well prepared, reasonable portion size and delicious. Overall, an enjoyable evening and very good food.

Menu changed and they took off some of their signature dishes such as bone marrow 
Table was not ready outside and they put us at a table next door 
They never came to refill our drinks 
And we had to ask for a wine list 

Food was OK — really gone down hill since last time

Our server Robert was amazing.  He was very kind, attentive and made sure we were warm and comfortable in those very awful chairs that the restaurant is providing during Covid.  one of the managers was disrespectful to us, we are  not sure because we were NOT white or because we were women.  But that's the reason my review didn't get the 5 stars.  that woman had no idea how insulting and unprofessional she was to us and my sister.  not recommending this place for the food or the ambiance. never again.
Afraid to say for my local restaurant, but nothing exemplary and kinda overpriced for what you get.
Service was great, food wasn't as good as usual. Got a burger with fries and fries were cold. Cod was meh. Chicories salad was tasty but overdressed.
Food is amazing. Do not miss the cornbread. Or burrata. Or burger. It’s all really great
I was with my two kids and husband. We loved the food and the service!!
Really good food excellent service beautiful restaurant

Tables were a little close for our comfort level, so we moved our table a little further away. For both appetizers and dinner, they brought out the wrong dishes to us at first and then corrected themselves. For dinner, they brought out my husband's food and then proceeded to tell me they were out of the dish I ordered, so I had to wait another 15 mins to get my food. I really liked this restaurant pre-COVID but we won't be returning.
They are doing a good job of outdoor dining.  Service very good. The menu is always been a little limited but the pastas are great
My husband and I loved the steak and cod and service and happy refresher IPAs! It was a treat.

Camper has been our neighborhood pandemic paradise for all special occasion dinners. Such a treat - we are so grateful for all the care and amazing California creations Logan and the team continue to up their game with new fabulous menu additions all the time. Homemade pastas, the festive cocktails and decadent desserts not to be missed.

We just moved to Menlo Park and were so excited for this place to open back up! The ambiance was perfect for a cold February night - They had a variety of heaters and lights.

The food was delivered fast and was AMAZING! We both got pasta dishes and an appetizer to share. Our waitress, Brenda, was so nice and welcoming!

Excited for this to be our new neighborhood spot!
The best  restaurant in Menlo Park
Incredible outdoor dining experience with very safe COVID protocols being followed. Had excellent service and our waiter recommended delicious options,
Wonderful restaurant! The dinner was absolutely delicious!
Fantastic food! Fantastic service!
Love this place. Best, most interesting pasta around.
The best  food good wine exactly what are looking

The food took an hour to come out, when it did the chicken was dry and beans weren’t cooked. We weren’t seated on the restaurant but in a shop doorway two doors down, it felt very cold and isolated. Not the experience we were hoping for and not what we’ve had previously at camper.
Food good , not great
the food is aways amazing. Fresh, ever-changing, great emphasis on local. Unpretentious, yet awesome.
set outside on the patio which is aside from one with lights - ambience was just ok, food is  good.
Intended to celebrate the election results. Fantastic service! Seated at a table in the street that was cold and not as nice of an atmosphere as the nice built out deck.

Amazing cocktails and wine list. The nicest staff around. Total angels. They have the french tradition of truly making you feel at home and welcome. The food is magnificent too! Everything is fresh and seasonal. A rare gem in the area!

Outdoor dining on a chilly night with a reservation and our heater did not work.  Never asked if we wanted another glass of wine and never refilled water glasses.  Food was good, but not exceptional.  Probably won't go back.

The service was horrible. The waitress had an “I can’t be bothered” attitude. We had to flag her down for everything and there was only four tables. We also had to remind her several times about our drink order. I won’t be back.
I did not like our seating next the stop sign.  Car head lights were constant distraction.

This was my second dinner at Camper in 2 weeks.  I find the food to be delicious and consistent. The brussels sprouts are unbelievable as is the cornbread. Portions are generous and it's fun to share and try several dishes.  
The outdoor dining is comfortable and romantic with string lights surrounding the perimeter.  Our server, Robert, was outstanding! He is very knowledgeable about the food and ingredients and always has great recommendations.

Indeed farm to table, fresh product, but nothing really outstanding: decent cocktail, starter of pork pâté was disappointing, main course of steak was good, and service was expedited, nice & friendly but not very attentive, a little bit on the "elephant in a china shop" side...

Same price range as other restaurants we value a lot in the area, but not really justified.

Not sure we will come back
The burrata and corn were outstanding.

The food was fantastic!  Everything was cooked perfectly and the flavors were all just so good. The server was super nice and as a staff, they did their best but the pace of service was a bit off. Food could have been timed better and the drinks were a bit slow to arrive. However, knowing how all the restaurants are understaffed and doing their best to flex to new ways of working, I wouldn’t hold this against them.

Their menu is very unique.  It takes me a while to decide but I am always pleased with the results.  

With Covid we are sitting outside and had the extra good luck of our table looking into the art gallery.  I hope they invest in some good heat lamps so it extends the outdoor dining through the winter months.

I did miss the smoked ricotta cheese served with their yummy bread.  I usually buy a loaf to go.  They had the bread but were out of the cheese.  The cook was kind enough to tell me that he was making it again next week and if I called  he would save me some.  By then I will probably have to buy more bread to go with it!🤣
I loved sitting out front on the patio enjoying Camper’s delicious food! Don’t miss the freshly baked sourdough bread... it’s amazing! Also loved the fried chicken sandwich .
We are on the patio and it was perfect.

Camper was a great new find for us with top really good and elevated comfort food and cocktails.  We haven't found many places like that that really deliver on the Peninsula.  It was a great evening out for our family.
Very friendly and knowledgeable wait staff willingly to make adjustments to the menu; fresh delicious food!
Street dining is hard but they did a good of job as possible. We will be back!

Outdoor dining on a Saturday evening.  Very comfortable and very good service; staff and guests all obeying heath dept directives perfectly.  Excellent first courses.  Super interesting pastas; maccheroni with ragu Modanese excellent.  Would go back in a heartbeat.
We liked the farm to table veggies and the fresh baked sourdough.

Great, slightly surprising, set of dishes with a locally-sourced emphasis. We enjoyed the restricted menu, and look forward to returning when things can open up again. Dining outside was very pleasant in August. High quality selection of wines by the glass.
Great food and friendly service. Chef Greg and managing partner Logan are terrific. Important to support local restaurants.
Fantastic dinner!  Logan runs an amazing restaurant (despite COVID).  Thanks for being open and offering a delicious dining experience!
Love the food  at this place. The outdoor dining space which has been created is very pleasant
Love the homemade pasta dishes!!!

Camper has an abbreviated menu with outside dining.  The food is very good,especially compared with other local choices, with a lot of effort given to the preparation.  We have dined there in the past and will continue to go there for a nice meal.  I think that there wines by the glass, red and white, need help.  Have tasted 4 and none offered much in the way of fruit or oak, but they were bitter.

Weird bucatini pasta: overcooked and awfully bitter clam sauce (never a good sign with seafood!). The gazpacho was not bad but the salad had old leafs and such a spicy dressing that it was inedible. At least the Shishito peppers and the burrata did not do any more damage to the dinner but absolutely nothing special. Extremely disappointing and way overpriced.
The best authentic Italian pasta in the peninsula or South Bay 😀
Great dinner from start to finish- wonderful drinks and truly delicious food. Can’t go wrong go coming here!
Food was very good, in particular the burrata cheese w/ cherry tomatoes and sourdough bread were awesome.  Service was great and very covid-safe!
Delicious food.  Tables spaced appropriately outside for COVID.

One of our favorite restaraunts in the Bay Area. The food is always fresh, the outdoor seating is well positioned, easy parking nearby, and amazing menu that changes a lot. Nice to see Greg and his team adapting to the new way of feeding people.
Just what the doctor ordered.  The perfect "date night".
I don’t know what they did but the food is waaay better than before. Super fresh, great flavors, accessible pricing. Well done!

Wonderful set up.  All safety precautions taken. Food was excellent except my husband didn’t care for his pasta dish. When he mentioned this it was taken off the bill without asking. Would definitely dine here again.

All ingredients market fresh. Pastas were remarkable in taste and presentation. Staff friendly proficient and professional.
Enjoyable evening in safe environment. Menlo Park should consider making Santa Cruz into a mall and give needed option to sustain our local restaurants /chef and staff.

We were with family who do not live together and they were very accommodating about social distancing. Food was excellent with unusual dishes. Good drinks too!  Servers had masks and gloves. 

One thing tho - when we were leaving, I noticed a lot of folks were not wearing masks - and they were not eating
Excellent food and cocktails. I appreciate that they have some outstanding vegan options.

We had a reservation but were to be seated next to albeit with some distance from a large and loud group of guys. I would suggest that the large group be on the smaller part of the patio and smaller groups of 2 or 4 on the larger size. The staff expressed concern that we asked for seats in another area, since they do save the patio for those with reservations. As the group drank more and got louder, we were glad we chose the street seating!
Also, while homemade ketchup may be good, it isn’t bad to have an alternative!!
Excellent creative pastas and pizza, with great service and interesting cocktails. Love this place.
We enjoyed Camper's new outdoor setup; it was very comfortable from a COVID safety standpoint. Staff was great, and it is one of our favorite menus.

Food was amazing, it was a pleasant warm evening, so dining outside felt very comfortable 
Always great imaginative cuisine combined with great cocktails a fantastic wine selection

Camper, in my opinion, is one of the best restaurants downtown Menlo Park has had in decades. The food is outstanding without the restaurant being pretentious. I have not had a single bad experience at Camper. I love that it feels like a cozy neighborhood eatery and the staff are super friendly and well informed of the menu offerings. I also adore their cocktails!

While we are all ensconced in our homes during this challenging time, please consider ordering takeout from your favorite dine-in restaurants. If you haven't tried Camper, please do!

Food was ok, but we got fish that was super “fishy” tasting and were somewhat underwhelmed with the steak. The sleeper winner of the night was the impossible burger! 

Had a couple of service issues where we were served the wrong meal that was then immediately moved to a different table (not really COVID-19 friendly). It also took a while to be served to start.

We had a great time.  The food was delicious and the ambience was lively.  We also enjoyed the cocktails.  The dessert and dessert cocktail was a highlight for us.  Our service was acceptable but nothing special, which is what we typically expect at this price point.  However, the food and drinks are worth coming back for!

Attentive service, good food. Dining room mgr a bit heavy handed — would come by frequently, just after we had ordered drinks or dessert or more drinks and ask the same thing the server had. Could be more unobtrusive.
We were in a cozy booth with friends who had a stroller. It was a great spot to bring kids.

The service was slow and to get the attention of the many servers that were floating around was difficult. First time we ended up standing up waving our arms to get their attention, the second time I physically got out of my seat and went up to a server to ask for something .

We split the salad which was huge!  It was OK, nothing really special.  My wife had the Rock Cod was OK.  I had the Bavette, ordered medium rare but was more rare which would normally not be a problem but is was very "chewy".  The accompaniments were OK.  Our waitress was terrific and our water glasses were always full.  The noise level was very loud.  Both my wife shared each others meals and both of us had some post meal discomfort the next day.
