It was a good experience but we could tell this newly opened restaurant is still working out a few kinks here and there.  The food was very good overall.   It was a weekend night and kind of noisy to have a conversation without effort.   The lighting needs some tweaking as my wife was in a shadow that requires her to use her cell phone light to read the menu while I was in bright light of a spotlight.   The wait staff were very nice and attentive overall, but a few times they didn’t seem to know who had the ball on our orders.   To be really clear, we has a good experience and I’m simply providing constructive feedback on what to improve to make it a 5-star experience for us.

It's just their first week--I'm sure they'll iron out the (very few) kinks soon. We have another res there in several weeks and we're excited! The food was great--delicious, delivered at proper temps, reasonable portion sizing and beautifully plated. Kinks: took 10 minutes at the beginning of the meal to get drinks to the table; once patrons are seated, pour water. Once bottles of wine are ordered, get them out and poured! It's tough to kick off the evening when you're chatting at a table with nothing but menus and napkins... Second kink was plate delivery--lots of waiters hovering at the table with plates, unsure who had ordered what. We all ordered red meat entrees, and because waiters didn't know where each plate went, our entrees ultimately got confused. My husband's dry aged medium rare ended up with my brother in law, who had ordered flat iron medium... Third/final thing--we were seated in the back banquette area... Service is very attentive but with the neon exit signs, glass exit door that people are actually using, and the walkway to the bathroom, the ambiance back there definitely suffers. We'll try to sit at the bar or in front next time!

The food was excellent but the service and kitchen were struggling. We met the chef Greg. We like to go to SF for good food and service, he wants us to be able to experience the same quality at peninsula
 We will definitely try again for good food .
too loud...one wouldn't think a "camper" theme would be so loud.  Expect the atmosphere to be more subtle and easy going.

Camper just opened and I get that. I always give a place a few tries. The place is so pretty and the owner and manager were charming and gracious. The bird seed crackers were fabulous. The caesared deviled eggs were just all right and you better love anchovies given the size of the piece right in the center. The eggplant dip was fine, as was the burrata/tomata salad and the green salad, which was visually stunning. Nothing I would order again other than the crackers. My drink, The Pescadero, was light, lovely and perfect! My friend loved her red Burgundy and had two glasses, which she never does. I will go back to try the entrees. I will say that I am an accomplished home cook, so going out for roasted chicken and salad, even when wonderfully fresh and beautifully prepared, doesn't excite me. I think the farm to table, rustic concept, while new to Menlo Park, is starting to feel boring to me. That said, the restaurant is gorgeous and I am sure people in Menlo Park will love it.

Fresh food.  GREAT flavor. Unexpected combinations (Heirloom cucumber +plum salad ++++) and familiar favorites  Bolognese, burgers.  Contemporary and 'clean' offerings with zero pretense.   Greg, Logan and the team are  a welcome addition to Menlo Park.   Great to be greeted by Josie.   CAMPER will quickly establish itself as a 'neighborhood gem.'

Great new restaurant in Menlo Park.  Food is tasty with interesting combinations of flavors and textures, fresh and balanced.  Mixed drinks are creative and there’s a great wine menu too. Definitely a new staple in our dining routine.

We went as they were just opening but everything was great. All the pastas were amazing. Everything looked beautiful and tasted wonderful. There are a lot of options for vegetarians and lots of great small bites and very nice vegetables. We didn't eat a lot of entrees because we filled up on pasta and appetizers. Desserts were tasty as well.

Enjoyed Camper twice this week during the pre-opening. Drinks were delicious (recommend the Indians Summer served up) and the cheese fritters we’re off the charts. The team is warm and friendly and the environment is relaxed but polished. Already the best place in Menlo Park!

So excited to have Camper in Menlo Park.  Been waiting a long time for great food, great service and awesome atmosphere to come to this corner of Santa Cruz Ave.  Can't wait to get back and try the rest of the menu.
A delicious addition to downtown Menlo Park's dining scene. Local farm-to-table cuisine exceptionally executed with friendly service.
Salads were delicious!

name: Agave Mexican Bistro
description:
Family owned and operated, the Agave Mexican Bistro in Mountain View, CA is an award-winning establishment noted for authentic Mexican fare and incredibly popular margaritas. The seafood dishes at Agave Mexican Bistro are also a customer and community favorite.

Menus at the Agave Mexican Bistro include happy hour, lunch, dinner and a children's menu. Each features a huge array of authentic dishes, and anything can be made to your preference in terms of heat and spiciness. There are starters, chef's favorites, specialties, burritos, soups, salads, traditional platters, shrimp specialties, fried classics and some stunning desserts to top it all off. Many dishes are vegetarian, or can be made vegetarian on request.
hours:
Mon–Thu 11:00 am–10:00 pm
Fri, Sat 11:00 am–11:00 pm
Sun 11:00 am–9:30 pm

reviews.text: This was a test dinner before we invited friends in April. Definitely the best sauces, chips, menu, margaritas and service we have had around here. All set for April and more.
Another wonderful meal at Agave. Food was delicious, service was friendly and impeccable.  Highly recommend.
Really good Mexican food and wonderful service.  We have been going to Agave for years and are never disappointed.  We love going to Agave.
Food was a bit pricy but it was wort it. Our waiter was excellent.
The food seems mass-produced.  The shrimp didn't seem particularly fresh or tasty.  Everything was pretty generic.
The food is nice, a bit overpriced for the quality though.
Well made drinks, friendly servers and excellent ceviche

Not great service. Decent Margaritas.

Nothing crazy the would drive me back. But also nothing that would stop me from coming in.

just kinda eh.
Very loud and underwhelming food.  The drinks were good.
Great food, but way too noisy - couldn't talk. Overall creative foods. Would go back.
Great food. Authentic Mexican food. Good value, huge selection  of tequillas.
Chips and salsa were delicious.  Our main dishes tasted great.  Agave makes wonderful sauces.
Great options for Mexican food, but service can be slow.
Great upscale Mexican food!
Great food! Lots of veggie options! Great service, good for kids or groups or even a date!

I had passed by this place very often, never stopped by.
finally had dinner here, and was impressed by Food, ambiance and service.
The food is always superb. "different and tasty recipes. The best margaritas ever. Just a dry reposado with freshly squeezed lime juice hmmmm

Food was not that good, and service was pretty bad. We had to ask twice for our check. It was a slow night, and all four servers seemed more interested in socializing in the corner than attending to their tables. Fish Tacos were not good, flan was pretty good.
The best Mexican food in our area.  Delicious sauces.  We've taken friends twice and they loved it too. Parking situation is the biggest drawback.
The food was good. We are vegetarian, and we were provided ample options. The service was simply awesome. Enjoyed my dinner.
The service was very good. Unfortunately the food was not .

Excellent Restaurant, i like it so much. Great Service.
Excelente Restaurant, me gusto mucho el servicio, muy recomendado

We were enticed to Agave after reviewing their menu, and noticing many unique menu selections.  My wife is a shrimp lover, and was able to taste something very new and unique in the "Camerones Ardientes", which she loved.  I am a freak for "Enjococado" which I have had a a sister restaurant, and always order as it is so good.  I was convinced to try something new in the  "Cochonito Pibil" a traditional Yucatan pork stew simmered in achiote.  I was not disappointed. 
Service was just as impressive as the food.  A great find and we look forward to future trips.

My wife and I are thrilled that so much of what we loved over the years at Fiesta Del Mar is living on at Agave.  The friendly waiters, great food (mole and guajillo sauces) and good drinks will bring us back on a frequent basis.  We also love the queso fundido!

The food was great and exactly what you would expect from this restaurant group. Best chips and salsa around. Unfortunately, our first server was lousy. It took a long time for him to check in on us so we ended up ordering our drinks at the same time we ordered the food. Even though our waiter was still in our general area, another server dropped off the food before we had our drinks. I think the guy that took our order totally forgot about us. The second server was able to get our drinks quickly, but it was very disappointing. Chips and salsa just don't taste right without a margarita!
Not that impressed of menu for first time visit. It was okay.

Started at the bar with great drinks and talented bartender. Moved outside and we're able to satisfy a vegetarian, a meat liver, and so eine alerguc to onion and garlic. Food was fantastuc, custom ordered, and all with a smile. Great sense of humor in our waiter. Incredible coffee afterward. Great safe bet for an incredible time

Great service and fantastic Mexican food! 
We came here for my wife's birthday. What a great experience! The food was delicious and the service was great.

Had a pretty pleasant time at Agave. I was craving fish tacos, and they totally delivered. The service was ever-so-slightly slow (just in the waiting for the check after plates had been cleared, food & drink was prompt). Overall good experience; I'll be back.

Great spot!  
The atmosphere is fun and casual.  The outside patio is great on a warm evening.  
The margarita list is long and can be tough to choose your drink since they all sound good.  I've tried several and have not been disappointed.
Fish tacos and mole poblano are my favorites.
Friendly and attentive staff make this a great place!

Excellent food tasty and well made and presented
Vegetarian options were also wonderful
The food and service are OK here (nothing to note exceptionally), but they do have a great Happy Hour special. :)  Otherwise, it can get pretty pricey, pretty fast.
Was the worst food one can imagine. We would never go again.

Food was good enough.  Service was just fair and it wasn't that crowded.  Had to ask for more chips and then check.  Probably won't be back because there are so many better Mexican restaurants in the area.

Three of us were seated in the outdoor dining area. Since It was a very nice afternoon, We really enjoyed the patio. Our waitress was nice but a little overwhelmed. The margarita was weak but the guacamole and chips and salsa were good. We ordered shrimp enchiladas which was not very tasty, just ok. I might go back just for outside seating and chips and salsa next time but the food was nothing to crave again.
Very nice to find delicious Mexican food - far from the generic stuff found in most places.  My flank steak was cooked perfectly.
This is not your usual Tex-Mex or American version of Mexican food.  Agave's chef prepares dishes, the names of which we are familiar, in a creative new way.

Good food, with an unusual choice: shrimp with huitlacoche, a corn fungus, sometimes called Mexican truffle.  It's tasty, although more like a mushroom than a truffle.  They also have a good tequila list and very good margaritas.  Service was prompt and cheerful.

I appreciated the interesting dishes on the menu and had a really hard time deciding what to order.  When I did decide, I was really pleased with my entree, and so was my husband with his, but I wasn't really wowed.  Drinks were yummy, chips too salty.  If you're on Castro and need some Mexican food, this place will certainly fit the bill, but I don't think I'll be back.
Yummy food. Delicious margarita.  Super friendly staff. Nice clean shiny ambience

We've eaten at their Fiesta Del Mar location and wanted to try something upmarket. This location has a better ambience and a more eclectic menu but the service was poor. It was hard to get the attention of the waitstaff and they brought the last person's entree when the rest of our party of 6 were halfway through eating ours.

The food and drinks were good enough. I enjoyed the meal with my date.
The service was fast and friendly.

However, the food and drinks were very expensive. It is not a fancy restaurant, yet dinner for two people came to $80.

Can't recommend because of the prices

Our group of 8 ladies have been here quite a few times for happy hour. NEVER AGAIN. We arrived at 6:00 on a Monday night. The website said happy hour went until 7:00. When we got there we were told it was really 6:30. They no longer allow you sit outside if you want happy hour prices, so we had to sit inside where it became extremely loud. The portions were LITERALLY 1/2 the size they used to be so we had to order twice what we used to - so not really happy hour after all (you do the math). It was really hard to get any attention to order anything. Even when we could get the waitress to come over, she only took the order for ½ of the table & we had to wave her over before she ran off so we could order too. A server dragged a napkin that was covered in bean dip all along the side of my friends thigh/leg. He did apologize, but didn't even offer a napkin to clean. I had to go ask for a wet cloth. Our waitress was nice, however after 6:30 she never came back (we stayed till 9:00). We would have easily had 1 or 2 more drinks each if she had asked. We even had to go get our own refills of water the rest of the night. To end on a good note, the food & drinks were very good, but we will definitely have to find a new place do spend our money.

We were going to a show at the performing arts center, and went to Agave without knowing anything about it.  We were so happy when we saw the menu bNothing like a 2 page tequila menu surrounded by healthy, authentic, fresh Mexican food.  We told the waiter the kind of tequila and margarita that we like, and he recommended the perfect cocktails from the menu. The food was excellent. Portion sizes were enough, but not so big that it sat heavy in our stomachs. The bonus was that we found parking for the performing arts center before our dinner, so we were able to walk right to the show with no hassle. We will definitely go back!
Great ambiance and food! We enjoyed our window seat and had a great meal. Thanks!
I had to walk up to the cash register to pay my bill because no one ever came to our table.
The only problem we had is that the waitress told us that the tortillas for both dishes were in the same basket. There were only two. When we asked for more, they brought out ... two.

Place seems to be confused about what kind of restaurant it is. Parts of it feel like they are going for a fine dining experience, other elements like all the tv's make it feel like a sports bar and then the high dollar items with the relatively low cost items, don't match. You could easily have one person spend $15 and another spend $40 with very little difference in the meals other than the price.

They seem like they just opened but from looking at yelp, they appear to have been open for awhile. From seating us, to getting us menus, and silverware, they just seemed lost, like no one has ever actually shown up for a reservation on time before.

Food was ok, I mean nothing was wrong with any of it, but it was all pretty average. Would not come back unless I was just trying to watch football with the guys or something, would definitely not take a business group here or a date. Just too many better options for mexican food in the area.
Agave has great food and kid friendly. Super fast service.
Santiago was a great waiter. He was very attentive but not overly so. Food was great. I have the grilled fish tacos.
I took a friend to Agave for her Birthday, she lives close by but had never gone there. She loved it! The Snapper Tacos were excellent, she will be back soon, she works down the street.

This was a randomly selected restaurant from Opentable. We had reservations for 5:45 but arrived earlier. The restaurant was not busy and the staff was exceptionally kind. They seated us right away and got us started promptly. After we ordered, the local crowd started to pile in. The ambiance changed into more of an evening spot. The sound was louder and the staff was busier. The football games were playing all around which made it feel like a trendy bar meets authentic Mexican restaurant. 

We enjoyed it very much and for three guests, with cocktails, spent $80. Not bad! 

I would stop by Agave again in the future. 

Thanks for taking care of us!
Very interesting and different menu.  Absolutely delicious. You have to try this place
Met some clients here and it was great.  Food was delicious.  I would recommend this place.

Drinks were great, food was spotty, service poor.  Nice outdoor patio, though.  Specifically, the food that was good was great, the food that was not, was cold.  Have been there twice.  Service poor both times.  Food inconsistent.  Outdoor dining fun. Would go back again just to try and get it all right, because it would be awesome if that happened.

Enjoyed the location in Mtn View, unable to accommodate a simple food request. Asked for a chile rille no a la carte and they could not do it? Took us forever to get our check. Employees seemed very disorganized.

Our experience had none of the negative issues that others noted on this site. The bartender Sergio was very welcoming and outgoing, the patio dinning was relaxing and we did not have service issues. The food was very good and not the usual Taco / Enchilada style you find in most Mexican places. Will be taking friends back often.
Nice friendly service to compensate for mediocre food and drinks.

I took my three sons here for dinner last night.  It's not a fancy place, so I expected to be there about an hour.  It was actually well over two hours.  Our waiter materialized about once every 20-30 minutes.  After being seated, it was a 20 minute wait for first contact.  Order drinks, another 20 minute wait.  Order appetizers, 20 minute wait.  Order mains, 30 minute wait.  Order a second margarita, never came.  Then another 30 minutes to get the check.  And it's not like it was a pleasant place to hang out and chat:  it was so loud we could barely hear each other even when almost yelling across the table, two feet away.  The food wasn't terrible, but Chipotle is better, faster, cheaper.  Never coming here again.
Excellent Mexican Food - well prepared and served - Delicious Sangria. Very nice casual dining experience -
The food here is amazing. Not your typical Mexican fare. Service is great and a very nice outdoor patio!

Very good food. I had the seafood soup and my husband had the steak. Both were delicious. Service was so so. Started off odd it was like we had 2 or three servers or they couldn't decide whose table it was. once we got our food, the staff disappeared. I had to go up to the bar and get a waitress to give us the dessert menu/get a to go box. Very good food, but not the best service staff. Everyone more than happy to pitch in even if we were not their table.

Was looking for some Mexican food prior to going to a concert at Shoreline.  Our party didn't know anything about Agave, so it was a total shot in the dark.  We were all very impressed.  Food, drink, service, all very good.  Not your traditional Mexican food, but more of an eclectic, fusion, contemporary flair.  Had dinner right at opening time, so atmosphere was somewhat subdued.  Would imagine it to be more energetic later in the evening.  Restaurant located on Castro Street which has many good restaurants---this being one of them.
Made every member of a party of 10 happy. With apps, main and pitchers of margaritas it was $40-50 each, well worth it. Loved sitting outside under the heaters.  Can't wait to go back.
We came here for Mother's Day Brunch, and I must say I was very pleased. Great selection, kid friendly and kind wait staff made it a wonderful morning
We were a group of 5. Each one of had a different dish and each one was great. Margaritas were delicious too. Waiter was a lot of fun and even the owner even stopped by to chat. A great night!

The entrees are reasonably priced, as I had the Salmon viva Mexico; my friend had the same, but vegetarian style with portobello mushroom. We each ordered a margarita, with different tequilas -- both with salt and on the rocks. Both were really nice. This place can get a little noisy as the crowd thickens.
Very disappointing! We had confirmed reservations for a Sunday evening dinner for a group of 7, but the restaurant was closed! We enjoyed delicious Thai food from two doors down instead.

This place has two sections (i.e. combined two shopping spaces for the restaurant). The section with the bar has better ambience: more light, bis TV screens on the walls, etc. This is a good place to watch sports as they have big TV's all over. The food is OK, nothing too great.

The maragaritas were very good. Not too sweet. The fish tacos were the best I have had for some time, White fish battered and fried with cole slaw, black beans and white rice. The carnitas were prepared a little different. The pork was slow roasted and then the portion to be severed was pan fired to add crunch and was served with a sauce that complimented the pork well. I highly recommend dining at this restaurant the next time you visit downtown Mountain View.
We had a good time. Margaritas were great. And the ceviche! Our server was fun and charismatic.
Phenomenal selection of margaritas. Great food... Although I wish they had a Fajita option.
agave is a good spot to check out for mexican cuisine. i've been there 3 times and always had a good experience.

So strange to see such a cavernous place so empty, yet it offers great food right downtown in Mountain View.

Flavors are good, spiciness at the right level, and menu offers good selection.

Why aren't people flocking here for lunch?

Lunch was inexpensive, I had juevos racheros and they were excellent. Two kinds of salsa for the chips. Good service. The coffee was excellent too. Everyone in my party was happy. Good place! The only downside was that the lunch menu was somewhat limited, but next time I will have to try dinner!

Had dinner on the patio. The service was great (although the bus boy seemed to be in a bad mood, but the waiter more than made up for him). Had the combination plate and everything was delicious. The patio is cute and festive and a great place to have a nice dinner. They brought us our own heat lamp right next to the table which was wonderful. The place was so good I went back for lunch the next day to watch the America's cup. Bartender was fabulous and friendly, food was again delicious. You need to try this place.

A couple of friends and I decided to go to Agave because it had great reviews. The food was great and the their signature jalepeno and guava margareta was good too. What kills my image of this place was the poor service espcially from the hostess.

Stopped by on a Friday night for dinner. There was an extensive list of Margaritas, tequilas and sangria. A delicious basket of chips and two salsas were brought to the table. I ordered a Margarita, my companion ordered a sangria, both were tasty. I ordered the carne asada tacos with corn tortillas, they were delicious, but a bit light on the toppings, I would have liked to see some salsa, pico de gallo, cheese, perhaps I needed to upgrade to the next taco on the list. My companion got the chicken soup. It was beautiful and fresh tasting. Giant TV screens on the wall did not detract from the décor. I would definitely return.

A friend and I ate on the back patio. Food was delicious, especially the salsa. The margarita menu was intense. I ordered the waiter's recommendation and it was great. Tried a different 'rita for the second round...seriously, two page list of tequila.
Handmade tortillas and great food - and soccer on the big screens inside which is a bit incongruous given how good the food is. A great place to eat.

Met three friends there for dinner and drinks. We ordered drinks, waited 25 minutes, then walked up to the bar and asked the nice guy behind the bar where our drinks were. He apologized and immediately made our drinks and brought them to us. The fish tacos were very good, as was the calamari. Given the food is not cheap, the quality was high so made it worth it. But the service was terrible. We then ordered two more rounds of drinks from the barman, as our server had vanished. The barman was great and personally delivered our drinks. We were low key, undemanding customers who expected fair service. Cocktails were lovely and the atmosphere good. Would we go back? Unlikely -- Castro st has a lot of restaurants with great service.

The service was great. Wait staff knew how to ensure your meal was memorable. If only the food lived up to the service. Don't get me wrong the food was good, just not spectacular. Which meant the food cost seemed high for what you got. They should reduce the food quantities, and raise the quality.
High end Mexican food. Lots of seafood options. I was most impressed by their courteous and rapid service.
the service was OK, the drinks are great but the food was mediocre. I will go back to try some other stuff and most likely at dinner...stay tuned :-)

It was a very quiet Monday night for Agave and the servers were very friendly and helpful. They gave (good!) advice and opinions when required but were otherwise unobtrusive. The food was above average; in particular the calamari appetizer was excellent.

I went to this place twice last week. First trip was for a business lunch, which gave a great impresssion in regards to the service and food.

Which led me to make a reservations for my son's 13th birthday party. I had a total of 11 people for the party. The food was good, no doubt, but you think for 13th birthday party, they would at least provide a small cake or dessert to acknowledge the birthday celebration. My son was really disappointed. I hinted to the server 3 seperate times....and wanted to charge me for a small desert...after spending over $400 dollars that evening.

I wouldn't go back there for a special occasion, but maybe for a business lunch.

This was the first time for the two of us and we had invited two other couples. The guacamole is prepared ahead of time. Most good restaurants have their guacamole made as you order. The food is tasty but would not go back as the service is slow and the chef is not accomodative.
I dined with a group and we sat in comfy couch seating in the back outdoor patio. We loved the firepits on the tables. The food was excellent and we had a great time.

I've been going to Fiesta del Mar for ages, and have always enjoyed it. Fiesta del Mar has great food, great service, and great drinks. I hoped for a more upscale version of that at Agave, Fiesta del Mar's sister restaurant, and didn't get it. The food wasn't very good (the chicken was dry, the chorizo flavorless), the service was weird, and the drinks were inexpertly made. I'll stick with Fiesta del Mar.
Went with a small group for a mid week meal. All our dishes were pleasant.

Very good food -- lives up to its tagline about being where Mexican meets CA cuisine -- regular meal-like servings (meat, sauce, vegetables, starch) with a mexican flavor. Far from Tex-Mex. Dining room is cheery and service was excellent the night we were there.

The brunch at Agave was terrific. They had a buffet that included traditional breakfast food (e.g. scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage) as well as some Mexican dishes (e.g. Cochinita Pibil, Pollo Asado, Carne Asada and Chiliquiles). There were also trays of black beans and rice. All superbly seasoned. Unfortunately, they offer the buffet brunch fo special occasions though they do serve items from the menu.

the food and service was amazing. brought my mom for mothers day brunch and she absolutely loved it. great outdoor patio with plenty of sunlight or they have multiple umbrellas to keep you in the shade. simple menu and very attentive staff. would mos def come back.
We really liked the decor. Everything was clean, earth toned, and fit the mood. We'll come back.
...with my daughter-in-law, she chose the venue for her birthday lunch. It was wonderful choice.
The beef churrasco was fantastic! My husband said the mole was superb. We all particularly enjoyed the coconut ice cream for dessert.

Not sure what happened, as we are big fans of the other restaurants in this group (La Fiesta, Fiesta del Mar Too, etc.) but we did not have a positive experience dining here. Extremely slow service, mediocre (at best) food. To be fair, when one of our group didn't touch much of her dinner, they took it off the bill. But overall I hope it is just startup issues because I will avoid the place for now. We will continue to dine at the associated restaurants.
Nice place to lunch and good bar - a little above average for lunch. Came here for dinner - it was ok; a little pricey for what was offered. Will recommend for lunch

Food was just ok. I expected more since I had heard it had great food but not so. Of the four of use that went, two of us were just ok and the others said they liked theirs but not big deal. I thought it would be slightly a notch above but not so for my dish. I like La Fiesta better.
Great new spot on Castro, fabulous tequila selection
Good food, good margaritas. , friendly waiters. Agave should get rid of the TVs - detracts from the ambience.
Went for Valentine's day - very enjoyable
Consistently good! We have been several times. The camarones a la diabla is my favorite! Shrimp cocktail was good and a very generous portion.

Place was practically empty at 630pm on Saturday evening. Owner was very nice as well as attentive server. We ordered the steak special which was bland, fatty,cold and undercooked. Enchiladas were ok but not warm enough. Would give it a B-/C+
Most dishes are a little pricer than similar restaurant but the carne asada is good.

I really really wanted to love this place ... we went on a sunny Sunday afternoon in February. We were in between lunch and dinner, and the service was poor. Our waiter was nice, but nothing really ever got delivered properly. The food was ok.

Margaritas were great, but I'm not even sure I would go back just for a margarita. It was "fine" but really expensive for what it was. I hate not loving it!

Went there for lunch. Place was empty at noon but they've only been open for about 6 months. Had the Veracruz Fish which was good, red snapper with peppers and a hint of sweet. Tasty. Margaritas were good too. I think they missed with the interior design though. Feels a little cheap while the menu is more upscale Mexican food.
i love this place, is fairly new but that food was grate and the staff were very friendly. we were celebrating my wife`s birthday and she was very happy. i recomend agave restaurant.

Empty on a Friday night (never a good sign). I immediately noticed the 4 or 5 tvs in the small main dining room, which were playing soccer. I don't mind bars or grills that play sports games, but a restaurant with $24 entrees shouldn't have quite so many tvs. If they sold $6 taquitos, well, sure, but not $24 shrimp! Anyhow, my husband ordered a taco combination, which was delicious, and I ordered the cremoso chicken enchiladas, which weren't bad, but were quite unusual (and the sauce looked like peanut butter). The rice was ok, but the beans were a bowl of brown water with perhaps four beans. Guacamole was delicious. Just kind of an odd experience.
Imaginative specials if you venture off menu. Recommended. We had a seafood lasagna (wait, thought that was Italian? But it was definitely Mexican) that was amazing.
Margaritas were great and food was good. Wanted better chips and more salsa though. Service was lousy as it took about 15 minutes to even get our drink order in.
Nice presentation, just ok taste - many dishes tend to be a tad too sweet.
Good food; ambiance nil. Not a place to take someone on a romantic date.
Not impressed with ambience or food . A big disappointment! We enjoy their other restaurants and this doesn't compare. We won't return. Nice employees who were very attentive!

It was our first time there. Our server Kevin went above and beyond. We were celebrating a birthday with a larger group and he was so attentive from beginning to end: welcoming all the guests, explaining the menu and serving us with a smile. A real discovery were the "quesadillas jamaica" hibiscus flower filled quesadillas with a delicious avocado dip! Yummy:)

I've been going to Fiesta del Mar literally since the day their original Shoreline location opened 20 years ago. I have always appreciated it as a great family place, and go there every chance I get. When I heard that the owners would be opening a bit higher-end place in downtown Mtn View, I was thrilled-- they are great restaurateurs, and Castro Street is still a few first-cabin restaurants away from being a really great spot. Our first trip to Agave last night was a real treat, and I'm looking forward to many, many more dinners there.

We got to Agave a bit early for our reservation, and were seated promptly by the very good hostess. I was impressed by the interiors (though I don't think the wide-screens showing college football qui
Very authentic Mexican food with excellent flavor

Food was very flavorful. My main complaint is with
Their timing. We felt rushed, they brought the main course
Minutes after our appetizer was served. Then picked
Up the check before the other couple had time to
Put their credit card down. The place had many free tables
So they weren't worried about turnover. Our waitress was nice
They just need to slow down. Will try them again.

We've been fans of Fiesta for years and tried Agave for a birthday celebration. It's a very different feel -- larger space, big-screen TV's, bar seating. We had the asparagus appetizer, the chile relleno, and the halibut special, all of which were excellent. The pickled veggies to start were good, although I prefer the more traditional chips and salsa. Margaritas were good, too, although we had a hard time tracking down our waitress to order seconds. As a vegetarian, I wish there were a few more entree choices on the menu.

I went to Agave with a group of friends. We chose the place because its association with Fiesta del Mar. The menu was different although some favorite items from Fiesta were also offered at Agave. The prices also reflected the upscaled decor. We were there on Wed night and the place was not packed and the atmosphere was relaxed. Overall an enjoyable experience but we missed the vibe at Fiesta.
Food is excellent and I will be back often. I'm a Fiesta Del Mar fan for many years. Agave is very close to being as good.
VERY CLEAN RESTAURANT, POLITE SEVICE, TASTY AND GOOD FOOD

Came here for dinner on a Saturday night. It was a little emptier than I expected at 8pm but it livened up as the night progressed. The food is very tasty. My wife and I enjoyed the calamari for starters. It was fresh and crispy. Main courses (salmon and enchilada mole) were very good. The mole was fantastic, we couldn't get enough of it. Our server was also very knowledgable about the tequila's they had. He was able to provide me with a good recommendation for my meal. I will be coming back

I've been going to Fiesta Del Mar Too for well over a decade and love their Margaritas. Their bar was full last Friday evening, so we decided to try out their new restaurant: Agave. The bar was empty up until 5:30pm or so and we just picked a table for dinner instead. The menu was glorious. We couldn't get past the yummy sounding appetizers so we didn't even try an entree. The queso fundido and toastadas de tinga were to die for. I love cevhiche and theirs was not bad but not my favorite (I like bigger chunks of fish and not quite so much spice). Still good though. We had nice strong house margaritas served up and they were perfect. I've found a new favorite spot in downtown Mountain View!

New Mexican restaurant in Mt. View. Focusing on being a tequila bar?... the list for tequila is larger than the food list. Our "up" margaritas were tasty but warm... not good for a bar. We ordered guacomole and calamari to start. We were surprised at the crispness and non greasy calamari that was crusted with coconut - a keeper! However the guac tasted medicinal.. like bottled lime juice was added :(.Chose a combination plate. In general the food was middle of the road.. carne asada .. tasty, white rice... hmmm i TOO BLAND... needed salt, none on the table... chicken mole enchiladas had nice sauce but water boiled chicken!

This is not your typical Mexican restaurant - you won't find burritos or flautas on the menu, but rather some delicious meals that require a bit more prep time and create some unique flavors. The restaurant menu is still in flux, this place is that new, but my husband loved the hangar steak and I loved my combination plate (carne asada, mole enchilada and roasted chili relleno). Chips and salsa are extra, with pickled veggies being the complimentary dish. I loved the smoky chipotle salsa more than the ranchera one, but understand that not everyone likes spicy (as the chipotle salsa can be). Outstanding service, love the plates and margaritas!
They have a great list of margaritas.
Great margaritas!
Upscale Mexican. Food was very good and service was great. Wait staff was very attentive and eager to please. You could actually taste the tequila in the Margaritas! Great first impression.

I can't say enough good things about Agave! This place is fantastic! The food is over-the-top outstanding. Not your usual Mexican fare, they serve unique combinations of flavors and ingredients with beautiful presentation. Try the fish tacos or any of the camarones (shrimp) dishes. I like the shrimp Alex that boasts a perfectly blended chipotle sauce. The homemade Mole sauce is just great, especially in the chicken enchiladas. If you want something special, go to Agave!

Service was great , food was delicious and will go back. I highly recommend it to our friends and family...
I love the fish tacos and my husband had coconut shrimp yummy.....
This was our first time at Agave. The food was fresh and innovative. we will return.

Still working through a few opening kinks but all in all a good experience. Creative dishes with the freshest of ingredients. Every dish we tried tasted wonderful, the margaritas were perfect. The staff friendly and helpful, never had to ask for anything or waited to be served.

Although they are still getting their legs underneath them, I'm really happy Agave has come to downtown Mountain View. The food was *outstanding* and there were plenty of options for meat eaters and vegetarians alike. The decor in the dining area could use a little work (not bad, just nothing special) and when the outdoor patio is ready, it will be an even better addition, but it's clear from the start, Agave will be a great addition to Castro Street.

name: Chevys Fresh Mex - Union City
description: Making the best Fresh Mex food from scratch, daily! Whether you’re with friends or family, there’s a fiesta waiting for you. No one beats our Every Day $4 Happy Hour, $3 Taco Tuesday, Kids Eat for $1 Wednesday & Weekend Brunch with Bottomless Mimosas! Join us for Good Food & Good Times.
hours:
Brunch
Sat, Sun 9:00 am–3:00 pm
Lunch
Daily 11:00 am–3:00 pm
Dinner
Mon–Thu, Sun 3:00 pm–10:00 pm
Fri, Sat 3:00 pm–11:00 pm

reviews.text:
I’m so glad Chevys is now taking reservations!  This restaurant is always crowded on Sat night, so I’m grateful for the reservation.

The food is always awesome and the chips are always yummy.  The guacamole was extra good
Good experience to hold retirement lunch for colleague.
Always a wonderful Experience Good Food  great Service

An absolutely perfect dining experience! I visited with a group of eight friends, and from start to finish, everything exceeded our expectations. The service was impeccable—attentive, friendly, and efficient. Our food was cooked to perfection, and the chips and salsa were served promptly, fresh, and delicious. The highlight of the evening was the thoughtful birthday celebration, complete with a fantastic dessert and a cheerful birthday song. Every detail was handled with care, making the experience truly memorable. Thank you for an outstanding evening—we’ll definitely be back!
Nice and quiet to have a conversation. Service was fast.
Open table is the best hands down. Make the reservation and boom that’s it!! Can’t believe I have t used it until now!
brenda, our server was very nice!  we had a good time! thanks

Food took a long time to come out but it was understandable since it was very busy(valentines day). Food was good the waiter was nice although he was very absent. 
Over all it was a very good experience 4.5☆

Great service given the Valentine’s Day madness, our server was busy but made sure we were ok when she could. Food was good as usual.

I hated to see people being rude to the wait staff because some things were taking a little longer-unaware of what’s going on around them, I would like to see how these same folks react in the same position.

Waited 40 minutes for our food, only to not be able to eat due to witnessing unhygenic practices happening in the kitchen 😵‍💫. Management seemed more upset about us witnessing the event than she was about it occurring in the first place.

In my opinion, the food is not worth the price point. I ordered the fajitas and I haven’t been to restaurant who doesn’t serve guacamole with fajitas. To top it off the staff is preoccupied talking amongst themselves to actually serve and do their job. If they aren’t talking amongst themselves they hide from the guests, they will glance at you to acknowledge that they see you but will ignore you.

Making a reservation using OpenTable was the best decision for this meal, since we were surprised by the Sunday crowd at this particular location. While it took awhile for the food to arrive, our server Sergio G was amazing! Not only did he bring us chips and salsa right away, he was very descriptive when we asked about the Happy Hour food items. Sergio was attentive and friendly despite how busy it was at the Bar Area where he worked. Lastly, when the food arrived, our chicken fajita entrees were cooked just right and still sizzling and smoking hot (temperature wise). This was one of our best Chevy's meals ever! Thanks Sergio and everyone at the Union City location.
Unfortunately I don’t think there’s enough staff at this restaurant. We spent most of the time waiting for food and drinks. Staff was very friendly, food was “okay” but not worth the $$.
Chicken fajitas and enchiladas were great quality! Service was friendly and prompt. Ambience - it’s high time they change their seat cushions on the booths.
Haven’t been here in a while; I was starving so it hit the spot

Service was great as we were seated right away. The host was wonderful. The food was great except for the fish tacos I ordered. Fish was a little chewy and salty. Probably won’t order that again. Drinks were great as well.
Great place to go but always pretty noisy.  I guess part of the ambiance.

We had a server who didn't show up for a while. When she did show up she took our drink order and our food order. Then left for about 10 minutes. Came back with the drinks and  she had 3 other tables (1 was a large party). She kept coming in and waiting on the other tables. We had to keep asking for more drinks. Then we noticed the people that came in after we do, were served and we were still waiting. Then she came over after we were sitting for an hour waiting and said the manager will be over in a minute to talk to us. The manager came over and said we compt part of your meal because the kitchen kept getting our meal wrong. I asked him if our order was ever put in. He replied, yes, they are just having trouble with it. I am not happy with our experience this time at Chevy's.

Quickly seated even  tho it was earlier then booked time. Moderate wait time for meal delivery as restaurant was busy for dinner crowd.  Employees were friendly, fresh chips & Salsa & beverages were served promptly . Bar area was quite busy even tho it was 8 pm, televised local sports & our GSW Warriors were playing!
Food,  drinks and service was wonderful.   I'll b see back, then happy hour prices were great.

Unfortunately this location seemed severely understaffed. It took 25 minutes just to get a waiter to come over to our table to put in a drink order. Our food came out before our drinks did but the food was overcooked, burned, or cold. It was not a good experience at a restaurant we usually enjoy going to for its consistency. This may not be the location to go to if you’re looking for a Chevy’s to eat at.

My fiancé and I had a great experience here last night for dinner. Brenda, our server was amazing and gave great customer service. The food was delicious, and we love the salsa and chips as always. We look forward to coming again.

Our server barely came around, never given got water refilled. We were there al 1 hour and 45 mins ( not by choice) Food seemed like it was sitting under heat lamps for a long time. Waitress messed up my  order and my husband had to wait over 10 mins after everyone else’s food was out,  for a his dinner which was a salad. I told them we had an 18th birthday girl and they never came and sang. Tortilla machine was broke.
We had poor service, long wait times and had to basically serve our selves

We were prompted checked in via my Open Table reservation, actually seated 15 min earlier than scheduled. Fernando was our server & was friendly & courteous. Meal came timely & so was the check, which we redeemed the Bday Xperience Reward.  It  is a restaurant brand reward program which we love how it works & frequent this location for meals & even work lunches.  Happy Hour bar environment creates a nice fun gathering place & drinks & apps are good. Ample parking & Mgr is noticeably present to make sure operating needs are smoothly performed.

Our evening began by being greeted by the most  pleasant young man of a host. We were shown to our table then Jennifer, our waitress greeted us and promptly took our drink orders gave us time to decide on our orders. The bus boy was prompt in bringing chips and salsa to the table for our table of 9. Our order was taken by Jennifer and the food was delivered, all 9 orders correct! We were celebrating a birthday and the staff did a great job in helping us celebrate.
I wish I would have gotten the bus boys name, he was personable and timely.  But more importantly when I paid my bill at the table I unknowingly dropped a $5.00 bill behind my chair, the bus boy noticed it, picked it up and returned it to me. I didn't see him or the $ but the honesty of this young man was so refreshing in this day and age. I just feel badly that o didn't get his name.
I just hope Chevy's management will read this and recognize him for his honesty.
Chevy's did a great job in helping us celebrating our friend, Pat's birthday!

Waited 15 to 20 minutes at my table and was never acknowledged or greeted by a server. The tables around me were being serviced during the time I waited and still no type of acknowledgement that I was sitting at the table, not even eye contact. I wasn't the only person waiting for a server. The guy sitting at the table behind me went up to the host stand and explained his similar frustrations. I didn't stick around after the table to the other side of me, who was almost done with their happy hour drinks, got a basket of chips and a side of salsa from a server who chose to still not acknowledge my table.

Went there for brunch and ordered the crab and shrimp omelet. It was delicious! The waitress was very friendly and made sure the mimosas glasses were filled.  The Manager was on top of it checking in to make sure everything was good.

Always have a good time dining in here
Excellent food
Our meal was great. However, our server forgot about us! All the other tables were being looked on frequently, but we couldn't get anyone's attention for drinks and chips and salsa!
First time using OpenTable. Chevy’s was really busy on a Friday night.  Employees tried their best on this hectic night.
It was a good meal at the bar. Nothing to write home about.
Worst service I’ve ever received. Server had to be called to table 3x.
The server was GREAT! The food was good too! Will go back again
Food was great, service was not. A ton of people working, but literally all just running around like chickens with their heads cut off. Restaurant wasn't even busy.
Service and food were excellent. Was very easy to make reservations for a large a group of 6 people.
Can’t complain for the price. Workers are over worked but kind. Will be back. You get what you pay for and I’m 100 percent ok with it!

Restaurant was not crowded yet we were shown to a table outside, where the waiter began arguing with the seater that he didn't want people outside he had too much work to do. It took 45 minutes for us to receive our food, no refill on drinks no refill on chips. The music was so loud it was impossible to talk. Overall a terrible experience

5/12/2024- This was out 1st time doing a Mothers Day Brunch at a resturant.  I recieved the email for the adversitiment and made the reservation for 11am.  We did get there on time and they were not set up for us yet (party of 9).  It took our waiter 45min to even take our order.  It was only after the manager (we assumed in the black suit) came to check on us and I stated it was 45min in and we have not been asked for our order yet).  We were under charged (but YES, we over tipped) and it was actually very sad.  Our youngest (10years old) was served last and he even had to ask for his food (he just got the corn dog bites).  Our waiter told him that it was sent to another table.  Our brunch took over 2 hours from start to finish.  We even had to ask for the fruit that was on the brunch menu (that we did order off of) and we also had to ask for our desert that was off the brunch menu (that we ordered from).  We did not have any alchol, but maybe we should have.  The food was ok, it just took forever to get there.  We were just shocked when the youngest kid's meal was the last to the table

Usually we have a great service here but this time it was terrible . Took forever to get a waiter , food took an hour to come out , once the food was out we had to wait for tortillas and by the time that was brought our food was cold ! We love chevy’s but this was a bad experience

Our Mojito and frozen Margarita were delicious beyond words. They paired fabulously with Chevy’s warm and ultra-crispy chips and yummy salsa. We shared a sizzling fajita combo — shrimp, carnitas, steak and chicken — that was outstanding!  It came to the table crackling hot. We scraped clean the black iron cooking plate so as not to miss a bite of the carmelized onions and peppers. We rolled outta there totally blissed out. Chevy’s, despite your closing lots of locations — boo hoo — the Union City restaurant was superb in its attentive service and fabulous food! Thank you!
food was good. Service was good, even for a busy Sunday afternoon. the freshly made tortillas have been a family favorite for over 20 years.
Overlooking the attentiveness of your server. It is possible when savoring the taste of your choice of entree.

Great food as always, but the restaurant was extremely busy and it was hard to get the waiter's attention. My fajitas came but it took 10-15 min to get the tortillas. The fajitas should be delivered with the tortillas. When the food server brought our food, we told him about the tortillas, that we need more napkins, etc. He never returned. We had to wait for the waiter to come by and he was extremely busy. The only thing I would do better.

We are regulars but this trip was a bit disappointing.  The food continues to be good but service was really bad this time.  The waitress was slow, I had to hunt her out for things we needed and tables went unbussed and general conditions of the restaurant was poor and dirty with food on the floor and stains on booth cushions.

Got their pricier fajita  (FLAMED MIXED GRILL FAJITAS) which included 

Steak which was too tough to chew,  

Chicken (overcooked and burnt), 

Carnitas which was overly salted,  

Shrimp was undercooked
the fajitas was called Flamed which I never saw except for how hot the vegetables were!

Our waiter was very attentive. Food was great. We split our meal and he was happy to provide an extra plate without our even asking. He kept our glasses full, the chips and salsa kept coming while we waited for our meal. Great experience!
Didn’t have tortillas. Ran out of chips. Rice was hard

Our server was nice.  I ordered the “surf and turf” Valentine’s set dinner.  I was eating my chicken taco and I bit on something hard, so I spit it out and found that it was a NAIL/SCREW!!! I was so disgusted and didn’t eat the rest of my food.  Good thing I ate the enchilada first which was good btw.  The manager took $10 off our bill. Thank you, I guess.  He was like, hmmm I’m not sure how the nail got there.  I’m pretty sure it didn’t walk there.  SMH 
Funny,  our server said that the table next to us also found something in their food.  It’s concerning to hear that.
Well we ordered some food to go the server never putted the order in.
Food was great. Service was Meh!! Person who took care of us wasn’t attentive . We had to ask for water, cutlery etc..

Had reservations for 5pm on 1/27. Got seated 5 mins late but the biggest issue was we waited more then 30 to get a server come to a table we actually had to find someone. At no point did we get offered water or anything word say someone will be with you shortly! The table next to us immediately got water & their order taken, they had double amout of people After finally getting our order taken we wait another 45mins  for food & water! Again we had to go ask for another server or at least someone to bring water.. we finally got our food & no drink because "the bar was behind" we had a bottle beer & a house margarita real simple drink & didn't arrive until almost end of meal!
its been a while since visiting & we will most likely not return back! we were excited to visit for my sisters birthday but the experience just left a damper on the evening
Great food and service . We enjoyed and will be back

Pleasantly surprised.  I reserved a table for 7 to meet with my sales team at 10:00 a.m. on a Saturday. The lady at the reservation knew who I was before I could introduce myself and led me to the table.

The entire staff was accommodating and friendly.  The food was delicious, and my team enjoyed it very much.  They were patient with us and didn't rush us out of the restaurant.  It was a very good time. I noticed the suggested tipping was moderate. This was nice, and with the good service, I was willing to pay the higher tip amount.
They ran out of Steak :( Although it was Christmas night.

Another great dinner at Chevy’s! Since it was Christmas Eve, it was a little quieter than usual, but that was a plus for us. Service was good, and food came out in a timely manner. Love the shrimp fajitas!
My kids loved meeting Fred Warner, they always love going to Chevy’s but now it’s that more memorable for them.
Our server was very helpful with our decision of choices

For the most part I usually get good service at this location but they were busy so I guess that’s why the ball was dropped, it was my boyfriend’s birthday so he decided to eat at Chevys. We sat in the bar and were there for 20 minutes with absolutely no service, no chips and salsa, no water and then a couple came in and was attended to immediately, so we decided to leave and go elsewhere

Im sorry that I have to actually write a poor review today.  We were seated quickly but bejng attended to was another story! We werecseated in the bar area for brunch.  Chips and salsa were given quickly.  Our waiter finally came, drinks and food order were placed.  Now the waiting begins…drinks took forever.. Food also and incomplete! Had to flag acwsiter down and then was never communicated.  Finally!! Our waiter came and we told him and then we wsited some more.  Pancakes came snd were not churro but just tegular buttermilk.  Still had to remind about coffee refulls and bottomless mimosa refills.  Had to wait even longer for check and we were not checked on.  Not sure if I will be back.  Ghe food was lukewarm warm and not tasty.  Chevys please do better.

The food was cold and disgusting, the service was horrible. Aside from taking our drink/food order, the server never came over to check on us to see how our food was, if we needed anything. We had to have someone find him to get anything we needed and especially the check. Absolutely horrible.
We had crispy chicken flautas and shrimp fajitas and they were fantastic!!
It was way to loud could not wait to get out of the restaurant started giving me a headache
Service was excellent food lacked flavor steak too rough chicken too dry and no seasoning on food

We did not get to eat there. They were not opened at the time the reservation was scheduled, which was at 8:45.   At two minutes after nine they ￼still were not open I tried to call. Nobody answered they could see me standing outside the door. I was very disappointed and I let all my pals on Facebook know as well. ￼ My reservations by your services (open table ) was at 8:45 and they (Chevys) were not open. ￼ This was one of the Sundays, I actually look forward to having breakfast there because I had a show to do all day yesterday.
Came for brunch! Seated promptly! Laura the  waitress was very attentive.  Great coffee & food! Would definitely come back!!

I had an Open Table Reservation and with the Restaurant being slow I had to wait to be seated . it took 10 minutes to get water nevertheless Chips and Salsa. I finally order and my large order of Mixed Grill Fajitas came with 3 Tortillas. I placed an order for a Raspberry Brisk tea and that took 10 minutes ￼to get to the table. The rice and beans were Salty. i was very disappointed in my belated Birthday Meal . The Service and Food were major disappointments.
it was my birthday. I got together with my girlfriends, and it was interesting.

The food was good, but I felt the seevings were small.

There was a surcharge added to my bill, which I didn't notice until I left the restaurant.  That's ridiculous, considering how much the bill was.

I'm not sure I will go back. Paying a surcharge to eat at a restaurant is ridiculous and good business practice. This should be mentioned before we order.
Excellent food and service. Always helpful and everyone always work as a team to serve clients.

The smothered burritos and taco birrito were burned. A soda cup was chipped so it was leaking. Our server was nice. The alcoholic beverages were watered down!! I drink occasionally so one glass is all it takes to give me a nice buzz. I had 2 Cadillac Margaritas! Nothing happened. So sad.
Service was good but the food was mediocre. Bland food and nothing to ad flavor. Didn’t have hot sauce. Ordered the veggie tacos and chicken tacos. Drinks were good but took forever to arrive
Great service by the staff and food is always on point!

Service at Chevy’s has gotten horrible. We waited a long time for someone to take our drink orders. Set up outside is nice, heaters. But service was terrible. Took 20 mins to get acknowledgement. Then after that’s it just took longer.
Enjoyed a great and delicious breakfast with excellent custoner service at the Union City Chevy's on Valentine's Day! Thank you Chevy's staff!

With the second closing of outdoor seating at restaurants we have been waiting for the outdoor seating to open up again. I really like going out to eat. When bringing the food home it seems to get soggy, so I like it better to go to the restaurant and eat there.
Awesome day to eat outside for a birthday lunch celebration.  Service was excellent.

First night open after Covid shutdown, it appears they were a bit unprepared and/or understaffed. Wait time a bit longer than usual. Never saw waitress after order was taken. Food was lukewarm when we got it and got cold really fast. Not helping was the fact that outdoor heaters were really more ambience than a source of heat.
The food and service was great!! We were warmed outside by a gas heater so it was very comfortable despite being a chilly day.
Wonderful! Special Day!
My birthday it wasn’t what I remember celebrating here before
Go late afternoon 2-3 for few diners. See if Blanca is working, she was wonderful
Ordered off seasonal menu, did not care for either beef dinner. One dish was supposed to be flamed at table, wasn't.

Everything was good except for our waitress. They weren’t even that busy outside but. Took forever to get our drink order in, forever to get our drinks, and even longer to place our food order.  She rarely even came out to check if we needed anything else. If we needed another drink, a refill, or even desert. Then it took a while to get our bill. We still tipped 20% to be nice because of COVID but if it wasn’t Covid we would have done 10%.

When we first got there, we were seated in the bar area, the door was open and there was a very annoying blast of cold air. I asked for another table in a warmer area, no questions asked we were immediately shown, and offered another table in the rear dining area. It was perfect for our party. 

The waitress was friendly and the service was outstanding, we really enjoyed the treatment that we were offered. The food was great and plenty of it. 

It was my daughters birthday and they gave her a birthday desert. Not to mention a hat as a souvenir. Everything turned out perfect.

Nice place and good food 
Good attention and friendly staff fast service
Great foods and margaritas. I go to Chevy’s @ least once a month

Everyone in my party enjoyed their food. They had a DJ that played some good music. Are server was pleasant and the Manager came by to check on our table. My only gripe was Chevy's sweet corn portion was poor lol. A baby ice cream scoop. I'm planning going back on Tuesday.
Ir was nice we enjoyed the food and the service as well .. nice brunch
Music was way to LOUD and staff was afraid to ask DJ to turn music down because DJ is friend of manager. We asked to be moved.
Good food outdoor dining not desirable but it worked .  Service okay took awhile to get our check.

Excellent service!  I am definitely coming back.  I had a wonderful experience with Maribel and also the staff was on spot, especially with Sunisa managing her team.  I will do a much better and thorough review on Yelp.  Muchas gracias, mi amigos!
The service was excellent and the food was top notch the staff was very attentive we had a great time

Last night my husband and I enjoyed using my birthday coupon Chevy's emailed me for a discount. My Surf N’ Turf Combo was very good and the first time I've had that.  I was so pleased the steak strips were tender (the last Mexican restaurant we went to they were tough) and the shrimp/crab enchilada was wonderful. The refried beans, thin tortilla chips and smokey salsa were great also. My husband's Super Cinco combo wasn't as tasty, but satisfactory. I liked the meat in the tamale but he wasn't used to the sauce, whereas I like how it made it less dry. Next time maybe we'll ask for the enchilada sauce on the side. We appreciated how clean and festive the restaurant looks and appears newly remodeled. Nicely updated and clean bathrooms.

Food was good but for some reason they forgot parts of our order.  After reminding them they said it was coming out and after 20 minutes of waiting we just asked for the bill.  The bill arrived with the charges for the undelivered food.  Fixing that took another 15 minutes.  Overall not a very good experience.

Great service, waiter was attentive and courteous, my granddaughters enjoyed the coloring books, which kept them occupied and happy.  For a birthday they really go out of their way and make a person feel welcome.  My granddaughter wants to have her birthday dinner their now, she wants the hat for her 6th birthday.

name: Hurrica Restaurant & Bar
description: As the only waterfront dining experience, with front-row view of the Award-Winning Westpoint Harbor Marina, you will enjoy serene delightful and casual-elegant dining experience in the Redwood City.Named after the famous and majestic Hurrica V sailboat, the design inspiration of teak wooden walls evoke a sense of warmth andExecutive Chef Justin Baade took his love of 'live-fire' cooking by building a custom hearth offering seafood, steak and vegetables either smoked, grilled or cooked in the embers.Housing the largest, privately owned jellyfish tank, it's a memorizing experience to see the baby jellyfish upclose and personal.Take a moment to enjoy the custom artwork from various artists and mediums such as wired fish artwork from the Wirelady, or commissioned mosaic artpiece by Angelina Duckett, even our restrooms are a work of art!We want our guests to have a unique and immersive experience, no only culinary but visually!
address: 150 North Point Court,  Redwood City, CA 94063
hours:
Hurrica 2 Go
Wed–Sun 8:00 am–5:00 pm
Lunch
Wed–Sun 11:00 am–2:30 pm
Bar
Wed–Sun 11:00 am–9:30 pm
Dinner
Mon–Wed, Sun 5:00 pm–8:30 pm
Thu–Sat 5:00 pm–9:30 pm

reviews.text: Easter brunch did not disappoint! We will make this our tradition.
We enjoyed excellent food in a beautiful environment with great service. The location right on the harbor is awesome, and the interior decoration is high end.

We love what Hurrica is doing and can become. It has some amazing foods and drinks especially on the dinner menu. The location, while a 'ways' out there is worth the distance to enjoy the sun, sea air, and a beautiful restaurant. The passion of the owners and Chefs is evident in how much they are trying to do for an upscale vibe but in a casual, comfortable setting. We've been for a few business dinners, personal meals, and a lunch. This particular time was lunch and while some items are still great (the prawn appetizer is perfectly prepared), the Seafood Chowder, while delicious, is too small a portion for the high price for a lunch dish. They have one of the best bread services at DINNER but at lunch they have a different bread service option which was a disappointment yet the same price as dinner. Cocktails are fun and fanciful and worth a try. Definitely recommend for dinner (scallops are amazing) but, for example, the scallops are missing at lunch as well. So lots of good and great potential - excited to see it keep going . Definitely give it a shot!

This was our first time. I took my husband for his birthday. Pretty drive to the restaurant, and lots of speed bumps. We sat outside facing the bay and the port.  I called two weeks in advance and they were all out of inside tables. Outside they have heat lamps and blankets, and it felt very peaceful.  Jo our server made sure to inquire about any food restrictions and knew everything about everything on the menu. He also masterfully deboned our dorade for us. The food tastes very fresh and so flavorful. The staff signed a Hurrica-designed birthday card and brought us a small portion of gluten free cake with a candle.  While we were admiring the jellyfish tank, we got to meet one of the owners. It’s a beautiful restaurant and the design is very cool with the kitchen behind a glass wall and the jelly tank.  Really glad we went for my husband’s birthday and will go back for other special occasions.

The service, wine selection and food were exceptional.  This was the first time we were there and we are definitely going again!  The design of the restaurant was beautiful and being on the waterfront, as the sun was setting, was spectacular.  If you truly want an exceptional fine dining experience, you must go to Hurrica!
The food is so good and a very creative menu. Pest food on the peninsula without a doubt.

Hurrica is truly one of my favorite restaurants! The food is consistently exceptional, the ambiance is thoughtfully curated, and the service is always warm and attentive. Every visit is a thoroughly enjoyable experience - I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience!

Deliciousness and wonderful attentive hospitality/service. The only thing I would change (if I could) was the sound level... but then that relates to your success and I am happy for you and that midweek is so busy!!
Beautiful restaurant, excellent service, good food abd great view,
Great experience- first rate staff.  Food was excellent

Hurrica was a hidden gem in RWC!  It’s situated right on the harbor, and the only restaurant in the area so it was very secluded and peaceful. Apart from the ambiance, the service was amazing and the food was delicious!  My husband and I dined here for our wedding anniversary and Hurrica made it such a special night for us. We will definitely be coming back soon, and would highly recommend!!
Fantastic food as usual. The filet, asparagus agnolotti, and pistachio Napoleon were delicious. Loved looking at the jellyfish tank. Booked again for later this week.
Always Good and Great for Group Dining.  Attentive waitstaff.

Had a fantastic dinner at Hurrica Restaurant & Bar in Redwood Shores and wanted to share the experience. The setting is absolutely beautiful—right on the docks at Westpoint Harbor. It's peaceful, scenic, and feels like a hidden gem in the Bay Area.

From the moment we walked in, the ambiance really stood out. There's this glowing jellyfish aquarium that immediately catches your eye, and the rest of the decor—redwood tables, ocean-inspired touches—strikes a perfect balance between upscale and creative. It’s elegant without being stuffy.

We were there for a business dinner, and the service was spot-on. Friendly, attentive, and professional. Our server had great recommendations and made sure everything ran smoothly without interrupting the flow of conversation.

The food was excellent across the board. We tried the milkbread, scallops, dorado, short rib, and shrimp cocktail—each dish was beautifully presented and full of flavor. You can tell the kitchen takes real pride in what they serve. The owner introduced herself and is delightful.

Hurrica is one of those places that feels special the moment you arrive and did not disappoint. I’ll definitely be back.

Perfect day for lunch at Hurrica- Oysters for Change (Benefiting LA Fire Department) were amazing along with the Petrale Sole and apple endive salad. Sun was out, walls were open and the jellyfish are always stunning. Thank you!

Our experience started out on the wrong foot.  We arrived to an empty reception desk.  After waiting a while, the hostess finally showed up, only to get on the phone and ignore us again.  Someone else, possibly a manager, arrived and finally seated us in the quieter room of the two.  The other room had a nice view of the harbor, but it was very noisy.  We started our meal with the apple and endive salad, which was OK.  It had a grilled cheese sandwich sitting on top, which was a little strange, but welcome, considering that there was no plain bread to order on the menu.  For the main course, I had the black cod, which was good, but I didn't like the bed of mayonnaise or the crepe underneath.  Why not just mushrooms and cauliflower?  My husband liked his grilled fillet of beef.  We both ordered a glass of wine to accompany our meals, which was good, but above $20.  The mezcal margarita was good, but had a distinct smoky flavor, not my favorite.  Other than the hostess, the service was professional, and the ambiance was nice.
The service was excellent and the food was over the top!

Stunnng setting and jellyfish tank in the room we were seated. Food was good; nothing to rave about. Had raw oysters, baked oysters, hamachi app, the only salad on the menu; whole dorado, swordfish and the other fish entree. Not bad; just not noteworthy.
Wonderful setting and the skirt steak was amazing
the bartender made me the most delicious drink when I asked for a speciality martini! he was so sweet and wrote us the recipe as well. Will be back! :)

Food was great.   Loved the Milk Bread and Onion Rings.   Chowder was excellent.   The managers are very friendly and always checking in.   The managers are hard working and I value their inclusive nature.

Our server did not have much of a personality, and did not go beyond her basic duties, however she was nice.

The only minus would be the noise level.   It is very loud.   We went to dinner at 5 pm and it was super loud after about an hour into our reservation.

Great place to have lunch or dinner.
Great view of the harbor and boats

It's hard to beat the beautiful location of this restaurant along the yacht harbor.  Outdoor seating is great.  Waitstaff are all very courteous and helpful, though our service was rather slow.  (The restaurant was packed on a warm weeknight.)  Loved the Liberty Duck salad, which I had as more of an entree.  Swordfish and cod entrees were very good and the chowder also got two thumbs up.  Cocktails are very good, also.
While the price is high, it's worth every penny. Everything was outstanding! Best food, service, atmosphere I have every encounterd. I couldn't recommend it highly enough!
Always Great Food.  The Duck Confit and Chilaquiles fantastic.  Alejandro was attentive like Jo and Luis.
Food was outstanding! Everything we ordered was delicious!! Would definitely eat there again!

Ambience was very nice. Food and service were also very good. Cod was delicious and oysters as well.
It is a bit pricey but worth it for the view.
Excellent service and food. Fish and chips are the bomb!

My 4th visit to this delightful restaurant.  Never disappointed in the food and service.  
The ambiance is a calm feeling looking out at the yachts moored there and of course, 
the jellyfish aquarium that adds to the atmosphere.  A prize to discover.

We had the most outstanding service with excellent food which wasprepared exquisitely
I believe our waiter’s name was Alejandro
Keep our love of Service above and beyond because he always smiled and paid a lot of attention towards us and we really appreciated his exceptional service ￼
Great seafood, unique recipes, polite service and great view. What a find  . I had to have surgery at Sequoia Hospital and it was our before surgery dinner and it was great. The lobster was great.
Delicious and unique food, prepared in open kitchen. Great service and nice waiters.
The food and service were impeccable! The indoors dining room had a high noise level making the total experience less than perfect.
Never knew this beautiful restaurant existed here in our peninsula. Superior service, ambience and delicious meal.
Excellent experience. Great food, service and went out of their way for a friend's birthday. Lovely experience!
Excellent service, delicious food, and great vibe! This was our 2nd dining experience here and did not disappoint.
Beautifully presented great tasting food.  Nice view of the harbor.  Easy parking.
The service and experience were exemplary. We will definitely return, especially to celebrate special occasions.

We were entertaining three guests from Kenya. The cocktails were wonderful, the service was the best. For dinner we had filet mignon, 2 orders of DORADE deboned tableside,. The spatzle was great as well with the Gruyere cheese ￼.
Everything was excellent! We appreciated how our server showed the jellyfish tank to the kids, even though we were seated at the other end of the restaurant.

This place is amazing. Food is so good. My orange no-jito wasn’t special but ok.

The woman who took care of us upstairs is a saint. For my brothers bday we booked 7 adults and 2 two-ish year olds (almost 2, 2.5) and we had the best experience. The woman brought out jenga and lamps for the kids to play with. She let us roam through the upstairs. We explored outside on the deck.

The swordfish was amazing. The sashimi bites are more like nigiri (rice) and huge. Can definitely cut them in 1/2 and so tasty. The carrot cake was fantastic- got it to go and loved every bite.
Definitely will return!
Great food with excellent service. Special on oysters was a great value
Spectacular food and service! Order it all! Don’t skimp!
Excellent food; Beautiful presentation; Gorgeous decor; Very attentive staff
High end restaurant in a bit of an out-of-the way location. Worth a visit.
One of the best I wish I could keep it to myself but everything here was just excellent.

Went for a birthday - the place does not disappoint.  The food was outstanding and the atmosphere is wonderful.  Our server forgot some orders and didn’t bring out the courses together which was a little frustrating when dining with children.  But not anything that I would complain about or prevent me from highly recommending this place.
The Hurrica Burger was delicious and fresh.   The burger was smoky and juicy.

What a beautiful building! Love the classy decor. Food was great, space is great, loved the jelly fish in the aquarium. Definitely will be back. Great place for us to get together for mom’s night out!
Great first experience. Perfect setting for a walk along the waterfront before dinner to make room for the amazing food and drinks to follow.

Good experience overall. Nice atmosphere and location. Service was excellent, staff very attentive. Overall food quality was great. Shellfish chowder was excellent to start. Wife oredered the cod, which was good but a bit fishy.i ordered the short rib which was rich and quite filling, paired well with the merry Edward’s Pinot noir. Wines by the glass were pricey. Nice restaurant for a nice evening out. Very noisy inside.

Hurrica's Restaurant in redwood City is the place to go to view the huge yachts,  peaceful 
surroundings, grand interior, jelly fish tank, and food that is presented in unusual mixtures - 
all in all a grand experience.
Great food and presentation!. We loved it.
Very pleasant exoerience. Outdoor seating was great!

Although I was asked to move tables in a stern and matter of fact manner it was a pleasant experience
Thank you

Exactly what we expected.  The staff was attentive, explained about any longer wait times to prepare some of the large “family portion” items and made the experience really enjoyable.  The fish and the 250 oz Tomahawk steak were all perfectly cooked and delicious .  Compliments to the chef and staff for flawless execution! Great choice for lunch or dinner.

Nice quiet location next to the bay with plenty of parking. Nice warm atmosphere with nice interior. Asked to be moved to a table next to the windows to get better lighting.
