Manager was attentive and friendly and had no problems moving us. Service was average and the food was pretty good. Each dish had good presentation and plating. Went for lunch and would like to try having dinner there. We enjoyed our lunch and would recommend this place.

Spectacular setting. The food was very good. Seafood outstanding. While the menu is smaller in scope, which isn't necessarily a bad thing, a number of the entrees are fried which for someone who is trying to lean into the healthier side that smaller menu starts to feel limiting.

We started with Kumamoto and Marin Gems oysters, followed by the broiled live sea scallop. The scallop had good flavor and texture, but the highlight of our appetizers was the Local Halibut Carpaccio—it was exceptional and easily our favorite dish of the night, standing out on a different level from everything else we ordered.

For our main courses, we had the pan-roasted black cod and the slow-roasted pork chops. The cod dish had some interesting components, but they felt somewhat disjointed and lacked an acidic element to bring everything together. The pork chops, on the other hand, included ingredients that weren’t listed on the menu, such as mustard seeds and a vinegary element—unfortunately, something my husband doesn’t eat. Like the cod, the dish felt a bit confused, and the sides didn’t complement it well.

For dessert, we tried the Champagne cake. It was decent but not particularly memorable.

The ambiance was lovely, with well-spaced tables and a comfortable noise level, making for a pleasant dining experience overall.

It was our first time.  WE loved it.  We shall be back very soon.
What a lovely location.

Booked for party of 6 but called to up it to 10 and ended up with 8 and they were extremely accommodating especially since the restaurant was packed. All of the food was delicious though the gal who ordered the pork chop mentioned she had a generous portion. The gals who ordered the swordfish and black cod mentioned the dish was cooked and seasoned perfectly. We ordered a lot of sides and recommend them all mushrooms with side sauce, extra crispy onion rings, broccolini and the milk bread. Oh the room is very special with good lighting, comfy seating and a spectacular aquarium wall with live jellyfish. ￼would definitely recommend.
It’s out of the way, but worth the drive for views, food and ambiance

My second time dining here. Overall great experience for our Anniversary dinner. The service was great, food was great (highly recommend the baked potato's as a side, atmosphere was gorgeous located right by the water overseeing nice boats and yachts. Props to the floor manager in which I believe his name was Cameron, (apologies if I got that wrong). Very nice gentleman, highly recommend anyone to try out this restaurant. If you're in for drinks, try the "Hurrica Cocktail." Will certainly be back again in the future. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

• Hurrica cocktail 5/5
• West Point swizzle 4.5/5 
• short rib 4/5 (personal opinion, very good still)
• baked potato 5/5
• New York strip 5/5
• clam chowder 5/5

A new favorite.  I kept hearing about this restaurant from friends, and we finally got to try it last night.  I ordered the Parker rolls with sea salt and coconut butter-amazing. We split the endive and apple salad, which was delicious. My husband said the pork chop was the best he has ever had in his life.  We had two great views from our table:  outside of the boats in the marina, and inside of the glassed-in kitchen...so much fun to watch the chefs at work.
Bonus for huge, free parking lot right outside the door.

We had very high hopes for this place. The ambiance and look of this place is awesome.
It must have been a tough night for the staff. Service was slow and once we finally got our food, the staff realized they forgot to put our kids order in. The manager was very apologetic and did his best to make things better. It was just an unfortunate experience for a place this expensive.

Always a treat to have dinner at this fabulous restaurant. The food is exquisite and the service is great.  I would highly recommend it to those foodies that enjoy great food and wonderful atmosphere.
Best steak I have ever eaten! The food was delicious and it's just a really beautiful spot. You feel like you're away on a vacation.
The food, service, cleanliness and ambiance did not disappoint.  I am very particular with where I will eat.  This is (hands down) my favorite restaurant!
Always Great Food!  The Brunch Menu is Nice and Varied. Luis is an attentive waiter.
Food and service was great! Definitely worth a visit.
Wonderful. Great staff and ambience. Best steak I’ve had in a long time. Great valentines dinner place experience. Will be back!

The food was amazing. The staff were very friendly and knowledgeable.
Parking was easy and free.
Great ambiance and atmosphere for Valentine’s Day or date night.
A little expensive overall but was worth it for Valentine’s Day.
I’d recommend to anyone looking for high-end food and experience.

Service and food was excellent my only complaint would be as the restaurant started to fill up it was difficult to talk and hear each other because you’re seated so close to others.
I had to constantly lean in over the table to hear my husband.
Always Good Food and Atmosphere. Breakfast and Lunch Options are Great and unique.  It is nice to have this type of cuisine and restaurant on the Peninsula.

Good food, best service, and it was so nice to dine by the water. The restaurant is very clean and the servers are friendly and attentive. We came for lunch on Valentine’s Day and enjoyed the oyster, fish and chips, and sole.

Hurrica is a wonderful place. The restaurant is beautiful. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The service is excellent. The food is excellent as well, some items are pricey but worth the price. We shared the Tomahawk aged steak it was tasty. I would recommend this restaurant.
Very nice. Great views. Food presentation outstanding.

Super fresh oysters, sublime lobster gnocchi and amazing beef fillet with layered tallow potatoes! Exceptional service from Joseph, Meesun and Cameron. Perfect wine pairings. A City-level experience on the Peninsula! Can't stay away. Highly recommend!

Amazing bartenders  with great drinks and a great menu to go with it! Must have the BREAD! Must have!! Every dish is amazing! From salads to apps to the fish!! ! Love the jellyfish aquarium and the ambiance at the yacht club.

Went for a special occasion and we were very satisfied with our experience! Sat at the bar and had good time chatting with the bartender as we ate and drank. Oysters were a highlight as were the sashimi bites. Great environment and the giant jellyfish tank is a fun touch

As always, spending the evening at this restaurant is truly remarkable. Leaving with your business partners feeling impressed is invaluable. MeeSun, thank you and your team for the fantastic hospitality. I'm looking forward to returning soon. 

HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
The Short Rib Eggs Benedict and Fish and Chips Great.  Large Portions, Fresh Ingredients.  The batter of the Fish and Chips Crispy and Flavorful.  The Fish Delicate.

The giant jellyfish fish tank sets the ambience of this high-end restaurant. The It is mesmerizing. 

The food is just as amazing as well. The pork chop is huge. Its chutney and side have Indian profile. I'd have never thought that would work, but it did. The black cod with really great with gourmet mushroom. 

The milk bread comes with a very interest "butter" - one of which is "butter" made of coconut cream and the other is is made of whipped ube topped with what they called coconut salt that is made of caramelized coconut cream. They are both delicious - something I'd have never thought of in lieu of butter.
Great return visit to Hurrica, again attentive service, fantastic food, and an overall outstanding experience!  The scallop appetizer and short ribs were standouts!
Wonderful meal - loved the whole fish, oysters, milk bread and scallop. Topped off with the best carrot cake ever!
Very ice experience overall. Good food and good service.
Fantastic - best experience ever!  Will definitely go back and recommend to family and friends.
Our New Regular Spot.  Generous Portions, Fresh Ingredients and great value.  Glad we tried Bruch.  The Petrale Sole Cooked Perfect.  Lots of Shrimp in the Chilaquiles.
Beautiful ambiance,food and service! Classy,romantic love the jellyfish 🪼

We had such a wonderful experience here! The food was wonderful and the staff were so friendly. The jellyfish aquarium is amazing. My dessert, the apple cake with cinnamon ice cream, was the best dessert I’ve had in a long time.
It would have been a 5 star but short ribs were a bit salty and our waiter seemed to forget us after we received our entré, didn’t come back as asked us about dessert which was disappointing.

We were there for lunch. Beautiful setting, beautiful restaurant !  
Absolutely the best oysters and clams in the Bay Area. Menu is diverse, and the food is fantastic.
Berger great, but I highly recommend the fish and chips. Deserts over the top.
Don't overlook this place.
Everything is good. Joe, the server, made excellent recommendations. Manager Mei S was kind and friendly. Exceptional restaurant, definitely coming again!

We had a lovely dinner. Owner Meesun was so nice and explained everything on the menu. She even upgraded our seating to the Yacht club. We felt so specia. The food was delicious and Alejandro, our head waiter was very attentive. Loved the jellyfish tank in the main bar. We would go back again.

Absolutely exquisite!! We always have a gorgeous experience when we come.  For an elegant (but relaxed) evening, you can’t beat Hurrica. Incredible food, great cocktails.  This places never fails to delight us (and our out of town guests).

The folks who run it, and the lovely staff, are wonderful.

Also:  For a casual late afternoon, we love hanging out on the outside patio overlooking the harbor.

Five stars isn’t enough.

Beautiful location and lovely atmosphere.  However, I found the dinner menu quite limited. I have a serious food allergy and the order didn't reflect my specifications. Had to send it back while the others dined. The portions were small but every bite was tasty.
We came to celebrate the 1 year Birthday of Hurrica!  From the Birthday Oysters, Entrees to Birthday Cake Bites it was great!  It’s our goto restaurant on the Peninsula!
I had a lovely meal. The service was amazing. I was there for the first anniversary and received a free glass of Prosecco upon arrival.

A phenomenal dinner again. Our third time here. I had the sliced filet mignon, my birthday friend had the Dorade fish. The cocktails were amazing and highly unusual. The service from the concierge Sophia at the desk along with Audrey our server made our dinner very special . Can’t wait to come again and see the beautiful yachts on the harbor and the jellyfish in the fish tank ￼

Loved sitting at the terrace on a sunny and warm day . Better than inside where there was a group extremely noisy . Excellent service. I had a pretty good hamburgués and my two male friends had fish and chips and they love them , I bang wait to bring my. Sons and their families here .
Great location. Great food. Very noisy in dining room. Outside was best option in nice weather.

Another wonderful experience at Hurrica. We arrived a few hours early to watch the Sunday afternoon football games￼ and had amazing service on the patio - on a gorgeous day. ￼
Cameron was phenomenal and went above and beyond for us, helping enhance our overall experience.
￼￼￼Later on we headed inside for dinner and the cuisine was spectacular.￼ Truly a unique gem on the Peninsula!

Inflation has really hit when you order Fish & Chips and you literally get one medium sized piece of fish and the rest French fries for $22.  I didn't even get the essence of the fish since it was surrounded by lots of crispy batter.  My husband ordered the Tiger Prawn Salad at $25 which was good, but the portion was quite small to quench his appetite.  Presentation was nice.  On the flip side, I do have to say the restaurant itself is beautifully decorated.  The waitstaff is very efficient and courteous.  It's a place you'd like to go to for the ambiance or to impress a first date.
Great food, wonderful atmosphere. There were a few hiccups with getting water and a drink ordered, but otherwise it was a lovely experience.

The food was excellent - we got several "bites" and "small plates" to share and loved every one of them. The Hurrica signature cocktail was also excellent. Service was friendly if just a bit inconsistent, and we found the dining room very noisy. But all in all a great experience, we will be bacl!

Really cool vibe.  Nice place for a special event (birthday, anniversary, etc.). Food was very good which you would expect given the prices. Service was somewhat slow with the entrees taking almost a half hour to come out. Cocktails were delicious but on the small side. Overall, we enjoyed our experience and will definitely be back.
Absolute BEST restaurant on the Peninsula!!!  Food is delicious, menu the best, service friendly, inviting and wonderful!   Staff is fantastic!  You are made to feel special when you dine at Hurrica!
The food and experience was great! The jellyfish tank makes a wonderful backdrop for this fine dining experience.
My first dinner here and LOVED it! Meesun took fantastic care of us, the tomahawk steak was amazing and adored the rocher dessert. The oysters were fabulous as always. I'll be back again soon!
Great service. Food was good and enjoyed the ambiance. Will try again

It was my birthday celebration and we sat in the main dining room. The host was nice enough to turn down the music so we could hear each other. They also all signed a birthday card from Hurrica to give to me. They also served me a dessert with a candle. How special they made me feel. Perfect place to celebrate any occasion! Thank you Hurrica!!
Everything was so amazing. Lydia was very attentive and we loved the food.

Wow, what an amazing dining experience! Everything was outstanding - the venue, the service (thank you, Alejandro!) and every dish we ordered was original and perfectly prepared. I had come here before for cocktails and bites with girlfriends, and it was lovely, but dinner is a whole new level, just an adventure in flavors and presentation. It truly reminded me of French Laundry in uniqueness, but Hurrica is much closer to home and easier to get a reservation so it’s a gem.

Food and cocktails were excellent.  Short ribs, milk bread, seafood chowder.  Service was sub-par.  Waited a long time to place our drink order.  Long time to place our dinner order.  I wasn’t even sure who our server was for a long time.  He never introduced himself.  Everything was a long wait, never asked us how our meal was.  Never checked in with us.  We had to wait soooooo long to get our check, I got up and left the table while my husband sat there and waited.  Such a disappointment.  It could have been a great night but it was ruined by poor service.
Great Innovative Menu that rotates.  Celebrated Birthday Dinner and it was great.

If you seek great food, impeccable service and ambiance, Hurrica is the choice. We were celebrating our anniversary. We were presented a beautiful card, signed by all staff members. This has become our favorite restaurant for celebrating memorable occasions.

Excellent location with a great view. Stunning live Jelly fish tank in the dining room. Everything we ordered was delicious, if slightly on the salty side. Would highly recommend the whole dorade fish entree.
The food is so incredibly fresh.  The combination of flavors is mesmerizing.  The portions are ideal.  And the option of veggie, to fish to steak kept everyone in the family happy!
Beautiful location with an innovative menu. The staff all went the next level to make our night top notch.
Outstanding food as always! Love the location. Never too noisy to have a conversation.
We had a fun New Years Eve dining experience, the food was great and excellent service

Fabulous four course dinner on New Year’s Eve! 
Did not disappoint, The food came out perfectly and delicious as always.
Fabulous dinner great service great atmosphere food amazing

2 of us had the swordfish which was tremendous! Spouse had short ribs which were very good. Son had the cod, extremely good. The price is high so know that going in. No alcohol but 3 n/a drinks and the bill for 4 was $244😳.

This is a beautiful restaurant that opened in January of 2024. The service is friendly and attentive without being overbearing. My wife had the duck confit which was outstanding. I had the burger which turned out just good. The bar is large and very attractive. The outside patios and views are lovely.
Loved this place. Everything about it was perfect.
Celebrated my Dad’s Birthday.  It was a great dinner!

Everything was lovely- waiter was really good- attentive, knowledgeable but not overbearing.

Ambience - excellent!

Always a special experience at Hurrica. MeeSun, Park and the staff go out of their way to provide amazing food, presentation , ambiance and service. We always leave more impressed than the last time- which for me was yesterday!!! Love this place

Amazing food and service! Amazing ambience to top it off. ￼Anywhere you’d look around the restaurant there’s something going, between the jellyfish tank, the harbor or even the chef as well as the cooks working hard behind the glass wall. Highly recommend for those who haven’t been. A+ experience

Oysters, Tuna Tartar, chowder, and pork loin were fantastic! The beet/crab salad not so much!! There was too much coarse black vegetation that was inedible, had no flavor and scratched the throat as went  down, and there was almost no crab, but the beets were very good. This was the second time I have visited your restaurant - the location, the ambiance of the restaurant, the jelly fish wall, the service and the overall experience was excellent. My rating is AAA+.

Great restaurant 
Little noises but great food
Exceptional servicew
Perfect place for your family to meet you for your birthday

Excellent food and service. We noted a birthday when we made our reservation and they provided some very special touches to celebrate.  Just above and beyond service with great food too. We're not from the area so a little unsure with the drive to the location but it's absolutely beautiful.  Looking forward to returning.

This was an exceptional evening for my wife and myself. This was our 10 year anniversary dinner.
The service was exceptional. The food was as well.
They made us feel very special and will highly recommend this restaurant to everyone looking for a special evening.
Thank you
Capt. Smitty

We couldn't praise this restaurant enough. From the front door greeting the servers and my own free lecture on the Jellyfish, YES they have a jellyfish tank. Ambience is impeccable. Food was simply amazing. Thank you Hurrica and staff for a memorable night celebrating my husbands 70th birthday.
Great food served in a lovely atmosphere. It's become our new go-to place in the area.
The food was excellent (menu is small.)   Outstanding service and ambience.  Great sommelier

We love this place. We had all the appetizers, literally all, and they were fantastic. The caviar toast is incredible; we doubled on that one. The drinks and wine list are great, and the service is exceptional!
Love the restaurant ambience and food.  Service was good, but slow.

We chose Hurrica Restaurant for our holiday team luncheon, and it was such a great experience! The holiday ambiance was beautiful and made the celebration feel really special.

The staff were super friendly and attentive. The host at the door greeted me with a warm smile, answered all my questions, and even asked if I needed anything, like water, while I waited in the entrance. That little gesture made me feel really cared for and set a positive tone for the rest of the visit.

Everything about the experience—from the welcoming atmosphere to the attentive service—was fantastic. I’d definitely go back again and highly recommend Hurrica for anyone planning a holiday gathering or team event.

Hurrica was the perfect place to take my friend for her birthday. The view is stunning right on the water. The menu has a great selection and the meals we had were delicious. I would recommend this place for a special event definitely.

This was our second time dining at Hurrica. We returned to celebrate an early Christmas with our son and daughter in law as our first experience two months ago was exceptional. Sadly, last night was a totally different experience. We were seated in the corner and were somewhat ignored. Service was extremely slow and lacking, the food was good, just not quite as stellar as our first visit. Overall it was an expensive, disappointing evening out. Not sure which visit was the norm, so will try again after the first of the year and decide if this will be our local go to special restaurant or not.
Wonderful and friendly service plus great food. We will definitely be back.

Great service by entire staff !
Excellent place to celebrate any occasion:)

Wonderful service. Waiter Alejandro was very attentive and knowledgeable. Only drawback was wine was a bit expensive. More than my entree. So we passed on wine. Beautiful location. Overlooking beautiful yacht harbor.
A lovely evening. Great service from a variety of friendly staff. The food was delicious. The biggest difficulty for me was the loud noise level.
An oasis in our backyard, love that we have fantastic food and a nice private setting close to the mid peninsula, but waterfront... .... wonderful experience.
A beautiful space and friendly service. However the food was a bit disappointing. Fish in the fish and chips was dry and Chilaquiles verde was blah.
Great addition to Redwood City. Great food in a fantastic setting, especially if the weather cooperates for sitting outside.
Sent a private note to the operator since I want them to make it right before I post publicly.

Love so much about Hurricane.  Good good, great ambiance.

Sadly the service is consistently sub-par.  I don’t really understand why.  The wait staff must not be well trained.  The times I’ve been haven’t been so busy that they are harried.

The extra 4% “fair wages” or what ever it’s called also annoys me, please charge what you need to for the food without dinging an extra % on the bill.
Wonderful presentation.  Excellent food. Views were awesome today

It was raining. A manager meet us with umbrellas outside One friend was ushered in as she was using a walker and I used the other brought out to me to help the other 88 year old friend. We were ushered to the table 
chairs were pulled out for us to be seated!!  Never have I felt so cared about. The hospitality was amazing!  There is a tranquility  and peace in the eloquent but casual environment overlooking the harbor and water 
On one wall separating the bar from the dining area is a huge aquarium where jellyfish float aimlessly 
The food served for lunch was excellent !
Thank you for a wonderful time We will be back!!!! Jan P
Lovely restaurant! We shared several small plates and enjoyed delicious cocktails. We definitely will be back.

Flawlessly executed dinner experience. Food quality and service were exceptional. Raw oysters with house yuzu mignonette, broiled scallop with finger lime, milk bread with whipped ube and coconut butter on the side, duck breast and escarole salad with persimmons, black cod entree with wild mushroom crepe, whipped cauliflower, and chanterelles on top. Coconut panna cotta to finish! Everything was delicious. Awesome open kitchen and a huge wall of moon jellyfish, which was mesmerizing to watch while eating. I will return. Beautiful location on the harbor.
Food is great and the service is really good and thoughtful!

I've been to Hurrica twice now. It really has a unique atmosphere for the peninsula. Most of the entrees we enjoyed were definitely a big hit. It is one of the best restaurants on the peninsula for a fun, relaxing atmosphere with plenty of water views day or night.

Fine Dining that is approachable and a great value.  I’d like to highlight the Pastry Chef who does a great job with the desserts.  Also to note this is the Team that made SF’s Farallon a great Seafood Destination.  This is now our go to restaurant on the Peninsula.

Nestled near the coast, Hurricane Restaurant and Bar is a gem that radiates both vibrant energy and relaxed charm. With its coastal-inspired decor and lively atmosphere, it's a must-visit for anyone craving good food with a side of fun.**Ambiance:** The moment you walk in, you're greeted by a warm and inviting setting. The restaurant is tastefully decorated with nautical elements that transport you to a seaside retreat. The lighting is just right, dim enough for intimacy but bright enough to keep the energy lively. The bar area stands out with its stylish counter and an impressive array of spirits that promise exciting concoctions.

**Food:** Hurricane's menu is a delightful mix of classic and inventive dishes. From fresh seafood delights like crab cakes and lobster rolls to hearty options such as gourmet burgers and juicy steaks, there’s something for every palate. The flavors are bold and satisfying, clearly prepared with attention to detail. Make sure to try their signature hurricane cocktail, a refreshing drink that perfectly complements themeal.**Service:** The staff at Hurricane are both friendly and efficient, maintaining the right balance between attentiveness and allowing you your space. They seem genuinely enthusiastic about their offerings, ready to give recommendations, which enhances the dining experience.
A Gem on the Peninsula.   Finally a restaurant on the Peninsula on par with John Bentley's.  The Chefs are from SF Famed Farallon, Water Bar and Epic Steakhouse.

This place is one of the best kept secrets of the Bay Area! The food is amazing -cooked by the former chef of Waterbar, the service exceptional-most friendly staff who remembers not just you but what you ordered (how do they do it?!) and incredible views of the most beautiful marina. Definitely order the chowder and make sure you make a reservation because it’s always packed!!!
Where are nice place road service good food love the place
Great food, great views, and fabulous service at a good value.

Every dish we had this visit was exquisite, especially the steak, and the duck salad. Our visiting friend can’t stop talking about how good the meal was. Special kudos to our server Alejandro for a delightful evening.

Nice atmosphere, friendly staff. Great place for a special occasion meal. Bit pricey for everyday, especially their items on the “Bite” selection of the menu. I had the oyster under “Bite”, it was the tiniest (1) oyster I ever had from a restaurant.
We loved our main dishes & their seasonal “pumpkin cheesecake” dessert is out of this world. It’s not your traditional pumpkin cheesecake… Its a must try, if you like pumpkin.

Setting and ambiance were great. Decor is very modern but not sterile. They have a cool jellyfish aquarium that is done really well.
Food was really quite delicious, cocktails too. Good wine selection.
Good place for indoor or outdoor dining. The bar also looked like a good spot to eat. Would definitely go again.

We had a couple of oysters, the prawn cocktail, the lobster, and the dorade.  Everything was very very good to excellent. If I'm being picky, I would have opted for another vegetable instead of the roasted potatoes with the lobster. Nonetheless, I would still order the lobster again.  Had the soft serve with olive oil and salt plus a cheese plate -- both outstanding.

Our food was delicious as always -but this time service was only average. We ordered a shrimp cocktail appetizer that we had to ask repeatedly to be brought to the table, as well as the sour dough bread service. It would have been lovely to have the bread available when our seafood chowder was delivered. It could have been her intent to not rush us - but we waited for our bill until I had to ask a few staff for it.
Amazing decor, ambience and service! Excellent food! A hidden gem in the penninsula!
Had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The dining and service were terrific. Will definitely go back.

We had a delicious dinner at Hurrica. All four of us ordered different starters, entrees, and desserts, and everyone raved about theirs. The owners and staff were welcoming and attentive. We enjoyed the intimacy of the beautiful wood-paneled dining room. We'll be back.
Truly lucky to hv this most wonderful and delectable dining experience so close here on mid Peninsula! Go and reward yourselves for an evening.
It’s always great, but be aware that they charge for bread.
The location on the Bay is worth the drive over the 17 speed bumps. Great food. Wonderful service.
Great food. Good service. Good ambience. The one drawback is how noisy it is. It’s sometimes hard to hear the people you’re having dinner with.

Have been here twice now. Really enjoy the ambiance for date night with my wife. Milk bread is amazing. For entrees my wife had the pork chop which was excellent. I had the Dorade which I had both times and is excellent. For dessert we had the cheesecake which was good but had too many ingredients. Will definitely be back.
The Place and Food are amazing. But the good service is only for “habitues”.
It is a beautiful restaurant in a lovely location by the water. The food was beautifully plated and tasted as good as it looked with top-notch ingredients.

We love this place! Their food is excellent and it is absolutely beautiful. Service and the staff is always spot on and it is such a special gem. So far we have introduced this restaurant to 6 couples at different times and they all loved it! I would highly recommend for anyone to try. You’ll be so glad you did.
Great for foodies, groups, views and drinks.  Highly recommend a visit.

Food was delicious and plated well. Space is very attractive. Lots of natural light in the main dining room with views of the water and the open kitchen (separated by glass). The bar area is large and inviting. There's also covered outdoor seating. Hostess was very friendly and welcoming. Server friendly and delivered great service. Will be back!
Great view, food and service.  I definitely recommend it.

If you are looking for fine dining with a harbor view Hurrica is the restaurant for you. From being greeted by Victor, to our table by the water, and our waiter whose recommendations were spot on, our lunch today was absolutely fantastic.
It was a little loud but wonderful wonderful night.  We had a large party and the service, food and atmosphere could not have been better!!
My favorite pace to dine.  The ambiance is unique. Love the jelly fish tank and looking out at those gorgeous yachts.  The wait staff is perfect--a very welcoming atmosphere.
Great restaurant and food also great view of the Westpoint Marina very pleased with the place.

Beautifully designed to fit in with the nautical theme of the nearby bay and harbor.  The bar is very inviting, with one side of the square allowing for outside seating.  Food and service were fabulous.  Would highly recommend for a lovely evening away from the bustle.

Great restaurant off the beaten path. Meal was very nice, the staff was attentive and professional. And oppose to only your waiter being able to service you, it seemed as though everyone working on the floor was able to assist or willing to step in and help out. Overall great for a date night out.

From the moment we arrived the service was top notch. The hostess was able to get us an inside seat. The table was perfect. The wait staff and management are so friendly. Then there’s the food!! It is yummy. The presentation and flavors are off the chart good. 5 star all the way
Oh and the restaurant is beautiful
Good food overall, a few plates didn’t come out hot.
love the small bites, oysters and appetizers.   Services are great.
Came in for brunch and stumbled upon their oyster happy hour. Apparently it’s everyday and the oysters on special rotate every day! Will def be back
Beautiful yacht harbor and bay trail view during the day.  Food was very good, even though service was not as attentive as expected.
What a fabulous experience! One of the most beautiful restaurants in the Bay Area. The food is definitely 5 star quality.
Great food and great atmosphere! Though, the outdoor seating can get a little chilly.
What a fabulous restaurant! Food is delicious and the staff is excellent. Lovely, special restaurant.  Noise level can be high indoors. Outside seating area is quiet.
Amazing ambiance, great food and good service. Location is wonderful on the waters edge.

Another great visit to Hurrica - lovely location as always, menu continues to evolve - everything was fantastic!  Special shout out to the small bite scallops - outstanding!    Looking forward to the next visit!

Second time visiting. Will go a third. The only reason I will not rate it higher is because I did no love my dish. Tasted great, but it seemed like two different concepts forced together. Too much water I would say (tri tip & wet salad).

My wife’s plate was excellent. Same as appetizers and dessert. I still think this is a one off and would recommend to friends looking for an option in this area.

This was my fifth time dining at Hurrica, and everything was fabulous, as always. The appetizer bites are delicious. We loved the scallop and the oyster bites. The lobster ravioli was phenomenal and perfectly executed. The whole fish dorade cooked on the hearth and deboned at the table is not to be missed. The carrot cake is the most popular dessert, and will make even the most dubious guest (the others at my table) smile with delight, and admit they do, in fact, like carrot cake, after all.

Thank you for making my father's friends and all of us feel so special celebrating a milestone birthday. The restaurant is gorgeous and every detail is well thought out. I can't wait for my sixth visit.
Great service beautiful setting and good food. Great drinks and good selection of wine.

I loved this restaurant. Highly recommended for anyone that wants something beautiful and different. I have been to the San Francisco Restaurants Water-bar and to Epic gorgeous environment and food. The day was warm we sat outside and looked at the marina, I took my stuff for a birthday luncheon. The food was excellent. The weight staff was excellent. My entire experience was excellent ￼￼
One of the best dinners of my life, beautiful decor and thoughtful service.
Hurrica never disappoints- always friendly, impeccable service, wonderful cuisine, and a beautiful setting. The best on the peninsula.!
Great food and good service loved the ambiance price competitive

It was my first time dining at Hurrica and it definitely won’t be my last! I took two friends to celebrate birthdays and the staff treated us great. Dean, at the bar, made one of the best mocktails I’ve ever had. It’s a beautiful space and the food is delicious.
Very cool jellyfish aquarium inside the restaurant!

It was a bit hard to find....However, when we finally arrived we couldn't have been more delighted. What a BEAUTIFUL restaurant.  Very high-end.  The staff was excellent and the fresh oysters were delicious accompanied with the watermelon mignonette sauce.  Perfect!  We enjoyed the Lingcod and Halibut dinners too!  Cooked to perfection.  We will return.
Excellent evening with good friends.  Pork chop was outstanding and cooked to my request.  Martinis are a little small but overall a superb evening of culinary experience.

The service at Hurrica is terrible.  The food is very good but the combo of bad service + very high prices makes Hurrica a place we will not go to again.

We have eaten at Hurrica twice and both times the service was bad.  Most recently, I took our family there to celebrate my mother's 81st birthday.  We were sat and no one came over to our table for probably 10+ minutes.  Throughout the dinner I had to flag down waiters to get a drink, order dinner, etc. etc.  After we finished our appetizer, we probably waited 30 minutes for the next course.  Clearly the waiter had forgotten to put in the order.  Overall it was a very poor experience even for a much more reasonably-priced restaurant.

To top it off, there was no recognition of my mom's 81st birthday despite me telling them via OpenTable and when we checked in at the restaurant.

I told the manager before we left how disappointed I was and pointed out all of the items above.  He said he would "take care of us" the next time.  However, there won't be a next time.

Nice restaurant way out at the end of Seaport Blvd. in RWCity.  Reception, waiter etc were all helpful and friendly enough. There is  a jellyfish aquarium in the bar that is worth a 5 minute mesmerization. 
Most important, at lunch, the food was excellent, the prices were OK, and ambience was great.
We will go again.
Delicious food and wonderful ambiance. The small bites are especially exquisite and you cannot miss the milk bread.

Location was a bit isolated but not hard to find. It got nice view right next to the dock.  Somehow even the doors were opened, noise level was quite high.  Seafood was fresh & good value. I just wished there were more seafood options for lunch. Good place to meet up friends or have business lunch
The appetizers, main dishes and drinks were excellent. The dessert was a bit of a dissertation (warm peach cake). The setting is lovely and we like that Hurrica is very dog friendly. We will be back!
Great place for dinner. Great food like the milk bread. The carrot cake was taste as well.

First time at Hurrica. We had great service from Joseph, he explained the menu and was very knowledgeable on the dishes. The owner dropped by our table a couple of times and saw her helping the staff and other customers. This a great experience and plan to be back soon.

Our meal at Hurrica today was amazing!  The food was delicious, every bite!  4 of us ate 8 dishes, and every morsel was the best ever!
In addition to the delicious food, the service was impressive. We had such a great time!

Another great experience at Hurrica. First time dining outside as wind usually oicks up but during heatwave this was perfect. Great cocktails, service and high quality food.  This is IMO one of the best restaurants in Peninsula p.t.
Our server was fantastic. Definitely try the scallops and the bread!

Was disappointed tonight. We ordered drinks. After 20 minutes no drinks. Server came to take our order and I said we’d like our drinks first. The whole night was extremely slow and not given much attention. I asked for the halibut with sauce on the side, but that didn’t happen. The fish was drenched in tomato sauce. I thought it was a milk sauce.

Given how far this is from a downtown area, it was surprisingly lively on a Wednesday at noon. Fresh oysters to start (including a bargain-priced daily special) followed by a salad with grilled prawns and soba. Chocolate soft-serve sundae to close, and it was all great. Service was exceptional. I had a special request related to a friend’s birthday and it was handled very thoughtfully in addition to excellent meal service. Decor is special occasion-worthy without being stuffy; it manages to be both calming and fun. Great view of the harbor. Can’t say enough good things about this place!

Service was substandard
Not attentive
Distasteful
Hostess was unprofessional
Waiters missed the orders
Premature removal of glasses and plates
Pretentious but fell short
Incredible experience. This was our third visit, and there will be many more!
What a fabulous find!! On the end of the road, a restaurant that is unexpectedly both charming, beautifully detailed with an excellent dining experience. Not cheap... But worth every penny!

WOW! Cant say enough good things about Hurrica. This is exactly the kind of restaurant built in exactly the right location in the right style to make it a staple for special occasions and fine dining at any time. Every item our party ordered and shared (and there were many) were all amazing. Compliments to the chef and staff for an incredible, satisfying experience. Theres no reason to get into details on any one particular dish because they are all amazing. We can’t wait to come back again soon to try more of the menu and enjoy the million dollar harbor and bay views.
A really nice suprise for RWC, We ate in bar and it was nice on a sunday for lunch,we hear it gets busy so make reservations..
Outstanding location with great staff. I highly recommend their ahi-tuna wraps
Everything we ordered were just amazing! Recommendations were on point. Can’t wait to go back!

Wow! What a beautiful restaurant in a perfect location almost on the water. It’s a bit out there on Seaport all the way to the end and the building the decor. Everything is gorgeous about this restaurant. They had four of the owners. They’re all working the floor, which made it really nice and special. Huge jellyfish tank adds to the ambulance and the chandeliers are just gorgeous. I highly highly recommend this restaurant.
We’re definitely going back. Be sure to order all of the appetizer starters one bites… Amazing.

Had a friend from out of town visiting, decided to take him. Food was fantastic and as always service was friendly and high quality!
Highly recommend!

My team was in the Bay area for work.  We had 2 team members that had birthdays while we were onsite.  We went to Hurrica for a lovely seafood dinner by the water and we got that and ALOT more.  The service was unbelievable, the food we fantastic and the vibe was over the top wonderful.  Best birthday dinner ever!  There was a lovely boat that came into port and they had great music playing as if it was just for us.  I can't wait to go back!
The food,service and ambience at Hurricane was amazing. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening and look forward to returning again soon.
Good food and ambience. Good customer service. The only downside is slower turn over of food and server making mistakes in giving us food that we didn’t order.
10 of us gathered and shared wonderful small plates and entrees accompanied with soectacular wine. Memorable evening dining  outside

Fantastic view, food was great but fish portion in fish&chips was small. 

Would definitely come back
Great place, great food and service. Love the jelly fish aquarium too. A little long and very noisy are the only drawback. But it’s a beautiful area and you can see the marina from inside the place.
We’ve dined at Hurrica a handful of times and every time is a great experience. The food, service and ambiance are awesome.
What a fabulous restaurant! It’s a beautiful place in a wonderful setting and the staff go out of their way to be helpful and accommodating!
Great location. Good food.good service. Pleasant lunch

The setting is beautiful along the bay. Our Fish and Chips were delicious and the wait staff personable and attentive. There is a large aquarium with Jelly Fish between the dining room and bar. Highly recommend this restaurant.

My friend and I had a wonderful, relaxing lunch. We each enjoyed sharing a seafood chowder and then each ordering the delicious prawn salad with the soba noodles and peanuts. Everything was so tasty. We really enjoyed this.
Wonderful meal but service could have been faster.
First time dining at Hurrica.  It was the best meal I’ve had in a very long time.  Every single employee was friendly and made us feel special.  The food was divine!

Great views and ambience.   Never get tired of seeing the jellyfish in the tank.  STRONG and delicious drinks.  The roasted mushrooms, the dorado fish and the white bass were wonderful.  Our wait guy was great and helpful with our dinner selections.  A wonderful evening
We were impressed with the food, ambiance and service. Exceptional service with an eye for detail and timing.
Excellent food and service. We loved the view and will definitely be back!

Food took forever to come out … except the kids meals which came out immediately and then the rest of us waiting nearly an hour for food - simple orders of just salads and sandwiches. Servers were hard to wave down. Items came out of order. Was celebrating a special birthday and called a day before to make arrangements. Didn’t get to celebrate at all because everything took so long. Super disappointing. Been there before and it’s been great. Location is great.

Food was yummy.  Very expensive steak options ($100+) and fish entrees around $50.  Great drinks, beautiful view.  It was VERY loud where we sat up against the jellyfish wall that I was shouting at my partner.  Our server wasn't very well up to speed on how to modify dishes to be GF (gluten free) or diary free.  She packaged up our left overs in a to go back and then set it down on the floor next to the table.  Ended up leaving it behind as a result.  Plus, who puts food on the floor...

Truly outstanding experience at this new restaurant

Any restaurant with a view of water to me already has three stars, and Hurrica’s location right next to the Marina gave it great views of all the Silicon Valley yachts (great food with a side of envy!)

The dining room is new, hip and attractive. A large jellyfish aquarium makes it even more appealing. We also liked the open kitchen.

We sat outside - there was a heat lamp and the staff offered to bring us blankets, although hey weren’t needed.

The food was exceptionally good. We highly recommend all four of the dishes we had: the milk bread (amazing dipping sauce), baked Miyagi oysters, salmon carpaccio, and (drumroll, please) the surprise star of the evening…the roasted mushrooms 

We went on a Wednesday night, and it was absolutely packed. Word is out! To that end, service was a bit slow (hence the 4 stars), but we think this was due to the huge crowd, a busy server, and our sitting outside. That said, EVERYONE was cheerful and friendly and seemed to very much care about our having a pleasant experience, which we did.

Please stay away from this restaurant- we don’t want to have difficulty getting reservations for the many times we intend to return.
Fabulous location, great ambience and high quality food which is rare to find these days. Will go back for more

this restaurant is beautiful. It's on the water, something the peninsula has been lacking. the hostesses were lovely and the waitstaff friendly. we had 3 different dishes and 1 was perfect, one was very good and one was OK. The filet was perfect, halibut very good and the pork chop was tough and chewy, but with good accompaniments. The desserts are awesome and fun; carrot cake and peach cake were totally yummy. 
I'd like to try lunch there for a different perspective.
End up sit indoor instead outdoor, servers are nice and, food is good but not enough choices
The food was ok. The service was slow and it took forever to get the check. For that price, everything should have been excellent.
Fantastic place.  Refreshingly filling in a sore void of classy casual dining on the mid-peninsula.

Really enjoyed our time! The views of the Marina/boats were stunning, the quality of the food/drink was top notch, and the service was really impressive. Can't wait to go back for a drink or full dinner!
Hurrica does not disappoint, their service is impeccable and the cuisine is creative and delicious. Great wine list, and the hostess was very accommodating with our picky table hunting.
This is an excellent new place well worth a visit, with superb service and great chefs.
Service was exceptional.  Food was good.  Noise level inside was quite loud.  I’d go back but request outside seating.
Wonderful experience. Wait staff was wonderful and food delicious. Absolutely terrific. Lovely location as well.

It’s such a lovely spot to have a meal!  Food is fabulous and inventive!  It seems very expensive upon first looking at the menu but we have discovered plates are sharable !  If it’s your first time ask your server about size!

What a great place! So beautifully designed and decorated with a super cool jellyfish tank and open view of the kitchen hearth. Wonderful view of the water also. Great service and such friendly owners. The food was fresh, delicious and portions were generous. We were a party of 9 and everyone was happy!! We plan to return for dinners and also for their oyster happy hours!

Appetizers (sashimi, onion rings) were good and tasty, but mains (pork chop and sea bass) were a little bland and not well seasoned.   Spetzl also a bit bland.   Good low salt restaurant ;-).  S’more was good !

Beautiful sunset ambience, lovely views but the overall noise level was a bit high. 
Our initial service was delayed but the maiter d' deftly stepped in & ordered our drinks. After that the service was good, the food delectable & overall we were impressed & will return.
Lovely lunch in a beautiful setting. The prawn salad was delicious. The service was excellent.

What a lucky find  this is! Nestled deep into the marina in RWC,  you walk into a beautifully designed space that is warm and inviting. We were greeted by a lovely host and had wonderful wine at the bar. Make sure to check out the jellyfish tank- it’s mesmerizing. We sat in the dining room and the food was delicious from start to finish. We can’t wait to come back again and bring our friends too. Thank you to the whole team there for a great evening!

Wonderful ambience , staff, food oh the food YUMMMYYY! 
Will most definitely be returning soon! 
We went for girls night out, BUT perfect for date night!
The food was great!! But service was terrible may be since they were short staffed ! Also the noice level was very high and could barely hear each other
Double Birthdays celebration lunch.   Food and drinks  were excellent and enjoyed in the beautiful restaurant with exceptional view.
As always great food, great service. Lovely atmosphere. One of our favorite restaurants.
Hurrica is an amazing experience!  Great food, awesome setting, welcoming staff.  This is a great place for any celebration or just to treat someone special.
Excellent service from everyone! Delicious food. Memorable evening.
This is a beautiful restaurant with an outstanding staff….and the food is amazing. Every bite was delicious.

Sitting seaside with yachts is a treat in itself. The food is creative, delicious, and well presented. I have lived here all my life and the location was so new to me, so fun. The bar was surprisingly empty. Love looking into the kitchen. I do wish the fish & chips was on the dinner menu. I'll go back for lunch. Highlights: onion rings and strawberry shortcake. Lowlights: 16 oz steak at $100 and a bit of over-hovering  by the managers. We will return.

Hidden treasure on the water in Redwood City! We had the delicious seafood chowder, the tuna sandwich, and the scrumptious strawberry shortcake for dessert. I highly recommend you take a trip to this beautiful restaurant on the water.

We brought family from out of state and they really enjoyed it. We had table 44 reserved but when we arrived it was in the sun so we asked for something in the shade. Unfortunately the shaded area is windy. I would like to recommend that the outside tables in the sun be protected from the sun in some way. Perhaps an awning could provide shade? Thank you
My husband and I had an early dinner and sat outside. The service was great and the food was wonderful. Ww will be back.

My wife and I came for our anniversary and loved it! Staff were very friendly and attentive. Food was amazing! Creative cocktail menu as well, highly recommend the martini. Will definitely be coming back!
I reserved well in advance for a birthday celebration only to be disappointed by a view of the parking lot. No birthday candle. Food very good but we hoped for more on a special evening.

My wife and I eat out all of the time and look for nice places all over Sac to the Bay and anywhere we travel and we both feel like dinner last night at Hurricas was one of the best dining experiences we've had in a while! One of the owners, Meesun, was great! She was active in the restaurant the whole time, talking and helping her guests. The staff were extremely helpful and hospitable. We had the milk bread and bone marrow to start. Both great. And we had the filet with duck fat potatoes and the kombu wrapped lobster. All good! The night before we ate at Selby's and this place was head and shoulders better than that place. We will be back and definitely recommend to anyone! Thanks Meesun and staff for a great time!

Bar was way too loud the restaurant was also loud,fortunately we were seated in a perfect spot open to the deck so we were able to have a comfortable conversation.
Service was very good.
The space is beautiful.  Very much off the beaten track.

Great addition to Redwood City, nothing like it in the area! Service was impeccable with great attention to detail.

Outdoor was perfect in the evening, didn’t even need an outer layer with the heat lamp. Great pics can be had at golden hour, with the boats in the background.

My group ate the caviar, mussels, figs and burrata, roasted dorade and pork chop, all amazing.

10/10!

Third time dining here and decided to go out with our best friends to share this spectacularly good new place. Specifically asked to sit in main dining room to give our guests best experience. Menu as great as ever. Preparation and presentation of each course superlative. Some mixed service ; asst manager? ( guy in a suit) Fantastic , sommelier good, waiter just ok, servers/bus boys bad!
Food flavors incredible!! Mijagi oyster and scallop in shell may be two best apps of all time. If they straighten out who’s serving/ taking orders and taking check this would be perfect.

We had an amazing dinner at Hurrica Restaurant & Bar in Redwood City, and it exceeded all our expectations. From the moment we walked in, the ocean view, ambiance was warm and welcoming, setting the stage for a perfect evening. The highlight of the night was undoubtedly the seafood—it was fresh, flavorful, and expertly prepared. Every dish we ordered was a delight, but the standout was their grilled seafood platter, which was perfectly seasoned and cooked to perfection.

The service was equally impressive. The staff was attentive without being overbearing, and their knowledge of the menu helped us choose the matching wine, dishes that we absolutely loved. Our server made sure our glasses were never empty, and the whole team went above and beyond to make us feel like valued guests.

If you're in the area and love seafood, Hurrica is a must-visit. We can't wait to return for another delicious meal!
Great food and atmosphere! Service was excellent as well! Been here a few times and will definitely return and recommend to others.

Lovely outdoor dining with view of hills and yachts. Went for lunch and ordered Seared Petrale Sole zucchini, andouille sausage, caper butter, fried sweet potato.  Sounded great and is a good concept, but the fish was quite dry, overcooked, and the other ingredients were also dry.  A
 nice broth would of saved the dish.  My friend's chicken Caesar did not have much chicken, but did have lots of greens and was tasty.  The coffee is delicious.  The server was very pleasant and helpful.
Delicious food, menu changes by season. The service is excellent and the views are spectacular esp around sunset. Highly recommend !

We had an amazing anniversary dinner. The food was delicious and we have tried most of the smaller dishes. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who is looking for fine dining and fresh, excellent tastes.
The service can be faster but everyone was very friendly and professional.

We were celebrating my best friend’s birthday. This was her first experience at Hurrica & our meal and time together didn’t disappoint. I have been to Hurrica twice & had raved about the restaurant. She loved the ambience- the jellyfish aquarium, and all the other well appointed exquisite specially thought out items that make the restaurant so memorable. We loved the seafood chowder, the lobster ravioli, milk bread & other small plates that made our meal so delicious.

We felt rushed the minute we walked in the door and throughout our meal.  Multiple stops at our table without giving us a chance to lookover the entire menu and ask questions.  It was a little uncomfortable.  They even attempted to take our plates when we clearly were not finished eating.

Also, when we asked if we could sit in a certain area, she said, "Oh no, that is for VVIP's"...what?
Aren't all customers VIP.  We kind of felt like second-class citizens at that point.

The venue itself is beautiful and the furnishings are impressive for sure!
I'll give it another try, but get the service part nailed down please!

great location.  service with a smile.  everyone was very nice and the staff seemed happy to be there.  the food was creative and well presented.  will definitely go again.  the wine list could use an upgrade but that was not an issue- perhaps their clientele is not looking for fine wine.

Nice location  by the water overlooking the bay and yatchs . Food was ok having eatin at the Waterbar. Service not honest attenative. We were overcharged so check your bill  . When we went pointed it out , the waiter offered no apology . Check your bill for overcharge.

My wife and I visited Hurrica for the first time last night. The dining experience was phenomenal. All of the food was delicious and the staff was amazing. We felt welcomed and we left very content. We enjoyed the drinks- shipwrecked and yacht rock- and the food- milk bread, melon salad, hamachi, potatoes, pork chop, and dorade-. We are definitely coming back and highly recommend you dine there.

Our waitress had way too many tables to serve.
Kept us waiting to order. Actual servers presenting was excellent! Food presentation lovely. Restaurant was way over crowded and extraordinarily noisy. Setting is beautiful!
Service was excellent.  Food was excellent.  We’ll be back
First time dining here and it was great! Food was delicious, service outstanding, and setting was beautiful! Will definitely return!
Excellent service as always! Our 10th visit was great

Fabulous experience at our first visit to this restaurant. Entertaining business  guests with 6 people total and it didn’t disappoint. Owner gave us a detailed and extensive overview of menu which we loved. I think we ordered one of everything by the time she was done. Scallop starter was incredible. Only disappointing aspect was long wait for wine/bottle opening and serve. Not our waitress. I think it was their sommelier. Highly recommend giving it a try. Great location too with loads of parking. Just go!
This is just a little jem! Redwood City got a beautiful new space with the best of the best in house and kitchen. Nice!

Always an amazing time! Cake here more than 5 times since it’s been opened.
Great food ! Great service !
Owner MeeSun is so sweet and a great genuine person ￼
Beautiful restaurant and great food. Expensive but well worth it for special occasions
Our waiter was a bit pushy on both taking order and taking away the plates while we were still finishing up.
As always, food, service & ambiance is superb! Everyone knows that this is my new favorite restaurant!
Great location for a romantic dinner-getaway, or friends night out! Loved over-looking the beautiful boats and yachts in the marina!
Good creative foods and all servers are friendly and prompt.  Also it's not pretentious like some other expensive restaurants.

This restaurant is an absolute gem that’s located at a gorgeous water view inside a new stunning building at the waters edge. As you drink and dine, the views of the active yacht boat harbor and serene mountain range in the background couldn’t be more beautiful and festive.

We arrived early at the bar to wait for our larger party. As our guests continued to join in, the bar atmosphere was a perfect environment to greet them. Excellent drinks, friendly staff and a glass view into their immaculatly clean kitchen, while chefs put on an unassuming performance getting plates ready for their customers. This was not only mesmerizing but truly a chef dance of perfection.

When seated, we were treated to the lovely owner’s long greeting. She pointed out items on her menu with pride and gratitude for being able to offer us the best of the best. A very personal touch.

I will say that the appetizers were very expensive for their small size, but delicious. The entrees were more hearty and oh so very good. Our friend-who was both vegetarian and had a food allergy-was able to request exactly what she wanted in a pasta and the chef made it to her specifications. Apparently they do this a lot with whatever fresh ingredients they have on hand.

We were enchanted by the entire experience, thank you for such a special place to dine, what a find!

Limited menu....very expensive
Food was great !!!!

A truly beautiful and special restaurant that is a dining experience to remember. Top-notch food, service and stunning views. The seafood was fresh and delicious. All the dishes from beef to pasta and desserts were spectacular. The wine and cocktail selection are fantastic. This is my new favorite place for fine dining and making memories. Five stars.

The place is beautiful.
The surroundings are even more so.
The ambiance is great. The food is good but not Wow.
I had a fried chicken sandwich with coleslaw and french fries. 
The coleslaw was less than mediocre.
My husband had clam chowder which he loved and fish and chips, which were not so great.
We the pana cota which was good.
We liked the place very much.
Would like to see more selections beyond seafood.

excellent atmosphere, service and food.  We would have loved to have stayed outside, but the staff realized it was too windy and cool and offered to move us inside.  would have been nice if a windbreaker or some device could have cut the wind and allowed us to stay outside.  (For future consideration).  Great first experience at a gorgeous setting!

This was the third time I've been to Hurrica in the past two months and I was able to explore the menu more broadly beyond the fabulous signature dish, Dorade. The pasta, king salmon, and sautéed mushroom small plates were each perfect. Desert was lovely. And we enjoyed a marvelous Barolo the manager suggested. Service seemed spotty at times, but overall satisfied.

We came as a group of 6 for dinner and everyone loved our experience! We had a round of cocktails and 2 bottles of wine for the table. The cured salmon, milk bread, and bone marrow were amazing starters and the dorade, filet, and pork chop were the collective favorites of our entrees. The desserts were all perfect!! The s’mores—yum!!!  Thanks for the hospitality and a delicious meal!

What a wonderful dinner, beginning with a warm welcome from hostess Courtney.  Then, we received an informed preview of the menu with great recommendations.  The food was amazing, especially the scallop and milk bread for appetizer and Dorade for entree.  The service was amazing.  We can't wait to go back.

We came on Aug 5th with 2 adults and 3 kids to celebrate my fiancée’s birthday. We were welcomed by the co-owners and everything felt very special. The food was great.

However, we all felt that the service could have been better. In particular, when the waiter was taking our order, (1) he insisted that we make a full order upfront (appetizers and main courses) - which was already a stretch, (2) he was simultaneously scanning other tables in his eyesight, definitely not giving us full attention, clearly demonstrating us his impatience when we had a slight hesitation when choosing the mains. To be honest, it ruined the mood for the evening. As we are putting in a big order of $700 for 5 people, all upfront per your ask, we definitely expect some patience and help, especially with 3 kids. We expected a much better service for the price tag.

All in all, the food was awesome. Service - not so much

Exceptional food, wonderful ambiance and attentive service. First time in while where I cannot wait to go back to try the other dishes that I passed up. Lots of great choices but only one stomach. The location cannot be beat and the moon jelly aquarium is mesmerizing.
Food and food service is always excellent there.  Eating and looking at the harbor and their beautiful jelly fish aquarium is icing on the cake!!
It’s a great fun place right on the harbor.  Wonderful food too

We loved the location and the design of Hurrica. Everything is beautiful and fresh, from comfy chairs to perfect bathrooms! We had salad and oysters and tuna sandwiches. All were yummy. The only change I suggest is that the delicious tomato soup be served in a lower cream soup type bowl. The very deep salad bowl made the eating a bit tricky. But overall excellent and we will return!
Delicious innovative menu. Tasteful presentation.  Beautiful decor and bay views.
The oysters were the best!!  Perfect ambiance and good food!👍
Fantastic new restaurant with great food and excellent service.  Highest recommendations.  Cheers!
Service was friendly but so slow. May have been an unusually busy evening
Make sure you get seated in the main dining room, not back in the overflow banquet room... especially when it's your anniversary!  :-(

Good service. Have to know the menu to get the best value.
Need steak knives
The salad was delicious and the dessert was to die for. Great marina views and terrific food.
Fantastic food! Super attentive service, beautiful views :)

With stunning artwork and decor, delicious food and unique drinks, Hurrica was a wonderful sensory experience. The staff went out of their way to provide us a memorable evening of dining and we will take them up on their invitation to return. Be sure to admire the stunning jellyfish aquarium!

Great having a new place in Redwood City with beautiful views by the water.  Food is pretty good for fine dining. My favorites where the lobster ravioli and filet of beef. S'mores dessert is on point. I would say whom ever oversees desserts is the star of the kitchen. Service is actually pretty poor imo. Very slow and they don't often check on you. They messed up our order and we had to call that out. It was corrected, but it feels like they're just not paying attention.  Other things that could be improved are promptness in taking orders. Replacing dropped silverware. Bringing out salt and pepper and things of the sort. I think this is perhaps their biggest weakness. If they get this sorted I think it'd be a jewel in RWC.
Excellent!  We will be back for an other experience.

We had a delicious lunch at Hurrica. Staff was friendly and informative. We might try the back room next time for a quieter atmosphere but loved seeing the water and the boats in the harbor. The bar is very pretty and would like to try it out next time.

We had a change in plans that caused us to arrive earlier than our reservation and we were not treated like an inconvenience- we were completely accommodated.  We know that cannot always be done but the willingness to try to make it work was so appreciated.  More importantly the food was amazing.  The menu offered our whole party what we all wanted.  We love this place!!
Delicious food. Excited to return to celebrate my birthday! ￼
They over charged us twice out of 3 times being there. Food is ok
This is our new favorite restaurant. Excellent service, food and ambiance. Highly recommend!

The staff at Hurraci is truly wonderful. The chowder was equally wonderful. The ambiance was also wonderful. Chicken sandwich was good, however, the tri tip was sent back as it was not the best of cuts.

Absolutely delicious food in a beautiful setting. Not super cheap but not crazy-expensive either. Seafood was all excellent, especially tuna starter and mussels with pesto and pappardelle pasta. Loved our dinner there!

Poor service:  check was miscalculated several times, no one particular server took responsibility for our orders so mistakes were mad.  Pork chop was filled with gristle and fat.  Oysters were delicious.  Bar service was fine.  Setting is spectacular.  Wine choices limited and spendy.  Would recommend with caution.
Food, location and service was really good. We will be back for dinner for sure.
What a lovely location! This is a beautifully designed and decorated venue. The food is fantastic and service is excellent. My first choice for dinner on the peninsula!

With views of the water and boats in a marina, and a fresh architectural style with a beautiful bar, Hurrica is a welcome newcomer to the mid Peninsula scene.  We had a lovely evening with friends dining at Hurrica twice in the past two weeks.  The cocktails are absolutely delicious.  Where Hurrica falls short is in its limited menu, which borders on the eclectic.  It’s hard to find something that you are excited to try, with foods like mussels, raw fish, bass, and halibut all available and beautifully presented, the flavors themselves are good but not great.   I really wish that they would add a selection of green salads to the menu (there are none), as well as a chicken dish and a salmon dish, all of which would be more universally appealing to guests with less adventuresome taste than what is featured on their current menu.

We were seated promptly and service was attentive. We had the milk bread, oysters, seafood chowder, bone marrow, onion rings, lobster with cordyceps, and prime rib. Everything exceeded our expectations except the bone marrow, since it had an excess of toppings and very little marrow.

Overall, we had a nice experience and will be coming back!
lovely new place;  beautiful surroundings outdoors and the interior is lovely!   Food was excellent;  to top it off the carrot cake was best I have ever had!

What an incredible discovery Hurrica was! We live in”down the street”, near downtown Redwood City. I used to work in the Seaport business park, and remembered that the yacht club and restaurant were going to be revived, so I went on a little exploratory mission.

I had no idea how high-end and fashionable (and expensive) this restaurant would be! The food and cocktails were absolutely perfectly executed. The service was just “ok” - it didn’t really feel like 5 star service, but it was acceptable.

We will definitely be back for special occasions!!!

Food and drinks were great. Decor, ambiance and noise was not what I had expected. Not quite as special as I had hoped it would be for an intimate dinner. I should have asked for the back dining room.

Hurrica is the pinnacle of dining. If you’re not dining here, what are you even doing? This place offers a fusion of cuisine and service that’s as sharp as a knife.

Walking into Hurrica, you’re greeted by a stunning waterfront view that’s pure class. The modern nautical ambiance, with those jellyfish tanks and top-tier decor, screams luxury and success. This isn’t your average restaurant; this is where winners dine and guess what?I’m a winner! ;)

The seafood is amazing, and even though it's primarily a seafood restaurant, the grilled filet of beef is a dish that dominates. It shows what happens when culinary mastery meets ambition. The chef here isn’t just cooking; he’s creating art that leaves an impact.

Erick and Francisco, the managers, are the best in the business. They know how to run a place with the efficiency and precision of a well-oiled machine. They get it – it’s about making every visit unforgettable and making every guest feel like royalty.

And let’s talk about the desserts. The pastry chef’s creations are visually stunning and taste incredible. The warm milk bread is next-level. This isn’t just dessert, this is an experience that proves the devil is in the details.

Hurrica, isn’t just a dining spot; it’s a statement. It’s where the elite gather to enjoy the best.

The food was ok but the services was terrible. I got the wrong dish. When I got up to use the rest room, I came back to find my seat given away even before I settled my bill. I had to go up to the counter to ask for my bill and pay.

Ambience: top notch

Food: very good

Service: 
1) Our waiter was very good. 
2) The delivery/timing of the small plates was below par for a top notch establishment.
3) The busboy was a bit too eager to clear the table, especially when there was food on the plate.

Bottom line: I would recommend this restaurant to others, particularly because of the chef and the quality of his food, but for this place to succeed, the service needs to be spot on.
We both had the Dorade, which was very good.  My husband enjoys wine by the glass and said his Mendocino red was awesome.

Too long of a wait between starters, small plate orders, entrees and the check; the best, most attentive service came from the gent that was managing water service.

Milk bread, oysters, soup and the caviar options were the best choices.

The New York strip arrived as medium and not medium rare. The bone marrow was okay. The presentation was better than the food product. The cucumber melon salad was a creative option - the dressing and feta ratio was too high for it to be enjoyable.

With all the great restaurants locally in neighboring cities, this is not on my list to return.￼
Stunning harbor views from the restaurant.  Food expensive but quite good. Wait staff very accommodating and friendly.

I had no ideal this "off-the-beaten-path" gem existed. We made reservations for our anniversary and were blown away by the ambiance, amazing food and stellar service. We had a drink at the bar and met Laramie who welcomed us to Hurrica and served a Mermaid Martini. She stopped by our table after our meal to confirm we had a great time. Ahmet, our server recommended every dish we ate and we couldn't have been more pleased with each course! After dinner as we were enjoying he Jellyfish tank, Victor, the floor manager stopped to ask us how we enjoyed our meal and showed us several of the unique art pieces in the dining room  and took us on a quick tour. Great time and we'll definitely be back!

A truly great dinner,  the best I have had for several years.  Main  course was a whole Daurade cooked on the hearth.   Dessert  was a fabulous carrot cake (with carrots "growing"  from the top).

Magnificent view of the yacht club from the veranda.    The bar  area is spectacular,  and even the rest rooms are special.

It is pricey, but well worth it for special occasions.

In spite of a full house of diners, the restaurant delivered excellent food and 
service.  The occasion was a friend's birthday and she was thrilled and delighted with her choice of the grilled scallop bites with the warm milk bread.  The entree of halibut further pleased her.  The carrot cake and tiny birthday cake topped off
a memorable evening.  Thanks to all.
Everything was great! I had the filet and it was fantastic! Great cocktails too.

Although we had reservations we weren’t seated until 20 minutes later. Food service was very slow. We were promised complimentary Prosecco for having to wait so long and never came until we asked for it twice! Food is average, definitely not worth waiting for!

My reservation was for 7:00pm but didn’t get seated until around 7:30.  I can understand a 5 minute wait for them to get the table ready but 30 minutes???  As for the food, the appetizers were good but the lobster and prime rib was nothing to write home about.  At $100 for the prime rib and $95 for the lobster we expected exceptional and not just so-so.  The place is beautiful but they have to do better with their main entrees.

Seated us around the corner from the front of the restaurant. Very windy. Had a Caesar salad probably contained 2 ounces of chicken. definitely could’ve been more generous . My sister had the burger and said it was amazing.￼ Once the food was delivered, waiter came by once. Sat for about 15 minutes, waiting for him to collect our bill and had to get another waiter to come and take it for us. ￼
Well-Appointed restaurant with professional white staff. Food was above average but the service was exceptional and the ambiance is very beautiful.

Outstanding Food - Atmosphere - Service.  Started with Oysters and moved onto small bites including Ceviche and Onion Rings that were perfect.  Lobster Ravioli that melted in our mouths and then with the Bronzino from the hearth which was spectacular.  Finished with the Carrot Cake desert which was the best we have ever had.

Hurrica Restaurant has excellent food and great service!

I can’t wait to go back!

Lovely place to enjoy lunch on the veranda on a beautiful summer afternoon. Clearly, a lot of thought and care went into the development of this new spot. Small details like the lovely glass and tableware show their attention to detail. Food and drinks are good, although a bit pricey. Would suggest that the menu offer some vegetarian options.  Overall, great views and vibe!
Beautiful view. Exquisite, unique, and delicious food.

Beautiful restaurant with great views of the harbor. Outdoor deck seating was perfect for a hot evening.
Food was delicious and service was wonderful.
A perfect Summer’s evening.
Service was slow and forgetful. Food was decent but likely won't go back as the food didn't make up for the service. Decor and ambiance is lovely.
BEAUTIFUL and delicious…our waiter Alejandro was so awesome.  Highly recommend.

Returning customer. Consistently excellent. Love the “east coast” raw clams … hard to find !
Highly recommended lunch spot.

What a great place to have lunch outside on a beautiful day.  View of the water and boats were so relaxing.  Had my favority beau soleil oysters and parmesan fries.  Friend had the delicious prawn salad with soba noodles.  This is a perfect spot for early hors d'oevres and cocktails.

Service very good and friendly.

Did not reserve correct table as requested. Food was tasty, although portions are small for the price. And even though the restaurant is in a location with a great view, unfortunately one of the two dining rooms has a view of dirt and parking lot.

The location at the marina is very nice. Even though we were seated outside facing the marina, the noise from inside the restaurant was quite loud. Food is very tasty, but the day we were there for lunch service was VERY slow. Menu is varied; a bit on the pricey side.

We had outside seating so gentle breeze and fabulous views. The food as always was wonderful! There appear to be many food service people but at times we really felt forgotten. When our server was there he was very personable and pleasant.
We had an amazing time celebrating our anniversary. The staff was attentive and gracious. The ambience as great and the decors was beautiful. The food was delicious.
I have been there now 3 times and have enjoyed each experience.

Food is awesome, we ordered every appetizer.  Hostess was very understanding, I had 5:15 reservations and I mistakenly showed at 5:45, they made it work.  We brought friends with us as this was our third time back, it was a hit.  Feels like a vacation feel and so close to home.
This is a new gem in Redwood City at the Waterfront with amazing food. We had Halibut, Salmon and Steak, everything was on point and super flavorful. We will be back soon!
Numerous service issues. Extremely slow kitchen. Disorganized staff. Food is excellent.
