Service was slow at best. Requested outdoor seating at the time of reservation but seated indoors due to lack of tables.
being there brought tranquility, we were sat outside. it was good overall
A hidden Gem! Beautiful setting, great service and probably one of the best fish and chips and Caesar salad I have ever had...
The prawn salad was outstanding. Fish and chips was just “ok”.
Great food, service, and ambience. View was amazing and the jellyfish tank is so cool!
A beautiful experience! We were seated inside by an open-air table. The food and service was perfection. We can’t wait to bring more friends and family to experience it.

Hello, what a wonderful place! Friendly servers. The food was delish. The space is gorgeous. At this price point, my expectation is that cocktails would show fast and water would be replenished often - this didn’t happen.

While the ambiance and quality of food are always impressive, the service always falls short of expectations for such an upscale establishment. The servers, though polite, seemed undertrained and struggled to meet the standards one would anticipate from a restaurant of this caliber. Simple requests were often forgotten and a long wait time.
Great food lovely ambiance. Have had the fried chicken sandwich and the prawn salad. Both amazing.

It was our anniversary and when I called a few days ago, the lady answering the phone told me even though patio seats were not available, they had a very nice window seat reserved for us. 
But it turned out to be totally wrong.
We waited for a long time to get our table 8:30 reservation and we got seated in the side dining area the farthest table from the window .

Not happy with the experience, especially because it was our wedding anniversary.

Great service, food, and an overall experience! This is our second time dining here and we enjoyed it. It was a warm day on 4th of July and we we sat outside. Nice ambiance and beautiful view of the marina. I ordered the halibut and my partner ordered the steak. Both were prepared to perfection. The drinks were fresh and in innovative. Thank you Eric and Francisco for making our experience more pleasurable. We will definitely keep visiting Hurrica!

It was a great restaurant. We had heard good things so we thought we would try it out. The food was amazing and the service was incredible. It is on the pricier side but they make sure to make it worth your while. We were highly impressed and will return again!

We have been to this restaurant 5 or 6 times but the last 2 times it was not up  to par. We had lunch there for the first time. The hamburger I ordered was burned and dry. My husband had the chicken sandwich and he said it wasn't very good. I like the location and ambiance but not sure we will go back since the quality of the food has definitely slipped.

This is my 3rd time for lunch.  It was a special birthday celebration for my dear friend who wanted her favorite mahi entree.  Sadly, the mahi was over cooked.  We were a party of three and we all ordered the mahi because in the past it was grilled perfectly, crusted on the outside and moist and tender inside.  But all three mahi’s were overcooked.
Hurrica offered to replace our mahi’s, but we had already eaten half of it by the time they came by to ask how everything was.  They were, however, kind enough to not charge us for the dessert.
Wait for drinks and food a bit long. Cocktails took nearly 15 min.

The only complaint we had was the noise level.
It was bad enough to interfere with our own conversation.

Is there anything that you could change?

Otherwise, everything else was perfectly to our satisfaction.

Many thanks,
Maria Erdi and family

Beautiful Restaurant.  Brand New.  It's an interesting and beautiful Live Jellyfish tank.
The bar is comfortable with many seats—great views and ambiance in each unique room.  The owner was there, she was very kind and offered to take our pictures.  She knew where to stand for an Impressive background, large yachts and lovely an spacious surroundings.  Staff friendly and accommodating.  Impress someone you love just because. Recommend Onion Rings and the Pork Chop!

Hurrica is an unknown gem.  There are so few peninsula waterfront restaurants.  The nautical ambience is beautiful.  The staff is friendly and welcoming.  We loved the menu choices and the service was excellent.  Will absolutely recommend this great spot to all our friends!  Can’t wait to go back again soon!
Beautiful setting inside and outside. Lovely experience and enjoyable for small groups as well as couples. Tasty food.

Food and Service was excellent.  Servers always had a smile on their face and they were quick with their service and attentive to everyone's needs.  The food was cooked to perfection and delicious.  I had the artichoke soup and Seared Mahi Mahi and both were superb.  Can't wait to go back there again to try another entree, which I am sure will also be delicious!!

Every meal is perfection. I tried the pork chop for the first time and it was amazing. Best I've ever had. I get joy bringing new patrons to this local gem and seeing them quickly become fans. Cant get enough!!!
The food was great. The prime rib was perfectly prepared. The oysters were delicious.  Service was very good. It was our first visit but we will be back soon.

The site is spectacular, the food is excellent and the service goes between over attentive to missing. All of our dishes were beautifully presented and so very good!!! We enjoyed every bite!
They have a policy about not seating people (with reservations) until the entire party is there. My friend was delayed in traffic and had I been allowed to sit at our  reserved table, I would have been comfortable and would have enjoyed a drink while I waited. Soon the very small lobby area became filled with partial parties. I hope they rethink that policy!

A bit out of the way, but once you're there, you are transported to serenity.  Starting with the water view, the sailboats (Yachts), the jellyfish tank, and the horseshoe marble bar.   We enjoyed cocktails, appetizers, the wine list, and main courses.  Save room for dessert!  Strawberry shortcake, wow!

Excellent experience and service!  The menu selection was fantastic. Our entire party enjoyed their meal. Great atmosphere and Marina setting. Would definitely recommend to friends and look forward to coming back again ourselves.

Beautiful views of the harbor. Food was pricey, nothing special. Lobster ravioli tasted like salted butter, onion rings had good size onions in thick crusty batter. They don’t skimp on salt here. Bone marrow was overpowered by crab gratin. Halibut was overcooked and salty. Staff was friendly and attentive.
Absolutely delicious! All the food we ordered was amazing, restaurant was beautiful, and service was great.

First time diners at Hurrica for lunch on recommendation of friends . Surprising area to find in midst of Redwood City by its marina areas but once you enter the restaurant , its warm environs and architectural design are so inviting ! On sunny days there is an open area , quite nice outdoors ,  a beautifully appointed modern bar area with a very interesting glassed watery  wall filled with jelly like sea creatures moving gracefully . This wall divides a small dining area and the impression is nautical . Against the back wall is the open kitchen which also gives modern appeal .
The lunch menu is small but ample with offerings of diverse fresh seafood as well as the usual hamburger and fish and chips and much more .  The food is tasty and fresh , well prepared and we had no complaints . Cocktail menu was original and diverse , catering to anyone’s tastebuds.
The service was prompt, polite , and efficient . All in all , a very nice place for lunch with a pleasant atmosphere … scenery away from city bustle was a plus but since the dining area was small and quite busy , the downside was the noise level even despite having the indoor-outdoor effect open at the time we were there .
However , I do think it would be good to try this restaurant for dinner  because the design of its interior would make it a  very cool vibe to enjoy .!
We recommend giving this restaurant a try ♥️
Great food and service, beautiful views. Recommend Hurrica for lunch, drinks or dinner!

Very nice restaurant in a beautiful location. Would be great if there were more tables with a view of the water. We sat inside for dinner because it was too windy outside and there is no wind screen around the tables, but the outside area is heated. The staff were very accommodating of our table preferences. Inside the noise level was high (Sunday night, almost all tables full) and it was difficult to converse easily. Food was very good, inventive, fresh, beautifully presented. Only one of our party had an entree, and the other 4 of us ordered bites, small plates, and sides. Everyone enjoyed the food. One of our party has celiac disease and the kitchen was able to accommodate this well, however our server had to go find answers from the chefs a few times about what to order, as he did not know much about gluten himself. If you have celiac, be sure your server double-checks, as a couple times he was incorrect about gluten content (no, the lobster ravioli cannot be made gluten free, but yes the crab-stuffed bone marrow can be GF if the sourdough is subbed out for something else (no GF breads offered). Bartender was happy to make a cocktail not on the menu (pineapple mojito!) and the other cocktails we tried were also very good. The jelly tank is very cool - haven’t seen one like it. Overall I’d be happy to go back and I’d prefer an outside table.

This was my second time at Hurrica. The first time was for happy hour and a last minute dinner reservation. This time, I made a reservation in advance and requested a table in the main dining area since it was a special occasion. When I arrived for my 6pm reservation, they said they didn’t have any tables available in the main dining area, so we sat outside. It was windy and cold outside but luckily there were heat lamps. However, service was pretty slow outside (our whole meal took 2.5 hours).
MeeSun could not have been a better host.  The food, service and ambiance was all top notch.  It was a dinner to celebrate my wife’s birthday and she was very happy.
Super evening at your restaurant.. what a treat and fabulous location… so looking forward to many more gatherings at Hurrica … well done

Great location. Great views from most of the tables. Good to great food.
Very noisy. And they are very busy so service is not always super quick .
Overall  a really good place. We will go again.

Service is really slow. It took 1 hour to get our food. The people around us were having the same problem. Hopefully they can iron out the kitchen issues as they get more experienced (I believe the restaurant hasn’t been open for a long time).  The ambiance was nice and the food was good.

name: Bishop Grill - San Ramon Marriott
description: A true expression of the Northern California lifestyle, our menus feature local ingredients, Chef inspired-seasonal dishes, served in harmony with refreshing beverages featuring hand crafted cocktails, local wines, and craft beers. All served in a relaxed, vibrant, and open setting.
hours:
Breakfast
Mon–Fri 6:00 am–11:00 am
Sat, Sun 7:00 am–11:00 am
Lunch
Daily 11:00 am–4:00 pm
Dinner
Daily 4:00 pm–11:00 pm
Happy Hour
Mon–Thu 4:00 pm–6:00 pm

reviews.text: Bartlett pear flatbread featured cubes of canned pears on doughy pizza base. They did not understand the assignment.  This is Fairfield Suites food and not worthy of the hotel.
Great food and service. It was easy to make a reservation and the food came very fast.

We had a reservation, it was confirmed the day before .. but they had no record of the reservation and were full. We went elsewhere. 

They asked if I had made the reservation online, I said yes. They didn’t explain, but that seemed to be the problem .. they don’t take reservations.

It was my wife’s and I anniversary. I ordered for myself to bring up to our room for my wife. The steak was small and overcooked. And I asked for maybe a small little slice of cake with a candle to celebrate our anniversary. They gave me a overpriced cheesecake and charged me for that
Dinner was very good.  The staff was very friendly, and observant!  It was the perfect quiet,  Friday night getaway.

The food that was there was okay.  For the price you would expect more selection such as carved beef station, eggs, waffles or French toast, and other breakfast/brunch items.  Selection was very poor and not worth the price compared to The LOT and other nearby buffets.

Overpriced for the new limited selections of the buffet. No chocolate fountain and no shrimp like years past. No carving station with tasty beef. Disappointed and will look for a new yearly location next Mother’s Day.

When I mentioned how the family was so disappointed on our tradition of having Easter Sunday at Bishop Grill .Management had us back to dine in their restaurant on them
We were a bit hesitant, because Easter was pretty bad
My son, grandson & I couldn't be more happy with the delicious food and grest service. I'm planning to write to the district manager to bring back the chocolate fountain, dessert station, the craving station
Good food and great service.

We usually come every Xmas day for brunch. It is a tradition and get us out of the house with extended family. Service is always good. We especially liked Princess Diana. Food is simple but good. Nice after all the rich holiday meals.
Not a place to go on a crowded night after a festival
It was very relaxing to have dinner and the staff is very attentive
The food is always fresh and prepared well. The staff is friendly and the restaurant is very clean.

We were greeted immediately and seated.   Kevin was awesome and very attentive to the ladies needs.  We had to make some adjustments and the staff was very accommodating.  It was centrally located for our luncheon and the menu was pleasing to all.
If you want a quiet place to eat with an extensive menu of high quality items and attentive service, consider dining at this local Marriott restaurant.

We chose the Bishop Grill at the San Ramon Marriott for a family party because it about a 1 hour drive from both our daughter's house (N) and our house (S).  We were a party of 7 ranging in age from 4 to 93.  The hotel and its grounds are nice, but we never ate at the restaurant before.   We were greeted by name when we arrived and promptly seated in an area that gave us both room and privacy - a win for both us and the other diners.

The menu was interesting and diverse, with vegetarian as well as seafood and meat items.  The children's menu is a kid pleaser.  Everything we ordered was quite good, with some ordinarily standard items prepared in an unusual way.  Desert and coffee were a perfect finish to the meal.  Everybody enjoyed themselves.

Though not a "destination" restaurant for foodies, I recommend this restaurant for everyday dining and for family-oriented special occasions.

This is barely decent as a "hotel restaurant" and definitely not a destination restaurant.  The food was marginal at best. The prawn salad had a tasteless and sparse dressing that no amount of salt could fix.  The bread had clearly been microwaved before being served - it was warm and then turned into little bricks. The "prawns" were tiny salad shrimp. The service was lackluster. Skip it.

Our family was coming from all directions and we needed a central place to meet for Saturday brunch.  No one had any suggestions until I found the Marriott and the Bishop Grill.
It is located in an easy access  and quiet setting.  The dining room was slow at that time and therefore comfortably quiet.  We had great conversational flow and were able to speak at a normal talking level.  Our drinks and food were served quickly, with the Eggs Benedict receiving great reviews.  Our female server was very attentive & pleasant throughout our meal and did not rush us at all.  We lingered while finishing our champagne and our conversation.

I would like to check out the Marriott for a little weekend getaway with my wife and two small dogs, but the $100 dog fee seems a little steep for one night.  Does $100 cover all nights stayed, or is it a nightly charge??

Third time we've come to Mothers Day Brunch here and this year things were a bit disorganized.  We were five minutes early and the hostess told us to sit and wait to be called.  Soon after a line formed behind the hostess podium.  About five minutes after our reservation time they started letting about six families in line go in.  Eventually, the hostess looked over at the three families that arrived early in the seating area and started calling our names.  It's not the end of the world but we hated to see people being rewarded for arriving late.  Add to this that some food items weren't ready and some hot items had been out long enough to start getting cold.  It was nice enough, just could have been better. We may not be back for a fourth.

Although the food and service were basically satisfactory, when we mentined Open Table, the wait staff and the manager on duty said they had never heard of Open Table. Another manager said she had heard of the organizayion when the manager on duty asked around the hotel, but said tthat the restaurant had no business connection with Open Table, and would not think of giving any information about a customer to any organization. Apparently someone at the Bishop Grill knows about Open Table or you would not have asked me about our experiene, strange as it was. We enjoyed our food and left with a smile and thank you.

Attended as a business lunch. Very nicely appointed since its remodeling. Good menu selection at reasonable prices. The entree could have been warmer temperature-wise (bbq chicken flatberad) but other wise tasted good, as were the shoestring fires (the lemon aioli was very good).

A very casual atmosphere that is suited for casual meals and business meetings.

Went on a quiet day but the service was personable and attentive. Food was fantastic - want to go back to try other things. Would recommend for a pleasant lunch in a underserved area. Sit down meal to take your time and enjoy.

From the moment that our party walked into this hotel dining area, I knew that I had made a terrible mistake in choosing it to celebrate Father's Day. The setting was not ideal for celebrations, the ambience was a negative one, scenery was lacking and the breakfast buffet food was very poor, but the barbeque lunch buffet was slightly better. This hotel should never advertise and ask for others to join them to celebrate any occassion. To be honest, even if I were a guest at this hotel, I would not choose to eat in their dining area...it reminds me of a dining area in a low budget hotel.

A refreshing and innovative change from new name, decor and most importantly a new Executive Sous Chef who uses local sources combined with a creative approach to fantastic entrees'. This place will be a destination for the locals once the word gets out as it has to the many conventions booked including ours of over 200 will be surprised and pleased with the new twist on the originals. Chef Frank's use of the basic five ingredients in each of his offerings really is a true journey to culinary delight. The sampling of his cut flat iron steak with a reduction sauce/presentation/special spuds/green layers was exceptional; the "Mary" chicken was a classic with a hint of citrus, moist and no wonder it's probably one of their signature dishes.

I expected much more. The menu was limited. The preparation was unimaginative and frankly done to minimum standards. Service was so so. We were asked about the food and service. An example would be an orienal salad that consisted of a prepared chicken breast on top of lettuce with a few cucumbers. Scant dressing was applied.
We dined here because we attended a convention zt the Marriott. The beef tenderloin was ok. It had a standard brown sauce, served with sad mashed potatoes and asparagas. The breakfast bar compared to a middle rate hotel breakfast.

The restaurant is located in the Marriott Hotel. It took a while for staff to acknowledge us waiting to be seated. When I mentioned I had a reservation, the waiter did not check a list so I didn't know if my reservation was listed. It took about 10-15 minutes to receive a menu and about as long before the waitress took our order. Food was ok but not fantastic.

I was a guest of the hotel and attending a conference there. It was the only restaurant in the immediate area. There was adequate staffing, but unorganized it appeared they did not have assigned duties, so the staff was trying to cover the bar, wait and clear tables, greet guests, etc.

It was saturday and not very busy. We were greeted fairly quickly by the waitress and served coffee pretty quickly. The staff moved slowly and seemed to be overwhelmed by the tables that were there and encouraged us to use the buffet. We ordered off the menu. When the food arrived it was Luke warm. Like it was from the buffet. Our toast and muffins did not arrive with our food. The eggs were under cooked and greasy, like eggs poured from a bucket not freshly scrambled. The overall quality of the food equaled that of a cheap diner and wasn't even close to worth the 13.25 we would be paying for each breakfast. We complained about the eggs and waited for new ones. They never came and no one really seemed to care. Skip this place.
We went to Stixx for the second year in a row to celebrate Mothers Day with my wife and children. The food and service were incredible and we will be back again next year.

We had a fantastic time at the Easter brunch. The food and desserts were great, and, to the delight of my daughter, the Easter bunny visited, and took all the kids on an egg hunt. Overall, a very pleasant experience.

Went there for Easter brunch.  Someone forgot to light the steam tables so the food was cold!!!  How could that happen, especially on such a major dining out holiday?  Your in the food and lodging business!  THAT'S WHAT YOU DO!!!  But the food there would be mediocre at best, even if it was served at an edible temperature.  And this place is WAY OVER PRICED.  In the past couple of years I've learned that ANYTHING with the name "Marriott" on it is going to be a bad experience at a rip off price.  In fairness I've given various Marriott restaurants and hotels several tries over this period of time hoping that mine were just isolated experiences but they never get better so now I've given up on them.

Hotel guest were having a meet and greet in the lobby area adjacent to the restaurant. The noise level was excessive, however well within the norm for such an event. The problem was the proximity to the dining area. This event ended at approximately 8:00 p.m. I do feel the restaurant service personnel were delayed due to the high volume of persons at the event. The wait for bar service was unacceptable.
Enjoyed a great Valentine's Day Dinner with my friend. The service was terrific and I would recommend this to everyone.
The service and food were great. The cheese quesadilla appetizer was delicious, and the large salads were very good, especially the oriental chicken salad.

Had to wait over an hour from time of seating to receiving dinner. Twice told staff we were waiting for our dinner more than an hour. Had to ask for refill on ice for ice tea. Food was barely warm when finally served. We were temped to go home and cook a frozen dinner from our freezer rather than continue to wait. Yes, we did discuss this as an option when we passed an hour.

I won't be so mean because the employees were nice to open that day and work on Christmas day. However, a lot went wrong. 1. it took forever to get our appetizer, 2. it took forever to get our food. 3. the food was not even cooked well. They did apologize, but it would have been better to have a complimentary drink or food, or discount. Especially because we had came to here to celebrate a wedding anniversary, so the experience here really stinked.
The service was not as good as usual!
Wonderful caesar salad and service!
Met some relatives here that flew in from Newport Beach to have breakfast with us. Thought the prices were high for this area.
The service was fantastic. Had the brunch for Mother's Day. All servers and management came by. We were not rushed. Will go back again and recommend others.
Exceeded our expectations! The food was exceptional. Much better than I was expecting. Hope they do this on a regular basis.

Junior was our server and he was awesome he was very attentive, friendly and fast about getting anything we needed. The food was mediocre; I was expecting a little more then what they provided in quantity and in quality! If u want great service this is the place the Marriott has never let me down but if u want great food the one in sf is way better!!!

We attended the Mothers Day brunch and it was awesome! The food was the highest quality and the service was fantastic. My wife said it was the best brunch we have gone to for mothers day in years. The highlight for my daughter was the chocolate fountain which was acutally a hit for everyone. We will be back next year.

name: Bridges Restaurant
description: In it's 28-year history, Bridges has received many accolades and awards, including being honored as one of Diablo magazine's "Seven Best Restaurants in the East Bay". Whether dining on the lush, vine-covered patio while enjoying the sounds from our natural granite waterfall, or relaxing indoors amid a sophisticated, comfortable ambiance you will discover why Bridges is a favorite Bay Area dining destination. Executive Chef Kevin Gin awes with his innovative interpretation of California cuisine featuring European and Asian influences. The staff's professional eye for detail and commitment to exceptional service add to the upscale, yet unpretentious dining experience. Bridges warm elegance, spectacular menu and great energy make it the ideal venue for socializing with friends, celebrations, business meetings or private events.
hours:
Sat 5:00 pm–9:00 pm
Sun 5:00 pm–8:00 pm
Lunch
Mon–Fri 11:30 am–2:00 pm
Brunch
Sat, Sun 11:30 am–2:00 pm
Dinner
Mon–Thu 4:00 pm–8:00 pm
Fri 4:00 pm–9:00 pm

reviews.text:
Bridges Easter menu was unfortunately boring and disappointing. It’s one of my favorite restaurants. This missed the mark this time.
The corned beef hash was terrible. The  upside the cocktails were great. Our server was excellent too. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. Bridges is usually  so much tastier .
Drinks were wonderful but the Easter brunch fare was meh.
We celebrated a friend’s birthday at Bridges, and enjoyed a very nice brunch. The salmon salad and the Benedict were both delicious!

We all love the grilled shrimp with noodle cake and red curry. We always get the same dish!

Our waiter was great!

Food and service was top shelf! Crying baby the whole time made it had to talk. I recommend sitting in the front of restaurant where it is brighter for lunch. As always, fantastic lunch. Waiter made it special!
Food quality has been suffering since the Pandemic. It really isn’t the Bridge’s of years ago. Both the quality and presentation of our dishes were poor. Service was excellent.
Probably the worst food and service I have ever experienced.

Very disappointing evening.  We arrived on time for our 6:00 PM reservation, were promptly seated, but it was slow going the whole way.  It took fifteen minutes to get a drink order in, another fifteen minutes to get our drinks, but worst of all, our dinner was not served until 7:15. We had an event at the theater next  door at 7:30, so that gave us around ten minutes to wolf down our meal.  And I mean wolf.  Our server, Anna, tried her best, but she was overwhelmed.  Looks like too many folks were booked at the same time.

Food has become disappointing. I ordered wine, braised, short  rib pasta,, the chunks of grey beef were hidden under the pasta and shaved Parmesan, no sign of the rich wine based flavor you would expect from this dish. Instead, the beef tasted like reheated leftover flavorless steak.  For the price, there are much better meals to be had in town. Very unfortunate because the atmosphere is still so lovely.
Excellent restaurant with great food! Comfortable ambience and beautiful setting.

We just had a fabulous dinner at Bridges! My husband and I both went with the servers suggestion. We got the salmon and the shrimp dish. So incredibly delicious. Great service great atmosphere. We will definitely go back again.
Lovely lunch with a friend today! Our waiter was top notch as attentive, patient, and knew what recommendations to make. The burgers were so delicious as rated highly in TriValley! We’ll be back soon

Never disappoints!  Excellent food with large portions and creative menu with an Asian flare. Plenty of choices for all. All of our drinks were wonderful. Excellent service - very attentive from the host, waiter, and table servers.  Love the outside patio and although for the season they have plastic sheeting for wind and rain it was lovely and will likely soon be removed for spring.  Easy parking.

The staff seems very untrained.   The table was not set properly.. brad and butter plates on the wrong side as were the water glasses. 
Took 15 minutes for a waitress to come only to tell us she works be right back.   5 minutes later she did.   We ordered appetizer, split a salad and 2 entrees.  We had barely begun the app when the salads came, brought by the busser.  We set them aside.  We had barely begun the salad when the entrees came.   We sent them away,  but when they were brought to us,  it was clear they put them under a heat lamp instead of making fresh,  so the pasta sauce was dried and not nearly as good as it would have been had they done it correctly.   
They also forgot it was a birthday occasion,  and instead of the regular menu item I was told we would have we had what tasted like a boxed cupcake.   Bridges has gone downhill, but mostly due to an untrained staff... on a Saturday night.

The service was excellent. However, the menu is very limited. My wife ordered the clam chowder and said it was rather “watery” and not much flavor. I ordered the nights special, surf &turf. The lobster tail was overcooked and rib steak was a bit stringy, but was okay.

Group of 3 adults celebrating a birthday. Due to recent change of ownership wanted all to visit to experience, including a family member in our local region, less familiar with history of restaurant & Danville.
Menu & ambience no change, grateful! My reservation request for quieter table away from loud groups was honored, after confirming at check-in via reservation. Recommend.

Met some girlfriends for lunch at Bridges. All of us really enjoyed our food. Service was a little slow, but when she did check on our table our waitress was very nice. Always very pretty ambiance. Will be back!

It was a Friday evening and the restaurant appeared to be only half occupied. My wife and I each had the baby greens salad and the salmon. Loved the sweet potato mash that accompanied the fish. The apple tart dessert was tasty but not exceptional.
Excellent service great menu items. What great lunch place, atmosphere ￼to have a conversation coupled with delicious food. ￼
Great food and wonderful service!! Quiet experience and we totally enjoyed our whole time.
I have been dining here for over 10  years. Ownership has changed. I would like them to go back and serve salted butter with the bread. The honey butter distracts from the taste of warm bread.
Our family loves Bridges!  Great food and excellent service
Great Danville icon , still a great place to eat,

We had a lovely dinner before going to see Peter Asher at the Village Theater. Ben was a perfect server!
4 of us had the Wasabi coated salmon and it was AMAZING! The other two had the pasta dish and they both loved their entrees, too!

Food is always good. Price point, especially for lunch, is perfect. Quiet so conversation is easy.
Drinks from the bar take too long and the lack of staff is always a problem so service suffers although wait staff is always friendly.

I’ll be back

Our waiter was very attentive and had a lovely demenour. I have eaten here for years but the menu has changed and does not have a lot of choices. Too many sandwiches and salads for lunch and not enough mains. I was hoping for salmon or some kind of fish with either rice or potatoes but the only fish selections were spicy prawns or salmon salad. I hope the menu improves because the restaurant was very empty . I do thank them for bringing my lunch guest a birthday cupcake with candle. Nice touch
I had brunch with a group of six. Good food good portions would’ve enjoyed a better lunch menu. Only Brunch was available

We were one of the only people in the restaurant, yet our server was very slow. It was a half an hour before we were even able to place our order. The food was good, but average for the price which is why I placed the value lower.

Server Ben and Aaron are wonderful!
Love the Tombo tuna

My wife and I ordered two different whiskeys on the rocks. There was hardly any whiskey in the glass. I ordered the Braised Short Ribs. It tasted ok, but there was way too much noodles and very little meat.
I’m so happy this place is under new management. The food is much better. Healthy, delicious meals. The old stuff was heavy and rich. Again glad it’s like new.

My friend and I enjoyed a delicious lunch beginning with the Brussels Sprouts appetizer followed by the clam chowder. We were already full when our sandwiches were brought to our table so we nibbled on the French fries but boxes our sandwiches to go.  And now lunch is taken care of tomorrow!
perfect and quiet! Came here to celebrate my cousin turning 21. And we received a small happy birthday plate. We ordered the fried chicken sandwich and truffle fries. The truffle fries were so good

The food was good with a creative menu. But the loud noise level made for a less than enjoyable experience. The dining room was crowded with many tables and hard table surfaces (no tablecloths -- I liked the old Bridges better). Bar service was very slow, as was the kitchen. The wait staff was nice but also seemed stretched rather thin. On the other hand, given how slow the bar and kitchen were, wait staff couldn't do much more. This restaurant has seen better days.
It took over a hour for the food and it came out cold and tasteless. They couldn’t handle the valentines traffic, the kitchen that is. The server and staff were pleasant and apologetic

It was a very disappointing Valentine’s Day experience. They changed their standard menu with a limited menu that was very expensive and mandated appetizers and desserts. There was no mention of this anywhere when we made reservations - other restaurants doing this type of thing clearly disclosed it ahead of time on OpenTable and on their website   ￼

We were supposed to be seated inside - we weren’t. at least we could hear the piano player… Oh no…  the piano player was, well, not able to keep rhythm.  His set list was from beginner songbook (Disney/ariel/moon river etc.).   It was really humorously painful￼.

Also they ￼were not staffed well enough to service the crowd they attracted - and the food took a long time to arrive as did the server.

The lobster was so overcooked it had to be sent back. It was discolored and I was not able to extract it from the tail because it was so tough and stringy and, unfortunately, its replacement was not that much better.  ￼

We got our dessert to go because we could not take it anymore… only to find when we were home that one of them was missing a third. Just missing.

The beef was good. And so were the portion sizes.￼

We were also charged for a drink that was ordered, but never delivered.  We got that reversed, of course.

All in all, it was a very disappointing experience. We’ve eaten at bridges several times￼ and have always been satisfied, finding the prices reasonable and the food pretty good. But the special forced menu that was cast upon us and their inability to provide decent entertainment and timely service was a real letdown.

2 drinks .. 2 entrees … $250 … 2 much!  It felt like a money grab honestly. I thought the special pink menu should’ve read ‘happy Bridges day’.   ￼

The server was doing the best she could given ￼the circumstances and was quite pleasant when we did see her.
Perfect setting to celebrate Valentines Day with friends.  When we arrived staff presented wives with a red rose which was a nice touch. Food was excellent and staff was friendly and responsive.
Terrible experience!  Don’t waste your time at this restaurant.
Yum it was great and the staff was the best. Thank you.
Very busy valentines night!  Service tried hard, but consistently came short!  The prefix menu, could have a green salad (not just a beets salad) and the dessert selection could be improved.
Amazing place and food was awesome! Olivia, our waitress was perfect. She was very attentive.

Food was good, portions could of been a little bigger for the price. I have eaten at Ruth Chris and fir the same price of steak was much bigger. The place was a little loud but very nice. Service was good and the desert was very good. I give it a 3.75 out of 5.
Great service but thought food was pretty bland, something we. Had not experienced before. Appetizer of Brussels sprouts was excellent but entrees of risotto and short ribs pappadell were both bland
Great lunch spot.  Nice selection of food and drinks.  Wait staff friendly and helpful AND prompt. Noise level very low so conversation was easy.
Great service and the brunch was great.  Our server and the GM gave good service.  Thank you so much.
The Thai curry shrimp with rice noodle cake, was delicious. I got a "mocktail" and that was great too. And the chocolate cake with gelato was excellent as well. Lovely experience all around.
Mahi mahi and lobster special was very good but the rest of the food needed a bit more seasoning. Service was great.

This was my first visit there.    I probably won't' go back.    We were seated in a very very noisy area of the restaurant.    We came to celebrate a special occasion.

The food was just ok for me -

I have eaten there many times… usually I am pleased. Yesterday I hosted 7 and I was deeply disappointed!
1) food was either barely warm and or inedible e.g. the risotto was runny and bland, the salmon needed a knife to cut through it.
2) service was incredibly slow
3) it appeared that both the kitchen and floor were understaffed
4) my guests were cold and needed to keep their coats on during the dinner
5)  For myself as the host, the experience was incredibly stressful.
Outstanding service with good food in a very nice ambiance!
Lunch was delicious and our server was gracious and our server, Olivia, was gracious and  hospitible. It's always a pleasure dining at Bridges!

The food was awful. We ordered two New York steaks $50 each, and it was cooked poorly, the meat was cheap, and you could barely cut through it. We politely shared the feedback and the waiter took no initiative to tell the manager or take at least one steak off the menu. My wife took two bites and that was it. The mash potatoes were bland. It’s sad because we’ve been there many times and I think the food quality has diminished greatly. $175 and a bad experience.

We have been to Bridges many times.
We did not feel the quality of the food OR the service were up to Par.
It is not that the waiter for disrespectful or rude  (he was friendly), just felt he might need a bit more experience...... 
Also -- disappointing that Coffee Machine is still broken !!! was broken last time we were there.

Again -- I don't want to blame waiter, just lacked better quality of food
(Clam Chowder was very good) --rest of dishes, not as good

My sister from TN flew into Oakland last Sunday for work.  We spent the afternoon watching the NFL playoffs.  I wanted to treat her to a nice dinner Sunday night.  I haven’t been to Bridges since before the pandemic, and really wanted to return for a special dinner.  The service was fantastic.  The 5 of us all enjoyed our delicious dinners.  The wine list seemed smaller than what I remembered, but we still had very nice bottles of white and red wine with dinner.  I live on the Peninsula, but if I were in the Danville area again, I would definitely return to Bridges.
Our server was amazing! Food was delicious! Will be returning!
Great food. Great service. Def one of our favorite restaurants
Great staff good food.  Nice experience.  They are working on updating their menu.

I've been a Bridges customer for many years. Today's smoked salmon and avocado open faced sandwich was disappointing. The salmon consisted of small cubes of salmon rather than the large thick slices of salmon that have always been used before. I hope Bridges returns to using the large slices of smoked salmon.

Haven't eaten at Bridges in a long time. Liked it in the past. Not so much now. Companions and I were disappointed in the mediocre food and slow service at lunch. 

We all ordered the Grilled Prawn Sesame Noodle Salad, which we have eaten with gusto at past lunches. Now, a gloppy mess, tasteless. We shared a warm apple crostata for dessert. It was neither warm nor tasty and took too much time to be served.

To add insult to injury, Bridges didn't carry decaffeinated tea, and the waitress didn't know that decaf coffee was available. On the positive side, the waitress was a smiling delight, and her demeanor assuaged our grumbles ... a little bit. The other wait staff were also delightful.

Sorry to be negative, but we expect more from Bridges than they delivered.
Love this place. Great for a lunch with friends or business colleges. Beautiful with good food and a variety of choices
We loved the food, service, and ambience. Wonderful place to celebrate any occasion. We’ll be back, 100%
The food was excellent, from the kids burger to our lobster and steak.
Food was ok. Service was poor. Ambience ￼poor. Unsatisfied customer
Everything was great. The waiter was easy going and made our meal easy to order. Very quiet.
We are a group of women who have a particular fondness for the grilled shrimp and noodle cake with curry sauce. We all love to eat outdoors and have the same dish. Bridges does not disappoint.

Everything was lovely until a large party was seated next to us and they were exceedingly LOUD.  Our dinner was a business meeting and it got very difficult to even hear what was being said. In addition, we were seated up against a wall in a corner.
Clam chowder watery. Chicken salad somewhat tasteless. Mostly bread. Burger was good. The waitress we had was not very friendly.
The food was very and our waiter Jarrod was excellent!
Quiet calm place for weekend brunch.  Menu has variety.  Breakfast items and Asian salad were plentiful and delicious.
On the brunch menu, the burger is excellent.  Large and cooked perfectly to order.

Relaxing, could be romantic, atmosphere. Fairly quiet. Service fabulous. Roast chicken very good. Very little vegetables on the plate while too much rice. Hubby had shrimp linguine with Alfredo sauce. He said his was fine. The bread served upfront was tasteless and some pieces too dry like it sat out all day. Also the olive oil to dip the bread in was very bland. The Apple galette was perfect in taste and warmth. Wines tasted just as described.
Excellent service and we were able to have a relaxed dinner.  They even remembered my husband’s birthday!🎂

Our waiter was very slow and inattentive.  The buser was excellent  and did more than the waiter

Food came out quickly

Champagne served was flat. Took us over 15 min to get replaced .  We had to wait for the bill way too long

Everything  else was nice but the server was terrible.  No personality  and didn't offer many suggestions when asked  except the highest item on the menu!!!

Is this TGI Fridays? Chili's? Food menu features the standards: salmon, chicken, beef, pasta...One non standard was the vege risotto which was tasteless and lacked depth or really anything. Didn't even taste like risotto but squash and rice. Wine list is more than pedestrian. Short, large boring CA wineries. All provided by one distributor who likely prints the menus for the list placements. Staff was quite friendly and relatable. I was disappointed as I have read about Bridges for decades but dont live nearby so have not gone untl last night. Not offering people in Danville anything even passable much less special.

We used to love going to bridges. But this time service was just as great. But food was awful. 😞.
I wonder if the chef has changed. Fries, burger, steak. Everything was bad…none of us could finish anything. The molten chocolate cake was like the frozen ones from the grocery stores. I was so disappointed

We wanted to order turkey sandwich and there was no turkey.   We then ordered a chicken salad and the dressing was terrible, either it’s too much dressing or what?

There were plenty of tables around but the waiters put the guests all close together therefore it was very noisy.

The restroom needs renovation to make it more updated.  Then there’s not enough choice of food such as no pasta  dishes like before.

I am disappointed after many years as a long time patron of this restaurant.

New management and what appears to be, all new servers.  Our waiter was not very familiar with the menu, indicating this was his second day on the job.  I miss the old wait staff who I became very friendly with (Chelsea in particular) and the manager, Haven.

Being a long standing and frequent customer, I am adopting a wait and see attitude toward how things may change, most noticeably the menu that I have loved and whether or not I develop a rapport with the wait staff.  We really don't need another Chinese restaurant in Danville, so hopefully the menu with a few changes, will remain the same, rotating dishes depending on the season.

This was a reservation for new years eve. Mind you that is a difficult time at restaurants, but the service was absolutely terrible. We saw some friends at another table and when I spoke to them a couple days later, they agreed on the service. Our waiter was very nice, but when we spoke with him, he said the restaurant assigned him 15 tables inside plus the outside patio and they were very busy. Well, that is not the servers fault. The restaurant simply did not plan accordingly. It was unfortunate, because we always love Bridges - however, I won't be going back anytime soon. Literally, we could not get waters. We had to clear our own plates off to the side. And the wait times for everything was longer than it should have been by a lot.
New Year’s Eve. I believe they were having a few problems. Service was slow and the kitchen was backed up. However, the food tasted good and the ambience was nice. ￼

We were seated and completely ignored for the first 20 minutes of our experience. I asked the hostess who our server was and she was going to check, but I didn’t hear back. Finally, we asked another staff member and a server came by. Literally, 20 minutes with no one stopping by or taking our drink order.

Once we had a server identified service was fine, but I likely will not return after this poor experience. With the menu price, the service did not match the value of this experience.

Food was horrible , beef tenderloin was overcooked, scallops were rubbery, ahi tuna was green! Never seen green ahi before! Service was like a pop up restaurant, servers had no idea how to offer decent service.
Sub par meal, inattentive service, Bridges used to be much better.   Very disappointing.
Welcoming/check-in was awful.  Very poor organization unpleasant people.  Meal was average - - no where close to the Bridges of 2-5-10 years ago.  Another one bites the dust?

It was disappointing.  Food was not up to par.  One of our entrees came to the table COLD.  The plate and the outside of the meat were both warm, but the center of the pork chop was barely above freezing.  It was clear that the NYE prix fixe menu included pre-cooked entrees that were not adequately warmed up for service.  I hope this restaurant can restore its former glory.

First time coming to Bridges and we loved it!! We had the ribeye and lobster, everything was cooked perfect. The service was great, we loved that the owner came and introduced himself to us. One of the things that caught our attention was how the owner was very hands on helping. We will definitely be coming back.
We will be coming back! Solid dining experience. 9/10.

Excellent food and good service overall. Bridges, under new ownership, appears to continue to be a great restaurant for special occasions, and more.
Only minor disappointment: They forgot to celebrate the birthday event I had indicated we were there for when I made my reservations. I did not bring it up though when we were there.

First time here for Christmas dinner food was good unfortunately options for a picky eater were limited and and a meal was forgotten however they did comp the meal it was very late….Service was a lacking attention to detail nand ran out of 2 of 4 desserts but we made the best of it

This was an overall awful experience. Bridges was understaffed and the food was cold!

We started our evening at the bar while we waited for our table. Even though the bartender was doing the best she could, she was having difficulty keeping up with the demands. The bar was a mess (piled dirty glasses, dirty bar) and she was trying very hard to make drinks and keep the bar going. She forgot our order and we told her again, but it was not right. Again, not her fault....Bridges fault.  A mess!
Then we were seated with one of the worst male food servers I have ever experienced. He told us he was "crying on the inside" !!! They were out of our entree of choice ( at 7 pm) and out of our dessert of choice. Our food was cold and when I asked him if I could have a serving of warm mashed potatoes he brought a scoop that was even colder than the ones on my plate. He never returned to ask how our meal was.  It was such a disaster, we actually laughed ! After all, it was Christmas and we were determined we would have a good time.
We're really not hard to please but this was really really bad. Needless to say, we will not be back and we are Danville residents.

We went for Christmas dinner and the experience was terrible.  We ordered 3 prime rib and lobster dinners.  The waiter came by a bit later and said they were out of lobster.  Okay, we will just have prime rib.  When dinners arrived he brought 2 prime rib dinners because they didn't have a third.  The 2 dinners DID have a lobster tail but it was dried up and inedible.  The food was cold.  One of the prime rib servings consisted of 2 thin heel pieces.  We had to order 1 other meal for the person missing one.  When it as dessert time we had a choice of 3 but they only had one kind left.  They did credit us for one meal but our evening was ruined.  I will stick to lunch at Bridges.  Dinner has never been their strong suit.
Hanna and Ben were absolutely amazing!!!  Ben was so great and handled my wife’s allergies perfectly!!  Both should be recognized as outstanding employees!!

Our service was slow and my wife’s food arrived cold! When we asked to replace it they just heated up in the microwave. I ordered prime rib/lobster and had to ask for a steak knife. Not our typical experience at Bridges. They seemed understaffed and didn’t see any management trying to help out!

We have lived in Danville for 36 years and dined at Bridges often, enjoying the environment and the wonderful quality of food that was offered. Recently however, perhaps due to staff changes or transfer of ownership, the food seems poorly prepared and sadly pedestrian.
Just last night we paid $60-80 per plate for cool, possibly re-heated and uninspiring dishes. Disappointing!
Bring back the creative fusion of American/Japanese cuisine we once enjoyed and we may return.

Was a nice Christmas meal.
Had piano playing, festive decor. They accommodated us for being late and gave us a great table. Mention options were great. Everything was a little bit slower because of the holiday but we were in no rush. Food came out a little different than expected but still nice overall
Very pleasant ambiance with quiet-to-moderate noise level. Excellent dining.
My husband’s food was served after being dropped on floor ! Totally unacceptable and unsanitary. The owner just called it a mistake … We will never go back.

There was a Christmas party going on - they should not have opened the outside to reservations. Our server did the best they could; they were swamped inside and having to manage outside, too. The food was subpar for the price we paid. They should have focused on the Christmas party and let the rest go. We had to keep going inside to ask the hostess for help (who was incredibly nice and helpful). Honestly, I won't be going back.
We’ve been coming since they opened.  It’s never disappointed.  The service is excellent as is the food.  Portions are large.  Would highly recommend.
Waitress did a phenomenal job. Very attentive and managed a large group well.

Fiirstly, the temperature of the restaurant was cold and so much so it was uncomfortable. Wait staff said they had raised the thermostat but after over an hour, not much improvement.

The menus are typed in too small a print. Maybe 8 or 9 pt . Should be larger print for older clients. I could not read the menu or the prices even with my glasses.

The wait staff was wonderful, the food delicious. The greeter at the door impeccable. Reservation helpful and on time.

Open Door very helpful.

We sat outside for our Christmas dinner with friends.  Their beautiful patio area is protected with temporary walls and there were plenty of heat lamps.  Service is outstanding and food is delicious - always a lovely experience!

Had our team holiday party at Bridges and were very satisfied.  Good food choices, reasonable prices, and great assortment of desserts for sharing!  Even though we were in the dining room, we felt like we had our own private space and could enjoy the event.  Thank you, Bridges, for being part of our holiday celebration this year!
Our server was great and patient with my 87 year old mother. Food was great, as usual.

Great service and ambience. Bread and butter are good but poke is average. Chicken and waffles; chicken is flavorless and dry, waffle is fluffy and chewy. Good bacon syrup. Shrimp salad is overdressed and soggy. The cabbage becomes less crunchy because there is too much dressing.
Pleased - was wondering if new management would be noticeable.  Nothing untoward!
This is my 4th annual family dinner I have hosted here and we keep coming back the food is always consistent staff and and ambiance are great!
Lovely setting, but the food was underwhelming and unfortunately the service was lacking, as well.

The service at Bridges today was awful.  Our server took our order and didn’t bring food for at least 45 minutes. The restaurant was not crowded so don’t know what took so long.  Waiter barely talked and seemed uncomfortable with even interacting with us. My food, grilled shrimp and noodles,  was so soggy, and cold, that I didn’t eat it.  Would not recommend going here anytime soon.
Food was mediocre - everything else: service, ambiance etc was good.

We had the breakfast plate, the eggs were dry and the potatoes greasy! Our wait person wasn't friendly and didn't deserve the nice tip she received. Not sure I will return even though I love Danville.
A lovely restaurant with a great menu and great service.

It’s a sad day when I have to give a very low score to a formerly outstanding restaurant in every category.
Our previously special outing restaurant, Bridges, in Danville has changed owners and has a new chef.
The result is that we will not return.
The food: Caesar salad floated in dressing.   Chef forgot to make the “croutons” crispy instead of blah squares of bread!!
The sir fried shrimp lacked enough curry cause and the noodle cakes were tasteless.
The rolls brought to the table were filled with air - NO substitution for the previously served dense cranberry walnut bread.

Atmosphere:  Bridges used to be for a special night out. A time to dress up and be served an elegant dinner in a romantic atmosphere.  Tonight was so disappointing.  The prices are high and most people arrive in jeans and sneakers.  The romance is gone along with the delicious food and professional servers.


Goodbye, Bridges.  It’s terribly sad to watch you go downhill.

I have been to this restaurant numerous times - all before change in ownership.  Don’t know if that plays into our experience today but I will not ever go back.  The food was beyond bad.  Edamame was old and cold.  The sesame shrimp salad had gallons of dressing that congealed the noodles.  The pizzeta was undercooked.  It’s really a shame because this has always been a favorite choice.  They need to do something or this place will never last.
We love this restaurant. Great food, classic American restaurant with a great movie history.
Wonderful holiday dinner! So grateful to everyone who worked so hard to make this a lovely experience.
Dined for Thanksgiving Dinner and was so disappointed that we will never return.
Food was a little cold - had to send food back to kitchen

We strayed from our usual thanksgiving location in san Francisco and went to bridges to avoid the drive. We both quickly realized the drive is worth it. The food at Bridges was mediocre, they were overly chaotic, and service was poor. People seated after us got things way before us, then they were forgotten about and we eclipsed them. Servers couldn't tell who ordered what and we were seated in a bad location that was a worse experience than a downtown diner. Food was not bad but nothing to write home about at all. We had a regretful thxgiving dinner-wise but now we know to stick with other options that are more highly rated. If you don't want to cook and want to stay in town - I'd check out other options first but if you had to book Bridges - it will be "ok".
Great food and experience.  Our server Denzel was great.

We dined on Thanksgiving. The food was amazing. The service unfortunately was  not up to bridges usual. Our server was new and overwhelmed and inexperienced .As a result we waited for our food. And We never got sugar ,steak knives ,spoons. We laughed because it was so crazy. I’m grateful they were open and presented us with a great meal once we got it. The runners and bus people worked hard and were helpful. We overall enjoyed it. Hopefully never get that server again.
Portions are TOO large. Severely detracts from the  fine-dining (?) experience.

Difficult to assess because it was Thanksgiving. There was not enough help, so the wait staff were all running around trying to keep up. But our server was funny and pleasant and the rest of the staff were very pleasant also.
Holidays are challenging.
Great experience:) I would love to come back again

While we have been long time customers, the new ownership will need to step up a bit to keep us! Made a res. For our Thanksgiving!
Seating was quick yet ended up waiting 30 min for our beverages, then another 30 min for our food! Soup was excellent! Turkey dinner was served in a pile style, cold on the outside, and cranberry sauce, smeared over the gravy covered pile! Chunks of various breads used for stuffing, dry. At home we dissected the pile and found a 3” piece of neck skin, uncooked! In the center!!!   The dessert, Lemon Cheese cake (ordered to go) was Excellent! Bill $200 for 2
Servers, though rushed were professional!
Last year the Thanksgiving dinner was fantastic. This year it had no flavor.

Excited for Thanksgiving dinner.  To my dismay, we were seated outside on a chilly patio with no ambiance or festive decor.  Felt like we were in flow over parking …an afterthought.

While service was very good, the food was mediocre at best.  Tasteless gravy, boring stuffing, very dry turkey.  The squash soup was good, though.  Pumpkin pie was ok.  Texture was a bit off.  Will not go again for Thanksgiving, that’s for sure.  It was disappointing.

We had Thanksgiving here last year and it was very enjoyable. But this year we were made to sit outside which we were never told when we made the reservation. Half the tables inside were empty but the person seating us refused to let us sit inside. Even with heaters it was cold. We sat down and they immediately tried to bring us someone else’s order. Once we did order they tried to bring our side dishes before they even brought our soup and salad let alone main dishes. They tried to talk us into keeping them and when we requested they be served with our main dishes they got angry and stomped off. We had to constantly ask for silverware but they did keep our water glasses full. Overall, not a great experience especially for the money.
Wonderful Thanksgiving dinner!  Great food & service!
Beautiful restaurant. Delicious food and attentive wait staff.
Excellent service and food. They accomplished our party of six. We all had various plates and thoroughly enjoyed our meal.

If you’re ever in Danville, Bridges Restaurant is a must-visit spot that perfectly balances exceptional food, expertly crafted drinks, and a warm, inviting atmosphere. It’s our go-to place for a reason, and every visit reminds us why it’s such a beloved institution in this charming town.

For starters, Bridges isn’t just about the culinary experience—it’s a part of cinematic history! Fans of Mrs. Doubtfire will recognize it as the setting of the iconic “run-by fruiting” scene. The ambiance alone is worth the visit, blending timeless elegance with a cozy vibe.

On this visit, we brought friends from out of town, and as always, Bridges delivered. The menu is thoughtfully curated with dishes that cater to every palate. Whether you’re indulging in their beautifully plated entrees or sipping on a perfectly balanced cocktail, you can taste the attention to detail in every bite and sip.

The service? Impeccable. The staff are knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely passionate about ensuring every guest has a memorable experience.

Bridges is more than just a restaurant; it’s a Danville institution that captures the spirit of the community. Whether you’re a local or just passing through, this is a dining experience you don’t want to miss.
Service is always friendly and menu choices are abundant. I like feeling that we aren’t being rushed. Our lunch was delicious
A little loud at times, but the menu, food quality, and service have always been outstanding here for us!
Always a great experience!  Love this place. Great food, great service and great atmosphere.
Beautiful restaurant with friendly staff. The food was blah. Bland fish, over cooked pasta. Over priced for what it is and a terrible wine list.

My wife and I dined at Bridges last night. I booked online for 6:15 pm.  Availability was wide open. When we arrived, they sat us at a two-top that was set up right next to an emergency back door.  The door was closed but drafty and my wife was chilly because of it.  We asked the waiter if they could move us to another table but he said they were all booked. I asked if he could pls check with the host to be sure as it appeared there were lots of open places.  He checked and came back to say sorry, they're all booked.  We ordered. My pork chop was very good. My wife's salmon was overcooked and dry.  Wife was uncomfortably cold so she ate what she could of the salmon, we paid and left.  Upon departure, it had gotten busier but there were still lots of open tables.  Pretty obvious that they could've re-seated us in the beginning but just didn't want to deal with it.  I will say that the waiter was very good even though he was busy but that was the only thing about this place that stood out as visit-worthy.  We won't be coming back anytime soon. Better options elsewhere.
Phenomenal Salmon entree.  I may go back very soon just to have it again.

We dined outdoors this evening, as one of our party is immunocompromised. The heaters kept us warm, and the atmosphere was lovely. 

The wait staff was attentive without rushing us, and the food was wonderful. One couple shared a   salad, and it was served split on two plates without that even being requested. One of us enjoyed the perfectly crisp brussels sprouts and the fourth said the tomato bisque soup was tasty. Three of us had the NY steak entry, and each steak was prepared perfectly to different temperatures. The fourth said the pork chop was delicious.

Overall, the evening was very enjoyable, and I think both the food and the service an improvement since the new owners took over.
We went to Bridges for a celebration dinner. The food was really good and the drinks were also well crafted. Service was also exceptional and the ambiance was perfect. Will absolutely return!
Delicious and fresh salmon salad. Great service. Will be going back.
Outstanding lunch and service. Highly recommend Bridges.

Absolutely loved our anniversary dinner at Bridges. We love coming here for happy hour and regular date nights but it’s nice to also come for a special occasion!
Food was delicious from apps, to salads, dinner, and dessert. The salted caramel gelato was 10/10!
Aaron was an excellent server and the other staff were also very friendly and helpful. Can’t wait to come back!

Very professional service and attention to detail. My wife had the Stir Fried Mexican Prawns which were an outstanding blend of many different flavors and textures. I had the Pan Roasted Chicken with Hazelnut Pesto which was perfectly cooked and a nice blend of sweet and savory, although I think they could have offered up a bit more carrots and chicken and less rice. The waiter was very observant as he noticed a birthday card on the table and later brought out a free chocolate cupcake with a candle and Happy Birthday spelled out in chocolate powder. A nice touch to a pretty nice evening. By the way, the live music was pretty good as well.

My whole family  had a good experience  eating in this restaurant. The food was good, the ambience is awesome, the service was topnotch and the owner was very accomodating and made sure that we were served well. Our server did a good job too. We will definitely comeback! 👌

Went to Bridges because we had a gift card and was the wife’s birthday. Had an early five o’clock reservation and got there a few minutes early so we decided to get a cocktail at the bar. Where’s the bar tender? We were getting ready to just go to our table and she showed up. Took our drink order then left to something else. We thought since she forgot my coke that’s where she went. Nope. There were no other customers in the bar mind you. So we just took our drinks and seated for dinner. This was a Thursday night and we were the first for dinner. We were not in a rush so didn’t sweat it that we were not immediately greeted by our waiter. Ben showed up and open our bottle of wine then walked away. Came back and we ordered ap, shaking beef lettuce wraps which were good. Waiter was nice but slow for some reason. We then hear the special of the night which was fillet mignon that sounded good. So we finished our appetizer and waited. After a longer than normal wait Ben came back and apologized for the delay and said the computers went down for a bit. No biggie. Wife and I ordered the filet special hers medium well. Mine medium. We also split  Caesar salad. Anchovies on mine none on hers.well they brought hers with anchovies and we just removed them. Salad was good but hers was still fishy. Then the main dish arrived and hers was cooked good but mine was undercooked so I sent it back. That was a mistake. In the mean time I ate all of my shrimp that the waiter suggested and after a little too long the steak plate returned. Totally overcooked. Mushrooms we chewy. Was not happy. So overall 2 of the three dishes ordered were good. My son had the Tomba/Albacore and said it was good. So service was slow and the “special” was 1 for two. Waiter Ben was nice though and comped my steak which made up for the mistake. Probably won’t be going back here.
GREAT luncheon.  Except for a somewhat loud nearby table, it was a perfect experience overall.
Always great food and great ambience
My chicken dish was EXTREMELY dry and tasteless. My husband had pork and was good our server was excellent but I’ll never eat there again.
Server was not attentive. Food not as good as in recent past
Nice menu with quiet ambience.  Service was friendly and attentive.  Menu selections were a bit narrow but food was delicious.
Excellent and prompt service. We needed to get to the airport on time to meet to visitor and no time was wasted.

Lovely ambience & service..unfortunately the food was not as delicious as Mother’s Day brunch . This time it was mediocre- okay flavor & portion but nothing delicious (pork chop had apple chunks & slightly goopy sauce- salmon good but rice cake cold & hard instead of crispy & warm- bread was stale). No specials & menu same as past years.
Food and service was outstanding. New owner was very attentive to make sure we were enjoying are dining experience.

My wife and I love and frequent Bridges, food, service always excellent. Over the years we have hosted three major events and everyone had a wonderful time. We met the new owner Freddy introduced himself, welcomed our feedback on old and new menu items.
Phenomenal!  Under new ownership and definitely worth the visit.  Food, service and ambience was a 5 Star experience.
Aaron was our waiter , he’s very attentive and made our visit very pleasant .  Definitely will be back!  Best burgers in Danville !!!
We celebrated my husbands birthday here tonight, our server Ben was amazing, the food was amazing and the entertainer was great as well.
The food and service was incredible.  The salmon was cooked to perfection!
Staff were friendly, had great insight to the menu options and suggestions.  Great service and food was delicious!
This is our favorite restaurant. The food is always spectacular and the service is unsurpassed. It is our goto for any special occasion.
Our meals were delicious. The staff was very attentive. The restaurant is lovely.
Neighborhood gem. Delicious food, great service, beautiful surroundings.
The food was excellent and affordable. The service was top notch. Reserving a table online was ver easy.
Please be warned - do not order the surf and turf. I have been going to Bridges for more than 20 years and have always had amazing food. I would have to compared my dinner tonight to Denny’s.
This was the first year in 27 years that Bridges didn’t acknowledge our anniversary.  A little disappointing.  Service was slow even though it wasn’t crowded.  Cocktails and food were good.

Bridges is our got to special occasion  restaurant .  We love how the menu changes seasonally.
There is always something we want to order!  We started with the Shaking beef lettuce wraps.  Super delicious!  Then I had the red wine braised short rib with pappardelle and it did NOT disappoint!  The Birthday Boy had Miso glazed salmon and he was very happy with his choice.  We've been coming here for about 16 years and will return again and again!!

We ate outside this time as we had a dog with us.  The staff were very accommodating and provided us the same service and attention as before.  This is what I like about Bridges; it's consistency in service, food, and ambience.

We made reservation at 6pm at Bridges Restaurant to celebrate our anniversary. First impression was great as we were greeted by the host and leaded us to our table. We found all other customers were sitting outdoor, and we were the first customer who was sitting indoor. We sat at our table for a full 5-8 mins, no one came to offer water or drinks. As time passed by, there are 2 more new tables customers be seated and we saw that they were served by a waiter and waitress right away. The bus boy filled their water glasses while ours were still empty for the past 10 mins. As we found the waiter came greeted and served the new table in front of us. He got them some breads too, ours were still empty. After he finished with that table, finally came to our table and asked us what we wanted (don’t forget, we came first and he didn’t show up!). But he was in a rush of cuz. We finally placed orders and drinks, we found that there were many flies inside the restaurant especially on the bar table where they place the ready to go dishes (which are ready to serve customer), mainly are salad, soup and appetizers… I found it disturbing seeing the flies getting on the food and were ready to serve for customers.  Our orders came later, everything were just fair, not as great as it was before. We ordered some drinks, a soup, 2 appetizers, 2 entrees and a dessert. Anytime, I couldn’t finish the dishes, I have to box it right away in case the flies get on my food. Sorry I can’t criticize the quality of food anymore as the flies issue was very disturbing to me during the whole dining experience. And the lack of customer service experience was remarked.  I don’t think I would ever return again.  It was kinda ruining our anniversary day but at least we did had a quiet dining time.  Anyhow, still need to give credit back to the restaurant as we mentioned it’s our anniversary, and they did offered us a complimentary  anniversary chocolate cake for us. Thank you Bridge’s Restaurant.

Service was terrible and slow.  We had to snag a busboy to bring us wine glasses for us to pour our own wine from a bottle we brought and paid a corkage charge for.  We also brought a birthday cake that we paid a cutting charge for but the slices sat on the counter for so long I finally got up and brought them to the table for everyone.  The place wasn't even that busy.  We definitely will not be going back again.
Good all around and excellent food. Service was attentive and friendly

We have been a frequent customer of this restaurant for over 30 years. However, it is disappointing that the menu has seen little change, and there are few innovative dishes. I believe it would be even better if you could add more new items to the menu. Additionally, I am concerned about the limited variety of dishes and desserts. As the best restaurant in Danville, I hope you will continue to strive for further improvement.

We went to Bridges to celebrate our anniversary. We decided to sit outside even though it was slightly chilly. There was a musician playing outside who was very enjoyable. The service was very slow - our waiter had several tables inside and was also coving tables outside. Fortunately, the food was very good which helped make up for the slow service. After dinner, I ordered a cappuccino. It arrived in a standard coffee cup and looked and tasted just like a coffee with cream. All in all, we very much enjoyed the food and we wish the service was better. We did not get acknowledged for our anniversary celebration.
Live music was too loud. It was a very cool night. Staff should have offered to turn on heaters.

Our favorite spot for lunch. We have our favorites that we split and share which never disappoints. Just a really pleasant spot to have a nice meal with excellent food and service. Already looking forward to our next lunch date!
Great food and attentive service. Beautiful setting, inside and out.
Excellent food, excellent drink, excellent atmosphere, excellent service.

I was a regular at Bridges a long time ago but haven’t been there in years since I no longer live in the area. The restaurant is well past its prime. The food was nothing like it used to be. Our fish was frozen in the middle and the correction was to microwave it. Needless to say that didn’t work. The service was so so and the atmosphere was not special at all. Sad because I was excited to take my partner there as I had many fond memories.

We arrived late at the restaurant due to lack of parking and freeway congestion, but staff accommodated our reservation anyways. The food was delicious and the restaurant ambiance is superb but slightly loud as it was near capacity. Always a good place to eat on date night.
Had a great meal celebrating our 50th anniversary. Brought a nice little candle cupcake at the end of the meal.  Very classy.
Had a nice birthday lunch on the patio.  We both had salads and they were fine.  The server was pleasant and responsive.  Will return.

Dining at Bridges on the patio is usually a very pleasant experience.  This time we were bothered by the constant stream of delivery trucks parked right in front of the restaurant & patio.  Constant noise delivering whatever and of course having to look at the trucks was not appealing.

Food was fine, if not pricey and all started well...until our server essentially disappeared! He knew it was a birthday celebration & said he bring a treat at the end of the meal. Never happened.  Very disappointed.
Love sitting on the patio here. It’s such a nice peaceful area. Food was good. Service was great one of our local favorites.

Fun, delicious bar bites, fabulous libations on the patio!
Wonderful Happy Hour!
Great food. Lovely space. Our waiter was great. Really noisy at 6 on a Saturday night even though they respected our request for a quiet table for hard of hearing senior.

This place is trash. It’s been running on the coat tails of Mrs. Doubtfire for too long now. I hope that the new management is able to turn it around. Poor/immature service, random menu, elementary food.
Wonderful service food and drinks!! We will return!
Love the establishment and its staff!  I go so often I actually get a little bored of the menu choices.

Food was very good.  Service was average at best.  The restaurant was not full yet we waited too long to place our order and much too long to close out our bill.  Service staff were polite and pleasant, perhaps just not enough of them?
As usual, The Bridges Restaurant in Danville, CA was outstanding. Great location and ambiance. Food, service outstanding.....our go to place for meetings and when friends/family come to visit.
They have some very unique entrees on their menu. I had a nice birthday lunch with my daughter.

Never again. We have been fans since before Mrs Doubtfire. No
More.

Only problem is the seating outdoors.  the seats are very low so the table hits me high on the chest - kind of awkward - an extra two inches would help -- so ad a cushion to the seat!!  I am not a small person about 5'5" - it's just not comfortable!!
Long gaps between visits from our primary server. Food came out slowly and bar service was pretty slow.
Went for lunch, sat in covered patio and it was wonderful. Good service and fast.

Bridges is one of our favorite restaurants. We sat outside on the patio which is a beautiful setting. We had very attentive service from Ben and the rest of the wait staff. We started with old fashion cocktails -- excellent, moved on to the truffle fries -- deadly good, and then my wife had tombo (a type of Hawaiian tuna) and I had the halibut special both of which were delicious. Ben recommended a Santa Barbara pinot noir to go with the main meal which was perfect. We look forward (always) to our next visit to Bridges.
