We had a fabulous time at Bridges. Wonderful service from Ben who went out of his way to be so attentive and helpful. The food was terrific and so was the setting. Simply, amazing.
Slow service food needs more seasoning lacks flavor

The service was great but the food was mediocre. My wife and I both ordered steaks medium rare and both were over cooked. We were originally seated indoor as requested but the gnats were annoying so we asked to move outside and they accommodated immediately. We ordered the apple crisp to split for dessert and it was cold in the middle.
Sunday brunch food, service, ambiance, all excellent. Music was a plus.
There was a LOAD party of about 10 that was too loud.  Disturbed our efforts to have a quiet dinner with good discussions.

Went for lunch and all ordered the same thing - Grilled Prawn and Noodle Salad which, it said, came with a sesame soy dressing. One of us, who has had it many times and has serious dietary issues, was uncomfortable eating it as it tasted as if there was mayo or cream in it. Not the dressing she was used to. The rest of we assumed it would be a vinaigrette of sorts but didn’t remember having it before. We did not enjoy the salad but each ate half of ours. 
Our waiter, who we called Mr Personalty because he had none, didn’t really check in with us or notice her food barely touched nor did the busgirl as she cleared except to ask if we wanted boxes which clearly we did not. 
Obviously our friend could have sent the food back but chose not to make a fuss. 
On our way out I asked to speak with the manager regarding the description on the menu. He implied there was cream in the dressing but because there was a new pantry chef, wasn’t sure. 
Cream is something which should be spelled out these days. The manager agreed and said they should correct the menu but didn’t really offer anything in the way of a gift card or even really a gee, I’m sorry or is your friend ok?
Not the customer service I would expect from Bridges….

Bridges always is such a joy.
The ambience is beautiful and the food, outstanding and an exceptional wait staff
Thank You Bridges

Excellent food, beautiful outdoor patio. However, except for attentive water refilling and our server checking in on our satisfaction with our meals, extremely slow service. Angel and support were very nice, service has the potential to be really good, but insufficiently trained, imo. My wife and I ordered glasses of the same wine and I was served mine first by our waiter. That did not go unnoticed by my wife. Main complaint on service is need to be more aware of time lapses between courses. We sat for around 20 minutes waiting to be offered dessert and then at least that amount of time again for the dessert to arrive. It was now 6:35 and we had been seated since 5:05.
Great lunch/brunch eating outside. Very accommodating kitchen!

Table for two, Sunday brunch at 11:30am, seated at the patio with live music.

We came here to celebrate our anniversary and it was a lovely experience. It wasn't busy so we were seated immediately. Our server was attentive and friendly. The Latin guitarist was tasteful - very pleasant and not too loud.

We ordered:
• 2 berry mimosas
• Danville scramble
• Avocado toast with smoked salmon

We highly recommend the avocado toast with salmon and the berry mimosa :)

This was our first visit and we will definitely be back!
Salmon and Tombo were delicious as well as the green salad. And Aaron was a great server! Love the patio for summertime dining, but just too hot for outside dining.
My Tombo Tuna was delicate and delicious, served on a fabulous bed of black wild rice.  Crunchy and satisfying.
Bridges never disappoints. Pre-dinner cocktail (Danville Old Fashioned) was on point. NY steak was delicious (the sauce was amazing). Excellent service as always.
The halibut special was outstanding as was the flatbread appetizer.  Our server Joel was outstanding.

Our server greeted us kindly. The NY steak was tender, and sauce a delightful addition. The short ribs were tender and flavored nicely. The highlight of the evening was the warm apple crisp with vanilla ice cream and caramel. It was heavenly!
The food, the atmosphere outside and service was excellent.  We enjoyed the music, great sound and not to loud.  We were able to have a conversation with out racing our voices.
Great venue for an outdoor casual business luncheon. Attentive service, good food and selection as well as fair prices.
Does not live up to the  hype. We were hoping for a really good meal and felt like we paid for close to high end  and didn’t get what we paid for.
The waiter was very engaging. I ordered halibut and asked for it not to be overcooked, but when it came it was dry. 🥲

We had cocktails in the bar and joined others escaping the heat outside. The daiquiri special was delightful. Our entrees and service in the dining room were top notch. The tombo and pork chop were tasty and served sizzling hot. Another great night at Bridges!

The air conditioner was broken - an extremely hot day. I know this is no fault of theirs and unexpected. I just believe the restaurant should have notified the customers who had reservations. It was unbearably uncomfortable to suffer thru our meal.  No explanation was given until we asked.  Unfortunate customer (overall) experience without any forethought to the customer experience.
Everything was great. Food and service was very nice. It was quite warm in the restaurant, but other than that wonderful!
Service is always outstanding here but the quality of food is not consistent.  Weekend brunches are more reliable.

My wife and I the same organic greens salad and the salmon entree . The salmon dish was tasty but the size seemed a little skimpy. For dessert we shared the pleasant warm apple crisp with vanilla ice cream. There were an unusual number of empty tables.
It’s a wonderful place for a date night. The Vine is next to it, and has live music outdoor.
We had a wonderful dinner and evening thanks to our GREAT server!

We were here for our anniversary and thought this was a high end restaurant. The menu was average, nothing like the menu online, 3 servers and Ben (our server) was all over the place. We ended up having to ask for the bill so we could leave.  Was surprised at the music...country (which is one of our favorites) but it didn't feel like it belonged in this venue.  Totally different from what we expected. The food was something you can get most any place.
We felt that the service was excellent. Different servers made sure we had what we needed.

The lunch menu is rather dull and there are not enough small dishes. I paid $13 for a very small plate of mixed greens with a couple of strawberries on it. The last several times I have dined here, the menu has just not been that great. Bridges at one time had such great food. Now I don't think I will return again. There are just too many other restaurants in Danville that have much more interesting menus.
The swordfish was over done. The music on the outside patio too loud. Not much depth to the menu and kinda pricy.

We have been to Bridges many times over the years, and have always been very pleased and happy with the food and service.  First let me say that the food is excellent and very delicious, and the service is outstanding, very helpful, prompt and friendly.
However, I do have an issue with where they seated us.  And this is not just Bridges, but other restaurants do the same thing.  My husband and I are both senior citizens (in our 70s) and restaurants and Bridges last night, too, continually seat seniors in the back of the restaurant, and also usually next to or very near the noisy kitchen.
We always dress nicely and quite honestly it is rather insulting to be seated in the back of the restaurant or in an obscure place.  I feel it is discriminating and disrespectful to do this to seniors.  Someday those young hosts and hostesses and wait staff will be senior citizens and perhaps they will see how insulting it is to be seated in a place that is not very desirable.
Always reliable ambience, food and service. Love the avocado and salmon toast.
My friend and I come often specially during the summer to sit outside and enjoy the service the weather and a delicious meal

Been a few years but the food was not memorable. The cesear salas was white and pale yellow from old romaine.  The dressing was not tasteful. The braised short ribs arrived cold   Dessert of gelato was great!   My friend felt the same. Sadly they were off the mark

We went for Father's Day because I saw the menu online and loved it. I (the father here) had my meal all charted out. It was expensive, but the prefixe menu sounded like a treat. When we got the menu handed to us at the restaurant, my favorite item was gone and another dish I was getting was completely changed. The waitress just shrugged it off. On any other day, change the menu all you want, but doing this when you've advertised a special Father's Day menu was really inappropriate to me. The food was pretty mediocre and overpriced. We won't be back.

We have been coming to Bridges for decades.
The food continues to be exceptional with great portions. The staff is friendly and professional .

My only regret is the bread.  A fine restaurant experience begins with the bread on the table. It enhances the salad and the evening’s enjoyment. Prior to Covid, the cranberry walnut bread was a huge reason we frequented Bridges so often.
The “baguette “ served is absolutely tasteless!!!!  It detracts from the quality of your fine restaurant.  Please don’t serve it.
The sour dough is ok.
If you are looking for a loyal and long time customer’s request and suggestion, PLEASE bring back the cranberry walnut bread.
Yours truly,
Carol

Service extremely slow. We had 2 youngsters with us and had to ask multiple times to at least get some bread while waiting for at least 15 minutes for a drink to be delivered. Food was oddly flavored. Even a Caesar salad was unrecognizable. Overpriced for below par entries. Their companion wine bar next store had a private party with heavy bass music literally vibrating my head. Will no longer dine there!!
The wasabi crusted salmon was AMAZING!!!!!!!!! and the service was great!
The patio is beautiful and a lovely place to sit.  The salads are delicious.

A super delicious meal in a serene environment.
The burger is the best around with all the trimming. The fries are crispy and not greasy.
To top it off their cosmos are amazing. The bar is a great meeting place.
The service was not ok, we spent to much time for drinks and food, one plate was not what we asked.

WORST EXPERIENCE EVER‼️￼Our family went to dinner for my birthday last night, August 26. We had 4  adults and 2 three year old children. We brought a bottle of wine,  the server open the bottle, left and never brought any glasses back. We finally had to ask the bus boy to bring some glasses 10 minutes later! The service was extremely slow when the girl served my appetizer
she spilled my wine all over and did not even bring a cloth to wipe it up. We brought a cake for my birthday. The cake was cut and sat for 10 minutes on a tray so my husband finally got up and served the cake to us. We were charged a full corkage fee, full 20% gratuity for six people even though we only had 4  people and 2 children. WE WILL NEVER GO BACK‼️

We both got the special salmon salad with arugula.  Dressing tasted like plain oil over lettuce.  Very little arugula.  Salmon was fine but under seasoned.  Service was nice and so was the Harken Chardonnay we tried although not a good value.

Excellent dinner, joined by friends…lovely evening on the patio…yummy food, 
Very relaxing…great drinks too!
The food was fine, the waitress pleasant. However the restaurant was woefully understaffed.

We've always enjoyed the Bridges patio in the past, however this time was an exception. There were construction workers on the nearby corner with a jackhammer so loud, it was difficult to talk. When we asked for an outside table,  maybe the hostess should have warned us of the noise level? The food was decent but the service was extremely slow, not even receiving menus or water for quite awhile on a very hot day.   It just didn't seem up to the old standards we were used to. We'll give it another try, hoping this just was a bad day.
Really Great Food but Aweful Service . Wont be back anytime soon . not worth waiting 30 mins for a drink and over an hour for our dinners .

We have been going to Bridges for at least 25 years and I will say our visit on May 30th was the absolute worst. The service was terrible - we sat down, our server came over took our drinks and didn't come back for 30 minutes when we finally had to flag him down.  Never asked if we needed anything, only came back to see if we wanted dessert. The food which is normally delicious - burgers and fries was so so, the bun was so stale I ended up eating just the meat.  I had her that Lisa who had been there forever doesn't work there anymore and it sure does show. It will be a hard choice to come back after this experience which is too bad because we loved this place.
They seemed short staffed (one waiter for the entire patio) and he seemed frustrated by that. But the food was good and the music was excellent.

Early lunch (11:30) which was not very crowded.   Server allowed me and my friend to catch up (hadn’t seen each other in over a year) checking back casually until we were ready to order!  I had the avocado toast served with a small salad and my friend had a Caesar salad.  The 2 avocado toasts had a healthy serving of smoked salmon and feta on top.  The portion was very filling!!!  I usually get the grilled prawns noodle salad but I knew that was WAY bigger than I wanted.  I would definitely have it again!
Salmon and prawns Thai style were delicious- Chris our waiter was fantastic - he’s the best !
Great Dining experience at a fantastic restaurant..!! the home of Mrs Doubtfire fire.! rest in peace robin..

The food was sub par (both the cheeseburger and the fried chicken sandwich which I question even contained chicken) and the service was deplorable. We were being waited on by a server who also was servicing a very large (30+ people) private party alll the way across the expansive dining room and outside. Very poor call on the part of the hostess to seat us in his station when there were plenty of other staff there who could have helped us. Management needs to prepare and train their staff better.

The food was very good but the service was just fair.  at one point, we were only one of two tables in the restaurant but the wait staff didn't come promptly either with our dessert menus, to take our dessert orders or with our check.  we were celebrating a birthday and the birthday cupcake was brought over before we ever had an opportunity to order other desserts.
The service was good. The food was terrible. My husband‘s burger was undercooked when he asked for medium well. I had the papperdelle and sauce was not good.
Great service from Joel. It was a special evening with 2 birthdays and a retirement. He was attentive and positive. The food was great!  My first time here.
We had a beautiful Mother’s Day meal. The food was a little pricey but delicious
I had the pork chop and it was very well done and bone dry. My wife had the swordfish and salad which she said was decent.
We always enjoy ourselves. Your team does an amazing job . Thank you, made my wife's Mother's day specially fun

Service was awful. Our server never acknowledged us and was always in a rush. He never asked how our meal was or asked if we needed anything. We had not decided on a dessert and he told us he didn’t want to have to come back for a decision. Took away our utensils and our food was served. We had to ask somebody for utensils before we could eat. When we paid our check, he never thanked us. I have never been treated this way in any restaurant, let alone one that is supposed to be an upscale restaurant. Bus boys were more kind and friendly than our server.

We went to Bridges for Mothers Day.  We have been there several times before and while it has always been expensive the food and service have previously been good to very good.  I hate to write this review however, this time it was very expensive,  the service was not very good and the food was poor for the most part.  With the tip it was 100.00 per person for brunch.  I had the the swordfish for my main course,but it was really just a salad with a very small piece of swordfish on top of the salad which tasted fishy.  When, I was done I felt like my 3 course meal was just soup, a salad, a scoop of sorbet and a lemonade for $100.00.  Also, historically, they have had very good large bloody mary's with a lot of celery, etc but a person in our party ordered a Bloody Mary and got a very small Bloody Mary with no celery, etc.  Unfortunately this restaurant has gone downhill.  Hopefully they will reverse course.

The restaurant was beautiful as always and the outdoor patio was great. Ordered the brussels sprouts for the appetizer which were delicious, then we ordered a chicken and a steak. The chicken was great, but the steak lacked seasoning and was very plain. That was the most expensive meal on the menu and I had higher expectations. Would’ve rather ordered two chicken dishes ￼
Good was not good. Overpriced for quality. Nice ambience.
Great service. Waiter very professional and attentive
The service was not very good, took long time to get cream for our coffee and had to go inside bar and get ourselves . Server did not feel genuine and was short with us .

Service was pretty bad, restaurant wasn’t full, waited almost 20 minutes for our food; had to ask several times for drink refills, no one came to our table to check on us; had to ask for to go containers and check.
Our waiter was so attentive and kind. He was so sharp!! Wonderful. Great ambiance, great atmosphere, and loved the option of indoor and outdoor. Food was good with great options.

It was a beautiful night for outside dining. Our server was friendly and wait staff was responsive. The swordfish was cooked a bit too much, and the Thai Shrimp was not as fresh and crisp tasting as usual. It was a nice experience.

We did not enjoy our meal there.  I realize the restaurant business is very difficult and I don’t like to criticize others unless it is really a warning, but I would not return to this establishment.  I had heard great things about Bridges for years and in all honesty, it felt like a place that the owners had given up on.  It’s run down, the food is quite bad, it was not cooked to order, and everything was just unpleasant.  Given the prices, I can see why it was so empty.  I sincerely hope they revamp the place because of its history.

Haven’t eaten at Bridges in over 25 years, but went there for the first time and to find out everything was great except for our server. She was not attentive. She was busy wandering around, taking care of other customers and barely came up to the table without having, introduce herself. I had to ask her name she just seemed overwhelmed. Probably not a person I would recommend. She didn’t act like she liked her job. It seemed like she just did it just because she had to. That’s sad because the food was great and being at bridges is a historical event just because of the movie 
Doubtfire .

We didn't care for our sandwiches.
They are doing construction next door and it was very loud.

Wait staff was excellent without being overbearing. For the quality of the burgers we had and cloth table cloth and napkins and ambiance, I think it’s the best deal around.
Our burgers were cooked rare and medium rare perfectly.

The service was great, wait staff were very friendly, attentive, and thoughtful.  However, the food was very disappointing (I had the asparagus and tomato risotto for my entree and blackberry cheesecake for dessert). The risotto was bland and watery, the cheesecake was claggy and lacked flavor. We had not been to Bridges for several years and, unfortunately, we won’t be returning.
Ben is an outstanding waiter !  He always takes great care of us .  Hannah is the manager and she’s always looking out to make sure we have a great experience .
Beautiful and peaceful outdoor ambiance, pleasant and attentive service and fine food.
My husband, daughter and I enjoyed delicious dinners out on the patio.  Our server Ben was very efficient and polite.
If you want great food and service at a classic restaurant in Danville, CA go to Bridges.

I was reuniting with Family from the East Coast and took them to Bridges because I knew it would be a wonderful experience. It was! The food was outstanding and the service was impeccable. We lingered for close to four hours and no one ever made us feel rushed or unwelcome. Bridges will be my go-to for out-of-town Guest from now on! ￼
Ambiance was scored lower because of all the cobwebs that are in the attic clearstory window.
Great service.  Extensive menu. Outstanding food!
Great food drinks and service.  Dine in the patio when weather is nice.
Our favorite place for celebrating special occasions.  Outstanding service and delicious food comes hand in hand.
Our service was excellent as was our meal. It was very busy. There was an event being served. It was great! Thank you

Steaks were cooked perfect, but they were fatty and the taste was disappointing, asparagus was super good.  hubby loved the sweet potato mash, they were too sweet to my taste. Service was terrific, busy as always.
Nice ambiance, smaller menu but tasty food, mid to higher price.

Saturday evening at Bridges for a birthday celebration…unfortunately a large party was also celebrating making for slow service, very loud experience. Since we sat for almost two hours we all commented on how uncomfortable the wooden chairs were. The salmon and pork chops were good meals. My shrimp salad was not good, tasteless bed of cold noodles and coleslaw type salad with 5 grilled shrimp.  Our fourth meal short rib with noodles was mostly noodles.  For the two birthdays they brought out one small cupcake, nice gesture but it was stale. This is the third time I’ve been to this restaurant and not enjoyed the meal. Don’t plan to return.
I love Bridges. Usually it's great. My children on my salad was dry, hard to eat.
Our Easter meal was fantastic. The New York steak was juicy and delicious. The strawberry cake was so tasty .
Horrible service. Bad food . Overall a disappointing experience .

I gave them 4 out of 5 stars because i reserved on line for in side seating. When we arrived we were seated outside. I asked why and was told when reserving on line you are automatically put outside. Weird.  But everything else was perfect. The food was delicious. The wait staff was friendly and attentive. This was Easter brunch and we were very impressed on how everything was top notch.
Easter brunch/birthday
This is a great local restaurant for foodies, couples or families
We had a lovely evening there with family for a birthday celebration! Food was delicious! It was very busy so our server couldn’t be that attentive to us! They might need more help, if possible!

Friday night during spring break was a quieter and less rushed dinner. The salmon came on mashed potatoes (should have asked for a starch substitute) and the daily special was a fish stew which was brimming with mussels, shrimp, scallops and chunks of several fish in a coconut milk sauce. It was delicious. Dessert of apple crisp was more apple than crisp. Gelato was not available because of a kitchen problem.
Wonderfully relaxing. Understated elegance. We enjoyed the food and setting so much.

A favorite spot in downtown Danville, which is full of great options for food and drink. Super comfortable outside dining area you can enjoy most days. Our favorite lunch date is Bridges to share the Bridges Burger and Honey Chicken sandwich…so tasty!

Very busy and loud which was fine.  Good and friendly service.  Odd experience where somebody opened up doors to people smoking and suddenly the cigarette/pipe smell was overwhelming in the restaurant.

Although we live locally we’ve not been back for years.   Although the service was good, we left unimpressed.   The restaurant also needs a makeover, or at least redesigned so you don’t feel like you’re eating at a cheap wedding reception. Even the candles were fake.  Bridges used to be a crown jewel of the east bay.  Now it’s just cubic zirconia.  The food was good needs a better vision as it seems Asian inspired but only as to a few items.
Food wasn’t as good as previous visits. Service was average, felt rushed even though restaurant wasn’t busy.
Fabulous restaurant and service.  Will dine here again.

I ordered the special -halibut w/soba noodles.  The fish was just ok and needed some salt but not very flavorful.  I also didn't really like the soba noodles; The shrimp and pork chop were very good my friends told me.  Our server was excellent in every way.
Good experience. Nice ambience. Kool location. Very tasty food.
Decent food. Great location. But it was super slow.
Great special occasion place. Super wine list and cocktails too.

I was really disappointed with our entrees.  My husband had the rib eye steak and it was sub par and I order the ahi tuna dish with the forbidden rice.  3 little pieces of over cooked tuna.  His ceaser salad came out with no dressing. We had better steaks and ahi at Forbes Mills.  It was our anniversary which they honored us with a small cupcake.

Our party of 5 went on a Tuesday night.  Oddly, the restaurant was a bit busy, due to some after work happy hour.  

Food was just meh.  Service was subpar at best.  Not a big deal, but they also ran out of bread for a 630 resy.  Ambiance was okay, but noise level is a bit high.  Only plus was drinks were stiff; but suprisingly, the bar uses subpar cherry for its old-fashioned and not luxardo.. why?!  

All in all, I don’t think the overall experience matched what we paid for a pricey dinner.

The restaurant was decent, but there were a ton of gnats. It made for an annoying meal. I mentioned to one of the staff members, and he admitted they have been really bad lately. I gave him some tips on how to control them but surprised a highly rated place would not have a plan in place.

We always enjoy the food here (this time Steak, Risotto, 2 way chicken, Salmon), although the menu seemed more limited than last time (6 months ago). Unfortunately there was a huge birthday party going on (including video screen, etc.) and they gave them a microphone which blasted through the whole restaurant. Good wine selection and I always enjoy the Doubtfire cocktail (jalapeño infused tequila),
Great food, excellent service and very nice ambiance.

I had family visiting from England. My cousin is a huge, huge fan of the movie, Mrs Doubtfire, so he was thrilled when he found out that we were going to be sitting in the spot where the cast had sat!!!  The staff were extremely welcoming. The server was very knowledgeable about the food, and the food we ordered was delicious.  It was mine, and my husband’s first time there, but it won’t be our last for sure!!

Thank you to everyone!
Steak and salmon were excellent. Table bread was room temp and tasteless
Been enjoying this restaurant for years. For us, we’d like to see a new menu or at least a few new items to try. With that said, everything is good here.
Staff was very attenuative and courteous. Food was good. It was a nice quite relaxing dinner. The only thing bad was a couple of baby flies landing on the bread.
Everything was perfect for our birthday celebration.

Bridges has great food, our server was excellent, & very attentive, only issue was it simply felt “too bright”, wide open, didn’t feel intimate & cozy, even we had a corner table…!
But, would return with friends, or family dinner!
Bridges continues to be an outstanding restaurant with a creative menu even after all these years.
We had a party of 8 to celebrate my husband’s 65th birthday. The staff was great, the food exceeded everyone’s expectations and the evening was a blast.
I love bridges and will always be one of my favorites but the pork chop was very dry unfortunately
Their fish is fabulous! We have joyed the poke appetizer, the salmon and the tombo. All delicious!!!
Dining at Bridges is always a fabulous experience. Aaron is an impeccable server and very attentive.
Excellent food and service. Our server was very sweet and professional.
Simply lovely! Delicious food and cocktails in a warm atmosphere!

Hadn’t dined here in a while, but glad I returned! They accommodated my request for a quiet corner table to celebrate my stepson’s birthday and for us to have a private moment to share information and memories about his dad, who suffers from Alzheimer’s. Service was great, food terrific and birthday acknowledged with dessert! Lovely!
I recently hosted a small birthday party brunch with 8 guests at Bridges.  The food was good and the service was excellent.

We were looking forward to having brunch here.  We sat down and immediately asked if the accordion doors could be closed due to a draft. We were told that another party requested that they remain open. So we asked to be moved to another table. We then waited almost 20 minutes before the server came over to take our orders. They never came to take drink orders separately.  The person pouring water came and spilled water on the table and left it - didn’t return to dry the table.  After waiting for drink orders and no one came I finally had to ask another server for assistance. We frequent high end restaurants and this is not that.  This was hands down the WORST service we have ever encountered and will not return.
Wonderful gem of a restaurant in Danville! Was perfect for our date.

The service was outstanding and our meals excellent.  There was a large group sitting behind with children and the noise level somewhat loud.  I know it couldn’t be helped, but the noise did influence our enjoyment.

Wonderful experience with friends. The seared tombo with fried black rice was excellent. Wife had the scallops special and loved it others enjoyed the salmon and the parpadelle. Service was great all in all a great evening

There to celebrate my husband's birthday. We love Bridge's and pretty much pick it for almost all our special occasions, and more.
A bit too noisy for me though. For that reason we normally ask to sit outdoors, but this time the rain forced us in. The outdoor eating area is very nice btw.

Good food and service.   Has been a while since we have had dinner at Bridges.  Very happy with the experience.  We did notice a high noise level - popular place with a lot of large parties.  Not much room between tables.

Usually enjoy going to Bridges. Many times we have dined there. Tonight’s meal was too salty for my taste- why do restaurants add so much salt to a dish? The only soup they offered appeared to be vegetarian, however they added beef stock.  Please consider more vegetarian options and stop with the beef or chicken stock in your soups.  Please bring back the nut crusted salmon. A real turn off to see wasabi crusted salmon. We asked the waitress for more bread - it never arrived. Servers were very friendly, however to get our check we waited a long time, then I waited for the waitress to come back to pick it up. My guests left while I waited - ended up going to the front desk to pay. The noise level was high.

We’ve been to Bridges a million times, so the only surprise was that it was so loud!  Food is always good, service was good… probably slightly more expensive for the portions, but for special occasions it’s understandable.  Just really surprising how loud it was when there weee non parties close by or anything like that.

The food was delicious.  My husband had the lamb shank, and I had the surf and turf, filet and scallops.  Both dishes were cooked to perfection.  We ordered the garlic chili broccolini as a side and were underwhelmed by it.  It was cooked well but we expected more flavor based on the description.   The wines were great.  It was rather noisy in the restaurant, but we could still hold a conversation.

We love Bridges and feel like it’s only getting better! One of the waiters Chris is such a phenomenal persona and took such exceptional care of us. Will definitely be requesting him and continuing enjoying the pure yumminess that Bridges cooks up! Thank Y♥️U!

As always, we had a lovely meal that was well prepared and delicious. The service was excellent and the decor was pleasant. Bridges is on our short list when we are looking for a special dining experience and we are never disappointed.
The food here is DELICIOUS, drinks and service are great as well!

Great service, excellent meal. Wine selection was superb. We had our wedding reception here 12 years ago. We still go back every time to grab a bite. Bridges restaurant never disappoints. Excellent customer service.

There was a glitch regarding the food. I ordered the Salad of the Week on the menu, but they were out of it and did not inform the waiter or me.  The kitchen just brought out an entirely different salad!  Not what I expected or wanted. So I ordered the Sambal honey chicken sandwich instead and waited for it while my husband enjoyed his Bridges burger.

Nevertheless, our waiter and the ambience were excellent as usual. They also comped my glass of champagne for the mishap on the food order.

This was my first time at Bridges. Service was good, although our server was fast walking from table to table seemed stressed, but they were very friendly! We ordered a Cesar to start and it was okay, heavy on the dressing. I ordered the risotto. I’m sorry to say, but no flavor, it was like having a bowl of white jasmine rice with spinach and mushrooms stuck into it and Parmesan melted on top. I took a few bites because I was so hungry, but I did not enjoy it. The menu says the risotto is supposed to have butternut squash, baby kale, dried cranberry and hazelnut risotto. It had none of that on there. 

Since our server was very busy they didn’t have a chance to check on us during our meal and we couldn’t catch his attention so I could possibly change my entree. But, towards the end our server checked on us and he saw that I didn’t eat much of the risotto and comped the entree for my fiancé and I. It was a very nice gesture and we appreciated it, but I would not recommend a meal here to friends. Unless there’s a special dish they’re known for and is great I would be willing to try. Overall, disappointed with the meal. FYI, my fiancé had the Stir Fry Mexican Prawns with Red Curry Sauce and we didn’t enjoy that either. No flavor to a plate with curry is hard to come by.
Delicious food and excellent service !

Our waiter was very nice and attentive.  
The bread was dry and not very good.  The steak was really good.  Good sauce.  The chocolate gelato was amazing.  
Overall it was a nice evening.
I love Bridges and dinner was excellent. It was busy for a Monday evening.
Waited over 20 minutes for server to acknowledge us.

It was a little rushed, since our reservation was at 2pm, probably the ‘last’ reservation for Brunch, and before closing to get ready for Dinner Opening.
After some confusion, we had a nice “brunch, more a breakfast”.
Very noisy. Excellent food. Good parking. Understaffed for the number of patrons.
This a restaurant that seems best for couples and small groups, as the place is not massive. We had a great Anniversary Dinner!

A favorite for dinner has also become a favorite for lunch. Great service, excellent food and at a reasonable price that’s competitive with other restaurants that don’t come close to the overall experience.

Another great dining experience at our favorite restaurant.
I brought out of state friends, and everyone was delighted with the service, and fabulous meal.
Thank you, Bridges♥️

Ladies who lunch are welcome to camp a while and chat over delicious cocktails, lunch and dessert. The avocado and smoked salmon open faced sandwich on sourdough was healthy and tasty. Lots of free parking nearby.

Monday evening following San Francisco 49ers huge win over Detroit was quieter than anticipated, but Bridges did not disappoint. The service was exceptional, and food well prepared, delicious, with generous servings....and a birthday cupcake with candle was provided as we were celebrating a birthday. Thus, pleased to give 5 star review on all fronts.

The service could have been better, I was sitting for about 10min before anyone ask me if I wanted a drink. A waiter ask me if I wanted bread, I said yes but never received any. I had to wave a waitress to ask for a server. After that everyone was very nice.

I found the ambiance loud and geared towards a younger crowd. Normally this would not have been an issue but I took my mother who is turning 90.  There was a loud raucous party next to us that was only separated by a piece of cloth. The wait staff was very young with the young men busing the tables likely to be barely over 16.  I good lesson in waiting to clear plates when people are finished eating is needed. We started making jokes about what is really means when one of the staff ask “are you still working on this”? We giggled about asking for a hammer and construction cones to indicate we were still working.  I thought the food was ok, not great.
All good> Service, food and atmosphere.  Great spot.
Always a treat. Service and comfort is great, food delicious and amazing ambiance
The restaurant has a great atmosphere and very good service.  We did not like that the menu did not have any vegetarian options for the main course.  We would not go back again.

Our server was wonderful!
Loved the shrimp salad and cashew chicken sandwich

What has happened to Bridges???

First clue, hardly anyone there.

It took a long time for our server to greet us.

The special was overpriced, the pork chop came with a very odd bread dressing so basically you just got a pork chop and the dessert came frozen, which was a cake!!!

Pro, excellent cocktail.

Server was pleasant, but not knowledgeable about menu and items ordered. Server did not check back until end of meal on a low traffic evening.

The food is always good!

Everyone was fantastic. We were treated like queens. All the staff was attentive, knew their menu and answered all our questions. The food was beyond delicious. The Rib-Eye was amazing! They knew we were fans of the Mrs. Doubtfire movie and took photos of us to complete our special get-together. We look forward to returning and telling all our friends to experience Bridges  for themselves. Thanks so much!
As always, food was amazing and our server, Ben, is the best!
Was disappointed in the quality of the food for the price. Service was adequate but not great. Ambience was good. Bridges is not the place it used to be.

Ben was the nicest server ever! Service with a smile and very thoughtful!
Food was so delicious and wonderful!
Always a great meal. I had the pork chop. It was done perfectly.

Bridges offers choices for anyone's palate and is consistently delicious!  The service is always stellar and it is my "go to" place for lunch, brunch, donner, or Happy Hour.
See you again soon!!

The food was amazing! We had salmon with forbidden rice, the brussel sprouts and salad.

Our waitress Hanna was amazing and made us feel very special for our anniversary!

What a wonderful restaurant and incredible food and service!
Wonderful service, as always. Food was good. Just wish they had more main entree choices.
Risotto was delicious, and was make dairy free per my request.  Apparently, this is a common request and the kitchen knows how to do this.
Food was fresh and tasty. Brunch menu has many wonderful dishes. Loved the chicken and waffles.
Terrible service and food is mediocre at best. Not worth the price point compared to other restaurants in Danville.
Bridges is absolutely beautiful and festive inside and the food is always yummy!  A fun place to celebrate a birthday or anniversary.
The place was pretty empty. I had the risotto- it was too salty and too rich. Prices are high. I didn’t feel the nice atmosphere that is usual, maybe because there were only a few diners there.
Young Waitress was the best we have had at Bridges.
Always reliable, always excellent food well presented.

Everything was excellent. The food was delicious, we had four different entrees and each was perfect!  I had the Corvina fish for the first time, and it  is now my favorite!
The service was exactly as you hope for. Present and attentive, helpful, yet very polite.
They have the best buss boys.
Definitely recommend and will return.
Thank you!
3 course meal had excellent appetizers, entree variety, and desserts. Generous portions. Great staff and diners!

We have been regulars at Bridges for brunch, lunch, dinner and occasional happy hours for over 20 years.  I am certain that our last visit was an exception to the overall experience we recently had on a Saturday afternoon. While there were only four other tables of diners (we had a 2pm reservation), and unconfirmed and based merely on observation: we waited for what seemed longer-than-usual for four drinks (2 mimosas, iced tea, and a mocktail) prior to our brunch orders, and it appeared that there was no bartender on duty. I assume that our food server had to prepare the drink order, and we finally received our drinks. The food was consistently good as always (chicken & waffles, burger, flat iron steak, and fried chicken sandwich) and we ordered desserts and dessert coffee. Food server did their best despite the slow bar order. We haven't written Bridges off of our list and hopefully this review is received as a constructive critique; it was primarily the slow  bar service. We thought that perhaps someone had called in sick with no replacement and created delays with bar orders.

Took our kids here (10, 8, 6) because they are fans of Mrs. Doubtfire and thought it would make for a fun family night. It did not disappoint. Great food, great ambiance, and great service. Highly recommend and will be back again!
The food is definitely not as good as it used to be, the service was ok, the restaurant did not seem that clean.  Overall disappointing and not how I remember Bridges.

Not worth it.

The service was questionable. Nothing was prompt.

We had the Thai curry prawns and a pork chop.

The Thai curry prawns were under seasoned and served over some sort of gelatinous  compressed noodle cake.  The pork chop was flavorless also served over a squash bread pudding.

All of it was expensive and all of it was mediocre at best.
Christmas Eve 3 course meal was wonderful. Starter choices, Entree choices and Dessert choices were amazing and wonderful. So happy we came to Bridges - beginning of a Christmas tradition.

Made reservations a few months ago and was never informed that there was a fixed menu for Christmas Eve. There was a good selection of options, but it felt a bit like food assembly line for dinner with plates already prepped for starters and desserts. The service was also okay and the food was nothing exceptional for what you paid. Won’t rush back, but it was fun to experience Bridges, where the famous Mrs. Doubtfire restaurant scene was filmed.

We have been to Bridges several times for special occasions like birthdays and thanksgiving. Food and service were always excellent. But the Christmas Eve’s dinner we had this year was very disappointed. The server was not attentive. The food was just boring. My husband got the crab soup, mahi mahi and chocolate ginger cake. The soup was pretty good. The mahi mahi had a yellow crust that was not cooked to golden brown. The bean stew on the bottom had no flavor. The caramel on top of that chocolate mousse did not pair well with the chocolate and finger cake. I ordered the duck confit on toast, leg of lamb and pistachio gelato. Duck confit was just pieces of duck meat with cheese and jam on toast, nothing special. The leg of lamb had no flavor, it came with cranberries that were just not seasoned. The wild rice and the bok choy were plain as well. Overall, everything was just bland and boring. Perhaps the previous chef was a much better chef.

Had a very enjoyable birthday dinner.  We told them we were not in a hurry and wanted to relax during dinner.  We spent 2 hours there and it was fantastic.  All the food came at appropriate times from the apps to the main course to dessert.

Would come again in a heartbeat!!

Food was excellent ordered pork chop & steak.
Also had kimchi black forbidden rice. Ordered apple crisp
Bridges is always good!  I love the menu and the service is great!

Bridges has slipped since Lisa retired.  We were a party of 6 and there were no shareable starters for the table.  I had to order 2 orders of Brussels Sprouts and an order of fries.  There was no bread for the table.  One guest needed gluten free, and her meal was a piece of salmon over an inordinate number of beans.  No vegetables on her plate.  Very limited menu.  One bright note… the service was great.  I’m hoping Bridges will regain its excellent reputation, but for now, we were entirely disappointed, and it was expensive.
Love Bridges but it is very noisy during the holidays.
Excellent food and service. We go there for special occasions. Downtown Danville.

This is our second year in a row, hosting a two family Christmas time dinner at Bridges.

Hannah has been our server both years. She’s been kind, thoughtful and attentive. She was overwhelmed tonight most of the night though.  And although we have all been to the restaurant over the years individually, as I said, this is our second year in a row doing this dinner with two families together ￼

Food this year was off, the apps were on point, but our  entrees were not.  We will be back, probably an off night.  This is a beautiful festive place, very happy Bridges is still standing!!
Food was good, service was OK, but very loud inside. We went for brunch and it was Christmas time, so a lot of large groups there.

Seating was very prompt at a nice location in the restaurant.Waitress never introduced herself.  The 3 salmon orders were good, but the pasta with short rib sugo very under seasoned and bland.  Overall, a good evening.
I had not been to Bridges in ten years and it did not disappoint.   Food was great and service was punctual and nice.   I am ready to go back again.
Our meal was excellent.  I had the braised beef and my wife had the chicken dish,  Olivia was a great server.  The menu is excellent and everyone is warm and friendly.

Because of covid, we still prefer eating outside!  Bridges has a beautiful patio with available heaters.  The service and the food were both outstanding.  We shared a poke tombo (tuna) appetizer, then had their amamazing winter squash risotto and the special lamb shank.  We shared an apple arising with wonderful vanilla ice cream.  The zinfandel and the cappuccino were also great.  Thanks for all of the above!!
It was a big "holiday lunch" day and a bit loud but our server and all the staff offset this and made all festive and terrific!
While the ambience was very nice, I was expecting the food to be much better than it was.
A great restaurant that I always wanted to try. Classic delicious food and very great holiday decorations.

Overall rated this a 4/5. My wife and I were seated in the bar area but we had our own small table and the bartender (Maggie) was very attentive.  The organic greens salad was ample and delicately dressed. We both had the risotto which was filled with interesting tastes and textures. The German chocolate cake dessert was dense and the frosting was delicious.

The presentation of our prawn salad was very attractive, but the food was just okay, nothing great to order again. Our friend had the signature hamburger dish, and it looked a bit dry. She did ask for it to be "medium," but it looked more "well done." The restaurant was very noisy, and we found it hard to carry a conversation among four of us. We found ourselves yelling and repeating to each other.

Service was great, ambiance fantastic, food was poor. For example, the steak was $52 and ordered medium rare. It came out extremely rare. I hate doing this but I asked them to put it on the pan one more time... then it came back half the steak extremely rare, half the steak medium-well. So it was both under-done & over-done at the same time. For that price it needs to be done correctly. And all the rest of the food was just meh.
Excellent food and service.  The restaurant gets loud as it starts to fill up so go early.
Excellent food and service. The prices are too high for my budget.
A favorite spot for lunch or dinner. The food is always excellent, the service is great and the ambiance is very nice. Highly recommended.

Service was poor---waiter was unable or unwilling to deal with allergy to onions.  Dishes had no sauce because of onions.  Asked several times for bread, which never showed up.  Charged for a dish that we didnt get because it had onions.  Our table was surrounded by several tables of very loud guests, so we weren't able to hear each other.  Food was tasty.
Love the new menu, and wonderful service from our server.
Turkey extremely dry. I had to find my waiter. Wine was good

We came for Thanksgiving '23. The service was exceptionally slow and the ambiance unpleasantly loud. The food was very good, though the soup arrived cold. We had to ask for the bread, which ended up arriving after the soup. Towards the end of the meal, a group of staff members began cleaning and chatting next to our table, which was disagreeable and unprofessional. Focused on finishing their duties and going home, the servers and staff stopped checking on our table and attending to basic services like filling our waters. There were still quite a few occupied tables in the restaurant, so we weren't holding them up by being the last table of the night. We've been to Bridges many times over the years and have never had this type of experience before. It was especially disappointing since it was Thanksgiving. We will not be returning for a holiday meal.
Fantastic food and service! We are never disappointed with this outstanding restaurant!
Fantastic experience. Great food, service and ambience. We will probably make it a tradition.
Bread is very disappointing, cold and not worthy of an otherwise very good restaurant. Also, Brussels sprouts were under cooked.
You can always depend on a wonderful meal and terrific service at Bridges. Consistent quality of food.
The service was Excellent! The food was fair! Very Nice Staff!
We had a very nice meal, but I had set my heart on ordering from an earlier menu and was disappointed that it was not available.
We have been going to bridges for years.  The food was awesome

I am a weekly diner at Bridges. Our server was pleasant. It seems the food is delayed, slower service in general. This has been the case for about a month or a bit longer. The steak, at $49.00 cost was tough. My friend had the caesar salad which had too much dressing and more anchovy flavor in general than usual. He had the classic prawn dinner and felt the sauce was not of the same consistency. I may recommend to a friend but a bit hesitant after last night.
A delightful meal.  Prawn and noodle salad is always my favorite
Great local spot with diverse menu options for everyone. Great wine list and ambiance.

Great restaurant and service.
They are helpful with our requests to be seated outdoors.

Very pleasant inside setting for 4 adults and very good service and timing. That said ,the chicken on chicken and waffles was terribly overcooked, very dark brown and just a thin sliver of chicken  The waffles were too tough. Lettuce wraps were good and chocolate/ coffee/ liquor hot drink fantastic!
Disappointed, been many a few years since I was there & menu @ ambience is much more casual.  I expected a finer dining experience
I haven't been to Bridges in quite a few years and was disappointed.  My food was just ordinary whereas before it had always been excellent.  Somehow the restaurant has loss it's glitter.

The Swordfish w/Tarragon was to-die-for. Cooked to perfection and the flavor was so excellent that I wanted to savor it. My husband agreed!  Our service from Ben and the staff was remarkable…as if they knew what you needed and attended immediately!

I made the reservation for our anniversary celebration. I also planned a delivery of 18 long stemmed roses, a box of chocolates, and a couple of balloons for my wife to enjoy as we dined.  Unfortunately, when the florist attempted delivery, neither the delivery person, nor the restaurant employee(s) checked the reservation list and refused the delivery.

Fast forward to dinner and there was no gift. It was disappointing to say the least when I got up from the table and asked the host where my wife’s gift was and I was told there was nothing there.  I went back to the table and told my wife what happened. It was a bit embarrassing since it was supposed to be a surprise.

Apparently the host informed the manager what had happened, so the manager came to the table to personally apologize for the mixup and offered to comp the wine we had ordered and dessert should we chose to have dessert.  Extremely nice gesture and it was very much appreciated.  We had an excellent meal overall. The food was delicious and the restaurant has a great atmosphere that we enjoyed.  The gift mixup was taken care of as best they could, so overall the evening was a success.

I would recommend Bridges for a great dinner.

We had the Friday night special for $62 per person, Filet Mignon Steak and Prawn, which was very delicious, my only negative is that they only gave you two prawns, should have been at least 3-4 for this price. Served with chopped potatoes, mushrooms, other veggies, and red wine demi.

The clam chowder was very tasty, but too soupy, someone added too much water to the recipe.  We also had a white Riesling Wine with dinner, it was very good, I don't recall the name, but it had pineapple and other fruit favors.

Bridges had a warm inviting ambience.  Service was excellent.  Attentive, but not intrusive.  Food was delicious.  We ordered the short ribs (which was a pasta dish) and the salmon entree.  Both were wonderful.  The only downside was that the chocolate torte was slightly dry, but the accompanying gelato was creamy and yummy.  I would definitely return.
It is sad to see how much Bridges has declined over the years. I went 10 years ago and it is was spectacular. Now it is just another restaurant with a lackluster menu.
Our son recommended this restaurant to us.  We live in he Central Valley.  We will certainly return for an outstanding meal!
We went to celebrate a birthday. We were seated right way at a very nice corner table.  The staff was friendly and the food was excellent.

Comfortable and lovely outdoor seating with your choice of good food and spirit's.
Long standing favorite of mine! Server's are attentive without crowding your space.
My entree plate was very hot but the bread pudding/stuffing under the pork chop was not   It was tasty though. The Bridges from 10 years ago is not the same quality

We were seated in a nice table outside with heaters and no one else!  It was very enjoyable.  The food was great.  I had risotto with Salmon as an extra protein and my spouse had the special tombo with Indonesian soy sauce.  Both were delicious and could not have been better.

Iconic restaurant.  

Great food, service….great place!

Can’t wait to go back.  

Thank you Bridges team.
Food is just mediocre.  Service was pretty slow the night we dined, took about 45 minutes for our table of two’s order to be taken.

I haven't been to Bridges for a long time but wanted to take people to a very nice lunch. This was the perfect place. Their outside seating is beautiful and peaceful and the weather happened to be perfect. The service was excellent and there many great dishes to choose from on the menu. the waiter was very accommodating. I hope to go back there soon!
I love going to Bridges for lunch or dinner. Always good food and service.
Our server was great, positive, upbeat, a fabulous sense of humor.
Another great evening of good food and excellent service. Our waiter Ben is the best.

We had a great dinner at Bridges.  Loved the menu the variety of the menu, from great fall entrees to a burger.  The appetizer selection was equally as interesting.  We sat outside with heat lamps and it was a really nice atmosphere.  Our waitress was very attentive and professional.  All and all, a really nice evening. We'll be back!
Great place for a lunch date! Variety of food and a beautiful setting!

Bridges Danville never disappoints!!
Food and service are exceptional👍🏻
This is our go to restaurant whenever we have friends and family visiting. Being the infamous restaurant from the movie Mrs. Doubtfire, always makes it a great conversation piece.
Our  server Hannah and our busser Jack were outstanding.  We enjoyed listening to Raphael sing and play guitar.  It was a magical night for an outdoor dinner

Ah, the fabled Bridges of Danville. Our motley crew of five sauntered into this eatery with hearts aflame with the fires of hunger and a desire for culinary delights. Little did we know, we were about to embark on a whimsical wade through the murky waters of mediocrity.

Seated amidst the open, we were like fresh contestants on a reality show titled, "So You Think You Can Dine?" The evening started with a server whose initial enthusiasm mirrored that of a squirrel on an espresso binge. But alas, as the day unfolded, her attentiveness vanished quicker than a vegan’s patience at a BBQ party.

Onto the main act - the Pastrami Benedict, a dish that promised a tantalizing tango of taste. Instead, what we got was a sad, slow waltz in a barren flavor desert. The potatoes that came alongside were alright, but let's be honest, heralding potatoes is like giving a high five to water for being wet.

Now, the pastrami. Oh, the pastrami! It was thinly sliced, bland, and more elusive than a cat at bath time. It had the charisma of a damp rag and the flavor profile of cardboard kissed by a hint of disillusionment. The French bread, masquerading as an English muffin, was a crunchy catastrophe. It was harder than explaining your browser history to your grandma. Each bite was a crusty cry for help amidst a sea of egg.

The lettuce wraps saga unfolded like a Shakespearean tragedy, where the meat played the king, and the six pitiful pieces of lettuce were the dwindling, disheartened courtiers. It was less of a wrap and more of a meaty coup d'etat.

In retrospect, the name Bridges seems rather ironic. Instead of bridging the gap between hunger and satisfaction, it seemed more like a bridge to the barren land of blandness and the forgettable.

Please note This was a Sunday brunch! I’d be willing to bet dinner service and food are better. I’d give this restaurant another try for dinner but not for brunch.

Brunch was amazing. Gina our server made some excellent recommendations. Everything was amazing and watching the TEAM work together - was a great experience. All of our food and drinks were impeccable!

This is a large restaurant which can accommodate a lot of people.  The decor is very nice, the food was also very good .  Our waitress was very helpful and considerate.  All in all this was a very good experience.  It was difficult to hear the conversation across the table because of the noise level but we had a good time.
Food was quite good, and service was attentive without being intrusive. A delightful evening.
We love Bridges! Ben is our favorite waiter and he is was awesome as usual! :)

Warm hospitality, accommodating service, great food, attention to high quality. If you have special dietary requirements, Bridges, bridges your need by providing a comfortable adjustment to their available menu. I have an EXTREME LELEL IF CELIAC DISEASE. Bridges is the SINGLE restaurant I can enjoy without fear of cross contamination. Your experience will be seamless, safe, and rewarding!
Went for wedding anniversary, they provided complementary dessert with designed plating.
Had brunch. Several had bacon and eggs. Very ordinary except more expensive than a breakfast place.
Service was really bad.  Waitress disappeared for 30 minutes at a time and I had to flag down others.

Bridges is such a nice place, but the food continues to decrease in quality. I have the ribeye special and it was honestly the worst steak I’ve ever had in my life.

The only thing good was  the wine we brought the friends we met and the truffle fries.  It’s disappointing because it used to be a go to for us.
Great place to meet up with friends and enjoy a fabulous meal.

Great atmosphere! My husband had the curry dish which was amazing. The shishto peppers appetizer was delicious! I ordered the risotto which was a horrible bowl of mush. I only had a few bites, it was practically inedible. Loved the live music and ambiance, will just stay away from risotto next time!

We were very excited to go there for our 1 year anniversary.   It started out really bad with the service we got from the female bartender, who could care less about taking care of us. It was more interested to discussing with a coworker at the end of the bar about another coworker. Our service at the bar was really bad. That asked to be seated even earlier, due to the quality of the bad service.   Luckily the service we received at the restaurant was great.  The only reason we did not give five stars across-the-board in our review was due to the service we received at the bar.
Lovely place to celebrate our anniversary!
We had a wonderful lunch today. The ambiance was incredible. The food was beautifully presented and tasted really good.

Lovely, private setting, with a delightful, covered patio for al fresco dining. We chose the outdoor option and loved the table we were seated at, under a trellis cover and surrounded by trees and a garden. Our server was attentive, but not pushy--no rush, which our group was grateful for as we had not seen each other in a while.  One of us opted for the burger, which was cooked perfectly, and the truffle fries were yummy. The rest of us ordered salads: the Cesar salad was tasty with just salad or with the added grilled chicken.  The special, prawn Louie was generous with beautiful, chilled prawns on top of the lettuce and Louie dressing. For dessert we share the vanilla and spumoni gelato, both of which were of excellent quality.  Very good wine list.  Indoor dining is intimate and beautifully decorated, so try this for dinner in the fall or winter months.
The food, wine, and our server were all fantastic!

We were on the patio and the yellow jackets took over.
Very few people eating on patio and now I know why.
Need to get the situation under control.
Food quality is consistently good. Fries were the perfect crispy-ness. The grilled prawn sesame noodle salad is always outstanding.
All I can say is yum !!  Absolutely try the Thai Shrimp dish.  Presentation lovely and flavors exceptional.  Also do at least share an order of the spumoni ice cream !!  You will not be disappointed.
The place is great , we loved the music, the food and the service . Over all is great
The server forgot to bring a wine bucket, even though she offered one and we said yes.  They ran out of halibut; we could only get one order, and they ran out of the dessert we wanted.
Lunch at Bridges. Divine, memorable, delightful. Highly recommend the Grilled Prawn Sesame Noodle Salad.
We ate dinner to celebrate my sons birthday. The service was great and the food was really good. We have always had a good experience at Bridges. We will be back for our next occasion.

This was a return trip with friends who enjoyed the previous experience enough to want to go again.  Pleasant, friendly, efficient wait staff.  Delightful food from appetizers to dessert.  We'll be back.
Nice ambiance , but food came out incorrectly and undercooked instead of replacing it like requested and acknowledged the staff came back with microwaved burger still undercooked.

Well it was fine up until I tried to use a gift card along with my CC to settle the bill.  My family took my elderly mother to the car and I waited at the table.  Our server ran after my family and told my oldest son in front of Grandma (her birthday) that the gift card had expired which I think is A. not possible and B. illegal in CA.  She never came to speak directly with me, still in the dining room waiting to sign my CC for the balance. Naturally my son and grandma were embarrassed.

After 25 minutes of sitting in an empty dinning room, the manager told me she had to call the owner to approve the gift card which he did (like she was doing me a favor) and then gave me a receipt with the wrong balance amount and the gratuity already included.

My wife and I are both gainfully employed and can afford to pay our bills.  I don't like being treated like some kind of a grifter.

The restaurant business is a competitive market and we will not be going back there and I will tell anyone who listens what a poor experience we had.

RPL
We have been coming to Bridges for 30 plus years. We were shocked at the poor service. Waiter was non existent and when he came by he was curt and unfriendly. Shame.

Staff training is a must. Young staff very nice but not knowledgeable about much ( wine or food)
Never came back to remove dishes and brought entree with empty dishes 
Chicken harissa very bland   Not impressed 
Seared tuna was very good 
Maybe trying another dish another time but for our first time there we were disappointed
Loved our lunch on the patio.  Our waiter was great!  We will be back soon.

Bridges never disappoints us, or any
guests that we bring.
Great food great staff… 
Thank Yon Bridges🥂
Good ambiance, good food, service is okay (we were seated outside) it was a Monday
Good food service very good in Danville California great
Excellent food . Plan to go back with my husband next few weeks
Great early dinner outside. Love their Asian noodle prawn salad, great combo of tastes. Setting is so beautiful.

Shrimp and cabbage salad was a failure. Shrimp was done nicely, but the cabbage was bland and mushy. Manager had to comp all three servings. I've heard rave reviews about this salad but this was not good.
Easy, convenient restaurant. Really nothing special though.  Average menu. Good, friendly service.

We had an awesome experience at Bridges.  The food was great, the weather was perfect for the outdoor patio and the service was exceptional.  A big shout out to our waitress and the wait support team.

The food at Bridges is very, very good.  My husband had the pork chop and it was cooked perfectly, served over a delicious mound of sweet potatoes.  I had the tuna Tombo - sushi grade served over black rice.  Lately the tuna has been my favorite dish and last night, it didn't disappoint.

Easy to make reservations online and pleasant and accommadating when adjusting our late arrival. We were seated promptly, hostess was professioal yet casual and fun. Very pretty setting and all wait staff was friendly and attentive. We needed to ask for bread and salt but no hesitation in providing it.  Cocktails were tasty and delivered in a timely manner. Great experience all around and happy to host our visiting friends and relatives there!
I have never had a bad meal at Bridges. Always delicious and perfect. Very friendly!
No better place in Danville for outdoor dining. Go on Friday for surf and turf and be sure to have a Danville Old Fashioned.

The food, service and setting are all very enjoyable. There are  limited vegetarian choices, and no vegan entree choice. We ordered several desserts after our meal. The only one I would definitely suggest you avoid is the fruit crisp, unless you like a softer, “mushy” crisp. Otherwise, we thoroughly enjoyed our meal.
Lisa  will be missed. .  She is working hard to train the new people. She is a star. And this buy far is our favorite restaurant after many, many years.

We recieved a special gift certificate from our family. We were so excited to dine at Bridges because we are new to the area and had heard it was special. The evening was  beautiful and our server was very nice. Our cocktails were great. We ordered salmon and pork chops and they were overcooked. We did not want to admit it, but eventually had to face the fact that this fact kind of ruined our dinner. Both require a fair amount of expertise since they both can be overcooked pretty easily. I called a few days later and left a message for the manager - letting them know that I was calling because I did not want to write a review for all to see. No one called back. So.....here it is folks. Chef needs help - we won't be back now - too many other options. Bummer.
Love Bridges!  The food is always good and the outside patio during the Summer is lovely.
It’s always been delicious. One of my favorites. I recommend for delicious adventures come to Bridges

We were kindly greeted immediately when we entered the restaurant. When seated we were given water and shortly after our server greeted us. She gave us time to make drink and starter decisions. When ready she took our dinner order. She checked back with us without being overly attentive. Drinks, wine and food were excellent. A lovely evening for my husbands birthday.
Service was excellent.  Food all delicious and loved the special of breaded short rib with scallops. Divine!

As always, Bridges never disappoints. The service is wonderful; the wait staff are very attentive and professional. Great menu items.
It’s where I like to bring friends and family when we want a restaurant that is a cut above.

Power went out and most tables did not get their food. We lucked out, but they need a generator & some way to pay with a card if the power goes out again. They took our credit card info and email. Food was great. Only one server for the whole restaurant though. Poor guy seemed stressed. Nothing was comped as far as we know.
Beautiful presentation of the food and everything tasted as good as it looked. The lovely patio and excellent service made for a relaxing and enjoyable evening

Bridges was my favorite restaurant in Danville for over a decade. I always went there and had a good experience. Good food, good ambiance and good service. Unfortunately, during the past 2-3 years, the quality of the food that is served has completely deteriorated. It is no longer fresh as before and the portions are no longer as generous. It feels like a good chef has left and the previous management has left also. I have heard complaints about the quality of the food from other people too. Sad.
Love sitting on the patio. Great salad and service.
Great service, excellent food. Clean and wonderful atmosphere

Dined on the patio near the fountain on a warm summer's evening. Service was spectacular, experienced, responsive and informative.  The beef lettuce cups were an awesome appetizer and the halibut special topped with lobster salad was outstanding. We had a great evening and will definitely be back soon.
Wasted space for a restaurant.  Food is poor quality.  Service was horrible.  Best part was the outdoor ambience.  Invest in a good chef and have the owners present.
Delicious as always! The food and service are always exquisite!
Bridges was a wonderful setting and brunch for a lovely visit with my niece.
The food was very good , but our server Chris had a very strange personality- he almost seemed bored and disengaged with serving us.
wonderful service, great atmosphere outside before going to theatre.  Had a nice, dry sauvignon blanc with tombo tuna.   Excellent
Our service was very attentive.  The waitress had some great recommendations.
Food was good as usual, it was a quiet afternoon not very busy.  No one ever came by to fill up our water glasses, that was my only complaint.  Other than that its a great place!

We were placed at a table next to a very loud dinner.  Made our meal miserable.  Could not even hear the music.  Server should have stopped serving drinks when they became so loud.   Made for a very unpleasant dining experience

Beautiful evening out on the patio. Before dinner drink was nice. Musician singing, very nice. Dinner came. Food is great. Then we started getting swarmed by meat bees. Had to move inside to get away. After that, a bunch of other diners followed suit. We were lucky it was a slow night. Best Irish coffee I’ve ever tasted. Bridges version is great, too, if you like a sweeter taste.
Fantastic food and outstanding service as usual.
All was good. There happen to be a baby shower at the same time, but it didn’t get really loud. Mike was a nice and personable waiter

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had the pleasure of dining at Bridges Restaurant on July 28, 2023, and I can't say enough good things about this incredible establishment. From the moment I stepped through the door, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism that set the tone for an unforgettable evening.

The ambiance at Bridges is nothing short of spectacular. The restaurant is beautifully decorated, offering a perfect blend of elegance and comfort. The dimmed lighting and the soft background music created a relaxed and intimate atmosphere, making it an ideal setting for a romantic dinner.

Now, let's talk about the food. The menu at Bridges is a culinary masterpiece. Chef Kevin Gin sent us several appetizers and I was blown away by the flavors and presentation. For the main course, I had stir-fried prawns on crispy noodle cake, which was cooked to perfection, tender, and bursting with savory goodness. The attention to detail in the plating was impressive, and each dish was a work of art.

The service was impeccable. Our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and friendly. They made excellent recommendations and ensured that our glasses were never empty. The staff at Bridges truly goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome and cared for.

What makes Bridges even more exceptional is the patio. We had a quiet table, and the picturesque setting added an extra layer of enchantment to our dining experience. It's rare to find a restaurant that combines top-notch cuisine with such a breathtaking natural backdrop.

To top it all off, dessert was a sweet symphony. I indulged in the cheesecake, which was a delectable way to end the meal.

In summary, my dining experience at Bridges Restaurant was nothing short of extraordinary.
We sat outside….great table. Our waitress was wonderful. We had a thoroughly fun evening. It’s been a while since I was there but I look forward to coming back again soon.

The food and ambience are always great. However, our food came out way too fast (10minutes tops after order was put in). We hadn’t finished our cocktails, and just wanted to relax a bit before dinner. It felt rushed, though the restaurant was not that busy.
lovely lunch menu.  service was excellent.  will definitely return!
The outside seating was very comfortable, the food excellent , and to make it all great, the singer and his delightful daughter with their beautiful soft music made the dinner memorable !
Always delicious! Noisy and crowded on the weekends.

We are regular local diners at Bridges from back in the days of the Sugatani family ownership. We stopped going there for awhile when we had a negative experience with one of their bartenders (whom we had gotten to know through patronage, and whom is no longer there). We started back after the Covid clearance period and have been pleasantly surprised that, despite the challenge of finding steady and reliable staff (in all industries), our experiences have been fun and enjoyable, so much so that we are there at least 1-3 times/month for a variety of occasions. Food has been well-prepared including flavor, presentation, and seasonal changes), food servers have been a blast, and the indoor as well as patio seating have always been serene and calming (and patio dog-friendly which is a significant advantage for us). You will not be disappointed!

Bridges was, as always, very comfortable and food very good.  Our servers were always attentive and kind.  I like the fact that the restaurant has inside and outside dining with plenty of room to do whichever the weather allows you to do.

We were celebrating our wedding anniversary and dined on a Sunday night and the restaurant was maybe 25% full.  We split an appetizer and each ordered an entrée.  The food was good, but not great.  The service, on the other hand, was excellent.  Overall we were disappointed and I think we will look elsewhere the next time we have a special occasion to celebrate.

We dined and camped at our patio table for hours as a result of a reunion lunch catching up with long-lost family members from out of town. Lunch was superb with just one minor culinary exception: I requested sunny-side up eggs atop my Chilaquiles (they can be fried or scrambled as well) and they arrived fried. Other than that, the Berry mimosas were fabulous, food server was well-paced throughout our "camping" and dessert was to die for. We were never rushed and were always asked if there was anything else we would like, and our glasses were always refilled with water. We are locals and regular customers, and my fried egg did not detract from our patronage. From the bar experience to table dining and menu selections, Bridges is always fun and enjoyable with a serene ambience.
Always consistent.  Always wonderful.  Excellent service.  Nice ambience.  It's my go-to restaurant for excellent food.
Iron steak dish was outstanding! All of Bridges staff (hostess, Ben our waiter and others helping out) made the experience lovely for us.
The service was great and the food was very good.  We had a table in the corner. Great location since the 4 of us (ladies) needed to catch up.
The patio seating at Bridges is very nice and extremely relaxing.  Great ambience to enjoy a good meal.
Nice spot, service always great, good bar, great brunch and lunch spot, but not impressed with dinner menu. Sorry!

Bridges is one of our favorite places to go for lunch. The noodle salad with prawns is absolutely amazing but this time we decided to switch it up and get the salmon salad. They cooked it perfectly. It was nice and crisp and perfectly seasoned and we like our fish cooked medium, not￼ raw in the middle and they got it just right. Our server Mike was very attentive and pleasant. We ordered a bottle of wine and it’s nice when they automatically bring you an ice bucket and you don’t have to ask for it.

Food was excellent. Drinks were fantastic too. But, I noted that we were celebrating an anniversary and there was no acknowledgment. We also felt rushed and that the wait staff was hovering over us to finish. They didn’t give us time to enjoy the meal and the company.

I have been going to Bridges from the very beginning when it was  first built. I was around when they filmed Mrs. Doubtfire.   I think it is the best. It has the most beautiful outside dining in Danville.

I know some people think 3 stars are bad, but not really.  The Bridges is a good place to go to once a while.  Not great, certainly not bad.  A solid OK.   The food has some strange combos of flavors, some work, some not so much.  Great service though.

Unfortunately my friend and I did not think Bridges was up to previous experiences.
