We brought a bottle of wine and the server put the white wine in an ice bucket and never checked back to pour our glasses. For a corkage fee, there could have been some attention. Both of us ordered salmon on a salad. We requested a 'medium' cook. Both our pieces were fully cooked and quite dry. It didn't appear to be freshly cooked either. I thought I would get a salad with a number of different ingredients per the menu and I only got lettuce.
Ribeye Steak was excellent. Smashed potatoes and the broccolini were just ok. Next time, I would ask to swap out that side.

I’ve been going to Bridges for many years.  Never had a bad meal except yesterday 6/25 Sunday.  We took a friend there for her birthday brunch.  There were 4 of us  Luckily the birthday girl’s meal was good.  The other 3 orders were Lettuce Wraps, Southern Eggs Benedict and mine was the Chicken Cashew Sandwich.
Lettuce Wraps….the meat filling was a bit salty, the Southern Benedict….egg was poached perfectly but the sausage gravy had no taste.  Had to add salt, then it was ok.  Mine was the Chicken Cashew Sandwich.  It was the worst sandwich I’ve ever had.  Not edible at all!  No taste except for the herb( not sure what it was) that was added to it.  The waitress was kind enough to change my order.  Ordered the Fried Chicken with waffle.  The chicken was slightly tender but the batter was very oily and not crispy.  Waffles are fine.  Our waitress was great.  The chef must have had an off day.  Disappointing brunch.  Not sure if I’ll ever go back for brunch there.
Food was delicious and our waiter was great! We love coming here. Always a great experience!

We love Bridge’s, the atmosphere etc., but  this time the food was very underhwelming.  The complementary bread was stale.  The Bruschetta had absolutely no flavor, the bread was not toasted, it was soggy.  There was no taste, just a splash of balsamic vinegar and tasteless tomatoes.  The presentation of the salads was poor, served on very small plates and consisted of mostly lettuce, really no flavor with a couple strawberrrie and a dab of goat cheese.  The burger was nothing special, which it is usually very good.

Based on our experience, everthing was very bland, for the price, someone would expect much better taste and quality.  Extemely dissapointed.

Bridges always serves top quality . The burgers are amazing . The salads are fresh and unique.
They really make you feel welcome
Our server was so attentive, and our lunch was really good. The salad of the week, with Jack Daniels bbq chicken, was perfect. Salted caramel gelato was pure bliss.

What a delightful experience it was to dine with my friend outdoors on Wednesday! And, Tyler was a wonderful waiter! He was pleasant, professional, helpful, and such a delight that day! Food was very good—I loved the French dip, but was disappointed in the prawn noodle salad—just not what I expected—but that’s ok.  I had a great time! Thank you! I will definitely return!—peg
Thought a couple of the chicken dishes were average.
Went for Father’s Day.  Didn’t like the menu. No healthy options. So left without eating to Elia in Walnut Creek.
Overpriced for breakfast, we paid over $200 for 3 people.

We love coming to Bridges, but this Father's day was a bust with the price fixe menu which I was not aware of.  All of the entrees were very wet/mushy and not desirable.  Salad had no dressing on it so we asked for more.  I'm sorry to say for such a pricey brunch for 4, we left a lot of food on our plates as we could bare to eat it anymore after a few bites.  I've rarely seen that from my family.  We may try it one more time, but not sure if I will be going back again.

Idyllic late spring evening with pleasant outdoor setting. The vinegar cured green strawberry salad was a palate pleaser but the tuna entree with squid ink pasta was exciting. It had a subtle kimchi sauce was but the kyurizuke accompaniment made the dish especially lively. Two minor issues are that Napa Chandon is the brut-by-the-glass and the fruit compote with gelato topping was less than memorable.
I had the pork chop and it was delicious.  The berry dessert was so so.
I had the surf and turf special. It's very tasty and well put together. Great service from Ben!

Although the restaurant was not overly busy, service from beginning to end was slow. Took over an hour from seating to service of our main courses. We had long finished our appetizers by then. The bread basket was served late, right before the main course, as we had already eaten 3 appetizers by then. My wife’s wine glass was empty and ready for a refill for 20 minutes before someone checked on this.
The staff were nice, food was served hot, food was good.
Overall still a good experience.
Excellent. Always consistent and good. Very pleasant sitting outside.
Slow service even though the place was not crowded.  Waited 10 minutes for our check. Felt ignored.  Food was OK.  I was expecting better.
The food was delicious. Restaurant is very nice and the servers are friendly.
Great food and service.   weather was perfect to eat outside on the gorgeous patio.

My wife had two issues with her order. The bun was stale on her chicken salad sandwich. Also, the fries had chili powder on them, which she is allergic to. to My salmon salad was ok. The salmon was fine, but the salad part was blah and under -seasoned on the dressing.

Short Ribs were nothing more than a bowl of noodles and a meager portion of meat.  Caesar Salad can meet its betters in many Bay Area restaurants.  Chicken and Shrimp Lettuce Wraps were very good and the Grilled Ribeye Steak dinner was excellent.  Service was also excellent throughout the dining experience (all staff) but it was very noisy (a large business group in one section) and very difficult to have a quiet, intimate conversation (we were there to celebrate our anniversary),  It might be quieter on other nights, but not tonight.  It is a very popular restaurant, but I remain neutral on making a recommendation to friends and family.

Our server was most helpful, and I always like when she is the one to help us.
Everything was great, and my guests from AZ were so happy to be back visiting in Danville, where they moved from, 4 years ago.
The food was superior. We had good service and ate outside. It was very pleasant.
Came in for brunch with my husband. Simple gear food. Yummy mimosas. Perfect for after church Sunday morning.
Food did not meet my expectations. The service was good

we enjoyed our dinner, waitress was very good, knew her wines well
live music was a nice touch to the evening
enjoyed all our food, Bruschetta, roasted cauliflower, and stir fried prawns
Worst service ever!! Will never go back they threw the bread in the table and walked away without a word and didn’t come back for over 15 minutes so we just walked out!
Great staff and service.  Food was great.  We celebrated a birthday which was well supported by the restaurant.

Great service staff all around, great appetizers and fish. Entrées, steak special was a bit tough, but consistently a great spot for service, ambience, and food. Bonus that the outside patio is dog, friendly with live music!

Bridges is the nicest restaurant there is in the East Bay 680 corridor, whether you’re interested in lunch or dinner.  Beautiful ambience, spacious covered outdoor seating, broad menu, yummy food and drink options, and great service.  My only complaint is the hard wooden chairs that were bothersome after an hour or more of sitting!
A good restaurant to dine with family and friends. It is my favorite over the years.

The food was amazing. My boyfriend and I decided to split the pork chop dish and the burger dish and they were so nice, they cut and placed on separate plates for us. The food was extremely delicious. We also tried the salad with goat cheese and candied pecans, very refreshing. Their drinks were spectacular. I had the ￼ raspberry lemon drop and my boyfriend had the bridges Manhattan. Both￼ were great.

Great patio lunch. Very nice waiter who was attentive ...our guests arrived late and he was very accommodating. Food was good; we got a variety of items and appetizers.
Fried cauliflower and frites were excellent.  Great salads, scramble, hamburger.
You can find a variety of different items. Something for everyone!  We got two birthday cupcakes to celebrate my husband's birthday and mine.  Love the ambiance of the patio and the inside of restaurant is romantically elegant.
Friendly staff, delicious food. Went in for breakfast/brunch and had the chicken chilaquiles and chicken and buttermilk waffles and was not disappointed. Super yummy

Two awesome dishes, great patio seating with a heater, and exceptional service.

Highly recommend!

Bridges never fails to impress consistently delivering wonderful dishes in a comfortable setting with a very pleasant waitstaff. It's a great setting for special dinner celebrations and client lunch meetings. My only concern is that the menu is very predicatable with the core being their standard fare. The menu would benefit from some new, innovative dishes.

This would have been a 5 star review, except for the condition of the dining room. The floor had chunks of food on the carpet in several places in our section and crumbs on the chairs. I would have thought the dining room would have been cleaned up for the dinner crowd. This was very odd so I'm not sure if this happens regularly during the week.  Food, server, and live music were awesome!

A real bummer. We were excited to try this restaurant, but we’re really let down. Ordered steaks cooked medium, and they came out very well done. The roasted carrots that came with my steak were burnt cinders. One of us ordered risotto which was way over seasoned (salty). When served, the staff just reached across and over the table. The bus boy did the same when filling our water, and spilled on the table or our plates each time. Won’t be eating here for a while.
Busy but got reservation at time desired and seated promptly
One table was extremely loud and almost got into a fight with a GENTLEMAN who asked them nicely to tone it down.      Ended well; the loud mouths bought him and his wife a glass of wine!! 👍🏻

We had an incredible dining experience at Bridges. The food was wonderful, ambiance outside was perfect for a beautiful night and Lisa the general Manager took great care of us! We will be back for more tasty cocktails, the delicious shrimp/noodle salad and wonderful staff.
Excellent as always. Apparently the restaurant is having trouble recruiting servers because its a little slow.
great food understandable tiredness of waiter however always prompt and attentive. i do wish more people smiled but it was a hectic day

Mother’s Day brunch was outstanding. When we arrived our table was ready and service was prompt. Menu selection was excellent and food was delicious. I took my 96 year old Aunt for her birthday in April and Mother’s Day in May. Bridges is her favorite restaurant and they never disappoint.

Went for Mothers Day brunch. I had the “brisket hash” which was mainly potatoes. Hardly any meat in it.
The wait staff was young and nervous as they dropped many plates around us. It became comical.

Busy day. Mother’s Day.
Service was good.
Ambiance very pleasant on the outside patio.
Food was fair.
We absolutely love bridges. It’s consistently good food, a great ambience, and a perfect location for walking downtown. ￼
Everything, food, service, atmosphere, etc. all good.
Great service, great food, great atmosphere! Thanks, Bridges, for making great memories!

Bridges is a neighborhood gem and is well managed. Recently my wife and I have noticed that the restaurant has not been as crowded as it once was and certainly not as much as the pizza parlor down the road. We had a lovely dinner outdoors starting with a delicious cauliflower appetizer followed by a nicely dressed chopped romaine Caesar salad and several pasta entrees. Our shared dessert was a pleasant peau de creme.
We had a wonderful night, sitting outside on their patio and enjoying a wonderfully relaxing night with amazing food and extraordinary service.
Great dinner - Maggie is an awesome manager and Ben a perfect waiter

Bridges is my go to restaurant when I need it all to come together for a fabulous dining experience. Our waiter showed the perfect level of attention, the food was fabulous, atmosphere calm and beautiful. Thank you Bridges chefs and staff. ❤️
Great live music with Rafaelo on the heated patio. Best burger ever and sweet young female server~very attentive. How refreshing!
My friends and I had a wonderful time and the food was outstanding 👌

Sunday brunch is very good with a nice selection of dishes.  Had trouble getting a second cup of coffee because we tried to summon a waiter to our table but after three tries someone finally delivered.
Wonderfully dinner, great service & lovely ambience!
They really need to change the menu more often, it keeps us from going back seven though it’s convenient.
Always enjoy the tastes of the various options at Bridges. Thank you all for giving our family great service too.
The sinful black fried rice was TO DIE FOR! I'm going to try and recreate it at home! 🍚💓

The food was very average, the pork was overcooked for sandwich dish so dry and chewy
Service was nice
Always a great spot for dinner!! Great food and great service.
Consistently great! The highest quality ingredients, prepared to perfection.

Considering date of week (Tuesday) and time (7.30)
Felt service was a little inattentive. Several large groups in both rooms may have caused some of this
Food was imaginative and well prepared
Will return at a later date
Great service, excellent food and awesome musician.
Quick and courteous service.  Perfect weather for outdoor dining.
My husband and I went to bridges for our 8th wedding anniversary and overall the food, the staff, and scenery was all very nice and prices were definitely worth it.
We sat outside for dinner. It’s been a while since I’ve been to Bridges and it was as good as I remembered. Food was very tasty and service was good.

Terrible food! I was shocked… haven’t been to Bridges in a long while and thought it sounded nice to meet some friends there for a 7pm dinner. Of the 5 meals ordered, only 1 was even ok. There were 2 orders of the ‘special’ which was supposed to be a 10oz rib eye steak over scalloped potatoes with a wine reduction. The initial presentation was sloppy with the potatoes looking rather mashed and the less than 1/2” (!) rib eye in a rubbery appearance served atop of them. Both the steak and potatoes were relatively tasteless.

Our 2 friends both ordered the pork chop which, again, was quite thin, poorly seasoned and the accompaniments tasteless. The saving grace was my meal which was the Tombo, cooked to perfection.

We did tell our server of the disappointment and he credited the 2 steaks, which was unexpected and very nice. We live in Alamo and frequent Danville restaurants often, but I have to say I don’t think we’ll be coming back to Bridges again.

We have been to Bridges for lunch and dinner before. We were not impressed with menu, food quality, and price,but we thought we should try it again, as we like to eat local. We went for brunch and ordered  two egg dishes. Neither one came with toast. I was surprised, so I asked our server, and sure enough no toast. I found that strange for an egg dish. Neither egg dish was memorable. Scramble had no bacon in it, despite the description on the menu saying otherwise. In general, I believe menu choices for brunch and lunch need updating. I don't think we will be back, as menu options, food quality, and price are not inviting.

Always love going to our Bridges.
Food and service is beyond good.
Loved sitting in the beautiful patio.
As good as it has always been.  Simply the best restaurant in the valley.
Wonderful service, always great food!
From start to finish, the staff was incredible at Bridges! Then the food was incredible! Could not have asked for a better experience for my birthday dinner at Bridges! Thank you so much!!
Love this place.  Every time we come here its always a good experience.

I liked the ambiance and location of the restaurant. Service was great. As my water was low it was filled up again without me tagging someone down. The appetizers were delicious. Although I was expecting more flavor to the entrees I ordered. It could be that the appetizers took a bit of that flavor away. But overall, it was a good dinner.
We always have the best experience here! The food and service never disappoints!

The Mexican prawns were very good.  But the special surf and turf was soso.  The meat was not cooked very well.  The shrimp were a bit undercooked.  And the vegetables were a bit undercooked as well.  The dessert was very good.  I would definitely go back for the shrimp dish.

Wonder meal and excellent service!
We love Bridges!
Great food and service as always. Delicious birthday cupcake.
The service was very poor and the food mediocre. There were 5 of us and no one thought their dinner was very good. Disappointing, this used to be a great restaurant.
Beautiful restaurant and great place of any occasion!

Easter brunch was a hit. The filet of beef melted in your mouth. The clam chowder was outstanding. We finished with carrot cake. The service was also excellent. If you want a delicious relaxing meal, I recommend Bridges. The bloody Mary’s are delicious. Eating outside is really fun too
Outdoor, enclosed seating was relaxed, quiet and comfortable. Service was competent and pleasant.
Great steak, fantastic food and dessert!

This was Easter brunch price fixed meal. Normally a huge Bridges fan but the main courses really fell short of the b“norm” and for the high price. Appetizers were great but main courses and desserts fell short. French toast casserole was too dense and heavy with solid packed bread and not enough egg and cream. The scrambled eggs with artichokes and cheese was watery. Egg texture was not real eggs. Eggs seemed poured from a carton and had been sitting  cooked, as in premade, for a while. They were weeping. Potatoes were good.
Someone loved the carrot cake but two of us thought the chocolate cream pie was more like chocolate dense mouse in a weird, too hard cookie shell. The sorbet was good but the cookie that came with it was dry and stale. Ok still love Bridges but will stay away from price fix meals.
Outrageous prices for average food! Live the location,  outstanding service.

It was a wonderful time there. Got seated quickly, server and stag were attentive. The food was amazing but whenever we go there it always it. It’s a bit pricey but worth it. May make it an Easter Tradition.
We had a fantastic dinner at a reasonable price and the service was OUTSTANDING from the hostess greeting you to the bus people to the server.  Definitely will be back.
Hopefully, this was just a bad service night and not the start of a trend.

I don’t know…not nearly as good as I remembered pre Covid.  Service was okay - dish wasn’t prepared the way we asked for it.  They sat us next to the kitchen door even thought the place was empty.  We wondered why they chose to seat us there.  Disappointing…
Service, as usual, friendly and professional. The pork tenderloin bang MI was a treat.
We keep coming back for that Bridges Burger! Our server was wonderful and just a lovely gal!
Bridges restaurant is a great place to celebrate special people. We celebrated with good food, good service, a good friend, who turned 75

The restaurant noise was extremely loud. Waiter was trying hard to be attentive but made some bone-head mistakes leading us to believe he was either a novice or quite distracted. The food was quite good!
Our server Aaron made it a very pleasant experience!

We have eaten at Bridges many times. We were going to a show next door so chose Bridges for its consistency in food and service. This time was different. We shared a Caesar salad that had zero taste. I left mine off to the side because it was a plate of chopped romaine, two little croutons and a sprinkling of cheese. Our server didn’t ask but that maybe because once she took the order we she didn’t approach the table until we were almost finished with our entrées. We had time for dessert and were curious in seeing a dessert menu. The server did come by after our plates were cleared so we asked to see a menu. Ten minutes later we couldn’t wait any longer so we flagged her over, yes we had to get her attention, and gave her our CC. She returned for my signature. She did not mention that she never brought us the dessert menu or ask for coffee or tea. On the way out I stopped to use the ladies room. When I came out she was in the lobby and told us she just remembered we asked for a dessert menu and she never brought us one or acknowledged she forgot. In her defense she and all the other servers were overwhelmed by tables. Unfortunate that restaurant managers don’t know how to control business so the staff can give the attention and service to their customers. It is called hospitality for a reason.
Aaron was an amazing server. He gave excellent recommendations on food choices and the food at Bridges is always delicious.
Outstanding delicious food.  Service is attentive and fast.  No rush to leave.
Mike was our excellent server. We moved from inside to the outside due to the high level of noise. The outside was peaceful and quite lovely.
Everything was done well including the service.  Always a pleasure dining here.
Great experience, great service, and most importantly great food flavors.

We had a lovely dinner at Bridges.  The service was good.  A couple of the items on the menu were excellent. The Parmesan crusted chicken was excellent as was the poke and Brussel sprouts.  The truffle frites were a bit disappointing and the bread was unremarkable.  Steak was ok as were the cocktails. Overall we had a nice dinner.
Delicious as always. Great service as always! We always enjoy Bridges for all meals!

We eat there occasionally and were celebrating a birthday.  First, not enough staff, food was cold, round of drinks came out after entrees, and it felt like a coffee shop; tons of kids, super loud.  High chairs everywhere.  Parents letting babies scream.  Sent fish back to be cooked longer (asked for well done) also asked for no sausage and bacon on the fish, but it came out that way both times)  I’ll wait until summer when as least we can sit outside if I ever go back.
The food was excellent though I missed the soy based edamame appetizer and the mushroom ravioli which they rotated out.
Had a business luncheon. Everyone enjoyed their food. Service was very good as well.
I so loved our server. She was so helpful and professional and so kind.
Great food and excellent service. Bridges is always the perfect place for a Sunday brunch.
A fun brunch food was good not great we would go back

The décor is very nice.
We love the service and bus boys were excellent.
The food were in salty side. Maybe cater to the senior.
I wish the restaurant can bake their own bread.
I know they can do better. Need to more creative on the menu.

I was disappointed that we were moved outside because we had one more person to the party of four at about one hour from the reservation. I was not able to see the inside of the restaurant and after sitting outside, I lost my interest on checking the place out. The food was good but too pricey, good thing we had a great team of people taking care of us.
Served so quickly! We were served our apps within 10 minutes of being seated, not to mention the food was incredible. Thanks for making our anniversary special!
EXCELLENT FOOD, SERVICE AND AMBIANCE.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

We were there for lunch. The restaurant was not busy. We waited well over 30 minutes to get a drink order and then another 30 minutes to place our food order. I guess they were lacking servers. I would not go back.
A wonderful dining experience, the lamb shank special was outstanding!
Perfect lunch with my sister.

We ordered the prawn noodle salad and it  was perfectly tasteless.  I asked for extra dressing and was given a dressing that didn’t even go with the salad. We could barely eat it. Our server was lovely and apologetic but I’m not sure I’ll go back. Been going here for years. Maybe they should remove this item from the menu.

The duck “bolognese” was inedible. The dish was not a bolognese and the duck was rancid. The shrimp salad with the noodles which is usually very good was under spiced and barely edible. They did take the pasta dish off the bill but the server was too busy to check in and notice that the food was inedible
Had a celebration diner with friends. An excellent experience.

Server was pretentious,

Air fried clicker flavorless, asparagus old - discolored.
Coconut cheese cake was dry (it looked like it was dumped on the plate-and slid to the edge!)

Overall the staff was awkward.

The food did not appear to be checked for presentation before leaving the kitchen.

No reason to return.
Excellent service with exceptional food.  Variety on the menu could be a bit better but all items were very good.
Wonderful restaurant that I have been coming to for years. Always great menu choices and excellent service.
LOVE this place!!  Has been my favorite for about 35 years!!  (Yes, I loved it before it was featured in Mrs. Doubtfire!!!) ❤️❤️❤️

We went to Bridges last Friday and the food (pork chop and salmon) was the best that it has ever been.  We returned on Monday and we both ordered the pork chop and the quality was much worse than on Friday.  Did someone leave the pork out overnight?  Our friend ordered the shrimp and the sauce was so salty that she could not finish it.  The bus boy told us that the server would come to the table to discuss but all that he did was present the check.  Very disappointing for one of our favorite restaurants.

Came here for family dinner to celebrate my husbands birthday and made a note in my open table reservation. Server was friendly and we ordered the special (flat iron and prawns); burger; and two of us did the prix fixe for Tri-valley restaurant week. We overhead another server ask her table if they were celebrating anything and I got concerned maybe our server didn’t know about the birthday. I went up to the matradee and double checked the Open table note and she assured me that our server was aware. Well, dessert came around and we got our two desserts that went with our prix fixe and nothing else. Very disappointed. What’s the point of including the note if it doesn’t get honored?!?
Don’t think I’ll be returning for a special occasion anytime soon, my youngest pointed out the crowd was very much on the older side, hardly saw any kids. Guess I’ll only come here if it’s for a work lunch and someone else picks it, definitely not high on my list - will opt for Forbes Mill or Piatti or Esin.
good food, outstanding service, pleasant atmosphere
Wishing our server was friendlier.  It seemed like she didn’t want to be there.  Everything else was great.
Food very good , outstanding value , service spotty high noise level

Showed up a few minutes early, was shown to our table immediately. Saturday evening, so we anticipated not having a quiet dinner. Place was packed, which was a good sign. Service was attentive but not over bearing. Looked at the menu before making reservations, thus not shocked at the prices: typical for the area for finer dining establishments. Mostly everything was to our liking from what we ordered, though the risotto was watery. Our server graciously offered to replace it without hesitation. The replacement seared tuna was scrumptious. My duck ravioli was rich: I had no problem cleaning my plate. Love that they support the local brewery with tap offerings from Danville Brewery.

It was noisier than I’d have liked, though that was mostly due to an exuberant patron behind us and, again, the volume of diners in the restaurant contributed. Can’t fault the restaurant for the volume, though it did detract a little.

Overall, though, a most pleasant experience. We’re starting to explore the local food scene more and more and this was a pretty damn good place to start for our forays into Danville.

We ordered an appetizer at the same time that ordered our entree.  We noticed that tables of people that arrived and ordered after us received their appetizers a log time before we did and their entrees just about the same time as we received our appetizer. By the time we received our entrees the other tables were either finishing their desserts or had paid their check.

The food was outstanding, salmon and pork chop, almost worth the wait.

Enjoyed our first visit to Bridges.  The service was warm and attentive.   The Crispy Brussels Sprouts and the Lettuce Wraps were delicious appetizers.  The bacon and lentil soup was savory and satisfying.  Everyone enjoyed their entrees including the Salmon, Pacific Tombo, Thai Curry Prawns, and Duck Ravioli.  Would recommend any of these.  The cheesecake was wonderful.
Great place!  Always a special night!
Timely and friendly service by Hannah. Very good cocktails, wine. Bruschetta, ceasar, NY steak, apple crumble delicious.
Good was excellent . They have a new chef and he has great recipes
Wonderful cocktail: The Doubtfire
Valentine’s Day
Great place for special occasions. Never disappoint!

Restaurant very busy due to Valentine’s Day crowd.  Table service was slow, even with limited menu. Perhaps restaurant was short staffed, but slow service. Had to return one plate because pork not thoroughly cooked.
Valentine’s Day
Went with my wife for a Valentine’s Day dinner. Could not have been a better choice! Food, drinks, service were all perfectly synchronized and the choices wonderful.

Bridges as usual was over the top. Valentines Day was more special because of Bridges.

All aspect of the evening were first rate. Thank you. Lisa/Hannah and Chef Kevin.

We normally love Bridges for celebrations as they always deliver on their dinners.  We went for Valentine's Day lunch and ordered the Cashew Chicken Salad sandwich and the Banh Mi sandwich.  Both sandwiches were okay/good but not outstanding like what we normally get.  The pork tenderloin for the Banh Mi was a bit dry and was lacking more flavor like what you would get at a Vietnamese restaurant.  Overall, we enjoyed our lunch but was disappointed due to our expectation of the quality of flavor we expect from Bridges.

The service was excellent but the food was just ok
The hostess and our server were darling.

The service was very slow. I think it was more a problem of not enough servers.   The food was not great. I had the crusted chicken and it was very dry. Items on the wine list and menu were no available. It was a disappointing evening.

Bridges was excellent as usual.   A busy Saturday night before Valentines made it a little more noise than past visits and that would be our only complaint.  I had the  STIR FRIED MEXICAN PRAWNS with THAI RED CURRY SAUCE for the first time and they were outstanding!
Food was fantastic!
We enjoy our meals there.  It is a big restaurant but still enjoy the food and atmosphere.
Wow hadn't been in 2 years Big doengrage
Beautiful place to eat. Outstanding ambiance, excellent service, and the food was delicious! We will definitely be back! Thank you Bridges for a wonderful dining experience!

I mistakingly reserved the table for 4, when we were actually a group of 6.   Fortunately, a group was leaving shortly, the helpful and delightful host gave us the table as soon as it was available.  Our service team was amazing and we had a wonderful evening.
Great service and beautiful place however food was expensive and tasteless. I had a chicken salad that had no taste and others at the table concurred. Other entrees were similar
It was very nice.  Helpful, food was great.. very nice atmosphere.
Service felt rushed, server had minimal engagement with our table.
The food made the taste buds come alive . The service was great and they went out of their way to ensure we had a great dining experience.
Everything was delish!!! Thank u for a fun and yummy Sunday brunch! Staff so friendly!! 🥰
Ben our server was great! Made our special occasion night out wonderful and such a nice way to celebrate.
The drinks were generous, the service was great, and the ribeye was delicious. Cooked blue just like I asked.
Great Dinner - Exceptional Service

Great ambience, food and beverages were delicious.
Unfortunately, our waiter Chris was off, awkwardly uncomfortable & not attentive. He definitely made the experience unpleasant.
Excellent food, excellent service and always consistent.  Well managed restaurant.  Lisa is awesome!
Always enjoy this place whether date night with my wife or with friends and family.

Yesterday, I got a clean, breast cancer-free bill of health from my doctor after months of very difficult chemotherapy treatments.  My husband and I (with my shiny bald head) went to Bridges to celebrate.  They were so kind to us!  The service and the food were, as usual, perfect.  It was the ideal place to celebrate!

After such a lovely evening, imagine our surprise when we discovered that they picked up our entire dinner tab!

This is a very classy place.  Thank you, Bridges!
We love Bridges!   Have been going to Bridges since 1992 - one of the few good fine dining establishments left.
New Years Eve

We have been dining at Bridges for 25 years. We have never been disappointed and New Years Eve was no exception. The Fixe Prix menu had plenty of variety at a reasonable price. Everything we picked was excellent. Our server was attentive and fun. All in all, couldn't be happier.

We had horrible service upon arrival. The waiter Ben was very unfriendly, did not care to explain questions we had, and not to mention EVERY dish we received was SUPER rushed. The second you were on your last bite the plate was immediately taken away and no time was given to even enjoy what you were having. Zero personality in the staff, and with the amount you are paying per person there, we absolutely expected friendliness and a positive experience which did not happen. Super dissatisfied.
the food was ok not anything great, there was not any vegeterian options or pasta etc.  the food was not as expected

I've eaten at  Bridges several times. The hostess seated us at our favorite table.
Unfortunately, our favorite waitress was off; she knows how to deal with the substitutions and dietary limits we have. The waiter didn't and also was hard of hearing. It was hard to communicate and the meal was less than the level we have had before. Just chance I guess.

Food was poor to average. Ribeye steak ($52) was literally inedible. 

Will never return
Nice decor, food excellent. Felt exclusive but was inclusive. Personable waitstaff. Great place for an occasion meal.

Nice ambiance. Service was good. Interesting though at the end of the meal to go boxes were left on the table for us (?) to fill. Unusual I thought for fine dining. The food was ok. The edamame, and the Brussel Sprout starters were the best part of the meal. The mushroom risotto was flat. It needed a bit more salt, pepper…and seasoning to liven it up. Over all we enjoyed our experience.
It was just ok

It was our Christmas Eve dinner but not so festive as expected. We sat for 20 plus minutes before ever having a waiter. We had to flag down a bus boy to finally have a waiter assigned to us by the manager, Thank goodness for AAEON, our waiter who gave us very good service once  he was assigned to our table. The food was ok but not amazing considering the high price of everything. The rib eye seemed more like pot roast than a steak and was very disappointing as it was served floating in liquid over mashed potatoes and carrots. It was strange. The. Sal on and lamb were ok but again not amazing. The place was full but we did not feel the experience. Was worth the cost. Our waiter Aaron did a great job in serving us and wanting to makeup for the ridiculous wait. We were seated right away but waiting for someone to wait on us was ridiculous. I am glad the manager assigned Aaron who is probably one of their best waiters. I don’t think we will make the effort to go back to Bridges in the future. It was very disappointing.
It was a surprise that our meals on 12/24 were a high price fixe. We would have appreciated a heads up when booking this online instead of the surprise when we were seated. Thank you
Great experience!!
Had a lovely dinner. My sister and I ordered the salmon and my husband had the Tombo - everything was delicious and perfectly prepared.

Food was EXCELLENT. Such a nice place after so many years- it’s still the best. Service was excellent but overall….it’s always a bit slow because I’m so hungry!  Our waiter was the best- and the hostess so nice as always. Thank you!!!

As always, my favorite dining out “go to” restaurant. 
Professional staff, excellent service! Our server was Ben who I always ask for when making a reservation. Lisa, the manager has been running this masterpiece for many years.
Outdoor and indoor dining, romantic spot with lovely presentation of all of the menu items.
Excellent food/wonderful environmennt/friendly staff/never disappoints
Bridges used to be such a great, upscale spot for dinner.  I think this restaurant is due for a refresh from a menu, aesthetics, and experience standpoint.

It was so incredibly noisy that we asked to be moved against the wall.  Still, we could barely hear each other.  Granted there were holiday celebrations, but some noise buffering is needed before I would come back.
Great overall experience. Nice to see a restaurant that has maintained the quality of its menu and service after the shutdown era. So many have lost it. Complements to the staff!
for a great, interesting dining or lunch experience, Bridges is the place in Danville, CA.  food is creative and delicious. service is experienced and friendly.
Wedding anniversary
The steak really was subpar. Not really sure why this place receives good reviews. I suppose people are reviewing the ambiance and atmosphere which is always good if you go with friends and family.

Menu choices are more limited than other places.  It was my birthday and they brought out a dessert with a candle,  which was nice until I saw that they also charged for it even though we didn't request it. Most restaurants give a free dessert on your birthday.  Overall OK.
Great from beginning to end. Seasonal drinks are excellent!

My server was very pleasant. The person that I was to eat with was late, but my server didn’t rush me to order, though she thoughtfully checked on me at appropriate intervals.  I enjoyed an appetizer & brunch.

The staff at the restaurant, professional and friendly.
The food, well presented, prepared, and flavorful.
Had a great time, food was excellent and highly recommend
Wonderful meal, great service! Grazie!!
Great service, food, and atmosphere!  We really enjoyed our lunch at Bridges, and cannot wait to go back.
Lovely meal. Food was excellent. Service was fabulous!

We can’t say enough about Bridges!!
It is always so wonderful… food, service and ambience are perfect.
Looking forward to spending many holiday gatherings at Bridges.
Dinner with family for Thanksgiving

We had Thanksgiving  dinner at bridges. Our server was great.  Attentive and friendly !The turkey dinner was good portions and delicious. They accommodated all our requests. The pumpkin martini was amazing. I always enjoy the meal at Bridges

It would have been nice to know that they were offering a prefix menu for the Thanksgiving Holiday.  It seems that parties were jammed in using older tables and chairs. Perhaps it would have been a better experience if they limited capacity.
Lisa was amazing! I had to change my reservation a couple of times and Lisa was so kind and helpful with the changes. Love the restaurant and the service!!!! 😂
Thanksgiving meal was very special, not only delicious, but a good value. Service and ambience are also top-notch. We hadn't been there in years but will definitely go back soon.
Bridges consistently delivers in all areas.  Food, service et al are always excellent.

Ambiance is really lacking. My entree was great but the other 3 in my party all said theirs wasn’t good. Service was clunky. This used to be the place to take family or friends for a nice dinner  don’t know that we’ll come back soon.
Wonderful food and staff... great place for birthday, anniversary or just a night out!
Delectable cuisine!! Exceptional service! ❤️
The asparagus soup was so delicious, can’t wait to go back for more. The service was attentive and thoughtful. Our entrees were generous and very good!
The cream of asparagus soup was magical. I also had the flat iron steak medium rare, and it was very flavorful. The service was outstanding. Thank you Franco
Soup and prawn salad at lunch were just meh! The sprouts app was ok.

This was terrific. I had recently had a horrible meal at Harvest and needed a pallet cleanser of sorts. I started with the cream of asparagus soup and it was really flavorful, well thought out and beautifully presented. I also ended up having the hamburger and the hamburger was, as it should be, delicious and very flavorful. I like the herb aioli with the french fries. The paradise tea is fabulous. Very much enjoyed this.
Bridges is very good. Shrimp noodle salad outstanding as is shrimp over noodle cake. Great green salads too.
Good food and good service. Great for special celebrations.
Monday night celebrate each other's accomplishments. Nice 4 top table and very good service. Our NY Steaks were cooked perfectly and were nice cuts of meat.
Our dinner was great and we even got a free small desert because it was my wife's birthday
Never disappoints - always a nice treat.
Great food, great service. What a lovely evening! Celebrating our daughter passing the California bar!!
This is the best of best! From food to service to value!
Great reunion of old friends, food & service outstanding but it was very noisy so had to yell at each other😞
Great service and very good food.
Brunch was good.  Service for food was good but took too long to get our drinks

We had a lovely brunch which I had not had before at Bridges. We ordered the soup to start and it was lukewarm at best and rather thin. When we got our entrées, the dirty dishes sat on our table once we were both finished and having boxed the leftovers. There were at least five servers or wait staff that stopped by our table prior to us leaving that could have bussed the table.
Nice table, great food and service!  My new favorite!
Delicious food! Pleasant waiter - service was good.
Server was attentive.  Food excellent.
We requested a special table.  The hostess was very accommodating.  Service was excellent.
Brunch on the patio was lovely.  Great setting, service and food.  Olivia, our server, was wonderful!

Our table started with the truffle fries and lettuce wraps. Our main courses included the butternut squash ravioli, Bridges burger, NY steak, and prawns dish. Ended the meal with chocolate cake and sorbet (raspberry). We were seated outside, but there were heat lamps, which kept our table at a comfortable temperature. Food was good, our server (and all the staff) was excellent and friendly, and the environment was nice and we had a wonderful dinner.

While we were being walked to our table, a nearby table decide they would move to our table.  The staff slowed this while we stood there and waiting for the move.  Then the same staff thought it would be ok to seat us at the table where the previous folks just left, not replacing the place settings.  I refused the seat.  After we were seated elsewhere, our friends food came without the sauce and our other friend’s salmon was not cooked at all.
We were given the expected sauce and another salmon came out.  The salmon was cooked to the same temperature as the previous order, incredible.
Our waiter was as disturbed as we were and asked that the manager come over to comp all the dinners.  The manager came out, apologized, and only compensated us for 1 meal.  The waiter returned and was even more disturbed by the events and apologized for the Mgr and said she misunderstood and he would ensure the meals were taken off.  The final results was only 1 meal was taken off, no consideration was given on our time and experience.
We will NOT be returning guests as a result.
Our waiter was so nice and the food was great.  My favorite on the menu is the pork chop.  It is always a great experience to dine there.
Ben was excellent!!  He always takes great care of us.!!

Have been a regular here for a number of years, alway amazed how consistently wonderful the food is. Also sitting on the patio is always a treat even when cold, staff always makes sure the heaters are adjusted. All in all one of the best restaurants around

Lettuce wrap appetizer had great flavor. Dinner was excellent! Two of us had the roast chicken and it was delicious and so moist. The brussel sprouts and fingerling potatoes were a perfect complement. The pork chop was great as always.
Always enjoy a meal at Bridges
Food was excellent and our server Olivia was spot on.

Very disappointed. The bruschetta wasn't anything I would consider ordering again, had beans on it, not good. The Mexican prawns were good and large. Service was slow had to ask multiple times for silverware, bread, previously ordered items.  Hope food and service improves back to previous standards.
The new menu is not good. French onion soup in a huge bowl with barely any cheese? Crème brûlée is no more on the menu. I think they made a mistake changing the menu and should change it back.
Great place to go when you want to have a conversation with your fellow dinners, have creatively prepared food and the evening is a little special.
I thought the swordfish special at $47 was over-the-top pricing.

We ate outdoors, as it was a warmish evening. We had the bread pudding as an appetizer, which was amazing. My partner had the half chicken and I had the raviolis. We both thought they were delicious.
The prices were reasonable, and our waiter was friendly and funny.

I used to love Bridges, last experience was awful.  Same menu and dishes I previously loved, this time terrible.  Too “soupy”,  over cooked fish, to salty, change in spices (?), terrible presentation.  Out of 5 people, only the chicken tenders got a thumbs up from a 12 year old.  One entree was delivered 15 minutes before any one else was served.  Wait staff not trained on removing dishes, sat on tables to long, entrees delivered and no utensils.
I don’t think I will ever return to Bridges.

Caesar salad was a disappointing. Mostly stems, no greens or croutons and barely any dressing…

Dessert selection lacked variety and creativity. 
Will return with hopes of improvements.

Our table of 4 was well greeted.  We had a positive and uplifting experience with the service staff.  The environment was warm and inviting.  The food was excellent!  We had the salmon and the porkchops.  The Soup (carrot and Cauliflower) was great!
Brunch was delicious and made for the most perfect afternoon for the four of us! Thank you to our hostess Hannah, our server Olivia and the ever fabulous Frederico.
Always a pleasure to dine there!
It's always so delightful to have a very enjoyable, well prepared and delicious meal, with a yummy dessert to finish the evening.  Thank you Bridges!
Excellent dinner, beautifully presented. Reasonable serving sizes
We enjoyed it.  The chicken was very tender and juicy.  We also really like the brussel sprouts.  I enjoyed the prawn noodle salad.

Outdoors dining was enchanting with live music wafting in from a area shared by several restaurants. The swordfish special was one of the best dishes we have had at Bridges in a long time. Coming in right behind in rating was the pear tart dessert.

We had a dinner reservation for two at 8pm on a weeknight. However when one party member arrived the server explained that the kitchen would close at 8pm. Nonetheless the party member went ahead and quickly put in the order before the second guest had arrived. It was not a big problem for us but it did seem odd that they would accept a reservation but ask us to order the moment one person was seated. We were later informed by the manager that the server misunderstood and that the kitchen was not closing at 8pm. Therefore we should have been able to place the order after we had been given time to see the menu. 

The manager quickly remedied the situation by putting the entire tab on the house. The solution was more than gracious. The food was wonderful and the wait staff were attentive. 

We will be back again soon.
An annual birthday lunch was resumed after a 3 year Covid hiatus. A lovely time it was. Bridges is a favorite
Food was delicious and Chris provided fantastic service. Dining outside on the patio was wonderful, with added benefit of entertainment

First time back at Bridges for over 5 years.  What a disappointment!  Service was painfully slow and food was average.  My risotto was heavy and mushy and the pear tart was so sweet that I could hardly taste the pear.
California cuisine. The menu was interesting and varied. The food delicious. Staff very friendly.
FABULOUS AS ALWAYS! THANK YOU HANNAH AND TEAM BRIDGES!

We love the setting and ambiance at bridges, however our last experience there was a bit disappointing. Our order came with a small salad which had nuts and prosciutto on it - not advertised on the menu and not a good thing for people with allergies. Service was good and we will return with the hope that this was just an accident.
We enjoyed Saturday Brunch on the patio. Great food!  Easy to visit and enjoy our friends.  Service was exceptional!

Have had many good experiences here until last night. Waiter seemed distracted and not very attentive. Hubby's pork chop was not good, and when he told the waiter, he just turned around and walked away. Other food was fine but terrible service and no attempt to make up for the bad tasting pork chop. No offer to get something else. Just walked away. We will likely not go back here.
Service was outstanding, the outdoor patio was relaxing and comfortable, and the food was great!
Patio is lovely
The wait staff was outstanding. Enjoyed the food and outside dining.
Our server did a great job and the food was good.  Great atmosphere!
Good food, good service, generous portions, and a very nice surroundings. It doesn’t get much better than that. Very pleasant evening.
All in all pretty good experience. Food was really good. Love the ambience The server was just OK. She follow the manual and did everything like a server should but she was not memorable.
Two great dishes with giant shrimp. Thai curry, well seasoned but not hot spicy at all. Asian noodle salad with perfectly grilled shrimp. See photos. Grand service.
Great food. We tried all new things to us on menu. We were not disappointed. The music was very nice and set up a great mood. Will do again
Beautiful day at a beautiful restaurant - couldn't ask for more

Terrific food!  The tuna(tombo) with black rice and wonderful spicy sweet sauce was superb.

The swordfish special was also great.

The guitar accompaniement to the meal really added class.
The setting and the food are always great!  Perfect spot for great food and easy parking!
Great service, food that was jus delicious. Few places treat you this well
Great guitar player! Delicious prawn sobe salad! Nice attentive staff!
The food was very sub-par.  Great property and great service
Not the Bridges it use to be. Short staffed with servers who really didn't know what to do. Might be awhile before I go back
Birthday for my son! Had a terrific time!
Had one of the best services we ever had. Enjoyed the food and the deserts were very fresh.

We have been dining at Bridges for over 20 years.  This was the worst experience by far. The servers were very young and inexperienced, the tables were cheap fake wood with nothing on them except a fork, knife and spoon with a napkin. No centerpiece, no salt and pepper, cheap silverware, uncomfortable chairs. The food was beyond horrible and my meal was not what was described on the menu.

Bridges is always great. We go there often. Unfortunately, last night I was there with my wife for our anniversary and we were seated next to some guy who must have been trying to impress his new date with his over the top LOUD foul mouth. He had to be mid-to-late thirties. Several tables around us were sort of shocked at the boldness of it all. I've heard all of the words before but was amazed at how this guy kept it up even though he knew everyone was paying attention and disgusted. And yes, we said something to him. It made him louder but at least his "date" was embarrassed enough to want to get out of there.
  No blame on Bridges part. The good part of the story was that as he was leaving he mumbled behind me "this is why I'd NEVER live in F***ing Danville".   HAHAHA. We are going to miss you

We love going to Bridges for special occasions! We took my parents who were visiting from out of town to celebrate my mom’s birthday and everyone had a great meal. The service is great. The food is impeccable. We love it!

A bit of a disappointment. Pork lettice wraps were greasy, and porcini mushroom ravioli with beets on top looked quite unappetizing and pink! Used to be an upscale restaurant, but now it's got high chairs and little kids and feels like an average family restaurant with expensive entrees.

Bridges  in Danville never disappoints.
Wonderful place for lunch, dinner or brunch and for every occasion!!!
Server needs to learn how to listen. Everything else was good but he just didn’t listen.

I celebrated my birthday with a longtime friend.  The setting, lighting, heating, and service was perfect! Ben was a  great waiter and handled two large parties as well. It started my birthday week off perfectly!

Very loud and we asked to move to another part of the restaurant. Still was loud. Service was slow and our waiter seemed preoccupied with other customers. We were inside. The outdoor dining option was available but the night was too cool.

Bridges has been a consistently good experience for us and that was true in this case.  As usual, the food was outstanding.  The service was a bit slow this time as it appeared that the restaurant may have been short-staffed at opening. Our waiter handled this extremely well and we understood that a bit of patience was in order.  We will definitely be back!

I have eaten at Bridges several times and usually have a very positive experience.  This time was significantly different.  We waited quite a while for a server, we needed to ask more than once for silverware for one of our party.  We brought a bottle of wine but one of our party asked for a glass of a different wine.  The server/sommelier expressed shock that he did not want the wine we brought and then told our party member that he would not like the wine he choose off the menu.  We did not get a bucket for our bottle and no bread for the table.  Three of our party did not care for their dinner, describing it as lacking flavor.  One ordered the porcini ravioli with beets and spinach.  After a few minutes the dish looked like pastel pink soup with spinach floating on it.  Not my best experience and the people we brought were out of town guests.
Great service and always good food
Server was extremely slow

Sat for a long time at the table before anyone acknowledged us.
Requested bread, and it was cold from the refrigerator
Soup lacked flavor, and we had to get salt and pepper off of the counter ourselves as no one was around
Entree lacked presentation, but was tasty
Server’s attitude was indifferent
Lovely evening on outside patio.  Server was fun and food was delicious!
Great food, great service. Been going for years and never disappointed !  Try the Thai shrimp with curry sauce!
Excellent service by waiter named Brandon.

I love the ambience, the wait staff very nice, excellent wine list. However, I always have difficulty selecting what I want to eat. I don’t care for the food combinations and combinations of ingredients. An example, yesterday I had the mushroom risotto but there was way too much cheese so that I could not even taste the rice. I couldn’t eat more than a few bites. One of the salads had pickled strawberries whatever those are and mint in the dressing. I cannot stand the taste of mint so I could never choose that salad. The avocado toast had smoked salmon piled all over it…I cannot stand smoked salmon so I did not choose that item. I wish the menu could have a few more straightforward items or maybe a La carte choices to create one’s own lunch. Also, horrible tasting coffee. A restaurant of this level should have a first rate tasting coffee.

Food was subpar at best snd inattentive service.

As always, my Saturday night “go to” that is peaceful with a beautiful outdoor patio. Cocktails are perfect, nice wine selections and entrees are spot on! Ben is a seasoned professional server, Lisa the manager, well it just does not get better!  Pay them a visit. Very steady, consistent experience with too notch food.
Food was good but menu offerings were limited. Overall experience was not up to the hype

The food was very good.  The server put in the wrong order for 1/2 of the salads.  So we waited a bit for the 1st course.  The main dishes were excellent!  We ordered the Steak and Mexican Prawns!  The prawns have always been delicious… The steak was a new order and both people in my party that ordered that enjoyed it and said it was cooked perfectly. My only complaint was that the server was sometimes rude in the comments made to us while he was handling our table, condescending.  I didn’t appreciate that, especially when it was a special occasion with us we celebrating birthdays. That put a damper on the experience which is why I rated the restaurant overall as a 4.

Was looking forward to eating at this restaurant but it was horrible. I ordered the salmon and they brought it back three times still raw. They were short staffed and the food quality was not what I would expect. I never leave bad reviews but this was really bad.
Great service, yummy lunch
Hannah was a wonderful server and a great picture taker.  Everyone loves the food they ordered.  Hannah brought out a nice birthday cupcake which was a nice surprise.  Thank you.

Bridges is a place to come when you want to experience delightful dining no matter what time of day. Thank you Mrs. Lisa your Team is always knowledgeable,  personalable,  polite just as well as each Dish and Dessert! Let's just say ...Bridges is the Sheer Essence of Quality -Period!  Marie 💜

Well done and delicious !
The patio was the PERFECT place to celebrate a birthday lunch. The service was good, the food was outstanding

Overall a good experience. Nice staff, good cuisine and nice patio

Service was good. Food was all pretty good but none of us raved about our meals. We had four different entrees and there was nothing the matter with them, but nothing that would bring me back right away. Not as good as other meals I have enjoyed there.
I love the place
Always good, we can count on them to deliver good taste & quality. They could improve their bread game with a quality sourdough or fresh herb rolls.
Food was decent but it was disgusting to have flies around my food.

Food imaginative, well presented and very tasty.  Wait staff attentive and courteous. Service of food painfully slow particularly since the number of other patrons was remarkably low. and no apologies were forthcoming for this tardy production.  Will be circumspect in recommending Bridges to others.

I had a yellow jacket attacking me and trying to eat my salmon while dining on the patio. I’m deadly allergic to yellow jackets so it was a bit alarming. Please put some yellow jacket traps out on the patio.
Excellent service and food. Very enjoyable. Will definitely go again.
Bridges was amazing and our server Chris was phenomenal. So fun and super attentive. Really enjoyed the ambiance and the food was amazing as well. Great spot for any occasion.

We will be back because Bridges is a local gem. What’s more, I have already bought mor coupons at Costco.
A wonderful evening! Brought family from out of town for a night of good food, drink, and ambiance! Will definitely be back!
Incredible experience! Amazing food and such knowledgeable staff on their food/ingredients. One of the best experiences I’ve had at a restaurant in a long time.
Our server was great! So was our food!

I have dined at Bridges umpteen number of times , great place to entertain family , friends and Clients .

Fantastic spot. Adding it to our new favorites list

Food was ok. Not the greatest. Service was great.

Bridges is a wonderful place to dine.  The staff is always professional and sees to all of your requests.  The outdoor space is beautiful and as it’s not noisy or chaotic. It’s become one of my favorite places to have lunch.
Bridges is always consistent . The food and service and cocktails are always spot on!
Fantastic dining experience all around. Highly recommend. Outside seating is great.

We chose this restaurant just to get us out of town.  We loved the ambiance and the noise level allowed us to chat without having to raise our voices.  The food was great and the servers were amazing.

We had dinner on the patio: shared the melted brie & caramelized onion bruschetta for a starter and also a Caesar salad and the risotto.  Those dishes were good but not great. While dining-out prices have increased in many restaurants during the past few years the prices at Bridges seem higher than similar restaurants and therefore not as good a value. Still recommend Bridges as a nice local restaurant but because of the prices we’ll likely go again only for special occasions.
Loved seating out on patio with friends and music in the background.

Food and service was great.  We loved the place.

Great dinner with Olivia as our server and Happy Hour with Maddie beforehand. Nice vibe, comfortable, outdoor dining, superb service at the bar and in the restaurant!

Fantastic meal and surprise cupcakes to celebrate our 40th! Loved the acoustic guitar especially.

Just not going back in the near future as their menu has also not changed in a few months.
Always a terrific dining experience! Toughest part is trying to figure out what to order because it's all so delicious!
Very nice setting on the patio. The service was good and staff very friendly.  We have always had a great experience at Bridges.
All around great restaurant!
Great service on the beautiful patio.  Food is solid as always.  Great for a summer lunch
This is my favorite Danville restaurant for lunch with business colleagues!
Great service! All around, excellent, friendly and a fun experience!

Waitress was very prompt and friendly. The bussers need a little bit of direction on the finer things for sure.

The porcini mushroom ravioli was amazing and the New York strip toped with Portobello mushrooms was cooked perfectly and tasted fantastic!

Service was a bit slow but luckily we were not in a hurry. Key lime cheesecake was delicious and the saving grace of the meal. Very expensive for a very disappointing dinner.
Excellent as always. Bridges holds value. Will come again
Always our choice for special dinners The open.doors add so much and quiet not rushed food. beautiful as well as delicious
Great restaurant with good food for the price. Also a great option for a wedding/rehearsal dinner.
Nice outdoor seating. But food is not super great. Pork chop was dry
Outstanding as usual is the food and service was wonderful!
A beautiful evening with friends last night in the outdoor area with a creative menu that was prepared at the highest level of excellence!
Family reunion

The egg scramble with onion, spinach and sausage had no option for substituting the sausage other than leaving it out, which made it very bland, and the eggs had too many onions. The salmon dish called “Atlantic salmon”was a large amount of eggs on top of small pieces of salmon. We expected a salmon filet, not a big pile of eggs with a little salmon under it. The appetizers were not that great aside from the salad. Desserts were good but I would only eat there again when I can order off the regular menu.  Typically I have had good meals at Bridges so this was disappointing but overall I still enjoy going there.
We attended brunch for Father's Day.  The staff greeted us and were able to seat us right away even though we were early. Food was wonderful.  A great experience everyone loved it.
Great place to dine for special occasion, always a treat
went there for Father's Day. very good service. good food

Great service, accommodated our move from outside to inside due to cold evening, food was delicious!
Arora, very pleasant and upbeat.  Food excellent.

Our waitress was amazing. She had a lot of customers and was work her buns off. But she took really good care of us.

Had a really nice business meal on the patio.  Attentive staff, good drinks, good appetizers and main courses. Everyone enjoyed their meal and the menu is diverse with something for everyone in each course.

Minor complaint - when I asked the waiter delivering our food for another glass of wine, instead of mentioning it to our server, he told me to ask.  I think he was learning.  

A great eatery. 
We’ll be back.

I love Bridges and usually I would give them five stars across-the-board. But I ordered a meal that, as it turns out, was not to my liking. We love Bridges!!

service very good, meals were done well, swordfish cooked just right, steak tender. overall very pleasant experience, birthday notation in registration not followed up only negative.

We had a delightful dinner on their outdoor patio area.  We were a party of 2 couples.  We were celebrating our 62 Anniversary.  We started with Truffle Frites for an appetizer along with a nice bottle of Malbec.  This was followed by a Lightly Pickled Strawberry Salad.  Each couple split one salad, each.  This was split for a in the kitchen - a nice way to serve it to us.  For our entrees, we each had something different.  I had the Pan Roasted Pork Chop, Chinese Five Spice Apples & Walnuts .  My wife had the Stir Fried Mexican Prawns, Thai Red Curry Sauce.  The other couple had the Pork Chop and the Sautéed Atlantic Salmon,Mustard Dill Beurre Blanc.  We finished with coffee, a Berry Cheesecake w/Chocolate Sauce and a complimentary Chocolate Cupcake with a candle in it.

The total experience was excellent!  Everyone was very happy with their food, service and the prices were reasonable for the Danville area.  We split the bill equally.  That came to $119.64, tax included but before tip.  The Astica Malbec was only $40 for the bottle.

My only reason for not rating this review 5-star was the menu offering.  It was a bit on the meager side for selection.  There was only one beef dish, 2 Pork dishes, 3 fish dishes plus 2 Seafood and 1 chicken dish.  I was hoping for a Rack of Lamb or a Braised Short Rib or some other meat choices.
My friend and I had great dinner!

We made reservation for a late Mother’s Day. We were warmly greeted and seated immediately. It wasn’t too busy so our drinks and food came out fairly quick. We chose to sit outside and the ambience was great, along with great food. Will be returning again soon!!
Service was excellent, and our food came out outstanding
Unequivocally, incontrovertibly, irrevocably head and shoulders above competing purveyors.  A unique, unencumbered respite in a pervasive jungle of mediocrity.

We love Bridges!!

This is our favorite restaurant…
 we love the staff.

the cost was outragous.  $46.00 for a scramble platter and $53.00 for a piece of salmon for brunch.  Shocking.

"Bridges" usually hits on all cylinders... and last night was no exception!  Our party of six enjoyed diverse menu opportunities with all "mains" expertly prepared, plated beautifully, and delivered with exceptional service!  No wonder it's a locals favorite!

Main course was skimpy. Two of us ordered the pork belly and the meat was the size of bacon bits. The vegetable that accompanied the main course was not very creative. Thin strips of bok choy lacked flair imagination and taste. Appetizers were great and the best part of the meal. 
The wait staff on the other hand was great. They were attentive and accommodating

It's rare I give a slightly negative review, and especially for Bridges, which I love, especially for lunches sitting outside. However, our dinner and experience last night was disappointing. We were seated at an inside corner table so noise level was low and that was good as we were with a customer and his wife (they had requested dinner at Bridges). Not sure what occurred. Was the server new and less experienced (I know restaurants are being challenged currently for hiring help)? Or, did the combination of being new and responsible for too many tables (we noticed she was going in and outside servicing a number of tables) cause our service and wait times plus lack of writing down an order cause delays and literally having to ask twice for wine and bread? At one point, I excused myself and shared with a manager my disappointment with the service. After that exchange, I did note others helped our server deliver our meals, remove plates after dinner, etc. Our server did apologize for not bringing the glass of wine we had to remind her to bring and that she had removed it from the bill. We certainly did not expect any cost to be removed. Because of previous outstanding service at this establishment, it was what we expected. We will return for lunches, however, I doubt I will be able to talk my husband into dinner here again. His comments, "There are so many other good places to eat and know the service will be five stars."

I told myself I would never go back. But I did go back today, and the fellow who was the server was really very good, very polite, very on top of things. Unfortunately he had to serve the slop that the kitchen is producing these days. It’s a shame.
