Seems as though our server had too many tables to keep track of. Would have been an "excellent" rating if he checked in more with us.

The restaurant gave us a cupcake with icing n candle for our 54 anniversary.  Service was very good.  Originally we requested sitting outdoors, due tremendous smoke and bad air quality , changed to indoor without any difficulty.

Bridges has a beautiful outdoor patio. We were fortunate to be seated by the waterfall.

The drinks were excellent.

We had grilled salmon and Thai shrimp. Both were excellent. 

There was a fruit crisp for dessert. It was just right.

The service was very professional. There was just the right amount of attention.
Wonderful dinner and had a very nice waitress.  Appeared to be a bit understaffed, but understand the challenges with Covid.  We will definitely be back.
Service, food and ambience were all wonderful.  We had a great double birthday celebration
Amazing service and food was delicious! I would highly recommend this restaurant.
The service and food made for a delightful dining experience

The food and service were great as always.  The past 2 visits there was a truck on the black top outside the outdoor area that sat there idling for 45 minutes with its engine on.  Not as enjoyable as earlier visits, especially with the poor AQI due to fires.
Lovely environment for outside dining.  Ask for a table near the fountain!  Food is so exceptional visually and quality wise.  I enjoy coming every time.
Food, service, and the atmosphere - always the BEST!
We sat in the patio near the Japanese garden,  it was very tranquil.  The food and service was awesome.
Great outdoor seating.  Service took awhile and we needed to ask for bread to accompany our salads.
Still the best restaurant in Danville.. one of our all time favorites!

Service was great,  staff friendly and attentive. My salad was tasty but the chicken breast I added was dry.  I've eaten at this restaurant several times and usually find the food excellent.  My husband said his burger was very good.

Just sad. Food used to be incredible and compelling. Tonight was bland and over cooked. The steak was thought, the medium rare pork chop was well-done, the chicken dishes lacked the sauce that was advertised with them, the espresso martini was excessively creamer-y. This isn’t the restaurant that I fell in love with pre-Covid.
We had the best time. Maddy was Awesome! The food was incredible. If you have the opportunity you will be very pleased you chose Bridges.
Hostess was rushing us out of the door from the second we got there.

This is a great local restaurant. I love the fish dishes. The wine list is interesting with some well priced wines. Overall very reasonable prices along with good food and ambience that makes you want to go back.
I took my team to Bridges to celebrate the successful completion of a project. Food was outstanding and service was terrific. Look forward to going back!
Lovely to sit outside.  The roof kept it cool even on this hot day.

I really love Bridges Restaurant!  They have a beautiful restaurant with a patio, great food, tasty cocktails  and outstanding service!
It’s always a home run!!!

We love going to Bridges and eating on the patio. However, our last visit left a lot to be desired. We arrived on time for our reservation and waited with our 92 year old guest with a walker for about 5-8 minutes while the young hostess talked on the phone and did not make any attempt to let us know she saw us. Seemingly bored, she lead us to our table without any encouragement  to follow or enjoy our meal. The back waiter was very welcoming and kept our water refilled. The waiter (A) who took our order was distant. Our order was delayed coming after 2 other tables which had ordered after us (we had almost the same plates). When we asked asked the waiter about our food, he just kept walking by and was dismissive with a "its coming". He essentially ignored us throughout the whole service. The only time he was somewhat friendly was when he delivered the check!  I realize the pandemic causes hiring challenges. But new workers need training. The back waiter and the guy who delivered our food were your best employees that day.

The food was good service was awful they sat us next to the kitchen/ galley  the noise level of plates clinging was horrible
Will never go there again
The manager was rather stand offish & impolite. Spoke unnecessarily bad about staff.
Excellent service, great food and ambiance.  We are planning on returning in the next month
Brunch is always a winner. Mimosas come in a variety of flavors. Menu options offer a nice variety, and the portions are generous.

Great food, slow service.  The pandemic has left the restaurant short staffed.  Our drinks took 10-15 min to arrive and our waiter had to check twice on our dinners.  Our server was attentive, so no fault of his.  The Mexican Prawns in Thai Curry Sauce was FANTASTIC - sounds weird but worth it.
Friendly staff really nice seating and the food was excellent
Good outside atmosphere.  Waiter was fun and attentive.  Food was pretty and tasted really good.  All in all, good meal at a nice place for a decent price.  Solid dinner.
Seated quickly. Orders taken quickly meal arrived tImely. Food average. Prices reasonable.
The food and service are both excellent and their outdoor dining area in very pleasant.
Good presentation of food with cloth napkins and A/C worked on a very warm day.
Sat outside on the patio. Service was friendly and prompt.

Great food and service! The cocktails were below average. We ordered a couple of classic cocktails and it was obvious in they were made with bottom shelf liquor. 

That aside, great place and we will go back again and stick to wine next time
We have dined here multiple times , last visit the service was not great and we had to flag servers down constantly for every and anything we needed. Disappointed.
It was the first time in 18 months that life felt normal.
One of our favorite dinner spots.  We’ve never been disappointed.
Great lunch, enjoyable glass of wine, wonderful service
Service & ambiance was very good but the swordfish special was overcooked. Bridges is one of our favorite places to go.

We sat outdoors which is really quite pleasant and tables are well-space for privacy.

Ambient noise was not a problem at all.  We had the swordfish special and the grilled salmon.  Both dishes were superb.

A good time had by all!
Always a treat

After years of curiosity and excitement, I finally made it to Bridges with a trio of friends to celebrate a birthday.  Underwhelming and disappointing is an understatement.  The dishes were all subpar and each one had issues:  one was to mushy (an Asian noodle prawn salad with what appeared to be over cooked, coagulated top ramen in the center), a tasteless short rib eggs Benedict with meat so dry the hollandaise couldn’t even moisten, and chilaquiles that were so hot they were sent back and replaced with an omelette that arrived so late my friend had already lost her appetite and we had to leave.  I was so embarrassed because I chose this over-hyped restaurant for this special occasion. Never again.  👎🏽👎🏽
Always enjoy Bridges. The menu is unique. So are the cocktails.
The service was horrible. No one came to our table for 15 mins and then our drinks didn’t arrive for another 20 mins. The waiter never apologized for the delay, and even seemed a bit flippant.
The service was a bit slow, but everything we ordered from apps to dessert was delicious.

We were there to celebrate our anniversary. The food and service were excellent! But we had a couple next to us where the guy had obviously been drinking before they came. He kept arguing with his wife the whole time! It was very stressful and uncomfortable. The couple on the other side of us complained to the manager. She went to their table and asked if everything was okay. They said yes and she walked away. But the guy just kept arguing the rest of the time they were there!

Great service
Good food
Great food.  Excellent service from the hostess to the water boy..

We came to celebrate a promotion. The host was great and got us a table outside even though our reservation was inside.  Our waitress was friendly and professional. My cocktail was delightful. 

The issue we had is one we have had repeatedly since moving here six months ago (from Berkeley): food.
We were already aware of the suburban phenomenon where a “nice restaurant” is confused with a “good restaurant”.  Walnut Creek, Danville etc. have a plethora of “nice restaurants”: lovely terraces and nice furnishings, lots of tables, decent service, high prices.  

But instead of fresh food perfectly cooked and cleanly presented, we are served large plates of poorly conceived and rushed dishes, overly sauced and seasoned, that feel cranked out by a factory.  

My date had a seared ahi tuna in a bed of couscous, pancetta and wild mushrooms.  I had a New York steak with Gouda grits. 

The Ahi wasn’t seared, it was just cooked halfway through. It came with a “sugar sauce”(?) which she wisely got on the side. Why anyone would pour a sugar sauce over seared ahi and mushrooms? Anyone?  The bed of mushrooms had so much pancetta it almost was more meat than the Ahi. I don’t get it. 

My NY steak (about $40) was a sad thin piece of semi tough meat. About 1/2” thick, was technically done med/rare but I would have been embarrassed to serve it.  A busboy came and took the plate while I was still eating, without a word. 

We have yet to find a “good restaurant” where we would go to celebrate a special event. A “good restaurant” that feels intimate, quiet, where the food is carefully and consistently prepared.  Where the wine list has the same attention to detail and pride.  

I like a good cocktail, people watching, and lounging on a nice terrace in the warm evening. Next time I’m in that mood, and I’m in a restaurant with 80 tables, I’ll have the cocktail and some fries and split. I guess I’ll go to Berkeley for the other until I find the right spots here; this isn’t it.
The menu items were all great. Loved the lettuce wraps and the Brussel sprouts were amazing!!!

Only complaint , wasn’t busy when we arrived. Took awhile to place our drink order. We ordered hors d’oeuvres after our drink order. Waitress was very sweet and apologized that the bar was taking so long. We actually got our hors d’oeuvres before our drinks!! Didn’t start off our evening very well, especially when entertaining out of state guests. 30 min later we got out cocktails.  Our guest had asked to leave after 15.  Embarrassing
Good for a business lunch. Ambiance was nice, service was average.

It was my first time there. We ordered the waffles to share. The vanilla bean cream and peaches were to die for. Also had the bacon Fritata and my friend had the chicken sandwich which was also very good. The service and ambiance of the restaurant was great. I’ll definitely go back.
Service, food and drinks were all well done.  Our waitress was friendly and efficient.
Service was fantastic.  The drinks were great—raspberry lemon drop tasted like summer.   The curry prawns are spectacular and never disappoint.  Great atmosphere as well.

Food was varied and quite good.   Interaction with greeters and hostess seemed less friendly than usual.  Our table for a group of 5 was not put in a great place, kind of in a corner against a wall and by a doorway that wait staff were frequently going in and out of.  Also in the past there has been some soft live music on the weekend but there wasn't this time.  Prices seemed reasonable and we didn't feel hurried.   I would recommend this restaurant for groups of 2 to 4 if you want a nicer table.
Bridges continues to be amazing, in the pandemic or not. Love eating there. The patio is amazing.

Food ordering 
was slow.  One item was burnt.

Outdoor area was very nice.
Great meal and wonderful service!
Had a great time!  Good food, the service was okay, ambiance was great.
Service was outstanding, very attentive, we did not even have to ask for our waters to be refilled. All servers were friendly, courteous and attentive!
Great food and service!

Lovely outdoor tables complete with tablecloths.  Food is extraordinary and perfectly presented.  Quality is the name of Bridges.  The staff is kind and considerate.  One of my most favorite places to visit.

My husband and I took our moms there for dinner last night and as alway, it was fantastic! I had the mixed green salad with grilled salmon and the other all ordered the salmon entree with noodles and we all loved our dish! Service is great, ambiance is lovely outside on the patio and the soups are always too notch!
Stupendous as usual. Bridges is a go-to restaurant for us.

Everything about our lunch experience was just right.  We were greeted cordially and seated right where we needed to be.  Our server was efficient and accommodating, and another server also stepped in to do various things for us.

We really enjoyed the lunch selections quite a bit —— delicious and beautifully presented.  We had such a great experience that we both ordered dessert —— another delight.

Thanks to you all for maintaining such high standards and graciousness.  It is much appreciated.

Have had the avocado toast with smoked salmon in the past, it was excellent.  This time I came a day after a holiday and it wasn't  as fresh.

Just a comment you might be interested in.
We still love Bridges!
Great place to meet with friends or family. We love going there
Service is very very slow

Not many choices and poor food quality. I order flat iron steak, if came with 4oz of steak and french fries for $29, not worth it at all. I used to like this place, but I won’t go back for a long time.
Service was excellent. Food was delicious. We will be returning to Bridges again!

My wife and I always enjoy dining at Bridges. It has been awhile since we were there last  but we did notice that there were limited  entrees. 
We would really like to see the return of live music. 
Thank you   
Gary and Ruth Yount
Quiet,clean, hot food .

Enjoyed a spectacular meal for our 32nd anniversary. Attentive young man sat us, but before taking us to a table he asked, if we’d like to sit at Mrs. Doubtfire table? What? Yes, of course, we would. We then were treated to the best service by Hannah, she made the evening even more special. She’s attentive, friendly makes you feel like you’re the only ones in the restaurant. But as I watched she was this way with all her tables. Our meal was spectacular, from the cocktails, appetizers, soup and entrees. Some of our favorites were the firecracker edamame, phylo wrapped brie, stir fry Mexican prawns with a curry sauce. The New York steak was out of this world delicious and cooked a perfectly. We will definitely be back soon. We’re looking forward to enjoying one of the delicious burgers with truffle fries and of course one of your specialty cocktails

This is the third time since May we took friends to Bridges for lunch the setting is always beautiful and intimate.  Love their cheese burgers and the salmon salad.  all three time our server was very attentive and friendly.
Wonderful evening; very pleasant outdoor dining.  Food and Service always great!
Great service and great desert.
We enjoyed the whole experience. Service was good and the food was great

Bridges has been and will continue to be a mainstay for the East Bay.
I was delighted to see how busy they were for  a 6:15 on a Saturday, it was a full house inside and out! 

Our waiter Ben had tables in different areas, thus making us kind of on our own. It could have been a bit better but he made it workout.

Our meal was delicious- green salad mixed with in season fruit and shrimp, very lightly dressed. The entree was a swordfish that was delicate on a bed of fresh sautéed corn, spinach and red bell peppers. The flavors came together beautifully. We brought a bottle of AXR 2017 Blazin Red 50% Cabernet/50% Merlot it was an excellent choice for our dinner.

Bridges always gets our attention as being a place to not only come on a regular basis but to bring friends who like a wonderful atmosphere, excellent food and knowing the next time you go there you won’t be disappointed.
Bridges is an old favorite of ours. The food is still delicious and interesting.

We reserved outside seating but when we got there it was still hot outside so we asked if we could sit inside instead and they were able to accommodate us!  Service was more than excellent.  At our table we ordered two swordfish plates, 1 salad with salmon and 1 steak.  All we’re excellent with not a crumb left behind.  We also had 4 different desserts and all were really good.  I had the homemade vanilla ice cream and it was amazing!  We will definitely bei going back.

Atmosphere was pleasant and noise level was moderate. Food was delicious, adequate portions. Surprisingly, our server was not as attenive as usual. When we asked for a few minutes more to select our choices, he didn't return for about 15-20 minutes. He seldom checked on us. Our reservation was 7:30 so the restaurant was not overly busy.
Great food and menu to choose from. Service is excellent.

The service is terrific, the setting lovely, but the food is definitely meh?! The menu is not great, granted we are foodies and eat out often so we’re pretty selective about choosing a restaurant. I ordered a white lady martini, which can sometimes be challenging to a bartender, and it was perfect, as well as the service we received.
The service was super slow. We had to hunt the server down a few times

We dined (lunch) on the patio which was well-shaded and tables were well-spaced. The menu offered a lot of variety. We both loved the spring risotto which was so fresh and delicious. The one scoop of ice cream or sorbeto was just enough for a sweet ending to the meal.
As always, lunch at Bridges was delightful  good food and good service.
Fabulous time. Great ambiance and lovely staff. Friendly and want you to have great experience. Food was delicious.
Great!xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxzxx don’t force a long re vuw. I won’t do it next time

My favorite dish is the Mexican Prawns.  I devoured my entree after starting with baked Brie and chicken lettuce wraps. My husband and son both had the Ahi Tuna. Everything was so delicious and so perfect. I can’t wait to go back!
My 18 year old granddaughter enjoyed her birthday lunch! The cheesecake dessert was gone in a heartbeat!

We had lunch outside and it was a beautiful setting . It was fairly busy so service was on the slow side.  We weren’t in a big rush so it didn’t affect us much but was noticeable. Portions were good and food was tasty . Ordered dessert and got a totally dirty fork that was disappointing. I asked for a replacement and never got an apology or new fork. Would have been a decent meal but ended on a downer.
Catching up with friends. Great dinner!

We celebrated Father’s Day. The menu is consistent . Nothing too exotic. I feel for restaurants who have had to survive the pandemic. Our waiter was very nice but stretched. He apologized for the wait for drinks. The reality post pandemic dining ain’t what it used to be both in food and service. I hail to the people who are sticking it out in that business.
Otherwise dining out would be nonexistent.
I think we are all working out the kinks.
I’m sure part of the problem is staffing issues
Overall enjoyable just not memorable

Bridges is always 5 stars…never a complaint. 
Food and service- thank you!
Always good. Love the current seating area outside.

Halibut (and prawn) entree a tinge overcooked; still excellent, would order again.  Salmon entree perfectly cooked. Both nicely seasoned.  Plating appetizing and very nicely done.  Organic green salad was disappointing: ordinary greens that were not the freshest, uninspired presentation. Would not order again. Timing between entrees and salad was a bit off. Server removed unfinished salad (fork in my hand), without asking, to place entree.  Perhaps small amount remaining appeared as "finished".  Shortcomings not significant to discourage returning. Bridges remains a high favorite overall dining experience and has been for many years for lunch or dinner.
Bridges is without a doubt a proven “go to” .  Never disappoints very consistent and always a pleasurable experience.  Our sever “Zach” was nothing short of “fantastic”.

I used to love this place, haven’t been back for a while and was disappointed by the lack of service and the immaturity of the staff. I sat for 10 minutes without anyone waiting on me after I asked a couple staff members to help me. The staff kept having side conversations, laughing loudly and it was really obvious that they were trying to organize for the dinner rush. It made it really uncomfortable for me, because I wanted my parents to have a good experience.

If the staff is going to have team huddles they should be doing it in the back and not in the middle of the restaurant. I pretty much overheard everything. It’s a young wait staff, but that’s no excuse for unprofessionalism. 

With the new layout they really should put signs on the streets, it was very difficult to find with the roads being closed.

Hoping this turns around, and I hope my comments get forwarded to the manager because I’d hate to have another person have an experience like I did.
Great Shrimp Noodle salad.  Beautiful restaurant with fantastic service.

We loved the food, which is always amazing. The service was quick and efficient and our meal was wonderful. The hand sanitizer on each table was really a wonderful touch. I wish more restaurants did that!

Love Bridges! But this time I felt rushed by the server.  We were a party of 6. The food was great...wish the menu was more extensive or at least changed occasionally. The chairs are very uncomfortable. But I will come back.

Have gone to Bridges for over 25 years for comfortable ambience and good food.  This last visit was a business meeting lunch.  I arrived 10 minutes before our guest.  The menu was abbreviated compared to the dinner menu.  Service was polite, and accommodative, but slow at times.  I also had to wipe away a spider cobweb from the corner of the window.  Our client enjoyed her Thai prawn dish, as well as our appetizers  (short rib tostada and roasted Brussel sprouts), which is the most important thing.  My salmon salad was ok, although the kale pieces were too large to eat gracefully without cutting, and the salmon a bit overcooked.   Dessert was a big hit, especially the mango sorbet and home made ice creams.
Always a great place to dine!  Maggie was our server and was outstanding!

Terrible!  Went for our Anniversary.  First waited 40 minutes for waiter to come to ask us  about drinks.  When I did order a cocktail, the waiter asked me what it was made with because “they probably didn’t have the ingredients.”
I said I didn’t know he asked me for a 2nd choice just in case.  I said English breakfast tea.  He brought me chamomile.  I got a shrimp noodle salad It was barely edible.  Yuck!  My husband got a green salad with salmon.  Barely any dressing.  Had to keep looking for our waiter just to get salt.  Anniversary dinner will require a take-over this year.  Bridges is off our list.  So sad.
Very good food and atmosphere   We really enjoyed your place.
Love this place! Hits just the right note of great service, outstanding food, casual yet fun for special events, perfectly timed dining.
Very nice, needed to remind waitress of bday celebration.
Amazing food and awesome service from Ben!
Good was delicious with a good variety of options. Staff was friendly.

I am so glad Bridges is back for dining. We were there for brunch. The employees are fantastic.  The outdoor setting is pretty with great spacing between tables. 
 I had the baguettes with smoked salmon & avacado.   I loved the flavors of the salad.  This was an excellent choice. 
We are looking forward to a return visit.
It was great!

Last minute plan turned out to be a wonderful experience. 
We always love dining at Bridges.
Love, love eating at Bridges. So friendly and welcoming. They always want to make sure customers have a great time.
Selection of food is impressive. Flavors unique and balanced. Each dish just as beautiful as flavorful. Service was great.

Went for my Partners birthday. Location is Cute and very lively as there’s live music outside and tons of outdoor dining. Restaurant was pretty busy, but we had reservations and were seated promptly. Hostess was nice and friendly, was given the option of indoor or outside . We chose outdoor and had covering and heat lamps. We were seated at 7pm, and The waiter was friendly and We were able to order drinks and appetizers right away, but after that we didn’t see him for just about 50min. Food came out really fast as we order the truffle fries and chicken wraps. We had finished our cocktails and appetizers and had been waiting  and didn’t order til after 810pm. SO got the NY steak and I got the sturgeon. Both tasty. Overall, we had a good tkme, tasty food, nice ambiance, alcoholic beverages to pass the waiting time, and nice dinner out surrounded by strangers having a good time. I can’t complain…miss being out and about. Maybe you’ll get lucky and get a different waiter.
Good service and delicious food.

Always great service and food.
I have been here many times.

I have been going to Bridges for many years for many Occasions. I must say the dinner my wife and I enjoyed was one of the best we have ever had, including dinners at many other Bay Area restaurants. We shared a Fire Cracker Edamame with a glass of Rose for my wife and Lake County Sauvignon Blanc for me. Then she had Mexican Prawns and Thai peanut sauce and fried noodle cakes. I had the Big Eye Tuna with forbidden rice. Bridges then gave us a dessert to share with a lighted candle. It was our anniversary. Our server, Chris, was really great, as were his helpers.

My food was delivered about 10 minutes after everyone else’s as it was ordered by the waiter incorrectly. My broccoli was tough. Overcooked at the top and raw at the stems. Waiter did not seem engaged, and didn’t bother to correct the bill. When we asked for a correction, he said he would make the change, but it was only a dollar.

We had a fantastic birthday dinner with our daughter (birthday girl) and her boyfriend!
It was the first time we ate out in well over a year and a half.  We chose to eat in the dining room vs the patio because of the cooler evenings.  It was ideal!  Tables were spread out and the staff wore masks the whole time. 
Service was outstanding and so was the food!!  Their appetizers were so good; we tried the chorizo pizzetta, roasted brussels sprouts with a lemon aioli, the edamame in a tasty sauce and their truffle frites!!  All were outstanding!!  Their cocktails and merlot by the glass were equally tasty! 
We all loved our entrees too!  We tried their burger, stir fry Mexican prawns, and my husband and I both ordered the special of the night which was a steak over roasted bell pepper, potatoes and brocollini ( it was truly fantastic x 10)!!  I don’t think you can go wrong with any of their dishes!  
Can’t wait to return soon and to eat in their beautiful patio!!

The food was excellent. Good variety of choices on the lunch menu. The service was a bit slow, but that didn't bother us because we were not in a hurry. It seemed that perhaps they were understaffed. But all the servers were working hard and helping each other. All Covid precautions seemed to be in place. Social distancing, mask wearing, etc. It was delightful to be  there and enjoy a delicious meal in a restaurant! Looking forward to a repeat visit soon.

Waited for 15 minutes for a server, the asked someone to send our designated server over only to wait another 5-10 minutes until I had to go to the hostess stand to ask who our server was and if they could send them over. Once they came over the service was good and the host comped our appetizer.
Very enjoyable dinner , pace was perfect, had time to enjoy our bottle of wine.
Food was very good, wait staff very friendly, the outdoor seating was very nice!
Birthday dinner with wife and son

Our food was great, waiter was amazing and very attentive.   We had the Orange blossom Creme brûlée, this was the only meh item as it did not set and was super runny; their pastry chef should of caught this before burning the sugar top.

Lovely space outside but noodle with shrimp dish was mushy and the shrimp was not cooked through.  I haven’t been there for so long and was disappointed.  Ah well….there are many other nearby restaurants to try.

Prawns with red curry - delish. Paloma cocktail- yum. Would normally give more stars for ambiance but we got the tent area which had none.  Normally outdoor is beautiful setting.  But food and service is what matters more.

Came here for a nice family graduation dinner and was deeply disappointed by the quality of the food and service. Waiter rarely checked in. No  salt and pepper, sparkling water was scarce and got my meal wrong twice. Not sure what’s going on but won’t be back again- sadly. The  food at hopstone was better tasting and worth whatever more we paid at bridges. I do not recommend this establishment.
The best Salmon I’ve ever eaten in 57 years. Excellent food-all of it including deserts, amazing servers and hostesses.
Very good food and patio is nice venue.
Our waitress was friendly and attentive. Food and cocktails were wonderful as always.

What a wonderful and delicious evening we had!  From the beginning to the end, all couldn't have been more perfect.  Our server was outstanding and was very willing to give separate checks, particularly as we requested this at the beginning of ordering.  The shrimp in red curry sauce continues to shine...the three of us had three different levels of heat and we were all so pleased with the meal.  Parking was not easy, but we were able to find a spot on the street very close by.
Anniversary
Went for a friends retirement party and our server, Andi was amazing. Our retiree is vegan and she was knowledgeable and helpful about menu options! Food was delish!!

The food is always good here. My only complaint is that I would like to see more variety on the menu (there were no duck or lamb entrees, and the salad offerings were underwhelming). Otherwise, it was delightful.
You can always count on Bridges for a solid meal with wonderful service.

It’s time for Bridges to change their post-vaxed menu. The Ahi on forbidden rice was delicious but was a variation on some of their pandemic curbside seafood dishes. The salad was dressed with mint vinaigrette but the herb flavor was vanishingly subtle. Dessert options were pretty standard and given the stiff competition from Esin they should be made more interesting.
Loved it - sooo good. The doubtfire cocktail was delicious and the sour cherry pork chop had the perfect balance.
It was great.

Waitress did not bring bread until we flagged her down. My NY Steak ordered medium rare was overcooked.
My wife’s birthday mentioned when reservation was made was never acknowledged

Disappointing  brunch overall. Not the Bridges I remember from the 90s. 
First the good: we had someone in a wheelchair in our party and we were able to accommodate them easily. The outside venue is lovely. The cocktails were great as were the starters (Brussels sprouts and truffle fries).
The service was disappointing. I get that we’re all coming out of Covid but this restaurant should be better than most. When we we seated we were asked if we had 5, or 6 people (there were five sitting there) then gave us 4 appetizer plates and silverware. We had to ask 3 times to get another place setting. Got our food, which was overall forgettable. The spicy maple chicken sandwich was neither. More like bland broiled chicken breast with zero condiments. Weird. Had to ask 3 times for condiments. Weird grilled cheese that seemed like it was grilled (to a point before the cheese melted) with no butter on the bread. Weird. An ok frittata. One person got bacon & eggs, hard to screw up. 
Just too bad, as this was a covid reunion after two years of not seeing elderly mother in lockdown and  the food and service was so poor it distracted from our fun. Seems like there’s still great reviews for dinner so maybe this was an off day or maybe just brunch sucks, but I’d skip it if I were you.
I was disappointed we ate there. Lot before covid and now it’s not the same menu and 90% was Asian and no problem with that but I eat that a lot and was looking for the old favorites and was sad.
Always consistent. Always excellent.
We had a lovely dinner at Bridges Restaurant. The patio is lovely and the food is very good. They also have a lovely brunch on Sunday.
The best dish I ever had... the grilled shrimp with noodle cake and fresh mint
I ordered the noodle salad on your lunch menu and the shrimps were good, but the noodles did not have any flavor. It needed some kind of added flavoring to the meal.
The bussers were terrible.
The atmosphere and food has been always great at Bridges. Staff is friendly and COVID careful.
Great food - just okay service.  Have had better with precious dining experiences at this restaurant.

Requested outside seating. Unfortunately, it was in the converted parking lot and not the patio. Huge difference. Waiter was terrific. Food was excellent. Will call next time to make sure we get the patio seating.
Our waiter was fantastic.
The food was excellent, highly recommend

For the price, I am sorry to say we were not impressed with our brunch at Bridges.  The restaurant seems to be trying hard to be "innovative," with interesting-sounding combinations and variations on classics.  Case in point -- my spare rib benedict with Tabasco hollandaise: it was served on room-temperature, untoasted sourdough bread, so the whole dish was barely warm by the time it got to the table.  Tepid  eggs with lukewarm hollandaise is NOT appealing, and the sauce itself had very little flavor -- either of tabasco or of regular hollandaise sauce.  My son got the frittata.  It was OK -- certainly nothing special.  Same can be said of my husband's prawn and noodle salad.  Desserts were WAY too sweet and my panna cotta was a weird combination of flavors.   One big plus was the service -- everyone at the restaurant was delightful, helpful and attentive without being annoying.  And the ambiance is very nice.
Everything was wonderful. Service was impeccable, food came out piping hot and delicious, amazing and well-priced wine selection.
We were taken care of by Samantha. She was fabulous!
Exceptional food!!! Great service by Ray, Ray. We will be back soon!!

The food was delicious ... except for the steak that was overdone and we had to send back. Still, the flavor was awesome. The service was terrible. Our server seemed to come over as an afterthought. It seemed to take forever for our main course, and then we had to ask a different server about returning the steak because our server did not come back to check on us.  The same thing happened in April when we were there last (and we had the same sad server). My daughter had to return her steak because it was overcooked, this time the medium rare was hardly pink at all. Neither time did a manager come over to talk to us, apologize, spring for a dessert. Not that they have to, but it would have made us feel as if someone actually cared. 

Going out to dinner these days is a treat, especially after so long in isolation. But, sad to say, even with the delicious food (and I love those brussels sprouts!) Bridges will not continue to be our go-to place to celebrate family events or for special outings.
Tables are well spaced. Great ambiance outdoors. The food was well presented and very tasty. The drinks were also very good. We’ll definitely return.

Anniversary lunch!  Celebrating this and our first restaurant experience (besides takeout) since the original SIP for Covid19.

All that we expected: safe, clean, well organized, excellent service and food!  No complaints here.  As we re-enter public venues, we will return here knowing how wonderful this was!

Tuna/salmon poke was excellent though when the server said it comes with chips, I thought he mean tortilla chips, not potato chips.  Would have preferred anything but potato chips, but the poke was still great.
My girlfriend had the prawn salad and it's the first time in many years that I've seen her clear her plate!

Lunch with my daughter at Bridges.  Always liked this place.  Appetizer (poke combo) was great and fresh and wonderful as was the fantastic avocado toast with Scottish smoked salmon.  The noodles with cabbage and prawns was really bad and should be taken off the menu.  Our waitress was just GREAT and removed it from our bill.  This dish was a ball of mayonnaise, served cold and was tasteless and heavy & nothing like what it could have been (perhaps a Malaysian inspired warm noodles, cabbage etc with prawns would be a much better menu item?)  For a chef to serve this dish is a little scary.  The 4-5 prawns were very good however.  Probably will hold off going back as I cannot get that mayo taste out of my mind.  Overall good place with just a one-off (hopefully) bad dish.
Every one was very polite but the menu was not that exciting
The food has really gone downhill and we were not happy with brunch. We have enjoyed it in the past, but I'm afraid we will not be back.

I would definitely recommend Bridges for small gatherings and also for large, outdoor gathering.  There were several celebration, mile stone birthdays and graduations taking place.  We were there for our first lunch with dear friends in 14 months.  We were able to have our intimate conversations, enjoy great food and drink while being around the celebratory groups!
The special requests need to be kept. I asked for flowers at the table and the request was missed

I was excited to try out this restaurant unfortunately I was disappointed. I ordered a medium salmon and a medium rare steak and both were over cooked. The rest of the food was ok, won't be back though.

Wow - well, first off we were thrilled to be able to eat at a restaurant - ANY restaurant, but we chose Bridges because we'd heard and read good things about it, and the menu looked interesting.  Reserved a table for two inside, arrived, and was seated immediately.  I ordered the tuna and my husband ordered the chicken (after discussing how chicken at high end restaurants bears no resemblance to the chicken cooked at home).  My husband asked for a starch substitution and the nice waitress was happy to do so, and didn't miss a beat "of course we can" she replied.
    But.....the food.    Absolutely surperb!  The tuna dish was the best I've EVER had, and my husband raved about the chicken.  Really wonderful dining experience and I would go again in a heartbeat, and we definitely will.  It was worth the 30 minute drive!

Food not cooked ( raw ).
I cut my burger in half to share with my wife, it was really undercooked.
Sent it back to cook properly. Instead of cooking another patty, the kitchen simply put the burger patty on the grill, and then reconstructed the two halves .
Looked unpleasant , and parts were still not cooked.

Very disappointing .
We've ate here many times and they seem to be going downhill.  Service was the worst ever, especially at less Covid capacity.
The waitstaff was friendly and attentive. This was my second time ordering both the salmon and the Brussels sprouts because they were so yummy on my last visit. They did not disappoint.
Lovely setting, great food, good service.  Always a pleasant experience

The service at Bridges was excellent.  When we asked to change our table to indoors, we were promptly accommodated.  Service was attentive but not rushed.  The waiter knew the menu well and was able to answer our questions.  Everyone’s food was delicious.  We’ll be back.
excellent service from start to finish. preparation above average for family dining. generous portions at reasonable cost.
Wonderful Anniversary

Our server Chris was fantastic
Funny and attentive
Good menu
Good food
Fun drinks
The outdoor patio is serene
Special lunch for my dads 88th Birthday. The waiter was outstanding and food delicious. Beautiful dining on patio.

Always a 5 star at Bridges so we booked for mother’s day dinner. Unfortunately we were not aware there was a special menu for the evening. Disappointed in the high prices, and limited options. Wish we had been informed in advance.

Mother’s Day with a 7:00pm reservation, arrived at 7:00pm and were allowed to have a drink at the bar prior to being seated, we were seated around 7:45pm, placed our order 15 - 20 minutes later and were told 10 minutes after ordering that the kitchen was closed for the evening, so no dinner for us at Bridges...drove nearly an hour to get there, very disappointing!!!
Mothers Day dinner - service was extremely slow and the food quality was well below parr.  Very disappointing.

We dined on Mother’s Day. We had a special waitress named Sabrina. She was really genuine and personable.
She was vey much on the ball. She took good care of us.
We had great meals and service . The halibut was really fresh and the steaks were equally good

Great service, but the food quality was just not there.  We've typically had very good experiences with the food at Bridges, but I would not recommend going there when they have the three course menu.  My carnitas hash was cold and the fried egg yolk was hard all the way through.  Disappointing, especially given the price.
Mother’s Day
Excellent as always. Terrific food, setting, atmosphere, and service. One of our favorite restaurants in the Bay Area.
Food was great, drinks were flowing, the staff was helpful and friendly.
Mothers Day lunch was a pleasant experience due to good food and the careful planning of Bridges ie Covid concerns.
Fantastic business dinner. Great service excellent bussing of food and refilling of water. Top notch.
The menu offered lots of choices. Both of our lunch salads were great. The staff was attentive but allowed us to enjoy our leisurely lunch!

I love Bridges and have for a long time. This day just felt different in terms of the quality of the food.  Just just did not seem as interesting or fresh as I remembered but it was still good. The service was a little impersonal and rushed.  

Again, to be clear, Bridges is one of the great restaurants in Danville. I will definitely give them another chance because they have always been consistently good. Maybe it was just an off day?
Food was not up to normal Bridges standard. Salty and cold.

The food was amazing and all of the staff were very friendly and helpful. We didn't feel rushed or crowded, plenty of space between diners for COVID and very clean. Our server Chris did a wonderful job :)
As good as it could be when dining in a parking lot.

Appetizers: The Beef Short Rib Tostada appetizer was amazing as the Firecracker Edamame was flavorful, with a mild to moderate heat level. The Chicken, Asparagus & Calbrian Chili Pizzetta fell flat and was flavorless.

Dinner: The Bridges Burger was excellent! Spring Risotto was average and the Pan Roasted Sour Cherry – Soy Glazed Pork Chop was dry and difficult to cut.

Service: We ordered appetizers and they still hadn't arrived 30 minutes later. The waiter checked on the order and said he submitted it but for some reason, the kitchen didn't receive it. They were finally served almost an hour after we were seated. 

We ordered the Spring Risotto with Grilled Shrimp and were brought Spring Risotto with Chicken.  We asked for mustard for the hamburger twice, and it was brought when the burger was almost finished. The waiter was not very attentive and we had to flag him down several times.

The Check: We provided the waiter with a credit card and specifically asked him to charge $80.00 to the credit card and we would pay the remainder of the bill in cash. The waiter came back to the table, set down the book with the check and credit card, and quickly left without saying a word. When we opened the book the bill showed that the credit card was charged for the entire bill, not the $80.00 as instructed. 

It was a frustrating experience for us and I'm not sure that I would return at this point.

Prawn with noodle salad is always great, but I tried the chicken sandwich and was 
disappointed--not much flavor.
Great as always

I love dining here most of the time, however my dinner the other night (Mexican Prawns) came out lukewarm at best. My friend had the risotto and that was steaming. I am not sure if mine was waiting for hers to be finished, but it was definitely not hot. I could not find my waiter to tell him, so I just ate it. I did not want to sit around and have my friend eat alone while they redid my food. 
Maybe it was a one off error, but just a heads up to Bridges.

I am so grateful to Bridges; they make going out to eat a very lovely and safe experience.  Everyone was very kind, the food was exceptional and the environment was set up to be safe with tables separated and very cozy.  They even had heat lamps outside in case folks get chilly.  My party really enjoyed everything.......very happy and feel blessed !!
A neighborhood gem and a great choice for a special dinner (birthday, anniversary, etc)
Everything was wonderful. Will definitely be back
Their customer service is outstanding! The food was delicious!
Wonderful atmosphere, service and food!
It is so good to be able to go out again and no better place than Bridges. From the service to the food and the amazing Doubtfire cocktail, everything was excellent.
Food is fantastic and the restaurant is in a pleasant setting.  We will definitely return.
always amazing! everthing you get there is always on point

This was the first time we have been able to get together with our good friends over a meal since COVID 19 restrictions.. We sat outside and it was a lovely evening. They had enough space heaters to make it very pleasant. Our waiter was not on his A-game as he brought us the wrong bottle of wine and was not attentive to having the right utensils for one of the meals that was ordered. But other than that it was a lovely evening.
We had a nice dinner, outside.  The tables were a good distance apart and it felt safe.

We hadn't been to Bridges since the shutdown, so we were excited to go for a pre-birthday celebration to see how it had endured.  What a great experience!  The food was outstanding, the ambiance was perfect/clean/safe, and the wait staff was very attentive.   We ordered the Brussels Sprouts, Tostadas, and Lettuce Wraps and loved everything!  We will definitely visit again.  Thank you!
Good food great service.
Always great at Bridges!

Food very good. I asked for a better table;
didn’t get it.
We did not like our table. I know it was busy outside,
but table not suitable.
Bridges offers a wonderful dining experience and is a memorable adventure.

Had the pork chop, salmon and steak - all very good. Dessert was a little disappointing - Panna Cotta was OK but the mocha mousse cake did not have much flavor.
Servers were all masked and helpful.
We had a lovely dinner at Bridges. Their outdoor seating in particular was really nice, especially with live music and tents for shade. Our meal was great, service was quick and efficient.

All around great Neal at Bridges. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious and I wouldn’t hesitate to order the same things again. Our server was personable and attentive. I’m looking forward to my next visit.

Quite disappointing.  The dish was odd and the fish tasted past its prime.

Parking lot atmosphere and very very very noisy.

One of our orders was not done as requested.

This used to be a favorite place.  No more.

Everything was Amazing.  The service was great and my compliments to the chef...everyone in my party was enjoying their meal, from the New York Steak to the burger.  I would not let my plate be taken until I finished my last bite.  Will definitely be returning.

I love eating on the patio at Bridges, never seem to tire of the flowers, trees, water features.  The food is good and often better than good.  Our only problem last time was snagging the waiter....had to get the busboy finally to find him to give us our bill.
Very pleasant!!

Our 55th wedding anniversary during Covid19,  we enjoyed our cocktails in the bar and delicious dinners in the dining room.   So happy to be able to celebrate our anniversary in a lovely indoor setting, thank you Bridges!
Beautiful outdoor seating out on the side street in front of the restaurant, with live music (Fri night).

I’ve been having lunch outdoors at Bridges often this year. They have a delightful setting, the food quality is excellent and the service is impeccable. It’s not the least expensive restaurant but it is thoroughly enjoyable and a great place to be with friends and/or your spouse.
As always, great food, great service, and the patio proved to be a fabulous lunch destination.
Absolute pleasure to dine outdoors at Bridges. GREAT service, ambience, menu and so fun to FINALLY get to be with dear friends after over a year! Thank you to Samantha, our fabulous server!

Bridges was an ideal restaurant to break the pandemic ice.  My wife and I had not eaten at a restaurant in over a year due to the Covid-19 pandemic.  The staff at Bridges all wear masks and are very polite and courteous.  The food was excellent in both presentation and taste.  We ate in the outdoor section.  The tables were spaced well apart, it was airy and quite pleasant.  We are looking forward to going to Bridges again in the near future.

Bridges has the most consistent high quality and have done a fantastic job staying open and on their game during this entire pandemic.  Their outdoor seating is hopefully here to stay and so many different options for seating is wonderful.  I never miss a chance to eat their famous "Mexican Prawns", which is a Thai-flavored dish with very large prawns from Mexico.  Also the Prawn noodle salad is fantastic.  You can't go wrong with any of their food!!!

It was so nice to be back having lunch on the patio at Bridges Restaurant. I’ve frequent this place a few times a year and yesterday’s visit was among one of the best. Great food, great service and a nice quiet environment to celebrate my stepdaughter’s baby luncheon. Be sure to order the crispy Brussels Sprouts. The best I’ve ever eaten and I’ve tried them all over the nation!
We enjoyed our meal. But I didn’t care for the aioli on the fries I’ll order without next time. I had a salad, my friend chicken sandwich.
Great indoor dining. Tablecloth’s and plenty of social distance
This is our classic date-night go-to! The food is always good and the drinks are amazing! We love all the outdoor patio space now!
Great service, food, ambiance.  Bar tenders know how to mix drinks well.

My dish was not good, and I barely ate it. The other members of the party loved their food, so that's great! Ambience was lovely. Our server was suuuuper slow despite hardly anyone being there. I actually saw the bartender pour my wine at the bar and should have just taken it, instead of waiting 15 minutes for it to be brought to me. Our dishes didn't come until 40 minutes after ordering, and when I asked for a dessert menu, the waiter said "oh right, we have a birthday here" 🤦🏼‍♀️. Then my husband was brought his stale birthday cupcake before anyone even got to order their dessert (we abandoned the dessert ordering idea after that). 

Overall, I'm looking forward to trying the other charming looking restaurants in the area.
Tasty & rich meals with shaded out door dining space. Worth a visit!
Wonderful lunch as always in a beautiful outside setting.  Great choices although I always select the grilled shrimp and sesame noodle salad.
Awesome as always. Wonderful service. Wonderful food.

We went for Easter dinner and found a fixed menu that covered brunch and dinner. So limited menu which was ok. However I would say the appetizers were very good as were the desserts. However the entrees we mediocre at best. I got the chicken 2 ways, which included a confit leg and what appeared to be a roasted breast.  It came with roasted potatoes with parsnips and fennel. The hash mixed was dry and flavorless. The chicken skin was rubbery and the breast was under cooked. My son had the lamb which was very gamey- and my husband got the fish, which was again - ok. Quite expensive to boot. So would not recommend this place.
Mostly great. My mother was freezing. Should have brought more coats. Other than that. It was really nice. Hadn’t been there in years.
Easter brunch was excellent food and great service.
We dined at bridges for Easter. The meal and service was excellent. Very safe and well executed. I’ve never had a bad meal at bridges. Every meal feels like a special occasion !

Easter Brunch for the 3 of us.  Patio was lovely & we were fortunate enough to be seated in our own little tented area.
Menu selections were great & offered something for everyone.  
Spring Leek & Parsnip soup, truffle mushroom conserva in puff pastry were excellent starters & the chicken 2 ways + the pan roasted Fijian mahi mahi were cooked to perfection.  We all couldn't resist the strawberry chiffon layer cake (light & fluffy) to end our dining experience.
Have always had a superb meal here & they are exceptionally good at holiday menus.
We were all so thankful to be able to dine outside during this difficult period in all our lives.
Thanks Bridges, see you soon!

Food was good.  

Service lacking.  More training needed, more courtesy, friendliness needed.  At times it felt that things were kind of thrown on the table, even making a banging sound.  

Lastly, restaurant needs an update.  Looking old and, somewhat dingy.

Would, only, recommend the food at this time.

Safety protocols in place and wonderful dining experience.  The outdoor setting during COVID was still excellent, shade and heaters for the mild  chill.  Great day to spend a birthday and Easter Sunday.
Easter brunch. Was very nice, outside, clean and COVID friendly. Food was good but a very limited menu a little more variety would have been nice. Service was impeccable.

Food was really good--amazing--the appetizers: lettuce cups and the poke---the steak dinner and the mexican thai prawns were excellent--service was slow that Sat. night and there was a large loud group
but have been there many times and still love it and it's one of our top places to dine in Danville.

Bridges has a regular Fav. But the wait to get out meals has been too long a wait. This was both the case for dinner and lunch. Seems like their kitchen is overwhelmed if they are also supporting or cooking for their wine bar next door. 30 minutes for burgers is too long. If it happens again I’ll be looking for another regular place.
Great staff and overall experience

We received the right amount of attention from our server.  His recommendations were helpful. He provided just the right amount of follow up.  
The food was excellent.
Delicious food, great drinks, we felt very safe and comfortable during Covid protocols and the waitstaff were terrific
Went shortly after pandemic easing. Staff seemed new and not fully trained  My expectations were somewhat high based on its long-standing in the area, but it failed to deliver
Beautiful setting. Wonderful food!!! A memorable afternoon for lunch.
Birthday lunch.
Always consistent. Always wonderful food, service and ambiance.
Everything was well done as always.  It was a beautiful sunny day and the brunch was great.
All around good
Great spot, good food and drinks. Service was very helpful.
Great food and service and the atmosphere was beautiful.  So nice to sit outside with the sun shining.
Nothing great they need a little uptick on the menu
fabulous food, the salmon and mexican shrimp dishes are my favorite .
Awesome dinner and restaurant. One of my favorite places.
Always fabulous!!!
Very pleasant
Bridges never fails to deliver.  Our server Olivia was the best.
Outstanding meal, and Ben our server was FANTASTIC. Had a great evening.
Everything was exceptional
They have done a great job with service during pandemic.
Always amazing service and fantastic food !
Excellent experience!! Loved the food and the service.

We went there for our 10th anniversary. It was the first time after pandemic hit to sit inside a restaurant. The food and service were amazing. The ambience was nice and quiet. The only problem were the open doors (because outdoor seating) and that was bringing in some chilly air.
great food , great service . The lunch menu is always wonderful
I always love Bridges. Very consistent , great food
Excellent place if you are concerned about safety, spaciousness and quality.
Glad that they are back open indoors ! Staff and patrons happy to be there again !
We really enjoyed the food and ambience.  Delicious and great service too.  Thanks for everything.  We will be going back soon.
Great service and the meal was outstanding   Family Brunch
Hoping for a better experience post covid restrictions.

The tent was fine.  Tables were a little close.  Birthday parties around us were a little loud. It was Saturday night.  The steak on a bed of broccoli and cheddar mashed potatoes was about as well seasoned and rich as any steak dish I’ve had.  Would definitely order again.  My wife had the salmon.   She had a similar response.  Re-emerging from covid, we will put bridges on our list for a return visit.
Love the Chicken Wraps - very tasty and different.  I enjoyed the Salmon and my wife had the pork chop.  Both delicious and creatively prepared.
Everything was perfect. Enjoyed our experience.
Lisa the Manager is simply spectacular!  Her customer service reinforces her firm understanding of how to run a restaurant.  Refreshing!

Very good food on four different entrees on party of four.  Good set-up on the outdoor seating...shielded from wind and individual heating device for the table.  Friendly, efficient service if maybe a tad bit slow.

Met with a friend for lunch whom, due to the pandemic, I hadn't seen in over a year. We felt safe and comfortable. Tables were spaced well and wait staff masked properly.  Service was excellent. Our server was very accommodating and patient to allow two old friends the time to catch up. We both ordered the Organic Mixed Baby Greens and added the salmon which was deliciously crispy on the outside and tender inside.  Delightful and delicious afternoon!
They have a lovely patio with heaters so even now with rain it is a place you can dine with friends.
This is the 2nd time we’ve eaten here. Even outdoor dining is special!

Had a delightful and safe lunch with a dear friend recently.  Our server was patient but also attentive while my friend and I were busy catching up.  
My Atlantic Salmon & Baby Kale Salad couldn't have been better.  The salmon was fresh and cooked perfectly.  I loved the addition of the crispy chick peas to the salad.  They were a creative, fun and delicious alternative to croutons. 
 My friend had the Grilled Prawn Sesame Noodle Salad and loved it (my usual go to dish).  Both dishes were delicious and beautifully plated. 
We had a great table with a heater and wind barrier.  Bridges has gone above and beyond in their COVID safety measures.
Beautiful setting for lunch, well distanced tables and great heaters.  Food is always excellent though a bit on the pricey side, it is well worth it.
Dedicious food and great service! Plus it has a beautiful ambience.
Honestly ,great waitress ,great food ,Bridges never disappoints

The service was slow. My waffles were burnt. When I told the hostess she replied with “ Are they to burnt for you? “ WTH??  My husband’s food arrived at least 15 minutes after mine. ( after we asked ). His was pretty good, The fried chicken sandwich was very good.  The fries were soggy and cold.
Outstanding service, thank you Samantha, but the food was not up to par.
We usually go to bridges on special occasions, but this time we were in the mood for burgers - delicious!
My family and I were there for our anniversary. The service was good. The appetizers were great the main courses were ok. Salmon was very dry and the steak was flavorless.

Food was good but certainly not the   best we've ever had. Main issue was our server clearly had too many tables.  For that price of meal you want just a higher level of service. My wife ordered another glass of wine before dinner arrived and didnt get it until we were nearly done. Then waited so long for a dessert order we changed our mind.  Still tipped well but felt service was off a bit
Great dinner at Bridges, as always!!
Great!  We were celebrating a family event.  The food and the server were great - she gave us recommendations that came out well. Loved the Creme Brûlée for dessert.
Nice place as usual

Our service and dinner was excellent.  The quality and the presentation was fantastic and we enjoyed every bite.  We had excellent service and am impressed how Bridges have accommodated everyone during this difficult time.  We look forward to it being entirely open in the very near future.

Great social distancing compartment between tables. Not all restaurants have made me comfortable to get back to dining out. They certainly did great to accommodate patrons! Service was top notch! Food was tasty! In love with the chicken and scallion Mac and cheese! Ate every last bite of carb!!!!!
Wish we had been able to dine on the patio instead of parking lot. Other than that, perfect evening!
Nice spot for outdoor dining, good food and excellent service.
Great restaurant and great time visiting with friends!

We are never disappointed with Bridges. My husband had the Avocado toast with smoked salmon, my son had the fried chicken sandwich with coleslaw and I had the Sesame noodle salad with grilled prawns. We had cocktails and wine and all were delicious. Our server Samantha was very attentive .

Being gluten free - loved this place but almost nothing on the menu I could eat!  
I think 30% is gluten sensitive so I hope this nice spot can offer a few items - 😉 our waiter was very helpful
Lovely birthday lunch for friend outside on patio. Attentive server, yummy food including complimentary birthday cupcake with candle.
Nice anniversary dinner and drinks
Had to wait forever for our food and they weren’t that busy. Unacceptable!!
The outdoor dining is lovely.  Food is always delicious.
Great food
I would have like to have a better selection of seafood.

Bridges has risen to the occasion in terms of an outside dining experience that doesn't feel like eating in a parking lot.  It was warm enough.  The food was excellent.  And my favorite repeat server, Hannah, is very good and suggesting drinks, wine and food.  Keep her!  We will be back.  I also appreciate your continuing to honor the Passport.  Makes me want to go there more often.  Thanks for that!
Dining experience is always great, even if it is outdoor dining.

Service was dreadful. I was dining alone and wait staff largely ignored me at every step.  Late clearing main course plate post meal, failure to enquire whether I enjoyed the meal, failure to fire up outdoor heater without any explanation or apology after I requested heat in late afternoon.  Management also ignored me.  Espresso arrived along with bill.  No one returned to collect bill payment, so I simply handed cash to one of the staff while walking out.  Restaurant was not busy, and there were plenty of wait staff, but largely untrained or unhappy with their lot.  I dropped $85 including tip, and as this was my birthday, the experience was immensely disappointing and not what I was used to from Bridges having been a client from their original opening in Danville.

We had an excellent anniversary experience at Bridges! Enjoyed the Mexican Prawns, my favorite, and hubby had the tasty NY Steak. They brought us an anniversary dessert which we enjoyed along with the Honey Creme Brûlée. Outside dining was made extremely powerful heaters. We didn’t even need our jackets! Service was very good. Food came out in a timely manner and never felt rushed. All in all, an experience we will repeat!
And enjoyed being served by Aaron.  The last two times at Bridges lately I find the food better than ever!!!!!  You have a great chef.
Their mushroom tortelloni was awesome. Chris, our server, was very attentive and pleasant. They did a nice job with distancing and Covid precautions. Looking forward to our next visit.
Outstanding and consistent as usual.
Wonderful outdoor patio on a glorious day.

The staff was very cheerful, and they are adhering to strict COVID guidelines. We essentially were dining in a parking lot, otherwise I would have given higher marks for ambiance. But it was a nice experience. The food was really tasty! Excellent roasted Brussels sprouts and lovely salmon. I just wish the dishes didn’t arrive literally on top of each other, like there was a rush, but that could be due to the time limit on the table. Overall great food and great cocktails, and the staff is doing a good job.

Celebrated a friends birthday. I ordered the pri fixe dinner menu from the Tri-Valley Restaurant week. The Citrus encrusted Salmon was delicious. The outside atmosphere was was cozy and we kept warm with the heaters.

Had the salmon. Was supposed to be on the rare side. Was way overdone and dry. For $30 that was a real disappointment. So will never go back there again. Sitting in the parking lot is also not what we expected.
Tasty food and nice service - Thank you!

I had the Mexican Prawns and they were amazing!!!  Not too spicy.  They had an Asian fusion flavor with a delicious peanut sauce over a noodle pancake.  I also had a very tasty Paloma that was very refreshing!

We had an ok time on our date. 
The good:
- My wine. I got a Malbec and I really enjoyed it.
- The ambiance. They did a good job or putting tents out and have tables spread out so that we felt social distancing protocols were observed. They also had nice strong heat lamps. And it was pretty quiet despite being outdoors.
- My husband’s pork chop was very tasty and not tough. 

The not so good:
- My pork chop was extremely tough and hard to cut through even with the steak knife provided.
- Our food took way too long to get to us. So by the time we got it, I was so hungry I didn’t opt to send it back. 
- Service was slower than usual.
Our server, Sabrina, was very personable, knowledgeable, and hardworking. A very pleasant evening under the covet circumstances.

The service was outstanding! Our food was scrumptious!

We’re looking for to our next visit.
Had a relaxing experience with good service and good food
As expected Bridges outdid itself. I took some friends and they were so impressed.
Service and food was wonderful. Well done. Given the circumstances, we found the setting to be perfect and our server + all others were outstanding.

We had a lovely Valentines Day in one of the alcoves that the restaurant set up.  I was worried about being cold but it was not an issue at all.  The food was delicious and our server, Olivia, did a great job.  My husband is gluten free and the restaurant was able to accommodate him without any issues.

Valentine’s Day.   Had a 7 pm reservation.  Got right in, then waited 15 min for the server to come over. We had a bottle of wine waiting to be opened. Since there was a fixed menu we ordered appetizers. The appetizers were served before the bottle of wine was opened.   The soup was bland and the chicken on toast tasted like the chicken was taken from a Costco rotisserie chicken.    

The main meal, we both got fillet, mine medium and hers med well.   Both came out rare.  I ate mine because I was starving and she ate half and couldn’t eat any more due to it being rare.   The Brussels sprout, onion, mushroom, squash mixture was completely mushy.    The shrimp were actually good but there was only two of them.  

Desert I had the sorbet and it tasted like there was freezer burn all over it.  

I really enjoyed the bread and butter.   Probably the best food of the night.  

The 78 dollar meal per person was ridiculously overpriced and the meal under delivered.   I have no problem with that price if it is worth it, but this wasn’t.  

It will be a long time before returning if we do.
granted we ate out in a tent, but the service was great, the food was great, the heat lamps kept us warm although it was raining and cold.
nice for Valentines Day dinner.  First time eating out since the beginning of the pandemic.
Valentines Day
A wonderful evening in the cool of early spring with warmth from radiator heaters and great company. A perfect setting for a perfect evening out.

Great restaurant with tasty meals and pleasant service.
Will come again.

It was Valentines day, so very busy. We got there at four, were seated promptly. The Soup and Salad were excellent. We asked for bread, it never came. I was served my halibut, but my wife's steak didn't arrive at the same time. She advised my to get started. The waiter rushed by and said the steak was coming. After 15 minutes I had finished my fish, my wife hadn't received her steak, the waiter was nowhere to be found. I went up to the front and asked for manager, explained my wife hadn't received her food. She asked to go to my table, which we walked to, and said she would find out what was going on. 5 minutes later she appeared with my wife's steak, and said the restaurant would comp both our meals. The steak was an excellent piece of meat, cooked well, but completely unseasoned. We aksed for salt and pepper. I suspect they grabbed a steak before it had been seasoned. We've eaten at Bridges before, and never had this kind of problem.
Amazing food, amazing customer service , amazing ambience. Overall one of the best dinners ever, Highly recommend the coconut crusted halibut

We went to Bridges for Valentines Day and it was FANTASTIC! Lisa and her staff are attentive, friendly and hard-working. There was always someone available to refill cocktails, water glasses, clear plates or attend to our needs, without feeling like they were 'hovering.' The food was great, the outdoor patio set up with individual booths and heaters made it very comfortable - in fact, at one point we even turned the heater down a bit - all in all a wonderful experience. We will be back!
Really enjoyed Valentine’s lunch at Bridges. Considering having to dine outdoors because of COVID, I was very comfortable. The food was excellent and the staff was great.

The Valentine's Day dinner was fabulous.  We had the halibut and filet mignon which were prepared with a very pleasing balance of flavors and cooked perfectly.  We also thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance of dining on the patio in our own private "room" with a gas heater that kept it comfortable enough to remove our coats.
All aspects were wonderful!
I have been going to this place for over 20 years, and it has been exceptional- every time! Highly recommend it! Kevin Gin is super talented.
Excellent pre Valentines Day meal with my wife and daughter!
Bridges is one of our favorite restaurants.  Food is always delicious!
Bridges is consistently good.  Even thru covid, their outdoor dining has been great. Would love to see a few newer menu choices though.

92nd birthday for my mother in law. Only negative was that I expected a little more consideration for seating us with a 92 year old with walker. We were sat at a table right by entrance that was in pathway of every one entering and exiting and with covid issues, this was not an appropriate table for a 92 year old. I asked for another table and the hostess had us walk with walker all the way to the other end, which was cold and dreary. I asked why we couldn’t sit at one of the tables in the sun, with safe plexiglass separation between the tables. She stated all her tables were good tables. A few minutes later someone left and she sat us there. We shouldn’t have had to go through this especially since I had called and asked for a special table for  a 92nd birthday celebration that the restaurant was aware of prior to us arriving.
Oh wonderful meal as always at Bridges! Our server was awesome

Aside from the food being delicious, they took some spins on them. I especially liked the Thai Shrimp dish with crispy noodle wedges. I almost licked the plate clean. The chocolate mousse dessert was so good! Too bad I barely made room for dessert. The brussels sprouts were also tasty! My husband's steak he said was really good and a good size. Overall, I think the restaurant's move to revive its menu is a hit. If you're looking for a younger crowd, you won't find them here. I noticed, most of the patrons were late 30s-65+.
Such a nice place to dine outside. Separate private spaces, lots of heaters. Our server was delightful. The Mexican prawns were really, really good. And the Kent Pinot Noir was a great surprise.
It was so nice to get out and have a delicious lunch.

I've been to Bridges before and was looking forward to returning now that outdoor dining re-opened.  I was a bit disappointed, though.  There was no heads up that parking was the entrance on Church Street was blocked, so it took some time to find parking, but that was ok.  However, it took over 25 minutes for our server to stop by and that was after me asking others twice to find our server so we could order.  We got water but that was it, and we were looking forward to cocktails while reviewing the menu.  Food was pretty good, though, and the outdoor set-up was nice.  Not sure I'd hurry back unless they improve the service.

Bridges has great outdoor dining. The staff uses utmost care during covid. The take out is terrific too.
The hamburger can’t be beat.
Beautiful location and high quality food

I had a nice meal out at Bridges with some friends during COVID-19.  We had a nice secluded outdoor table and there was a plastic partition between us and the nearest occupied table.  The menu was a little limited, I guess to the uncertainty of lockdowns.  The atmosphere was a little too dark for my preference.  Overall the food and service was very good.
Love the outdoor patio,  the wait staff is very helpful,  and it's the best burger in town!
We went to Bridges for a family celebration. We loved everything!

Great evening on the patio.  Heaters kept it warm on 45 degree evening! The configuration was well thought out!
Food and drinks were tasty!Service was excellent!
Wonderful experience!
Absolutely amazing food and experience! Highly suggest going here

Warm and cozy in the rain on the enclosed patio with a heater.  Salmon with black rice was yummy. My brother enjoyed his 1/2 chicken with mac&cheese and his green salad with pears and a side of crumbled bleiche cheese.
Great experience
Excellent food and service. So glad we got to enjoy before the COVID lockdown again.
We had a wonderful brunch, had a delightful, attentive server. The food was excellent and our space was outdoor, but very private and cozy!
We had a nice celebration for my son’s 21st birthday! The outdoor atmosphere was lovely And safe and we were warmed by the heaters.
Everything was very good with the exception of the pork chop that was ordered.  It was very tough and chewy. Flavor was good.

One of the best rib eye steaks we've eaten in a long time. Great atmosphere, great service, owner and management are attentive and evidently deeply care about their restaurant business and clients. Just love dining at Bridges, one of our all-time favorite local restaurant.

We had a wonderful time and felt Bridges has gone over and beyond to keep all safe.  

Our waiter was fantastic and deserved the large tip we gave!!!
We would sign any petition helping to keep these safe restaurants open during the shut down

My husband and I dined at Bridges for my birthday.  We receive one cocktial after 20 minutes, and a cup of soup.  We where done with are drink and soup and sat there for another 30 minutes with anyone checking on us.  We finally waved the manager over and told her we had been there an hour and haven't even ordered our entree.  She couldn't believe that had happened.  The waitress finally came and took out order which arrived fairly quick.  The flat iron steak had so much gristle that, upon my best of manners had to be removed from my mouth multiple times.   The waitress did try and smooth thing over by bringing me a dried out cupcake for my birthday dessert.  Needless to say the entire experience was a bust, and when we got the bill, we were charged the entire amount with bit even one drink taken off the bill for waiting an hour to order.  This resturant used to be our go to place for special dinners but we will NEVER go her again.

Hats off to Bridges for their responding admirably to the current Covid restrictions and challenges. Their “set-up” outdoors with partitions between tables creates a safe environment for delightful dining without looking makeshift. I will make a point in patronizing Bridges frequently throughout the pandemic. Food and service were wonderful.
Birthday celebration for work colleague.

Very difficult times for restaurant industry to supply quality food and to employ wait staff.
Bridges does both.
I had delicious lamb shank and my guest had Atlantic Salmon. 
Cheesecake for dessert.
Would highly recommend this restaurant.  It is consistently very good!

Wow... Bridges outdid themselves in these covid times.  They had safety measures in place but we enjoyed our lunch in the privacy of an outdoor "booth".  Everyone was accommodating and so friendly.  I had the mixed green salad with Salmon.  I almost licked my plate... others in my party had the Shrimp curry and the Rueben sandwich and were raving about them.  
Also, don't forget to try the creme brulee with maple...  oh my!

Highly recommend!!!!
Very nicely done for outdoor dining!

excellent waitstaff, delicious meals, great drinks, wonderful desserts
but the Best part was sitting outside in pretty darn chilly weather and feeling SO comfortable because of the way you intelligently set up the outdoor dining area with the fabric tops, and separated areas and patio heaters.   We all were so very pleased.
Thoroughly enjoyed our meal. Hannah was a wonderful server. Thank you.

The restaurant’s response to covid is excellent. Tables are spaced, the heaters kept us warm, and the servers are masked and careful.  The Thanksgiving menu offered a varied selection of choices which we really appreciated. We will return.
Food is consistently delicious.
It was a wonderful experience and the thanksgiving menu selection was fabulous. Will be back for sure.

I love bridges. The patio experience is weird now because of the patricians put in place due to Covid but this is temporary. In normal times is nice.
The food could be better. 
Hopefully, they will work on the food quality also. 
Service was fine.
My experience there was fantastic! I took my father there for lunch and he ate every bite! He said he would be back and so will I! But above all else the service we received was excellent!
Fabulous ambience even during the pandemic. Lovely food.

A friend’s luncheon of three was the first time together since last December. The food was outstanding, the service prompt and friendly, the ambience quiet, sheltered and heated. Above all, we felt safe with the precautions that the restaurant provided.
The food was good, the service was great and the ambience was great.  Would return.
