Considering we’re in COVID lockdown, the outdoor dining experience was fine with space heaters to ease the chill.  Our server was extraordinary, all of the dishes were well prepared and presented.
The pork chop and salmon entrees were outstanding!  The waiter allowed us to try 2 of our wine choices before making our selection.
Bridges outdoors for lunch on a nice day is hard to beat. Good menu choices and nice people.
We went back for the salmon which had during a previous visit.  It was just as good the second time!  The mixed green salad was delicious, too.

The staff here is so accommodating and kind.  We receive great service every time we’ve visited during COVID-19.  The food is delicious.  The bourbon salmon is a family favorite.  Desserts are  worth saving room for.
Thank you Chris for making the evening enjoyable as well as delicious.
Very open seating plan with plenty of distance between tables. Friendly and punctual service. Great evening.
It felt safe eating inside with tables spaced appropriately. Service was personable & food was great!
Good food and good service. Always consistent.
My thank you lunch to my interior designer and cabinet designer was so enjoyable. The entrees were so delicious. Service was great. I would recommend this restaurant anytime!
Our server was very professional and attentive.  He surprised us with a birthday cupcake!
BEAUTIFUL RESTAURANT[ ALWAYS LOVE IT.  STAFF GREAT-   ONE SALMON GREAT- ONE UNDERCOOKED.  BUT ALL IN ALL A LOVELY EVENING.  WAIT STAFF WONDERFUL
Great outdoor dining considering the Covid restrictions. Well separated tables with heaters made the chilly day enjoyable.
Always a nice place to eat.
I was there for my 50s birthday with my friends. I had a lovely time! Never disappoints me. Always have a great time there!

We had such a wonderful night celebrating our friend's birthday. Chris, our waiter was very good.  Attentive and even stayed after closing to be sure we had time to celebrate!
Great job!  Definitely recommend to anyone celebrating a special occasion.

The evening was perfect. Social distancing outside on a chilly evening with two heat lamps to keep us warm. Our waiter Chris was attentive, helpful, and a lot of fun! 
Thanks Bridges! Always a safe and delicious choice.
wonderful place to dine and enjoy all the history of Bridges!!!!!

It was my birthday.  I’m sensitive to cold and wore long underwear and a down vest.  It was like walking into a meat locker.  Wind seeping in between the windows and gusting through the door.  The server said the heat was as high as it could go.  I waited for my food with hands in my vest, five napkins on my legs and a friend’s scarf on my head.  The food was good but I couldn’t finish because of the cold.  I got a delicious cupcake that was the highlight of the meal, but not enough to overcome the overall misery of the experience.  Bridges need to do some weatherstripping and upgrade its heating.  I always enjoy Danville outings but will choose other venues for now.
We sat outside; restaurant has a  great space.

Experience was good. Tough to make it great during these times of COVID but they work hard to make it work with a cold night outside. Can't be helped. 

Cocktails were great but entree's fell a little short this time from the past experienes.

I had a wonderful bday celebration starting with a well socially distanced table, delicious food and excellent service. Great wine and spirits selection and delicious desserts.  Everyone at Bridges we’re very patient and accommodating. Thank you!!
Food excellent as always. Service strong and professional. Thank you for still creating a special environment and atmosphere amidst silly COVID rules.
Made for a fun dinner with a friend!

The restaurant was great in making us feel safe and secure in regard to the pandemic.
The staff was very attentive, professional and took care to make sure the food, table etc  was handled appropriately re. Covid.  Our table was set apart from others.  Our food was ok.  My prawns were a bit overcooked but edible.
The pork chop that I ordered was overcooked and dry
Great food, great vibes, reasonable pricing, and good location! Will come again!

For some reason, we had not eaten dinner at Bridges for years. We had a great dinner (I had the Rib Eye special which was excellent), great service, Bridges does an excellent job with Social Distancing and when it got a little chilly, the heat lamps really help. Bridges is back in our dinner rotation.

The service was excellent, food fresh,  very good quality and well prepared.

My companion and I shared the sushito peppers to start.  They were hot - but very tasty!  Bread delivered on request.  Water glasses were promptly filled.  I started with a cocktail and then a glass of wine with dinner.  Waiter did not know much about wine (self confessed) so he offered me a taste.  I had the tuna that we excellent and yummy rice (black rice, cannot remember the name, but nutty tasting.  Also had pineapple and some other tasty treats in it.)  My companion had the steak, cooked perfectly.  He asked to substitute fries for the mashed potatoes but their fryer was broken.  I ate his broccolini and it was yummy and cooked crisp.  The tables were at an appropriate distance for COVID.  All staff wore masks and cleaned tables and areas etc.  I asked for to go boxes and they were promptly delivered and self serve to put our leftovers in the box (COVID precautions).  Heater was turned and and brought closer to table at my request.  I have not been to Bridges for a while but I thoroughly enjoyed the evening.  The service was excellent, food fresh,  very good quality and well prepared.

We went to celebrate a family birthday during the pandemic. The staff was excellent and took appropriate social distancing precautions. More importantly, the food was fabulous and the outdoor setting was lovely and very comfortable! We’re already planning a trip back!

Loved  their Ahi tuna fish dish with that crunchy nutty forbidden rice dashed with spicy pineapple coulis. Service excellent with very polite and attentive Erin. Always a delight at Bridges with its indoor ambiance where we sat near the patio.

it took us an hour to get our entrees (just a burger and a salad) which we had to ask the bussers about since our server was MIA. we sat inside next to the thermostat and it was 67F. we will not be returning.
Celebrating my mother’s birthday. She always wanted to go there.
Excellent all around!!!
Another fabulous meal and fabulous service from Bridges.

First time here. The food was wonderful. The service was great. We are outside which was nice and it was very warm because they have heaters. I had the Tuna and my wife had the Filet Mignon. We were very pleased and look forward to returning.
I had the Thai prawns and they were amazing...very nice lunch.
Bridges is well-known for a reason. The food is spectacular, service is considerate and kind. Cocktails are to die for. Book now!
Great place for special occasions. Tables are spaced adequately and staff practicing Covid protocols. Very good and well prepared food. Bridges never disappoints.
Our table ordered the salmon, pork chop, and chicken and we all really enjoyed our meals.
Food was great, nice patio seating, prices very reasonable for brunch menu. Great service

Friendly and excellent service. Outside dining lovely. Delicious scones served to everyone. Drinks were fun, especially the Espresso Martini. Will try to make at home.
Chicken and biscuit somewhat disappointing- no eggs, but bacon gravy tasty.

Service was sub-standard. We had to ask for our waiter three times in order to order our meal and then hopefully dessert. We decided not to order dessert because it took almost 2 hours to get our dinner and who knows how long it would have taken to have dessert served. Food was quite good but we will think twice before coming back because the service was so bad.
Good quality ingredients and food was delicious 😋
Bridges never fails to deliver class, food, and service. I never think twice when I dine in Danville.
My standby in downtown Danville! Food, atmosphere and service is always great.
I have been going to Bridges from the first day they opened.  Although they were a couple times the service wasn’t great, yesterday was perfect and overall it remains the best restaurant in Danville.
Food is always excellent. Distancing was great.  Can’t wait to come again.
Food was wonderful, staff was courteous- it was a first date - it was my job to pick the spot and I scored
I had such a great time in this restaurant.  The food is fabulous!  Creative and the ambiance is so pretty under the night skies.  Highly recommended!!  I will have to come back here again!
Many great seating options and all well shaded and separated.  Server was so friendly as well as helpful.  Food was delicious; every single person at our table absolutely loved it.
One of my go-to restaurants. Always consistent and delicious. There lunch menu is somewhat abbreviated from pre-pandemic days. So fewer choices but all excellent.
You can count on bridges for steady, consistent quality in a very relaxed setting.  I attended two birthday functions in the last week at bridges… both exemplary in all regards!

We are local residents wanting a special lunch date out for our 25 Anniversary. Friends spoke highly of their recent lunch and safeguards at Bridges, specifically the fish. Online I requested a corner or back wall table. On arrival we were offered an inside next to the door, or a narrow table in the midst of several large parties. We reminded hostess of our reservation request for my private table facing into patio area. Luck have it, a table opened up! Nice waiter about to return to his college studies, who got everything wrong.
1. Requested to pricey glasses of rose champagne and received rose wine, a toast! 
2. Appetizers, nothing special. 3. Beet Salad too much vinegar. 
4. The kicker was 2-sword fish entrees ordered, but only 1-dish arrived dry and over cooked! Now what? Ok more Rose wine and wait for the waiter. 10-minutes later 
waiter apologizes for the order, offered to get one going. Now, 15-minutes, sword fish getting cold. We declined, and the waiter comp us the edenamee and a cup cake!  
We paid, likely never to return on a Sunday for a special occasion meal. 
Disappointing, yes!
The website menu is outdated from the brunch menu we were given. So everything we had planned on ordering was unavailable.

Just when you think Bridges couldn't get any better, the outside seating on Church Street due to Covid shows that it can! Hope they continue with it in the summers even after covid threat is over. Food is delicious as it's always been, service is fantastic, ambiance great. Jon them before the weather turns and the closed street seating comes to an end, it's really nice!
We had Hannah as our server. Super nice, very efficient and our food was great!

We had a girls' lunch on a beautiful Saturday afternoon at Bridges. The service was friendly and attentive and the food was delicious. We shared several plates, but my favorites were the Malaysian chicken lettuce wraps and the poke. The Bridges-tini with pineapple-infused vodka is a go-to for a refreshing cocktail!

My husband and I, had a fabulous time! We loved how well the social distancing was done outside! We love the outdoor seating even more now. Again, we had too much fun and the food was spectacular as always! Our waitress, was on it! The service at Bridges is always top notch.

Honestly the steak was one of the worst I have ever had. I am not a big fan of sending things back to the kitchen and making a big deal but it was so badly cooked. Reeked of propane, chewy and hard, no seasoning and a slab of butter just sitting on top. Bad quality and not very good quality control to let that come out of the kitchen. Sad for a $35 steak. I was hoping to make a consistent visit to Bridges as I love the outdoor seating but the food was not up to par especially for me to pay $35 for a steak I could have bought for $8 at safeway and cooked ten times better myself using a pan. My wifes meal was good and well made but still left something to be desired. I am not sure I will go back, if I do, it will be swordfish. My guess is thats a frozen swordfish and not fresh. Anyways, been to Bridges before and have had a much better experience it just doesnt sit right to spend over $100 on a dinner and know I could have prepared it better myself after 6 beers. The waiter had way too many tables and only came by every once in a while, very nice guy but overworked.

Service was very poor. I had mentioned it was my husband’s birthday. Nothing special was done. 
Very disappointed.
Bridges have done an excellent job to spread tables far apart. We felt comfortable and really enjoyed the fact it was quieter because there were no large noisy groups!
Bridges never fails to deliver. They are head and shoulders above their competition.

Bridges has always been our go to place for outdoor dining. They have done a great job on the patio setting up partitions and spacing tables. 
Service excellent. 
I would like to see an expanded lunch menu, a few more sandwiches and salads. 
We hope to spend more time at this restaurant on the patio before the weather cools down.
A very pleasant evening. Outside tables were well spaced. Service was great as was the food — halibut and risotto.

Christian our server was great. Attentive and polite and patient. They do a great job of making you feel safe.
It was a delicious relaxing meal. The hamburger and fries hit the spot. If you want a hearty burger.
We have eaten at Bridges many times. Food is delicious, service good. They have taken excellent precautions in regard to COVID.

We enjoyed the outdoor seating area with the partition. It made it feel more like a booth, a bit more 'cozy' for our little group of three. Our lunch was great--good food, great service. Thank you very much.

Asked for bread.  Was told there was none.  Ordered a side of mash potatoes, was told there was none.  

Table next to us, after we ordered,  got bread.  My pork chop came on a bed of mashed potatoes.  

Host was nice and comp’d us our appetizer. But still.

The food was tasty and the server was acceptable.  However, we were celebrating an anniversary - which I had notified the restaurant in advance - and being seated in the street definitely took away some of the ambiance we were expecting.  My chair was close to the curb, where the street slopes down, so that was not comfortable either.  We did end up moving the chairs so that was taken care of.  The ambiance did improve as it grew darker and the street ambiance was less obvious.

I totally understand why they need to do this - and if eating in the street isn't a turn off to you...  but if you want to support this restaurant and eating in the street is not something you want I suggest you have dinner after the sun has set.
Exquisite food and excellent service.  Kudos to Chris for expertly handling a full patio
Table of 6, we dine out frequently and are not tough to please. The quality of the food was awful across all dishes ordered.
Had the most amazing thai curry prawn dish! All the food and service was wonderful
We were surprised by a Happy Anniversary dessert at the end our meals! Excellent!
Great Birthday dinner for my mom. We were very happy to be able to dine inside. I had the Halibut special and it was wonderful!!

We came for dinner with our two young kids and had fast and friendly service. The food was fabulous, we really enjoyed the salmon and half chicken. We appreciate fast service for the kid's meals, it's always great if they can get fed first as they get impatient. I really liked my passion fruit lemon drop cocktail as well, it was perfectly balanced.
Very happy
Beautiful brunch quiet setting, very highly recommend!
We had another delicious dinner at the bridges ! We love seating outside on the street by the Live music !
Staff and service personnel were wonderful.  You can tell the management genuinely cares about your experience, quality of food and superior service
Great patio. Haven’t been to Bridges in a long time. Pleasantly surprised.
As Always Bridges staff and restaurant is consistlently the best!
My friend and I had a lovely time while dining at Bridges due to the professionalism, friendliness and helpfulness of staff during lunch.

They did a really nice job with their patio and outdoor dining section. They have partitions between some tables and it really gives a nice, intimate, private feeling. Attentive staff and delicious food. Portion size is good and nice variety of menu options. 

Lovely and they picked up on our reason for being there - celebration a friend’s birthday and they gave her a cupcake. Very nice touch.
always great food and service and a local favorite of ours.

We had a wonderful dinner at Bridges sitting outside on their beautiful patio. The tables were very distanced and the servers were professional-wearing their masks at all times and not getting to close to us.  The food was delicious! Perfect night out!
Brought the girlfriend for her birthday. Their pork and salmon are AMAZING. The service was perfect and the little birthday cupcake was a nice touch at the end. Well definitely come back.

We always feel safe at Bridges.
Covid has made you think where to dine... never have to worry at Bridges.
Staff is fabulous!!
Good fish meals and salad but risotto was undercooked and too many undercooked vegetables in risotto.   Great ice cream for dessert.

We had a party of four for outdoor dining lunch.  I must say the food was spectacular (I had the roasted butternut squash soup and duck quesadilla).  The staff were all very observant to health and safety protocols and the tables were appropriately spaced.  It was a delightful experience.
Amazing food and service. Monday night and very busy!!!
my go to spot in danville for great food and drink

Brunch

Food not as tasty as before. Service was not to attentive. Took 1 hour to get food way after others.
Had brunch.  All guests loved what they ordered.  I eat a plant based diet and the menu has changed since I was last there for brunch and not as many options for vegans.
Great evening! Food was exceptional! COVID protocol in place.

The ambiance was wonderful. We enjoyed the music as well. 
It was very enjoyable!
The ambiance was fantastic. The staff was very friendly and made wonderful recommendations.

The outdoor seating was protected with partitions between tables.  The garden setting was scenic and the staff were attentive.  The staff regularly brought water since it was a hot day.  They allowed us time to relax since we asked for more time with the menu.  The brunch was delicious -- the eggs benedict with corned beef was innovative.

During the pandemic, this was a nice outdoor setting to have brunch. The tables were far enough apart and we felt safe going there. This was our first time there and we plan to go for dinner sometime soon. A nice respite from staying home so much.
Great Anniversary!!! Great Lemond Drop!! The table was great, safe, clean!!
Great service and the menu specials were just what my wife wanted. She had the halibut and it was amazing. I had the New York and it was perfectly cooked and the wine reduction sauce was amazing!!
Considering Bridges, like most restaurants, have dining outside, Bridges service and food was outstanding.  Can't wait to go back when they have indoor dining - I highly recommend Bridges!

Great experience every time we go to Bridges. We were seated in their patio and they have black barriers between our table and the next one, which was great and made us feel safe. They also sanitized the high chair for our daughter which was nice. Food and service were great as usual :)

The server was rude to my mom and she is an elderly.  She asked for hot water and he rudely said just a minute and then had to ask for it the third time to get it. Very disrespectful. He needs training on how to treat elderly because we will all get old someday.

Service was terrible, very slow. Waiter had a bit of an attitude and forgot parts of our orders. The food was decent but still left much to be desired. The whole experience was kind of a let down, we had high hopes for this place.
great food
Didn't realize that they only served brunch on the weekend. It was okay.
Will certainly go again!!

We arrived at 7:10pm for our 7:15pm reservation for 2.  The hostess said they were waiting for some tables to clear and asked us to wait over at a bench near their sister restaurant, The Vine.  We saw a number of tables open over the next 20 minutes but was never called.  Finally I went back to see the hostess, explained our situation and was seated within 2 minutes.  Apparently we had been forgotten and would have never been seated. 
Once seated though, the service was very good and everyone was very nice.
lovely outdoor spot in downtown danville. thank you
Great place
2 of us had the halibut special and both were very overcooked and dry. The other two meals were very good.
this was a visit to one of our favorited but now under trying conditions. Our waiter was overworked but persevering. It was the best to be expected. To the future.

As always Bridges exceeded our expectations. Our service was excellent. We would love to know the brand of the hand sanitizer as it’s the best we’ve used yet!
Regards,
