Bridges has always been one of our favorite restaurants. They have now had to keep everyone outdoors, but they have done a great job of providing ambience to go along with their great food and service.

It was our first dinner out since restaurants began reopening. The tables were well-spaced out, the staff all wore face masks and gloves, when appropriate, and all proper protocols were in place.  The service and outdoor atmosphere were great. Best-tasting food I’ve had in months!
Bridges did a great job serving during this pandemic. They made us feel welcome and safe. It was a great dining experience on the patio.

We weren’t sure what to expect in the middle of a pandemic but Bridges was great!  Tables spaced out, nice patio table, great food and great service! They even made us a special anniversary dish with a cupcake.  We had a great time!

Bridges Restaurant was a great first step back into social distancing at restaurants.  Great food, great ambiance...I think they did a fantastic job at setting up their tables and we felt very safe.  Our server, Breann, was very pleasant and the service felt very personal.  Thanks for a fun night.
Graduation
Great dining experience, especially given how they just reopened for patio dining.

We celebrated our anniversary and had such a nice dinner. The outdoor dining area is so nice and open. You can’t beat their burger and my husband’s Thai prawns were good as well. Yummy cocktails and service was excellent.

Our first venture out in three months.  It was a total treat.  The patio was beautiful, the   ambiance happy, the masked service cordial, helpful, and careful, the food first rate. There was a hiccup with our dessert and after about 30 minute wait they brought it bagged to go.  It was just as delicious to have when we got home. A most pleasant evening and way to break our SIP.
Was great to get out after sheltering in place for two months. The outdoor patio was beautiful. The food was better. Always a fabulous restaurant
We loved it.  The service was awesome with a fun atmosphere.
Great food and wonderful garden patio. A nice relaxing place to have a great lunch or dinner. Food is creative and exceptional.
Nice to be back in civilization. Mexican Prawns were super! Staff very professional and they have separated tables for outside dining.
Delicious food and excellent service.  We felt safe and socially distanced from others, we enjoyed a great night out!
Dining out in the patio for the first time since the pandemic. Amazing food and service!  Well done, Bridges.

Went on Saturday night. Loved how they were practicing social distancing and still accommodating their guest. Food was amazing. Probably the best yet. The cauliflower soup with bacon and the pomegranate soy half chicken was awesome! I highly recommend!

Everything was very good. EXCEPT, something in the salmon dish was not so good. I was very surprised. It was very bitter. I didn't want to say anything because I was hosting clients. You guys should taste the dish......
Have always enjoyed Bridges, whether its outside on the patio for Happy Hour menu or inside for a more varied menu.

Really loud, cold bu the window and the food was just ok...
I was hoping for more.

We had a 5:30 res, hoping to have a quiet dinner but since it was Sat., the restaurant was nearly full by 6.  We were in the back against the wall and the tables are close.  We will choose the patio soon!
Wonderful brunch with the book club ladies, mimosas were great and the price was right. I'll be back
I must say, I'm rather disappointed in Bridges. It just has not kept up with changes in menu. Baked brie was cold, Gnocchi overdone and the dessert underwhelming...
Overseas guest in town
Lovely as always

I have never been disappointed when dining at Bridges.
I bring friends from everywhere and they always love
our dining experience.
Lunch with friends.  Another beautiful day in CA, so dined outside on the lovely patio.  Both the food and the service were excellent.

We were a party of three. We all enjoyed the salmon; two of us had the salmon entree and I chose to have a piece of salmon with my Kale salad. The fish was ever so slightly overdone - one minute less of fire would have made the fish perfect. We all agreed the flavors and seasonings were absolutely delicious. Our service was spot in - just the right amount of checking in and never needing to look for our server. Atmosphere is a bit noisy but is great when you’re not looking for that romantic quiet evening out. My visit was as on a Saturday evening at 7:00pm so it was fairly busy. All in all I highly recommend Bridges for a nice lunch or dinner - good food, nice atmosphere and good value. Definitely ask for the patio seating if it’s nice outside.
Great food, great service, great management.  Always consistent.

First lunch date after 6 weeks in/out of the hospital for major surgery and great food in a most pleasant setting for good value with your favorite people...lunch on the patio at Bridges was just what the doctor ordered!

The lunch menu was extensive.  It was difficult to make a decision as there were so many delicious possiblities.  Our waiter was very helpful and gave us more information so we could make an informed decision.  The outdoor patio has a pleasant ambience for dining.

I have eaten here many times, although not in the past three months. Had reservations at noon for lunch. To start, the hostess was the person doing the seating (greatly slowing the check-in process). There were a number of tables outside that offered a degree of privacy, but we were not offered any of these; instead we were seated at a table between a party of six (with two small children), and a party of two gal pals. I had no problem hearing the conversation at either table. The food was acceptable, but somewhat under-seasoned (salt and pepper are not on the table). The truffle frites were good, but the fried chicken sandwich was burnt and dry. The garden salad was quite good. Our server was attentive, but stretched between too many tables. This is the first time in recent memory that I have had a bad experience at this restaurant; ordinarily it is good even if the menu is a tad predictable. Time will tell if this was an aberration.
Dinner was fine.  Presented well.  Support staff all great.  Waiter must have been having a bad night
Wonderful restaurant with good food. Great place for lunch👍🏻

Outdoor seating at lunch was nice.  Food was ok to say the least.  Our group had several different items, not salads, which were served cool to room temperature. Ordered rare burger that was cooked medium. Server did not return for quite awhile after food was servered.
Love the salmon salad and burger. The fried chicken sandwich looked amazing. Thank you for a great lunch out.
Gina gave us a wonderful service. She was very friendly and attentive.
Your server, Nicole, is one of your greatest assets!!!!!
The evening was great.  We moved to a quiet table and the food was very good
Service is always good. Plates attractive.
I enjoy the Monday thru Friday lunch menu much more than what the weekend has to offer
Always a great experience. We brought out of town guests that are real foodies and thought the food was delicious and the ambience outstanding!  Bravo Lisa and team!!
From start to finish, we could not have asked for a nicer evening. The food, service and ambience was delightful. We can't wait to return.
Ordered the pomegranate chicken and Thai prawns, would order both again. Service was excellent; timely but not rushed.
The absolute worst service I have had in years.  Food was edible but not for the price.  I had stopped going there years ago but thought I would give it a chance again.  I won’t be back.
Great service from our server, Brian. Very consistent restaurant!!
Our server was spectacular and made our evening a great experience!

My wife and I have lived in Danville for over 33yrs and we have been a regular Bridges customer for years.   We like supporting our local restaurants and Bridges has been and continues to be our favorite go to restaurant.

Pleasant, relaxing environment. Food good but uninspired. I remember it as a place that used to be impeccable in taste and presentation. Luster seems missing or gone. Service was adequate but was served coffee and cappucino that were less than lukewarm. Waitress seemed offended when brought to her attention and said "I made it to order". My thought was 'so what', if you didn't serve it hot?
Will try again soon for dinner. Sunday brunch was not their shining moment.

I have been to Bridges many times, this time we brought out of town family for brunch. Service was the worst we have ever had. Water without ice was never delivered. Wine was not poured. Replacement napkins were not received after a spill. Food was underwhelming, bacon on my dish was burnt. I don’t think the wait staff checked back with us to ask how the food was...It will be awhile before I return
Valentines

Food was awesome. Had scallops (the off the menu special) on the setup for Mexican Prawns...to die for!! Husband had NY Strip which was delicious, but he said he should have ordered what I had! Service by Ben was wonderful and engaging where we didn’t mind his few up sells! Overall, very pleased!

We really wished it would have been better!!! It has so much potential and Bridges could be a very special place. But... all the food was bland.  Had to add salt and pepper twice to the soup.  They tore pieces of bread and tossed them in the soup.  It would have been so easy to toast them. I had to ask for a plate, a knife and a spoon to eat our meals. The Pork Chop was overcooked and dry. They poured my partner more wine and not anyone else at our table. It was quite embarrassing! Not surprised by the lake of service and food. Last time we were there they missed the mark... but truly hoped it would have been better this time.  Go to FAZ next door.  They are much better!!

Nice restaurant for a special occasion. The waiter was very professional and prompt. Appetizer (fried ravioli) was a little higher priced than seemed to match with the quantity (only 3 ravioli) but the drinks were good and we enjoyed our entrees.
Great food and great service.
Very good food and courteous service - best balanced avocado toast

Delicious food for every course and amazing service. A well oiled machine in terms of spacing courses. I said the words “ I can’t believe it but I think I’m ready for dessert” and under 10 seconds later it was in front of me. A great Valentine’s Day treat!

We always enjoy Bridges, however this Valentines was quite a disappointment. Different menu, with prices nearly double, polite but inattentive service & an unavailable menu entree that was replaced with a cold entree that had to be replaced , somewhat ruined our Valentines celebration.
Anniversary plus Valentine’s Day

Service was terrible. It took a half hour to get a cocktail. The waitress tried to pull the cork out before she even had the corkscrew all the way in. She broke the cork. The bottle was a 96 Opus One.

She then Returned the bottle and there was wine all over the label as if she spilled it .I had the stuffed veal. The entree was cool to cold not good. We ordered Martinis dry they can out with Vermouth in them she had to remake them. It was terrible experience and to top it off it was  Valentines Day. We will not return and I do it recommend Bridges to anyone.
Best dinner I ever had at Bridges.  Perhaps one of the best dinners ever!  Great Valentine's Day dinner!

Bridges is one of our favorite restaurants.  I took my girlfriend there for Valentine's Day and we both had an awesome experience starting out with a great table, thanks to Lisa, the Manager. Nico, our server was great and our meals were amazing. I highly recommend Bridges Restaurant and will continue to frequent this fine dining establishment!!
Outstanding food!  Delicious & perfect.

Worse chicken sandwich ever, cooked in black grease. My wife and I have come here for dinner a few times, it’s was good. We were shocked with the quality of the lunch chicken sandwiches. Literally any fast food can make it better
Nico was on it. Great meal, great service on Valentine's day.
Bar seemed to be backed up so we got our cocktails with our salad. Wine by the glass? Tasted as if the bottle had been open a few days Food was great
Interesting but limited menu, not what would have fascinated us
The grilled prawn noodle salad is excellent. Inside or outside very pleasant dining.
Delicious food and good service. Perfect for a date

Always a treat to be at Bridges! 
My favorite "go-to"!
The iced tea was outstanding.  The turkey sandwich was nice and the Rolls Royce Burger was juicy and wonderful.

Always a great place for a business lunch. Food is delicious, servers are attentive and the atmosphere is relaxed. We sat inside because the patio was closed but we enjoyed the table and the view of the restaurant.
Bridges never disappoints. Solid and creative menu selections expertly prepared.  It’s been one of our favorite “go to” places for over 30 years.
Bridges never disappoints.  Great food and ambiance.

Bridges has the best burger and pulled pork.
The staff is welcoming and accommodating.
The favorite place to dine
I was very disappointed

Food was great. We liked our server. Lonyhei (maybe) however there were several mid communications - my date ordered tea with sugar. The tea came, and we had to ask for the sugar a second time. 
We ordered a side of mushrooms but they came long after the entree.
Then our plates were not removed promptly.  

The Mexican Shrimp was delicious!
Great service!
The food is always excellent!  Staff are attentive!  Lunch was so delicious!

We thoroughly enjoyed our brunch at Bridges.  The service was impeccable.  We were a group of 8, who had not been together in over a year.  The server(s) took great care of us, and then left us to chat, and chat, taking care to refill waters and coffees well beyond what most would have done!!  Great food, well prepared and presented well.  Thank you.

The sandwich was a sloppy tasteless fiasco,the birthday cupcake was dry,the server could not be found,when he could clearly see  my order was not edible,he did not offer to help or make it right? Why? becuz he was too pre occupied!!!!!! Terrible experience
Wonderful food and staff!

Bridges is a wonderful restaurant!
I always love bringing friends for a fabulous dining experience.

We had a family dinner with our kids from Hong Kong.  We all ordered from price fixe menu and the selections took care of all our needs.  Great presentation on all the dishes and we also had some great appetizers!  Bridges is one of my go to restaurants!
The Prix Fixe is a tremendous value with many choices.  Highly recommend

My husband and I wanted to have some romantic time since we have been so busy with work. I didn’t expect so many people there but it was packed. I made a reservation but the table was so small And it was in the middle of big crowd. It was extremely noisy and felt we were stuck between two big groups. I ordered salmon but it was not cooked well. I asked waiter to see and he said he would get a new one. We waited until my husband finished his dinner. In meantime a waiter didn’t stop by at all. The food was not good at all and the service was bad. No plan to visit again.

This is not my 1st visit to Bridges. The food and service is consistent. However, today i ordered the special, which was scallops with polenta. It wish I was told how much the "special" was. (I WILL ask in the future). The special was 4 scallops with some polenta for $38!!! That is way overpriced.
Another great meal, the only knock would be on the hostess not coming for us in the bar when the table was ready.
Very nice ambience.  Service is good and staff is friendly.
It's always a good place for lunch when you want excellent food and an atmosphere in which you can talk and hear others at the table!
Bridges is always good. I have never regretted a meal there, and service is always good, food delicious. A bit pricey but not for the value, esp if you do the prix fixe meal.

We arrived early, planning to sit in the bar. However they had our table ready, which was perfect, tucked in a corner near the windows overlooking the patio. There was a large, loud party in the first dining area that was a little disturbing. About 30 minutes into our dinner it seemed to quite down and my husband and I were able to enjoy our Anniversary and 1st date return to Bridges. The food was wonderful, cheese plate, wine, Thai Shrimp (amazing), Pomegranate Soy Half Chicken. We even had port and pana cotta.  And a shout out to Hanna for great service, suggestions and attentiveness. Thank you.

Excellent experience. Great service, food and drink. Fairly quiet as restaurant go these days so it was good for a romantic dinner. Missed the valet parking service they used to have or maybe it was just not there that night.

Tough to give a negative review to a restaurant I have enjoyed for years.  My dish, the Gouda gnocchi should be scrapped.  Nothing came together in that dish.  My wife’s dinner choices were very good as always.  If I ate here alone tonight, I would have awarded no stars.

PERFECTION. Made an early dinner reservation as this was our first time in Danville and wanted to scope locations first. We will certainly be back! From the second you walk in you realize something special is about to happen. Loved our walk about in Danville prior, cannot wait for our return. Thank you!
Great quiet lunch with friends.  All our food was very good and on time.  Drinks a bit pricey.  Only service flaw was we had to ask for refills on coffee.
Great place for special occasions.  Food,Service, Ambiance very good.
Sorbet dessert was disappointing but the main course and soup were very nice
Great spot
You can count on Bridges for a consistent, way above average dining experience.
Wonderful experience.  Keep up the high standards, it's wonderful!

My husbands birthday was made extra special by celebrating at Bridges.  Delicious food, knowledgeable and friendly waiter and a special birthday treat.
Thank you once again, Bridges!

As Bridges regulars, we treated a friend who had never been to Bridges to celebrate her retirement.  The waitress remembered us from a few weeks ago and even remembered our drinks of choice, offering them from memory.  The playfulness of the staff, knowledge of the food, willingness to make recommendations and her impeccable timing made it a perfect evening.  The waitress heard us talking about retirement and brought my friend a cupcake with a candle.  This outing could not have been any better.  Thank you, bridges!
This was perhaps my third visit to Bridges. Great service and delicious food. The only downside was the pineapple martini. Everything else was excellent.
Excellent food and service.
My spare ribs were very burnt and had to go back, but the replacement came back out quickly since there were only 5 entries on the menu for New Years. The food just wasn’t great for the price.

We go to Bridges every year for New Years (and often in between ☺️) and last year (2018) we were actually disappointed in the service!   Never before had we experienced less than excellent service.   Everything seemed rushed, somewhat disorganized and our server seemed unconcerned about his customers.  We weren’t sure we wanted to go again this year, but opted to do so - and EVERYTHING was exceptional!   Service was very well-balanced, carefully coordinated, and friendly and caring!   We don’t expect perfection, but we do go to Bridges for a fine dining experience, and were so happy that we had that for our New Year celebration!   And we are never disappointed with the food!
Service was too slow for a busy night.

New Years Eve
Very enjoyable evening. Loved the service and food

It was a fixed menu and they did not offer any chicken or steak was hoping to order filet.
Prices were too high. Ribs were $78 and cheese tortellini was $58.
I would never go back.
New Year’s Eve

Love the special event menus that Bridges offers...was here for Thanksgiving and came right back to celebrate New Years Eve.  Really enjoyed trying unusual offerings...The Octopus Squid Ink salad was absolutely outstanding, some of the best tenderest Octopus I've ever had. Quail was equally as tasty.  Got to sit in a different area this time and the noise level was SO much better.  Try to get seated on the main floor and not the area close to the entry.
Excellent Price Fixe dinner for New Years eve....always creative with menu offerings and tastes were amazing....

Been to Bridges before and food and service were good.  Tonight the server Ben made our experience horrible.  Celebrating 2 past birthdays and going into the New Year and didn’t ask if we were celebrating anything.  Heard him wish another table Happy New Year and didn’t do the same for us.  Food was good, but had to wait 20 minutes AFTER appetizers came out to order dinner, Ben didn’t want to wait for one party member and wanted to come back and take our order after already waiting 20 minutes, so we FORCED him to stay and take our order for fear of waiting 40 minutes to order dinner.  Asked for refills and party member waited OVER 30 minutes to receive the wrong drink and then had to go to the bar themselves to get the correct drink.  Didn’t offer us a dessert menu and we had to get it ourselves from one of the bussers.  Asked for lemon wedges and never came back and again had to yell at another busser who brought it back right away.  Late party member waited over 5 minutes because no one was at the front to greet her.

If you’ve never been, make sure to NOT have Ben as your server if you want to be disappointed.  Really need to screen better when hiring servers as they are the front line to your business.

Our lunch at Bridges was wonderful...the cream of cauliflower soup, the hot pastrami sandwich and the flat iron salad were all excellent. 
As always the service was outstanding , we will be back soon!!
Christmas Eve was wonderful!!!

1. We were not informed when making the reservation that it was 1 price to include 3 courses.
2. I ordered my steak medium and it came rare. I sent it back but by the time it returned nearly every one was finished eating.
3. The whole meal was way overpriced. $75 for a rib eye steak is ridiculous. Even if it does include 2 other courses.
Especially since mine and my son’s steak were very fatty even for a rib eye. The steak should have at least been a NY strip.
4. No offer was ever made to mitigate any of the above.
An excellent Christmas Eve dinner!

Food was fabulous! Starter was the wrapped Brie with the apple jam! We’d ordered the salmon with the strawberry salsa, my sister ordered the Mexican prawns and I had the gnocci with cognac cream. Dessert we shared the chocolate frangelico cake with espresso cream. While the menu has changed, the quality of the food has stayed consistent. 
The restaurant was a bit louder but it may have had to do with the general holiday revelry. Ben was a great server who we’d request next time.
ok place, food is average, service was poor, could be due to the waiter serving way to many tables, won't go back
Wait staff was amazingly helpful with the food, beverages, and taking photos for our party.

I was there for lunch the week before Christmas and ordered the fried chicken sandwich which was a thin filet heavily-breaded. It was dry and overcooked. I would have gotten a better sandwich at a fast-food place. I really want to love Bridges and I’ve been here numerous times and usually leave disappointed.  The food varies from OK to awful.  There is a very nice courtyard and it’s in a nice area with parking. It fits a good niche for friends getting together.  Menu is pricey, food is pretentious and it’s expensive.
Great food  but needs more choices.  After the holidays hopefully it will not be so noisy!
Always a great experience. We have been dining at the bridges for 19 years. Wonderful food and the service is always off the charts. My lamb shank was amazing.
Ordered a dessert and it was pathetically tiny for $9!
Consistently good food & service.  A little bit noisy due to the holidays but overall excellent.

The private party ruined our party. When we arrived, the noise level from the cocktail hour of a private party was so loud we had to shout at the host. Our table was in the middle of the restaurant adjacent to the kitchen but the noise was overflowing from the large private party. We could not hear ourselves to even have a conversation and then the party gave speeches and there was laughter and applause. At this point, I complained to the host and the manager came by to apologize and offer to comp a round of drinks. We had nice appetizers of a cheese plate and another of brie in a pastry shell....very nice and well served. The meals were served promptly and we all well presented and hot. I had the lamb shank that was delicious, others had the prawns and another had the salmon. Everyone liked their meals. The only special was an eight-ounce fillet that was disappointing and didn't look like it started as eight ounces. We had some carrot cake for dessert that was rather gummy and uninspiring.
Lunch for 6 was very good. Sergio, our waiter, did an excellent job at a busy time.
We had a wonderful dinner with good service.  It was quite loud, but it’s the holidays, and they hosted many holiday parties that night!!!
Ben is the best!!

Main course was served not to liking of one of our party. It was returned with request that it be cooked to medium rather than rare.  After long wait it was finally returned with no change whatsoever.  Wait staff's only response was to apologize. Large disappointment after many many delightful meals at Bridges.  Something seems to have changed and it's not good
Phenomenal experience for a holiday date with a loved one. Full course meal, beautiful decor and exceptional service.
Had dinner before the Liz Grant Comedy show at Village Theater
The salmon dish was stunning

We had a work Holiday luncheon for 15. The menu was scripted just for our party which was fabulous. Our table was against the wall so it was out of the way to not interfere with  other diners. The waiter was also fabulous. Very attentive. The food was delicious (as expected). We had a special event cake dessert that the staff cut for us along with champagne. They even took Holiday photos of our group for us. A great time was had by all! Everyone enjoyed the luncheon immensely.  Thanks to Bridges for accommodating us!

Our evening would have been perfect if we were seated in a more quiet section of the restaurant.   Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience.  We received excellent service from our server Lon Ray (?).  For starters, we enjoyed the Adelsheim Pinot Noir , and a generous portion of shrimp/pork lettuce cups.  The braised lamb shank was delicious and tender, (although we weren't too fond of the starchy pudding underneath it) and the filet mignon was seasoned perfectly.  Chocolate mousse dessert was excellent and the complimentary birthday cupcake was a very nice touch.
Great meal! Met every expectation.
The waitress was very knowledgeable about the menu.
Great everything.

very good food and nice rooms with comforting atmosphere.
Good service.

We celebrated Thanksgiving with family in another state earlier in November and found ourselves alone for the Thanksgiving holiday. Although we did miss family, the new experience of not cooking and instead lounging, watching movies, and preparing to decorate for Christmas was a wonderful good time. It was a simple drive to a fabulous meal and then no clean up! The food was truly delicious...and I really didn't miss leftovers...much.
Fabulous!  Great service.
My company was good I enjoyed the food and the wine
Seating a little cramped, but service and food exceptional. Even after the meal, it was certainly noticed that all employees directed a smile and a “thank you” for coming, on our way to the exit.

Bridges often times gets lost in the Danville hubbub of brand-new and "exciting" restaurants. This is a shame because even though it is not the latest, greatest, newest Danville restaurant, it is, by far, the most consistent and special restaurant in Danville. Carefully prepared and presented entrées and correctly and deliciously made cocktails. The atmosphere is comfortable and relaxed whether you sit indoors or out. Always a great choice.
Delicious food. Lousy two desserts.

We requested a quiet table as we have two hearing impaired people. We were seated in a quiet table location but shortly there after a large party of men was seated right next to us and we couldn’t hear our conversations at all after that. My husband and I ordered the lamb shank which was so tough and flavorless that we could hardly eat it. It tasted like it had been reheated and was quite leathery in texture. I wish I could speak better of bridges because our community needs good restaurants and at one time Bridges was among them. We will not be revisiting soon
Such a calming atmosphere at Bridges. The food was excellent, thanks Kevin Gin!
Poor service. Had to ask for water twice, ask for bread once and call the busboy over twice to remove dishes.  Food was so-so and took forever on a Thursday night.
A most enjoyable dining experience with fine food and attentive service.  We plan to return on a regular basis for a fine meal.

Birthday celebration 
We had the salmon and Mexican shrimp dishes. Both were excellent.
The ambiance is still very appealing, the service is as expected, but the food quality was disappointing. Particularly in view of the prices.
Music was a little loud but everything else was perfect

We were the only ones seated outside, so, it was very quiet. Service was attentive and super friendly while still professional. We started with the brie, which was delicious. My husband had the lamb shank and I had the salmon. They surprised us for our anniversary with a chocolate cupcake for dessert. Wonderful experience. We'll be back!

Neighborhood Gem with live music on the patio, during the warmer evenings. We enjoyed the music and atmosphere. My husband really enjoyed his steak dinner. Steer clear of the shrimp and pork lettuce cups. The pork was ground up and was dry. Very disappointing.
The menu is a bit limited but always very good.  Their patio seating is enjoyable.

Soup delicious
Chicken dish had so much garlic it burned our mouths
Muddle of flavors on dish under chicken,
Not sure what it was
Special request ignored 
Waiter disappeared after main course, had to flag him
Down to get check (abandoned idea of dessert and coffee since it took so long to find waiter)

Used to be much better.
Celebrated my husband’s birthday at Bridges. We enjoyed the Shrimp & Pork Lettuce Cup appetizer, salmon, pork chop and Thai shrimp entrees and sorbet and s’mores chocolate desserts!

The reservation process was undeniably simple and there was no wait for our table. We did seem to wait for quite a awhile for initial service contact. Once this began our meal presented was quite good. The Hemingway cocktail was splendid.
The food is always perfectly cooked and fresh. Ingredients are blended together carefully, creating unique dishes that would be hard to replicate at home- making the dining experience unique.
Great food, great service!
We sat in the patio area and it was terrific!
The three of us had a lovely lunch. Our waiter Ben was very attentive and personable. Our food was great and we had an overall nice time at lunch.
This was our first visit. Service and good were excellent. It was a pricey lunch. Had glass of wine soup, salad special, dessert and coffee. However we would go back again. Perhaps try dinner.
Birthday celebration
Birthday lunch was excellent
The food was excellent, but this is my second visit where the service was terrible.

Dined for brunch just as the restaurant was opening on Sunday. The lights flickered a few times as our area has been impacted by heavy winds and power outages. The staff was attentive, not skipping a beat! Such a positive vibe. Our meal was divine!
Consistently good food, good service. Everything is fresh, good flavors, nice to see the expanded selection for vegetarians, great place to celebrate special dates.
Bridges has consistent quality and I enjoy bringing guest here to experience a good meal and great service.
Dinner was good but service was fair.   Ambiance was quite nice.   Delightful spot to eat.
Food and service were just okay.  The noise level was too high to hold a conversation.  The wooden chairs get uncomfortable.  The dessert was weird.  Next time we'll go somewhere else.
One of my favorite places to meet a friend for lunch, especially on a day when we can eat outside. Delicious food and great service!
I loved the Mexican friend shrimp in Thai sauce over the fried noodles. One of the best things I've ordered anywhere in a while!

It's our second time back to dine at this restaurant. The first time was for lunch. We loved the food and service. I took my family there for dinner.  Everyone enjoyed the food and quiet atmosphere. My wife loved the lamb shank. All loved our server's service was excellent. Definitely recommend this place.
Great dinner time

I love the food. Always have had a great meal. Today i asked for the pork chop prep but with salmon and not the the chop. They are accommodating ! Meal was delicious. 

Happy and friendly staff too.
The noise level was uncomfortably loud. We almost didn't stay to keep our reservation, but the hostess found a different table for us which was somewhat quieter, but not much.
Food was okay...not as tasty as I remembered the dishes being a couple years ago. Service is very friendly and attentive.
Lunch with a friend
Good place for business

We were early so the room was about half full, very quiet.  as we left the crowd was beginning to arrive.   The service was a bit slow, diffidently not fast food, but what's the rush?  Waiters great, food terrific, ambiance wonderful.

I went there Sunday morning.  There was a guitar player who was very good.  The ambience was very good.  I had the sirloin lamb poached egg breakfast.  My poached egg came as a hard yolk poached egg.  The waitress saw it and realized immediately.  She took it back.  She credited us for three coffees as compensation.  It's unfortunate a restaurant like this must credit coffee after making such a basic mistake on poached eggs.  The chef should be fired for such poor control of the kitchen.  The restaurant across the parking lot named Harvest was packed compared to a mostly empty Bridges.  I think I understand why.

My wife and I regularly eat at Bridges and have not been overly impressed with their recent menu items. That was not the case on our most recent visit. The Atlantic Salmon with Fresh Strawberry Salsa was a standout as was the Big Eye Tuna with Apricot Teriyaki on a bed of kimchi fried Himalayan red rice. The kimchi rice had subdued heat which enhanced the flavor of the barely cooked tuna. Our salads were also excellent as was the Smores dessert.
Amazing place for a date night. Great food, good wine, and just a great atmosphere.
Our service was fantastic! The restaurant was ready and prepared for our date night dinner!
Thé food was delicious as always, but thé service was terrible.  We waited an hour and a half for our entrées.
Bridges continues to be one of our favorite places to eat in the area. The food/menu is  interesting, well plated and always over delivers on taste.
Birthday dinner. Their reputation precedes them.
Great place. good food and great service. Nice vibe..
Great cocktails, wine, food and service. We had a wonderful evening!
Bridges is one of my favorite restaurants in Danville.  The service and food are excellent and always consistent.

Celebrated a birthday luncheon for a friend.  Our waiter Nicco was fantastic.  He made sure our order was as we requested and allowed us to sit and chat together without constantly asking if there was anything else we needed.
Food as always was delicious.  I had the special salad for the week.  Yummy!
Good food though a bit on the expensive side. Lovely setting and great service. Will visit again for other special occasions
Food was great and ambiance very pleasant

Food was very good but what I wanted was no longer on the menu. Service was great but a little slow for the first course. It was a 6PM Saturday night reservation so an earlier reservation or another night might have been better. Still, it's one of the best restaurants around.

Wooden chairs were highly uncomfortable.  We were seated next to a very noisy family, which made it hard to converse with each other.   We were disappointed by the menu--not many choices--and by the food.  Our waitress was great.
Another great dinner with great service.     Love that the menu is updated and current with fresh new items.
Food was tasty but pork chop could have been more tender and shrimp and sauce was colder than the noodles. Would have liked the plate to be cooked at all the same temperature.
Friendly staff good service limited food
Haven’t been to Bridges in a few years but it’s just as good as always.  Food, service and patio guitar player were all outstanding!!
Love the ice tea.  Always great food and service.  Love this place.

Met a friend, who I had not seen for many years, for dinner.  We sat outside and it was perfect!  The atmosphere was calm and the noise level was perfect for visiting.  My friend had the Vietnamese Pork and Shrimp lettuce cup appetizer and I had the Seared Bigeye Tuna and Pickled Watermelon along with the Mixed Baby Greens salad.  Everything was delicious and perfect portioning for people with smaller appetites.
Excellent service...let us sit there and visit as long as we wanted!
The service was slow, it took half a hour to get our bill.
The Saturday evening crowds overwhelmed the service staff, who were obviously working hard.  More staff is required if they're going to seat so many people outside.

Host was rude but everyone else was nice and food was decent. My friend enjoyed the avocado toast but my peach casserole had a weird texture and I wish I'd had ordered something else. Our server was very sweet.

The service was fantastic.  
The prawns with noodle cake was fabulous. Always our first choice. The salmon special with strawberries was delightful.
The singer on the patio was great.we were surprised that we needed heaters on the patio, and they worked perfectly.  
Overall another wonderful date at Bridges!

We love Bridges and that's why we chose it to celebrate my husbands birthday.  However it went completely unrecognized by the staff.  I saw a desert with a candle and thought it was ours, but out to another table it went.  The food was delicious as always, but thought they dropped the ball on the celebration.  Kinda ended the meal on a disappointing note.
Consistently amazing.  Great food, great service and great ambience

Bridges did a wonderful job for my wife’s Birthday Dinner...! Enjoyed a quiet table on the patio...Great lettuce cups, mushrooms, and risotto for Apps. We tried the prawns, salmon and Ahi for main course, all were excellent. Emma was our server and did a spectacular job. We will definitely be back for our next special occasion.
Love this place in every way 😉 love the scotch coffee drink 😀

Sat outside on the patio, really nice plus live music
The food was good not great
Beautiful night on the patio with great music, not too loud. Both the halibut and sturgeon specials were off the charts! Great service all around. Perfect way to celebrate our anniversary.

Bridges never disappoints myself and my guests.
It’s a perfect place to bring friends.
Food and staff amazing!

Sarah was the server and was excellent! Lisa the manager always assures this restaurant is running smoothly. 
We dine here more than any other local restaurant. They continue to deliver excellent service, delicious food and a 5-Star dining experience!

The service was great. Very friendly and welcoming.  The kitchen on the other hand- food took forever to come out, our server was continuously apologizing. When our courses finally came they were bland and seemed to have been sitting for a long time. 
Would not dine here again
Was a disappointment for an anniversary dinner.
Love love love Bridges. Their patio is so relaxing!

I recently had a monthly group dinner and also celebrated an early birthday dinner with friends at Bridges.  We try to go to a new restaurant every month.  The restaurant was quiet, not sure if it was because a lot of customers were seated outside on the patio or that it was a Thursday night.  Everyone commented that the service and food was excellent.

Bridges is always 5 star!!
Perfect place to brings your 
Friends and family!
Still at the top of their game:  inventive, fresh, and consistently excellent.

Stars would be closer to 3.7. Waiter personality was great but wine menu knowledge lacking. Food was meh. Pork chop was not flavorful. Swordfish was decent but not killer. 
Outdoor ambiance quite pleasant with a wonderful live singer. 
For the money, expected a little more in value. Will go back maybe in the future; worth a second look.

Sat outside and table next to us was a party of approx six who were quite loud.   Was distracting until music started which helped overcome the noise of that family.   Overall experience was great.   Service was very good.   Food was just ok.   Had the swordfish and it was served a little cool for my liking.  We still like the place and will return but feel it is a little pricey for the quality of the food.
The food was wonderful & the server was even able to accommodate a special request for a vegan entree. Service was excellent.

Ordered the Vietnamese por and shrimp appetizer, it was dry and lacked pizzas. The wines were $15 per glass. The grilled swordfish was good as was the kale Caesar salad. The dessert was a caramel créeme brûlée which was good, the double espresso had a nice aroma.  

Th reputation of Bridges exceeds the experience. Will not return.

We went to Bridges to celebrate our anniversary. I had never been, but had heard great things. While initially the service was good, things became disappointing when our main meals arrived. My salmon was quite raw and my son's tuna did not taste fresh at all. The two other meals, Halibut and Ribeye, were quite good. Even though I immediately sent my plate back, my new fish plate was not returned until everyone else had finished their food. To his credit, our server, did not charge me for my plate. I think the problem was in the kitchen..  Not sure I'll return.

As usual our food was excellent!   But the whole dining experience was marred by our waiter.  He pretty much did disappearing acts throughout and seemed terribly bored.  This is the first time we have had this happen and usually have a wonderful meal at Bridges.
Great food and nice ambiance .Always happy to go there
Nice hostess and waiter

Everything was decent/fair. However, I experienced sniffling, sneezing, allergy attacks throughout dinner from sitting near the dusty window ledges. Not quite what I had in mind dining at the restaurant made famous by the movie, Mrs. Doubtfire. I had hoped for exceptional cleanliness and something at least equivalent to (in food deliciousness and confidently excellent service) my favorite Danville spot - The Peasant & the Pear. The only dish that tasted really good here at Bridges was their Porcini Mushroom Ravioli. Will not return here for dinner but possibly for their happy hour/bar food, which seemed to be popular judging from everyone outside on the patio area.
Carefully prepared entrees, extremely attentive, but not overbearing service. Excellent Baby Kale salad.
Outside dining is divine!
Totally shocked by the poor service. The four of us have not seen such bad service in some time.
They need fans on the patio in warm days also ask pianist to play soft background... not time for a concert😖
Excellent meal! TV show “Check Please” was spot on. Highly recommended.

We asked for a quiet table, and they accommodated.
We both ordered the Mexican Prawns.
As usual, they were excellent.
Glasses of Trig Merlot were very good.
Friday night is our dinner date night - 
we often dine at Bridges.
Loved everything.  Outside music is always too loud.
Very nice experience. Our server Briann was on top of it!
Terrific lunches outside on the patio. Great service. Courteous, knowledgeable staff and reasonable prices. Did I mention the delicious food?
We love Bridges it’s one of our favorite restaurants here in Danville totally would recommend to anyone.

Thank you to Bridges, the staff and our waiter, Ben, for making our anniversary very special.  We enjoyed a bottle of champagne, a wonderful charcuterie/cheese plate, the soup was excellent and our entrees were amazing.  They even surprised us with a small dessert for our special occasion. Again thank you so much. We plan on returning soon.
Nice Sunday lunch on the patio. Leisurely pace, excellent service and really good quality food.

Our dinner last Saturday evening was one of the best that we have ever enjoyed at Bridges.  There were four of us, and each of our meals was excellent.  Our server was charming - even though she was very, very busy.  It was a truly enjoyable evening out with friends, thanks to Bridges.
Our server was phenomenal. Cheery, attentive. Love the way the wait staff help one another get the entire party served at once.  Great teamwork!!

Inside seating area was very very loud. The outside area with musical entertainment seemed nicer. Our only problem was that we were told we would be charged extra for a substitution of a vegetable with an entree. Unusual rigidity for a California restaurant.
Always a great meal at Bridges. Very underrated restaurant in Danville. Professional staff and high quality food
We had the mixed green salad, vegetable soup, with the swordfish, and halibut entrees. All were excellent!  We can always count on Bridges for a fresh and creative meal. It is a neighborhood jem.
A lovely place to enjoy a leisurely lunch. Great ambience, adequate service and acceptable food.
our server was incredible ... the manager was awesome!
The food was delicious, the service was spot on, the cocktails were excellent and the ambiance was fabulous.
Great foood wonderful atmosphere outside with live music!

Situated in the heart of Danville's quaint shopping district Bridges did not disappoint even with my higher expectations. Wonderful wine selection. Our wait person was friendly and made us felt unhurried. Food presentation was good and the food taste was to the T. Great overall visit despite getting an unsigned handwritten nastygram by someone who decided where I parked wasnt to their liking despite no signage to the contrary. I parked in the designated Bridges lot.  At least they had good diction and penmanship skills!
Not as good as it has ben in the past. Food and service has slipped.
Dinner with Friends on the patio. What a nice experience with live music on the patio. Excellent service and nice wine choices. This is our new summer patio go to.

The risotto starter was excellent, some of the best I've had.  The starter salads were good and very generous - enough to share.  The pork chop entree was very good, the chicken entree was okay, but not great.  Sarah, our waitress, was fabulous.  One of our diners was late for our reservations and Sarah was very accommodating about the delay.  She was quietly aware of our needs before we even had to ask.  On our way out I passed on compliments about Sarah's service to the restaurant Manager.  The Manager shared Sarah had only been with them a month.  Great asset to their staff!
Great food, great location, great service, great price. Will go back for sure.

Bait and switch situation! Received text stating "Happy House from 5pm -closing". However, they never stated that it was only in one section. We were seated in a dining only section (could not order from the Happy Hour menu). Terrible stressful situation. I will never go back or recommend this restaurant.
Always a great place for dining. One of the best patios in the East Bay.
The food was great service not good. We had to flag down the waiter several times. We were there for 2 and 1/2 hours just for lunch. Should have been around 1 hour.
The food was great and the ambiance very nice. The service was a little slow and lacking, but the food made up for that!
Lovely place to have a delicious brunch and listen to beautiful guitar music. Sitting on the patio was possible in the heat due to ample tables in the shade. Will be back soon.

Our food was excellent. My wife ordered the ravioli’s and I ordered the gnocchi. My gnocchi had spring vegetables which were super refreshing and a nice twist and it was a nice quantity of food. My wife’s ravioli’s were also delish. The truffles were really nice but not overwhelming. The dish also had  a very nice quantity of food as well. There must’ve been 8-10 large sized raviolis altogether. We had a salad and a glass of wine as well and our bill came to $75 altogether so I feel everything was very reasonably priced as well too.

Lisa, the manager, is incredible and one of the hardest working managers I have ever seen.  She’s answering the phone for reservations, walking around making sure everyone is happy.  Helps out her staff by waiting tables, ensuring that the restaurant is running smoothly.  Bridges is one of our most favorite restaurants, we will definitely be going back!
Great place to have our anniversary dinner. Well taken care of. Food and service great.
Great ambiance, excellent food and nice presentation!
Our First Times in Bridges Restaurant - we went there because of the movie Mrs. Doubtfire. Wounderful Evening, great to have been there.
Love bridges
We can always depend great food, great service and perfect ambiance!
EXCELLENT SERVICE, MOST WILLING TO PLEASE.  WE SHALL RETURN.

As always, we had a delightful luncheon  at Bridges. The patio ambiance was perfect and the Prawns with Noodles were wonderful as usual.  Our waiter Brian was attentive yet not obtrusive and the general manager Lisa was as welcoming as ever.  Highly recommend for an outdoor luncheon on a beautiful day!

Great food in a very pleasant setting. The outdoor area is also lovely.
Highly recommended
Great food and nice service.
My favorite restaurant in East Bay!  Awesome ambiance and incredible food.

Our dining  experience was just what we were looking for to celebrate a special occasion. Ambiance was very nice, elegant setting but not too fussy. Waitstaff was very responsive, pleasant and helpful without being intrusive. A range of menu items gave everyone something they liked. Soup/salad course was especially tasty with a healthy salad and delicious mushroom soup. We dined comfortably indoors but outdoor dining looked very inviting. . . . next time. This would be a wonderful place to bring friends when you want to have a memorable night out.

We have been going to Bridges for years and their lunches and dinners are very good, however their Sunday Brunch was terrible.  The eggs were way overcooked and the waffles tasted like cardboard...And their "fried chicken" was something you would get at McDonalds..
The service was good which is the only reason we're giving it 2 stars.

Amazing service. I felt like family. The manager went out of his way to accommodate grandma who arrived early and needed help. Our server Sara was the kindest and most accommodating person I’ve interacted with. It was an amazing brunch and I would most definitely come here again. Highly recommend the patio and live music.

We enjoyed our evening w one exception , the noise level in the sit down bar area was extremely loud so we moved into
Our table sooner than expected. I doubt this can be helped... just a loud crowd. Other than that we had a lovely time; the meal was paced to our liking.. nothing rushed .. great food great service .
One small thing, would it be possible NOT to remove our plates until everyone is done w their meal.  It makes the other person feel they need to rush to finish their meal .
I ordered the New York steak medium, it was raw and did not eat it.

I’ve always given Bridges 5 stars across the board. We ordered, salads arrived quickly & were delicious. 45 minutes later we flagged down our waiter. Another 15 minutes & we had our entrees. Pork chop was lovely but the brussel sprouts weren’t done. We skipped dessert because it was so late.
Birthday luncheon. Good food and great service
Lunch date with my husband - always a special occasion! Bridges is one of our favorite restaurants because it is consistently overall excellent!

My wife had sturgeon; needed salt, which she never salts.

I had New York strip, ordered medium, but arrived very well done, and not a great cut.

Service was excellent.

We feel they are now living off their reputation.
Excellent as always. Tried the shaved Brussels sprout salad for the first time.  We all loved it.

Not what it once was. Admittedly I haven't been here for quite awhile. We were a party of 3 ordered halibut, steak and mushroom ravioli. Steak wasn't well seared and not prepared as ordered (asked for rare, was medium), mushroom ravioli was much too oily in presentation, also, bowl it was presented in had a noticeable chip on the rim, halibut was the best option of the three. There was a nice selection of wines by the glass, however, these were mostly ones I can easily purchase myself, many available at Costco; would have preferred to have a choice of wines not easily available.
Delicious seasonal menu!  Great Service!  Amazing wine and cocktail menu.  We went for dinner but happy hour was also happening at the same time and that looked amazing as well.

First time st Bridges in several years. Not sure why we haven’t been there in a while. Great happy hour but not enough wait staff. Sat outside; poor guy that was there was running crazy!  Food was fabulous! We are off the dinner menu and was pleasantly surprised at how tasty everything was. We’ll be back!

Our food was creative and tasty and attention was paid to my allergy.
Dining on the covered outside patio is a lovely experience with the surrounding landscaping and the fountain.
Sat outside, food and service good
Excellent especially the tuna over red rice with Korean Kim chi. Great service as well.
I love the private setting.  Wonderful experience for a business dinner. A lucky find on Yelp. Will be back and bring my wife.
We had a delicious meal. We were very disappointed in the uncomfortable chairs, the wood hit most of our backs and made us all uncomfortable. Quite surprising since everything else was great.
Wonderful birthday lunch for a special friend.  Our server really took care of us.

Beautiful restaurant. Good food and service....salmon salad excellent. However, my colleague ordered the Brussels Sprouts Salad and it had anchovies throughout! This was not stated on the menu. She did not return it because it was a business luncheon. She should have. Perhaps this ingredient  should be mentioned on the menu.
We had a wonderful waitress. She took several pics of us for our anniversary. Loved the Mexican asian prawn stir fry!!

We were disappointed they couldn't get my husbands Berger right he wanted well done he got med.well.than when he sent it back they put cheese and the Aioli which is mayonnaise based and my husband hates mayonnaise and requested no cheese he had to send his burger back twice and than he got it to go the 3rd. Time

Food was very good. Cocktails nice.  Quiet allowed nice conversation . Ambiance as always very nice.  Only down side was service was spotty and very slow, server inexperienced and did not follow up with offering more coffee and checking on us. Birthday cupcakes a very nice touch. Thank you.
Food was good, not spectacular. Menu was limited but had decent creativity. We say outside which was lovely at 7:45PM.
Awesome as usual!!
Korean lettuce cups superb. Mexican prawns delicious. Harissa chicken tasty but needs more harissa. Service attentive but slow. Really noisy - not like in Mrs. Doubtfire.
Sevice was great! Loved the patio. The singer on the patio was great!
Great food and great service!  Went for our anniversary and they surprised us with a cupcake to celebrate.
We went on a friend's recommendation and would be happy to pay that forward. Great evening!
Bridges has been on my short list of excellent restaurants for some time. Brian our waiter was just great.
Food was OK, not like I remember.  The chocolate Martini was a disappointment, but KAT rocked the service level.
Birthday. Had dinner outside.  There was music playing and it was very nice.
Great salads, tasty food...be ready for a pricy meal

Great food and attentive service.  We really enjoyed ourselves and although it was a little bit of a splurge, we felt the overall experience was well worth the money.  The birthday cupcake and creme brulee were excellent!

When we are celebrating our anniversary in town, Bridges is ALWAYS our choice.  Great in every way!
 We just celebrated our 49th and were pleased that the management recognized us on our special day.
Food and service is consistent.  Excellent service and food.

Great patio for lunch. Food very good. Service perfect   
Always enjoy outdoor dining at Bridges. Will be visiting again soon

Food wasn’t good. My soup was the worst Ive ever had. The waiter never came back to check on our meal in fact he disappeared so I had no opportunity to send back and order something else. Everyone who ordered a fish entree was disappointed as it was all over cooked. We won’t return to Bridges again.

MY HUSBAND AND I WENT THERE FOR OUR 25TH WEDDING ANNIVERSARY.
THE STAFF WAS AMAZING.  
THE MANAGER SENT OVER A CAKE WITH ONE PINK AND ONE BLUE CANDLE IN IT AND A MASSAGE SAYING HAPPY 25TH ANNIVERSARY
Yfliygiygiyy

Had an enjoyable dinner there for Father's Day. It was annoying that there were only two fish options and both of them were entirely sold out by 7 PM. They did a good job of working with my mother-in-law's allergies and the service was pretty prompt and friendly. Unfortunately, the steak that I ordered was mediocre with a fair amount of gristle and uneven interior temperature. Overall, it was a pleasant evening and I'd like to return to try their regular menu.
The only negative was the insect that kept floating around our inside table. But it is to be expected on a warm night with all the windows open.

The Fathers Day Brunch menu selection was rather disappointing, from the appetizers down to the dessert.  Totally not worth the price.
Though weve been dining here occassionally, it was our first Fathers Day brunch with them and was really not satisfied. They should have offered their regular menu as another option to choose from. 
To sum it all, after the meal we all wished weve gone somewhere else.
Not worth it, the choice of desert was very bad for a 3 course meal on Father’s Day . I would not spend $250 for party of 4 and not have a decent desert menu .

Most of the service people were outstandingly accommodating and enthusiastic.  I would say that the hostesses could have been a bit more friendly and welcoming.  For example, when I asked if it would be possible to switch to outdoor seating, one of them sort of "huffed," and said "We will do our best."  She was obviously not thrilled with the request. And yet  there was ample seating outside.  The table next to us didn't even become occupied until we were almost ready to leave.  Our waiter, however, was outstanding -- a really nice and helpful young man. The other really helpful and happy person that stood out was the gentleman who takes care of getting the heaters place by the tables.  He was great. I had jokingly told him that my cousins who were with us were weather "wimps" from LA. He was amused but then went out of his way to get us TWO heaters. :-)
I go to Bridges often for lunch meetings and dinner engagements. Great menu, great atmosphere, and the service is excellent.

Terrible!  Service was horrible even though our server mentioned she had only two tables.

Food only so so.

Mugs dirty as replaced only to have the replacement mugs to arrive dirty.  When pouring the tea from the teapot, a bug comes out.  Requested new tea.  The original teapot remained on the table.  Then to add insult we were charged for two pots of tea.

Terrible all around.

The best part of our experience was the young man who replaced the tea cups.  He was embarrassed.

I have eaten at Bridges many time and it has never been unacceptable.

Very nice lunch outdoors on the patio.  Had the Big Eye tuna poke bowl, which was well-presented, fresh and  a nice mix of vegetables and mango. My dining partner had the daily special, an arugula salad which she enjoyed. They provided a nice complementary chocolate cupcake with whipped cream and raspberry sauce for her birthday, which was appreciated. Service was attentive without being intrusive, and the setting makes for a relaxing leisurely meal together. Well done!
Mrs Doubtfire fans from the UK. Came for the 90s nostalgia, left having had a v nice meal and pleasant evening! Fairly pricey but then it is Miranda Hillard’s favourite restaurant.
Birthday lunch

On an exceedingly uncomfortable, hot day, we were most comfortably cool inside the restaurant, next to a window overlooking the shaded patio.  The service was superb, the food excellent (one seafood cioppino with side salad, one hot pastrami sandwich with accompanying salad).  The salad accompanying the sandwich was about the same, large, size as the salad ordered as a side with the cioppino.  Both were excellent.   My memories of notable pastrami sandwiches in the past (Tommy's Joynt in the 1950s, the Stage Deli in the 1960s) have faded far too much for comparison; but to me the Bridges' version was just fine-- I thoroughly enjoyed it.
We always experience excellent service, food, ambience, and it's easy to book reservations via OpenTable.  The staff follows up the day before to call and confirm, just in case . .
Love your patio!  And the prawn noodle salad!!!
I love the Ahi Poke Bowl. It’s perfect and I order it almost everytime.

I always enjoy coming to Bridges.  This time was on a Monday night so it was a little quieter but there are occasions when I think the noise level gets pretty intense. The service is always excellent I do  enjoy the food but this time I ordered the salmon and I tried to describe how I wanted it cooked but it still arrived too
well done.  I also thought that the seasonings on the vegetables it’s sat on was a little overwhelming. I probably won’t order the salmon again.

Please, please get rid of the hard wooden chairs in the back dinning area. I had to go to my car for a pillow and still was vary uncomfortable. Nearly ruined an otherwise pleasant experience. My dinner mates agreed.

Special good bye dinner! Saying farewell to an old friend moving back to Mississippi.And as always Bridges consistent good food, atmosphere and service gave us a good meal and a special dessert to celebrate!!!

While I was expecting the lunch menu for Saturday at 1pm, the brunch menu was lovely and satisfied everyone in my party.  The $4 mimosas are a steal and the shrimp noodle salad had to come home with us because it was so large and tasty.  The pork hash was a little on the small side but flavorful.  The avocado toast was perfect size and delicious.  It was nice to sit outside and enjoy the music.

We went to Bridges with our family for my husband’s birthday. The food was delicious and the service, excellent. We sat near the patio and the weather and setting were lovely. The only drawback was the noise. We couldn’t really hear each other talking across our table for six but it was still a fun celebration.
We went for a date night and loved it! Service was great and the food was worth the drive.
This was a very nice surprise.  I look forward to going back.
I rate the food, service & ambience a solid ‘10’!

Lovely atmosphere, waitress was friendly and attentive. Great variety on the menu.  Parking nearby. Choice of inside or outside dining.
I enjoyed the pastrami sandwich. Very tasty and not overwhelmed with huge chunks of bread. The French fries were crispy and hot. The waitress kept my ice tea replenished.  Perfect!
The waiters were too obtrusive, interrupting important conversations on every approach.  Then brought the bill before we had decided on dessert.  Very young and amateurish.
Bridges used to my favorite restaurant.No more the last experience the food was was over cooked . Service was slow and neglectful. My meal had no flavor .
Very nice dinner.  Tuna was amazing.  Highly recommend
You guys need more variety in the menu. Same menu in recent memory. The lettuce cups were excellent but give us some new entrees. Please !!!!
Loved the cocktails, dinner was delicious and the dessert was a knockout. Good as usual. I miss the dessert sampler from years ago but still eat here often.

Bridges is the best restaurant in Danville.
Always enjoy bringing out of town guests.
Never disappoints.

We had Ben as our server and he was wonderful! He made our lunch so pleasant and fun. We look for him whenever we are dining at Bridges.  Our food was great. We brought friends who had never been there before and they loved it!

Had Margaritas in bar until restaurant opened, bar service was excellent as were the Margaritas. Had requested a booth if available, we were seated at a table next to windows facing the patio, which was a nice bright table in a semi dark dining room. We started with a Mushroom Risotto appetizer, which was very good. My wife ordered the Halibut special dish which  she enjoyed very much. I ordered the New York steak which was served with a Horseradish Crema which I did not care for so I scraped off as much as I could. The steak was very tender and came medium rare as ordered. The steak could have been more favorable, maybe that's why it's served with the Crema sauce. Our server was excellent. We noted on our reservation that we were celebrating our Anniversary, but no mention was made nor was there any small dessert offered as a gift.
We had to move our table because of a group that was a little loud and Bridges was wonderful and accomadating.
Good food, great service. Cool to dine at the same location Mrs. Doubtfire was filmed.

Bridges always delivers an excellent experience. Brian, our server, was phenomenal, fun, and attentive. Our party of four really enjoyed the flavors of the various dishes. Since it was raining, the inside was packed so the noise level was higher, yet we really recommend Bridges for creative dishes and first class service. Thanks Brian for making our evening very special!
As usual, Bridges did not let us down. The staff and service made our special celebration even more special. Thank you, again, Bridges!!!!

My husband wasn't too sure about coming because he's often not impressed with menu's around Danville, but wow was he happily surprised!  From beginning to end the service, food and ambiance was great.  The creativity on the menu was better than expected and very tasty.  Our server was both knowledgeable and attentive.  Good value as well.  We will be back!
This place is great for celebrations and very comfy , I love the Brie app delicious and the salmon yummy, and I love the fact Miss Doubtfire was filmed here ♥️
We had never been here before and decided to go for our anniversary.  It was a wonderful experience.  Both food and drink were top notch.  We will definitely go back again soon.

Bridges, as always, is a gem! Our server, Nicholas, was attentive and congenial. I had the grilled prawns with sesame noodles, and my friend had the poke bowl..both were delicious. That's why we keep going back!
Bridges is always enjoyable because the food is unique and delicious, the wait staff is very attentive and the noise level is low.

We had a wonderful brunch on mother’s day.
The short ribs were amazing.
I think it would have been even better if 1 glass of champagne was included.
Very enjoyable meal
Was a little disappointed with the chilled avocado soup and children’s brownie. The soup was bland and the brownie was gritty. Mocktails were delicious and service was prompt!

We went for mother's day brunch and it was a real delight. We sat outside and the weather was perfect. Very light music from a live singer/guitar player which was an added nice touch. The food was incredible and our server was attentive and accommodating. We had a lovely brunch!

I took my mother for Mother's Day brunch. The menu options were lovely.  The staff member made a few suggestions for lunch which we decided to follow.  Our drinks were delivered quickly, the entree presentation was fabulous and the food delicious!  Bridges never disappointments :)  We will go back again, and again, and again.  If you want consistently good food, great ambiance and wonderful wait staff, try Bridges.
Been going to Bridges for years. Great food, great service, lovely decor.
Great location with ample parking for guests.  Contemporary decor and live music the day before Mother’s Day.  Good brunch selection for discerning palates, including a kid-approved options.
Lisa is AMAZING for sure - I am a fan & will be back!

To say that Bridges was disappointing would be an understatement. The service was terrible with multiple mistakes made in serving the wrong foods to the wrong people with every course, having to ask for spoons twice for the soup courses, and very long wait for the food. Steak was tough, salmon was over done and food was not always hot. Shaved brussels sprouts salad was nice but not unique in any way.
The ambiance was terrible - there was a large party going on outside and all of the doors were open throughout the restaurant to facilitate the servers, but freezing out the customers. We struggled to find a table that was comfortable. 
The menu is uninspired and not well executed. I have been here twice and will not be back - Bridges is trying to be something that it is not (i.e. a gourmet, high end restaurant) and it succeeds only in the excessively high prices!!!

The wait staff was very professional and courteous and punctual. My five other friends enjoyed their main meal..My meal was terrible. Raw Brussel sprouts topped with dried chicken. We’ve ordered several cocktails mojitos mainly and each time they came out it was completely different there was no consistency whatsoever.
