Perfect place for dinner with good friends. Loved the patio dining.

Had our family and friends here (14) people to celebrate after I proposed to my fiancée. Delicious food, as usual. Friendly staff, as usual. Creative, fresh, 5 star menu, as usual. Bridges has been one of our favorite restaurants for the 6 years we've spent together and we'll continue coming here to celebrate special occasions for the rest of our lives.

Overall we we very pleased with our experience. I had the special which was the halibut. It was excellent. My boyfriend had the pork chop which he said was a little tuff but lesss tuff once he got to the center.  Dessert was excellent, I had rhe Ricotta cheese cake and my boy friend had the Meyer lemon cream brûlée.

I have been to thus restaurant 5 or 6 times.  I made a reservation for 7.15 last night. For 2.  We arrived around 7.18.  There were several empty tables.  The hostess said the table was not ready and would come back to get us.  It was at least 10 minutes and 3 other couples came in..  when the hostess did return she avoided eye contact with us and immediately seated the other parties who I don’t think had reservations.  She then disappeared again.  I asked another hostess why we were not seated and then she immediately seated us.   We were greeted by a waiter and ordered drinks.  We waited about 15 minutes fir the drinks after seeing the waiter take them to an outside table.  I had enough and got up to leave.

We were met by a courteous valet parking person. The host was nice and although we arrived early, we were seated immediately. Service and the food was great however the steak was a lil chewy and lacked flavor. Overall a great experience.
Lisa was AMAZING!
The evening was wonderful.  Food was very good and the service excellent.  large party that was rather loud came in toward the end of our meal.  Other than that is was  perfect

I never can say enough about Bridges.
It is always wonderful.
Food and service beyond words!!
We have always enjoy the food at Bridges.  The atmosphere is nice.  The service is excellent.

Quality food, the specials were swordfish and a beef fillet, which was outstanding, service was short and sweet, to the point, and polite, I would recommend to the establishment that they keep the swordfish on the menu, and recommend this spot to anyone who is looking for a romantic spot to go on a date. Valet was on point as well. All in all a great experience. Thank you!
The tuna appetizer was terrible. The fish tasted fishy and was not fresh. Sitting outside is nice.

Sat out on the patio.  Came home with numerous insect bites.  Waitress was somewhat pushy, got my order wrong with no apology or substitute. Water glasses were empty.  Prices were ok. I would be hesitant to go again. Menu is healthy oriented and somewhat hard to understand about adding things.  Not my top choice.
Bridges never disappoints. Love this place and we keep coming back!

As a party of 2 we ordered a salad and sandwich it took more than 45 minutes and we ended up having it to go. The restaurant is good but they were unable to staff or manage the kitchen with a large number of lunch tables
We had a lovely evening but when we got home, I saw that they had cancelled our reservation 1 minute before we were due to arrive. We did arrive on time.   ?????
Blind date

Bridges is both a great neighborhood and upscale restaurant.  The menu is diverse and interesting.  The happy hour in the bar (after 5pm, M-F) offers n ice value cocktails, wine and table treats.  We dined outside and totally enjoyed the setting as the restaurant is located a short block off Danville's main downtown street.  Our server was perfect.  We all commented that Bridges is a real restaurant with an everyday priced menu.....
We went there on Easter Sunday.....my bad.  It was a set menu and i am certain that the proteins sat under a heat lamp. fish was super dry. Service was excellent though

Overall the experience for an Easter Sunday was great.
We only saw our server to take our order and then give us our check.
Never asked if we wanted anything else, like coffee....
As it was Easter we did leave a 15% tip but we will remember her going forward as someone we don't want to wait on us. We have been here many times and never had this experience.

It is traditional for me to go out for a nice Easter brunch after church.  I am relatively new to the area but had heard good things about this place.  But my hopes of a nice Easter brunch were gone with this whole experience.

After being seated, I waited about 15 min. before anyone came by to take my order.  I started with the Bridges-Tini - a pineapple infused vodka with pineapple juice.  There was no taste of vodka in the drink so I basically got fruit juice for $14.  But.....I didn't get my drink until AFTER I had been served my 1st course of food.

The tri-color cauliflower was tasty, as was the almond cake for dessert.

Then I waited.....and waited....and then came the main brunch item.  It was the beef brisket hash with fried egg.  Instead of shredding the beef, they left it as small chunks.  But the chunks of meat were tough and not very tasty.

This place at 12 noon was not any busier than any other weekend day.  Also, for a place of this caliber, holidays should not be an excuse for poor quality food or service.  I was surprised that all of the chairs had hard seats.  This was not a relaxing experience for me because of that.

I was so disappointed in the quality of food, the poor service, and the high price (the food was NOT worth it) that I will probably never go back.  There are other fine dining options in the Tri-Valley area.

Limited and overpriced Easter Brunch menu that was not posted on their website. We were expecting their regular brunch menu that was posted on their website with similar price points since no special menu was listed. Quality of food and service not worth prices. We had limited alternatives once we arrived at restaurant.
thank you for an enjoyable lunch   servers were great and   family enjoyed our visit
friend visiting
Great place to dine!
Fantastic experience!
First time there, Bryan made me and my family feel welcomed. Outstanding service, very attentive. The fries went well with the edamam sauce.
Bridges never disappoints. Food and service are both outstanding.
Always reliable - we love this place!  Can't recommend highly enough!!

Excellent food and service. The swordfish special was outstanding. The steak dinner, which could have been so-so was the best meat thang we have had in a long time. The sauces were unusual but very nice.
Great ambiance, but the service was slow and our sever distracted.
Bathrooms need updating.
Best steak I had in a long time!

Service was friendly, helpful. It was early in the evening so there were not many people there yet- a beautiful day, there were a few more diners on the patio! Food was excellent and we could have really close and intimate conversation with friends we had not been with for a year. Would highly recommend. We had the special, Mahi Mahi, the salmon, excellent, and the chicken which was devoured! Nothing at all to complain about, we had a wonderful time!
We enjoyed the service and our entrees the best. Good wine selection too.

Nice restaurant and interior decors but they keep changing their menu (according to the waiter), so we couldn’t try what we wanted/saw via yelp photos... service was great! Staff was friendly. Food was ok. I’ll recommend this restaurant because of their service and ambience.
Bridges is our favorite "go-to" whether for lunch, brunch, happy hour or dinner. The staff is the best and it's always a terrific experience.

The Salmon was very good after my wife and I changed how it was cooked and presented. Just not
use to the different kind of sauce that the chef evidently liked to use.
Lunch was great in all ways. No negative issues at all.
Many very good options for lunch.  Reasonable prices and good service.  Easy parking with the new adjacent parking lot.

Overall, it was a nice, enjoyable evening. Weekday dinner - it was clear that they were understaffed, however everyone came together to help when needed. The hostess continued to help out on the floor which was nice as it kept our meal moving at times it had slowed. Meal was great and was nice to see that they had a kids menu (not advertised online that I could see). Everyone was friendly, courteous, and professional.
Great food. Everything had unique taste and was cooked to perfection. Service was excellent.
The food was all very nice and the service was friendly. We just felt forgotten for a good chunk of time.

Had date night with my husband and I’ve always wanted to try Bridges, and we were not disappointed!  Wait staff, food, and ambiance all top notch. Looking forward to coming back again when the weather is warmer so we can enjoy the large outside seating area.

Our waiter was excellent and remembered it was a birthday celebration with a beautiful cupcake and a "Happy Birthday" exquisitely written on the place with a candle on the birthday cupcake!!  The food was excellent and we have already recommended it to family and friends.

As always the food was excellent!!! Service was a bit slow...
But will always be back.

Our group of 20 out of state guests thoroughly loved the entire experience and amazingly delicious menu selection. The private seating was perfect for the ambience we were looking for. The service was outstanding and we would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone.

My wife and I went to Bridges for my birthday dinner.  Excellent food.  I had the swordfish that was tender, juicy and just delicious.  It was served on top of a generous portion of white beans and green - enough that I took 1/2 home and had for dinner the next night.  My wife loved her steak and also took home 1/2 of her potatoes and veggies.  The lemon creme brûlée's was fantastic.  The birthday cupcake was just OK

Was looking at venue for rehearsal dinner. Went twice to try food hoping it would match the ambience for the restaurant. It did not. Sad we will not have our event on the patio but the food did not impress, especially for the price.

Good brunch selection and competitively priced for the level of quality and selections.  Sadly, a little noisy due to our table being centered with larger table groups celebrating events.  No behavioral issues, just noise level a little high for easy conversation.  No a problem unique to Bridges, so not really a "knock" on the restaurant.  All in my party would return

Great food, pretty restaurant and the service was very good.  It was a birthday for one of us in our party and they served up a nice cupcake.  I think we all had a wonderful time and would recommend to others and would definitely go back.
We both ordered the Grilled Prawn Noodle Salad. Excellent. Our waitress was very attentive.

Took my mother and her guest out for her 89th birthday. Notified the restaurant in advance and asked, if they could, to have some sort of special acknowledgement for her. Got stuck in traffic and had to call to delay my reservation...it was no problem. We arrived and decided, since the air conditioner was on overdrive inside, to sit outside on the patio. Found a perfect partially sunny table and sat. My mother thought it was still a little cool and the server offered to turn on the heater behind her. We did so but it still didn't reach her. The server actually offered to move our table about a foot so that my mom could feel the heat. I was so impressed at how they continuously thought of ways to make my mother comfortable. So accommodating!! Ordered wine and prosecco and toasted her birthday while nibbling on the delicious warm bread. Our food came...shaved brussel sprouts salad with a couple of extra anchovies for mom, noodle salad with shrimp for her guest and the quinoa salad with salmon, asparagus and portabellas for me...all were delicious and just the right amount. We didn't eat; we dined; we savored. It was a wonderful, light atmosphere. Although there were other people on the patio the noise level was perfect and we hardly noticed them. Servers were available but didn't hover. After lunch, my mother's friend asked if we could order coffee, a sure sign they were having a great time and were in no hurry to leave. We never felt rushed. Right after we got our coffee, a server delivered the most beautiful plate to my mother. It had a wonderful and decadent chocolate cupcake with whipped cream, mini chocolate chips and candles. Also a couple of fruit syrups drizzled on the plate, as well...strawberry (delicious) and another one I couldn't identify...peach? mango? And in the most beautiful calligraphy, the words "Happy Birthday" were written in cocoa powder. It HAD to have been done with a stencil. It was too perfect! It was an awesome lunch. We had the best time!!
Great place to bring guests, impeccable service and warm surroundings make for a perfect setting to catch up over a leisurely lunch.  We love the patio in warm weather, too.

I had read so many reviews of Bridges which spoke of the great service and wonderful food.  Well, we go the wonderful food, but the service was poor.  We went on a Sunday night and I guess the manager thought they didn't need too many waiters.  Our person was all over the floor- who knows he might have been the only waiter!  Sounds like it is great on Friday or Saturday.  They do have great food!

I booked a table for a special birthday dinner for my 80 year old husband because having been to Bridges a number of times prior to this one, I'd had excellent meals.  This time I was sorely disappointed.  The food was mediocre - steak tough - strange combinations that didn't quite "make" it (it seemed as tho the chef was experimenting - it WAS a Sunday evening and not many patrons  - trying to come up with something interesting and different.)  I requested that my salmon be medium rare and it came very well done;  the sides were room temperature and not tasty.  I'm sorry that I'm being so negative and I'm more sorry that Bridges didn't live up to either my expectations or my previous visits.
Excellent!
We had a lovely afternoon with friends we had not seen in a long time. We had an early dinner reservation on a Sunday, perfect for conversation and catching up. The service and food were excellent!

Excellent, but needs to very their menu more.
The Siam lettuce cups Appetizer is outstanding!

Bridges is our family's go-to spot for celebrations!  Birthdays, anniversaries, graduation, etc.  The food is amazing and the desserts are fantastic!  We love the calmer, quieter brunch times, and always look forward to our meal.

It was an amazing March morning. The sun was out so we decided to eat on the patio. It has such a relaxing ambience. The service and food was outstanding. Thank you Lisa for taking such good care of us!
First warm evening and loved sitting on the patio!!
Our server, Kyle did a fantastic job! He was very friendly and attentive!

Wonderful anniversary dinner.  Great menu.  Server was very attentive and the food amazing.  The swordfish was very fresh and the portion was hearty. The mushroom ravioli were flavorful and tender.  Was able to enjoy a couple of ravioli for lunch the next day as the potion was also hearty.
Ben is a wonderful waiter and must have overheard that it was my husband’s birthday and brought out a cupcake with candle in it without me asking!

I would return. Charming setting, good service 
, and menu variety
Biz Lunch - wonderful venue.
Delicious dinner at Bridges.  The restaurant was very noisy and our waiter forgot our appetizer.  Other than that we had a wonderful meal.
Nice restaurant .  Not a lot of options, but very good quality.  Friendly staff.

Great ambience for a celebration and romantic dinner. Server Nikko did an excellent job. We enjoyed the ahi tuna tremendously, and the brussel sprout salad was surprisingly good. Bridges in a gem for us locals.
Good food and great server the scallops were great.
I have been coming to this restaurant since 1992, and it has always been superb! Never had a bad meal here.

It has been a while since we have been, and we weren’t intending to eat here, but it was serendipitous.  It ended up being a great meal, with amazing service, and a beautiful night overall.  Thank you for taking care of us (again) Lisa and staff!
Went for friend’s birthday and had great time.

Lunch was lovely and we all ordered the noodle salad and it was delicious.  The server was very accommodating and helpful to several guests who had walkers and needed extra assistance.  The original reservation was for five but later corrected to six via the confirmation notice but table was still set for five which was quickly corrected.  For a change there was adequate parking as we had an 11:30 reservation.

We hadn’t been to Bridges in awhile and everyone said the same thing when we left ... “ we should come here more often!”  From the valet parking to the attentive service to the generous portions of delicious food — it was great!

Always enjoy dining at Bridges!
The food is outstanding and the service is spot on every time we go.
Perfect place to celebrate with friends or 
To bring family visiting from out of town.
Food is delicious, staff are friendly, helpful, yet professional.  A definite favorite!!
Lisa is THE BEST!
Terrific. And big thanks to our wonderful server, Brian, fit baking it such a lovely, fun experience.
Always excellent! Good food, great service, nice ambiance.

Our appetizer arrived without a problem but we were unable to get our waiters attention to take our order for dinner.  We had an engagement at the theater following dinner and when we did finally get the order placed it was quite a rush to get the food out to us.  The food was only mediocre and we were forced to eat  our meal in 5 minutes.  I was very disappointed, we usually have a much better experience at this restaurant.

Our breakfast dishes, the Chinese sausage scramble and pastrami hash, were very good and reasonably priced. We're eager to try the lunch or dinner offerings on our next visit. Service was appropriately attentive, not hovering.  The decor was pleasingly simple.
No contact from a server after 20 mins of sitting there. Got up and left.
Excellent as always. Great unobtrusive service matched with creative cuisine made for a truly enjoyable evening.
Overall great experience, beautiful ambiance and amazing food
I’ve always liked the ambience and the staff. Excellent service from our server, Kyle. The main entrees were bland though, although baked Brie appetizer and desserts were delicious.
noise level was awful parking has been improved , service was a bit slow because they were very busy perhaps more staff could help
Overpriced for the food. Waiter was nice and accommodating.
We went there for our anniversary. So I did not expect them to do anything special. However, they surprised us with a Cupcake with candle. Apologies for not noting the waiter name, he was excellent.

The food was delicious!!! We started with the baked Brie and lettuce cups. The Brie was so soft and creamy and was counter balanced by the honey drizzle. The lettuce cups were super savory and tasty, if not a touch too salty. We then had the special which was the duck breast and also the steak. The duck was perfectly balanced between salty crispy skin and the plum wine reduction. The steak was good, but not amazing. It was a solid choice. To end the night, the soufflé was absolutely a must. The toffee ice cream and pecan streusel tied everything together decadently.
the Food was very good but the service was horrible.

Unblieveable experience at Bridges!! Had a reservation at 5:30 and I was on time. After being seated and after waiting 10 minutes we were finally given a menu. The waiter said he would return with wine glasses and to uncork or bottle!! Never happened I had to uncork my own bottle while waiting!! I then had to ask a bus boy to bring us glasses! A different waiter brought our glasses. This same waiter came back and took our order 10 minutes later!!  Eventually our own waiter return and we advised him that our order was taken!! Not once did he fill our glass of wine!!  Really bad service and cold in the restaurant other patrons complained!!  But the worst of all when I got my bill I was charged a corkage fee of $20!!  Unblieveable!! I paid it but I did bring it to my esters attention that charging $20 for corkage for bad service and I did all the work was not good business!!
Edible joy ! Thanks to Nico as well for the incredible service with the entire team.

It has been one our favorite restaurants for 40+ years. Despite a couple changes in ownership, Bridges’ quality has remained top notch. And, as long as Kevin Gin is in charge of the kitchen, you can be assured of a wonderful dining experience!!

Mediocre menu and food.  Very good waiter / service, but after 3-4 tries there, won't be going back.  My steak was grizzly and the potatoes were poorly tasting.  My wife went simple (soup and salad) and was disappointed in how bland the food was (especially the soup).

Food was very bland. I expected to pay more at this restaurant but I was extremely disappointed with the menu overall and the quality of the food. They didn’t have most of the items on their menu that they displayed on their on-line site as well.

I love the restaurant but the menu did not have enough selection for me.  I am accustomed to coming to you during the week.  We came on Saturday and the menu selection was not as varied.  We loved the truffle french fries.  I had the shrimp salad, it was goodb but was hoping to have a warm meal do to the cold weather we're experiencing.
We thoroughly enjoyed our meals.  Amazing veal chop.  Delicious chocolate souffle.  Waiter was great.
The food, wine and service were exquisite, as always.  Everything about dining at Bridges offers a wonderful experience.

Great food ,Nice service, love the ambiance 
Free valet parking , we Sat inside but their terrace in summer is lovely
Good food, great service. Never felt rushed.
The food seemed overpriced but maybe that was an uptick due to the holiday.  My meal was the best I have ever had at the restaurant.  Everything I ordered I would order again.  It was delicious!

Valentine’s Day dinner was delicious!  Of course the price was a bit high and menu limited but it was understandably a busy night and not out of the ordinary for Valentine’s Day. 

In spite of the holiday, the staff was attentive and customers were all in good spirits.  I had Scallops and the short ribs ordered  by my husband were both excellent in taste and presentation.  

We will definitely return on a less crowded evening.
Celebrating Birthdays staff made us feel extra special.  Thank you Bridges staff
Early lunch on a rainy day - outstanding service, great burger!!
Great place for lunch!  Wonderful menu and ambiance!  Bridges never disappoints!
Nice ambiance, OK food and service, but not great. Way overpriced restaurant for the value.

We like Bridges. The food is very good and the service was great. The only issue is that it is a bit pricey with many entrees in the $30 range. Also, the corkage is $20 a bottle. We had brought two bottles so that was an extra $40 to the bill. I think they should not charge that much for corkage.
Wonderful service and the food very delicious!!!

The service was extremely slow - the waiter took 15-20 minutes just to get us our drinks. Knowing fully well that I am a vegetarian , the food arrived with meat . And the beer was warm !!! 

Overall, our experience was fair at best !
Excellent as always.  6 for lunch and everyone was pleased with their order.  Comfortable, quiet, attentive staff and excellent meal

A group of 4 of us were there for 2 of our birthdays, and we wanted something special. None of us had been to Bridges in years, we were pleasantly surprised how they've kept up with the trends. The service was fantastic, the food was delicious and the prices were reasonable. They did a good job accommodating special requests. We were all pleased and will returning the near future. Also, we would recommend the restaurant to friends.

Food quality was great with excellent service. 

Vegetable choices were very limited for dinner - only one option.
I enjoyed the freshness of the Cioppino, the fish was not overcooked. The waiter was very personable and professional.
Came here to celebrate my husband’s birthday and the staff made it very special!!  Food and service was impeccable...thank you for helping me celebrate my husband’s special day.

It was the girl’s night out with my friend and her daughter. We ordered from the pre fixed menu (great food by the way). Half way through our salads they brought us our entrees... it seemed a little odd and felt rushed but thought that maybe it was a miss understanding since we had dinner at Bridges many times and had an excellent experience every time. We finished our meal and ordered cocktails, when the hostess came to our table and very politely asked us to leave because they needed our table for another upcoming reservation!!! We were speechless and it didn’t register what happened for a couple of minutes. We asked for the manager when we realized it wasn’t a joke. The manager, Tylor, was very nice and apologized, comped our meal and off we went. But it wasn’t about getting a free dinner. I still can’t believe we were asked to leave when we were still sipping our cocktails. WOW!!! We were in so much disbelief we forgot to tip our server who did an excellent job.  I’ll make sure to go back and tip him but the hostess left a bad taste in my mouth. Didn’t expect this from Bridges.

We had a wonderful experience at Bridges today. Our server was terrific and the menu was very good, offering a combination of breakfast and lunch fare. It was not very crowded at 12:30 PM, which is a welcome benefit. I would definitely dine here again.

As always food and service was great 
The big takeaway is the noise level spoils the night
Wonderful dinner wonderful time as always

It was very nice.  Parking was the pits.  The Valet was very attentive.  The construction in th public lot was a distraction.

The time, attention,  and food was good.  We'll be back.  A second service of coffee would have been nice with the dessert.   But it was not offered.  Aside from that all was good.  

PB

And the steak was very rare, so we asked for it to be heated up and it was still so rare that the meat had a gooey texture. We decided to not eat anymore and head to a local place for dinner. Note we live about a hour away from this place. On a positive side the staff was very nice and gracious but maybe the chef just sucks.
Bridges continues to serve delicious food.  That is why we frequent Bridges!!

Always a pleasure to be in the comfortable confines of Bridges: from Colleen’s  warm welcome, to a lovely presented lunch with a personalized Birthday dessert to a fond farewell from Randy, Bridges has never disappointed.
Ben is great and so is the food.

Food and service was great overall.  Only disappointment was the parking where construction of a new parking lot underway.  Had to park out on Hartz, plus it was raining...not ideal.  Hopefully this will be greatly improved when parking lot is completed.
We are never disappointed when we dine here. Wonderful food, service, and ambiance.

Great place for a date night and to catch up with friends! Thank you!
Brunch menu is fairly limited...
Delicious , classy restaurant !! Was happy to see a vegetarian dish on the menu which was amazing !! The service was also outstanding!!
Excellent service and outstanding food. The Hostess was extremely accommodating and our waiter was very attentive.

We love Bridges!!
We are never disappointed.

and was treated to a special dessert!
Delicious!!
Thank you Bridges
The experience is not the same as I remember from years past. The food was good but not a huge selection. The service was outstanding. Parking is not the best. Where is the valet??????
Bridges food is always top quality. The ambiance is warm, inviting and relaxing. During the summer the patio is the best.
Overall great experience!
For the first time, the food was very greasy
One of my favorite East Bay Restaurants. Very reliable and never disappoints.

Al always, it's nice to enjoy lunch or dinner at Bridges. Love the place, the food is great and overall is a wonderful experience as bar area is really nice in the evening.
Wonderful  lunch with a friend great service
Bridges was the perfect spot to spend with out of town family. We visited for Sunday brunch and the group loved the choices something for everyone.

I felt all of the food was lacking in taste.  The main entree we got the gnocchi with duck, the dish was pretty tasteless to start, but ultimately made no sense.  It felt as if it was a bowl with veggies, ducks and sauce all cooked separately and then thrown together at the last minute.  After dropping dessert menus our server disappeared for 15-20 minutes before ever coming back.  Overall very underwhelming experience and disappointing as I’ve heard such great things

Food was excellent and we really enjoyed the ambiance 
Great wine selection 
service was great and the staff was attentive 
overall we had a great experience
New Years Eve.
Food and service is always fantastic. The owners were there on site for New Year's Eve, great committment to their customers.

We celebrated New Years at Bridges and the dinner was wonderful.
A good selection on a price fixe menu.
We had a great waiter named Zack. He was cheerful and enthusiastic.
We really enjoyed the early dinner at Bridges.
We have been to Bridges many times over the years.  They are back on top of their game.  Had great meals and evening there.

Food was pretty bland. The creek brûlée was too think to be called a true crime brûlée, and the cheese gnocchi accompanying the rabbit was not dense enough to be considered a gnocchi. The tuna was cooked perfectly, but our overall impression was heavy, and was not great for the price. The service was great, and the alcohol selection was good.

UNFORTUNATELY, THIS WAS NOT OUR BEST DINING EXPERIENCE.  THE 2 STEAKS ORDERED WERE TOUGH AND ONE HAD TO BE SENT BACK TWICE AS IT WAS NOT DONE AS REQUESTED.  THE RAVIOLIS AND CHICKEN WERE OK, BUT WOULD NOT RECOMMEND TO ANYONE--THE CHICKEN WAS GREAT FOR SOMEBODY IN LOVE WITH PEPPER!  THE BEST PART OF THE DINNER WAS THE SALTED CARAMEL CREME BRULE AND THE WAITER., ALTHOUGH HE DID TRY TO UPSELL ALOT!  HE RECOMMENDED THE MUSHROOMS FOR THE STEAK AND THEY ALREADY CAME WITH MUSHROOMS--WHOOPS!

Service was very poor. Slow to take order. Slow to check to see how meal was once served. Had to wait to get someone’s attention as was served the wrong meal. Was given the rabbit when chicken was ordered. Waiter  precede to tell me it must be the spices. I know the difference between rabbit and chicken. 
Bathroom was very bad. Water and paper towels on floor. Foyer ceilings were covered with spider webs and dust. The front bar smelled of stale beer. I have always heard good things about this place but will not be returning any time soon. Very disappointed.
Looks like they lost their chef. Food was mediocre, service was slow, would not go back
We live Bridges for special occasions.  Great food and service and it’s not stuffy.
Family last night together over holiday

All of us enjoyed our entrees, from the subtle flavors of the tuna to the robust richness of the gnocchi. Our service was fine. The only concern I have is that our cocktails were very weak- and for $12 or $13 a pop they should have been substantial. 
Bridges is a stalwart of the Danville area, and holds its own against many other restaurants, but doesn't shine like it used to. Still, you wouldn't know it by the crowd- the venue was busy and nearly every table was being used.
Limited fixed course menu.  Both fish dishes were Asian, which seemed strange for Christmas Eve.  All three dessert choices were unappealing.  Price was not reflective of value.

Amazing Christmas Eve dinner! Choice of 3 starters, entrees and desserts and since their were three of us we sampled all of them. Every single one was delicious! I believe the restaurant was sold out, but the service was still excellent.  I would LOVE to see some of the choices on their regular menu...soooo good!
Great time, great food, great service, great company. What could be better?
The professionalism of the staff was superb.  I always feel like the staff really cares that you have a great experience in there restaurant. V this is our favorite Sunday brunch spot.
Tablecloth was filthy. Butternut squash soup was grainy and underseasoned at best. Rabbit gnocchi was great, rissoto cooked perfectly, but again underseasoned.
Food and atmosphere was great.  First time visit and service was exceptional.

Great service. Our server, Joe, was great. Perfect timing. Never had to look for him if we needed something. Lettuce cups were very salty and the apple upside down cake was on the sweet side and could have benefited with more cranberry coulis. Otherwise, a very nice time.
Always great!!!   French fries are the best.  Hi there for celebrations all the time.
Campfire s’mores dessert is not available year round unfortunately.  That was the only reason I went.
Wonderful food, terrific sorbet, truly fine dining
My friend ordered the Ahi Tuna salad. She was underwhelmed with the portion size and felt as if it was an appetizer. Usually our meals are perfect but this time, the salad was a letdown.
Service was very good. Our waiter detailed vegetarian options on request. Presentation was amazing and our meal delicious.

Service and food were mediocre. I feel like they have increased their prices compared to the past. Very noisy.
I’ve gone to Bridges on multiple occasions over the years. I was disappointed and may not return as often.

This was our first time to this restaurant. My group and I are in town for a business meeting and I found your restaurant online. The service was great. We were all attended to promptly. I would definitely return and recommend this restaurant.
Noise levels were to high
Wonderful Dining Experience!
Bridges is my favorite place for lunch.  They always serve the most interesting things.  And eating outside or in the restaurant is a pleasure.

I was there on a crowded Sunday just before Christmas. The food was excellent and the service was quick and attentive to our small group despite the fact that the restaurant was very busy with large groups.

We have been coming to Bridges as a group for several years. This year was disappointing. 12 of us for a holiday brunch. The wait staff forgot to bring the yummy cornbread. The pork belly hash was so-so. Hopefully this was just an anomaly.
Love bridges it’s one of my favs and I’m a repeat customer
I have eaten at Bridges ever since it opened.  It has been consistently the best!!!
Consistently quality food and service.  My sword fish dish was excellent along with the rabbit dish my husband had.  This is one of our favorite places for dinner and Sunday brunch.
We always enjoy the food and service at this restaurant! I do love the patio dining and entertainment during the warmer seasons.

We arrived at 5:30pm and were promptly seated at a table near a door - there were plenty of other 2 person tables available.  It took 10 minutes before the waiter came over to take our drink orders.  After that it was another 15 minutes before the drinks came & another 10 minutes for him to come back to take our food order.  The food came pretty fast & was good.  After our dinner plates were cleared, it was another 10 minutes before he asked if we wanted dessert.  We then waited another 20 minutes before he took our dessert order.  We were there 2 hours & we are not slow eaters. Other tables he was serving came & went before us.
We have enjoyed Bridges in the past, will go gain, but surprised last week end.  Soup was tepid.  Entrees were bland.  Steak was tough.  Service was excellent.

We reserved a table to celebrate my wife’s birthday and instead of a quiet, intimate evening, we were seated behind a large party and much of our conversation was drowned out.

That said, service was impeccable. The food was superb. Wines complemented nicely. And the staff surprised my wife with a birthday cupcake.

5 stars if it was a little bit quieter. Noise level was not unreasonable for the holiday season.  A memorable evening none the less.

Overall disappointing.  We expected sparkling Christmas decorations in the dining room and there were none.  Sitting next to loud, large groups makes the experience very unpleasant.  Service was fine, food was at best average. Salmon and steak sat on top an unrecognizable blend of vegetables and/or fruit combination.  Broccoli salad was awful... others have also complained.
We do not plan to return.

My boyfriend took me to Bridge on my bday and it was amazing. It looked really classy and did not feel over dressed for the place. Food excellent waiters helpful and patient. And at the end I received a treat for my bday😉😉😉 i felt celebrated and made me feel good.
Very good food. Good service.
Excellent food, excellent atmosphere, and great wait staff and cooks!!
So loud that it was difficult to carry on a conversation at my own table.

Wish I had gotten our waitress's name--she was outstanding (serving us at table 31 at 11:30) 12/4.  When she asked us if we were celebrating anything, we said friendship!  At the end of our delicious meal, she presented us with a cupcake with three lighted candles and "Friendship" written on the plate!!!!  We not only thanked her but the kitchen--what a special touch.  Don't lose that--and you will continue to be a popular restaurant in Danville.
Bridges is a classic with wonderful food and excellent service.  Great for a date or for a special occasion!
Loved our lunch! Our waitress was lovely! I don't remember her name but please give her a raise. She deserves it!!
Great service and hot tasty food! A birthday party was going on nearby and it was a festive feel at the restaurant!  Love to take my mom and friends there when they visit!
Enjoyed meal.
Great place, wonderful food & service!

The room was cold with a draft from the windows.  Water glass was never refilled.  Busboy asked to pack up my meal while I was still eating.  Busboy noisily tossed plates on table as he was setting up cleared tables.  Noodle salad was over-cooked.  Small gems were not small.  Decaf coffee tasted awful.  Dessert choices were too sweet.  Very disappointing as I was treating a friend for her birthday.
Everything was well done.  Service, food and atmosphere was excellent.
Great food and service. Server brought a little dessert with candle for my son’s birthday- very sweet. And no charge!
Pork chop was dry, soup was not that great.  It seems Bridges is not as good as it used to be.  Its very expensive too.
Thanksgiving dinner was superb!   The restaurant is a bit noisier than we like, but everything else was very good.    We definitely want to return for dinner again.
We ate on Thanksgiving.  My wife's food was served just warm and was sent back leaving me eating while we waited for hers to be re-made.
Bridges is one of our favorite restaurants - always great food, service & ambience. A+++

I ordered soup and a salad.  The soup was very good but too little of it for the price.  The pear, cheese and nut salad had plenty of pear slices and greens but only two pieces of nut and one, dime sized piece of cheese.  Definitely not worth the price.  The wine was fine and priced right.  However, no way is soup and a salad worth $50 even with 2 glasses of wine and a 20% tip.  I eat this way often, in nice restaurants from Alamo to Walnut Creek and have never paid so much.   I won't be back and won't recommend.
They were out of rice for the poke bowl!

We had a very nice dinner with friends from out of town. They all enjoyed the food and the Ambiance of the restaurant. The server did a nice job explaining the regular meals and the specials for the evening.
I was very pleased with Bridges.  We had a party of 10 for a baby shower.  Bridges had everything ready as I had requested.  It was a lovely Brunch.  The food was delicious.  Service was excellent.
Sunday brunch... twice we waited at least 15 minutes for coffee/refill because they claimed "it is brewing". How can you not have enough coffee brewed/brewing for brunch!?

Parking was the low-point of the evening. Bridges has valet, but if you don't want to use it, you have to hunt around Danville's crowded streets. After we found a spot and got to our table, everything was fantastic. The food was oddly simple, but extremely well prepared and presented. Everything tasted exactly like you would imagine: the fish was fish, the beets were beets, the brussel sprouts were sprouts--and they all went very well together. No heavy spices to overwhelm the natural flavors of fresh food. Service was attentive and yet remained in the background. We had a very nice time.

Third visit in the last 2 years.   
Chairs are very hard and uncomfortable.  Food was very poor quality. 

I can not recommend to anyone.

Years ago it was wonderful, but not now.
Great ambiance and good service. The fish dishes were delicious.

Menu has changed... and I was super disappointed. None of the meals at my table were anything close to being on par with what we expected from past experiences at Bridges. I don't think I'll go back. Not worth the money when your meal is so disappointing.
Great food and exceptional service. It’s an  wonderful place to celebrate a special event.
Service was slow.   Didn’t have enough staff on duty.
Been here many times and will return.  But, tonight was off!  Service and food were both below their standard.

I reserved at Bridges for some friends for after work dinner thinking it was another place that I liked in Danville. Bridges turned out to be a GREAT restaurant! The food was fresh and delicious. The menu was creative, but not over the top. Our server was excellent. There are only 2 reasons I didn't click that 5th star: 1) the gnat that joined throughout the dinner, and 2) the decor is rather cold for me. I will be back the next time I am in Danville.
The wait staff was attentive and helpful. Lunch was delicious and service was timely.

Overall, restaurant was ok. Service not so great. Slow to refill water, friend wanted half and half with her coffee but half and half never brought to table after request.  My biggest problem was with the "hostess".  During my meal, I received an email message from Open Table that I had not honored the reservation I had at the restaurant where I was still having my meal.  Went up to the "hostess" and told her the situation.  Instead of apologizing for not marking me as arrived, she asked ME where I was sitting to verify that I was actually a customer.  Seemed rude and disrespectful.  Like it was my problem that my reservation had not been acknowledged in the system.  The problem got fixed but not in the kindest or most professional manner.

There were 6 of us, 5 ordered the same item however two were with special instructions, when the food was deliver by the runners, not the server, they did not know who got what and never mentioned that two were cooked special. My suggestion is to STOP using runners. The server should be the “SERVER” or call them what they are “ORDER TAKERS”.

Other than the hostess at the front being a little unresponsive to our presence the service was excellent. Food was better than I had remembered. One of the best I I’ve had in Danville. No wonder it’s still in business! Would definitely eat there again soon
The weather was nice enough to sit outside in the lovely patio.  All of the staff were friendly and helpful.  The noodle and prawn salad was very tasty.  Will definitely return in the future.
Slopped patio made the tables and chairs a little awkward to use in some cases. Very nice setting!
I have been to this restaurant many times and have always  rated it very good.  However, this was certainly an off night.

Let me start with I love Bridges. The food is delicious and everyone is very nice. 

This time I was hosting two very good friends from out of town. It was my choosing to go to the best restaurant in Danville. Unfortunately, this time wasn’t the best. 

We had missing spinach from a spinach scramble. We asked for jam, our server left to retrieve jam. He returned 10 minutes later and stated the restaurant didn’t have jam. We requested coffee, that took about 10-13 minutes. After the fact we were told they were brewing a fresh pot, and it took my friend  a long time to get a coffee warm up.

I hope this comes as constructive criticism. I will be returning in hopes that the service is back to Bridges level.

Thanks

Sunday brunch customer
It was a really nice evening. The entertainment on the patio was great!  And the food was excellent. Service is always spot on at Bridges.
Tasty entrees (yet pork chop and swordfish received the same watercress garnish from the kitchen). Service was sporadic. Overall, an enjoyable birthday dinner.

went late for dinner on a Friday, service was spotty except for the bread  bacon was not cooked as much in the halibut dish, and my passionfruit lemon tart drink was not as good as last time, too much lemon & vodka not enough other stuff...it is usually spot on, so my guess is this was all because we were there late.

We love Bridges for special nights out 
The service is exceptional and the food always fit for a foodie
We had wonderful dinner at Bridge's. Salmon and chicken dishes was great . Love to go back again.

I have been coming to Bridges for over 20 years. Kevin Gin is a super talented chef, and I have never had a meal there that I didn't like. I highly recommend this restaurant. The patio is beautiful and on a nice night, really elevates the dining experience.
Excellent restaurant for any occasion.

The food and atmosphere were great. It was very clean and inviting. Not too crazy about the complimentary dessert. The server could have been a little more attentive, especially compared to the other servers near our table. Overall it was a very pleasant experience that I would strongly recommend.
Bridges never disappoints...everything was delicious, fresh, well presented, service was great.

The patio seating was fabulous, with great weather and gorgeous lighting, and live entertainment in the background.  Our waiter was attentive and engaging.  The artichoke ravioli and The Special grilled line caught catch of the day were scrumptious.  Just steps away from the Village Theatre.  A perfect evening.
Always great. It has been my “go to” restaurant for years. I love the seafood cioppino!  It is light and delicious.
Great time at Bridges, always delivers, very reliable and great food.
Had a fabulous anniversary dinner! It's our go-to Danville place!

I couldn't have asked for a more wonderful setting to celebrate my late mother's birthday, especially since it had been on her bucket list to dine here (Mrs. Doubtfire has been a family favorite since my childhood). We each ordered a different dish and enjoyed each one immensely. The desserts were rich and decadent, and we had trouble choosing between the different options because they all sounded so lovely. The sauce for the Mexican Prawns was incredible, and the Balsamic Swirl Cheesecake is worth a return trip!

I did want to note - since our mother had recently passed (just earlier this year) there were a few moments throughout the evening where emotions overrode us, but the server was incredibly compassionate and patient. Upon discovering the reason for our celebration, he comped our desserts in a much appreciated gesture of kindness. We cannot express enough gratitude for the stellar service - it made our experience even more special and memorable.
We celebrated my friend’s birthday on the patio. It was great!
Bridges is consistently enjoyable, great food, love the atmosphere on  the large patio.  Good value!

Went for Sunday brunch with some friends, and was seated outside. The hostess was very friendly and accommodating, and the food and mimosas were excellent. Service was outstanding in a very quaint and chill environment. One of the best brunch spots in Danville by far. Would highly recommend!
The only problem was that Bridges did not have our reservation from Open Table. Bridges was very accommodating and seated us outside on a very busy night.

We went there for Saturday date night. Sat outside. Service was good. Food was nothing remarkable. The bread to start tasted stale and plain. I had the pork chop and my husband had the salmon - both were good and nice size portions. We had the creme brulee for desert which was very rich - it had a biscotti on the top that could have broken a tooth.
We will come back!!!  It’s not inexpensive but it was worth the cost.  The service was excellent.

It was a fantastic dinner experience, excellent service, nice atmosphere followed with an amazing solo music.
The food and the drinks were as good as they can be, I will definitely will recommend anyone such a great restaurant.
Food was very good. We ordered artichoke ravioli and fall risotto. Both were well done. No complaints.
The food was exceptional. Service was very good. Love the round tables, great for large groups. I  was there for a business meeting but I will go back with friends !

Our second birthday dinner at Bridges and we were not disappointed. Our waiter was attentive without being suffocating, we had appetizers with drinks which was a nice combination and our entree's were diverse and delicious.

We - three ladies - enjoyed Sunday brunch, seated outdoors.  Unfortunately our lunch date coincided with smoke from the Solano fires.  We were offered to move inside the restaurant but enjoyed staying outdoors by the fountain, listening to the live music.

A true gem that has stood the test of time.  I love the outside seating and the inside seating.  No bad spot in this restaurant.  Food is wonderful and reasonably priced.  Servers very attentive and go the extra mile.  You never have to wait for anything they are always right there to help.

Our experience was just OK tonight unlike previous times when it's been truly fantastic all the way around.  
Something was just a bit off kilter tonight. 😏

Bridges is a great place for a fabulous culinary experience.  
Great food and good times

Disappointing experience.
I had indicated we were celebrating birthdays - yet nothing was mentioned or done.
Two of us are vegetarians (and allergic to mushrooms), the menu selection was quite limited, and some specifics were not indicated on the menu (ingredients, whether or not items were "on the side").
Server was just okay - not particularly helpful with the menu, or our issues with the food.
We love to come for Sunday brunch and enjoy the music.
Enduring  1 1/2 hours of late Saturday afternoon traffic from Los Altos was worth the trip.

Lovely patio but we could have done without the live music,
which drowns out the white sound from the fountain and 
made conversations difficult

A nice place for lunch, dinner... on a date or just with friends.

I eat here monthly. 

Joe is my favorite server!!!

Loc Barnes
Went there for Sunday brunch and the menu had something for everyone in our party of 4...
Anniversary
This place is excellent the service the food. I love the cheese cake.  Live music in the patio!!!

it was a beautiful restaurant.  we made reservations days in advance and apparently when you book with open table you are low man on the totem pole.  Wont be using open table anymore.  we asked to eat outside and even though we made reservations before others , we didnt get an outside table.  if we booked straight thru the restaurant. they said we would have.

A great place for lunch or dinner - festive not fussy and a good, varied menu with seasonal items.
Highly enjoyable.

Usually excellent food preparation.
This time we both had filet mignon.
Both of us had upset stomachs after dinner.
We will avoid steaks here in the future.
My 96 year old mom's favorite place to eat and we love the out door dining!

Bridges is always a pleasure!!
I love bringing friends from out of the area.
They truly enjoy the wonderful menu.

It was all going downhill 15 minutes in and no drinks or appetizer orders taken ... then as I walked In to begin my complaint ...the first waiter I ran in to took over even though it was not his area and took care of us for the remainder of the night pulling us back from the brink of a poor experience on a needs night out . Great food , great wine and capped off with the first round of drinks on the House by the manager who dropped by to make sure things were back on track . Great recovery , we will be back .
Always excellent food and outstanding service. A favorite!
Good food and everyone can find something on the menu. I found the servings generous so order appropriately.
Anniversary dinner

It had been more than a decade since I had been to Bridges. I recalled it being very good and chose it to celebrate my wife's birthday.  Our experience that night was absolutely exceptional.  We sat outside in Bridge's lovely courtyard comfortably shaded by mature trees and listened to pleasant live music.  Our meals could not have been better, from an amazing Brussel sprouts salad with toasted quinoa and shaved parmesan cheese to my Mexican prawns in a Thai red curry sauce to my wife's impecaably prepared fresh halibut. Everything was delicious and lovely.  Service was prompt without being intrusive.  My only complaint would be charging $18 for a glass of Mt. Veeder cab (delicious) when BevMo sells the bottle for $36; that's more than a 300% markup.

We will definitely be returning to Bridges but next time we'll bring wine from our own collection and pay the corkage fee.
Petite hearts of romaine salad was pleasant with cotija cheese and pickled red onion strips. A Caesar variation. Risotto and ravioli entrees were delicious. Shmoors dessert was a nice finale.

Excellent as usual
 Never fails. ❤
Outdoor is beautiful 😊

Absolutely sublime celebratory meal, dining outside next to the fire and seated in front of the guitar player. Service was attentive and friendly, mixed drinks were flavorful and accurate and all of the dishes were exactly as requested.

One of the Best Date Nights ever. Our server Nico was very good and his recommendations were spot on. William cleared and refreshed our table with us barely noticing. Our food was excellent and the service was fabulous. Dessert was yummy. We sat outside, not far from the fountain which is relaxing, and the live music was amazing. Definitely will come back.
The lunch menu is very limited. Seems unusual that you have not had romaine lettuce. There’s not big normal salad.

Our server Ben was excellent.  He made our birthday evening event successful..the food was not tasty as presented... the presentation was excellent.. for the price we paid, not worth it.  The lemon drop was excellent.  Definitely will come back for the happy hour..
Lovely, relaxed setting on the patio. Food is always interesting and tasty. Menu contains a nice diversity of choices to suit any appetite or mood.

We love Bridges!
The staff is siesta a delight.
The menu is amazing.

Our dinner was superb! We discovered a price fix menu and gave it a try. The pork chop was very flavorable, German potato salad delicious. The salmon was made to order and tender. The salad had a wonderful flavor, as well as the dessert.  The service was non- invasive, but met all our needs. The staff was friendly and engaging. We love the comfortable ambience of Bridges. It’s our favorite place for any occasion.
Visit with family from Arizona
Bridges is always a consistent treat for a special occasion.

Its been awhile since I visited Bridges. I am happy I returned. Its a beautiful place both inside and on the very nice patio. We were there on a Saturday night and there was a very nice singer there that evening. All the food was quite good. Our table had the shrimp with Thai curry, the swordfish and a special scallops dish. Everyone was very happy. Good wine list and well prepared cocktails. The service was good. My one slight negative is that the waiter did not really know how to pair wine and food. His recommendation of a pinot with the shrimp dish did not work well, at least for me. Next time I will do my own pairing. Nonetheless, a very good evening and at a restaurant that's been around and uses its experience to provide an very nice dining experience.
Friendly and not that pricie! Great martinis  with handmade blue cheese stuffed olives.
Just Outstanding! A classic gem worth visiting time and time again.
One of our favorite places to sit outside during the summer for lunch.   Food is delicious and the atmosphere is relaxing.

We have been coming to Bridges for several years and the food a service is always good. This time I came with my daughters and the too found everything to their liking. I would definitely rate Bridges a 4 + .
Birthday dinner with my wife. Great service

We had a great meal.
One guest had the seared tuna which tasted great.
I had scallops which was delicious too.
Our waiter was the best. He really went out of his way.
Sincere not canned.
Bridges is always a good meal
Bridges was great! The food was delicious and the service was excellent. They made my daughter’s birthday very special. (And we love Mrs. Doubtfire!)
As always the service and food were excellent. definitely go back
Salmon is always amazing, cooked to perfection with just the right amount of seared crunch with the perfect temperature and taste.

This was a very disappointing 40th anniversary dinner! Our server was terrible!. He never checked to see how our dinner was. Our water was never refilled. We never got forks for our entrees. The coffee we ordered never arrived and we had to ask the bus boy to bring us our bill. We would have complained to our server about these things but he was never around! During the meal when we did spot our server he was chatting at the bar! There are lots of dinner choices in our area. This will never again be one of them for us.

My husband and I both had the swordfish special. It was honestly the best meal we have had at Bridges in quite a while! That was because we learned to say "no salt" otherwise the chef has a very heavy hand, in our opinion.

Service was very good but food was disappointing. Very dry chicken breast with ok waffles. Several large pieces of egg shells on poached eggs, terrible decaf coffee. And to top it off you can hardly see the sign when approaching the front. Are they getting ready to close down?
Highly recommend the prawn scramble.  My children enjoyed the chicken and waffles.  The desserts were sublime!  Our waiter was well-versed on the the entire menu.

Have heard great things about Bridges but must say there were a few disappointments for us. Apparently there were some new staff & our server was a bit distracted with our service while attempting to keep an eye on many other tables. A cocktail ordered before dinner had to be replaced & the after-dinner drinks were a disappointment. Overall the food was ok, not exceptional, as was hoped. Doubt there will be a return visit~

Came to Bridges for a Bridal Shower, and they were very attentive to us. The host called me two days in a row to make sure there were no more special requests/ how to accommodate the special requests I had made on the reservation. I had requested to be seated on the patio, but they called in advance to let me know that the day prior many guests had requested to be moved inside because of the over 100 degree weather, and the party and I really appreciated that we were given the option to sit inside! Great restaurant, great service, and very nice ambiance.

Brunch was very tasty!  Two of us had the avocado toast with a poached egg, and two had the burger.  I couldn't have the fresh mozzarella in the salad, so they replaced with goat cheese -- fantastic!!  And my daughter ordered a drink that had club soda rather than sprite, and they remade it for her because she wanted it sweeter.  We had a relaxed meal and were full to the brim.
Awesome once again!

We tried to make reservations for a Thursday lunch at 12 or later, but could not. When we arrived at 11:30 for our reservation the place was completely empty. No one except a large party waiting outside. Had a very nice lunch, very nice professional servers. But, when we left at 1:15 there were still many, many empty tables.  Why we were not able to get a table after 12 is a mystery. We won't be going back and instead will stay in Livermore were are better served.
I took my friend for her birthday. Food and service were great. A perfect experience aside from the unpleasant hostess.

Gluten Free options were very limited.  I did order the risotto, which was tasty and satisfying but the sandwich board had no Gluten Free bread.  My friend ordered the hamburger, a typical American plate.  She said the meat was dry and I could see that it looked to be so.  
The environment on the patio is lovely but I think I will not return for the food and I need more Gluten Free options.

This was the half-way point for my friend and I to meet.  I had the Pan Roasted Atlantic Salmon with a Moroccan Olive-Basil Oil on top of Japanese eggplant,Jimmy Nardello peppers, pole beans and heirloom tomatoes.  Presentation was as outstanding as its taste!!  I only ordered an entrée because my appetite was not huge.  The Salmon was cooked to perfection and the vegetables had a slight hint of spice!  Overall the entrée was light.  We had dinner on the quiet patio which allowed two friends to catch up uninterrupted!

I met a friend on an evening where traffic was a bit challenging.  I arrived the host was gracious and told me if I was there for happy hour and after agreeing to do that I was very pleased with the waiter, the drinks, and the food.  I would recommend this restaurant to anyone.
Excellent. One of our favorites. Great food and wonderful service.
It was very surprising that took almost 10 minutes for a server to come and greet us.
Please (please please) change your menu more often.  Its smaller than ever, and its getting boring.  Presentations are nice, service and ambiance good, but desperate for a little inspiration!
Everything was well done and the staff was attentive.

We've come to Bridges many times, with the most recent being Sunday brunch with family in town. The food is outstanding, along with the cocktails and mimosas list.  The decor and overall vibes are tremendous in a relaxed and sophisticated environment. Service is very attentive, and the outdoor seating area is also beautiful. Highly recommend!
Overall the restraunt is good. Parking is tough

Wonderful food. Nice outdoor seating. Attentive wait staff. Absolutely no rush by restaurant to move patrons out after meal finished. Perfect for a special occasion. Cozy for 2 people but can also accommodate a large group.
Amazingly Awesome!  Fabulous food, with vibrant flavors.  Excellent service and reasonable prices..This is our new favorite East Bay Restaurant!
Anniversary
Bridges continues to shine with not only delicious food but a lovely setting both inside and out.  The staff is friendly and welcoming as well.
A lovely place to while away an afternoon.    Food is always perfectly cooked and plated.   It has managed to withstand the test of time
Great place to celebrate a 80th birthday.  Even had yummy cupcake with a candle.
we came from kensington, SF, so quite a drive, but it was a lovely evening, thank you very much

From the greeting podium to the ending, staff barely smiled which set a grumpy, unfriendly tone.

I ordered a hamburger which appeared to be herb-seasoned. The large RAW onion ring was placed ON the burger - instead of allowing the guest to decide - I had to dig it out. The bun was cold and I couldn't figure out what a cauliflower flowerette was doing on the plate - seemed out of place as a garni. Fries were un-edible, cold and tasted like they'd been sitting for a long time; they were served with a catsup/mustard combo dish with the catsup already touching the fries - I don't like catsup on fries so even if fries were edible, I couldn't have eaten those. Hamburgers are my litmus to any newly visited restaurant. I will not return to Bridges....

An aside - one guest ordered a salad. A server offered freshly cracked pepper to ANOTHER table but not to our table's guest.

We went to Bridges for 2 birthdays and we were very happy with our choice.
The appetizer were fabulous, the main courses tasted so good (Salmon, Ahi, NY Steak), everything was cooked to perfection and very flavorful!
They were a little short staffed the night we were there, but all the staff was doing a great job!
Will return.

The food was good; though watch out, salads are "finished" with salt, so if you don't like that have them hold the salt...

The wait staff was pleasant and attentive.

Though very busy ... it was still a very nice luncheon.
Outside seating was wonderful!
Our group ordered a variation of entrees, each presented beautifully and just as delicious.
Bridges always delivers on exceptional food and service with timeless ambiance.
Always consistent and always good! The outdoor patio is sublime!
Great food great service!

Everything was excellent until I ordered my dessert, creme brûlée, to go.  Paid the bill, left the restaurant, drove back to hotel, opened my to go box and it had a scoop of, I’m guessing, chocolate pudding. Called the restaurant and asked to speak with a manager, manager apologized but did not offer to refund the dessert or offer any additional solution.  We won’t return no matter how good the food due to the poor customer service.

Excellent food and ambience on the patio. Our waiter patiently let us take our time and even provided a special
Birthday dessert for the birthday girl.  I’ll be back....
We sat outside on a beautiful summer evening. Inside is very loud.
The food and the atmosphere were very good.  The service was very slow.

The dishes we ordered were unique and delicious. Service was outstanding and the atmosphere was lovely. I marked the noise level as moderate, but only because there was a guitarist was playing in the background.  Two of our party were celebrating birthdays and it wanted the lunch to be special. It was!
Loved the ambience, service and food! Will definately go again!
Ben was our server, great server! Food was very fresh and very tasty! Great atmosphere on the patio.

Excellent service.  The food was delicious and my wife and I were very pleased.  The complimentary valet was a nice touch.  We did have some annoying gnats flying around our table but It didn't affect our food.
Great place. The halibut dish was incredible.
We were late but the staff was very accommodating.  Our waiter was excellent.  The mushroom base to the halibut was great. Three of us ordered the halibut we all ate everything on the plate.
Fabulous service and excellent food.  I had a FABULOUS ahi poke salad that was delicious.

My favorite for lunch is the burger.
The best I’ve had. With awesome beefsteak tomatoes.
The patio dining is great.
The service is top flight too.
I highly recommend their brunch too

Service started slow to start but got better, we were waiting on a few people but when we were ready to order our server was no where to be found. After we were able to order, our drinks came out quickly but the food was slow probably because they only had one chef and soup chef cooking for a fairly busy brunch time. Food was good but for smashed avocado toast with shrimp was over $15 which seems pricey for something I could make at home. And it’s sad they do not have bottomless mimosas but they do have fun flavors that were delicious but $4 each.

My husband and I came here for Sunday brunch. We were seated promptly but waited and waited and waited. We saw other tables who sat down after us receive water and bread before us. We were ready to order and our menus on the table and our waitress still ignored us. The place was very busy and loud outside, but inside was nice and quiet. I guess we should have sat inside since we aren’t rowdy and we care about service. 

We’ve been here a couple of times for dinner and have been extremely happy with the service. I don’t know why brunch service is so bad. I don’t think we’ll be coming back for a long time.

A business meal with 2 others. From the valet to our waiter Ben, excellent.  The people I brought, were very happy with their meal and the ambiance.  I ordered the Chicken which was undercooked and wasn't sure what it was that you put it on, but it was terrible along with the warm German Potato Salad.
Singer way too loud, conversation very difficult when sitting outside also chairs are too low for table height, more of a lounge chair than for sitting up to eat.

Our reservation was for 12:45 so we expected lunch.  The menu was generally Brunch.  Disappointing that we had only 2 choices of salads.  

Maybe another time.

went for dinner with two friends and sat outside, which was lovely. The waiter arrived promptly and took our drink orders. This is where it went downhill. It literally took 15 minutes for our drinks to arrive. During that 25 minutes, we had three servers bring us 3 different food orders that didn’t belong to us. Then we saw our drinks being brought to another table. We tried to flag down the server, but he went inside. We then asked another server to find him and redirect him, di he disappeared to do so. Then our drinks came out again but the server wandered around aimlessly and went back in. We were finally able to have our waiter bring our drinks. After that fiasco we ordered and our food was delivered uneventfully although we did have one last attempt of good delivery that wasn’t ours. All three of us were disappointed with h the food. There was nothing outstanding about the taste and all of us decided we would not return. All in all, it was disappointing and Bridges seems to be surviving on it’s prior reputation.
The food and service are always consistent. Ben our server is always on his A game. Couldn’t ask for anymore. If I give it mor than 5 stars I would
Great food as always.  I tried the burger this time and with the havarti cheese it was outstanding.  Great server as well.

Have been here several times in the past, but this time something seemed not as good as before! Our orders were somewhat slow, and a turkey club came as an ordinary turkey sandwich. The servers were attentive, yet seemed to rush our orders, once they came.
Just not the same.... Hoping it was just an off day...
Our waiter was great, the meal flowed nicely and it was an enjoyable environment.

We had to send both of our fish of the day dishes back, which was the Swordfish. They were both extremely salty. In fact, when our waiter came back after we sent the dishes back he said he tasted them and they made his lips burn! He also had to bus boy try them and he had the same reaction! So, we had to wait while our meal was remade. This has happened the last three times we have gone to Bridges!

This was our anniversary and the service was very slow. The server was very apologetic but blamed it on the large party inside. I believe a restaurant should be able to accommodate regular customers when large parties are present.  We were here last year for our anniversary and the service was extremely poor that evening as well.  So as much as I like it, we won’t be returning.

We and our friends had a very nice relaxing meal. I was reluctant to try the squid ink risotto but wow it was great!!! The Ssam Lettuce cups also a winner. The catch of the day I think was a grilled swordfish: it was very tender and tasty. My wife had the N.Y. Steak and I got to try it. Also a winner. Overall a great night!

My fiance and I loved our meal! From start to finish. We started with the Mexican prawns as our appetizer. They were served on a cauliflower puree (which was to die for) and the prawns did not disappoint. We then split the Brussels sprout ceaser salad. I had never had Brussels sprouts shaved in a salad before and it was a pleasant surprise! My fiance had the swordfish special with carrot puree and I had the pork chop with apples and celery root. His fish was cooked beautifully. It was white, moist and flaky. My pork chop was served at a perfect temperature and full of juice and flavor.

We cant wait to go back!
Great service, great food in a beautiful restaurant :)
My guest was disappointed that the weekly menu changed on Saturday.  She is very picky and ended up ordering a hamburger.  She would have liked to have chosen from the Monday through Friday menu.
Never disappoints
Bridges Restaurant is always a wonderful time. Food and service is excellent.
Great- food was excellent and patio is wonderful!
This is definitely are go to place for Brunch, lunch and dinner.  We have never been disappointed.  Enjoy the music when dining outside.
Nice dinner.  Always pricey at Bridges.   Very busy on Saturday night.  Server dropped off for quite some time before bringing our drinks.  But I'm sure it was just the amount of patrons dining.
Great patio seating.  Great place for Happy hour and music.
When there is a 3 course fixed menu on line and then told it does  not apply for the evening that you are dining there, that is not good!
I was looking forward to having a reuben sandwich but found out it was only served Monday-Friday at lunch so was disappointed.
Brunch was fantastic!  Great service and the best Shrimp Eggs Benedict I’ve ever tasted!

The curry shrimp dinner was outstanding. My wife enjoyed the halibut. My water glass was well attended to, never had to ask for more when was getting low. Really enjoyed the Lisa coffee drink for dessert! There were reasonably priced wine selections. Our waitress Breann was very good.
Horrible service. Food was awful.
We sat outside and the waiter couldn’t have been nicer! The food was good, not great. It was a nice experience
The food was delicious and the service was excellent. Our waiter was very friendly and very nice. He was excellent,

My daughter mentioned it was my birthday when she got there and I also noted it when I booked the reservation but they did not do anything for me. Drinks took long to come but other than that it was great. I think the desserts were our favorite part of the meal.
Waiters were awesome, it was pretty lit my guy. Satisfied mentally and physically, shout out to the guy that looked like Zayne Malik
We enjoyed a Sunday brunch with a variety of items. Reasonably priced and great service. Food was fresh and tasted amazing. Thanks

First time at Bridges for a special birthday dinner. Did not disappoint as the service was great, hostess very accommodating, food was delicious and they brought a BD surprise dessert to the table. Definitely will come back and certainly recommend.

The food and service were top notch. Two of our party ordered the Ono (Specialty of the night) and it was exceptional! Steak was cook to perfection as well. Needless to say, there were no "doggie bags" leaving the restaurant that evening.

We went to Bridges to celebrate our anniversary. Such a beautiful place for a special occasion that is not too formal. The staff was great. We absolutely loved our server. He was so happy and fun. Great service! At the end the restaurant surprised us with a desert that was complementary. Such a nice gesture! I highly recommend this restaurant. We will be back for sure!

One of my favorite places. We love it. It was a warm evening and we sat on the patio and listened to the nicest singer guitarist  In addition to very good food. They have an outstanding bar tender who knows how to mix excellent martinis and manhattans a rarity.  Some good things to order Korean steak lettuce wraps appetizers. Lentil soup, mexicannprWn dish and the salmon with black rice.

Ambience was great.  Staff was friendly and courteous.  Food presentation was very good.  Better than I expected.  But the food seemed a bit salty to me.  Could be improved for future guests. Dessert was great!  My Campfire S'mores Tart was really good.

Had dinner with two of my sisters last Friday night.  Sat out on the patio and thoroughly enjoyed our meals, all very good.  Also thoroughly enjoyed the guitar and singing of the gentleman entertaining us with an awesome play list and wonderful voice.  His music totally enhanced the evening and even as hot as it was on Friday, the patio was wonderful.  Always solid food at Bridges.

Been coming here for years but it had been awhile. When my husband ordered a martini with the WELL Vodka he was told he could ONLY have it on the rocks. He said...who has a martini that way? It was $2 more to have it the way he wanted so he opted to have a premium vodka if he was paying more for it.  The drink that used to cost $5 cost him almost $14. Service was so-so and the bar was fairly empty. We miss Elise who used to be our waitress in the past.

We took my husband and my mom here for their birthdays as a very special occasion. Although the service was excellent, it couldn’t make up for the terrible food. We started by ordering each of the two salads on the menu: the mixed greens didn’t have any dressing on it and the Brussels sprouts “dressing” was pure thick mayonnaise; it was completly inedible. When our entrees came, half of my mothers chicken was pink and red; either undercooked or just a bad piece of meat. To the restaurants credit, they made another dinner for her but by the time it was ready everyone else was finished eating. When choosing a restaurant as well known and as high end like Bridges, we all expected much better quality.
Awesome as always!!!! Salmon and pork chops were both terrific.
Bridges is our “go to” restaurant! ALWAYS fabulous food and I love the pineapple martini. Also enjoy the summer evenings on the patio with music, like being on vacation ❗️

This was our 48th anniversary. By our count, this was the 34th anniversary we dined there.  
EXCEL ANT
The food  and service are consistently good. Never been dissapointed so that's what brings us back.
My wife had the ravioli which was delicious. I had the chicken which was horrid; one of the worst meals I have honestly had in years.

My wife, son and his wife, and my granddaughter took me to Bridges for the Father's Day special 3-course meal. Appetizers, entrees, and desserts were delicious. Entrees included short ribs, ono (fish), veal, and halibut. Wait staff was very attentive and we had an(other) enjoyable meal and evening at Bridges.

Feels like I'm again writing same review as past few...great food, poor service. Maybe the job market is too tight because great service seems to be hard to come by. We had short ribs -- perfectly cooked and tender and served on a creamy corn base , and ono -- large filet perfectly prepared and served with spinach and grains. Really delicious. But again, server was stiff and generally not around. Everything was overpriced. Bridges is an institution, but showing its age.

Went to Bridges for Father's Day Dinner.  It was a mistake! We have been there many times for both dinners and lunches and have been pleased with the food quality and service. This Father's Day dinner required us to choose from a special fixed price menu ranging from about $45-$65.  Food quality and portions were very disappointing all the way from appetizers to desserts.
