It's hard to understand why this restaurant needs to take advantage of its customers on a special occassion  like Father's Day with a limited "special menu" at double the usual prices and a definite decrease in the food quality.
We had the worst experience with the service and the food. It was very unfortunate!
Bridges never lets me down! I visit from Los Angeles and it is worth the 400 mile drive!!
First time eating at Bridges. Booked for Father’s Day Brunch. Really enjoyed the salad but the eggs where not fully cooked and the potatoes were over cooked. Very expensive for not liking the food

The food was mediocre and our server was pleasant but not terribly attentive.  The bill was 270 before tip for five people - no alcohol.  Wasn’t a great value.  No one at the table finished any course.  It just wasn’t that good.  

We eat out frequently.  This is the third time we’ve been to Bridges and it will be our last.

Very disappointing from what Bridges was in the past.
My wife's meal was risotto.  Neither of us could eat it.  First, it was not arborio rice.  Then it was served with a pile of cheese on top.  Pretty poor, so bad that we sent it back.  They replaced it with a steak.  Steak was good, but served on top of a pile of potatoes.....no vegetables, and the potatoes had barbecue sauce on them.....inedible.  My shrimp meal was adequate.  Overall, other that our server who was great, this was a big disappointment, and definitely over-priced for the the food quality.
Although we indicated on the reservation that this was an anniversary dinner, it was never acknowledged.
In spite of cold wind on the patio, a full restaurant, and a bride and groom (!), we enjoyed a lovely, lingering evening celebrating Father's Day and a son's birthday. We always return to Bridges.
Fathers Day
Consistently good. The service, the food, it’s all good at Bridges.
Always a great meal; love the Prawns in Red Curry sauce.
Our favorite place to dine. Love the food and the staff is great.
Great meal and service. An experience to be repeated.

I thought the veal streak was terrible - all bone and fat. Highlight was the scalloped potatoes. Including the 18 percent tip is a little presumptuous. Service was great. Menu needs to be larger for such a well known Bay Area icon.

As always the food was very good and the desserts wonderful.  We had the hot Mexican choc Creek brûlée.  Amazing.  The service was unusually slow but we were in a hurry and sitting outside is always so relXing.
Loved the food and the staff they knew what was excellent for lunch.
It was great, as always.  Ambiance perfect outside with the weather and the cuisine and cocktails were perfect, as well.  Server was perfectly attentive, although NOT TOO MUCH, just perfect!
Very nice outside dining. The fixed price 3-course-dinner Sunday - Wednesday night is a great deal!
Fine food, great ambiance, exceptional service.  Wish I could remember our server's name as he deserves special praise.  Bridges is a restaurant that will never disappoint.
Enjoyable. Good Food. Good Ambiance. Brunch is a good time to come. $4.00 Mimosa's were appreciated.

Patio was closed due to wind... was quite noisy inside.
Burger was too greasy.
Not enough choices for lunch. Pastrami should not have onions in it. The pastrami was very good but it should not include onions
Great view tasty food great service was a good choice to show off Vancouver for our friends from Australia

The halibut special was exceptional. It had all the things I love: quinoa, arugula, corn. I am not sure of the sauce or dressing but it was delicious!  The others had the pork chop, salmon and the risotto and all said it was very good.

Bridges has been and continues to be one of our favorite dinning out restaurants.  
Enjoyable setting, food and service! For any occasion.....
fantastic !!!
Great place for lunch especially if it's warm enough to sit outside.  There outside seating area is in a garden like setting.  The food is always wonderful and reasonable.

Our server put in both of our orders wrong and brought us both the same fish, neither of which we ordered. Two weeks ago ago we had the same waitress and she gave us such poor service that our meal was comped by Bridges. This time we had to ask her to comp us a round of drinks while we waited another 20 min for the meals we ordered. We expect much better out of Bridges restaurant.
Perfect for a fine lunch, quiet conversation, and lovely surroundings for two old friends to meet. Waiter was  friendly and attentive. Even brought my friend a Birthday cupcake with a candle.
Service was lacking but everything else good
Perfect restaurant to meet up with old friends. Food was delicious and served kindly by our waiter. Service friendly and prompt. Good atmosphere quiet

PHENOMENAL!!! Great food, great service, great staff, beautiful setting. Just love coming to Bridges as I know I will always walk away satisfied. My husband and I ordered their special which was Hawaiian fish monchong. Tender, tasty and the chef balanced it well with the right fresh ingredients. We had a bottle of Frank Family Chardonnay, delicious. Perfect meal. Mama was happy. =)

Really good place for large parties. We saw a few families celebrating birthdays. Main dish that we ordered wasn’t extraordinary but it was good. The drinks, Brussels sprout salad and service is outstanding! If you’re East of the tunnel definitely worth trying.

It was a celebration for my son's graduation from College. Sat out on patio. Lovely table in nice area. Live music-man playing guitar and singing. Not too loud, was just right. Service was a bit slow, not very attentive. Food was good. All in all it was a good experience and a nice meal. Great ambiance. That is why I like Bridges patio if the weather is good!

The atmosphere is wonderful but the choices for brunch limited and a bit strange. An omelet or just plain eggs and bacon/sausage and a sweet pastry would be a nice addition. Great service but food a bit bland.

Our dining experience was enjoyable at the beginning but service provided by our waiter was sketchy. We have enjoyed going to Bridges over an extended period of time, as the food is excellent. I would still recommend, but service missed the mark with us this time.

Love the overall feel of this restaurant. Our server  Nico, was very helpful and friendly & able to answer any questions we had regarding the menu! Our food was AMAZING, so flavoursome! 
Highly recommend to all
Unbelievable errors with our order - two out of four main dishes were wrong. Food presentation and taste was below par for the price.
Great service!
Still love this place! The food was beautifully presented and the taste lived up to the visual preview. Reminds me that I need to return more often.

bridges had been highly recommended by our parents, Check Please and the other couple we were dining with. However we were very disappointed in our meal. The one good dish was the Asparagus Risotto that was ordered by our vegetarian friend. My husband ordered a pork chop that was dry, my friend ordered the special of the day which was halibut. She said it was “so,so”.  I had the artichoke ravioli which had no flavor in the filling or the sauce. I ate very little and took the rest home to try later thinking that maybe the wine we had with dinner was too heavy for that dish. Sadly, it was equally flavorless after having no wine.  This was very expensive meal to have been so poorly prepared.
Love Bridges and always food is perfect. Great atmosphere .

Food surprisingly mediocre

Swordfish dry

Vegetables uneven temperature

Really surprisingly poor
We sat outside and the wait staff seemed to lose track of us so had to ask a busboy to get a waiter for us.  After that, it went more smoothly.  Food was OK, but it migt have been what I ordered.
This the second time I had been to Bridges. It's just a great, friendly vibe place, and I highly recommend it. the food is always great, too!
Outdoor seating for Mother’s Day. Heater did not work. Menu was underwhelming with outrageous pricing. Extremely disappointed.

VERY arrogant hosts at the front desk. They act as if they are the only restaurant in Danville. It is great that they had Mrs. Doubtfire give them "kudos" 20 years ago, but the place is desperately trying to hold on to that image, even though it is long gone.  The food is small portioned and extremely expensive. Bartender is so-so at that "level" of restaurant, they need to hire a bartender that knows how to make any kind of drink- perfectly, not a college student. Overall I would come back, however, it will not be for sometime.

In spite of our unwillingness to go out to brunch on Mother's Day because the food is usually not very good, we assumed that with a prix fixe menu  Bridges would yield a great meal.  However, it was a little disappointing -- not up to its usual high standards.

We frequent Bridges and really love it. Booked Mother’s Day brunch for the family. I wouldn’t choose to do it again. Prices were ridiculously high for Prix Fix menu and the food  choices were not broad enough for various family members to find things that you really wanted to eat, let alone for the prices. Service was unusually slow and not overly engaged. Cocktail order wasn’t right but the food was good. We also went on New Year’s Eve and the set selections were much better. That said, Bridges is a great restaurant and will go back for regular dining.
Mother’s Day brunch was a full-on price gouge with mediocre food and poor service.  Experience only saved by the beautiful outdoor setting.  Unlikely to return.

Went for Mother's Day and obviously paid a premium for the privilege.  I don't mind paying inflated prices if the food stood up to the price, but it simply didn't.  The French Toast "casserole" came out and looked like dog food in a bowl, with strawberry's and cream, visually very off-putting ($40), and my biscuits and gravy ($46) were no different than the $10 version I'd get at greasy spoon.  It was a pre-fix with an appetizer (the truffled deviled egg toast was probably the best part of the meal) and dessert (the cake was dry and mostly flavorless, the espresso cream was still partially frozen, so they either left it in the freezer to set too long, or it wasn't made fresh that day) and the berry tart with cream was more like a cheesecake cream, which wasn't stated in the description.  The Potatoes were completely soft, no crispness at all.  I don't mind paying $130 for a meal, I mind paying $130 for a lackluster meal that tasted no better than what I could get for $25 at Denny's.
Mother’s Day

It was a very nice evening. Our server didn’t rush us and made sure everything was to our satisfaction. I was disappointed in the appetizer. The Brie wasn’t really big enough for four of us. All our dinners were delicious.

When we eat at Bridges and are never disappointed.  It is a regular restaurant for us when we want to go somewhere for special occasion or for dinner with friends.  It is also good choice fir business meals.

We just had a fantastic dinner at Bridges! The food was delicious, the service was very friendly, and the ambiance was beautiful! A+ for presentation with the meals! I am definitely coming back here again.

On a whim I booked a reservation as the weather was nice and we hadn't visited in over a year.  We have our favorites around town but wanted something different.  We ordered the Brussels sprout salad, steak, curry prawns and kids burger.  The salad unfortunately had anchovies (which wasn't mentioned in the menu) I am allergic so couldn't have that.  The steaks were cooked well but it just was okay.  Maybe if it was accompanied with cooked veggies other than mushrooms might have made it more flavorful.  The curry prawns were a bit bland but our son liked his burger and fries.  For the price we wished we had gone to one of our go to restaurants as we were all hungry in about an hour.  Loved sitting outside and the musician was very talented.
Bridges is always delicious & the staff is always polite, happy, young folks. Everything was perfect except that they were cleaning all around us as we were in last brunch seating.
My favorite go to spot for Danville love the food love the service staff is wonderful and the food is consistently excellent.
Great burgers.

Lunch with friends.  Ordered the Rueben and it came on toasted white bread.  Just pastrami and cheese!  Really??  
This Danville institution is living on its reputation.   My guests were equally underwhelmed.
Wonderful outside spot on the patio on a warm night.  Amazing food once again...proving to be our favorite restaurant in Danville.
Bridges never disappoints. Service was great, location was great, patio is beautiful, food was delicious!
Ordered the chicken and besides being cold, it tasted like Costco roasted chicken with some strange sauce smeared on.  Very disappointing.
We had a nice outdoor dining experience to celebrate my daughter’s birthday.  We enjoyed the guitar player/singer and our meal was very tasty. Perfect evening!
Absolutely delicious food, wonderful outdoor patio.
Please be sure I receive credit for our meal. Your System sent me a note stating we we a ‘no show’ which isn’t correct. Please confirm!
Anniversary

Birthday dinner.  It was good food all around.   Nice wine and drink selection.  Big eye tuna appetizer was delicious.  NY cheesecake dessert was tasty too.  All main dishes were done right and we enjoyed everything.

I have been to Bridges twice in the last two months.  Both times, the people with me and myself have had a hard time finding something on the menu that appealed to us.  One person out of 5 was pleased with the food when it arrived.  It’s not that the food is bad, it is that the menu doesn’t have anything appealing on it.

Our party for 4 arrived early and were seated in an excellent table.  Service, food and the server were excellent.  Special of the day was recommended and was also excellent.  Salads were fresh and just the right  size. to compliment an entrée.  My husband had the soup which he also pronounced to be fresh and excellent.  Only small hiccup was waiter forgot my wine but offered the wine glass at no charge when was mentioned it was forgotten.  We will definitely eat here again when we are in the area.
Bridges always meets and exceeds my expectations! We had wonderful craft cocktails in the bar and the Prix Fixe menu was enjoyed by all.
It was great!!

I had dinner with a girlfriend but this can be a special occasion place or business place. Service is great. I had the salmon over black forbidden rice. It’s my favorite fish there. Try it!

The dessert menu is lacking. But we went down the street and got frozen yogurt. Yum!
Really nice waiter Ben. Attentive with good timing. Didn’t feel rushed. Yummy fish and the coconut strawberry sorbet was delish!

Two of our group got good food, but the salmon dish I ordered wasn’t cooked correctly.  It was crusty, dry and had no flavor.  The quinoa on which the salmon was placed was tasteless, so I asked for balsamic vinegar.  The waitress didn’t bring it.  Finally, I asked another wait staff member to replace my dish.  The new dish was barely cooked, and the second batch of quinoa was tasteless.  Very disappointing!

We dined at Bridges for a special occasion. There was something on the menu for every one. We had a party of six. The waiter was outstanding and well informed. We had a wonderful, delicious, relaxing, and fulfilling evening. It was really perfect!
Outstanding service and good food.    People there may you feel welcome and they do remember you.

Service started slow. No waitress not waiter approached us   To check if we were ready to order. We had to call the attention of a busboy who left to call the waitress assigned to our table. Apart from this, everything was perfect as always.

This was our first time at Bridges where we had lunch. Our waiter was very busy and we had to wait to get things like salt & pepper, coffee, etc.. but he was very courteous. Bus staff could have picked up the slack but I don’t think the structure was in place for them to do that. The food was OK. The location is lovely: the patio is set away from the street so it is peaceful and quiet with redwoods and a lot of plants. It was nice trying it but I don’t think we will go out of our way to go back.
Always love going to Bridges.  Seems like we go there for only for special occasions when we should go there more often.  Service was top notch.  Food was great.

We enjoyed our meal at Bridges.  My husband had the Salmon and I had the Swordfish.  For an appetizer we enjoyed baked Brie and pear which was delicious.  For dessert I had expressions ice cream with chocolate shavings which is housemade.  We would have enjoyed sitting outside listening to music but they were very busy and we had to sit inside.  Quite noisy but enjoyable.

Service was poor, food was not even average. We ordered NY steak and fresh catch of day; swordfish, in the future would not eat there unless maybe the bar specials.  Music and outdoor seating is terrific, all the rest ... not good
Food and service is consistently good. Never disappointed.

The service was superb. The ambiance was friendly, busy and  very noisy. My wife ordered the New York Steak, my daughter the Tuna, and both enjoyed their meal. I ordered the pork chop, and sent it back because it was way over cooked. Its replacement was better but certainly not to my liking. I didn't eat but a few bites. I was disappointed  considering its cost.  We drove in from Benicia, not sure if I would do it again.

The menu was very limited at brunch and lunch.   I’m fact, it was so limited that I ordered a cheeseburger. The burger had a very charred taste to it.  There was no mayonnaise- just a flavored aioli, which I found warm , (temperature wise), and not pleasant tasting.

We had a terrific brunch while meeting some family from out of state that we had never met before. The food was very good (7 of us ordered a variety of dishes and liked them). The service was excellent. We had a young, enthusiastic and engaged waiter. I really appreciated the restaurant accommodating my food sensitivities and being so nice about it. We sat outside on the patio, which was beautiful. The whole experience was perfect.
The food was delicious and served on time. My only complaint would be that it was a bit too noisy sor fine dining.
Service was great, they could almost read our minds. The table was ready when we arrived and we were served right away. Will definitely refer friends and visit again.
Love sitting outside. The staff cancelled my reservation though we were seated and there.
Bomb amazing great grand wonderful

It was our beighbors’s first time; and they definitely loved it! There were a lot of private parties, so we were happy to go at 5:45pm and leave, as service definietly dropped after 7:30 pm because it was so busy.

We drove from Modesto and our son drove from Marin so we chose Bridges as a halfway point. We used to go to Wente for Sunday brunch but that is no longer available. We couldn't have been more pleased with our new choice! We have designated Bridges as our new halfway spot. We were celebrating two birthdays and Bridges surprised us with song and dessert!. Brunch/lunch choices all looked wonderful. The guys went for the gourmet burger and I had the grilled prawn Chinese noodle salad. We would all order our choices again but it is very tempting to explore the menu. The lamb shanks and the chicken and waffles were on our list as well as the shaved brussel sprout salad. It was too cool for us to eat on the lovely patio even with heat lamps but we will do that weather permitting. Nicole was our waitress and she was a pleasure to be with, very informative and friendly. This was a great experience. We are looking forward to our next visit.
Great place, great food! Of course made famous by Mrs Doubtfire but far from a tourist trap. Definitely worth the trip from San Francisco if your in the area
Been going here for years,place has gotten out of hand with the noise level
2  birthday celebrations. Was quite terribly noisy.

The atmosphere has completely changed at Bridges. Upscale fine dinning is not the emphasis. Food preparation, ingredients, and creativity are a bit diminished, but by the busy activity on a Saturday night, diners have adjusted their expectations. Enjoyed our meal, if we kept in mind that it’s become more of a neighborhood restaurant. The cafeteria style laminated faux wood chairs are a real challenge to overcome in that space. Sorry to see the changes, but suppose that’s a direction Bridges had to take to stay afloat.
Anniversary

Pretty much same menu they have had for quite sometime.  Missing their spring rolls and plum sauce they used to have for an appetizer. No potatoes of any kind offered. Food was only ok. Lintel soup was outstanding. The prawns in the Mexican Thai dinner were over cooked. Not an exciting type menu. It will be a long time before we are back. Too many great restaurants are in the area. Maybe if menu changes.

Three of us ordered the salmon salad and it came with a yellow sauce that tasted horrible!  It tasted like dish soap.  We asked for the salads to be re-made and the waiter agreed but did not apologize or offer us any sort of discount.  I have never sent food back or written reviews but I was expecting a wonderful meal and it was not good at all.  Wilted lettuce, not seasoned well and the horrible sauce.  Very disappointing for a high end restaurant.  It was my moms birthday and she didn't even eat her salad.
The restaurant is amazing.  We had lunch outside and the outdoor patio was wonderful.  The food was absolutely delicious!
Great menu.  Great food.  Great service.  Great restaurant.  Always consistent.  A real gem.

Food was terrific.  The chef was very accommodating to our needs.  Kyle, our server, was excellent.  Noise level was too high.  Difficult to have a conversation.   We like Bridges but noise level is an issue.

We’ve been to Bridges several times before and have always had a wonderful experience and this time was no different other than an even hotter entree (always good!). The food was delicious, service was excellent and I have to commend Bridges on a consistently positive experience every time we visit!
As always, dining at Bridges was a very pleasurable experience.   The food was excellent, EXCEPT for the dressing on the baby spinach salad...we both thought it was way to oily/greasy.

Appreciated the wait staff for my business dinner. Our server Brian was very professional and attentive demeanor which is really appreciated. They are also very accommodating to our request as needed. Thank you.

Always a pleasure for a special occasion.  Great Service.  Lovely gluten-free dessert
for my Birthday Guest.  so kind of the Chef to do that.  It was very very tasty for both of us.

Both myself and my friend had the salmon on top of a lettuce bed. The salmon was good an cooked well but the creme fraiche sauce with mustard had an unpleasant metallic taste and we both sent ours back to have the sauce removed..A birthday cupcake was nicely served to my friend.
Anniversary
Birthday, nicely played cupcake with Happy Birthday.

4 of us celebrated a birthday- we ordered smaller plates (salad, appetizers & shared) 
It was delicious, service was great & we had a nice time!
A gracious atmosphere and an excellent waiter really don't offset the prices especially in consideration of portions on the small side.
Beautiful day to enjoy Easter brunch on the patio.
Easter brunch
Love coming here and have for holidays. Our Easter brunch was good

We go to Bridges often and it never disappoints! The food was incredible, we had an appetizer, Salad, and entree and all of it was delicious. Our waiter was awesome, we brought our own wine and he decanted it right away. We also sat outside and there was live entertainment! Always a great place to eat!
Food was excellent and service was good. We haven’t been in a few years but still a very good experience.

We had not been to Bridges for many years & decided to have lunch there.  It was a pleasant warm day & the patio was restful.  Everything was excellent.  The only negative was that the music needs to be in the background(ie, softer) & more suited(less musak) to this casual/elegant restaurant.
Great brunch with $4 mimosas!

Had not been here in quite a few years.  Went for my 60th birthday and we all had fantastic meals: Swordfish was incredible as was the Lamb shank.  We enjoyed the spinach salad to start and finished off with Chocolate creme brulee

We were celebrating my husband’s birthday. It was a very nice day so we sat outside. The food was great as it always is. I think we were in a change in servers so the service was a little off but overall everything was great
The food was beautifully presented and delicious.  We had a quiet table just like we requested. The service was excellent attentive and timely.
Food and service excellent. Unfortunately mixed drinks were not good. Tried two different kinds, both were bad.
Friendly and courtesy  staff  Good value Nice atmospher

It was my Daughter’s Birthday and the restaurant and staff knocked it out of the park! A dining experience to be remembered! Absolutely wonderful and accommodating! Thank you so very much! Great job! 👌💕
We’re never disappointed here.  Only curiosity...why doesn’t the Mexican chocolate Creme brûlée have any kick?

This was our first time at Bridges and I honestly had never heard of it.  My husband and I were looking for somewhere to have a lovely late dinner in the area while our daughter was at her prom down the road in San Ramon.  What a nice surprise!  The atmosphere is very warm and elegant, the service was fabulous and the food was delicious.  All our dishes were executed fabulously with very interesting flavor combinations.  There were lots of subtle asian flavors blended in with very classic dishes.  Would definitely go back!

Very interesting menu. Portion sizes are LARGE. Should have split the dessert. Noise level pretty high. It began to fill up as we were getting ready to leave, so the bill was returned a bit later than anticipated.
been here millions of times over 25 years. Oh forgot to say during warm weather patio is nice and sometimes a little music
Had a wonderful birthday celebration, asked for a quiet table and was provided a nice spot. Everyone was enjoyable and the food was delicious!
My friend and I had a difficult time finding something on the menu to order for lunch.
Everything was well done with the food and wine being excellent..  The server and table staff took very good care of us.

Outstanding dinner. Interesting,  unusual salads (shared as first course!)   Wonderful lamb shanks and a perfect New York Steak. Outstanding service and fabulous desserts. Bridges is our favorite restaurant in Danville. It never disappoints!

We went here for our wedding Anniversary. It was the perfect place for that romantic vibe. We were seated at a table for two by the window. The wait staff were all very knowledgeable of the menu and we felt free to ask questions.
We started out with the beet risotto. Now mind you I hate beets but the waitress assured me you couldn’t really tell it was in there and she encouraged me to try it and we loved the risotto. Well she was so right it had such a vibrant color and was so rich with cheesy tastes with just the right amount of creaminess and salt. Oh man we ate that dish up. 
For dinner I ordered the salmon. It was cooked to perfection. My salmon had a crusty top to it with small sprouts on top as well. The black rice as the side was like a puffy yet crispy rice. The rice had an interesting texture but in a good way. I loved the whole dish. My husband got a steak with mushrooms on top with a side of polenta. The steak was cooked as requested and the polenta was very creamy and smooth. There were also brussel sprouts that were fried up to the correct consistency. 
We never had to wait a long time for our drinks or wait for a waiter to come by. Everyone there was very lovely and we would definitely go back for a lovely dinner.

They never filled our water again, the food was okay. The dinner came but no one had cleared the appetizers. The drinks were marginal. My chicken was hard to eat and tasted dry the dish itself tasted like expensively priced cheap Indian food. They really try with the flavors but this place is not as it once was. I used to love the food. Not so much anymore. It is a 90’s Asian fusion place that needs an update.

Came to celebrate our Anniversary.  Food, ambiance and service were all good.  However, the noise level was so bad my husband could hardly hear what I was saying from across the table.  Typically, we've enjoyed this restaurant......end result we cancel our Easter reservation.

Amazingly poor service. Not even half way through our meal and the busboy is asking if he can clear the table.... I had fork in hand! Okay so he made a mistake, but throughout our meal this repeated it self three more times. Can't they tell we have not finished! The wait staff in general was less then attentive, really lacked class. Oh well, a classy establishment with second class service, to bad.

Pretty good entrees. I opted to go for the filet even though I told myself not to get steak at a non-steak house. It was fine and I preferred the sauce and sides over the actual steak. But still, it was creative and flavorful. But if you're looking for a great steak, go to a steak place, you know?

My date had the salmon (we actually swapped mid way through) and I loved the fish but didn't care much for the side it was served with. But still, it was a flavorful dish.

The desserts were killer: Mexican chocolate creme brulee and a peanut toffee ice cream. I'd rate the desserts were way better than the entrees.

All in all, a nice, quiet place for dinner with good food. I've eaten here for lunch a few times before and enjoyed it. Dining here for dinner left me with the same thoughts: nice and pleasant.

We've enjoyed Bridges in the past for special occasions, but this time we had unimpressive service. Our young man was nowhere to be found. We had to track him down whenever we wanted something. ( ie water, dessert, return an order)
Love the atmosphere. Food was great and staff attentive and friendly. Recommend a reservation during peak time. Outside seating when the weather is nice.

We were there on 4th  March with party of 8 for wedding celebrations. But, I was rather shocked to see those very uncomfortable wooden chairs . It was rather shocking to see them in such a classy restaurant. I wish they would reduce their prices first before using those wooden chairs. We were so uncomfortable that we left immediately after the main course. We also had an old and sick person with us and it saddened us to see the pain on her face. We will never go to Bridges again.

Husband’s birthday dinner. Had a great predinner cocktail. Loved the Rare Bird, a little spicy.  Food was good. Loved the tartar.   I mentioned on open table it was for a birthday and they brought a special dessert at the end. Love this place.
Our waiter Ben was very professional, efficient, and personable.
A little pricey and the food was not outstanding. But all round, a very pleasant atmosphere and service.

Family and friends get together,  ten of us were accommodated very well.   Had brunch and it was a great menu something for everyone.   But most got the chicken and waffles, excellent.  Bill was reasonable considering the amount of people.
Great ambiance, fun cheery place
My husband and I treated my sister and husband to dinner for her birthday. We all ordered different entrees and each one of us raved about the dish. Great ambience and service as well!

Bridges is always a great place for meeting friends or business meeting.
Food and staff are wonderful!
Very nice patio seating!!
Love Bridges for lunch!
It was a lovely birthday dinner! Our waiter even brought my a cupcake with a candle at the end!
Took my daughter for her birthday. We had a great time; food and service excellent. Two office parties going on so was rather noisy but overall nice.
One of my favorite restaurant, the chef is very creative, the food is tasty and healthy, great service, we enjoy a lot.
The service was excellent and the food fabulous.  We will go again and again!
A very nice location!

Had a great birthday brunch. They effortlessly accommodated a party of 12 young adults. Outside patio seating was great. Only item - we brought in a cake - and were charged a plating fee of $2.50 per person. Was not aware of charge when I called in prior to making sure it was ok to bring in a cake. Should be more transparent and forthcoming about their fees.

We arrived early and were seated at a quiet table inside as it was chilly outdoors. The service was polite and friendly but our server didn’t come by frequently enough so there were long waits for drinks and for ordering dessert. Everyone enjoyed their meal and had a good time. As the restaurant filled it got quite loud. I’d go back for brunch if it was a good day for patio seating, but try elsewhere for indoors.

Everything for the food was great and delicious with the exception of the special on the menu that evening which was filet and shrimp with sausage.  It was an absolute big disappointment.  The filet mignon was thin, pan fried, very dry and flavorless, with two very dry and bland shrimp (not large prawns) and the sausage was cut into very thin and small quarters mixed in with too many vegetables.  When  the waiter told us about the filet mignon and shrimp, we were expecting a nice thick, grilled to perfection with somewhat large, juicy prawns and creatively-cooked sausages.  A huge disappointment for the value and for a 'special' on the menu in an upscale restaurant.
Wonderful restaurant.  Great food, service, ambiance, and in a quiet setting.  The free valet parking is very nice.  My gin martini was perfect!  It was a great Valentine's Day dinner.
Great meal!  Had lamb and swordfish on Valentine’s Day.
A lovely eve for our Valentines. The tables were just a bit tight
Always one of the best in town

Valentine’s dinner on 2/13. Food was top notch as was the service. Restaurant was animated but not excessively noisy. We were seated right away and they were sensitive to my dietary needs (lactose free).  I had sea bass special and he had swordfish and we both had starter salads. Good wine selection by the glass.
We are always very satisfied with your restaurant but this time, I was shocked to find the chairs are super heavy and very, very uncomfortable .

My husband and I have birthdays two days apart and there is no better place to celebrate than Bridges!  The food is exceptional (ahi tuna and a very buttery fish with capers). Dessert was delicious and their Bulleit manhattans are wonderful. It is a place where one feels that they have really been treated well

I hadn't been here in about a year and was pleasantly surprised.  I think the menu is better, more choices and the specials were very creative.  Three of the group ordered the reasonably priced prix fixe menu which had three courses for $29.00.  All of the staff were very attentive and pleasant.
Je n’ai pas été impressionné avec les serveurs qui ne sont pas attentifs.
Lamb shank was great. Had a lovely quiet corner. Good friends, good food—cannot beat that combo

It was a great food experience. I have the Seared Tuna and wife had the Crusted Salmon. Both excellent choices. I had an old fashioned drink, that cam excellent as well. Service was a little slow. We were seated in the far end of the patio, maybe that's why but minus one star for that.

The ambience is good and so is location. Service is ok. But for the price and occasion this truly failed with too much noise and the food was not great at all - NY Steak and Butternut Squash soup were just fine but the Chicken was really bad! 

We were there to celebrate our Wedding Anniversary and I would not recommend this place for such occasion as it is too casual with quite a bit of noise!
It’s wonderful for every day and special dinners. Love this place!!
Good food reasonably priced with efficient service. Quiet and prompt seating.

I've had many meals at Bridges...Not sure what happened yesterday but the spinach salad hardly had any dressing and the chicken added on was very dry. Really not good at all.  I had a better salad at The Habit the day before for half the cost. I will call this a fluke...
My friend said their meal was okay. The only reason I give it 4 stars is the ambiance and service was great.  I should have sent it back but this was a business meeting so I just let it go.
Bridges patio on a sunny day is always fun for lunch, happy hour or dinner.  And when they have live music, even better.  The food is always good and I love the fruit infused ice tea.
Great server, Aaron.  Good meeting spot, thanks!

I’ve been disappointed with the menu the last few times I’ve gone. The choices were mostly fish, one steak choice, one lamb choice, one chicken dish and one vegetarian option. I think they could have a better variety. The quality of the food is not in pace with the cost.
Food was really good and the service was great and would definitely recommend this place.
Beautiful restaurant, great service,  love the menu and quality of food.  The patio is beautiful
Wife birthday
Great experience!  Great service and creative menu selection

Wonderful dinner! Service is terrific and the manager Lisa makes you feel like you are a part of the family. 
Highly recommend !

Very comfortable & casual vibe with Danville charm. The food is good, but not pretentious. Menu is appropriately varied, but I'd definitely try the Asian noodle shrimp salad which was DELICIOUS. The quinoa power bowl salad with steak just didn't have enough flavor, with shredded brussel sprouts delivering a bitter taste without a better dressing. However, the steak was cooked perfectly and was REALLY tender. Will DEFINITELY be returning to this hidden gem in quaint downtown Danville.

We have out of town family who come to visit and they always want to go to Bridges.  The food is  delicious, serving staff friendly and helpful.  You can count on a delicious meal.  They are consistently fantastic.
Always great atmosphere, server was very pleasant and friendly. Food was great and restaurant was nice and clean. Second time here and will be back.
It was my birthday.  We were seated and waiter took our order. After that, our waiter never came by to check on us.

The food and service  were both excellent! What was really impressive was the car valet saw had our car in front with seat heaters on when we got to the front door. My daughter was on crutches, and it was so kind of him to have the car THERE before we even presented the ticket!
Food & drinks were refreshing! Would return again!

As always Bridges was wonderful!
Brian our waiter was fabulous!!
We were celebrating a birthday which 
Was great fun!

First visit to Bridges and there will be more in the future.  Bridges is gem conveniently located in downtown Danville.  Parking isn't a problem, ambience is subdued and even romantic. We had swordfish which was perfectly prepared and presented and the waitress suggested a white wine that went well with dinner.  Dessert was an outstanding creme brulee done just right.  My only complaint is the noise level in the dining room which interfered with conversation at times.  The restaurant was packed on this Saturday evening with customers enjoying the food and ambience.
Had a sea bass that was cooked to perfection on a bed of quinces, absolutely delightful

It has been over 25 years since we have dined at Bridges - which was during the era of when original owner Art Bridges owned it and when that famous scene from Mrs. Doubtfire (Robin Williams) was filmed in the restaurant.   We now live in Southern Orange County, CA, and when we wanted to get together with some old friends, this was our mutual choice.  All four of us were extremely pleased with our meals, the service, and the ambiance.  I had the Portobello Mushroom Raviolis and they were truly outstanding!  Close to, if not the best I've ever had!

The bartender was very friendly and attentive. Our waiter did a fine job but should have come around more frequently to pour the wine we bought from them. Food is excellent, I had the Mexican Prawns with curry sauce
I can always count on Bridges to deliver delish fresh food & great service

We’ve been going to Bridges for years. Although we hadn’t been in 1 year. They changed the menu and we didn’t see anything that we would want to eat on the main entrees.  So I ordered a steak. The worst steak I’ve ever had. Wasn’t seasoned well at all. The server even acknowledged that he’s heard this. He noticed I didn’t eat it so he took it off the bill. I was greatful for that. 

Please change your menu back. This is the farthest it’s been from the normal type of menu I’ve seen here.

From soup to nuts , as they say, we were treated with delicious food and a wonderful wait staff.
Our shrimp salads were wonderful.  We will return for our next friend’s birthday celebration.
A place to celebrate and enjoy!
We celebrating our Anniversary  and it was very enjoyable.

Oh man, the Macadamia Nut Crusted Salmon on wild rice....so awesome! Bridges Danville continues to be a California legend - Great ambience, great outdoor seating, great food, nice wine list, and some very creative cocktails. Proof once again that good eats in the Bay Area are not limited to San Francisco!

Hans Thoma

The Mexican shrimp with Thai sauce was OUTSTANDING.  Brie and Tuna appetizer great as well.  Down side was the noise.  I couldn't hear 3 of the 6 people in our party.  Squeezed out table in between  4 tops and our chairs were bumped repeatedly.
WE LOVE TO DINE EARLY, WE ALWAYS SEE SOMETHING SPECIAL ON THE MENU, BREAKFAST LUNCH OR DINNER. WE RECEIVED EXCELLENT SERVICE!
Never had a bad experience here!

Bridges was fabulous, from entry to exit. Valet was quick and easy. Hostess was very pleasant. Our service was directed by Maya. She was awesome. Our appetizer was delicious, drinks were generous and the entrees were phenomenal. My wife had the swordfish and I had the ribeye. Dessert was so yummy. We shared the gingerbread pudding. Just an enjoyable evening.

Bridges is great for summer outdoor dining. Being there in January left a bit to be desired. Food was fine, but service was less than attentive and any semblance of real hospitality was lacking. We'd go again for lunch, but for dinner probably only in the summer to enjoy their patio.
Very enjoyable meal!
Party of 14, all food came out at the same time and cooked to perfection!  Shawn was our server and did an excellent job.  The Filet was amazing!
I met a friend I had not seen in a while. We both had the Seafood Cioppino and found it to be excellent.   It was a bigger bowl than we expected for lunch. I would order it again.
Two of us ordered the New York steak and it was barely 1/2” thick and tasted like a steak you’d expect from a fast food restaurant. Terrible!!

Lisa, our hostess, was very kind and personable.  She made us feel welcome and important and as if we had known her for some time.  The cuisine was exquisite, as all of our party of 4 thoroughly enjoyed everything we ordered.  The wait staff was outstanding in their attentiveness and timing, without making us feel rushed, etc.  Ours  was a VERY PLEASANT DINING EXPERIENCE.  (I have already recommended Bridges to other members of my family, my friends, and my business partners.)
Went to celebrate New Years Eve close to home . Service  was excellent with multiple  employees taking part.
The Pre Fix menu was just not that good. Food was bland not tasty.

Wanted to have a nice meal NY eve but very disappointed. I wasn’t told the menu is different ahead of time when called me to confirm the reversation. Once sat down, bread was hard and cold. Server (high school kids) standed by the bar chating, in front of the food. Kids meal wasn’t include the drink until I asked for it, and the cup was so small about 3 oz and full of ice. Can finished the drink in 5 zip for kids. Order chicken tender as kids meal and I feel like those are Costco frozen chicken stripe. Appetizer was poor, no quality at all as a fine dining restaurant. Over $220 for this meal is really not worth. Ruin my new year holiday just because this experience. Never go again and never recommend sorry.

I went here with my husband for New Year Eve. They had a special menu. The food had no taste. My first course was a soup that was supposed to have crab. No crab. The waiter noticed I didn’t eat it and came over to offer me a different appetizer. That was a beef tar tar. It was much better in taste but crazy spicy. 
My main dish was fish and again not much flavor and the fish was dry. I couldn’t eat it. The dessert was a chocolate mouse and that was delicious. I was surprised the meal had no flavor because they charge $72. The waiter comped my meal so that was very nice. I didn’t complain about the meal so I appreciate that they noticed I didn’t enjoy it and made sure I didn’t pay for it. That’s good management/service. They just need to hire a different executive chef. Too many restaurants to compete with to have food taste like that.
Amazing ambiance, amazing food, amazing service. Brian was very attentive at all times, professional and knowledgeable. I will definitely be back soon.
One of the best meals I have had in a long time. Outstanding
Our dinner was enjoyable except for the fact that My steak was over cooked and I should have spoken up.  We were treated very nicely for our anniversary.

The food was amazing. Every single bite was full of flavors. The wine selection was pretty good if you like to enjoy a good wine. The cocktail list offers a wide array of original cocktails. The restaurant is a good option for dates, family or group events, anniversaries, birthdays, any special occasions.
Thanks to Open Table for facilitating the reservation and to the Bridges team bringing a lovely and delightful evening.
Great service! Excellent food! Comfortable ambiance!
Bridges is a nice place for a date or a large group. The wait staff is very attentive. The menu has a nice variety. It is also good for brunch.
Always great.  You'll never be disappointed with your dining experience at Bridges.
Very loud. Unruly table in section allowed to ruin the experience of other dinners. The price / value ratio was off

Ordered two Holiday Specials with Filet Mignon which were good.   Ordered two grilled New York’s that I wouldn’t feed to my dog.  Grisle throughout and paper thin.  What a waste of a special Holiday meal.  Just horrible.

I have been eating at bridges since it opened years ago. It is always been the best, but the newest menu is absolutely fantastic.  My best friend and I chose it to have our Christmas dinner and gift exchange and it was one of the best meals we’ve ever had. We had four small plates and  salad and they were so creative, unique and delicious!
Lisa & Becky are THE best!  Lisa & Becky are THE best! Lisa & Becky are THE best!

Don’t look up. Dust and cobwebs everywhere. Space feels dated. For the money I did think it was worth the value. Service was great. Super friendly. Food was fine. Nothing to write home about. I wouldn’t go again though...

Not a very impressive visit to Bridges, despite so many great visits in the past. No valet at lunchtime during the holidays? Watered down cocktails? Possibly the world's worst french fries?  I will only return on the great strength of the dinner menu and service from past visits.
Had a delicious Sunday brunch.  I'd like to return when there is outdoor dining with music!
Fabulous on every level. Great service and people waiting on us; above and beyond PLUS GREAT menu where all six guest found something they loved on the menu!

With respect to food, this was truly one of the best restaurant meals I have ever had. The "for the table" starter of red beet risotto was outstanding; it was creamy with a beautiful beet color and topped with pieces of steamed pink beet (this was the key to sending it over-the-top) as well as two different cheeses--this is not to be missed! The two mains that my date and I shared were as wonderful as the starter. First was grilled, line-caught swordfish, atop a bed of black lentils with butternut squash and Applewood smoked bacon; the complex, smoky, earthiness of this dish was deeply satisfying and perfect for a chilly evening. On a par (or maybe even a bit favored) was rare ahi tuna on a sticky rice cake containing Chinese sausages. The rice cake was browned to a wonderful crunch on the outside; it was full of salty soy and sesame flavors and a texture that complemented the velvetiness of the tuna perfectly. For dessert we had pear tart with huckleberry syrup and ginger ice cream. The presentation of this was lovely, but the flavor was not particularly special; the pastry was a bit disappointing with regard to flavor and texture and neither of us tasted any ginger in the ice cream. 
     It was a VERY busy night at Bridges, perhaps because it is the holiday season. However, despite the busyness, the service was attentive (maybe a little too fast in removing my dinner plate since I was still chewing). The restaurant was packed and the patio was closed because the evening was chilly. Consequently, the restaurant was very noisy, and conversation was a bit difficult. For food this good, however,  I am willing to tolerate the noise. I think this would be a lovely place on a summer's evening to enjoy dinner on the patio; I imagine it would be a bit quieter. Wine list was also good.

It has been a while sine we dined at Bridges.  We normally sine in San Francisco but decided to try Bridges again since it was closer to home.  The food and service was splendid.  It was a very good evening and I would highly recommend the restaurant.
Extremely noisy from a party. Very slow service. Took almost 40 minutes to get a salad and burger and neither was anything special. Over hyped.

Bridges is always wonderful.
New menu items are great!
Great service and food. Always a consistently good experience.

I had a very tough steak!  Service very slow.
I told them, didn’t hear a thing
Waiter "Ben" outstanding.  Get your reservation at least a week ahead.

Bridges was beautifully and festively decorated for Christmas.  We were quickly seated and served. Our luncheon salads were fresh and delicious and the waitress surprised my friend  with a delicious chocolate, whip-cream iced cupcake with ”Happy Birthday” written on the serving plate in chocolate. Thank you, Bridges, for a scrumptious and wonderful birthday celebration for my dear friend!
Great food, decent vegetarian options, a little loud and the seats near the patio door were a little cold, but not terribly.  Excellent service, overall 4.7/5.
Great food and nice atmosphere . I will definitely comeback.
Out of town company/holidays

We had a tasty, affordable, and fun Thanksgiving dinner at Bridges. Although there was no vegetarian option on the menu, the chef had one for those who asked, and along with the sides provided at no extra charge, the meal was quite satisfying. The appetizers were nicely put together, but the beet salad was a too tiny for preference. The deserts were very beautifully arranged as well as tasty. Service was mostly good, although I did have to get up to get the attention of my server at one point.
Excellent food and service whenever we go. Reliable at all times.
Great Thanksgiving Day brunch.  Food, service,and venue were excellent.
Excellent - totally! A+ food & service!
Delightful. Great server. Salmon (on the salad) was sooo delicious, had fabulous sear on it. Jalapeño mimosa was great.
Bridges is always great. The food is amazing as is the service.
Lovely meal. Thanks for being consistent over all these years.
The baked brie appetizer was barely warm.  The Brussels  sprout salad was raw, which was not indicated on the menu.  The entree was nothing spectacular.  Service though was excellent.
I think Bridges is the best restaurant in Danville!

Ambience and service were amazing. My girlfriend has been wanting to go here forever since seeing it on Check Please. 

The food fell short , it had the foofy added to it without the tastes or quality .  I️ had the seared tuna and as clean of a catch that is you could tell it was 2-3 days old ( fishy taste ) . The kimchee and sauce thankfully balanced out the fishy taste . For the rest of the menu The dishes were rather basic and I️ wasn’t too much a fan of the fall menu having  squash, pumpkin  risotto in every damn meal. The only way to avoid the fall menu was to go with steak and fries .

The place is a local gem from what I️ know and the food is good , but not great. Not something I️ would choose for a special occasion , but would go back for lunch or a drink  if in the area. 

Good wine selection

Our waiter Zach was amazing!!
He went over and beyond!

Parking is getting tougher, but that is because of all the great places to eat so close by with Bridges being at the top of the list. Always great service and food. We always get appetizers and salads before the main course because they are just too good to pass on. Saturday nights can be busy and a bit loud, but it is a happy loud and folks are having a good time enjoying a great meal.

had a lovely dinner for 11 out of town guests from all over the country; every person
enjoyed the meal; the service was terrific and the food was delicious, as usual
Always a great experience

We had a wonderful experience at Bridges this evening.  A nice before dinner happy hour cocktail and truffle fries with the nicest bartenders and then a great dinner with impeccable service.   Seared tuna done just right and a filet done medium rare made a perfect combination to share.  We’ll be back!
What is surprise this was a disappointment. It was OK but it should’ve been awesome. I’d say that for the food service and the Decor.Sort of feels like it’s missing it’s soul .

I hadn't eaten at Bridges for a while and a house guest  remembered eating there and wanted to go again. Sadly, we were both disappointed. The entrees were limited, the entree descriptions weren't appetizing and we finally selected the New York steak. It tasted as though it were grilled in oil, probably wasn't 1/2 inch thick and was so tough you could hardly cut it. The blue cheese grits that were served with it were disgusting. The best part of the meal was the ice cream. Sadly, after many years of dining....I will never eat at Bridges again.

One of the oldest restaurants in Danville so less trendy but it always pleases. The chef has eliminated the "fusion" entries on the menu which is a good thing in that Bridges has gone back to basics which it does quite well.

Always delicious! From my all time fave, the shrimp red curry dish to all the fresh fish and the duck. All good. Service is great and friendly, and the ambience is nice, especially the outdoor dining in warm weather with live music.
The staff was very helpful and nice. The food was amazing! Everyone was so please that we would come back again for a business meetinf

The food was excellent, as was our waiter.  The kitchen food runners are lacking, though.  Our entrees arrived while we were in the middle of our salads, and the runner failed to apologize, she just rearranged everything on the table in order to jam our entree plates onto the table.  She had no concern that the entrees were early, and did not seem to care.  Our waiter did apologize after I pointed out that this was a significant faux pas, and he did comp dessert and coffee as a result.

Fine dining locations such as Bridges SHOULD KNOW not to bring the entrees until the salad plates have been cleared, and the complete lack of caring by the food runner was appalling.

Salads were bland, the steak was horribly over cooked (and also tasted and looked like it was expired). The location of the table that we received was awful, despite making a reservation a week in advance and requesting a great spot. Service was on the slow side. Won’t be going back again.
Friendly staff really took care of us. Great food.
Excellent service and outstanding food. I had the duck and it was wonderful! Would definitely recommend Bridges for a great dinner.

Slow and inattentive service.  The servers were either new or forgetful.  We were seated promptly upon arrival but server did not come to our table for at least 10 minutes. She finally came and greeted us at the table.  Took her a long time to come back to us to take our drink orders.  Even the hostess realized that we did not have any drinks on the table the whole time and offer to take our wine order.  Then another long wait before our waitress came back with the bottle of wine.  

We ordered the soup of the day which was squash soup.  It came out luke warm and really watery.  It was so blend that I think canned soup tastes better than that.  I also ordered the duck breast entree with cous cous salad.  The duck breast came out warm and the skin was soggy.  Dessert was NOT good either.  We ordered the chocolate souffle cakes and once again it came out cold.  I believe chocolate souffle cake supposed to be hot/warm.  

Total disappointment on this restaurant.
Delicious!! Always perfect and daily specials which are outstanding. Just ate there on Sunday evening and Monday evening. You will never be disappointed.

We were celebrating a friend’s birthday after church on Sunday. I had the avocado toast and salad and it was very good. My friends tried the burger and they really liked their choice as well. I was impressed with the live acoustic guitar artist who even came by to sing Happy Birthday to our friend. It was truly amazing.
The food was delicious and service outstanding.  Great place to dine!

We decided to go to Bridges as my kids are big fans of Mrs. Doubtfire. We were pleasantly surprised by the great food and atmosphere at Bridges. We had a great time and service was excellent. Gina was our server. She was very sweet and accomodating.

Enjoyable lunch, however, I waiter was not very good.  He took a long time to get drinks etc.  He forgot a few things that we had ordered and despite reminding him several times, failed to bring  the dishes/coffee.

Disappointing, but the ambience and the patio is wonderful.
Food was good enough, service was very slow -- Brian needs to step up his game.
Beautiful birthday lunch outdoors. As always, staff was over the top with accommodating all our needs, food was fabulous and overall ambience couldn’t have been better.

My wife and I are retiring and moving out of state. As a last celebration with friends we had to visit one last time.  Manager Lisa continues to offer  a menu, and bar service which are beyond reproach.  Thank YOU!

Yet again, nothing short of a delightful experience..The staff is always pleasant they even remember your face if not your name which is totally okay with us. One thing I've learned, the service and servers are a direct reflection of the individual in charge.  GM- Mrs. Lisa your staff is genuine, kind, pleasant and accommodating from the moment we arrive on site. Waiter Josh even remembers that Ken does not like fruit in his creme brûlée ..lol now thats exceptional! 
Thank you Bridges!

- Ken & Marie
- Vallejo

We were celebrating our anniversary and the restaurant went out of their way to make our evening memorable.  We were seated  immediately and our server was attentive but was able to pace our food arrival so we could enjoy our  evening.   The menu was varied and our dinner was delicious.  We will come back again soon.

The food and service is fantastic 
The salmon salad was different than usual instead of a single piece of salmon it was small slivers and not well presented or as good as usual.
Skip the bacon in the s’mores dessert as that’s not healthy and detracts from the great cheesecake.  Don’t get weird with the food choices and stick to fresh, local without too many added flavors or ingredients.

Awful service ! Extremely slow ......added gratuity as party of 10 themselves which was not worth adding on -
Taking it off our list ! For the price they charge and serve farmed salmon !!!!
One of those places where you always want to go to lunch.  The duck salad was delicious.  The first werenot crispt and had a kind of mealy texture.

We were celebrating  my wife's birthday and she thoroughly enjoyed the experience including the service, the romantic atmosphere and the delicious food that can best be described as Asian fusion.  She felt that the Three Course Prix Fixe Menu was an especially good value since it included soup or salad + dessert.

We waited almost an hour for our food to be served. First time engaged couples families were meeting - wait made it awkward and a little embarrassing.  Our waiter gave us a small bowl of fruit to apologize which was nice but there were 6 of us and 1/2 c fruit didn’t go far. Food good once we got it. Big party going on in next room. Bridges didn’t staff appropriately. Rarely saw our waiter, wait for food excessive.
I haven’t been to Bridges in years. Was surprisingly how much I had enjoyed it. It was quite an improvement.

Great food. Went right when it opened and was seated right away. The service was good, the only thing is the service got a little slow when more people showed up. Overall a great experience, will go again.
My sister and I wanted a quiet, adult dinner. We were looking for seafood and a good wine list. We got it all at Bridges. The food was great and the service was outstanding.
Outstanding food. We sat outdoors. Very romanticc. Two piece combo was outstanding.

Great place, one of our favorites ! 
Had a wonderful get together with a large group!
Thank you
We celebrated a birthday and everything was very enjoyable; nice variety on the menu, reasonably priced, service was good as well.

Celebrated a birthday luncheon with friends.  The food was excellent, the service exceptional.
This is a beautiful restaurant with a quiet, tranquil setting when eating al fresco.  The birthday girl  was served a delicious piece of chocolate cake as well. 
The restaurant was immaculate.  We arrived for an early lunch, just as they were opening, and the employees were wiping down all the outdoor spaces, heaters, umbrella stands and all the doors and windows leading outside.  You could tell by this much care with the surroundings and amenities that the food would also meet the same standard.

We’ve been going to Bridges for years.  Thought this time service was lacking.  Had to ask where our entrees were as we sat for almost an hour.  I ordered the flat iron steak which came room temperature so I assume it was sitting for awhile.  Too many options for restaurants.  Not rushing back.

We’ve been going to Bridges since it opened. Even before Robin William 
was there. 
Always great food that evolves as trends change, but classics are still there.  Great servers and staff. You do pay a bit more but it’s worth  it. 
Enjoy!
Just a wonderful night out. Not rushed.  Great service. The taste was just right. Can't wait to go back again.

The food was creative ample and tasty. The waitress wasn't on top of her game at all for us or there's orders near us... she blamed kitchen 
The salad hadn't come out because she never rang it in and missing item s on plate and desert (with wrong icecream on side) and dessert drink came about 15 minutes apart... but that said it's a pretty restaurant we've been to 2 times before. Expensive but good food
Shrimp noodle salad, yum
Out door dining with live music (not too loud) was fabulous!  Good was delicious too!

Loved the dinner and the garden patio is always beautiful.  I love listening to music during dinner  and am glad it's fresh music, a little upbeat. 
 Musicians asking for tips  is a a little weird.
I'll be back because the food is always prepared perfectly.
Bridges should ask Maria Maria in danville who they use for entertainment

We waited too long for a server to get to us for water, drinks, etc...
She was nice and efficient when when she did get to us.
I had the seafood cioppino, which was okay but not great.  It needed more flavor to the broth,
perhaps some fresh herbs as well.  My husband enjoyed the duck breast with an excellent couscous salad beneath.
Great place to dine.  Very good service! Will go back again.

Our table was ready for us when we arrived. The server was attentive and courteous. The experience was 5 star from the appetizer through the dessert. We will definitely be coming back more frequently. Great atmosphere!
Awesome! Always a good experience here.
Wonderful place to eat.  The outside dinning, was very quiet and romantic.  Our server Sean, was very friendly and attentive.  We will eat there again and recommend it to our family and friends.
never disappointed,healthy and tasty. The part I love is that the chef knows all kinds of ingredients and is very creative.

JUST A VERY NICE PLACE WITH CREATIVE FOOD AND PRESENTATIONS.
SERVICE NICE AND ATTENTIVE.
Excellent service and delicious food. My husband and I had a great time celebrating our anniversary. This was our second time here and we will definitely be back ;)

Lovely fall evening on the patio  Music was a plus.  White wine needs to be chilled more.

We each ordered a different seafood dish and loved all 3.

Desserts were delish!
One of the best restaurants I've been to. The food was impeccable.

Atmosphere was perfect! Food and drinks were brought out in a timely fashion. Service was excellent. It’s been a while since I’ve visited the restaurant and I’m happy to see it’s still just as good as I remember.

What the heck happened? Bridges used to be a great restaurant but we were there for lunch on Friday and the place was empty (first sign) we ordered Ceaser Salads with chicken and the lettuce was brown on all the edges. The manager said that it was delivered yesterday and because it's been hit, it turns brown faster! What?  If I wanted brown lettuce, I could have eaten at home. Then the eggplant sandwiches came out. The eggplant was cold and pre-fried and the bread was hard. Awful, really bad. Such a shame, pretty restaurant but c'mon.
I was very impressed with the cauliflower and chicken salad which we both had, it was different and had so many wonderful flavors
one of my favorite lunch spots in danville. love the salmon salad and great service
The Sunday through Wednesday Pre Fixe Menu is a gem. Lovely spot. Patio dining particularly nice. Great service.

I went to Bridges on Friday night with a friend and ordered the macadamia crusted salmon on the forbidden black rice. It was so delicious! We sat outside and the guitarist/ singer was the perfect addition to the ambiance. I couldn't stop thinking about the salmon, so I went back on Saturday night and requested an outdoor table again. Saturday's singer was practically hard rock! He was extremely loud, the song selection was hard rock and so disruptive to the ambiance that we asked to be moved indoors. Eventually they closed the doors to the outdoor area which was great so we wouldn't have to hear the music!  Food and service was just as good.  I recommend Friday night outdoors and Saturday  night  indoors!
Very good, had the NY Steak. Many items on the menu were intriguing.

The food is excellent, employing sauces that bring out the flavor of the entree.  They have an excellent prix fixe selection and multiple specials.  We have had dinner there now and then and have not been disappointed.
Family outing for Birthday celebration! Service was exceptional and food was delish!
4 meals, all not very good, under seasoned, lacking flavor, not good. Some portions wouldn't make an appetizer.
We love Bridges, as its where we got married 6 years ago!!
We had a wonderful time.  Food was delicious. They didn't rush us!  Great service
Really great service.   Our server was friendly and very engaged

Bridges maintains its reputation with superb ambiance, attentive service and delectable food! The watermelon and goat cheese starter was out of this world followed by delicious Mexican sea bass w salsa and perfectly cooked filet mignon. We had taken a couple of bottles of wine and our watchful server always made sure our glasses were never empty.  Perfect evening!
Very pleasant and classic restaurant experience.  Highly recommend after a long work week and a place to reward your efforts.

The duck entree was definitely the star of the meal. The salads were dressed with a very  tart and unpleasant vinaigrette and and the cioppino special was anything but. Amazing how Bridges can be so off on the specials time and again. The peach tart dessert was not memorable.

The service was superb, the food excellent, the only suggestion is it was so noisy with others talking that I could hear their complete conversations across the room.  This was a friday evening and a full house.  We had a fabulous time!!!

I'm so glad we found this restaurant!  First of all, they have a fabulous prix fix menu Sunday-Wednesday that we usually enjoy a couple times per month.  Their happy hour is great, and we will be coming back to try some of the happy hour food.  We love sitting outside during warm months and listening to the live music that has always been really nice.  The service is so friendly and very attentive without being annoying.  What else can I say?  We love Bridges!
Always reliable - excellent prep and presentation.  Love this place - we are very fortunate to have a destination like Bridges so accessible to us in the East Bay, especially the 680 Corridor.
Great brunch. Food was delicious and service was polite and not annoyingly asking questions every five minutes. Leisurely atmosphere with excellent prices.

We love this restaurant and they do care about the customer. When we had a bad experience once they made the effort to change our minds and we did come back and had a much better experience. The food is very good.

Normally I like going to Bridges. But this day something was off. I've had better eggplant sandwiches. The waiter kept telling another table and mine that he was "sorry" each time he came back to the table. Apologizing for the kitchen. Apologizing for not bringing more water, etc.. The brunch menu is more limited than the weekly menu. Will go back but not for brunch.
We love Bridges for the atmosphere. the service is always good.  The menu is limited compared to other good restaurants in the area.

We were in the Walnut Creek area visiting family. We wanted a local restaurant for lunch and we had seen Bridges on Check Please Bay Area. It had good reviews on the program. We were not disappointed. Hamburger was excellent. interesting choices on the menu. Good salads. A fish dish would have been nice,

Wonderful atmosphere and dining for our team dinner. I needed to make reservation for team of 15, same day, found the restaurant on Open table. Great dining experience and great app which made it possible!
My wife's birthday
Great service.  The waiter was very accommodating in letting us set the pace for the evening.  Our anniversary and we wanted a very casually paced dinner.

Family with 1 year old sitting in her highchair.  Brian the server was in top form and brought our 3 mimosas stat.
The ambiance was warm and cozy. The music was fabulous played by 2 talented musicians.

My eggplant parmigiana sandwich was not a hit, either the eggplant wasn't cooked sufficiently or it was too thick to absorb the marinara. I had to deconstruct it to eat it. But why add French fries, Monsieur le chef.? Perplexing. Arugola would be better.

Let's not dwell too much on the food at busy Sunday brunch. Otherwise it was a pleasurable afternoon.
Always enjoy dining on the patio on a nice day!  Great food and choices.

We had brunch with friends last December and every one was were very impressed with their selection from the brunch. Last weekend my wife and I visited the restaurant for brunch. We were somewhat disappointment  with the food. Even though the menu choices were the same  the preparation of the items were not quite up to our expectations based on our previous visit.

Good dinner.  Restaurant was very busy so the service was slow.   Sat outside with live music and busy patio area.  I had the chicken...husband had the swordfish special.  This is a good, solid restaurant that never disappoints.

Been wanting to go to Bridges for a while. Went last Saturday for dinner with family and we were not disappointed. Parking is a little tight depending what time you arrive so beware of that. The food and service were excellent.
Good food, nice ambiance, nice service, pleasant for outdoor lunching.
Really enjoyable, good food, good service, nice ambience, like an old fashioned Navy O Club

Sorry to see their 'trio' is mo longer available 
for lunch.  Prawn Asian salad was very good and super fresh.  Should have passed on the Brie , ham and apricot sandwich that sounded so good but failed to please. 
Super service!!
Would have liked a placemat since eating outside.
Great service and great food! Can't wait to come back.
Birthday dinner was crowded but still a great time! Thank you for the happy Birthday cupcake
Ein sehr angenehmes Dinner bei Bridges: interessante Menü Angebote, köstlich zubereitet, sehr freundliches Personal, romantisches Ambiente im Patio, Angenehme Musikbegleitung!
I love everything here, the ambience, the service and the food.
Food wasn't as good as we have had in the past.  Service and atmosphere were amazing.

We were a group of 18. Everyone ordered off the menu and when finished said the food was great. To please 18 people with such high praise of the food was rewarding. The drinks and food all came out at the same time. The service was impeccable. It was my husbands 60th Birthday dinner and they brought him a special cupcake with a candle. I would highly recommend the place for a great meal and dining experience.
Nice atmosphere. Great waiter. Brian.    Manager came by and was nice to talk with.  Will be back regularly

Nice outdoor patio, wine list and wine bar. Occasional live music. Good for both business meals and dates. Menu is not extensive, but what's there has good ingredients and nice presentation. A Danville gem proving that good Bay Area eats are not limited to San Francisco.
- Hans Thoma
Great service and ambiance outside, but very disappointed that the food quality has gone downhill since we visited a year ago.
Wonderful!

The menu could have a larger selection. The only thing in it that appealed to me was the steak which was very good. I don't like fish, don't like bacon on cheesecake, the desserts had fruit in every one I believe and I can't eat fruit. Other than a larger selection on the menu it was great

The restaurant is beautifully appointed and the patio is very pleasant.  We had wonderful service provided by Aaron.  We could have had a lovely anniversary dinner here, except for the NY Strip entree.  It was terrible!  It was overcooked, dry and tough.  Clearly not a quality piece of beef and not cooked with skill.  I ordered it medium-rare and it was served medium-well.   The potato-pork belly hash accompanying the steak was good and saved my experience.  My husband and daughter both enjoyed their fish entrees -- Ono and Ahi Tuna -- and we liked the spring roll appetizer, but the Brie appetizer was just ok.  Absolutely, I should have sent the steak back, but then I'd be eating totally out of phase with the remainder of my party, so I sucked it up and ate it without complaint.  My feeling is, the kitchen should get it right the first time.  If they don't they don't normally get another chance from me.  There are so many other great restaurants in the Bay Area.  Plus, this restaurant has a reputation and a pricing structure that warrant an expectation of impeccable food quality.  They missed the mark for me so our next special occasion dinner will be someplace else.  I may come back someday, but I'll order the fish!
SPECIAL OF THE DAY FOR LUNCH WAS OUTSTANDING--SKIRT STEAK WITH KOREAN FLAVORS!
Things have really fallen off since the last time I ate there.
This was our first trip to Bridges and we found everything to be outstanding.

Another great meal, we eat here a few times a year and are never disappointed.  Every facet of the food and service is top notch, but we especially like the desserts including whatever creme brulee they are serving.  All this in an atmosphere that feels open, relaxed and fun.

swordfish entree was excellent, as was the spring greens salad.
The gnocci dish was disappointing due to the very small amount of gnocci covered with 
lots of frisee.  The corn risotto entree was also a disappointment-it was on the dry side and
lacking flavor.  The biggest problem we had was getting any service-our server was trying hard but there were not enough servers and/or bussers.  We sat for 15 minutes without any server coming by and finally got up to ask for help.  Our server was nice enough, but very "military"-calling me Mam repeatedly and no woman likes to be called Mam.

Our service was good, our location outside was not all that great.  The food was outstanding and for a nice restaurant in Danville it wasn't that pricy.  My steak was great, one of the best cuts I've had lately.

Pricing high
Server rushed us thru dinner

Dinner was served quickly

Food good but over priced food.
Ambiance very nice - open and airy and quiet - at least where we were
They do have music and I would not have wanted to see in front of that 
Server would get lost for 20 - 30 minutes at a time - but once ordered food came quickly
Would like to go back but overpriced
Waited for 20 minutes, no one came by. Plus the guitarist was playing and singing too loud, could not hear myself. We just got up and left.
Great food and wonderful service. Lovely outdoor patio. A thoroughly enjoyable experience!

We have dined at Bridges for years and typically, we come for dinner and are always pleased.  Last week I treated a friend to a birthday lunch. We  were warmly greeted and were given the luxury of choosing where we wanted to sit.   However, something has changed with the lunch menu. It does not seem very inspired. The pricing is fair though for the item choices.  Our waiter was not particularly attentive.  We ordered the ham and brie sandwich and the organic baby greens salad.  Both tasted fine, but nothing to write home about.  My friend asked for coffee and was served coffee that had been sitting there since the morning and tasted like it had been.  We sent the coffee back and our waiter did offer to comp us a fresh brewed espresso, which was very good.  The chocolate birthday dessert with "Happy Birthday" written in cocoa powder was a nice touch and the peach tartin was fantastic!

We've been living in Danville since 1992 and have enjoyed dining at Bridges over the years. Also, seeing the Mrs. Doubtfire poster on the way to the restroom never gets old. Great food and we love the peaceful patio setting.
Always good food and atmosphere. Favorite neighborhood restaurant

PROS: The prawn dish with mint was delicious. The prix fixe menu appears to offer a solid option; unfortunately no wait staff pointed out its existence and we ordered without noticing the separate card announcing it - but for a large group it may be a good draw.
