Good wine by the glass options. The portions of everything were large and we were stuffed (a Con for us, but Pro for some). CONS: The food was heavier and richer  than expected (see "Pros"). We really didn't like the Chinese broccoli side dish (and it's a food we're used to), blah, mushy trifle dessert, or waitress-praised ahi dish that tasted like bottled teriyaki sauce. There are other dining options available in the area that offer a comparable or better value and more vibrant menu (e.g., try Esin, Peasant and Pear, etc.).

Dinner was a disaster. It was to be a special birthday dinner for my wife.  Bridges should have called in advance to say there would be a 50 person raucous retirement party in 1/3 of the restaurant, as we would have rescheduled another date.  The noise level was intolerable.  The mixed green salad was ok, but it would have been nice if the peaches had been ripe and tasted like peaches.  The corn risotto was excellent, but the gnocchi was uneatable, so we shared the risotto.  The chocolate cake was good, but the peach tarte tatin had no peach taste.  They comped dessert and gave us a gift card, but doubt I will be going again.  Very disappointing.
Expensive for food that isn't really good. Had a reservation at 8 and still waited 25 minutes for a table. It was not awful, but just wasn't good, especially considering how expensive it was.

Ambience it's great. Food is wonderful. Waiter is very nice and even offered to provide drink replacement if I didn't  like the first one. My only other comment is that the waiter is covering too many tables and wet waited for a while to get our order placed. The other people in the next table got there after we came and they got their first.
Great food and service.  One of the best restaurant in Danville, CA.

Left me a bit disappointed with some of the service. Recommended desert was not very good at all. It was removed from the bill, but the initial bill received was not even our correct food. The passportdinning card was utilized, but the accounting was vague and the explanation for the "error" was not good. Left me thoroughly disappointed
Bridges never disappoints. The delicious food, the impeccable service, the casual ambiance...always enjoy the place.
menuはそれほど多くありませんが、逆に注文がしやすく、ボリュームもそれなりで非常に良かった。お店の雰囲気は映画に使われただけのことはあり、静かすぎず煩すぎず、非常に居心地の良い感じ。

Extremely disappointed in the food and presentation of the items ordered for our recent  dinner at Bridges.  First course was the Cream of Cauliflower Soup.  Soup was barely heated and had to be returned.  Second batch was just a bit warmer and lacked any flavor.  Entrée ordered was the Half Roasted Chicken with Purple Potatoes and Sautéed Asparagus.  I had seen this dish featured on Bridges web site and was quite disappointed when I was served my order.  Instead of nicely roasted pieces of purple potatoes, my chicken was laying on a bed of greyish purple MASHED potatoes.   While I am a fan  fingerlings and colored potatoes, Chef needs to re-think mashing them.  A  "poi" looking bed to place the serving of chicken was not at all appealing both in taste and presentation.  The asparagus was cooked as it should be, al dente and the chicken was moist and cooked to perfection. I ordered the Honey Orange Brulee and enjoyed the crackling sugar crust and the delicate orange flavor.
Love the food, ambiance and just one of my favorite places to eat in Danville!
The food was fantastic. We went there because we had a gift card. What a pleasant surprise. We'll definitely go back again!
We had a great brunch.  It was the first time I have had chicken and waffles and it was amazing!

My daughter and I tried their Sunday brunch for the second time. Brunch menu had good selections and while my daughter ordered grilled salmon salad, l had chicken with waffles with an order of Tropical mimosa. The chicken was tender crispy coating and the grilled salmon was also good. Portions were enough for us and only thing we thought could be better was the salad can have more flavor to it.  The tropical mimosa was refreshing and we look forward to try other dishes next time.
Wonderful place. Highly recommend this great restaurant. Classy and yet with the times.
I found the food very good and the service was just right.  Loved the s'mores cheesecake as well as the duck entree.  Will definitely return and bring friends.
What a great opportunity to get away from the crowds and relax on the patio.  Great glass of wine and salads for each of us.  The orange creme brulee was outstanding!

Great 5 star night for Bridges! That's not always the case, but it was on Friday. The salmon and swordfish were excellent,  as was the guitarist, the weather, and the outdoor dining experience. Planning another summer evening there soon!

Excellent food but needs to change the menu more often.
Very redundant menu with few changes month to month.
The experience was outstanding!!!

Easy to carry conversation 
Food ok like so many restaurants in ca
Enjoyed the ambiance
Great ice cream and great ambiance. The patio is really nice
Always a favorite for special occasions or with friends and family.  Kyle was our server and he was FANTASTIC!  Loved our meal, and OMG, I'm from Hawaii and l that Ahi was to DIE FOR!
Terrific spot for date night or dining with friends

I have been to the Bridges many times and it is a good place to meet someone when the need arises with my job. Having said that, the menu is limited and just plain weird. I should probably say that I have a seafood allergy and that really limits it, although my business partner order a salmon salad and it was ground up like tuna! My friend did not like it at all. The waiter should have explained the dish. I ordered a sandwich that came with fries. Had I known, I would have substituted a salad.  Lately, I'm almost always disappointed when I come here.

Enjoyed a very tasty business lunch here recently, with the Wedge Salad and the Hangar Steak and Frites.  Excellent setting, and delicious food, at very reasonable prices.  Will be back for a dinner meal soon!
Our lunch was delicious and outstanding service.  We eat here often and always enjoy.

I totally understand the need for a "special" menu for holidays (in this case Father's Day), but the prices were just TOO HIGH.  Every entree started at $48+ (3 courses offered) was agreed on by the entire table of seven people as being OK.  When a Mimosa (small glass of champagne w/orange juice) is $12, it's just not a god value for the money.
Enjoyed Father's Day brunch. Selection was not traditional but the food was very tasty.

We went to Bridges for Father's Day Brunch.  They had a prix fix menu for the day.  Food was good.  Service was excellent.  A bit pricey for what you get but it was a special occasion so it was ok.  Would like to go back when they have their regular menu.

Bridges has been on my wish list of restaurants to go to for a very long time, unfortunately, I was VERY underwhelmed by the food.  Thankfully I decided to share an appetizer, entree and side with my date, so at least I wasn't out for 2 entrees.  

Sadly, all the food, other than the appetizer, was very bland.  We had the NY Steak and it wasn't seasoned at all.  I don't think they put any salt or pepper on the steak let alone the potatoes that came with the meal, or the purple mashed potatoes we ordered on the side.  Everything could've been eaten by a baby it was so bland.

We did mention it to the waiter and explained that they do seafood better, but I think to myself, it still has to be properly seasoned.  I BBQ a better steak at home.

Brought a friend from out of town here for dinner on Saturday and was very embarrassed by the service and the quality of food.  We should have left in the very beginning of the evening when we were ordering and our server walked away in the middle of taking our order not letting us finish.  We had to go to him to finish with placing the order. It didn't end better than it started.

The dinner was overall very good. We both had the snapper which was excellent except it was served with kale which wasn't all that great.  The drinks were good and Niko, our waiter was great. The girl singing was also really good,  not too loud, but sang good cover songs.
Enjoyed a wonderful meal celebrating our son & dauter-in-law's Anniversary & Father's Day too!  Everything was so delicious and had great service too!
So much better than the last visit.  Glad we decided to give it another try!  We will be back for another enjoyable meal.

Bridges is always the same: adequate food (overdressed salad but excellent risotto), mediocre service and yet a great place to meet in the middle. We have been meeting here every other month for several years and yet no one ever remembers us. Oh well.

We had a lovely lunch on the cool and shady patio. The server didn't rush us and the food was delicious. I had the special salad of the day, kale and ahi which was seared just right. 
Parking was plenty and convenient which is a real plus in downtown Danville. I look forward to returning to The Bridges soon.
Everything was well done and the service was excellent.

This was a very disappointing experience.  I ordered roasted chicken that tasted bland. Mashed potatoes were purple  and the asparagus was buried somewhere in there.  Needless to say, it's the presentation was very disappointing and the food totally tasteless.  The service was not at the standard of what I would expect at Bridges.  She never told us what the specials are we had to ask.  She didn't know her specials very well and she had a look at her piece of paper the whole time.   They brought wine that we end up havng to serve ourselves because she never came to refill it.   She never checked on us to see how our dinner was going.   She would look at us but she never come by.  I do want to state that bus staff  are very much on top of their jobs.  It was an expensive and disappointing experience. With all of this said, I don't think I'll be returning again to Bridges.
I like Bridges for the peaceful atmosphere and classy environment. The food is great and service gentle, easy and quick.

We just moved to the area so didn't know what to expect with Bridges. The review online were pretty good. It's a very beautiful restaurant and on saturday that had some nice live music outside. They were also very accommodating with turning on the heat lamps as it got cold. While I think we'll go back to check it out again, we were pretty disappointed in the food itself. The service was a little slow and they had an issue cooking the steaks right. Mine was underdone, my husband's was overdone. He got the filet special, so I would expect they'd pay more attention to the "specialness of it". They returned a new one which wasn't cooked enough. Third time's a charm, they got it right. But then charged us the full price. I don't mind paying the full price for dinner if you serve me what I asked, but when you get it wrong twice and cause me to eat by myself while my husband has no food, then I watch my husband eat by himself when he finally gets his food, I think that's bad business practice. Comp the coffee or something. They should know better. The restaurant itself was a very nice setting, so we'll give it one more try, but for the prices they should have done a little bit more to make up for their mistakes.

My wife and I wanted to go out for a nice dinner on Thursday night. We haven't been to Bridges in a while and thought we would check it out again. Boy...am I glad we did!! The food was amazing and Ben, our server, was very knowledgeable, professional and a really nice guy.
I had the special swordfish and my wife had the house specialty prawns after we each started with a salad. For desert we had the creme brulee. Everything was cooked to perfection and it couldn't have tasted any better.  We will definitely be back soon...already made another reservation for next Saturday night for a family dinner. 

Thanks Randy and Kevin for making our date night dinner a very special occasion!!!!!
Always consistently good!  Love their service and ambience.

First time here and it was amazing. I took my fiancé out for his birthday, and everything went right. Our server was very professional and very knowledgeable of the menu. I let Open Table inform them that it was his birthday and as soon as we were done with our entree they brought over a cupcake with a decorated plate and candle. He never made us feel rushed and was not at all over bearing. The prices match with the quality of food they serve. We will definitely return when we are in town.
Anniversary
Ben aisa wonderful waiter.  Very attentive and professional.  We enjoyed our dinner with client/friends. Salmon was cooked just right. We requested a quiet corner and it was lovely.
They asked our reason for dining while reserving, but our Anniversary celebration wasn't recognized; it's no big deal.
Beautiful place, good food and excellent service. My husband and I had a great time, we will definitely come back!
We had a very nice dinner at Bridges for our anniversary.  The food, ambience, and service were all great. We sat outside on a warm evening and it was very pleasant.

Love everything about this place! Literally, the food is delicious, we had 8 people with no complaints. My sister in law is allergic to peanuts. The server made sure everything that was brought to the table wasn't even cooked in the same area as food with peanuts. The atmosphere, service and ambience was endearing. Live music outside total plus. Will be back soon!
Amazing place! We come here 4 times per month!! Love it love it love it!!

Service was great, salmon was awesome. Only negative was the hostess with an angry face and bad attitude.  Place was half  empty and she wanted to sandwich our table of two in between two other tables of two and when we asked for another table (there were plenty) she was really nasty about it
Bridges is the best...Delicious food and best people!

An excellent experience for dinner on Mother's Day.  Seated immediately, attentive service, excellent food and service.  There was a limited menu for the night, but it had a good range of choices.  As expected it was what I consider expensive.  But it also was special so worth it for the occasion.
First time to the restaurant, took my wife out for Mother's Day brunch, service was excellent food was excellent

I would not recommend this restaurant for Mother's Day.  While the ambience is good, and they have live music, the food was disappointing.  They had a small, pre-determined menu, and you could only chose off of that, and oh by the way - the prices were CRAZY expensive.  The French toast for example (which came with an appetizer and dessert) was $42.00 no joke.  Go on a regular Saturday night or lunch, but avoid at all costs on Mother's Day.  They basically did a big F U to their customers

I was disappointed with Mother's Day Brunch.  I thought the menu and prices might be different for Mother's Day but expected the experience and food to warrant it.  The menu was limited and the prices were ridiculous.  As an example, six shrimp with grits, a greek yogurt appetizer, and a scoop of sorbet was $56.   The french toast and the frittata the least expensive meals at $40 and $42 respectively were only okay.  My son and father ordered the most expensive meal short ribs at $62.  The strawberry crisp was served cold and no one at the table ate it.   The mango sorbet and Greek Yogurt appetizer were bright spots.   Service was only okay.  I get it was Mother's Day and am not opposed to spending a lot if the value is there but Bridges did not provide enough value.  Won't be going back.

Up-scale casual cozy atmosphere, creative though not pretentious foodie foods, great place for brunch, dates, lovely patio dining, stellar table service. Food with lots of food in it, worthy of putting in your cake hole, not for the faint of wallet.

Fantastic food and service, had a great feel, all of the employees were smiling and curteous which really kept the vibe nice. Met Steven, the manager and was impressed with him. Definitely will repeat.
Service was slow and didn't clear dishes.  Offered side salad for $2 more and then charged $12.  Charged $3 for soda that was supposed to be included in kids meal.  Will not be back.
We all had salads....delicious!  The service was wonderful.
The pastrami sandwich was not that good and rather greasy.
Food, service, atmosphere--top notch, as always.  Thanks for a lovely, intimate birthday dinner evening with dear friends.  We will be back again, soon.
Went to celebrate my sister's birthday - really great service and food was delicious!  Went with our boys and we all had a great time.

My husband and I went to Bridges for our anniversary. The meal was excellent, he had the catch of the day and I had the salmon-both done to perfection. Their soup (butternut squash and bacon I believe) was to die for and the creme brûlée was excellent. The service was on point- did not hover too much but there when needed. We also got a complimentary cupcake for our special occasion :) The noise level was enough so the place didn't feel dead but we could also hold a conversation easily. They have a great wine list (says an amateur wino). Only complaint was my husband's cocktail was not to his liking. Overall we had a great meal and experience and will be back again.

We have been to Bridges numerous times in the past, however, not for several years now.  So this was the first visit in some time.  We had stayed away over the last several years because we heard the quality of food had gone down and the prices were still fairly high.  We found that was not the case.  The food was excellent, service very good and the prices reasonable for such quality, imagination and service.  The only complaint we could have is that it would have been nice to have another meat selection.   The fish selections were more numerous which for me was ok.  My wife however doesn't like fish so she was limited but found the steak excellent.
As always great. Our server, Brian was awesome

We went for our anniversary. We both had salmon over forbidden rice as part of a price fixe menu including salad and dessert (sorbet yum!) for $29 pp.  Restaurant was quiet and perfect for our celebration.   Food was delicious and server was attentive without hovering. They even wrote "happy anniversary" in chocolate on our dessert plate.  Great dinner.

We had a quiet, mid-week, dinner on the patio. The food was excellent and creative. Service was great. The temperature was just right for eating outdoors. There was nice music by a small two person group. Overall just a great experience.
New menu.   Not as good.

I love Bridges, been there many times.  This time my friend and I sat outside; it was a warm evening.  It was very quiet (it was a Sunday so not surprising).  Other times I've been there I've eaten inside and it is noisier...to be expected.     The service was outstanding, the appetizers were exceptional -- I could make a meal from just the appetizers!  Everything was perfect - love it!

Amazing food. We went for brunch and paid around $2 more per entrée than at Bill's or Denica's but the environment was far superior - with the great service and live music. We loved the experience and would definitely return.

Truly a wonderful place with exceptional food, great staff  and lovely local! Decor is inviting, a bit loud when full, but not annoyingly so! Really just a great, great place STILL, (been in business for a while), to celebrate or just enjoy a fabulous  meal!

This was our first time at this restaurant.  The food was wonderful, we ordered the specials of the night.  We were not rushed through dinner and really had the time to enjoy the food and atmosphere.  We look forward to returning and trying other dishes in the near future.

Great setting with celebrity factor (Mrs. Doubtfire), but what are they thinking with the Chicken and Waffle dish?  The chicken had to have been heated from frozen.  Three of us ordered this dish; one wanted to send it back to kitchen.  The meat was not prepared fresh and the waffles were over toasted and had no flavor.  Very disappointing; thankfully, not too pricey.  This meal was such a disappointment; we won't be back for brunch. Ever.

We brought a dear friend to Bridges to celebrate a milestone birthday.
It was a perfect luncheon.
The food and staff made our celebration 
" The Best".
Thank you Bridges!
The prawn noodle salad is my favorite dish!
It was our second time at this place, wonderful food, service and overall value. WE love coming here for special occasions!
Birthday celebration for my friend. Patio dining. Excellent!
Enjoyable birthday lunch with friends!!
Went for our anniversary, nice service, but the place is showing some wear and it seems like the menu hasn't changed much since I first dined here 30 years ago.

name: AC Waterfront Lounge
description: Enjoy Spanish-inspired tapas and entrees with wine, beer, and handcrafted signature cocktails.
address: 1333 Veterans Blvd,  South San Francisco, CA 94080-1954
hours:
Breakfast
Mon–Fri 6:00 am–10:30 am
Sat, Sun 7:00 am–11:30 am
Lunch
Mon–Fri 11:30 am–1:30 pm
Dinner
Daily 4:30 pm–10:30 pm
Bar
Daily 4:30 pm–11:30 pm

reviews.text:
It was our first time at AC Waterfront.  The service was friendly, drinks were good, food was ok, but very expensive for the experience.

It felt like the same space where breakfast is served in the morning.  The Opentable pictures lead you to believe it's more elegant than it is, although the view from our table was very pleasant.

It was fine, but not a place a local would likely go back to.
A great place for good food and water views. Great service too

The food was bland. We had to ask for salt and pepper.  Coffee was very watery.  The water for my date's tea was not very hot.  The value was not at all equal to the price or the setting.  The music volume was way too loud making it difficult to converse with the person I was with.  The only memorable things were the setting and the dessert.

The Valentine’s Day dinner was excellent!  I had the salad starter and salmon entree.  The salmon was cooked perfectly.  I dined with my brother and sister and they also enjoyed their meals.

There is a DJ on Friday nights which is fun.  Be warned that it is a little too loud so you can’t enjoy a conversation with anyone while you’re dining on those nights.

I went here for Valentine's Day and the experience was fabulous. The attentive service was superb and the Filipino lady who greeted us was so friendly and accommodating. We enjoyed the chicken sandwich, one of the better sandwiches I've had in a long time. Also, the Korean steak had lots of flavor and was delicious. We ended the meal with the lava cake which added the perfect touch. Of course, we will be back again! Thanks for the great meal!
Lalani was a great host. We enjoyed the experience as first time guest.
Great venue, and awesome staff. Thank you again for the unforgettable experience.
No OpenTable points given, no explanation. Felt like a bait and switch, very unpleasant.

This whole experience was amazing! Our waitress that just moved to the Bay from AZ, completely stunning  and so amazing while taking care of your table. I will for sure be back.

If you happen to see this note, please share my message to the young lady. ￼
Nice view , friendly server , very solid food. Don ‘t often order a burger for dinner but it was great
Beautiful view. Friendly bartender. I returned for evening drinks. A little pricey for liquor and beer drinks. Electric palm trees in the middle patio.

I was very surprised that Open Table ranked this restaurant as #1 for lunch places on the water in San Mateo County.  Felt more cafeteria style.  Flatbread was not actually traditional flatbread.  It was pizza bread that could have come out of the frozen section at grocery store.  Salmon Burger was good.  It was very quiet which was very nice for visiting.  Would not go again.

The staff and service was great, we felt well looked after.
Food was good and try the chocolate tart it will surprise you, it did me and I have been in hospitality for over 40 years but I still love surprises!

Everything was great, from the reservation, food, ambience, waitstaff. Place was clean ,  friendly staff, food were served hot, fresh and cooked to perfection(salmon, chowder, crab cake)
Our waiter took the time explaining their menu,  checking on us and attending our needs with smile and professional way.  The ambience is simply lovely, romantic, beautiful waterfront and clean. A lot of parking .

I scheduled a reservation at 1:00 for two and much to my surprise the restaurant was closed
It was embarrassing to say the least as I frantically searched for another place.   Your schedule needs to match open table

I was looking forward to trying their food, I made reservations at 10:15 pm & by the time I get there no one attended me. So I sat at the bar just for them to tell me that there is no bartender & that kitchen was closing at 10:30 pm. I was so confused as to why they accepted my reservation then when I couldn’t even get a cocktail & had to rush to find something to eat. Only got some fries which was extremely overpriced & they double charged me on my room & card. Honestly very disappointed!
The food was excellent, as was the service.  But they were playing disco music which was ear-splitting.  We could not converse or enjoy our food.  It was exhausting.

Everything started with the check in. The 2 employees were great. I lost his card but he was incredible. I checked in Saturday at the SFO location.  Ambiance and food were star. And they hooked us up with an incredible view to the cove.  The price point was perfect but none of that would have mattered if the the service wasn’t like it was, it set the tone. Please find that gentleman and lady that checked me in, that’s the service model. I know because I’m the manager of Customer Experience and Community Relations at my job
This restaurant is an absolute treasure.  Our server made this birthday celebration particularly special.

AC Waterfront Lounge is a treasure.  What a great time my family had there.
The server was outstanding.

Submitted a review on Yelp...needed reservations here for a Mothers Day brunch...walked in to a glorified cafe for guests...Why the hell is this cafe even on Open Table? Front desk and restaurant staff no help at all. Threw menu at us and said sit where you want...we left in 5 minutes
There’s nothing else of this quality in the area. We were happy to go here again. We thought the food was good and the drinks were good. Service was great.

Our service team was very attentive. They were especially nice to my 90 year mother.
Very nice hotel restaurant ambiance.

This place was convenient for us and inviting, on new year’s eve .. it was nicely decorated, the bar person & waitress were the only ones there and very nice and made us aware that the wait for food was going to be an hour due to only having one cook, there were not a lot of people there at the time .. for some reason they were doing take out not sure why if they didn’t have enough help.. it was over an hour for two burgers and a salad
salad had no cucumbers it was mainly lettuce, grape tomatoes and avocado with 5 grilled shrimp on a small plate  ?? that is not a salad, salads usually have cucumbers, onions etc and my daughters burger was very dry and over cooked, It was definitely overly priced to say the least which was unfortunate.. The service people were working very hard to keep people happy we felt bad for them ..
It’s really too bad that they catered to take out customers instead of people in the hotel.. very nice hotel it would be nice to have a good restaurant with good food..
It was closed and the front staff assistant manager was extremely rude and not willing to accommodate me

Lovely convenient location near the airport.  Large scenic glass windows provide a waterfront view while dining.  Service is attentive.  Food is average and on pretty expensive for what you get.  A bowl of chopped fruit was $7.  Crab benedict was good.
Nice location hidden away

We celebrated our 48th wedding anniversary.  Good ambience but we found the service a bit slow.  We like the waitress.  She tried hard to serve although she was by herself.  My cooppino was good but my husband had the Korean steak and it was okay.  This place may be perfect for cocktails or drinks.  The place is nice!

We went because the restaurant was described as Spanish on Open Table. The only "Spanish" item was Spanish-style chicken wings. We had the avocado toast as an appetizer, which was delicious—beautiful slices of avocado, feta cheese, and sprouts. Our entrees a cioppino and grilled shrimp were tasty.  The wine menu has a reasonable selection at reasonable prices. We very much enjoyed the Albarino. We split a lava cake with ice cream and fudge sauce. 

Edgar, our server, was essentially working by himself as bartender and server. He had one trainee to help him. Despite having one foot in a boot, he managed to take care of those dining and those at the bar. And doing it without seeming rushed. The waterfront view is a real plus.
Mothers day brunch/buffet was fabulous. Excellent service and the food was top notch.

Very nice venue with a scenic view out the window of the bay. The food was very good and the service was also good, considering the dining room was packed on a Thursday night. The noise level was very loud, though. I would not rule out the restaurant due to that, however.

This new spot is off to a good start. They've got a beautiful view and a spacious interior. Their Angus beef burger was excellent, although it needs a more substantial bun. The truffle fries were a fine complement, but they could use better fry stock and a bit more truffle flavor. I enjoyed a very good red blend with the meal.

name: Opa! - Campbell
description: At Opa! Campbell we offer our guests a warm, inviting authentic Greek dining experience.  We provide quality food and excellent service at an affordable price.Our menu includes traditional Greek dishes, such as, moussaka, gyros, souvlaki and baklava.From the bar, enjoy a glass of wine or one of our signature cocktails including The Grand Opa! Sangria, The Opa!tini or The Argonaut.We look forward to serving you at Opa!
hours:
Brunch
Sat, Sun 10:00 am–2:00 pm
Lunch
Daily 11:00 am–4:00 pm
Dinner
Mon–Thu, Sun 4:00 pm–10:00 pm
Fri, Sat 4:00 pm–11:00 pm

reviews.text: Thank you for  helping our party choose the menu items based on their allergies and confirming with the Chef.

Don’t know why we keep coming back here… each time we have an issue with the food quality. Last night was no different. Cold Moussaka… wasn’t cooked all the way through. Sent back, got a dish that was mashed up and probably microwaved. Nothing comp’d… just “oops sorry, here’s you food back all mashed up and microwaved”. Kinda sad really cos the location is awesome and the service was good. They need a better chef…
Had a lovely business dinner with a large group.  Jorge, our server, was wonderful.

We sat outdoors because we had our service dog with us. The music was pretty loud, but besides that, noise level was appropriate. The outdoor heaters worked great! Our server wasn’t especially friendly, but he was efficient.  Food was solid overall, but my soup wasn’t hot. The amount we paid for three people was pretty high for what we had, but overall, a good experience.
Waiters inattentive. Salad came same time as meal, not before. Water glasses not filled. Service poor in general.

Our starters included zucchinin chips, which were different and very tasty, plus spanikopita, which was excellent.  My vegetarian moussaka was decent; my wife's chicken was good and her mashed potatoes excellent.

We booked an inside table but it wasn't available when we got there, and we had to wait at the bar area. Eventually we decided to stay there because the wait was long, so we ordered food but it was delivered very late because they made a mistake with the table/order location number. When the food arrived, they were cold. There was no real apology for all of this from the restaurant management. I understand that the place was busy for the Valentine's Day, but it was also my husband's birthday and I wanted much better service. I am very disappointed and won't make reservation again at this place. The only good thing was a friendly bartender.

The food was excellent.  The location / ambience was excellent.   We ordered an appetizer and asked for it to come out before the main course.  Nope - the appetizer arrived with the food, along with the salad that should have arrived earlier as well.  The waiter asked if I wanted another beer shortly after I got my first one - I asked - check back a bit later.   He asked again - after the dinner was finished, and the first beer was long gone, so I passed.  Asked for a box to take the leftovers - was given a box that was 1/3 the size of the leftovers, so had to ask for a bigger one.   The food was great, the ambience was great, but the waiter's timing sort of diminished the experience.
We had a very nice dinner at Opa, and service was very good.  The tables are a bit close to each other, which does not make for a very intimate dinner atmosphere.
Perfect evening. Great food, great service. They even sang Happy Birthday to my mom with a candle and free dessert.
Great experience!   Quiet, food was good, service was great!

The service is good with attentive wait staff. We usually go on the weekends for brunch, and our bottomless mimosas are never empty. The food is good but not great. I would recommend Opa! to other people.
Great service and great food. Would definitely go again
We've been to this restaurant for many years. My husband and I liked our food and the service was great! We will dine there again.

This was my third and last time at this restaurant. 
The food was terrible this time, specially the presentation. Perhaps the main chef was on xmas vacation.
It was a busy Friday night.  The cocktails were good.  The food was good but on previous visits, the food was better.
Opa never disappoints! Food was delicious and service was great!
Out of the 5 of us, nobody was super happy with their meal; dry salmon, cold pastitsio, too much feta, etc. Just not the best experience overall. We left disappointed and won't return anytime soon.

Dinner was great and we made it to our show at the Campbell Theater.  Service was excellent, we felt taken cared of. The drinks and food were very good.  I'd recommend sharing a baklava if you so choose because it is a big portion.
Great great service, as always...and delicious food...
Great Greek food with many interesting and flavorful dishes.

Some of the people in my party were a few minutes late and while I sat at the table nobody brought water, asked if I wanted a drink, etc. wait staff wasn’t that friendly and the food is not as good as it once used to be. “Fiery” Mac and cheese has become bland in flavor steak was undercooked. Disappointing as this has always been a favorite spot to eat
2nd here in a short period of time but for a business lunch. Very good food. Nice patio for outdoor dining. As I said last time place needs more staff. Service could be more attentive and quicker.
The food is always good...never disappoints...We especially like the lamb shank and the meatloaf!

I really like this OPA which is nested among other sister restaurants. The food always is good in terms of taste, presentation, and quantity. I especially enjoy the fish entrees. Patio is a treat when there is good weather. Service always seems a bit slow at this branch—staff working hard and attitude positive so the problem seems understaffing.  Will go back
The gentleman playing music on sidewalk was way too loud. Lamb chops were overcooked and small portion. Not worth price.

We have been to Opa over the years and their food quality has never disappointed. We have eaten at their Cupertino, Santa Clara, Campbell and Willow Glen location several times over the years. Their food quality and service has always been great. Live music at Campbell was an added bonus this time around.

The outdoor seating was mostly full.  Almost nobody sat inside the evening we went.

Service was not well paced.  We were sitting for long periods without any attention because they were clearly understaffed.  Food was decent.  Our vegetarians were a bit underwhelmed.

This is a restaurant that calculates the tip on food+drink+sales tax.  And does not disclose that up front!
The service was great. Food was meh. Ordered the calamari was ok.

Initially, the restaurant struggled to locate our reservation, and when they finally did, they combined several small tables to accommodate our party of ten. Although the service was friendly, it was quite inefficient. We experienced long waits for various services, including discussing our order, receiving drink refills, and getting the check.

The kitchen had run out of sausage, which was part of three orders, but this wasn’t communicated when the plates were delivered. The server did offer bacon as a substitute, but only one piece was served on a salad plate, which felt underwhelming.

To top it off, we were charged for an avocado add-on that we never received. Overall, the experience was disappointing.

The quality of the food and drinks is consistently good, but the service could be improved. Our server, Mr. Grumpy, seemed impatient from the beginning. He rushed us to place our orders and appeared annoyed when we needed a moment to decide. Overall, his attitude made the whole experience very unpleasant.
sit outdoors to avoid screaming kids that parents don't control

I had a reservation, but the staff basically gave us the worst spot available - right infront of the dirty dish station. When we entered the whole dining area was free. I would say avoid the place because it's not what it used to be. The food was also not the best.
Had a great time for my 3 year anniversary quality food and service
Very good food and an excellent server.. the patio was packed ..I suggest taking Uber aw parking can be difficult
Overall a good meal. We went early and did not experience how noisy it can be inside. The bar staff was great.

Our friend wanted lamb chops and she loved them but I really think 4 little lamb chops and mashed potatoes at $48 was kind of high.
The 3 dips and pita bread were my favorite.
Fresh food, good service, nice outdoor area. Table was crooked. Beet salad was good. Macaroni was so so
Food was very tasty and excellent service...we dined inside on 6/25 at 11:30

We have always enjoyed Opa but tonight was different. We were 9 minutes late as parking was difficult.  I was told that my reservation was canceled and that they were busy.  He then went ahead and seated us.  We sat for 20 minutes.  No one acknowledged us. Finally my husband stopped a waiter and asked if we could please order.  They came with water and 5 minutes later the waiter came by and took our order.  The food was delicious as always.  It got cold and so we asked if they could turn the heater on next to us.  It took asking 3 times before it was done.  We were given our check with no offer of coffee or dessert.  Serve was not good.  It was a shame because we love going to Opa.  Did something change??  Hope they figure it out that service matters.

The food was very good but the service was very poor. It took forever to order a drink although it was not very busy. Then the waiter kept bringing the wrong food to our table. We finally got the correct order and the chicken and lamb souvlaki was very good. However, we were never offered dessert or coffee and had to wait for about 10 minutes for our bill. Very disappointed as we have been going there for years.
I did not receive my points for this visit. Can you pls help?
Good food as always.  A bit pricey.  The outdoor seating is pretty well shaded

Food is usually great but my beet salad was overdressed and the prawns way over-cooked. Strangely the pita bread was tough. The fries with feta are delicious! Would come again but our waiter was terrible! I had to get up twice-once to find him so we could order, again to ask for the bill. Sitting on the patio is lovely!

The menu describes a Greek “sundae” which I understand under the regular definition of a “sundae” (“A sundae is a tall glass of ice cream with whipped cream and nuts or fruit on top”). I was really looking forward to a Greek spin on this dessert. When it came, it was a scoop of ice cream with two pieces of baklava on a plate.  I thought this must be a mistake, so I asked to see the waiter.  When he did not come, I went inside and told the front desk that I had received the wrong dessert.  She said she would let him know.  When he did not come, I asked another server.  He did not come to the table for a very long time.  By the time he did come to the table, everyone was finished eating and were waiting for me.  He told me that the plate with the scoop of ice cream “was” the “sundae.”  This is very misleading - it is not a sundae but instead baklava with a scoop of ice cream.  It took way too long for someone (anyone) to explain that I had what Opaa calls a “sundae.”  It was disruptive to our evening and upsetting.  To his credit, the waiter took the untouched “sundae” off of the bill.

Always a decent menu. I had to special request to NOT have balsamic drizzled over the pastitsio. Waiter was outstanding with allowing us to graze with appetizers with our drink. Followed with entrees. Price has creeped up.
Server was very friendly & nice but minor details of picking up lemons on the floor she spilled more attention to details.

05-18-24 Very nice place located on the busy downtown Campbell strip. The outside seating seemed to be preferred by customers. It was a nice evening. The interior was nice. They opened enough windows and doors to kinda make you feel you are outside also but under the cover of a roof. The food was very good. Our server Nestor was great. No pressure on us first timers. We had.

1. Greek Nachos $17.00 we liked them.
2. Seafood Souvlaki $26.00 nicely done.
3. Kokinisto Me Manesta $48.00 was good and something to share because it's a lot.
4. Gyro Pita w/Firies $17.00 plain Jane but good.
5. Falafel Pita $16.00 is not no Falafel Drive Inn Falafel but ok.

We would most likely return to this place to try other menu items. This place was fairly busy and was used open table to set reservations. Really didn't need it but just played it safe.
Very pleasant staff. Great food for the most part. A little loud.

Best waiter ever.
Very good food. And good drinks❤️
Celebrating family birthdays. It was great!!! Staff were so good. Very thoughtful!!
Always reliable and tasty. Had a delightful waiter. Sat outside for the first time this season which was fantastic.

We had a fabulous lunch meeting with our sales team.
Outstanding
This place was extremely overpriced and service was lacking. It felt like a fast food restaurant as the portions are small and the food tasted bland. Very disappointed overall

Very nice afternoon business lunch with very attentive service.  Weather did not cooperate so could not sit outside (a benefit of this Opa location).  Nice portion of Mahi Mahi which was a little overcooked, but had a nice sauce.  Like the range of food and drink choices here and prices are reasonable.  Will definitely go back.
Food was delicious as always, snd our server was fantastic! Wish I could remember his name.we were there on April 10th at noon on the patio

The food was great, but unfortunately, the service was horrible. Despite many empty seats visible for walk-ins, we were told it was full. Interestingly, online booking showed plenty of availability, prompting us to use OpenTable to secure a table for the same time.

I've been to this Opa! several times, and it never disappoints. My sister, my niece, and I went on a Monday evening, so there weren't many people there, and we had no trouble hearing each other. The wait staff was very attentive but not overbearing, and the food (flaming cheese, dip sampler, beef skewers w/ fries, and especially the cream cheese phylo dessert) were all very tasty. I will not hesitate to go back!

Food and service was excellent. Sitting outside was very nice. The only reason why it doesn’t get five stars is that I had a reservation and there were plenty of nice tables available and for some reason the person at the front tried to put us at an old, very stained table in the very back of the patio and when we showed her that there was another table that was not old or stained and in the front of the patio, with a nice view, she insisted that we had to sit in the back, even though we had a reservation. When we didn’t back down, she gave in, but we shouldn’t have had to fight for it.￼
Went for brunch and they were attentive and friendly! Will be back soon!
Delicious  food, fabulous service but extremely noisy...but won't keep me from coming back...

Seated for over 10 minutes - no-one came by with water or anything. Had to flag someone down. Restaurant was not busy so there really was no excuse….

When the food arrived we were served burned spanakopita which we sent back. The 2nd attempt was better, but they must have been cooking too fast as it was cold in the middle. 

Entrees arrived and we were served really over-cooked, dry chicken. Again, we returned it. 2nd delivery was better, but still not worth the price of the meal - I could have done better myself.

The manager was nice and discounted the bill, but honestly, they need to do better in the kitchen. It’s not a cheap restaurant. It’s got a great location, but someone in the kitchen loves to cook the food to death!!

This was the worst dining experience I’ve had in awhile.   The restaurant was overbooked and we had to wait well beyond our reservation time to be seated. The noise level was so loud I could not hear my husband across the table. They had booked a couple large groups and did not update their reservation system to account for the lack of tables. The food was mediocre at best. Our server was friendly and attentive. To top it off they marked us a no show on open table… seriously?!? I wish we had been a no show as that dining experience was a terrible waste of money.

My Chicken Soulvaki was cooked perfectly and tasted good. The two orders of Lemon chicken were dry and it was not creamy, too thick.  They did not have much flavor.  Our service  was good and we had a good time.
Disturbing wresting / fighting on the tv.
Love their signature Sangria and food was good too.

Our experience at Opa was truly special!   The atmosphere was lively and busy but it was never instusive.  My wife and I were able to have a great conversation on our wedding Anniversary.  The host was excellent!  Our server Victor and hia assistant server were awesome!  And of course,  the food was absolutely terrific! We cannot wait for our next visit

The appetizers were good. Greek salad is always good. Lamb shanks, 3 of them, all came out cold in the middle with watery pasta. Wife’s steak sautéed was good, watery though. Lamb skewers were over cooked. This is purely a note for the kitchen staff. I have been there many times and it has been good. Kitchen does seem to be struggling with meat temps lately. Always will go back, love the location and the service is always good.
Food was great but service was really slow. We had to ask twice for some one to take our order. Also a little cramped inside.

I was so looking forward to their Moussaka, but i did not enjoy it at all. It was so salty I could barely eat half of it. And the flavor and texture was just not there. My husband got the avgolemono soup, and he didn’t eat most of it either. It was mostly broth with almost no orzo or chicken.
We shared our feedback with the server and nothing happened. We paid the full price which was quite expensive to begin with.
Opa never disappoints. The healthy options, the great outdoor ambience and the food is really delish

Our waiter was perfect. He was friendly and seemed to enjoy his job. He kept our drinks filled and allowed us to dine at our own, leisurely pace.  While the food was delicious and plentiful, I had to take off a star because my French fries were cold. We dined outside which was great but a tad noisy.

Wonderful atmosphere and ambiance. Food was excellent. Shared a few starters and enjoyed their yummy specialty Sangria.
👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

A very mediocre experience at Opa. Our server seemed to come and then disappear for 15-20 minutes, but the rest of the staff helped to fill in during his absences. Food was just okay. Things came out incorrectly cooked - my father's lamb was nearly well done when ordered medium rare and my grandfather's steak was medium well when it was ordered medium rare. I had the whole sea bass and the fish was quite good, but my spinach and potatoes were drenched in olive oil. For the price points, I expected better.
The music was way too loud it was very hard to have a conversation
We Drive to Pleasanton quite often just to eat at this restaurant. We have a fantastic meal and receive excellent service every time we are there!
Love coming here on sundays for breakfast/brunch. The farmers market happens right next to the place. The food is great. LOVE the hash and eggs, and the dip sampler.
We sat outside and it was good. The waiter was attentive and the food good.

Chicken was dry, service was very slow
We were disappointed.
Chicken was tough on the lemon chicken dinner, but my mousaka was nice as was the bourbon cocktail. Weather was fabulous on oatio!

The service was abysmal!  Worst service ever.
Soon as we sat down we were immediately approached about what we wanted to order and not just drinks. We asked for a minute and he appeared to be annoyed.
I understand he was serving tables and bartending, but he was terrible. After ordering drinks, we barley saw him. He finally came back and we ordered both an appetizer and our entrees as we weren’t sure we’d see him again. We explained to please pace out the time from our appetizer plate and the entrees. We told him twice. He rudely nodded.
Sure enough, not half way into the appetizer when the entrees came.
Poor service in that as well as the place we’re practically thrown down on the table.
They were about to give me an entree I didn’t order and I told them it was wrong. Two minutes later they brought another dish that was incorrect as well. I told them again what I ordered and they looked angry. We then saw the manager give our server, who by the way never came back after the order was originally made, a very nasty look because he put in the wrong order.
The manager said it would be right up, and I waited 20 minutes with nothing. I went up to the manager and she said she put a rush on it??  Not sure why the length of time as it was a cheesesteak.
She did offer a complimentary drink, but I didn’t want another.
The bill came later with no apologies, no discount on anything ordered to include my entree. Nothing was said about the terrible service from our server or the management. She was no where to be found when we left!
To top it off, there couldn’t have been more than 20 people in the place that can hold well over 100.
Great food, great customer service.  Noise level was high and hard to hold a conversation.  Our first time there but will be back.

Overall, a really good experience at Opa! Minor things that tend to irritate guests...many servers stopped at our table, trying to bring meals that belonged at other tables. Really? It's not that complicated....it happened at least 3 times during our dinner. C'mon, Opa! Get your servers / runners in line, please. I actually felt bad at one point...the poor server standing with plates in hand looking at all the tables trying to figure out where to go. Food was hot and tasty....good preparation, and reasonable portion sizes. Good value for the money. Our waiter was attentive to our needs and helped our party of 12 enjoy the meal.
Unfortunately, our server was slow and made few visits. Also, they were out of spicy avocado dip, which is our favorite. We love Opa and will return, however.

We went last night as a party of eight. Four adults and four kids. Server took a long time before coming to take our orders. The kids skewer plates all came with fries even though we requested two of them have rice. One of the adult entrees must’ve been forgotten by the server or the kitchen because it didn’t arrive until all of us were finished eating. They did offer generous compensation and didn’t charge us for that entree and gave the kids free ice cream. It was a long dinner with four very patient kids. Patio had a good number of people but we were pretty much the only people inside.

We took our grandson here to celebrate his completion of a summer internship. He enjoyed his selections from the many options on the menu, especially the appetizer he chose and which the 3 of us shared, which was a pita bread sampler with lots of toppings and flavors. And he had room for an entree as well as a delicious baklava sundae with all the fresh berries and ice cream. I'm not sure how he ate it all, but it was a fun dining experience!

Opa! is always a great place to go to with friends for lunch. This time was no exception. I enjoyed my iced tea and roasted vegetable salad while my friend devoured her Greek Beet Salad. And those Gyro Fries are super addictive! I was so sad when their downtown Los Altos location shut down, but happy to make the drive down here to enjoy their consistently delicious offerings coupled with great service.

We ate indoors and it was lovely!  The tables were arranged to allow quiet conversation, so my 94 year old mother could hear really well.
I had the lamb kebob which was delicious and their Greek salad is to die for!
Delicious food and love the atmosphere. Enjoyed the food and lots of vegetarian choices

Arrived at 4:00. Only one server for about 6 parties on the patio.  Took our order and never saw him again.  Had to ask the good runner for our bill. Chicken pita was inedible.  It was dry and the cheese? They put on the top had hardened at some point prior to reaching our table.  Cobb salad was meh.  Lettuce wasn’t crisp, and had brown leaves.  Need a break from Opa, hopefully they will get it together.  Underwhelmed for $85.

All in all, it was a fun experience. But I will say there was a server who came over and said excuse me may we have your attention. I guess we didn’t hear her when she was calling out the dishes that she was bringing.
Where is the old staff!?!! The new staff is slow and inattentive.

I like the location. Located in historic downtown Campbell. 
I recommend eating outside as it is very pleasant and inside is too noisy due to the high ceilings.
Our server was friendly.
I had the gyro sandwich with fries.
My go to order. But it seems like it has changed, in a bad way.
I used to love the mustard sauce that came with the fries, but now it seems like just French‘s mustard. It was disappointing.
The gyro meat reminded me of meatloaf.

I’m hoping they had an off night. The bartender was our waiter, and he was really busy - he did great keeping up and was very friendly.  The restaurant itself was not busy, so I’m thinking they were understaffed. The meat was over cooked, and the rice pilaf was cold. The Greek salad was only lettuce, onion and feta, had to ask for dressing. The presentation of the dishes looked like they just plopped the food on the plates with no thought. They did remove my mother in laws meal from the bill, as hers was too over cooked to eat, so that was nice. I don’t think we will be back for a while, maybe they need time to train kitchen staff?
Food is always delicious and staff are courteous & very helpful
Good food ..service waa a bit slow at first but picked up...meatliaf and dip sampler are delicious!

We go to this place pretty frequently. It’s a little pricy, but the food is good. We’ve always had good service. Their rendition of avgolemono soup is pretty good. I had the roasted veggie salad last time and it was yummy.  The outside seating is pleasant.

Great food and service
A must visit restaurant. 
It does get noisy when the place is filled.
We both enjoyed our meals, my husband had the skewered chicken with orzo and I had the Opa sauteed veges with a beef skewer. Patio seating was pleasant on a warm evening. Service was efficient.

This visit was the worst service I can remember. We had inside reservations and were told that they only had seats outside. Then we were put at a table next to the guy on the corner playing bad music way too loud. And he wasn’t performing, just playing Spotify. When our server arrived the first time we ordered an app and drinks. After finishing app and drinks we had to ask for our server to put in our dinners. We didn’t see him again until 30 minutes after finishing dinner. Our meal took over 2 hours and multiple tables around us came after us and left before us. Food was good as usual and we weren’t in a hurry but…
It took 3 times to get the chicken  orzo  without onions and all the orders cat the table came out at different times. It was not  the server’s fault. The hostess was nice.
Opa was wonderful as always! Our server was amazing, super friendly and engaging. The food was so yummy and the environment is festive.
Came for a special occasion but was very disappointed. Very poor custom service. Long wait times but the restaurant was not busy. Very unprofessional staff. I will not return to this location.
We sat outside and the food came fast, and the service was super friendly and attentive. As always, the meal was great and hot!

The food was VERY LATE. the people who were sat after us had gotten all their food and eaten and had left before we got our food. Which took over a HOUR When it arrived it was hard and overcooked. I had to send it back and had it remade. This is my favorite dish and get it every time I go. So was shocked at the lack of service and care

We’ve eaten at Opa! before and expected better tasting food and service for the price. We barely got any attention from our waiter who waited until after we ate our appetizer to take our main course order. We ordered Moussaka and Pastiche which were extremely salty making it not very tasty.  Both came with a Greek salad whose tomatoes and cucumbers were cut very large. Our waiter never came back to check in how our food was tasting and we basically had to call him over when we were done to get our check. And to top it off, the acoustics were so bad at this location that we couldn’t hear each other without raising our voice. Needless to say we won’t be going back to Opa! anytime soon.

I’m going to have to say, this time was just OK. I’ve been here several times and loved it. Not this time. For a holiday (Easter), not very crowded. Service was very slow. Had to ask three times for water. My pasta looked like the end of the barrel. Too expensive! Don’t know if I will be returning.

Had a reservation for an outdoor table - somehow that got wiped from my original reservation but Opa was nice to still help make it happen and that's where the good ended.... service was minimal.  Took our order - we ordered a hummus combo appetizer and entrees and everything literally came out same time.  And we still had to ask for water which none had been brought to us - seemed a true lack of service. Asked for more opa sauce and it also took several asks of different people to actually get. Still tipped 20% but not deserving of the actual service.  Disappointed.  Good food can only take you so far!  Hope it gets better for Opa's but last time we were there, had poor service too.  :(

Overall enjoyed the meal but service was a little subpar. Restaurant wasnt too busy, so was a tad annoyed our entree's didnt come out the same time and had to flag our server down to see what was going on.
The Opa team did a wonderful job in delivering a wonderful time to celebrate my dear friends birthday.
We went here a few weeks ago and it was wonderful. We went last night and we won’t be back. The server was nice, but the food wasn’t very good. What a disappointment.
It was nice, but not a wow.  What would make a wow?  No mask, friendly & knowledgable service, good food, nice soft music.  Thank you.
It was very good and the food was great. The pita and hummus was delicious.
My dining partner was half an hour late and the staff treated me graciously and attentively. Very impressive. We’ll be back.
Service was excellent and food was delicious! I would have preferred a table not so close to the door because it was cold whenever anyone came in/out but we got through it!
Very disappointed in our experience. Food was, as one of our guests described it, "interesting." Not at all what it used to be.
The food was amazing and service was great!! We dine outside the atmosphere was good. They had heaters as well

We love Opa's but this visit was a bit hit and miss.  Had a reservation and we got sat in the corner near the bar.  They were busy and it seemed the bartender was our server which meant other than taking our order and the basic getting our check, etc - we never had our waters refilled even though people walked by with a water pitcher and felt a bit neglected.  The food was good except for the Frito Misto appetizer - a bit on the greasy side and all the items aside from the calamari were heavily battered and mostly batter and the dish had a lot of just empty fried bits.  :(  Hoping this is just a one time miss.
Fabulous! Excellent service and food and will be returning again soon!

First time experience at this restaurant.  Had been in the Los Gatos location years ago.  Our favorite Greek food involves lamb, and sadly they were out!  Avgolemono Soup was good, Gyro Fries were kinda dry.  Moussaka very good.  Beef Souvlaki was good, but the rice that came with it tasted like it came from a box.  Bougatsa dessert was good, but the Baklava was disappointingly dry and did not taste fresh.  Coffee was very weak.
We went for brunch, food was so good. Flavored to perfection.

Great food at Opa.  I have the same thing every time, Gyro Meat platter and it never disappoints. My son loves their Greek Cheese Steak sandwich, so much so that he orders 2 and takes the extra one home.
Valentine’s Day
The noise was deafening. Could barely hear each other across the table. Won't go back despite the good food and friendly staff.

The food was good however the service was not good
The hostess came to tell us to leave after 1:15 , she said there another reservation at 8:15
I would now be returning to that OPA
Our server was wonderful; happy, helpful and quick!   Food was delicious as always.

It would be much more enjoyable if something could be done about the guy that comes every weekend and plays loud music on the corner.  I enjoy coming here and eating outside with my dog, but I can’t have a conversation with anyone who’s with me and it’s really annoying
It was a little chilly, even sitting inside. But overall, we loved it. Food was great and service was excellent
The staff were great.    The meal itself was average at best, worst I have ever had at Opa
Always love the food at Opa.  There's something for everyone.  I like sitting outside better than inside for the atmosphere, but I don't like being cold in the winter so I'll sit inside too.
This was the perfect spot for our girls night out.  Food was wonderful, staff was attentive, and restaurant is bright and inviting.  Kept us all warm on a chilly night.
Dinner after show for participated actress
Wonderful concept.
Post Navy deployment dinner with my daughters. It was a wonderful experience.

The appetizers are still excellent but the quality of the entrees has really dropped.  The lamb souvlaki and lamb pita were very difficult to chew and the souvlaki was lukewarm at best.  This used to be a go to for us but I don’t think we will be returning other than maybe for an appetizer or cocktail.

The meatloaf was moist and tasty.  Took leftovers home for lunch the next day. The zucchini appetizer was also very good and we dipped them in a side of spicy avocado dip.  Overall service and meal was outstanding.
Food was delicious and service was very good, but WAY too noisy...patio is more ambient but too cold to sit outside in November
I had a great time at Opa!  The service was great, the food was fantastic and it’s in a really nice little area.  Get the flaming cheese!
Six diners with six different menu choices and we all said we would order the exact same thing the next time! Delicious!
Food was great!

Campbell location:  our table assigned server never returned after we got initial glasses of water. We kept reminding other staffers that we were ready to order our dishes. Those servers said our table belonged to the first server. Dish served missing spoon until we asked for. Front door check-in staff was helpful.  Heat lamp is wonderful in cold weather. Food quality is up to par. 

Previously we dined at Opa! Santa Clara location with same foods and much courteous and better service.
Good food. Great service a little loud inside. Lots of heaters outside if you’d like less noise.
Everything is great & enjoyable!
Service wasn't good, I think we got a new waiter who wasn't on top of it but overall good place!

The restaurant did not have my OpenTable reservation. Fortunately, they were able to seat us outside like we wanted. The service was good, but the waitress didn’t check that often. She was good. The food was excellent!

Great and friendly service. Good food. 
 Nice outdoor seating.
Food was lukewarm on arrival. Starter appeared with the main course. Noise level was at a pitch you could hardly hear the other person at the table. Apart from that everything was great.

Everything was great! We ordered two chicken Pita meals and the Benedict's breakfast meal. First time we tried something off the brunch menu. All of the meals delicious! Food was hot when served.  Service was great. Ryan, or server, was friendly and attentive. We will definitely be back again soon!

The absolute worse service I’ve experienced. Do not order a dish with chicken our party of 8 all had extremely dry chicken and flavorless rice pilaf. We had to turn to the waiter and stare until he finally came over to our table. Never asked if we wanted drinks or water. We had to flag him down repeatedly to order. Gratuity included at $80 with bare minimum service had I not flagged him down. It was not busy at all for that kind of service. None of us were impressed or had anything good to say. Terrible way to celebrate a birthday. It’s a shame because the ambiance was good. We will not be back.
Everything was perfect as usual 😍

I got the Greco Roman flatbread and while it may be appeasing to some it was not my taste. I reheated my girlfriend's chicken pita sandwich for lunch today however and it tasted great. We chose outdoor seating, and our table was in the middle and uncomfortably close to the neighboring tables. About 2 feet away from me was the next table. Loud Greek dance music is played outside, so do not expect quiet. Every time someone ordered one of the items that is flaming they shout Opa! It's fun to watch and I'm sure gets tiring for the servers who are doing it for the 7th time that evening. The pricing was very good and our server did their job proficiently. I ended up leaving my credit card in the bill pouch and when I came back they found it quickly. Overall it was a good experience and I'm glad I chose Opa! for our date night, however you should know to expect a less than intimate one on one environment (indoor seating looking pretty close together as well).

Went here for an early lunch on Sep 27 based on recommendations from Open Table. Overall was not disappointed. The Service was excellent with the waiter affording us ample time to get settled and review the menu. The food when it arrived more than met our expectations and was ample. Overall very pleased and will definitely return and recommend to friends
Had so much fun sitting outside.  Perfect night. The wait staff was so sweet and kind.
The meal was fantastic, especially the flank steak.  We had a party of four and each person was very impressed with the quality of the food that was provided.
Our waiter, Jose, was terrific!!  And so was to good.  Sitting outdoors with all the action from the farmers market made for a perfect brunch.
Good Food! Good service!

The food is Ok but not exiting. 
The chicken was very dry.
I wouldn’t go back for the food but for a drink I would
Great place to have lunch with old friends.   Good place to be able to visit.
Food and service was good. Unfortunately the music was way too loud. Very difficult to have a conversation sitting outside

Lamb kabob was tough. Difficult to cut with table knife. No sharp knife offered.
Chicken orzo dish was just okay.
Nice outdoor sitting
We had a great evening of dining outdoors. The music was a nice touch and added lots of ambiance to our experience! Food was great, as always!
The food and drinks *never* disappoint! Because it's on a busy street corner, the car is driving by and revving motorcycles can make it a bit loud times.
Great place for a Sunday brunch

I’ve tried my best to like Opa. I have ordered different things, brunch and dinner, and it’s still awful. Yesterdays brunch came out stone cold.  Potatoes seemed like they were left over from the night before, hard and cold. My egg pita breakfast sandwich was runny and cold as well.  I feel like my $75 can be better spent elsewhere.
Food was delicious. Waiter was friendly and helpful providing great suggestions. We enjoyed our dinner but for the price the portions size were underwhelming.
It was ight
Food was normal nothing to brag about. Ambiance was noisy and somewhat chilly.
Magical atmosphere around open firepit outdoor dining. Perfect exotic music and ideal corner for fun and laid-back people-watching.
Opa has always been my favorite restaurant. Great food and ambience and reasonable prices.

The bartender working Sunday 8/28/22 at 10am was HORRIBLE from the moment I walked in. I sat at the bar and he was a solo bartender. I was the ONLY person at the time sitting inside of the restaurant. It was at opening and only a few tables of people outside. 
He had the rudest demeanor. I had to ask him to get me a menu, water, utensils, to take my order, to refill my mimosa, to get me the check, etc. I had to ASK FOR EVERYTHING and he appeared as if it was a major inconvenience to him and it irritated him. He did not once check on me on his own. He then disappeared at times outside. He would stand with his back to the bar talking on the phone to people and texting throughout my visit. 
When I asked for the check and one more mimosa he said yes and then I watched him walk outside on the sidewalk and was talking to people. Never got me my check or mimosa. He eventually came back and brought them. I immediately had my card ready and gave it to him to pay. He then walked outside AGAIN towards MO’s. After ten minutes I was very frustrated and asked another server for help. His response was that this is an ongoing issue and this bartender has been working there far too long. At this same time a nice couple was sitting at the bar now getting the exact same terrible service. Then a woman sitting outside walked in to talk to the manager because he was not attending to them as well. 
He eventually caught word that he was being looked for and passed my card and check back to another server and he never even ran my card!! I did speak to the manager who rectified the situation by comping my meal which I never expected or needed, but it was appreciated. After many complaints I could see the manager discussing this with him. He then had the nerve to confront me and ask “what did I do that you spoke to my manager”? I had no problem expressing my grievances but he should have had a more professional and apologetic response. Not blame me for his lack of care. Horrible service
The food was not good and they were out of a few items. Disappointing since I’ve been here numerous times before.
It was really loud indoors. I’d recommend sitting outside if available. Our appetizers were great. My lamb shank was ok. Our waitress was new, a little slow but doing her best.

Service was excellent.  Food is mediocre at best. Ambience is great.  How can a “Greek Named restaurant not produce a decent basic Greek salad?’   Mine was tasteless.   Someone needs to go look up a recipe book asap.   I had lamb souvlaki,  and I just wanted a small Greek salad to go with, as it was lunchtime and anything else sounded too heavy. I didn’t want the included sides of fries, rice or veggies.  I was charged an extra $5 for that privilege.
This was my first time at this restaurant, I had the Opa Saute, it was terrific and the seafood skewer was great.

Food was good. Service was lacking as took a long time to take order, get drinks and one of the items that was not correctly ordered by waiter. She mentioned she was new and learning menu. Overall decent experience and will be back.

Food was super tasty and outdoor seating was great for people watching.  The cocktails were also delicious.  Outside noise was periodically peppered with noisy cars.  We chose to be outside, so if traffic noise bothers you pick inside instead.  They were busy, so occasionally it took longer than we hoped to get silverware or a water refill, but our server was nice.  This was our first time here and we'll definitey go back.

Evening started with pre-dinner drink orders being incorrect, twice. Then, the waiter brought the wrong wine with dinner but we caught it before it was opened because the waiter forgot to bring a wine opener to the table.  Waited a long time in between one person's drinks and food being brought to the table and the rest of the group. Although there is plenty of outdoor seating, this restaurant is at the busiest and loudest intersection in downtown Campbell. We were treated to cars revving their engines and peeling out, and extremely loud music being played by cars - the same cars passing by multiple times. Food was good but prices have gone way up.  Generally, we've enjoyed Opa! in the past, but may try one of the other locations instead of Campbell.

We love this opa, but sadly our recent visit was a disappointment. Our food was over cooked (rice, chicken, fries, basically everything) and they forgot one of our dishes two times. Not sure if this is typical service on a Monday, but we all felt like we won’t go back again for awhile.

I was really in the mood for Greek/Mediterranean food. And Opa definitely did NOT deliver. My beef souvlaki was well done and had zero seasoning or flavor to us besides burnt. The rice wasn’t cooked well and just masked with a lot of onions and peppers and idk whatever veggies they had. The Opa Fries we’re just lathered with red sauce in one spot. Super salty and soggy fries. The calamari was about the only thing good that we had. Drinks were flat. Bf burger wasn’t anything spectacular. Server wasn’t attentive. Last time I went to opa was the same thing. My steak was well done and I wanted to give it another try, but this is definitely our last time there.
appreciated that server wore mask and was appropriately attentive but not overly so
Excellent food and service, this place was highly recommended and delivered a nice dining experience :) It was a bit loud inside so it was hard to hear however.

Hosts were kind and helpful. Unfortunately, it was very busy and I had to wait for an outside table with shade. Not a lot of space between tables/other parties and the noise was really bad, plus a vendor in front of the restaurant had loud music playing. Our waiter asked for the music volume to be lowered on our request, and that helped a bit. I had the seafood skewers and the meat was dry. They DID accommodate my need for a side dish of specific vegetables . My friend had 1/2 chicken entree and she said it was very tasty. The bartender made a customized mocktail that was a bit too sweet, but watered down was delicious. Dessert was sweetened with honey and great berries, so that part was good.
I loved getting food with a friend I haven't seen in a while
Opa’s Campbell is always a favorite. Good food good atmosphere.

The food didn’t quite seem up to par- kabobs a little overcooked. I usually like to sit outside because it is quieter but the man that sits on city land on the corner playing his music over loud speakers is very annoying. When we mentioned the noise level to the waiter he said there was nothing they could do about it. He is not paid by anyone apparently.
Special dinner w friends
Great outdoor seating!  Service and food was great!
We all had very tasty meals and the outdoor seating was very accommodating.  The service was very good. Our group will be back.
Food was decent for Greek food. Service was absolutely horrible. Manager didn’t do anything all night except walk around.

Pros: great atmosphere, great live music, spacious outdoor, umbrella and heating available.
Cons: food quality was not good: chicken and lamb pieces were so hard. lamb pieces in Gyro were so chunky and hard that made it hard to chew and swallow, while it was supposed to be thin cuts of meat. appetizer portions were very small. Steak was just OK. shrimp was good.
Service was very slow and non-attentive(lady with piercings on her face): no steak knife for steaks, no spoons for desserts, we had to ask a few times and wait very long to get missing plates, missing silverware, extra glasses.

We went there around 8PM on a weekday night. Three of us ordered the flatiron steak, which was moderately priced at $25 including potatoes and asparagus. The steaks were flavorful but a bit tough (might be the nature of this cut?). Also a bit overcooked, but in all candor it's difficult to get a thin steak cooked medium rare. We also ordered martini's before dinner and they were great - very large and well prepared. We sat outside - plenty of heaters, it was actually warmer outside than inside. There was some street noise from cars going by and an annoying (to me, at least) person playing music very loud on the street corner (not the restaurant's fault, obviously). We thought that the value was pretty good due to the excellent service, the quality of the food and drinks, and the ambiance.

Food was good - love their Greek gyro cheesesteak with the opa fries!  But service was just okay.  Server never checked on us but to take the order and then at the end - he brought us boxes and the check.  Nothing special on the service side.  Do like the outdoor seating option especially during the nice weather!
I usually order the Moussaka when I eat Greek.  Opa didn't disappoint.  It comes with a salad.  I also ordered the Opa Fries as an appetizer.  That was delicious as well.
Horrible waiter. Poor service. Food was cold. Drinks came with main course.
Great service, good food, noise level is high, chairs are uncomfortable, but still among my favorites

Delicious food and wonderful service as always .it was warm and we were on the outside patio.but it was tolerable..it was my friend's birthday and they even brought a small dessert for us to share, compliments of the house!
Very good restaurant except for the service.
Terrible acoustics, meh food, and overall wasn’t worth it. I was there once before and it was a little better, but after last night I won’t go again.
