The hostess was extremely rude.  When we checked in, she claimed our reservation was only for 2 but they could "squeeze us in."  I tried to show her our reservation was for 3 inside, and she just hustled us to a sunny location by the sidewalk outside.  Have been eating here for years and the chicken tasted off.  Bussers and runners were kind and helpful but that was about it.  Have had better nights here.
Outdoor seating was perfect! Not sure if they always have it but there was also some live entertainment. Service was quick and friendly. We'll definitely be back!
Food was Ok, nothing to write home about. Probably won’t go there again

I get that places are understaffed, but we asked for plates twice since we were sharing, and in one case were told, “I don’t do that. Ask your waiter.” We never got plates & our waiter never returned except to drop off the check. Food was good.
Wonderful location with good food. Hard to get refills on your drinks.
Everything was great but the manager tried to tell us the restrooms were closed before we even got our food.. only complaint

Food was great and sitting outdoors was perfect weather although one of our tables was all wobbly.  Service was a bit spotty - server was nice but seemed like he always had to be reminded of one drink he missed, one soup he missed, one entree late, replace dirty spoons as our ice cream melted, one beer, and the list goes on.  But overall - our party of 10 had a great time.  Some food was super yummy like the Opa fries - some was just okay.  Spinach on the whole sea bass was super salty and over seasoned and side Horiatiki salad was bland.

Food is more American than Greek. 
Noisy terrace with loud music covering conversation. 
Food is average

Noise level was loud cause the musician playing right there on the same corner was a bit too loud for us to converse just 7’ away (the music is appreciated, but they should cross the street to the non-restaurant corner so patrons can hear each other talk without yelling). 

They must be short staffed cause we sat for 15 min before getting help, took 3x and three servers to get our water. Food wasn’t bad. 

My Opatini wasn’t made according to the menu but it wasn’t a bad martini, overall.

I wanted to try a new restaurant while visiting the Bay Area.   Opa is a true find.  We had a nice corner table outside.  Our waiter was very attentive which is hard to do these days with staffing shortages.  Then there was the food.  I can't remember the name but it was sautéed mushrooms and spinach with a veggie skewer and my choice of a Steak skewer.  They were both excellent as I finished the entire plate.  We also split a village salad (typical Greek) and it was great also.   I look forward to going again when I visit again.
Our waiter was outstanding--truly a professional in every way.
One of our favorite places

Ate outdoors with occasional car noise. Disappointed that owners cannot figure out how to use heating and umbrellas on the same patio. Poor planning on a chilly night. 
The food however was terrific. Great Moussaka and Pasticio and generous side Greek salad. Service was excellent.
Bad service

The waiter did less than the minimum. He never came to see if everting was all right and fill up our glasses with water. At the end he didn't propose to us the desserts menu and give us "rudely" the check. Because of his attitude we did not even dare to ask for the dessert menu when we wanted to order some. (it was not closing time and there were lot of people in the restaurant).
It is bad because it was not the first time we came but it is probably the last. We were having a good time but the way he treated us made this moment less enjoyable.
Food was not good, service was equally as bad. I will not return.

This was our 3rd time at this restaurant in the last couple of months. We usually go after visiting my hair stylist because we love the location and the food is great!

We arrived right at 6.30pm and were seated right away. The server came over and took our drink and appetizer order, and said he would be right back. Drinks came out in about 10-15 mins which seemed like a long-ish time, but not long enough to get us annoyed. However, 35 minutes later, there was no sign of any appetizer, and our server still hadn't come back to take the rest of our order. I tried to stare him down to catch his eye, but he didn't even glance at our table. Finally, I had to get up from our table and go to him to let him know we were very ready to place our order (and to ask about the missing appetizer). He said he would come over when he finished putting an order into the kitchen. Another 10 minutes went by, and still no sign of him or the appetizer!

I was super hungry and now this was getting frustrating, so I went to find the manager to see if we could get another server. Meanwhile, one of the bus-ladies saw we were still sitting with no food, and she came over to help us (she would have made a much better server than the guy we had!) The manager also assigned a different server to our table immediately.

Our loser server never actually submitted the order for our appetizers, so our new server quickly got them out to us. After that rocky start, our new server was able to recover our evening and it was pretty undramatic from thereon. The manager also comped us a dessert which made my son very happy!

Funnily enough, the people on the next table also had problems with the server, so maybe he is just not cut out for the job. They told us they also had to go find him a few times, and he completely messed up their order. 

I believe our experience is more reflective of one bad server and the restaurant itself is actually really good.
food was very enjoyable but menu descriptions could be more complete
Birthday celebration
terrible service....surprisingly. Not sure why I can't
Very nice waiter

Good value restaurant, but the guy in the front desk was rude (must be the owner).  Plus, they did not assign a waiter for our table.  The bartender noticed and he served us.  He was good, but the fact they did not assign a waiter was bad.  Food was ok.  Overall 4 stars at best.
Good food, efficient service, nice staff.

I’ve been to Opa! a few times and this was the worst experience I’ve had here. We waited awhile for our appetizers, when we received our soup it wasn’t hot, when we received our entrees the rice was cold (wasn’t warm at att), and our service wasn’t great. If the service was better, the other hiccups wouldn’t have mattered as much but our server rarely checked on us and actually left our dirty plates in front of us when we were finished.

Went here for Mother’s Day and regretted it for the following reasons:
-Hostess denied our request to sit inside without even checking, even though it was super cold out and I told her I have a two year old and my mom with me 
-The waiter didn’t know the menu at all, had to look over my shoulder to what I was pointing in order to write it down and couldn’t answer basic questions
-They brought chicken on the nachos when we said to keep it vegetarian 
-Waiters bringing food out didn’t know which table they were supposed to go to, had to ask customers to check 
-The food quality was horrible compared to what it was a few years ago
-My son’s simple tomato sauce pasta took forever to get to the table, had to remind the waiters twice, and it wasn’t even good in the end 

Very disappointed, probably never eating her again

We decided to go here for Mother's day dinner. The service was great. It was chilly outside, however they lit the fire pit and we warmed up quickly. We ordered the lamb chops, calamari and seafood skewers, they were all good.

The short version - call Opa! to confirm your reservation with OpenTable, it does not always show up at the restaurant.  Opa! was great.

The reservation made through Open Table did not show up when we arrived at Opa! in Campbell.  After I showed them the confirmation email, the staff was able to put together a table for our party of 8.

Opa! 5 stars, OpenTable 1 star.
Mother’s Day.
Our waiter was fantastic, the hostess was overworked, the food was good but came to the table late and different stages. It was Mothers Day.
Mother’s Day
Food was great, service was even better! They were super accommodating to food allergies and very sweet to our child.
Was not offered anything special !
Great outdoor dining. Large menu can satisfy all tastes. Try the sangria.
It took almost 1 hour to complete the order. I don’t recommend this place.

I made the reservation for lunch but the system didn't give me the option to sit outside, so we ended up sitting inside. The waiter who took my order didnot write down our order and I didn't receive my beer for a long time and I had to tell two other employees before I got my beer.
Amazing service and friendly workers! Thank you for a great experience and we will be back.

It was my birthday and I mentioned it on the reservation but they didn’t say anything. The weather was cool and rainy so the indoor dining was full. It was pretty loud inside. The food was great, but the tables were very close together so it was difficult having a conversation.
Great service, friendly staff. The food was ok, not the best we’ve had but it’s a matter of taste. It’s a nice restaurant for lunch.

We were in town and randomly joined Opa for their brunch menu.  Delicious! The restaurant has a fun vibe, the staff was upbeat and attentive, we had the breakfast pita and egg Benedict.  Both were huge servings, fairly priced, fresh, cooked well and full of flavor.  I told myself I wasn’t going to eat the whole thing… couldn’t help it. Will definitely remember this establishment should we find ourselves in Campbell again.

We were seated quickly for our last minute reservations. The food we ordered came quicker that I’ve experienced at most restaurants lately, so that was a nice surprise. Everything we ordered was perfect. Only down side was having to ask the server for the glass of Proseco that I had ordered with the food. Other than that one small thing, it was great! Enjoyed the meal and atmosphere.
Our waitress was warm and friendly and attentive. Our meals were delicious and ample.
Great food, prompt polite service, good value for the money.
No service- was sat in a section w no waiter assign. Complained twice abs then ignored so we had no other options but to leave.

Good food and company- we ate outside, inside is generally loud . Good food- only one complaint- we ordered the flaming cheese nd the server was not able to light it  due to the lighter and it getting heavy so she just dropped it on our table.

We will go back.  There was an issue when glass rained down on our table when someone behind the bar shattered a mug or wine glass.  The staff was quick to replace our drinks and appetizer.  They even comped our drinks without us asking or complaining.

Perfect dirty martini. I'm addicted to the zucchini cakes and keftedes and I can't stop. Service was great. 

The only little thing was that we weren't getting a lot of warmth from the heaters. I had a warm jacket on but kind of uncomfortable. It is winter so there's that lol....

Very nice experience. 

Very good food.

Excellent service.
Our server was super friendly, and the food was great.  My favorite dish is the Lemon Orzo Chicken dish,  definitely enough for 2 to share.

The ABSOLUTE WORST service! Saturday night at 5pm with a reservation for 4 (2 couples). We were seated with menus and water immediately. Had to ask for a waiter. It was hard to catch anybody's eye. The waiter said he came by twice but we were talking. I guess we were supposed to sit quietly and wait for him to show up. Drinks were ordered and came. One was a Greek margarita- but was there any alcohol in it? We ordered the dip sampler which was delicious. We were seated near the kitchen and watched everyone stand around. We watched the tall thin sloppy blond waiter knock over the plastic to go sauce cups onto the floor, pick them up and restack them for use! We were horrified.  Finally got our food order in. We were done with the appetizer plates by then but they were still left there when our food came.  We had to move them around as our tall thin sloppy blond waiter HANDED our plates to us! So one had meatloaf, another had kebabs and rice and Greek salad, another had a steak served on an iron pan that was cold, and I had a falafel pita. Our friend asked for another Greek margarita but asked to have tequila in it this time as he couldn't tell there was any in the first one. The meatloaf and kebabs were served first. The meatloaf came out steaming hot. We waited several minutes for the steak on the iron pan and my falafel pita. The kebabs we're supposed to have a Greek salad substitute. It didn't come until after the kebab plate when he told the server to never mind, He had expected it first. Then it came to the table last anyway. My falafels were mushy and raw inside. The meatloaf was just ok. The kebabs had cold rice, and the steak served on an iron pan came out cold - probably from sitting on the counter for 5 minutes being overlooked. A very disappointing and very expensive  meal. With 5 star prices we had a Dairy Belle experience. But actually, that’s an insult to Dairy Belle! Their food is good snd you get what you pay for. Unlike Opa!
I think it was overpriced and overrated. The portions were too small for the price being charged.
service was poor. very rushed and not courteous whatsoever. felt like free food was being served.

I had not been to this Opa location in quite awhile, before Covid started for sure.  The restaurant, even though we were inside, was quite cool/cold temperature wise.  Our food came shortly after ordered, and due to the room temp of the restaurant, food was cold before finished eating.  Waiter was OK, not very attentive.  Had to flag him down a few times, and they were not that busy.
I really like the food at Opa, so will give this another shot at another time, probably after Covid is under controle.

Opa’s did not receive the reservation from Open Table. So Open Table gets 1/2 star for efficiency. 
Food was very good and service was excellent.

It was all fair. Food was okay, my meatloaf was very oily but I liked the mashed potatoes and my husband liked his salmon. Service was fair-ish. Didn’t really see our waiter much, couldn’t order second drinks or refills thankfully we ordered our entrees while we ordered our appetizers.

It was Valentines Day! We brought our pup and he was welcomed & greeted very nicely by our Hostess and Server. 
We sat by the fire pit and it was nice and cozy. 

The food is always great! We had a very nice time.
Food was good but they forgot to serve us our salad.

Poor service. 
We got our appetizers before our drinks. The waiter didn’t even give us silverware after our food arrived. We had to ask for it. Food was under seasoned. Our vegetable souvlaki was undercooked and seafood souvlaki was over cooked.
Portions are MUCH smaller now .. and reservations are always required, which is frustrating when a majority of the tables are empty and waiters are standing around waiting for customers.

Service was alright, although I don't understand why'd they bring out appetizer and 2 courses at the same time and forget the wine we ordered.
Also, why would they recommend as the best dessert a banana-nut bread in a Greek restaurant??
The  ordered medium-done lamb chops came out  well done, and the chef must be in love, because he went heavy with the salt. :( Can't recommend to a friend, sorry...

Must be the staff shortage everywhere but it took a while for our order to be taken even though there were hardly 5-6 tables occupied. The food did arrive quickly though the quality of this place seem to have gone down significantly. Pita bread was hard and rubbery. The flat bread was better but appeared to have been overdone on the sides (burnt).

We ate outside, and were actually warm enough with the heaters. I enjoy their Opa! fries, so that was our appetizer, and the sides included with the roasted chicken were very good. That said, the chicken was not as tender as I would have liked and it was hard to eat with knife and fork. The sauce was also not as lemony as I like in greek food. Next time I will try the Avgholemono soup instead. I will go back, overall it was an excellent choice.
Waitress was very attentive, the food was delicious and presentation was great. It was our first time coming here and we will be back.

I sat at the table and was waiting for my wife to arrive.  Waiter never even comes to the table to welcome me and ask me if I want anything while waiting.

After 10 minutes I had to waive him down to at least get me a cup of ice water.

He shows up at the table and this is exactly what he says in grumpy mood:

“What do you want?”

Dinner comes and he never asks how it was or if we needed anything else.   He just tried to sell us more wine to fatten up his too.

I hope the 10% tip I left him woke him up a bit.  Totally rude and obnoxious.   Food wasn’t even that good either.   Don’t waste your time and money here.
Food was just ok. But the drinks were terrible. We literally had to give them back. Servers were working hard.
Server was polite, professional, and very attentive.  Food was delicious!  Tables spaced out in restaurant — plenty of room between other customers.  :)
I had a great birthday dinner with friends.
The lamb was really good! Sometimes that is hard to cook correctly. Compliments to the chef.

Sat outside, tables were comfortably distant from each other and service was great.  I loved my falafel on pita which came with a side of rice.  Two of us ordered the side of rice with their sandwiches and one ordered fries.  Fries were DELICIOUS, the rice didn’t have much taste.  Kind of blah.  Overall everything was wonderful.
I had a great experience at Opa!! I went here on a dinner date with my BF and we were able to get amazing food and service.

I was in this restaurant location more than few times. 
But, this time food wasn't good. I ordered Let's Wrap with Chicken, last time Chicken was warm and more amount. This time was so little amount.
My friends ordered Moussaka and Patricio, both dishes was lukewarm. 
Both are casserole dishes, should be oven hot!

We had a great time!  The appetizers and cocktails were absolutely delicious!  The entrees were good as well, but not as spectacular as the appetizers.  Can't wait to go back, but this time for Happy Hour!
Always an enjoyable meal at Opa's. This was our first time at the Campbell location. Our service was excellent.
Excellent Food and Service!  Very happy about the outdoor dining option!

Wonderful first time experience dining at Opa! Met up with a friend from college and had a great time. The ambiance was perfect and there wasn’t much of a crowd which was perfect for us to chat and catch up. Our waitress provided the best recommendations and was very hospitable. An amazing first time and will definitely be back. 

P.s. their lamb chops are perfection!

It was freezing! Everyone inside had to wear winter coats bc they had the doors open so staff could go in and out to the patio. It wasn’t enjoyable bc it was so cold. Food has gone downhill since my last visit. Our server was waaaaay too busy and we sat with dirty dishes in front  of us for too long. Won’t be going back!
Food seems far more American than Greek.  Poor Greek wine choices.  Clumsy service and unwillingness to arrange heaters to make outdoor dining comfortable.

A fav Campbell restaurant forvyears as always prompt and attentive service. Sea bass, moussaka, lemon chicken dishes all delicious. Good $$ value for food. Will continue to eat here with family abd friends.

Food was amazing!!, service very good, may want to slow down to bring out the rest of the food until the patrons are done with the appetizers, so as not to rush them and trying to fit everything on the table.. other wise the servers were great!
Bartender was awesome

We were celebrating an engagement so the noise made it a bit difficult to converse but we enjoyed the evening despite that.  Our favorite dish wasn't available last night.  The service was fantastic and the food was good.

Came for the Saganaki on a Saturday night and they were out :(
Also brought birthday dessert and never got my bag back
Ephram was a great server . The food  was yummy and fabulous!

Had a delicious lunch with family to celebrate a birthday. Can’t wait to go back and try other menu items. Everything we had was amazing. Make sure you save room for dessert, the banana bread pudding was the best!

Friendly staff and great food.  Went to celebrate my Birthday at happy hour.
Had a great time!

Our server was fast, friendly.  Everyone was very attentive. I usually don't order dessert but we felt so comfortable that my husband and I decided to stay longer and have a delicious dessert. Highly recommend this restaurant.

Asked for medium rate steak. It was extremely chewy and well-done. 

The service was just ok… had to flag down our waiter to place our order. We’d been there a full 30 mins by the time we ordered food as he forgot to take our order. Then everything came out too fast and we hadn’t finished our appetizers when our main course came out.

Our server got the over-cooked steak removed from the bill so that got him bumped up.

I love the ambience and location of this place and have enjoyed coming here a lot in the past. I hope they get back on track for our next visit.

Food was very good. Two meals of four were delivered cold and had to be sent back. The service we had was completely unacceptable.  After discussing our dissatisfaction, the manager did revise our bill significantly.
We have been here numerous times, and have always been completely satisfied. Unfortunately, last night  was an unfortunate mess.  The waiter was incompetent if we could ever find him without having to ask someone to locate him.  As i said, the food was good as usual.
Everything was great!  We had the Heirloom tomatoes and cheese that was fantastic and chicken kabobs.  The dirty martinis were great too!  We will definitely go back!!

Met up here for a ladies happy hour and sat outside. Our server was super attentive and moved heat lamps to make sure we were comfortable. The happy hour menu has some great items and very fair prices. The food and drinks were good and we had a great time!

This is a great family restaurant.   We eat here often and like all the items on the menu.   The food is always well prepared, the servers prompt, the ambience of downtown Campbell is very mellow and if you go on a Saturday evening, you get to see a parade of classic cars!!
Portions were a lot smaller than what they used to serve before, this is why I have it 3 stars. Was very disappointed with the small portions.
Delicious food, and wonderful service..love the Zuuchini Chips and you can't beat all the souvlakis..they are sooo good!
Excellent service by Eduardo, delicious food, as always....and the best patio in downtown Campbell...

Made reservations for 4 (2 kids). Were seated off the sidewalk- in the street. Waiter practically forgot about us, took forever to take our order, served adults first and the kids last. Did not bring food out all at once. Also, I had to remind server to bring child's side dishes.  Super crappy experience.
Great Greek food, nice outdoor dining
Great food and great service

Food was ok, but doesn’t match the ambiance. Televisions were playing the news for some reason (with captions) so my young daughter learned what drug cartels are as dinner conversation. Lastly, there is a strange ringing buzzing noise coming from the front desk that just goes on and on. I think it is their phone with a unique tone that no one ever answers…ever.

Our host and server Estuardo was great. We were promptly seated at the outside shaded table we requested. He took our drink order and everything was correctly and efficiently delivered. He did the same with our food order and our To Go order. Our flatbreads were really good. 

Service is really important and he was friendly and professional and prompt and we appreciated it very much!
Food and service was incredible
Food and service were very good.

We had a wonderful time at Opa!s. The food was delicious and service was also good.
Would recommend Opa!s for a nice pleasant outdoor meal.
Loved having a lunch outdoor in the patio with friends. The flaming cheese is a must-have and a lemon soup is delicious.
My steak came well done even though I asked for medium well, it didn’t seem like a busy night cause there were so many empty tables but our server was walking around a lot.

I got the basic gyro pita with lamb meat.  The meat was 'spongy' is the only way I can describe it.  The last time I was there I remember the lamb being delicious and very gyro-like.  I was disappointed in the food but loved my sangria and our server!

It was to chose from the expansive menu. Everything look delicious. We had 2 appetizers, the lettuce wraps and a lamb skewer. It was plenty for the 3 of us and was delicious. Loved the service and the ambiance of sitting outside on a beautiful Fall evening. Look forward to our next visit.
Loved the cold beer, outdoor patio, and Greek Green Salad. The chicken kabob was dry, but otherwise a great dining experience!
Food was good and service was a little slow. They forgot to give us cutlery and small plates till we had to ask a couple of times
Good food. Quick service and lovely outdoor seating.

We were celebrating a special birthday. The lava cake dessert was the most littlest thing we have ever seen. When I told the waitress it was sooo small she said She could bring another one. My comment was not for $11 dollars! It looked like a squished 1/2 cupcake Not going to spend $22😐

I was pleasantly surprised to find a reservation for 3 about 45 minutes before the arrival time on a Saturday night. They are offering both outside and inside dining. We checked in at the reception and were seated inside. We had a very strange encounter with one of the servers as soon as we got seated. He wasn't an English speaker, so couldn't really understand him but he gestured us to check with the reception before sitting, as if we just decided to seat ourselves without checking in. He wasn't welcoming and the guy who walked us to the table was also confused. Just very strange and I didn't appreciate it. But it was a pleasant experience after that. Our server for the night was very pleasant. We ordered the Opa! Fries as a starter. Their Opa! sauce is very good but the quantity they offer is not very generous. And we had to wait a while to request for some more because our server sorta disappeared in the kitchen 😊 The food was definitely well portioned and yummy.
It's a good restaurant, but I feel like the menu never changes... good and bad.

We had a reservation through open table and in the comment section I put we would like to seat outside. when we showed up they wanted to seat inside which I mentioned we put a comment for seating outside the host told us that was a wrong box and we should of checked off another box for the recommendation! He put us outside in a table that seems like had children chairs and looked very uncomfortable and at the same time offer their nicer table to other group after I protested they moved us to another table but no service for the next 30 min until finally some one showed up to take care of our table. The food and drinks are good but over priced for the quality of the it.

Only reason for the 4 star is when the food arrived for our table mine wasn’t there. I waited 5 minutes and had to ask about it. It wasn’t prepared, canceled the order and just spent time enjoying the company
Always great service and the food is consistently fresh and hot. Our go-to spot
Food was delicious, our wait person was friendly and helpful. Enjoyed our late lunch without huge lunchtime crowd.
Overpriced just ok

We went for a milestone birthday; Opa did not disappoint. Food was excellent. The Saganaki/Flaming (Kasseri) cheese is a tableside flambé-like event on a hot skillet. The Heirloom Tomato & Halloumi cheese salad was succulent and sweet and the cheese was savory. The entreés ordered were: 1) the Opa Sauté (lamb skewer & veggie skewer over sauteéd spinach, mushrooms & grilled onions), which was ample and well-seasoned, and 2) Kokinisto Me Manestra (slow roasted lamb shank over tomato & pepper covered orzo pasta and sauteéd spinach) which also was ample, succulent and very flavorful. (We each would order those again!) Even though we did not order dessert, they brought small desserts with a candle on the plate of the birthday boy.
Birthday.  Slow service.  But thankful for everyone who showed up for work!  👏👏

The service was unpleasant. We gave our drink order but it never came in till we started the main course. When we asked again, the lady asked if we wanted the drunk. There wasn’t any confusion initially and her tone wasn’t nice at all. We asked if there’s a lot of rush or anything but no response. Such a rude lady.
Yogurt with pita bread and cucumbers was excellent.  Lamb chops beyond outstanding.  Ran out of lemon soup early on a Saturday evening.  Extremely disappointing.
Outdoor seating was nice, our server was very friendly.

I really like the food on the menu. Its a bit more then I'd like to pay. However, it's worth every cent. This time I had the Greek burger with fries. It came with a lot of sauce on the burger so be sure to cut it in half. You are less likely to make a mess on yourself. The burger it self was like a beff/lamb mix with lettuce, tomato and some mustard on the side. Super good. The fries come with some feta or goat cheese on top. Though I just dipped that in the mustard. Good with or without the mustard. 

Ordering food from Opa is always a good decision. I know I"ll be back.
Service was unorganized and unattentive.  Very mediocre food for the price!

We went to the restaurant at 7:30.
It was such a bad experience, after placing our orders and waited till 8:30 an hour no dish was served.
When we asked the waiter who served us what was happening he said there was much confusion he doesn't know.
We asked could he checkhe seemed unconcerned and he said he doesn’t know.we asked if there is an ETA he said i dont know.
The table next to us arrived.ordered food got their dishes in 5-10 mins.
Our waiter didn’t seem to care neither dis the manager seem to care.
After and hour and half of wait with no food no response from any member of the restaurant we had to leave with no food.
Appalling fact was that the server or the manager or anyone did not seem to care.
We were there to celebrate our kids going to college such a happy occasion but we had to return back with out celebrating….i wish i could gove zero stars!!

It is poor poor service !!!
The tzatziki was amazing! The best I've ever had.
Excellent service, perfect setting for night out, but was expecting more traditional Greek cuisine than what the menu showed (e.g. Dolmas was conspicuously absent).
Service was terrible and the restaurant was almost empty.
The selections were perfect as was the service.  Not rushed.  Plenty of time to sit, chat and enjoy the excellent food.  The Greek cheesesteak was superior.

This was our first time after being recommended to this specific location from a family friends and WOW! Excellent cocktail menu, wonderfull appetizers, cutest ambiance, and our server was so attentive. If I could give more than 5 stars I would. Shout out to Daniel for giving us great recommendations and being so friendly and attentive as our server. We will be regulars here from now on! Keep it up!
I have had better Greek food but it was still good and the price fair.
One of our all-time favorite spots!!! The food and service is always great
Sat outside at the curb, which was fine except for the loud cars and motorcycles.  Food was delicious as always.  Service was on point.
Very nice place. The outside patio is great. We loved it.
Was excellent. Bartender was a little rude.
Better than Dish Dash..really/Honestly. Have been before and will go back again
Great outdoor dining!

Good late lunch, my salad was fresh and good. My husband had the roasted chicken which he said was good, but wish it hadn't had a creamy sauce poured over it. Our server was very nice and customer service oriented to meet our needs. We really enjoyed the outdoor dining on a warm summer day.
Always love OPA. Service is excellent. Food does not disappoint!
Food is great,  server was great.  Took a little longer than expected to have order taken,  but it was a lunch rush.
Our server was amazing and very friendly. Garden of eden flatbread was outstanding!
Consistently pleasant, good food, love their patio.
Great food as always. Portions were huge! Also our waitress was so so kind to our table, and especially patient.

Made a last minute reservation on open table for 2 and were seated promptly upon our arrival. We come here a couple times a month and the service, good, and cocktails are always made great! This time was no exception. I usually go for the beef cheesesteak pita, I recommend asking for the spicy aioli on the side. The wife usually gets the seafood pita, also asks for the tzatziki on the side. Service is always really good here no matter how busy they are which is why we come frequently. Looking forward to my pita next time :)
Delicious!! Saganaki was FIRE 🔥

Wasn’t happy with food and service .  The server seemed disappointed that we didn’t order appetizers or wine .  He was rushing us to order and seems as though he wanted us to dine quickly so the table can be filled with some other customers.  Some of the grilled veggies were not warm like they just warmed up my food in microwave.  I know they could do better so I have been there many times .

Wonderful Food and Attentive Staff. Can tend to be busy so will need to bear that in mind and have a little patience at times. But the outdoor patio is delightful. It was a wonderful experience having good food with friends. Thank you for providing us the perfect environment for us to do that.
Great food in a great atmosphere!  Will definitely be back.
After making an outdoor reservation, the Opa staff told me they didn't have any available tables even though I had a reservation and turned me away. Very rude staff and such a lack of service.
They were missing a food item on brunch menu, and with it being so short, it was disappointing.

Love you guys. Everything was really good. We sat at the bar and the bartenders did a great job but they needed help. 😫 It was packed and they were working like dogs.  Everyone should be tipping big right now!

Food, pricing and location was great. The server we had, however, was not attentive. He rarely checked in on us, we had to constantly try to flag him down to order, get refills, or boxes. I felt like we spent the majority of our time waiting on him.

Three of us shared 3 appetizers and a salad for dinner.  The sliders made with Gyro meat were very good, as was the fried cheese.  We also had a dip sampler, and it came with a few stuffed grape leaves which were nice and lemony.  
The Santorini salad never disappoints with both grilled chicken and prawns!  YUM.

The place was quite busy for a Thursday night, and it appeared that the tables were all spaced at least 6 feet apart.  In any case they seemed to be having a good night.  We had not been there since before the start of Covid, so it was a nice re-visit!

We were there for my mother’s birthday. Food was excellent. Asking us to go inside for the QR code vs having it at the table seems silly. Heat lamp went out and we asked a couple times and eventually someone put it on but the first person gave up. Service could use just a little boost to match the delicious fare.

Took a while to be seated even though the restaurant wasn't busy. We stood at the hostess desk for quite a while without anyone saying anything to us. The food was good but some of it came out cold. Otherwise a good meal...
Opa is always great food. It's a go to place for us.
Great! Good food!
It took forever to get a waiter but food was very good.

The service was excellent - friendly, quick, and accurate. Everything was good except the chicken sliders. These were rubbery, and funny enough came out later than everything else. We also had the flank steak - tasted great, but cooked more than requested (not a big deal for us). Overall we’d return!
Food and service was amazing! I always keep coming back to this place and location.
Delicious and my dish was good for my keto diet. Looking forward to my next visit.

Literally the worst service we’ve ever had there. And it wasn’t a crazy busy night. They just would come to the table then never come back, we had to ask multiple times for things. Server seemed to realize he messed up by being overly attentive when it came time for the check and to go boxes.

Still a favorite spot so we’ll be back. Last night just really kinda sucked.
I love the outdoor eating area at Opa Campbell.  Their brunch is my favorite meal because I love the Spartan benedict and bottomless mimosas!
Great happy hour! Highly recommend the Cucumber Mojito
Vegetables delicious but swimming in butter.  Salmon dry and overcooked.  Mashed potatoes, excellent!
Had a business lunch and we were very satisficed with our meal and service.
They were obviously under staffed. All our food came out cold. I had to call a server to our table to take our order after 15 minutes. Disappointing since I usually have good meals there.
Sat us in direct sunlight and we’re not able to provide umbrella. 10+ minutes to get order taken- after that all Ok except we could not sit as we would like.

The food was delicious, as always, but the service wasn’t that attentive (other than the busboy who was wonderful!). We love Opa and will be back, but this visit wasn’t the best service we’ve ever had.
It was great to be back in Opa’s. The food was great but it was the wait staff made the evening. Our server made us feel very welcome and was very helpful and attentive.
Mother’s Day celebration
Food was delicious and service was great.  We'll definitely be back.
Went for Mother’s Day. Little expensive for a family of five but it was amazing! Will definitely go back for special occasions
Nice place for a date night, busy outdoor enviroment
I hadn’t seen my friends since pre-Covid. Although food was good, I felt a little rush with servers.
Horrible service!!! Multiple customers complained about the horrible service. We had to wait 40 minutes before anyone even came to take our order. Food took FOREVER to arrive.

Our server was average at best.  It took a while to get the drinks.  We ordered the greek nachos with gyro meat, but they came with chicken.  We I told the server, she said she would get us a plate of gyro meat on the side.  Little did I know she would also charge us for that.  When the meals came, four of the five came out together.  It wasn't until about 7 mins later when she checked on us that I told her my meal was not there.
We had a great dinner.  The food was great as were the drinks.  Everyone was very friendly.

too cold outside even with the heaters, cold inside too - sat by the door
food was good, drink service took long...ordered another glass of wine, never came
instead got a check...we were not ready to leave! and wanted to order more....
Monday night wasn't the best night I guess

The food was great! We had the lemon chicken orzo and flaming cheese. The host was a little aloof. We had a reservation for 8 PM and our table was not ready. They seated us in the very back by the bathrooms when there were so many available tables. We asked to move closer and he reluctantly accommodated. That was not a good first impression. The waiter was wonderful, but didn’t really check in. Overall, was good for a dinner, but probably won’t be back because of the service.
Amazing food, waiter, Jose was , maybe new  hard to understand but very accommodating. Unfortunately half of our dishes weee cold. Not sure why.
Fresh Greek food with outdoor seating in lovely downtown Campbell. Meat as well as vegetarian choices

My husband enjoyed his Greek salad. I had the lettuce wraps- they were so-so. Wouldn’t order them
Again.
Great food, service, and atmosphere. It was nice to have dinner outside. Perfect place for date night.
One of my favorites in Downtown Campbell! Great food and the staff is great!
Great food, great service, staff was all adherent to Covid safety precautions.
As always very good dining.

Pretty restaurant seating outside but food is just not what I would return for.  Scallops and shrimp skewers were dry (over cooked)    Lamb kabob was also dry and over cooked.  If Opa specializes in these types of dishes they need to learn do them well.   Won’t be back.
Had a fun outdoor dining experience, excellent service and our salads were really fresh and good.
Love this place!!!

I have never been to OPA in Campbell, and I will not be back. Our server was Rigo who was also the bartender at the restaurant. I do not have any complaints against him and I would give him a 5 star rating because he provided the best service he was able to. He was overly busy with bar tending and being a server so he was running around and apologized. What was horrible was the food. We ordered two kids meals, a salad, and Fiery Feta Flank Steak (medium). A table in front of us came in about 15 minutes after us and they got their food first. That table had a different server. When our food was brought out, we good the kids meals and the steak (well done). We asked for ketchup from the person that brought our food out and waited, after we asked 2nd person for ketchup and waited, then we asked our server, and the ketchup was brought out. My partner was hungry so he started eating the over done steak. About 15 minutes later the salad was brought  out and a few minutes later the mashed potatoes and asparagus. The mashed potatoes and asparagus were cold not warm but completely cold. We told our server who took them back and later we got lukewarm potatoes and asparagus. We didn’t send them back because there was no point the kitchen either had something against us or the server. I hated our first experience dining out.
Love the big patio here for outdoor dining. Cocktails are amazing. Service was great and food was delicious as always. I love this spot!

We really enjoyed being able to visit and enjoy the wonderful foods Opa has always offered. The servers were friendly but it just felt like they were barely keeping up with the crowd. No complaints....just felt bad that it seemed like they didn't have enough staff.
Birthday celebration
Family Easter brunch!
Ops is good...food is tasty...a bit expensive but atmosphere is good ..
We had a lovely evening sitting outside. The service was great, and the food was excellent!
We had a lovely Sunday lunch on the patio. I order the salmon with the potatoes which was quite delicious. The waiter was so attentive, replenishing our ice tea when needed.
18th wedding anniversary
Appreciated the large patio area available for dining. Service was outstanding (Jose?); food was delicious!
Great place to have a romantic dinner or family night out
It was very good food & nice sitting outside. My fries could have come out a little warmer.
Enjoyed the service and outdoor seating.  Food (meat loaf and salad) extremely salty.
The services was amazing and the food was the best!
Quality of food not the same as before.  Experience was not that great as well.  Was talking to my friends and they agreed
The best sangria around, with the addition of the little Grand Marnier bottle that can be ordered with it!  We had the calamari platter and the sliders, which were both outstanding!
The food was good, the red Sangria is the best! Good service and outdoor seating was very pleasant.

It’s hard to say it was everyday dining during Covid, but I was with my wife eating out so it was nice.  We had a nice outside table with a heater and sunshine.
I had a beer with a cup of lemon soup.  Also a Pita sandwich with fries. My wife had a flat bread.  Food was delicious,  service excellent and we enjoyed our afternoon.
We love Opa and appreciate being able to dine outside during the pandemic. The food and service were perfect.
Great outdoor dining experience!

Opa! is always a go to for a family night out, girls' night out or even a work lunch (when we could lunch together as a large group).  The food is consistently delicious, and the sangria is huge and tasty!  Definitely recommend it.

First of all, they had no record of our reservation. And insisted we were the ones who were wrong after we showed them the open table confirmation and everything. So they seated us on the street with no heater when other tables had multiple. We asked and asked for one but they had zero interest in being kind to us. We are nice people and tried to roll with it but it was quite disappointing. It’s always been one of our favorite places (we’ve done grad parties and celebrated many special occasions at Opa!). I guess it just wasn’t a good evening for us this go around. Extremely sad for our first night out in a very very long time.

Celebrated Valentine’s Day. We decided to go casual instead of a fancy sit down place. We were surprised how nice it was to relax. We prefer this location to the willow glen one. There’s more outside seating at this Campbell location.
Outdoor dining experience was great!  Serve was fast and food and drinks were perfect

The only nice part of the meal was the food.  The service was very poor.  They sat us in the outdoor seating area they had set up in the street and basically forgot about us.  We finally got a drink order and ordered food at the same time.  They never cleared our appetizer dish from the table, we never were asked if we wanted refills or a new drink.  Once we finished with dinner, we had to wait 25 min for someone to come over to deliver our bill.  During the course of the dinner, we also had an issue with two drunk guys on the patio.  They were technically sitting on the patio at Mo's (they share the same patio as Opa), but they were extremely drunk, loud, obnoxious and cursing very loud.  I asked two people who worked at Opa if they could ask them to leave or ask Mo's to help with the situation, but we were told they couldn't do anything about it.  We were not the only people asking them to help.  There were other tables with small kids that got up and left mid-dinner because they were cursing and being a bad example of how to act.  Downtown Campbell has gone downhill and clearly no one is doing anything about it.  It's a shame that the family environment is no longer something you can look forward to do there.  I will no longer go to dinner at Opa Campbell for this reason.  It's a shame because I love the food, but it's not worth it.
chicken skewer got me sick, ate 1/2 of one skewer. everything else was delicious.
That was the grossest meal I’ve had in a long while
Beautiful outdoor setting and the food was terrific with amazing dessert!
It was delicious! Excellent customer service. They maintained distance and people only took mask off to drink or eat.
Opa is my go-to restaurant when I want to have a nice time!
Best Greek food!! Love coming here .
Everything was delicious. Can't wait to go back and try more.
glad they are open and the food was good. Not quite as mama's greek food as I would like, but still very good.
Lots of traffic noise, and random people asking to sing for tips, but they had good service and food was good.
Great experience to dine outdoors and watch people passing by.  Majority of them wore masks.  Enjoyed the evening, the food and service.  Would go again.

From the first interaction at check in the staff were rude, and confrontational. I had booked a table and was told “we called you and you didn’t answer”, surprised I checked my phone and showed the gentleman that I did not receive a call. I asked which number they called and he could not confirm a number. I was then told that as all my party had not arrived I could not be seated, I politely mentioned that I had booked a table and would like to be seated to await my party and order a glass of wine. After threats of having to bring out the manager, which I was fine with, I was seated. Our server was polite and courteous until we tried to spilt the bill 5 ways. We were told “only 3 cards”. Considering such a difficult time during Covid, I would have expected to have our business welcomed. We will not be returning.
The Mousaka was good with a very tasty sauce. Friends had Lemon chicken with Orzo, which they liked. The staff was very aware to be safe; stricter COVID rules than So. Cal. Service was very good.

I went here with my girlfriends to celebrate some of their birthday's.  The food and service was excellent. They had all the rules and regulations for COVID and were very accommodating. I would highly recommend!!

The server did not wipe the table 
We were seated immediately after the previous customer left .
During this pandemic people should wipe and clean the table after each customer
Honored our reservation right away. Covered our table with a umbrella from the sun. Even moved it later when they noticed sun on my back. Yummy food. Quick service.

Great place for every occasion!
Especially birthdays!
Good food.  Outdoor dining.  Good weather.  What more could you ask?
Great! Always a great place to go
Awful experience. Management is awful. No one came to my table for 25 mins upon seating. Food was cold and like it was left out for hours. Didn't comp us anything.
The food was delicious and our waiter was excellent!
Birthday with friends
Food was delicious, atmosphere great.  Outdoor dining was perfec lt, and socially distanced.  Good job Opa!

Not very good.  Seated at 7:30 for 7:00pm resies.  Food cold.  Cold on patio, server was not allowed to move space heaters, nor was he willing to move us to another table. Would not honor $50 OT reward gift card. Manager/owner sitting in the office not being helpful.
Excellent outdoor seating and fast service.

Dinner on a recent Friday evening.  The food was great, very authentic.  Service was excellent.  The restaurant was doing all they could to keep the diners safe, with QR code menus and clearly marked social distancing between tables.  Sadly, a group of 6 women came in and sat at the table next to us, with only one woman wearing a mask. but since it was outdoors, we felt reasonably safe.

I was not happy with service and food. Server took like 10mins after I was seated to take my drink order. The beef skewer was not cooked they way I wanted and rice was very greasy 
I’ve been to Opa many many times any the service and food was not that bad 
Don’t know if we are going back.
We feel the value isn't great, it's too expensive for what you get.

Not a good experience. Limited bar and the appetizers we’re not good. We made another resturant reservation while having ice tea and ate a few bits of two appetizers. We realized we could not have dinner there as things were not good so we paid our bill and walk down the street to a nice meal. We did feel bad about the server as she seemed very nice but totally untrained by management.
Very nice experience
We had a very nice time. Being able to eat outside was a plus and the food was delicious. It was our son's birthday and he enjoyed it very much.
Great that they’ve done away with handling menus. Taking covid seriously. Food was good. Arrived timely. We were well attended to as well. Overall, very good experience
Aside from a snafu on the reservation, everything was fine
Celebrated many birthdays here! Awesome all around.
It’s a good night out. An enjoyable evening outdoors with good Opa’s food.
Love this place always! Good food. Good service.
Great place. We've celebrated there our anniversary. Everything was super!
Good food, good & friendly service.  Outdoor reservable seating! :-)
We really like this place, great food and service.

Outdoor dining at Opa was fantastic! The food was very good, portions are just enough. Drinks were delicious, I had the Greek mule and my friend had a Mont mojito. 
The souvlaki are my favorite with any of the meat choices. 
I would come here for get togetherness, dates, special occasions, etc. we felt safe while dining and everything was sanitary before we sat down.

The evening we ate there the heaters weren't working so it was a little cooler than 2 of my party would have liked. There was also extra noise from Police helicopters who we found out later were dealing with a shooting locally so the noise level would normally be fine I'm sure and I suspect the heaters will be fixed in the near future. Everything else was perfect, attentive staff, tasty well prepared food and a selection of Draft beer not shown on the menu but very welcome.
Food and service were good but the portion of my Gyro meat was on the small side for the price.

Been here 3 times since they opened up patio seating during Covid.Great food, socially distant tables , excellent Sangria.
What is not to like?
As excellent as ever. Brought a friend and she was impressed.
Very good, lovely outside seating. We were a little disappointed that brunch was not offered Saturday at noon, however food was very nicely presented and tasty.
We love the food and the patio. We love Campbell

We enjoyed our Family Birthday Dinner.  They sat us in a space which was away from other dinner's, which was nice to see and they had us take a picture of the menu with our phones, which loaded the menu app.  Once we were seated we realized that the sun was going to be a problem and they took care of that once they where able to use another umbrella from another table.  That was really nice and the service was great!!!!!!

Had a great dinner at Opas. Staff was constantly cleaning up and checking on us. Tables were distanced and everyone was adhering to the rules. 
Thank you to all the employees for taking such good care of their guests.
I showed up for my reservation but they had closed already. Call to confirm hours before booking through OpenTable
Had a wonderful dinner outside during this pandemic time.Servers were very careful serving,wore masks, tables are quite a distance from other diners.Food was wonderful. A lovely evening out.

I don't know what else to say in addition to all the five-stars.  Opa does not fail to deliver quality and delicious, authentic Greek cuisine, every time. Who could ask for more? My husband and I will keep on coming back to dine in this fine establishment.

Met up with a couple of coworkers for late lunch/early dinner.  Outdoor dining only. No happy hour at the moment.  I’m sure once COVID dies down, happy hour will be available again. Food, service and drinks were good. Most of the tables had shade but staff always try and accommodate to make sure you don’t get burnt! Would come back here again!

We made reservations but had to wait over 50 minutes outside for a table. The food was great and just as I remember it. But, it also took too long for our orders to be taken.
