We went to Opa! for our anniversary during COVID-19 and they were set up well with outside-only seating.  Staff were attentive and the food, as always, was fantastic!
The waitress brought the dessert menus and asked if wanted to go boxes while we were in the middle of eating our meals.

We arrived early and even so the waitstaff we extremely accommodating.  Our server was outstanding, so nice!  It was a great Father’s Day and we will definitely be back soon.

PS...the basil martini was delicious!
Father’s Day

Have to say I was disappointed by the level of precautions that were taken. One of the servers who came to our table didn’t have their nose covered. We waited to be seated but the table hadn’t been cleaned. And it looked like the paper menus had been used before. It didn’t seem like proper cleaning precautions were being taken and it made me very uncomfortable with the dining experience.
Father’s Day finner

I like the location on a corner in downtown Campbell. There is a good amount of outdoor tables with many umbrellas to shade the tables. We had a newer waiter but he did well and he had an overseer who would check In with him. We had a pleasant 2 hour lunch visit and didnt feel rushed. Both our meals were excellent.
Good service and nice place for light summer fare.

I am so glad that they have opened for outdoor dining. I hope if you go, you are safe, wear a mask (when applicable), bring hand sanitizer, etc. This place is awesome and we all need to do our part so they all don't get shutdown again.
Great to go back to the restaurant and opa is good.
Awesome first dine out during COVID

Our first meal out since March. We loved the experience. Food was delicious. Presentation was enticing. Service was very quick and responsive. Opa was a good choice for our first night out in a long time.
The servers were nice and attentive. It was really off putting that they stood so far away as if they were scared of us. Did we look contagious?

Not ready for Covid dining. Customers were not wearing masks. Menus were dirty. Our reserved table had no umbrella in 87 degree temps. Our waiter appeared inebriated and messed up our order. Everything took forever. They were very  understaffed. 

We have been fans of Opa , but they should not open if they are not ready. We would like them to succeed  but not at the expense of making their customers or staff sick. Covid is serious. Sadly, we were wrong to go out so soon.

So happy that I'm able to sit out side and have a great dining experience! 

Today is one my best friends birthday but we celebrated last night at her favorite restaurant OPA!

We made reservations and upon check in they had our table ready for us in a shaded location per my request! 

Our waitress was amazing, her name was Socorro! I asked that she kept the lemon drop shots coming since we were out to celebrate  

Every single item we order was prepared correctly and brought out in the requested order!

Opa is a great place for drinks and appetizers or a full dining experience, it's a definite must have in the South Bay! 

Please try not to salivate as you view my attached pictures, lol...
the restaurant doesn't take Covid Seriously if that is any concern of your family.
Sun in my eyes. Need more umbrellas. 25 min for waiter to take our order. Nice waiter though, I felt sorry for him.
Fun greek restuant in downtown Campbell. Good for families.
Food is great; just too noisy. Cznt have a dinner conversation.
Great service and food!

LOVED the girl who waited on us....a beautiful smile, cheerful, attentive, and accommodating. Unfortunately, I don't remember her name. However, my husband asked if she is Greek and she answered that she is Persian. She was wonderful, as was the food. Great birthday dinner for me!
The food was delicious and our server was great. I’ve been to other Opa locations but Campbell is the best.
wrong food served. Noise level is extremely high, very bad caustic.

I had lemon chicken ,  it was not well cooked ,  ended up not eating .  However the entire experience including services are great .    I could have given it 5 stars if not for the way my plate was cooked ( especially for chicken ) dish .

Get some blinds so your customers aren't fighting the sun beating through the window. I would expect a large catered team to receive better service for meal that was planned well a month out. Service was mediocre.
Great food and nice atmosphere. Staff was friendly
The food and the service was as amazing.
Went here for my son's 19 birthday, party of 12. Opa was very accommodating, great service, food was great.

What a fun evening! We happened to be seated outside when the Zombie Thriller Walk came by! It was sooo fun! Food and service were great too! I love this Opa! It’s so much better than the other Opa restaurants in the area!

We had a large party (10 people) reservation for 5pm. Not only were they able to accommodate us on the patio, but they were able to have our table ready for seating 10 minutes early, even though our entire party had not arrived. They were wonderful!
Party of 20, all went well!

I used to go to this Opa at least four to five times a year with my coworkers. I thought it was the perfect place for groups. The last time I was here was in October 2016 and it sure has changed since then. Tonight we went with some family that was visiting from Sweden and I was so embarrassed that I decided to take them to Opa. My toddler ordered a lemonade and for some reason I decided to taste it before giving it to her and I’m so glad I did— it tasted the way I would imagine sewer water to taste.  I ended up not giving it to her. 

We ordered calamari as an appetizer and it was terrible.  The pieces were chewy and tough and the batter was dark, which is typically a sign of using old oil. We ordered two other appetizers, and although I understand everything cannot be brought out all at once, each appetizer not only came out separately, but we were able to finish the plate and even have a bit of an intermission before the next appetizer was brought out. There was such a gap in between those orders that even our server took away our appetizer plates before we were served with the last of the three appetizers. 

As for entrees...  I always order the lamb souvlaki and tonight’s order was such a disappointment. It had no flavor and was served practically cold.  The service was mediocre and to be completely honest, I’ve been there with picky groups that some may say were difficult to deal with and had better service from Opa, but then again that was almost three years ago. Next time I’m in the mood for Greek food, I’ll gladly make the drive to Palo Alto where there are many great options.
Great food! Wonderful service by a very attentive server for our large group.  Also appreciated that our table was ready to go before we arrived!
We had 11 people in our group for lunch. The service was great and the food delicious. They even accommodated our need for separate checks. We'll be back!
Very good service & food.

Excellent food, paired with the worst service I have experienced in the past 20+ years. The service was inattentive and extremely slow, the soups arrived well after the main courses and were cold, same for the flat bed pizza which also arrived cold,  just to name a few issues. After all the problems we were overcharged by the waitress.

Beautiful day to have lunch on the patio at Opa!  We had a party of 7 and all of the food came out hot at the same time.  Large party was no problem for the wait staff.  Just a good meal all the way around.

I would only recommend Opa! to small groups and for sitting outside or at the bar. Our services was slow and our food wasn't warm when we did get it. It was also way too loud for any of us to hear more than a person away. A real shame since I've always enjoyed going here in small groups of 2 or 4.
Our daughters birthday
Great group dinner. Attentive and friendly service, great food!!
Poor service. Our waiter was absent most of the time we were there and here it was my dad‘s 95th birthday celebration. Food was good but lack of service was sad!
My daughters birthday

Service was really slow. We made reservations and still had to wait 15 minutes. Then when we were sat no one came to get our drink order for 20 minutes then didnt come back to take a food order for another 20. Although our waiter was nice it was just too slow for my taste. The food was amazing though and I would of course come back!

I like this restaurant and have come many times with friends and enjoyed the yummy food. Normally quite loud, we went earlier for a family birthday and had great seating and not so noisy. The service was great, and they accommodated some people coming late. Yummy food and great service made our dinner and celebration extra special.
Thanks so much!
We had a good meal for 12. We were celebrating our wives birthday. The service was great and the food great as well.

I was glad to have doing a restaurant that I could book a reservation for 11 people at the last minute. But when we got there our table was not ready. We had to wait almost an hour before being seated. I understand that things happen and diners you expected the be there for 45 minutes stayed for 90 minutes. But this kind of thing seems to be happening more and more when I go out. I was impressed by their offer to provide some wine and sides for free. And they let me choose their most expensive wine on the list. But after all that, to service was still just mediocre. I didn't feel like we were given proper attention during out meal at all. That being said, the food was pretty good. OPA! usually has several entrees and sides that delight. I just hope that their service gets better.

We went here for lunch with our team to celebrate a colleague's vow ceremony and we all had a delightful time! The service was friendly and prompt, the food was divine and we each had leftovers, the ambiance was bustling, which made it a bit noisy, but not enough that we had to shout at one another. We will most certainly go back!
Great food and ambience

name: Porta Blu
description: Porta Blu is open with a full menu for indoor and outdoor dining and take-out, offering southern coastal European cuisine while drawing inspiration from California produce. Porta Blu's bar features innovative seasonal cocktails and a well-curated local beer and wine program.  Enjoy the ingredients focused menu from the outdoor dining patio or in the vibrant atmosphere of the backyard garden and activity lawn.
hours:
Breakfast
Daily 6:30 am–11:00 am
Lunch
Daily 11:00 am–2:00 pm
Bar
Daily 3:00 pm–11:00 pm
Dinner
Daily 4:00 pm–10:00 pm

reviews.text: Porta Blu is a beautiful restaurant with excellent food. My friend and I visited for the Passport dinners with wine pairing, and everything was perfect, starting from the entrance. I especially appreciated the conversation with the chef; I am sure he is a future star of our culinary scene. I definetly will be back for another food events.
Great place for meetings or intimate conversations
Porta Blu restaurant at the Hotel NIA was an amazing experience! Great fresh food and service. I highly recommend the jalapeño avocado hunmus and flatbreads!

Outrageous!  My friend and I each had a flat bread.  They were mediocre for $25 and &26. I ordered a glass of the “house” Chardonnay. My friend had an iced tea. Bill came…$95. I asked the server and he said, the 5ounce wine was $20 (what?????), but since I wanted the eight ounce, the price was an additional $9. I have never paid $29 for a glass of wine, not even a premium glass. No more Porta Blu for me!!

We had a great brunch with coffee and something to eat, as well as pastry.

The food was great and fresh. The service was excellent and very welcoming! Congratulations on the servers
Fabulous interior, super friendly service. Filet was under cooked for both of us (and the table next to us we saw) but overall wonderful gem
Greeted with a Valentine’s Day bubbly, a rose, and a photo op—nice dinner!
Ate there on 12/26, and the food, ambiance and service was fantastic. Huge shoutout to Oliver for great service. Food, drinks all of it was great.
The food is excellent. One of the best I've ever tried. The chef personally went to our table to explain to us how he prepared our diner. Excellent service.
They did not have my open table resi or said they did not.   Tried to seat us in the bar with my 90 yo parents for dinner.   Something was off!
Dined here several times over the last few years. Always enjoyable. Great food and great service. Never too crowded. Menu changes are great
Not a fan. Food mediocre. Blaring music from pool competing with music from restaurant.

This was a nice option to celebrate Father’s Day; the restaurant wasn’t busy at all when we arrived and we almost had the patio all to ourselves. The food was very good and was ready quickly. The service was a bit shaky at first; our table wasn’t ready upon our arrival which was strange as we had a reservation and the restaurant was almost empty; it was as if they weren’t expecting us. But once we were seated and after a bit of a spill of my latte at the table, the service got better and we were delighted by a surprise visit by the executive chef who came to see how we were enjoying the meal. That was a very nice touch. Overall good food and a pretty atmosphere.
Very relaxing place ; restaurant has beautiful outdoor area
Birthday dinner. We had a leisurely meal and were never once rushed. Our first cocktails took awhile to be delivered but after that, everything was just as we could have wanted.
It was a pleasure to eat at Porta Blu. and the food was delicious. Our server, Oliver, had such great advice and service. It's quiet and comfortable. Highly recommended.

Empty restaurant, more than 4 waiters, and zero service. We got up from the table and went to the bartender to: 1) order drinks 2) pick up the drinks 3) place a food order. The bartender told us our waiter would be there to take our order- we never met him. No check-ins on how the food was, just... no service. Meanwhile, the waiters all stood staring at the TV's, there were someone's slippers under the bar, my date's order was wrong, etc... it was all bad. The hotel rooms and grounds are beautiful but this restaurant's staff needs a huge refresh on customer service.
Food was excellent.  Service was sporadic & server kept forgetting items.
Very quiet. Limited lunch menu. Worked well for business meeting.

This place has great potential. The ambience is lovely and cozy. The food was delicious except for a couple of minor things, but the service is awful. The staff is super nice, but completely inattentive. 

As for the valet situation, if you stay more than 3 hours, then you must pay $30 which is easy to do - see awful service. I hope they can make some adjustments as this place could easily be a hidden gem.

I may or may not go back, as I am a local (even more reason to make some adjustments) and I would recommend this place with strong caution about the service.
Service was painfully slow. Rather than explain they were busy, they just ignored us.

My husband and I enjoyed dinner here very much. The service was excellent, and the ambiance was very nice. We ordered the aged rib eye with mashed potatoes and the steak frites. Our steaks were cooked to perfection. We shared a Ceasar salad, which was good, though a bit heavy on the lemon in the dressing. In the morning, we enjoyed breakfast and ordered the eggs benedict; the Hollandaise sauce tasted of too much lemon as well. Everything else was fantastic. We will be back for another dinner and breakfast.

The octopus appetizer is really good, the squid ink pasta main dish is good as well. The chili oil was not removed for the first time, but kitchen redid another one without the spicy oil after we tasted it. Sea bass was okay, but slightly over cooked because it’s a bit dry. We wanted to try the tiramisu but it was sold out. We ordered the crunch with mousse, and it’s okay. It would be worthy of the price if it’s made in house. Service is good but can be better for its price, the waiter was attentive.

Service in the bar area was extremely poor.  Waiters were untrained, and did not know the answers to standard questions..

Waiting 15 minutes to be served a simple drink is unacceptable…. Especially when there were only four customers in the entire cocktail lounge, and five waiters/bartender.

I will not return, nor will I recommend it to anyone.

The restaurant was oddly quiet when we entered, and we soon found out why. The service was extraordinarily slow (despite being the only people in the entire restaurant, we waited about an hour and a half for our entrees). The wait staff made constant mistakes from bringing dishes to the wrong person, to repeatedly forgetting one of the people at our table had a dairy allergy. (they forgot to remove the dairy from her appetizer, and from the side salad which they served her as a replacement for the side that came with her dish which had dairy) They seemed confused about which things on the menu had dairy, and the menu also had several things labeled gluten free which we were then told were actually not gluten free. If you have a food allergy, I would HIGHLY recommend staying away. We did not feel safe here. To top things off, they completely forgot to put in the order for my entree. They offered to make it, but at that point we had already been waiting for the other entrees and apps for about two hours, so we decided to leave. Most of the food was alright, but nothing stood out, and it certainly wasn’t worth the price point of the restaurant. The one exception to the food being alright was the deviled eggs which tasted nearly inedible. The whole thing seemed like a massive failure of management. Whoever is responsible for running this restaurant needs to ensure the experience is significantly improved.

I'm pained to write this review. This restaurant was a favorite before the Pandemic. Employee shortages are common now, and only one woman ran the entire front... Cafe, serving and hosting. She started strong by speaking with the kitchen about my food allergies and taking my guest's order when she arrived. The food was good. Then she completely disappeared. No one cleared our plates. Ever. We had to ask someone to send her over for dessert menus. She said the kitchen was closed. Seriously? It was my friend's birthday, and I added that to the reservation. So, she agreed to coffee and Gelato. The coffee came and the Gelato did not. We had to ask again to send her back with the check. She didn't charge for the coffee or gelato, and after another long while, we received the check.

Then, the valet charged me $32 because the 2-hour free parking expired. No negotiation. So, 1 Pellegrino, 2 coffees, a burger and a chicken sandwich cost $94. Oh, and my guest paid $15 to park in the garage. Grand total $109. Ugh.

While a few apps were quite tasty and excellently prepared (kudos on the burrata), the flatbread disappointed. Flabby, tasteless dough and watery, flavorless sauce. A glob of cheese over cold meat. We were disappointed, too, in the “winter squash” option. First, the delicate squash was cold and nearly raw (who serves chunks of raw squash?), and instead of pomegranate molasses, it has a few pomegranate seeds. When I wondered if they would cook the squash a bit longer, I was told that was how they served it. We’d wanted the deviled eggs, but they were out.

The food was fantastic but service was quite poor.  We had to flag down a waiter for help to order drinks, order food, clean table (twice) and each time if we wanted water.  We really love the food and decor but hard to recommend with such poor service.  There were only 3 tables on a Friday night and the waiter and busboy walked around but never engaged unless asked.
Interesting menu, great service, but overpriced wines.
The setting is nice with the outdoor area and the games on the lawn. The food was pretty bland and over priced. I would not eat here again.
High delays service;  no one knows how to service wine bottle to customers; food was ok though nothing special
Service was a bit slow for a Sunday night

Love this restaurant. I've been coming here since they opened a few years ago. The new chef is creative, and the menu is exciting! They managed my food allergies very well, except I think the grill had pepper on it and the broccoli picked it up. Luckily, it wasn't enough to trigger a huge reaction. The fish was definitely overcooked. So, everything tasted good, but it wasn't perfect like I usually expect from this restaurant. That said, I'll definitely be back.

The food was okay, although it was almost cold.  We just ordered small plates and everything came at once.   Valet parking was an issue.  You are allowed 2-1/2 hours for parking.  It took a few minutes to get our bill paid, and by the time I was outside, I had exceeded the time limit and was told I would need to pay the $30 fee. Happily the Valet supervisor was there and she dismissed the charge.  We spend $200 for a few drinks, a few small plates and tip.  Pretty expensive.
Hotel restaurant, easy place to eat. Hotel looks great. Service was inattentive, prices were stupid for what was delivered. Limited menu, crab pasta had no crab. Buttered noodles

The ambience for a Friday night double date was great but the food and drinks was sub par and questionable. I ordered niçoise salad. It was Roman lettuce with dressing drizzled over. That’s it. There was nothing about this salad that made it niçoise or justified it costing $32. The menu shows NIÇOISE SALAD
soft egg, haricot verts, seared tuna, none of these toppings were on the salad.  We also ordered the steak STEAK TARTARE—tasted ok but we noticed that some parts of the raw meat was brown, that doesn’t seem right for fresh uncooked beef. I wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for decent dining. Maybe happy hour is a better.
Very comfortable outdoor setting.  Small but nice menu
food was cold.

Cocktail glasses and menus weren’t cleared, food was late, staff were rushing around. Doors to the outside were left open  as waiters served outdoor diners creating a draft and lower temperature in the dining room.
EJ was a very well trained, attentive server. manager Neftal was on the ball. Great experience.
Great ambiance and quality food! A good experience overall.

Very lackluster garlic fries that were madly overpriced and also cold and boring bear tart dessert that was also very overpriced for tasting like nothing more than a local coffee shop breakfast treat. Overall felt a waste to pay >$30 for fries and a small tart. I could get a full dinner elsewhere for that.
Convenient location; excellent decor; great venue
The manager there is incredible. Fantastic experience every time.

We were three of probably ten persons dining that night and got lots of attention from the staff. We started in the bar with some cocktails prepared by a very friendly bar tender who also became our server for dinner. We started with a hummus platter which except for carrots had some very interesting radishes, fennel and jicama to accompany it. My companions had the salmon and one started with a salad. I went for the Steak Frites, but the menu had changed to a steak with mushrooms in a nice wine reduction. It was rare as I ordered and tasted great. We shared a bottle of Oberon Merlot which was excellent. My companions ordered a chocolate desert, a lemon drop martini and a chocolate martini as well. Service was fabulous and we enjoyed conversations with the staff. A really nice evening.
The chicken was dry    They offered another choice but we declined the offer. They subsequently removed the cost.
Very quiet place to have a Thanksgiving dinner.
Really cool ambiance, but the food was way too salty. Service was also slow. Didn't seem like they were fully on top of things despite the restaurant being pretty empty.
Service was excellent. Food was delicious and a great value. Really enjoyed the outdoor garden ambiance.
Service was terrible. It took a really long time to get seated and once seated to order drinks. I am guessing they were understaffed but I will not go back there.
Dinner was great. Service was good, food was delicious. The only disappointment was when I asked for a dessert menu, I was told the kitchen was closed. I understand y’all close at 8.
Lousy food and even worse service. Nice setting but ruined by everything else... stay away.

We were staying at Hotel Nia and had eaten here before. There were very few patrons so the noise level was low. Our server was very nice and efficient. It was an anniversary so they gave us a glass of champagne. My wife had the chicken and I had the New York steak. Both dishes were seasoned exceptionally well and the steak was rare just as I ordered it. We shared a bottle of Flora Springs Merlot.
Very limited menu and food was disappointing- used to be quite good pre-Covid.  Beautiful place and good service. Hoping they will pick it up in the future.
Great service! We recognize it's difficult to function during the pandemic but our server did a wonderful job given the circumstances.

Good food and cocktails despite limited menu, friendly gracious service, and just being out are such a relief after months of lockdown! Plenty of space between tables, good protocols = Covid safe. The decor is exceptional at any time.

We very disappointed from the level of food, the lack of drinks in the bar (ask for martinis, received margaritas), the lack of quality wine (had only two bottles of white - very basic ones) and the service was not good to say the least. 

Very unfortunate experience
Even though the menu is limited, Porta Blú is doing a good job with the limitations brought by COVID.

The waiter kept ignoring my friend.  She ordered her steak medium rare and it came medium well.  When I wanted some sauce, he ignored me.
Other than that, the evening was pleasant.

The food was not good. The cheese pizza dough was soggy and the tomato sauce obviously from a can. 
Since the restaurant is inside the hotel- social distancing was not being observed at all in the hotel pool and other areas- there was a party with about 30-40 people happening- no one wearing masks, the pool had about 30 people in the area, including a dog- no masks. Very disappointing experience.
This is a hotel restaurant and the food is what you’d expect from room service. To be fair during COVID the menu was reduced and there was no one in the restaurant so hard to judge.

The parking is not clear and the signs have you end up on a tall parking structure where you pay something like $10 and hour. They validate partially for valet parking but that is without validation $25 flat tatey

Two rounds of FAB appetizers. The rib eye serves 4 people. The desserts are lacking. 

But hidden gem

The food was excellent however there was a mistake with a cocktail I ordered. I ordered a lemon drop which I think was expensive at $19 so they should gave gotten it right. Please imagine my shock and disgust as I take a sip of a drink that should have been sweet and rimmed with sugar but it was mistakingly rimmed with salt. At $19 a drink the bartender should not make that kind of mistake. Also, the acoustics are very poor inside the restaurant. Being barely half full it was extremely loud and hard to hear my partner from just across a small table.

Great food and great hotel but the most horrible chairs. Your choice is a great dinner in miserable chairs or sit comfortably elsewhere. I am tall but felt I was sitting low in a kindergarten chair. So also my other guest
Our go to spot for business dinners!

This was a wonderful experience. Great service, great food. Thanks for the complimentary birthday dessert!
Bravo!

We have never been disappointed coming here for dinner!  Our absolutely favorite item is the shrimp scampi in the sourdough bowl.  As an appetizer, two of us completely de-construct the entire thing, sopping up the last of the sauce with the last of the bread!  I understand the menu is changing in January.  We hope this item isn't removed.  Porta Blu (in the Hotel Nia) is a beautiful venue... take the time to walk around the outdoor courtyard and enjoy all the incredible design details throughout the building.  Food is wonderful.  Service is superb.
Food was too salty. Sent back and returned as salty. Eggs benedict too overdone.
The food was much too spicy. Only one item on the menu (chicken) was seasoned normally . Everything else was full of chilies.
Very dry burger. Will not come back

It is a lovely location  and the service was superb, but the food fell short.  The soup was almost I edible salty, the fries were delicious but had a dangerously high level of salt.  The burger was disappointingly overdone.  No return in our near future.
beautiful and easy to talk and visit.  too bad you are always out of candy.

We had a late dinner (9 PM) after a meeting. The restaurant is very eclectic in decoration and use of space, interesting views in all directions and some fun decor. We opted for a meal of small plates: tomato basil soup, rich but not heavy, scampi in a lemon cream sauce served in a bread bowl, a garlic flatbread - more like a pizza with arugula on top, you squeeze roasted garlic out o bulb to put on top, and ahi poke which had a delicious sweet soy sauce on it. We had a little too much bread in our choices, but there are lots of other choices. The staff was great very polite and friendly. My one disappointment was the wine prices which seemed a bit high. We did enjoy a bottle of Imagery Pinot Noir which was light and paired well with all our choices. Small plates were well priced we thought.
The food is very good - just not extra special. But the ambience and the service is why I would come back here.

I’d like a little more variety in the menu for main plates, but there was a great selection of small plates/appetizers. The Thai chicken wings were great,  crispy and flavorful.  We also really liked the scampi in the sourdough bowl, great way to enjoy the extra sauce.

Come here quite a bit for business. Appetizers are always a big hit. Farm to table menu is seasonal. Some of our favorite staples are the avocado hummus, flatbread, and garlic fries. Bar has a fun vibe and bartenders are always attentive.
Good food, excellent service and great lunch ... easy to have a good conversation. Fun sharing food.

My husband and I had a lovely lunch here. We shared the cheese plate and a strawberry salad. We also had coffee drinks which were great. We sat outside and it was really peaceful and a pretty environment. I’d love to return for dinner and brunch sometime. The grounds are really nice. It’s a great spot & a real gem.

The only negative was not getting our parking validated. With the $$ money spent on dinner a $25 parking fee was outrageous. The waitress told us only valet parking was validated. Seems inconsiderate for those who parked their own cars.

It was not clear where we should park because they only had Valet parking so we parked in a garage next to the hotel thinking it belonged to the hotel because it didn’t say anything on the facade.  It turned out to be Facebook’s parking lot and we ended up spending $20 for parking when we could have gotten 2 hours free if we had valeted the car.  It wasn’t clear what the best option was and for that reason I would not recommend going to this restaurant and getting caught having to pay $20 for parking.  We were there for three hours and 3 minutes and the extra 3 minutes cost us another $5.00.  The hotel itself did not have a parking lot that we could use without using the valet and we didn’t know that at the time.  Very disappointing.  The restaurant and the food were very nice, but not outstanding in any way.  The drinks were extremely expensive - not worth the price.
Love this place, close to my office and the ambiance is great. They were Very accommodating as our group had grown.  A bit pricy but with it.

My friends and  I enjoyed the ambiance, the service and it was so nice of the manager to stop by and say hello.  We all enjoyed meeting him.  My only disappointment was my entree, the lamb shank.  I asked if the meat fell off the bone which is how lamb shank should b served.  It did not and there was no lamb flavor to the meat.  The meat had no flavor at all.  I brought what was left of the shank home but when I opened it in the light, it was all fat.  I tasted it again but again, there was no flavor to the meat.
I will come back and hope the next entree I order will not be disappointing.
Great cuisine. Parking is challenging.

This restaurant features Mediterranean Cuisine, although it is clearly someone’s “take” on Mediterranean food.  
Nothing authentic.  The food lacks the simplicity and purity of ingredients that Mediterranean food is prized for.
We ordered the waiter’s recommendation for our appetizer, supposedly their most popular, the baked buratta.  The buratta was drowned in so much carmelized onion, bacon, and balsamic vinegar, that they might as well have used American cheese.  The buratta, was ruined.  The menu is limited, the portions small and the combinations weird.
Not rushing back.
It was pretty expensive for the quality of food. Wine list especially pricey. Setting is lovely.

Great experience, restaurant is very inviting, food was artfully plated and cooked perfectly. Ordered the burrata and the shrimp starter to share, both very flavorful. Then the black cod and trout sandwich for mains, great portions, flavors and textures. All very good, we will be back.
Father’s Day
We had reservations for Sunday brunch at 10:30, but they had a large group and could not even think about seating us until at least 11 a.m. Why take a reservation at 10:30 then?

Good appetizers, disappointing entrees. Bucatini were bland and, at the same time, with too much lemon taste. The cod was well cooked,  but was missing salt and flavor. Dessert good but not noteworthy.
Great place for drinks. Ambiance was great but food left a little something to be desired for the price

Service was great, not very crowded.  We both wanted the lamb but we were told it was sold out so I opted for the bucatini pasta which was a dry with little flavor, a bit disappointing . My significant other ended up ordering the steak which he said was very good; I had a taste and it was very flavorful, cooked perfectly. He also ordered the "marbled potatoes" which was a waste…just some baby potatoes with a little oil for sauce but no real flavor, could not taste romesco or cilantro. That said, we will definitely go back and try Porta Blu again!

I find that hotel restaurants are a bit of a gamble, and I've found that to be the case on what are now three occasions I've been here.  Hotel, restaurant and grounds are beautiful, and the food is good, which makes up for some of the "amateur"-feeling way the restaurant seems to be run.  Several bumps during our most recent visit (e.g. not bringing our salads/soups until they brought our entrees; the server not bringing me a credit card slip even though my credit card was on the tray, but instead let me inadvertently sign for it thinking I was a hotel guest and needing to circle back with me after the fact to resolve my tab).  

The menu and ambiance are enough to get me to keep trying them, but perhaps with just some moderated expectations.
Bad food. Everything was overpriced. Would not go back there again.

Food and Ambiance was wonderful. My only constructive comment, is right after we were seated the server asked for my credit card, which was a bit off putting. I felt like there was a question, I was a risk of not paying the bill. I would have preferred them asking for my credit card at the time I made the reservations not when I just sat down at the table. In addition the server wasn’t very attentive. Although the person pouring water was on top of it. To me service is as important as the food, especially on a special occasion like Mother’s Day.

Service was a bit slow. The food and cocktails were good, but a larger selection of mains or specials would have been great. If their menu doesn’t change, I might have have to get the same thing next time I happen to visit , which isn’t ideal.
New addition to Silicon Valley. Indoor and outdoor seating outs. Great vibe for work HH and drinks/dinner.

The ribeye steak was one of the most flavorful and tender steaks I have had at a restaurant and was a rather large steak, too! The service was great, our iced tea has ice cubes made from tea, and the honey shrimp as an appetizer was great!

We were excited to try Porta Blue for my husband's birthday.  The restaurant itself is beatifully appointed and has a mix modern/traditional Mediterranean decor.  Menu selections we're limited.  No specials.  As a starter, I ordered the Butternut squash soup which was lukewarm, lacked complexity and the overall flavor was bland.  For entrees, our party of six tried the ribeye which was fine but not fantastic, the lamb shank was dry, chicken was good but the accompanied arugula and veggies we're so salty they were inedible.  Mushroom ravioli was cold.  Food was mediocre at best.  Sadly, I don't see us coming back.
Delicious but expensive

I met a friend for a birthday lunch. The food and service were excellent. Complementary valet parking was a plus. The ambiance is OK; decor is ecclectic with rugs and doors (!) hanging from the high ceiling. Prices were higher than I'd spend for an average lunch out but not for a special one. It was extremely quiet but then there was a very light lunch crowd.

The food was awesome! I wanted my guests from Colorado to experience California cuisine. They were very impressed with the quality of the food and service. The chef came out to greet us and make sure everything was good.
Oyster appetizer was tasty. Chocolate mousse was too dense. Waiter was personable and attentive.

Valentine’s Day was a gastronomic delight. From creative cocktails from Jose the bartender to an amazing five course dinner from sous chef Luc Elzayek. This is a local gem that we feel lucky to have found.

We really liked the atmosphere and the bar scene looked good. The food is good, the menu rather limited yet includes, meat, fish, poultry and vegetarian offerings. The 1/2 chicken was very good, worth a repeat visit. The service was slow, it took over 20 minutes to get our drinks, it could be that a larger party our server attended to may have impacted our service. We will definitely give it another go.

My husband and I were treated extremely well by the staff and managers.  We are foodies and found the service and quality of cuisine outstanding.  The menu is seasonal and the hand crafted cocktails are very creative.  This was a treat and we will be coming back for our anniversary and other date nights.

Server, while very friendly and nice, was unable to be timely with anything.  Asked for an additional piece of bread as our appetizer order (for 3 people) came with 2 pieces....received with dinner entrees.  Asked for butter since they couldn't make the mashed potatoes without garlic....arrived 3/4 of the way through dinner and rock solid cold.  Food was fun but nothing special.  Shared Appetizer, main dish & glass of wine came to over $70 per person.
Valet is free and cool/app based.

I took a friend for a birthday lunch.  I had mentioned this to the restaurant ahead of time and they did bring a dessert at the end of the meal, but it showed up as a $10 charge on my ticket.  The waitress forgot to bring the appetizer and brought the entrees instead so we cancelled the appetizers.  The salad accompanying both meals was mostly lettuce with large slices of green apples and little else.  They do  validate the parking with a restaurant meal, but I did not know that and parked in the garage about 1/2 mile down the street.  The parking was $5.  The total meal for 2 with ice tea was $82 for lunch.  Way too much and very little service.

What a disappointment! We knew it would be expensive but wanted to see the new hotel and restaurant. The food and service were extremely mediocre. They were "out of" one of their signature drinks, but put the $18 charge on the bill anyway, instead of the beer that had to be ordered instead. When I realized and called back, the night Manager was very nice and handled the overcharge. Service and drink and food delivery was really slow, and not because the place was busy--it was less than 1/4 full on a Saturday night. The flat bread was not even as good as many you can get from the grocery freezer section. In the Bay Area you've got to be on your best game to open and succeed with a new restaurant. This place needs some major improvements. The best part of the restaurant was the setting and atmosphere.
They need to seriously look at training their staff on their menu and basic customer service. It's a gorgeous place but the cuisine and service ruined it unfortunately.
Great service, lovely patio area and good food. Yummy burgers and salads.
The food was excellent. Our waiter and the wait staff were all very good, attentive but not over bearing.

We enjoyed the dinner overall very much.  Everyone was mostly attentive, pleasant and tried really hard to make the evening nice. 

The bars needs olives for cocktail drinks.  Basic thing....the olives served in the appetizers are too sour for the drinks.  I liked my Cosmo but my friend who is an excellent bar critique said it was way too sour. 

2 cocktails drinks were served and everyone else waited 20 mins after that for theirs drinks, even the tea

We were not asked if we wanted another cocktail for quite a long time and we would have ordered another but it was too late as the entrees were coming so we ordered a bottle a sav blanc which was good and the waiter recommended.  Our wine and tea drinks were not refilled for quite a long time we had to ask.

Bday Dessert was nice. 

The lighting was too dim we had to ask for another table light but that went out shortly after they gave it to us and waiters didn’t notice or replace it.  We were tired of asking for things so gave up.

All the appetizers we had were great especially the crab cakes, mezz and tomato tapenade.

The tomato soup was boring.

Everyone enjoyed the entrees very much.  The chicken, clams, salmon and lamb chops all great.

One of our party did not get his food for 10 mins after we did.  Waiter apologized and did make up for it.

Over all the wait staff really tried to make our dinner nice but it seemed a little inexperienced.  But explained all the dishes very nicely and was trying really hard just needs more experience.

Oh and the music playing in the restaurant was boring hotel background instrumental music.  Need better music.

I think wait staff just needs more experience but they seem to be trying. 

Thank you.
Miguel, Fernando and Jill were all fabulous.  We will be back!
The restaurant looks nice and the food was OK, but the friendly service was definitely inexperienced.  It was relatively expensive, but I will say that the portions were large.
This was our third time dining at Porta Blu.  We really enjoy the food and the atmosphere...a well designed venue!
Great food. Porta Blu is brand new and part of the nia hotel, which is an oasis by itself right on 101. This is a great addition to the down town Menlo Park restaurants.
Service was slow, mistakes were made on the meals and it was very pricey. Will probably not return

Location is nice, close to my office building.  Service today was a little slow even though the restaurant was not full.   One of our lunch entrees was incorrect, so while they brought the correct one, the other person's food was getting cold.
A real find in a beautiful hotel.  I will choose this restaurant when I want to impress my friends with a new place to dine.

Four of us had dinner and all of us enjoyed the food very much. Not only was it delicious but it was presented beautifully. Our waitress and the rest of the wait staff were well trained. 
Our only complaint was the mandatory valet service that had to be done on your phone. It was a pain and not very well organized.

Really great new restaurant and fun new venue in the Palo Alto Menlo park area.  Highly recommend. The service was charming. She as new and everything was excellent. Just some fine tuning is all that is needed. Its a new restaurant after all.  Will put this on the list of go to restaurants.

Food was excellent but service was very slow.  Not sure if it was a staffing issue or just being a new venue and still trying to iron out the wrinkles!  Bar and pool area looked like a fun after work spot. 

Free valet parking for first 3 hours.

The hotel and ambiance is beautiful.  Wonderful experience.  Very high end, thoughtful design.  The food offerings were interesting and very tasty.  But the kitchen needs to ensure that the food comes out at the right temperature.  The soup was delicious but lukewarm.  I sent it back.  The fries were cold so I didn’t bother to eat them.  At this venue this shouldn’t have happened.   Will give it another go.

We only had breakfast here. It is a lovely restaurant with a nice patio but you walk in and hope someone notices you as there is no clear entrance or hostess stand. . Some of the servers, unfortunately not ours were very attentive. We had to ask for syrup, cream, sugar, jam and butter.
We had cold brew coffee one morning it was very good, the next it was very watered down. We asked our server and he couldn’t explain why. My husband went to the coffee bar and asked if they had a different batch which they did...why couldn’t the server have been proactive?
Also, very pricey...$50  for breakfast for 2. $5 iced tea and $19 for an omelet with no sides, luckily we had a breakfast voucher which covered a portion. They must think everyone is on an expense account!

The restaurant is just starting, and there was a limited menu (compared to the menu listed on their web page). The food was okay. The chicken tanginess was good, but not unusual. 

I ordered a martini and the glass arrived half full. "That's the way we serve it," the waitress said. "That's not the way I like it," I replied. She did agree to fill up the glass, which was nice.

We were a party of 10 for dinner.  Our waiter was very nice but service was slow, not that attentive and the food was very mediocre.  The patio was perfect and perfect for our group.  Restaurant needs to work on the quality of their food and the way it's cooked.

Friendly staff and gorgeous, open air restaurant. Unfortunately, the food was poorly executed. The lamb chops were cooked well done. When it was re-fired, it was perfectly medium rare but ridiculously salty. The accompanying lentils and rice was gritty and hard. It was inedible so I ended up having to order pizza for delivery (I was staying in the hotel).

Our cocktails were very good but the food was just ok. The Mezze platter that we shared was nice, not fabulous. We shared a lamb tagine. Meh. The couscous that came with it desperately needed salt and if they had cooked it in chicken broth (even vegetarian chicken broth) it would have had a bit more flavor. 
Our server was very nice and the dining room is quite unique and very pleasant.
I'd go back for a cocktail but would dine elsewhere. I'm afraid the chef needs to perfect his offerings. So sorry.
We were limited to a pricey mother’s day fixed dinner  menu which was not mentioned when we made reservations. Good service. Food was just ok.
Overall was great, loved the ambiance but needs improvement on the food and menu choices.

Although the current construction zone surrounding this hotel makes you think you might need a hardhat, once inside, this place is terrific. I had low expectations - hotel dining and all that, but my priors were all set aside. Lunches came with huge, fresh green salad, done with extraordinary care. But my salmon burger was just simply the best version of this I have ever had -- not chopped with filler, but a whole filet, on terrific sourdough. Husband had the chicken kebab, with excellent pita. The service was over the top. We will be back.

Warning: don't be fooled by the aesthetics of this establishment. I am unsure which element here is worse- the food or the service. I am not sure if any spices were used to marinate the chicken as it was extremely bland. A bowl of white rice has more flavor. Furthermore, the meat selection for the lamb was quite awful. They must have bought it from the sale section at Lucky's supermarket, a store that I would never shop at. While we were eating appetizers, we noticed that compliments of the chef were being brought to a table across the room. We inquired about said compliments of the chef and only then were they offered to us. Having to request the items being offered to select guests as compliments is quite appalling to me and classless. I had hoped this establishment would hold itself to high standards of service and offer quality food. I do not recommend this establishment to anyone.

Excellent service.  very good ambiance and a beautiful and spacious garden.  We love it.  For a party of 2, we ordered cauliflower soup of the day, Feta & spinach pie, Portuguese crab cakes, Grilled chicken Kebab, and Porta Blu burger. All were good except the burger, I ordered medium rare and it turned out medium to medium well and the patty was pretty dry.  I didn't ask for return and only gave my comment to our server after I paid the bill.  He acknowledged it and would deliver my message to the chef to make it better going forward.

Food was a bit hit and miss.   Some dishes were good like Jamon flatbread but the crab cakes were tiny.   Two little quarter size crab cakes for $17!!   And it was a bit too salty.   On to the main dish.   Manila clams w chorizo was excellent.  Chicken kebab was dry and completely under seasoned.   Lamb was good.   Service was attentive but staff lack training - eg She put our leftover brown bag on the table when we are still waiting for dessert.  Appetizer fork was placed in the wrong position relative to main course fork.   Waited a long time for serving spoon when we want our main dishes family style, etc.   last but not least we marked the reservation as a birthday dinner and no one said anything.   Even tho my mother in law was not upset, I was.   We ordered cake as dessert hoping they would at least put a candle on it but nope.   Hotel was beautiful would love to come back for drinks but will think twice for the restaurant.
They are new and have some kinks to work out. I had a Morrocan chicken dish with couscous.  It was plentiful but very dry and thus I didn't eat much of it.  The waitstaff was excellent.

Hotel Nia is part of Marriott’s Autograph collection and Porta Blu is a Meditararean restaurant that has just opened a few weeks ago and we were eager to try it. The ambiance is very modern and open and airy with a seamless flow from inside seating to outside seating. The staff was very courteous and helpful. The menu is small and limited especially for vegetarians. We had the mixed platter and a flat bread pizza for a appetizer and then the vegetarian Tajine for the main entree along with with the 4/5 sides that were on the menu. The vegetarian medley came with a couscous that was very bland. Overall the food was disappointing. Maybe the non veg options are better

Am glad we were one of the first to try this restaurant. Valet parking is available (validated) and entry into the Hotel Nia is fascinating. There is sublte artwork and décor everywhere. We were seated immediately at a table just inside the outer courtyard. Very pleasant and they closed the sliding doors when it go cooler. Peter was our server and was amazing. Very professional and personable. He explained several of the wine/drink choices without being pushy. The Crema Catala was very good and the Kentucky Buck was refreshing. The house salad and daily soup were both exceptional. The lamb tagine was very tasty and my wife couldn't finish her portion. The Steak Frites has a wonderful flavor.
Superb service, fun menu, a few start up problems like serving a beautiful hot entree on a cold plate.

name: Cabana Cove Restaurant & Bar
description: Indulge in a variety of fresh, culturally-inspired cuisine at our on-site eatery, Cabana Cove. Open daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner, the restaurant features indoor and outdoor seating, along with a full-service bar and lounge.
address: 4290 El Camino Real,  Palo Alto, CA 94306
hours:
Breakfast
Mon–Fri 6:00 am–10:00 am
Sat, Sun 7:00 am–11:00 am
Lunch
Mon–Fri 11:00 am–1:00 pm
Sat, Sun 12:00 pm–2:00 pm
Bar
Daily 4:00 pm–10:00 pm
Happy Hour
Daily 4:00 pm–6:00 pm
Dinner
Daily 5:00 pm–10:00 pm

reviews.text: My boyfriend and I went here to celebrate New Year's Eve, and it was a fantastic experience! Sam made us an amazing drink that we absolutely loved. The F&B Manager, Alejandra, was incredibly professional and sweet—she even surprised us with a small discount at the end, which was such a thoughtful gesture. Our server, Michael, was also excellent and provided great service throughout the evening. The live music was out of this world—it truly felt like we were in Hollywood! Overall, it was a magical night, and we can’t wait to visit again!"

We went to Cabana Cove restaurant to celebrate a friend's birthday with a dinner treat. We enjoyed the holiday dinner menu, which offered good value (especially the ceviche) and excellent service. My friend was craving chips and salsa, which weren’t on the menu, but manager Alejandra surprised us by having the chef prepare them for us. And the best part? They didn’t even charge us for it. We ended up having the New York strip and halibut, though we weren’t impressed with the dessert selection. The staff were fantastic and paid extra attention to our needs. We’re from SoCal and will definitely return the next time we’re in town.

I recently stayed at the Cabana Hotel in Palo Alto and had breakfast at their Canaba Cove restaurant. I ordered the egg white omelet, which was made to perfection—light and fluffy! They offer two options for breakfast: an a la carte menu and an all-you-can-eat buffet, catering to every preference. A delightful start to my stay!

When I arrived I was greeted by a male server at the podium who was very nice.   I was meeting a business partner for breakfast.  I was pleasantly surprised by the buffet offerings, various breakfast cereals,  warm oatmeal with choice of toppings: brown sugar, nuts, raisins, and there were eggs, sausage, pancakes, sliced fresh fruit.  The is also a menu with about 6 to 8 breakfast entrees but I did not order from the menu.  All the coffee and OJ I could drink.  By the end I was pleasantly full and ready to take on the day's work.  My business partner ordered the omelet and it was very large, a good value for the price.  The buffet price was $23.95.

Very nice place to go after the workday. What really makes it special is the people. Sam the bartender was such a good guy to talk to and he makes a great cocktail. Place is a little older but has charm.

If zero stars were an option, I'd give it. One would assume that a restaurant in an international hotel chain would be a safe, solid choice for a business lunch. One would be wrong. When we arrived, there were two other (solo) diners in the restaurant, and the server (bartender?) seemed confused about the drink options they could offer. I should have trusted my gut then and suggested our table of 4 go somewhere else. Alas, the service was painfully slow, even for soft drinks and water, and we soldiered on. After one hour and 10 minutes, only two of us had received entrees (burgers and fries), and the other two of us continued to wait. One of us finally got a club sandwich, in which she found a bread clip (the thing that closes a bag of bread). The other of us never got any food at all -- because I was informed (after waiting 1h15) that indeed they didn't have the entree I chose (despite it being just 1 of 5 things on the lunch menu). Instead of waiting longer, we opted to just leave -- but not before the manager insisted that we come back again and get 1/2 off our meal.

I’m so glad we made it in for happy hour! Bar snacks and specialty cocktails all 50% off! What a steal! We shared the Grilled Octopus, Tostones with a delicious Mojo Verde Sauce, and the beef Tallow French fries. They have a beautiful courtyard where we enjoyed the Whiskey Ginger Cove  and Sweet & Smokey cocktail. Cocktails and food were full of flavor and perfect for the evening. Thank you to the bartender for the recommendations! We decided to stay for dinner and their 28 Day Dry Aged Ribeye did not disappoint! Highly recommend if you decide to dine here! My date had the Cabaña burger with French fries. Both cooked perfectly medium rare. Will definitely be back!

I stopped there for a quick lunch with a business colleague during an event in Los Altos. Service was excellent, friendly and attractive- and, our server was amazing. I had a cabana burger and my colleague had a lemon garlic pasta with salmon and they both were outstanding. They were also very kind to offer us complimentary soft drinks. We will definitely return for their new happy hour cocktails.

We found out only after arriving for our reservations that due to a show happening at the hotel, the restaurant was not serving off the menu, but having a buffet instead. Two pasta dishes, gluey mashed potatoes, salmon piccata that was decent and well done prime rib. I could deal with their thought process that there would be so many people eating there that a buffet would be easier (the restaurant barely was half full), but what was very annoying was the 20% gratuity they automatically tacked on for a buffet!!!  And unfortunately, there was no other place to eat. FYI, the buffet was already $55, so with tax and the 20% the entire bill was $72.00. … for a $25.00 meal.

name: The Conservatory
description: The Conservatory, located inside The Ritz-Carlton, Half Moon Bay, features a modern beach house design overlooking the dramatic Pacific Ocean. Delight in a menu of homegrown California cuisine, as well as signature cuts and sustainable seafood dishes. Enjoy handcrafted cocktails at the bar with a coastal spin on the classics.
address: 1 Miramontes Point Rd,  Half Moon Bay, CA 94019-2376
hours:
Breakfast
Daily 7:00 am–11:00 am
Lunch
Daily 12:00 pm–3:00 pm
Bar
Daily 12:00 pm–11:00 pm
Dinner
Daily 5:00 pm–10:00 pm
cuisine: Californian, Bar / Lounge / Bottle Service, Farm-to-table

reviews.text: Ate here on Easter, Sunday. Beautiful setting and view from our window table overlooking the Pacific Ocean. However, the food was average at best with tiny portions.  My $42 Mary’s Chicken arrived on a bare plate with two small pieces with a small mound of frisée greens. Nothing else. Total bill was almost $300 for two people with no alcohol and parking. Also, staff was clearly trying to get us out so the meal felt rushed.

Staying at the Ritz Carlton Half Moon Bay for 4 nights for our 30th wedding anniversary, our first evening was a travel day so we didn’t really wanna go anywhere for dinner. Decided to eat at this restaurant inside the hotel. Excellent choice would highly recommend. ￼
The lobster burger was absolutely delicious! This is the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion.
One of our favorite restaurants to visit, amazing views

Not at all within the scope of fine dining.  The food wasn't especially great, and we never saw our server except when we tried to flag him down?  Yes, the hotel is very clean with high end finishes, but that's where it goes wrong, the two don't match.
Beautiful ambience , excellent food and great service

Incredibly lovely team from Emily on the phone as we were running late, to the lady who checked us in to Antonia and Edith who were just excellent. So impressed and even the Valet kindly offered us water as we left.

We had 7 PM reservations on a Saturday night. The restaurant was packed with people, including a lot of kids which made the noise level very high. The food was good, but was not memorable. Given￼ the cost of the restaurant I was not satisfied.
You have to pay $50, with no self parking. Pebble Beach  has self parking and easier to go grab lunch spend the day.
Very pleasant setting with excellent service.  Menu is good.  Feels a bit overpriced due to its setting in the Ritz Carlton.
We had a table with the most amazing view! Service was great and the lunch was delicious.
We came for a birthday and they forgot to acknowledge it but charged us for a dessert we didn’t get.
Unparalleled service.  Incredible view.  Prices high but you expect that at a nice resort.  Food only so so.
Delicious food, gorgeous views, great service. We had the omelet and traditional breakfast. Bothe were good. The hash brown was delicious!

Fantastic service! Amazing views! Food was very good, pricey but consider the location.
We enjoyed our lunch date. Disturbed by the parking fee.  $50 for basically 2 hours!  If you are dining and paying a great deal for the meal, feel like it should be discounted by at least half.  Otherwise a wonderful place for a special treat.
Excellent service, from the host to the food runner to the waitress. The food & cocktail were both amazing (though the cocktail was quite overpriced at $30). I will certainly be a return guest.

I recently dined at Conservatory within the Ritz-Carlton, and I am compelled to express my profound disappointment. My experience was nothing short of a complete failure, and a stark contrast to the expected standards of this esteemed brand.
From the moment we were seated, the service felt rushed and impersonal. Our order was taken hastily, and predictably, arrived incorrect. Not only were several items wrong, but the food that did arrive was lukewarm at best. Upon being seated they dropped condiments on the floor and put them back on the table for us to use.
Attempting to rectify the situation proved futile. Our server displayed a complete lack of concern. The correct items remained on the table, and were cold. They brought the check while we were still completing our meal, just 35min from being seated. The entire meal felt like a rushed, careless affair, a far cry from the refined dining experience one anticipates at a Ritz-Carlton.
To add insult to injury, we were never informed of the restaurant's closing time. With only 45 minutes remaining until closing when we were seated, we were left in the dark until our server abruptly announced her impending break and the restaurant's closure, effectively cutting our already disastrous meal short. This lack of transparency and basic courtesy is unacceptable.
The combination of incorrect orders, cold food, indifferent service, and a complete disregard for customer satisfaction made this dining experience an absolute travesty. For a restaurant operating within the Ritz-Carlton, this level of incompetence is simply inexcusable. I expect far more from a brand synonymous with luxury and impeccable service. This experience was a significant letdown and has severely tarnished my perception of the Ritz-Carlton's culinary offerings. I will not be returning, and I strongly advise others to reconsider dining there.
Lovely and awesome view.  Great food.  Will definitely go back.

The food was amazing, got the sea bass and crab bisque. The bread warm and tasty. The dessert, raspberry mango mousse and chocolate mousse and coffee were really good too. The view unparalleled, the service superb.
Great food and incredible views.  Well worth the cost of admission!

The dining experience, the view, the food and the service were all great.  HOWEVER, a $50 mandatory valet fee for dinner is absurd and an immediate turn-off.  If you don't want guests who not staying at hotel, then don't be on OpenTable.  At the very least advertise in big, bold lettering that you will have to pay $50 to park at restaurant.  Unthinkable for a Ritz Carlton property.
Outstanding service. spectacular views. Lunch menu was tame with fresh ingredients but lacked flavors.

name: Curry Up Now - Zanker Road
description:
Innovative & Unexpected Indian Fare, that's a little Naughty too!
Since day one, Curry Up Now has been on a mission to serve Indian flavors & ingredients in a friendly and recognizable way. Our signature dishes include fan-favorite tikka masala burritos, bowls, tacos, Deconstructed Samosa, Naughty Naan, and more, as well as a wide variety of the more traditional and Indian street food snacks like Thali Platters, Kathi Rolls, and many Indian Street Foods.
hours:
Mon–Thu 11:30 am–10:00 pm
Fri, Sat 11:30 am–11:00 pm
Sun 11:30 am–9:00 pm

reviews.text: Fun and hip casual Indian bar.  Lots of good drinks and fun finger foods

name: Broma
description: A modern palette blended with regional tastes embodies an atmosphere that welcomes novel thought and casual gatherings. Inspired by Spanish cuisine, yet influenced by many places, our restaurant is a culinary journey—one that’s as bold and diverse as the flavors found on our menu.Inspired by his travels through Spain and Portugal, Michelin-starred chef Jarad Gallagher Latin influenced cuisine at Broma.We work closely with our purveyors to source only the finest ingredients, both local and abroad.In addition, we offer hand-crafted cocktails from The Emerald Hour, craft beer, American and international wines, and a variety of delightful non-alcoholic options.
address: 1625 N Shoreline Blvd,  Mountain View, CA 94043-1305

reviews.text:
If you are celebrating special occasions, like birthday or anniversary, don’t come here, although they asked you what you celebrate when you made reservation, nothing complimentary. They misled us to ordered a “birthday dessert “ and it’s not complimentary when paying bills
—- edit : adhere I saw other reviews that their birthday there got a “nice gesture “ , I changed my rating to one star.

Came for the Valentines Day special and had the tasting menu - food was excellent and the dishes had very complex textures and flavors, and everything was clearly curated very carefully and intentionally.

The staff was surprisingly attentive and pleasant despite how busy it got, and they even took the time to take a polaroid of us and present us our photo with a small paper flower. 100% would return
We really enjoyed our dinner, everything we ate was delicious and the service was impeccable.  We will be back again soon!
Delicious Modern Spanish cuisine, excellent service and wine list!
Another delightful meal, with friendly and attentive service and imaginative and delightful food!  Cannot recommend Broma highly enough.  Kudos to the Chef and entire staff.

We met friends, shared some small plates and had mains as well. All the dishes were delicious, with high quality ingredients (and we’re foodies who know how to cook)! We loved that it was quiet enough to converse. It is attached to a hotel in a somewhat off-the beaten path location but it’s worth a visit (and open on days when many restaurants are closed, like Mondays). The ambiance is very nice inside. A hidden gem!

Brilliant and inventive take on modern Spanish food, with a lovely respect for quality ingredients and a most intriguing balance of flavors and textures.  The evening was a delight and we look forward to another visit soon!

Very good food and service
Our first time. Will come back.
Excellent food and service. The flavors and freshness were out of this world. Ambiance is okay.

Great selection of small and large plates, plus nice craft cocktails.  James was our server.  He was timely, friendly and helpful.  The amuse bouche was overly salted, but still tasty.  We tried the Spanish artichokes, duck empanada, and wrapped pork tenderloin.  The artichokes were flavorful and perfectly cooked.  The creamy base they nested them in was overly generous.  The empanada was surprisingly large.  The cherry mole and corn around the edge of plate made for variety in every bite.  The pastry was perfectly baked. The pork tenderloin had a perfect pink center, tender and juicy.  Definitely a place I would dine at again. The menu changes regularly, so what is on the website may not be what is offered.  Still, lots of variety and a relaxing but sophisticated atmosphere
Octopus dish was terrible and very overpriced for minimal selection
Every menu item we order was so tasty! The paella dish and the bacon sourdough toast were amazing!
Good Spanish fusion food that I world return to eat
The food was far worse than i expected. Medium quality steak and worse deserts

One of the best Spanish restaurants in the area! The ambiance was really incredible with low lighting and modern industrial decor. The service we received was great and so was the food they served. Will definitely be coming back.

Food, cocktails, wine and service were all excellent. Scott was amazing and thoughtful with his time and attention with ordering wines. He even surprised us with a very thoughtful gesture at the end of our birthday celebration meal. Will definitely be back!
Great meal with the Filua preset course on Fridays!
Nice clean place with a great service and decent food. I would recommend
We loved everything about this experience. The food, the service, the cocktail list. A great change of pace for the South Bay!

Great experience overall. Nice selection of dishes and great execution too.

A mix of Spanish cuisine fusion with cuisines from all around the world.

Food is creative and excellent.  Every dish is superb.  The staff is helpful and friendly and the atmosphere charming.  We were there for our 40th wedding anniversary and could not have chosen a better place to be.

Whilst the food and service were both very good. There was still a feeling that this was a hotel restaurant. With the outdoor seating overlooking the hotel swimming pool, sitting indoor is definitely a nicer atmosphere. Nice restaurant but would not be rushing to go back.

We went based on recommendations from a friend, whom recommended it last year.  After we booked it, they warned us that the restaurant has changed format.  We went anyway since we already booked it on Open Table.

The restaurant has a nice décor, easy parking (but very steep ramps, so for lowered cars be careful!).  The service was very good and the wait staff is trained well.

We were disappointed as there was no more tasting menu options.  We had the $56 Spanish ham but it was not what we expected.  It was precut and not as nice as we would have thought for that price.  We have been to Spain and expected for that price it would be similar.  We also had the Artichokes which was tasty but anything fried with a nice cream sauce is pretty good.

The options are more main meals and some that we observed from nearby tables could be shared.  The Striped Bass was good but not great.  The spices used were unique but the fish to us was little overcooked.  The pasta with morels had very little pasta and was more veggie based; it was flavorful but not completely satisfying.

The Mexican Hot chocolate was a cold pudding desert that was not very sweet, a bit gritty in texture and not that good at all.  The cheesecake was ok but not that special.

We read the Yelp reviews during dinner and all the great reviews were when they had the tasting menu as the reviews all raved about a number of those tasting dishes.  There were only two reviews this year (2024) and they read like someone from the restaurant writing it, which I think was the case:(  They need to go back to their tasting menu as their current menu seems over prices and not that special.  We were really looking for more tasting dishes that would remind us of our travels to Spain but this was far from that :(
I love their food as it comes with unique flavors and the atmosphere was excellent!
Loved the food and the service. Will come back for sure!

I usually don’t leave bad reviews, but my biggest issue with this place is the price for what you get. The food is mediocre at best and the prices do not align with the quality of food. Service was outstanding, and ambience was nice. Lower your prices or the improve the food. No wow factor whatsoever. Sorry Broma, we wanted to love it.

If it is on the menu, get the Fideua for
sure.

I dined with three friends, two of which had eaten here before. We were seated right on time.  They had great cocktail menus with excellent choices for wines and spirits.  We had three great small plates and shared three mains, and it was exactly the right amount for our hearty appetites.  Extra kudos to the staff who were perfectly accommodating without being overly fawning.
Amazing food, amazing service and server. We love coming here and would recommend it highly
Great service, great table. The service was attentive and I’m not even sure who our primary server was. Excellent
The food and dining experience were reasonable, but nothing that I would return to or make a trip for.
Very good food, great service and really nice place.

First time a Broma. The overall experience was good, great service, the food was very good but! I was disappointing about how spicy the dishes were (4 of us) . I felt I was at Mexican restaurant (don't get me wrong, I love Mexican food) No one in the group was not expecting to eat spicy dishes, we are all from Spain :-)

I went with some girlfriends for a Galentine's dinner.  The ambiance is nice although it's a bit weird to walk through a hotel lobby and a long hallway with a pool on one side and the kitchen on the other to get to the seating area. 
The servers were very kind and attentive.  We wanted some wine, but it was so overpriced so we went instead for the Lychee sangria which was ok.  As far as our dinner goes the Chicken Croquetas were very enjoyable and tasty but there was nothing special about the Pan con Tomate and the charcuterie board with Manchego and Chorizo iberico as, really sad. I could see every element of that board as something I could get from Trader Joe's for much less than what we paid for it, it was an incredibly disappointing start of our dinner and lowered our expectations enormously.  Fortunately the Seafood Fideua we shared was really good..  
We had a decent experience but I don't think we'll go there again
food is good but beware of optional 20% gratuity already added on the bill.
Extraordinary food -- delicious and creative.  Friendly and efficient service.  A lovely place to dine, and a special, memorable meal.
Fantastic experience dining at Broma! Superb service, food and drinks were delicious and paella was the best one i’ve ever had to date!!! Will def be back
It was a good and relaxing evening and the food was delicious service was ok, most servers were warm and welcoming, but just our main server seems like doesn’t want to work.
Broma is probably the best-kept culinary secret in the South Bay/Peninsula area.  The food is a foodie's delight, and the menu still has plenty of things the less snobby eaters would enjoy.
Food and service was great but we were here for a birthday and all they offered was a free candle for the birthday girl. No dessert just a candle. Could’ve gotten 5 stars.
Food was delicious.  Service so-so.  Wrong entree, given check before I had to ask for dessert.  Would not have the same waiter again

Mediocre food for premium price.
Nothing exciting. Will not go there anymore.
And they automatically add 20% tip to the bill

Staff is polite, but fairly slow and doesn’t know how to accommodate guests with dietary restrictions. The menu has poor selection of vegan or vegetarian options, some menu items can be made vegan by removing meats, without replacing them with vegan ingredients, you end up paying same high price for what feels like an incomplete meal. Results in an overall poor experience, do not recommend.
Fabulous food with great atmosphere and excellent service!!

Our favorite restaurant
Food and service one of the best on the peninsula

Had the Broma Experience option on the menu. Perfect amount (actually maybe even too much) of food for two people.  Service was great at the start but by the time we got to the last course it was taking a long time to clean up between courses and bring out the next. 20% gratuity is added automatically to the bill, but didn’t deserve 20%, probably would have given 15%. Nonetheless, great food and decent (but not great) service in a nice atmosphere. Will definitely be back in a few months.
Food was overall quite good, especially the Fideo dish.
Great wine selection and mixed drinks. Squid ink pasta dish was amazing. Get the walnut ham prosciutto no matter what.

We were on the look out for authentic tapas. Many places put an American slant on the flavors it seems. While this place has its own slant, it does so without losing its connection to Spanish sensibilities. The food was superb and surprisingly generous in portions. We loved the moderistic and understated ambiance. The experience channels modern Madrid. Located in the Shashi Hotel, we were reminded of our time at the Hotel Urban in central Madrid, especially Shashi's open air Emerald Bar and adjacent pool area. Start with a cocktail there before heading to your table.  Definitely on par with cocktails you get at Tatel Madrid. No doubt, pricing is a bit on the high end, but worth the value for sure. Gratuity is included in the pricing as well as proper compensation for their staff.
We had a good time for my girl’s friends hangout. It nice place you can chat, and food is presentable and yummy.

None
