None None None None 
None

Not the kind of experience I was expecting. The design of the restaurant is modern and elegant but that’s it. Not a lot of choice in the menu, very expensive for the quality, service was just okay and feeling pressured to choose more plates ($$$). Overall I’ll recommend you to check on Teleferic Barcelona first before trying this Spanish restaurant. Not recommending it.

Tasting menu is always recommended.
Wine list is easy to navigate.
Delicious food.
Amazing bar with hand crafted cocktails.
Don’t drive by this restaurant.
Service was excellent and food was delicious. Perfectly staycation getaway.
It’s an east with your eyes kind of place. Ny was 75 and wasn’t very filling.
Great food, the pasta paella was excellent so was the octopus and iberico. Everything was really good. Will definitely go back
Delicious food, well crafted. Our server was very friendly.

My wife and I had a really nice time at Broma. I made a reservation on a Thursday night since we would be attending a concert nearby, and I felt like we were given a really nice table (pleasantly positioned by a gas fire place, away from the noise of the bar and the swimming pool). Based on what I've seen online, it looks like the menu can vary. We ordered two cocktails (one from the menu and one off-menu), two starters, one main course, one dessert, and one after-dinner drink. Throughout the entire meal, several staff members kept us well-attended. It really felt like everyone was working together as one very well-oiled machine. The starters came out one at a time, which worked out perfect for us since we like to share everything. In addition to being delicious, the dessert was a wonderful surprise of different textures. It really left us with the impression that each dish was really well-thought-out in every detail. I would definitely come back here, again!
Enjoyed the Broma Experience and loved it!! Would just recommend the 6 course experience if you have no rush and are very hungry. We enjoyed with a pitcher of lychee sangria that was fabulous
Great paella and creative menu.  James is a terrific waiter.
Delicious and satisfying meal. It was pretty pricey as well

Food was interesting, decent but not great for the price. Our server was excellent, definitely helped make the experience enjoyable. The maitre de was impolite and full of himself. Needs to be replaced.
Nice place and service is good. Food is too salty.
I'm not sure why Jamon is so insanely expensive, but I would skip it.  The octopus was good, and the other dishes were average.  Nice space, but not worth the price overall.

Great experience at Broma.  My husband and I ordered the tasting experience and the chef chose all items.  The food did not disappoint!  8 amazing courses of food!  I loved every course and was able to have so many different items from lamb to octopus, including wonderful grilled vegetables and burrata salad with tomatoes and peaches.  The selection hit every taste bud!  I would highly recommend for a long leisurely dinner.
Spectacular food and service! Love the wine list as well.

Fabulous Spanish food. Service was warm, friendly and efficient. Had a hard time making decisions on the menu. Luckily they provide an amazing tasting menu at a very reasonable price for the quality. We even had a vegetarian in the group, and she was very happy. Will be back. Thank you Broma!
Too expensive for the food served, Service good and friendly
Service was great and the food is good. A lot of people in the bar section but the dining area is perfect

Excellent service. Very accommodating. The place is in a boutique hotel. Not very big and wasn't very crowded on a Sunday night. We sat in the courtyard where you are blocked from the traffic and views of the "industrial park" like Google campus. You can hardly tell that you are surrounded by Google/Microsoft/Intuit buildings.

The food quality is good, but I wouldn't say exceptional. Maybe I was expecting a lot more. The style is Spanish tapas, so most dishes are meant for sharing and that includes the main courses which are definitely too big for one person.

We sat down in an outdoor courtyard that still felt cozy and private, were served delicious and innovative foods and drinks, and at the end felt confident we were provided an experience well worth the price.

Full marks.

We opted for the Broma experience.
A 6 course “small” plate tasting season menu. Everything was so flavorful and the timing was excellent. My only regret is that I didn’t save enough space for the main course. A squid ink pasta with mussels and sausage. It was outstanding!
Delicious food and spectacular drinks. Dessert was also fantastic. Great and attentive service, thanks to Victor.
Excellent food and attentive staff.  Very good value for the money.
The food is amazing at Broma.  Fresh ingredients, imaginatively-prepared food.  Great service and a quiet atmosphere.   Menu changes frequently, but never disappoints.
Amazing dinner experience, we will back soon . Food amazing, Service amazing

Second time at Broma (went back 2 months after our first visit). Service is still great, food is still great. There's a few outdoor tables (with heating) but we sat indoors both times because we wanted to avoid the breeze. Flavors are on-point, and plenty of options with different meats, seafoods, and veggies but not an overwhelming amount. On the pricier side, but worth it. Can't wait to go back!

The service was outstanding with our server very knowledgeable about the menu. The flavors of all the dishes were complex and complimentary across the board. The cocktails were a great addition to our dinner.
The croquetas de pollo e manchego are a must try, the Portuguese sardine is the perfect combination of umami, salty, and sweet, and the octopus was inspired with a little bit of heat and great contrasts in texture.
I thought it was way over-priced for what it was.  Average food for gourmet prices while getting bombarded by fruit flies at the bar.
Food was amazing (scallops were bland); Service from waiter was slow (we waited a long time to order and get our bill and wasn't present to flag down);
Best pork knuckle with plenty of flavors and cut it with my fork.  LArge portion and enough to share or take home for another meal.  Great experience and beautiful settings.

This place is great! We weren’t sure what to expect but saw the menu and it looked good. Food was delicious. We had the chorizo octopus sausage, asparagus, sardines, fish entree and lentil entree. Everything was good proportions. I really really liked my lentil dish it was perfection and made good leftovers as well! Staff was accommodating and very friendly. Will be coming back. Very good find!
We love it! The food was great and the ambience very relaxing!

Our 1st starter of Cinco Jotas Jamon Iberico de Bellota, Picos Camperos tasted great but extremely meager for the price, $55, so that was a grave disappointment.  Our 2nd starter, Portuguese Sardine, Toasted Baguette, Sofrito, Guindilla & Jamon ($16.50) was DIVINE. Our entrees of Sherry Braised Pork Shank, Iberico, Yukon Gold Potato, Chimichurri ($38) was fabulous; 28 Day Aged Ribeye, Horseradish Cre`me Frai^che, Shallot, Demi-Glace ($68) was very tender: Overnight Day Boat Scallops , Carrot Nduja, Parsnip Emulsion, Peanut, Kumquat ($40) was well seasoned and nicely presented but only 1 large and 2 smaller Scallops so the portion was again, too small.  We shared one dessert of Basque Cheesecake, Berry Jam ($12) and that was excellent.  The restaurant also gave each of us one La Estepena Polvoro'n de Almendra to celebrate our anniversary with a candle which was a nice gesture.
I have been to Broma many times because it never disappoints. The creativity of the food is amazing and the staff is super friendly.  Highly recommend!!
Too salty for most of the food, grilled octopus it’s a bit over cooked. Aged steak and the fish are nice.  Services are great over all, staff are very nice and welcoming.
First time and we loved it. Would strongly recommend. Food is delicious. We had beef, chicken, fish - and all was very good. Great service. Quiet, comfy, relaxing atmosphere.

Spanish and Catalonian food are not on every street corner, so to have a place like Broma to go and enjoy it is noteworthy. However, having been to and dined in Barcelona and other Spanish and Catalonian restaurants in the Bay Area, while Broma is solid, for the price point, it did not leave an indelible impression.

The service was great and very attentive but the food was solid but will be soon forgotten. Of the six small plates we ordered, the Hamachi crudo was the standout.

Cascal, also in Mountain View, feels like a better value and experience alike.

The service was excellent. Our waiter was so passionate about the food and I could tell everyone working enjoyed being at work. Great service, great food, a little more pricey than I thought was necessary (but I’m from out of town so who knows what’s happening with inflation).

Broma surprised us by being in a hotel with a cozy ambiance and excellent service and food! We started with a smoky mezcal mole cocktail- delicious. We ordered the bacalao fritters, patatas bravas, hamachi crudo and then the scallops and vegetarian main courses. All were amaaaaazing and the attentive service added to our dining pleasure:)
Awesome food, service and ambiance. A little pricey but it was worth it.
I’m tempted to give a so-so review so it doesn’t get crowded, but the food and service were outstanding. In particular, the cocktails and tapas were stellar. We’ll be back often.

We mentioned to the waiter that one of us was having birthday celebration and showed him the passport. Disappointingly, the restaurant did not show any generosity here and pretended no knowing it throughout the dinner, even a small cake
Food was just ok nothing spectacular. There were only 4 dinners in the whole restaurant and we still had to wait on our drinks after all the food was on our table. Probably won’t go back again.

Every month, my gf and I meet my friend and his wife for a double-date. It's become kind of a fun competition to see who picks the better restaurant. This past Saturday, my gf and I picked Broma Restaurant, and honestly I feel bad the other couple have to pick next because it's going to be very hard to top our experience we had here!

It was kind of chilly when we got there but luckily we were seated next to the fireplace which was perfect. There was a lively birthday party happening at the outdoor bar area, but we were seated in the dining area and there wasn't any noise from the party disrupting us.

Service is incredible - very helpful staff who have expert knowledge of their dishes and have amazing recommendations based on what your preferences are. They made sure to make note of any allergies and ensured whatever we ordered would have those items removed. The waitstaff's timing was impeccable - they always seemed to show up during a break in our conversation and never interrupted us, and also replaced our plates and utensils after every dish.

The food itself is incredible. All of our starters were great but I think the dish that stood out the most was the Steak Tartare - it comes with foie gras butter and caviar served with fried plantain chips to dip. Honestly I could have just ordered 4 plates of this for the night. I can't get enough of it.

Broma's options for entrees makes it hard to settle for one option - everything sounds amazing, and if you've seen the photos online, you know the presentation is aesthetically pleasing as well. I decided on the 28 Day Dry Aged Ribeye. Ordered it Medium-Rare and it came Medium-Rare. I don't have the most advanced pallete in the world and I'm certainly not a renowned wordsmith, so let me just say that was a certified Damn Good Steak™. 

TL;DR: Great place to entertain friends and family or celebrate a special event or even just a romantic couples dinner!
Great place! Amazing food! Took my BFF for her 30th birthday and we did the Broma experience and was totally worth it!
the service was excellent as well as the food! can’t wait to go back!

The food is delicious but unfortunately the menu doesn’t make any sense.  Entrees like a ribeye steak or a whole fish are served a la carte with no side options. They pointed us towards the tapas but that was only olives, salad and asparagus. When we asked about any potatoes or rice, it was a big production with the waiter despite him saying that “many people ask about sides.”
First he said they didn’t have potatoes. I showed him potatoes on the pork dish.
Finally he agreed to ask the kitchen for potatoes on the side to go with our steak and fish.

The food was delicious but no one in our large group would go back. It was just too much drama to get side options to go with a meat.
We arrived as a party of four on Predidents Day.
Everything was delightful with the exception of a noisy child at a table next to us.  I would highly recommend.

Our server was amazing. Super friendly and detailed about the menu.

The Broma experience was beyond incredible. Highly recommend!

We ordered the patatas and croquetas manchego. They were so tasty. The patatas have this green sauce that is on the spicy side but you just can’t have enough of it!

The presentation of all plates was so cool and sophisticated. The service was excellent. The place is cozy and modern.
Wonderful date night location in a swanky hotel. Feels super upscale yet cozy.
Waiter was very kind by marking which items on the menu that could not be made dairy free,
Great setting, good food, pricey but very good wine list.

Service was fantastic. The food was also delicious. We shared the Broma experience and it had a ton of dishes for us to try. We also came for my wife's birthday, and they gave us a fantastic slice of carrot cake on the house. Overall, great experience and great restaurant.

We had the prix fix Broma Experience.  Everything was spectacular. A wade variety of appetizer bites, jamon like we had in Barcelona, olives, cheese nuts. Entrees included a  rib eye steak and white fish that were both seasoned perfectly. We ordered the wine pairing that included 5 types of Spanish wines and a desert sherry. Dessert had three different selections. The portion sizes were appropriately small given the number of dishes included. One of the best meals I’ve had in a very long time. I wash surprised that the place wasn’t jammed. Also, excellent bar. Highly, highly recommended.
The food is always exceptional at this restaurant. The drinks and wine list are superb! Attentive service.

This restaurant is really a gem. The quality of the food is high and the flavors even higher.

Great all the way around. I highly recommend!

The menu is lacking creativity and selection.

Service was on point and cocktails were average.

The food here is always impeccable! Their wine list is so varied, love their choices of unique wines. We love the fact that they also have incredible specials from time to time, like white, truffle risotto –– it was so delicious!
Service was excellent
Food was really tasty! We would definitely go back. The only thing that was odd was that the outdoor dining was right next to the hotel pool.
It took a while for the food to come out, but overall it was a good restaurant with a good atmosphere and service.
Great place!. the see bass appetizer was incredible. Service was superb.
Excellent food. Imagine your favorite pupseria times 100! (Parking tip, though: do not spiral around the multi-story parking lot. Stay on the street, or go across the street.)
Great service and food.  Authentic Portuguese and Spanish tapas with a unique flare.  good price value for what you get, which is excellent food.
Excellent multi-course meal driven by your own choices. Service was outstanding and not rushed.

Enjoyed our dinner.  After booking our reservation, the Open Table App indicated the Menu would be Pre Fixe with choices listed for appetizer, Main, and Dessert.  Had our hearts set on Spot Prawns and New York Steak as well as the Heirloom tomato.  When we arrived our server indicated this was not the case and "we haven't had that in a long time ..."  I explained we would need more time to look over the menu as we had already decided on our options from the App Menu.  Ordered Drinks and Appetizers. Highly recommend the Duck Liver Mousse.  The Skirt Steak and the Chicken with Tumeric rice were very good.

We had mentioned we were celebrating a birthday and other than mentioning it when we arrived, nothing else was done.  We came for the food and it was very good.  Service was average at best.
Fun place to eat outside! We meet friends for drinks and small plates to share.
Gorgeous surroundings, tasty food! Loved being outside and enjoying the space. Perfect for a lively business dinner.
Great new place for Spanish tapas.  Everything tasted fresh and not heavy and greasy as some tapas can be.  Delicious desserts!

Service was great, seated use early. Took great care of us.
We were unfortunately seated next to chatty and loud table. What do you do?
Water was warm, no ice?
Food was excellent thou! 
Great overall experience!

Excellent cuisine, finely balanced combinations of fresh ingredients. Service is fast and professional, staff are properly trained and friendly and helpful. Best restaurant in the Bay Area with consistently excellent food and wine.

The restaurant was fine. I would bring any business or personal contact here as the environment was what I would expect of a higher class of restaurant.  
The outside space still has a "hotel" center court feel, but it was very comfortable.
However the menu needs work: I was thinking that it would be Spanish ("Inspired by Spanish cuisine"), but only the starters gave me that impression, and the main listing included Peking duck and a Wagyu Beef Burger. 
The cocktails and wine list was impressive.
Regardless, as there were some "creative tastes" (loved the croquetas de bacalao), I will return to taste more.
Great spanish inspired menu. Chef Gallagher makes delicious food and he did not disappoint with Broma. We will be back to try all the dishes.

The service is a JOKE, the food is below average with the price point + 20% service fee. I highly recommend you to stay away from this restaurant, poor service from the host + the server at our table.

Loved our dining experience here.  We were not rushed, we were attended to without it being too much.  Cocktails were delicious as the food.
We did share the feedback that the duck mousse was not a hit.  We each had one taste and no one else wanted any more.  It was too "gamey" and we did not find it appetizing at all.
Great food, and attentive service.  Deserves to be busier.
The service is good. The food is bad. It doesn’t deserve this price.

Not great flavor, very smaill quantity for the price
Good dessert

Came here for a light dinner before a concert at Shoreline. We had the burger and butter leaf lettuce salad, and both were terrific!  The burger ($22) was juicy and full of flavor - no need for ketchup as it would have masked the natural flavors of the beef. Came with slices of fresh heirloom tomatoes and crisp lettuce, in a bun that didn’t turn soggy till the last bite. I agree with the Yelp reviewer who said he’d rather have had fries than the mashed potatoes that came with the burger.  Our salad ($17) was nice and unique in flavor, but nothing I’d crave coming back for. 

James, our server, was great! He was friendly and knowledgeable.  He made recommendations, but didn’t try to “upsell” us to order more dishes or more expensive drinks.  It’s hard to find good servers these days and he was well worth the 20% gratuity included in the bill.

Prices were on the high side but we didn’t mind because of the service. Setting is nice, but the casual vibe didn’t match the high prices. If I want a 3-course meal for $120, I have other options I’d choose over Broma.  I would come back here for drinks and appetizers or a casual meal, knowing I’d be paying more but getting good service.
Delicious food, amazing service, great ambience. I am vegan and made sure to let the staff know in advance, they were very attentive and made sure to provide vegan options for me for every course.

A birthday night out. A very eclectic menu exquisitely prepared. We started with the duck pate and butter lettuce salad. Both were excellent especially the plum jam with the pate.  The duck entree was probably the best duck breast we have ever experienced. The pork cheeks and clams were perfectly seasoned (just the correct amount of red pepper paste) but make sure to include the broth with almost every bite (especially the potatoes). We usually get something chocolate for dessert but instead chose the pistachio tart. That was the least successful dish of the evening. Not enough pistachio flavor. When we commented to the server, he mentioned that they only use pistachio powder on the top of the dish. Real nuts would have been better in our opinion. The service was attentive but not in your face.

Food was of the highest level -- creative and delicious.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  The atmosphere was warm and pleasant and made for a perfect birthday dinner.  If you have the opportunity to dine here, don't pass it up.

Food was lackluster, either flavorless or incorporating an incompatible mix of flavors, depending on the dish. Seating is next to the hotel pool, so the ambiance consists of listening to children splash and play. The so-called prix fixe menu is a scam—they simply ask you to pick any appetizer, entree, and dessert from the a la carte menu and charge a price of $76, but the prix fixe is more expensive than most menu combinations. In my case, the prix fixe was quite a bit more expensive, so I elected to order a la carte (duh), but our waiter charged me the prix fixe price anyway and proceeded to argue with me about it when we received the bill, saying I had been required to go prix fixe since this is what my wife had done (which he hadn’t explained when we ordered). In the end, prix fixe pricing didn’t make sense for my wife either; it took some complaining on our part, but in end he switched us to a la carte pricing, taking our total charge down by $36, well over the price of their typical entree. Altogether, bad food, bad ambiance, an absolutely goofy approach to prix fixe, and rude staff. Do not recommend.

A unique and truly fine dining experience! We enjoyed the prix fixe option, and all courses were outstanding as were the delightful extras. Fresh, perfectly prepared, and delicious. We appreciated the ambiance of the outdoor courtyard, and the service was top-notch as well.
Great food, very nice ambiance. Enjoyed the very professional service

Entrees could have had veggies or other things next to them instead of just being a chunk of meat, though the duck was tasty. Food came out rather slow and the service wasn't much faster. Was fairly pricy for what we got.

The cocktails were excellent and very creative. The service was also excellent from the hostess who seated us to the waiters and support staff. The food was ok. My favorite was the little gem salad with jamon serrano. The prices were high.

Service was attentive. The atmosphere is very modern. I appreciate the 20% gratuity included in the bill for their staff. The food was good, but not great, and for this reason we'd likely choose to go elsewhere for tapas in the future. 

Great spot for a date or a work dinner. Average for meal quality given the availability of other option in the Bay.

We had the prix fixe menu and LOVED it! The amuse bouche was a delicious Gazpacho. I had the White Asparagus Appetizer with the Wagyu Steak for the Entre. Both were perfectly prepared and delicious. My wife had the Hama hi Crudo appetizer and the Duck two ways for her Entree. The duck breast was perfectly seared and had a delicious sauce. The desserts were divine. We will be back
Hair imbedded in dessert; should never had happened in restaurant especially in one that claims itself to be an upscale restaurant.
Wonderful meal in quite a cute new spot!
My dinner group was moved to Broma instead of Emerald Hour. It was amazing. This place is a true hidden gem. Everyone in my group will be back again.

Went for dinner with another couple on a Saturday night and sat outside in the central courtyard, near the pool.  Not very crowded on a Saturday night, which was nice. Service and food were very good.  The croquetas de bacalao, iberico jamon and skirt steak reall stood out. Drinks were excellent as well, with the rhubarb grappa and classic old fashioned being particularly special. It was lovely to sit outside and have no wind blowing in the seating area.  Parking in the hotel garage was ok, but spaces are a bit tight and it is not a clear path to get down the stairs to the restaurant unless you walk down the ramp.  If you see a spot on street in front (Space Park Way), grab it. Definitely going back.  Would be a nice place to have a bite before/after a movie across the street or a show at the Pear theater.

Went for some dinner and drinks with a friend. Wasn't expecting the location though very nice inside. The meal was excellent and the drinks were unique. It looks to be a local hangout for Googlers and I can see why. Nice spot that I will come back to again.

The service was very good. Beginning at the door walking through, and being greeted by a host who attended to us promptly. We were seated where we requested outdoors looking at the pool. The wait people were attentive, and well trained in service. The ambience was not good considering how delicious the food was. The appearance of the hotel in general is not appealing. It seemed that the inside of the restaurant had a lot more decor, and color. We might go there again mainly because the food is so good.

The ambience is elegantly modern, with a relaxed, open vibe. The background music was perfect. We ordered several appetizers with our friends as shareable plates, plus a few dinner plates. Everything was delicious. The cocktails were amazing. Service was just perfect. We live in Mountain View area so definitely going in our favorite restaurants rotation.
Awesome ambience and food
Excellent drinks
Great table next to the fire with outstanding shared plates and service.  The cleanup staff kept our table spotless and drinks full.
Quite, cozy, beautiful place. Good food, delicious cocktails and desserts
Food was incredible. Lots of options to make vegetarian. Service was a little disjointed, but friendly, knowledgeable and accommodating. You feel like you’re at a spa!
Outstanding food and great service. They accommodated us easily for our dietary restriction.

The restaurant is not very large, so if you are next to a loud group, you lose your quiet romantic setting. We were the loud group. The cocktails are good/strong, the food is beautifully plated and tasty. Great mix of options. Favorites are the croquettes, fig sandwich, butter lettuce salad (maybe ask to go lighter on the dressing). We didn't have anything we didn't enjoy. The desserts also are all outstanding. Sharing dishes is the way to go. Yes, it's pricey, but right now, everything is. Our waters never hit empty. Service was professional and helpful. In the lobby they host group parties, but it is very separate from the dining area, so we never heard them even though they were quite loud. Options to sit outside with heat lamps.
Enjoyed the Spanish and Latin American aspect to the food - the serrano ham, chicken croquettes, and squid ink pasta were all outstanding.

Very very pleased with our visit. Food and drinks were wonderful …. and the staff amazing. Can not wait to return.

And yes … the orange creamsicle fizz was incredible.
Beautiful crafted cocktails. Classy atmosphere. Many excellent food choices and could accommodate my GF Dairy free allergies! Will be back!
Food, atmosphere and service were great.  Creative menu and drinks selection with a Spanish flare.  Will go back!
Our waiter was awesome!
Best!!! Hidden gem!!
The steak was a delicacy. Well cooked, moist, and the sauce and greens gave it extra taste. The octopus and trout were amazing as well.

I love emerald hour for ambience, service and I used to love the menu. The menu has changed significantly and has very limited Options for a vegetarian. There is only 1 vegetarian option available as a main, the fig tam melt, which is great, but it’s not savory. They used to have a mushroom burger which was excellent but that’s not available anymore.
Sadly I won’t be back till I know I’ll have more options. That said service and drinks were excellent! Whatever we ordered was good too, yet only the crudo was memorable. 
Good luck!

It was my first visit  to Emerald Hour last night.  My friends and I wanted an outdoor space to have  drinks and dinner at, have it be lively enough but also not loud.   Have a good meal and cocktails.  Happy to report that  was the experience, AND attentive without being too much staff.
Absolutely delicious, the service was friendly and inviting. We sat next to the fire and could not have enjoyed it more.
Love it! Thanks to our great server Christian, host Cynthia and Director of the restaurant Justin!
Hidden Gem. Last minute booking for V day, well exceeded my expectation. Would love to come back for food and great atmosphere!
Great food and service, we loved it!!  The only consideration is there are a lot of hard surfaces on the interior, which makes it a rather noisy as conversation bounce from nearby table to us.

We really enjoyed our recent dining experience at the The Emerald Hour.  The menu is unlike any we have experienced.  We were able to enjoy a number of wonderful dishes and the presentation was perfect.   The service was very attentive.  The atmosphere was very relaxing.
Always a great place to meet! Staff is wonderful, food is delicious!
Best restaurant in Mountain View.  Minimum 50 characters.
Excellent food and cocktails. Not very busy, at least for now

Absolutely mouthwatering food. We didnt even order the entrees and kept ordering the small/share plates because they were absolutely delectable! Definitely recommend it for a chill evening with friends.
Super creative drinks. Spanish inspired food. Not a lot of vegetarian options. But our group all said we’d return.
My new favorite restaurant in the area!
Very nice setting. Good service
Fantastic restaurant with great food and service. Octopus and beef tartare are to die for

The menu descriptions are a bit too vague so if you have any food allergies you may want to double check to make sure the dish you order doesn’t have it. Main thing I would recommend here is the chill ambiance. Seemed to have a large wine selection, but we just ordered cocktails, which were just okay. Thankfully the entrees were tasty (other than the fact we found paper in the burger) but the small plates were underwhelming.

They could use a few more vegan options.
I will be going back.
Sent clients here on a date. They said the food was horrible and could only eat oysters - nothing else. Not a good date spot!

Due to the COVID pandemic, there was only one restaurant open and a small kitchen.  We ordered three appetizers and bread.  The bread was the highlight of the food.  Everything else was mediocre without a lot of flavor.  The service was great and they were very friendly and welcoming.  This may just be an interim issue.
Very inventive menu, perfectly prepared. Totally unexpected for a hotel restaurant on an off night.
Exquisite cocktails and outstanding attention to detail and flavors on the food.  Menu brought us back to our travels through Spain and Portugal.
Amazing food and great cocktails. Great vibe, highly recommend. Went with my friend for dinner last night and going to take my husband back next week!

Everything we ordered as starters and dinner were really good. We had the octopus, bread, peppers, escalivada, charcuterie plate, croquetas and burgers. Cocktails were not my style. They felt a bit weak, except for the original classic, which was boozy but lacked balance. I didn’t love the outdoors space right next to the hot tub (separated by glass) or all the dogs joining their owners for dinner. But I realize I am in the minority on that front.

Outstanding food. Ambience was okay, it's a restaurant in the lobby of a hotel. Outdoor seating was next to the pool, so we asked to be moved inside which had more ambience. Overall a very good restaurant, a bit pricey, but everything we ate was impeccable.
Mostly small plates with some sandwiches and steak entrees.  Very good and large bar menu.

Great spot to grab dinner and drinks before a concert at Shoreline. We didn’t realize the restaurant is inside of a hotel and would consider staying there next time. The food & drinks are delicious. It’s a little pricey but fun for a treat yourself meal.
Nice new restaurant, even my kids loved the food! Will be going back.
Limited menu and very high prices for what you got, but the food quality was good and it the ambiance was nice
My husband and I loved the evening. The place is lovely, the food was excellent, the service (always ask for Christian!), and the cocktails were simply wonderful. Don’t miss this great restaurant

Service was great, especially a guy named James. Food was decent. The burger can be improved: all the ingredients were amazing, the problem was you couldn't actually eat it as a sandwich, the moment I took a bite the entire thing fell apart.
We took the chocolate mousse which was tasty - but boring, nothing special.
Overall it was a nice experience.
Everything was soo good.. the food, the space. We sat outside

Great service, but limited menu. Also - we would have enjoyed our meal (much) more if there were heaters outdoors as so many other restaurants have now to accommodate the chilly Bay Area evenings. We were all shivering by the time we left.
We were there for our anniversary and it was really great food (with super drinks) and really friendly service.
Too few menu choices. You need to bring a foreign language dictionary to understand what the items are. Taste is underwhelming
Very pleasant atmosphere, good food and service.
A very satisfying meal with awesome food, good service and nice ambience! We will be back.

Completely and totally happy with our experience here. The bar program and the food were absolutely perfect — I would go here soon as come the fall it is going to super busy once word gets out. Amazing.
Excellent food and cocktails. Every dish is prepared with great care!
Great food, and great drinks.  All the staff are courteous and helpful.  The atmosphere is charming and comfortable.  Perfect place for an intimate night out.
It was our first time at the restaurant and it was a great place for cocktails and small plates!  We enjoyed it and will definitely go back!
Great drinks food and service loved the location and design

Engaging space and menu. Everything we ordered was delicious. Some unique offerings. The sausage stuff squid was the star of the night. Great burger as well. Very attentive service , solid cocktail. Absolutely we will return.
Truly great food and service! Love everything on the menu. Great decor and environment. What more can one say!?
Fun new place with a SoCal vibe. However, most of the food & drinks are overpriced. I don’t mind paying $60.00 for a fish entree “for 2” but a 6 oz. cod with rice does not come close to feeding 2.

Phenomenal experience and food. I had the strip loin and it was one of the best steaks I’ve ever had.

Very friendly staff
Every bite was very delicious. Great service and nice ambiance.

Dining at The Emerald Hour was phenomenal. From the service to the food, everything had a perfect touch. Since the pandemic, I have not had much of a chance to dine but with being one of my first experiences out - The Emerald Hour was great. Our server Cynthia was so kind - I loved her personality and she made some great recommendations. I would highly recommend getting the baby fingerling potatoes (the aioli is everything!!!), the Wagyu burger (BEST burger I've ever had... I mean.. even the bun is seasoned c'mon!), and the A5 Miyazaki Wagyu. The Wagyu steak was just divine. It was my first time ever having Wagyu and it was cooked to perfection and melted in my mouth. The chef of the night, David, checked on us - which was super sweet. We also got to meet Mikhail, the restaurant manager, Justin, the director, and Chef Jared, who curated everything. Dining here was truly time well spent.
New and amazing place! The service was super attentive and the dishes were all very thoughtfully composed - do not miss out on the veal sweetbreads - full stop incredible!
I loved every item we ordered. Hard to say what my favorite item was but I highly recommend starting with the country bread.
Best new date place in Mountain View. It was a great escape from Castro St to a great vibe and a modern menu.
Great ambience, food, and service. Cocktails were well crafted. Will definitely come back!
It was lovely!  We will go back for sure!

Great new place, very comfortable and nice. The food is very fresh and testy.
We also enjoyed the desserts very much!
Lovely new addition to the night life in Silicon Valley - REALLY good cocktails - food looked great too!
Excellent cocktails. Interesting meals well prepared. Professional service. Good portion size. Pricey.

Had the rustic bread was very good needed more butter for loaf, the Halibut crudo very nice flavor a little tough for  halibut, the salad we had an issue was flavorful the dressing the issue was no Goat Cheese, well we did find maybe a quarter teaspoon maybe I never found any at all salad definitely needed some creaminess and I suggest some crunch a chopped nut? Waygu burger was very flavorful cooked MR, side pickled vegetables is wrong choice with a burger, needed a nice fresh French fry or something ??
Went to the Emerald Hour not long after it opened.  The service was impeccable and both the cocktails and the food were delicious and original.  I will definitely be back!

Food was wonderful and service was amazing. Will definitely be going back to try more food and drinks! Everything was so fresh and open. The sitting area and bar area is nicely spaced for Covid restrictions. Love it all! New and wonderful! You need to go if you haven't tried it yet. I open tabled it and was sat right away

name: Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard
description: Currently, our back parking lot is under construction due to the development of Stockman's Park. Parking is limited, but the parking lot is still accessible from L Street, or Railroad Avenue.  We also have a few designated parking spaces near our rear entrance, but if all of those spaces are full, there is also a parking garage on Railroad Avenue. We apologize in advance for any inconvenience!Winner of Diablo's Best of the East Bay Award, Uncle Yu's delivers Asian cuisine with a twist.Innovative Asian cuisine enhanced with quality ingredients, paired with a Wine Spectator Award winning wine list, striking atmosphere and engaging service create the perfect dining experience.Whether you desire a quick bite, a fantastic glass of wine, a meal with the family or a sommelier's wine paired dinner, Uncle Yu's delivers!In addition to our dining room, we have a lively lounge and bar, a beautiful outdoor patio and a private room for special occasions and holiday parties.
hours:
Lunch
Daily 11:00 am–3:00 pm
Dinner
Mon–Thu, Sun 3:00 pm–9:00 pm
Fri, Sat 3:00 pm–10:00 pm

reviews.text: Food was exceptional… having to swat the knats like lung fu fighting was another thing. Owners should really figure out how to get rid of the knats

As always the food was amazing but tonight’s service was exceptional. Thanks Athena for making my birthday amazing with such great service. Athena never let my drink go empty, smiled the whole dinner and always checked on our table. Best service
The waiters was great with us and the food was fantastic. Will definitely be coming back soon
Frequent visitor for lunch. Beautiful restaurant !! Lunch specials are reasonably priced and portions are abundant. Never experienced a choice I didn't enjoy.

Very much enjoyed my visit to the best Chinese Food in the Bay Area . Great place for a family dinner or with best friends. Food is absolutely delicious topped off with a ice cold Tsingtao Lager
Well worth trying out I promise you will not be disappointed

We always have a good experience at Uncle Yu's.  We had many of our favorite dishes including Garlic Noodles, Orange Chicken, BBQ sea bass.  There were some updated to the wine list and tried a new Pinot Gris and Rioja that I enjoyed.

The service from Darlena, our server and other staff was exceptional. The hostess was really sweet after we were 20 minutes late. The prawns with vegetables were delectable! The prawns were huge, plump, moist, but well cooked. The sea bass had an end bite that was a little fishy but then less so at the middle of the piece. After my sister asked Darlena, she brought out mocha ice cream with chocolate drizzle for my husband’s birthday, nice touch!
Excellent food . Love the refried rice and Schwan shrimp
The hostess wasn’t that nice , but we were seated  on time for our reservation

When I go to a Chinese restaurant, I always look for Asian diners, in that way, I know that the food is going to be decent. On a Sunday evening, there were no Asians, only white people.
When I got the food, I see why there were no Asians. The food was mediocre food adjusted for white people!
Way overpriced and wasn’t a good value.

Great staff. Very attentive. Nick helped us with a specific wine need and my wife loved it!
Food was delicious and we had a good night out.  Recommend you round out the night with one of their many delicious desserts!

Valentine’s price fixe menu was exceptional.  We frequently go to Uncle Yu’s, but this menu was a huge step up.  Every dish more delicious than the last.   It was so, so good.  We have eaten at Michelin star restaurants, and this menu was as good as, or better, than some of those meals.  Bravo.
We went for the Chinese New Year’s celebration pairing menu and it did not disappoint.   All four courses were delicious.  My favorite were the dumplings with the Petite Chablis
The food was not very good.  There was little flavor and seasoning.  While the food was healthy, the best dish was the greens with pears salad.
We once again had a very nice lunch today @ Uncle Yu's. Always a great place for a special lunch

Truly the BEST Experience here this past Sunday evening!! First of all the host who allowed us to sit and dine near the bar was spectacular!! This is the third time I’ve been to the restaurant and loved every single time we came here!! The appetizer Eggplant Bites was so good 😊 Our cocktails Mango Martini and Whiskey sour was delicious 😋 Next, we had dinner which was to die for!!! Yum Yum Yum!! We had the Fried Tofu with vegetables and Calamari dish… both were very tasty and scrumptious!!! ❤️❤️❤️ Lastly, we had the Limoncello Cake 🍰 which was made perfectly for us!! We CANNOT WAIT to come back to relive this experience again 😘❤️❤️🌟🥂😎 Our server was splendid and very attentive!! I don’t remember her name, but she had dark hair and had a warm smile 😊
Uncle Yu's is always excellent - service, food, ambience, staff.  Always a treat.

Intentionally overcharged by the waiter. While this has not been my typical experience, it is worth noting. I dine here frequently and always start with a Cosmopolitan and this time something was off - it tasted like soap and there were a lot of bubbles that didn't go away (my friend agreed). I let the waiter know and he offered to have another one made. He brought the second one and I let him know it wasn't right either and I let him know I'm considering wine instead - he says he wants to talk to the bar staff  and at the same time I ask about the two tiered pricing for wines by the glass and he says prices are for either 3oz or 6 oz. He leaves and comes back with a 3rd one and again it is not tasting right and I ask the waiter for a taste of a champagne and a rose. After receiving the two samples I proceed to order the champagne.  All of these exchanges with the waiter are fine - no issues. When I get the bill I see the champagne charge is 32.00. I look at the menu and notice the champagne is listed as 16.50 3oz/32.00 6oz). I'm surprised as my champagne was in a standard flute and was just over half full. So I proceed to tell the waiter I'm surprised to see the charge for $32.00 and he says "oh, remember you asked me about the two tiered pricing", which he never asked me what size champagne I wanted. Rather than argue with him I accept his response and leave. It was still bothering me when I got home so I pour 3oz in a standad champagne flute (it fills the glass just over half full) and 6oz (the glass overflows) and so I confirmed the waiter flat out lied and intentionally overcharged me. I thought about going back to address the issue with the manager but I didn't.
Dee ordered dimsum, virgin drinks, soup, fried rice and  chicken entree’s and they were all well cooked.
Food was fine. $110.00 for 2 entrees & 2 glasses of wine. Ridiculous. Service was great. But overall skip
Food was great! The ambience very chill, the lighting not bright, had a good date night
Food was good as always. Our waiter, I do not recall his name, was not attentive and forgot drinks.
Always a great experience at Unclu Yu's! Food, drinks, and service are always on point. One of my top 3 restaurants in the greater Bay Area. The special dumpling appetizer is absolutely amazing.

Excellent dinner and excellent service on a busy Saturday evening. Patrons were energetic and good vibe in restaurant.  Food, as always was very good. The service was attentive in spite of the crowd. Nice way to end the holiday season.

Came in for my birthday dinner with the family. Yu’s was packed out on a Thursday nite. Took them a while to get service to us but we weren’t in a hurry. Drinks were ordered and came super quick - dim sum order and was delightful - we try to get something different (our second time here so we’re still exploring the menu). Duck spring rolls were brilliant - sea bass puffs were outstanding. Mains ordered - triple crown was nice but a little underwhelming. Garlic noodles and the spicy aubergine were on point.

Liking this place more every time we come - we’ll be back!
Uncle Yu always delivers - delicious food, friendly staff, and fun vibe. A family favorite!
Niece Ambience, great service and good food. A little waiting at the beginning.
It was delicious with top notch service.  We will be back for many more meals.
Amazing food! Service is on point. Just had a lovely experience!
Visited during busy holiday time.  Service was okay, but not as attentive as previous visits.  Was disappointed we were not offered  the full menu.
Beautifully decorated for the holidays! Nice ambiance. Great service!
This is our favorite place for Chinese food.  A work manager was in town for a meeting so this was our first choice. Food was delicious, service was also great.
Had a very nice dinner with friends.  The food here never disappoints.  Loved the lobster shumai and Honey Walnut Prawns.  Delicious

I had the pleasure of dining at Uncle Yu's recently with my girlfriends, and I can confidently say it was one of the better dining experiences I’ve had in a while. From the moment we walked in, everything was pleasant.

The service was great. We were greeted warmly at the door, and our server struck the perfect balance between being attentive and giving us space to enjoy our meal. Every request was handled promptly and with a smile, making us feel truly cared for.

As for the food—impressed. Every dish was great, both in flavor and presentation.
Awesome food and great setting.  Service was impeccable.
Great service and great lunch specials.  Yummy.  The food was good.
Delicious food, comfortable table in pleasant, relaxing dining area, casual yet elegant.
I’ve been to this place multiple times the food the quality of the appetizers high level never disappointed ￼
Food was pretty bland and basic. Portions were small too. Ambience was nice though
The food was very nice atmosphere was beautiful we felt that the service was lacking and also the value everything seems so overpriced for the amount of food
Always a great meal at Uncle Yu’s. It’s super convenient for a meal before a show at the Bankhead Theater!
Food is always why we come here. Far beyond any other Chinese eatery in the area.

Service person was good and efficient but unfriendly. We felt rushed.   Noise level is awful.  Five dishes ordered and some just taste the same with no variation in flavor.   Vegetable dish was all mostly broccoli.  Vegan rice is delicious.   No vegan pot stickers that used to be on the menu.  Restaurant itself is nicely decorated and feels special, but most of the food was ordinary this time. Bathrooms out in the hall were dirty.
As always, Uncle Yu's was great. The Wild  salmon  spring rolls are delicious. My new favorite appetizer. The chicken salad is also great. Not to mention the drinks.

ANOTHER lovely meal at Uncle Yu’s!   Dimsum was as good as ever, and wine was great.  Our server was attentive and knowledgeable.  Romantic dinner or a girls’ night out -  Uncle Yu’s is THE right spot!
The 3 of us enjoyed our lunch. The food was delicious and our waiter was helpful and attentive.
Very americanized food.  It was fine, but we won't return with so many better options around.
Great food but music outside too loud, could not hear my fellow diner. Good service, food delicious.

This is by far the best Chinese restaurant I’ve ever been too! I’m am not a Chinese food lover..though I’m a foodie however, Uncle Yu’s has changed my mind! Food is fresh & oh so delicious! Book today I promise you you won’t be disappointed!
Fabulous food and great wine list in a beautiful restaurant.
Parking in downtown Livermore was an adventure, but the restaurant was great. I was meeting some old friends and the service was good and they let us take our time to chat and catch up.
awesome food, great experience!  will go there again and again.

We just love this neighborhood find!!! The staff are so professional. The ambience is so beautiful inside and out, and the food is always delicious.  It’s my favorite for birthdays, anniversaries or even a middle of the week bite.   If you haven’t been here, you’ve gotta try it !! The food is never greasy, always healthy fresh high-quality. ￼￼
Uncle use never to never disappoint us. Food is always amazing. The waite staff and hostesses are great.

As always, the food and service were excellent! I brought my friend to this location for the first time and it was her birthday. She was very pleased with her lunch and the attention we received from the waitress. She even got a slice of Limoncello cake for her birthday! My friend even ordered more food to take home for dinner tonight so she didn't have to cook!  I look forward to my next trip here!
Fabulous food. Wonderful service. Great ambiance. Couldn’t have enjoyed it much more. Highly recommended.
Awesome wait staff and equally lovely food.    Great salmon and snap peas as always!!

Wonderful experience as usual. The food is excellent; I recommend the sea bass puffs (appetizer), lotus lettuce cups, orange peel waygu beef and walnut honey prawns. The service has always been great. I recommend the limoncello cake for dessert.
It’s meh at best.  Some dishes too salty while others like any depth of flavor.
Great food and a good amount.  Service was excellent. Definitely recommend!!
In our opinion Uncle Yu’s is the best Chinese restaurant in the East bay!  The food & ambience is a solid 5 star!
I think our waiter came to our table once, seemed a bit tired
Food and service are "always amazing"... Great restaurant!

Excellent meal & service. Matthew is 5 stars!
Long time customers (25 years) and great to return after a few years.

Overall it was a good lunch. I made reservations for a coworker’s birthday and in the past Uncle Yu’s was great with a birthday dessert and great service. This lunch the service was just very ordinary and no surprise birthday dessert etc.
I never miss Uncle Yu when I’m in Livermore! Great food and service…love it!
Love this restaurant.  Food is always delish no matter what we order.  Nice outdoor patio.
Nice outdoor seating. Food was great. Service just so-so. I think maybe she forgot she had a table outside.

This is one of our favorite restaurant's. We went for our Anniversary and they treated us like gold! They even gave us a special dessert and glass of dessert rose'. 5 star food and service. The dim sum dumpling chef's special appetizer is amazing and our go-to app! They also have a good bourbon selection and their specialty cocktails are awesome! We have frequented this restaurant for years and twice in the last two weeks! A must try! We have never been disappointed and you will not be either.
Best Chinese food in Livermore. Excellent drinks and nice outdoor seating area.

Food, drink and atmosphere was, per usual, great.  The waiter was a different story. I was there celebrating my parents 55th wedding anniversary and he came to the table an asked my 80 y/old mother (in a patronizing way), "would you like a drink, young lady?"  Social etiquette 101--do not condescend to older adults with "young lady" when it's clear they are very, very far from that.  It does not endear nor make customers feel comfortable or welcome. Further, the waiter (we were sitting outside) was inattentive and NEVER made direct eye contact with any of us.  We were and will remain loyal customers to your restaurant--but I'm bummed out my mom and dad felt minimized from his careless and awkward attempt to connect with us.
One of my favorite restaurants hands down! The food, cocktails, service, and ambience is top notch! If you have never been to this restaurant, you are missing out!
Good and service were excellent. It’s expensive but hard to beat the quality

Uncle Yu’s has a great, separate vegan menu - be sure to ask for it. The mushroom appetizer and fried rice were my favorites, but I also loved the Szechuan Kong po broccoli. Corkage is only $20, so we enjoyed a wine we brought and the weather was perfect to sit outside. We’ll be back!
Great food. Excellent service. Nick really knew his wines.

Had the prix fixe menu and wine pairing for a party of three.  The total bill came to slightly over $600, this wouldn’t be too bad if the food were better.  The wine pairing was the real stand out.  The food itself never rose above just ok and given the preparation and flavor was not worth the price.  We had a substitution for an allergy and the substitution was flavorless cabbage.  Very disappointing.  This restaurant seriously needs to up its food game on the prix fixe if it wants to match its prices and expectations.  As it is today, the prix fixe is little more than a glorified wine tasting with mediocre appetizers.
The food, decor, drinks, service were overall outstanding.  Highly recommend it for lunch or dinner.  I plan to return soon.

As always, the food was delicious!
The Seafood soup is to die for….
Really good food. Really good service. I highly recommend this place.
Great drinks.  Delicious food.  Attentive service and a very enjoyable vibe.  Uncle Yu’s always delivers.
Fantastic in every way.  Our second visit here and many more to come..  a great place to show off to our guests.￼
Dinner was fabulous! The walnut prawns were absolutely amazing! Our server was very attentive! Our only concern was a bit noisy.

We have never been disappointed.
Food is wonderful! Service is excellent!
We have eaten there many times and  will certainly be back.
Food is consistently good.  We like this restaurant.
Great dining experience. Food and service are top notch
Great food and great service . Ambience was good as well for family outing.

Excellent food and service (as always).
Great experience.
Neeest discovery and absolutely in love. First Chinese restaurant in Bay Area that is a pleasure to walk into. Food  is amazing so is the staff.
It was an elegant late dinner. The appetizers were tasty, and then we loved the entrees.
I ordered my meal with extra sauce…which I didn’t get. Next time I will order it different.
We love Uncle Yu’s, favorite restaurant in Livermore. Food is always consistent, and so delicious. Service is always outstanding.
Good food and service.  Quite noisy.
Excellent service, food and atmosphere! We sat out on the patio and enjoyed a leisurely dinner for our wedding anniversary. Awesome gluten free menu. Will be back for sure.
Large, delicious menu eith specialty items as well as typical fare. Quiet, attractive ambience with attentive service. The honey walnut prawn salad was delicious, light and perfect for lunch.
The food and service were good, the overall experience was nice, the portions tend to be a bit small but the flavors were good.

As always this place has the best food and service I’ve ever had. We got the Din Sum platter and fried calamari. I’ve never had better! The only thing I didn’t like was the girl who brought our food ( not our server) was not gracious at all. She left the table as I was trying to thank her and clearly didn’t want to engage in a conversation. I would suggest additional training for those that approach customers. I would suggest a simple enjoy your meal or bon-a-petite would be good and asking if we can get you something else? This is our favorite restaurant of all time and I would expect no less. Even the bus boy was friendly. It came as quite a surprise with Uncle Yu’s un parallel standards. This said it’s the best restaurant I’ve ever experienced. No complaints. Just a friendly suggestion.
Fantastic meal!  Very busy but service was excellent. Our friends loved it! We loved it.
I have always had a great experience at Uncle Yu. The food is always good and consistent, and the service and ambiance are always great.
As always, the food and service was excellent.  We also enjoyed the lychee margarita, perfectly balanced, simply delicious.

The food was excellent (fresh and very tasty). The service was not very good and the hostess needs to put some clothes on and wear less perfume. Everyone she walked by our table the stench of her perfume made me want to puke.
5 stars all around.  Excellent Chinese food.  I especially enjoy the lettuce wraps and lychee ice cream.
When we went they couldn’t find our reservation. Everything else was fine

Very impressive restaurant, complete with the very best Chinese food I've ever enjoyed.  The wait staff was also excellent with a vast knowledge of the food and wine.  Attractive surroundings inside and in a nice Livermore downtown location.
Service was slow. Small portions for the price overall I’d go back for dinner.
Always a delicious meal and the best service! A big favorite for special occasions or everyday dining.
Had a birthday lunch and it was fantastic!!!  Server amazing, food delicious and atmosphere always the best…..
Great service, great food, and very clean and comfortable.

The food was absolutely outstanding! All four of us enjoyed it. Two of us are vegan, and there were plenty of vegan options that were extremely tasty . We asked for seating outside, hoping it would be quieter out there, but the music was extremely annoying. Very good food! Service is always above and beyond.
Good was good, ambience was very nice and quiet. The weather was gorgeous outside, and our waiter and staff were very friendly and courteous ￼￼
Ambience delightful. Service perfect. Food delicious.
Food was great and plentiful. Service was excellent
Great food and great service.  Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard is a great place to go for a nice night out.
Great service and great food and a beautiful atmosphere
We had a great experience.   We definitely will be back for the exceptional food and service.

This is the second time we tried this place and it’s our new favorite restaurant. Everything about it is top notch. We had the dim sum platter and Chow Fun this time and thoroughly enjoyed it. Last time the king crab rice and dim sum platter. I think one can’t go wrong spending money here. My wife and I are picking as I’m a chef that doesn’t like to go out if I. can do it better myself.  The chef here is far better than I am.
The dumplings sampler is just delicious, everything freshly made, we ordered the fried rice with Wagyu and the Kung Po.. just great!
Great bar cocktails to start evening! Food was excellent and overall atmosphere was great! My favorite place to bring friends!

Yummy yummy went into my tummy!
Lobster Shumai, crispy orange beef, Kung Pao Trio and Seafood soup….

Uncle Ys is one of most favorite restaurants to go with friends and family to celebrate or enjoy a nice evening out. The food and service and drinks are just the best! We love Uncle Yu’s!  Always our favorite place to go!

We have always loved the food here at Uncle Yu’s, as it’s some of the best Chinese food in the Bay Area. With that being said, the service this time around was very reminiscent to that of a casual dining chain restaurant. There was no energy from our server whatsoever. The busser coming around to take our dishes and refill our waters interacted with us more. I also ordered a beer after my first cocktail, and that never came out. Great first meal for us at Uncle Yu's. Waiter was great to talk to and helped with our daughter's nut/sesame allergy. Drinks were lovely and came super quick. Food was outstanding, super super hot (temp) and perfectly spiced. We will be back for sure!
Best Chinese we may have ever had. Outstanding gluten free options. Highly recommend.
This place is yummy delicious..ambience awesome !I food was very tasty..I go every day if my wife let me

Delicious food again. The fried rice is a must and their BBQ Sea bass is incredibly tasty and perfectly cooked.
Uncle Yu’s is my favorite restaurant in the Tr- Valley area! Nick is a fantastic owner and host. The food is excellent and the wine list is outstanding! Great place to cleanly occasion!
I would place Uncle Yu Restaurant among some of the top chinese food I have had.
Lunch or dinner, this place never disappoints.  The food is always excellent with its creative specialty dishes, staff is friendly, great atmosphere.

Amazing cuisine…every dish has its own texture and spices. I could live on their pad thai! Bell is the perfect attendant, Ben was her right hand. It was wonderful to see Sonny again, too. A perfect meal!

Got to the restaurant earlier than our reservation.  Went to the bar and had delicious drinks.  Hostess came and got us when table was ready.  Waiter attended to us very quickly despite busy Sunday night.  They didn't have the desired egg rolls but suggested an alternative.  Food came quickly.  Shortly after we started eating the waiter said that the egg rolls were ready and that they were on the house.  Nice gesture.  Food delicious.  Service impeccable.  Ambience always nice...an exuberant party next to us raised the noise level, but they were just having fun.  Nice evening out.

This is now my favorite Chinese place. My husband and I are Chinese. We ordered wagyu beef chow fun, honey walnut shrimp, chicken fried rice, string beans and shrimp har gau. I love that they have a gluten-free menu and got almost all of our dishes from that menu. I would definitely recommend this place!

Food was delicious as always. We noticed new dishes being used…looked nice…but we also noticed the portions were smaller. I was disappointed, I’d rather pay a few bucks more and get the previous amount of food. I know prices are going up, raise the price don’t make the meal smaller.
An incredible place.  Simply the best Restaraunt in town.  Try the dim sum platter!
We had a prix fix meal with wine. Fantastic. It will always be what I look for when we return to this great restaurant
Not a fan of the music selection and volume but food is great.
I always enjoy this place.Great service and awesome food..if I have a complaint but it's a little complaint...The restrooms need to be maintained better.
I love the unique Asian fusion and THE FLAVORS!! John the server was highly attentive and gave excellent service!  Always a favorite!
Always a great dining experience at Uncle Yu’s. The food was fantastic and our server, Alex did a great job.
Consistently good.  Very wide and nice selections on the menu.  Very courteous staff.
Uncle Yu’s never disappoints!  Always reliably delicious food in a beautiful setting, easy parking, friendly hosts, and the best quality dishes.

Very highly recommended. It’s always a great experience. Every dish we’ve tried has been superb. Quiet enough considering that the place was packed (even on a Monday)! Looking forward to going again soon!
Everything - the food, service, ambience was great!!

Great food & service, tasty drinks. Highly recommend

After much fuzz and wait we got a table - while I am still fuming my wife says that we should call the restaurant directly to confirm availability instead of wasting our time on reservation apps.

The atmosphere was very nice! I think they need to reevaluate/retrain the service staff to provide Better /attentive service to the clients.

Enjoyable early dinner for 2 couples with a reservation, indoors around 5pm it is less crowded and quieter, the service is attentive but not rushed or pushy. We picked a comparatively less expensive bottle of pinot noir from their impressive 25 page wine list, and it was very good.  Loved the smoked duck wraps.

Usually the service is good but today it was bad.

Always wonderful service from Juan. Food never disappoints! Lively atmosphere. A true favorite for lunch or dinner.

a must visit for excellent madarin food and atmosphere. keep up the good work

Always a great place for a very good dinner and great service!

Where do I even start? I was really looking forward to trying this place given the high reviews and that we are so close. The food was absolutely terrible! I think my Manhattan was the only thing which I actually liked. Other than that, everything from the appetizers to the main course was just so bad. I’m giving it an overall three stars because our waitress was really nice and tried to make it up to us.
We ordered the 4 appetizer combo plate. They ran out of the goat cheese wontons which was supposed to be apart of the plate and we ordered that esp so the vegetarian on the table could have it. We asked they sub it for another vegetarian app. It came out with nothing vegetarian but rather everything being seafood based. To comp us, they gave the table vegetarian spring rolls. The entire app plate for the rest of us was severely fried to where it was chewy, greasy and not to mention bland.
The garlic noodles hardly had any garlic and was basically a plate of ramen style noodles with butter and some chives on top.
The Szechuan Shrimp was probably the worst dish on the table. We ordered it because we thought it would be peppery and spicy. Traditionally, Szechuan cooking uses peppercorns and chilies. This had neither - rather a ketchup based pungent sauce was the base with a ton of diced onions floating around in the sauce. Simply awful. We are a few bites and just couldn’t do it anymore.
The sea bass - a $45 dish - was bland, chewy and simply not worth it. It was set aside zucchini and some other vegetables in a miso sauce.
Our tofu (which again was ordered by the vegetarian) never came out, so they gave it to us to go. The vegetarian person literally had the egg rolls and the noodles for dinner.
We were comped for some of our meal but man, what a bad bad experience in terms of the food quality and taste.
Also, there were so many fruit flies swarming over our food. I now see other reviews mention the same. Solution?
The night of we all had stomach aches.

We love the restaurant, but we’re a bit disappointed in the food this time.

One of THE best Chinese food restaurants you will ever have. Some of their outstanding dishes are app Lobster Shumai, garlic noodles, generals chicken, honey walnut prawns.

Instead of sitting outside in the heat, we sat at the bar to eat.  Had crab cakes for an appetizer which were very good.  For dinner had the fried rice with crab and Wagyu beef with orange.  I didn't realized the latter would be deep fried.  Could not really taste it.  It was good still!  Had an older Chardonnay which was suggested by the bartender and it was a perfect pairing!  For dessert, had the flourless chocolate cake which was decadent.  I always have a great dining experience there.

The place was sparsely filled but we had to wait for service and then for our food and ultimately we had to wait for our check.  The young man who waited on us was pleasant but that is the only thing pisitive I can say about a very disappointing, over-priced experience.
Great meal and service as usual.
Always an outstanding meal at an outstanding restaurant.
Consistently good.  Excellent food quality, taste and presentation.
It was great!
Love Uncle Yu's... The Lobster Shumai are not to be missed. Tried the Orange Peel Beef for the first time, excellent sweet and spicy, very yummy. Fun to go before a concert at the Bankhead Theater!

We had a party of eight and decided to order family style. The appetizers, Lotus Chicken and Pot Stickers, were the perfect starters for the group. Main courses included orange beef, sautéed string beans, honey walnut prawns, kung po chicken and rice. All the dishes came out quickly and hot. Everyone was satisfied with the portions, with only rice left over. The cappuccino tartufo and hazelnut torte were the big hits for desert. 

Nick helped with the wine selections...Cuda Ridge merlot and a Steven Kent Cab paired with dinner. Alegre Koden Rioja was perfect with desert. 

The servers worked as a team, filling glasses, delivering dishes and removing serving platters. 

Can't wait to go again.

I have enjoyed everything I have tried at Uncle Yu's. This time I came back specifically for the Crab fried rice. It is the best there! We started with Baked Bass appetizer. Sooo delicious. It's even better with Prosecco. We also added Broiled shrimp and vegetables and we shared scallops.  This entire combo was like a taste of gold and enough food to carry away for another meal. 

Our friend from out of town was definitely impressed.
Always great food and wonderful service. Can get loud dining indoors.
Food, beverages and ambiance were great.  Disappointed in our server, Derek.  He was uninterested and inattentive.
Thanks for another delicious Friday Night!
Daughter home for a visit.
Food was great but certain staff were not friendly which made it uncomfortable since the majority of the staff were white and we are Black.
a very nice place for celebration, first time to visit and was not disappointed
Food was so good and the service was excellent they were very friendly and helpful.Definitely will be back😄
Food too salty

My wife and I had Crabmeat Stuffed Prawns, BBQ Sea Bass, Beef with Asparagus, Pork Fried Rice and Stir Fried Mixed Vegetables.  All dishes were excellent.  We took home enough left overs for a second dinner at home.

We eat lightly at night and found the choices here very good.  The crab-stuffed shrimp is a must-try.  Amazing flavors and textures - it's just a great dish. They elevate the most normal Chinese food.  Kung Pao happy family includes scallops, shrimp and Wagyu beef.  You really taste the better flavor with that beef.

We didn't drink, but the wine list looked great and there were so many other dishes we wanted to try.  It's a bit of an oasis in a busy place and felt luxurious.  It was a little cool, but their patio area is definitely lovely.  A large city parking lot is available just before you get there, making parking easy.

We had a reservation for 3 at 8:30 pm and expected a nice dinner with our friend. Unfortunately, we had to wait 1 hour and 15 minutes to get our food after we ordered them and some of them were already cold. No follow up from the server,  no apology. It was very disappointing.
One of my favorite places to eat in Livermore. The sea bass is absolutely incredible! I get it every time. Everything was great as usual.
Delightful
Server was quite busy. Kitchen forgot our soups (or server never put in the ticket for them). Food is always good.
Very clean and spacious, speedy service, great food and amazing bartender!
Lovely patio table with a really attentive server. Food was excellent as always. Love the place!
Fantastic meal. Great service. Love this place.
Delicious food, as always! And the outdoor patio was lovely!
Always good food and enjoyable surroundings.  Nice place to catch up with old friends.
The evening started with a very knowledgeable waitress. She helped us get drinks that complimented our meal and introduced us to some of the changes in the Uncle Yu’s menu.
Fantastic food and service. Great wine selection. May want to skip the desserts.
The lobster shaumai and bbq Chilean sea bass….Perfect!

Great food, nice ambience (we sat indoors for lunch)! Loved the dumplings tray with a variety of dumplings. Pan seared scallops were delicious! Food quality and presentation are superb. Look forward to going there again.

Post pandemic reunion with a close friend. Food was great. As usual. We ordered 2 apps and 4 mains. Singapore noodles is always a must for us. A must go to place in Livermore if you’re celebrating a special occasion. NOT your garden variety Chinese restaurant. Uncle Yu’s is primo!

It had been a very long time since I dined at Uncle Yu's. 
The time was perfect. It was well spaced, excellent food. We 
ordered the best crab fried rice ever! Also, Spicy Chef Prawns and  Crispy Eggplant. All were very ample portions. I did not care for Prosecco, but everything else was wonderful.
The food is outstanding.  The flavors are right on.  Love this place.
Great experience! Our reservation was at 8:45 but didn’t realize they close at 9 pm. Everyone was still great and food was delicious! No complaints here! We will definitely be coming back.

The food was good but expensive. In fact it was more expensive than we thought when we ordered. When we were seated we were handed actual menus with prices listed with the food. However, when our check came, we were charged more than the menu posted. I made the server aware of this discrepancy but he just said we should have used the virtual menu. We were not made aware of the QR coded menu until after I gave feedback. Also beware of wine glass prices: "taste" portions are what most restaurants post as a "glass" of wine. Bottom line: tricky pricing.
Uncle Yu's always comes through , never had a bad dish there.

Made a reservation for 12:30 got right in 
We were given option of inside or outside.
Our meal was very good.  Service was friendly and all the waiters worked together to make sure all tables had what was needed(water, silverware).  A favorite for us.
Mother’s Day visit
Dinner was amazing.  Our server was attentive. Great sitting outside.

Crab stuffed prawns!! A must have.
Matthew the server provided friendly and welcoming service!
The bartender made the PERFECT martini with a layer of ice on top. Amazing.
Another great experience.  Food is always consistently good.

We had lunch on a Saturday with reservations and a party of 6. The food was delicious and presented beautifully! The service was impeccable and the staff adhered to Covid guidelines. We definitely will return!
Google Pay didn’t work
food so dilicious definitely strong recommended and going back there again.

My family/friends have been enjoying lunch/dinner at Uncle Yu’s since it opened in Livermore years ago.It was always a favorite place to celebrate birthdays, be it dining w/ a large group or just an intimate dinner.We were always greeted at the door w/ a genuine hello & the wait-staff was friendly & familiar–always with a kind word of “welcome” or “nice to see you again”.
Unfortunately, this is no longer the case. During the initial stages of the pandemic, we ordered take-out, as we really like the food.When the restaurant reopened, initially for outdoor dining only, we jumped at the chance to come back.We have been back several times, also with friends on some occasions. However, the welcoming place we had come to know no longer  exists. No warm welcome & things have changed… sadly, not for the better.
During our last visit, we made online reservations. It did not mention the choice of inside dining. We inquired about that option when we arrived and saw no less than 6-7 adequately spaced empty tables…We were told rather curtly “your options are better outside”, a rather odd phrasing. After we had been seated, a server came by w/water & spilled the entire bottle on our table--splashing on me, as well as my husband. Of course, it was an accident & he did express his apologies.We had to move to another table & we requested one on the inside of the restaurant. We were both a bit wet, it was a chilly evening/quite windy.The server said he would be sure to get us an inside table due to these circumstances. Well, that did not happen-we were moved to another outdoor table.We should have left the restaurant at that point....Our waiter made no mention of our being doused w/water when he arrived. A cup of hot tea would have been a nice gesture or an acknowledgment from management.
After our entrees were consumed & the plates cleared-silence.Then after 10 mins. the waiter asked if he could “offer the check."What happened to dessert? We felt rushed/dismissed,& will not be back.
The food was amazing. The employees were super nice.
Outdoor seating a little loud due to street noise
Excellent food, great selection of specials, and an extraordinary win list make this a must place to eat
Food and service are both consistently very, very good.
Splurged on the taster menu with the wine pairing, and it was outstanding!
Patio is a great spot to meet friends for an outdoor visit and good food.

We came here for my birthday. The food was delicious. Our server was thoughtful to check in with us when she could tell the food was taking longer. We appreciated her transparency. We had a great experience and look forward to coming back.
Gluten free options were available and much appreciated.  We shared a salad, 2 appetizers and 2 entrees and 3 cocktails....everything was delicious.  Service was excellent.

This was most likely our 10th visit to this restaurant. The faire is exquisite each and every time! Our favorites are the crab fried rice, crispy eggplant, bbq sea bass and the chef’s special dim sum!  I highly recommend Uncle Yu’s at the Vineyard.

This place is always excellent. I bring my niece and friends here for their birthdays. I enjoy the service. The staff is always nice and professional. The food is outstanding. This is my go to Chinese restaurant. I drive two hours to get here and it’s always worth the drive

For the price point, service should be more upscale and server more attentive. Folks clearing tables throwing old drinks on bushes and loudly stacking glasses. No one offered to light our heat lamp and we could not get someone to do it. We waited a long time to put in our order. Food was great and consistent with other visits. We have both worked in comparable restaurants prior and feel someone should pay better attention to the front of the house.

We had an awful service last night. Our waiter was MIA most of the times. At the end of the night, there were no staff that we can see...it’s as if they all took a break all at the same time.
