We had to wait 10-15 minutes to see our waiter so we can pay. Not the same level of service that I’m used to and been here many times!

Our first outing in a long time with 5 of us.  We very much enjoyed the ambiance.  Our server did an excellent job.  The food arrived quickly and was delicious. We lingered for several hours and did not feel rushed by the staff.  We usually do have a good experience at Uncle Yu's.  One of our party commented that it's the best ambiance in Livermore.

Great food always, Saturday nights can get hectic, which impact the service and wait for food  , still the food is always amazing.  We’re huge fans of sitting in Derek’s section when he’s working , he gets 5 stars from us .  His section on the nights we’ve gone is an exceptional experience and the reason we come back!
The food is always delicious here, but on this visit the Mongolian Lamb was exceptionally delicious.

It was a great experience. Rob was a great server and was very attentive to our table but also gave us space to enjoy each other’s company. But he was always there when we needed something. The cocktails were great, always consistent. Rob also was able to give us a ton of vegan options and recommend dishes based on things we liked. Love this place and definitely will continue to support!
Great service and delicious food.
It was our anniversary and everything was fantastic
The food was very good.  They have a nice selection of wines by the glass.  We sat outside on the patio on a cool night and the heaters kept us comfortable.
Food was very good, service good as well BUT they missed the fact it was a birthday dinner! Made the note when making reservation but nothing special was offered.
Some of the best Chinese food in Tri Valley
We love the food here! The outdoor set up is excellent. See you soon.

Uncle Yu's is our favorite place!  I took my wife there for her Birthday.  She had the Barbecued Sea Bass.  She normally doesn't like sea food, but I think she would eat this dish EVERY SINGLE DAY if she could.  It is her favorite thing (EVER).  It was awesome (as usual) - she was kind enough to let me sample...  I had the Mandarin Triple Crown which was fantastic.  All of the ingredients were cooked to perfection and the sauce is to die for.  Our Server (Jessica) was attentive, but not bothersome - she just happened to be there at exactly the right times and wasn't there when she wasn't needed,  Great personality and very knowledgeable about the menu and overall restaurant.  She was a very good asset to a perfect Date Night with my wife on her Birthday.
This is our special occasion restaurant. We have our favorite dishes that never disappoint. The prawns and walnuts dish and the garlic noodles - yum!!!

We’ve been trying to eat here the last few weeks but if you don’t have a reservation the wait is almost 2 hours. So we finally took the time and planned it and to be honest, we should’ve had the food to go. There was 2 in our party and they sat us in a circular table for 6! So we chose opposite ends because we were trying to avoid the walkway. The difficult part about it is trying to get to the food placed in the center to share them family style. 

The table was also right next to pedestrian pathway that is covered with a tarp. It was windy and the tarp kept slapping me on the face. The busboy and server could see this and wasn’t going to do anything about it. Then the server comes and asks if everything was okay while looking at another table. He was just so disingenuous about his question. 
Overall, it wasn’t a pleasant dine out experience.
Uncle Yu's never disappoints for local Chinese cuisine.
One of our favorite restaurants in Livermore. Amazing food and very unique Chinese food.
They have a good outdoor dining set up. The food is consistently good and the service is attentive . This restaurant has an excellent wine selection as well. Overall the attention to detail shows.
The food and service here are excellent! I will always recommend them as I've never had a bad meal here!!

We were there to celebrate a birthday.  We were seated immediately at a wonderful outside table. I don’t remember our servers name but he was awesome and didn’t rush us at all. Nick helped us with our wine selections and as always his choices were great!  When it came to dessert they brought out a slice of yummy chocolate cake for the birthday girl and an extra for the rest of us to share. Alway great wine, food and times at Uncle Yu’s!!
A wonderful place for a business lunch.
I enjoy the music and ambiance of the restaurant.
Food not as good as I remember.
Great staff service, wonderful food, as always!
Enjoy a Family Birthday....

Food is always good, and interior seating is very pretty. But now having to eat outside is not as great!  Food was almost cold...and outside setting is
nothing special.  Hope to get inside soon!

The food as usual was top notch.  Unfortunately, I think the outside dining concept might be more difficult to pull off here and the service suffers ... definitely not up to the standards we've come to expect at Uncle Yu's.

Our first time...but not our last.  Our server, Victor, was professional yet very friendly and efficient.  We loved the shrimp/walnut salad, the orange beef and the mixed seafood "fisherman's basket"?  The "spicy" Thai dumplings were not spicy in the least.  In fact, very bland.  But the rest of the food, service and ambiance were great.  See you soon!
Wonderful evening! Enjoyed everything about this place :-)

We had such a great time! We dined for dinner in March, so it was still pretty chilly and windy. Our waiter was very accommodating-he made sure that we had a heater and that we were away from the wind. The food was excellent. I highly recommend the Mongolian beef and Kung pao chicken. Their drinks are also tasty. My boyfriend and I ordered Cadillacs, and we were both pleased. We would definitely visit again!
Great food, service and atmosphere.  Highly recommended.  We will be back.
Always a great time. You can never go wrong at Uncle Yu’s.

The food was excellent, service was good.  We ordered the sea bass, wagyu chow fun and dry fried string beans (tempura style?) and was pleased with all dishes. The outdoor patio seating with heat lamps helped, but winter nights are still not ideal conditions.
went for valentines day dinner- food options in the pre crafted menu are yummy and cooked with utmost precision- i recommend for all the asian food lovers

Service was spot on. Disappointed with the menu not being same as online. Food was good but not 60 dollars per person good. Garlic noodles was the biggest disappointment. For an 8 dollar dish of noodles I expected more then a bowl of ramen noodles.
We found Uncle Yu’s by chance and we are so happy we did! The food is AMAZING, the staff is friendly and welcoming. We can’t say enough great things about this place!

Disclosure: rating is based on high hopes of the food based on other reviews. 

Pros: Great ambience in a great neighborhood, friendly staff and awesome service! Noodles was the shining plate of the night for flavor

Cons: for the price tag on the food I was expecting more - Sea Bass didn’t meet my expectations and the rest of the meal items although tasty seemed overpriced and should have more bang in flavor

Summary: good to try out for a date night - based on the four items we had I believe you will be paying more for the ambience than the food

Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard is one of our favorite restaurants in town.  The food is delicious and the atmosphere is nice without being stuffy.  The chilean sea bass and orange peel beef are two of our must-haves each time we go.  The food is a little pricier than most Chinese food restaurants, but it is well worth the cost.  I highly recommend Uncle Yu's if you want a delicious meal and are willing to pay a bit more for it!
Nice set up outside. Food was good so was the service. Maybe a little bit pricey, seems more as usual. We definitely will come back. If it gets colder more heaters needed...

The food and service are always outstanding, even in these times outdoor dining, Uncle Yu’s always makes the experience special. We had the sea bass which was fabulous! And the combination fried rice, with large shrimp, pieces of chicken and pork is a meal in itself!
The food was excellent as always. We got to sit right next to a heater so the temperature was good. Our waiter was very good. One of our favorite places to eat. Ther food is always very fresh.
The flavors here are unbeatable to ,y knowledge. This is excellent Chinese food and the sauces are supreme!
I was allowed to make a reservation just to arrive to them advising there are closed. Update your hours of operation!
My boyfriend wanted to go here because his friends always post about this place and honestly it was so good.
Food was ok, couldn’t really enjoy it because the flavor was not up to par.
Love this place. Great food. Good service. Will always dine here when possible.

Every dish we ordered tasted so delicious.Same thing goes for the drinks/ cocktails. Service was excellent, very accommodating 
Will definitely come back
It was raining when we were there, but they were prepared for the weather and outside seating with canopies and heaters.
Okay, yeah... it's a little pricey for Chinese food, but it was SOOOO good! Go, split some dishes with friends. It's worth it.

We ate outside and unfortunately it was very cold even with the heaters. Our service was really good, however and the food was delicious as always. We tried a new ppetizer, salmon spring rolls. They were great.

I ordered appetizers and 2 entree. Everything was very tasty and was served warm. The service there was first rate and I appreciated it. I have to say I was very impressed with the quality of the food and ate every last bite. I would definitely return here.

So outside on a chilly night.  Did their best to move heaters.  Still freezing.  But amazing service and  delish food. No complaints.  Thanks for trying to work within the restrictions.  We had a great time.

It was chilly on Friday.  They had several tables that were "reserved" that they would not seat us at even though we had a reservation.  Instead, they put it at a table without a heat lamp.  Several tables had more than one heat lamp.  We ended up leaving before they took our order as we did not feel welcome.
Delicious food great service beautiful restaurant.  We sat outside it was lovely.   Thanks very much. We visit often and are so glad you are open!
Food prices have gone up and quality has gone down.
Once again another amazing meal. Our server Joan is the best. She always remembers my favorite cocktail and has excellent suggestions. I love all the food at Uncle Yu's. I love trying new items.
With the weather changing, please consider more heaters for outside dining. Very cold as heaters had to be shared.

Food was pretty good.  Not as good as we remembered.  The prices have been raised ALOT and now you have to pay extra for the rice that used to come with the meal.  No soup/salad anymore either.  So the value has gone way down!  Would I return?  Not for a casual meal.  We could go somewhere "fancy" for what we paid for this Chinese food, which we usually think of as less expensive fare.

This place did not disappoint. The entire menu sounded amazing. The wine list paired so well with the food menu. The fried rice Wagyu style was delicious. The meat was perfectly cooked and the flavor was perfectly paired well with the rice and veggies.
Excellent food and a pleasant dining experience.  Will repeat for sure.
Food, drinks and service fantastic!  Definitely one of my favorite restaurants!
Good prices

The experience was good and felt safe in regards to pandemic precautions. Most of our food was very good. The big disappointment was the Chinese chicken salad for our guest. It was just not up to par with other entree’s and one would think that salad would be exceptional. I could buy a salad kit from Costco that would have tasted better.
The atmosphere is always outstanding, and the food is always impeccable with taste and flavor.

Decided to go to Uncle Yu’s with some out-of-town friends. They were looking for a place that offered a gluten-free menu and Uncle Yu’s did. We had a great time. The cocktails were amazing and the food and service were even better. Sitting outside under the lights was great. Couldn’t have asked for a better meal or dining experience.
Great for a Birthday

Our meal was delicious! Never experienced a bad meal and always look forward to returning.  Some the dishes are pricey (Sea Bass) but it is the best dish on the menu...in my opinion.    Asked for soy sauce twice and never received it, although won't result in me not returning.
We sat out on the patio, we had an amazing dinner.

The reason for the less than 5’s-
1) out of propane and kind of chilly. And there was an available heater lamp!  But no propane. 
2) more guests than staff!  Our food came very slowly - and we didn’t even have silverware or plates yet!
Great service. Excellent food.
Had a great time at my friends Bday food and service was delicious
Couple next to us were coughing the whole time and the big party of 10 on the right side of us were talking so loud without masks while standing. We felt extremely uncomfortable.
Not cheap but worth every penny if you want the best Chinese food in town.

The food was excellant as always; however, there seemed to be plenty of help on duty but service was very slow.  We weren't in a hurry but from start to finish our meal was 2 hours.  Don't miss out on the Garlic Noodles!

We had brought family and friends from out of town and it was very special because we could always be guaranteed Uncle Yu’s would serve us well not only with wonderful service but delicious food and ambience even though we’re all under Covid dining now it kind of made it special to sit outside

The food was great! Service wise, our waiter was not very friendly. RARELY checked in with us and gave us updates on why the food was taking longer than expected. Wish I wrote his name down, but he has 3/4 tattoo sleeve.

Uncle Yu's is a favorite and go to restaurant for me when looking for a place to dine in Livermore.  It is an upscale Chinese restaurant that offers good value and ambience for the money.  It is nice to eat off of a white table cloth without paying "white table cloth prices".
This place is incredible. We ordered a large spread of dishes and shared them all. Will definitely be going back next time I'm up in Livermore!

Food was very good, but wait between courses was a bit long. Guessing was due to servers having to bring food out to the extended patio maybe. We weren't in a hurry so was wasn't a big issue. Would definitely dine here again though.

We were seated in the patio (per my opentable request) which was great. The server took his time coming and we ordered drinks and appetizers, then dinner. we finished the small appetizers and waited and waited for the dinner - we asked the server when we saw him and he said that he was 'giving us time with the appetizers' - well, he could have asked us! My friend had the salmon and snap peas - she enjoyed the snap peas but the salmon looked like 'chicken nuggets' and was dry on the inside but sauced on the outside. The thin-sliced lamb was tender but had quite a few pieces of gristle mixed in. altogether an unmemorable meal especially for $115+ before tip. Not likely to go back anytime soon.
The food and service were both very good.  I was highly recommend Uncle Yu’s!
Server Lukas was great.

Everything was well done the food was fine, the wine list is extensive and we had a really really nice lunch. The patio is covered so the sun is not beating down. we’re still obviously In COVID mode and social distancing but they did a really good job of keeping tables separated and with tagteam service everything was really good and service excellent.

Our anniversary dinner out during unhealthy air quality and pandemic. Service was okay- we had two different staff members ask for our drink orders. The food was just okay- nothing spectacular. Unfortunately the two different entrees we ordered came with the same sauce, which was hoisin sauce . The menu called the sauce for one entree’ haunting sauce’ so we were surprised when it was just hoisin.

The food is always fantastic. I went there the other night with my daughters, and we just had appetizers for the full meal since they are all so delicious. I highly recommend the lobster shumai, peking duck spring rolls, crabmeat cheese puffs, and bbq ribs. I'm also a big fan of their mu shu pork!
The food was delicious and the service was outstanding.
Excellent food. Excellent service.  Our waiter was awesome. The food was too.  Highly recommend UY!
GF lunch - quiet setting on the patio, outstanding service and exceptional meal, as always! Uncle Yu’s is a stand out favorite
It was very nice we could visit and the food was great!
Our family was absolutely stunned at the quality of the food!  We especially loved the Peking Ribs!!  The best ribs any of us ever had.  Ever!
It was just wonderful to get out of the house and have one of my favorite meals in a warm and familiar environment...it felt very pre-Covid

Everything was great! The host starting by preparing a great table, followed by quick service and excellent food. With all of the restriction around covid, Uncle Yu’s was very accommodating and I couldn’t have asked for a better evening.

Retirement luncheon.  Service was a little slow for the restaurant that was not very busy.  Food was ok.  I’ve eaten here many times but it appears the quality has gone down. Chow mein side on lunch special was tasteless and dry, salmon portion was very small in comparison to vegetables.  Veg egg rolls were mushy inside.  Lunch specials are a little expensive in my opinion.  $15-$18 each is a bit much.

Overall:  3 stars

One of my favorite restaurants in Livermore. My husband and I go here at least once a week. During the shelter in place we still ordered take out from here. We were so happy to see it was open for outdoor dining. Everything is good here. I have not had a bad meal here.
Friends getting together for their monthly lunch together

Birthdays... we decided to do the 4 course tasting menu and wine pairing. It was phenomenal!! Great pours and exceptional food! Our server , Bell , was very informative about all of the food  and wine, and did an excellent job pacing the whole dinner. I would definitely do it again!!🍷
The food and the service was excellent everything everything came really quick that appetizers were great our server was really outgoing and nice so overall I would recommend this place to anybody
The 2nd time I've been there with a reservation and had to wait 15min+ to be seated. Waiters are very friendly and attentive though.
Rob is the best bartender in town if you want a basil lemon drop. Food is always great. One of our go to places .
A little pricey but worth it. Flavorful. Quality ingredients.

Great food and service!

But we were seated next to the door and every time it opened, we got blasted with a cold draft.......
We were placed in the back room which can be a bit noisy but thankfully it was a quieter evening so it wasn’t an issue.
Great meal as always
Had a great evening here, excellent service, amazing wine list and fantastic food!  We'll be back!
Chris gave outstanding service. He was very attentive.  Major Kudos

Had a wonderful Sunday night dinner. There were four of us eating. We had two appetizers: eggplant and egg rolls. And 5 dishes for the main course: pad Thai, Waugh fried rice, sweet and sour pork, Mongolian beef and honey prawns. The fried eggplant was very yummy and a little but sweet. Pad Thai was super delicious. the Mongolian beef and prawns were a must. Egg rolls were mediocre along w the sweet and sour pork. The service was great. We had a small table and had to squeeze in our plates. In addition a large table sat near us and were pretty loud but not horrible. Overall it was a delicious and filling dinner. Will definitely recommend.
While the theme was Valentine's Day and the string instruments are appreciated.  The restaurant is just too small to support.  It made trying to enjoy the conversation of my table impossible

Again, Uncle Yu’s delivers a terrific assortment of eats!  My favorites this dinner was were the lobster dumpling and  the special salad!  I could not have been happier!   The atmosphere was buzzing with a string quartet playing in the background!  Can’t wait for February 14 to come again!  This was the third or fourth year going to the Valentine celebration!  Always different and always yummy! Well done Uncle Yu’s!!!
I loved the atmosphere and kindness of all the staff. The food was amazing and I plan to go back!
One of, if not the best places in Livermore to eat. We have never had a bad experience here

Dining here was a very nice experience for me and my husband. We like a good ambiance, awesome staff/service, excellent food and drinks, and we got it! Don't expect large portions like a normal family style restaurant because this is not what you're going to get. But if you can appreciate a very nice gourmet style restaurant, then you would love this place. We ordered 2 appetizers, 3 entrees and 2 deserts, and all were delicious! We also had cocktails and they did not disappoint. We will definitely be back next time we are in Livermore.

The food as always was very good. Our server, Aubry, was terrific! Our only complaint was the table location. We were sat at the back of the restaurant near the service station. These are horrible seats. The noise from the service station is intrusive and 2 guests have to face the back of the restaurant and the service station which is distracting. Suggest blocking the service area a bit more to reduce the noise, and considering turning the tables so that no guests are facing the back wall.
This was a special occasion (birthday dinner) for a long time friend.  The service was wonderful and the food was excellent.  His martini was perfect!
This is a nice place but very pricey for the portion size.  Food is always great!  Seems in the last year or so the portions have gotten smaller.  Overall, it's worth it but be prepared for this.
Delicious food, great customer service and friendly staff. Couldn’t ask for a better Chinese restaurant in downtown.
As always we had a great meal and wonderful service!

Uncle Yu is one of my favorite Livermore restaurants. Unfortunately, my husband and I had forgotten it was Chinese New Year and the restaurant was crowded and noisy.  We waited about twenty minutes to be seated, even though we had reservations. No fault of the staff. People just weren’t leaving. For the most part, the food was good. Chicken on the chicken salad was dry. Other than that, the other dishes were delicious. Will definitely be back.

We were celebrating a birthday. Been here a few times and enjoy the food and experience, though this time the waiter wasn’t as attentive as usual, especially when it wasn’t as busy as it usually is. Hopefully it will be better next time.
Great food that never disappoints.
Absolutely wonerful.  My favorite restaurant in Livermore.

Food was good, but pricy for dim sum. Service absolutely terrible. Waited 20 minutes for a check. Had to ask for things twice, long wait to take order. Ended up walking to the bar to get a drink refill myself, because after the glass sat empty for a good 15 minutes we flagged our waiter and asked for a refill. Another 15 minutes later still did not have it. Painful!
We went here for the first time and everything was great. I am not a Chinese food fan but I really liked Uncle Yu's. It will be my go to place from now on.
All the dishes were excellent, but everyone especially liked the spare ribs, delicious & attractively presented.
Food and service were great! We had a nice family meal, best part is that with a 5 & 6 year we were in and out in an hour!
First time to Uncle Yu’s and will definitely be back. So many great menu options. The food is amazing!
Uncle Yu's never disappoints, although parking can be tricky at times
As usual... excellent food and service.

NYE lunch with loved ones.  This was my  10th visit.  Excellent as usual...the chef’s dim sum was just delightful.  I also had a champagne flight which was refreshing.  Don’t miss the crispy eggplant nor the bbq sea bass.
This is one of our favorite restaurants in the area. Food and service were awesome! Great wine selection too.

Food and service were great in a nice ambiance 
It was not busy since we went for lunch at 1:30 so mileage may vary if busy

We had an amazing first visit at Uncle Yu’s. I have to really compliment the amazing service! Our waiter was very pleasant, friendly and provided us with a 5 star excellent service! Hands Down! A great dining experience is not only about the food- but about how you, as a patron is treated. Unfortunately, I forgot our waiters name- so sorry. He made us feel like he appreciated us being there. He’s someone who truly knows how to make a guest feel welcome, and this goes a very long way. Forget the food...although it was spectacular too! Uncle Yu... I’ll be back with my friends! Love the place, the food and the amazing service!

We waited a long time to be served which cut into our wine tasting agenda. It was the day after Christmas so I understand they might have been shorthanded. I ordered the crispy prawns on the lunch menu. The sauce was so sweet and heavy handed that I did not notice that it was chicken until I had eaten a good portion. The other plate was the salmon which was better.We chose this restaurant hoping for healthy, tasty, light fare. Will eat elsewhere next time. Also chose it for the wine flights featured on the website. No trace of flights on the wine menu.
My family had a really good time.  We have been coming to Uncle Yu’s for the past 8 years for Christmas Eve.
With friends.  A wonderful experience
The food is good as are the cocktails.  When busy it’s a bit noisy and the service slows down a bit but I like it
Variety and quality of food here is always great.  Nice dining room.   Always recommend!
Been here on a few different occasions and have absolutely loved each one! The service staff are incredibly attentive and friendly. The food is delicious! Definitely recommend for a good meal!
62nd Anniversary celebration
Great food and friendly service. Make sure to make reservations! They have a full page of gluten free options which js great!
Celebrated family Christmas dinner... food and service was fantastic (as usual).
Service was unusually slow - not often a problem here. Maybe they had some no-shows.
All eleven of us enjoyed a wonderful lunch today. Our server Jake did a great job. The food was delicious and staff here is awesome!
We had a party of 10. Excellent service. Love the large round table with the lazy Susan in the center. And the food was excellent!
Arrived on time and was almost seated after a walk in couple. Hostess and host need to have better communication. Overall happy with the service
Just fantastic!  Best and most interesting Chinese menu we've ever had.  Beautiful restaurant.  Definitely plan to return!  Don't miss it!!!

We have enjoyed Uncle Yu's restaurant in Lafayette for many years.  We no longer live in California, so when we were back for a visit to Napa in September we stopped for lunch -- unfortunately the restaurant was closed due to a fire.  

We had another short trip this week, staying at a hotel in Livermore.  We were very pleased/suprised to see Uncle Yu's had a restaurant in Livermore.  The venue was more upscale than Lafayette, the noise level higher, and the food significantly spicier.  The service (Juan) was excellent.

Would I return?  Yes.  But not order any spicy dishes!
Got stuck in the back room and it was not festive,no music etc.  not that busy in main dining room either.

It was fine its just never as good as you think its going to be. So I had made a reservation and somehow the table is never ready and you have to wait for 10 minutes while they set it. I thought that was the whole point of making a reservation. Also this is a kind of special occasion restaurant and they never seem to make you feel special. The service isnt bad - its just not great.  They do make a point of speedily clearing plates even if you havent finished and making you feel hurried. All in all I have been here about 6 times and I think thats enough chances to get it right. So in conclusion, it's fine but I prefer to spend my $ on amazing!!
Excellent, as always 😊
Food is always amazing...excellent service received tonight from Aubrey... everyone delivered their A game!

We always have a great time at Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard.  First, there is a great vibe to the restaurant: warm, welcoming, and friendly.  The staff is fantastic!  Like all restaurants, some servers are a notch or two above the others but everyone is good here (if you are seated in Matthew's station, you will have the best time ever, he is awesome).  Lastly, the food is always top shelf!  There is great variety and they will customize a dish to your liking (some dishes we ask for "no spicy seasoning" and others we ask for"no onions/chives" and there is never a problem.  Nick is always available for wine recommendations; he has always done a great job for us in helping select just the right wine. This is one of the best "finer restaurant" choices in the Tri-Valley.  We highly recommend Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard.
Great server, food was excellent, beverages were well prepared, extra noisy group also in the restaurant at the same time
Too much salt in the food. Others in my party concurred.  Long time customer and love Nike’s place   Hope this feedback helps address a potential problem in the kitchen.
Good food and service. Parking was a bit tough, but able to find a spot nearby

The Livermore downtown has over achieved.  It took 20 minutes to find a parking spot at 5:30.  That was after circling and ending up 2 blocks away.  The restaurant had wonderful food a relatively low prices, as I have seen for 10 years.  It was quite busy and noise level was the highest I have seen there.  Not nice.
The food and service were amazing and didn’t interrupt the follow of the conversation

We loved the pairing menu, especially the beef tenderloin. The wine was on-point as always. 

But. The restroom situation is something that has to be resolved. The ladies room could’ve been a scene after a rave. Each stall was out of toilet paper, debris all over the floor... it was a gross mess! After all these years I hope the owner decides to do something to make the restrooms private, because they’re a mood killer! 🤢

Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard is our go to social occasion place. We've celebrated every important family occasion there for over 10 years. The service is outstanding, the sauciers are magical and it's a lovely space. We love food and travel the entire bay area to explore restaurants, but sometimes, there's no place like home, especially when it's so good. Clarin, Justin and Belle set the standard for excellent service, and always make us feel like family. There are many reasons this pace is always packed, so a reservation is with the effort. Don't miss the pork corn and shrimp dumplings and the crispy eggplant. Enjoy!

Overall, restaurant was okay. Food was average. The Singapore noodles were by far the best. Wine selection good but pricey. Also, it was quite loud. The food could definitely be better given the prices. Also, their fish was overcooked (Petrale sole)

We celebrated my husband’s birthday at Uncle Yu’s this year and the entire family loved it.  We ate family style and every dish was delicious.  Great service and atmosphere as well.  Thank you, Uncle Yu’s for a perfect dinner out with family!
Love this place. Crab fried rice is amazing. Wine list is outstanding. I can’t eat most Chinese food but I can eat here because there is no msg.
Consistently great food and drinks at Uncle Yu’s. One of our go to places on the weekends

The place was crazy busy for a Tuesday night.  All was good.  Although I made a reservation, we had to wait about 15 minutes for a table.  That was okay as there was a spot at the bar.  Good stuff all around.
We had a delicious dinner after a day of wine tasting. The service was very prompt and courteous, food was delicious and the price was just right.  Will definitely recommend to friends and be back.

We always love Uncle Yu - food is hot and delicious, prompt, the drinks are good (great wine list) and the service is friendly. Mom has a great time celebrating. We will def come again. General Tsao chicken and the garlic pepper shrimps were deliciousness on a plate.
Food was amazing. The dim sum was delicious. Very extensive wine list.
All was good, we celebrated my husbands Birthday and relatives really enjoyed the food.
Always a great destination!  Food and drink wonderful, outdoor patio was perfect for a warm afternoon with plenty of shade.  Accommodated our large group of 10 plus high chair without any issues.

sin we with friends this evening. Food was amazing, as always. Server was not very personable. Felt like he was bothered that he had to serve our table. Definitely disappointed in the server’s attitude. 
 But again, food was outstanding. Love Uncle Yu’s!
Only problem was the  long wait to be seated after we arrived at our reservation time.
Very good!
Our server was awesome - very easy going. Had a great time!

Made a reservation for my anniversary and the hostess seemed uninterested when we told her. We were sat and then had our order taken by “Robbie” I believe, who also seemed uninterested in serving us. The drinks came out no problem but the food took around 45 minutes to come out. This was made worse by the fact that 2 other large groups were seated after us and all got their food before us. When we finally got our food, my wife’s was unexpectedly deep fried and incredibly salty. The rest of the food was pretty good. No one ever checked back with us until it was time for us to go and we’d already been sitting for 20 minutes just waiting for the bill. We were treated like they didn’t want us there, and it ruined our anniversary night. Disappointed to say the least and we likely never come back
The food and service is great! Highly recommend a visit. Nick, the owner, is very helpful with choices.
Alway good food and experience at Uncle Yu, friendly staff and service.
Never disappoints!  My daughter and I love Uncle Yu's
Best restaurant in East Bay, hands down. Best service, food quality, food taste and ambiance. Plus, if you're a wine enthusiast, you will ADORE the wine selection.
Wonderful meal

wW have been to this restaurant many times...and have always liked it.  But the last 2 times we have
had a female server who is not enthused about her job.  We feel like it is a burden for her to help
us.  The bus boy Alex saved the day this time...he was exceptional and we tipped him.  We also
tipped the waitress 15% because she actually took our orders.   I am hoping we don't get her again.
Our group had Kung Pao Chicken,Combination Chow Mein, Beef Chow Fun, Curry Lamb, Singapore Rice Noodles and spinach dumplings. Food was all very good. Highly recommend this restaurant.
Uncle Yu’s was wonderful and the waygu beef and crab rice was exceptional!
Retirement dinner
Always excellent food, atmosphere and service! Working our way through the entire delicious menu.

We used to go here in San Ramon and unfortunately they closed that location. So we were really excited to see it is still in Livermore. This place is the only place I will go to for Chinese. Its fresh and so good!
good food and great service.
Excellent, as usual.

This is an attractive place with good service. This was my first visit and the food did not impress me. I imagine that with more experience I could make better selections. Our best dish was the YU SHANG EGGPLANT, followed by the CRISPY SALT AND PEPPER CALAMARI. Our other 3 dishes were mediocre.
We had a business lunch there and everything was excellent.

The food was phenomenal. The ambiance leaves a bit to be desired, the room was very loud. Service was decent, the waiter gave us space but didn’t really go the extra mile to orient us around large menu, which I would have done had I been the server. I would certainly return but hoping service and ambiance are a bit more refined next time, especially for the price point. Extensive wine list was very nice.

We have been going to Uncle Yu's since it opened in Livermore, and loved it.  Sad to say, the most recent dining experience, which was a birthday celebration, was a big miss.  We had to request for a new server, as the server, Belle, was quite rude and lacked people skills.   We also had to send back our eggplant appetizer because it was undercooked.    

Most disappointing was the restaurant manager, or someone, did not even acknowledge our concerns or apologized for the 2 incidents.  Maybe it was an off night for the wait staff and kitchen staff, but for the premium that Uncle Yu's is charging for Chinese food, may be best to explore other dining options in the area.
Had been to uncle yu’s every birthday celebration and my daughter love to eat here specially she keeps ordering the pecking duck. Nothing more unusual than the food are great.

I would  like to see on the menu two items:
Orange Chicken & Pork Fried Wonton. I like fried wonton, but not with cheese.
The food and the ambience is great. The price point has doubled in the last five years it’s grossly over priced
They missed a dish and it came after all we’re done eating,  same for the wine bottle we ordered early in process -  this is our second in a row subpar experience with service - food is good though

I drove from San Jose to eat at Uncle Yu’s because of a recommendation.  I enjoyed the food and the atmosphere.  I will return and try some of their other dishes that looked wonderful. I didn’t feel bloated with sodium.  😁👍

We only went there because we won an auction from our school. As I expected, this is not the authentic Chinese restaurant. This is really an American Chinese restaurant. 

The food is decent enough if you are White but not good enough if your are Asian. 

The decor and service are better than your true Chinese restaurants. 

If you want real Chinese food, go to Koi Garden in Dublin, 88 Bao Bao in Dublin and China Lounge in Pleasanton.
Uncle Yu's never disappoints.  Quiet Sunday morning, appetisers and out !!

Good food and ambience. The only concern I had was they mentioned all their dim sum have pork fat in it, which was not mentioned anywhere. However, we always ask, so we did and the server informed us. 
Overall good food and good selection of desserts.

Not your local typical Chinese restaurant so you won’t find the separate traditional menu.  Nice atmosphere, full bar, pricier and “fancy”.  I’m not a snob to the hole in the wall spots but if you’re looking for a nice ambiance and good food, this is the place!  I love their fried eggplant dish and the food is good, I’ll come back but know you’ll be spending a lot more than what you’d pay for the local spot in your strip mall.  Service was a bit slow but it was Friday and it was pretty packed. I won’t say no if friends say “Let’s go to Uncle Yu’s in Livermore!”

Our waiter was not attentive and not friendly at all. We were in a back room by ourselves and felt we were forgotten about. One order was wrong and the guy that brought it out actually argued with us. The Kung pao chicken was extremely salty!!!! 
It was our son’s birthday and the waiter brought him dessert and did not offer any of us the dessert menu to order and enjoy dessert with the birthday boy.
Overall very upsetting experience. 
Definitely will not be back.

Good friend and I meet every so often for a Matini and lunch.  We go slow and our server was  into our pace.  Tried some wine flights along with lunch.  Very good.  Food is always amazing, portions are generous.  Value is average or a bit above.  Will go back for sure!
Celebrated a friends birthday...the friendly service and good food along with glasses of lovely pinot made for a fun celebration!
Food was so super salty. And stale. Nothing was fresh. It was a very bad experience. The servers were fighting amongst themselves. It felt like we were dinning in a 1star restaurant.

We were seated outdoors which was nice.  There was a lady signing which enhanced the atmosphere.  This was a pleasant surprise. We happily ordered a few items from the Gluten Free menu (it's hard finding asian gluten free menu). The food and service was good.  The chicken wraps were refreshing and tasty.  The singapore noodles were okay (they had curry flavor, I'm not a curry fan).  THe scallops and prawns were good.  Eating GF asian is a hit and miss. I would come back and try other dishes. The non-GF items looked really tasty.  Huge wine list though on the expensive side.
Unreal level of food quality and presentation.  Whatever your favorite Chinese food dish is, get it there and it will be the single greatest experience of your life.   Pumpkin dumplings for life...

All great except I had advised them of a Birthday and there was no acknowledgement of it. We ordered a special dessert which we paid for so we could celebrate with no help from them. Disappointing close to an otherwise nice evening.
Service was excellent! Food was delicious and fresh. Everything was hot when it was served. Keep up the good work
As always, Uncle Yu's was great. We tried a Dim Sum dinner for a change and it was very tasty. Will do it again.
Lunch was great.
Uncle Yu's never disappoints.  We went to celebrate my birthday!  Love Uncle Yu's!

We were greeted promptly and a table was ready within minutes (we did have a reservation.) We chose to meet our group at the bar; the bartender was very friendly.  Our servers were also friendly, the food came out quickly and accurately.  We did feel a bit forgotten after that.  Furniture could use an update - one chair back was broken.  Overall, a nice dinner and we will return.
Uncle Yu’s is our go to for high quality Chinese food and all around classy ambiance. We bring guests to Uncle Yu’s and they always walk away raving about how good the food is. Highly recommend!
Our server seemed very disinterested and was slow to check on us.  She also seemed annoyed when we asked for clean plates between our appetizers and main course.

The lunch specials give you more choices for side dishes than usual.  Our two main courses were quite good but a bit different than other Chinese restaurants in the area.  Service was above average.  Choice of beers was good.
We had a great evening...my girlfriend loves Uncle Yu's and it was perfect!
Food and service were outstanding. Sat outside on a warm summer night, could not get any better!
We waited a long time for a server to attend to us. Once they straightened out their server issues, everything else was excellent.
We return here about once or twice a month. Every time we enjoy the food. Always excellent and consistent.  The live music on Sunday about 5pm is a special bonus.
Great food, service, and the best wine list in the area. Mathew and Michelle provided impeccable service.
The table of 8 next to us was very loud, spoiled the quiet ambiance we had anticipated. Also, slightly disappointed that there was only one Pinot Grigio on the wine list. Otherwise, excellent!
Food was good service was slow, waiter and busboy kept trying to take plates and beverages which were not yet fully consumed from table.  Waiter was not up to Uncle Yu’s typical standards.

Restaurant was HOT ... kitchen had an issue and couldn't do any stir fry ...

Went there for 70th birthday for a friend and told hostess that ... no acknowledgement on part of staff ... disappointed!
We always enjoy everything about Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard, and, in particular, the delicious and beautifully prepared food.  Certainly, this is one of the finest restaurants in the East Bay.

The food was very tasty. The service lacked in several areas. Never knew the server's name.  Never did the server bring the check, after taking plates 10 minutes had passed and no sign of him. We had to go to the cashier at the door to request bill. The server then showed up with apologetic words of he was plating a dessert. What does that mean? Was I not a customer as well? Would like to go back for the food, but hesitant because I might get the same waiter.

This is a higher end Chinese restaurant with great service, great food, & good vegan & vegetarian options. We've had szechuan vegetables, kung po broccoli, home style tofu, a side of their spicy garlic pepper sauce, sorbet, orange no-jito, vegetarian pot stickers, lotus tofu cups, yu shang eggplant & vegetarian Singapore noodles. We loved the food, service & experience.
I order the same thing everytime... salmon with snow peas and brown rice. All 4 guests ordered the same thing.

I love this place.  The food is always amazing.  Nice ambiance, the one area I think they could improve is their cocktail service.  Drinks are serviceable, however, I feel the drinks should be better than serviceable at an upscale place like this. I fully admit to being a cocktail snob with high expectations, however, there's really no reason to have ice chips in a martini.  It's not that hard to double strain.  Other than that, this place is great.

I have dined at Uncles Yu's many times. Usually the food and service was very good.  Sunday both were unusually bad.    List of the issues:
1) They did not match my open table reservation, so I got an email from open table saying I was a no show.
2) The server was slow, looked visibly tired and forgot if he had taken our order or not.
3) He brought me the wrong beer (pilsner instead of IPA) and never came back so that I could exchange it for the correct one.
4) The Walnut Prawns were crusty and gross.  usually very good at Uncle Yu's.
PROS:
1) We sat outside and the ambience was great.  There was a singer who sounded great and not to loud.
2) Generally I love Uncle Yu's.

We were there to celebrate my daughters birthday and did the chef choice meal. We got there at 4pm, and didn't leave until 8pm. No one tried to rush us through dinner and the service was fantastic.  Thank you Nicky.

We have eaten at Uncle Yu's for years.  In this case, we had a farewell dinner for some friends, and had a table for 9.  We got the "Banquet" option, which is food for the entire table.  The food was okay (not as good as meals past), but the service was horrible.  We begrudgingly had to pay the pre-calculated 18% tip due to the number of people, but the service did not warrant it.  I would expect a table of 9 to get good attention, but we had to flag down our server every time we needed anything (and her wait station was only 15 feet from us).  Drinks were not offered until 20 minutes after we were seated, and it took an hour for the food to arrive (30 minutes after ordering), while smaller tables around us where seated and served while we waited.

Uncle Yu's, you can do better.
Quality Chinese dishes adapted to western taste with outstanding wine list - a favorite.
Great place to celebrate our anniversary!
Lovely space, excellent service.  Food okay, but was better last time we were there!!
We celebrated a special birthday with friends we hadn’t seen in a while. The food was delicious and the service was great. They brought a surprise dessert for us to share.
So super yummy! Every dish was delicious - Honey Walnut Prawns Crispy Chicken, shrimp fried rice and pork chow mein.  Plenty of food for 4 hungry adults!

Food was quite good, but unlike previous visits service was not. after long wait for appetizers, waiter said  they gave our order to someone else and offered hot and sour soup, which we declined. They delivered one appetizer (wonton soup) and after a slightly shorter wait, the others. However, they comped the appetizers. We will go back given the opportunity (we live out of town).
Retirement dinner
We immediately ordered appetizers, which we didn't receive until after receiving our entrees. Food was delicious, however small portions considering the price.

The food was delicious! We had a very attentive server, as well. The only downside was that we would have liked to have been seeded outside but there was a guitar player whose Amplified music was very loud and would have drowned out any talkin that our party wanted to do. We sat inside instead, but it was such a beautiful day it was a shame to waste the nice weather.

Really really slow service -  took over an hour to get drinks, one dish came super late after we were almost done,  ordered the special plan they had  -  spilled a drink on a guest and no Ofer to comp.

Overall it was a wonderful experience. We enjoyed the food and the service was very good. Our waiter was attentive and polite. Our water glasses were topped off regularly. But I think it’s time to upgrade the dinnerware, they were a bit worn and understated for the upper grade ambiance provided.
We would certainly come back and recommend it to others.

I've been to Uncle Yu's 5 times now and haven't had a dish I didn't fall in love with.  From the moment you are greeted at the door to the server that is at your table soon after you are seated, you know things are going to be great!!  It does get crowded so be sure to make a reservation.
Lucas was extraordinary! Thank you for such a wonderful Birthday celebration.
Amazing Chinese Food! The Seabass was delicious...along with everything else we tried! Get the eggplant appetizer as well.
Post Father’s Day.
One of my favorite restaurants in the Tri-Valley. Spectacular food, amazing wine list with impeccable service. It doesn't get better than Uncle Yu's.

Do not recommend booking a reservation to this restaurant  through OpenTable. The restaurant offers the option of booking a reservation as “Standard seating” or “Outdoor seating”, yet the restaurants’ policy is to seat you wherever they happen to have availability at the time of your reservation. We were also notified that reservations through the app could overbook them. Call them directly unless you don’t mind the possibility of not getting a table and/or where they end up seating you.
Great food.  Nice place. The staff were friendly. I would go back again

This restaurant is wonderful. This was our  4th time eating there. The staff is very professional. They sat us down right away and the service was good. We absolutely love the Crab rice, Sea Bass, and Maine lobster with the black bean sauce. Nice ambiance ( it did get quite a bit noisy towards the end of the evening), but overall, a great evening!!

The service was excellent. The food was cooked perfectly and was delicious.  We had the scallops and shu mai for appetizer then shared a couple of lunch specials. The prices are really good for the quality of food. It was a very nice experience and quiet inside the restaurant for easy conversation.

We had a little make-up baby shower for a cousin of mine on Sunday (for those of us that were unable to make her actual shower). GM Justin was amazing and so was our waiter Matthew. The food was excellent and they were very attentive to the needs of the two women in our party with seafood allergies. Service was awesome all around. Perfect ambiance too. We will be coming back!

They were a bit under staffed so service was a bit slow.  Our food came with we didn't have plates until a few minutes late.  Food was good in their typical fashion with one exception - we tried the Crispy Salt and Pepper prawns for the first time and they were overcooked and the shrimps were not crispy at all.  The orange beef and dry cooked string beans have always been good without exception - highly recommended.

Any restaurant with Kalin Cellars wines on the wine list gets at least one bonus star from me - and I really wanted to love Uncle Yu's. Unfortunately, once you get beyond what is really an outstanding wine list, you arrive at an average Chinese restaurant with nothing much to recommend it - well, except for those bottles of Kalin, of course....
Great service!!!

Asked for an outside table, and even though back patio was full, they accommodated us street-side with more of an ad hoc setup. Was a grand way to spend our dinner date, with what felt like our own private area and also enjoy the outdoor energy of downtown Livermore on a wonderful evening. Service was warm and professional... and food as always was outstanding!

Agreed to serve hot & sour soup without meat (nice).  It was served lukewarm (not so nice).  The appetizer was served after we’d finished our meal.  It was very good, but because we had completed our meal we ate only one of the three pieces.  There was no offer to amend the bill.  Haphazard service appeared to be going through the motions.  The main dishes however were very good...
Reservations on open table easy and efficient; great food, fantastic service. Definitely recommend.

We have been fans of Uncle Yu’s for over 20 years. We make it our special treat restaurant. The last 2 times we went we noticed a down turn with the food. The last two times we mentioned it to our waitress and she told the manager. We thought that they would make appropriate  adjustments. Even though the service and ambiance is spectacular. The food is not worth the money or the level to make it our “special “ restaurant.

It was our first time here for a party of 10. Food was really good and the atmosphere of the restaurant was great. Our party was placed in a separate room from other tables which were nice since we had a big group. Menu selection which were pre-fixed had really good recommendations. The only thing that kind of messed up the whole vibe was our server. He didn’t really smile or make conversations with us. He had a very dry personality and we felt he looked a bit annoyed. One of us made a joke and he had no expressions just not friendly at all. Overall my experience was good hopefully if I come back I get a different server.
Love love  uncle Yu.  One of our favorite places to eat at.
Food service is slow but the food is amazing.
A little pricey, but good food and good service.  We will eat here again.
The staff is top notch, the food is high quality and the wine is out of this world.
Food is amazing and our server made excellent wine recommendations.
Excellent dining experience!  Great food and excellent service.  Looking forward to returning again!

The food is excellent- many vegetarian and vegan options. The vegan fried rice is really delicious! Our kids love the vegan fried rice, garlic noodles, crispy eggplant, and vegetarian pot stickers. 
The service is wonderful- friendly, personalized, and fast. Hands down our favorite downtown Livermore restaurant! We recommend to all our family and friends!
I highly recommend the sea bass.  It was absolute heaven.  Everything was delicious!!!
The food and service was fantastic.  The ambiance was great.
The food was unbelievable!
Birthday celebration
The food was very good and so was the service. We will be back.
Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard is the best Chinese in the East Bay. The food is fresh. They use high quality ingredients.  The food is creative. Try the lobster, crab fried rice and the rack of lamb.

Our family went to Uncle Yu's for my mothers 82 year birthday celebration.  We made reservations and were seated right away.  The food was awesome!  Quantities of each dish were on the smaller side which is surprising for a Chinese restaurant and for the price.  Other than that, we will come back again and again.  I highly recommend  for anyone who wants really good food.

Very nice restaurant and food was good. It took about 20-25 minutes from when the soup was served to the half of the party that ordered soup for the rest of the items to arrive.  A little difficult with young children, but aside from that the dinner was nice
Fantastic all the way around!

The quality of the food says it all, the flavors are so well married and the ingredients are so demonstrably fresh. Wait time were reasonable, staff was friendly and prompt. Overall a nice dining experience worth repeating.
We had a very nice dinner with excellent service provided by our server.

Waiter had bad timing, seeming to vanish when needed and in your face when not.
Coffee was cold.
Food, as always, was excellent.
Great service and amazing food! Our wait staff and the kitchen were quite accommodating with our dietary preferences. The sea bass was superb!
We ordered three dishes and loved them all - beef with orange peel, General Tsao's chicken and eggplant.  The eggplant was special.

Went with some co-workers for dinner. All in all, good service and good food, though some items were a little pricey. Minor issue with waitress not putting in one person's soup order so it was delayed in coming out, but she took it off the bill at the end. Would go back!
Great spot for business lunch. We all loved our food!

The food is very well-prepared and a fresh and new take on traditional favorites.  We have eaten here several time and the staff is always very friendly and good at what they do.  Clarin was our server on Friday and I can't say enough  good things about her.
Great Except brought wrong check to us and ran the cc thru. Than caught by another server
Service was excellent.   Food should have been excellent also but to dishes- lobster and kobe meat dish were so salty that I could not eat.  Enjoyed pairing with wine.  Perhaps was off night.
Horrible service, mediocre food and for a restaurant that prides itself on wine list. No knowledge by waitstaff. Brought incorrect wine

The food was exceptional - I had the Pan-Seared Scallops appetizer and the BBQ Seabass for my entree - both were truly outstanding!!  I had Lychee Martinis - at the recommendation of our totally attentive and delightful server, which were ever-so-delicious!!  My friend enjoyed her food and drinks as well, but my selections stood out, and were particularly enjoyable!!

Food is amazing however the waiting to be seated with a reservation was long. Waited 30 minutes to be seated after reservations. The hostesses were pretty rude when we asked why it took so long to be seated. Overall happy with the food.

Had a reservation, set us in the bar. cold
air due to opening closing front
door, food was good, service
was a best not very good
Service was friendly and efficient. Tables kept orderly with many dishes. Perfect location with easy parking. We forgot to use coupon and they voided out original tab and redid it with discount

The food is reasonably priced and is absolutely amazing. If you're going put on something nice as everybody that was there was dressed accordingly. Took a girl here for our first date definitely scored some points. Would recommend this place definitely!!
Service was slow, but he appeared busy.
Great service. Great food
Excellent food, ambiance, decor, and service. Our waitress was very attentive throughout. Really enjoyed ourselves.
The food did not disappoint, it was delicious. The service was pretty good. Its a lot noisier there than I expected but it was very nice overall.
Wonderful dinner at Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard as usual.  Love the crispy eggplant, lemon chicken, spicy green beans!
Uncle Yu’s never fails to deliver. Upscale Asian, definitely need an Open Table reso. Wine list extensive with choices for any dish. The crispy, spicy sole special is a new favorite.

We reserved a table but ended up sitting at the bar since it was pretty open.  The only confusion was when I was trying to inform the hostess to cancel the table reservation to give others our ‘time’ since we opted to stay at the bar.  For some reason and despite my confirmation via email, she could not locate my name or my reservation.  I did not want to further hold up the line so said it’s fine and dropped it.  The service we received at the bar was exceptionally great and two team members took very good care of us, ensuring we got our orders and drinks in a timely manner.  I happened to mention what occurred at the reception to one of them and he immediately went to reception, found my name and confirmed our presence so I could get the points.  I had given up on the points earlier but truly appreciated the team member’s move to take action on my account.  The only regret I have is that I was not able to ask his name so I could send positive feedback to his supervisor about his excellent service.  We love going to Uncle Yu’s for their small plates, cocktails and extensive wine list!
Excellent service and food.
We had the tasting menu, which was amazingly good value give the quality of the wines served. The sommelier has an amazing wine list if you enjoy good wine and his knowledge is impeccable.
I went there with customer, but waiters made several mistakes. It made me embarrassed. I disappointed.

Food as always was fabulous as was the service. Wish we could get a table in the main dining room! We keep getting seated near the door and it is way too loud. Will try and request main dining area next time. Great place with wonderful food!
Amazing as always.
We were there for my grandma’s birthday and it was great! Good for large groups, great food, great service from the staff. Family style is the way to go.
Our experience was great!  Great food, great service!  We love Uncle Yu's!

Lovely setting and one of the best Chinese food our family has ever eaten. Excellent service and great selections of wines. We had a wine flight of 3 wonderful wines. We will come again, highly recommended.

There was a large party in the back dining room and as large parties go the noise level was quite elevated. The hostess was kind enough to move our table and a couple other diner’s tables to a different more quiet location.

At our arrival we had to wait for like 15min to get a table but everything else was great service and the food and prices are great too this place is always packed of people I have been there several time is better than P.F.Chang take a chance there you will be back for sure enjoy it...

Reservation was 6:15. We were finally seated at 6:45 after arriving at 6:10.  Then got a table very close to the door and the staff wouldn’t move us despite many open tables. Will not return based on attitude of the staff. Food great as always.

My wife and I like to eat out on  Friday evenings, and this Friday found us at Uncle Yu’s. Great atmosphere, fantastic food, wonderful wine list and top notch service. Uncle Yu’s is always a celebration!
This our go to restaurant. The food is excellent and service friendly and top notch.
Uncle Yu's is a reliably good choice for lunch or dinner.  Going back tonight with a group to enjoy the special Chinese New Year dinner!
The place was busy, we had made reservations for 6:45 were seated by 7,  the service and food was very good. Will definitely good back
Chef’s tasting.. worth it!!

Service was less than average, one of the servers spilled sauce from one of our dishes all over my friend and said nothing. Our food came out cold. We asked for fortune cookies and were told to get them at the door.

Moved to Livermore 3 years ago and have been so impressed with Uncle Yu's  that it has become our go to place for all special events (birthdays, friends visit, valentines day). Wine list is extensive with prices to fit our budget.  Cocktails are well prepared and very tasty, food is the absolute best in all of the Tri Valley area.
We went for a birthday dinner. It was tasty and fun.
Fabulous as usual.
Food was excellent.  Servers were attentive.  Prices are reasonable, given the quality.
Great food and service. One of my favorite go-to restaurants!
Booth seating provided upon request was good. Food well prepared and tasty. Service during meal was excellent. What's not to love here.
The wait staff was very helpful with describing both wine and food options, and they were attentive to our needs.

Possibly the best tasting and best prepared Chinese food I have eaten in the states! Excellent all the way around service busboy to waiter. Lovely decor. A hit slow to seat us for our reservation; something about a shortage of menus. We could see our booth standing empty for the entirety of our over 20 minute wait. Hoewver, all was forgiven one our apetizerd, soups, and entrees hit the table.😄

The dessert menu was quite decadent and delicious.

Great food and service.  Portions have gotten smaller over the years.   The Dim Sum  appetizer is 100% delicious.  This place is always packed, so I highly recommend reservations.   Also the bartenders know how to make fantastic cocktails.
Great service and food.
Our server Luke was awesome!!!
always one of my favorite  restaurants the food and severus are always good
Went there for lunch on a  Sunday. Not very crowded. Food was great; wine was good too and the service was excellent.
Our guests from Wisconsin really enjoyed the meal as much as we did.

This was our third visit to Uncle Yu's.  Each time the food has been excellent.  The menu has many options which will satisfy everyone's preference (i.e., beef, chicken, seafood, & vegetarian).  The food is beautifully prepared and our party of four shared plates providing a wide variety of tasting options.  My only concern (this visit only) was our waitress.  She was not very attentive and disappeared at times requiring us to ask another waitress for assistance.  I am hopeful that this was an anomaly that will not occur in the future.

Went for my sons birthday. Great service, amazing food, awesome wine list. Definite reccomend for special occasions. The salt and pepper lobster was delicious. All of the food that we ordered was perfect.
Food has always been good that's why we return.
One of my go-to restaurants for every occasion. Their food and service is excellent.
Robert  was Great!!
As usual, the food and service was wonderful.  The waiter had good suggestions for food.  Always, it is my favorite restaurant in Livermore.

Our first time at Uncle Yu’s, after moving to Livermore from Mountain View - where there are world-class Asian restaurants. Yu’s matched the best from the Bay Area, with a bonus of a great wine list and a sommelier who understood our desires and made excellent suggestions. The food and service were extremely good as well. We’ll be back!
New Year’s Eve get together.
The crab & mango salad wasn’t served with the cilantro vinaigrette as described.
Loved our food and experience
The food was fresh and hot with a lot of flavor. The server took good care of us.
Very pleasant experience.
Great relaxed meal with perfect service!

Food was tasty but portions were small for shared plates for 5 people.  Due to the holiday season, the restaurant may have been busier than usual.  Service was slower to respond, which made for a nice casual lunch but it was noted.
Loved the food and the wine selection, but the service was really poor. Even though we had a reservation they made us wait 30 minutes before giving us a table

Dined the day after Christmas to celebrate my wife's birthday. The food was nearly perfect, right texture, correct serving temperature and delicious.  The service was fair. Juan, our server seemed to be disinterested after the plates were on the table...We wanted our picture taken...Granted the place was busy but he did not check with us after we sang Happy birthday to her.....I guess next time, I will have to request a different server and birthday picture before I pay the bill.

We had Christmas Eve dinner here and everything was delicious! My favorite was the crispy eggplant appetizer....so yummy! I’ve never had a bad meal at Uncle Yu’s; highly recommend it!

ps: They make a fantastic French 75 Cocktail 😊
We just love this place.  The Chef's Dinner with the Wine paring is a blast!

All was good for this dinner except that we had to wait a 1/2 hour after our reservation time to be seated. The restaurant management should know how to plan their reservation flow better. They comp'd us an appetizer but that never feels right to me. Food and wait-service was excellent.

Normally service is exceptional but this time we waited 20 minutes to be seated after our reservation time.  Also asked for our leftovers to be boxed but they were inadvertently discarded.
 Otherwise, all was good.  I am going to chalk it up as a busy time of year.
Another great meal at one of our family’s favorite places!

We've eaten at Uncle Yu's a couple times before and always enjoyed it.  This time our server really made a difference.  The food was great as usual.  The service, however, really made it special.  I only wish I would have remembered our server's name so I could publicly give her props.  She welcomed our family and worked with the different taste and diets to put together a memorable experience.
Always good
We always go here before going to the Bankhead theatre. Can count on great food, prompt service, and a fun atmosphere.
Excellent food, excellent service. Great place to eat before going to a show at the Bankhead theatre.

We loved our meal last night! We purposely order more than we can eat but there is a reason for that because we loved the leftovers. Opened our boxes and the left over rice was not in it! I'm telling you it was a lot of rice which I love. Oh well, maybe someone else needed it more than me. :0(
Many thanks to our server, Juan, who made the birthday celebration very memorable.
Took a bit to get seated but everything else was great

Uncle Yus uses high quality ingredients to make premium Chinese food and try to wrap this up with a high level of service.  However they simply have too many workers who seem to get in each other's way and slow things down while making the meal more expensive.  

So the plus is that you will get very good Chinese food made with high quality ingredients. The minus is that it is expensive and some of the service will be good while other parts like waiting for your reservation or check may be very slow.
Good to dine at a local favorite that maintains good service during the rush of the holidays.
Always have a good experience here. Service is always good! It’s a beautiful restaurant that is a treat to come to
Great food and service. Loved everything we ordered.

We had a fairly large group and most elected to go for the "Banquet" style.  Although the food was excellent, the value for the price was just not there.  We didn't get that much food for the price we paid.  Having said that, the "Banquet" style is a good way to get a sampling of many items.
Love their secret vegan menu!!
Upscale Chinese restaurant in Livermore with good food and good service.

We had 8 people and the food was delicious and the service perfect!  We are regulars here and are never disappointed.  The mu shu pork divine as is the Kung pap chicken. Hot and sour soup the best anywhere.  Good wine selection.  Pork fried rice delicious.   Everyone ordered a variety of dishes but that’s what I had!  Great wine dejecting too even by the glass.
Excellent every time !   My teenagers look forward going to dinner at Uncle Yu’s.  Food is exceptional

Uncle Yu's consistently provides an excellent meal in a warm cozy atmosphere. We had the chef's special fillet and it was delicious. It was well seasoned, with just enough spice to make it interesting. We also had the eggplant appetizer, and the perennial favoritem honey walnut prawn salad. YUM!

What can I say? Great food, service, ambiance, & price. Staff is knowledgeable & accommodating for gluten sensitivity, lots of g.f. options & nothing is ever plain, which is challenging with most Asian food restaurants. Really love eating here.
the food was real authentic. very flavorful and met our expectations
Awesome food.  Awesome service.  We were offered a complementary appetizer by our server cause we frequent the restaurant often. Make reservations.
It is always a great place to dine with friends. A very pleasant atmosphere and you can hear each other talk. Dishes you can share as well as items you can order for yourself.
Well prepared, quality food.  Knowledgeable staff.   Extensive wine list.  Overall, a very nice restaurant experience.

Why is it that the hostess or host of many restaurants seat women next to the kitchen door or the server station?  There were many tables available at Uncle Yu's and the hostess attempted to seat me next to kitchen door. To be fair, she did agree to  move me to a nicer table.
Very comfortable.  Great food and excellent service.
A nice surprise in Livermore, great food. The new vegan menu was great for the vegans in our group
It's awesome. Will eat there again. Food was super tasty.

This was our first experience with Uncle Yu's Restaurant in Livermore. Although we had arrived earlier than our  reservations, they were able to accommodate us in a timely manner. The menu and the service was great! The BBQ Sea Bass was our absolute favorite! We loved it so much that the next day after our wine tasting trip, we decided to go back and eat more Sea Bass again! lol It was very well prepared and not overly cooked. I would definitely list this as one of my favorite restaurants! Will be going back very soon.
Always great food!

Food was over priced. I cant understand how our food was bland. We have given this place to many chances and each time the food was bland. I have tasted better Chinese food at the other places in Livermore.
We ordered basic Chinese food, fried rice, chow mien, lemon chicken, all of it was tasteless. My family agrees with this review.

The sweet-and-sour pork and the honey walnut prawns were exceptional. The Mongolian beef was good. The pad Thai was less than memorable. Way too mushy. Definitely on the higher priced scale than a lot of other Chinese restaurants but great ambience

We came for anniversary dinner prop to show at Bankhead in Livermore.  Budgeted 1.5 hours for dinner...turns out this was not enough time......arrived and were no seated at our 6:30 rez time and we were told to wait in the bar.....no one came to get us and finally my husband went over and asked is bad been forgotten....seated 20+ minutes late with zero acknowledgement of anniversary of apology for late seating.   Then our waiter (Derrick... Nice kid) tried to take our order quickly but he forgot our drinks and at the end of the meal we ordered sorbet....but it never came even though we were charged for sorbet.   Food was good....unfortunately service speed and attentiveness was very subpar.  T.  Johnstone
We came to eat at Uncle Yu's before the Jim Messina concert with a small group.  The food was very good and the service was excellent.
Excellent service. Tasty dishes. Great wine list.👍
Great service and great food. There was so much we had and all is always great. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu.
The food and service was excellent.  I am returning customer and definitely will be back.

Food was great and good value. 

However slow service night. Made a reservation and we were seated 20 min late. It carried on with slow service all night.
Can’t wait to be back... best sea bass & Peking duck!
The food was great and there are plenty of options for vegetarians. Everything we had tasted great. The crispy eggplant (appetizer) was really good, also the Pad Thai.
Always great! The food and service are phenomenal. A family favorite.
As always a great dinner.  Love the salt and pepper calamari!!!

Definitely a cut above the usual Chinese restaurant.  We had several classic Chinese dishes that were presented well and delicious.  Ingredients tasted fresh.  Atmosphere is classy and relatively quiet.
We celebrated our daughter’s birthday And we really enjoyed the delicious food . The ambiance and the service was excellent.
The food was not outstanding I have had better not enough to share with a group and too expensive.

We were wine tasting in Livermore and choose Uncle Yu's for lunch. We had reservations, but came about 15 minutes early. It took them about 15 minutes to seat us even though the place was fairly empty and the table we were given was empty when we walked in. Once seated they ignored us for another 15 minutes. Not a problem for us because we had a lot to talk about.

Now for the good part. The luncheon menu had a wide range of choices. We each chose a different main course and side dish so we could try everything. All of the food was very good. The dishes tasted fresh. The portions were large. Extensive wine list with descriptions that made pairing with individual entrees easy.
Great food and top notch wine list....if you are around during they day they also  have a really great value lunch menu.

I'm a lifelong fan of Chinese food, but finding any outside mediocre (or worse) has proven to be a perpetual challenge. Uncle Yu's is the only I've been willing to get on an airplane to experience. I discovered the first Uncle Yu's more than 20 years ago in San Ramon, CA. It has gone through moves and name modifications but the same commitment to quality, authenticity and unrivaled service remain. The wine list is equal to or better than any 5-star property in the Bay area. Their Livermore, CA site is a welcome reward after a day of wine tasting and sightseeing in the valley. Their location in Lafayette, CA is smaller and more casual but also worth a drive.
Love Uncle Yu's, been there many times and the food is great everytime. Particularly love the Lobster Shu Mai and the Bomba dessert!
Good food, nice ambiance but a little pricey for Chinese food. Always good though.
Had a birthday lunch for 6 people.  Lunch menu was a very good value.  Everyone enjoyed their meal and the service was outstanding.

This was my second time at Uncle Yu’s. Loved it the first time I had gone! Great appetizers and very enjoyable cocktails. Went a second time for date night and our server was so friendly! Ha. A bigger meal and definitely left satisfied. A little pricey, but still worth the dine! Will go again.

Wonderful meal, never disappoints! Great, friendly service!
Best SeaBass ever, anywhere!
Food was bland, very loud group in the private room. Many diners unhappy
The tasting menu was definitely worth to try. The apptizer and second dish that came with it worthed every single penny. The regular menu has nothing special
Always great food and excellent service.  Go there regularly and have never been disappointed.

dirty re-used table clothes, wrong check, just not very nice for date night.

I expected more. Cocktails were nice, though
Food was excellent. Service could have been a bit more polished. Overall had a great time and would be back.

Uncle Yu’s is my wife’s favorite Livermore restaurant, so we celebrated her birthday there with friends. After tasting each of the wines in the flight that she ordered, she realized they hadn’t brought her the correct flight. Our first three dishes were served to the table next to us, but when those diners noticed that they had been served food they didn’t order, the waiter moved the food to our table. Finally, after we had finished eating everything else that we ordered, the server brought out a final dish that they had forgotten to serve us. 

Perhaps the staff was just distracted, but whatever the case, it was a bit disappointing.

We've visited Uncle Yu's many times and most of those times were for either a birthday or date night. This visit was for our anniversary and unfortunately, this visit was different.

We were seated promptly upon arrival and waited on soon after. And then things went downhill. Drinks arrived and food was ordered.
