A while later, the first appetizer arrived and about ten minutes later, the second appetizer arrived - even though they were ordered at the same time. Then, three of our dinners arrived and about ten minutes later, the fourth dinner arrived. When our drinks were refilled, they tasted like they had added an ounce of tea to a glass of water - they were supposed to be Arnold Palmers.

Now, on to one of the biggest disappointments of the night. Even after selecting "anniversary" in the reservation and adding the same in the notes, nothing was mentioned about our anniversary by the staff. No congratulations, no complimentary dessert, nothing. But, there were plenty of birthday candles and desserts that night. Not that we were expecting complimentary anything but since every single visit in the past did offer complimentary desserts for the occasion, then we felt a bit disappointed this time. Maybe policy changed to save money, not sure.

Note that this review says nothing about the food - because the food is always delicious and consistent.

Also, I would recommend that if you're seated to one of the tables towards the back by the kitchen that you request a different one. There was a lot of chatter back there with dishes being dried and boxed plus the noise level of the kitchen traffic made for a not-so romantic dinner date. Get a table on the right or middle, just stay away from the back.
Uncle Yu's never disappoints.  As usual the food and service was excellent.  The food is always fresh, tender, and tasty!
One of the best Chinese restaurants around.  The food is very fresh. The Chicken salad is one of my favorites.
I food was quite good. Service was first rate. Wine selection well above many restaurants. Over all pleasurable experience.
Reserved as a Birthday and not acknowledged.  Also mentioned it and not acknowledged.  Disappointing for my son.

Upscale decor, soothing ambiance, with Jazz playing in the back ground, Top notch service. Very good food.  A bit pricy. Got out the door with 1 glass of wine, 1 pot of tea, 3 main dishes before tip: $80.00

The settings are wonderful.
Ther service is very attentive, love the choice of wines by the glass.
The food is very fresh and hot.
Very accommodating and overall great. We had a guest with peanut ,tree nut, and dairy allergy and uncle Yu’s staff handled everything and accommodated our guest.

A very busy night, so service was a bit slower than usual.
Not to worry, once our order was placed the appetizer was on time as were the entries.
Every dish was outstanding, but my favorites remain Lotus Chicken and Prawns with Honey Glased Walnuts, melts in your mouth delicious!
Large party, was accommodated and had fast friendly service!

Every dish we ordered was excellent, especially the wagyu beef, the lettuce wraps, and honey walnut shrimp. The sorbet they brought to the two birthday people was equally delicious. Enjoyed the patio on a beautiful summer day.

Having stumbled upon this place due to show tickets across the street from it, I was very impressed with the exquisite service, food quality and ambiance of Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard restaurant in downtown Livermore. The menu and the wine list are extensive and the prices are quite reasonable. It is definitely a high caliber Asian fusion restaurant and I can't wait to go back there for its own sake and not just as a meal before or after a show.

Surprisingly great tasting food and very good service.  Kid friendly and great for family gathering.  Very accommodating.  The custom prefixes menu is a good bargain to taste the variety options available.  The salmon with pea pods were exceptional.    The crispy chicken was very moist not heavily glazed.
The food was great and amazing selection.
Food took a long time, but usually is better/faster.

Always a great choice for lunch with friends.  The lunch specials are varied, and there is usually something on the menu that appeals to everyone.  Uncle Yu's is one of my favorite restaurants and a top Livermore choice!

We haven’t been to Uncle Yu’s in awhile. Decided to stop in for dinner before a concert. I will now be back often! I forgot what a great meal and service you get here. Highly recommend the tasting menu and with wine pairing! Lobster, Kobe beef excellent wine and great cocktails, can’t go wrong here.
We sat outside and the ambiance was amazing.  Our server was great too!

We had a wonderful lunch at Uncle Yu’s.   The entrees were delicious and the menu was extensive ensuring that everyone in your party will find something to their liking. We would highly recommend the Pumpkin Dumpling with Sea Scallops and Wild Shrimp appetizer as a special treat.   This was my second visit to Uncle Yu’s and I’m sure that we will returning in the future.
Great service and good food

Excellent food!!!!!!
A real treat !
Service was bad and subtracted from a good experience.

Food is was mostly really good but they made a mistake on one of the plate and cooked the correct one last minute but it didn’t taste right. Also we got the all the plates in a 10 Minutes stretch so some people ate cold food (not counting the one they messed up ) 
The most disappointing thing was that we ordered flight of wine that is supposedly very good but the wine weren’t that great and the server did t know what they were also there is a table fee ? Lol

Shame that the prices go up and the portions get smaller. The non-associated Andy and Yu's is nicer but also just as pricey. Used to be able to get 6 potstickers in an order and they have since changed to 4.  BBQ Pork Fried rice was decent, instead of getting char siu we got what looked like SPAM. Sweet and Sour chicken is always good but the portion sizes are terrible. Have to buy 2 of everything just to feed a family of 4. Less veggies and more chicken,

Sea Bass Puffs.... Hrngh... So good. I also love their dimsum options. The Lychee Magarita was good. A bit strong. The Goat Cheese won tons we're also very tasty. If come back just for the Sea Bass Puffs.
Great food and service with an amazing wine list. On the strip in Livermore where parking in the evening may be challenging but that is not the restaurant’s fault.
I took my son and his wife out to dinner and we had a very nice time.  The food was great and the staff was very pleasant.

My wife and I have generally liked Uncle Yu’s; however, on this occasion, when we ordered the honey walnut shrimp, the shrimp smelled and tasted fishy.  This tells me the shrimp were not fresh; and in fact, are on the verge or turning.  I was very disappointed!!!

My wife and I had the prix fixe for anniversary dinner. As always, the food was spectacular, and wine pairings were amazing. Only reason Uncle Yu's doesn't get 5 stars this time is that the server didn't bring our doggy bag when we left.

If you are looking for authentic Chinese cuisine, they bypass Uncle Yu's. A disappointing style of cooking. As the food is fairly standard American-Chinese, you would find much better value at your neighborhood Chinese restaurant.
We love this place.  The allow us to order as we like, which is important for picky eaters.....
Food and service was amazing!

Overall good. Food was nice , service was good , ambience was nice except for having flies in the restaurant. They kept the door open. Floor can be cleaner. They put us in the corner near the kitchen.
We had the Chef's paring dinner. It was fabulous! a surprise at each course. The wine paring was spot on.
I went there for lunch and my meal was fantastic. Excellent service and the food was incredible as always.  It’s a must do lunch date for my Seattle family whenever they are in town.
My Wife’s birthday
As usual Uncle Yu’s was a great meal. We have our favorite dishes of course and are never disappointed. We keep coming back for a reason. Great dishes and service.
$45 Peking duck was served luke warm and extremely oily.

Not up to par with slow service. The food was rushed and not completely cooked. Not what I have come to expect from Uncle Yu's which is typically terrific . Server was a bit snarky.  Warm beer served...go figure that one out.... I will not let this less than superior outing diminish my overall liking of Uncle Yu's.  The New Years Eve dinner date was to die for, yes, that good!!!

Great food!  Great ambiance!  They have good wine and champagne and we had a great salmon pizzeta appetizer. We also had a great sorbet dessert. Luke was our server and he was very friendly and knowledgeable. One of my favorite places in Livermore!
Sadly the hot and sour soup was coagulated as if it were previously frozen. Huge chunks of brown goop is not appetizing. Our server was exceptional.
Great Peking duck!  Good potstickers. Lychee cocktail is wonderful.
Great food and ambiance. We enjoy the outdoor patio. The service is always friendly.

One of the most memorable dinners I’ve had in a long time! We loved that they don’t serve your typical heavy/oily dishes, rather, they serve up fresh takes on Chinese restaurant classics. We sat outdoors and ate family style. One person in our group is gluten free and vegetarian so we ordered a few vegetable and rice options of off the Gluten Free menu, an appetizer, a salad,  and a chicken entree. The meal was outstanding! We ended with a few desserts to share. We were surprised that 5 of us could eat all of that for under $100. We will definitely be back!

Uncles Yu's (Livermore) is by far the best Chinese Food we have ever had. The proteins are top grade and the produce is extremely fresh and tasty.  They use the finest ingredients.  The dishes have a strong flavor profile that are differentiated from each other.  Absolutely delicious every single time.  Great for a family dinner and/or special event!
Another great dinner with friends and family. Thank you to the UY'S team!

Business meal after a long meeting.  Food was excellent and service above average.  Noise level a bit higher that desired as we continued our meeting at dinner.  Would go back again, overall experience was good.
OMG the poached fish is to die for! we keep going back for more! greats service, amazing food!
Excellent- always great experience- great food- great service!

The food was good.
The waiter or should I say the staff boxing our leftovers shortchanged us. I was very disappointed not to discover  one of our entrees which was not even halfway consumed not on the to-go bag when I got home. We even offered to just box our leftovers ourselves but was told that  they box it for excellent service. Oh, well...

Been here several times over the years. Has been a go to for some special occasions. Seeing a gradual degradation in overall quality. The menus have been dogeared for at least 2 years now. Need to be replaced. The price for a 6 oz. glass of a Livermore wine is 15% more than in other comparably priced restaurants. The portion sizes are decreasing even as the prices are increasing.  They mask this in smaller sized service plates.   Even the service slipped this time. Servers brought us someone else's app. Took them awhile to take it back. Hope some other diner did not get either their app. either cold or reheated. The only redeeming quality is that the taste of the food continues to be maintained at a high level. The owners see to be distracted with opening new restaurants.  I hope they regain focus.

Excellent service, food, and cocktails. We had a wonderful lunch, but the stars of the meal were the appetizers and cocktails. Dad loved the desserts. I appreciated the attentive service and well paced service. Thank you for a memorable afternoon out with the parents.
Great food, great service.
Great and fun!
Love Peking Duck and order it frequently here, last nights was flimsy and not crispy.
Outstanding as usual. Lobster Shumai just the best things ever.
The food here is always amazing!
This is our go too restaurant in Livermore. Great food, great service. We always recommend Uncle Yu's. Reservations recommended
Great service and great food.  Never disappointed going to Uncle Yu’s.
Came on based on other users reviews. The food was okay. The ambiance was nice.
Had a fantastic time dining outdoor listing to the sole singer. Food was scrumptious and service was caring.
Amazing food and over the top service. Overall awesome experience, would love to go back.

We’ve gone to Uncle Yu’s for many years.  Recently even with a reservation and seeing open tables, we’ve sat and waited. This weekend, we waited 25 minutes past our reservation to get a table that had been open the entire time.  
Once seated, it took 15 minutes just to get water and another 5 to locate our waiter, who had been at the table next to us twice before we asked if he could help us. 
There also used to be a visible supervisor keeping tabs on operations but that wasn’t visible this weekend.  This is a great restaurant with solid food. I hope the kinks in service can be addressed
Luke warm food...later gastric ...let us just say issues. Unpleasant waitress, dirty & stained seats. Will not be returning!
Our family was on a time restraint, because of a show at The Bankhead Theater, the staff was very accommodating. The food was ready and good.
We have been to this location and it continues to be one of our favorites when it comes to Chinese food.
Wonderful Peking Duck and legendary wine list with both exotic and affordable options
Second time here. So outstanding. Food, service, ambiance. Perfection. Can’t wait to be back.
To celebrate mother’s Day.
We love it and go often.  We like the relationship between the Bankhead and Uncle Yu's.

Did Chef’s tasting menu as an anniversary dinner and it was incredible. Nice to sit back and  let the Chef surprise you. The ginger-butter lobster was out of this world. Been here many times but first time trying the tasting menu. A great experience.
Everything on their lunch specials menu tastes great with quick service, centrally located downtown, and beautiful dinning rooms which look larger than they are due to all the mirrors.
Great Mother’s Day experience. Wonderful greeting with speedy seating. The food was fantastic. Great atmosphere. We will surely be returning.
Delicious food and a great place with friends, family, or a date.  Attentive service and free parking nearby.

The food was outstanding. I was also impressed by the excellent local variety of the wine list. The wine was almost as hard to choose as my meal! I would probably recommend not going on holidays. I went on Mother’s Day and even with a reservation waited 30 minutes to be seated.

Mother’s dinner for 5. We arrived 15 mins early and was told to be seated soon. But we didn’t get a table until 15 mins past our appointment time. Very disappointed. After seated, we didn’t see our server for 10 mins. We have to ask the manager for server. The dishes are pretty salted. Overall a very unpleasant experience for a restaurant that have such a high review. Never again.
Mother’s Day

Went for Mothers day. Got seated within 5 minuets of my time.  Food was a little expensive but the quality was worth it. It's my second time there. We don't eat out much. We will be back soon. Had a wonderful meal. Mongolian Beef, Shanghai Noodles  Lotus Lettuce. Outstanding.

My family and I went to Uncle Yu's for Mother's Day and the food was GOOD! They have good portion size bowls or plates for two people to share. When you think about Chinese food you think about food in white boxes and sometimes not enough, but this is nothing like that. The food is fresh, hot and ready for you to enjoy. Who ever is reading this, find time to check this place out.
Even though our waiter wasn't Nick, he helped us with our wine choice as well as our food!  He's always so pleasant and helpful!

Uncle Yu’s was the perfect dining experience for Mother’s Day. Everyone liked the food (they have a vegan menu so I was extremely happy!) and appreciated the deep & calming color scheme/atmosphere. All the staff we encountered were efficient AND had a great sense of humor.  Most important, Mom had a great time.
Celebrated Mother's Day lunch; great service, excellent food, although a little bit on the pricier side. Lacy, our waitress was awesome.

We went for Mother's Day and had a great time!  Food and service.. and wine were all excellent.  I liked how it wasn't a special or fixed menu either - we were able to order off the regular menu and enjoyed some of our favorites entrees... and ate family style so tasted a variety.

Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard  is a great Asian restaurant,  The food itself is consistently good and the menu diverse enough for anyone to find something.  We did the shared dish style dining (it's amazing how much you miss those turntables when doing this) and the dishes were nicely varied enough for everyone to have something.  The prices are high moderate.

Another impressive part of the evening was the wine.  Nick, the proprietor, is a sommelier and has a very extensive wine list from around the world.  We chose a lovely French Gamay Beaujolais .  Wonderfully perfect with the Chinese food.  If you don't know what to do, feel free to ask.  They are very helpful.

There is a large lot for parking next door, but it can be difficult if there are events going on in Livermore.  Something to keep in mind.

It is popular so reservations are a must.
The food was spectacular.  This might be the best Chinese cuisine in the Bay Area.

We had an excellent experience at Uncle Yu's whilst celebrating a Golden Wedding anniversary.  One of our party has celiac disease and the server was most attentive and understanding about how the gluten free menu items should not be cross-contaminated in the kitchen.  The food was delicious as well as the cocktails and wine.  They have an excellent wine list.  The service was outstanding.  We had a lovely, relaxed dining experience.

The waiter forgot one of our dishes. When we asked about it he looked a little surprised and said “it’ll be right out”. I saw him go back to the register and type the order in. It came out in a few minutes - and it was not as we had ordered (shrimp instead of chicken. There was no admission and after that, no offer of compensation. I just thought that was poor form. It also very much disrupted our dinner. We ended up having to take the dish to go.
Never disappointing. Guests  visiting from out of town and they have never had better Asian cuisine.. top notch!

Taste and ingredients are top quality.  Orange beef, walnut prawns,  four bites, fried rice, duck, sea bass are unique.  Always use Wagyu beef.  Worldwide wine selection to pair with different dishes.  Service is excellent with most  servers.  Table bus personnel are tops.

Nice atmosphere and food is always delicious no matter what you order.  Service is consistent too   We sat outside this time as was such a nice evening.  We asked to take our time and the waiter didn’t rush our courses.  Nice cocktails and a great wine list too.  A happy evening for us!
Great dinner before a night at the Bankhead Theatre

Poor service - we had to get up to find server to order wine refills and also additional dressing that was initially ordered. Surprisingly slow/poor service as the restaurant was not very busy. Previous owner consistently ran restaurant 100% more efficiently. We previously dined here (and San Ramon) weekly for 25+ years.
Fabulous food
Food and service was very good

Came to celebrate a milestone birthday.  Most restaurants would acknowledge by the waiter / waitress wishing happy birthday.  Not this waitress at Uncle Yu here in Livermore.  The soup came quickly, the entrees not so fast.  The food was above average.  Waitress never checked back to see if we needed anything.  Then we ordered desserts.  Our water glasses had been empty since the middle of our entrees but were never filled.  Then the desserts were served and I had to ask her for more iced water.  The service here was extremely SLOW!  Definitely NOT ATTENTIVE at all.
Overpriced with poor service and mediocre food. Portion sizes and quality have gone way down over the years. It’s not worth a trip. We were ignored by the server and will not be returning.

Had a great lunch at Uncle Yu’s! The food was exceptionally good. Everything was prepared and cooked perfectly. I had sweet and sour pork which can, sometimes, be overlooked but it was tender and the sauce was amazing.
It was a bit busy for a Sunday and it took unusually long to get waited on but our server Jenna made up for it with attentiveness and her friendly smile! Overall a great meal.

Uncle Yu's never disappoints us.  Everytime we visit this restaurant we are always pleased with the excellent service, delicious food, and portions.  We were going to a show at the Bankhead so the staff serviced us expediently.   It is nice that this restaurant is always consistent.
Gluten free dishes were bland, Sea Bass was excellent

Wonderful food, very pricey wine.
Both whites we had were slammed by wines half their price.
We used to love this restaurant for birthdays and anniversaries.  Our recent visit left us feeling that the prices have increased, but the quality and quantity of the food has decreased.

Very disappointing. We’ve been here several times and it’s always been good, pricy, but good. What irritated us the most is we specifically said “No Onions” on anything and 4 of the 7 dishes we ordered had onion in it !!!!!!! Soup was warm at best which really is annoying. The server was pushing the eggplant appetizer because the table next to us had it also. 
We took her recommendation and was not impressed .
It was a business dinner so was very disappointing.
Great food and service!

While we've had enjoyable meals here before, tonight was a real disappointment. I will think twice before coming back. We arrived on time for an 8:15 reservation and were told they were running 10 minutes late. Okay, no problem. A half hour later, they said it would be another 10 minutes! At 9:00 pm we were finally seated with lots of excuses about "people not leaving". You're a restaurant. Your job is to understand your table turn rate. Had I been told at 8:15 that my reservation was pointless and it was a 45-minute wait, I would have walked down to any other restaurant on First Street and could certainly find something that didn't have a 45-minute wait. 
Unfortunately, there was nothing special about the dinner that warranted either the wait or the "premium" price. Did you really just charge me $9 for 4 tiny wonton chips with a dab of goat cheese? Why, yes, you did. The entrees were fine but nothing special. The room was too loud to be able to converse comfortably with those at my own table (although I do know everything about the kitchen remodel of the people at the next table).
Quite mediocre compared to the reviews we had read.

We love the food, wine and the sommelier Nick. It's always an adventure in wine tasting and the pairing he suggests are perfect 
We love this place
Uncle U's in Livermore is consistently great.  The wine list is superb, the food is excellent (especially the barque sea bass) and the service is second to none.  What more can you ask for.
Love dining at this ingredient eccentric, but never pretentious Livermore favorite.
We had a wonderful meal and excellent service.   Always a great place to dine.

This location was easy to find as well ample parking.  The sea bass puffs and crab cakes are excellent for starters. A Recommendation for an entree' would be the BBQ Sea Bass with soy beans & diced Zucchini although they should dice them a little larger. Overall my dining experience was pleasing and I will visit again.

We went for my wife's birthday. The quality of the food is way above average. The ambience is very upscale. Our waitress was excellent as well. 

A great place to go for Asian cuisine. There are many standards on the menu, but you will find plenty interesting options as well. 

I was surprised the prices are reasonable for such a upscale atmosphere.
The best service and great food. Michelle was our server and she went out of her way to make sure everything was great. The food is always consistent and pure quality.
It was really nice; great ambiance! Food was tasty - only ordered a few things. Will go back again.

Food was fantastic, definitely next level. Had some commonly seen Asian food dishes that were stepped-up versions of the old standbys. Good wine selection. Good atmosphere. A favorite. Also had gluten-free options.
A great dinner after attending Livermore Valley Opera performance! Thank you, Uncle Yu’s for sponsoring LVO!
Love everything about Uncle Yu’s. Our Singapore noodles were a little shy on curry this time, but highly recommended.

This was my first visit, and we will definitely go back.  We were a small group celebrating a birthday so I didn't have much time to peruse the menu, to I'm looking forward to my next dinner, and I'll update my review.  My initial perception is a very good (varied) menu, nice ambiance, with moderate pricing.  Any place you can get a very good entree for $24 and a nice glass of wine for $7.50 is a winner.

It was refreshing to find a page that offered Gluten Free Choices to one of the people  in our party!  That was appreciated.  The food is always good, but it was a little odd to have so much sauce on the plate.  I will have to remember that the next time to see if I can have less "squishy sauce".  Overall, it was nice!

This is not your small Chinese restaurant "down the block". Beautifully decorated, Unbelievable wine list plus bar service.
Fantastic Chinese Cuisine with excellent quality ingredients. 
The fish dish was tender and succulent. The Tea Duck was wonderful. The Bombas for dessert a real treat.
Absolutely fantastic. Service and food were on point.

Uncle Yus never lets you down!!!  One of our favorite restaurants and Nick the owner is incredible along with all of the staff!!!
We have been going every year for the Chinese New Year (along with other times during the year) special menu which I highly recommend.  It is creative and amazing!!!
Uncle you's you Rock!!!
Business dinner, great food! Will come back when I’m back in town.
Great food, great service. Will definitely be back!
A very nice lunch to celebrate multiple birthdays. The food was delicious.

We've been going to Uncle Yu's regularly for the last few years. We've found the food and service to be consistently excellent.  There are many fine choices on the menu and we especially like the sweet and sour chicken. They offer brown rice in addition to white rice. They have a great wine list for those who enjoy a glass of wine with their meal. There is a gluten-free menu as well - we tried a flourless chocolate cake which was decadent and tasty. They are conveniently located near the Bankhead Theatre and the Livermore Cinemas. You might want to make a reservation on Open Table (go to Uncle Yu's website) as they can get quite busy even on weeknights. Please note that this review is referring to the Uncle Yu's in Livermore - hope you enjoy.

Review on Yelp too.
Very busy.... which is good for the owners.... bad for the diners
Even with reservations it took an hour to be seated and we were even nice about it
Vodka Cranberry with Grey Goose..... watered down..... can Grey Geese fly
Heavenly Manhattan...... no Martini glasses... terrible drink too. I Ski at Heavenly but will never order this drink again or visit Manhattan. They did promo this drink on the receipt.
Wrong food order brought to our table...... receipt shown as promo.... do you think the owners know. 
The brown rice was terrible.... could have used it to mortar my bathroom tile..... the overflow server/ cook.... just smiled when we complained......where is ICE ......did I go too far
The waitress...... is that politically correct.... she probably got fired from Denny's last week
I have been to Uncle Yu's many times......its time to find a new go to restaurant in my City.
In all fairness the egg rolls are good, Lemon Chicken was OK, Spare ribs were really good.

We celebrated Valentine's Day with a lovely evening at Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard.  The food was absolutely delicious (3 course menu), the wine selections varied and wonderful, and to add to the romantic atmosphere, there was a beautiful string quartet entertaining us all evening.  Another fabulous occasion at Uncle Yu's.
Absolutely one of the finest dining experiences in Livermore.  The Valentines Day five (5) course meal was terrific! It could not have been better!!!
Uncle Yu's is always a favorite restaurant. The food is delicious and service is good.

There were several tables available and we were directed to a smaller table for 4. I asked to sit in one of the available booths but was told they save those for larger groups but less than 10 minutes later they said a group of 4 there. Then at the end we provided 2 cards and asked for the bill to be split evenly. My card was a gift card for $100. They charged the entire $100 and the other couple we were with only had their credit card charged for $65. The other couple paid the tip but we were still charged more and I wasn’t going to ask them to give me money to even it up. Food was good but we were extremely crowded and had plates on top of plates. Very disappointing
very nice place. Service was excellent. Easy to find and free parking next door. Great food  nicely presented.

Uncle Yu’s is a unique Asian fusion restaurant with a great variety of choices, both number of items and prices.  Five of us went to dinner and the bills varied from $14 to $65 (mine with wine).  They have a variety of soups from $5, entrees from $14-45, and a massive wine list. I want to return with my wife for the multiple course meal with wine pairings.  All five of us loved our food!
Wonderful meal all around.  The orange beef is fantastic!  Service is great and restaurant is beautiful.
All the dishes we had were good. The orange peeled beef had a better flavor than our previous trip.
The food was simply delicious and the service non intrusive, friendly and just right.
Great service and excellent food.  This is the only place we will get Chinese food
Love the new surprise menu!
Outstanding!  Appreciate the phenomenal experience.

Everything was perfection at Uncle Yu's last Saturday night.  From the wine selection and appetizers, to the main courses, the dishes were superb,  the service was excellent, and the ambiance was beautiful.  Special thanks to Nick who took such superb care of us.  We have not seen him since the San Ramon location closed, and he was as charming and accommodating as ever!  Thank you, Nick.
Going to uncle Yu’s has never failed to amaze us… The food is always excellent the service is beyond expectations… This is why we come back continually!

We stopped going to Uncle Yu’s about 2 Years ago after consistently bad service over several visits. We decided to give it another try last night, and had the best restaurant experience we’ve had in a very long time. The food was spectacular (as it always has been, really), but our server—Michelle—was the one who made it such a positive experience. Beyond her personality, which was warm and friendly without being disruptive or intrusive, she attended to our orders, or drinks, and our food in a way that was perfectly paced (not an easy task!). We got refills on our drinks without even asking, and were able to finish our appetizers just before the main courses started to arrive. She made my son’s birthday so special, a great experience for everyone all around!
Good but not good enough to go out of my way for

We met for lunch and were not disappointed.  The servers were friendly attentive and very helpful with recommendations. Everyone ordered off the lunch menu and we all had different dishes. I have the Sezchuan Shrimp. It was delicious. The lunch came with soup and it was great too. I highly recommend Uncle Yu’s and would go back for dinner.

We went for New Year’s Eve. In the past they had a limited prix fixe menu, however this year they offered a more extensive menu and the kitchen and service staff were overwhelmed. The food was still excellent, however the service suffered.
Food was excellent, fresh tasting with a variety of choices. The restaurant has a five star atmosphere and I would recommend highly.
Excellent. Gets better every time.

Food was good.  Server seemed on top of it for vegetarians, but served a the meat potstickers when veg was asked for...big yuck.  Also asked for rive, never received.  For us, curry wasn’t as good as recommended.
Wonderful Christmas Eve dining. Couldn't have been better.
Horrible, and we may never use Open Table again.  We are sick of your nasty no-show messages when we did show but the restaurant you represent will not honor the reservation.

VERY good food, good service, amazing wine list. A bit loud, but most restaurants are these days. Sigh.
I just hope they co it ue the quality along with their popularity.
Cheers

Always consistently delicious.  Good service but usually it’s great.   Nice wine list.  Lovely cozy setting.  Highly recommend for lunch or dinner.   Also a nice patio outdoors in nice weather.  Must make reservation.

Hi, we had a reservation for eight people at 7:30.  Unfortunately, we could not be seated until 7:50.
We had preselected and ordered our food some two weeks earlier and agreed to have the menu printed by Uncle Yus.
Unfortunately, they adid not print it, nor advise us that they couldn’t.
Our server was not aware of menu, advanced food order or the special occasion and advised us that we could have ordered the food two days prior. We advised her that the order had been accepted two weeks prior. She then advised us that she was new and wasn’t aware.
No major issue as the management team apologized and compensated by providing free appetizers.
We had a great time, food was great ( as always ) and we will continue to dine in our favorite restaurant.
But, the feedback is well intended and not a complaint. Hopefully, it will prevent oversights like this for diners going forward
Very Good Food but the place is a bit busy and seating is close.  I still recommend this place for a good night out for dinner.
Consistently delicious food great ambience warm and cosy.   Superb service.  Live the booths.  Highly recommend creative cuisine.
Excellent service and great food. Dim sum were delicious.  Great location.

The food was good, but not great.  The spicy stuff really wasn't spicy at all and the Hot and Sour soup could have been hotter and more sour!  We like the white pepper and vinegar.

The waitress was fun but her service kind of fell off at about the middle of our meal and she never asked us if we wanted dessert.  She brought the bill and we said we would like to look at the dessert menu!

All in all, not a bad experience, but not one we want to repeat anytime soon.

Love Uncle Yu's !!

Our waitress, Clarin, was so incredible and kind.  Truly a wonderful place !

This was my second visit to this restaurant.  Unfortunately, the second time was not as good as the first.  The appetizers were the only bright spot on the evening - they were spectacular.  However, drinks were not delivered (had to remind the server), and were not refilled promptly (again had to remind the staff).  For what we paid, we really expected a higher level of service from this restaurant.  I am not sure when we will be returning.
We're regulars at Uncle Yu's. A great menu and a super wine list. Excellent downtown Livermore CA location too.
Better value version of PF Chang’s
Service was great as usual. I liked it that the soup and appetizers came first with a little lull before the entrees.

Ot was my birthday dinner and even though I put this info in the notes when I booked the reservation, the server had no idea and that was disappointing.  He did bring over a delicious bowl of mango ice cream that I enjoyed very much.  Overall the food was good. Very busy and lively, we would consider another visit.

My friend and I had a great dinner. The service was fast, professional, and outstanding!  My Riesling selection was the best and my friend enjoyed the "Yutini."  Our only problem were the annoying fruit flies that seemed to be drawn to our table. I think it was because we were under a light.
Food and service we’re great!
This is THE place to meet for fantastic Chinese food. The ambiance is second to none and we love the service. 2 👍🏽s up.
Exceptional food and wonderful service - absolutely delightful evening!!

Some of the dishes were good, some were inedible.
The service, however, was terrible. Not a single happy face in sight.
It took ages for even appetizers to come out, then they came out one by one and some were missed.  When looking for someone to ask questions, there was no staff in sight.
Part way through the meal some strange alarm went off at the bar, and was ignored for about 5 minutes.  Really odd that no-one was even in the room for that time period, even though a dozen tables were occupied.
Never again.
Relatives visit from east coast

This was my first time at this restaurant but I was with a group of friends who had been there before. It took over 45 minutes to get our wine and one dish was pretty much inedible (very dry). The server wasn't very friendly and not too attentive. Our bus boy was great though and kept up with water refills etc. The friends who had been here before said their original experience was much better. Maybe it was a off night :/
Food is always wonderful, and presentation is great
The food was exceptional!! I was very impressed. I heard many good things and had never tried it, but it definitely lived up to the hype!!
Our table was ready for our party of five when we arrived.  The food was fresh, hot, and delicious .  The service was excellent.
This is a beautiful restaurant and the food and service were excellent.
Went here on a business dinner and everyone in our group was very pleased with every dish we ordered, great service, and excellent wine list.

Everything was delicious i'm considering Saturday night is probably one of the busiest nights, the service was great. It started off with some soup that is always super tasty. We dove into the Peking duck, shrimp and scallops, like there was no tomorrow. We ended the night with a little green tea ice cream and a sugar high the last of the whole drive home!

As always, uncle Yu's delivers a great experience!
Great food with minimal wait. Always fresh and high quality ingredients. Priced fair for the quality. Service always friendly and courteous. Great for date night as well as family night.
Great food as always - service is attentive but not hovering. Went for a birthday and he brought a wonderful dessert with a candle... very nice place - we dine in and get take out. Always great.

We had a pre-show dinner here on a Friday night.  Our waiter was very attentive.  We ate off the gluten-free menu, which a good variety of options.  The food was delivered promptly and was very tasty.  One of our party has celiac disease so it is important that there is no cross-contamination in the kitchen.  She was fine after the meal.  The restaurant has a nice vibe and is close to parking and the theatre.

We enjoyed the tasting menu with wine parings
Each course was more extraordinary than the one before
Belle's attention and service were flawless, as was that of the sommelier.
A meal like this is something everyone should enjoy at least once!!
One of the best restaurants in the tri-valley area.  Love the Peking Duck!

We had the 3 course wine pairing dinner and it was really good.  The 3 appetizers were each paired with their own wine samples.  The main course was wonderful and the pairing was perfect.  The desert and its pairing was out of this world.  We plan to return again!
Not a good visit. Will not be returning. Over-priced for nothing.
Great food, wine and location.  Service was A+.  This is the second time for me to go the place but will go again.

Best date restaurant we've been to in a long time. We enjoy the Uncle Yu's in Lafayette, and also liked the cocktails in the one in San Ramon (now closed). Thought we would try the vineyard branch of the chain, and weren't disappointed. Lovely candle-lit ambience, and 35 page wine list! The hand-crafted cocktails are also amazing & flavorful. Had the dragon bao, duck, beef and soup, and all were superb. Wait staff is prompt and pleasant, we will definitely return :)

I reserved a table for 7 for a birthday lunch.  We were escorted to a semi-private room with about 4 tables  but we were the only party in the room.  We each ordered a dish to eat family style and with the rotating center it was easy to fill the plates.  The food could not have tasted any better.  The BBQ Sea Bass was exquisite!  Well...it was all so delicious .  We also partook the Kung Po Chicken,  crispy salt and pepper calamari, prawns with honey walnuts, Peking Scallops, vegetable fried rice, wor wonton soup, and shrimp chow mein. We laughed and very much enjoyed dining in Uncle Yu's Restaurant.  Oh we also had 4 different desserts...all delicious especially the Pear Tart!  I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant and I will return to dine again.  They also make a mean Bloody Mary. The service was top notch as well.

Luke was our server, friendly and very helpful to describe some dishes we had questions about.  Martini's are iconic!   I  love that Uncle Yu's is in Livermore.  It has class, impeccable.  thank you for  being here...

I know it was over 100 outside but bringing the guitar player inside from the patio was a bad decision. Cancel and pay the performer - it was unbearably loud with the music inside and very hard to have a conversation over dinner. 

Usually love Uncle Yus - this was just a bad decision.

I love Uncle Yu's as the food is wonderful.  However, the noise level is over the top!  Had dinner there Sunday night, and it was quite possibly, the worst dining experience I've ever had due the noise level, and the table of 12 very boisterous people sitting next to us.  Also, there was a singer with a guitar in the dining room.  Obviously, could not hear her, nor would I want to.  Terrible environment to enjoy a dinner in.  Sorry Uncle Yu's, I won't be back for a while.
Have been coming since moving to Livermore 10 years ago.  Good food and wonderful wine list -- very unusual for a Chinese restaurant.  Staff is friendly and has treated our kids very well --

Had a date night here last week. Food and service were both decent, but significantly above the average for Livermore, so I'll definitely be back.

Food highlights included the crab stuffed shrimp- super decadent, and the bbq seabass, which was an overkill of fun lobstery texture in the best way. General tso's chicken was not crispy as I was anticipating but was incredibly tender. 

On the other hand the noodles for the Wagyu Chow fun weren't cooked properly and stuck together in clumps of un-sauced, incompletely boiled yuck. The pork bun combined some very proper steamed bun with unseasoned, flavorless ground pork filling. Like a home run that sails just out of bounds, it could have been really great. 

Service kept things moving along nicely though. The hostess helped us find just the right table, and our server Clarin was prompt and responsive.

Our drinks were never empty (huge plus for me, nothing makes a person feel forgotten- and helpless- more than being thirsty and being able to do nothing about it). Clarin also happened to be nearby after all our first bites. Most of the time things were just fine, so these were uneventful visits, but when the seabass turned out to be cold and raw in the middle, she just so happened to be right there to take it back. 

Overall, an experience that could have gone either way was properly managed to be a solidly good night. We'll be back.

Our first time and Uncle Yu's. and we were overall very impressed with the the food and the restaurant. Michelle our server was great and very helpful in making sure our dining experience was a memorable one.
I always enjoy dining at Uncle Yu's.  The menu options are varied and there is always an option for everyone.
Nice ambiance, friendly staff but food was mediocre.  Chinese chicken salad a big disappointment. No flavor. Other dishes were drenched in sauce. Will not return soon.
We had a most enjoyable dinner at Uncle Yu's.  The food was very tasty.    Our server was friendly and attentive.    The cocktails from the bar were excellent!
Always a good time!
Three of us celebrated one birthday. As anticipated the food was terrific, although the Mongolian beef arrived colder than preferred. Service was not up to par. Disappointing.
It was my wife's birthday and we enjoyed ourselves. The wait staff took good care of us. We would like more attention to vegan dishes, however.
The food was exceptionally well prepared, extensive wine which was a pleasant surprise and Brenda’s service was outstanding.
We always enjoy dining at Uncle Yu's.    However, over the past few visits the service has not been up to par.

Service was ridiculous, I had to complain after 20 minutes just to get someone's attention

Millennial workers have no clue what customer service, what a mistake to come there for our 26th wedding anniversary
Uncle Yu's - great food in Livermore. Part of the great Uncle Yu's tri-valley tradition!

This is probably what you can consider a high-end restaurant for Livermore.   The atmosphere is very nice.  It's elegant but not so much you feel like you to be dressed formally.  Actually, there was a mix of very casual to nicely dressed and no one seemed to care.  Food is very tasty.  My favorite is the Walnut Shrimp.  The shrimp are huge, so I'd say they were more prawns than fish.  They have a good wine list and a full bar.  They have a nice outdoor patio.   Reservations Friday & Sat. are highly recommended.

Decent food, a bit pricey for the quality but still a good experience. The staff took my credit card but inexplicably failed to run it.  We spent 500 on a group meal.  So I got a phone call later that night which was irritating.  No apologies from them for their mistake.
The dim sum platter was excellent, and the pumpkin shrimp dumpling was very unique.
We had a wonderful lunch with cocktails before attending a movie downtown.great service and as usual delicious food.

Great food!
Great ambience!

I have been going to this Uncle Yu's for years.  After the change of ownership, it has never been the same.  Food is frequently dull and the service is adequate, but nothing more.  We had to flag our waiter down a couple of times to get drinks refilled and to ask for a bill.

Service was friendly and helpful, but slow. Food is always delicious...with many very flavorful dishes. Some in our party thought spice was a little light. It always maddens me that you have to buy white rice. At $20 for an entree, at least white rice should be included. Don't come here if you're looking for good value - the food and drink is expensive.

The food is a creative spin on old favorites and when paired with some of Nick's recommendations it brings the experience to a new level. The eggplant dishes are always an outstanding surprise to those who don't "like" eggplant.
We have been regulars Starting in San Ramon and then from when they opened in Livermore-
 Nick has taken the Uncle Yu's name to a level well above the original.

We had great service the food was very good. We had a few appetizers to share and we all ordered an entrée to share. 

Every dish that we ordered was better than I thought they would be.  I will go back there again and again.
Always a great meal in store at Uncle Yu's. We ended our meal moving outside to listen to an up and coming local artist that really made the evening special!
It was very enjoyable. The service was good and I liked the music.
Most amazing food and service!!!
First time I have had not the best service.  Our server seemed to have many tables outside and forgot about us. Iahvebeen going here for years.
Great meal. Great entertainment.
Outstanding wines with excellent food. Worth the trip
The food is always fantastic, while the service is consistently slow.  It's a scenario I've come to live with . . . love the food . . . tolerate the poor service.
This has always been an amazing place to dine that serves clean Asian food.

We have eaten at other Uncle Yu's in the East Bay
With the Kung Pao Trio The other restaurants gave you more beef,chicken or scallops and 3 prawns
At this location I received 2 prawns,very little beef and the same with the chicken
It was very tasty but mostly vegetables
Great birthday dinner in honor of my sixteen year old. Great service and amazing food.
The atmosphere,  the food, and the service was outstanding.

Sadly because of extreme heat the power was out and we couldn't have our Father's Day dinner there but Uncle Yu's is our favorite restaurant anytime so we will always return there. The service and staff are amazing and the food is always on point.
Great food, wine, customer service, romantic and elegant.
Uncle Yu's Vineyards in Livermore never disappoints. Whether large or small parties food is consistent and delicious!!!
Uncle Yu's never disappoints! Everything I've ever had on the menu is excellent.

The food at this place is wonderful as always. 
My only complain is the wait time. Even after making a reservation for 6.30 they could not seat us till 7pm. The whole purpose of making a reservation is so that you do not have to wait. I would not have mind a 10 -15 minute wait beyond reservation time. However to wait for 30minutes beyond your reservation time was absurd!!! They need to improve on this, other than that, the food is always excellent and the atmosphere is great!

Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard's food is an excellent and a great choice to celebrate birthdays.  My girlfriend surprised me and took me out to dinner for my birthday.  I ordered from the Gluten Free menu that had several choices.  Also, we ordered the Flourless Chocolate Cake which was also Gluten Free - Delicious...  My girlfriend ordered her usual the Peking Short Ribs that she says are always good!  I ordered the prawns and vegetables with brown rice.  Overall rating 5 of 5, excellent.
Good ambience, good service, great selection of food and a whole page of dishes for gluten-free diners!
Great lunch specials.  Good choices for all.  Great value for price.
Great food. I always go here!!
The food and the service were, per usual, excellent.
Uncle Yu's never disappoints. They have great lunch specials. Our waitress could have been friendlier (many past experiences with excellent service and she may have been new. Great wine list too.
Our daughter was visiting from SoCal.  Uncle Yu's is her favorite Chinese restaurant in the Tri-Valley.   We had a wonderful family lunch which we all thoroughly enjoyed.
Great service. Friendly, patient, knowledgeable. Good food and atmosphere. An good place to be able to have conversations.
Fantastic! The food is absolutely delicious and the service was great. Can't wait to come back!
My date and I loved our experience so much that we purposely missed our movie show time and went to a later show instead!

Three lady friends gathered at Uncle Yu's for dinner Friday night.  The place was hopping, so we were so glad we had reservations.  It's a great atmosphere, superior service and a fun vibe at Uncle Yu's.  Food is incredibly delicious!  Try it, you'll come back again and again as we do.

Mothers' day dinner - no better place to have it. 
The food consistently excellent. 
The wait staff is deeply knowledgeable in wine pairing so that helps assure the perfect choice. 

If you bring kids, no worries. Even though they don't have a kids' menu, simple things like sticky rice, pot stickers, and egg rolls should get them by. My suggestion for the young kids is to stick to the appetizers.

Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard is one of our favorites! The wine list is extensive and the food is wonderful...no matter your choice from the menu. Our waiters are always friendly and helpful but never "hovering". Whether its a lunch date with my friends or date night with my husband, our experiences are always "top notch"! Can't wait to go again...
The food here is exceptional! We eat here every few months and are never disappointed. The string beans, scallops and sea bass are all a must try.
Would highly recommend the lobster fried rice. Gorgeous place and amazing food

Uncle Yu's is a fusion cuisine. Some dishes are inspired by Chinese dishes, but not quite authentic Chinese. I highly recommend BBQ see bass and tea smoke duck. The outdoor dining area looks attractive, but I didn't dare to try, because that day was a little bit cold and windy.
Excellent food, wonderful service, great price. Uncle Yu's is our favorite downtown Livermore restaurant.
Great food, fantastic wine flights
Great food, ambiance and service!
Always a great time.

Uncle Yu’s said they would not honor our Opentable reservation and that the wait would be at least one hour.  We have eaten there many times over the past 20 years, in San Ramon and Livermore.  We will never eat there again.
My wife and I attend concerts at the Bankhead Theater often and Uncle Yu's is always perfect for such an evening with its parking convenience to the theater and truly excellent Chinese offerings.

The food at Uncle Yu's is always delicious, and the lunch specials, which include soup, entree, and rice or noodles, are a wonderful deal.  Our birthday get-together dined on chicken kung-po, Mongolian beef, and prawns.  All dishes were served quickly and we enjoyed trying each of the entrees.  White tablecloths and napkins, nice ambience, and attentive service made our luncheon very enjoyable!  And the birthday girl enjoyed a dish of mango sorbet for dessert!  Enjoyed our lunch!
Great service, good food and nice scenery. We had a wonderful time on our "date night" and will definitely come back!

We hadn't been to Uncle Yu's at the Vineyard in a while, but they certainly haven't lost their touch.  The ambience is very interesting and upscale.  Our server could have been a little friendlier, but her service was good.  I especially appreciate that they have Wagyu beef on the menu and lots of vegetables.  Every dish was well-executed and very tasty.  I'd prefer they use a little less oil, as the dishes were too slithery and it seems like a waste to use that much when less will do.  The tea was excellent, the seats comfy and the atmosphere festive for our joint birthday party.

Boyfriend and I made reservations for 7 pm and arrived a little early so sat and waited a bit. Pretty sure our wait time was in line with the promised reservation time. Wine list was a bit overwhelming as they have a lot to choose from. I ended up ordering a flight of wine to sample a few vs committing to one glass. We ordered the Mandarin Beef and it was a pleasant surprise to my boyfriend. He typically does not order beef in dishes as they tend to be dry, tough, and/or have quite a bit of grissle. This meat was tender and the outside flash fried to give it a perfect crispness without being overly crunchy. The candied and fresh orange peel gave the dish great flavor. This sealed the deal for my boyfriend and we will be coming back. We also had the triple crown and commented that the textures were all very nice. Meat was tender and vegetables were not over cooked or soggy.
The sea bass is so delicious !  We always base our meal around that item.
We love Uncle Yu's!  Great food, great ambiance, and great service!  I especially appreciate the gluten free menu.
The lunch specials offer a good variety of very reasonably priced, high quality meals. This restaurant is excellent  in all respects. I will definitely return!
As always YU's shines bright midst the hoard of Yuppies and Millenniums. We mature visitors just love the staff and food. We even got to sit in Big Johns booth....
The food was excellent -- as usual -- and the service matched.  We return to Uncle Yu's as often as we can!
It was my best friend's birthday. Food was okay, kinda salty. Service was not up to par. Waiter was inattentive & didn't even recognize Birthday, even after telling him.
The dinner was excellent, they seated us right on time, the service was done to perfection.

Uncle Yu's never disappoints!
We had a lovely anniversary dinner this week, Lotus Chicken is a must, as well as Pork Buns. Prawns with Walnuts and all accompanied by  outnof this world  Chow Mein.
Add in a great bottle of Wente Pinot Blanc, you have another great evening in the books!
Staff was attentive, friendly and everything was delicious. We will definitely return!

We had a great dinner. Staff was great on a busy night, lots of good wine being poured, and when the food arrived things were taken to the next level. They have their own dim sum chef! 'Nuff said. Make sure you get the dim sum appetizer to start out.

Forgot how much better uncle yu's is than other Chinese restaurants.  Very good food, solid service and great wine choices.   A little pricey for this type of food, but worth it on an occasional basis.  Hot sour soup, spicy string beans and special Kung pao some of our favorites.

Restaurant ambience was really nice. The wine list, as suggested in other reviews, was really good. Maybe the items that we ordered weren't their best. The eggplant & chicken lettuce wraps appetizers were really good. However, the orange peel beef had barely any beef in it. The other entrees were all okay. Didn't try the dessert menu.

The meal and service were excellent.  The great tasting Crabmeat Cheese Puff appetizer was wrapped in a thin wonton served warm and cheesy.  The prawns in the Seafood Soup were large and fresh tasting, and the remainder of the seafood items had wonderful tastes and textures.  There were large prawns in the sweet tasting Prawns with Honeyed Walnuts, and the chicken in the Lemon Chicken had just the right amount of lemony taste.  Both the Prawns with Honeyed Walnuts and Lemon Chicken were covered with enjoyable light sauces.  The server was extremely professional and attentive.  I will be returning to try other items on the impressive menu.
Our favorite place to eat in Livermore! Worth our 40 minute drive!
The food was amazing and the staff was great as well. We will definitely be going back.
The waiter was very professional and friendly. The food was delicious, and a large menu to choose from. I would recommend this restaurant to family and friends.

Unfortunately not the normal high quality experience expected at Uncle Yu's.  Service was slow and inaccurate with undercooked pot stickers and wine refill that never showed.  When you spend $100.00 for Chinese food, you expect a great experience.
Always a good meal!
Consistent food quality and excellent service. We've been going to Uncle Yu's for years and never disappointed.
We always love Uncle Yus! Always delicious with great service.

Uncle Yu's is one of the BEST Chinese restaurants.  One of our friends tells me she can no longer dine at "regular" Chinese restaurants since she tasted the delicious dishes at Uncle Yu's.  The Hot and Sour soup is a favorite, as well as the Asian Salmon Pizzetta, the Red Cabbage Salad, and General Tso's chicken, but there are so many other delicious dishes.

Uncle Yu's always provides excellent Chinese/American food.  The ambiance is very comfortable and the noise level is low enough that one can have a meaningful conversation without shouting.  Great for lunch.  The only distractions are the wide screen TVs over the bar giving the feeling of a sports bar, which it is not.  Easy parking with handicapped parking right behind the bulding.
The service was slow, and when I mentioned it, the situation was remedied immediately.  I was very impressed.  We will go back.
Overwhelmingly mediocre

Food was excellent.  The problem was that it took 45 minutes to arrive at our table after ordering.  We complained and the restaurant comped us with a free desert.  We were not campaigning for a free desert but to let them know the wait for the food was excessive.

Also, parking is a problem although this is really not the restaurant's problem.
Was first time came to this restaurant with friend, it is peace and nice inside, it is tasting menu. good  fiting good for foodies!
The food was tasty and good quality. Service was prompt and friendly.

Celebrated my wive's birthday

We've been there several times since we live in Livermore and we're very grateful to have such a great restaurant in our town. 

The food is always delicious and there is a certain delicacy about all the dishes that makes everything taste a few notches above the rest.
Always consistently good.  Waiter was exceptional.  We basically spent the afternoon.
Enjoyed a delicious lunch special plate

We've been here many times, but this time was especially amazing. We were going for our little sister's 18th birthday. We input the note in the reservation that we were celebrating the occasion. Upon arriving, we opened our menus and found a custom sign wishing her a happy birthday with the date. Food and service were excellent! It came time for dessert and our sister was unsure what she wanted. Our server was going to get dessert menus but instead came back with a trio of mini desserts with a candle lit and sang happy birthday. It was a great experience.
Excellent food and service. Our table was a bit crowded - and we were a bit too close to front door.  The place always is crowded so we were lucky to have a reservation.
This is a great place to have dinner.  The food was amazing and overall service was excellent.
Dinner was fabulous as usual.  Love the Honey Walnut Prawns.
Excellent food and service.  The wine list is extensive and the waiters know what wine to pair with the food.
You pay a bit more than the typical Chinese restaurant, but it's well worth it!  Every dish I've ever had there is just amazing.  Great wine and drink selection as well.
Great lunch menu!
very good quality and nicely prepared.  broad selection.  fresh ingredients across all servings.  reasonable price.  definitely a neighborhood gem.  went at lunch, not sure about dinners or crowds.
Our server was fantastic and the food and wine pairing were absolutely top notch. Easily one of the best dining experiences I've ever had.
We arrived early and were seated late - we had the five course dinner with wine and the sequencing and delivery of the courses suffered/not good.
Very nice place but pricing was a bit high for Chinese cuisine.
Food tastes good and the Portions were very appropriate ...  service was not good.  Waiter did not understand the difference between pan fried and steamed dumplings.
Great food and service which was priced right
Lunch with a dear friend! Thanks for excellent service! Rafael was especially attentive and efficient! Thanks!
Crab cheese puffs are a must, they are delicious and the spicy sauce adds to the flavor depth!  Hot & Sour soup is one of the best we have ever tasted!  Will definitely come back!

Uncle Yu's has always been one of our favorite places. The food is very fresh and natural, not saucy like some of the Chinese restaurants we have gone to.. The Chinese chicken salad is loaded with fresh chicken. We love this place.

Gorgeous Livermore offers many exceptional restaurants but Uncle Yu's stands out for the consistent quality of its food, ambience, and very convenient location close to the Bankhead Theater. My wife and I always love dining there before a concert.  Livermore has so much to offer that it is well worth the usually ghastly drive from San Jose on a weeknight to enjoy its evening activities.  Be sure to ask the staff for recommendations as the menu varies.

As always, a great meal at Uncle Yu's Livermore.  Food was perfect and service was spot on!  Because the bar is not separate from the dining area, the noise level goes up when the bar is full and the tv's and music are on, but Americans tend to be noisy when dining.

After reading the reviews for Uncle Yu's we were not disappointed with our dinner! Simply amazing! Our group had 8 and everything we tried was excellent. 

We will be back again soon!

We always love to come here! We came during Chinese New Year. It was very busy, and much louder than usual. We expected a busy place so came with patience! We waited a very long time for our food and drinks, but we enjoyed them all once they arrived!
We'll be back, just not on New Year's Day again:)!
Fresh and flavorful entrees.   Love it.

Excellent service and food.  We had the Dover Sole in a Peking sauce was to die for!
Perfectly cooked-Fantastic!
Great food great service. My mother's 80 surprise party was a hit.

the staff were very attentive and made us feel welcome, the drinks were served very quickly and our order taken promptly,  the food arrived within a reasonable time and it was very good, we all had different things and every body enjoyed it. Will definitely be back to this one, its a keeper.

Uncle Yu's is an exceptional dining experience.  The food was excellent, with new flavors and delicious creativity for even old favorites.  The sea bass was exceptional.  We over-ordered and the few leftovers were gone by the next day.  Recommend you allow enough time for the meal if you are getting to the theater.  Not a place for a "fast bite," but a great place to relax and enjoy fantastic food.   The service was excellent, with very friendly staff.
The food as always was fantastic.  Our friends had never been to Uncle Yu's and said it was the best chinese food they have ever had.  Service was outstanding.
I love this restaurant! It is always delicious and has a great variety of choices. The Peking duck is excellent! And all the appetizers are wonderful. The service is warm and friendly.

Once again the food is amazing. Our server Joan is the best, explains the menu in detail. The Eggplant is wonderful the Walnut Prawns were perfect. I have yet to have something I did not like. As there were 10 of us we had so much food. I can't list it all.   The Uncle Yu's Tini is the best.
As always, the food was delicious and the service was prompt and courteous.  Really like this restaurant and would recommend it highly.  A tad pricey, but the quality of the food makes uo for it.

Uncle yus is consistently excellent food and drinks in a warm setting.  The service is always superior and there is an In House sommelier.   On this cold evening my husband and I were in the mood for comfort food so we shared Kung pau chicken with pork fried rice which is always delicious and did not disappoint.  Their hot and sour soup is the best ever.  We did also share a vegetable and tofu dish that was disappointing and lacked flavor tho I asked for spicy.  Way too high a tofu to veg ratio- we had only a few bites, there were hardly any veg which I had asked for. The waiter had recommended but it was not a good choice.   Otherwise a lovely evening!   Can't beat the ambience and wonderful martinis too.

My wife and I went to celebrate her birthday, and we both ordered the chef's special 5-course tasting with wine pairings. Service got off to a slow start, probably because we shared a server with a birthday dinner party of 20 guests, which occupied most of the "party room" where we were seated. After 15 minutes, we finally received the sparkling wine that we had ordered as a starter, and afterwards service was responsive and well-timed. After 30 minutes, the big party received their main courses, and the noise level dropped to a reasonable level.
The food was excellent, as we expected, and wine parings were amazing. The "BBQ" (roasted) sea bass was our favorite dish. We were disappointed in the wagyu tenderloin, which had been one of our favorites on previous occasions, and is possibly my wife's favorite. It was tender and flavorful, but lean and overcooked for our preference. We apologized to our server for failing to specify our preference for rare, and he apologized by removing the cost of that course from her fare.
OTOH, the cab pairing for the beef was our favorite wine for the evening. When we gushed to the sommelier he brought us an extra pouring. And the food-wine combo that blew us away was an oaky chard paired with seared scallop as part of the first course. (I know, that pairing sounds obvious and trivial, but the two really lifted each other into unexpected heights of flavor.)
Uncle Yu's is my favorite restaurant in the Tri-Valley, and it's one of my wife's favorites. We have sophisticated tastes in food and wine, perhaps even snobbish. Our experience this time was nearly perfect, as we have come to expect. We'll probably go again for the opera gala next month.

Everything was perfect, as usual. Food is always very fresh tasting. Each dish has it's own wonderful flavors. Restaurant is beautiful, lighting is perfect, food is extraordinary. Huge wine list. This restaurant is consistently excellent no matter what day or time we've dined here.

First time to try here because I was attracted by the Peking Duck and Rock Lamb. They are very good! Just feel a bit of pricy, otherwise, food are very good. I booked a table via Open table, but I guess my special note were not being noticed. We were there to celebrate my husband's birthday. We got a free treat the end of meal, but wish to have a personal touch would be even better. Overall, good dining experience.

Went there to celebrate a birthday.  Food was delicious, it always is. Plenty of choices for a group of 8 to share.  Server was kind of blah.  She did her job but not much personality.  Didn't make any suggestions as to type of food or how many a dish would serve.  Most importantly, everyone got something they really liked to eat.

It was nice.  The check ended up being approximately 1/3 more than we usually see when we go out for Chinese.  I can see this place being a nice place to meet after work or maybe a date night.  We'll stick with our hometown favorite though.
I've eaten at Uncle Yu's at the Vineyards several times over the past few years and the service is always stellar, as is the food.
Good food and great service.  Excellent wine selection.

Food was excellent as always as was the service. However since we've been going to this restaurant the prices have increased significantly and the portions have shrunk. Also I felt pressure by the staff to turn the table which given price is ridiculous.

Always enjoy Uncle Yu's. However, this visit was disappointing.  We had to wait a bit longer than usual to be seated and the service was very slow.   Our waiter seemed disinterested and made no apology for the slow service.  A few kinds words would have been welcomed and appreciated, especially given that there were only two of us dining for lunch. We were polite and did not complain even though we could have given the long lag time between courses.  As we know, a sincere acknowledgment and thank you goes a long way.
It was amazing, I love this place!!! Everything was perfect, as usual!

We visited on Christmas Eve.  The restaurant was packed.  Our reservation was at 6:15 pm and we were seated promptly.  Our server was attentive and suggested an additional entree for the table.  We had the pot stickers, honey walnut prawns, mixed fried rice, lemon chicken and the Buddhas vegetables.  The pot stickers were the favorite of the table!  
We opened a few gifts and we did not feel like we were rushed in any way.  We will definitely be back.
The best Chinese fusion ever.  Fresh crispy vegetables.  Could use a little more salt and pepper in rice but I am NOT complaining.  Been there many times and I simply love the place.  Big smiles
Uncle's U's is one of our favorite restaurants. Never disappoints.

Three months later and I can still recall how bad the food was. Uncle Yu's had great reviews so we gave it a try for lunch. Frankly Livermore has a long way to go if this passes as an outstanding restaurant.

I ordered the appetizer plate for my meal which included shu mai and salmon "puffs". The shu mai was bland and filled with some brownish-grey paste as was one of the other items. The salmon item had an orange paste and a sweet, flaky crust. The only condiment on the table was soy sauce.

My friend had Chinese chicken salad. The chicken was breaded and fried. I looked around at the food at the other tables and saw the same thing - insipid, Westernized "Chinese" food. Everything was fried and covered in gloopy sauces. I saw nothing that resembled classic Chinese food. 

I realize that I'm a fault for not being more critical of the descriptions I read beginning with the generic "Chinese" food without a regional attribution like Hunan or Szechuan. I guess I was surprised because we have such a range of Chinese food in the Bay Area, in California so I don't understand why Uncle Yu's is trying to pass off their food as classic and authentic let alone that it's a gourmet destination.

We recently went for a special holiday lunch. We each ordered an entrée and we had a side of chow mien and fried rice for the group. There was nothing left to take home because it was so good. The honey calamari was something new to most of us and it was fabulous!
Everything was very good, food, drinks.  server lacked personality and no suggestive selling.
Great food! Great service! A little crowded tables, no private conversations here. Will be back!

Food is always top notch. Very flavorful and nicely presented. Staff is reasonably attentive, though several requests required repeats. Eggplant appetizer was particularly delicious and the honey calamari dinner is always excellent. For the prices, rice should be included - at least white or brown. Don't get tricked into order the fried rice as they serve a version with 5-10 protein items - tasty, but in appropriate with the dinner item you're likely to put it on...AND it costs $12 - the waitress didn't tell us that when she offered it. We were very surprised and disappointed when we saw a $12 rice dish on the bill.

So bottom line: Very good food, but overpriced and given the fried rice surprise - it will be a long time before I return to Uncle Yu's. Conditionally recommended with the reservations and caution mentioned here.

The food is great. We have gone here for most of our special occasions but this time the waiter was extremely rude. We had a large party and spent about $500. The waiter was in a hurry at the end to make us leave. He asked if we wanted anything else. My husband asked for a refill on his coffee and he said ok but we have another party coming in behind you. When he came back with the coffee I told him it was very rude to  tell us  that we basically needed to leave for the other party coming in when we had spent so much money. He said well sorry but I am just worried about the next party getting seated. Insaid you are more worried about people who havent arrived yet than you  are about the people who are still here? He said well sorry if you think that's rude.  The manager asked what was going on and I explained to him and he said sorry don't worry about him and take your time. I think since we had a large party the waiter was guaranteed his tip so he didn't care how he treated us.  It's a shame because we were there to celebrate my son's birthday and the waiter ruin it
Wasn't impressed. I could have gotten the same thing at a Chinese take out. Very expensive for what you get.
A go to for us when we entertain guests from out of town. Everything on the menu is good. Nice choice of wines.

Service is good.  Food portion is small for the price.  Most potsticker appetizer orders come in quantities of 6.  This location has a quantity of 4.  Main dishes as well - portion sizes are small.

Since we have a big family of growing boys, going to a restaurant that has high price for small portions is not the way to go.

We like to graze and wine it--so this restaurant was perfect for us. Noise level was almost over the line, but bearable. The food (all starters, which we shared) was deliscious and definitely not run of the mill Chinese--e.g. Giant prawns in phyllo, crispy eggplant. Yum!  They also feature Livermore Valley wines and the service was very amiable.
Always a favorite - great food, often with a twist.  Best wine list in Livermore!  This time we ordered two different flights of five Livermore wines each and shared them.

Uncle Yu's is my favorite restaurant in the Tri-Valley.  The food and wine are excellent!
JeanS

Took the family for Sunday lunch, we order 5-6 entrees with some Brown rice, plenty to feed all of us. They provide an option for a portion and a half so we took advantage on same family favorites. Food came out together which was great given we order quite a spread. Decent fare, attentive staff and value for money.
Excellent service with great food.  Nice ambiance. Good menu selection.
The ambiance is great, the wine list extensive, the sommelier very helpful, lots of variety on menu, food exquisite.  Favorite dish is the BBQ Sea Bass and the service excellent.

All the dishes were delicious, with super-fresh ingredients.  Fantastic, unique wine list, hand-selected by the owner, Nick, who will happily describe any of the wines for you.
Great value, and definitely worth the trip from anywhere in Tri-Valley.
Excellent Appetizers. Main course Sea Bass highly recommendable. Dirty Rice with Dungeness Crabs was not really good. Chicken KungPao good. Can highly recommend the entire appetiser list.
Delicious, well-prepared meat and vegetarian dishes. Beautiful décor. Excellent service and extensive wine list. Parking no problem. On the whole, a little on the pricey side, but worth the cost.

name: Gibson’s Irish Pub
description: Unwind in our cozy atmosphere while enjoying live music, dueling pianos, and the thrill of live sports, all paired with delicious food and lively Irish charm. Let us be your go-to spot for great drinks, unforgettable performances, and good times with friends.
hours:
Mon–Thu, Sun 11:30 am–9:00 pm
Fri, Sat 11:30 am–12:00 am

reviews.text: Nice new Irish Pub restaurant in Walnut Creek.  The food was tasty and the dining room was nicely designed.  The Guinness on tap was delightful.  The only down side is the restaurant there is no Irish music!  The dueling pianos is a nice touch, but so would booking some live Irish music.  That may come as the Gibson’s Pub establishes itself in the community.
Not a good experience tonight.  The service was terrible.  We waited so long for someone to say Hello.  The order was all mess up, so was the bill.

So much fun. Our reservation was in the entertainment room (?) for dinner near the dueling pianos! The appetizers and dinner came out quick and were really good (fish n chips, and the steak). The cocktails were good, bar was packed so understandable that they took a bit. The dueling pianos that played from 9-12 (Travis and Dave) were amazing, highly recommend!
Great dualing pianos .  Good service nice waiter.
Food and pianists were amazing!!  Customer service was great as always!
Great service, food was good and the piano player fun!

The spicy shrimp salad is very good.
Wonderful service.

Great fun!
The dueling piano players are super talented, playing, singing and getting the room involved.

Food was much better than expected, try the Irish Egg Rolls, the Guiness Irish Stew and the Irish Boxty.

Guiness on tap  followed by Irish coffee - perfect.

Service was friendly and efficient.

Great choice for a bunch of folks who want a guaranteed good time!!

Thank you Gibsons for providing a great experience! Met up with friends and enjoyed a birthday dinner and show in downtown Walnut Creek at one of Gibsons dueling piano evenings.
