The piano players were thoroughly entertaining! And the audience participation was a big plus, especially the ‘Sublime Chorus’. Will return for the dueling pianos and great food and cocktails. Looking forward to more evenings at Gibsons, especially for the dueling pianos experience.
Our party reserved the entertainment experience for the show through the open table app and called Gibsons to add more people to our party. Since it was a special occasion it was nice to be guaranteed a table for the entire show. We were seated at a table in front of the piano’s when we arrived, which was not as loud as I thought it would be. Would definitely recommend.

Our server was terrible, second time this happened where they had to take our order twice because it wasn’t in the system only to have 2 sets of food arrive at our table at different times and we had to request it taken off of our check. Both times, the waitress didn’t even bother to remove the duplicate orders without us having to ask and remind her. The service is also bad overall, I have eaten here 5 times and the service was bad 4/5 where our water wasn’t refilled, we didn’t have correct amount if utensils, sides we asked for didn’t arrive and they didn’t check on us at all. The food is decent for the price. Great place to watch games which is why I keep going back but keep your standards low if you’re expecting more.
We love this place , so much fun for date night and gathering with friends!
Very noisy! One dish, the bangers and mash, was excellent. The ribs were dry and not very tasty. Salad was smaller than expected.
Service timing wasn't great, waited 25 minutes for our first drink, our appetizers came out first. Server was great, bar just not well staffed.

Gibson's pub is a fun place.  Everyone enjoyed their meals.  We were there Saturday night to see the dueling pianos.  The energy is great and the crowd was very happy.  Be prepared, the noise is loud.
Absolutely had a great time with my friends on my birthday! The dueling pianos are legit! Such a great time! Would recommend to reserve your spot in the piano room to get the best experience!

Was lucky enough to get a table by the piano bar section.  It was fun for the music and entertainment aspect but the food I found pretty lacking.  My shepherds pie had no flavor. And for pub food it was pretty pricy.

We had wonderful service, the ambience was lovely, and the food was great. We went for lunch so it was on the quieter side. I could imagine how much fun it is when they have dueling pianos on the weekend!

We went to Gibsons on a Saturday night to check out the famous duel pianos, however I didn’t realize that on the weekends they start at 9 pm. Our reservation was for 7 pm and by the time we finished our food it was 8:30 and we were ready to go home.
The food was alright, we ordered the Irish stew (my son liked it), the shepherds pie (my husband thought it was ok) a pastrami sandwich (was ok but had too much mustard) and the grilled shrimp salad which was pretty tasty.
For dessert we ordered the coconut bread pudding and for some reason it took like 30 minutes for us to get it and by the time they brought it to us we were disappointed as it wasn’t good, it didn’t have much taste.

So disappointed!  We were really looking forward to our dinner here..it did not meet our expectations at all.  My fish and chips were so bland.  Wedge fries soggy.  My husband’s shepherds pie was runny.  My beer tasted off as well.  Our server rarely came by.  She did asked how our food was, but walked away before I could reply. I would not waste my money here again.
It’s a friendly place with mediocre food. It is an American bar restaurant, nothing authentic Irish pub about it. Fish and chips are soggy

We liked the vibe at Gibson’s but the food was a disappointment.  It lacked seasoning, the fish and chips needed salt as a basic seasoning.  The cole slaw was basically cabbage, the dressing I couldn’t find.  I did like that they included malt vinegar for the fries.  My husband had the chowder, he liked the flavor but said it was a bit pasty and didn’t like that the shrimp had the tails left on.  
I would be hard pressed to come back for anything more than a cocktail which we liked.
Good place to have great pub food and drinks!  We especially loved the Guinness Irish stew and the BLT salad.  We will be coming back!!  Great service from staff.

We went last week and again this week for food and entertainment.  Last week the piano player was great and we could still talk.  This week it was obscenely loud--and painfully so.  We went to another room, far away from the music, which was still loud.  We found out later the piano player,, who also could not sing well, was the father of the first player.  

We won't be going back until there is a change.  We did enjoy the food and our server was one of the best we ever had.  Where is management in all this?

Great services and excellent interaction from our waitress. Food was decent. Great ambiance and the piano bar is a lovely place to hang out and listen to music. It can be quite loud, it’s not a place to have a chat. The piano player/singer was entertaining and very engaging.   The also have a different sections/ area for quite dinner.  I will definitely go back and recommend it.

This was our second time dining here, both times on a Sunday evening. The place was fairly empty, so the noise level was minimal, and the service was good. Everyone at our four top table ordered something different, and everything was excellent. The only thing so far that I would avoid was the roasted brussel sprouts.They were not crispy at all and actually mushy. Overall,  I highly recommend Gibson's and will definitely go back.

We made a reservation in the Piano Room. When we arrived they seated us in a different room. When we asked if it was the piano room our nice waitress took us back to the front to help figure it out. The hostess argued a bit with the waitress and then told us that reservations are first come first serve and they didn’t have a table for us. We were very disappointed. We made a reservation 3 days in advance and didn’t receive a table. The host was very dismissive and would not provide an explanation further than reservations do not guarantee a seat in the restaurant. It would be nice to state that somewhere upon reservation. Overall, it was a very negative experience as we looked forward to the piano room experience, on a special night for my partner and I.

Had a really nice time at Gibson's Irish Pub.  It was our first visit and we went on a Wednesday night.  It was our first time.  We sat in the piano lounge.  The service and food were good.  The entertainment was so much fun.  We will be back.
We all enjoyed the food and the service. Fish and chips , Shepard's pie and stew were very good. Devlied eggs with steak also great. Bar area can be loud.

We had our Valentine’s Date on Saturday the 15th to see the dueling piano guys! Wow so much fun they definitely love what they do we made a request Slayer Raining blood and they killed it!! The food and drinks were delicious! Everyone had a great time and I think we all need Gibsons Irish pub in our lives at the moment! Thank you for a great evening!
Wonderful, friendly service.  Delicious Irish stew.
Super fun once the pianos started. Food was great, and service was awesome.

We thoroughly enjoyed our first visit to Gibson’s. A wonderful new addition to the Walnut Creek bar & dining scene. Great ambiance, attentive friendly service, and delicious food. Great job Gibson’s. We’ll be back soon!

First time, watched the Super Bowl with a fun crowd. Really attentive waitstaff and good food options. Fun cocktails and generous pours. Loved the interior and great seating options. Will definitely be back again.
Such a great time. You need to be in the piano room. So fun!
The waitress was trying but our drink order was wrong, the food was below average, and our check was wrong.

Unfortunately they were very short staffed and it showed. Dropped the ball multiple times. But one of the employees was amazing (Nick) and made it up to us in the end which we greatly appreciated. All the food was very delicious. We will definitely be returning.

The staff were very nice, and I would have gave 5 stars but our waitress went on break and the server she said would be helping us while she was on break never came over to us so we had to ask someone to order dinner. I ordered the fish and chips because I saw good reviews of it, the fish was good but the chips part were not, it tasted if the oil they were cooked in had been changed in while and the “coleslaw” was just cut cabbage with nothing in it. My husband had the pastrami sandwich which was good but everyone was over priced which is the norm now. So not sure if we’ll be back. Nice atmosphere and decor though

Place looks great! Open concept in front room is cool. I was there for lunch. Staff was very attentive. I asked for suggestions and recommendations and specific details about the menu and all were answered very nicely. Food tasted good. I have already told a dozen people about my experience and I'm sure they will all be by soon. I personally invest in restaurants, so I look for specifics, and you guys hit the mark. I look forward to coming back for dinner and drinks.
Cheers on your success!

We had a wonderful experience for our first time here. Staff is super friendly and the food is great. There are seating at high top tables, lower tables, and at the bar. The restaurant is separated between a quieter dining area and a bar area with TV and high and low tables. It's great for an afternoon or evening with friends, family, or even for dates. Will definitely come back!

Gibson's is only two weeks old, so it is far too soon to evaluate food and service. They will continue to improve. The very good news is that there is a real niche for an Irish pub menu and bar in this area, the menu is trad and well-designed, and Gibson's has real promise. The only serious deficiency, that cannot be blamed on newness, is the wine list, which is much too limited in variety and too upscale in price for the menu and the clientele. It would also greatly enhance their branding and appeal if they would consider bringing in Celtic music (there are many bands in the Bay Area and this music is a big draw traditionally in the West Bay Irish pubs. Good luck to Gibson's.

New opening pains.  The service is slow.  They scurry around like they are busy.  They are doing nothing.  Marking that up to new opening.  The food was very good.  The noise level is through the roof.  We are in the other room away from the piano bar and they speaker in the piano bar into the dining area. Too loud!  I will go back.

Fun pub environment!
The stew and Shepard’s pie were great!

The food was very disappointing - fish and chips had no flavor , deviled eggs and Brussels sprouts were average at best. 
The service is a mess - takes for ever to get service and then no one comes back to check on you. 
Realize it’s a new place but the owner is not new to food service in WC. 
We booked a table in the center by pianos and I did confirm the location.  When we got there they seemed confused and put our group of 4 in the furthest corner.  We asked to move several times and had no luck.  As the night goes on people just stand right in front of your table - and you are blocked in and can’t see anything . 
Will wait several months before we go back .
Service was all over the place. Took 15 minutes to get someone to take our drink order. Appetizers came out before drinks and was t very impressed with the food

This is a brand new restaurant and bar. It hasn’t been opened for service more than a week or two. The food was great. That said construction was still going on (and annoying) in the next room.  Also the servers were nice but don’t exactly have the kinks worked out yet on being coordinated. For example we ordered coffee at the end of the meal with dessert. The server said that they didn’t have any made at that time (because they didn’t have their coffee machine up and running yet but they could brew up a pot the old fashioned way. We said that would be great. It never came. So later we asked and the other server said outright we don’t have coffee. We explained what the other server had told us so she went to check. Later the other server we originally ordered coffee from came back and apologized saying she couldn’t make it. So definitely they need to work out their communication amongst their serving staff. I’m sure once they get their building finished and they work out the bugs in their service it will all be great for this new business.
Enjoyed our meal at Gibson's on their second day of serving food. Look forward to returning to try other menu options.
This restaurant is not open. We made a reservation, showed up and the building is completely under construction. Absolutely ruined our entire night. So frustrating. Don’t reserve! It doesn’t exist!!

name: Imperial Treasure - Palo Alto
description: If you wish to make a same-day reservation, kindly call us at 650-656-9597There are different treasures in everyone's heart. It can be a good memory, can be a precious token, it can be a gift, a dish from childhood. When you open the menu, it's like opening a map of China. From Beijing roast duck to Shanghai soup dumplings, Sichuan chicken, food is meant to heal the heart. Whether you go to the north and south of the river, all visitors and guests are welcome. Imperial Treasure will work hard to put passion behind every dish!We look forward to welcoming you soon!
address: 151 California Ave unit e,  Palo Alto, CA 94306-1926

reviews.text: The restaurant was packed with quite a few people waiting outside, nearly all Asians.  The food was good, but not exceptional.  We had the Peking duck, ordered ahead, as did many tables.  It is too much for 2 people so it would help to have a half duck option as is common in China.  The Peking duck was good, but not the quality one expects for a restaurant that advertises this as their speciality (and it is quite expensive).  We had one other regular dish, a vegetable option, that was good but swimming in sauce.  Along with the soup that followed the duck (the soup was quite good) and the duck, this was more than enough for 2 people but didn't give us chance to sample the many other dishes on the menu that looked good at other tables.

Bugs flying all over the food.  Management is not able to do anything about the bugs.  Minimum requirements for a restaurant is to be clean and sanitary.  This restaurant does not meet the minimum.  Do not come.

I haven’t had Chinese food like this in years. We enjoyed every plate was fabulous. We were drooling as the Peking Duck as the the cart rolled by, but we will be back and to try the Peking Duck on our next venture to I imperial treasure ￼

We booked our spot thru Open Table by selecting “ experience” type including a Roasted Duck on a neither lunch nor dinner time. When we arrived, we were told there is no roasted duck served for this reservation. We all came from South Bay and were excited for this roasted duck, but so frustrated that being told there is no duck along with Experience type booking which was supposed to be included 1 roasted duck when we booked. I used to booked thru Open Table same way and was told that no need to give a call to confirm because the type of “experience reservation” is included a duck. That is why I did not put any notes for a duck in this reservation. It is so ridiculous experience for us at all. Why wouldn’t we book a regular time for our lunch here because we wanted to make sure we have a roasted duck experience reservation as the 1:45pm is the earliest time that serves a roasted duck according to Open Table. Now there is no kind of reservation on their page which is good to not confuse customers.
outstanding Peking duck...other dishes are also very tasty, especially the orange chicken
Generally it is good. But, if you want to order the roasted duck, you must make a reservation ahead of time.
This is the best Chinese restaurant I have eaten at in many years. Fabulous menu. Great Peking duck. Terrible wine list. the place was very crowded and quite noisy.
Good service, mediocre food with an open smelly kitchen

Been there several times. Still didn’t manage to try the Peking duck since I do not have a large party to share. Service and food are good so far. Probably the only impressive place to host guests in the Palo Alto neighborhood.

name: Gyu-Kaku Japanese BBQ - San Mateo, CA | Downtown (Central Park)
description: Founded in Tokyo in 1996, Gyu-Kaku has become the world’s #1 Japanese BBQ brand! Thanks to our devoted fans we have reached over 700 locations worldwide. Each day, hundreds of thousands of people gather around the table-top smokeless grill, a centerpiece of our dining concept, enjoying selections of premium meats, just off the grill, and other freshly prepared foods from our kitchens, inspiring laughter, conversation, and a magical dining experience.Our authentic yakiniku (grilled barbeque) dining experience crowns you the chef. Share a variety of delicious appetizers and premium cooked meats over a flaming grill, paired with Japanese sake, frosty cold beers, or other alcoholic and non-alcoholic options of your choice. We're the perfect spot to enjoy time with friends and family, organize an office party, or to spend quality time with your significant other!Before you go, don't forget to taste our best-seller Harami Skirt Steak or Prime Kalbi Short Rib among other must-try dishes!
address: 329 S. Ellsworth Ave,  San Mateo, CA 94401
hours:
Mon–Thu 5:00 pm–9:15 pm
Fri, Sat 11:30 am–9:45 pm
Sun 11:30 am–9:15 pm
EARLY HAPPY HOUR

Happy Hour
Mon–Thu 5:00 pm–6:00 pm
Mon–Thu, Sun 9:00 pm–9:15 pm
LATE HAPPY HOUR
Fri, Sat 9:00 pm–9:45 pm

reviews.text: Food server was quite rude.  Very noise.  Food ok.
Been dining with this restaurant for a long time. Still have good tasting food. Meat is still fresh and tasty. My nephew and my niece loved everything they order.
My favorite Japanese bbq!!! I’m always coming back with friends, it’s a fun atmosphere and excellent food!
My twin daughters & I got the Meat Variety pre-fixe meal & were super full. Soooo yummy & super fun.
Very nice place for something different all around. Very friendly atmosphere, excellent service and very clean.
Fantastic time at Gyu-Kaku as usual!  The service is always great there.

Great experience! Would love to come here again with my significant other. Food was delicious; got the “Meat Lovers” course. Enjoyed the starters and the variety of meat given. Wonderful staff/servers! We got our grill changed many times throughout our dinner. Lily, our server, was very sweet and ensured we had a great dining experience.
Service was excellent, & food as always outstanding. Garlic fried rice a must.

This was an unexpected "wow"!  Very casual, clean and modern inside.  Great service and easy to figure out how to grill etc.  The shrimp was spicy and fabulous, I highly recommend the cabbage salad which had the best flavor.

Always amazing!!
This place it is a little louder than others but it does not affect the experience. Great food and great services.
Great presentation- just the right amount. Excellent customer service. Very friendly staff. Impressive bathroom- their disabled toilet cubicle has heated seat!!

Had a great experience, taking my family to dinner here on New Year’s Eve. The staff was incredibly helpful and prompt with the service. The food was excellent and drinks were delicious! Would highly recommend for a fun evening!
Excellent service by our server, Cesar. His attentiveness and friendly approach made our dining experience exceptional.
Everything is delicious, and the service is outstanding! We've been a handful of times and haven't ordered anything yet that we didn't like :D
Good food , service is ok . Will continue me back !
Amazing, pork was goated. Will definitely be back and order the wagu
Amazing cuts, great service. Really enjoyed this second visit.
Cesar was very helpful and checked up on us continuously. It was a good night
Always a good dining experience here. This location in San Mateo has higher than average customer service.
Service was good and staff were attentive. Food was OK but nothing special.
This place is fantastic! The meat selection is exceptional, and the portions are generous. We thoroughly enjoyed our first visit and will definitely be back!
My favorite bbq place. Portion sizes are perfect, staff is nice, food comes out fast and is delicious. They also change your grill frequently.

Came for dinner with my family. We’re Japanese and my sons love and miss Japanese style bbq.
The taste,ambience, services are same mostly.
We have been coming here for years and we love it. It is our to go place for all occasions. We normally get the meat meals for 3 or 4.  Will continue to go. Super clean. Really nice staff.

Our outstanding server was very friendly and helped us order as it was our first time there. She checked on us regularly. The staff also change the grill grates at the table a few times during the meal which helps cook the meat better.  The meats were marinated well and the table sauces they provide were tasty.
This was a new experience and I found that some of the food good and some delicious!! I will be back again!
We love eating here! The food is delicious and cooking your food is a fun experience. We had the $40/pp meal and it was plenty of food! Such a fun restaurant!

I love that place. The food is very good, the meats are so yummy. There are kids menus. I like the indoor after the renovation. It looks so cozy and nice. The staff is very friendly. I also like that they have white wine in the menu. I would recommend this place for any occasion or just a casual night out with the family.
Absolutely great! You must make a reservation and never have to wait. Service is very efficient and food it is very good. Jumbo sake is the best! Highly recommended.
Always delighted when we dine here. We have been about 10 times or so and have never had a bad or disappointing experience

Great food and everything 👌
Highly recommend it 👌
It was great.  Tasty cuts of meat with sauce.  Would definitely go again.
The food quality was really bad. They didn’t have proper seating for my toddler, and we had to keep asking for napkins and basic service. Overall, it was not a good experience.
Great food, great service, great atmosphere, fun to cook our own food and eat at our own pace.￼

Went to Gyu-Kaku for an early Father's day with our 2 children and their significant others.  What a hoot!  We had a blast ordering, cooking, eating and drinking Sapporo beer. It was about $50 per person including drinks, which was actually a good deal given the high quality of the meats and other ingredients.  One in our party didn't eat beef, so the basil chicken, noodles, and veggies were welcome. I loved the shishito pepper appetizer!
Lily was our server and was incredibly sweet/attentive. The food tasted great and was brought to our table fast which we appreciated because we were sooo hungry.

My first experience with Japanese bbq and was
Thoroughly impressed

We love this place for a family feast, and we often go for the set menu. Great place to try a lot of different meats, grilled by yourself. The meat is fresh and well seasoned. The side dishes and appetizers taste good too. And the set menus are good value for a family. Highly recommended!
Everyone we go to GyuKaku it’s always fun. Food is very good. It’s fun for the kids to experience cooking their meals and having fun.

This gyu-kaku location has a very nice ambience and environment. The food is outstanding and the service is top notch.

We had a delay in our guests and the front desk was able to accommodate our request to push back- pending there was space of course. Just the ability to negotiate a different time slot was great.

The food is amazing and there’s no complaints there

The service is top notch and granted it was Mother’s Day weekend, our hostess was able to accommodate our requests

I do have one suggestion which the other gyu kaku location was able to do;
If possible time the amount of items being delivered. The table is small especially for parties of four so having a prefix menu with all meats provided is difficult to manuever in one session. Please give a suggestion or time the plates according to how much a party is consuming their meats.
If the staff is checking the grill replacement, it could also be the same of checking in if the customers want their next flight of meats
love this place would eat here everyday worth every penny
High quality meat, well seasoned, good variety, and reasonable price. We went for a set meal for three, and all of us are totally satisfied both by the quality and quantity. Highly recommended!

Such a fun experience! The food was delicious, especially all the steaks. It is fun to cook the food and even better when it tastes great. Also, love getting warm sake and Japanese beers. Definitely recommend - and make sure to end with s'mores!

This used be one of Kurt fabs and go tos. Had not been there in a while. Portion size has been decreased. Now one has to pay more for “upgrades”. For example, $3 to get bibimbap vs white rice, $5 for something else, and so on. It can add up. Portion size lowered and they found a way for us to spend more.
Very fun experience.  Please bring back the sweet onion for grilling.
My first time having Japanese bbq but it was awesome! Grilling yourself is mad fun.
It was our first time eating Korean bbq and we were not disappointed! Everything was soooo yummy! And it was fun to cook the food there. Cesar, our waiter was so helpful and nice!
Ok, think they change the set. Dine in experience was just fine. Might return again.
Food and service was great! The food came very quick, and tastes very fresh
The service was great and the food and experience was awesome!
Great food and excellent customer service. My only comment is about their grill equipment. The fire from the grill is not distributed evenly.

Love having dinner here.  It's great for groups and you the price is a great value.  You get so much!  If you get the "packaged" menus, "food for 2" is more than enough to feed 3 people.  I wish though that they had a choice of a choice of s'mores or mochi ice cream.  Very minor thing though!  :)  Service is relatively quick and very friendly and accommodating.

I went on Christmas Eve with my elderly parents who one of whom has mobility issues.  We sat close to the door to accommodate his issues but because we were close to the door, there was a very cold draft.  They reseated us and even kept my dad's walker towards the front.  When we were done, they brought it back for him.
I love eating here. I think it’s a good value for the variety you get and the quality of the meat. Service is consistently attentive.

Food was good.  Service
Slow to get the attention of the waiter.
Had to ask to get the open table points even though they confirmed my reservation at check in

I have gone here multiple times, the service is always phenomenal, I will continue going here. Parking isn’t too bad to find. The food is really delish. The waiters and waitresses are always checking up.
Orion great service, great guy definitely makes me want to go back every time
Very nice Waygu beef course.. more than enough for two people.  Meat is melting in my mouth so yummy!
First time. Definitely won’t be my last. Thank you to the amazing staff!!
Amazing experience and great food.. I will come back again next time.
Great as always.
Service and food were okay.  The salad had too much mayonnaise and the sauces were just okay.  This place leans more towards Korean vs. Japanese shabu shabu.

Look for A5 Wagyu meat, however their none .  They have Wagyu Kalbi Short rib Mix instead and it at $60.  This short rib mostly 70% FAT not meat.  This is not Wagyu meat hardly and red color of beef in it.  Other than  that all is al right.  Parking is plenty full.  Confusing about Happy hours time, the sign, showed Monday 5 PM to  8 PM we arrived at 6.15 PM . Staff told me that Happy hours  are no longer available.  Need more clear Signage in the restaurant.
my favorite place ever! it also holds a special place in my heart, because I met my fiancé for our first date here ￼
Our server was absolutely amazing! Personally we believe that she, Emily, the trainee, deserves a raise!!! Thank you for an amazing dining experience!
Good spot for casual dining - good food, moderate noise ambiance. (Except when it's someone's birthday - the singing and tambourine playing gets to be a bit too much.) Other than that it was great.
Overwhelming menu decisions haha oh well meat was good
Yum! Never disappointing and always filling. Highly recommend.

I have been to Guy-Kaku before and have raved about it.  I took a good friend who has not experienced Japanese BBQ and other wonderful dishes.  She loved it and is excited to share with her husband.
Wonderful restaurant great service food is fresh and super delish!  I will be back

The reception girl need training, when I  went in and asked some request, she look very unhappy , and we finished the dinner and leave, the waiters said nothing, it's not look like before, I still paid 20% tips eventhough like that, I am disappointed this dine.

I enjoyed our dinner at Guy-Kaku.  I like the overall look of this restaurant walking in.
We were greeted by a happy and helpful server.  Menu was large and very detailed.  Food was great. I love the whole process of Japanese BBQ.  Helpful hints on cooking time were great.
I’ll be back!

Went 2 Fridays in a row, that good! Recommend the garlic fried rice and garlic noodles, the meat are smaller 3oz portions perfect to try a little bit of everything. 5 people ate last night for about $200 w/tip!

Great Time,
Orion was a great server, knew the menu well, made the experience wonderful

After being seated (our reservations were for 6:00 pm), we waited for over a half hour for any service despite ringing the bell and asking several workers for a wait person.  No response.  People seated after us were being helped and, in several cases, starting their meals.  Once we got served, our meal went very quickly.
Staff were quick and helpful. Food was great, I'd recommend to take your friends or family here.

Amazing
We love love love this place.
We come here all the time for any celebration
Poor service. Waitress was rude and argumentative. Kept pointing finger in our face. Kept blaming that they’re understaffed on their service.
We have been coming here for year and we love it. The food is amazing and the service is great!!
Terrible. A $200 meal only contains thee plates of low quality meat. Not worth it at all!
Absolutely amazing, and just as good if not better than the Cupertino location.
Food was fast but when we got to table 6:45pm until 7:08pm then someone came and acknowledged us. The host say ring the service bell for help! But after 4 times no one came we was about to leave.
It was a nice dinner for us. We enjoyed the food and service!

Set course prices are reasonable and allows you to sample a little of everything so that next time, you can just pick what you want. The prime rib Kalbi was excellent. Garlic noodles were also very good. The crispy rice appetizer was excellent too. The s’mores were standard stuff you had as a kid. But by then we weren’t hungry anyway. Service was unobtrusive and not rushed.
Meat quality and cut is getting worst! It’s just not worth going there.
Wonderful Japanese experience!
Yummy as always

Orion is an amazing server great reccomendations and energy!
Amazing experience and delicious meats.
A bowl of white rice was the same price as my mug of beer, that was highway robbery but otherwise this place is fantastic.
Always wonderful food quality. The waiter was nice but talked me out of ordering a cocktail which was a bummer.
Went during happy hour and had a great experience! 10/10

Great food, especially the garlic fried rice with their spicy sauce. Excellent service and attentive waiting staff. The ambiance was ok, nothing really noteworthy. It's pricey, at $90 for 2 after tax and tip.
Waygu was $70 for the smallest plate. There were like 8 teeny pieces. It was ok not worth it! :(

This is a special Japanese restaurant that keeps its Japanese character but provides food that is not considered alien to westerners. The flavor is incredible. A balanced meal is provided with great rice, soup, and veggies. The service is excellent. I had a wonderful experience and I will be back.
The food was delicious, our server Lily was wonderful. Very friendly, cheerful and provided us everything we asked for.
Everyone in my family loved it. Great, festive holiday meal. So many yummy things and ended with the most delicious lava cake and matcha tiramisu!!!
Great food and great experience.

We always love coming here especially with friends.  The price is a great value with the huge amounts of food that's included.   Service is attentive and thankfully we were seated in the back corner where it's slightly more quiet where we can have a nice conversation without yelling. We've been going to Gyu-Kaku for years now. Basically since it opened. Initially, we loved it. The food and service was top, the staff and vibe was huge! But like all good things, gyu-kaku is coming to an end. 

While the pandemic did have a negative impact, the restaurant basically just stopped trying. They stopped with food consistency: noodles are mushy, meats are over marinated (last night we couldn't even eat the yakishabu bc it had been sitting in soy marinade so long it was basically a salt brick). The chicken karaage has changed from solid pieces of chicken thighs to fried breading in micro pieces. 

The hours they post aren't the hours they serve. They have scaled back and basically if you come after 730, it's not worth it. They say they close at 10pm (early for them; they used to have last call around 11pm) and yet at 830 they were shutting down and barely let us seat for our reservation. To make matters worse: they told us it was last call AS WE WERE ORDERING AT 830. then proceeded to bring us the bill BEFORE the food arrived. 

Sad to say, I think that's my last visit. We've been here about 50 times over the years. Maybe more. But it's not fun anymore and the food is crap. 
Bye. 🤷‍♀️

We’ve had dinner at Gyu-Kaku quite often.  

THE GOOD 
1.  The good is descent and reasonably price.  Prices are even better when you dine during the happy hour periods.  

2.  I wouldn’t go as far to say that the service is excellent, but it is good.  You can expect a staff member to greet you within 5 minutes of being seated, ready to take your drink order.  As soon as you place your order, the food will start coming out about 7-10 minutes after your order is placed.  

3.  Via their Mobil app, you can reward points every time you dine at their establishment.  The points are truly worthwhile accumulating, and they are not stingy with their points, where you can redeem points almost every time you visit.  On an average, I’ve received up to $25.00 of my entire bill.  

THE BAD

1.  Reservations are recommended, else, you could find yourself waiting at least 45 minutes or longer for a table.   Even wait time with reservations is an average 10 minute wait.  

2.  The bathrooms are not very well maintained.   While it’s kind of cool that the toilets are heated, the stalls are often dirty, stinky, and often have no toilet paper in them.      I often just go in there to wash my hand before and after dinner, and often wait to use the bathroom until I get home.  

3.  The restaurant Is quite loud.  This is not a place to have a romantic dinner.   Besides,   Cooking on a grill is not quite my definition of a romantic date, but rather, a place for friends, and family to enjoy a fun night out and grill/cook together.

For meat we ordered garlic shoyu chicken thigh, shio white soy duck breast, spicy gochujang pork belly, a spicy gochujang pork shoulder, garlic shoyu ribeye, and a salt & pepper filet mignon. Besides that we shared a bowl of rice and garlic chicken noodles. The noodles were delicious on their own. The meats were all decent, and it was fun cooking them on the grill. The recommended 2-3 min for certain meats was too long with the default high flame setting; it ended up burning a few slices of pork. The best way for us to cook was to vary it based on the size of the meat and flipping it over to check for brown-ness. I thought the duck was the highlight since we've never grilled duck before; it came out tender, juicy, and rich. The gochujang sauce (I've never seen it outside a Korean setting) gave a nice fermented and savory kick to the meat. The only downside was the small portion sizes with the meats. I didn't feel it was worth the price to have only a few slices of each on a plate, but I guess that's what you'd expect with a yakiniku/barbecue place. The upside was that most of it was delicious. The default dipping sauces ("Spicy", "Sweet Soy", and "Ponzu") were great with the meats, especially the spicy and sweet soy ones for my palate. The waiter (Christian) was fantastic throughout, and the taiyaki (best deep-fried in the kitchen) with black sesame ice cream was an amazing finish to the overall meal.

Great as always! We love Gyu Kaku in San Mateo and that is why we even celebrated my husbands bday there.
Always enjoyed my time here. You will too if you are meat lover.

Huge improvement of customer services. Waiter always check in with us to ensure we get what we need. A manager show up to apologize for the delay of our couple of dishes. Food is tasty. The only downside are restroom require more attention for clearning. Soy sauce bottles are sticky.
Everything is good as always. Our fam’s favorite  go to restaurant!
Horrible service. We had to ask for fork, chopstick, spoon for soup, spoon for dessert, water, & it took forever to get them. No highchair, only booster chair. Food was decent, nothing special.
Portion was small,  definitely not for big eater. Services was good
Amazing place we love coming here and being able to have unique food that isn't easy to find in other places.

I like this place , and all my family is always happy to be here , but last time we got very very bad customer service, our waitress was very unprofessional,  she mixed up our food with other table , didn’t bring the rest our order, and at the and she give us a totally wrong bill with double charge !  The rest of the people, who work there is very nice , good and hard working young people!
The food quality has gone down a lot the past few years. Service is nonexistent. Food takes days to come out for something you cook yourself. Plates were dirty when I sat down. Super disappointed
Great service and the food was fantastic. WE didn’t the Meat Lovers for two and there was so much food we couldnt finish it all. Great experience we will be back.
Place was great, quick service and great food. went with a friend and had no trouble getting everything and enjoying our meal

Services has improved. At least our waiter show up to our table for couple of times. He forgot couple of our ordered items. It delivered right away after we asked. It wasn’t a very busy day. We get our table on time with reservation ahead. Meat quality is average. The ramen got have bowl of soup. It will be great if they put more. Only concern is dirty restroom.

Food was good and our waitress was pleasant too, but I wish she could be more attentive.  I asked for no dressing on my salad which was included in my lunch selection, and I was given a salad with dressing.  I immediately notified our waitress who took it away but later brought me another salad with dressing on it.  I didn’t bother to tell her again and tried to eat a little, but ended up giving my salad to my husband since he likes the dressing.  I like my salad plain without any dressing, or with simply a dash of lemon juice or balsamic vinegar.  My husband commented that the chef had already put dressing on all the salad, so our waitress probably couldn’t do anything about it.  However, I still feel that we customers should be given the choice on whether we want dressing on our salad.
Needs professional management for a restaurant at that scale. Service is pathetic with children behaving... well, like children.
Understaffed so service was slow but overall food quality was good. Just wish there were better portion sizes.
Love the food! The quality is great and it’s fun to cook at your table.
Food is freaking awesome and so is the service!

Good food, but service really sucks here.  I have been here several times as we like the food.  But the constant changing of servers throughout the course of one meal is ridiculous. Not only that, but they do not check in with you to see if you need anything.  It also took almost thirty minutes to flag down the bill.

Wish they would improve their service here!
Amazing  the food is always delicious drinks are  spectacular
I think this is better for groups of 3 or more because that will let you enjoy a larger variety of meat to grill.
Lots of variety to choose from.
Gyukaku is always awesome. Food is delicious as they always are. Make sure to try the premium beef tongue if you haven't.
The food was great. We had made a reservation on Open Table and no table was ready for us. They just put us at the top of the wait list. They should update availability on Open Table.
All meat are very fresh. Gyu-Kaku created an unique taste. Happy Hour Menu is recommend but it isn't that cheap.
Good food , service, and ambiance. Food was overly seasoned though: too salty. The fruit juice iced tea was good but too sweet (tasted like undiluted concentrate).

アメリカで焼肉。korean BBQとは違った味わい。人も多く、はやっている店。
セットメニューもお得感あり。注文しすぎると、値段が高くなるので、セットメニューの方が安心。
Everything was great!

Grilled Tongue was tougher than usual. Ramen noodles were under-cooked, doughy but tasty broth and meat in tonkotsu. No "shichimi" seasoning for ramen soup, only chili powder when asked.
Helpful staff on new app conversion & Open Table.

I love this place! We went for our anniversary and had a reservation. We ended up waiting a while, but didn't really mind. The manager comp'd our drinks anyway, very nice staff. We were very happy with the quality/amount of food. We got the Kobe Beef for two and love it!
Great vibes, good food, and amazing customer service. I would honestly go back the next time I am in San Francisco. The cost may seem high but it is a lot of food and the quality is high.
Always fun coming here.  The BBQ sale with pitcher of beer makes it all worthwhile as well as the happy hour menu.  Always make a reservation.

One of the workers who was cleaning the table next to us splashed water on my friend's purse and her clothes without an apology, instead, he brought us a stack of napkins on the table. Besides, they wanted us to move to another table when we were still eating and drinking because they needed our table for the big group. I feel that was kind of rude.
Best place ever
Everyone was very good. Only complaint was that manager who was acting as server wouldn't discount beer with loss leader Sapporo that was super cheap and ran out earlier. M

Gyu-KaKu, San Mateo, has a terrible seating procedure/attitude.  When it is busy, one has to wait even with one shows up on time with a reservation.  Okay, I understand.  When it is half empty, one has to wait because they "the section is closed".   When five out of six show up on time with a 6:30pm reservation on a Thursday night while the sixth is parking, the five were made to wait until the sixth arrived after parking, while the restaurant is 60% full and the table is empty and ready.  I don't understand.  The attitude is just rude.

If one is hungry for Japanese Barbecue, I recommend that one try Guy-KaKu's much more polite and customer friendly competitor, Juban, in Burlingame.

I love going to Gyu Kaku it's my go to if I want really good BBQ, the services are excellent, everyone was super friendly, our waiter was really helpful with suggestions if the meal we pick was good for our parties. I always recommend going here.
Food was good but other customers got their food before we did. We ordered AND were there before the other customers. I thought that was messed up.
It took so long, over 20 min, for the food to come. Taking the prepared raw meat out shouldn't take that long.
Great service. Thanks William!! He was very prompt and checked on us frequently. Duck breast was the best!

Arrived on time for reservations at 5:30 P.M. on the Monday before July 4th.  Every table was filled.  Was the restaurant overbooked?  We waited next to the host stand a bit more than 10 minutes to be seated.  The place was packed with walk-in diners waiting inside and outside the entrance.  After we were seated, service was uneven as we waited another 10 minutes before a server arrived to take our order.  The vegetable side dishes (including  the "assorted veggies" which we did not order)  arrived  10 minutes before the appetizers were served.  The marinated meats and rice bowls were delivered another 8 minutes later.   The grilled asparagus and garlic spinach were surprisingly good.  You have to turn the spinach quickly with the tongs to prevent burning on the grill grate.  The assorted veggies included two button mushrooms,  sliced trumpet mushrooms, exactly two thin slices of zucchini squash, two little shishito peppers, two cherry tomatoes, and a foil packet of CANNED corn to be warmed on the grill grate....definitely awkward  and a challenge trying to eat individual canned corn niblets with chopsticks.  The fried calamari had a nice crisp batter with a spicy dipping sauce.  The pork gyoza were okay with a shoyu dipping sauce.  The marinated yaki shabu beef and spicy pork were tasty.  Our server checked in on us one time after the final delivery of the marinated meats.   We had to ask for water later....We'll give this place another try - like on a non-holiday weekday when hopefully, they're not slammed, and perhaps the service might be better.
The food was good and the service was great. It is also a great value when you come during happy hours.

The food was great, but although I had a 1:30pm reservation through open table and we got there at 1:17pm, and checked , we didn't seat until 1:51 pm.  
But other that that, food was great and for good price.
Good good god
I don't really want to write a review, here's 50 characters to meet the requirements.
It was good as usual

Used to come every weekend, and I can tell a trend of how the service here goes from good to bad. Now everything is as slow as possible. I had a reservation at 10 pm, and I didn't get water till 20 min after I sat. Till 10:45 pm all I got was a corn. No water was added and I had no mood to order dessert. Even checkout took 10 min. And this is not the first time I had such an experience. Definitely won't come every week like before.

Already mentioned it was my birthday when I made the reservation. My table changed 3 servers in an hour. There were also two birthdays person in there, and they got free desserts and the birthday song. I already mentioned again it was my birthday to the third servers, and he said "ok, we could do that!" After that, I heard the birthday song again, but it's for the other table...At the end, I got nothing . I checked the bill and still got nothing. Is it because my table only had two persons? So they thought my birthday was not important than the others???

I have been to this restaurant a few times because I like the food, atmosphere, and overall dining experience. BUT, I went last week with 5 other people, and there was one very big issue with service/overall experience. We had a table for 6, with one grill, which is fine. But, only 1/3 of the grill actually worked. The food took a very long time to cook, because we could only use a small portion of the fire. We mentioned this to the waiter and he said, "that's unfortunate". Seriously? Not only did it take us over 2 hours to eat, I was so busy shuffling around the meat on the grill that I was not able to enjoy my dinner.

I have been to this restaurant several times but this time I found 1 of the tongs still have some dried sesame sauce sticking on it. My friend asked for a glass of water and noticed after drinking almost all of it that the glass is broken which made her worried if she has drank any broken glass. Hope this is an exception. The food and ambience is good. I'm not happy with the service this time as I need to look for our server or call some other server attention to ask for a tea or water refill or for the dessert menu. We went on a Saturday lunch and it doesn't look that busy. I'm disappointed this time. Hopefully it will improve.

Had a 20 minute wait despite reservation and we showed up timely.
Waiter shortage and service took a long time.
Food is good as usual
Food and price is good but serving time is extremely slow. We had to wait more than 30 minutes for getting first dish of meat.

Had a reservation at 10pm and got my seat exactly on time. Service was wonderful; the bbq plate was changed three time. Ordered 5 different kinds of meat and they were all flavored well. By using the reward program, I'm able to get a free ice cream or s'more on my next visit!

Music was so loud that we could not have good conversation. I think they play it very loud intentionally so that customers leave sooner than they should. 

Waitress was not knowledgeable and bus girl had a bad attitude.  They were busy and they do not pay attention to customers. I will not spend my money there again.

We were reserved a table for 5 people,  but they only provided us a 4 people table, so one person end up to seated on the hallway side. When we asked them to changed a bigger table, they said more reservations coming. I really don't like the way I was seated on the hallway. Hopefully they will have a bested arrangement for the big table.

We got all of our appetizers, noodles and rice pretty fast. The problem was the meats and foods to grill came 20 minutes after we consumed ALL of our food! And we didn't eat fast or anything. So basically when we got our meat, that's all we had. We couldn't enjoy our food as a whole. Big disappointment there. Food was good though..

After we got vegitables, it took 20 min to get meats. We had to ask servers for the meats and drinks multiple times. I understand that they were busy and it is not server's fault. This is manager's job to improve that.
Too much fat with the meat, service was super slow, took an hour to finally get the meat
Addiction since first bite! I live 30 minutes away and I honestly don't mind the drive at all! I wish there was one closer to me but oh well
Love going here the experience is always great

Nice Selection of Soju, Beer, and Soju Cocktails.  Has set combinations that allow you to try a variety of dishes.  Ala carte available with best deals during Happy Hour.  Has Duck Breast which Korean restaurants do not typically have.
Our server, Lani, was really great!  She was helpful with suggestions since it was our first time there; also very friendly.  Be sure to get there early for happy hour, every day!
Awesome birthday. Service was great. Thanks!!
Good quality!good price!

I left hungry and confused. The approach was not prepared and the menu was hard to follow. Meats were not organized enough to know what you're eating when you get them. There's a part of me saying I need a redo but then again I'll probably be wasting my time.

My husband and I have eaten here a few times before inviting 6 more people to join us for Easter lunch.  Service could improve a notch or two. The servers seemed tired, no energy. There was only one time (I believe we've eaten here at least 6 times) in which the server was outstanding.  My husband and I like it here a lot and will dine here and continue to bring family and friends.

Love these kinds of Japanese restaurants where you can cook your own food.  It's fun and interactive and you can avoid any awkward conversation because you're concentrating on not burning your food.  :)  Really good prices and food was good.  Would definitely go back with friends.  Love that the table dividers can be easily removed to accommodate large groups.

The waiter did not remember anything we told him when we ordered - we didn't want beef tongue in our yakiniku meal, he didn't bring us sesame oil when we asked in the beginning, never offered me more water as I kept finishing and having to wait. There was never an offer of a grill change. Service was so slow that our sukiyaki bibimbop IN THE HOT STONE was COLD by the time our meat arrived, which spoiled our experience. The flame was burning on one side of the grill and the food tasted like open flame at times.

We were greeted then forgotten...I think the reception area is a bit chaotic and the employees that greet are not trained properly.  This is unfortunate because food is quite good..they use high quality ingredients...and overall it works.
Much fun !
My daughter loves coming here. It was her birthday wish to eat here. We enjoyed the happy hour pricing and she even got a smores Birthday ice cream and song.

Terrible Service - had to ask for the meats after the vegetables had to be brought over 15 min prior.  Never got a water refill.  had to asked for the grill to be changed.  Never got my white rice - and had to remind the waiter to cancel it.  Over priced for what you get.
My family we love this place, we have family time while we cook and eat. We celebrate my son 7th birthday and yes will be back soon.
Great happy hour food and drinks option.

The waitress never told us there was no ahi tuna since 6pm. We got there since 7:30pm. The meat took too long to come out and our waitress put the heat so high, it burned our food. Nothing special. Won't be going back soon.

It's was really nice William really made our experience a lot better when our server wasn't there and told us to wait a min William came right over and asked us what we needed and didn't keep us waiting long like our original waiter.

They are short staffed.  We ordered a combo meal and we literally had to flag down various people to order, get our drinks, make sure they weren't forgetting certain dishes, etc.  No complaints about the food but the service was lacking.

We went with some friends visiting the area. It was fun to have a group so we could try a bit of everything on the menu. Order A La Carte. It's more affordable and you can pick and choose what you want, especially great for vegetarians. Download the app for special perks! 
We loved everything.

Food was reasonable priced and the offer late night happy hour. The cold soju was good but of course not strong. You Come her for the food not the alcohol. The service wasn't that great. If we needed something I had to walk to the host to ask for it.
Fun dining experience!  Really enjoyed the overall experience and the food was delish.  Had seen this pop up on Open Table several times and finally gave it a try. So glad we did.  Will be back!
Yummy food! Great deals during happy hour! Happy hour for 2 meal is enough for 3 people if you add 2 additional meat orders.
Gyu always exceeds our needs. We usually come in with a legit crew, strong. They are so incredibly accommodating and provide us with the best the best can offer.
love the BBQ. The beef is amazing there! you won't regret choosing this place.
Its a bit pricey when other comparable spots are all you can eat for the same price. The service was good but the servers kept spilling meat juice on mt table and wouldn't clean it unless I asked.

I stumbled on Gyu-Kaku when looking for a place to enjoy lunch with a friend.  I thought we would be eating sushi (and might have rejected it if I'd paid more attention to the detail).  We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.  It was a great adventure, cooking our meats/fish at the BBQ in the middle of the table.  I will definitely come back, though I wouldn't bring my grandkids.  Too much opportunity to get in trouble with the proximity of the hot BBQ.

Excellent food - tasty marinated meat & seafood!! Fun to bbq your own meat at he table. I love coming here for the great food but wish it were not so loud! My throat is sore from yelling to my dining mate sitting across the table and we could barely hear the waiter, had to ask him to repeat what he said almost every time he said something. Definitely not a date spot!

Brought a friend here for her birthday and ordered one of the specials. The quality was great, excellent quantity as well. The person taking care of us gave us really good instructions on how long to cook everything and checked in on us often. We all had a great time and can't wait till it's someone else's birthday or something so we can come back.

I've been to this location several times and the one in W Los Angeles.  Both have great food but San Mateo's is more modern and the waiters and waitresses are very friendly.  We always have a great time and the food is delicious.
Unique style, good and friendly service.

Very good service, friendly staffs, and awesome food! 

Came for a friends' get-together, they were super friendly from beginning to the end. Very informative if we had any questions about the food or anything. We ordered 8 people set even though we had 6 people and the amount of food they've given us was divine! I've never seen so much meat all in one giant platter before. It was a sight to see. The dessert was heavenly , the ice cream taste very good! My favorite dessert was the Chocolate Lava Cake with Vanilla ice cream! I'm glad I chose this place to have the get-together. I will definitely be coming back and bring more friends along! Thank you for giving our first time a great experience at Gyu-Kaku!

Tried this place once before and was not impressed with the service or food. I decided to go there again to give this place a 2nd chance. But it was the same bad experience. The waiter never checked on us  and it was really hard to just get his attention for just an extra bowl to share the garlic noddles which was $10 and very little to even share. But we went there for the meat. But again the meat was low quality and over marinated with miso and other flavors that u couldn't taste the meat at all. I think the marinate was just to cover up the low quality meat. I couldn't get home fast enough to brush the flavor out of my mouth.  Very disappointed for the 2ND time       . There will not be a 3rd time.
always out of something. portions never match pics...excuse is they serve by weight...presentation sucks.
The restaurant should hire more waters and waiters.

Everything was great! Theres only one thing that bothers me almost everytime I dine here and that is the sauce containers on the table. They're ALWAYS very sticky and gross that I don't want to touch them, even though I enjoy the sauces so much with my food. I mentioned this to my server and he cleaned the containers in front of me, but maybe having different containers that dont leak the sauces would be a fix to this problem. Other than that, everything else was perfect! :)

Our reservations were for 10pm and we arrived 30 minutes early. I asked if we can be seated earlier since there were many tables available but we had to wait. We were seated, then was asked to be moved because our server was too busy. We were seated in the corner of the restaurant away from others. Food was great and service was good. I just didn't appreciate the check-in and seating service that I received.
I forgot how much I love this place. The staff is great, the food is great and the experience is one of a kind.  Will be back sooner than later for sure.
Had the Kobe beef dinner.  Many varieties of excellent Kobe beef.  Freakin' tasty!!!
As a Gyu Kaku patron I was quite impressed with the SM location
Very tasty meat. All meats were marinated with different sauces. Their salads and appetizers are also great

Food is always good,  service is a hit and miss depending on your luck but most of the time a good experience, if you are coming here while Happy Hour is going on, make reservations or you'll end up waiting an average of 45-60 minutes for a table.
I will definitely come back.
Delicious and good prices for happy hour
My huband and I had the 80 set dinner.  It was a lot of food but it had a lot of veggies and meat. We plan to go back with our kids soon.

Gyu-kaku is one of my favorite restaurants in the entire Bay Area. It's a Japanese BBQ place, think Korean BBQ grill-your-own style but Japanese instead. (tastes better, IMO)

None of the description words in the OpenTable survey form above really fits the place, which I find funny, because it's so enjoyable but it's not any of those words they provide on the checkboxes list there. You have to try it if you haven't.
I would return. Price was reasonable. Overall a good experience.
when i go to san mateo this place is always on my list..
Food was great. Loved the Happy Hour prices.
Good food and delicious ice cream.
The restaurant should provide proper high chairs for small children.
Love this place! You need to try the tofu bites.

Great value, good cuts of meat (not as fatty as your usual Korean BBQ) and great flavor thanks to the charcoal fire grills. We got the $55 meat-lovers meal for 2, which included at least 4 types of beef, garlic shrimp, miso soup, rice, and a large salad. We were full but not overly, since you can grill at your own pace. Service was great! We requested a grate switch midway through our meal to get rid of the burned bits, and they did a lovely birthday song with dessert.

Music was a mix of Miike Snow, Two Door Cinema Club, and Vampire Weekend, if you're curious about vibe.
Ciming here on the Sunday after Thanksgiving was not such a good idea.  Perhaps it was a holiday weekend, but they ran out of many of our favorite dishes.  Disappointed at the experience.

I  like the food and it's fun to grill your own food, it's fast too cook, without getting smoke all over you. The waitstaff is nice.
My only complaint is that I've been here several times and they are always out of something - which is odd since sometimes it's a certain marinade or one of their specials they are running, early in the evening - they should not be out of these kinds of things.

This was my 4th time at this restaurant, but the first for my husband & sons. They all loved it. My boys loved the grill aspect of it. The food is really good and the lunch options include rice, soup, salad, and edamame. Good value.
good food, good service, good atmosphere, good price!!
It's best to make a reservation ahead of time because they fill up quick!

Slow service server did not take the time to explain what was available we were left to fend for ourselves
Barbecuing your own food is a novel idea I like the concept but our grill did not operate correctly only half the burners were working
Our server was very kind and professional, usually when I come here the service isn't always great since they are always pretty busy. I was pleased with my experience for lunch!
Food was good. Service was not as good. This is not the first time I ate at the restaurant. I wish it could get better.

The best thing about Gyu Kaku is the experience in cooking your own food on the tabletop grill.... it makes for an interactive and fun dinner experience.  I loved the variety on the menu and the cuts of meat are always good quality and marinated well. 

The service is really spotty and one of the reasons I dont come here more often.  The manager was great- he accomidated our request to be seated away from the drafty front door with a smile but our hostesses were dour, way to brief and curt and seemed to run away from us.  We asked for second napkin and a stack was tossed on the table without a word.  We tried to flag down our server 2x and ask for a second round of drinks and she litterally was running by the table.  

The music was way too loud for the venue- between the grill fan and the music it was hard to have a conversation... but the decor and ambiance is nice... so all in all, I would not take too much stock in this.  

I would come here much more often if the service was better.... even the Cupertino branch of this seems to have a service issue. :( sad.
great food, fantastic service - a very pleasant experience

Had dinner with my husband, his mother and her boyfriend.
Love the fact we could play with a our food a little before we ate it.
the Kobe Kalbi was delicious! just wish there was more in the serving.
We plan on making this on of our favorite places to frequrent.
This place has happy hour everyday.  Good value.  You cook your own food.  Meat and seafood are good.  The garlic noodles were just okay.
Ok food, but pricey for the amount and quantity.  Also they brought out different meat then what we had asked.  But it was ok we ate it.
Overall good tasty food and service.  Can get pricey if not ordering from their happy hour or last call menu.
Sticky sauce bottles as usual. Second visit in a row they forgot the miso soup. The karaage got sent back (it was cold) but other than that it was good!

My husband and I constantly go here for late night dinners or gatherings with friends. On this occasion, we had a double date with another couple. We had reservations and they seated us exactly at 7pm. Unfortunately our burner wasn't working and the server moved us to the next table.  Minutes later, the manager approaches us and rudely asks us to move. There was obviously miscommunication with the staff. The manager ended up apologizing and bought us a pitcher of beer. Despite the incident, the food is always good and the service is usually decent. I would still recommend going to this place especially during happy hour.

Love this place.  Servers are always so helpful.  Appreciate the value...you can go big or go small.  And appreciates the new addition of cheese fondue.  So fun to cook your own meal.  Great place for friends, dates, and families!

A table is hard to come by at dinner time (and later) without a reservation.  Be sure to bring a washable coat (it will smell like the food you cook afterwards) if you're by the front door when it's cold outside.  The door opens and the cold air blows in a lot, so you'll need it!

Lots of items to choose from. We ordered some meats to grill, some appetizers, some rice and noodle dishes and enjoyed everything. Only beer and wine, so they offer sake cocktails. Portions a bit small, but the prices aren't that high, so you tend to order a lot. It does add up though. Grill is not smoky and meats grill pretty quickly, although our grill had lopsided hot spots. Fun dinner.

I'm from the the east bay and tried this place in LA a couple of months ago. Then I heard there was a location in San Mateo and had to drive out for the Tofu- nuggets they are to die for.  The food was very flavorful the service was not so great. In my party there was only the 3 of us and often our server would forget about us. He would take our order, but forgot the bring us our food. At one point he forgot to bring us our steak and we were sitting there for about 15 minutes with nothing. In my opinion this place is good ONLY if you're in the area. Its very pricey, and not worth the drive. I much rather have had spent $88 at Gogi Time.
Excellent service, delicious food

All day Happy Hour on Monday is always cheap. They also offer lunch specials. The meat is not frozen or dry so that helps a lot with the cooking. If you order Toro Beef, make sure the flame is not to high since it is fatty and may stoke the flame. Garlic noodles are good but they are a small serving for 2. The Spicy sauce tastes like lumpia sauce so it is my favorite.
It's not my style to dine there on a Friday night. I like to be served and not to cook.
Good as always

the service was so bad. we got the wrong shishito peppers. we ordered the appetizer (cooked) but we got the uncooked one and i bit into it and did not like it bec it was spicy! and the portions of the other food are so small. anyway the meal was ok and i am glad we had the groupon but again the service was bad! shishito peppers are supposed to be mild in flavor, little spicy  and little bitter. the ones we got were spicy and not good! i have eaten them before in a another venue and these were good, yours are not!
Very good for our first time, good find from open table
The set dinner $ look reasonable,  staff are very friendly!  Good place and very enjoyed.

Me and my boyfriend had a very horrible experience there. We got a coupon and was told that the coupon couldn't be used in addition to discounted meals, which was fine to us. But ever since then our server guy's attitude became totally weird. First of all, store was not really busy and all we ordered were raw meat (meaning minimum amount of pre-processing), but it took about 15 mins for each meat dish to be brought to our table, we ordered 4 meat dishes and therefore we were waiting forever. Secondly, the sauce bottle were not cleaned well so when I grabbed them they were sticky from the outside of the bottle. At the end, the waiter brought us the check and purposely threw the pen into a pool of sauce that were left on the table, we had to pick up the pen and wiped it clean ourselves. I signed the check, he probably realized how bad of a service he provided to us that he saw me finishing signing and immediately grabbed the receipt and wanted to see how much I tipped. Overall the service was extremely rude and we also found the food was just OK (definitely not prime quality of meat). Definitely not going back and will not recommend any of our friends to go there again.

It was fun for our family of three and the quality of the meats was good. 
Service: during our 60-90 minute meal, we had three different servers rotate out which was a little odd.  Also, 2 out of three of them were trainees who were unsupervised and a little forgetful.  They were earnest and friendly but forgetful.  Why schedule so many trainees on a Friday night?  I saw at least 2 other trainees. 
Food: good quality meats
Ambiance: modern but the super sticky floors were distracting and made me think about what else wasn't being cleaned. 
Noise level: it was a little difficult to have a conversation without raising your voice.
Value: we tried the $55 meal for two and this was a good amount of food and variety for the price.  We added the onigiri, assorted vegetables, and desserts to our meal.  They could be a little more generous with the portions for the assorted vegetables: two slices of zucchini, one slice of onion (cut in half), two slices (yes, slices) of oyster mushroom, two button mushrooms; two cherry tomatoes, and a small package of corn with butter.
Other: cooking on the grill - the downdraft vent worked very well and felt it was pretty safe to say have a child at the table.

Gyu-Kaku is one of our favorite places to eat. The meat is always marinated really well, the vegetables are fresh, and I could eat their bimbimbap all day if it was *little bit* healthier :) It is fun for date night, lunch with friends, or big group dinners.

Service is always excellent at this location and it is almost always happy hour. We prefer to order a la carte to doing their pre-fixe meals, but they have tons of options.

The only drawback is there is no bar and the wait times can be pretty lengthy. Thank goodness for Open Table and the easy reservation system!!
Really good! I love coming here. 5$3 food is really good
Not true authentic japanese BBQ. Okay place to eat, but nothing special.

We recently visited Gyu Kaku in San Mateo on what I consider a slower than normal night. Unfortunately, our server seemed absent minded and forgetful.   We had to ask for things multiple times before we would get them.  The manager usually comes  to check on each table, but not this time. We'll continue to dine at Gyu Kaku, but may not  continue to visit this location if the service does not improve.

We made a reservation for 1; showed up at 12:50. We were asked to wait 10 minutes for our table. The restaurant was not full. A couple walked in and was seated before us. That was annoying. They also forgot the rice when bringing all the food. Small mistake. Always good quality food though. I'll gladly be back.
Got sick, don’t think I’ll be back

Came here to celebrate my anniversary with my boyfriend after making a reservation earlier that day for 5pm. We get there, it isn't crowded at all, there are plenty of open tables yet somehow, despite the reservation I made, we got seated at 5:30. Why did we wait 30 mins WITH a reservation? Despite this, we shrugged it off as we were starved. 
Then comes the waiter...then the next waiter...and then yet one more. We were introduced to three different waiters in a timespan of 30 minutes. Talk about highly disorganized. 
It took 15 minutes for our RAW FOOD to come to our table. 

There was quite a bit of miscommunication and disorganization going on this day. I'll just go back to the Cupertino location. Sorry, San Mateo, you screwed up big time.

We had a table of 6 and there was more than enough room for us all. The courses were served in a timely manner, not everything at the same time so we could cook some food, then the next plate of meat came. Go during happy hour to save some coin!

Went here for Happy Hour on a Friday night. Got a few items off the menu: spicy pork, pork belly and hanger steak. They were all really good. Also got sake and beer. The sake was too hot for my taste, almost boiling, so it burned my mouth when I tried to drink it. Overall though, it was a good experience and I would return.
Meat quality seem to get worse every time we return, a each plate of meat have lots of tiny scrape, like leftover end cuts

Very good!!!
Enjoyed much  all my family member love this place . Wanna come every week!!
Great yakiniku place. Service can be slow but there were lots of diners inside. Understandable.

I absolutely love this place! I've been here twice and both experiences were amazing. During my most recent visit, I came to celebrate my birthday. We brought a cake and the server was able to hold onto the cake while we ate. I wasn't expecting to be sung to or be given dessert or anything like that. But that happened and it made my birthday more special
The dishes are not clean enough, has oil and dry rice on it. Food is good, all the meet tastes very good.

Conceptually, the idea is good, but the experience & food was somewhat mediocre. This was our first time dining at this restaurant. We arrived about 10 minutes before our 6:00 reservation and ended up waiting about 20-25 minutes for a table. There were a number of open tables, but we were told the wait staff was still on break and we would need to wait for them to return.  

This Japanese restaurant has no sushi. Dining patons cook on a gas grate/grill in the middle of the table. We ended up ordering the Kobi dinner for 2 and added on 2 appetizers. It ended up being plenty of food for the 3 of us.  As first timers, we did not know the grill had to be oiled so we did not know to ask. We saw the neighboring table get "oiled" so we asked about it so they did ours as well. That seemed to help. 

Some guy would randomly come to the table to swap out the grill grate. He would say nothing. Swap the grate and move on to the next table. It was just an odd experience. 

With so many great options in the Bay Area, I think we would choose something else for our next dinner out.

We have 5pm reservation & waited for 10mins, the restaurant wasn't busy with 3/4 restaurant empty.
Very slow service.  We always have to flag or get our waiter's attention.  We cooked half of our order, we never received our order of rice until we ask for it.   The good thing about it, water was always full & empty plates were always cleared from our table.
It was my first time, but I'm very satisfied with the food and the service.
Made reservation and seated on time. It took a long time for our main portion of the meal to come out. 40 mins which was very disappointing.

It was my birthday! They sang, awesome food service! Andy was a great server and was on point with all his orders! Thank you so much for an awesome experience! Will definitely be back! Food was amazing!
Enjoyed tasty meats that can cook at the table.  Japanese draft beer goes with the yakiniku flavors.  Very good dinner experience.
great place for a get together! wonderful variety and we received awesome service. thanks!

This is the 3rd time I have gone where the food was so-so and the service was horrible. It's disappointing when my first few visits went so well. The service seems to be getting worse and worse while the food is just average. I do enjoy the meats and overall flavoring of the food but with the service being so terrible it's hard to justify going back.
Great food and great service! Price is great too for lunch and happy hour!  Definitely going back very soon.

The food was excellent. Two obsevations I have: first, no one cleaned off our grill before we were expected to use it, which I thought was strange. Two: I am someone with a disability, and the bare floor is uncomfortable for me to walk on, but that seems to be a trend in San Mateo. Otherwise, overall, it is a good value for the money.

We like Gyu-Kaku very much. The food is excellent and the service is good.
They have great sauces and interesting menu items.
Parking is not difficult and the value is excellent!!
It's a fun place to eat.
This place was fantastic. Thanks for making my dinning experience fantastic. The staff was friendly and amazing.

We had an awful experience tonight as our grill did not work and they had to move our table. Our food didn't cook, they left a dirty towel on our table and we had to talk to manager on the phone. Really embarrassing and insulting. Love the Concept and food. We had another bad experience . Tonight was so bad and very poorly handled.
Waiter was excellent, food was great as always.

We've been to Gyu-Kaku several times, and enjoy the grill it yourself format.  This time, we were warmly greeted by our server, Jae, who took our order, delivered our drinks and then went on break.  No fault of his, everyone is entitled to a break.  However, while he was gone, we had very oddly timed, sometimes forgotten about, service.   All our veggies came out right away, then a long, long lull where no food came out nor did anyone check on us.   The second wave came but we could not get anyone's attention (despite several attempts) to get the rice we had ordered.  Rice finally came then waited another long while before our last dish came (just one single order of pork belly, I don't know why there was a 30 minute wait).  I feel that if we had had our original server for the entire time, things would have been fine.  This will not discourage us from going to Gyu-Kaku again, but this was not a smooth an experience as we've had in the past.

We normally enjoy eating at Gyu-Kaku and have not been here recently.  We decided to go here to celebrate a special occasion and were surprised how the quality and service have gone down.  The service was poor, we not only waited an usual amount of time to get our food, but also at least 20 min for the bill after requesting it, then we waited another 10 min to actually pay while people in the lobby were waiting for a table.  We were very disappointed.
We love this place! Our kids always suggest going there before anywhere else.
