Tried their new kobe lunch menu.  My comments ar not worth it.  The kobe meat didnt taste like kobe. I still think the 2 or 3 items lunch set is the best.
New menu setup.
Another great experience!  Never seems to disappoint.

Everytime I come to San Mateo store, I see lines or lots of waitings, but at the same time, lots of empty tables. Maybe they need to hire more servers so that you can serve more people at the same time, avoiding lots of crowds. Doesn't make sense to see people waiting but no one were offered to sit with tons of empty tables.
Our server did not come to check on us. We had to ask for tea and other things from other waiters
Love this place! So good and fun too! We come here regularly and cant get enough.

Gyu-Kaku was definitely a break from your traditional lunch venue. We grilled our own meat and vegetables and it gave us time to chat while cooking. Be prepared to smell a little like barbecue when you leave and it may be a little warm sitting next to a hot grill for 45 minutes yet the change of pace was nice. The restaurant was loud between music and acoustics so be aware in case you want to have a business conversation.

Gyukaku is a sub-par restaurant chain in Japan, similar to McDonald's here.  Food is midiocre and only young kids eat there.  It's almost at every major train station in Japan and priced reasonably.  But here,  4-5 very thin slices of meat is priced same as a full entree in American restaurants, and they use tons of sugar to marinate to make you feel full.   Well, I did not see any Japanese patrons in the restaurant, only other Asians who believed Gyukaku is a real Japanese restaurant were eating there.  Originally, there was not a barbecue cooking in Japanese traditional life style.  This is a mimic of the authentic Korean barbecue.  I would go to Korean barbecue reastaurants instead.

you cook your own food, so no more underdone, overdone meet.  The staff is especially nice and they have a nice selection.  I recommend the Happy Hour, where you can not only get a discount, but they also have drink specials!!

The restaurant is modern, clean, and the best deals are during happy hour times. Evenings can get crowded.  The wide selection of items (veggies, beef, pork, lamb, shrimp) to grill and BBQ for yourself right at your table. The wait staff service was excellent  and staff was very friendly and attentive.
Great food as always, but food took a long time to get to the table. Which is raw because you cook it yourself, so I don't know why.
Waiter was a little pushy with the order and we felt a little rushed as they seemed to be in a hurry to close up shop. Overall, food fantastic and their macarons were yum.
The meat is high quality. Flavors thoughtful. Fun atmosphere.
Portions are just to small.  Left feeling hungry and a huge bill.
Amazing food. Recommend to anyone.
Food is delicious. The meats are great. Best time to eat is for lunch but only because it's cheaper. I absolutely recommend this spot.

The food, to be fair, is always tasty and fresh with good presentation.  Lately, the service seems to be going in the wrong direction.  When we ordered the pre-set meal, which we have ordered before, this time the meal came our haphazard, meaning all at the wrong times.  The meat came first.  Hot garlic noodles came at the very end.  Salad was served as we were midway thru our meal.  They brought us pot stickers as a mistake when they realized that the pot sticker appetizers were never delivered to our table at all.  They need to get in sync as far as the dishes coming out and the manager was busy running around not seeming to solve any of the other tables issues.  Need someone onsite who can regulate and assume order to the chaos.  Other than that, our waitress was new, but cordial, apologetic and will be a great waitress in the future.  Not anything major, easily correctable, but needs to happen quick so you dont lose any customers.....thanks!

Our server Joyce was very good.  They were short staffed that day, but she still took the time to explain everything to us since it was our first time there.    Took the time to tell us the 'favorites' and make suggestions.  Very impressed with that!!

Great food but service + the amount of time we had to wait for our orders = not acceptable, especially for a cook-your-own-food place. Even though Cupertino is further away, we will be going there in the future.  Such a bummer.
Great food and excellent service! Will definitely come back here again!

4 of us enjoyed our lunch the other day.   The lunch menu & "happy hour" menus are pretty good.  My one complaint was with the "Miso butterfish".  The menu photos shows 2 nice pieces of fish.  What we got were miniscule little bits, average size 1" x 1" at the most.  For $6.95 this is not good...  Could do without the too loud music too!

This place is my daughter's favorite.  It is fun cooking your own food, and it is even more fun cooking for your parents!  We are a regular there, and the quality of the food and the service is very consistent.  The selection of food is good.
As always, my meal was delicious. We split the meat lovers combo during happy hr and loved it! Service was a little slow but I've come to expect it during lunch hours.

name: Trellis Restaurant
description: Trellis, with the truly unique upstairs patio offers, "al fresco dining" along with it many other charms. Fresh Italian seasonal menu, the vibrant specials and the daily homemade bread, soups and desserts are tantalizing.  A warm-comfortable dining room and banquet-catering facilities with 2 full bars - Trellis is the choice for any occasion.  Banquet facilities are available for groups from 10 to 120 guests and the Chef will gladly consult on any special banquet catering needs.We look forward to serving you!
address: 1077 El Camino Real,  Menlo Park, CA 94025
hours: Lunch: Monday - Friday: 11:00 AM - 2:30 PM; Dinner: Daily: 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM

reviews.text:
Everything excellent, as usual!
Great for food & easy to hear other person for conversations too
Such a lovely experience to dine at Trellis with our two kids - friendly and caring staff made this a night to remember. And the food and wine was delicious!
Yummy food. Nice & quiet & easy to talk.  Great service.  Now our go to place!

Outstanding food, fabulous service at reasonable prices.  The added bonus was we could hear each other talk!
Thanks Trellis
Everything outstanding.  Love this place.  Food great, very friendly & flexible with menu choices & preferences.  Great value too.
Great dinner experience with my wife.  Good food, good service.

We went on Valentine's Day and they had a really short menu with barely any vegetarian options. To add to that, they ran out of buratta and even bread! We couldn't get anything besides the penne pasta. 

The waiter did not seem to know the menu much because when I asked for vegetarian options, he suggested some dish that had lobster in the name and said "it's just the name. There's no lobster in it..." This ruined our Valentine's Day dinner so we ended up having to go elsewhere to grab food. 

The service was also really slow. They took forever to give me the check and the credit card. Seems like they need to get with the times because they still hand write their receipts and manually calculate the total with tax.

I would not recommend this place, especially on special occasions and if you are a vegetarian.

We waited 10 min before anyone even came to our table to greet us. But, others who sat down after us were immediately served. Then when we were done people around us received their left overs boxed & packaged nicely in a nice brown paper bag. We were given a plastic bag like at the grocery store.
Another delicious evening at Trellis.  Took two first-timers and they will definitely go back many times.  Service always warm and welcoming - just an ideal spot.
Great service from Alejandro! Good recommendations and very attentive.
favorite restaurant ever  fabulous food  fabulous service fabulous everything
Very kind staff. Cozy back room that was accommodating to children.
Similar to banquet food. Tasted good but nothing special for what you pay.

A very enjoyable evening - we hadn't been to Trellis for years. The chicken piccata and zabaglione were delicious. I especially liked the large number of capers. The potato puree was really mashed potato - so I am glad it wasn't liquid potato that I thought the puree might turn out to be!  There was plenty of tender chicken - quite tasty too.

As expected, the service was impeccable.
Trellis is one of our favorite places. Food and drinks never disappoint and the service is welcoming and friendly.
Owner took care of us personally to find the perfect table.   Very friendly staff and great food.
Trellis is our restaurant for special occasions. The owner and staff are fabulous and make us feel special every time.
The food is wonderful and the servers are friendly as is the owner.
We have been going to Trellis for over 20 years.  It is consistently good - food, service and ambiance.  We had such a wonderful evening!  The best part is that it is quiet!

LOVE Trellis!! Even though it has been open for many years, we just discovered it a few months ago. It has become our favorite dining place.
Food, service, ambience couldn’t be better!

Everything is always perfect at this restaurant.  Chicken piccata, seafood pasta, polenta are outstanding.  They are the best anywhere.  One of my favorite places to eat.  The bartender is great as well.
We always love the food and service at Trillis and will continue to go often.

We love this charming spot with its delicious food and wine, and superb service.  My wife thinks Trellis serves the best pesto she’s ever tasted.  We always enjoy the pasta and seafood offerings, but we also have much more of the wonderful menu to try.  Thank you!
Large diverse menu which has the variety for our group consisting of vegetarian, pescatarian, and carnivores.  Outstanding attentive service.
Pleasant restaurant with good food and very nice staff

We went to Trellis for the first time and everything was amazing. We sat on the rooftop even though it was hot outside it will still nice. All the items we ordered were delicious, our favorite was the spaghetti bolognese. The staff was very pleasant, welcoming and quick with the service. Will definitely be back soon.
Susan’s downfall - out of this world!  Quiet, wonderful service easy parking in back
Delicious food, wonderful outdoor rooftop patio, and excellent service. It’s a true neighborhood gem!

Neighborhood gem with lovely seating on their terrace. Everyone enjoyed their food, the seafood was fresh and my pasta was tasty. My boyfriend had the chicken parm and loved it. Excellent service throughout the evening, we will definitely be back. 💗
The food is consistently exceptional: freshest ingredients prepared to perfection.  Staff is attentive and friendly; welcoming, family-oriented atmosphere never disappoints.

Wonderful service is the first thing you notice when you walk in the door.  The host and waitstaff are always  extremely welcoming and professional.
Our wine selections and main courses were superb. My wife’s spaghetti al pesto with chicken was fantastic, made with fresh, made in-house pesto.  It’s her favorite. My pan-seared sea scallops with provencal sauce was equally amazing.
We ALWAYS have a wonderful dining experience at Trellis.  Thank you!
Our waiter was so friendly and kind that it elevated our experience.

What a lovely little restaurant.  We ate upstairs on the patio.  Perfect weather and charming place to eat.  The service was amazing.  I believe our server’s name was Eduardo.  Everyone was so attentive and helpful.  The food was fantastic.  Eduardo recommended the “Susie” special pasta.  It was so delicious.
Highly recommend this restaurant.
This is one of the best Italian restaurants in Menlo Park, the food is excellent and great service ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Great good and attentive service. The dishes are classic Italian as is the decor.  We enjoyed a juicy and delicious fillet mignon and sides, with yummy gnocchi as a starter. Excellent service.  They make you feel it’s a special meal!
Wonderful place to celebrate a birthday!  Service was phenomenal!

I have been to this restaurant before and loved it. We were staying in the area and our 40th wedding anniversary fell while there. We chose to spend it enjoying the most perfect meal back at the Terrace…

The owner is a breath of fresh air… the service is top notch… and the food wonderful…

Thank you for a wonderful 40th anniversary night♥️
We enjoyed the specials and appreciated the recommendations.  Wonderful patio to enjoy a leisurely dinner.
pasta  dishes are outstanding, service was excellent and not rushing customers out the door

First time for us at Trellis. We loved food, service and ambience! So sorry we had never tried it before…it is a gem in our neighborhood.
It will be a regular for us in the future!

This was a great atmosphere for a date— very quiet and good for conversation. The food was pretty good; but I bit underseasoned for my taste. It was hard to order; especially cocktails. We had to repeat ourselves several times.
Our "go to" neighborhood restaurant!  Food is ALWAYS GREAT, service impeccable, and prices moderate.  Also, roof top outdoor dining is the best on the peninsula. Menlo Park is lucky to have Trellis!

We love this place. Been going for years. But the food has been sub par on last 2 visits. Sole was over cooked. Bolagnase was kind of odd.
We hope they get back on track!
Great variety of dishes, very good service, with nice ambience.   We were able to have a nice conversation with our dinner mates while enjoying  an excellent meal.
Great meal and service. We are regulars and always have an enjoyable experience
The staff were great and on a Sunday night it was very quiet so we were able to have a conversation without having to raise our voices.

This restaurant was a great surprise to us!  Really good food, excellent service and very friendly and genuine people!  Really enjoyed a birthday celebration!  Food and drinks were fantastic!  Thank you!
Outstanding as usual.  Free food, great service, and reasonably priced.

This restaurant is superb! The food was delicious, the wait staff is knowledgeable, friendly, and very accommodating. The rooftop dining patio was beautiful and a pleasure to dine on. I highly recommend Trellis for a special occasion or a nice evening of dinner out.
Trellis has been our go-to restaurant, a neighborhood jewel.

We are relatively new to Trellis having been taken there by our good friend John.  From the moment you enter you feel like you’re “home”.  In addition, the menu is quite extensive and the food delicious.  One gets the impression that ALL of the staff love their job!
One of my favorite Italian restaurants in Silicon Valley. Any Pasta taste good!
It is always a pleasure to celebrate a special time at Trellis on the Upstairs terrace. The ambience, service and food never disappoint!

Very good food and service!!
We had gnocchi and carbonara,
both were delicious!!
Very Friendly service and great food.   Nice wine selection.  Over all we had a very nice time and will go back often
Always a special treat to celebrate our birthdays!

Great food. Service was satisfactory. No drink menu was offered; appetiser came after the entree. I loved the ambience but will never go back there after this experience. There are other places near where I live that meet/exceed expectations.

As always, the food and service was terrific! There were many people taking advantage of the lovely evening and were eating in the patio so the noise level was higher than ususal, but it was all very enjoyable!
We love Trellis and that's why we keep going back!
Wonderful service/ prompt, friendly, accommodating!!
Great place to grab easy delicious food.  My team has sat inside and outside and both experiences were great.

ordered duck breast salad.  just 4-5 very thinly sliced small pieces of duck breast on top of mostly fresh green salad & overly generous amount of candied walnuts.  i wasn't too hungry so it was ok.  the service was impeccable tho.
We had a very enjoyable and delicious lunch on the veranda. I’ll be back soon

It’s always a fun atmosphere to go to Treas restaurant. Especially if you’re able to sit up on the second floor and overlook El Camino Real. But the food is wonderful and the weight staff is very personable and friendly. It’s excellent value for the dollar. Highly recommend. You won’t be disappointed.
We give thanks to the very attentive and gracious staff who cared for us and made our family dinner special.
Trellis is my favorite restaurant. The quality of their food and service is always consistent.

What a wonderful lunch. Our server ID 2, was courteous and friendly. It’s a lovely restaurant and I will come back. I ordered Spaghetti al pesto/chicken fillets/sun-dried tomatoes & pine nuts. It arrived pipping hot and was delicious.
Bread with olive oil & balsamic vinegar was served. Great food, relaxing and polished interior.

Food was excellent. The menu specified in blue letters that 20% was added automatically to the bill. So we paid the amount on the credit card form without checking anything, and walked out. Our server came running after us in the parking lot where we were chatting with the owner. The server complained that we did not tip him! He said that he ignored the menu instructions to include service. We gave him a cash tip of 30%, but that left us irritated that the owner who was right there said nothing.
We are always pleased with our experience at Trellis. Great for large business dinners.
Food was delish, service is great very friendly bunch of guys!  Absolutely we will be back again.
Perfect place, wonderful experience. Great food, love it.
Me and my date loved the whole dinner experience overall we will be back again food was more amazing then I thought this was out first time and we love it.

Staff was very attentive and courteous. The restaurant was really busy- Valentine’s dinner- but we were promptly seated and our orders were taken quickly. Food is delicious - we started with the apple and goat cheese, followed by veal scallopini and the gnocchi , and finish with Tiramisu. The scallopini was a little bit on the dry side but the sauce was very tasty. Our experience was very good and would return.

I indicated the reservation was for a birthday. The restaurant ignored that. Someone was sitting at the bar and playing a game show on his phone. It was so loud it was annoying.

The food was decent but not exceptional. Wait staff was courteous.
A great place with reasonable prices. The servers are top-notch, and the owner greets all diners.  I’ve been there many times.

There is too much noise from the kitchen with clattering dishes in the main dining room. Patio
Was closed
It was a great experience. I am going to cancel my February 14 reservation at another fine Menlo Park restaurant if I can get one here.
Excellent food— we all ordered different things and really enjoyed. Well-made drinks and very attentive, but not intrusive,  service—we’ll be back!!
Great food and service!! Will definitely go back!!

Hubby and I went here for New Years Eve.  We always go on special occasions.  The food here is always delicious, the ambience very pleasant, and the service is excellent. My husband always gets the Veal Scalopini and the Prawn Appetizer. I usually get the polenta appetizer and a salad.  Everything perfect as usual.  Highly recommend.
This restaurant  has awesome service and food.  I would highly recommend.
Charming, attentive & friendly staff, good food!

My two very good friends and I have been meeting at Trellis in December for at least ten years.  The food is fantastic and the service is great.  We would never think to have our annual holiday celebration at any other restaurant!
Just love Trellis and always forget it is so close and so very good!
The wait are very professional and friendly… the food is always amazing
Delightful dinner. We were a party of four, all ordered something different. Great service, wonderful pasta, and the specials were perfectly cooked & presented.
our all time favorite family restaurant.  heartily recommend

We went on Friday Nov 17 on a 5:45 reservation. All 4 of us got there on time. Took a long time to order food. Waiter was busy.  After dinner, took even longer to get the bill. We waved at the waiter many times. He just ignored us.  Finally left at 7:10. We missed our music performance at Menlo College.  Two of our party had to go home because we were so late no seats were available.
We celebrated our 33rd anniversary & husbands birthday, we enjoyed the service, food and will be back soon hopefully, this will be our go to restaurant for special occasions!!

An amazing old style restaurant. I felt like I had gone back several years and was sitting in a corner of Italy. The food was delicious and the service was fabulous. A definite must if you are visiting in Menlo Park.

Our favorite go to restaurant for special occasions. As usual all was excellent. Good options for 12 & 14 yr olds as well as adults. Service was great, as was the food.
Overall cost was quite reasonable. Will be back
It was pleasant. Service was excellent. Staff was very friendly. The lamb I had was perfect. We will definitely be back.

This restaurant is truly one of the best restaurants in Menlo park. For those of you who go to a lot of the popular ones on Santa Cruz Ave. please take a detour at least wants to try this yummy restaurant.😊
As always, the food and upstairs setting were lovely. The waiters are always attentive.
The canaloni was dry and seemed to have been made days before. Should have ordered a pasta made fresh
A midweek night so dining numbers down but service and food quality was excellent.

Best restaurant in Menlo Park! Kurt and everyone else there treat us like royalty every time we visit! It feels like they’re part of our family, and we’re part of theirs. The linguini with clams and seafood pasta are my two all time favorite dishes,and my mom loves the chicken piccata. I have yet to find a dish I don’t like there. Oh and the zabaglione is to die for, definitely not to be missed!

The staff were pleasant and heelpful.  The food was OK, not very current; reminded me of dinning a decade ago.   The plate was piled high with vegetables, the fish and a starch.  Hard to differentiate the flavors.

Really enjoyed Trellis in Menlo Park.  We sat upstairs and loved the atmosphere.  The waiters are personable and the owner (or manager) made sure that everything ran smoothly.  The cocktails and the food were great.  The creme bruleé was not good.  The custard was dried out.  We will definitely go back to Trellis.  I recommend this restaurant!

The patio was a marvelous space on a late sunny summer afternoon, and we had an enjoyable dinner. Truthfully I was expecting a bit more on the culinary side of the house... the food was fine, but standard. Probably a better place to enjoy some wine and appetizers while the breeze rustles through.

When we arrived, we were told the rooftop patio would be too windy, so we moved to a table inside. Food was terrific. Our waiter was great and very attentive. It was my birthday, and this is a lovely place to go for an event.
Excellent food and service, always consistent! I highly recommend trying the Trellis and if you like Gorgonzola, order the Susan’s Downfall, it’s amazing.
This is a good restaurant for dinner or lunch. It's a little crowded in the front part of the restaurant, but there is a large rear room that provides more seating.
Wonderful as usual.  All 6 I have loved what we got to eat ￼
The food was terrible. The pasta was overcooked and the meat lacked flavor. It was the worst Italian restaurant experience I've had.

The place is great - the rooftop garden is amazing. The staff is very helpful and friednly and they make you feel very comfortable. The only thing that was not up to par is the food - it was nice and tasty, but nothing special - compared with the pricetag on each of those dishes.
the patio was fantastic, its like being in Italy !! The best
Excellent foo, a good blend of French and Italian.
My goto place for a good meal with my friends and family. Great service.
We always enjoy our meals at Trellis: great service, delicious food, and beautiful ambiance (especially if you get a chance to sit outdoors on the beautiful rooftop patio area).

As always, eating on the outdoor rooftop of this delightful Italian themed restaurant is a pleasure.  Warm and friendly service, good basic Italian and Mediterranean food, and, a rarity these days, a quiet ambiance where one doesn't have to yell to be heard over the noise.  Portions are large, so sharing is definitely a possibility.  We return here often and have never been disappointed.
We love this restaurant for its homey, reliably delicious food and full bar. The owner Kurt is also a delight.
Amazing old school Italian place with a nice rooftop

Great service, with very friendly waiters!
Food was excellent

Great place to have a nice meal outdoors in the warm evening.  We were actually a party of 12  (waitstaff was very accommodating).  Service was excellent.  Good wine menu.  Tasty appetizers.  Delicious entrees.  Dessert was the bomb.  Def returning when in the area.
This is our go-to place. We love the food and the service is always excellent

This was a last minute find for us on Mothers Day and we loved it! The service was excellent and very friendly and the food was delicious. We plan to go back to experience their full menu sometime soon.
This restaurant is a hidden gem! Eating on the rooftop and eating delicious food transported us to Italy!
Trellis does an excellent job all-around. great food, generous portions, very helpful staff, and a nice venue, especially on the outdoor patio.
Birthday dinner for girlfriend- great good and very attentive staff. Food was amazing and the ambience was fantastic. Love the outdoor patio
Trellis is always the highlight of our week. Thank you for making our family dinners out so special, and delicious!
Seafood and pasta dishes are well-executed. Solid wine list. Excellent service. Cozy ambience.
Everything about our dinner was perfect as always at Trellis

very good service.....competitive food quality with most of the many italian restaurants in the area....pleasant ambiance and decor.....but noisy when full......moderate prices and ok wine list....$25 corkage......very pleasant upstairs roof dining in warm weather  [although they have heaters]
Food was delicious and portions were generous. Omar gave us the most attentive service. Overall we will definitely be back.
Not too crowded, great location, good food, great service and not too loud
The food portions were big.  It was nice to be at a restaurant.
Delicious classic fare, with attentive, cheerful service. Hoping to return!

To be honest, I'm running out of superlatives to shower upon Trellis. This has to be the absolutely BEST restaurant on the Peninsula. No matter the weather, I only dine outdoors on their roof patio, which is the best outdoor dining around. The people, including ebveryone from the owner, to the wait staff, to the table staff, to the chef and kitchen staff are all flawless. Ther are NEVER any disappointments in any aspect of the dining experience. The quality of the food is always consistent, never the occasional 'off-day' that is all too common at even the best of restaurants. I have introduced many, many people to Trellis and every last one of them has become a regular. If you want the best of everything at reasonable prices, look no further.
Everything wonderful  - food, service, ambiance &value
We had excellent service for a group of six.  The food was delicious and it was quiet on a midweek day for lunch. It was our first time eating there and will certainly go back.

Perfect as always. There’s a reason this is our favorite restaurant in the area. Kurt and the entire team at Trellis always gets it just right. P.S. if there’s ever another widespread power outage and you can’t cook at home head over to Trellis and they’ll cook you a perfect meal you won’t be able to get enough of .
A fairly cozy restaurant that needs a good refreshing in ambiance and menu.  Food was good but not great, but the service was excellent.
Delicious as always! Everything was perfect, so happy to see them so crowded.
We had a great experience at Trellis this past weekend. They were wonderful at accommodating our large party. The food was delicious and the service was excellent.
Trellis is a Menlo Park treasure!  Great food, great service, relaxing atmosphere and best of all is their roof top outdoor dining.  Best, by far, in Menlo Park
Great. Service!
Kurt and his team always do a wonderful job at Trellis and as always, the food was outstanding and the service friendly and professional. One of our favorites in the area and not to be missed.
Good solid Italian food. Great waiter who never rushed us even though it was Valentine’s Day and very busy.
Everything beyond great.  No improvements needed.  Perfect meal, service, cost, flexibility in diet requirements etc!!!
Great food. Looks like cooked fresh to the order. Great sauce with pastas.
Very personal service. The stairs to the roof patio are daunting, but I prefer sitting by the cook anyway. Huge menu. Carbonara is the best. Even better if you save your leftovers for the next day.
Service was rushed throughout the evening.
Always a great meal at Trellis. Don’t miss Susan’s Downfall, it is delicious! The food is dependable and the service always professional.
Great Italian dinner with amazing service...highly recommend.

The members of our party thoroughly enjoyed the sole (specialty of the day) and the chicken scallopini and shared desserts--tiramisu, vanilla ice cream with warm raspberry sauce and the creme brulee.  Our waiter and his assistants were very attentive and the owner of the restaurant stopped by our table to greet us and wish us well.
The food was excellent from start to finish.  The waiter was friendly, welcoming and helpful.  It was a pleasure to have him as our waiter.
Fabulous!  Wonderful!  Truly one of the best restaurants in the Bay area.
Not a lot of gluten free food to choose from if you have a gluten allergy.  But the service is outstanding, the ambiance warm, friendly, cozy and attractive.
As always, the best Italian food on the peninsula.

This place is excellent in so far as service, food and ambiance.  We had eaten here many years ago and it kind of fell of my radar for some reason until now, but I'll definitely try not to let that happen again!
My husband had Beef Bourgogne. Delicious!  I had the  Petrale Sole. Delicious!  Quiet and delightful!

This is not just any normal old Italian place. For example, salads. Anything other than the plain garden greens can be a lunch in itself. I and my friends had the warm spinach with panncetta salad and found it very satisfying. The apple and goat cheese salad can also serve as a lunch entree. The bread basket, always brought out, gives a diner warm, house-made bread---delicious!  And we split the polenta appetizer and it easily went four ways - the polenta is fluffy and the pepper, mushroomand tomato sauce served with it makes it a delight.  Go Trellis!
Just great, as usual
We enjoyed your food, service and everything. Thank you. We'll be back.

Really lovely meal and good service too. We had planned to sit on the terrace but it was rainy and cold. They kindly accommodated us indoors and we enjoyed delicious soup and pasta plus tiramisu for dessert. It’s a little gem of a place and I can’t wait for better weather to try the terrace.
As usual, Trellis is my "go to place" for a great meal.  Curt and his staff, both kitchen and service ALWAYS do a great job!

Service and ambiance were great
Food was good
Reserved table on the roof top and it was really nice
Outstanding authentic Italian food.  Amazing service, friendly staff. Lovely rooftop dining area.  Great wine.  Terrific place!
Trellis is a neighborhood gem!!!
I had a work dinner on the balcony and it was perfect! Thank you Trellis for a lovely evening!
Food delicious and outside patio very nice

The food was spectacular, the service was great, and the ambiance even better. Every dish we had was delicious. Everyone enjoyed the beautiful and serene rooftop. Will definitely be back to try out some of the other dishes.
This restaurant is consistently great. Our only issue was a very loud table next to us on the patio.
A delightful neighborhood place. If you want loud and energetic, there’s the rooftop; if you want quiet and intimate, there’s downstairs. Food is reliably excellent and staff is attentive.
First time there and we plan on adding Trellis to our frequently visited restaurants.

Loved getting VIP table for a reservation literally a hour after we made a reservation.  Kurt and his staff absolutely spoil you and give you everything you want within reason.  From decanting a bottle of wine that hard to open to a double scoop of ice cream in my ice cream sundae, I am coming back again.

Everything we ordered was plated beautifully and delicious, scallops, chicken parmigiana, spaghetti carbonara,beef  bourginon, & the dessert were our highlight, we will return for the raspberry speciality.
Thank you Trellis!
Great food. We return here often. Never had a bad meal. Love the Fettuccine Carbonara and the Cannelloni but the other pastas are just as flavorful. Definitely recommend

OMG, the pasta with pesto & chicken is fabulous.  It’s better than most I’ve eaten in Italy even. They add sun-dried tomatoes that really give it a special flavor. I now have to agree with my friend who said the chocolate mousse is the best he’s ever had… Anywhere. It is definitely now our go to restaurant

Great food and service as usual! As always (for the past couple of years) we ate on the patio upstairs. Just after 5pm we were the first or second party seated. We split a salad and a seafood special (shrimp and scallops). Lovely experience for date night!
Everything great. Just absolutely love their upstairs outdoor patio dining attractive and open. The food and service is still outstanding.
Great Wait Staff. Comfortable setting and good food.
Outstanding as usual.  The pesto pasta dish is the best ever had in US, & even better than some had in Italy!
very good good, excellent service with a good value on price

Everything was outstanding- Yum food, great service, ambience and Beyond reasonable prices.  The four of us ate our fill and we all ended up going home with doggy bags.  PS I am not related to the owner
Somehow, we’d never dined at Trellis before despite living in e area for decades. Now, we can’t wait to go back!
food was amazing! definitely recommend for anyone visiting the area

We went to Trellis for the outdoor seating but were seated too close to indoors which was largely enclosed.  This likely contributed to our feeling uncomfortablet about the servers being unmasked.  The food was excellent though so if you aren't concerned about Covid you will have no problem dining here.
Excellent Italian food, great portions and great service - we will go back - also outside seating - very pleasant place to eat.
The service was not good at all. It took us one hour to get our drinks. It was slow and very unprofessional.
We sat upstairs in their outdoor patio area and it was very pleasant. Service and food were excellent. Will definitely be back
Very good food in a nice shaded outdoor setting with good service.  This place is an excellent restaurant value.  I only went because of the ratings they got here and I was not misled.
Pasta was under cooked and the dish was a bit too salty

I’ve been dining at Trellis for more than 22 years. Always enjoyable. The owner, Kurt, greets guests warmly. Service is knowledgeable and attentive. The menu is extensive.  The food is consistently excellent. Good value. 

Convenient free parking in the Menlo Park CalTrain station.

We arrived around 5:40 and had a corner seat on the rooftop terrace.  No one else was there at the time.  Our servers were pleasant and attentive, without being overly so.  We split an ample green salad with citrus vinaigrette and did not finish it to save room for the main course.  Our dinners were served promptly.  I had the filet of sole, well-seasoned with a piquant sauce.  The serving was also ample, so there were leftovers.  Dessert was fresh berries with whipped cream -- just right. This is a restaurant we will continue to return to.  My only caution if eating outside is to make sure your chairs have a cushion on the seat, and for additional comfort, put one behind you.  The chairs are hard.
As always, Curt and his team provided an outstanding lunch for me and my party.

I hosted lunch for seven people. We were seated on the outdoor rooftop.  The server was attentive but did not push us for time. Great food, wonderful ambience.  Trellis has become one of my go-to places for business meals.
Very consistent restaurant.  Especially recommend "Susan's downfall," ravioli in a very rich gorgonzola sauce.

We really enjoyed our meal there.  It was a date night and we will be returning for another date night as this will be our place.  I usually end up bringing my family to a spot we like, but this one, I will keep to myself so it will be our special little place.

We saw Trellis as we were staying nearby and decided to give it a try. Ended up going back 3 more times! Everything from the drinks, food and service were excellent. We sat downstairs as my mom has trouble walking, and it was so nice to be able to have a conversation and hear each other. Very happy we found this restaurant!
Great pastas! Warm staff. Delicious food and generous portions.
Exceptional menu variety. Carbonara is excellent as are all fish dishes. We will add this to our top 5 in the area.

Met some friends for dinner on the upper patio. The service was excellent and the menu had great variety, reasonable prices. Food arrived hot and we were all served at the same time. Nice wine list as well.  We will be back.
My family and I sat and ate outside, and the patio is so cute. Drinks were good and the food was AMAZING. Will definitely be back.
Lunch on the rooftop on a beautiful day.  Great selection of salads/sandwiches and entrees.  Outstanding quality of food and service.
As always, Curt and his team provide a fabulous dinning experience.  Particularly delightful is the roof top garden.

Our dinner was tasty!  Only draw back was the pasta that came with our veal parmigiana!  It was dry & over cooked…almost like reheated! I added the olive oil that is on the table to give it some taste & moisture!  Service was very good!  Our zabaglione  for dessert was outstanding!  Yes we will return but would order another entree.
Food is authentic, not too much cheese, it’s just perfect.
my all time favorite restaurant and the owner is fabulous too

This is a traditional Italian restaurant, with  good standard pastas and entrees, done very well. The real selling point, though, is their welcoming atmosphere and fantastic service. On of that, a really lovely rooftop area for dining and a full bar. We come here for a reliably excellent, relaxing evening out.
What a wonderful night with friends. The staff was perfect! The food was delicious and the upstairs patio was beautiful!

We used to go here occasionally before we moved away. Nice Mediterranean meals and a good wine list. We were with friends and the elevator was not operational so we had to dine indoors as two of our party could not climb the stairs. Our orders included Chicken Piccata. Beef Carpaccio, a chicken sandwich and blackened salmon. Everything was very tasty with nice presentations as well. We opted for a bottle of California Viognier. The waiter was very helpful and friendly and let us take some to visit before we ordered. I would certainly come back here again.
Trellis always delivers. Food and service exemplary and the upstairs outside patio is magical. We always enjoy the entire experience of dining at Trellis.
Our favorite restaurant. Such attentive service and attention to everything that makes dining out a treat!
The food was very nice.  I was a bit surprised to see an upcharge of$4.00 to add 3 small mushrooms to my veal/prawn dinner!  the beet salad was very well done!  affogato was good.

Fantastic service, food and wine list! Our waiter was an absolute delight and very attentive. Lovely spot for a date night or meet up with family and friends. The Apple and goat cheese salad was refreshing, as was the chicken, don’t skip dessert! The tiramisu was delish. So glad we gave this place a try, authentic Italian food with a great vibe. Staff that takes pride in their service. Truly a delight to dine here with Murat as our server, he went above and beyond and it was such a treat. Also the upstairs patio is lovely, definitely reserve ahead!
Excellent food and great service.  The rooftop dining very lovely and indoor dining is intimate.  Lunch or dinner - both great options.
Upstairs lunch outside was very nice. Great service and the salads were excellent
Very good service, friendly staff, delicious food, great pasta dishes… We definitely recommend this ristorante!!!

We came for my birthday and Kurt, Murat and the entire staff made our experience wonderful! Delicious food, beautiful ambiance, warm and inviting staff with great recommendations if you can’t decide. Generous portions too!

Granted, if you are driving down El Camino and blink, you might miss their small, unassuming storefront. So, DON'T blink! Every aspect of this restaurant is perfect in every way. Starting with the owner, to the wait staff, to the ambiance (don't miss the rooftop patio, no matter the weather, it is truly a gem), to the food and prices, especially considering the generosity of the servings. Trellis has been the perfect choice, whether it be for a quiet lunch with one or two friends or an evening office gathering for 12-15.  Everything remains perfect, no matter the occasion or size of the group. Everyone I have introduced Trellis to has immediately moved it to the top of one of their favorite places to dine list. If you haven't been there yet, try it - you won't be disappointed!
Best Italian food in Menlo Park...and maybe the Peninsula.  Curt has really taken great care of his staff during the pandemic.  Trellis is our "go to" place in MP.
Very nice ambiance. Food was well presented and good portion too.  Overall very nice.
About a 6 out of 10
The rooftop terrace is beautiful.  The service was wonderful.  It was a Friday morning and not crowded which was nice.   The salad was good, but could have used a bit more flavor.
The roof patio is great.
Lovely large rooftop patio.
Trellis has great food, drinks, and desserts.  We go their for holidays, family events, and just to have a great meal.
Great food and excellent service. I'll return to Trellis for another wonderful dinner.

The veal scalloping was very tender and the potions were ample.  We made the reservation for indoor seating, but we’re seated on the roof.  The rooftop is very pleasant, but we left our jackets in the car and we’re cold. That was the only thing that spoiled the experience.  Had we known we’d be seated outside, we would have been better prepared

Trellis is always outstanding. This meal was a celebration for both of my guests - one achieved a new title (working with her dog) and the other about to celebrate a birthday - but the actual day she will be back in Oregon. So, double celebration and lovely meal - we had requested outside on the patio - but the winds were too severe - we understood. But the patio is magical!
Food and service always excellent and nice indoor setting as well.
Delicious as always! Kurt and everyone else at Trellis always makes us feel like family! Hands down the best restaurant in Menlo Park!

Amazing as always! The staff are always friendly and remembered us even though it’s been a while since we had been there. The food is fresh and prepared perfectly. The veal was tender and the potatoes were like fluffy clouds. The pasta was perfect as always! They have a nice wine selection and are ready with suggestions if needed. Their specials offer a nice variety and they are always accommodating with any requests. We absolutely love Trellis!!
Everything was delicious. Service very attentive. Really liked dining on their roof.
Great as always.  Can’t wait to return

Most delicious Italian food in Palo Alto 
Great friendly service 
Excellent prices 
Generous drinks 
Don’t miss out on this special place
The food and service was excellent, but it's a little pricy
Food and service was great! Love the pasta. Enjoyed the bread as well.
Excellent service from when we walked in the door. Everything we ate was a delight - love the bread, Caesar Salad, wines by the glass - and pasta dishes.  YUM
Wonderful as usual.  This will become our ‘go to’ place

Delish and friendly. 
Delish and friendly. 
Delish and friendly.

Everything was great.  Because it was raining, we didn’t really want to be outside (as we originally requested) so we were offered a quiet table in an empty corner (away from others) perfect!!!  Everyone ordered something different & all were beyond pleased.  1st time ordered dessert.  All I can say was the chocolate mousse was divine!

Food outstanding & plentiful  (I asked for doggy bag.  So had yummy dinner too. ) The service is outstanding, but not pushy. Everything - atmosphere etc. etc. was great.  
I already have two additional reservations for the future
Everything was great. Loved the food wonderful service and the outdoor dining can’t be beat.  I’ll be back

The food at Trellis is always exceptional, as is the service. This time the service was very slow and inattentive. A little embarrassing because we had invited two other couples to join us. Still, we will be back.
A+ as always!!

The food was absolutely delicious & beyond reasonable! The service could not have been better - prompt & always available. It was wonderful being outside upstairs and when it got too sunny, the staff immediately moved an umbrella to shade us.  I already have reservations set up again.  Total yum!!!
A comfortable setting with excellent service and food.
Classic Italian restaurant with great flavor and iconic selections!
Dining at Trellis is always a memorable time. You talk about the food, service and ambiance even after dining there.
Delicious steak
This was our first visit to Trellis and we enjoyed it very much. It was a nice afternoon and the outdoor dining was great.
Best place to go for a nice fine dining experience.  Good and service is exceptional as usual.
Good menu, good service

This restaurant always delivers.  The weather was terrible yet we really wanted to dine outside.  They have a covered patio upstairs with nice warm heaters and the service was outstanding as well as the food.  Will continue to go back!
Warm and friendly staff. Delightful dining experience with the family for holidays.
Pricey menu w/ food quality not always not up to par

Trellis is always a pleasure.  I had been there multiple times for dinner but this was the first time I had hosted a lunch at Trellis.  They were very accommodating to our needs and their lunch menu is as terrific and varied as their dinner menu.  Very yummy lunch!

We had a lovely dinner and the staff was very accommodating.  I am very worried that this restaurant is going to suffer from the lack of foot traffic in downtown Menlo Park.   We were only one of two parties in the restaurant on a Sunday evening.  What a sad downtown with multiple storefronts empty.  Very difficult for the restaurants to bring in diners.  The city should be doing something to reinvigorate Santa Cruz  Avenue!

We often forget about this place when we’re deciding where to eat, but we will be putting it in the rotation more from now on. The rooftop dining is lovely, with excellent traditional Italian fare and a full bar. The host is warm and welcoming, the service professional. Really a nice evening out. Highly recommend.
Nice to see Trellis busy again. Chef and staff are at their best with lots of parties and customers.
Great evening, such amazing service and staff! We will be back again soon.

Our trio dined outdoors on Trellis’ spacious second floor patio, warmed by heaters. All the food was delicious and portions large. The beef carpaccio featured a large plate of paper thin beef with a mustard sauce drizzle; the Chef’s seafood and rice dish is as lusty as paella minus the sofrito; the capellini with scallops was delicately flavored - yum.  Do save room for desserts!
Large upstairs patio, delicious food & interior refresh is required
As always, an enjoyable, delicious night out with a friend. Wonderful wait staff.
Always a good meal. Excellent service, pleasant atmosphere and tasty food. We are fans of this long standing restaurant.
Excellent food.  Excellent service.  Good ambiance.

As always, the food was good, with lots of choices. The staff was attentive and made sure they expressed pleasure in seeing us again, after the COVID restrictions.  The portions seemed more generous; we both took home leftovers.  We are happy to be dining in again.
True old fashioned Italian restaurant. Great food , large menu and good value!
Trellis is a great secret in Menlo Park... it is quietly tucked in and allows for conversation that is audible.  Great service, lots of food on the menu.
We had the orange and beet salad.It was very good.I also had the fettuccini and shrimp.Good size portion.Took home leftovers.Tiramisu was excellent.

Our go to restaurant for special occasions. Last nights took family out for my Birthday - 6 adults, a 9 1/2, a 12 1/2 and one almost 17 plus 6 adults.  All were able to find something one menu they liked. They even offered a "kids" portion for the youngest. Even gave me a dessert with candle.

All were comfortable  out doors on the rooftop patio.

Great place anytime.
I came thinking this is a fine dining place. However, food was not good. Also ambiance isn't exactly great.
The service was excellent, the food was good but not remarkable

Service was great, very friendly. Food was very good and tasted fresh. Only negative distraction was the person answering the phone calls to the restaurant at the bar and placing them on speakerphone so everyone hold hear the conversations. Not exactly professional in my opinion. But overall, dinner was fine.
Broad menu of Italian dishes, including many pastas.  Nice outdoor rooftop seating.  Great service.  Reasonable prices.
We had a delightful meal on their upstairs terrace.  Everything was well prepared and the service was friendly and outstanding.  A lovely place to spend an evening.

Trellis is probably one of the best (and mostly underrated) restaurants on the Peninsula. We've eaten there for years and have never had a bad time. The upstairs outside Patio is probably one of the best places to relax and enjoy a great meal.  This isn't a "hot" spot or a "happening" place, it's a place to be comfortable and feel like home without doing any work.

This was our second time dining at Trellis and it was equally delicious.  We had the following dishes:
Chef's risotto that was exquisite with a wonderful seafood flavor and a very generous portion, I recommend sharing this dish.  
The pan-seared scallops are the best we have had in the Bay Area, cooked to perfection. 
The char-broiled lamb chops were excellent, flavorful and moist.
The steak au poivre was amazing with an excellent sear and amazing sauce.
Can't wait to go back!

We had lunch outdoors on their rooftop terrace.  It was relatively empty, so quiet.  The terrace is very pleasant with trellised vines all around it blocking it off from the surroundings.  The food was very good.  It was expensive for lunch but the portions were very large and both my friend and I took half of our lunch home for dinner.
The taste and quality of the food is excellent.  The service is impeccable.  That is why we continue to go here.

My husband, three kids, and I went to Trellis to celebrate our wedding anniversary. It was our first visit to the restaurant, and we all enjoyed our dinner. The outdoor terrace is very nice. The waiter was attentive and brought our food extremely quickly. We got the duck with polenta, the lamb chops with mashed potatoes, pesto pasta, angel hair with tomatoes and basil, spaghetti bolognese, as well as bruschetta and prawns as appetizers - all was very good. For dessert we tried the chocolate mousse, and apple torte - also very nice. My husband and I got a glass each of red wine, and it was a very generous pour. 

It’s not cheap (we spent $300 for the five of us, for two appetizers, two glasses of wine, five entrees, three desserts, and two coffees), but we’d definitely come back again for a special occasion.

Really good food at reasonable prices, in a nice casual setting.  My party had swordfish, duck, beef bourguignon, and carbonara pasta, plus a shrimp appetizer, chocolate mousse, and tiramisu.  Nothing disappointed.  A nice variety of wines, also reasonably prices.  Friendly service, and a nice atmosphere.  If you review the photos, you will know what to expect.

Another great dining experience. Food always is tasty and service is great. Everyone is very friendly and welcoming. Try the outdoor patio upstairs - it’s quiet and warm. Thanks again. We will be back.

This was our first time at Trellis which had been recommended by friends. We brought a bottle of wine knowing that the corkage fee ($20) was reasonable. Our party tasted a variety of food from carpaccio to gnocchi, veal parmigiana to seared sea scallops. Every dish was very good. We finished with zabaglione  and fresh berries for dessert which, again, did not disappoint. I have to add that my wife is Italian so we are quite familiar with good Italian food.
Finally, our waiter was impeccable! He gave us great advice on what to order, was knowledgeable and courteous without ever being pushy. On a couple of times he went well above what I would expect. What a treat!
Great place for outgood dining. The four of us all enjoyed our meals. Strongly recommended.
Excellent food and service! The outdoor seating upstairs is a hidden gem!
My family had a very pleasant meal on the roof.

Olive Garden style food. Ridiculous price for wine by the glass and only available for lower quality wines. Amazed that they can stay in business in the bay area where there are so many good restaurants.
An excellent restaurant in Menlo Park with great food.  The owner is very hospitable.

Despite a problem with Open Table overbooking the restaurant we were accommodated in a quiet room with well-spaced tables upstairs - we'd booked for an outdoor space. We had not been for years and the restaurant really makes good use of its outdoor upper deck. 

As usual the host gave us a very warm welcome. He apologized for putting us inside a very plain room - but he need not have apologized it was quiet with well-spaced tables - just 3 older couples including myself and husband.

The fresh sole special was done to perfection - with fresh vegetables - daintily sliced carrots included - and orzo pasta al dente.

This is a restaurant that looks very plain on El Camino, but the food is always good and I've had private groups there in the past as it does go back quite a long way. So I'd highly recommend it whether you want a romantic dinner or an alumni event.
We enjoyed the food but we wish they had more choices for vegetarians.
Nice Father’s Day meal.  Good food.  Good service.  Rooftop Garden perfect.
It was a lovely evening , food and service was perfect.
Good was very good. Service was extremely slow - but friendly.
Lovely restaurant.  The food was very good and the service was great.  Glad to know that they survived the pandemic, as so many restaurants did not

Everything was fantastic! The service was great. Food was great. And ambiance was lovely - we ate outside on the patio. We recommend the apple and goat cheese salad, the sole, the seafood pasta special, the lamb and the chocolate moose!

Everything was outstanding. We tried various salads, pastas, and entrees and everything was exceptional. Top quality ingredients well crafted. Rooftop deck has wonderful ambience. Great find as we met relatives half way down the Peninsula.
Excellent and friendly service.  They make you feel at home with delicious food.
So good to be back to Trellis, good food, good people. Best when served right from the kitchen.
Stellar Mother’s Day brunch on the upper terrace.  Great service and food
Trellis Restaurant provides very good Northern Italian cuisine. The service is excellent.
Food not as hot as usual. Normally I find their food very delicious

The food was amazing! We ordered the polenta appetizer, carbonara, cappellini and zabaglione for dessert. Everything was just amazing! The reason for 4 stars - the bread was not what they’ve used in the past and just wasn’t good. Too crumbly and lacked any sort of chew to it.
The service was good, could have been a little more attentive to check in on us but our server was pleasant so it was fine.
This is such a nice place to relax and enjoy a great meal!
Nothing to comment
Excellent service.  Food is always delicious.
Food is decent and outdoor roof trellis setting is very charming.
First time eating in a restaurant in over a year.  Staff very attentive, service prompt, food excellent.  They had gratis dessert for both birthday celebrants.  Wonderful.  Molto bene!

I’ve been enjoying Trellis for nearly 20 years. It’s amazingly consistent- which is to say it’s always delicious 😋!
Appetizers, salads, pasta, and entrees- you can’t go wrong here. Kurt, I suspect the owner, though I’ve never asked, is there every time I’ve been there through the years. 
One of my favorites, although I’ll warn you it’s rich, is Susan’s Downfall.  
Enjoy!

The Trellis Patio is a special place.
The food is good anytime, but it was a beautiful day with friends making it even more fun.
Good food, nice surroundings, nice people.
We have been dining here for well over a decade.  Always had a great meal with friendly and helpful staff.
The food and service were both great. It was the first time we went there and we definitely will go there again.
We’ve been coming to Trellis for many years now and everyone is always

The four of us enjoyed a wonderful evening at Trellis.  We sat outside on the terrace.  It got a little cool but they turned on the heat lamps before we knew we needed them.  The service was outstanding and all of us enjoyed our dinners.  We  definitely plan to return in the near future.
Haven't been there for a while. Menu has changed to the better. Very enjoyable meal.

Simply amazing old school dining that is hard to beat. Do yourself a favor and take someone you love for a romantic dinner for two, and then come back the next night with your friends and family. Its seriously that good.
Wonderful place to have a quiet dinner with outstanding service and food.  Very relaxing in these times.
The food was delicious and the atmosphere was lovely. It was a gorgeous evening on the patio. Our server was very, but not overly, attentive.  Cant wait to go back!
Amazing service! The food is fantastic.

Excellent place with lovely ambience.  Food was authentic Italian and their dessert especially the Tiramisu which was super delicious. They offer complimentary bread which my kids loved it,  it was fresh from the oven, warm and soft. Our server was excellent too, very warm and friendly. All in all, we had a very good first experience and would definitely go again.
The pastas were really bland and so was the soup. Chicken and bread were okay.  Can't really recommend it for the prices they are charging.
Great for everyday dining but patio is also great for date night!

Trellis is our favorite restaurant in the area, hands down. The food is exceptional, the ambience is wonderful, and the staff go above and beyond to make your dining experience a memorable one. I highly recommend Trellis to anyone who wants a special night out.
always great italian fare. good variety menu and great service

We have been to Trellis many times during the pandemic and had some wonderful dinners on their lovely terrace.
Finally this time we were able to eat inside again. The tables were separated
and we were very comfortable. The service was impeccable and the dinners were delicious as always and  the dirty martinis were perfect.
Can’t wait to return soon!
Kurt, the Trellis owner, is always present and always friendly to guests.  It makes everybody feel welcome as they eat superb food from his kitchen.
Had a WONDERFUL experience at Trellis. The food, cocktails, service and the ambiance were fantastic. The patio is where to be for lunch or dinner! We will be back very soon.

We ate on the rooftop patio. The food was excellent (though the salads were overdressed for my taste); the pasta seemed fresh and tender.  The service was excellent... the pacing was just right. I never felt rushed.
Great service and food in a very welcoming atmosphere hosted by great staff. They do what everything you need done to have a nice experience.
Most delicious food.  Chicken scallopini with the best polenta and homemade bread.  Great ambiance on the roof patio outdoors with heaters.  Best zabaglione I’ve ever had!!  You must try it!

Pre-Valentine’s Day!
Food was delicious but, service are a little slow but, very reasonable & friendliness of the the staff is quite comfortable & relaxing!
We’ve been here at least 3x & my husband really likes it because of the service & friendliness of the staff.
Consistent high quality food and service. Prices are reasonable. Outdoor patio excellent in any weather.

This was our first time dining out at a restaurant in almost a 8 months - we went out for a birthday celebration.  It was our first time at Trellis, but certainly not our last.

The outdoor patio was very nice and had a level of seclusion that we appreciated (they also did a good job with their "social distancing" efforts).  Nice ambiance and was conducive to having conversations.  

 I don't recall our servers' names but the service was efficient and friendly. They also accommodated the fact we brought in our own birthday cake and performed the requisite candle lighting and singing of happy birthday. The owner (I assume) paid us a visit - nice guy. 

Food was outstanding.  Loved the turnip soup and the duck with roasted polenta was fantastic, will probably get that the next time I go.  My wife who is Italian loved the chicken parm (as did I), it was not too heavy and with great flavors. Other dishes that we ordered were also prepared with a lot of care. 

Will return!
always delicious.  we go there all the time ad love it.  we are moving to Florida and will miss Trellis most of all.
Awesome awesome lovely delightful and Nothing less than perfectionism!! Highly recommended
I ordered the risotto and it was delicious. Service was great and ambiance on upstairs outdoor patio was cozy!
The chicken was a bit too salty. Service was excellent

The service here is always awesome, the rooftop is an incredible and unique find for the area. It is warm, cozy, and feels very safe for social distance. I would definitely recommend and look forward to coming back.

The staff was responsive to our needs and will definitely visit again.

We ordered the special which was delicately seasoned petrale sole. 

Thank you for a memorable time with a out of town friend.
Great place and very kind servers. Food of course was very good as well.

Trellis offers delightful rooftop patio dining in the middle of downtown Menlo Park.  It's high enough to block the normal El Camino traffic noise and far enough away to minimize the CalTrain noise at the nearby station.  While it's in an urban area views of the sun setting over the western Santa Cruz Mountains are often dramatic. 
As for the food, the menu is consistent from year to year and consistently good every time we've gone.  My wife boasts of being a member of Finicky Eaters Anonymous but always finds items on this menu that she truly enjoys.  An appetizer that we've ordered many times is fried calamari with lemon aioli - something that seems like it would be boring but that never is.  Big chunks of fresh, tender calamari with a crispy crust - just the thing to go with a beer or cocktail.  My wife has ordered the warm spinach salad with sauteed mushrooms & pancetta.  Even though she usually doesn't like mushrooms, this salad somehow works for her.  For me it's the roasted beets & orange segments over endive that I go for if I'm eating light.  And if I'm not, it's the saffron risotto with mixed seafood that satisfies long after the last fork full.  We don't usually have dessert but have made an exception for their Tiramisu after they served a free slice at a birthday celebration.  If we have any room left at all, we share this slice of heaven that is made special with a drizzle of Amaretto and (I think) a shot of fresh espresso.  Wine list covers 2 pages of mostly Italian and California wines, all carefully selected to please at whatever price point you can afford.  The Chianti Classico satisfies but the two times we splurged on Brunellos we were not disappointed.  Would we go back?  You bet we will.
Go there. You will not regret it. I have spoken. Period.

I treated two of my cousins to lunch.  A very rare occasion that any of us eat out.  Everything was near to perfect.
I had the lunch special of swordfish, one cousin had a chicken sandwich and the other had a shrimp salad.  All were served in large portions and very tasty.
Will certainly go back if ever I am down that way.  I strongly recommend.
We have been coming for 15 years and are never disappointed.

This was my second visit and this is a great place. The rooftop patio has safe distancing and yet this is a fine dining experience with great waiters, a full menu, delicious homemade bread and very pleasant ambiance. My clams for a first course were delicious and in a tasty Provencal sauce. This was a huge portion. My apple- goat cheese salad was so good on my first visit I ordered it again. There's so many choices of main courses it is hard to decide what to order. I highly recommend Trellis.
Birthday celebration.

We particularly like the outdoor, rooftop ambience.  Servers were timely, attentive and courteous.  I had fresh pan-fried filet of sole with a tasty sauce with capers.  Vegetables were nicely seasoned; the brussel sprouts were not bitter.  I normally don't care for them but these were good.  We've never been disappointed here, although I prefer the rooftop to indoor dining.

We love Trellis and recently celebrated our anniversary there. Upon arrival we were greeted warmly as always and seated in their lovely patio upstairs.
The host and our waiter were very nice and made us feel so happy to have chosen to eat there.
We started out with the clams and they were terrific in a delicious broth with bread to dip.  I ordered the fettuccini with jumbo prawns and jumbo scallops and it was really good. My husband had the lamb chops which he loved.
For dessert had the spumoni  that was justice right after my big meal. Also want to mention the delicious dirty martinis that I thoroughly enjoyed. Love this place and can I wait to return.
I felt safe dining on the Terrace as the tables are spaced wide apart.  Great menu and service.

Loved this restaurant. First time there for 4 of us and we stayed almost three hours. The patio was so nice and a full menu was appreciated. Delicious food, and I know the staff is happy to have had us there during time of COVID. Tables were spaced very far apart. Loved their homemade bread and my veal scaloppini, calamari appetizer with great texture and style, fabulous goat cheese/apple salad. Others had beef burgundy and petrel sole, all expertly prepared. I really want to return soon and may just order the exact same thing.
Great ambiance, service and food during Covid 19.  Large portions!
This is our go-to restaurant. We invited our friends and terrace dining was superb. Food is delicious there.
Very pleasureable dining experience especially during these Covid and smokey air challenging times.
Perfect place for covid dining. Outdoors, but not out in the street.
Great server and bus boy. Excellent social distancing throughout.

We ventured out to a restaurant to celebrate a special occasion during Covid.  We've been pretty much eating at home until now.  This was a fantastic destination for Covid-safe dining.  There is a large, attractive rooftop patio, which existed prior to the pandemic.  The menu is excellent, wait staff are very attentive and professional.  The food was great, and we really enjoyed a safe evening, dining outdoors to celebrate our daughter's birthday.  Susan's Downfall is not to be missed! We will definitely be back.
Excellent food and the roof top outside dining is always great but absolutely priceless with the Covid issue.
Great food and great staff. Had a great evening on the rooftop deck.

I felt that they did a very good job adhering to the Covid safety guidelines.  The rooftop patio dining  was  quite relaxing, with excellent service.  The food was very good as usual.  It was almost a pre-Covid dining experience, except for the masks and social distancing.  Highly recommended for a dine out experience.
absolutely fabulous. impeccable service, excellent food

excellent service in a pleasant outside large patio area with unbrellas and space heaters.
the menu items are hit or miss though. so-so carpaccio and veal parmesan. excellent vegetables. very good jumbo shrimp. decent wine selection at a variety of prices. $20 corkage.

Food was great, especially the fettuccini prescatore.
Rooftop dining is a relaxed pleasure.

My husband took me to Trellis for my birthday. We both enjoyed our delicious dinners
and my dirty martini was perfect. We were so happy  to be able to eat outside 
on the  patio upstairs. Also want to mention that the servers are top notch. Can’t wait to return.
Great place food service and atmosphere
Service and food are always excellent.  Also have a great outdoor space for dining during Covid-19.

Excellent service great food. Delicious entree. Great to relax and to sit outside 
Thank you
Excellent restaurant which I found through Open Table. I would highly recommend. The food was fabulous, and the service impeccable.
Staff was very courteous and wore masks and gloves  Back patio had lots of umbrellas and was a well spaced nice setting  Split the Spinach salad which is my favorite and the scallops were good too.
Our experience was very good.  Attentiveness & friendly staffs are always alert to serve willingly.

Took a while for them to attend to our table
We had to request service
Risotto was crunchy, not while chicken and shrimp in it was overcooked
Great food, service, and location. Wonderful hospitality.
We just moved to Atherton and have been looking for a neighborhood Italian place...we think we found it!  Loved our meal and the space.  We’ll be back soon.
Excellent pasta, By far, the best experience in the area
Excellent food from the appetizers to the main courses; duck, chicken, salmon and pasta. Deserts are outstanding, especially the tiramisu.
The food is always prepared well, and the main entrees are just amazing and delicious.
Trellis is always a safe choice. Extensive menu, excellent service, flavorful food and above average wine/bar list.

Service was excellent as usual.  We go here often on special occasions.  Veal scallopini is always delicious. I ordered the cannelloni which was cheesy and hot.  Creme caramel and coffee for dessert was perfect.  The staff is always super friendly.

Good food (not outstanding).  The ambiance was loud.  The tables are virtually on top of each other, and it was extremely difficult to hold a conversation with the person across the table from you (from the multitude of conversations happening 3 feet to either side and across from you).  The restaurant was nicely furnished but I would’ve much preferred to be in the back part where the sound seemed to dissipate more.  The service staff was very friendly and very attentive (my water glass never got less than half full!) - well done there.

Extremely rude and unprofessional experience on Valentine’s Day.

We had a reservation and reached there on time. We were seated at a window table. After a few minutes at the table, we were told to move to a different table at the back of the restaurant. The host was unapologetic and rushed us to the other table. This was a very frustrating start to our Valentine’s evening and made it difficult to enjoy the rest of the dinner.
Special holiday menu. Nice selections, but we also asked for an item not on the menu and they were able to provide it. Upstairs dining was quiet and not rushed. All in all a delightful evening.

Great for special occasions and family gatherings
Outstanding Italian food

Great wait staff; very friendly and food was served at a good pace, like good restaurants do.
Lovely tasting cream tomato sauce as a pond for the shrimp.  A hidden gem in MENLO!
Delightful experience in a quiet environment, delicious food and attentive service.  We will return and recommend to friends.

The food was excellent - I especially loved their polenta. But what I truly appreciated was being able to enjoy my meal without the ear-rattling noise that is so prevalent in restaurants these days. Would definitely go back next time we’re in the area
Never disappoints!
Christmas Family Tradition
Good Italian restaurant with good service, good food, pleasant surroundings.  We ate upstairs and were fine until a noisy family came in to sit next to us.

We love this restaurant and all three of us agreed on choosing it for our Christmas Eve —after church —celebration! The food and service have always been “right on” and the 24th was no exception . Our waitstaff was very attentive and we got great parking!
We all enjoyed our meals. Salads, entrees and desserts were all excellent. Friendly service, too. We would be happy to go back!

We made a reservation for Christmas Eve @ 6:30pm.  My daughter showed up at 6:35 but our table had apparently already been given to another party.  They did say they would still seat us but we did have to stand around awhile.  Other than that glitch, the food and table service were very good as usual.

Come early because the parking at lunch time is a nightmare in Menlo Park, but the extra time is made up for by the great food.  Trellis' food is a very "fresh" version of traditional italian dishes.  Can really taste it in the ingredients and herbs.  Not as heavy (butter/cream) as other italian places we have been...especially nice for a lunch when you don;t want to fall asleep when you get back to your office! :)
Excellent selection and quality of dishes at this Mediterranean/Italian restaurant.  A nice quiet place to go especially if you want a quiet environment to talk.  Service was friendly and efficient.

Trellis is a favorite neighborhood restaurant, and every time we go there, we always tells ourselves that we just don't go there often enough.  In the warmer months, they have roof top dining which is lovely.

Parking was a bit of a hassle. However, ambience, food, and service was superb.  Pricing was
reasonable. Well worth a repeat visit.
Food was mediocre.  One of our friends couldn’t eat her pasta b/c it was so spicy.
Our service provided by Murat was excellent as was the food.  Kurt has an excellent team.  We enjoy this restaurant & wish we lived a little closer.
First time at Trerllis! Celebrating my birthday with family and Trellis did not disappoint! Good food, lovely atmosphere, and great staff!
Excellent dinner and service!
Everything was great except the chicken in my dish was overcooked. Another customer complained of same. We go there several times a year and are always happy with the food and service!
Great service. Great food. One of our favorites. We’ve eaten here many many times.

Trellis has become one of our favorite spots.  This time there were six of us and we dined inside, in the dining area just as you come in from El Camino.  One of our party sent her cocktail back -- I think she and the waiter miscommunicated; then she sent her Grgich wine back saying that it had started to turn.   I ordered the veal scallopini, which was tender and the sauce was savory.  Everyone else seemed satisfied with their meals.  I'd like to try the inside dining area in the middle of the restaurant -- the seats looked like they'd be more comfortable than the ones we sat on.  Otherwise, I think this is a great choice for dining.  I particularly like the rooftop dining in warmer weather.  Will definitely return.

Trellis is a wonderful restaurant.  Casual, friendly, great food, and attentive (but not overbearing) service all combine for a delightful experience!  We love going to Trellis because we know we're going to have a great meal.  In warmer times, try the outside patio upstairs in the back - very quiet and calm.  Thanks!
excellent food and service.  It is always  a pleasure
The food and service was just awesome!
Love the terrace, food was excellent

I liked the 3 separate dining areas,  front, rear & outside upstairs.  You can tailor your  dining experience location from casual to more upscale.
The food and service exceeded my expectations.
Went for a birthday all the food
Excellent food and service for more than 15 years.
I have recommended Trellis to a number of friends!

Food is mediocre. 


We started with Carpaccio. The meat was fresh, nicely presented, and overall very nice. 

My pasta was watery which I personally find unacceptable. How hard is it do drain pasta? 

I had some apple-type tart that I didn’t like. Never had something like that before. Maybe going for an Olive Cake, but was not very good. The only thing going for it was the ice cream.

Great service, nice ambiance, reasonably-priced and tasty food, convenient parking.  I don't want too many people to discover this spot and turn it into the type of place where you have to wait outside for a table.  It's definitely one of my favorite spots.
Great food and excellent attentive service for a large group dinner, we were downstairs and the only party and it was fairly quiet there. Enjoyable experience and will definitely go back.

Very pleasant experience dining. The staff was accommodating and quite helpful. The food was meticulously prepared in a true light California style. I had the special scallops and prawns bordelaise while my wife had the king salmon. We started with the carpaccio and the calamari strips, which were both superbly done and presented. So much food that we skipped dessert. Would definitely visit Trellis again.

Lovely Rooftop terrace, good service, but the food was just so-so for the price. The caprese salad was an unripe run of the mill tomato with a basil leaf and a lovely burrata, but priced much too high for the quality. Veal picatta same idea; sauce good veal okay, veggies very plain Jane, but expensive.
The staff was wonderful and we enjoyed a delightful dinner!

Very lovely patio with quiet and privacy in the early evening; several different dishes, each nicely prepared with generous portions. All in all, a great choice for a serious evening with friends and colleagues-
