Been coming here for years, and the food and service is always EXCELLENT!  We go out on a regular basis, and this is always dependable and delicious!  In warmer weather, I definitely recommend the outdoor patio upstairs.  Highly recommend, and can't wait to return.

This was our second visit to Trellis Restaurant.  We like it because the ambiance is pleasant both inside and on the rooftop terrace.  The tables have tablecloths and there is soft music playing.  It is possible to have a normal conversation without talking over noise.  Our server was attentive without being pesty.  I had linguine with clams, and my partner had pasta with pesto & chicken.  The seasoning was tasty and garlic was not overpowering.  We will definitely return.

Ambience is wonderful, a lovely outdoor setting for dining. Food was great. I particularly recommend the spinach salad and goat cheese with apple as starters - delicious and healthy. The beef bourguinon was excellent!

Trellis Restaurant in Menlo Park is our go-to choice for Italian food. The service is excellent, and the roof garden seating is pleasant on all but the chilliest/rainiest days. (In the latter cases, we enjoy a quiet meal in the back dining room.) Their wine list is good, not pretentious, and covers most sorts of red and white wines. "Susan's Downfall" is my favorite pasta dish; with a salad, it makes a pleasantly-filling meal, and leaves room for a dessert or after-dinner drink.

We love Trellis Restaurant, especially in the summer when you can take advantage of their beautiful outdoor terrace on the roof.  We never understand why Open Table does not list them in their premier outdoor dining experiences.  The food is always good with lots of items like bread & desserts made in house as well.  Always a treat for us.

This is one of our favorite restaurants.  Be sure to try the upstairs terrace when the evening is balmy.  The polenta-mushroom appetizer is heavenly.  Salads, pasta, and main courses are all very good.  Service was perfect!
This was a special evening with good friends due to superb food and service.

The menu is very diverse.  There is something for everyone.  The food and service were very good.  The waiter did not write down our order and forgot a few items, but quickly responded when we mentioned the error.
Great little restaurant...many areas to eat in, so hte space does not look big. Service was wonderful. Will come afain

Food and service was very, very good.  We had a lovely dinner.  There was a birthday party at the next table with quite a number of people including children and that is what brought the noise level up to higher than usual.  Other than that, everything was really lovely!
Great food, beautiful to sit on the outside patio upstairs.

First time we ate at Trellis.  Food was very good.  Service excellent.  The space where we were was a little crowded.  Noise level was high but acceptable for such a small space.

Nolan
Great food and service with a rooftop patio which is really nice in good weather.
Duck polenta burrata pesto were all very well made

Birthday celebration for a dear friend and brother. Everyone had a good time. The food was delicious. 
The people were very nice. Would definitely go again. 
Great for larger groups.

This restaurant is not a good choice for a person with allergies.  When informed of the dairy allergy of one of our group, the waiter said that one item would be OK because "it just has a little cream"  and another item would be OK because "it just has a little butter."  He seemed surprised when we pointed out that both cream and butter are not safe for someone with a dairy allergy.  
When we asked if another item could be modified to avoid allergens, the waiter said that it would depend on whether the chef had enough time.  There was only one other occupied table when we were ordering, so I can't understand why this was a challenge.

Bread excellent, good wine choices, pastas were a bit “leathery” as if nuked a little too long (not al dente), pesto sauce very good, but “Susan‘s downfall ravioli” sauce not as good as at Café pro bono . Very good Caesar salad. Very good crème brûlée. Chairs are very hard. Good service.
Have been going to the Trellis for many years.  The food continues to be excellent, with a menu providing many different choices.  Wait staff is always pleasant and attentive.

Our family had a wonderful Mother’s Day dinner in the lovely upstairs outside patio. It was warm and pleasant even at 6 pm and the service for our large group of kids & adults was very attentive. The food was terrific! I highly recommend Trellis.
Food was delicious and nicely presented.  Service was excellent; waiters very attentive.
Great food and service. Convenient location in Menlo Park.  We'll go back soon.
Delicious food and drinks, and excellent service as usual.

Very nice smaller Italian restaurant. Nice atmosphere. Was not busy when we went so noise level was perfect. Wish they had beef ravioli as that was what I wanted. Food was tasty but a little high priced.

The food was delicious, and the ambience was good.  When we went there were not too many tables so it's very quiet.  The sea bass was cooked to perfection.  Restaurant overall had a very relaxing environment.
Nice place. Good food.
Very friendly staff. Food was excellent and well worth the price.
Great restaurant

Great service, good Italian food (pasta was actually al dente as it should be), but the prices are on the steep side for what are basic pasta dishes. Awesome chocolate mousse and creme caramel for dessert. Back end on the restaurant smells damp and old, so if you enter that way, it's not a great first impression.
I think if I brought my very Italian grandmother here, she would have enjoyed herself too. Delicious!
Large party enjoyed the experience thoroughly!  Food was good, and service was attentive and sincere.
Typical mediocre Italian restaurant. Big portions of mediocre food. Way overpriced. Service was terrible. Our server forgot about us in the back.
Great food, super attentive and friendly waiters
I had rack of lamb, my friend had the scallops. She adored her meal. Mine was good but not like her scallops. Their fresh steamed vegetables are delicious.

Trellis has consistently been outstanding! The wait service is perfect- not rushed, but not drawn out. The food selection is excellent and innovative. The duck I had was prepared to perfection, and my friend’s prawns and scallops were delicious.  I made a reservation, although it was not needed for a Wednesday evening. I would recommend a reservation on the weekend. I will definitely return to Trellis to try other entrees.

We were a group of eight, with two hearing impaired people - so having a quiet place was important.  The restaurant seated us in the back room, at a very nice intimate (for 8) people.  The food was excellent, the service was good without being hovering, and we all had a great time.  We'll go back again and again!

Trellis always has very good Italian cuisine..
Very fresh pasta's and meats... The fish and lamb shanks are excellent... great find...
Great time.  Yummy food, good service.
Great service and food. We had 16 for NYE and they treated us like royalty.
Excellent experience.  Friendly staff, great food, excellent service.
One of the best in the mid Peninsula.  Don't miss Susan's Downfall,  wonderful combination of gorgonzola and almonds with ravioli.  The risotto  is fabulous. Great service for our large party.
Christmas Eve, a wonderful evening. Food was phenomenal and wait staff so kind.  Love this place, our family tradition for SO many years!!
Our meal was wonderful. There were six of us and two of the people Where in Walkers. The staff was very accommodating, and everyone was very helpful. We would definitely go back.
Great neighborhood gem!
One of the better restaurants serving good Italian food in Menlo Park
Trellis never disappoints.  I have returned several times with people who had not previously dined there and each of them is now a Trellis fan.  The food and the service is always wonderful.
Food was good...would give it another 1/2 star if possible. Good value as well...was seated right away and service was very good.
True and meaningful concern for guests of all ages, with excellent food in a quiet ambience.

We appeared to be the only customers when we arrived. As such, service was immediate and attentive. Eventually other tables were filled and everyone in the dining room seemed to be enjoying their meals. The food was served in nice presentations (my mom’s salad resembled a big flower) and was delicious. The Fettuccine Carbonara was delicious, I might have to order that dish the next time! Overall, it was an enjoyable dinner.

Wonderful lunch last Monday to celebrate an 83 years young birthday!  Great food, friends and a wonderful tour of the of the outdoor dining area, complete with a hand full of grapes plucked from the Trellis.

Yes Kurt, I will be back before you know it with the hubby!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Trellis consistently delivers on high quality food and service. Front dining area and when good weather, upstairs rooftop tables are very nice, other tables lack the ambience that should accompany such great food. We had table of 8, each ordering different entrees and all offered outstanding reviews of their meals. Caesar salad at Trellis remains the high bar with which my wife and I compare every other Caesar we eat- and none have rivaled the Trellis Caesar. The Trellis Carpaccio is also a consistently delectable way to start a fine dining experience.
Overall one of my favorite restaurants on the Peninsula.

Our waiter had to be reminded that we ordered wine after the main course had been served.  And the chef special risotto was rather dry and tasteless - very disappointing when it’s the most expensive item on the menu.  I’d stick to the basics if if we make a return visit as the food is usually much better.
Delicious dinner/good service!

Another GREAT experience. Food is always delicious and the service is very warm and inviting. Everyone is always so friendly and accommodating. We LOVE Trellis, and definitely will be back again! Thanks

OWNER treated us extremely rudely upon arrival and we had to leave.

This review is for dinner that four of us was to have on Dec 25 at 6:30.  We arrive on time and waited about 10 minutes to talk to a greeter which was the owner.  A table in front had just opened up and one of our party inquired if we could be seated there, after the owner said we were to be seated in a back room.  The party inquired courteously that we would prefer the table in front.  At this point the owner extremely rudely said that that table was taken (by whom we did not know since no one else was waiting) and if we did not want the one he offered we could leave and eat elsewhere, at which point he stormed off.  Naturally we did not stay and ate elsewhere.

We had eaten at this restaurant at least 20 times before and were treated well and the food was O.K.  However after this treatment we will never return and will advise our friends and acquaintances to eat elsewhere.  Respect for customers is, in my opinion, paramount for restauranteurs and this owner clearly has little.

This is one of our favorite restaurants on the Peninsula.  We have enjoyed many a meal with family & friends here.  The roof patio was delightful for lunch on this warm November day & the fare delicious as always!

Halloween night was the first time we dined here.  It was relatively quiet --  nice to not have to shout to hear one another speak.  The restaurant has several dining areas and is larger than it appears from the street.  The waiter was attentive and friendly without being overly so.  I had the beef bourguignon with mashed potatoes and my partner had spaghetti pesto with chicken.  My dish was reminiscent of something my mother cooked years ago -- very tasty.  I would have given it a "5" except the onions in the dish tasted vinegary like cocktail onions and not like they'd been cooked with the meat.  Nonetheless, I would order it again.  I tasted the spaghetti dish and I would say the pesto had a mild flavor -- not too heavy on the basil or garlic.  We ate inside and had a window seat that looked out on El Camino.  Next time we'll try the interior dining room, and definitely the rooftop dining when the weather is warmer.  I highly recommend this spot.
Great servers- fantastic food - even crème caramel! Generous portions! Congenial host, who is also a great bartender!
Great meal as usual. Our favorite restaurant
Food was fine but not outstanding. Scallops were great but only three of them. Veal piccata was good. Very friendly and attentive staff. Great ambience. Can actually have a conversation and be heard.
We have a whole upper floor for our 10 group. Food is good, environment and service are great.
The upstairs patio is one of the nicest venues in the area, ideal for a quiet meal and a good value as well.

We've been coming here for years and are never disappointed. Kurt, the owner, is very personable and generous, often giving things "on the house" to the regulars. The food is always excellent and the service efficient and professional. There's a fine wine list, with options for every budget, but if you prefer to bring your own bottle, the corkage fee is a reasonable $15.  Upstairs, the patio provides a very pleasant outdoor ambiance, reminiscent of a European restaurant. I'd highly recommend Trellis for any occasion, or simply a wonderful meal.

Didn't know what to expect since reviews on Yelp were mixed, but happy to report that my experience was top notch.  Our waiter was attentive without being intrusive, the food was good and dining on the rooftop was a real treat.  Prices are reasonable for what you get.  Wine list is a little lite, but other than that, a good experience.
Nice place.  Small, food is good, attentive service.  I was disappointed in the coffee, though.

My friends and I have been meeting at Trellis for a (December) holiday lunch for about five years now.  We enjoy the food and the atmosphere so much that we now go there for dinner a couple of times a year as well.  The owner is very personable and makes a personal appearance at each table to ensure that the diners are happy.
One of our most favorite restaurants on the SF Peninsula!  We enjoy the food & service immensely.
The outdoor roof top dining area in the summer can't be beaten!

Although the food was tasty overall, it was a bit pricey.   I enjoyed my duck entree.  I’m not sure about the others in our party, but one 
man generally picked at his food and didn’t eat much of his entree.  On the way out, I overheard two people agree that they wouldn’t return.  We also enjoyed the ambiance of the rooftop garden.  However, the indoor restaurant is not too inviting.  Perhaps we were there on an off night because the service was quite slow.  We were seated right away but it took quite some time for any server to notice that we were there.  Even after we ordered our drinks it was a while before they were delivered.  Up to this point, we hadn’t received any water or bread.  When our entrees were delivered the server gave my entree to another person in our party.  It was only after the diner had tasted some of the food that the server came back to the table with another entree and realized he had given the wrong entree to that party.  We had to ask for bread but were eventually told it was still baking.  We did receive a basket of bread eventually (after a second request) and it was tasty.  I wanted to like this place because of the rooftop garden, it is unlikely we will return.

Ladies dinner at a restaurant we'd had great food and enjoyment at.  Until this night.  The waiter was great but not sure how experienced he was.  However, the food was such a disappointment.  I have raved about the spinach salad here, and the pasta carbonara.  We started with a lemon drop that tasted like lemon juice and hardly any sugar on the glass rim.  The spinach salad wasn't as good as the last time but it was still pretty good.  The pasta carbonara was not good.  You know how you get a cream-based pasta and the next day when you reheat it, the butter separates out from the cream?  That's how my FRESH pasta came to me.  It was actually better the next day when I reheated it because I added my own cream and fresh parmesan.  Then the dessert.  Nobody had room for individual desserts so we decided to get the warm zabaglione for minimum 2 people and split it 3 ways.  The waiter asked if we were sharing and we said yes.  What he brought us were 3 glasses full of zabaglione and it was not even good.  It's supposed to be creamy and it was more runny.  Then when the check came, they had charged us almost $30 for it!  We asked about it and the waiter told us the manager saw what we were given and to charge us more money.  So my companion talked with the manager who got belligerent and nasty with her.  He said the food is good and that the dessert was supposed to be for 2.  But the menu says "minimum" for 2.  You have to order it and wait and since they were busy we had to wait longer than normal.  The manager ended up taking more money off than we were questioning which was good I guess but it all just left a bad taste in everyone's mouth. In more ways than one.  We gave the waiter a nice tip and I told him we would not be back.  So disappointing.

Great Italian food. Susan’s Downfall Ravioli is delicious. You can order it as an appetizer or a main course. The spinach salad is also great.  Everyone in our party of 8 was pleased with their entrees!
Great atmosphere.  Owner Was super friendly and took the time to show us the amazing vine around the patio.   Would definitely go again
Nicest owner ever

Trellis is always excellent.  I had the fish, which came with a delicious sauce, orzo, and vegetables.  I brought home half of the dish, and they gave me extra sauce.  The veal dishes  are excellent there too as well as all the pasta dishes I have had there in the past.  The cocktails are well prepared and generous in size.  Their wines by the glass are also good quality and reasonably priced.  The service is very prompt and personalized.  I highly recommend Trellis as a great Italian restaurant.
Delicious food. Excellent service. The weather was nice and we were seated upstairs on the roof terrace. Very nice.
Food was great, wait staff was outstanding, outdoor seating delightful

Love this restaurant.  Love Susan’s Downfall.  Love the outdoor terrace.  But first time not fully happy.  The waiter was unpleasant and dismissive of our choices.  I think he was new.  Previously the waiter has been outstanding.   The main course was luke warm. Overall the experience did not live up to prior experience or to expectations.  :(

This was our first visit to the Trellis restaurant having recently moved near by.  We are familiar with the neighborhood so had no difficulty finding it and celebrated on 61 anniversay on their top patio.
The owner was recptive but not overly intrusive which we liked! Though the lack of elevator was a bit daunting, we made it up to the we had a wonderful evening and anniversary with a nice complimentary dessert!  All in all it was a fine time!

Great game hen special and warm spinich with mushroom salad.  Veal picata  so so.
Wonderful attentive and knowledgeable server.  
Grapevines and sunshine on rooftop  terrace  made our dinner SO pleasant.

We took a visiting out-of-town friend to dinner at Trellis. She's a foodie, so I hoped it would live up to her standards. It surpassed them! She was pleased with the wine list (we let her select & she chose a Chianti Classico Reserva . . .delicious!). She also ordered carpaccio as a starter (my husband and I opted for the split pea soup, which was great) and said it was among the best she's tried. And she had the scallops and pasta main dish; again, it got rave reviews. (My husband had the leftovers the next day for lunch and agreed 100%.) My gnocci were succulent, too, as was spouse's flounder.

We usually bring nonprofit reps, who are pitching donation requests to us, to Trellis for lunch meetings, but now we know that dinner is even better! To be continued. . .
Very good!

Our favorite place for special occasions. Also for any other time.  See my past reviews of Trellis or other comments. 
Tonight’s visit was for my wife’s birthday. Invited several friends, who have been here with us before, to join. 
All gave high ratings.
Enjoyed the rooftop garden.

Food was excellent - everyone in our group loved every appetizer and entree. Delicious! Service was a bit....weird? No hostess, waiter tried to force us to sit inside even though our reservation was for outdoor dining. I asked him to check us in on Open Table and he didn't (so we didn't get the dining points without having to contact OT customer support, which is great BTW). We were served drinks and appetizers, and our appetizers were done and we had to call him over so that we could order our main course (usually that happens before the apps are served, right)? It was a very hot night and we had to ask for an ice bucket for our white wine. The waiter was very nice when he was there, just the service seemed a little "off" (I think maybe he was covering both upstairs and downstairs?). The upstairs deck is very nice with grape vines growing all around. You would never know that you are on a main street - it is quite secluded. I'd eat here again for sure. Just don't expect service on par with the price point. No body was rude or anything, just not tip-top service.
A good dining experience, relaxing atmosphere

Love this place!  The service is always excellent and the food is always delicious. The only thing I'd about this visit was that our server returned to the table to ask us if we still wanted the Caesar salad we ordered because the kitchen was really busy???  We did still want it.  When it did come to our table, it was not split like we requested and the portion was alit less than usual.  Running out of salad perhaps?  Other than that, everything was well done as usual.

A nice experience overall, but had hoped the patio was open for seating since the main dining room isn’t very pretty.  The server was pleasant and genuine, but he seemed new and inexperienced.  Quality of food was above average and since there was only one other group in our section, it was ideal for conversation.
Excellent food and excellent service.  It was a gathering of friends.  None of us had been there before.
Great neighborhood gem. Good food, very personable and wonderful service!

Our review of Trellis is mixed.  Bottom Line:  We want to go back and give it another try.  The best part of our dinner was the extremely careful and conscience service.  Our server was a woman very invested in our comfort and pleasure.  She checked on timing between each course and whether the food was to our pleasure.  The food was, sadly, mixed.  My caprese salad was delicious, as was my partner's fried calamari appetizer:  An ample portion served hot with a light but crispy coating.  And our deserts of chocolate mousse were creamy and chocolatey.  The problem was in between.  My partner had the evening's special:  from the description, he expected a veal piccata with shrimp.  The shrimp was short of perfection, being overcooked, and the veal came with a brown sauce and no capers.  My duck breast was dry.  The accompanying polenta was absolutely delicious:  lightly crisped outside and soft inside.  Our veggies were tender crisp, buttery and tasty.  There will be a next time, especially with the coupons we have received in the mail.  Without the 20% off coupon, we would have thought it overpriced.

Three friends for lunch - wasn't very crowded, so quiet, although a group of 6 came in and it definitely would be at least moderate due to the small space in front.  Food was great - all 3 of us had something different and all enjoyed our meals.  The place looks dark from the outside, but interior is nice and staff is very nice, knowledgeable about the menu, and provided good service.  We will go back.
Food is always excellent here. The hubby and I are repeat customers.

Great food, good and careful presentation, excellent service, friendly staff, and we definitely will return....
Menlo Park resident for 4o years.....

Trellis is a great neighborhood restaurant with a consistently tasty menu.  The owner was very helpful in that he conferred with the chef to be able to order the risotto scallops without any dairy as was requested by our guest.  The lamb that I had was beautifully cooked.  Most entrees were accompanied by a nice serving of mixed vegetables which is something I always appreciate.  We had wanted to sit in the patio upstairs but it was too windy so we opted for a nice round booth on the first floor.

We wish we would have discovered Trellis a long time ago.  Interesting menu, good food, fair value and great service. Lots of wonderful entrees. Enjoyed calamari appetizer that was big enough for 3-4 people.   Cocktails were good.  It has three dining areas, a small front room that was relatively quiet, a back larger rooms and a terrace upstairs that will be delightful in warmer weather.  We REALLY appreciated that it was quiet and we could talk with one another; this is a rarity in most local restaurants.
Have been here many times and 3xpect to be back often. A go to spot
Food: very yummy. Service: excellent.  Ambience: pleasant.  Highly recommend.

Excellent food!  We each ordered different kinds of salad (spinach, mixed greens, and endive-beet salads) as well as soup.  Every one of us loved our salad.  Our pasta entrees were also delicious and generous -- canneloni, capellini, spaghetti bolognese,  seafood pesto.  Two of us had to get to-go boxes.  The desserts were the best!  The chocolate mousse was the correct size -- not too much or too little -- just enough to top off the delicious dinner with something sweet.  It had enough dark chocolate taste to show off that it was made with very good, dark chocolate.  The ice cream (or spumoni in this case) was creamy and full of flavour.

The wait staff were attentive but discreet.   We had plenty of time & space to talk and enjoy ourselves, but we also felt the presence of the staff because they checked on us periodically.

Wonderful restaurant -- we will definitely be back!

The food was very good, as usual.  My only complaint was the service.  It seems to always be slow.  I think that is because there are not enough servers.  But otherwise we really like this restaurant and will be returning.
Our party of 6 enjoyed everything we ordered; nice fresh delicious and attractive food in a French bistro-vibed setting

This place is just terrible for vegetarians. My wife and I went there for Valentine’s Day. They had a “special” menu on that day, and it had no vegetarian entree’s, like none. We had to leave the place and go next door to Black Pepper Asian Fusion Restaurant, which was far more hep and far more fun. 
Sorry, but a strict “no” for vegetarians.

Service was outstanding. We barely took our seats and our server was there asking us for our drink order. We were upstairs so it wasn’t noisy at all. Food was delicious and had a homey feel to it. It was good but wouldn’t say that it was gourmet. Everything was yummy, but a few things took it down a notch. For example, the Parmesan they offered was the powdered like grated cheese you pour out of a can. If it was shaved off a brick of fresh parm it would have been nicer. The Caesar salad was a little heavy on the dressing, but it was good. Our lobster bisque, lamb ragout and lobster ravioli were really good. The delicious food and outstanding service made our Valentine’s dinner special and we’ll recommend it to our friends (we already have!). We’ll be back!

Bread for the table was delicious, really soft and flakey. Calimari was also nice, larger pieces than most other restaurants. Had the Salmon dish with sun dried tomatoes. It was perfect, fish was cooked perfectly and the tomatoes or orzo were tasty. Also got the veal cannolini, which my date and I both decided had a lot of mozzarella cheese, giving the dish a pizza vibe.

We are regulars at Trellis, love to come here for Birthdays and such , but also just for a nice evening out. Always friendly service and the food is fantastic . Great selection of wines by the glass , too, as well as a full bar .The pasta dish called Susma’s Downfall is my personal favorite!

Everything weve tried on the menu here is excellent.  They have a very good variety of Italian dishes and it is all delicious and very nicely presented. The service is excellent and each area of the restaurant has a nice atmosphere.  We often come here on special occasions and Date Nights and will most definitely be back again..
Love the upstairs patio and the variety in the menu. The servers recognize and bring our cocktails,pronto! Reliable quality and freshness no matter the season. Favorite!
A variety of choices and everyone were pleased with their meals.  My boyfriend is italian and he enjoyed the home style Italian cooking.  The staff were very friendly and helpful, too!

My wife and I have always had great meals there, never an off night and the Caesar salad is best we've had anywhere in the world. Lately, I've started bringing larger groups there. With good weather, there is outdoor seating on a roof deck and a two private rooms that can be used, each with it's own adjacent bar.  We had 14 in the upstairs private room and enjoyed the privacy and the seating was allowed all to partake in the dinner conversation.  The seating in back of the restaurant near kitchen is less attractive but quiet and cozy. Fabulous food wins the day!

We were a party of 10 here for an early New Year's Eve meal. Table ready when we arrived. Outstanding service and excellent meal. All happy with their selection - 8 different entrees. Reasonably priced.
Outstanding Italian fare.  Very under rated as to culinary skills and much better than better known Italian restaurants in the area.

Excellent food. We were trying Trellis for the first time on Christmas Day which is always a little scary but they had a reservation time available and we trusted the other reviews we read. Glad we did. Terrific swordfish and veal dishes . We have high standards for Italian food and weren’t disappointed. We will definitely be back!

A few of my friends and I get together for a very long (and alcoholic) lunch at Trellis every December holiday season.  The food is wonderful; the staff is very attentive; the owner always makes a point of stopping by our table to greet us and ensure that we are happy.

Had an amazing dining experience at this restaurant from beginning to end. As my party was being taken back to our table, we noticed a plate of bruschetta that was being prepared for a large private party. We asked our server, Mila, if we could get an order of that and although it wasn't on the menu she graciously had an order made for us. The service throughout the meal was outstanding, all of the staff who stopped the table were very warm and welcoming, and the food was delicious. I would definitely recommend this to others and plan to return :)
Excellent food, attentive service, friendly manager.
Excellent Italian food. Our waiter was superb: knew what to recommend; knew when to bring it; didn't interfere. Perfect.
Always consistently good food. Love the lamb, linguini with clams and those amazing raviolis! Reasonably priced as well.
Because everything was 1 star. Food had no quality.
Food is consistently delicious and service great.  A little on the pricey side but not out of reasonable range for the area.
Business lunch
A favorite place.

We loved Trellis.  It's  a beautiful restaurant on the outside and inside.  They have several rooms for dining and an outdoor patio, but the front room was where we sat and it has a pretty view through the large glass windows.  The room is quite nice for dining with an Italian feel to match the cuisine.  We started with the spinach salad with grilled mushrooms, sliced cherry tomatoes and shaved, roasted nuts.  It was delicious and the portions excellent.  Then we have the shrimp appetizer and they give your a hearty portion of nicely grilled shrimp in an olive oil and lemon vinaigrette.  We loved it.  For entrees we had the fresh petrale sole fish served with orzo and mixed vegetables.   And we had the grilled scallops.  Both were excellent.  For a side dish we had penne pasta with tomato meat sauce.  They made a special half order for that.  Overall, this is a fine restaurant in Menlo Park with great food and ambiance.  Also the owner is very friendly and seems to thoroughly enjoy providing a great Italian meal!  It's definitely a restaurant we want to try again.
Neighborhood gem. Celebrated out wedding anniversary and our daughter's sweet sixteen.

Always enjoy Trellis.  Jose starts making our cocktails when he sees us walk in and Murat makes us feel right at home as our server. Kurt always stops by to say hello. Food is always well prepared. Try Susan's Downfall.

I had Susan's Downfall, very good. Very light rich cheesey sauce with the Ravioli.  I throughly enjoyed the dish. I had warm zabiaone  served over fresh fruit.  It had  just the right expected amount of Marsala wine flavor. Yum

We have been coming to Trellis for many years.
The food  and the service are always good.
The owner Kirk always come to greet us and make us feel welcome.
All the staff are very friendly and helpful.
I highly recommend the restaurant for weekend dinning.
The menu is traditional Italian fare done very well. Some rich comfort dishes as well as some lighter options. The service was wonderful.
Wonderful and tasty food, big portions! Great ambiance :-)
The patio was delightful and all my guests were very impressed with the food, ambiance and service. I would recommend trellis highly
A return visit. Good as usual, never disappoints. Met several regulars
Nice "Al Fresco" dining experience on a nice summer day.  Food and service was quite good.  I had the Fettucini with prawns and Spumoni ice cream.  I will try to come here again.
Food was okay, but the room where we were seated smelled very strongly of cigarettes.

We love this restaurant and eat here often. Wonderful menu choices, excellent food and very attentive service. I don't eat meat, and I have lots of options at Trellis that are delicious. They will adapt any dish. Yesterday I ordered pesto pasta with sundried tomatoes without the chicken.  It was GREAT. And for dessert, I had creme brulee which was the best I had ever had. 
I feel fortunate to have this wonderful restaurtant in our neighborhood.
Food and service excellent as usual.  We love to come here for a treat or on special occasions.
The service was great but there were not many diners in the restaurant but the waitress was sweet and very kind. However, the dishes were average at best and the dessert tasted stale.
Chicken dish was tough and little flavor..pasta dish was outstanding. Service was excellent.

We go to Trellis at least once a month.  All of my grandchildren love Trellis.  They love the pastas and bread.  The salads are excellent, and all of the entrees are great--veal, chicken and steak.  The wine list is very good and not over-priced.  We at outside in the patio.  It was quiet and extremely pleasant.  Our server [7], who always takes care of us, was great.  Trellis is great.

What a nice surprise.  The only reason I booked this was because of the picture.  I probably wouldn't have booked this place by driving by.  The outdoor seating on the roof is nice.  I'll definitely come back, but next time I'll come up the back alley directly up the stairs and on to the roof.

I'm not a big fan of bread before the meal, but this bread was GREAT.  It seemed hot, right out of the oven --- melt in your mouth.
The attention & concern of the owner; the efficiency of the wait staff; and the excellent food that comes out of the kitchen make this place a real gem!

That's was great service & denner.
And, the cost performance is prrety good.

As a long-time Trellis customer, I am saddened to leave a negative review.  The central issue concerns a member of our dinner party who has a severe garlic allergy, and called in advance to inquire if they would accommodate him with a tomato sauce without garlic.  The owner assured him that they would -- all he had to do was ask.  When ordering, the request was made.  However, when his chicken parmigiana arrived, it was a piece of breaded chicken with a slice of tomato on top.  No sauce.  When asked, the waiter said they couldn't make one.  Later, after speaking with the owner, a garlic-free tomato sauce arrived, but at that point, our entire party had finished eating.  After dinner, when speaking with the owner again, he was dismissive, saying that the kitchen was busy and it was hot, so they didn't want to make the sauce.  No apology.  No offer to comp the meal (there were 9 of us). Nothing.  What a disappointment.

This restaurant was such a pleasant surprise.  The food was excellent, the service was incredibly efficient and the staff are so friendly.  We loved eating on their outside terrace.  We are so anxious to return.

My wife and I had dinner here and did not have a great experience. Food was ok, but server asked us what was in a common cocktail that we ordered and people were seated uncomfortably close to us, despite many open tables
Without a doubt, the best & most caring restaurant in Menlo Park!
The Petrale Sole was delicious, perfectly done and not over-kill on butter.
Amazing food, and great service.  Murat- our server was such a doll, and the food was impeccable; we had the scallop risotto special and the veal and loved them both.  Patio seating is a bonus!

Very worn decor, loud tv on over the bar during dinner service. The food was below average in quality and taste, especially considering the area. If you're trying to impress a client or even a significant other, eat somewhere else. If you are just trying to grab dinner because not much else is open in the area on a Monday, this place will do ok, but keep your expectations on cleanliness, attentiveness, and good in check.

Trellis is one of our favorite restaurants.  The food is always excellent.  There are many very good choices of salads and entrees, and my grandchildren lover going there.  We inevitably get the same server, who is always attentive.  Because of the nice weather, we ate outside in the upstairs patio (as did everyone else).   It was quiet, warm and very pleasant.  I am sure that we will be back in Trellis next month.
They have a terrace that is great! Some dishes are unique and they are all prepared there! The taste is great and the service as well!
Mother's Day lunch was just right, not too fancy but not too casual. Everything tastes great!

The food was decadent, service was on point, and the outside terrace area was just right with a breeze.  The owner was out tending to the grapes leave trellis on the terrace and stopped by to chat.  What a lovely evening.
Unusual in this day & age to find a restaurant -- especially its owner, his service people, and his kitchen -- so dedicated to providing a memorable experience.

The food is consistently excellent and the staff is friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable. 

The menu offers a large selection, theres a full bar and excellent wine list. 

I have dinner at Trellis whenever I'm in the Mountain View area, and have been going there for more than 15 years.
excellent food, very good service, friendly and attentive staff.

It was my birthday, and my younger son, his wife and my two granddaughters wanted to go out to dinner with us.  Where should we go that the girls would like?  Trellis, I was told even though we had been there with the same group two weeks previously.  Trellis it was.  It feels like our neighborhood place to go.  The food is always excellent, the choices are varied, the service is excellent and the wine list is very good and not grossly over-priced.  It was another excellent evening.  The adults had two salads and two minestrone soups to start, two salmons, a chicken dish and veal for entrees.  All were great.  The girls, 7 and 4, love the pasta dishes that the kitchen prepares for them.

name: The Creek Eatery
description: WOOD FIRED.CRAFT BEERS.GOOD TIMES.Located smack dab in the heart of the Silver Creek Valley in San Jose, CA. The Creek has an urban feel — thanks to the rustic-industrial design with reclaimed wood and wrought-iron light fixtures that play into the muted charcoal-and-turquoise color scheme. Between a private dining room and a large communal table in the bar area, there’s plenty of seating for large parties, plus a heated patio that provides overflow for busy nights. We host a kitchen with a gleaming, copper-sided, wood-burning pizza oven that’s front and center as diners enter.In addition to the welcoming decor we've got 10 bar taps that rotate seasonal and local breweries. Occasionally we offer up special menu items along with tap takeovers with the likes of Barebottle Brewery, Drake's, Coronado Brewing Company, and more. Be sure to follow us on Instagram and Facebook for our latest specials and events!
address: 5623 Silver Creek Valley Rd,  San Jose, CA 95138-2473
hours:
Mon–Thu 11:30 am–9:00 pm
Fri 11:30 am–9:30 pm
Sat 10:00 am–9:00 pm
Sun 10:00 am–8:00 pm

reviews.text: We love the Creek Eatery! Living in Silver Creek we don’t have a lot of good dining choices nearby. The Creek offers great cocktails & a decent wine selection. The menu is full of plenty of food options & the daily specials are always good! We’ve always experienced excellent service from the wait staff! What’s not to like? And, it’s a 5 minute drive from home!👏🏼
Food was great. Very attentive service by all the staff.This place is consistant. Have been here several times.always a good experience here.

The service was great and the foods came out fast. Our food was delicious.  I had the salmon and my husband had the prime rib eye.  The calamari and tiramisu also delicious.  Highly recommend this restaurant.   Only problem was the table was too small.
Food was terrific and service was good. Thanks very much.

There were 2 very large parties which I’m sure was distracting, but there’s just no excuse for fries being undercooked and tepid. Burgers were overcooked. Service was barely present. No one checked in on food, so we did eat it, mostly because who knew how long it would take to get someone. We wanted dessert originally and second drinks but gave up and just got the bill. My husband had to chase down the waiter to get a bill because other than taking the order and delivering food we never saw him.
Delicious food and good service! I will definitely come back.
Service, food, outdoor patio all great!  Saturday/Sundays are the best because until 3 PM you can choose from both the breakfast menu and the lunch/dinner menu.
We sat outside in comfortable chairs and enjoyed a quiet conversation and lunch.

Great food and service! We all loved it!
Decor super cute, we will return!
We had a great time, we were not rushed to leave the private dining room. We were there for over 3 hours. Food was great, big portions and worth the price .

Went a few weeks ago and the food and service was great, so we came again.  Same great food and service….first time we were a party of 6 second time a party of 10 Severs were awesome both times!    Only suggestion….air conditioning….it gets really warm in the restaurant

I was completely disgusted by the staffs hygiene .  One employee sneezed and did not wash his hands and another employee was blowing his nose and not washing his hands and handling pizza dough.  He was also handling his cell phone and wiping his shirt off around the food.  Just grossed me out and I will never go back there to eat.
Was in town & met up for brunch/lunch with friends & family. Waitress was very attentive, everything turned out great! Would definitely go back.
We had a “confirmed” reservation on Open Table, but they were closed for Super Bowl Sunday.  Very disappointing.
It’s such a cute little restaurant. Their shrimp fettuccine is amazing. Definitely perfect for date night or girls night out.

Really wanted to like this place, but it was just so-so. We had calamari, salads and pizzas, and consensus was that the pizza crust was good. Everything else was a bit disappointing and service was very inattentive.
Great service! Excellent food and drinks. I’m comin back ASAP :)

First time eating here....lunch at 12 noon on a weekday (Veterans Day). Not busy or crowded so we ate on the patio as it was a nice day outside. Our server took a while to come to our table so one of us retrieved her from inside. Three drinks arrived and the 4th one never showed until again one of us had to follow up. Food eventually was served and pretty tasty. The Creek burger was delicious! The fried green beans were also a hit! The BLT salad and rigatoni pasta were also very good. The hot cookie a la mode and flan for dessert were good too. Being one of us was a veteran, his cocktail drink was complimentary and $4 discount applied to martini. First impression left us wondering if we made a good choice since service was a bit sketchy, but afterward, we decided maybe a revisit is in order since the food was pretty good.
It was great !! We will definitely be back

It's so disappointing, that so many area restaurants are all the same here in the South Bay. Similar uninspired menus, same old, same old. When I saw the menu on open table, it described an offered side as a flavored bacon (don't remember the details), but it is what prompted me to pick this place. Needless to say, the bacon is no longer on the menu.  The server did not try to sell the menu or explain much of anything when I asked about it.  In fact, I had to ask him to tell the cook how I wanted my steak, He started to walk away, with out asking this important steak question. Service was just OK.  I  ordered skirt steak on the rare side. The server assured me that it would be plenty red. It came all sliced into little fingers and was medium well and maybe 6 ounces of meat? Hard to tell, but for $32 was not my  idea of steak. Instead ordered hot wings, which were tasty, although a bit dry and overpriced for an order of just six peices at $14.  My dining companion had a meat pizza and really enjoyed it. Only one wine by glass selection? Asked if they had a house wine, I guess not? Server did not try to explain this, so I didn't drink anything. Their loss. He was ok, but didn't seem to really enjoy interacting or being there. He was pretty absent during our visit. It was not a busy night either. I guess I was picking up a vibe of indifference. I was surprised when he offered a free dessert to compensate for the steak mess up.  Didn't really want dessert, but he kept insisting. It was just OK, but not very exciting. A strawberry cheesecake with a gel layer on top.  I can't imagine wanting to come back here.
